internal class DelegateClipper
{
	private List<Point> Points { get; set; }

	public Func<int, double> X { get; private set; }

	public Func<int, double> Y { get; private set; }

	public int Count => Points.Count;

	public DelegateClipper(Func<int, double> x, Func<int, double> y, int count, Clipper clipper)
	{
		List<Point> list = new List<Point>();
		foreach (int item in EnumerableRange(0, count))
		{
			list.Add(new Point(x(item), y(item)));
		}
		Points = new List<Point>();
		X = (int ii) => (Points.Count <= ii) ? double.NaN : Points[ii].X;
		Y = (int ii) => (Points.Count <= ii) ? double.NaN : Points[ii].Y;
		clipper.Target = Points;
		foreach (Point item2 in list)
		{
			clipper.Add(item2);
		}
		clipper.Target = null;
	}

	private static IEnumerable<int> EnumerableRange(int start, int count)
	{
		for (int ii = start; ii < start + count; ii++)
		{
			yield return ii;
		}
	}
}

		[TreatAsPX]
		public virtual Rect ContentViewport
		{
			get
			{
				if (_contentViewportDirty)
				{
					_contentViewportDirty = false;
					Rect currentContentViewport = GetCurrentContentViewport(ViewportRect, EffectiveViewport, ActualWindowRect);
					_contentViewport = currentContentViewport;
				}
				return _contentViewport;
			}
		}

		internal InteractionState State
		{
			get
			{
				return _state;
			}
			set
			{
				if (State != value)
				{
					InteractionState state = _state;
					_state = value;
					if (IsInteractivityLoaded)
					{
						SeriesViewerInteractionManager.OnStateChanged(this);
					}
					if (state == InteractionState.DragZoom && _state != InteractionState.DragZoom)
					{
						OnCheckDragZoomEnding();
					}
				}
			}
		}

		internal Rect WindowRectAtStartOfWindowOperation { get; set; }

		protected internal bool IsHighlightingProximity
		{
			get
			{
				if (ActualHighlightingBehavior != SeriesHighlightingBehavior.NearestItems && ActualHighlightingBehavior != SeriesHighlightingBehavior.NearestItemsRetainMainShapes)
				{
					return ActualHighlightingBehavior == SeriesHighlightingBehavior.NearestItemsAndSeries;
				}
				return true;
			}
		}

		protected bool NeedsNearestSeries
		{
			get
			{
				if (ActualHighlightingBehavior != SeriesHighlightingBehavior.NearestItems && ActualHighlightingBehavior != SeriesHighlightingBehavior.NearestItemsRetainMainShapes)
				{
					return ActualHighlightingBehavior == SeriesHighlightingBehavior.NearestItemsAndSeries;
				}
				return true;
			}
		}

		public Rect PreviewRect
		{
			get
			{
				return _previewRect;
			}
			set
			{
				Rect previewRect = _previewRect;
				_previewRect = value;
				if (_previewRect.IsEmpty)
				{
					View.HidePreviewPath();
					return;
				}
				View.UpdatePreviewPath(ViewportRect, ToGridArea(PreviewRect));
				View.ShowPreviewPath();
				RaisePropertyChanged("PreviewRect", previewRect, _previewRect);
			}
		}

		public Rect ActualWindowRect
		{
			get
			{
				return _actualWindowRect;
			}
			protected set
			{
				if (_actualWindowRect != value)
				{
					object oldValue = _actualWindowRect;
					_actualWindowRect = value;
					RaisePropertyChanged("ActualWindowRect", oldValue, value);
				}
			}
		}

		protected SeriesViewer()
		{
			AnnotationFactoryManager.Register();
			InteractivityFactoryManager.Register();
			VisualDataFactoryManager.Register();
			_actualWindowRect = Rect.Empty;
			_crosshairPoint = new Point(double.NaN, double.NaN);
			LastZoomTime = DateTime.Now;
			IsDefaultCrosshairDisabled = false;
			IsDefaultTooltipDisabled = false;
			ShouldFreezeBrushesCached = true;
			View = CreateView();
			OnViewCreated(View);
			View.OnInit();
			UpdateCrosshairVisibility();
			InitializeOPD();
			ActualSyncLink = new SyncLink();
			UpdateSyncLink(null, ActualSyncLink);
			ChartContentManager = new ChartContentManager(this);
			PropertyUpdated += delegate(object o, PropertyUpdatedEventArgs e)
			{
				PropertyUpdatedOverride(o, e.PropertyName, e.OldValue, e.NewValue);
			};
			Series.CollectionChanged += Series_CollectionChanged;
			Series.CollectionResetting += Series_CollectionResetting;
			HighlightingAnimator = new DoubleAnimator(0.0, 1.0, (int)HighlightingTransitionDuration.TotalMilliseconds);
			HighlightingAnimator.PropertyChanged += HighlightingAnimator_PropertyChanged;
			CentralArea = new ChartAreaPanel(this);
			AddLogicalChild(CentralArea);
			View.CreateLayout();
			InvalidateActualWindowRect();
			InitializeScalingRatio();
		}

		internal void InitializeOPD()
		{
			if (_previousOPD != null && OverviewPlusDetailPane == null)
			{
				OverviewPlusDetailPane.ThumbnailSizeChanged -= OPD_ThumbnailSizeChanged;
			}
			if (OverviewPlusDetailPane != null)
			{
				OverviewPlusDetailPane.ThumbnailSizeChanged += OPD_ThumbnailSizeChanged;
			}
			if (OverviewPlusDetailPane != null)
			{
				OverviewPlusDetailPane.InitializeScalingRatio(ActualPixelScalingRatio);
			}
			if (_previousOPD == null && OverviewPlusDetailPane != null)
			{
				NotifyThumbnailDataChanged();
			}
			_previousOPD = OverviewPlusDetailPane;
		}

			}

		private void Series_CollectionChanged(object sender, NotifyCollectionChangedEventArgs e)
		{
			CachedEffectiveIsSquare = EffectiveIsSquare();
			if (e.OldItems != null)
			{
				foreach (Series oldItem in e.OldItems)
				{
					oldItem.SyncLink = null;
					oldItem.SeriesViewer = null;
					RemoveDataSource(oldItem);
					View.RemoveSeries(oldItem);
				}
			}
			if (e.NewItems != null)
			{
				foreach (Series newItem in e.NewItems)
				{
					if (!View.SeriesAttached(newItem))
					{
						View.AttachSeries(newItem);
						newItem.SeriesViewer = this;
						newItem.SyncLink = ActualSyncLink;
						newItem.UpdateSeriesIndexedPropertiesInternal();
					}
				}
			}
			NotifyThumbnailAppearanceChanged();
			OnComputedPlotAreaMarginInvalidated();
			OnHoverBehaviorOverridesChanged();
			UpdateActualPlotAreaBorderBrush();
		}

			OnComputedPlotAreaMarginInvalidated();
		}

		}

		}

		private void Series_CollectionResetting(object sender, EventArgs e)
		{
			CachedEffectiveIsSquare = EffectiveIsSquare();
			foreach (Series item in Series)
			{
				item.SyncLink = null;
				item.SeriesViewer = null;
				RemoveDataSource(item);
				View.RemoveSeries(item);
			}
		}

		internal void MatchRatio(ref double width, ref double height, bool widthChanging, bool heightChanging)
		{
			Rect viewportRect = ViewportRect;
			double width2 = viewportRect.Width;
			double height2 = viewportRect.Height;
			double num = width2 / height2;
			double num2 = width / height;
			if (double.IsNaN(num))
			{
				return;
			}
			if (double.IsNaN(num2) || widthChanging || heightChanging || Math.Abs(num - num2) > 0.0001)
			{
				if (widthChanging && heightChanging)
				{
					if (width > height)
					{
						height = width / num;
					}
					else
					{
						width = height * num;
					}
				}
				else if (widthChanging)
				{
					height = width / num;
				}
				else
				{
					width = height * num;
				}
			}
			if (height > 1.0)
			{
				double num3 = 1.0 / height;
				height = 1.0;
				width *= num3;
			}
			if (width > 1.0)
			{
				double num4 = 1.0 / width;
				width = 1.0;
				height *= num4;
			}
		}

		internal virtual bool EffectiveIsSquare()
		{
			return false;
		}

		private void EnsureHighlightingAnimator()
		{
			DoubleAnimator highlightingAnimator = HighlightingAnimator;
			if (!highlightingAnimator.AnimationActive() && highlightingAnimator.IntervalMilliseconds > 0)
			{
				highlightingAnimator.Start();
			}
			if (highlightingAnimator.IntervalMilliseconds == 0)
			{
				UpdateHighlights(1.0);
			}
		}

		private void HighlightingAnimator_PropertyChanged(object sender, PropertyChangedEventArgs e)
		{
			UpdateHighlights(HighlightingAnimator.TransitionProgress);
		}

		protected internal void UpdateHighlights(double transitionProgress)
		{
			bool flag = HighlightingManager.Tick(transitionProgress);
			if (transitionProgress == 1.0 && flag && HighlightingAnimator.IntervalMilliseconds > 0)
			{
				HighlightingAnimator.Start();
			}
			List<Series> dirtySeries = HighlightingManager.DirtySeries;
			if (HighlightingManager.AllDirty)
			{
				SeriesCollection series = Series;
				for (int i = 0; i < series.Count; i++)
				{
					series[i].OnVisualPropertiesChangedImmediate();
				}
			}
			else
			{
				for (int j = 0; j < dirtySeries.Count; j++)
				{
					dirtySeries[j].OnVisualPropertiesChangedImmediate();
				}
			}
			if (!flag)
			{
				HighlightingAnimator.Stop();
			}
		}

		public void HideToolTip()
		{
			View.HideTooltip();
			HideDragCrosshairAndTooltip();
			for (int i = 0; i < Series.Count; i++)
			{
				_ = Series[i].IsAnnotationLayer;
			}
		}

		private Brush GetBrush(BrushCollection brushes, int index)
		{
			if (brushes == null || brushes.Count == 0)
			{
				return null;
			}
			return brushes[index % brushes.Count];
		}

		{
			_manipulationOccurred = false;

			{

		private PlotAreaMouseButtonEventArgs GetPlotAreaButtonMouseArgs(Point pt, bool isFinger, bool isChartCoords)
		{
			Point chartPosition = new Point(pt.X, pt.Y);
			Point plotAreaPosition = new Point(pt.X, pt.Y);
			UIElement child = PlotAreaBorder.Child;
			if (child != null)
			{
				chartPosition = child.TransformToVisual(this).Transform(pt);
			}
			return new PlotAreaMouseButtonEventArgs(this, chartPosition, plotAreaPosition)
			{
				ManipulationOccurred = _manipulationOccurred
			};
		}

		private PlotAreaMouseEventArgs GetPlotAreaMouseArgs(Point pt, bool isFinger, bool isChartCoords)
		{
			Point chartPosition = new Point(pt.X, pt.Y);
			Point plotAreaPosition = new Point(pt.X, pt.Y);
			UIElement child = PlotAreaBorder.Child;
			if (child != null)
			{

			}
			return new PlotAreaMouseEventArgs(this, chartPosition, plotAreaPosition);
		}

		internal void OnPlotAreaMouseUp(Point pt, bool isFinger, bool isSecondaryFinger)
		{
			bool isChartCoords = false;
			if (this.PlotAreaMouseLeftButtonUp != null)
			{
				PlotAreaMouseButtonEventArgs plotAreaButtonMouseArgs = GetPlotAreaButtonMouseArgs(pt, isFinger, isChartCoords);
				this.PlotAreaMouseLeftButtonUp(this, plotAreaButtonMouseArgs);
			}
			if (!_manipulationOccurred && !isSecondaryFinger && this.PlotAreaClicked != null)
			{
				PlotAreaMouseButtonEventArgs plotAreaButtonMouseArgs2 = GetPlotAreaButtonMouseArgs(pt, isFinger, isChartCoords);
				this.PlotAreaClicked(this, plotAreaButtonMouseArgs2);
			}
			_manipulationOccurred = false;
		}

		private SeriesHighlightingBehavior ResolveSeriesHighlightingBehavior()
		{
			if (HighlightingBehavior == SeriesHighlightingBehavior.Auto)
			{
				return SeriesHighlightingBehavior.DirectlyOver;
			}
			if ((HighlightingMode == SeriesHighlightingMode.Brighten || HighlightingMode == SeriesHighlightingMode.FadeOthers) && HighlightingBehavior == SeriesHighlightingBehavior.NearestItems)
			{
				return SeriesHighlightingBehavior.NearestItemsAndSeries;
			}
			return HighlightingBehavior;
		}

		protected void RaisePropertyChanged(string name, object oldValue, object newValue)
		{
			if (this.PropertyChanged != null)
			{
				this.PropertyChanged(this, new PropertyChangedEventArgs(name));
			}
			if (this.PropertyUpdated != null)
			{
				this.PropertyUpdated(this, new PropertyUpdatedEventArgs(name, oldValue, newValue));
			}
		}

		internal void OnLegendSortChanged()
		{
			OnLegendSortChanged(Series);
		}

		internal void OnLegendSortChanged(IEnumerable seriesCollection)
		{
			foreach (Series item in seriesCollection)
			{
				LegendBase actualLegend = item.ActualLegend;
				if (actualLegend == null)
				{
					continue;
				}
				Control legendItem = item.LegendItem;
				if (legendItem != null)
				{
					if (actualLegend.ContainsChild(legendItem))
					{
						actualLegend.RemoveChild(legendItem);
					}
					if (!actualLegend.ContainsChild(legendItem))
					{
						actualLegend.AddChildInOrder(legendItem, item);
					}
				}
			}
		}

		internal void SimulatePlotHover([SwiftMutableParameter] Point point)
		{
			Point world = ToWorld(point);
			if (ShouldSimulateHoverMoveCrosshairPoint)
			{
				CrosshairNotify(world);
				return;
			}
			SeriesHighlightingBehavior actualHighlightingBehavior = ActualHighlightingBehavior;
			if (actualHighlightingBehavior != SeriesHighlightingBehavior.NearestItems && actualHighlightingBehavior != SeriesHighlightingBehavior.NearestItemsRetainMainShapes && actualHighlightingBehavior != SeriesHighlightingBehavior.NearestItemsAndSeries)
			{
				return;
			}
			UpdateNearestSeries(world);
			for (int i = 0; i < Series.Count; i++)
			{
				Series series = Series[i];
				series.UpdateProximityHighlights(world);
				if (series.IsStacked)
				{
					series.ForSubVisualSeries(delegate(Series sub)
					{
						sub.UpdateProximityHighlights(world);
						return true;
					});
				}
			}
		}

		}

		internal Rect GetScaledEffectiveViewport(Rect otherViewport, Rect mainViewport, Rect mainEffectiveViewport)
		{
			if (mainEffectiveViewport.IsEmpty)
			{
				return mainEffectiveViewport;
			}
			Rect rect = mainEffectiveViewport;
			Rect rect2 = mainViewport;
			double num = (rect.Left - rect2.Left) / rect2.Width;
			double num2 = (rect.Top - rect2.Top) / rect2.Height;
			double num3 = (rect.Right - rect2.Left) / rect2.Width;
			double num4 = (rect.Bottom - rect2.Top) / rect2.Height;
			num = otherViewport.Left + num * otherViewport.Width;
			num2 = otherViewport.Top + num2 * otherViewport.Height;
			num3 = otherViewport.Left + num3 * otherViewport.Width;
			num4 = otherViewport.Top + num4 * otherViewport.Height;
			return new Rect(num, num2, num3 - num, num4 - num2);
		}

		protected internal virtual Rect GetCurrentContentViewport(Rect viewportRect, Rect effectiveViewportRect, Rect windowRect)
		{
			Rect rect = effectiveViewportRect;
			Rect rect2 = windowRect;
			Rect rect3 = viewportRect;
			if (rect3.IsEmpty)
			{
				return Rect.Empty;
			}
			if (rect.IsEmpty)
			{
				return viewportRect;
			}
			double num = (rect.Left - rect3.Left) / rect3.Width;
			double num2 = (rect.Right - rect3.Left) / rect3.Width;
			double num3 = (rect.Top - rect3.Top) / rect3.Height;
			double num4 = (rect.Bottom - rect3.Top) / rect3.Height;
			num = rect3.Left + (num - rect2.Left) / rect2.Width * rect3.Width;
			num2 = rect3.Left + (num2 - rect2.Left) / rect2.Width * rect3.Width;
			num3 = rect3.Top + (num3 - rect2.Top) / rect2.Height * rect3.Height;
			num4 = rect3.Top + (num4 - rect2.Top) / rect2.Height * rect3.Height;
			Rect result = new Rect(num, num3, num2 - num, num4 - num3);
			result.Intersect(rect3);
			return result;
		}

			_contentViewportDirty = true;
			return Rect.Empty;
		}

		internal void CheckPlotEvents(Point pt, bool duringManipulation)
		{
			bool isChartCoords = false;
			if (ViewportRect.Contains(pt))
			{
				if (!_isMouseOverPlot)
				{
					_isMouseOverPlot = true;
					if (this.PlotAreaMouseEnter != null)
					{
						PlotAreaMouseEventArgs plotAreaMouseArgs = GetPlotAreaMouseArgs(pt, isFinger: false, isChartCoords);
						plotAreaMouseArgs.IsDuringManipulation = duringManipulation;
						this.PlotAreaMouseEnter(this, plotAreaMouseArgs);
					}
				}
				else
				{
					_isMouseOverPlot = true;
					if (this.PlotAreaMouseOver != null)
					{
						PlotAreaMouseEventArgs plotAreaMouseArgs2 = GetPlotAreaMouseArgs(pt, isFinger: false, isChartCoords);
						plotAreaMouseArgs2.IsDuringManipulation = duringManipulation;
						this.PlotAreaMouseOver(this, plotAreaMouseArgs2);
					}
				}
			}
			else if (_isMouseOverPlot)
			{
				_isMouseOverPlot = false;
				if (this.PlotAreaMouseLeave != null)
				{
					PlotAreaMouseEventArgs plotAreaMouseArgs3 = GetPlotAreaMouseArgs(pt, isFinger: false, isChartCoords);
					plotAreaMouseArgs3.IsDuringManipulation = duringManipulation;
					this.PlotAreaMouseLeave(this, plotAreaMouseArgs3);
				}
			}
		}

		internal void OnZoomPanInteractionStarting()
		{
			_zoomPanEndIsDeferred = false;
			if (!_zoomPanning)
			{
				_zoomPanning = true;
				_manipulationOccurred = true;
				if (this.ViewerManipulationStarting != null)
				{
					SeriesViewerManipulationEventArgs e = new SeriesViewerManipulationEventArgs();
					e.IsZoomPan = true;
					this.ViewerManipulationStarting(this, e);
				}
			}
			SeriesViewerInteractionManager.OnZoomPanInteractionStarting(this);
		}

		internal void OnZoomPanInteractionEnding()
		{
			if (_zoomPanning)
			{
				_zoomPanning = false;
				if (this.ViewerManipulationEnding != null)
				{
					SeriesViewerManipulationEventArgs e = new SeriesViewerManipulationEventArgs();
					e.IsZoomPan = true;
					this.ViewerManipulationEnding(this, e);
				}
			}
			SeriesViewerInteractionManager.OnZoomPanInteractionEnding(this);
		}

		internal virtual void UpdateSyncLink(SyncLink oldLink, SyncLink newLink)
		{
			if (oldLink != null)
			{
				oldLink.ChartsInternal.Remove(this);
				oldLink.PropertyUpdated -= this.PropertyUpdated;
			}
			if (newLink != null)
			{
				newLink.ChartsInternal.Add(this);
				newLink.PropertyUpdated += this.PropertyUpdated;
			}
			foreach (Series item in Series)
			{
				item.SyncLink = ActualSyncLink;
				item.SeriesViewer = this;
			}
		}

		protected internal virtual void WindowNotify(Rect windowRect, bool userInteraction)
		{
			WindowNotify(windowRect, userInteraction, !userInteraction);
		}

		internal void WindowNotify(Rect windowRect, bool userInteraction, bool force)
		{
			if (!userInteraction)
			{
				ActualSyncLink.WindowNotify(this, windowRect, force);
			}
			else if (IsZoomingHorizontallyEnabled() || IsZoomingVerticallyEnabled())
			{
				bool num = !windowRect.IsEmpty && !double.IsNaN(windowRect.X) && !double.IsNaN(windowRect.Y) && !double.IsNaN(windowRect.Width) && !double.IsNaN(windowRect.Height);
				Rect windowRect2 = windowRect;
				if (num && !IsZoomingHorizontallyEnabled())
				{
					windowRect2 = new Rect(0.0, windowRect.Y, 1.0, windowRect.Height);
				}
				if (num && !IsZoomingVerticallyEnabled())
				{
					windowRect2 = new Rect(windowRect.X, 0.0, windowRect.Width, 1.0);
				}
				ActualSyncLink.WindowNotify(this, windowRect2);
			}
		}

		protected internal virtual void PreviewNotify(Rect windowRect, bool userInteraction)
		{
			if (!userInteraction)
			{
				ActualSyncLink.PreviewNotify(this, windowRect);
			}
			else if (IsZoomingHorizontallyEnabled() || IsZoomingVerticallyEnabled())
			{
				bool num = !windowRect.IsEmpty && !double.IsNaN(windowRect.X) && !double.IsNaN(windowRect.Y) && !double.IsNaN(windowRect.Width) && !double.IsNaN(windowRect.Height);
				Rect previewRect = windowRect;
				if (num && !IsZoomingHorizontallyEnabled())
				{
					previewRect = new Rect(0.0, windowRect.Y, 1.0, windowRect.Height);
				}
				if (num && !IsZoomingVerticallyEnabled())
				{
					previewRect = new Rect(windowRect.X, 0.0, windowRect.Width, 1.0);
				}
				ActualSyncLink.PreviewNotify(this, previewRect);
			}
		}

			}
		}

		[CatchesAll]
		internal IEnumerable<SeriesViewer> SynchronizedCharts()
		{
			if (ActualSyncLink == null)
			{
				yield break;

			{

			}
		}

		internal Point ToWorld([SwiftMutableParameter] Point pt)
		{
			pt = new Point(pt.X + ViewportRect.Left, pt.Y + ViewportRect.Top);
			Rect contentViewport = ContentViewport;
			double x = ActualWindowRect.Left + ActualWindowRect.Width * (pt.X - contentViewport.Left) / contentViewport.Width;
			double y = ActualWindowRect.Top + ActualWindowRect.Height * (pt.Y - contentViewport.Top) / contentViewport.Height;
			return new Point(x, y);
		}

		internal Rect ToWorld([SwiftMutableParameter] Rect rect)
		{
			rect = new Rect(rect.Left + ViewportRect.Left, rect.Top + ViewportRect.Top, rect.Width, rect.Height);
			Rect contentViewport = ContentViewport;
			double num = ActualWindowRect.Left + ActualWindowRect.Width * (rect.Left - contentViewport.Left) / contentViewport.Width;
			double num2 = ActualWindowRect.Top + ActualWindowRect.Height * (rect.Top - contentViewport.Top) / contentViewport.Height;
			double num3 = ActualWindowRect.Left + ActualWindowRect.Width * (rect.Right - contentViewport.Left) / contentViewport.Width;
			double num4 = ActualWindowRect.Top + ActualWindowRect.Height * (rect.Bottom - contentViewport.Top) / contentViewport.Height;
			return new Rect(num, num2, num3 - num, num4 - num2);
		}

			{
				_zoomPanning = false;
				if (this.ViewerManipulationEnding != null)
				{
					SeriesViewerManipulationEventArgs e = new SeriesViewerManipulationEventArgs();
					e.IsZoomPan = true;
					this.ViewerManipulationEnding(this, e);
				}
				_manipulationOccurred = false;
			}
		}

		internal virtual bool CanDisplayAnnotations()
		{
			if (State == InteractionState.None && !_pinching)
			{
				return !_suppressCrosshairChange;
			}
			return false;
		}

		internal virtual bool AllCanDisplayAnnotations()
		{
			if (ActualSyncLink != null && ActualSyncLink.Charts.Count > 0)
			{
				if (!CanDisplayAnnotations())
				{
					return false;
				}
				for (int i = 0; i < ActualSyncLink.Charts.Count; i++)
				{
					if (!ActualSyncLink.Charts[i].CanDisplayAnnotations())
					{
						return false;
					}
				}
				return true;
			}
			return CanDisplayAnnotations();
		}

		public void CancelManipulation()
		{
			if (State == InteractionState.DragPan)
			{
				View.CancelMouseInteractions();
				State = InteractionState.None;
				OnZoomPanInteractionEnding();
				PreviewNotify(Rect.Empty, userInteraction: true);
				if (WindowResponse == WindowResponse.Immediate)
				{
					WindowNotify(WindowRectAtStartOfWindowOperation, userInteraction: true);
				}
			}
			if (State == InteractionState.DragZoom)
			{
				View.CancelMouseInteractions();
				State = InteractionState.None;
				OnZoomPanInteractionEnding();
				View.HideDragPath();
				PreviewNotify(Rect.Empty, userInteraction: true);
			}
		}

		}

		protected virtual void PropertyUpdatedOverride(object sender, string propertyName, object oldValue, object newValue)
		{
			switch (propertyName)
			{
			case "Title":
				View.OnTitlesChanged();
				break;
			case "Subtitle":
				View.OnTitlesChanged();
				break;
			case "ZoomCoercionMode":
				CachedZoomCoercionMode = ResolveZoomCoercionMode();
				break;
			case "ActualSyncLink":
				UpdateSyncLink(oldValue as SyncLink, newValue as SyncLink);
				break;
			case "CrosshairVisibility":
				if (!IgnoreCrosshairVisibilityChange)
				{
					UserSetCrosshairVisibility = true;
				}
				if (CrosshairVisibility == Visibility.Visible)
				{
					CrosshairsVisible = true;
				}
				else
				{
					CrosshairsVisible = false;
				}
				if (IsInteractivityLoaded)
				{
					SeriesViewerInteractionManager.RenderCrosshairs(this);
				}
				break;
			case "CrosshairPoint":
				if (IsInteractivityLoaded)
				{
					if (NeedsNearestSeries)
					{
						UpdateNearestSeries(CrosshairPoint);
					}
					SeriesViewerInteractionManager.RenderCrosshairs(this);
				}
				NotifyCrosshairUpdate();
				break;
			case "WindowRect":
				if (ActualSyncLink != null)
				{
					_windowEventDepth++;
					WindowNotify((Rect)newValue, userInteraction: false);
					_windowEventDepth--;
				}
				if (!WindowRect.Equals((Rect)oldValue) && _windowEventDepth == 0)
				{
					OnWindowRectChanged((Rect)oldValue, WindowRect);
				}
				InvalidateActualWindowRect();
				break;
			case "WindowPositionHorizontal":
				ActualWindowPositionHorizontal = WindowPositionHorizontal;
				break;
			case "WindowPositionVertical":
				ActualWindowPositionVertical = WindowPositionVertical;
				break;
			case "ActualWindowPositionVertical":
			case "ActualWindowPositionHorizontal":
				if (!SuspendWindowRect)
				{
					UpdateWindowRect(GetActualWindowScaleHorizontal(), GetActualWindowScaleVertical());
				}
				break;
			case "IsSurfaceInteractionDisabled":
				View.OnIsInteractionDisabledChanged();
				break;
			case "HighlightingTransitionDuration":
				HighlightingAnimator.IntervalMilliseconds = (int)HighlightingTransitionDuration.TotalMilliseconds;
				break;
			case "OverviewPlusDetailPaneVisibility":
				UpdateOverviewPlusDetailPaneVisibility();
				break;
			case "ActualWindowRect":
				_contentViewportDirty = true;
				if (!newValue.Equals(oldValue))
				{
					ActualWindowRectUpdated();
				}
				if (((Rect)newValue).Width == 1.0 && ((Rect)newValue).Height == 1.0 && ((Rect)oldValue).IsEmpty)
				{
					ZoomLongAgo = true;
				}
				RaiseActualWindowRectChanged((Rect)oldValue, (Rect)newValue);
				break;
			case "PlotAreaBackground":
				View.OnPlotAreaBackgroundChanged((Brush)newValue);
				break;
			case "PlotAreaBorderBrush":
				UpdateActualPlotAreaBorderBrush();
				break;
			case "OverviewPlusDetailPaneHorizontalAlignment":
			case "OverviewPlusDetailPaneVerticalAlignment":
				InvalidatePanels();
				break;
			case "PlotAreaMinHeight":
			case "PlotAreaMinWidth":
				CentralArea.InvalidateMeasure();
				break;
			case "ShouldFreezeBrushes":
				ShouldFreezeBrushesCached = ShouldFreezeBrushes;
				break;
			case "ShouldRefreshOnCompositionRender":
				ChartContentManager.ShouldRefreshOnCompositionRender = ShouldRefreshOnCompositionRender;
				break;
			case "UseTiledZooming":
				ActualUseTiledZooming = UseTiledZooming;
				break;
			case "ZoomTileCacheSize":
				ActualZoomTileCacheSize = ZoomTileCacheSize;
				ClearTileZoomCache();
				break;
			case "PreferHigherResolutionTiles":
				SeriesViewerInteractionManager.OnPreferHigherResolutionTilesChanged(this);
				break;
			case "HighlightingMode":
			case "HighlightingBehavior":
				_actualHighlightingBehavior = ResolveSeriesHighlightingBehavior();
				if (IsInteractivityLoaded)
				{
					HighlightingManager.HighlightingBehavior = ActualHighlightingBehavior;
				}
				break;
			case "LegendItemBadgeShape":
			{
				foreach (Series item in Series)
				{
					item.LegendItemBadgeShape = LegendItemBadgeShape;
				}
				break;
			}
			case "LegendItemBadgeMode":
			{
				foreach (Series item2 in Series)
				{
					item2.LegendItemBadgeMode = LegendItemBadgeMode;
				}
				break;
			}
			case "Brushes":
			case "Outlines":
			case "MarkerBrushes":
			case "MarkerOutlines":
			case "MarkerAutomaticBehavior":
			{
				foreach (Series item3 in Series)
				{
					item3.NotifyIndexedPropertiesChanged();
				}
				break;
			}
			}
		}

		protected internal void UpdateNearestSeries(Point world)
		{
			double minDist = double.MaxValue;
			Series closest = null;
			for (int i = 0; i < Series.Count; i++)
			{
				Series series = Series[i];
				if (series.IsAnnotationLayer || (series.HasIndividualElements && series.HasSpecificHighlightingMode))
				{
					continue;
				}
				if (series.IsStacked)
				{
					series.ForSubVisualSeries(delegate(Series s)
					{
						Tuple<double, Series> tuple2 = CheckClosest(s, minDist, closest, world);
						if (tuple2 == null)
						{
							return true;
						}
						minDist = tuple2.Item1;
						closest = tuple2.Item2;
						return true;
					});
				}
				Tuple<double, Series> tuple = CheckClosest(series, minDist, closest, world);
				if (tuple != null)
				{
					minDist = tuple.Item1;
					closest = tuple.Item2;
				}
			}
			ClosestSeries = closest;
		}

		private Tuple<double, Series> CheckClosest(Series currSeries, [SwiftMutableParameter] double minDist, [SwiftMutableParameter] Series closest, Point world)
		{
			Point point = currSeries.FromWorldPosition(world);
			Point seriesValuePosition = currSeries.GetSeriesValuePosition(world, useInterpolation: true, skipUnknowns: true);
			if (double.IsNaN(seriesValuePosition.X) || double.IsNaN(seriesValuePosition.Y))
			{
				return null;
			}
			double num = (point.X - seriesValuePosition.X) * (point.X - seriesValuePosition.X) + (point.Y - seriesValuePosition.Y) * (point.Y - seriesValuePosition.Y);
			if (num < minDist)
			{
				minDist = num;
				closest = currSeries;
			}
			return new Tuple<double, Series>(minDist, closest);
		}

		internal void ActualWindowRectUpdated()
		{
			ZoomLongAgo = false;
			LastZoomTime = DateTime.Now;
			if (IsHighlightingInitialized)
			{
				for (int i = 0; i < Series.Count; i++)
				{
					Series[i].ClearHighlights();
				}
				HighlightingManager.Clear();
			}
			if (HighlightingAnimator.AnimationActive())
			{
				HighlightingAnimator.Stop();
			}
			bool suspendWindowRect = SuspendWindowRect;
			SuspendWindowRect = true;
			UpdateAcutalWindowProperties();
			SuspendWindowRect = suspendWindowRect;
			View.HideTooltip();
			View.UpdateZoombars(ActualWindowRect);
		}

		private Rect ToGridArea(Rect rect)
		{
			if (ViewportRect.IsEmpty)
			{
				return Rect.Empty;
			}
			Rect viewportRect = ViewportRect;
			double num = viewportRect.Left + viewportRect.Width * (rect.Left - ActualWindowRect.Left) / ActualWindowRect.Width;
			double num2 = viewportRect.Top + viewportRect.Height * (rect.Top - ActualWindowRect.Top) / ActualWindowRect.Height;
			double num3 = viewportRect.Left + viewportRect.Width * (rect.Right - ActualWindowRect.Left) / ActualWindowRect.Width;
			double num4 = viewportRect.Top + viewportRect.Height * (rect.Bottom - ActualWindowRect.Top) / ActualWindowRect.Height;
			return new Rect(num, num2, num3 - num, num4 - num2);
		}

		protected virtual Rect CalculateActualWindowRect()
		{
			double x = WindowRect.Left;
			double y = WindowRect.Top;
			double width = WindowRect.Width;
			double height = WindowRect.Height;
			if (CachedZoomCoercionMode == ZoomCoercionMode.AxisConstrained)
			{
				x = Math.Min(1.0, Math.Max(0.0, WindowRect.Left));
				width = Math.Min(1.0, Math.Max(0.0, WindowRect.Width));
			}
			if (CachedZoomCoercionMode == ZoomCoercionMode.AxisConstrained)
			{
				y = Math.Min(1.0, Math.Max(0.0, WindowRect.Top));
				height = Math.Min(1.0, Math.Max(0.0, WindowRect.Height));
			}
			return new Rect(x, y, width, height);
		}

		protected void RegisterBackgroundContent(DependencyObject content, Action<bool> refresh)
		{
			if (_background != null)
			{
				UnRegisterBackgroundContent(_background);
				_background = null;
				_backgroundContentInfo = null;
			}
			_background = content;
			_backgroundContentInfo = ChartContentManager.Subscribe(ChartContentType.Background, content, refresh);
		}

		protected void UnRegisterBackgroundContent(DependencyObject content)
		{
			ChartContentManager.Unsubscribe(ChartContentType.Background, content);
			_background = null;
			_backgroundContentInfo = null;
		}

		protected internal void DeferBackgroundRefresh()
		{
			ChartContentManager.Refresh(ChartContentType.Background, _background, _backgroundContentInfo, animate: false);
		}

		protected internal virtual void OnHoverBehaviorOverridesChanged()
		{
			bool isDefaultCrosshairDisabled = false;
			bool isDefaultTooltipDisabled = false;
			bool isAnnotationLayerPresent = false;
			for (int i = 0; i < Series.Count; i++)
			{
				Series series = Series[i];
				if (series.IsDefaultCrosshairBehaviorDisabled)
				{
					isDefaultCrosshairDisabled = true;
				}
				if (series.IsDefaultTooltipBehaviorDisabled)
				{
					isDefaultTooltipDisabled = true;
				}
				if (series.IsAnnotationLayer)
				{
					isAnnotationLayerPresent = true;
				}
			}
			IsDefaultCrosshairDisabled = isDefaultCrosshairDisabled;
			IsDefaultTooltipDisabled = isDefaultTooltipDisabled;
			IsAnnotationLayerPresent = isAnnotationLayerPresent;
		}

			PlotArea.Children.Add(PlotAreaBackgroundPresenter);
			PlotArea.Children.Add(GridPanel);
			PlotArea.Children.Add(SeriesPanel);
			GridPanel.Children.Add(GridCanvas);
			Path element = new Path
			{
				Data = new GeometryGroup(),
				IsHitTestVisible = false,
				Stroke = null
			};
			Path element2 = new Path
			{
				Data = new GeometryGroup(),
				IsHitTestVisible = false
			};
			Path element3 = new Path
			{
				Data = new GeometryGroup(),
				IsHitTestVisible = false
			};
			GridCanvas.Children.Add(element);
			GridCanvas.Children.Add(element2);
			GridCanvas.Children.Add(element3);
			Detail = new Canvas
			{
				IsHitTestVisible = false
			};
			Panel.SetZIndex(Detail, 4);
			PlotArea.Children.Add(Detail);
			previewPath = new Path
			{
				IsHitTestVisible = false
			};
			Detail.Children.Add(previewPath);
			DoubleCollection doubleCollection = new DoubleCollection();
			doubleCollection.Add(2.0);
			doubleCollection.Add(4.0);
			dragPath = new Path
			{
				IsHitTestVisible = false,
				Stroke = new SolidColorBrush(Colors.Black),
				StrokeThickness = 0.75,
				Data = new RectangleGeometry()
			};
			dragPath.StrokeDashArray = doubleCollection;
			Detail.Children.Add(dragPath);
			horizontalCrosshair = new Line
			{
				IsHitTestVisible = false
			};
			verticalCrosshair = new Line
			{
				IsHitTestVisible = false
			};
			PlotAreaBorder.MouseEnter += PlotArea_MouseEnter;
			PlotAreaBorder.MouseLeave += PlotArea_MouseLeave;
			PlotAreaBorder.MouseMove += PlotArea_MouseMove;
			PlotAreaBorder.MouseWheel += PlotArea_MouseWheel;
			PlotAreaBorder.MouseLeftButtonDown += PlotArea_MouseLeftButtonDown;
			PlotAreaBorder.MouseLeftButtonUp += PlotArea_MouseLeftButtonUp;
			Model.GetComponentsForView().SeriesViewer.KeyDown += Chart_KeyDown;
			PlotAreaBorder.IsManipulationEnabled = true;
			PlotAreaBorder.ManipulationStarted += PlotAreaBorder_ManipulationStarted;
			PlotAreaBorder.ManipulationDelta += PlotAreaBorder_ManipulationDelta;
			PlotAreaBorder.ManipulationCompleted += PlotAreaBorder_ManipulationCompleted;
			PlotAreaBorder.TouchDown += PlotAreaBorder_TouchDown;
			PlotAreaBorder.TouchUp += PlotAreaBorder_TouchUp;
			PlotAreaBorder.TouchMove += PlotAreaBorder_TouchMove;
			Stylus.SetIsPressAndHoldEnabled(PlotAreaBorder, enabled: false);
			ToolTipPopup = new Popup
			{
				DataContext = new DataContext(),
				Child = new ContentControl
				{
					IsHitTestVisible = false
				}
			};
			ToolTipInfoBox = new Popup();
			ToolTipInfoBox.PlacementTarget = PlotAreaBorder;
			ToolTipInfoBox.Placement = PlacementMode.Relative;
			ToolTipInfoBox.IsOpen = false;
			ContentControl contentControl = new ContentControl();
			ToolTipInfoBox.Child = contentControl;
			StackPanel content = new StackPanel();
			contentControl.Content = content;
			if (SafeSetter.IsSafe)
			{
				ToolTipPopup.AllowsTransparency = true;
				ToolTipInfoBox.AllowsTransparency = true;
				try
				{
					typeof(Popup).GetProperty("HitTestable", BindingFlags.Instance | BindingFlags.NonPublic | BindingFlags.GetProperty).SetValue(ToolTipPopup, false, null);
					typeof(Popup).GetProperty("HitTestable", BindingFlags.Instance | BindingFlags.NonPublic | BindingFlags.GetProperty).SetValue(ToolTipInfoBox, false, null);
				}
				catch (SecurityException)
				{
				}
				catch (MissingMethodException)
				{
				}
				catch (MethodAccessException)
				{
				}
			}
			else
			{
				ToolTipPopup.PlacementTarget = Model;
			}
			CentralArea.Children.Add(OverviewPlusDetailPane);
			Action<object, PropertyChangedEventArgs<Rect>> action = delegate(object sender, PropertyChangedEventArgs<Rect> e)
			{
				OnOverviewPlusDetailPaneWindowChanged(e.OldValue, e.NewValue);
			};
			OverviewPlusDetailPane.WindowChanging += action.Invoke;
			OverviewPlusDetailPane.WindowChanged += action.Invoke;
			Panel.SetZIndex(OverviewPlusDetailPane, 5);
		}

		public void OnActualHitTestModeChanged()
		{
		}

		protected internal virtual InteractionState ResolveDefaultInteraction(bool isFinger)
		{
			if (isFinger)
			{
				return InteractionState.DragPan;
			}
			return InteractionState.DragZoom;
		}

		protected virtual void OnManipulationStarted(Point position, bool isTouch, int touchCount)
		{
			_manipulationsDisabled = true;
			SeriesPanel.IsHitTestVisible = false;
			GridPanel.IsHitTestVisible = false;
			if (!_translating && _touches == 1)
			{
				Model.OnManipulationStarted(position);
			}
			_holdPosition = position;
			if (_holdTimer == null)
			{
				_holdTimer = new DispatcherTimer(DispatcherPriority.Normal)
				{
					Interval = TimeSpan.FromSeconds(2.0)
				};
				_holdTimer.Tick += _holdTimer_Tick;
			}
			if (touchCount < 2)
			{
				_holdTimer.Stop();
				_holdTimer.Start();
			}
			else
			{
				_holdTimer.Stop();
			}
		}

		protected virtual void OnManipulationCompleted(Point position, bool isTouch, int touchCount)
		{
			Rect dragState = Model.SeriesViewerInteractionManager.GetDragState();
			if (_translating && touchCount < 1)
			{
				Model.OnContactCompleted(new Point(dragState.X, dragState.Y), isFinger: true, isSecondaryFinger: false);
				Model.OnDragCompleted(new Point(dragState.X, dragState.Y));
				_translating = false;
			}
			if (_scaling)
			{
				Model.OnPinchCompleted(1.0, position);
				_scaling = false;
			}
			Model.OnGestureCompleted(position);
			if (!_scaling && !_translating)
			{
				SeriesPanel.IsHitTestVisible = true;
				GridPanel.IsHitTestVisible = true;
				_manipulationsDisabled = false;
			}
		}

		protected virtual bool OnManipulationDelta(Point position, bool isTouch, double scale, double translationX, double translationY, bool isInertial)
		{
			IsTouch = true;
			Rect dragState = Model.SeriesViewerInteractionManager.GetDragState();
			if (scale != 1.0)
			{
				if (_scaling)
				{
					_pendingScale *= scale;
					if (Math.Abs(_pendingScale - 1.0) > 0.01)
					{
						Model.OnPinchDelta(_pendingScale, position);
						_pendingScale = 1.0;
					}
				}
				else
				{
					_scaling = true;
					_pendingScale = 1.0;
					Model.OnPinchStarted(position);
					Model.OnPinchDelta(scale, position);
				}
			}
			Point point = new Point(dragState.X + translationX, dragState.Y + translationY);
			if (translationX != 0.0 || translationY != 0.0)
			{
				if (_translating)
				{
					Model.OnContactMoved(point, IsTouch);
					Model.OnDragDelta(point);
				}
				else
				{
					_translating = true;
					Model.OnDragStarted(point, IsTouch);
					Model.OnContactMoved(point, IsTouch);
					Model.OnDragDelta(point);
				}
			}
			return true;
		}

		private void PlotAreaBorder_ManipulationCompleted(object sender, ManipulationCompletedEventArgs e)
		{
			OnManipulationCompleted(e.ManipulationOrigin, isTouch: true, e.Manipulators.Count());
		}

		private void PlotAreaBorder_ManipulationStarted(object sender, ManipulationStartedEventArgs e)
		{
			OnManipulationStarted(e.ManipulationOrigin, isTouch: true, e.Manipulators.Count());
		}

		private void PlotAreaBorder_ManipulationDelta(object sender, ManipulationDeltaEventArgs e)
		{
			OnManipulationDelta(e.ManipulationOrigin, isTouch: true, e.DeltaManipulation.Scale.X, e.DeltaManipulation.Translation.X, e.DeltaManipulation.Translation.Y, e.IsInertial);
		}

		private void PlotAreaBorder_TouchUp(object sender, TouchEventArgs e)
		{
			PlotArea.ReleaseTouchCapture(e.TouchDevice);
			_touches--;
			if (_touches < 0)
			{
				_touches = 0;
			}
			if (_touches == 0 && _manipulationsDisabled)
			{
				SeriesPanel.IsHitTestVisible = true;
				GridPanel.IsHitTestVisible = true;
				_manipulationsDisabled = false;
			}
			if (_holdTimer != null)
			{
				_holdTimer.Stop();
			}
			Model.OnContactCompleted(e.GetTouchPoint(PlotArea).Position, isFinger: true, _touches > 0);
			foreach (Series item in Model.Series)
			{
				item.View.FinishTouchUp(e.GetTouchPoint(PlotArea).Position, e);
			}
		}

		private void PlotAreaBorder_TouchDown(object sender, TouchEventArgs e)
		{
			if (e.TouchDevice.Capture(PlotArea, CaptureMode.SubTree))
			{
				_touches++;
				if (_holdTimer != null)
				{
					_holdTimer.Stop();
				}
				if (!_scaling && !_translating)
				{
					Model.OnContactStarted(e.GetTouchPoint(PlotArea).Position, isFinger: true);
				}
			}
		}

		private void PlotAreaBorder_TouchMove(object sender, TouchEventArgs e)
		{
			e.Handled = true;
			if (!_scaling && !_translating && _touches < 2)
			{
				Model.OnContactMoved(e.GetTouchPoint(PlotArea).Position, isFinger: true);
			}
		}

		private void _holdTimer_Tick(object sender, EventArgs e)
		{
			Rect dragState = Model.SeriesViewerInteractionManager.GetDragState();
			_holdTimer.Stop();
			if (Math.Abs(dragState.X - _holdPosition.X) < 10.0 && Math.Abs(dragState.Y - _holdPosition.Y) < 10.0)
			{
				Model.OnPlotAreaHold(new Point(dragState.X, dragState.Y));
			}
		}

			}
			StealingCapture = false;
		}

		protected virtual bool ZoombarsSupported()
		{
			return true;
		}

		public virtual void OnTemplateProvided()
		{
			SeriesViewer seriesViewer = Model.GetComponentsForView().SeriesViewer;
			if (ZoombarsSupported())
			{
				VerticalZoombar.SetBinding(FrameworkElement.StyleProperty, new Binding("ZoombarStyle")
				{
					Source = seriesViewer
				});
				HorizontalZoombar.SetBinding(FrameworkElement.StyleProperty, new Binding("ZoombarStyle")
				{
					Source = seriesViewer
				});
			}
			else
			{
				if (VerticalZoombar != null)
				{
					VerticalZoombar.Visibility = Visibility.Collapsed;
				}
				if (HorizontalZoombar != null)
				{
					HorizontalZoombar.Visibility = Visibility.Collapsed;
				}
			}
			previewPath.SetBinding(FrameworkElement.StyleProperty, new Binding("PreviewPathStyle")
			{
				Source = seriesViewer
			});
			PlotAreaBorder.SetBinding(Border.BorderBrushProperty, new Binding("ActualPlotAreaBorderBrush")
			{
				Source = seriesViewer
			});
			PlotAreaBorder.SetBinding(Border.BorderThicknessProperty, new Binding("PlotAreaBorderThickness")
			{
				Source = seriesViewer
			});
			PlotAreaBorder.SetBinding(Border.BackgroundProperty, new Binding("PlotAreaBackground")
			{
				Source = seriesViewer
			});
			horizontalCrosshair.SetBinding(FrameworkElement.StyleProperty, new Binding("CrosshairLineStyle")
			{
				Source = seriesViewer
			});
			verticalCrosshair.SetBinding(FrameworkElement.StyleProperty, new Binding("CrosshairLineStyle")
			{
				Source = seriesViewer
			});
			(ToolTipPopup.Child as ContentControl).SetBinding(FrameworkElement.StyleProperty, new Binding("ToolTipStyle")
			{
				Source = seriesViewer
			});
			(ToolTipInfoBox.Child as ContentControl).SetBinding(FrameworkElement.StyleProperty, new Binding("CrosshairTooltipStyle")
			{
				Source = seriesViewer
			});
			VisualStateManager.GoToState(VisualStateTarget, "Idle", useTransitions: false);
		}

		private void OnOverviewPlusDetailPaneWindowChanged(Rect oldRect, Rect newRect)
		{
			Rect rect = SeriesViewerSurfaceViewer.ChangeRect(oldRect, newRect, Model.IsZoomingHorizontallyEnabled(), Model.IsZoomingVerticallyEnabled(), OverviewPlusDetailPane.World);
			if (rect.IsEmpty)
			{
				OverviewPlusDetailPane.Window = oldRect;
			}
			else if (rect != newRect)
			{
				OverviewPlusDetailPane.Window = rect;
				OnOverviewPlusDetailPaneWindowChanged(oldRect, rect);
			}
			else
			{
				double num = Model.ViewportRect.Width / Model.ViewportRect.Height;
				rect = new Rect(rect.Left / num, rect.Top, rect.Width / num, rect.Height);
				Model.WindowRect = rect;
			}
		}

		public void UpdateOverviewPlusDetailRects()
		{
			if (Model.OverviewPlusDetailPaneVisibility == Visibility.Visible)
			{
				double num = 1.0;
				if (!Model.ViewportRect.IsEmpty)
				{
					num = Model.ViewportRect.Width / Model.ViewportRect.Height;
				}
				Rect world = OverviewPlusDetailPane.World;
				Rect world2 = new Rect(0.0, 0.0, num, 1.0);
				OverviewPlusDetailPane.World = world2;
				if (world.Width != world2.Width || world.Height != world2.Height || world.X != world2.X || world.Y != world2.Y)
				{
					((SeriesViewerSurfaceViewer)OverviewPlusDetailPane.SurfaceViewer).IsDirty = true;
				}
				if (!Model.ActualWindowRect.IsEmpty)
				{
					OverviewPlusDetailPane.Window = new Rect(Model.ActualWindowRect.Left * num, Model.ActualWindowRect.Top, Model.ActualWindowRect.Width * num, Model.ActualWindowRect.Height);
				}
			}
		}

		private void Model_ActualWindowRectChanged(object sender, RectChangedEventArgs e)
		{
			UpdateOverviewPlusDetailRects();
		}

		private void Model_GridAreaRectChanged(object sender, RectChangedEventArgs e)
		{
			UpdateOverviewPlusDetailRects();
		}

		internal void GetThumbnail(double width, double height, RenderSurface surface)
		{
			bool flag = false;
			if (width != _lastWidth || height != _lastHeight)
			{
				_lastHeight = height;
				_lastWidth = width;
				flag = true;
			}
			foreach (Series item in Model.Series)
			{
				if (flag)
				{
					item.ThumbnailDirty = true;
				}
				item.RenderThumbnail(new Rect(0.0, 0.0, width, height), surface);
			}
		}

		public void RemoveSeries(Series series)
		{
			SeriesPanel.Children.Remove(series);
		}

		private void PlotArea_MouseEnter(object sender, MouseEventArgs e)
		{
			Point position = e.GetPosition(PlotArea);
			Model.OnMouseEnter(position);
		}

		private void PlotArea_MouseLeave(object sender, MouseEventArgs e)
		{
			Point position = e.GetPosition(PlotArea);
			Model.OnMouseLeave(position, _translating || _scaling || Model.State != InteractionState.None);
			foreach (Series item in Model.Series)
			{
				if (item.SeriesInteractionManager.IsMouseLeaveDeferred)
				{
					item.OnMouseLeave(position, item.SeriesInteractionManager.LastHoverItem, e);
				}
			}
		}

		private void PlotArea_MouseLeftButtonDown(object sender, MouseButtonEventArgs e)
		{
			ContactStarted(e);
		}

		private void PlotArea_MouseMove(object sender, MouseEventArgs e)
		{
			if (!_translating && !_scaling && _touches < 1)
			{
				if (_manipulationsDisabled)
				{
					SeriesPanel.IsHitTestVisible = true;
					GridPanel.IsHitTestVisible = true;
					_manipulationsDisabled = false;
				}
				ContactMoved(e);
			}
			Point position = e.GetPosition(PlotArea);
			Model.CheckPlotEvents(position, _translating || _scaling || Model.State != InteractionState.None);
		}

		private void PlotArea_MouseLeftButtonUp(object sender, MouseButtonEventArgs e)
		{
			ContactCompleted(e);
		}

		private void PlotArea_MouseWheel(object sender, MouseWheelEventArgs e)
		{
			Point position = e.GetPosition(PlotArea);
			e.Handled = Model.OnMouseWheel(position, (double)e.Delta / 1200.0);
		}

		private void Chart_KeyDown(object sender, KeyEventArgs e)
		{
			Key key = e.Key;
			if (Model.OnKeyDown(key))
			{
				e.Handled = true;
			}
		}

		private void PlotArea_SizeChanged(object sender, SizeChangedEventArgs e)
		{
			Rect oldGridAreaRect = new Rect(new Point(0.0, 0.0), e.PreviousSize);
			Rect rect = new Rect(new Point(0.0, 0.0), e.NewSize);
			if (!oldGridAreaRect.Equals(rect))
			{
				_contentArea = Rect.Empty;
				_plotAreaLocation = Rect.Empty;
			}
			PlotArea.Clip = new RectangleGeometry
			{
				Rect = rect
			};
			Model.ProcessPlotAreaSizeChanged(oldGridAreaRect, rect);
		}

		private StackPanel GetInfoStack()
		{
			return (StackPanel)((ContentControl)ToolTipInfoBox.Child).Content;
		}

		internal void ShowInfoBox()
		{
			HideTooltip();
			if (GetInfoStack().Children.Count > 0 && !ToolTipInfoBox.IsOpen)
			{
				ToolTipInfoBox.IsOpen = true;
			}
		}

		internal void ClearInfoBox(bool isVertical)
		{
			StackPanel infoStack = GetInfoStack();
			if (isVertical)
			{
				infoStack.Orientation = Orientation.Vertical;
			}
			else
			{
				infoStack.Orientation = Orientation.Horizontal;
			}
			int count = infoStack.Children.Count;
			for (int i = 0; i < count; i++)
			{
				infoStack.Children.RemoveAt(0);
			}
		}

		internal void UpdateInfoBoxYTranslation(double height)
		{
		}

		internal void HideInfoBox()
		{
			ToolTipInfoBox.IsOpen = false;
		}

		public void AddToInfoBox(object control)
		{
			StackPanel infoStack = GetInfoStack();
			((FrameworkElement)control).Detach();
			control = new ContentControl
			{
				Content = new TooltipItemContext
				{
					SubContent = (UIElement)control,
					ItemContext = ((FrameworkElement)control).DataContext
				},
				ContentTemplate = Model.CrosshairTooltipItemTemplate
			};
			infoStack.Children.Add((UIElement)control);
		}

		{
			MouseButtonEventArgs obj = (MouseButtonEventArgs)eventArgs;

			Model.OnContactStarted(position, isFinger);
		}

		{
			MouseEventArgs obj = (MouseEventArgs)eventArgs;
			bool isFinger = false;
			Point position = obj.GetPosition(PlotArea);
			Model.OnContactMoved(position, isFinger);
		}

		private void ContactCompleted(EventArgs eventArgs)
		{
			MouseButtonEventArgs obj = (MouseButtonEventArgs)eventArgs;
			bool isFinger = false;
			Point position = obj.GetPosition(PlotArea);
			Model.OnContactCompleted(position, isFinger, isSecondaryFinger: false);
		}

		internal void ResetWindowRect()
		{
			Model.ClearValue(SeriesViewer.WindowRectProperty);
		}

		private void Zoombar_ZoomChanged(object sender, ZoomChangedEventArgs e)
		{
			if (!ignoreZoombar)
			{
				Rect rc = ProcessZoombarChange(sender, e.NewRange);
				Model.OnZoomChanged(rc);
			}
		}

		private void Zoombar_ZoomChanging(object sender, ZoomChangeEventArgs e)
		{
			if (!ignoreZoombar)
			{
				if (sender == HorizontalZoombar && !Model.IsZoomingHorizontallyEnabled())
				{
					e.Cancel = true;
					return;
				}
				if (sender == VerticalZoombar && !Model.IsZoomingVerticallyEnabled())
				{
					e.Cancel = true;
					return;
				}
				Rect rc = ProcessZoombarChange(sender, e.NewRange);
				Model.OnZoomChanging(rc);
			}
		}

		private Rect ProcessZoombarChange(object sender, Range zoombarRange)
		{
			Rect actualWindowRect = Model.ActualWindowRect;
			if (sender == HorizontalZoombar)
			{
				double num = (zoombarRange.Minimum - HorizontalZoombar.Minimum) / HorizontalZoombar.Maximum - HorizontalZoombar.Minimum;
				double num2 = (zoombarRange.Maximum - HorizontalZoombar.Minimum) / HorizontalZoombar.Maximum - HorizontalZoombar.Minimum - num;
				actualWindowRect.X = num;
				if (num2 > 0.0)
				{
					actualWindowRect.Width = num2;
				}
			}
			if (sender == VerticalZoombar)
			{
				double num3 = (zoombarRange.Maximum - VerticalZoombar.Minimum) / VerticalZoombar.Maximum - VerticalZoombar.Minimum;
				double num4 = (zoombarRange.Minimum - VerticalZoombar.Minimum) / VerticalZoombar.Maximum - VerticalZoombar.Minimum;
				double num5 = num3 - num4;
				actualWindowRect.Y = num4;
				if (num5 > 0.0)
				{
					actualWindowRect.Height = num5;
				}
			}
			return actualWindowRect;
		}

		public void UpdateZoombars(Rect windowRect)
		{
			ignoreZoombar = true;
			if (HorizontalZoombar != null)
			{
				double num = (windowRect.Left + HorizontalZoombar.Minimum) * HorizontalZoombar.Maximum + HorizontalZoombar.Minimum;
				double num2 = (windowRect.Right + HorizontalZoombar.Minimum) * HorizontalZoombar.Maximum + HorizontalZoombar.Minimum;
				HorizontalZoombar.Range = new Range
				{
					Minimum = num,
					Maximum = num2
				};
				double num3 = num2 - num;
				if (double.IsNaN(num3))
				{
					XamZoombar horizontalZoombar = HorizontalZoombar;
					double smallChange = (HorizontalZoombar.LargeChange = 0.0);
					horizontalZoombar.SmallChange = smallChange;
				}
				else
				{
					HorizontalZoombar.SmallChange = 0.1 * num3;
					HorizontalZoombar.LargeChange = num3;
				}
			}
			if (VerticalZoombar != null)
			{
				double num5 = (windowRect.Top + VerticalZoombar.Minimum) * VerticalZoombar.Maximum + VerticalZoombar.Minimum;
				double num6 = (windowRect.Bottom + VerticalZoombar.Minimum) * VerticalZoombar.Maximum + VerticalZoombar.Minimum;
				VerticalZoombar.Range = new Range
				{
					Minimum = num5,
					Maximum = num6
				};
				if (double.IsNaN(num6 - num5))
				{
					XamZoombar verticalZoombar = VerticalZoombar;
					double smallChange = (VerticalZoombar.LargeChange = 0.0);
					verticalZoombar.SmallChange = smallChange;
				}
				else
				{
					VerticalZoombar.SmallChange = 0.1 * (num6 - num5);
					VerticalZoombar.LargeChange = num6 - num5;
				}
			}
			ignoreZoombar = false;
		}

		internal static List<Series> GetAllSeries(Series series)
		{
			SeriesCollection series2 = series.SeriesViewer.Series;
			List<Series> allSeries = new List<Series>();
			for (int i = 0; i < series2.Count; i++)
			{
				allSeries.Add(series2[i]);
				if (series2[i].IsStacked)
				{
					series2[i].ForSubVisualSeries(delegate(Series s)
					{
						allSeries.Add(s);
						return true;
					});
				}
			}
			return allSeries;
		}

		internal AxisTitlePosition GetDefaultHorizontalAxisTitlePosition(Axis axis)
		{
			AxisLabelsLocation axisLabelsLocation = LabelPanelArranger.ResolveLabelLocation(axis.LabelPanel);
			if (axis.CrossingAxis == null)
			{
				switch (axisLabelsLocation)
				{
				case AxisLabelsLocation.InsideTop:
					return AxisTitlePosition.Bottom;
				case AxisLabelsLocation.InsideBottom:
					return AxisTitlePosition.Top;
				}
			}
			else
			{
				switch (axisLabelsLocation)
				{
				case AxisLabelsLocation.InsideTop:
					return AxisTitlePosition.Top;
				case AxisLabelsLocation.InsideBottom:
					return AxisTitlePosition.Bottom;
				}
			}
			if (axisLabelsLocation == AxisLabelsLocation.OutsideTop)
			{
				return AxisTitlePosition.Top;
			}
			return AxisTitlePosition.Bottom;
		}

		internal AxisTitlePosition GetDefaultVerticalAxisTitlePosition(Axis axis)
		{
			AxisLabelsLocation axisLabelsLocation = LabelPanelArranger.ResolveLabelLocation(axis.LabelPanel);
			if (axis.CrossingAxis == null)
			{
				switch (axisLabelsLocation)
				{
				case AxisLabelsLocation.InsideRight:
					return AxisTitlePosition.Left;
				case AxisLabelsLocation.InsideLeft:
					return AxisTitlePosition.Right;
				}
			}
			else
			{
				switch (axisLabelsLocation)
				{
				case AxisLabelsLocation.InsideRight:
					return AxisTitlePosition.Right;
				case AxisLabelsLocation.InsideLeft:
					return AxisTitlePosition.Left;
				}
			}
			if (axisLabelsLocation == AxisLabelsLocation.OutsideRight)
			{
				return AxisTitlePosition.Right;
			}
			return AxisTitlePosition.Left;
		}

		internal Rect GetContentArea()
		{
			if (!_contentArea.IsEmpty)

			Point point = CentralArea.TransformToVisual(Model).Transform(new Point(0.0, 0.0));
			Point point2 = CentralArea.TransformToVisual(Model).Transform(new Point(CentralArea.ActualWidth, CentralArea.ActualHeight));
			_contentArea = new Rect(point, point2);
			return _contentArea;

			Point point2 = PlotAreaBorder.TransformToVisual(Model).Transform(new Point(PlotAreaBorder.ActualWidth, PlotAreaBorder.ActualHeight));
			_plotAreaLocation = new Rect(point, point2);

		internal void OnTitleChanged()
		{
			if (Model.Title == null)
			{
				if (CentralArea.Children.Contains(TitlePresenter))
				{
					CentralArea.Children.Remove(TitlePresenter);
				}
			}
			else if (!CentralArea.Children.Contains(TitlePresenter))
			{
				CentralArea.Children.Add(TitlePresenter);
			}
			TitlePresenter.Visibility = ((Model.Title == null) ? Visibility.Collapsed : Visibility.Visible);
			CentralArea.InvalidateMeasure();
		}

		internal void OnSubTitleChanged()
		{
			if (Model.Subtitle == null)

				if (CentralArea.Children.Contains(SubtitlePresenter))
				{
					CentralArea.Children.Remove(SubtitlePresenter);
				}
			}
			else if (!CentralArea.Children.Contains(SubtitlePresenter))
			{
				CentralArea.Children.Add(SubtitlePresenter);
			}
			SubtitlePresenter.Visibility = ((Model.Subtitle == null) ? Visibility.Collapsed : Visibility.Visible);
			CentralArea.InvalidateMeasure();
		}

		public bool JustZoomed()
		{
			if (Model.ZoomLongAgo)
			{
				return false;
			}
			if ((DateTime.Now - Model.LastZoomTime).TotalMilliseconds < 300.0)
			{
				return true;
			}
			return false;
		}

		public void DisplayZoomTiles(Dictionary<object, ITileZoomTile> existingTiles, List<ITileZoomTile> newTiles, double tileSize)
		{
			int count = newTiles.Count;
			int i = 0;
			if (_zoomTiles == null)
			{
				_zoomTiles = new Canvas();
				_zoomTiles.UseLayoutRounding = false;
				_tileImages = new List<Image>();
				Detail.Children.Add(_zoomTiles);
			}
			_zoomTiles.Width = Model.ViewportRect.Width;
			_zoomTiles.Height = Model.ViewportRect.Height;
			_zoomTiles.Visibility = Visibility.Visible;
			for (int j = 0; j < _tileImages.Count; j++)
			{
				Image image = _tileImages[j];
				if (image.Source == null || !existingTiles.ContainsKey(image.Source))
				{
					if (i < count)
					{
						image.Visibility = Visibility.Visible;
						ITileZoomTile tileZoomTile = newTiles[i];
						ImageSource source = (ImageSource)tileZoomTile.Content;
						Canvas.SetLeft(image, tileZoomTile.XPosition);
						Canvas.SetTop(image, tileZoomTile.YPosition);
						image.Width = tileZoomTile.Width + 0.5;
						image.Height = tileZoomTile.Height + 0.5;
						i++;
						_ = tileZoomTile.Width / tileSize;
						_ = tileZoomTile.Height / tileSize;
						image.Source = source;
					}
					else
					{
						image.Visibility = Visibility.Collapsed;
						image.Source = null;
					}
				}
				else
				{
					ITileZoomTile tileZoomTile2 = existingTiles[image.Source];
					image.Visibility = Visibility.Visible;
					Canvas.SetLeft(image, tileZoomTile2.XPosition);
					Canvas.SetTop(image, tileZoomTile2.YPosition);
					image.Width = tileZoomTile2.Width + 0.5;
					image.Height = tileZoomTile2.Height + 0.5;
					_ = image.Source;
					_ = tileZoomTile2.Width / tileSize;
					_ = tileZoomTile2.Height / tileSize;
				}
			}
			for (; i < count; i++)
			{
				ITileZoomTile tileZoomTile3 = newTiles[i];
				Image image2 = new Image();
				image2.Stretch = Stretch.Fill;
				image2.IsHitTestVisible = false;
				_tileImages.Add(image2);
				_zoomTiles.Children.Add(image2);
				Canvas.SetLeft(image2, tileZoomTile3.XPosition);
				Canvas.SetTop(image2, tileZoomTile3.YPosition);
				image2.Width = tileZoomTile3.Width + 0.5;
				image2.Height = tileZoomTile3.Height + 0.5;
				ImageSource source2 = (ImageSource)tileZoomTile3.Content;
				_ = tileZoomTile3.Width / tileSize;
				_ = tileZoomTile3.Height / tileSize;
				image2.Source = source2;
			}
			HidePlotContent();
		}

		public void HideZoomTiles()
		{
			if (_zoomTiles != null)
			{
				_zoomTiles.Visibility = Visibility.Collapsed;
			}
		}

		public object AcquireTileContent(Rect window, TileZoomTile tile, int tileSize)
		{
			int num = 0;
			Canvas canvas;
			if (!_tileSurfaces.TryGetValue(num.ToString(), out var value))
			{
				value = new RenderSurface();
				canvas = new Canvas();
				canvas.Clip = new RectangleGeometry
				{
					Rect = new Rect(0.0, 0.0, tileSize, tileSize)
				};
				canvas.CacheMode = new BitmapCache();
				canvas.Width = tileSize;
				canvas.Height = tileSize;
				_tileSurfaces.Add(tile.ID.ToString(), value);
				canvas.Children.Clear();
				value.Surface = canvas;
				value.Surface.HorizontalAlignment = HorizontalAlignment.Left;
				value.Surface.VerticalAlignment = VerticalAlignment.Top;
			}
			canvas = value.Surface;
			List<Canvas> list = value.Surface.Children.OfType<Canvas>().ToList();
			for (int i = 0; i < list.Count; i++)
			{
				value.Surface.Children.Remove(list[i]);
			}
			Rect viewportRect = new Rect(0.0, 0.0, tileSize, tileSize);
			for (int j = 0; j < Model.Series.Count; j++)
			{
				Model.Series[j].RenderAlternateView(viewportRect, window, value, "tile_" + num, 1.0);
			}
			RenderTargetBitmap renderTargetBitmap = new RenderTargetBitmap(tileSize, tileSize, 96.0, 96.0, PixelFormats.Pbgra32);
			value.Surface.InvalidateMeasure();
			value.Surface.Measure(new Size(tileSize, tileSize));
			value.Surface.Arrange(new Rect(0.0, 0.0, tileSize, tileSize));
			value.Surface.UpdateLayout();
			renderTargetBitmap.Render(value.Surface);
			return renderTargetBitmap;
		}

		internal void DestroyAllTileContent()

			}
		}

		internal void DeferCacheClear()
		{
			if (_cacheClearTimer == null)
			{
				_cacheClearTimer = new DispatcherTimer();
				_cacheClearTimer.Interval = TimeSpan.FromSeconds(5.0);
				_cacheClearTimer.Tick += _cacheClearTimer_Tick;
			}
			_cacheClearTimer.Stop();
			_cacheClearTimer.Start();
		}

		private void _cacheClearTimer_Tick(object sender, EventArgs e)
		{
			_cacheClearTimer.Stop();
			Model.SeriesViewerInteractionManager.DeferredClearOfTileZoomCache(Model);
		}

		internal void CancelDeferredCacheClear()
		{
			if (_cacheClearTimer != null)
			{
				_cacheClearTimer.Stop();
			}
		}

		internal void DeferEndToTiledZoom(int delay)
		{
			if (_endTileZoomTimer == null)
			{
				_endTileZoomTimer = new DispatcherTimer();
				_endTileZoomTimer.Interval = TimeSpan.FromMilliseconds(delay);
				_endTileZoomTimer.Tick += _endTileZoomTimer_Tick;
			}
			Model.OnDeferZoomPanEnd();
			_endTileZoomTimer.Stop();
			_endTileZoomTimer.Start();
		}

		private void _endTileZoomTimer_Tick(object sender, EventArgs e)
		{
			_endTileZoomTimer.Stop();
			Model.EndTiledZoomingIfRunning();
		}

		internal void CancelEndToTiledZoom()
		{
			Model.OnDeferredZoomPanEndCancelled();
			if (_endTileZoomTimer != null)
			{
				_endTileZoomTimer.Stop();
			}
		}

		public void HidePlotContent()
		{
			if (_plotContentShown)
			{
				_plotContentShown = false;
				GridPanel.Opacity = 0.0;
				SeriesPanel.Opacity = 0.0;
			}
		}

		public void ShowPlotContent()
		{
			if (!_plotContentShown)
			{
				_plotContentShown = true;
				GridPanel.Opacity = 1.0;
				SeriesPanel.Opacity = 1.0;
			}
		}

		public void OnTileZoomEnding()
		{
			ShowPlotContent();
		}

		internal Series GetCurrentSeriesOver()
		{
			for (int i = 0; i < SeriesPanel.Children.Count; i++)
			{
				if (((Series)SeriesPanel.Children[i]).SeriesInteractionManager.MouseIsOver)
				{
					return (Series)SeriesPanel.Children[i];
				}
			}
			return null;
		}

		{
			if (!View.Model.IsMap)
			{
				XamDataChart xamDataChart = (XamDataChart)View.Model;
				if (xamDataChart.EffectiveViewport.IsEmpty)
				{
					return xamDataChart.EffectiveViewport;
				}
				return xamDataChart.GetScaledEffectiveViewport(View.OverviewPlusDetailPane.PreviewViewportdRect, xamDataChart.ViewportRect, xamDataChart.EffectiveViewport);
			}
			return Rect.Empty;
		}

		{

			{
				Opacity = control.Opacity,
				HorizontalAlignment = control.HorizontalAlignment.ToString(),
				VerticalAlignment = control.VerticalAlignment.ToString(),
				TextAlignment = TextAlignment.Left.ToString(),
				TextWrapping = TextWrapping.NoWrap.ToString(),
				Font = control.FontFamily.Source,
				FontFamily = control.FontFamily.Source,
				FontSize = control.FontSize,
				FontStyle = control.FontStyle.ToString(),
				FontWeight = ExportFontWeight(control.FontWeight),
				FontStretch = control.FontStretch.ToString(),
				MarginLeft = control.Margin.Left,
				MarginRight = control.Margin.Right,
				MarginTop = control.Margin.Top,
				MarginBottom = control.Margin.Bottom,
				LabelBrush = AppearanceHelper.FromBrush(control.Foreground),
				LabelBrushExtended = AppearanceHelper.FromBrushExtended(control.Foreground)
			};
		}

		{
			return fontWeight.ToString();
		}

		internal bool LabelsChanged()
		{
			int count = base.LabelDataContext.Count;
			if (_visibleLabels.Count != count)
			{
				return true;
			}
			for (int i = 0; i < count; i++)
			{
				string label = HorizontalView.GetLabel(base.LabelDataContext[i]);
				string text = _visibleLabels[i];
				if (label != text)
				{
					return true;
				}
			}
			return false;
		}

		public HorizontalSmartAxisLabelPanel()
