			_categoryWidth = 0.0;
			_maxPanelHeight = -1.0;
			_wrapTextFlag = true;
			_isPanning = false;
			_fontInfoMap = new Dictionary<int, FontMappingInfo>();
		}

		internal bool IsHorizontal(double angle)
		{
			if (angle % 180.0 == 0.0)
			{
				return true;
			}
			return false;
		}

		internal bool IsPositive(double value)
		{
			if (!IsNumber(value))
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (value <= 0.0)
			{
				return false;
			}
			return true;
		}

		internal bool IsNotNegative(double value)
		{
			if (!IsNumber(value))
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (value < 0.0)
			{
				return false;
			}
			return true;
		}

		internal bool IsNumber(double value)
		{
			if (double.IsNaN(value) || double.IsInfinity(value))
			{
				return false;
			}
			return true;
		}

		internal double ResolveTopMargin()
		{
			double num = 0.0;
			if (base.ActualLabelLocation == AxisLabelsLocation.OutsideTop || base.ActualLabelLocation == AxisLabelsLocation.InsideTop)
			{
				num = num + GetTitleHeightBounds() + TopMargin;
			}
			if (base.ActualLabelLocation == AxisLabelsLocation.OutsideBottom || base.ActualLabelLocation == AxisLabelsLocation.InsideBottom)
			{
				num = num + base.Axis.ActualTickLength + TopMargin;
			}
			return num;
		}

		internal void ResolveUserAngle()
		{
			double num = 0.0;
			if (IsNumber(MinimumAngle))
			{
				num = MinimumAngle;
			}
			double num2 = 180.0;
			if (IsNumber(MaximumAngle))
			{
				num2 = MaximumAngle;
			}
			if (IsUserAngle())
			{
				double num3 = GetSmartAxisSimplifiedAngle(Angle);
				if (num3 < num)
				{
					num3 = num;
				}
				if (num3 > num2)
				{
					num3 = num2;
				}
				ActualAngle = GetSmartAxisSimplifiedAngle(num3);
			}
		}

		private void ResetFlags()
		{
			_wrapTextFlag = true;
		}

		protected internal override double GetDesiredExtent(Rect gridAreaRect)
		{
			if (!_locked && base.Axis != null && base.LabelPositions != null && base.LabelPositions.Count > 0 && base.LabelDataContext != null)
			{
				List<Axis> list = base.Axis.Chart.FindMatchingAxes(base.Axis);
				if (list != null && list.Count > 0)
				{
					_matchingAxis = list[0];
					if (_matchingAxis.LabelPanel.WidthAndHeightAreSet || _matchingAxis.LabelSettings.Visibility == Visibility.Collapsed)
					{
						double num = _matchingAxis.LabelPanel.Extent + gridAreaRect.Left;
						double top = base.LabelViewport.Top;
						double num2 = gridAreaRect.Width - num;
						double height = double.MaxValue;
						_gridAreaRect = new Rect(num, gridAreaRect.Top, num2, gridAreaRect.Height);
						if (base.LabelViewport.Width > 0.0 && base.LabelViewport.Width < num2)
						{
							num2 = base.LabelViewport.Width;
						}
						num = 0.0;
						base.Axis.DoRenderAxis(animate: false);
						_actualPanelBounds = new Rect(num, top, num2, ActualExtent);
						CalculatePanelSize(new Size(num2, height));
						if (_visibleLabels.Count > 0)
						{
							Lock();
						}
						base.Axis.View.LabelNeedRearrange();
					}
				}
			}
			return ActualExtent;
		}

		internal double GetLabelPosition(int index)
		{
			if (base.LabelPositions.Count > index)
			{
				return base.LabelPositions[index].Value;
			}
			return 0.0;
		}

		protected internal override void CreateFontInfoMap()
		{
			FontInfoMap.Clear();
			FontInfo font = Font.CopyFontInfo();
			double availableCategoryWidth = GetAvailableCategoryWidth();
			for (int i = 4; (double)i <= MaximumFontSize; i++)
			{
				FontInfo fontWithNewFontSize = FontUtil.GetFontWithNewFontSize(font, i);
				GetTallestLabel(availableCategoryWidth, fontWithNewFontSize);
			}
		}

		protected internal override void UnlockAndRefresh()
		{
			base.UnlockAndRefresh();
			Unlock();
			InvalidateMeasure();
		}

		internal double FetchFontHeightForFontSize(int fontSize)
		{
			double num = 0.0;
			if (FontInfoMap.ContainsKey(fontSize))
			{
				return FontInfoMap[fontSize].FontHeight;
			}
			return FontUtil.GetCurrentFontHeight(FontUtil.GetFontWithNewFontSize(Font, fontSize));
		}

		private double GetLongestNonBreakingLabelWidth(string label, double fontSize)
		{
			double num = 0.0;
			double num2 = 0.0;
			FontInfo fontWithNewFontSize = FontUtil.GetFontWithNewFontSize(Font, fontSize);
			foreach (string item in HorizontalView.SplitString(label, _wrapChars))
			{
				num2 = FontUtil.MeasureStringWidth(item, fontWithNewFontSize);
				if (num2 > num)
				{
					num = num2;
				}
			}
			return num;
		}

		private string ResolveLongestNonBreakingLabel()
		{
			string result = "";
			double num = 0.0;
			double num2 = 0.0;
			FontInfo fontWithNewFontSize = FontUtil.GetFontWithNewFontSize(Font, 16.0);
			foreach (string allLabel in _allLabels)
			{
				foreach (string item in HorizontalView.SplitString(allLabel, _wrapChars))
				{
					num2 = FontUtil.MeasureStringWidth(item, fontWithNewFontSize);
					if (num2 > num)
					{
						result = item;
						num = num2;
					}
				}
			}
			return result;
		}

		private string ResolveLongestLabel()
		{
			string result = "";
			double num = 0.0;
			double num2 = 0.0;
			FontInfo fontWithNewFontSize = FontUtil.GetFontWithNewFontSize(Font, 16.0);
			foreach (string allLabel in _allLabels)
			{
				num2 = FontUtil.MeasureStringWidth(allLabel, fontWithNewFontSize);
				if (num2 > num)
				{
					result = allLabel;
					num = num2;
				}
			}
			return result;
		}

		private string GetTallestLabel(double width, FontInfo fontInfo)
		{
			string text = "";
			double num = 0.0;
			double num2 = 0.0;
			foreach (string allLabel in _allLabels)
			{
				num2 = FontUtil.MeasureMultilineStringHeight(allLabel, fontInfo, width);
				if (num2 > num)
				{
					text = allLabel;
					num = num2;
				}
			}
			int num3 = (int)fontInfo.FontSize.Value;
			if (FontInfoMap.ContainsKey(num3))
			{
				FontInfoMap[num3].TallestLabel = text;
				FontInfoMap[num3].TallestLabelHeight = num;
			}
			else
			{
				FontMappingInfo fontMappingInfo = new FontMappingInfo();
				fontMappingInfo.TallestLabelHeight = num;
				fontMappingInfo.TallestLabel = text;
				fontMappingInfo.FontHeight = FetchFontHeightForFontSize(num3);
				FontInfoMap.Add(num3, fontMappingInfo);
			}
			return text;
		}

		private bool HasBreakingChars(string text)
		{
			for (int i = 0; i < _wrapChars.Length; i++)
			{
				for (int j = 0; j < text.Length; j++)
				{
					if (FontUtil.CharsEqual(text, j, _wrapChars, i))
					{
						return true;
					}
				}
			}
			return false;
		}

		private void RecreateAllLabels()
		{
			_allLabels.Clear();
			if (base.Axis.IsDateTime && base.Axis.IsContinuous)
			{
				for (int i = 0; i < base.LabelDataContext.Count; i++)
				{
					string label = HorizontalView.GetLabel(base.LabelDataContext[i]);
					_allLabels.Add(label);
				}
				return;
			}
			double num = base.Axis.GetAxisInterval();
			if (double.IsNaN(num) || num == 0.0)
			{
				num = 1.0;
			}
			int num2 = (int)num;
			IFastItemsSource fastItemsSource = ((CategoryAxisBase)base.Axis).FastItemsSource;
			for (int j = 0; j < fastItemsSource.Count; j += num2)
			{
				string label2 = HorizontalView.GetLabel(fastItemsSource[j]);
				_allLabels.Add(label2);
			}
		}

		private List<string> GetVisibleLabels()
		{
			if (LabelsChanged() || (base.LabelDataContext.Count != 0 && base.LabelDataContext.Count != _visibleLabels.Count))
			{
				RecreateAllLabels();
				_visibleLabels.Clear();
				foreach (object item in base.LabelDataContext)
				{
					string label = HorizontalView.GetLabel(item);
					_visibleLabels.Add(label);
				}
				LongestLabel = ResolveLongestLabel();
				LongestNonBreakingLabel = ResolveLongestNonBreakingLabel();
			}
			return _visibleLabels;
		}

		private void HideAllLabels()
		{
			HorizontalView.HideAllLabels();
		}

		private void CalculateCategoryWidth()
		{
			CategoryAxisBase categoryAxisBase = (CategoryAxisBase)base.Axis;
			double num = 0.0;
			double num2 = 0.0;
			bool flag = true;
			Rect viewportRect = categoryAxisBase.SeriesViewer.ViewportRect;
			Rect windowRect = categoryAxisBase.SeriesViewer.WindowRect;
			double actualPlotAreaMarginLeft = categoryAxisBase.Chart.ActualPlotAreaMarginLeft;
			double actualPlotAreaMarginRight = categoryAxisBase.Chart.ActualPlotAreaMarginRight;
			Rect currentEffectiveViewport = categoryAxisBase.GetCurrentEffectiveViewport();
			_ = _gridAreaRect;
			if (_gridAreaRect.IsEmpty || viewportRect.IsEmpty)
			{
				flag = false;
			}
			if (flag && _gridAreaRect.Width != viewportRect.Width)
			{
				flag = false;
			}
			num2 = ((!flag) ? viewportRect.Width : _gridAreaRect.Width);
			num = ((!_locked || !(windowRect.Width < 1.0)) ? ((num2 - actualPlotAreaMarginLeft - actualPlotAreaMarginRight) / ((double)categoryAxisBase.CachedItemsCount * windowRect.Width)) : categoryAxisBase.GetCategorySize(categoryAxisBase.SeriesViewer.WindowRect, categoryAxisBase.SeriesViewer.ViewportRect, currentEffectiveViewport));
			_categoryWidth = Math.Max(0.0, num);
		}

		internal double GetAvailableCategoryWidth()
		{
			return Math.Max(CategoryWidth * (double)_minAxisInterval - ProximityMargin, 0.0);
		}

		private int GetBestMinimumInterval(double panelWidth)
		{
			if (_allLabels.Count == 0 || _visibleLabels.Count == 0 || base.Axis == null || _matchingAxis == null)
			{
				_minAxisInterval = -1;
				return -1;
			}
			double categoryWidth = CategoryWidth;
			double num = base.Axis.GetAxisInterval();
			if (double.IsNaN(num) || num <= 0.0)
			{
				num = 1.0;
			}
			double num2 = 0.0;
			num2 = ((categoryWidth != 0.0 || !(num > 1.0)) ? Math.Max(categoryWidth * num - ProximityMargin, 0.0) : (base.ViewportRect.Width / (double)_visibleLabels.Count));
			double size = (IsUserFont() ? FontSize : MinimumFontSize);
			FontInfo fontWithNewFontSize = FontUtil.GetFontWithNewFontSize(Font, size);
			double num3 = _maxPanelHeight - TopMargin - base.Axis.ActualTickLength - GetTitleHeightBounds();
			double currentFontHeight = FontUtil.GetCurrentFontHeight(fontWithNewFontSize);
			if (num2 < currentFontHeight)
			{
				_minAxisInterval = -1;
				return -1;
			}
			string longestLabel = LongestLabel;
			string text = _allLabels[0];
			string text2 = _allLabels[_allLabels.Count - 1];
			double num4 = HorizontalView.MeasureStringWidth(longestLabel, fontWithNewFontSize);
			Rect seriesViewerViewContainer = HorizontalView.GetSeriesViewerViewContainer();
			bool flag = _matchingAxis.LabelPanel.Extent - HorizontalView.MeasureStringWidth(text, fontWithNewFontSize) / Math.Sqrt(2.0) < seriesViewerViewContainer.Left && base.LabelViewport.Right + HorizontalView.MeasureStringWidth(text2, fontWithNewFontSize) / Math.Sqrt(2.0) > seriesViewerViewContainer.Right;
			if (num4 > num3 && num4 > num3 * Math.Sqrt(2.0) * num3 && flag && HorizontalView.MeasureStringWidth(LongestNonBreakingLabel, fontWithNewFontSize) > num2 && FontUtil.MeasureMultilineStringHeight(longestLabel, fontWithNewFontSize, num2) > num3)
			{
				_minAxisInterval = -1;
				return -1;
			}
			_minAxisInterval = (int)num;
			return (int)num;
		}

		protected override void WindowRectChanged(Rect oldRect, Rect newRect)
		{
			base.WindowRectChanged(oldRect, newRect);
			if (!oldRect.Equals(newRect))
			{
				_isPanning = false;
				if (oldRect.X != newRect.X && oldRect.Width == newRect.Width)
				{
					_isPanning = true;
				}
				if (oldRect.Width != newRect.Width)
				{
					_gridAreaRect = base.Axis.ViewportRect;
					_labelWindowRectChanged = true;
					_wrapTextFlag = true;
					CalculateCategoryWidth();
				}
			}
		}

		protected override void LabelViewportSizeChanged(Rect oldRect, Rect newRect)
		{
			base.LabelViewportSizeChanged(oldRect, newRect);
			if (!newRect.IsEmpty && !oldRect.Equals(newRect))
			{
				_labelViewportSizeChanged = true;
				if (HorizontalView != null)
				{
					_gridAreaRect = newRect;
					_wrapTextFlag = true;
					CalculateCategoryWidth();
				}
			}
		}

		private bool ShouldRearrangeLabels()
		{
			if (!ShouldResize && !_labelViewportSizeChanged)
			{
				return _labelWindowRectChanged;
			}
			return true;
		}

		private bool ShouldUseWrapping(double maxHeight)
		{
			if (ShouldUseRotation() || ShouldUseStagger() || _maxPanelHeight <= 0.0 || !_wrapTextFlag)
			{
				return false;
			}
			double availableCategoryWidth = GetAvailableCategoryWidth();
			double num = (IsUserFont() ? FontSize : MinimumFontSize);
			FontInfo fontWithNewFontSize = FontUtil.GetFontWithNewFontSize(Font, num);
			Rect rect = HorizontalView.MeasureString(LongestNonBreakingLabel, fontWithNewFontSize);
			if (rect.Width > availableCategoryWidth || rect.Height > maxHeight)
			{
				_wrapTextFlag = false;
				return false;
			}
			FontMappingInfo fontMappingInfo = FontInfoMap[(int)num];
			double num2 = 0.0;
			if (fontMappingInfo != null)
			{
				num2 = fontMappingInfo.TallestLabelHeight;
			}
			if (num2 > maxHeight)
			{
				_wrapTextFlag = false;
				return false;
			}
			return true;
		}

		private bool ShouldUseRotation()
		{
			if (IsNumber(Angle))
			{
				if (IsHorizontal(Angle))
				{
					return false;
				}
				return true;
			}
			if (IsNumber(MinimumAngle) && !IsHorizontal(MinimumAngle))
			{
				return true;
			}
			return false;
		}

		private bool ShouldUseStagger()
		{
			if (IsUserStaggerLevels() && NumberOfStaggerLevels > 1)
			{
				return true;
			}
			if (MinimumStaggerLevels > 1 && MaximumStaggerLevels > 1)
			{
				return true;
			}
			return false;
		}

		internal bool IsUserFont()
		{
			if (IsNumber(FontSize) && FontSize >= MinimumFontSize && FontSize <= MaximumFontSize)
			{
				return true;
			}
			return false;
		}

		internal bool IsUserAngle()
		{
			if (IsNumber(Angle))
			{
				return true;
			}
			return false;
		}

		internal bool IsUserStaggerLevels()
		{
			if (IsPositive(NumberOfStaggerLevels) && NumberOfStaggerLevels >= MinimumStaggerLevels && NumberOfStaggerLevels <= MaximumStaggerLevels)
			{
				return true;
			}
			return false;
		}

		internal bool IsUserExtent()
		{
			if (IsNumber(Extent) && Extent >= MinimumExtent && Extent <= MaximumExtent)
			{
				return true;
			}
			return false;
		}

		internal override bool IsHorizontalPanel()
		{
			return true;
		}

		protected internal override void MakeDirty()
		{
			_shouldResize = true;
		}

		internal double CalculateWidthForLabel(string label, double fontSize)
		{
			FontInfo fontInfo = Font.CopyFontInfo();
			fontInfo.FontSize = fontSize;
			return FontUtil.MeasureStringWidth(label, fontInfo);
		}

		private double CalculateTotalWidthForFont(double fontSize)
		{
			if (base.LabelPositions.Count == 0)
			{
				return 0.0;
			}
			if (_visibleLabels.Count == 1)
			{
				return CalculateWidthForLabel(_visibleLabels[0], fontSize);
			}
			double num = CalculateWidthForLabel(_visibleLabels[0], fontSize) / 2.0;
			for (int i = 0; i < _visibleLabels.Count - 1; i++)
			{
				double labelPosition = GetLabelPosition(i);
				double labelPosition2 = GetLabelPosition(i + 1);
				string label = _visibleLabels[i];
				string label2 = _visibleLabels[i + 1];
				double num2 = CalculateWidthForLabel(label, fontSize);
				double num3 = CalculateWidthForLabel(label2, fontSize);
				double num4 = Math.Max(labelPosition2 - labelPosition, num3 / 2.0 + num2 / 2.0);
				num += num4;
			}
			return num + CalculateWidthForLabel(_visibleLabels[_visibleLabels.Count - 1], fontSize) / 2.0;
		}

		private double CalculateFontHeight(double fontSize)
		{
			return FontUtil.GetCurrentFontHeight(FontUtil.GetFontWithNewFontSize(Font, fontSize));
		}

		private double GetSmartAxisSimplifiedAngle(double angle)
		{
			double num = AngleSimplifier.SimplifyAngle(angle);
			if (num > 180.0)
			{
				num %= 180.0;
			}
			return num;
		}

		private double CalculatePanelHeightForTextWrapping(double minHeight, double maxHeight, double minFontSize, double maxFontSize)
		{
			_wrapTextFlag = false;
			double bestFontSizeForWrapping = GetBestFontSizeForWrapping(minFontSize, maxFontSize, maxHeight);
			Size currentBestFontLabelSize = _currentBestFontLabelSize;
			if (bestFontSizeForWrapping == -1.0)
			{
				return -1.0;
			}
			Font.FontSize = bestFontSizeForWrapping;
			_wrapTextFlag = true;
			return Math.Max(currentBestFontLabelSize.Height + TopMargin + base.Axis.ActualTickLength + GetTitleHeightBounds(), minHeight);
		}

		private double GetBestFontSizeForWrapping(double minFontSize, double maxFontSize, double maxHeight)
		{
			double availableCategoryWidth = GetAvailableCategoryWidth();
			Size currentBestFontLabelSize = new Size(0.0, 0.0);
			for (double num = maxFontSize; num >= minFontSize; num -= 1.0)
			{
				FontInfo fontWithNewFontSize = FontUtil.GetFontWithNewFontSize(Font, num);
				if (!(FontUtil.MeasureStringWidth(LongestNonBreakingLabel, fontWithNewFontSize) > availableCategoryWidth))
				{
					double num2 = 1000.0;
					GetTallestLabel(availableCategoryWidth, fontWithNewFontSize);
					num2 = FontInfoMap[(int)num].TallestLabelHeight;
					if (num2 <= maxHeight)
					{
						currentBestFontLabelSize.Width = availableCategoryWidth;
						currentBestFontLabelSize.Height = num2;
						_currentBestFontLabelSize = currentBestFontLabelSize;
						ActualFontSize = num;
						return num;
					}
				}
			}
			return -1.0;
		}

		private void CreateLabelMapForTextWrapping(double fontSizeToUse, double labelHeight)
		{
			_labelMap.Clear();
			_labelMap.Add(new List<Rect>());
			double availableCategoryWidth = GetAvailableCategoryWidth();
			double y = ResolveTopMargin() + base.LabelViewport.Top;
			for (int i = 0; i < _visibleLabels.Count; i++)
			{
				double x = GetLabelPosition(i) - availableCategoryWidth / 2.0;
				Rect item = new Rect(x, y, availableCategoryWidth, labelHeight);
				_labelMap[0].Add(item);
			}
		}

		private double CalculatePanelHeight(double minHeight, double maxHeight, double availableWidth, double minAngle, double maxAngle, double minFontSize, double maxFontSize)
		{
			if (IsUserFont())
			{
				double num = FontSize;
				if (num < minFontSize)
				{
					num = minFontSize;
				}
				if (num > maxFontSize)
				{
					num = maxFontSize;
				}
				minFontSize = (maxFontSize = num);
				ActualFontSize = num;
			}
			if (ShouldUseWrapping(maxHeight))
			{
				double num2 = CalculatePanelHeightForTextWrapping(minHeight, maxHeight, minFontSize, maxFontSize);
				if (num2 != -1.0)
				{
					ActualNumberOfStaggerLevels = 1;
					return num2 + 1.0;
				}
			}
			if (!ShouldUseRotation() && DetermineNumberOfStaggerLevels(availableWidth, maxHeight) > 0)
			{
				return CalculateFontHeight(ActualFontSize) * (double)ActualNumberOfStaggerLevels + ResolveTopMargin();
			}
			double num3 = CalculateWidthForLabel(LongestLabel, minFontSize);
			double num4 = CalculateFontHeight(minFontSize);
			double titleHeightBounds = GetTitleHeightBounds();
			double num5 = titleHeightBounds;
			double availableCategoryWidth = GetAvailableCategoryWidth();
			ActualFontSize = minFontSize;
			if (IsUserAngle())
			{
				return Math.Min(maxHeight, TopMargin + titleHeightBounds + base.Axis.ActualTickLength + num4 + num3 * Math.Abs(Math.Sin(ActualAngle * (Math.PI / 180.0))));
			}
			if (num4 > availableCategoryWidth)
			{
				return titleHeightBounds;
			}
			CategoryAxisBase obj = (CategoryAxisBase)base.Axis;
			double num6 = availableCategoryWidth / 2.0;
			if (obj.CategoryMode == CategoryMode.Mode0)
			{
				num6 = 0.0;
			}
			_ = _allLabels[0];
			string text = _allLabels[_allLabels.Count - 1];
			FontInfo fontWithNewFontSize = FontUtil.GetFontWithNewFontSize(Font, minFontSize);
			Rect rect = HorizontalView.GetSeriesViewerViewContainer();
			if (base.LabelViewport.Width > 0.0 && base.LabelViewport.Width < rect.Width)
			{
				rect = base.LabelViewport;
			}
			num5 = ((base.LabelViewport.Right + HorizontalView.MeasureStringWidth(text, fontWithNewFontSize) / Math.Sqrt(2.0) - num6 > rect.Width) ? (TopMargin + num3 + titleHeightBounds + base.Axis.ActualTickLength) : (TopMargin + titleHeightBounds + base.Axis.ActualTickLength + (num4 + num3) * Math.Sin(Math.PI / 4.0) + (num4 - num4 * Math.Sin(Math.PI / 4.0))));
			double num7 = 1.0;
			num5 = Math.Ceiling(num5 + num7);
			if (num5 > maxHeight)
			{
				return titleHeightBounds;
			}
			return num5 + 1.0;
		}

		private double CalculatePanelHeightWithNoRotation(double availableWidth, double minHeight, double maxHeight, double minFontSize, double maxFontSize)
		{
			double num = (minFontSize + maxFontSize) / 2.0;
			int num2 = 0;
			double num3 = 0.0;
			double val = 0.0;
			bool num4 = IsUserFont();
			bool flag = IsUserStaggerLevels();
			if (num4)
			{
				num3 = CalculateFontHeight(FontSize);
				if (flag)
				{
					ActualNumberOfStaggerLevels = NumberOfStaggerLevels;
					val = num3 * (double)NumberOfStaggerLevels + TopMargin;
				}
				else
				{
					double num5 = CalculateTotalWidthForFont(FontSize);
					for (int i = 1; i <= MaximumStaggerLevels; i++)
					{
						if (num5 / (double)i <= availableWidth)
						{
							ActualNumberOfStaggerLevels = i;
							val = num3 * (double)i + TopMargin;
							break;
						}
					}
				}
			}
			else
			{

						continue;

						{

							val = num3 * (double)j + TopMargin;
							break;
						}
					}

			}

		}

		private bool FoundHorizontalCollisions(List<Rect> rects, Rect containerBounds)
		{
			if (rects == null || rects.Count == 0)
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (rects.Count == 1)
			{
				Rect rect = rects[0];
				if (rect.Width > containerBounds.Width || rect.Bottom > containerBounds.Bottom)
				{
					return true;
				}
			}
			for (int i = 0; i < rects.Count - 1; i++)
			{
				Rect rect2 = rects[i];
				Rect rect3 = rects[i + 1];
				if (rect2.Right + ProximityMargin > rect3.Left || rect2.Right > containerBounds.Right || rect3.Right > containerBounds.Right || rect2.Bottom > containerBounds.Bottom || rect3.Bottom > containerBounds.Bottom)
				{
					return true;
				}
			}
			return false;
		}

		private bool FoundAngledCollisions(List<Rect> rects, double angle, Rect containerBounds, double fontSizeToUse)
		{
			if (rects == null)
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (rects.Count == 1)
			{
				Rect rect = rects[0];
				Rect rect2 = rect.RotateAboutPoint(rect.X, rect.Y + rect.Height / 2.0, angle);
				if (!containerBounds.Contains(rect2))
				{
					return true;
				}
			}
			for (int i = 0; i < rects.Count - 1; i++)
			{
				Rect rect3 = rects[i];
				Rect rect4 = rects[i + 1];
				double num = (rect4.Left - rect3.Left) * Math.Sin(angle * (Math.PI / 180.0));
				Rect rect5 = new Rect(rect4.Left, rect4.Top - num, rect4.Width, rect4.Height);
				if (rect3.IntersectsWith(rect5))
				{
					return true;
				}
				Rect rect6 = rect3.RotateAboutPoint(rect3.X, rect3.Y + rect3.Height / 2.0, angle);
				Rect rect7 = rect4.RotateAboutPoint(rect4.X, rect4.Y + rect4.Height / 2.0, angle);
				rect6.Y = rect3.Top;
				rect7.Y = rect4.Top;
				if (!containerBounds.Contains(rect6))
				{
					return true;
				}
				if (!containerBounds.Contains(rect7))
				{
					return true;
				}
			}
			return false;
		}

		private void CreateLabelMap(int staggerLevels, double fontSizeToUse, double fontHeight, bool rotated)
		{
			_labelMap.Clear();

			for (int i = 0; i < staggerLevels; i++)

				double x = (rotated ? GetLabelPosition(j) : (GetLabelPosition(j) - num / 2.0));
				Rect item = new Rect(x, y, num, fontHeight);
				_labelMap[j % staggerLevels].Add(item);
			}
			if (rotated)
			{
				return;
			}
			for (int k = 0; k < staggerLevels; k++)
			{
				Rect value = _labelMap[k][0];
				Rect value2 = _labelMap[k][_labelMap[k].Count - 1];
				if (value.Left < 0.0)
				{
					double num2 = 0.0 - value.Left;
					value.X += num2;

				}
				if (value2.Right > _actualPanelBounds.Right)
				{
					double num3 = value2.Right - _actualPanelBounds.Right;
					value2.X -= num3;
					_labelMap[k][_labelMap[k].Count - 1] = value2;
				}
			}
		}

			}

				}

						}
					}
				}
			}

				}

		private void SetRotationTransform(FrameworkElement textBlock, double angle, int index, double anchorX, FontInfo font, double fontHeight)
		{
			Point point = new Point(anchorX, HorizontalSmartAxisModel.TopMargin);
			double num = HorizontalSmartAxisModel.LabelViewport.Top + HorizontalSmartAxisModel.ResolveTopMargin() + point.Y;
			TransformGroup transformGroup = new TransformGroup();
			TranslateTransform translateTransform = new TranslateTransform();
			RotateTransform rotateTransform = new RotateTransform();
			if (angle > 0.0 && angle <= 90.0)
			{
				translateTransform.X = point.X - fontHeight / 2.0 * Math.Sin(angle * (Math.PI / 180.0));
				rotateTransform.Angle = angle;
			}
			else
			{
				double num2 = FontUtil.MeasureStringWidth((textBlock is TextBlock) ? ((TextBlock)textBlock).Text : GetLabel(textBlock), font);
				translateTransform.X = point.X - num2 + fontHeight / 2.0 * Math.Cos(angle * (Math.PI / 180.0));
				rotateTransform.Angle = angle + 180.0;
			}
			translateTransform.Y = num;
			rotateTransform.CenterX = point.X;
			rotateTransform.CenterY = num + fontHeight / 2.0;
			transformGroup.Children.Add(translateTransform);
			transformGroup.Children.Add(rotateTransform);
			textBlock.RenderTransform = transformGroup;
		}

		internal void ArrangeTextBlocksForWrapping(List<Rect> labelBounds, Size labelSize, double availableCategoryWidth)
		{
			int num = 0;
			foreach (FrameworkElement label in GetLabels())
			{
				double x = HorizontalSmartAxisModel.GetLabelPosition(num) - availableCategoryWidth / 2.0;
				double y = labelBounds[num].Y;
				double height = labelSize.Height;
				Rect arrangeBounds = new Rect(x, y, availableCategoryWidth, height);
				ArrangeTextblockWithoutRotation(label, num, arrangeBounds, useWrapping: true);
				num++;
			}
		}

		internal void ArrangeTextblocskWithoutRotation(List<Rect> labelBounds, double fontHeight)
		{
			int num = 0;
			foreach (FrameworkElement label in GetLabels())
			{
				double x = labelBounds[num].X;
				double y = labelBounds[num].Y + HorizontalSmartAxisModel.LabelViewport.Top + fontHeight * (double)(num % HorizontalSmartAxisModel.ActualNumberOfStaggerLevels);
				double width = double.PositiveInfinity;
				double height = double.PositiveInfinity;
				Rect arrangeBounds = new Rect(x, y, width, height);
				ArrangeTextblockWithoutRotation(label, num, arrangeBounds, useWrapping: false);
				num++;
			}
		}

		internal void ArrangeTextblocksWithRotation(FontInfo font, double fontHeight, double availableHeight)
		{
			if (availableHeight == 0.0)
			{
				HideAllLabels();
				return;
			}
			int num = 0;
			foreach (FrameworkElement label in GetLabels())
			{
				ArrangeTextblockWithRotation(label, num, HorizontalSmartAxisModel.ActualAngle, HorizontalSmartAxisModel.GetLabelPosition(num), font, fontHeight);
				num++;
			}
		}

		internal void HideAllLabels()
		{
			foreach (FrameworkElement label in GetLabels())
			{
				label.Visibility = Visibility.Collapsed;
			}
		}

		internal List<string> SplitString(string label, char[] delimiters)
		{
			return new List<string>(FontUtil.SplitString(label, delimiters));
		}

		internal Size GetEmptySize()
		{
			return Size.Empty;
		}

		internal double MeasureStringWidth(string text, FontInfo fontInfo)
		{
			return FontUtil.MeasureStringWidth(text, fontInfo);
		}

		internal double MeasureStringHeight(string text, FontInfo fontInfo)
		{
			return HorizontalSmartAxisModel.FetchFontHeightForFontSize((int)fontInfo.FontSize.Value);
		}

		internal double MeasureStringHeight(string text, double fontSize)
		{
			return HorizontalSmartAxisModel.FetchFontHeightForFontSize((int)fontSize);
		}

		internal Rect MeasureString(string text, FontInfo fontInfo)
		{
			double width = FontUtil.MeasureStringWidth(text, fontInfo);
			double height = HorizontalSmartAxisModel.FetchFontHeightForFontSize((int)fontInfo.FontSize.Value);
			return new Rect(0.0, 0.0, width, height);
		}
	}

	internal class XamDoughnutChartView
	{
		protected XamDoughnutChart Model { get; set; }

		internal Canvas Root { get; set; }

		internal ContentControl CenterPresenter { get; set; }

		public Rect Viewport { get; set; }

		public XamDoughnutChartView(XamDoughnutChart model)

			Viewport = Rect.Empty;
			Model = model;
		}

		public virtual void OnInit()
		{
			Root = new Canvas();
			Root.SizeChanged += delegate

				SizeUpdated();
			};
			CenterPresenter = new ContentControl();

			CenterPresenter.HorizontalContentAlignment = HorizontalAlignment.Stretch;
			Root.Children.Add(CenterPresenter);
		}

		internal void OnContentPresenterProvided()
		{
			Model.ContentPresenter.Content = Root;
		}

		internal void OnTemplateProvided()
		{
			CenterPresenter.SetBinding(ContentControl.ContentProperty, new Binding("CenterData")
			{
				Source = Model
			});
			CenterPresenter.SetBinding(ContentControl.ContentTemplateProperty, new Binding("CenterDataTemplate")
			{
				Source = Model
			});
			Model.RenderChart();
		}

		internal void ProvideContainer(object container)
		{
		}

		internal void UpdateView()
		{
		}

		internal void PositonCenterPresenter(double x, double y)
		{
			Canvas.SetLeft(CenterPresenter, x);
			Canvas.SetTop(CenterPresenter, y);
		}

		internal void AddSeries(RingSeriesBase series)
		{
			if (!Root.Children.Contains(series))
			{
				Root.Children.Add(series);
			}
		}

		internal void RemoveSeries(RingSeriesBase series)
		{
			if (Root.Children.Contains(series))
			{
				Root.Children.Remove(series);
			}
			series.RenderLegendItems();
		}

		internal void ClearSeries()
		{
			foreach (object child in Root.Children)
			{
				if (child is RingSeriesBase)
				{
					((RingSeriesBase)child).ClearView();
				}
			}
		}

		private void SizeUpdated()
		{
			Viewport = new Rect(0.0, 0.0, Root.RenderSize.Width, Root.RenderSize.Height);
			Model.OnSizeUpdated();
		}

		internal void EnsureCenterPresenter()
		{
			if (!Root.Children.Contains(CenterPresenter))
			{
				Root.Children.Add(CenterPresenter);
			}
		}

		internal void SetCenterPresenterSize(double width, double height)
		{
			CenterPresenter.Width = width;
			CenterPresenter.Height = height;
		}

		protected internal virtual void ExportViewShapes(DoughnutChartVisualData doughnutChart)
		{
			doughnutChart.Width = Model.ActualWidth;
			doughnutChart.Height = Model.ActualHeight;
			doughnutChart.HoleRadius = Model.Height / 2.0 * Model.InnerExtent / 100.0 * Model.Series[0].RadiusFactor;
			for (int i = 0; i < Model.Series.Count; i++)
			{
				doughnutChart.Series.Add(new RingSeriesVisualData());
				doughnutChart.Series[i].Rings = new RingVisualDataList();
				doughnutChart.Series[i].Name = Model.Series[i].Name;
				doughnutChart.Series[i].LabelExtent = Model.Series[i].LabelExtent;
				doughnutChart.Series[i].LeaderLineMargin = Model.Series[i].LeaderLineMargin;
				doughnutChart.Series[i].LeaderLineVisibility = Model.Series[i].LeaderLineVisibility == Visibility.Visible;
				doughnutChart.Series[i].LeaderLineType = Model.Series[i].LeaderLineType.ToString();
				doughnutChart.Series[i].LabelsPosition = Model.Series[i].LabelsPosition.ToString();
				for (int j = 0; j < Model.Series[i].AnalyzeRings().Count; j++)
				{
					doughnutChart.Series[i].Rings.Add(new RingVisualData());
					doughnutChart.Series[i].Rings[j].Arcs = new ArcVisualDataList();
					for (int k = 0; k < Model.Series[i].AnalyzeRings()[j].ArcItems.Count; k++)
					{
						doughnutChart.Series[i].Rings[j].Arcs.Add(new ArcVisualData());
						doughnutChart.Series[i].Rings[j].Arcs[k].Slices = new SliceVisualDataList();
						for (int l = 0; l < Model.Series[i].AnalyzeRings()[j].ArcItems[k].SliceItems.Count; l++)
						{
							if (Model.Series[i].AnalyzeRings()[j].ArcItems[k].SliceItems[l].Slice == null)
							{
								continue;
							}
							doughnutChart.Series[i].Rings[j].Arcs[k].Slices.Add(new SliceVisualData());
							SliceVisualData sliceVisualData = new SliceVisualData();
							Slice slice = Model.Series[i].AnalyzeRings()[j].ArcItems[k].SliceItems[l].Slice;
							sliceVisualData.Visibility = slice.Visibility == Visibility.Visible;
							sliceVisualData.EndAngle = slice.EndAngle;
							sliceVisualData.StartAngle = slice.StartAngle;
							sliceVisualData.Radius = slice.Radius;
							sliceVisualData.Origin = PointData.FromPoint(slice.Origin);
							sliceVisualData.ExplodedOrigin = PointData.FromPoint(slice.ExplodedOrigin);
							sliceVisualData.Index = slice.Index;
							sliceVisualData.IsExploded = slice.IsExploded;
							sliceVisualData.IsSelected = slice.IsSelected;
							sliceVisualData.Outline = AppearanceHelper.FromBrushExtended(slice.BorderBrush);
							sliceVisualData.BackgroundPath = new PathVisualData("slicePath", slice.View.GetSlicePath());
							doughnutChart.Series[i].Rings[j].Arcs[k].Slices[l] = sliceVisualData;
							PieLabel label = slice.Label;
							if (label != null)
							{
								doughnutChart.Series[i].Rings[j].Arcs[k].Slices[l].LabelVisualData = new DoughnutChartLabelVisualData
								{
									LabelSize = SizeData.FromSize(label.Bounds.Size()),
									LabelValue = ((TextBlock)label.Label).Text
								};
								if (!double.IsNaN(label.Bounds.Left) && !double.IsNaN(label.Bounds.Top))
								{
									doughnutChart.Series[i].Rings[j].Arcs[k].Slices[l].LabelVisualData.LabelPosition = new PointData(label.Bounds.Left, label.Bounds.Top);
								}
							}
						}
					}
				}
			}
		}

		public void OnDetachedFromUI()
		{
		}

		public void OnAttachedToUI()
		{
		}
	}

			}
		}

		protected override void RepopulateAxisBasedOn(DataSeries ds)
		{
			if (ds.SuggestedPrimaryAxis == DataSeriesAxisType.Logarithmic)
			{
				XAxis.IsLogarithmic = true;
				XAxis.LogarithmBase = 10;
			}
			if (ds.SuggestedSecondaryAxis == DataSeriesAxisType.Logarithmic)
			{
				YAxis.IsLogarithmic = true;
				YAxis.LogarithmBase = 10;
			}
		}

		protected override bool IsValid(DataSeries ds)
		{
			if (!base.IsValid(ds))
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (ds.SuggestedPrimaryAxis != DataSeriesAxisType.Linear && ds.SuggestedPrimaryAxis != DataSeriesAxisType.Logarithmic)
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (ds.SuggestedSecondaryAxis != DataSeriesAxisType.Linear && ds.SuggestedSecondaryAxis != DataSeriesAxisType.Logarithmic)
			{
				return false;
			}
			return true;
		}

		protected override void ResetAxes()
		{
			XAxis.IsLogarithmic = XAxisIsLogarithmic;
			YAxis.IsLogarithmic = YAxisIsLogarithmic;
			XAxis.LogarithmBase = XAxisLogarithmBase;
			YAxis.LogarithmBase = YAxisLogarithmBase;
		}

		protected override Series CreateSeries(DataSeries ds, DataSeriesType resolvedSeries)
		{
			Series series = null;
			switch (resolvedSeries)
			{
			case DataSeriesType.ScatterPoint:
			case DataSeriesType.ScatterLine:
			case DataSeriesType.ScatterSpline:
				series = CreateScatterBasicSeries(ds, resolvedSeries);
				break;
			case DataSeriesType.ScatterBubble:
				series = CreateScatterBubbleSeries(ds);
				break;
			case DataSeriesType.ScatterHighDensity:
				series = CreateScatterHDSeries(ds);
				break;
			case DataSeriesType.ScatterArea:
				series = CreateScatterAreaSeries(ds);
				break;
			case DataSeriesType.ScatterContour:
				series = CreateScatterContourSeries(ds);
				break;
			}
			if (series is ScatterBase)
			{
				(series as ScatterBase).XAxis = XAxis;
				(series as ScatterBase).YAxis = YAxis;
				(series as ScatterBase).MaximumMarkers = base.MarkerMaxCount;
				(series as ScatterBase).MarkerCollisionAvoidance = MarkerCollision;
			}
			else if (series is ScatterTriangulationSeries)
			{
				(series as ScatterTriangulationSeries).XAxis = XAxis;
				(series as ScatterTriangulationSeries).YAxis = YAxis;
			}
			else if (series is HighDensityScatterSeries)
			{
				(series as HighDensityScatterSeries).XAxis = XAxis;
				(series as HighDensityScatterSeries).YAxis = YAxis;
			}
			return series;
		}

		private Series CreateScatterBasicSeries(DataSeries ds, DataSeriesType resolvedSeries)
		{
			ScatterBase scatterBase = resolvedSeries switch
			{
				DataSeriesType.ScatterLine => new ScatterLineSeries(), 
				DataSeriesType.ScatterSpline => new ScatterSplineSeries(), 
				_ => new ScatterSeries(), 
			};
			scatterBase.XMemberPath = ds.GetMemberPathFor(DataSeriesIntent.SeriesX);
			scatterBase.YMemberPath = ds.GetMemberPathFor(DataSeriesIntent.SeriesY);
			return scatterBase;
		}

		private Series CreateScatterHDSeries(DataSeries ds)
		{
			return new HighDensityScatterSeries
			{
				XMemberPath = ds.GetMemberPathFor(DataSeriesIntent.SeriesX),
				YMemberPath = ds.GetMemberPathFor(DataSeriesIntent.SeriesY),
				HeatMinimumColor = GetPaletteColor(ds.Index),
				HeatMaximumColor = ColorUtil.FromString("Black"),
				MouseOverEnabled = true
			};
		}

		private Series CreateScatterBubbleSeries(DataSeries ds)
		{
			Color paletteColor = GetPaletteColor(ds.Index);
			ValueBrushScale valueBrushScale = new ValueBrushScale();
			valueBrushScale.Brushes = GetPaletteBrushes(paletteColor);
			BubbleSeries bubbleSeries = new BubbleSeries();
			bubbleSeries.XMemberPath = ds.GetMemberPathFor(DataSeriesIntent.SeriesX);
			bubbleSeries.YMemberPath = ds.GetMemberPathFor(DataSeriesIntent.SeriesY);
			bubbleSeries.LabelMemberPath = ds.GetMemberPathFor(DataSeriesIntent.SeriesLabel);
			bubbleSeries.RadiusMemberPath = ds.GetMemberPathFor(DataSeriesIntent.SeriesRadius);
			bubbleSeries.RadiusScale = new SizeScale
			{
				MinimumValue = 10.0,
				MaximumValue = 50.0
			};
			if (ds.HasMatchingHint(DataSeriesIntent.SeriesFill))
			{
				bubbleSeries.FillScale = valueBrushScale;
				bubbleSeries.FillMemberPath = ds.GetMemberPathFor(DataSeriesIntent.SeriesFill);
			}
			return bubbleSeries;
		}

		private Series CreateScatterContourSeries(DataSeries ds)
		{
			Color paletteColor = GetPaletteColor(ds.Index);
			ValueBrushScale valueBrushScale = new ValueBrushScale();
			valueBrushScale.Brushes = GetPaletteBrushes(paletteColor);
			ScatterContourSeries scatterContourSeries = new ScatterContourSeries();
			scatterContourSeries.XMemberPath = ds.GetMemberPathFor(DataSeriesIntent.SeriesX);
			scatterContourSeries.YMemberPath = ds.GetMemberPathFor(DataSeriesIntent.SeriesY);
			if (ds.HasMatchingHint(DataSeriesIntent.SeriesValue))
			{
				scatterContourSeries.FillScale = valueBrushScale;
				scatterContourSeries.ValueMemberPath = ds.GetMemberPathFor(DataSeriesIntent.SeriesValue);
			}
			else if (ds.HasMatchingHint(DataSeriesIntent.SeriesFill))
			{
				scatterContourSeries.FillScale = valueBrushScale;
				scatterContourSeries.ValueMemberPath = ds.GetMemberPathFor(DataSeriesIntent.SeriesFill);
			}
			return scatterContourSeries;
		}

		private Series CreateScatterAreaSeries(DataSeries ds)
		{
			Color paletteColor = GetPaletteColor(ds.Index);
			CustomPaletteColorScale customPaletteColorScale = new CustomPaletteColorScale();
			customPaletteColorScale.InterpolationMode = ColorScaleInterpolationMode.InterpolateHSV;
			customPaletteColorScale.Palette = GetPaletteColors(paletteColor);
			ScatterAreaSeries scatterAreaSeries = new ScatterAreaSeries();
			scatterAreaSeries.XMemberPath = ds.GetMemberPathFor(DataSeriesIntent.SeriesX);
			scatterAreaSeries.YMemberPath = ds.GetMemberPathFor(DataSeriesIntent.SeriesY);
			scatterAreaSeries.Opacity = 0.6;
			if (ds.HasMatchingHint(DataSeriesIntent.SeriesFill))
			{
				scatterAreaSeries.ColorMemberPath = ds.GetMemberPathFor(DataSeriesIntent.SeriesFill);
				scatterAreaSeries.ColorScale = customPaletteColorScale;
			}
			else if (ds.HasMatchingHint(DataSeriesIntent.SeriesValue))
			{
				scatterAreaSeries.ColorMemberPath = ds.GetMemberPathFor(DataSeriesIntent.SeriesValue);
				scatterAreaSeries.ColorScale = customPaletteColorScale;
			}
			return scatterAreaSeries;
		}

		protected override Axis GetXAxis()
		{
			return XAxis;
		}

		protected override Axis GetYAxis()
		{
			return YAxis;
		}

		protected override void CreateAxes()
		{
			XAxis = new NumericXAxis();
			XAxis.Name = "xAxis";
			XAxis.PropertyChanged += OnXAxisPropertyChanged;
			YAxis = new NumericYAxis();
			YAxis.Name = "yAxis";
			YAxis.PropertyChanged += OnYAxisPropertyChanged;
			if (XAxis.LabelSettings == null)
			{
				XAxis.LabelSettings = new AxisLabelSettings();
			}
			if (YAxis.LabelSettings == null)
			{
				YAxis.LabelSettings = new AxisLabelSettings();
			}
		}

		protected virtual void OnXAxisPropertyChanged(object sender, PropertyChangedEventArgs e)
		{
			string propertyName = e.PropertyName;
			if (!(propertyName == "ActualMinimumValue"))
			{
				if (propertyName == "ActualMaximumValue")
				{
					RaisePropertyChanged("XAxisActualMaximum");
				}
			}
			else
			{
				RaisePropertyChanged("XAxisActualMinimum");
			}
		}

		protected virtual void OnYAxisPropertyChanged(object sender, PropertyChangedEventArgs e)
		{
			string propertyName = e.PropertyName;
			if (!(propertyName == "ActualMinimumValue"))
			{
				if (propertyName == "ActualMaximumValue")
				{
					RaisePropertyChanged("YAxisActualMaximum");
				}
			}
			else
			{
				RaisePropertyChanged("YAxisActualMinimum");
			}
		}

		protected override void ApplyMarkers(Series series, int index)
		{
			if (series is ScatterBase scatterBase)
			{
				scatterBase.MarkerCollisionAvoidance = MarkerCollision;
				scatterBase.MarkerType = ResolveMarkerType(series, index);
				scatterBase.MaximumMarkers = base.MarkerMaxCount;
			}
		}

		protected override void InitializeYAxis(Axis yAxis)
		{
			base.InitializeYAxis(yAxis);
			((NumericYAxis)yAxis).AbbreviateLargeNumbers = YAxisAbbreviateLargeNumbers;
		}

		protected override void InitializeXAxis(Axis xAxis)
		{
			base.InitializeXAxis(xAxis);
			((NumericXAxis)xAxis).AbbreviateLargeNumbers = XAxisAbbreviateLargeNumbers;
		}

		protected override void OnPropertyUpdated(string propertyName, object oldValue, object newValue)
		{
			base.OnPropertyUpdated(propertyName, oldValue, newValue);
			switch (propertyName)
			{
			case "XAxisInterval":
				XAxis.Interval = XAxisInterval;
				break;
			case "YAxisInterval":
				YAxis.Interval = YAxisInterval;
				break;
			case "XAxisMinorInterval":
				XAxis.MinorInterval = XAxisMinorInterval;
				break;
			case "YAxisMinorInterval":
				YAxis.MinorInterval = YAxisMinorInterval;
				break;
			case "XAxisIsLogarithmic":
				XAxis.IsLogarithmic = XAxisIsLogarithmic;
				break;
			case "YAxisIsLogarithmic":
				YAxis.IsLogarithmic = YAxisIsLogarithmic;
				break;
			case "XAxisLogarithmBase":
				XAxis.LogarithmBase = XAxisLogarithmBase;
				break;
			case "YAxisLogarithmBase":
				YAxis.LogarithmBase = YAxisLogarithmBase;
				break;
			case "XAxisMinimumValue":
				XAxis.MinimumValue = XAxisMinimumValue;
				break;
			case "YAxisMinimumValue":
				YAxis.MinimumValue = YAxisMinimumValue;
				break;
			case "XAxisMaximumValue":
				XAxis.MaximumValue = XAxisMaximumValue;
				break;
			case "YAxisMaximumValue":
				YAxis.MaximumValue = YAxisMaximumValue;
				break;
			case "MarkerCollision":
				ForEachDataSeries(delegate(Series series, int i)
				{
					ApplyMarkers(series, i);
				});
				break;
			case "XAxisAbbreviateLargeNumbers":
				OnXAxis(delegate(Axis axis)
				{
					((NumericXAxis)axis).AbbreviateLargeNumbers = XAxisAbbreviateLargeNumbers;
				});
				break;
			case "YAxisAbbreviateLargeNumbers":
				OnYAxis(delegate(Axis axis)
				{
					((NumericYAxis)axis).AbbreviateLargeNumbers = YAxisAbbreviateLargeNumbers;
				});
				break;
			}
		}

		protected override void PropertyUpdatedOverride(string propertyName, object oldValue, object newValue)
		{
			base.PropertyUpdatedOverride(propertyName, oldValue, newValue);
		}

		protected override void PropertyUpdatedOverridePlatform(string propertyName, object oldValue, object newValue)
		{
			base.PropertyUpdatedOverridePlatform(propertyName, oldValue, newValue);
		}
	}

		protected override List<DataSeriesType> SupportedDataSeries => new List<DataSeriesType>
		{
			DataSeriesType.Area,
			DataSeriesType.Column,

		[DontObfuscate]
		[TSSuppressSynthesizedInitializer]
		private CategoryXAxis XAxis { get; set; }

		[DontObfuscate]
		[TSSuppressSynthesizedInitializer]
		private NumericYAxis YAxis { get; set; }

		protected override List<IDataSeriesAdapterRule> SupportedDataRules => new List<IDataSeriesAdapterRule>
		{
			new SimpleCategorySeriesRule(),
			new SubCollectionsRule()
		};

		internal override XamDomainChart CreateExternalObject()
		{
			XamCategoryChart xamCategoryChart = new XamCategoryChart(this);
			xamCategoryChart.OnImplementation_PropertyChanged(string.Empty);
			return xamCategoryChart;
		}

		protected override void InitializeChart(XamDataChart dataChart)
		{
			base.InitializeChart(dataChart);
			dataChart.AnimateSeriesWhenAxisRangeChanges = base.AnimateSeriesWhenAxisRangeChanges;
		}

		protected override void InitializeSeries(Series series, int index)
		{
			base.InitializeSeries(series, index);
			if (series is HorizontalAnchoredCategorySeries horizontalAnchoredCategorySeries)
			{
				horizontalAnchoredCategorySeries.MarkerCollisionAvoidance = MarkerCollisionAvoidance;
				horizontalAnchoredCategorySeries.IsTransitionInEnabled = IsTransitionInEnabled;
				horizontalAnchoredCategorySeries.TransitionInMode = TransitionInMode;
				horizontalAnchoredCategorySeries.TransitionInSpeedType = TransitionInSpeedType;
				horizontalAnchoredCategorySeries.TrendLineBrush = base.TrendLineBrushes.GetModulus(index);
				horizontalAnchoredCategorySeries.TrendLineType = base.TrendLineType;
				horizontalAnchoredCategorySeries.TrendLineThickness = base.TrendLineThickness;
				horizontalAnchoredCategorySeries.MarkerType = ResolveMarkerType(series, index);
				if (series.IsNegativeColorSupported)
				{
					series.SetNegativeColors(NegativeBrushes.GetModulus(index), NegativeOutlines.GetModulus(index));
				}
			}
		}

		private CategoryXAxis CreateXAxis()
		{
			return new CategoryXAxis();
		}

		private NumericYAxis CreateYAxis()
		{
			return new NumericYAxis();
		}

		protected override void CreateAxes()
		{
			XAxis = CreateXAxis();
			XAxis.Name = "xAxis";
			XAxis.PropertyChanged += HandleXAxisPropertyChanged;
			YAxis = CreateYAxis();
			YAxis.Name = "yAxis";
			YAxis.PropertyChanged += HandleYAxisPropertyChanged;
			if (XAxis.LabelSettings == null)
			{
				XAxis.LabelSettings = new AxisLabelSettings();
			}
			if (YAxis.LabelSettings == null)
			{
				YAxis.LabelSettings = new AxisLabelSettings();
			}
		}

		protected override void InitializeYAxis(Axis yAxis)
		{
			base.InitializeYAxis(yAxis);
			((NumericYAxis)yAxis).AbbreviateLargeNumbers = YAxisAbbreviateLargeNumbers;
		}

		{
			return XAxisActualMinimum;
		}

		{
			return YAxisActualMinimum;
		}

		public double GetCurrentXAxisActualMaximum()
		{
			return XAxisActualMaximum;
		}

		public double GetCurrentYAxisActualMaximum()
		{
			return YAxisActualMaximum;
		}

		public CategoryChart()
		{
			EnsureAxesInitialized();
		}

		protected override IEnumerable ResolveMockData()
		{
			if (_mockData == null)
			{
				_mockData = CategoryChartMockDataGenerator.Generate();
			}
			return _mockData;
		}

		private void HandleXAxisPropertyChanged(object sender, PropertyChangedEventArgs e)
		{
			string propertyName = e.PropertyName;
			if (!(propertyName == "ActualMinimum"))
			{
				if (propertyName == "ActualMaximum")
				{
					RaisePropertyChanged("XAxisActualMaximum");
				}
			}
			else
			{
				RaisePropertyChanged("XAxisActualMinimum");
			}
		}

		private void HandleYAxisPropertyChanged(object sender, PropertyChangedEventArgs e)
		{
			string propertyName = e.PropertyName;
			if (!(propertyName == "ActualMinimumValue"))
			{
				if (propertyName == "ActualMaximumValue")
				{
					RaisePropertyChanged("YAxisActualMaximum");
				}
			}
			else
			{
				RaisePropertyChanged("YAxisActualMinimum");
			}
		}

		protected override void RepopulateSeriesFromDataAdapter()
		{
			base.RepopulateSeriesFromDataAdapter();
			XAxis.Label = ((base.XAxisLabel == null) ? XYChart.GetXAxisLabel(XAxis, base.DataAdapter.DataSeries) : base.XAxisLabel);
			XAxis.ItemsSource = ((base.DataChart != null && base.DataChart.Series.Count > 0) ? base.DataChart.Series[0].ItemsSource : null);
		}

		private HorizontalAnchoredCategorySeries SeriesFromChartType(CategoryChartType chartType, DataSeriesType suggestedType)
		{
			return chartType switch
			{
				CategoryChartType.Column => new ColumnSeries(), 
				CategoryChartType.Point => new PointSeries(), 
				CategoryChartType.Line => new LineSeries(), 
				CategoryChartType.Area => new AreaSeries(), 
				CategoryChartType.Spline => new SplineSeries(), 
				CategoryChartType.SplineArea => new SplineAreaSeries(), 
				CategoryChartType.StepLine => new StepLineSeries(), 
				CategoryChartType.StepArea => new StepAreaSeries(), 
				CategoryChartType.Waterfall => new WaterfallSeries(), 
				CategoryChartType.Auto => GetSeriesFromSuggestedSeriesType(suggestedType), 
				_ => new ColumnSeries(), 
			};
		}

		private HorizontalAnchoredCategorySeries GetSeriesFromSuggestedSeriesType(DataSeriesType suggestedType)
		{
			return suggestedType switch
			{
				DataSeriesType.Area => new AreaSeries(), 
				DataSeriesType.Column => new ColumnSeries(), 
				DataSeriesType.Line => new LineSeries(), 
				DataSeriesType.Point => new PointSeries(), 
				DataSeriesType.Spline => new SplineSeries(), 
				DataSeriesType.SplineArea => new SplineAreaSeries(), 
				DataSeriesType.StepArea => new StepAreaSeries(), 
				DataSeriesType.StepLine => new StepLineSeries(), 
				DataSeriesType.Waterfall => new WaterfallSeries(), 
				_ => new ColumnSeries(), 
			};
		}

		protected override DataSeriesType GetSeriesType(DataSeries ds)
		{
			return ChartType switch
			{
				CategoryChartType.Area => DataSeriesType.Area, 
				CategoryChartType.Line => DataSeriesType.Line, 
				CategoryChartType.Point => DataSeriesType.Point, 
				CategoryChartType.Spline => DataSeriesType.Spline, 
				CategoryChartType.SplineArea => DataSeriesType.SplineArea, 
				CategoryChartType.StepArea => DataSeriesType.StepArea, 
				CategoryChartType.StepLine => DataSeriesType.StepLine, 
				CategoryChartType.Waterfall => DataSeriesType.Waterfall, 
				CategoryChartType.Auto => ds.SuggestedSeries, 
				_ => DataSeriesType.Column, 
			};
		}

		protected override Series CreateSeries(DataSeries ds, DataSeriesType resolvedSeries)
		{
			HorizontalAnchoredCategorySeries horizontalAnchoredCategorySeries = SeriesFromChartType(ChartType, ds.SuggestedSeries);
			horizontalAnchoredCategorySeries.ValueMemberPath = ds.FindMatchingHint(DataSeriesIntent.PrimarySeriesValue).Path;
			horizontalAnchoredCategorySeries.XAxis = XAxis;
			horizontalAnchoredCategorySeries.YAxis = YAxis;
			return horizontalAnchoredCategorySeries;
		}

		protected override void RepopulateAxisBasedOn(DataSeries ds)
		{
			if (ds.SuggestedSecondaryAxis == DataSeriesAxisType.Logarithmic)
			{
				YAxis.IsLogarithmic = true;
				YAxis.LogarithmBase = 10;
			}
		}

		protected override void ResetAxes()
		{
			YAxis.IsLogarithmic = YAxisIsLogarithmic;
			YAxis.LogarithmBase = YAxisLogarithmBase;
		}

		protected override void ApplyMarkers(Series series, int index)
		{
			if (series is HorizontalAnchoredCategorySeries horizontalAnchoredCategorySeries)
			{
				horizontalAnchoredCategorySeries.MarkerCollisionAvoidance = MarkerCollisionAvoidance;
				horizontalAnchoredCategorySeries.MarkerType = ResolveMarkerType(series, index);
			}
		}

		private void ForEachCategorySeries(Action<HorizontalAnchoredCategorySeries> action)
		{
			ForEachCategorySeries(delegate(HorizontalAnchoredCategorySeries series, int index)
			{
				action(series);
			});
		}

		private void ForEachCategorySeries(Action<HorizontalAnchoredCategorySeries, int> action)
		{
			if (base.DataChart == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			for (int i = 0; i < base.DataChart.Series.Count; i++)
			{
				if (base.DataChart.Series[i] is HorizontalAnchoredCategorySeries arg)
				{
					action(arg, i);
				}
			}
		}

		protected override Axis GetXAxis()
		{
			return XAxis;
		}

		protected override Axis GetYAxis()
		{
			return YAxis;
		}

		private Series CreateCategoryHighlightLayer()
		{
			return new CategoryHighlightLayer();
		}

		private Series CreateCategoryItemHighlightLayer()
		{
			return new CategoryItemHighlightLayer();
		}

		protected override List<Series> GetAnnotationLayers(string namePrefix, bool includeSecondaryLayers)
		{
			List<Series> annotationLayers = base.GetAnnotationLayers(namePrefix, includeSecondaryLayers);
			if (annotationLayers != null)
			{
				List<Series> list = new List<Series>();
				if (_IsCategoryHighlightingEnabled)
				{
					list.Add(CreateCategoryHighlightLayer());
				}
				if (_IsItemHighlightingEnabled)
				{
					list.Add(CreateCategoryItemHighlightLayer());
				}
				for (int i = 0; i < list.Count; i++)
				{
					Series series = list[i];
					series.Name = namePrefix + series.GetType().Name;
					annotationLayers.Add(series);
				}
			}
			return annotationLayers;
		}

		protected override void SetCalloutMemberPaths(Series callout, Series targetSeries, DataSeries dataSeries)
		{
			base.SetCalloutMemberPaths(callout, targetSeries, dataSeries);
			if (base.DataAdapter.DataSeries.Count > 0)
			{
				if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(base.CalloutsXMemberPath))
				{
					base.AnnotationLayerProxy.SetXMemberPath(callout, dataSeries.GetMemberPathFor(DataSeriesIntent.AxisLabelValue));
				}
				if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(base.CalloutsYMemberPath))
				{
					base.AnnotationLayerProxy.SetYMemberPath(callout, dataSeries.GetMemberPathFor(DataSeriesIntent.PrimarySeriesValue));
				}
				if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(base.CalloutsLabelMemberPath))
				{
					base.AnnotationLayerProxy.SetLabelMemberPath(callout, dataSeries.GetMemberPathFor(DataSeriesIntent.PrimarySeriesValue));
				}
				if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(base.CalloutsContentMemberPath))
				{
					base.AnnotationLayerProxy.SetContentMemberPath(callout, dataSeries.GetMemberPathFor(DataSeriesIntent.PrimarySeriesValue));
				}
			}
		}

		protected override bool IsCrosshairVerticalLineVisible()
		{
			if (base.CrosshairsDisplayMode == CrosshairsDisplayMode.Both || base.CrosshairsDisplayMode == CrosshairsDisplayMode.Vertical)
			{
				return true;
			}
			if (base.CrosshairsDisplayMode == CrosshairsDisplayMode.Auto)
			{
				if (ChartType == CategoryChartType.Column || ChartType == CategoryChartType.Waterfall)
				{
					return false;
				}
				if (ChartType == CategoryChartType.Auto && base.DataAdapter != null && base.DataAdapter.DataSeries != null && base.DataAdapter.DataSeries.Count > 0)
				{
					DataSeriesType suggestedSeries = base.DataAdapter.DataSeries[0].SuggestedSeries;
					if (suggestedSeries == DataSeriesType.Column || suggestedSeries == DataSeriesType.Waterfall)
					{
						return false;
					}
				}
				return true;
			}
			return false;
		}

		protected override void OnPropertyUpdated(string propertyName, object oldValue, object newValue)
		{
			base.OnPropertyUpdated(propertyName, oldValue, newValue);
			switch (propertyName)
			{
			case "ChartType":
				RepopulateSeriesFromDataAdapter();
				break;
			case "MarkerCollisionAvoidance":
				ForEachCategorySeries(delegate(HorizontalAnchoredCategorySeries series)
				{
					series.MarkerCollisionAvoidance = MarkerCollisionAvoidance;
				});
				break;
			case "IsTransitionInEnabled":
				ForEachCategorySeries(delegate(HorizontalAnchoredCategorySeries series)
				{
					series.IsTransitionInEnabled = IsTransitionInEnabled;
				});
				break;
			case "TransitionInMode":
				ForEachCategorySeries(delegate(HorizontalAnchoredCategorySeries series)
				{
					series.TransitionInMode = TransitionInMode;
				});
				break;
			case "TransitionInSpeedType":
				ForEachCategorySeries(delegate(HorizontalAnchoredCategorySeries series)
				{
					series.TransitionInSpeedType = TransitionInSpeedType;
				});
				break;
			case "XAxisInterval":
				XAxis.Interval = XAxisInterval;
				break;
			case "XAxisMinorInterval":
				XAxis.MinorInterval = XAxisMinorInterval;
				break;
			case "XAxisGap":
				XAxis.Gap = XAxisGap;
				break;
			case "XAxisOverlap":
				XAxis.Overlap = XAxisOverlap;
				break;
			case "YAxisInterval":
				YAxis.Interval = YAxisInterval;
				break;
			case "YAxisIsLogarithmic":
				YAxis.IsLogarithmic = YAxisIsLogarithmic;
				break;
			case "YAxisLogarithmBase":
				YAxis.LogarithmBase = YAxisLogarithmBase;
				break;
			case "YAxisMinimumValue":
				YAxis.MinimumValue = YAxisMinimumValue;
				break;
			case "YAxisMaximumValue":
				YAxis.MaximumValue = YAxisMaximumValue;
				break;
			case "YAxisMinorInterval":
				YAxis.MinorInterval = YAxisMinorInterval;
				break;
			case "NegativeBrushes":
			case "NegativeOutlines":
				ForEachCategorySeries(delegate(HorizontalAnchoredCategorySeries series, int index)
				{
					if (series.IsNegativeColorSupported)
					{
						series.SetNegativeColors(NegativeBrushes.GetModulus(index), NegativeOutlines.GetModulus(index));
					}
				});
				break;
			case "YAxisAbbreviateLargeNumbers":
				OnYAxis(delegate(Axis axis)
				{
					((NumericYAxis)axis).AbbreviateLargeNumbers = YAxisAbbreviateLargeNumbers;
				});
				break;
			case "IsCategoryHighlightingEnabled":
			case "IsItemHighlightingEnabled":
				RepopulateSeriesFromDataAdapter();
				break;
			}
		}
	}

			get
			{

				return false;
			}

		public DomainChart()
		{
			QueuedActions = new List<Action>();
			InitializeDataAdapter();
			CreateAxes();
		}

		protected virtual void InitializeDataAdapter()
		{
			SuggestedMarkerTypes = new List<MarkerType>();
			DataAdapter = new Infragistics.Controls.Charts.DataAdapters.DataSeriesAdapter().Implementation;
			if (IncludedProperties != null)
			{
				DataAdapter.IncludedProperties = IncludedProperties;
			}
			if (ExcludedProperties != null)
			{
				DataAdapter.ExcludedProperties = ExcludedProperties;
			}
			DataAdapter.SupportedSeriesTypes = SupportedDataSeries.ToArray();
			DataAdapter.Rules.Clear();
			foreach (IDataSeriesAdapterRule supportedDataRule in SupportedDataRules)
			{
				DataAdapter.Rules.Add(supportedDataRule);
			}
			List<string> list = new List<string>();
			foreach (IDataSeriesAdapterRule rule in DataAdapter.Rules)
			{
				list.Add(rule.GetType().Name);
			}
			DataAdapter.DataSeries.CollectionChanged += OnDataSeriesChanged;
		}

		protected virtual bool IsSupported(DataSeriesType seriesType)
		{
			if (seriesType != DataSeriesType.Unknown)
			{
				return SupportedDataSeries.Contains(seriesType);
			}
			return false;
		}

				for (int i = 0; i < d.Series.Count; i++)
				{
					d.Series[i].NotifyVisualPropertiesChanged();
				}
			});
		}

		public void Flush()
		{
			if (DataChart != null)
			{
				if (IsRepopulatingSeries)
				{
					RepopulateSeriesFromDataAdapter();
				}
				DataChart.Flush();
			}
		}

			}
		}

		{

			{
				return;
			}
			for (int i = 0; i < DataChart.Series.Count; i++)
			{
				Series series = DataChart.Series[i];
				if (!series.IsAnnotationHoverLayer)

				}
			}
		}

		{
			if (!IsSupported(ds.SuggestedSeries))
			{
				return false;
			}
			if ((IEnumerable)ds.Data == null)
			{
				return false;
			}
			return true;
		}

			return "series_" + (DataChart.Series.Count + 1) + "_" + ds.SuggestedSeries.ToString();
		}

		protected virtual string GetSeriesTitle(DataSeries ds, DataSeriesType resolvedSeries)
		{
			if (IsDisplayingMockData && ShouldUseSkeletonStyleForMockData)
			{
				string text = "";
				double num = 5.0 + Math.Round(_rand.NextDouble() * 4.0);
				for (int i = 0; (double)i < num; i++)
				{
					text += "█";
				}
				return text;
			}
			if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(ds.Title))
			{
				return resolvedSeries.ToString() + (DataChart.Series.Count + 1);
			}
			return ds.Title;
		}

		protected virtual void RepopulateSeriesFromDataAdapter()
		{
			if (DataChart == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			IsRepopulatingSeries = false;
			ResetChart();
			if (ActualItemsSource == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			List<MarkerType> list = new List<MarkerType>();
			foreach (DataSeries item in DataAdapter.DataSeries)
			{
				list.Add(GetMarkerType(item.SuggestedMarker));
			}
			SuggestedMarkerTypes = list;
			int num = 0;
			foreach (DataSeries item2 in DataAdapter.DataSeries)
			{
				if (IsValid(item2))
				{
					if (item2.Index < 0)
					{
						item2.Index = num;
					}
					RepopulateAxisBasedOn(item2);
					RepopulateSeriesBasedOn(item2);
					num++;
				}
			}
			UpdateAnnotationLayers();
			ForAllSeries(InitializeSeries);
		}

		{
			return null;
		}

		private bool IsAnnotationLayer(Series series)
		{
			if (!HasAnnotationLayerProxy)
			{
				return false;
			}
			return AnnotationLayerProxy.MatchesType(series);
		}

		private void UpdateAnnotationLayers()
		{
			List<Series> annotationLayers = GetAnnotationLayers("", includeSecondaryLayers: true);
			if (annotationLayers != null)
			{
				for (int i = 0; i < annotationLayers.Count; i++)
				{
					DataChart.Series.Add(annotationLayers[i]);
				}
			}
		}

		protected virtual bool IsCrosshairHorizontalLineVisible()
		{
			if (CrosshairsDisplayMode != CrosshairsDisplayMode.Auto && CrosshairsDisplayMode != CrosshairsDisplayMode.Both)
			{
				return CrosshairsDisplayMode == CrosshairsDisplayMode.Horizontal;
			}
			return true;
		}

		protected virtual bool IsCrosshairVerticalLineVisible()
		{
			if (CrosshairsDisplayMode != CrosshairsDisplayMode.Auto && CrosshairsDisplayMode != CrosshairsDisplayMode.Both)
			{
				return CrosshairsDisplayMode == CrosshairsDisplayMode.Vertical;
			}
			return true;
		}

		protected virtual List<Series> GetAnnotationLayers(string namePrefix, bool includeSecondaryLayers)
		{
			if (!HasAnnotationLayerProxy)
			{
				return null;
			}
			List<Series> list = new List<Series>();
			if (includeSecondaryLayers && _CalloutsVisible)
			{
				int num = 1;
				if (_CalloutsItemsSource == null)
				{
					foreach (Series item3 in DataChart.Series)
					{
						Series series = CreateCalloutLayer();
						AnnotationLayerProxy.SetTargetSeries(series, item3);
						AnnotationLayerProxy.SetCollisionChannel(series, "MainChartCollisionChannel");
						SetCalloutMemberPaths(series, item3, DataAdapter.DataSeries[num - 1]);
						series.Name = namePrefix + series.GetType().Name + num;
						list.Add(series);
						num++;
					}
				}
				else
				{
					Series series2 = CreateCalloutLayer();
					SetCalloutMemberPaths(series2, null, DataAdapter.DataSeries[num - 1]);
					series2.Name = namePrefix + series2.GetType().Name + num;
					list.Add(series2);
				}
			}
			switch (_CrosshairsDisplayMode)
			{
			case CrosshairsDisplayMode.Auto:
			case CrosshairsDisplayMode.Horizontal:
			case CrosshairsDisplayMode.Vertical:
			case CrosshairsDisplayMode.Both:
			{
				Series series3 = CreateCrosshairLayer();
				AnnotationLayerProxy.SetCrosshairThickness(series3, _CrosshairsLineThickness);
				AnnotationLayerProxy.SetCrosshairUseInterpolation(series3, !_CrosshairsSnapToData);
				AnnotationLayerProxy.SetCrosshairHorizontalLineVisibility(series3, (!IsCrosshairHorizontalLineVisible()) ? Visibility.Collapsed : Visibility.Visible);
				AnnotationLayerProxy.SetCrosshairHorizontalLineStroke(series3, _CrosshairsLineHorizontalStroke);
				AnnotationLayerProxy.SetCrosshairVerticalLineVisibility(series3, (!IsCrosshairVerticalLineVisible()) ? Visibility.Collapsed : Visibility.Visible);
				AnnotationLayerProxy.SetCrosshairVerticalLineStroke(series3, _CrosshairsLineVerticalStroke);
				AnnotationLayerProxy.SetCrosshairOnAxesEnabled(series3, _CrosshairsAnnotationEnabled);
				AnnotationLayerProxy.SetCrosshairXAxisBackground(series3, _CrosshairsAnnotationXAxisBackground);
				AnnotationLayerProxy.SetCrosshairXAxisForeground(series3, _CrosshairsAnnotationXAxisTextColor);
				AnnotationLayerProxy.SetCrosshairYAxisBackground(series3, _CrosshairsAnnotationYAxisBackground);
				AnnotationLayerProxy.SetCrosshairYAxisForeground(series3, _CrosshairsAnnotationYAxisTextColor);
				AnnotationLayerProxy.SetCrosshairXAxisPrecision(series3, _CrosshairsAnnotationXAxisPrecision);
				AnnotationLayerProxy.SetCrosshairYAxisPrecision(series3, _CrosshairsAnnotationYAxisPrecision);
				list.Add(series3);
				break;
			}
			}
			if (_FinalValueAnnotationsVisible)
			{
				Series series4 = CreateFinalValueLayer();
				AnnotationLayerProxy.SetFinalValueBackground(series4, _FinalValueAnnotationsBackground);
				AnnotationLayerProxy.SetFinalValueForeground(series4, _FinalValueAnnotationsTextColor);
				AnnotationLayerProxy.SetFinalValuePrecision(series4, _FinalValueAnnotationsPrecision);
				list.Add(series4);
			}
			if (includeSecondaryLayers)
			{
				switch (_ToolTipType)
				{
				case ToolTipType.Item:
				{
					Series item2 = CreateItemToolTipLayer();
					list.Add(item2);
					break;
				}
				case ToolTipType.Category:
				{
					Series item = CreateCategoryToolTipLayer();
					list.Add(item);
					break;
				}
				case ToolTipType.None:
					ForAllSeries(delegate(Series series5)
					{
						series5.ShowDefaultTooltip = false;
					});
					break;
				case ToolTipType.Default:
					ForAllSeries(delegate(Series series5)
					{
						series5.ShowDefaultTooltip = true;
					});
					break;
				}
			}
			foreach (Series item4 in list)
			{
				if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(item4.Name))
				{
					item4.Name = namePrefix + item4.GetType().Name;
				}
			}
			return list;
		}

		protected virtual void SetCalloutMemberPaths(Series callout, Series targetSeries, DataSeries dataSeries)
		{
			callout.ItemsSource = ((_CalloutsItemsSource != null) ? _CalloutsItemsSource : targetSeries.ItemsSource);
			AnnotationLayerProxy.SetXMemberPath(callout, _CalloutsXMemberPath);
			AnnotationLayerProxy.SetYMemberPath(callout, _CalloutsYMemberPath);
			AnnotationLayerProxy.SetLabelMemberPath(callout, _CalloutsLabelMemberPath);
			AnnotationLayerProxy.SetContentMemberPath(callout, _CalloutsContentMemberPath);
		}

		protected abstract void RepopulateSeriesBasedOn(DataSeries ds);

		protected abstract void RepopulateAxisBasedOn(DataSeries ds);

		protected virtual void ResetChart()
		{
			ResetChart(DataChart);
		}

		private void ResetChart(XamDataChart chart)
		{
			if (chart != null && chart == DataChart)
			{
				ResetAxes();
			}
			if (chart == null || chart.Series.Count == 0)
			{
				return;
			}
			ForAllSeries(delegate(Series series)
			{
				if (IsAnnotationLayer(series) && AnnotationLayerProxy.IsCalloutLayer(series))
				{
					AnnotationLayerProxy.RemoveCalloutStyleUpdating(series, RaiseCalloutStyleUpdating);
				}
				RaiseSeriesRemoved(series);
			});
			foreach (Series item in chart.Series)
			{
				ResetSeries(item);
			}
			chart.Series.Clear();
		}

		protected virtual void ResetSeries(Series series)
		{
			series.ItemsSource = null;
			series.Legend = null;
			series.ClearAxes();
		}

		protected abstract void ResetAxes();

		private void OnDataSeriesChanged(object sender, NotifyCollectionChangedEventArgs e)
		{
			if (DataChart != null)
			{
				if (e.OldItems != null)
				{
					e.OldItems.Count.ToString();
				}
				if (e.NewItems != null)
				{
					e.NewItems.Count.ToString();
				}
				if (!IsRepopulatingSeries)
				{
					QueueWork(DoRepopulateSeriesFromDataAdapter, ref IsRepopulatingSeries);
				}
			}
		}

		protected void DoRepopulateSeriesFromDataAdapter()
		{
			RepopulateSeriesFromDataAdapter();
		}

		[EditorBrowsable(EditorBrowsableState.Never)]
		protected Color GetPaletteColor(int index)
		{
			if (ActualBrushes == null || ActualBrushes.Count == 0)
			{
				return DefaultPaletteColors.GetModulus(index);
			}
			Brush modulus = ActualBrushes.GetModulus(index);
			if (modulus == null)
			{
				return DefaultPaletteColors.GetModulus(index);
			}
			return ColorUtil.FromBrush(modulus);
		}

		[EditorBrowsable(EditorBrowsableState.Never)]
		protected ObservableCollection<Color> GetPaletteColors(Color lastColor)
		{
			return new ObservableCollection<Color>
			{
				lastColor.GetLightened(0.5),
				lastColor
			};
		}

		[EditorBrowsable(EditorBrowsableState.Never)]
		protected BrushCollection GetPaletteBrushes(Color lastColor)
		{
			return BrushCollectionUtil.From(GetPaletteColors(lastColor));
		}

		protected internal MarkerType GetMarkerType(DataSeriesMarker markerType)
		{
			return markerType switch
			{
				DataSeriesMarker.Circle => MarkerType.Circle, 
				DataSeriesMarker.Hidden => MarkerType.Hidden, 
				DataSeriesMarker.Diamond => MarkerType.Diamond, 
				DataSeriesMarker.Hexagon => MarkerType.Hexagon, 
				DataSeriesMarker.Hexagram => MarkerType.Hexagram, 
				DataSeriesMarker.None => MarkerType.None, 
				DataSeriesMarker.Pentagon => MarkerType.Pentagon, 
				DataSeriesMarker.Pentagram => MarkerType.Pentagram, 
				DataSeriesMarker.Pyramid => MarkerType.Pyramid, 
				DataSeriesMarker.Square => MarkerType.Square, 
				DataSeriesMarker.Tetragram => MarkerType.Tetragram, 
				DataSeriesMarker.Triangle => MarkerType.Triangle, 
				DataSeriesMarker.Smart => MarkerType.Unset, 
				_ => MarkerType.Automatic, 
			};
		}
