		protected internal void QueueSingleInvoke(Action action)
		{
			if (!QueuedActions.Contains(action))
			{
				QueuedActions.Add(action);
				bool pending = false;
				QueueWork(delegate
				{
					action();
					QueuedActions.Remove(action);
				}, ref pending);
			}
		}

		protected internal void QueueWork(Action action, ref bool pending)
		{
			if (!pending)
			{
				pending = true;
				if (ExternalObject != null && Utilities.AllowsAsyncOperations(ExternalObject))
				{
					ExternalObject.Dispatcher.BeginInvoke(action);
				}
				else
				{
					action();
				}
			}
		}

		protected virtual void InitializeChart(XamDataChart dataChart)
		{
			bool num = dataChart == DataChart;
			if (num)
			{
				dataChart.Brushes = ActualBrushes;
			}
			if (num)
			{
				dataChart.Outlines = ActualOutlines;
			}
			dataChart.MarkerBrushes = MarkerBrushes;
			dataChart.MarkerOutlines = MarkerOutlines;
			dataChart.MarkerAutomaticBehavior = MarkerAutomaticBehavior;
			dataChart.Legend = Legend;
			dataChart.IsHorizontalZoomEnabled = IsHorizontalZoomEnabled;
			dataChart.IsVerticalZoomEnabled = IsVerticalZoomEnabled && IsVerticalZoomAllowed;
			if (dataChart.HighlightingMode != HighlightingMode || dataChart.HighlightingBehavior != HighlightingBehavior)
			{
				dataChart.HighlightingMode = HighlightingMode;
				dataChart.HighlightingBehavior = HighlightingBehavior;
			}
			dataChart.ComputedPlotAreaMarginMode = ComputedPlotAreaMarginMode;
			if (!double.IsNaN(PlotAreaMargin.Left) || !double.IsNaN(PlotAreaMargin.Top) || !double.IsNaN(PlotAreaMargin.Right) || !double.IsNaN(PlotAreaMargin.Bottom))
			{
				dataChart.PlotAreaMargin = PlotAreaMargin;
			}
			dataChart.LegendHighlightingMode = LegendHighlightingMode;
			dataChart.ShouldAutoExpandMarginForInitialLabels = ShouldAutoExpandMarginForInitialLabels;
			dataChart.AutoExpandMarginExtraPadding = AutoExpandMarginExtraPadding;
			dataChart.AutoExpandMarginMaximumValue = AutoExpandMarginMaximumValue;
			dataChart.SeriesMouseEnter += delegate(object o, ChartMouseEventArgs e)
			{
				RaiseSeriesPointerEnter(e.Series, e.Item);
			};
			dataChart.SeriesMouseLeave += delegate(object o, ChartMouseEventArgs e)
			{
				RaiseSeriesPointerLeave(e.Series, e.Item);
			};
			dataChart.SeriesMouseMove += delegate(object o, ChartMouseEventArgs e)
			{
				RaiseSeriesPointerMove(e.Series, e.Item);
			};
			dataChart.SeriesMouseLeftButtonDown += delegate(object o, DataChartMouseButtonEventArgs e)
			{
				RaiseSeriesPointerDown(e.Series, e.Item);
			};
			dataChart.SeriesMouseLeftButtonUp += delegate(object o, DataChartMouseButtonEventArgs e)
			{
				RaiseSeriesPointerUp(e.Series, e.Item);
			};
			if (num)
			{
				dataChart.WindowRect = WindowRect;
			}
			if (num)
			{
				dataChart.Title = Title;
			}
			dataChart.TitleHorizontalAlignment = TitleAlignment;
			if (num)
			{
				dataChart.Subtitle = Subtitle;
			}
			dataChart.SubtitleHorizontalAlignment = SubtitleAlignment;
			dataChart.AlignsGridLinesToPixels = AlignsGridLinesToPixels;
			dataChart.AnimateSeriesWhenAxisRangeChanges = AnimateSeriesWhenAxisRangeChanges;
			if (dataChart == DataChart)
			{
				RepopulateSeriesFromDataAdapter();
			}
			InitializeChartOverride(dataChart);
			InitializeChartOverridePlatform(dataChart);
		}

		protected BrushCollection ResolveBrushCollection(BrushCollection brushes)
		{
			if (!ShouldDisplayMockData || !ShouldUseSkeletonStyleForMockData || ItemsSource != null)
			{
				return brushes;
			}
			if (brushes == null)
			{
				return null;
			}
			BrushCollection brushCollection = new BrushCollection();
			foreach (Brush brush in brushes)
			{
				Brush item = BrushUtil.ToGrayscale(brush);
				brushCollection.Add(item);
			}
			return brushCollection;
		}

		protected Brush ResolvePossiblyTransparentBrush(Brush brush)
		{
			if (!ShouldDisplayMockData || !ShouldUseSkeletonStyleForMockData || ItemsSource != null)
			{
				return brush;
			}
			return BrushUtil.FromArgb(0, 0, 0, 0);
		}

		protected virtual void InitializeSeries(Series series, int index)
		{
			if (!double.IsNaN(Resolution))
			{
				series.Resolution = Resolution;
			}
			if (!double.IsNaN(Thickness) && !series.IsAnnotationLayer)
			{
				series.Thickness = Thickness;
			}
			if (!double.IsNaN(CrosshairsLineThickness) && series.IsAnnotationLayer)
			{
				series.Thickness = CrosshairsLineThickness;
			}
			series.LegendItemBadgeShape = LegendItemBadgeShape;
			series.LegendItemBadgeMode = LegendItemBadgeMode;
			series.OutlineMode = OutlineMode;
			series.UpdateMarkerOutlineMode(MarkerOutlineMode);
			series.UpdateMarkerFillMode(MarkerFillMode);
			series.MarkerFillOpacity = MarkerFillOpacity;
			if (!double.IsNaN(Thickness))
			{
				series.UpdateMarkerThickness(MarkerThickness);
			}
			if (!double.IsNaN(AreaFillOpacity))
			{
				series.AreaFillOpacity = AreaFillOpacity;
			}
			if (series.IsUsableInLegend)
			{
				series.Legend = Legend;
			}
			if (series is IUnknownValuePlotting)
			{
				((IUnknownValuePlotting)series).UnknownValuePlotting = UnknownValuePlotting;
			}
			series.IsHighlightingEnabled = IsSeriesHighlightingEnabled;
			if (IsAnnotationLayer(series) && AnnotationLayerProxy.IsCalloutLayer(series))
			{
				AnnotationLayerProxy.SetCalloutStyleUpdatingEventEnabled(series, CalloutStyleUpdatingEventEnabled);
				AnnotationLayerProxy.AddCalloutStyleUpdating(series, RaiseCalloutStyleUpdating);
			}
			ApplyMarkers(series, index);
			ApplyTrendLines(series, index);
			InitializeSeriesOverride(series, index);
			InitializeSeriesOverridePlatform(series, index);
			RaiseSeriesAdded(series);
		}

		protected abstract void CreateAxes();

		protected void EnsureAxesInitialized()
		{
			if (!_areAxesInitialized)
			{
				_areAxesInitialized = true;
				InitializeAxes();
			}
		}

		protected virtual void InitializeAxes()
		{
			InitializeAxesOverride();
			InitializeAxesOverridePlatform();
		}

		protected virtual void ReleaseChart(XamDataChart dataChart)
		{
			ResetChart(dataChart);
		}

		protected void ApplyTrendLines(Series series, int index)
		{
			if (series is ITrendLineSeries trendLineSeries)
			{
				trendLineSeries.TrendLineBrush = TrendLineBrushes.GetModulus(index);
				trendLineSeries.TrendLineThickness = TrendLineThickness;
				trendLineSeries.TrendLineType = TrendLineType;
				trendLineSeries.TrendLinePeriod = TrendLinePeriod;
			}
		}

		protected abstract void ApplyMarkers(Series series, int index);

		protected virtual MarkerType ResolveMarkerType(Series series, int index)
		{
			if (MarkerTypes == null || MarkerTypes.Count == 0)
			{
				if (SuggestedMarkerTypes == null || SuggestedMarkerTypes.Count == 0)
				{
					if (series == null || !series.IsMarkerlessDisplayPreferred)
					{
						return MarkerType.Automatic;
					}
					return MarkerType.None;
				}
				MarkerType markerType = SuggestedMarkerTypes.GetModulus(index);
				if (markerType == MarkerType.Unset && series != null)
				{
					markerType = (series.IsMarkerlessDisplayPreferred ? MarkerType.None : MarkerType.Automatic);
					if (markerType == MarkerType.Automatic)
					{
						markerType = ResolveDefaultMarkerType(series);
					}
				}
				if (markerType == MarkerType.Automatic)
				{
					if (series == null)
					{
						return MarkerType.None;
					}
					return MarkerType.Automatic;
				}
				return markerType;
			}
			return MarkerTypes.GetModulus(index);
		}

		protected virtual MarkerType ResolveDefaultMarkerType(Series series)
		{
			return MarkerType.Automatic;
		}

		protected virtual IEnumerable ResolveItemsSource()
		{
			if (ItemsSource != null)
			{
				return ItemsSource;
			}
			if (ShouldDisplayMockData)
			{
				return ResolveMockData();
			}
			return null;
		}

		protected virtual IEnumerable ResolveMockData()
		{
			return null;
		}

		protected virtual void OnPropertyUpdated(string propertyName, object oldValue, object newValue)
		{
			if (this.PropertyChanged != null)
			{
				this.PropertyChanged(this, new PropertyChangedEventArgs(propertyName));
			}
			switch (propertyName)
			{
			case "DataChart":
				ReleaseChart(oldValue as XamDataChart);
				InitializeChart(newValue as XamDataChart);
				break;
			case "ShouldUseSkeletonStyleForMockData":
			case "ShouldDisplayMockData":
				ActualItemsSource = ResolveItemsSource();
				ActualBrushes = ResolveBrushCollection(Brushes);
				ActualOutlines = ResolveBrushCollection(Outlines);
				break;
			case "ActualBrushes":
				OnDataChart(delegate(XamDataChart chart)
				{
					chart.Brushes = ActualBrushes;
				}, subCharts: true, propertyName);
				break;
			case "ActualOutlines":
				OnDataChart(delegate(XamDataChart chart)
				{
					chart.Outlines = ActualOutlines;
				}, subCharts: true, propertyName);
				break;
			case "ActualItemsSource":
				if (ShouldDisplayMockData)
				{
					ActualBrushes = ResolveBrushCollection(Brushes);
					ActualOutlines = ResolveBrushCollection(Outlines);
				}
				DataAdapter.ItemsSource = ActualItemsSource;
				break;
			case "ItemsSource":
				ActualItemsSource = ResolveItemsSource();
				break;
			case "IncludedProperties":
				DataAdapter.IncludedProperties = IncludedProperties;
				break;
			case "ExcludedProperties":
				DataAdapter.ExcludedProperties = ExcludedProperties;
				break;
			case "Brushes":
				ActualBrushes = ResolveBrushCollection(Brushes);
				break;
			case "Outlines":
				ActualOutlines = ResolveBrushCollection(Outlines);
				break;
			case "Legend":
				OnDataChart(delegate(XamDataChart chart)
				{
					chart.Legend = Legend;
				});
				break;
			case "HighlightingMode":
				OnDataChart(delegate(XamDataChart chart)
				{
					chart.HighlightingMode = HighlightingMode;
				});
				break;
			case "HighlightingBehavior":
				OnDataChart(delegate(XamDataChart chart)
				{
					chart.HighlightingBehavior = HighlightingBehavior;
				});
				break;
			case "LegendHighlightingMode":
				OnDataChart(delegate(XamDataChart chart)
				{
					chart.LegendHighlightingMode = LegendHighlightingMode;
				});
				break;
			case "LegendItemBadgeShape":
				OnDataChart(delegate(XamDataChart chart)
				{
					chart.LegendItemBadgeShape = LegendItemBadgeShape;
				});
				break;
			case "LegendItemBadgeMode":
				OnDataChart(delegate(XamDataChart chart)
				{
					chart.LegendItemBadgeMode = LegendItemBadgeMode;
				});
				break;
			case "PlotAreaMargin":
				OnDataChart(delegate(XamDataChart chart)
				{
					chart.PlotAreaMargin = PlotAreaMargin;
				});
				break;
			case "ComputedPlotAreaMarginMode":
				OnDataChart(delegate(XamDataChart chart)
				{
					chart.ComputedPlotAreaMarginMode = ComputedPlotAreaMarginMode;
				});
				break;
			case "ShouldAutoExpandMarginForInitialLabels":
				OnDataChart(delegate(XamDataChart chart)
				{
					chart.ShouldAutoExpandMarginForInitialLabels = ShouldAutoExpandMarginForInitialLabels;
				});
				break;
			case "AutoExpandMarginExtraPadding":
				OnDataChart(delegate(XamDataChart chart)
				{
					chart.AutoExpandMarginExtraPadding = AutoExpandMarginExtraPadding;
				});
				break;
			case "AutoExpandMarginMaximumValue":
				OnDataChart(delegate(XamDataChart chart)
				{
					chart.AutoExpandMarginMaximumValue = AutoExpandMarginMaximumValue;
				});
				break;
			case "IsHorizontalZoomEnabled":
				OnDataChart(delegate(XamDataChart chart)
				{
					chart.IsHorizontalZoomEnabled = IsHorizontalZoomEnabled;
				});
				break;
			case "IsVerticalZoomEnabled":
				OnDataChart(delegate(XamDataChart chart)
				{
					chart.IsVerticalZoomEnabled = IsVerticalZoomEnabled;
				});
				break;
			case "WindowRect":
				OnDataChart(delegate(XamDataChart chart)
				{
					chart.WindowRect = WindowRect;
				}, subCharts: false);
				break;
			case "Title":
				OnDataChart(delegate(XamDataChart chart)
				{
					chart.Title = Title;
				}, subCharts: false);
				break;
			case "Subtitle":
				OnDataChart(delegate(XamDataChart chart)
				{
					chart.Subtitle = Subtitle;
				}, subCharts: false);
				break;
			case "TitleAlignment":
				OnDataChart(delegate(XamDataChart chart)
				{
					chart.TitleHorizontalAlignment = TitleAlignment;
				});
				break;
			case "SubtitleAlignment":
				OnDataChart(delegate(XamDataChart chart)
				{
					chart.SubtitleHorizontalAlignment = SubtitleAlignment;
				});
				break;
			case "UnknownValuePlotting":
				ForAllSeries(delegate(Series series)
				{
					if (series is IUnknownValuePlotting)
					{
						((IUnknownValuePlotting)series).UnknownValuePlotting = UnknownValuePlotting;
					}
				});
				break;
			case "IsSeriesHighlightingEnabled":
				ForAllSeries(delegate(Series series)
				{
					series.IsHighlightingEnabled = IsSeriesHighlightingEnabled;
				});
				break;
			case "Thickness":
				if (!double.IsNaN(Thickness))
				{
					ForEachDataSeries(delegate(Series series)
					{
						series.Thickness = Thickness;
					});
				}
				break;
			case "OutlineMode":
				ForEachDataSeries(delegate(Series series)
				{
					series.OutlineMode = OutlineMode;
				});
				break;
			case "MarkerFillOpacity":
				ForEachDataSeries(delegate(Series series)
				{
					series.MarkerFillOpacity = MarkerFillOpacity;
				});
				break;
			case "MarkerThickness":
				if (!double.IsNaN(MarkerThickness))
				{
					ForEachDataSeries(delegate(Series series)
					{
						series.UpdateMarkerThickness(MarkerThickness);
					});
				}
				break;
			case "MarkerOutlineMode":
				ForEachDataSeries(delegate(Series series)
				{
					series.UpdateMarkerOutlineMode(MarkerOutlineMode);
				});
				break;
			case "MarkerFillMode":
				ForEachDataSeries(delegate(Series series)
				{
					series.UpdateMarkerFillMode(MarkerFillMode);
				});
				break;
			case "Resolution":
				if (!double.IsNaN(Resolution))
				{
					ForAllSeries(delegate(Series series)
					{
						series.Resolution = Resolution;
					});
				}
				break;
			case "AreaFillOpacity":
				if (!double.IsNaN(AreaFillOpacity))
				{
					ForAllSeries(delegate(Series series)
					{
						series.AreaFillOpacity = AreaFillOpacity;
					});
				}
				break;
			case "TrendLineBrushes":
			case "TrendLineType":
			case "TrendLineThickness":
			case "TrendLinePeriod":
				ForAllSeries(delegate(Series series, int i)
				{
					ApplyTrendLines(series, i);
				});
				break;
			case "MarkerMaxCount":
				ForEachDataSeries(delegate(Series series, int i)
				{
					ApplyMarkers(series, i);
				});
				break;
			case "MarkerTypes":
				if (oldValue is ObservableCollection<MarkerType> observableCollection)
				{
					observableCollection.CollectionChanged -= OnMarkerTypesCollectionChanged;
				}
				if (newValue is ObservableCollection<MarkerType> observableCollection2)
				{
					observableCollection2.CollectionChanged += OnMarkerTypesCollectionChanged;
				}
				ForEachDataSeries(delegate(Series series, int i)
				{
					ApplyMarkers(series, i);
				});
				break;
			case "MarkerAutomaticBehavior":
				OnDataChart(delegate(XamDataChart chart)
				{
					chart.MarkerAutomaticBehavior = MarkerAutomaticBehavior;
				});
				ForEachDataSeries(delegate(Series series, int i)
				{
					ApplyMarkers(series, i);
				});
				break;
			case "MarkerBrushes":
				OnDataChart(delegate(XamDataChart chart)
				{
					chart.MarkerBrushes = MarkerBrushes;
				});
				break;
			case "MarkerOutlines":
				OnDataChart(delegate(XamDataChart chart)
				{
					chart.MarkerOutlines = MarkerOutlines;
				});
				break;
			case "AlignsGridLinesToPixels":
				OnDataChart(delegate(XamDataChart chart)
				{
					chart.AlignsGridLinesToPixels = AlignsGridLinesToPixels;
				});
				break;
			case "AnimateSeriesWhenAxisRangeChanges":
				OnDataChart(delegate(XamDataChart chart)
				{
					chart.AnimateSeriesWhenAxisRangeChanges = AnimateSeriesWhenAxisRangeChanges;
				});
				break;
			case "ToolTipType":
			case "CrosshairsDisplayMode":
			case "CrosshairsSnapToData":
			case "CrosshairsLineVerticalStroke":
			case "CrosshairsLineHorizontalStroke":
			case "CrosshairsLineThickness":
			case "CrosshairsAnnotationXAxisBackground":
			case "CrosshairsAnnotationXAxisTextColor":
			case "CrosshairsAnnotationYAxisBackground":
			case "CrosshairsAnnotationYAxisTextColor":
			case "CrosshairsAnnotationEnabled":
			case "CrosshairsAnnotationXAxisPrecision":
			case "CrosshairsAnnotationYAxisPrecision":
			case "FinalValueAnnotationsVisible":
			case "FinalValueAnnotationsPrecision":
			case "FinalValueAnnotationsTextColor":
			case "FinalValueAnnotationsBackground":
			case "CalloutsVisible":
			case "CalloutsItemsSource":
			case "CalloutsXMemberPath":
			case "CalloutsYMemberPath":
			case "CalloutsLabelMemberPath":
			case "CalloutsContentMemberPath":
				QueueWork(DoRepopulateSeriesFromDataAdapter, ref IsRepopulatingSeries);
				break;
			}
			PropertyUpdatedOverride(propertyName, oldValue, newValue);
			PropertyUpdatedOverridePlatform(propertyName, oldValue, newValue);
		}

		private void OnMarkerTypesCollectionChanged(object sender, NotifyCollectionChangedEventArgs e)
		{
			ForEachDataSeries(delegate(Series series, int i)
			{
				ApplyMarkers(series, i);
			});
		}

		{
		}

		}

		protected virtual void PropertyUpdatedOverridePlatform(string propertyName, object oldValue, object newValue)
		{
			switch (propertyName)

			case "TitleForeground":
				if (DataChart != null)
				{
					DataChart.TitleForeground = TitleForeground;
				}
				break;
			case "TitleFontSize":
				if (DataChart != null)
				{
					DataChart.TitleFontSize = TitleFontSize;
				}
				break;
			case "TitleFontFamily":
				if (DataChart != null)
				{
					DataChart.TitleFontFamily = TitleFontFamily;
				}
				break;
			case "TitleFontStretch":
				if (DataChart != null)
				{
					DataChart.TitleFontStretch = TitleFontStretch;
				}
				break;
			case "TitleFontStyle":
				if (DataChart != null)
				{
					DataChart.TitleFontStyle = TitleFontStyle;
				}
				break;
			case "TitleFontWeight":
				if (DataChart != null)
				{
					DataChart.TitleFontWeight = TitleFontWeight;
				}
				break;
			case "SubtitleForeground":
				if (DataChart != null)
				{
					DataChart.SubtitleForeground = SubtitleForeground;
				}
				break;
			case "SubtitleFontSize":
				if (DataChart != null)
				{
					DataChart.SubtitleFontSize = SubtitleFontSize;
				}
				break;
			case "SubtitleFontFamily":
				if (DataChart != null)
				{
					DataChart.SubtitleFontFamily = SubtitleFontFamily;
				}
				break;
			case "SubtitleFontStretch":
				if (DataChart != null)
				{
					DataChart.SubtitleFontStretch = SubtitleFontStretch;
				}
				break;
			case "SubtitleFontStyle":
				if (DataChart != null)
				{
					DataChart.SubtitleFontStyle = SubtitleFontStyle;
				}
				break;
			case "SubtitleFontWeight":
				if (DataChart != null)
				{
					DataChart.SubtitleFontWeight = SubtitleFontWeight;
				}
				break;
			case "TransitionDuration":
				ForEachDataSeries(delegate(Series series)
				{
					series.TransitionDuration = TransitionDuration;
				});
				break;
			case "TransitionEasingFunction":
				ForEachDataSeries(delegate(Series series)
				{
					series.TransitionEasingFunction = TransitionEasingFunction;
				});
				break;
			case "TransitionInDuration":
				ForEachDataSeries(delegate(Series series)
				{
					series.TransitionInDuration = TransitionInDuration;
				});
				break;
			case "TransitionInEasingFunction":
				ForEachDataSeries(delegate(Series series)
				{
					series.TransitionInEasingFunction = TransitionInEasingFunction;
				});
				break;
			case "ToolTipStyle":
				OnDataChart(delegate(XamDataChart chart)
				{
					chart.ToolTipStyle = ToolTipStyle;
				});
				break;
			case "ToolTips":
				ForEachDataSeries(delegate(Series series, int index)
				{
					series.ToolTip = ToolTips.GetModulusObject(index);
					series.UpdateShowDefaultTooltip();
				});
				break;
			}
		}

	[WpfWidget("XamScatterChart")]
	[WidgetElement]
	[XamWidget("ScatterChartView")]
	[XamWrapperWidget("XamScatterChart")]
	[XamWrapper]
	[WidgetDependencyProperty]
	internal class ScatterChart : CartesianChart
	{
		private const string ChartTypePropertyName = "ChartType";

		private ScatterChartType _ChartType;

		protected override List<DataSeriesType> SupportedDataSeries => new List<DataSeriesType>
		{
			DataSeriesType.ScatterPoint,
			DataSeriesType.ScatterLine,
			DataSeriesType.ScatterSpline,
			DataSeriesType.ScatterBubble,
			DataSeriesType.ScatterHighDensity,
			DataSeriesType.ScatterArea,
			DataSeriesType.ScatterContour
		};

		protected override List<IDataSeriesAdapterRule> SupportedDataRules => new List<IDataSeriesAdapterRule>
		{
			new ScatterDataRule(),
			new SubCollectionsRule()
		};

		public override DomainType DomainType => DomainType.Scatter;

		public ScatterChartType ChartType
		{
			get
			{
				return _ChartType;
			}
			set
			{
				if (value != _ChartType)
				{
					ScatterChartType chartType = ChartType;
					_ChartType = value;
					OnPropertyUpdated("ChartType", chartType, ChartType);
				}
			}
		}

		internal override XamDomainChart CreateExternalObject()
		{
			XamScatterChart xamScatterChart = new XamScatterChart(this);
			xamScatterChart.OnImplementation_PropertyChanged(string.Empty);
			return xamScatterChart;
		}

		protected override DataSeriesType GetSeriesType(DataSeries ds)
		{
			if (ChartType == ScatterChartType.Auto)
			{
				return ds.SuggestedSeries;
			}
			if (ChartType == ScatterChartType.Point)
			{
				return DataSeriesType.ScatterPoint;
			}
			if (ChartType == ScatterChartType.Line)
			{
				return DataSeriesType.ScatterLine;
			}
			if (ChartType == ScatterChartType.Spline)
			{
				return DataSeriesType.ScatterSpline;
			}
			if (ChartType == ScatterChartType.Bubble)
			{
				return DataSeriesType.ScatterBubble;
			}
			if (ChartType == ScatterChartType.HighDensity)
			{
				return DataSeriesType.ScatterHighDensity;
			}
			if (ChartType == ScatterChartType.Area)
			{
				return DataSeriesType.ScatterArea;
			}
			if (ChartType == ScatterChartType.Contour)
			{
				return DataSeriesType.ScatterContour;
			}
			return DataSeriesType.ScatterPoint;
		}

		protected override Series CreateSeries(DataSeries ds, DataSeriesType resolvedSeries)
		{
			return base.CreateSeries(ds, resolvedSeries);
		}

		protected override void InitializeChart(XamDataChart dataChart)
		{
			base.InitializeChart(dataChart);
			base.DataChart.Axes.Add(base.XAxis);
			base.DataChart.Axes.Add(base.YAxis);
		}

		protected override void ApplyMarkers(Series series, int index)
		{
			base.ApplyMarkers(series, index);
			if (series is ScatterPolygonSeries scatterPolygonSeries)
			{
				scatterPolygonSeries.MarkerCollisionAvoidance = base.MarkerCollision;
				scatterPolygonSeries.MarkerType = ResolveMarkerType(series, index);
			}
		}

		protected override MarkerType ResolveDefaultMarkerType(Series series)
		{
			if (series != null && series.IsScatter && series.IsPolygon)
			{
				return MarkerType.None;
			}
			return base.ResolveDefaultMarkerType(series);
		}

		protected override void OnPropertyUpdated(string propertyName, object oldValue, object newValue)
		{
			base.OnPropertyUpdated(propertyName, oldValue, newValue);
			if (propertyName == "ChartType")
			{
				RepopulateSeriesFromDataAdapter();
			}
		}

		protected override void PropertyUpdatedOverride(string propertyName, object oldValue, object newValue)
		{
			base.PropertyUpdatedOverride(propertyName, oldValue, newValue);
		}

		protected override void PropertyUpdatedOverridePlatform(string propertyName, object oldValue, object newValue)
		{
			base.PropertyUpdatedOverridePlatform(propertyName, oldValue, newValue);
		}
	}
	[WpfWidget("XamShapeChart")]
	[WidgetElement]
	[XamWidget("ShapeChartView")]
	[XamWrapperWidget("XamShapeChart")]
	[XamWrapper]
	[WidgetDependencyProperty]
	internal class ShapeChart : CartesianChart
	{
		private List<IDataSeriesAdapterRule> dataRules;

		private const string ChartTypePropertyName = "ChartType";

		private ShapeChartType _ChartType;

		protected override List<DataSeriesType> SupportedDataSeries => new List<DataSeriesType>
		{
			DataSeriesType.ScatterPoint,
			DataSeriesType.ScatterLine,
			DataSeriesType.ScatterSpline,
			DataSeriesType.ScatterBubble,
			DataSeriesType.ScatterHighDensity,
			DataSeriesType.ScatterArea,
			DataSeriesType.ScatterContour,
			DataSeriesType.ScatterPolygon,
			DataSeriesType.ScatterPolyline
		};

		protected override List<IDataSeriesAdapterRule> SupportedDataRules
		{
			get
			{
				if (dataRules == null)
				{
					dataRules = new List<IDataSeriesAdapterRule>
					{
						new BreakEvenDataRule(),
						new ShapeDataRule(),
						new SubCollectionsRule()
					};
				}
				return dataRules;
			}
		}

		[TSClientName("XSRP")]
		private SRProvider SRP { get; set; }

		public override DomainType DomainType => DomainType.Shape;

		public ShapeChartType ChartType
		{
			get
			{
				return _ChartType;
			}
			set
			{
				if (value != _ChartType)
				{
					ShapeChartType chartType = ChartType;
					_ChartType = value;
					OnPropertyUpdated("ChartType", chartType, ChartType);
				}
			}
		}

		internal override XamDomainChart CreateExternalObject()
		{
			XamShapeChart xamShapeChart = new XamShapeChart(this);
			xamShapeChart.OnImplementation_PropertyChanged(string.Empty);
			return xamShapeChart;
		}

		public ShapeChart()
		{
			EnsureAxesInitialized();
			SRP = new SRProvider();
			base.DataAdapter.Localizer = SRP.GetString;
		}

		protected override DataSeriesType GetSeriesType(DataSeries ds)
		{
			if (ChartType == ShapeChartType.Auto)
			{
				return ds.SuggestedSeries;
			}
			if (ChartType == ShapeChartType.Point)
			{
				return DataSeriesType.ScatterPoint;
			}
			if (ChartType == ShapeChartType.Line)
			{
				return DataSeriesType.ScatterLine;
			}
			if (ChartType == ShapeChartType.Spline)
			{
				return DataSeriesType.ScatterSpline;
			}
			if (ChartType == ShapeChartType.Bubble)
			{
				return DataSeriesType.ScatterBubble;
			}
			if (ChartType == ShapeChartType.HighDensity)
			{
				return DataSeriesType.ScatterHighDensity;
			}
			if (ChartType == ShapeChartType.Area)
			{
				return DataSeriesType.ScatterArea;
			}
			if (ChartType == ShapeChartType.Contour)
			{
				return DataSeriesType.ScatterContour;
			}
			if (ChartType == ShapeChartType.Polygon)
			{
				return DataSeriesType.ScatterPolygon;
			}
			if (ChartType == ShapeChartType.Polyline)
			{
				return DataSeriesType.ScatterPolyline;
			}
			return DataSeriesType.ScatterPoint;
		}

		protected override Series CreateSeries(DataSeries ds, DataSeriesType resolvedSeries)
		{
			Series series = null;
			return resolvedSeries switch
			{
				DataSeriesType.ScatterPolygon => CreateScatterPolygonSeries(ds, resolvedSeries), 
				DataSeriesType.ScatterPolyline => CreateScatterPolylineSeries(ds, resolvedSeries), 
				_ => base.CreateSeries(ds, resolvedSeries), 
			};
		}

		private Series CreateScatterPolygonSeries(DataSeries ds, DataSeriesType resolvedSeries)
		{
			return new ScatterPolygonSeries
			{
				ShapeMemberPath = ds.GetMemberPathFor(DataSeriesIntent.SeriesShape),
				XAxis = base.XAxis,
				YAxis = base.YAxis
			};
		}

		private Series CreateScatterPolylineSeries(DataSeries ds, DataSeriesType resolvedSeries)
		{
			return new ScatterPolylineSeries
			{
				ShapeMemberPath = ds.GetMemberPathFor(DataSeriesIntent.SeriesShape),
				XAxis = base.XAxis,
				YAxis = base.YAxis
			};
		}

		protected override void InitializeChart(XamDataChart dataChart)
		{
			base.InitializeChart(dataChart);
			base.DataChart.Axes.Add(base.XAxis);
			base.DataChart.Axes.Add(base.YAxis);
		}

		protected override void ApplyMarkers(Series series, int index)
		{
			base.ApplyMarkers(series, index);
			if (series is ScatterPolygonSeries scatterPolygonSeries)
			{
				scatterPolygonSeries.MarkerCollisionAvoidance = base.MarkerCollision;
				scatterPolygonSeries.MarkerType = ResolveMarkerType(series, index);
			}
		}

		protected override MarkerType ResolveDefaultMarkerType(Series series)
		{
			if (series != null && series.IsScatter && series.IsPolygon)
			{
				return MarkerType.None;
			}
			return base.ResolveDefaultMarkerType(series);
		}

		protected override void OnPropertyUpdated(string propertyName, object oldValue, object newValue)
		{
			base.OnPropertyUpdated(propertyName, oldValue, newValue);
			if (propertyName == "ChartType")
			{
				RepopulateSeriesFromDataAdapter();
			}
		}

		protected override void PropertyUpdatedOverride(string propertyName, object oldValue, object newValue)
		{
			base.PropertyUpdatedOverride(propertyName, oldValue, newValue);
		}

		protected override void PropertyUpdatedOverridePlatform(string propertyName, object oldValue, object newValue)
		{
			base.PropertyUpdatedOverridePlatform(propertyName, oldValue, newValue);
		}
	}

			}
		}

		protected override void RepopulateSeriesBasedOn(DataSeries ds)
		{
			DataSeriesType seriesType = GetSeriesType(ds);
			Series series = CreateSeries(ds, seriesType);
			if (series != null)
			{
				series.ItemsSource = (IEnumerable)ds.Data;
				series.Name = GetSeriesName(ds);
				series.Title = GetSeriesTitle(ds, seriesType);
				series.ShowDefaultTooltip = true;
				base.DataChart.Series.Add(series);
			}
		}

		protected abstract Axis GetXAxis();

		protected abstract Axis GetYAxis();

		protected virtual void OnXAxis(Action<Axis> action)
		{
			OnXAxis(action, null);
		}

		protected virtual void OnXAxis(Action<Axis> action, string propertyName)
		{
			action(GetXAxis());
		}

		protected virtual void OnYAxis(Action<Axis> action, bool subCharts)
		{
			action(GetYAxis());
		}

		protected virtual void OnYAxis(Action<Axis> action)
		{
			OnYAxis(action, subCharts: true);
		}

		protected virtual void OnXAxisTitle(Action<TitleSettings> action)
		{
			ApplyTitleSetting(GetXAxis(), action);
		}

		protected virtual void OnYAxisTitle(Action<TitleSettings> action)
		{
			ApplyTitleSetting(GetYAxis(), action);
		}

		protected virtual void OnYAxisLabel(Action<AxisLabelSettings> action)
		{
			ApplyLabelSetting(GetYAxis(), action);
		}

		protected virtual void OnXAxisLabel(Action<AxisLabelSettings> action)
		{
			ApplyLabelSetting(GetXAxis(), action);
		}

		[TreatAsPX]
		public double GetScaledValueX(double unscaledValue)
		{
			Axis xAxis = GetXAxis();
			return xAxis.GetScaledValue(unscaledValue, new ScalerParams(base.WindowRect, base.Viewport, xAxis.IsInverted));
		}

		public double GetUnscaledValueX([TreatAsPX] double scaledValue)
		{
			Axis xAxis = GetXAxis();
			return xAxis.GetUnscaledValue(scaledValue, new ScalerParams(base.WindowRect, base.Viewport, xAxis.IsInverted));
		}

		[TreatAsPX]
		public double GetScaledValueY(double unscaledValue)
		{
			Axis yAxis = GetYAxis();
			return yAxis.GetScaledValue(unscaledValue, new ScalerParams(base.WindowRect, base.Viewport, yAxis.IsInverted));
		}

		public double GetUnscaledValueY([TreatAsPX] double scaledValue)
		{
			Axis yAxis = GetYAxis();
			return yAxis.GetUnscaledValue(scaledValue, new ScalerParams(base.WindowRect, base.Viewport, yAxis.IsInverted));
		}

		protected override void ReleaseChart(XamDataChart chart)
		{
			base.ReleaseChart(chart);
			if (chart != null && chart.Axes != null)
			{
				Axis xAxis = GetXAxis();
				Axis yAxis = GetYAxis();
				if (chart.Axes.Contains(xAxis))
				{
					chart.Axes.Remove(xAxis);
				}
				if (chart.Axes.Contains(yAxis))
				{
					chart.Axes.Remove(yAxis);
				}
			}
		}

		internal static string GetXAxisLabel(CategoryAxisBase xAxis, IEnumerable<DataSeries> dataSeries)
		{
			foreach (DataSeries item in dataSeries)
			{
				DataSeriesMemberPathHint dataSeriesMemberPathHint = item.FindMatchingHint(DataSeriesIntent.AxisLabelValue);
				if (dataSeriesMemberPathHint != null)
				{
					string path = dataSeriesMemberPathHint.Path;
					return "{" + path + "}";
				}
			}
			return null;
		}

		protected override void InitializeChart(XamDataChart dataChart)
		{
			base.InitializeChart(dataChart);
			if (dataChart == base.DataChart)
			{
				base.DataChart.Axes.Add(GetXAxis());
				base.DataChart.Axes.Add(GetYAxis());
			}
		}

		protected virtual void InitializeXAxis(Axis xAxis)
		{
			xAxis.MajorStroke = XAxisMajorStroke;
			xAxis.MajorStrokeThickness = XAxisMajorStrokeThickness;
			xAxis.MinorStroke = XAxisMinorStroke;
			xAxis.MinorStrokeThickness = XAxisMinorStrokeThickness;
			xAxis.Stroke = XAxisStroke;
			xAxis.StrokeThickness = XAxisStrokeThickness;
			xAxis.Strip = XAxisStrip;
			xAxis.TickLength = XAxisTickLength;
			xAxis.TickStroke = XAxisTickStroke;
			xAxis.TickStrokeThickness = XAxisTickStrokeThickness;
			xAxis.UseEnhancedIntervalManagement = true;
			if (xAxis == GetXAxis())
			{
				xAxis.Title = XAxisTitle;
			}
			xAxis.Label = XAxisLabel;
			xAxis.LabelFormat = XAxisLabelFormat;
			xAxis.LabelFormatSpecifiers = XAxisLabelFormatSpecifiers;
			ApplyLabelSetting(xAxis, delegate(AxisLabelSettings settings)
			{
				settings.Angle = XAxisLabelAngle;
			});
			ApplyLabelSetting(xAxis, delegate(AxisLabelSettings settings)
			{
				if (settings.Extent != XAxisExtent)
				{
					settings.Extent = XAxisExtent;
				}
			});
			ApplyLabelSetting(xAxis, delegate(AxisLabelSettings settings)
			{
				settings.HorizontalAlignment = XAxisLabelHorizontalAlignment;
			});
			ApplyLabelSetting(xAxis, delegate(AxisLabelSettings settings)
			{
				settings.VerticalAlignment = XAxisLabelVerticalAlignment;
			});
			ApplyLabelSetting(xAxis, delegate(AxisLabelSettings settings)
			{
				settings.Visibility = XAxisLabelVisibility;
			});
			ApplyLabelSetting(xAxis, delegate(AxisLabelSettings settings)
			{
				settings.Location = Resolve(XAxisLabelLocation);
			});
			ApplyTitleSetting(xAxis, delegate(TitleSettings settings)
			{
				settings.HorizontalAlignment = XAxisTitleAlignment;
			});
			ApplyTitleSetting(xAxis, delegate(TitleSettings settings)
			{
				settings.Angle = XAxisTitleAngle;
			});
			InitializeXAxisOverridePlatform(xAxis);
		}

		protected virtual void InitializeYAxis(Axis yAxis)
		{
			if (yAxis == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			ApplyLabelSetting(yAxis, delegate(AxisLabelSettings settings)
			{
				settings.Angle = YAxisLabelAngle;
			});
			ApplyLabelSetting(yAxis, delegate(AxisLabelSettings settings)
			{
				if (settings.Extent != YAxisExtent)
				{
					settings.Extent = YAxisExtent;
				}
			});
			ApplyLabelSetting(yAxis, delegate(AxisLabelSettings settings)
			{
				settings.HorizontalAlignment = YAxisLabelHorizontalAlignment;
			});
			ApplyLabelSetting(yAxis, delegate(AxisLabelSettings settings)
			{
				settings.VerticalAlignment = YAxisLabelVerticalAlignment;
			});
			ApplyLabelSetting(yAxis, delegate(AxisLabelSettings settings)
			{
				settings.Visibility = YAxisLabelVisibility;
			});
			ApplyLabelSetting(yAxis, delegate(AxisLabelSettings settings)
			{
				settings.Location = Resolve(YAxisLabelLocation);
			});
			ApplyTitleSetting(yAxis, delegate(TitleSettings settings)
			{
				settings.VerticalAlignment = YAxisTitleAlignment;
			});
			ApplyTitleSetting(yAxis, delegate(TitleSettings settings)
			{
				settings.Angle = YAxisTitleAngle;
			});
			yAxis.MajorStroke = YAxisMajorStroke;
			yAxis.MajorStrokeThickness = YAxisMajorStrokeThickness;
			yAxis.MinorStroke = YAxisMinorStroke;
			yAxis.MinorStrokeThickness = YAxisMinorStrokeThickness;
			yAxis.Stroke = YAxisStroke;
			yAxis.StrokeThickness = YAxisStrokeThickness;
			yAxis.Strip = YAxisStrip;
			yAxis.TickLength = YAxisTickLength;
			yAxis.TickStroke = YAxisTickStroke;
			yAxis.TickStrokeThickness = YAxisTickStrokeThickness;
			if (yAxis == GetYAxis())
			{
				yAxis.Title = YAxisTitle;
			}
			yAxis.LabelFormat = YAxisLabelFormat;
			yAxis.LabelFormatSpecifiers = YAxisLabelFormatSpecifiers;
			InitializeYAxisOverridePlatform(yAxis);
		}

		protected override void InitializeAxes()
		{
			base.InitializeAxes();
			InitializeXAxis(GetXAxis());
			InitializeYAxis(GetYAxis());
		}

		protected virtual void ApplyLabelSetting(Axis axis, Action<AxisLabelSettings> action)
		{
			if (axis != null)
			{
				if (axis.LabelSettings == null)
				{
					axis.LabelSettings = new AxisLabelSettings();
					axis.LabelSettings.Angle = axis.GetDefaultLabelSettingsAngle();
					axis.LabelSettings.Margin = new Thickness(axis.GetDefaultLabelSettingsLeftMargin(), axis.GetDefaultLabelSettingsTopMargin(), axis.GetDefaultLabelSettingsRightMargin(), axis.GetDefaultLabelSettingsBottomMargin());
					axis.LabelSettings.HorizontalAlignment = axis.GetDefaultLabelSettingsHorizontalAlignment();
					axis.LabelSettings.Location = axis.GetDefaultLabelSettingsLocation();
					axis.LabelSettings.VerticalAlignment = axis.GetDefaultLabelSettingsVerticalAlignment();
				}
				if (axis.LabelSettings.IsFrozen)
				{
					axis.LabelSettings = axis.LabelSettings.Clone() as AxisLabelSettings;
				}
				action(axis.LabelSettings);
			}
		}

		protected virtual void ApplyTitleSetting(Axis axis, Action<TitleSettings> action)
		{
			if (axis != null)
			{
				if (axis.TitleSettings == null)
				{
					axis.TitleSettings = new TitleSettings();
					axis.TitleSettings.Margin = new Thickness(axis.GetDefaultTitleSettingsLeftMargin(), axis.GetDefaultTitleSettingsTopMargin(), axis.GetDefaultTitleSettingsRightMargin(), axis.GetDefaultTitleSettingsBottomMargin());
					axis.TitleSettings.Angle = axis.GetDefaultTitleSettingsAngle();
					axis.TitleSettings.HorizontalAlignment = axis.GetDefaultTitleSettingsHorizontalAlignment();
					axis.TitleSettings.VerticalAlignment = axis.GetDefaultTitleSettingsVerticalAlignment();
				}
				if (axis.TitleSettings.IsFrozen)
				{
					axis.TitleSettings = axis.TitleSettings.Clone() as TitleSettings;
				}
				action(axis.TitleSettings);
			}
		}

					settings.Angle = XAxisLabelAngle;
				});

				break;

				{
					settings.VerticalAlignment = YAxisLabelVerticalAlignment;

				break;

				OnXAxisLabel(delegate(AxisLabelSettings settings)

					settings.Visibility = XAxisLabelVisibility;

				break;

					settings.Visibility = YAxisLabelVisibility;
				});
				break;
			case "XAxisLabel":
				OnXAxis(delegate(Axis axis)

					axis.Label = XAxisLabel;
				});
				break;
			case "YAxisLabel":
				OnYAxis(delegate(Axis axis)

				break;

			case "XAxisTitleAngle":
				OnXAxisTitle(delegate(TitleSettings settings)

					settings.Angle = XAxisTitleAngle;
				});

			case "YAxisTitleAngle":
				OnYAxisTitle(delegate(TitleSettings settings)

			case "XAxisTitle":
				OnXAxis(delegate(Axis axis)

					axis.Title = XAxisTitle;

				break;
			case "YAxisTitle":
				OnYAxis(delegate(Axis axis)

					axis.Title = YAxisTitle;

			case "XAxisMajorStroke":
				OnXAxis(delegate(Axis axis)
				{
					axis.MajorStroke = XAxisMajorStroke;

				break;
			}
		}

		internal void OnYAxisLabelLocationChanged()
		{
			AxisLabelsLocation location = Resolve(YAxisLabelLocation);
			if (location == AxisLabelsLocation.OutsideLeft || location == AxisLabelsLocation.InsideRight)
			{
				YAxisLabelHorizontalAlignment = HorizontalAlignment.Right;
			}
			else
			{
				YAxisLabelHorizontalAlignment = HorizontalAlignment.Left;
			}
			OnYAxisLabel(delegate(AxisLabelSettings settings)
			{
				settings.Location = location;
			});
		}

		internal void OnXAxisLabelLocationChanged()
		{
			AxisLabelsLocation location = Resolve(XAxisLabelLocation);
			if (location == AxisLabelsLocation.OutsideBottom || location == AxisLabelsLocation.InsideBottom)
			{
				XAxisLabelVerticalAlignment = VerticalAlignment.Top;
			}
			else
			{
				XAxisLabelVerticalAlignment = VerticalAlignment.Bottom;
			}
			OnXAxisLabel(delegate(AxisLabelSettings settings)
			{
				settings.Location = location;
			});
		}

		internal AxisLabelsLocation Resolve(YAxisLabelLocation location)
		{
			switch (location)
			{
			case YAxisLabelLocation.OutsideLeft:
				return AxisLabelsLocation.OutsideLeft;
			case YAxisLabelLocation.OutsideRight:
				return AxisLabelsLocation.OutsideRight;
			case YAxisLabelLocation.InsideRight:
				return AxisLabelsLocation.InsideRight;
			case YAxisLabelLocation.InsideLeft:
				return AxisLabelsLocation.InsideLeft;
			default:
				if (DomainType == DomainType.Financial)
				{
					return AxisLabelsLocation.OutsideRight;
				}
				return AxisLabelsLocation.OutsideLeft;
			}
		}

		internal AxisLabelsLocation Resolve(XAxisLabelLocation location)
		{
			return location switch
			{
				XAxisLabelLocation.OutsideBottom => AxisLabelsLocation.OutsideBottom, 
				XAxisLabelLocation.OutsideTop => AxisLabelsLocation.OutsideTop, 
				XAxisLabelLocation.InsideBottom => AxisLabelsLocation.InsideBottom, 
				XAxisLabelLocation.InsideTop => AxisLabelsLocation.InsideTop, 
				_ => AxisLabelsLocation.OutsideBottom, 
			};
		}

		protected virtual void InitializeXAxisOverridePlatform(Axis xAxis)
		{
			ApplyLabelSetting(xAxis, delegate(AxisLabelSettings settings)
			{
				settings.FontFamily = XAxisLabelFontFamily;
			});
			ApplyLabelSetting(xAxis, delegate(AxisLabelSettings settings)
			{
				settings.FontStretch = XAxisLabelFontStretch;
			});
			ApplyLabelSetting(xAxis, delegate(AxisLabelSettings settings)
			{
				settings.FontStyle = XAxisLabelFontStyle;
			});
			ApplyLabelSetting(xAxis, delegate(AxisLabelSettings settings)
			{
				settings.FontWeight = XAxisLabelFontWeight;
			});

	internal class IsInstanceOfTypeConverter : IValueConverter
	{
		public object Convert(object value, Type targetType, object parameter, CultureInfo culture)
		{
			return value != null && parameter is Type && ((Type)parameter).IsInstanceOfType(value);
		}

		public object ConvertBack(object value, Type targetType, object parameter, CultureInfo culture)
		{
			return value;
		}
	}

	[WidgetIgnoreDepends("NumericAxisBase")]
	[WidgetIgnoreDepends("NumericRadiusAxis")]
	[WidgetIgnoreDepends("NumericYAxis")]
	internal class AutoRangeCalculator
	{
		public static void CalculateRange(NumericAxisBase target, [SwiftMutableParameter] double userMinimum, [SwiftMutableParameter] double userMaximum, bool isLogarithmic, int logarithmBase, out double minimumValue, out double maximumValue)
		{
			minimumValue = ((!double.IsNaN(userMinimum) && !double.IsInfinity(userMinimum)) ? userMinimum : double.PositiveInfinity);
			maximumValue = ((!double.IsNaN(userMaximum) && !double.IsInfinity(userMaximum)) ? userMaximum : double.NegativeInfinity);
			double num = minimumValue;
			double num2 = maximumValue;
			if ((double.IsInfinity(num) || double.IsInfinity(num2)) && target != null)
			{
				AxisRange axisRange = target.GetAxisRange();
				if (axisRange != null)
				{
					num = Math.Min(num, axisRange.Minimum);
					num2 = Math.Max(num2, axisRange.Maximum);
				}
			}
			if (!double.IsInfinity(num) && !double.IsInfinity(num2))
			{
				if (num == num2 && num != 0.0)
				{
					num *= ((num > 0.0) ? 0.9 : 1.1);
					num2 *= ((num2 > 0.0) ? 1.1 : 0.9);
				}
				if (num == num2 && num == 0.0)
				{
					num2 = 1.0;
				}
				if (userMinimum > userMaximum)
				{
					double num3 = userMaximum;
					userMaximum = userMinimum;
					userMinimum = num3;
				}
				double num4 = ((double.IsNaN(userMinimum) || double.IsInfinity(userMinimum)) ? num : userMinimum);
				double num5 = ((double.IsNaN(userMaximum) || double.IsInfinity(userMaximum)) ? num2 : userMaximum);
				if (isLogarithmic)
				{
					if (num4 <= 0.0)
					{
						num4 = ((!(num5 > 1.0)) ? Math.Pow(logarithmBase, Math.Floor(Math.Log(num5, logarithmBase))) : 1.0);
					}
					if (double.IsNaN(userMinimum) || double.IsInfinity(userMinimum))
					{
						double d = Math.Log(num4, logarithmBase);
						num = Math.Pow(logarithmBase, Math.Floor(d));
					}
					else
					{
						num = num4;
					}
					num2 = ((!double.IsNaN(userMaximum) && !double.IsInfinity(userMaximum)) ? num5 : Math.Pow(logarithmBase, Math.Ceiling(Math.Log(num5, logarithmBase))));
				}
				else
				{
					double num6 = Math.Pow(10.0, Math.Floor(Math.Log10(num5 - num4)) - 1.0);
					double resolutionExtent = target.GetResolutionExtent();
					if (target != null && resolutionExtent > 0.0 && !target.HasUserMinimum && !target.HasUserMaximum)
					{
						num6 = new LinearNumericSnapper(num, num2, resolutionExtent, target.ResolveHeuristicResolution()).Interval;
					}
					num = (((!double.IsNaN(userMinimum) && !double.IsInfinity(userMinimum)) || double.IsNaN(num) || double.IsNaN(num6) || num6 == 0.0) ? num4 : ((!(num6 <= XamDataChart.DecimalMinimumValueAsDouble)) ? (num6 * Math.Floor(num / num6)) : Convert.ToDouble(Convert.ToDecimal(num6) * Convert.ToDecimal(Math.Floor(num / num6)))));
					if ((double.IsNaN(userMaximum) || double.IsInfinity(userMaximum)) && !double.IsNaN(num2) && !double.IsNaN(num6) && num6 != 0.0)
					{
						double num7 = Math.Ceiling(num2 / num6);
						num2 = ((!(num7 <= XamDataChart.DecimalMaximumValueAsDouble) || !(num6 <= XamDataChart.DecimalMaximumValueAsDouble) || !(num6 * num7 <= XamDataChart.DecimalMaximumValueAsDouble)) ? (num6 * num7) : Convert.ToDouble(Convert.ToDecimal(num6) * Convert.ToDecimal(num7)));
					}
					else
					{
						num2 = num5;
					}
				}
			}
			minimumValue = num;
			maximumValue = num2;
		}
	}

		[XamWPSuppressWidgetMember]
		[XamiOSSuppressWidgetMember]
		[MvcSuppressWidgetMember]
		[TSSuppressWidgetMember]
		public bool UseSmartAxis
		{
			get
			{
				return _useSmartAxis;
			}
			set
			{
				if (_useSmartAxis != value)
				{
					_useSmartAxis = value;
					Rect labelViewport = Rect.Empty;
					if (LabelPanel != null)
					{
						_ = LabelPanel.LabelViewport;
						labelViewport = LabelPanel.LabelViewport;
					}
					AxisLabelPanelBase labelPanel = LabelPanel;
					LabelPanel = CreateLabelPanel();
					LabelPanel.Axis = this;
					LabelPanel.LabelSettings = LabelSettings;
					LabelPanel.LabelViewport = labelViewport;
					if (SeriesViewer != null && SeriesViewer.View != null)
					{
						SeriesViewer.View.UpdateLabelPanel(labelPanel, LabelPanel);
						RefreshAxis(shouldResizeAxisPanel: true);
					}
				}
			}
		}

		[JAVASuppressWidgetMember]
		[XamWPSuppressWidgetMember]
		[XamAndroidSuppressWidgetMember]
		[XamiOSSuppressWidgetMember]
		[MvcSuppressWidgetMember]
		[TSSuppressWidgetMember]
		public FontInfo SmartAxisFont
		{
			get
			{
				if (_smartAxisFont == null)
				{
					if (LabelSettings != null)
					{
						return LabelSettings.FontInfo;
					}
					if (_smartAxisDefaultFont == null)
					{
						_smartAxisDefaultFont = View.GetSmartAxisDefaultFont();
					}
					return _smartAxisDefaultFont;
				}
				return _smartAxisFont;
			}
			set
			{
				_smartAxisFont = value;
				_smartAxisFontSize = FontUtil.GetFontSize(_smartAxisFont);
				RefreshAxis();
			}
		}

		[JAVASuppressWidgetMember]
		[XamWPSuppressWidgetMember]
		[XamAndroidSuppressWidgetMember]
		[XamiOSSuppressWidgetMember]
		[MvcSuppressWidgetMember]
		[TSSuppressWidgetMember]
		public string SmartAxisFontName
		{
			get
			{
				return _smartAxisFontName;
			}
			set
			{
				_smartAxisFontName = value;
				double num = _smartAxisFontSize;
				if (double.IsNaN(num))
				{
					num = 12.0;
				}
				SmartAxisFont.FontFamily = new FontFamily(value);
				SmartAxisFont.FontSize = num;
				LabelPanel.CreateFontInfoMap();
				RefreshAxis();
			}
		}

		[JAVASuppressWidgetMember]
		[XamWPSuppressWidgetMember]
		[XamiOSSuppressWidgetMember]
		[MvcSuppressWidgetMember]

		{
			get
			{
				return _smartAxisFontSize;
			}
			set
			{
				_smartAxisFontSize = value;
				SmartAxisFont = FontUtil.GetFontWithNewFontSize(SmartAxisFont, _smartAxisFontSize);
				RefreshAxis();
			}
		}

		protected Axis()
		{
			VisualDataFactoryManager.Register();
			AnnotationFactoryManager.Register();
			ExtentOverride = double.NaN;
			View = CreateView();
			OnViewCreated(View);
			View.OnInit();
			TextBlocks = new Pool<TextBlock>
			{
				Create = View.TextBlockCreate,
				Activate = View.TextBlockActivate,
				Disactivate = View.TextBlockDisactivate,
				Destroy = View.TextBlockDestroy
			};
			AnnotationTextBlocks = new Pool<TextBlock>
			{
				Create = View.TextBlockCreate,
				Activate = View.TextBlockActivate,
				Disactivate = View.TextBlockDisactivate,
				Destroy = View.TextBlockDestroy
			};
			AnnotationBackings = new Pool<Rectangle>
			{
				Create = View.AnnotationBackingCreate,
				Activate = View.AnnotationBackingActivate,
				Disactivate = View.AnnotationBackingDisactivate,
				Destroy = View.AnnotationBackingDestroy
			};
			ViewportOverride = Rect.Empty;
			LabelDataContext = new List<object>();
			LabelPositions = new List<LabelPosition>();
			LabelPanel = CreateLabelPanel();
			LabelPanel.LabelSettings = LabelSettings;
			LabelPanel.Axis = this;
			Series = new List<Series>();
			_annotations.CollectionResetting += _annotations_CollectionResetting;
			_annotations.CollectionChanged += _annotations_CollectionChanged;
			_autoAnnotations.CollectionResetting += _autoAnnotations_CollectionResetting;
			_autoAnnotations.CollectionChanged += _autoAnnotations_CollectionChanged;
			base.DefaultStyleKey = typeof(Axis);
			if (LabelSettings != null)
			{
				_currentLabelSettings = LabelSettings;
			}
			PropertyUpdated += delegate(object o, PropertyUpdatedEventArgs e)
			{
				PropertyUpdatedOverride(o, e.PropertyName, e.OldValue, e.NewValue);
			};
			SeriesViewer_ActualWindowRectChanged = delegate(object o, RectChangedEventArgs e)
			{
				if (SeriesViewer == null || !SeriesViewer.IgnoreWindowChanges)
				{
					WindowRectChangedOverride(e.OldRect, e.NewRect);
				}
			};
			View.BindLabelPanelStyle();
			ApplyDefaultSettings();
			LabelPanel.LabelSettings = LabelSettings;
		}

		private void RefreshAxis()
		{
			RefreshAxis(shouldResizeAxisPanel: false);
		}

		private void RefreshAxis(bool shouldResizeAxisPanel)
		{
			if (shouldResizeAxisPanel)
			{
				LabelPanel.Unlock();
			}
			MustInvalidateLabels = true;
			Refresh();
		}

		private void UpdateActualTickLength()
		{
			if (TickLength > 0.0)
			{
				ActualTickLength = TickLength;
			}
			else if (SeriesViewer is XamDataChart xamDataChart && double.IsNaN(TickLength) && IsCategory && (IsVertical || Orientation == AxisOrientation.Horizontal))
			{
				ActualTickLength = xamDataChart.ChartView.DefaultCategoryAxisTickLength;
			}
			else
			{
				ActualTickLength = 0.0;
			}
		}

		internal virtual bool ValidateAxis(Rect viewportRect, Rect windowRect, AxisView view)
		{
			return SeriesViewer != null;
		}

		protected internal bool IsValid()
		{
			Rect windowRect = Rect.Empty;
			if (SeriesViewer != null)
			{
				windowRect = SeriesViewer.WindowRect;
			}
			return ValidateAxis(ViewportRect, windowRect, View);
		}

		protected virtual void ViewportChangedOverride(Rect oldRect, Rect newRect)
		{
			PendingSizeChange = false;
			ViewportRect = newRect;
			MustInvalidateLabels = true;
			UpdateRange();
			RenderAxis(animate: false);
			if (SeriesViewer != null)
			{
				SeriesViewer.ChartContentManager.ViewportChanged(ChartContentType.Axis, this, ContentInfo, newRect);
			}
		}

		protected virtual Rect GetEffectiveViewportForUnitViewport()
		{
			if (SeriesViewer == null || SeriesViewer.EffectiveViewport.IsEmpty)
			{
				return Rect.Empty;
			}
			Rect effectiveViewport = SeriesViewer.EffectiveViewport;
			Rect viewportRect = ViewportRect;
			double num = (effectiveViewport.Left - viewportRect.Left) / viewportRect.Width;
			double num2 = (effectiveViewport.Top - viewportRect.Top) / viewportRect.Height;
			double num3 = (effectiveViewport.Right - viewportRect.Left) / viewportRect.Width;
			double num4 = (effectiveViewport.Bottom - viewportRect.Top) / viewportRect.Height;
			return new Rect(num, num2, num3 - num, num4 - num2);
		}

		protected virtual void WindowRectChangedOverride(Rect oldRect, Rect newRect)
		{
			MustInvalidateLabels = true;
			RenderAxis(animate: true);
		}

		internal void Refresh()
		{
			RenderAxis(animate: false);
		}

		protected virtual void PropertyUpdatedOverride(object sender, string propertyName, object oldValue, object newValue)
		{
			switch (propertyName)
			{
			case "LabelFormat":
			case "LabelFormatSpecifiers":
				if (LabelFormat != null)
				{
					BindingFormatter = new BindingFormatter();
					BindingFormatter.FormatString = LabelFormat;
					BindingFormatter.FormatSpecifiers = LabelFormatSpecifiers;
				}
				else
				{
					BindingFormatter = null;
				}
				break;
			case "SeriesViewer":
				if (oldValue is SeriesViewer seriesViewer)
				{
					seriesViewer.ActualWindowRectChanged -= SeriesViewer_ActualWindowRectChanged;
					seriesViewer.ChartContentManager.Unsubscribe(ChartContentType.Axis, this);
					View.DetachFromChart(seriesViewer);
				}
				if (newValue is SeriesViewer seriesViewer2)
				{
					seriesViewer2.ActualWindowRectChanged += SeriesViewer_ActualWindowRectChanged;
					ContentInfo = seriesViewer2.ChartContentManager.Subscribe(ChartContentType.Axis, this, DoRenderAxis);
					View.AttachToChart(seriesViewer2);
					if (RangeDirty && !ContentInfo.RangeDirty)
					{
						RangeDirty = false;
						UpdateRange();
					}
					UpdateActualBrushes();
					UpdateActualTickLength();
				}
				break;
			case "IsDisabled":
				RenderAxis(animate: false);
				break;
			case "ShouldKeepAnnotationsInView":
				ShouldKeepAnnotationsInViewCached = ShouldKeepAnnotationsInView;
				RenderAxis(animate: false);
				break;
			case "ShouldAvoidAnnotationCollisions":
				ShouldAvoidAnnotationCollisionsCached = ShouldAvoidAnnotationCollisions;
				RenderAxis(animate: false);
				break;
			case "IsInverted":
			{
				IsInvertedCached = IsInverted;
				AxisRangeChangedEventArgs rangeChangedEventArgs = new AxisRangeChangedEventArgs(0.0, 0.0, 1.0, 1.0);
				DoRaiseRangeChanged(rangeChangedEventArgs);
				{
					foreach (Series item in Series)
					{
						item.InvalidateAxes();
						if (item.SeriesViewer != null)
						{
							item.NotifyThumbnailAppearanceChanged();
						}
					}
					break;
				}
			}
			case "Label":
				View.OnLabelChanged();
				if (newValue is DataTemplate)
				{
					UsingTemplate = true;
				}
				else
				{
					UsingTemplate = false;
				}
				MustInvalidateLabels = true;
				ResetLabelPanel();
				RenderAxis(animate: false);
				break;
			case "MajorStrokeThickness":
			case "MinorStrokeThickness":
			case "StrokeThickness":
				RenderAxis(animate: false);
				break;
			case "LabelPanelStyle":
				View.OnLabelPanelStyleChanged(newValue);
				RenderAxis(animate: false);
				break;
			case "LabelSettings":
				if (newValue is AxisLabelSettings axisLabelSettings)
				{
					axisLabelSettings.RegisterAxis(this);
					_currentLabelSettings = axisLabelSettings;
				}
				else
				{
					_currentLabelSettings = new AxisLabelSettings();
				}
				if (LabelPanel != null)
				{
					LabelPanel.LabelSettings = _currentLabelSettings;
				}
				PropagateLabelSettings();
				MustInvalidateLabels = true;
				RenderAxis(animate: false);
				break;
			case "Title":
				View.OnTitleChange();
				break;
			case "TitleSettings":
			{
				TitleSettings titleSettings = newValue as TitleSettings;
				if (titleSettings != null)
				{
					titleSettings.RegisterAxis(this);
				}
				else
				{
					titleSettings = new TitleSettings();
				}
				if (TitleTextBlock != null)
				{
					TitleTextBlock.DataContext = titleSettings;
				}
				PropagateTitleSettings();
				RenderAxis(animate: false);
				break;
			}
			case "TickLength":
				MustInvalidateLabels = true;
				UpdateActualTickLength();
				View.LabelNeedRearrange();
				RenderAxis(animate: false);
				break;
			case "EnhancedIntervalMinimumCharacters":
			case "UseEnhancedIntervalManagement":
			case "EnhancedIntervalPreferMoreCategoryLabels":
				MustInvalidateLabels = true;
				RenderAxis(animate: false);
				break;
			case "CrossingAxis":
				if (SeriesViewer != null)
				{
					SeriesViewer.InvalidatePanels();
				}
				break;
			case "MinorStroke":
				UpdateActualBrushes();
				if (newValue != null)
				{
					ShouldRenderMinorLines = true;
					RenderAxis(animate: false);
				}
				else
				{
					ShouldRenderMinorLines = false;
				}
				break;
			case "CrossingValue":
				if (CrossingAxis != null)
				{
					CrossingAxis.RenderAxis();
				}
				break;
			case "Stroke":
			case "MajorStroke":
				UpdateActualBrushes();
				break;
			case "MinExtent":
				View.LabelNeedRearrange();
				break;
			}
		}

		protected internal void PropagateLabelSettings()
		{
			if (View.Ready())
			{
				View.ChangeLabelSettings(_currentLabelSettings);
			}
		}

		protected internal void PropagateTitleSettings()
		{
			View.OnTitleChange();
		}

		private void ResetLabelPanel()
		{
			TextBlocks.Count = 0;
			AnnotationTextBlocks.Count = 0;
			AnnotationBackings.Count = 0;
			if (View.Ready())
			{
				View.ResetLabelPanel();
			}
		}

		protected void HorizontalStrip(GeometryCollection geometry, double y0, double y1, Rect viewportRect)
		{
			double num = Math.Min(y0, y1);
			double num2 = Math.Max(y0, y1);
			if (num < viewportRect.Bottom && num2 > viewportRect.Top)
			{
				RectangleGeometry rectangleGeometry = new RectangleGeometry();
				rectangleGeometry.Rect = new Rect(viewportRect.Left, num, viewportRect.Width, num2 - num);
				geometry.Add(rectangleGeometry);
			}
		}

		protected void HorizontalLine(GeometryCollection geometry, [SwiftMutableParameter] double y, Rect viewportRect, PathRenderingInfo renderingInfo, bool isAxisLine)
		{
			bool flag = y <= viewportRect.Bottom && y >= viewportRect.Top;
			if (!isAxisLine && flag)
			{
				flag = !IsGridLineColliding(y, renderingInfo.StrokeThickness, viewportRect, isVertical: false);
			}
			if (flag)
			{
				if (renderingInfo.AlignToPixels)
				{
					y = AlignLineToPixels(y, viewportRect.Top, viewportRect.Bottom, renderingInfo);
				}
				LineGeometry lineGeometry = new LineGeometry();
				lineGeometry.StartPoint = new Point(viewportRect.Left, y);
				lineGeometry.EndPoint = new Point(viewportRect.Right, y);
				geometry.Add(lineGeometry);
			}
		}

		protected void VerticalStrip(GeometryCollection geometry, double x0, double x1, Rect viewportRect)
		{
			double num = Math.Min(x0, x1);
			double num2 = Math.Max(x0, x1);
			if (num2 > viewportRect.Left && num < viewportRect.Right)
			{
				RectangleGeometry rectangleGeometry = new RectangleGeometry();
				rectangleGeometry.Rect = new Rect(num, viewportRect.Top, num2 - num, viewportRect.Height);
				geometry.Add(rectangleGeometry);
			}
		}

		protected void VerticalLine(GeometryCollection geometry, [SwiftMutableParameter] double x, Rect viewportRect, PathRenderingInfo renderingInfo, bool isAxisLine)
		{
			bool flag = x >= viewportRect.Left && x <= viewportRect.Right;
			if (!flag)
			{
				int num = (int)Math.Round(x);
				int num2 = (int)Math.Round(viewportRect.Left);
				int num3 = (int)Math.Round(viewportRect.Right);
				if (num >= num2 && num <= num3)
				{
					flag = true;
				}
			}
			if (!isAxisLine && flag)
			{
				flag = !IsGridLineColliding(x, renderingInfo.StrokeThickness, viewportRect, isVertical: true);
			}
			if (flag)
			{
				if (renderingInfo.AlignToPixels)
				{
					x = AlignLineToPixels(x, viewportRect.Left, viewportRect.Right, renderingInfo);
				}
				LineGeometry lineGeometry = new LineGeometry();
				lineGeometry.StartPoint = new Point(x, viewportRect.Top);
				lineGeometry.EndPoint = new Point(x, viewportRect.Bottom);
				geometry.Add(lineGeometry);
			}
		}

		private bool IsGridLineColliding(double position, double lineThickness, Rect viewport, bool isVertical)
		{
			bool result = false;
			if (SeriesViewer is XamDataChart { ShouldClipGridlines: not false } xamDataChart && !viewport.IsEmpty)
			{
				foreach (Axis axis in xamDataChart.Axes)
				{
					if (axis.Visibility != Visibility.Visible || axis.StrokeThickness < 1.0 || axis.ActualStroke == null || axis.ActualStroke.IsFullyTransparent() || axis.ViewportRect.IsEmpty)
					{
						continue;
					}
					if (axis.CrossingAxis != null && axis.HasCrossingValue())
					{
						double crossingValue = (IsVertical ? viewport.Left : viewport.Top);
						double relativeCrossingValue = 0.0;
						axis.ScaleCrossingValue(out crossingValue, out relativeCrossingValue, axis.SeriesViewer.WindowRect, viewport, axis.GetCurrentEffectiveViewport(), isVertical ? viewport.Left : viewport.Top, isVertical ? viewport.Right : viewport.Bottom);
						Rect rect = Rect.Empty;
						Rect rect2 = Rect.Empty;
						if (isVertical && axis.IsVertical)
						{
							rect = new Rect(crossingValue - axis.StrokeThickness / 2.0, axis.ViewportRect.Top, axis.StrokeThickness, axis.ViewportRect.Height);
							rect2 = new Rect(position - lineThickness / 2.0, viewport.Top, lineThickness, viewport.Height);
						}
						else if (!isVertical && !axis.IsVertical)
						{
							rect = new Rect(axis.ViewportRect.Left, crossingValue - axis.StrokeThickness / 2.0, axis.ViewportRect.Width, axis.StrokeThickness);
							rect2 = new Rect(viewport.Left, position - lineThickness / 2.0, viewport.Width, lineThickness);
						}
						if (rect.Left <= rect2.Right && rect2.Left <= rect.Right && rect.Top <= rect2.Bottom && rect2.Top <= rect.Bottom)
						{
							result = true;
							break;
						}
					}
					else
					{
						Rect rect3 = Rect.Empty;
						Rect rect4 = Rect.Empty;
						if (isVertical && axis.IsVertical)
						{
							rect3 = new Rect(axis.ViewportRect.Left, axis.ViewportRect.Top, axis.StrokeThickness, axis.ViewportRect.Height);
							rect4 = new Rect(position - lineThickness / 2.0, viewport.Top, lineThickness, viewport.Height);
						}
						else if (!isVertical && !axis.IsVertical)
						{
							rect3 = new Rect(axis.ViewportRect.Left, axis.ViewportRect.Bottom - axis.StrokeThickness / 2.0, axis.ViewportRect.Width, axis.StrokeThickness);
							rect4 = new Rect(viewport.Left, position - lineThickness / 2.0, viewport.Width, lineThickness);
						}
						if (rect3.Left <= rect4.Right && rect4.Left <= rect3.Right && rect3.Top <= rect4.Bottom && rect4.Top <= rect3.Bottom)
						{
							result = true;
							break;
						}
					}
				}
			}
			return result;
		}

		protected void ScaleCrossingValue(out double crossingValue, out double relativeCrossingValue, Rect window, Rect viewport, Rect effectiveViewport, double constraintLeft, double constraintRight)
		{
			double num = Math.Abs(constraintLeft - constraintRight);
			crossingValue = Convert.ToDouble(CrossingValue);
			crossingValue = CrossingAxis.ScaleValue(crossingValue);
			if (CrossingAxis is CategoryAxisBase { CategoryMode: CategoryMode.Mode2 } categoryAxisBase)
			{
				double num2 = 0.5 * categoryAxisBase.GetCategorySize(window, viewport, effectiveViewport);
				bool flag = categoryAxisBase.Orientation == AxisOrientation.Horizontal;
				if (categoryAxisBase.IsInverted == flag)
				{
					num2 = 0.0 - num2;
				}
				crossingValue += num2;
			}
			relativeCrossingValue = crossingValue - constraintLeft;
			if (crossingValue < constraintLeft)
			{
				crossingValue = constraintLeft;
			}
			else if (crossingValue > constraintRight)
			{
				crossingValue = constraintRight;
			}
			if (relativeCrossingValue < 0.0)
			{
				relativeCrossingValue = 0.0;
			}
			else if (relativeCrossingValue > num)
			{
				relativeCrossingValue = num;
			}
		}

		protected internal double AlignLineToPixels(double value, double min, double max, PathRenderingInfo renderingInfo)
		{
			double num = value;
			if (renderingInfo != null && renderingInfo.StrokeThickness > 0.0)
			{
				double num2 = renderingInfo.StrokeThickness % 2.0;
				if (num2 == 0.0 || num2 == 1.0)
				{
					int num3 = 1;
					num = Math.Floor(value);
					if (num + 0.5 < value)
					{
						num3 = -1;
						num = Math.Ceiling(value);
					}
					if (num2 == 1.0)
					{
						num += 0.5 * (double)num3;
					}
					if (num >= max)
					{
						num -= 1.0;
					}
					else if (num <= min)
					{
						num += 1.0;
					}
				}
			}
			return num;
		}

		internal void RenderAxis([SwiftMutableParameter] bool animate)
		{
			if (SeriesViewer != null)
			{
				SeriesViewer.ChartContentManager.Refresh(ChartContentType.Axis, this, ContentInfo, animate);
				if (this.RenderRequested != null)
				{
					RenderRequestedEventArgs e = new RenderRequestedEventArgs();
					e.Animate = animate;
					this.RenderRequested(this, e);
					animate = e.Animate;
				}
			}
		}

		internal double ResolveHeuristicVerticalResolution()
		{
			if (LabelFontHeuristics == null)
			{
				return -1.0;
			}
			if (double.IsNaN(LabelFontHeuristics.LabelHeight))
			{
				return -1.0;
			}
			if (LabelSettings != null && LabelSettings.Angle != 0.0)
			{
				return -1.0;
			}
			if (Label is DataTemplate)
			{
				return -1.0;
			}
			return Math.Max(MinHeuristicResolution, LabelFontHeuristics.LabelHeight);
		}

		internal double ResolveHeuristicHorizontalResolution()
		{
			if (LabelFontHeuristics == null)
			{
				return -1.0;
			}
			if (double.IsNaN(LabelFontHeuristics.LabelMinimumWidth) && double.IsNaN(_preciseWidthHeuristic))
			{
				return -1.0;
			}
			if (LabelSettings != null && LabelSettings.Angle != 0.0)
			{
				return -1.0;
			}
			if (Label is DataTemplate)
			{
				return -1.0;
			}
			_ = LabelFontHeuristics.LabelMinimumWidth;
			if (!double.IsNaN(_preciseWidthHeuristic) && EnhancedIntervalMinimumCharacters == -1)
			{
				return _preciseWidthHeuristic;
			}
			return Math.Max(MinHeuristicResolution, LabelFontHeuristics.LabelMinimumWidth);
		}

		internal bool ShouldUseLowerInterval(double interval, Rect windowRect, Rect viewportRect, Rect effectiveViewportRect)
		{
			if (IsCategory && EnhancedIntervalPreferMoreCategoryLabels && HasPreceiceWidthHeuristic() && interval > 1.0)
			{
				double num = interval - 1.0;
				if (num < 1.0)
				{
					return false;
				}
				double labelSpacingForInterval = GetLabelSpacingForInterval(num, windowRect, viewportRect, effectiveViewportRect);
				if (double.IsNaN(labelSpacingForInterval))
				{
					return false;
				}
				if (labelSpacingForInterval > _preciseWidthHeuristic)
				{
					return true;
				}
			}
			return false;
		}

		protected virtual double GetLabelSpacingForInterval(double interval, Rect windowRect, Rect viewportRect, Rect effectiveViewportRect)
		{
			return double.NaN;
		}

		internal double ResolveHeuristicResolution()
		{
			if (IsVertical)
			{
				return ResolveHeuristicVerticalResolution();
			}
			return ResolveHeuristicHorizontalResolution();
		}

		protected override Size ArrangeOverride(Size arrangeBounds)
		{
			if (!arrangeBounds.Equals(lastBounds))
			{
				lastBounds = arrangeBounds;
				PendingSizeChange = true;
			}
			return base.ArrangeOverride(arrangeBounds);
		}

		internal void DoRenderAxis(bool animate)
		{
			if (View.IsDisabled())
			{
				return;
			}
			double num = 0.0;
			int num2 = 0;
			if (LabelPositions != null && LabelPositions.Count > 0)
			{
				num = LabelPositions[LabelPositions.Count - 1].Value;
				num2 = LabelPositions.Count;
			}
			if (MustInvalidateLabels && UseEnhancedIntervalManagement)
			{
				LabelFontHeuristics = GatherLabelFontHeuristics();
			}
			RenderAxisOverride(animate);
			if (!IsVertical && MustInvalidateLabels && UseEnhancedIntervalManagement && ShouldUsePreciseWidthHeuristic && !(Label is DataTemplate) && EnsurePreciseWidthHeuristic())
			{
				RenderAxisOverride(animate);
			}
			double num3 = 1.0;
			int num4 = 0;
			if (LabelPositions != null && LabelPositions.Count > 0)
			{
				num3 = LabelPositions[LabelPositions.Count - 1].Value;
				num4 = LabelPositions.Count;
			}
			if (UseSmartAxis)
			{
				MustInvalidateLabels = true;
			}
			if (num3 != num || num4 != num2 || MustInvalidateLabels)
			{
				MustInvalidateLabels = false;
				if (View.Ready())
				{
					View.LabelNeedRearrange();
				}
			}
			View.EnsureRender();
			EnsureExtentUpdated();
		}

		private bool EnsurePreciseWidthHeuristic()
		{
			if (!double.IsNaN(_preciseWidthHeuristic) || LabelDataContext == null || LabelDataContext.Count == 0)
			{
				return false;
			}
			FontInfo fontInfo = GetFontInfo();
			if (fontInfo == null)
			{
				return false;
			}
			double num = double.MinValue;
			for (int i = 0; i < LabelDataContext.Count; i++)
			{
				object obj = LabelDataContext[i];
				if (obj is string)
				{
					num = Math.Max(FontUtil.MeasureStringWidth((string)obj, fontInfo), num);
				}
			}
			num += 5.0;
			if (LabelSettings != null)
			{
				num += LabelSettings.Margin.Left + LabelSettings.Margin.Right;
			}
			_preciseWidthHeuristic = num;
			return true;
		}

		public void ResetCachedEnhancedInterval()
		{
			_preciseWidthHeuristic = double.NaN;
			RenderAxis(animate: false);
		}

		protected bool HasPreceiceWidthHeuristic()
		{
			if (!double.IsNaN(_preciseWidthHeuristic))
			{
				return EnhancedIntervalMinimumCharacters == -1;
			}
			return false;
		}

		internal virtual double ClampValue(double value, ScalerParams p)
		{
			return value;
		}

		protected void ResetPreciseWidthHeuristic()
		{
			_preciseWidthHeuristic = double.NaN;
		}

		internal LabelFontHeuristics GatherLabelFontHeuristics()
		{
			FontInfo fontInfo = GetFontInfo();
			if (fontInfo == null)
			{
				return null;
			}
			double num = FontUtil.MeasureStringWidth("W", fontInfo);
			if (_priorHeuristicLength != num || LabelFontHeuristics == null)
			{
				_priorHeuristicLength = num;
				double currentFontHeight = FontUtil.GetCurrentFontHeight(fontInfo);
				if (LabelFontHeuristics == null)
				{
					LabelFontHeuristics = new LabelFontHeuristics();
				}
				LabelFontHeuristics.LabelHeight = currentFontHeight;
				LabelFontHeuristics.LabelMinimumDesiredCharacters = EnhancedIntervalMinimumCharacters;
				LabelFontHeuristics.PreferMoreCategoryLabels = EnhancedIntervalPreferMoreCategoryLabels;
				LabelFontHeuristics.LabelWidestCharacterGuess = num;
				LabelFontHeuristics.LabelMinimumWidth = LabelFontHeuristics.LabelWidestCharacterGuess * LabelFontHeuristics.LabelMinimumDesiredCharacters;
			}
			return LabelFontHeuristics;
		}

		internal FontInfo GetFontInfo()
		{
			FontInfo result = null;
			if (SeriesViewer != null)
			{
				result = SeriesViewer.GetFontInfo();
			}
			if (LabelSettings != null && LabelSettings.HasFontInfo)
			{
				result = LabelSettings.GetFontInfo();
			}
			return result;
		}

		{
			if (View.Ready() && !HasUserExtent())
			{
				View.EnsureAutoExtent();
			}
		}

				bool num = UpdateRangeOverride();
				if (num)
				{
					MustInvalidateLabels = true;
				}
				RangeDirty = false;
				return num;
			}
			if (!RangeDirty)
			{
				RangeDirty = true;
				SeriesViewer.ChartContentManager.RangeDirty(this, ContentInfo);
			}
			return false;
		}

		internal void UpdateActualBrushes()
		{
			if (!(SeriesViewer is XamDataChart xamDataChart))
			{
				return;
			}
			Brush brush = null;
			Brush brush2 = null;
			Brush brush3 = null;
			if (IsCategory && !IsAngular)
			{
				brush = xamDataChart.DefaultAxisStroke;
				foreach (Series item in Series)
				{
					if (item.IsScatter || item.IsRadial || item.IsPolar || item.IsRadial)
					{
						brush2 = xamDataChart.DefaultAxisMajorStroke;
						brush3 = xamDataChart.DefaultAxisMinorStroke;
						break;
					}
				}
			}
			else if (IsNumeric && !IsAngular)
			{
				brush2 = xamDataChart.DefaultAxisMajorStroke;
				brush3 = xamDataChart.DefaultAxisMinorStroke;
				brush = ((CrossingAxis != null) ? xamDataChart.DefaultAxisStroke : null);
				foreach (Series item2 in Series)
				{
					if (item2.IsScatter || item2.IsRadial || item2.IsPolar || item2.IsRadial)
					{
						brush = xamDataChart.DefaultAxisStroke;
						break;
					}
				}
			}
			else if (IsAngular || Orientation == AxisOrientation.Radial)
			{
				brush = xamDataChart.DefaultAxisStroke;
				brush2 = xamDataChart.DefaultAxisMajorStroke;
				brush3 = xamDataChart.DefaultAxisMinorStroke;
			}
			ActualStroke = ((Stroke != null) ? Stroke : brush);
			ActualMajorStroke = ((MajorStroke != null) ? MajorStroke : brush2);
			ActualMinorStroke = ((MinorStroke != null) ? MinorStroke : brush3);
		}

		{
			if (this.PropertyChanged != null)
			{
				this.PropertyChanged(this, new PropertyChangedEventArgs(name));
			}
			if (this.PropertyUpdated != null)
			{
				this.PropertyUpdated(this, new PropertyUpdatedEventArgs(name, oldValue, newValue));
			}
		}

		[TSSuppressWidgetMember]

		[SwiftSuppressWidgetMember]

		{
			bool num = Series.Contains(series);
			if (!num)
			{
				Series.Add(series);
			}
			UpdateActualBrushes();
			return !num;
		}

		[JAVASuppressWidgetMember]

		[SwiftSuppressWidgetMember]
		[WFSuppressWidgetMember]

		{
			bool num = Series.Contains(series);
			if (num)
			{
				Series.Remove(series);
			}
			UpdateActualBrushes();
			return num;
		}

		public virtual object GetItemValue(object item, string memberPathName)
		{
			if (ResolveMemberPath(memberPathName) == "Label")
			{
				return GetItemValueByMemberPath(item, memberPathName, Label as string);
			}
			return null;
		}

		protected string ResolveMemberPath(string memberPathName)
		{
			if (!_memberPathMap.ContainsKey(memberPathName))
			{
				string value = char.ToUpper(memberPathName[0]) + memberPathName.Substring(1);
				_memberPathMap.Add(memberPathName, value);
			}
			return _memberPathMap[memberPathName];
		}

		protected object GetItemValueByMemberPath(object item, string memberPathName, string memberPathValue)
		{
			FastReflectionHelper fastReflectionHelper = null;
			if (!_helpers.ContainsKey(memberPathName))
			{
				fastReflectionHelper = new FastReflectionHelper(useTraditionalReflection: false, memberPathValue);
				_helpers.Add(memberPathName, fastReflectionHelper);
			}
			else
			{
				fastReflectionHelper = _helpers[memberPathName];
			}
			fastReflectionHelper.PropertyName = memberPathValue;
			return fastReflectionHelper.GetPropertyValue(item);
		}

		protected override Size MeasureOverride(Size availableSize)
		{
			MeasuredSize = availableSize;
			Size result = base.MeasureOverride(availableSize);
			if (double.IsInfinity(MeasuredSize.Height))
			{
				MeasuredSize = new Size(MeasuredSize.Width, result.Height);
			}
			if (double.IsInfinity(MeasuredSize.Width))
			{
				MeasuredSize = new Size(result.Width, MeasuredSize.Height);
			}
			return result;
		}

		internal void OverrideViewport(Size estimatedPlotSize)
		{
			bool flag = false;
			if (MeasuredSize.Width == 0.0 || MeasuredSize.Height == 0.0)
			{
				ViewportOverride = new Rect(0.0, 0.0, estimatedPlotSize.Width, estimatedPlotSize.Height);
			}
			else
			{
				flag = true;
				ViewportOverride = new Rect(0.0, 0.0, MeasuredSize.Width, MeasuredSize.Height);
			}
			if (flag)
			{
				ContentInfo.IsDirty = true;
				MustInvalidateLabels = true;
				LabelPanel.OverrideViewport();
				UpdateRange(immediate: true);
			}
		}

		internal void UnOverrideViewport()
		{
			ViewportOverride = Rect.Empty;
			LabelPanel.UnOverrideViewport();
		}

		internal AxisComponentsForView GetAxisComponentsForView()
		{
			_axisComponentsForView.RootCanvas = RootCanvas;
			_axisComponentsForView.Axis = this;
			_axisComponentsForView.LabelPanel = LabelPanel;
			return _axisComponentsForView;
		}

		internal bool HasUserExtent()
		{
			if (!double.IsNaN(ExtentOverride))
			{
				return true;
			}
			if (LabelSettings != null)
			{
				return LabelSettings.HasUserExtent();
			}
			return false;
		}

		internal double GetUserExtent()
		{
			if (!double.IsNaN(ExtentOverride))
			{
				return ExtentOverride;
			}
			if (LabelSettings == null)
			{
				return 50.0;
			}
			return LabelSettings.Extent;
		}

		{
			if (IsVertical)
			{
				return new LineGeometry
				{
					StartPoint = new Point(viewport.Left, scaledValue),
					EndPoint = new Point(viewport.Right, scaledValue)
				};
			}
			return new LineGeometry
			{
				StartPoint = new Point(scaledValue, viewport.Bottom),
				EndPoint = new Point(scaledValue, viewport.Top)
			};
		}

	[TSWidget]
	[JAVAWidget]
	public class AxisCollection : ObservableCollection<Axis>
	{
		public Axis this[string axisName]
		{
			get
			{
				using (IEnumerator<Axis> enumerator = GetEnumerator())
				{
					while (enumerator.MoveNext())
					{
						Axis current = enumerator.Current;
						if (axisName == current.Name)
						{
							return current;
						}
					}
				}
				return null;
			}
		}

		public event EventHandler<EventArgs> CollectionResetting;

		public AxisCollection()
		{
			PropertyChanged += delegate(object o, PropertyChangedEventArgs e)
			{
				if (e.PropertyName == "Name")
				{
					for (int i = 0; i < base.Count; i++)
					{
						if (base[i].Name == e.PropertyName)
						{
							OnCollectionChanged(new NotifyCollectionChangedEventArgs(NotifyCollectionChangedAction.Replace, base[i], base[i], i));
						}
					}
				}
			};
		}

		protected override void ClearItems()
		{
			if (this.CollectionResetting != null)
			{
				this.CollectionResetting(this, null);
			}
			base.ClearItems();
		}
	}

		{

					return false;
				}
				return Axis.LabelSettings.Visibility != Visibility.Visible;
			}

			{
			};

		public virtual void Clear(Rect windowRect, Rect viewportRect)
		{
			LabelDataContext.Clear();
			LabelPositions.Clear();
			TargetPanel.Axis = Axis;
			TargetPanel.WindowRect = windowRect;
			TargetPanel.ViewportRect = viewportRect;
			if (viewportRect.IsEmpty || windowRect.IsEmpty)
			{
				SetTextBlockCount(0);
				Axis.AnnotationTextBlocks.Count = 0;
				Axis.AnnotationBackings.Count = 0;
			}
			if (Axis.TextBlocks.Count == 0 && Axis.AnnotationTextBlocks.Count == 0)

				TargetPanel.Children.Clear();
