		public void ScrollRangeIntoView(double minimum, double maximum)
		{
			if (base.SeriesViewer != null && minimum != double.NaN && maximum != double.NaN)
			{
				double proportionalAxisValue = GetProportionalAxisValue(minimum, this);
				double proportionalAxisValue2 = GetProportionalAxisValue(maximum, this);
				if (proportionalAxisValue != double.NaN && proportionalAxisValue2 != double.NaN)
				{
					base.SeriesViewer.WindowRect = new Rect(proportionalAxisValue, base.SeriesViewer.WindowRect.Y, proportionalAxisValue2 - proportionalAxisValue, base.SeriesViewer.WindowRect.Height);
				}
			}
		}

		internal override NumericAxisRenderingParameters CreateRenderingParams(Rect viewportRect, Rect windowRect, Rect effectiveViewportRect, Rect contentViewport)
		{
			Rect rect = contentViewport;
			NumericAxisRenderingParameters numericAxisRenderingParameters = base.CreateRenderingParams(viewportRect, windowRect, effectiveViewportRect, contentViewport);
			ScalerParams p = new ScalerParams(windowRect, viewportRect, base.IsInverted, effectiveViewportRect);
			double num = double.NaN;
			double num2 = double.NaN;
			if (!base.IsInverted && windowRect.Right == 1.0)
			{
				num2 = base.ActualMaximumValue;
			}
			else if (base.IsInverted && windowRect.Left == 0.0)
			{
				num = base.ActualMaximumValue;
			}
			if (double.IsNaN(num))
			{
				num = GetUnscaledValue(rect.Left, p);
			}
			if (double.IsNaN(num2))
			{
				num2 = GetUnscaledValue(rect.Right, p);
			}
			double num3 = Math.Min(num, num2);
			double num4 = Math.Max(num, num2);
			base.ActualVisibleMinimumValue = num3;
			base.ActualVisibleMaximumValue = num4;
			numericAxisRenderingParameters.RangeInfos.Add(new RangeInfo
			{
				VisibleMinimum = num3,
				VisibleMaximum = num4,
				Resolution = rect.Width
			});
			return numericAxisRenderingParameters;
		}

		protected override void RenderAxisOverride(bool animate)
		{
			base.RenderAxisOverride(animate);
			Rect windowRect = ((base.SeriesViewer != null) ? base.SeriesViewer.ActualWindowRect : Rect.Empty);
			Rect viewportRect = ((!windowRect.IsEmpty) ? base.ViewportRect : Rect.Empty);
			Rect currentEffectiveViewport = GetCurrentEffectiveViewport();
			Rect contentViewport = GetContentViewport();
			AxisRenderingParametersBase axisRenderingParametersBase = base.Renderer.Render(animate, viewportRect, windowRect, currentEffectiveViewport, contentViewport);
			if (axisRenderingParametersBase != null)
			{
				base.ActualInterval = axisRenderingParametersBase.TickmarkValues.Interval;
				base.ActualMinorInterval = axisRenderingParametersBase.TickmarkValues.ActualMinorInterval;
			}
		}

		protected override void ViewportChangedOverride(Rect oldRect, Rect newRect)
		{
			base.ViewportChangedOverride(oldRect, newRect);
			if (newRect.Height != oldRect.Height)
			{
				UpdateRange();
			}
		}

		protected internal override NumericScaler CreateScalerOverride()
		{
			if (base.IsLogarithmic)
			{
				return new HorizontalLogarithmicScaler();
			}
			return base.ScaleMode switch
			{
				NumericScaleMode.Linear => new FastHorizontalLinearScaler(), 
				NumericScaleMode.Logarithmic => new HorizontalLogarithmicScaler(), 
				_ => null, 
			};
		}
	}

				Rect effectiveViewportRect = p.EffectiveViewportRect;

		internal override NumericAxisRenderingParameters CreateRenderingParams(Rect viewportRect, Rect windowRect, Rect effectiveViewportRect, Rect contentViewport)

			ScalerParams p = new ScalerParams(windowRect, viewportRect, base.IsInverted, effectiveViewportRect);
			double num = double.NaN;
			double num2 = double.NaN;
			if (!base.IsInverted && windowRect.Top == 0.0)
			{
				num2 = base.ActualMaximumValue;
			}
			else if (base.IsInverted && windowRect.Bottom == 1.0)
			{
				num = base.ActualMaximumValue;
			}
			if (double.IsNaN(num))

				num = GetUnscaledValue(rect.Bottom, p);
			}
			if (double.IsNaN(num2))
			{
				num2 = GetUnscaledValue(rect.Top, p);
			}
			double num3 = Math.Min(num, num2);
			double num4 = Math.Max(num, num2);
			base.ActualVisibleMinimumValue = num3;
			base.ActualVisibleMaximumValue = num4;
			RangeInfo item = new RangeInfo
			{
				VisibleMinimum = num3,
				VisibleMaximum = num4,
				Resolution = rect.Height
			};
			numericAxisRenderingParameters.RangeInfos.Add(item);
			return numericAxisRenderingParameters;
		}

	internal class AxisRendererBase
	{
		public Action Clear { get; set; }

		public ShouldRenderHandler ShouldRender { get; set; }

		public Action OnRendering { get; set; }

		public ScaleValueHandler Scaling { get; set; }

		public RenderStripHandler Strip { get; set; }

		public RenderLineHandler Line { get; set; }

		public ShouldRenderLinesHandler ShouldRenderLines { get; set; }

		public ShouldRenderContentHandler ShouldRenderContent { get; set; }

		public RenderAxisLineHandler AxisLine { get; set; }

		public DetermineCrossingValueHandler DetermineCrossingValue { get; set; }

		public ShouldRenderLabelHandler ShouldRenderLabel { get; set; }

		public GetLabelLocationHandler GetLabelLocation { get; set; }

		public TransformToLabelValueHandler TransformToLabelValue { get; set; }

		public AxisLabelManager LabelManager { get; set; }

		public GetLabelForItemHandler GetLabelForItem { get; set; }

		public CreateRenderingParamsHandler CreateRenderingParams { get; set; }

		public SnapMajorValueHandler SnapMajorValue { get; set; }

		public AdjustMajorValueHandler AdjustMajorValue { get; set; }

		public GetGroupCenterHandler GetGroupCenter { get; set; }

		public GetUnscaledGroupCenterHandler GetUnscaledGroupCenter { get; set; }

		public AxisRendererBase(AxisLabelManager labelManager)
		{
			Clear = delegate
			{
			};
			ShouldRender = (Rect r1, Rect r2) => false;
			OnRendering = delegate
			{
			};
			Scaling = (AxisRenderingParametersBase p, double v) => v;
			Strip = delegate
			{
			};
			Line = delegate
			{
			};
			ShouldRenderLines = (AxisRenderingParametersBase p, double v) => false;
			ShouldRenderContent = (AxisRenderingParametersBase p, double v) => ShouldRenderLines(p, v);
			AxisLine = delegate
			{
			};
			DetermineCrossingValue = delegate
			{
			};
			ShouldRenderLabel = (AxisRenderingParametersBase p, double v, bool last) => false;
			GetLabelLocation = (AxisRenderingParametersBase p, double v) => new LabelPosition(v);
			TransformToLabelValue = (AxisRenderingParametersBase p, double v) => v;
			GetLabelForItem = (object item) => (object)null;
			SnapMajorValue = (AxisRenderingParametersBase p, double v, int i, double interval) => v;
			AdjustMajorValue = (AxisRenderingParametersBase p, double v, int i, double interval) => v;
			LabelManager = labelManager;
			CreateRenderingParams = (Rect r1, Rect r2, Rect r3, Rect r4) => (AxisRenderingParametersBase)null;
		}

		public AxisRenderingParametersBase Render(bool animate, Rect viewportRect, Rect windowRect, Rect effectiveViewportRect, Rect contentViewport)
		{
			ClearLabels(windowRect, viewportRect);
			if (ShouldRender(viewportRect, windowRect))
			{
				OnRendering();
				AxisRenderingParametersBase axisRenderingParametersBase = CreateRenderingParams(viewportRect, windowRect, effectiveViewportRect, contentViewport);
				ClearLabels(windowRect, viewportRect);
				if (axisRenderingParametersBase == null)
				{
					ResetLabels();
					return null;
				}
				if (axisRenderingParametersBase.RangeInfos.Count > 1 && !axisRenderingParametersBase.HasUserInterval)
				{
					SpreadInterval(axisRenderingParametersBase);
				}
				using (List<RangeInfo>.Enumerator enumerator = axisRenderingParametersBase.RangeInfos.GetEnumerator())
				{
					while (enumerator.MoveNext())
					{
						RangeInfo rangeInfo = (axisRenderingParametersBase.CurrentRangeInfo = enumerator.Current);
						if (!double.IsNaN(rangeInfo.VisibleMaximum) && !double.IsInfinity(rangeInfo.VisibleMaximum) && !double.IsNaN(rangeInfo.VisibleMinimum) && !double.IsInfinity(rangeInfo.VisibleMinimum) && rangeInfo.VisibleMinimum != rangeInfo.VisibleMaximum)
						{
							DetermineCrossingValue(axisRenderingParametersBase);
							LabelManager.FloatPanel(axisRenderingParametersBase.RelativeCrossingValue);
							CategoryMode mode = CategoryMode.Mode0;
							int mode2GroupCount = 0;
							bool isInverted = false;
							GetUnscaledGroupCenterHandler getUnscaledGroupCenter = (int n) => n;
							if (GetGroupCenter != null)
							{
								getUnscaledGroupCenter = GetUnscaledGroupCenter;
							}
							if (axisRenderingParametersBase is CategoryAxisRenderingParameters)
							{
								mode = ((CategoryAxisRenderingParameters)axisRenderingParametersBase).CategoryMode;
								mode2GroupCount = ((CategoryAxisRenderingParameters)axisRenderingParametersBase).Mode2GroupCount;
								isInverted = ((CategoryAxisRenderingParameters)axisRenderingParametersBase).IsInverted;
							}
							axisRenderingParametersBase.TickmarkValues = GetTickmarkValues(axisRenderingParametersBase);
							axisRenderingParametersBase.TickmarkValues.Initialize(new TickmarkValuesInitializationParameters
							{
								VisibleMinimum = axisRenderingParametersBase.CurrentRangeInfo.VisibleMinimum,
								VisibleMaximum = axisRenderingParametersBase.CurrentRangeInfo.VisibleMaximum,
								ActualMinimum = axisRenderingParametersBase.ActualMinimumValue,
								ActualMaximum = axisRenderingParametersBase.ActualMaximumValue,
								Resolution = axisRenderingParametersBase.CurrentRangeInfo.Resolution,
								HasUserInterval = axisRenderingParametersBase.HasUserInterval,
								UserInterval = axisRenderingParametersBase.Interval,
								MinorInterval = axisRenderingParametersBase.MinorInterval,
								HeuristicResolution = axisRenderingParametersBase.HeuristicResolution,
								IntervalOverride = axisRenderingParametersBase.CurrentRangeInfo.IntervalOverride,
								MinorCountOverride = axisRenderingParametersBase.CurrentRangeInfo.MinorCountOverride,
								Mode = mode,
								Mode2GroupCount = mode2GroupCount,
								Window = axisRenderingParametersBase.WindowRect,
								Viewport = axisRenderingParametersBase.ViewportRect,
								IsInverted = isInverted,
								GetUnscaledGroupCenter = getUnscaledGroupCenter
							});
							RenderInternal(axisRenderingParametersBase);
						}
					}
				}
				RenderLabels();
				return axisRenderingParametersBase;
			}
			return null;
		}

		private void SpreadInterval(AxisRenderingParametersBase renderingParams)
		{
			double num = double.MinValue;
			int num2 = int.MinValue;
			CategoryMode mode = CategoryMode.Mode0;
			int mode2GroupCount = 0;
			bool isInverted = false;
			GetUnscaledGroupCenterHandler getUnscaledGroupCenter = (int n) => n;
			if (GetGroupCenter != null)
			{
				getUnscaledGroupCenter = GetUnscaledGroupCenter;
			}
			if (renderingParams is CategoryAxisRenderingParameters)
			{
				mode = ((CategoryAxisRenderingParameters)renderingParams).CategoryMode;
				mode2GroupCount = ((CategoryAxisRenderingParameters)renderingParams).Mode2GroupCount;
				isInverted = ((CategoryAxisRenderingParameters)renderingParams).IsInverted;
			}
			using (List<RangeInfo>.Enumerator enumerator = renderingParams.RangeInfos.GetEnumerator())
			{
				while (enumerator.MoveNext())
				{
					RangeInfo rangeInfo = (renderingParams.CurrentRangeInfo = enumerator.Current);
					renderingParams.TickmarkValues.Initialize(new TickmarkValuesInitializationParameters
					{
						VisibleMinimum = rangeInfo.VisibleMinimum,
						VisibleMaximum = rangeInfo.VisibleMaximum,
						ActualMinimum = renderingParams.ActualMinimumValue,
						ActualMaximum = renderingParams.ActualMaximumValue,
						Resolution = rangeInfo.Resolution,
						HasUserInterval = renderingParams.HasUserInterval,
						UserInterval = renderingParams.Interval,
						IntervalOverride = rangeInfo.IntervalOverride,
						MinorCountOverride = rangeInfo.MinorCountOverride,
						HeuristicResolution = renderingParams.HeuristicResolution,
						MinorInterval = renderingParams.MinorInterval,
						Mode = mode,
						Mode2GroupCount = mode2GroupCount,
						Window = renderingParams.WindowRect,
						Viewport = renderingParams.ViewportRect,
						IsInverted = isInverted,
						GetUnscaledGroupCenter = getUnscaledGroupCenter
					});
					rangeInfo.IntervalOverride = renderingParams.TickmarkValues.Interval;
					rangeInfo.MinorCountOverride = renderingParams.TickmarkValues.MinorCount;
					if (!double.IsNaN(renderingParams.TickmarkValues.Interval))
					{
						num = Math.Max(num, renderingParams.TickmarkValues.Interval);
						num2 = Math.Max(num2, renderingParams.TickmarkValues.MinorCount);
					}
				}
			}
			foreach (RangeInfo rangeInfo2 in renderingParams.RangeInfos)
			{
				if (rangeInfo2.IntervalOverride == num)
				{
					rangeInfo2.IntervalOverride = -1.0;
					rangeInfo2.MinorCountOverride = -1;
				}
				else
				{
					rangeInfo2.IntervalOverride = num;
					rangeInfo2.MinorCountOverride = num2;
				}
			}
		}

		private void RenderLabels()
		{
			LabelManager.UpdateLabelPanel();
			bool flag = false;
			if (LabelManager.LabelsHidden)
			{
				LabelManager.SetTextBlockCount(0);
				return;
			}
			int num = 0;
			foreach (object item in LabelManager.LabelDataContext)
			{
				if (!(item is FrameworkElement label))
				{
					FrameworkElement textBlock = LabelManager.GetTextBlock(num);
					textBlock.SetValue(TextBlock.TextProperty, item);
					num++;
				}
				else
				{
					LabelManager.AddLabel(label);
				}
			}
			if (flag)
			{
				LabelManager.NotifyMustRefresh();
			}
			LabelManager.AddAnnotations();
			LabelManager.SetTextBlockCount(num);
		}

		private void RenderInternal(AxisRenderingParametersBase renderingParams)
		{
			double[] array = renderingParams.TickmarkValues.MajorValues().ToArray();
			double[] array2 = renderingParams.TickmarkValues.MinorValues().ToArray();
			LabelManager.SetLabelInterval(Scaling(renderingParams, renderingParams.TickmarkValues.Interval));
			AxisLine(renderingParams);
			for (int i = 0; i < array.Length; i++)
			{
				int num = renderingParams.TickmarkValues.FirstIndex + i;
				double value = array[i];
				double num2 = 0.0;
				num2 = ((i >= array.Length - 1) ? double.PositiveInfinity : array[i + 1]);
				value = SnapMajorValue(renderingParams, value, num, renderingParams.TickmarkValues.Interval);
				num2 = SnapMajorValue(renderingParams, num2, num, renderingParams.TickmarkValues.Interval);
				double num3 = Scaling(renderingParams, value);
				double num4 = Scaling(renderingParams, num2);
				if (ShouldRenderLines(renderingParams, num3))
				{
					if (num % 2 == 0 && ShouldRenderContent(renderingParams, num4) && !double.IsInfinity(num4))
					{
						Strip(renderingParams, renderingParams.Strips, num3, num4);
					}
					renderingParams.CurrentRenderingInfo = renderingParams.MajorRenderingInfo;
					Line(renderingParams, renderingParams.Major, num3);
					renderingParams.CurrentRenderingInfo = null;
				}
				num3 = AdjustMajorValue(renderingParams, num3, num, renderingParams.TickmarkValues.Interval);
				if (!double.IsNaN(num3) && !double.IsInfinity(num3) && ShouldRenderLabel(renderingParams, num3, i == array.Length - 1))
				{
					object label = GetLabel(renderingParams, value, num, renderingParams.TickmarkValues.Interval);
					if (label != null)
					{
						LabelManager.AddLabelObject(label, GetLabelLocation(renderingParams, num3));
					}
				}
			}
			if (renderingParams.ShouldRenderMinorLines)
			{
				foreach (double value2 in array2)
				{
					double value3 = Scaling(renderingParams, value2);
					renderingParams.CurrentRenderingInfo = renderingParams.MinorRenderingInfo;
					Line(renderingParams, renderingParams.Minor, value3);
					renderingParams.CurrentRenderingInfo = null;
				}
			}
		}

			: base(labelManager)

		}

		internal void GetSnapperInfoInternal(AxisRenderingParametersBase renderingParams, out double interval, out int minorCount, out int first, out int last)
		{
			CategoryAxisRenderingParameters categoryAxisRenderingParameters = renderingParams as CategoryAxisRenderingParameters;
			CategoryMode categoryMode = CategoryMode.Mode0;
			if (categoryAxisRenderingParameters != null)
			{
				categoryMode = categoryAxisRenderingParameters.CategoryMode;
			}
			LinearCategorySnapper linearCategorySnapper = new LinearCategorySnapper(renderingParams.CurrentRangeInfo.VisibleMinimum, renderingParams.CurrentRangeInfo.VisibleMaximum, renderingParams.CurrentRangeInfo.Resolution, renderingParams.Interval, categoryMode, renderingParams.HeuristicResolution);
			interval = linearCategorySnapper.Interval;
			if (renderingParams.CurrentRangeInfo.IntervalOverride != -1.0)
			{
				interval = renderingParams.CurrentRangeInfo.IntervalOverride;
			}
			double num = Math.Floor((renderingParams.CurrentRangeInfo.VisibleMinimum - renderingParams.ActualMinimumValue) / interval);
			double num2 = Math.Ceiling((renderingParams.CurrentRangeInfo.VisibleMaximum - renderingParams.ActualMinimumValue) / interval);
			first = (int)num;
			last = (int)num2;
			minorCount = (int)linearCategorySnapper.MinorCount;
			if (renderingParams.CurrentRangeInfo.MinorCountOverride != -1)
			{
				minorCount = renderingParams.CurrentRangeInfo.MinorCountOverride;
			}
		}

		protected internal override object GetLabel(AxisRenderingParametersBase renderingParams, double unscaledValue, int index, double interval)
		{
			if (!(renderingParams is CategoryAxisRenderingParameters categoryAxisRenderingParameters))
			{
				return null;
			}
			int num = 0;
			num = ((interval >= 1.0) ? (index * (int)Math.Floor(interval)) : (((double)index * interval * 2.0 % 2.0 != 0.0) ? (-1) : ((int)Math.Floor((double)index * interval))));
			object result = null;
			if ((categoryAxisRenderingParameters.Count > 0 && num < categoryAxisRenderingParameters.Count && num >= 0) || categoryAxisRenderingParameters.WrapAround)
			{
				while (num >= categoryAxisRenderingParameters.Count && categoryAxisRenderingParameters.WrapAround)
				{
					num -= categoryAxisRenderingParameters.Count;
				}
				result = base.GetLabelForItem(num);
			}
			return result;
		}

		private void RenderMinorLines(AxisRenderingParametersBase renderingParams, double interval, int minorCount, double majorValue, int i, double nextMajorValue)
		{
			CategoryAxisRenderingParameters categoryAxisRenderingParameters = renderingParams as CategoryAxisRenderingParameters;
			if (categoryAxisRenderingParameters.CategoryMode == CategoryMode.Mode0 || categoryAxisRenderingParameters.Mode2GroupCount == 0)
			{
				return;
			}
			for (int j = 0; j < (int)interval; j++)
			{
				for (int k = 0; k < categoryAxisRenderingParameters.Mode2GroupCount; k++)
				{
					double num = base.GetGroupCenter(k, renderingParams.WindowRect, renderingParams.ViewportRect, renderingParams.EffectiveViewportRect);
					if (categoryAxisRenderingParameters.IsInverted)
					{
						num = 0.0 - num;
					}
					double value = base.Scaling(renderingParams, (double)j + (double)i * interval) + num;
					renderingParams.CurrentRenderingInfo = renderingParams.MinorRenderingInfo;
					base.Line(renderingParams, renderingParams.Minor, value);
					renderingParams.CurrentRenderingInfo = null;
				}
			}
		}

	internal class NumberAbbreviator : INumberAbbreviator
	{
		public string Abbreviate(double num)
		{
			double num2 = Math.Abs(num);
			char[] array = new char[5] { 'Q', 'T', 'B', 'M', 'K' };
			double[] array2 = new double[5] { 1000000000000000.0, 1000000000000.0, 1000000000.0, 1000000.0, 1000.0 };
			for (int i = 0; i < array.Length; i++)
			{
				if (num2 >= array2[i])
				{
					return Math.Round(num / array2[i], 1).ToString() + array[i];
				}
			}
			return MathUtil.NumberToMinDecimalsString(num);
		}
	}
	internal class NumericAxisRenderer : AxisRendererBase
	{
		private INumberAbbreviator _abbreviator;

		private bool _noAbbreviator;

		public NumericAxisRenderer(AxisLabelManager labelManager)
			: base(labelManager)
		{
		}

		protected internal override object GetLabel(AxisRenderingParametersBase renderingParams, [SwiftMutableParameter] double unscaledValue, int index, double interval)
		{
			if (renderingParams.Label != null)
			{
				return base.GetLabelForItem(unscaledValue);
			}
			if (renderingParams.IsNumeric() && ((NumericAxisRenderingParameters)renderingParams).AbbreviateLargeNumbers)
			{
				return Abbreviate(unscaledValue);
			}
			return MathUtil.NumberToMinDecimalsString(unscaledValue);
		}

		private string Abbreviate(double value)
		{
			if (_noAbbreviator)
			{
				return value.ToString();
			}
			if (_abbreviator == null)
			{
				_abbreviator = NumberAbbreviatorFactory.GetAbbreviator(base.LabelManager.Axis.SRP);
				if (_abbreviator == null)
				{
					_noAbbreviator = true;
					return value.ToString();
				}
			}
			return _abbreviator.Abbreviate(value);
		}
	}

	public class HorizontalLinearScaler : LinearScaler
	{
		public override double GetUnscaledValue(double scaledValue, ScalerParams p)
		{
			if (!p.EffectiveViewportRect.IsEmpty)
			{
				double num = p.WindowRect.Left + p.WindowRect.Width * (scaledValue - p.ViewportRect.Left) / p.ViewportRect.Width;
				num = num * p.ViewportRect.Width + p.ViewportRect.Left;
				return GetUnscaledValue(num, NumericScaler.UnitRect, p.EffectiveViewportRect, p.IsInverted);
			}
			return GetUnscaledValue(scaledValue, p.WindowRect, p.ViewportRect, p.IsInverted);
		}

		public override double GetScaledValue(double unscaledValue, ScalerParams p)
		{
			if (!p.EffectiveViewportRect.IsEmpty)
			{
				double scaledValue = GetScaledValue(unscaledValue, NumericScaler.UnitRect, p.EffectiveViewportRect, p.IsInverted);
				scaledValue = (scaledValue - p.ViewportRect.Left) / p.ViewportRect.Width;
				return p.ViewportRect.Left + p.ViewportRect.Width * (scaledValue - p.WindowRect.Left) / p.WindowRect.Width;
			}
			return GetScaledValue(unscaledValue, p.WindowRect, p.ViewportRect, p.IsInverted);
		}

		public override void GetScaledValueList(IList<double> unscaledValues, int startIndex, int count, ScalerParams p)
		{
			Rect windowRect = p.WindowRect;
			Rect viewportRect = p.ViewportRect;
			Rect effectiveViewportRect = p.EffectiveViewportRect;
			bool isInverted = p.IsInverted;
			bool flag = !effectiveViewportRect.IsEmpty;
			double actualRange = base.ActualRange;
			double cachedActualMinimumValue = CachedActualMinimumValue;
			double left = effectiveViewportRect.Left;
			double width = effectiveViewportRect.Width;
			double left2 = windowRect.Left;
			double width2 = windowRect.Width;
			double left3 = viewportRect.Left;
			double width3 = viewportRect.Width;
			double num = 0.0;
			double num2 = 1.0;
			double[] array = ArrayAccessHelper.AsDoubleArray(unscaledValues);
			bool flag2 = false;
			if (array != null)
			{
				flag2 = true;
			}
			for (int i = startIndex; i < count; i++)
			{
				double num3 = ((!flag2) ? unscaledValues[i] : array[i]);
				if (flag)
				{
					double num4 = (num3 - cachedActualMinimumValue) / actualRange;
					if (isInverted)
					{
						num4 = 1.0 - num4;
					}
					num4 = left + width * (num4 - num) / num2;
					double num5 = (num4 - left3) / width3;
					num5 = left3 + width3 * (num5 - left2) / width2;
					if (flag2)
					{
						array[i] = num5;
					}
					else
					{
						unscaledValues[i] = num5;
					}
				}
				else
				{
					double num6 = (num3 - cachedActualMinimumValue) / actualRange;
					if (isInverted)
					{
						num6 = 1.0 - num6;
					}
					num6 = left3 + width3 * (num6 - left2) / width2;
					if (flag2)
					{
						array[i] = num6;
					}
					else
					{
						unscaledValues[i] = num6;
					}
				}
			}
		}

		private double GetUnscaledValue(double scaledValue, Rect windowRect, Rect viewportRect, bool isInverted)
		{
			double num = windowRect.Left + windowRect.Width * (scaledValue - viewportRect.Left) / viewportRect.Width;
			if (isInverted)
			{
				num = 1.0 - num;
			}
			return CachedActualMinimumValue + num * base.ActualRange;
		}

		[TreatAsPX]
		private double GetScaledValue(double unscaledValue, Rect windowRect, Rect viewportRect, bool isInverted)
		{
			double num = (unscaledValue - CachedActualMinimumValue) / base.ActualRange;
			if (isInverted)
			{
				num = 1.0 - num;
			}
			return viewportRect.Left + viewportRect.Width * (num - windowRect.Left) / windowRect.Width;
		}
	}
	internal class FastHorizontalLinearScaler : HorizontalLinearScaler
	{
		public override void GetScaledBucketValueList(IList<double[]> unscaledValues, IList<int> bucketIndexes, int startIndex, int count, ScalerParams p)
		{
			Rect windowRect = p.WindowRect;
			Rect viewportRect = p.ViewportRect;
			Rect effectiveViewportRect = p.EffectiveViewportRect;
			bool isInverted = p.IsInverted;
			bool flag = !effectiveViewportRect.IsEmpty;
			double actualRange = base.ActualRange;
			double cachedActualMinimumValue = CachedActualMinimumValue;
			double left = effectiveViewportRect.Left;
			double width = effectiveViewportRect.Width;
			double left2 = windowRect.Left;
			double width2 = windowRect.Width;
			double left3 = viewportRect.Left;
			double width3 = viewportRect.Width;
			double num = 0.0;
			double num2 = 1.0;
			double[][] array = ArrayAccessHelper.AsBucketArray(unscaledValues);
			bool flag2 = false;
			if (array != null)
			{
				flag2 = true;
			}
			for (int i = 0; i < bucketIndexes.Count; i++)
			{
				int num3 = bucketIndexes[i];
				for (int j = startIndex; j < count; j++)
				{
					double[] array2 = ((!flag2) ? unscaledValues[j] : array[j]);
					if (flag)
					{
						double num4 = (array2[num3] - cachedActualMinimumValue) / actualRange;
						if (isInverted)
						{
							num4 = 1.0 - num4;
						}
						num4 = left + width * (num4 - num) / num2;
						double num5 = (num4 - left3) / width3;
						num5 = left3 + width3 * (num5 - left2) / width2;
						array2[num3] = num5;
					}
					else
					{
						double num6 = (array2[num3] - cachedActualMinimumValue) / actualRange;
						if (isInverted)
						{
							num6 = 1.0 - num6;
						}
						num6 = left3 + width3 * (num6 - left2) / width2;
						array2[num3] = num6;
					}
				}
			}
		}
	}
	public class HorizontalLogarithmicScaler : LogarithmicScaler
	{
		public override double GetUnscaledValue(double scaledValue, ScalerParams p)
		{
			if (!p.EffectiveViewportRect.IsEmpty)
			{
				double num = p.WindowRect.Left + p.WindowRect.Width * (scaledValue - p.ViewportRect.Left) / p.ViewportRect.Width;
				num = num * p.ViewportRect.Width + p.ViewportRect.Left;
				return GetUnscaledValue(num, NumericScaler.UnitRect, p.EffectiveViewportRect, p.IsInverted);
			}
			return GetUnscaledValue(scaledValue, p.WindowRect, p.ViewportRect, p.IsInverted);
		}

		public override double GetScaledValue(double unscaledValue, ScalerParams p)
		{
			if (!p.EffectiveViewportRect.IsEmpty)
			{
				double scaledValue = GetScaledValue(unscaledValue, NumericScaler.UnitRect, p.EffectiveViewportRect, p.IsInverted);
				scaledValue = (scaledValue - p.ViewportRect.Left) / p.ViewportRect.Width;
				return p.ViewportRect.Left + p.ViewportRect.Width * (scaledValue - p.WindowRect.Left) / p.WindowRect.Width;
			}
			return GetScaledValue(unscaledValue, p.WindowRect, p.ViewportRect, p.IsInverted);
		}

		private double GetUnscaledValue(double scaledValue, Rect windowRect, Rect viewportRect, bool isInverted)
		{
			double num = windowRect.Left + windowRect.Width * (scaledValue - viewportRect.Left) / viewportRect.Width;
			if (isInverted)
			{
				num = 1.0 - num;
			}
			return Math.Exp(num * (base.LogActualMaximumValue - base.LogActualMinimumValue) + base.LogActualMinimumValue);
		}

		private double GetScaledValue(double unscaledValue, Rect windowRect, Rect viewportRect, bool isInverted)
		{
			double num = 0.0;
			num = ((!(unscaledValue <= 0.0)) ? ((Math.Log(unscaledValue) - base.LogActualMinimumValue) / (base.LogActualMaximumValue - base.LogActualMinimumValue)) : ((Math.Log(CachedActualMinimumValue) - base.LogActualMinimumValue) / (base.LogActualMaximumValue - base.LogActualMinimumValue)));
			if (isInverted)
			{
				num = 1.0 - num;
			}
			return viewportRect.Left + viewportRect.Width * (num - windowRect.Left) / windowRect.Width;
		}
	}
	public abstract class LinearScaler : NumericScaler
	{
		public override void CalculateRange(NumericAxisBase target, double minimumValue, double maximumValue, out double actualMinimumValue, out double actualMaximumValue)
		{
			AutoRangeCalculator.CalculateRange(target, minimumValue, maximumValue, isLogarithmic: false, -1, out var minimumValue2, out var maximumValue2);
			actualMinimumValue = minimumValue2;
			actualMaximumValue = maximumValue2;
		}
	}
	public abstract class LogarithmicScaler : NumericScaler
	{
		internal double LogActualMinimumValue { get; set; }

		internal double LogActualMaximumValue { get; set; }

		protected override void OnPropertyChanged(string propertyName, object oldValue, object newValue)
		{
			base.OnPropertyChanged(propertyName, oldValue, newValue);
			if (!(propertyName == "ActualMinimumValue"))
			{
				if (propertyName == "ActualMaximumValue")
				{
					LogActualMaximumValue = Math.Log(base.ActualMaximumValue);
				}
			}
			else
			{
				LogActualMinimumValue = Math.Log(base.ActualMinimumValue);
			}
		}

		public override void CalculateRange(NumericAxisBase target, double minimumValue, double maximumValue, out double actualMinimumValue, out double actualMaximumValue)
		{
			AutoRangeCalculator.CalculateRange(target, minimumValue, maximumValue, isLogarithmic: true, target.LogarithmBase, out var minimumValue2, out var maximumValue2);
			actualMinimumValue = minimumValue2;
			actualMaximumValue = maximumValue2;
		}
	}

	public abstract class NumericScaler : DependencyObject
	{
		internal static readonly Rect UnitRect = new Rect(0.0, 0.0, 1.0, 1.0);

		protected const string ActualMinimumValuePropertyName = "ActualMinimumValue";

		protected internal static readonly DependencyProperty ActualMinimumValueProperty = DependencyProperty.Register("ActualMinimumValue", typeof(double), typeof(NumericScaler), new PropertyMetadata(double.NaN, delegate(DependencyObject sender, DependencyPropertyChangedEventArgs e)
		{
			((NumericScaler)sender).OnPropertyChanged("ActualMinimumValue", e.OldValue, e.NewValue);
		}));

		protected const string ActualMaximumValuePropertyName = "ActualMaximumValue";

		protected internal static readonly DependencyProperty ActualMaximumValueProperty = DependencyProperty.Register("ActualMaximumValue", typeof(double), typeof(NumericScaler), new PropertyMetadata(double.NaN, delegate(DependencyObject sender, DependencyPropertyChangedEventArgs e)
		{
			((NumericScaler)sender).OnPropertyChanged("ActualMaximumValue", e.OldValue, e.NewValue);
		}));

		protected double CachedActualMinimumValue;

		protected double CachedActualMaximumValue;

		protected internal double ActualMinimumValue
		{
			get
			{
				return (double)GetValue(ActualMinimumValueProperty);
			}
			protected set
			{
				SetValue(ActualMinimumValueProperty, value);
			}
		}

		protected internal double ActualMaximumValue
		{
			get
			{
				return (double)GetValue(ActualMaximumValueProperty);
			}
			protected set
			{
				SetValue(ActualMaximumValueProperty, value);
			}
		}

		protected double ActualRange { get; private set; }

		public abstract void CalculateRange(NumericAxisBase target, double minimumValue, double maximumValue, out double actualMinimumValue, out double actualMaximumValue);

		internal void SetActualMinimumValue(double value)
		{
			ActualMinimumValue = value;
		}

		internal void SetActualMaximumValue(double value)
		{
			ActualMaximumValue = value;
		}

		protected virtual void OnPropertyChanged(string propertyName, object oldValue, object newValue)
		{
			if (!(propertyName == "ActualMinimumValue"))
			{
				if (propertyName == "ActualMaximumValue")
				{
					CachedActualMaximumValue = ActualMaximumValue;
					UpdateActualRange();
				}
			}
			else
			{
				CachedActualMinimumValue = ActualMinimumValue;
				UpdateActualRange();
			}
		}

		private void UpdateActualRange()
		{
			if (double.IsNaN(ActualMinimumValue) || double.IsNaN(ActualMaximumValue) || double.IsInfinity(ActualMinimumValue) || double.IsInfinity(ActualMaximumValue) || ActualMinimumValue < -7.922816251426434E+28 || ActualMaximumValue > 7.922816251426434E+28)
			{
				ActualRange = ActualMaximumValue - ActualMinimumValue;
			}
			else if (ActualMaximumValue < XamDataChart.DecimalMaximumValueAsDouble && ActualMaximumValue > XamDataChart.DecimalMinimumValueAsDouble && ActualMinimumValue > XamDataChart.DecimalMinimumValueAsDouble && ActualMinimumValue < XamDataChart.DecimalMaximumValueAsDouble)
			{
				ActualRange = Convert.ToDouble(Convert.ToDecimal(ActualMaximumValue) - Convert.ToDecimal(ActualMinimumValue));
			}
			else
			{
				ActualRange = ActualMaximumValue - ActualMinimumValue;
			}
		}

		public abstract double GetUnscaledValue([TreatAsPX] double scaledValue, ScalerParams p);

		[TreatAsPX]
		public abstract double GetScaledValue(double unscaledValue, ScalerParams p);

		public virtual IList<double> GetUnscaledValueList(IList<double> scaledValues, int startIndex, int count, ScalerParams p)
		{
			IList<double> list = new List<double>(scaledValues.Count);
			for (int i = startIndex; i < count; i++)
			{
				list.Add(GetUnscaledValue(scaledValues[i], p));
			}
			return list;
		}

		public virtual void GetScaledValueList(IList<double> unscaledValues, int startIndex, int count, ScalerParams p)
		{
			for (int i = startIndex; i < count; i++)
			{
				unscaledValues[i] = GetScaledValue(unscaledValues[i], p);
			}
		}

		public virtual void GetScaledBucketValueList(IList<double[]> unscaledValues, IList<int> bucketIndexes, int startIndex, int count, ScalerParams p)
		{
			for (int i = 0; i < bucketIndexes.Count; i++)
			{
				int num = bucketIndexes[i];
				for (int j = startIndex; j < count; j++)
				{
					unscaledValues[j][num] = GetScaledValue(unscaledValues[j][num], p);
				}
			}
		}
	}

	public class VerticalLinearScaler : LinearScaler
	{
		public override double GetUnscaledValue(double scaledValue, ScalerParams p)
		{
			if (!p.EffectiveViewportRect.IsEmpty)
			{
				double num = p.WindowRect.Top + p.WindowRect.Height * (scaledValue - p.ViewportRect.Top) / p.ViewportRect.Height;
				num = num * p.ViewportRect.Height + p.ViewportRect.Top;
				return GetUnscaledValue(num, NumericScaler.UnitRect, p.EffectiveViewportRect, p.IsInverted);
			}
			return GetUnscaledValue(scaledValue, p.WindowRect, p.ViewportRect, p.IsInverted);
		}

		public override double GetScaledValue(double unscaledValue, ScalerParams p)
		{
			if (!p.EffectiveViewportRect.IsEmpty)
			{
				double scaledValue = GetScaledValue(unscaledValue, NumericScaler.UnitRect, p.EffectiveViewportRect, p.IsInverted);
				scaledValue = (scaledValue - p.ViewportRect.Top) / p.ViewportRect.Height;
				return p.ViewportRect.Top + p.ViewportRect.Height * (scaledValue - p.WindowRect.Top) / p.WindowRect.Height;
			}
			return GetScaledValue(unscaledValue, p.WindowRect, p.ViewportRect, p.IsInverted);
		}

		public override void GetScaledValueList(IList<double> unscaledValues, int startIndex, int count, ScalerParams p)
		{
			Rect windowRect = p.WindowRect;
			Rect viewportRect = p.ViewportRect;
			Rect effectiveViewportRect = p.EffectiveViewportRect;
			bool isInverted = p.IsInverted;
			bool flag = !effectiveViewportRect.IsEmpty;
			double actualRange = base.ActualRange;
			double cachedActualMinimumValue = CachedActualMinimumValue;
			double top = effectiveViewportRect.Top;
			double height = effectiveViewportRect.Height;
			double top2 = windowRect.Top;
			double height2 = windowRect.Height;
			double top3 = viewportRect.Top;
			double height3 = viewportRect.Height;
			double num = 0.0;
			double num2 = 1.0;
			double[] array = ArrayAccessHelper.AsDoubleArray(unscaledValues);
			bool flag2 = false;
			if (array != null)
			{
				flag2 = true;
			}
			for (int i = startIndex; i < count; i++)
			{
				double num3 = ((!flag2) ? unscaledValues[i] : array[i]);
				if (flag)
				{
					double num4 = (num3 - cachedActualMinimumValue) / actualRange;
					if (!isInverted)
					{
						num4 = 1.0 - num4;
					}
					num4 = top + height * (num4 - num) / num2;
					double num5 = (num4 - top3) / height3;
					num5 = top3 + height3 * (num5 - top2) / height2;
					if (flag2)
					{
						array[i] = num5;
					}
					else
					{
						unscaledValues[i] = num5;
					}
				}
				else
				{
					double num6 = (num3 - cachedActualMinimumValue) / actualRange;
					if (!isInverted)
					{
						num6 = 1.0 - num6;
					}
					num6 = top3 + height3 * (num6 - top2) / height2;
					if (flag2)
					{
						array[i] = num6;
					}
					else
					{
						unscaledValues[i] = num6;
					}
				}
			}
		}

		[TreatAsPX]
		private double GetScaledValue(double unscaledValue, Rect windowRect, Rect viewportRect, bool isInverted)
		{
			double num = (unscaledValue - CachedActualMinimumValue) / base.ActualRange;
			if (!isInverted)
			{
				num = 1.0 - num;
			}
			return viewportRect.Top + viewportRect.Height * (num - windowRect.Top) / windowRect.Height;
		}

		private double GetUnscaledValue([TreatAsPX] double scaledValue, Rect windowRect, Rect viewportRect, bool isInverted)
		{
			double num = windowRect.Top + windowRect.Height * (scaledValue - viewportRect.Top) / viewportRect.Height;
			if (!isInverted)
			{
				num = 1.0 - num;
			}
			return CachedActualMinimumValue + num * base.ActualRange;
		}
	}
	internal class FastVerticalLinearScaler : VerticalLinearScaler
	{
		public override void GetScaledBucketValueList(IList<double[]> unscaledValues, IList<int> bucketIndexes, int startIndex, int count, ScalerParams p)
		{
			Rect windowRect = p.WindowRect;
			Rect viewportRect = p.ViewportRect;

			double cachedActualMinimumValue = CachedActualMinimumValue;
			double top = effectiveViewportRect.Top;

			double top2 = windowRect.Top;
			double height2 = windowRect.Height;
			double top3 = viewportRect.Top;
			double height3 = viewportRect.Height;
			double num = 0.0;
			double num2 = 1.0;
			double[][] array = ArrayAccessHelper.AsBucketArray(unscaledValues);
			bool flag2 = false;
			if (array != null)
			{
				flag2 = true;
			}
			for (int i = 0; i < bucketIndexes.Count; i++)
			{
				int num3 = bucketIndexes[i];

				{
					double[] array2 = ((!flag2) ? unscaledValues[j] : array[j]);
					if (flag)

						if (!isInverted)
						{
							num4 = 1.0 - num4;
						}
						num4 = top + height * (num4 - num) / num2;
						double num5 = (num4 - top3) / height3;
						num5 = top3 + height3 * (num5 - top2) / height2;
						array2[num3] = num5;
					}
					else
					{
						double num6 = (array2[num3] - cachedActualMinimumValue) / actualRange;
						if (!isInverted)
						{
							num6 = 1.0 - num6;
						}
						num6 = top3 + height3 * (num6 - top2) / height2;
						array2[num3] = num6;
					}
				}
			}
		}
	}

		public override double GetScaledValue(double unscaledValue, ScalerParams p)

				scaledValue = (scaledValue - p.ViewportRect.Top) / p.ViewportRect.Height;

		private double GetScaledValue(double unscaledValue, Rect windowRect, Rect viewportRect, bool isInverted)
		{
			double num = ((!(unscaledValue <= 0.0)) ? ((Math.Log(unscaledValue) - base.LogActualMinimumValue) / (base.LogActualMaximumValue - base.LogActualMinimumValue)) : ((Math.Log(CachedActualMinimumValue) - base.LogActualMinimumValue) / (base.LogActualMaximumValue - base.LogActualMinimumValue)));
			if (!isInverted)
			{
				num = 1.0 - num;

		}

		private double GetUnscaledValue(double scaledValue, Rect windowRect, Rect viewportRect, bool isInverted)
		{
			double num = windowRect.Top + windowRect.Height * (scaledValue - viewportRect.Top) / viewportRect.Height;
			if (!isInverted)
			{
				num = 1.0 - num;
			}
			return Math.Exp(num * (base.LogActualMaximumValue - base.LogActualMinimumValue) + base.LogActualMinimumValue);
		}
	}
	internal class CategoryTickmarkValues : TickmarkValues
	{
		internal CategoryMode Mode { get; set; }

		internal int Mode2GroupCount { get; set; }

		internal Rect Viewport { get; set; }

		internal Rect Window { get; set; }

		internal bool IsInverted { get; set; }

		internal GetUnscaledGroupCenterHandler GetUnscaledGroupCenter { get; set; }

		private double ActualMinimum { get; set; }

		public override void Initialize(TickmarkValuesInitializationParameters initializationParameters)
		{
			base.Initialize(initializationParameters);
			CategoryMode categoryMode = (Mode = initializationParameters.Mode);
			Mode2GroupCount = initializationParameters.Mode2GroupCount;
			Viewport = initializationParameters.Viewport;
			Window = initializationParameters.Window;
			IsInverted = initializationParameters.IsInverted;
			GetUnscaledGroupCenter = initializationParameters.GetUnscaledGroupCenter;
			LinearCategorySnapper linearCategorySnapper = new LinearCategorySnapper(initializationParameters.VisibleMinimum, initializationParameters.VisibleMaximum, initializationParameters.Resolution, initializationParameters.UserInterval, categoryMode, initializationParameters.HeuristicResolution);
			double num = linearCategorySnapper.Interval;
			if (initializationParameters.IntervalOverride != -1.0)
			{
				num = initializationParameters.IntervalOverride;
			}
			double num2 = Math.Floor((initializationParameters.VisibleMinimum - initializationParameters.ActualMinimum) / num);
			double num3 = Math.Ceiling((initializationParameters.VisibleMaximum - initializationParameters.ActualMinimum) / num);
			int firstIndex = (int)num2;
			int lastIndex = (int)num3;
			int minorCount = (int)linearCategorySnapper.MinorCount;
			if (initializationParameters.MinorCountOverride != -1)
			{
				minorCount = initializationParameters.MinorCountOverride;
			}
			base.Interval = num;
			base.MinorInterval = initializationParameters.MinorInterval;
			base.FirstIndex = firstIndex;
			base.LastIndex = lastIndex;
			base.MinorCount = minorCount;
			ActualMinimum = initializationParameters.ActualMinimum;
		}

		public override IEnumerable<double> MajorValues()
		{
			decimal actualMinimumDecimal = Convert.ToDecimal(ActualMinimum);
			decimal intervalDecimal = Convert.ToDecimal(Interval);
			int i = FirstIndex;
			while (i <= LastIndex)
			{
				yield return Convert.ToDouble(actualMinimumDecimal + Convert.ToDecimal(i) * intervalDecimal);
				int num = i + 1;
				i = num;
			}
		}

		public override IEnumerable<double> MinorValues()
		{
			double interval = Math.Min(Interval, 20.0);
			int i = FirstIndex;
			while (i < LastIndex)
			{
				if (Mode != CategoryMode.Mode0 && Mode2GroupCount != 0)
				{
					if (MinorInterval > 0.0 && MinorInterval < Interval)
					{
						double curValue = (double)i * Interval;
						double endValue = (double)(i + 1) * Interval;
						while (curValue + MinorInterval < endValue)
						{
							curValue += MinorInterval;
							yield return curValue;
						}
					}
					else
					{
						for (int categoryNumber = 0; categoryNumber < (int)interval; categoryNumber++)
						{
							for (int groupNumber = 0; groupNumber < Mode2GroupCount; groupNumber++)
							{
								double num = GetUnscaledGroupCenter(groupNumber);
								yield return (double)categoryNumber + (double)i * Interval + num;
							}
						}
					}
				}
				int num2 = i + 1;
				i = num2;
			}
		}
	}
	public class LinearTickmarkValues : TickmarkValues
	{
		protected internal int MinTicks { get; set; }

		private double ActualMinimum { get; set; }

		public LinearTickmarkValues()
		{
			MinTicks = 0;
		}

		public override void Initialize(TickmarkValuesInitializationParameters initializationParameters)
		{
			base.Initialize(initializationParameters);
			LinearNumericSnapper linearNumericSnapper = ((MinTicks == 0) ? new LinearNumericSnapper(initializationParameters.VisibleMinimum, initializationParameters.VisibleMaximum, initializationParameters.Resolution, initializationParameters.HeuristicResolution) : new LinearNumericSnapper(initializationParameters.VisibleMinimum, initializationParameters.VisibleMaximum, initializationParameters.Resolution, MinTicks, initializationParameters.HeuristicResolution));
			base.Interval = linearNumericSnapper.Interval;
			if (initializationParameters.HasUserInterval && initializationParameters.UserInterval > 0.0 && (initializationParameters.VisibleMaximum - initializationParameters.VisibleMinimum) / initializationParameters.UserInterval < 1000.0)
			{
				base.Interval = initializationParameters.UserInterval;
			}
			if (initializationParameters.IntervalOverride != -1.0)
			{
				base.Interval = initializationParameters.IntervalOverride;
			}
			if (base.Interval == 0.0)
			{
				base.FirstIndex = 0;
				base.LastIndex = 0;
			}
			else
			{
				base.FirstIndex = (int)Math.Floor((initializationParameters.VisibleMinimum - initializationParameters.ActualMinimum) / base.Interval);
				base.LastIndex = (int)Math.Ceiling((initializationParameters.VisibleMaximum - initializationParameters.ActualMinimum) / base.Interval);
			}
			base.MinorCount = linearNumericSnapper.MinorCount;
			if (initializationParameters.MinorCountOverride != -1)
			{
				base.MinorCount = initializationParameters.MinorCountOverride;
			}
			base.MinorInterval = initializationParameters.MinorInterval;
			ActualMinimum = initializationParameters.ActualMinimum;
		}

		public override IEnumerable<double> MajorValues()
		{
			if (!double.IsNaN(Interval))
			{
				bool useDecimal = ActualMinimum > XamDataChart.DecimalMinimumValueAsDouble && ActualMinimum < XamDataChart.DecimalMaximumValueAsDouble && Interval > XamDataChart.DecimalMinimumValueAsDouble && Interval < XamDataChart.DecimalMaximumValueAsDouble && (double)LastIndex * Interval <= XamDataChart.DecimalMaximumValueAsDouble;
				decimal actualMinimumDecimal;
				decimal intervalDecimal;
				if (useDecimal)
				{
					actualMinimumDecimal = Convert.ToDecimal(ActualMinimum);
					intervalDecimal = Convert.ToDecimal(Interval);
				}
				else
				{
					actualMinimumDecimal = decimal.MinValue;
					intervalDecimal = decimal.MinValue;
				}
				int i = FirstIndex;
				while (i <= LastIndex)
				{
					yield return (!useDecimal) ? (ActualMinimum + (double)i * Interval) : Convert.ToDouble(actualMinimumDecimal + Convert.ToDecimal(i) * intervalDecimal);
					int num = i + 1;
					i = num;
				}
			}
		}

		public override IEnumerable<double> MinorValues()
		{
			if (base.MinorInterval > 0.0)
			{
				return GetMinorValuesWithCustomInterval();
			}
			return GetMinorValues();
		}

		private IEnumerable<double> GetMinorValues()
		{
			double num = 0.0;
			int minorCount = MinorCount;
			double actualMinimum = ActualMinimum + num;
			int i = FirstIndex;
			while (i < LastIndex)
			{
				int num3;
				for (int j = 1; j < minorCount; j = num3)
				{
					double num2 = actualMinimum + (double)i * Interval + (double)j * Interval / (double)minorCount;
					if (num2 <= VisibleMaximum)
					{
						yield return num2;
					}
					num3 = j + 1;
				}
				num3 = i + 1;
				i = num3;
			}
		}

		private IEnumerable<double> GetMinorValuesWithCustomInterval()
		{
			int i = FirstIndex;
			while (i < LastIndex)
			{
				double curValue = ActualMinimum + (double)i * Interval;
				double nextMajor = VisibleMaximum;
				if (i + 1 <= LastIndex)
				{
					nextMajor = ActualMinimum + (double)(i + 1) * Interval;
					if (nextMajor > VisibleMaximum)
					{
						nextMajor = VisibleMaximum;
					}
				}
				while (curValue < nextMajor)
				{
					curValue += MinorInterval;
					if (curValue < nextMajor)
					{
						yield return curValue;
					}
				}
				int num = i + 1;
				i = num;
			}
		}
	}
	public class LogarithmicTickmarkValues : TickmarkValues
	{
		private const double MINIMUM_VALUE_GREATER_THAN_ZERO = double.Epsilon;

		private const string LogarithmBasePropertyName = "LogarithmBase";

		public static readonly DependencyProperty LogarithmBaseProperty = DependencyProperty.Register("LogarithmBase", typeof(int), typeof(LogarithmicTickmarkValues), new PropertyMetadata(10, delegate
		{
		}));

		public int LogarithmBase
		{
			get
			{
				return (int)GetValue(LogarithmBaseProperty);
			}
			set
			{
				SetValue(LogarithmBaseProperty, value);
			}
		}

		public override void Initialize(TickmarkValuesInitializationParameters initializationParameters)
		{
			base.Initialize(initializationParameters);
			LogarithmicNumericSnapper logarithmicNumericSnapper = new LogarithmicNumericSnapper(initializationParameters.VisibleMinimum, initializationParameters.VisibleMaximum, LogarithmBase, initializationParameters.Resolution);
			base.Interval = 1.0;
			base.MinorCount = (int)logarithmicNumericSnapper.MinorCount;
			base.FirstIndex = (int)Math.Floor(Math.Log(Math.Max(double.Epsilon, initializationParameters.VisibleMinimum), LogarithmBase));
			base.LastIndex = (int)Math.Ceiling(Math.Log(Math.Max(double.Epsilon, initializationParameters.VisibleMaximum), LogarithmBase));
		}

		private double MajorValueAt(int tickIndex)
		{
			double y = (double)tickIndex * base.Interval;
			return Math.Pow(LogarithmBase, y);
		}

		public override IEnumerable<double> MajorValues()
		{
			int i = FirstIndex;
			while (i <= LastIndex)
			{
				double num = MajorValueAt(i);
				if (num <= VisibleMaximum)
				{
					yield return num;
				}
				int num2 = i + 1;
				i = num2;
			}
		}

		public override IEnumerable<double> MinorValues()
		{
			int i = FirstIndex;
			while (i <= LastIndex)
			{
				double majorValue = MajorValueAt(i);
				double minorInterval = Math.Pow(LogarithmBase, i);
				int num2;
				for (int j = 1; j < MinorCount - 1; j = num2)
				{
					double num = majorValue + (double)j * minorInterval;
					if (num <= VisibleMaximum)
					{
						yield return num;
					}
					num2 = j + 1;
				}
				num2 = i + 1;
				i = num2;
			}
		}
	}

	}

	public class VerticalAxisLabelPanel : AxisLabelPanelBase
	{
		[TSSuppressSynthesizedInitializer]

		internal double LargestHeight { get; set; }

		internal double LargestRenderWidth { get; set; }

		internal double LargestRenderHeight { get; set; }

		internal override AxisLabelPanelBaseView CreateView()
		{
			return new VerticalAxisLabelPanelView(this);
		}

		internal override void OnViewCreated(AxisLabelPanelBaseView view)
		{
			base.OnViewCreated(view);
			VerticalView = (VerticalAxisLabelPanelView)view;
		}

		protected internal override void BindExtent()

			VerticalView.BindExtent();
		}

		protected internal override double GetTitleEffectiveAngle()
		{
			if (base.Axis.TitleSettings == null)
			{
				return -90.0;
			}
			return base.Axis.TitleSettings.Angle;
		}

		public double GetLabelLeftOffset()
		{
			double num = 0.0;
			if (GetTitlePosition(base.Axis.TitleSettings) == AxisTitlePosition.Left)
			{
				num += GetTitleWidthBounds();
			}
			AxisLabelsLocation actualLabelLocation = base.ActualLabelLocation;
			if (actualLabelLocation == AxisLabelsLocation.OutsideRight || actualLabelLocation == AxisLabelsLocation.InsideRight)
			{
				num += base.Axis.ActualTickLength;
			}
			return num;
		}

		public double GetLabelRightOffset()
		{
			double num = 0.0;
			if (GetTitlePosition(base.Axis.TitleSettings) == AxisTitlePosition.Right)
			{
				num += GetTitleWidthBounds();
			}
			AxisLabelsLocation actualLabelLocation = base.ActualLabelLocation;
			if (actualLabelLocation == AxisLabelsLocation.OutsideLeft || actualLabelLocation == AxisLabelsLocation.InsideLeft)
			{
				num += base.Axis.ActualTickLength;
			}
			return num;
		}

		public double GetLabelSpan()
		{
			double num = ActualExtent - GetLabelLeftOffset() - GetLabelRightOffset();
			if (num < 0.0)
			{
				num = 0.0;
			}
			return num;
		}

		public double GetLabelRenderSpan()
		{
			double num = GetLabelSpan() - base.View.GetLabelLeftMargin() - base.View.GetLabelRightMargin();
			if (num < 0.0)
			{
				num = 0.0;
			}
			return num;
		}

		protected internal override List<Rect> CreateBoundsRectangles()
		{
			List<Rect> list = new List<Rect>();
			base.UseStaggering = false;
			base.UseRotation = false;
			if (base.LabelSettings != null && base.LabelSettings.HasUserAngle() && GetEffectiveAngle() % 360.0 != 0.0)
			{
				base.UseRotation = true;
			}
			LargestWidth = double.MinValue;
			LargestHeight = double.MinValue;
			LargestRenderWidth = double.MinValue;
			LargestRenderHeight = double.MinValue;
			double labelLeftMargin = base.View.GetLabelLeftMargin();
			double labelTopMargin = base.View.GetLabelTopMargin();
			double labelRightMargin = base.View.GetLabelRightMargin();
			double labelBottomMargin = base.View.GetLabelBottomMargin();
			double labelLeftOffset = GetLabelLeftOffset();
			bool flag = false;
			if (!double.IsNaN(base.CachedOverlayExtent))
			{
				LargestWidth = Math.Max(base.CachedOverlayExtent, LargestWidth);
				LargestRenderWidth = Math.Max(base.CachedOverlayRenderExtent, LargestRenderWidth);
			}
			for (int i = 0; i < base.TextBlocks.Count; i++)
			{
				FrameworkElement element = base.TextBlocks[i];
				bool isOverlay = base.LabelPositions[i].IsOverlay;
				double desiredHeight = GetDesiredHeight(element);
				double desiredWidth = GetDesiredWidth(element);
				double num = desiredHeight + labelTopMargin + labelBottomMargin;
				double num2 = desiredWidth + labelLeftMargin + labelRightMargin;
				double x = base.LabelViewport.Left + labelLeftOffset;
				double y = base.LabelPositions[i].Value - num / 2.0;
				if (isOverlay)
				{
					_ = base.CachedOverlayExtent;
					if ((double.IsNaN(base.CachedOverlayExtent) || num2 > base.CachedOverlayExtent || base.LabelPositions[i].ResetOverlayExtent) && !flag)
					{
						if (base.LabelPositions[i].ResetOverlayExtent)
						{
							flag = true;
						}
						base.LabelPositions[i].ResetOverlayExtent = false;
						base.CachedOverlayExtent = num2;
						base.CachedOverlayRenderExtent = desiredWidth;
					}
					LargestWidth = Math.Max(base.CachedOverlayExtent, LargestWidth);
					LargestHeight = Math.Max(num, LargestHeight);
					LargestRenderWidth = Math.Max(base.CachedOverlayRenderExtent, LargestRenderWidth);
					LargestRenderHeight = Math.Max(desiredHeight, LargestRenderHeight);
				}
				else
				{
					LargestWidth = Math.Max(num2, LargestWidth);
					LargestHeight = Math.Max(num, LargestHeight);
					LargestRenderWidth = Math.Max(desiredWidth, LargestRenderWidth);
					LargestRenderHeight = Math.Max(desiredHeight, LargestRenderHeight);
				}
				Rect item = new Rect(x, y, num2, num);
				list.Add(item);
			}
			double num3 = 0.0;
			if (base.UseRotation)
			{
				num3 = GetEffectiveAngle() % 360.0;
				if (num3 < 0.0)
				{
					num3 += 360.0;
				}
			}
			bool flag2 = base.Axis.HasUserExtent();
			if (!flag2)
			{
				CalculateExtent(num3, labelLeftMargin, labelRightMargin);
			}
			else
			{
				base.View.BindExtentToSettings();
			}
			if (base.UseRotation)
			{
				for (int j = 0; j < list.Count; j++)
				{
					Rect value = list[j];
					value.Y = base.LabelPositions[j].Value - LargestHeight / 2.0;
					list[j] = value;
				}
			}
			bool flag3 = false;
			if (!base.UseRotation && LargestWidth <= ActualExtent)
			{
				flag3 = true;
			}
			if (!flag3)
			{
				double actualHeight = base.ActualHeight;
				double labelSpan = GetLabelSpan();
				double num4 = labelSpan;
				double num5 = ((base.LabelPositions.Count > 1) ? Math.Abs(base.LabelPositions[1].Value - base.LabelPositions[0].Value) : actualHeight);
				double num6 = Math.Abs(Math.Asin(num5 / LargestWidth) * (180.0 / Math.PI));
				bool flag4 = (num3 >= num6 && num3 <= 180.0 - num6) || (num3 - 180.0 >= num6 && num3 - 180.0 <= 180.0 - num6);
				for (int k = 0; k < list.Count; k++)
				{
					if (base.UseRotation)
					{
						double d = num3 * (Math.PI / 180.0);
						double widthBounds = GetWidthBounds(base.TextBlocks[k]);
						num4 = Math.Min(labelSpan / Math.Abs(Math.Cos(d)), widthBounds);
						if (flag4)
						{
							double d2 = ((num3 > 0.0 && num3 < 90.0) ? (Math.PI / 180.0 * (90.0 - num3)) : ((!(num3 > 270.0) || !(num3 < 360.0)) ? 0.0 : (Math.PI / 180.0 * (num3 - 270.0))));
							num4 = num5 / Math.Cos(d2);
						}
					}
					Rect value2 = list[k];
					value2.Width = Math.Min(value2.Width, num4);
					list[k] = value2;
					if (!(base.TextBlocks[k] is TextBlock))
					{
						base.TextBlocks[k].Width = num4;
					}
					if (base.TextBlocks[k] is TextBlock textBlock)
					{
						string text = TrimTextBlock(k, textBlock, num4, labelLeftMargin, labelRightMargin);
						if (!textBlock.Text.Equals(text))
						{
							textBlock.Text = text;
							base.TextBlocks[k].Width = num4;
						}
					}
				}
				if (!flag2)
				{
					CalculateExtent(num3, labelLeftMargin, labelRightMargin);
				}
			}
			if (ShouldHorizontalAlign())
			{
				DoHorizontalAlignment(list);
			}
			return list;
		}

		private void CalculateExtent(double angleDegrees, double marginLeft, double marginRight)
		{
			double num = angleDegrees * (Math.PI / 180.0);
			double num2 = Math.Abs(LargestRenderWidth * Math.Cos(num)) + Math.Abs(LargestRenderHeight * Math.Sin(num));
			double titleWidthBounds = GetTitleWidthBounds();
			double val = num2 + marginLeft + marginRight + titleWidthBounds + base.Axis.ActualTickLength;
			base.Extent = Math.Max(base.Axis.MinExtent, val);
		}

		private void DoHorizontalAlignment(List<Rect> rectangles)
		{
			VerticalView.HandleHorizontalAlignment(rectangles, LargestWidth);
		}

		protected internal override void SetLabelRotationTransform(FrameworkElement label, double angle)
		{
			double centerX = 0.0;
			double centerY = LargestRenderHeight / 2.0;
			TransformGroup transformGroup = new TransformGroup();
			double num = AngleSimplifier.SimplifyAngle(GetEffectiveAngle());
			RotateTransform rotateTransform = new RotateTransform
			{
				Angle = num,
				CenterX = centerX,
				CenterY = centerY
			};
			double num2 = 0.0;
			double y = 0.0;
			if (num != 0.0 && num != 360.0)
			{
				num -= 90.0;
				if (!(num > 0.0) || !(num < 180.0))
				{
					num2 = ((!(num >= 180.0)) ? (num2 + Math.Cos(MathUtil.Radians(num)) * (LargestRenderHeight / 2.0)) : (num2 - Math.Cos(MathUtil.Radians(num)) * (LargestRenderHeight / 2.0)));
				}
				else
				{
					rotateTransform.CenterX = LargestRenderWidth;
					num2 = 0.0 - LargestRenderWidth + LargestRenderHeight / 2.0;
					num2 += Math.Sin(MathUtil.Radians(num - 180.0)) * (LargestRenderHeight / 2.0);
				}
			}
			TranslateTransform value = new TranslateTransform
			{
				X = num2,
				Y = y
			};
			transformGroup.Children.Add(rotateTransform);
			transformGroup.Children.Add(value);
			label.RenderTransform = transformGroup;
		}

		protected virtual bool ShouldHorizontalAlign()
		{
			if (!base.UseStaggering)
			{
				return !base.UseRotation;
			}
			return false;
		}

		public override Rect GetTitleBounds()
		{
			AxisTitlePosition titlePosition = GetTitlePosition(base.Axis.TitleSettings);
			double titleWidthBounds = GetTitleWidthBounds();
			AxisLabelsLocation actualLabelLocation = base.ActualLabelLocation;
			double num = 0.0;
			if (titlePosition == AxisTitlePosition.Left)
			{
				num += base.LabelViewport.Left;
				if (actualLabelLocation == AxisLabelsLocation.OutsideRight || actualLabelLocation == AxisLabelsLocation.InsideRight)
				{
					num += base.Axis.ActualTickLength;
				}
			}
			else
			{
				num = base.LabelViewport.Right - titleWidthBounds;
				if (actualLabelLocation == AxisLabelsLocation.InsideLeft || actualLabelLocation == AxisLabelsLocation.OutsideLeft)
				{
					num -= base.Axis.ActualTickLength;
				}
			}
			double titleHeightBounds = GetTitleHeightBounds();
			double num2 = 0.0;
			return new Rect(num, ((base.Axis.TitleSettings == null) ? VerticalAlignment.Center : base.Axis.TitleSettings.VerticalAlignment) switch
			{
				VerticalAlignment.Top => base.LabelViewport.Top, 
				VerticalAlignment.Bottom => base.LabelViewport.Bottom - titleHeightBounds, 
				_ => base.LabelViewport.Top + base.LabelViewport.Height / 2.0 - titleHeightBounds / 2.0, 
			}, titleWidthBounds, titleHeightBounds);
		}

		public override AxisTitlePosition GetTitlePosition(TitleSettings titleSettings)
		{
			if (titleSettings == null)
			{
				return base.Axis.SeriesViewer.GetDefaultVerticalAxisTitlePosition(base.Axis);
			}
			if (titleSettings.Position == AxisTitlePosition.Auto)
			{
				if (base.Axis != null && base.Axis.SeriesViewer != null)
				{
					return base.Axis.SeriesViewer.GetDefaultVerticalAxisTitlePosition(base.Axis);
				}
				return AxisTitlePosition.Left;
			}
			return titleSettings.Position;
		}

		internal override AxisLabelsLocation GetDefaultLabelsLocation()
		{
			return AxisLabelsLocation.OutsideLeft;
		}

		internal override bool ValidLocation(AxisLabelsLocation location)
		{
			if (location != AxisLabelsLocation.OutsideLeft && location != AxisLabelsLocation.OutsideRight && location != AxisLabelsLocation.InsideLeft)
			{
				return location == AxisLabelsLocation.InsideRight;
			}
			return true;
		}

		protected override void CreateTicks()
		{
			GeometryCollection ticksGeometry = base.View.GetTicksGeometry();
			base.Axis.ClearMarks(ticksGeometry);
			if (base.LabelSettings != null && base.LabelSettings.Visibility != Visibility.Visible)
			{
				return;
			}
			double actualTickLength = base.Axis.ActualTickLength;
			if (actualTickLength == 0.0)
			{
				return;
			}
			IEnumerable<double> tickValues = GetTickValues();
			if (tickValues == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			double num = base.LabelViewport.Left;
			AxisLabelsLocation actualLabelLocation = base.ActualLabelLocation;
			double x;
			if (actualLabelLocation == AxisLabelsLocation.OutsideLeft || actualLabelLocation == AxisLabelsLocation.InsideLeft)
			{
				num = base.LabelViewport.Right;
				x = num - actualTickLength;
			}
			else
			{
				x = num + actualTickLength;
			}
			PathRenderingInfo thicksRenderingInfo = base.View.GetThicksRenderingInfo();
			foreach (double item in tickValues)
			{
				HorizontalTick(ticksGeometry, item, num, x, base.ViewportRect, thicksRenderingInfo);
			}
			if (!base.Children.Contains(base.View.Ticks))
			{
				base.Children.Add(base.View.Ticks);
			}
		}
	}
	internal class ViewportUtils
	{
		public static double TransformXToViewport(double xValue, Rect windowRect, Rect viewportRect)
		{
			return viewportRect.Left + viewportRect.Width * (xValue - windowRect.Left) / windowRect.Width;
		}

		public static double TransformXFromViewport(double xValue, Rect windowRect, Rect viewportRect)
		{
			return (xValue - viewportRect.Left) * windowRect.Width / viewportRect.Width + windowRect.Left;
		}

		public static double TransformYToViewport(double yValue, Rect windowRect, Rect viewportRect)
		{
			return viewportRect.Top + viewportRect.Height * (yValue - windowRect.Top) / windowRect.Height;
		}

		public static double TransformYFromViewport(double yValue, Rect windowRect, Rect viewportRect)
		{
			return (yValue - viewportRect.Top) * windowRect.Height / viewportRect.Height + windowRect.Top;
		}

		public static double TransformXToViewportLength(double xValue, Rect windowRect, Rect viewportRect)
		{
			return viewportRect.Width * xValue / windowRect.Width;
		}

		public static double TransformXFromViewportLength(double xValue, Rect windowRect, Rect viewportRect)
		{
			return windowRect.Width * xValue / viewportRect.Width;
		}

		public static double TransformYToViewportLength(double yValue, Rect windowRect, Rect viewportRect)
		{
			return viewportRect.Height * yValue / windowRect.Height;
		}
	}
	internal class CategoryFrame : Frame
	{
		private Rect _fullClip;

		public readonly List<double[]> Buckets = new List<double[]>();

		public readonly List<double> ErrorBuckets = new List<double>();

		public readonly List<double> ErrorSpeedModifiers = new List<double>();

		public readonly List<Point> Markers = new List<Point>();

		public readonly List<double> MarkerSpeedModifiers = new List<double>();

		public readonly List<Point> Trend = new List<Point>();

		public readonly List<double> TrendSpeedModifiers = new List<double>();

		public readonly List<Point> ErrorBars = new List<Point>();

		public readonly List<double> ErrorBarsSpeedModifiers = new List<double>();

		public readonly List<double> ErrorBarPositiveSizes = new List<double>();

		public readonly List<double> ErrorBarNegativeSizes = new List<double>();

		public readonly List<double> SpeedModifiers = new List<double>();

		public static int _categoryFrameVersion;

		private int cnt;

		public int FrameVersion { get; set; }

		public Rect CustomClip { get; set; }

		public CategoryFrame(int count)
		{
			_fullClip = new Rect(0.0, 0.0, 1.0, 1.0);
			cnt = count;
			IncrementFrameVersion();
		}

		public override void Interpolate(float p, Frame min, Frame max)
		{
			IncrementFrameVersion();
			CategoryFrame categoryFrame = min as CategoryFrame;
			CategoryFrame categoryFrame2 = max as CategoryFrame;
			int count = categoryFrame.Buckets.Count;
			int count2 = categoryFrame2.Buckets.Count;
			int num = Math.Max(count, count2);
			int count3 = Math.Max(categoryFrame.Markers.Count, categoryFrame2.Markers.Count);
			int count4 = Math.Max(categoryFrame.Trend.Count, categoryFrame2.Trend.Count);
			int count5 = Math.Max(categoryFrame.ErrorBuckets.Count, categoryFrame2.ErrorBuckets.Count);
			int count6 = Math.Max(categoryFrame.ErrorBars.Count, categoryFrame2.ErrorBars.Count);
			bool flag = categoryFrame.SpeedModifiers.Count > 0;
			if (flag)
			{
				ReconcileSpeedModifiers(SpeedModifiers, p, categoryFrame.SpeedModifiers, categoryFrame2.SpeedModifiers, num);
			}
			bool flag2 = categoryFrame.MarkerSpeedModifiers.Count > 0;
			if (flag2)
			{
				ReconcileSpeedModifiers(MarkerSpeedModifiers, p, categoryFrame.MarkerSpeedModifiers, categoryFrame2.MarkerSpeedModifiers, count3);
			}
			bool flag3 = categoryFrame.TrendSpeedModifiers.Count > 0;
			if (flag3)
			{
				ReconcileSpeedModifiers(TrendSpeedModifiers, p, categoryFrame.TrendSpeedModifiers, categoryFrame2.TrendSpeedModifiers, count4);
			}
			bool flag4 = categoryFrame.ErrorSpeedModifiers.Count > 0;
			if (flag4)
			{
				ReconcileSpeedModifiers(ErrorSpeedModifiers, p, categoryFrame.ErrorSpeedModifiers, categoryFrame2.ErrorSpeedModifiers, count5);
			}
			bool flag5 = categoryFrame.ErrorBarsSpeedModifiers.Count > 0;
			if (flag5)
			{
				ReconcileSpeedModifiers(ErrorBarsSpeedModifiers, p, categoryFrame.ErrorBarsSpeedModifiers, categoryFrame2.ErrorBarsSpeedModifiers, count6);
			}
			if (Buckets.Count < num)
			{
				while (Buckets.Count < num)
				{
					Buckets.Add(new double[cnt]);
				}
			}
			if (Buckets.Count > num)
			{
				Buckets.RemoveRange(num, Buckets.Count - num);
			}
			if (flag)
			{
				double num2 = 0.0;
				for (int i = 0; i < Math.Min(count, count2); i++)
				{
					double[] array = Buckets[i];
					num2 = (double)p * SpeedModifiers[i];
					num2 = ((num2 > 1.0) ? 1.0 : num2);
					for (int j = 0; j < cnt; j++)
					{
						array[j] = categoryFrame.Buckets[i][j] + num2 * (categoryFrame2.Buckets[i][j] - categoryFrame.Buckets[i][j]);
					}
				}
			}
			else
			{
				for (int k = 0; k < Math.Min(count, count2); k++)
				{
					double[] array2 = Buckets[k];
					for (int l = 0; l < cnt; l++)
					{
						array2[l] = categoryFrame.Buckets[k][l] + (double)p * (categoryFrame2.Buckets[k][l] - categoryFrame.Buckets[k][l]);
					}
				}
			}
			if (count < count2)
			{
				double[] array3 = new double[cnt];
				for (int num3 = cnt - 1; num3 >= 0; num3--)
				{
					array3[num3] = ((categoryFrame.Buckets.Count > 0) ? categoryFrame.Buckets[categoryFrame.Buckets.Count - 1][num3] : 0.0);
				}
				if (flag)
				{
					double num4 = 0.0;
					for (int m = count; m < count2; m++)
					{
						double[] array4 = Buckets[m];
						num4 = (double)p * SpeedModifiers[m];
						num4 = ((num4 > 1.0) ? 1.0 : num4);
						for (int num5 = cnt - 1; num5 >= 0; num5--)
						{
							array4[num5] = array3[num5] + num4 * (categoryFrame2.Buckets[m][num5] - array3[num5]);
						}
					}
				}
				else
				{
					for (int n = count; n < count2; n++)
					{
						double[] array5 = Buckets[n];
						for (int num6 = cnt - 1; num6 >= 0; num6--)
						{
							array5[num6] = array3[num6] + (double)p * (categoryFrame2.Buckets[n][num6] - array3[num6]);
						}
					}
				}
			}
			if (count > count2)
			{
				double[] array6 = new double[cnt];
				for (int num7 = cnt - 1; num7 >= 0; num7--)
				{
					array6[num7] = ((categoryFrame2.Buckets.Count > 0) ? categoryFrame2.Buckets[categoryFrame2.Buckets.Count - 1][num7] : 0.0);
				}
				if (flag)
				{
					double num8 = 0.0;
					for (int num9 = count2; num9 < count; num9++)
					{
						double[] array7 = Buckets[num9];
						num8 = (double)p * SpeedModifiers[num9];
						num8 = ((num8 > 1.0) ? 1.0 : num8);
						for (int num10 = cnt - 1; num10 >= 0; num10--)
						{
							array7[num10] = categoryFrame.Buckets[num9][num10] + num8 * (array6[num10] - categoryFrame.Buckets[num9][num10]);
						}
					}
				}
				else
				{
					for (int num11 = count2; num11 < count; num11++)
					{
						double[] array8 = Buckets[num11];
						for (int num12 = cnt - 1; num12 >= 0; num12--)
						{
							array8[num12] = categoryFrame.Buckets[num11][num12] + (double)p * (array6[num12] - categoryFrame.Buckets[num11][num12]);
						}
					}
				}
			}
			if (flag2)
			{
				Frame.InterpolateWithSpeed(Markers, p, categoryFrame.Markers, categoryFrame2.Markers, MarkerSpeedModifiers);
			}
			else
			{
				Frame.Interpolate(Markers, p, categoryFrame.Markers, categoryFrame2.Markers);
			}
			if (flag3)
			{
				Frame.InterpolateWithSpeed(Trend, p, categoryFrame.Trend, categoryFrame2.Trend, TrendSpeedModifiers);
			}
			else
			{
				Frame.Interpolate(Trend, p, categoryFrame.Trend, categoryFrame2.Trend);
			}
			if (flag4)
			{
				Frame.InterpolateWithSpeed(ErrorBars, p, categoryFrame.ErrorBars, categoryFrame2.ErrorBars, ErrorSpeedModifiers);
			}
			else
			{
				Frame.Interpolate(ErrorBars, p, categoryFrame.ErrorBars, categoryFrame2.ErrorBars);
			}
			if (flag5)
			{
				Frame.InterpolateWithSpeed(ErrorBarPositiveSizes, p, categoryFrame.ErrorBarPositiveSizes, categoryFrame2.ErrorBarPositiveSizes, ErrorBarsSpeedModifiers);
				Frame.InterpolateWithSpeed(ErrorBarNegativeSizes, p, categoryFrame.ErrorBarNegativeSizes, categoryFrame2.ErrorBarNegativeSizes, ErrorBarsSpeedModifiers);
			}
			else
			{
				Frame.Interpolate(ErrorBarPositiveSizes, p, categoryFrame.ErrorBarPositiveSizes, categoryFrame2.ErrorBarPositiveSizes);
				Frame.Interpolate(ErrorBarNegativeSizes, p, categoryFrame.ErrorBarNegativeSizes, categoryFrame2.ErrorBarNegativeSizes);
			}
			Rect customClip = categoryFrame.CustomClip;
			Rect customClip2 = categoryFrame2.CustomClip;
			double x = customClip.Left + (customClip2.Left - customClip.Left) * (double)p;
			double y = customClip.Top + (customClip2.Top - customClip.Top) * (double)p;
			double width = Math.Max(0.0, customClip.Width + (customClip2.Width - customClip.Width) * (double)p);
			double height = Math.Max(0.0, customClip.Height + (customClip2.Height - customClip.Height) * (double)p);
			CustomClip = new Rect(x, y, width, height);
		}

		private void ReconcileSpeedModifiers(List<double> modifiers, float p, List<double> minSpeedModifiers, List<double> maxSpeedModifiers, int count)
		{
			if (maxSpeedModifiers.Count == 0)
			{
				for (int i = 0; i < minSpeedModifiers.Count; i++)
				{
					maxSpeedModifiers.Add(minSpeedModifiers[i]);
				}
			}
			else
			{
				Frame.Interpolate(modifiers, p, minSpeedModifiers, maxSpeedModifiers);
			}
			if (modifiers.Count < count)
			{
				int count2 = modifiers.Count;
				for (int j = 0; j < count - count2; j++)
				{
					modifiers.Add(1.0);
				}
			}
		}

		public void ClearSpeedModifiers()
		{
			SpeedModifiers.Clear();
			TrendSpeedModifiers.Clear();
			MarkerSpeedModifiers.Clear();
			ErrorSpeedModifiers.Clear();
			ErrorBarsSpeedModifiers.Clear();
		}

		public void ClearFrame()
		{
			IncrementFrameVersion();
			ClearSpeedModifiers();
			CustomClip = _fullClip;
		}

		public void ResetFrame()
		{
			ClearFrame();
			Buckets.Clear();
			ErrorBars.Clear();
			ErrorBuckets.Clear();
			Markers.Clear();
			Trend.Clear();
		}

		public void IncrementFrameVersion()
		{
			_categoryFrameVersion++;
			if (_categoryFrameVersion >= 2147483646)
			{
				_categoryFrameVersion = 0;
			}
			FrameVersion = _categoryFrameVersion;
		}
	}

		public void InitMarkerRenderSettings(Series source, bool shouldOverrideMarkerStyle, GetCategoryItemsHandler getItems)
		{

			InitialMarkerRenderOutline = source.GetActualMarkerOutlineBrush();
			InitialMarkerRenderOpacity = 1.0;
			InitialMarkerRenderThickness = source.GetActualMarkerThickness();

			ActualMarkerRenderOutline = InitialMarkerRenderOutline;

				MarkerOverrideArgs.MaxAllSeriesHighlightingProgress = 0.0;
				MarkerOverrideArgs.SumAllSeriesHighlightingProgress = 0.0;
				MarkerOverrideArgs.TotalAllSeriesHighlightingProgress = 0.0;
				if (source.SeriesViewer != null && source.ActualHighlightingMode != SeriesHighlightingMode.None)
				{
					MarkerOverrideArgs.MaxAllSeriesHighlightingProgress = source.SeriesViewer.HighlightingManager.MaxMarkerHighlightingProgress;
					MarkerOverrideArgs.SumAllSeriesHighlightingProgress = source.SeriesViewer.HighlightingManager.SumMarkerHighlightingProgress;
					MarkerOverrideArgs.TotalAllSeriesHighlightingProgress = source.SeriesViewer.HighlightingManager.TotalHighlightingProgress;
				}

					OverrideArgs.SumAllSeriesHighlightingProgress = source.SeriesViewer.HighlightingManager.SumHighlightingProgress;
