		public void SetShapeAppearance(Shape shape, bool strokeOnly, bool fillOnly, bool extended, bool useOutline)
		{
			Brush brush = ActualRenderFill;
			if (useOutline)
			{
				brush = ActualRenderOutline;
			}
			if (fillOnly)
			{
				shape.Fill = brush;
			}
			else
			{
				if (strokeOnly)
				{
					shape.Stroke = brush;
				}
				else
				{
					shape.Fill = brush;
					shape.Stroke = ActualRenderOutline;
				}
				shape.StrokeThickness = ActualRenderThickness;
				if (ActualRenderDashArray != null)
				{
					shape.StrokeDashArray = ActualRenderDashArray.Duplicate();
				}
				else
				{
					shape.StrokeDashArray = null;
				}
				shape.StrokeDashCap = ActualRenderDashCap;
				if (extended)
				{
					shape.StrokeMiterLimit = ActualRenderMiterLimit;
					shape.StrokeLineJoin = ActualRenderLineJoin;
					shape.StrokeStartLineCap = ActualRenderStartCap;
					shape.StrokeEndLineCap = ActualRenderEndCap;
				}
			}
			shape.Opacity = ActualRenderOpacity;
		}

		public void SetMarkerAppearance(Marker marker, DataContext context)
		{
			marker.Opacity = ActualMarkerRenderOpacity;
			context.ItemBrush = ActualMarkerRenderFill;
			context.Thickness = ActualMarkerRenderThickness;
			context.ItemOutline = ActualMarkerRenderOutline;
		}

		protected void ApplyHighlightingStyle(Series series, HighlightingInfo info, double seriesOthersProgress, double secondaryOthersProgress, double fadeOpacity, bool isMainShape)
		{
			if (series.ActualHighlightingMode != SeriesHighlightingMode.None)
			{
				ActualRenderOpacity = series.SeriesInteractionManager.ApplyHighlightingOpacity(series, info, ActualRenderOpacity, seriesOthersProgress, secondaryOthersProgress, fadeOpacity, isMainShape);
				ActualRenderFill = series.SeriesInteractionManager.ApplyHighlightingColor(series, info, ActualRenderFill);
				ActualRenderOutline = series.SeriesInteractionManager.ApplyHighlightingColor(series, info, ActualRenderOutline);
			}
		}

		protected void ApplyMarkerHighlightingStyle(Series series, HighlightingInfo info, double markerOthersProgress, double seriesOthersProgress, double fadeOpacity)
		{
			if (series.ActualHighlightingMode != SeriesHighlightingMode.None)
			{
				ActualMarkerRenderOpacity = series.SeriesInteractionManager.ApplyHighlightingOpacity(series, info, ActualMarkerRenderOpacity, markerOthersProgress, seriesOthersProgress, fadeOpacity, isMainShape: false);
				ActualMarkerRenderFill = series.SeriesInteractionManager.ApplyHighlightingColor(series, info, ActualMarkerRenderFill);
				ActualMarkerRenderOutline = series.SeriesInteractionManager.ApplyHighlightingColor(series, info, ActualMarkerRenderOutline);
			}
		}

		public void PrePerformStyleOverride(double fadeOpacity)
		{
			ActualRenderFill = InitialRenderFill;
			ActualRenderOutline = InitialRenderOutline;
			ActualRenderThickness = InitialRenderThickness;
			ActualRenderDashArray = InitialRenderDashArray;
			ActualRenderDashCap = InitialRenderDashCap;
			ActualRenderRadiusX = InitialRenderRadiusX;
			ActualRenderRadiusY = InitialRenderRadiusY;
			ActualRenderOpacity = InitialRenderOpacity;
			AssigningSeriesShapeStyleEventArgsBase overrideArgs = OverrideArgs;
			overrideArgs.Fill = ActualRenderFill;
			overrideArgs.Stroke = ActualRenderOutline;
			overrideArgs.StrokeThickness = ActualRenderThickness;
			overrideArgs.StrokeDashArray = ActualRenderDashArray;
			overrideArgs.StrokeDashCap = ActualRenderDashCap;
			overrideArgs.RadiusX = ActualRenderRadiusX;
			overrideArgs.RadiusY = ActualRenderRadiusY;
			overrideArgs.Opacity = ActualRenderOpacity;
			overrideArgs.IsNegativeShape = ActualNegativeShape;
			overrideArgs.FadeOpacity = fadeOpacity;
			overrideArgs.HighlightingHandled = false;
		}

		public void PostPerformStyleOverride(Series series, HighlightingInfo info, bool isThumbnail, bool isHighlightingEnabled, bool isMainShape)
		{
			AssigningSeriesShapeStyleEventArgsBase overrideArgs = OverrideArgs;
			ActualRenderFill = overrideArgs.Fill;
			ActualRenderOutline = overrideArgs.Stroke;
			ActualRenderThickness = overrideArgs.StrokeThickness;
			ActualRenderDashArray = overrideArgs.StrokeDashArray;
			ActualRenderDashCap = overrideArgs.StrokeDashCap;
			ActualRenderRadiusX = overrideArgs.RadiusX;
			ActualRenderRadiusY = overrideArgs.RadiusY;
			ActualRenderOpacity = overrideArgs.Opacity;
			if (isHighlightingEnabled && !overrideArgs.HighlightingHandled && !isThumbnail)
			{
				ApplyHighlightingStyle(series, info, overrideArgs.TotalAllSeriesHighlightingProgress, overrideArgs.TotalAllSeriesHighlightingProgress, overrideArgs.FadeOpacity, isMainShape);
			}
		}

		public void PrePerformMarkerStyleOverride(double fadeOpacity)
		{
			ActualMarkerRenderFill = InitialMarkerRenderFill;
			ActualMarkerRenderOutline = InitialMarkerRenderOutline;
			ActualMarkerRenderOpacity = InitialMarkerRenderOpacity;
			AssigningSeriesStyleEventArgsBase markerOverrideArgs = MarkerOverrideArgs;
			markerOverrideArgs.Fill = ActualMarkerRenderFill;
			markerOverrideArgs.Stroke = ActualMarkerRenderOutline;
			markerOverrideArgs.Opacity = ActualMarkerRenderOpacity;
			markerOverrideArgs.IsNegativeShape = ActualNegativeMarkerShape;
			markerOverrideArgs.FadeOpacity = fadeOpacity;
			markerOverrideArgs.HighlightingHandled = false;
		}

		{
			AssigningSeriesStyleEventArgsBase markerOverrideArgs = MarkerOverrideArgs;
			ActualMarkerRenderFill = markerOverrideArgs.Fill;
			ActualMarkerRenderOutline = markerOverrideArgs.Stroke;
			ActualMarkerRenderOpacity = markerOverrideArgs.Opacity;
			if (isHighlightingEnabled && !markerOverrideArgs.HighlightingHandled && !isThumbnail)
			{
				ApplyMarkerHighlightingStyle(target, info, markersOthersProgress, seriesOthersProgress, markerOverrideArgs.FadeOpacity);
			}
		}

	internal class OrderedDictionary<TKey, TValue> : OrderedDictionary, IDictionary<TKey, TValue>, ICollection<KeyValuePair<TKey, TValue>>, IEnumerable<KeyValuePair<TKey, TValue>>, IEnumerable, IDictionary, ICollection
	{
		private Dictionary<TKey, TValue> Dictionary { get; set; }

		private List<TKey> OrderedKeys { get; set; }

		public TKey this[int index] => OrderedKeys[index];

		public TValue this[TKey key]
		{
			get
			{
				return Dictionary[key];
			}
			set
			{
				int index = OrderedKeys.IndexOf(key);
				OrderedKeys[index] = key;
				Dictionary[key] = value;
			}
		}

		internal override int Length => Count;

		public int Count => Dictionary.Count;

		public bool IsReadOnly => false;

		public ICollection<TKey> Keys => OrderedKeys;

		public ICollection<TValue> Values => Dictionary.Values;

		ICollection IDictionary.Keys => Dictionary.Keys;

		ICollection IDictionary.Values => Dictionary.Values;

		bool IDictionary.IsReadOnly => IsReadOnly;

		bool IDictionary.IsFixedSize => ((IDictionary)Dictionary).IsFixedSize;

		int ICollection.Count => Count;

		object ICollection.SyncRoot => ((ICollection)Dictionary).SyncRoot;

		bool ICollection.IsSynchronized => ((ICollection)Dictionary).IsSynchronized;

		object IDictionary.this[object key]
		{
			get
			{
				return this[(TKey)key];
			}
			set
			{
				this[(TKey)key] = (TValue)value;
			}
		}

		public OrderedDictionary()
		{
			Dictionary = new Dictionary<TKey, TValue>();
			OrderedKeys = new List<TKey>();
		}

		public void Add(KeyValuePair<TKey, TValue> item)
		{
			Add(item.Key, item.Value);
		}

		public void Add(TKey key, TValue value)
		{
			Dictionary.Add(key, value);
			OrderedKeys.Add(key);
		}

		public void Clear()
		{
			Dictionary.Clear();
			OrderedKeys.Clear();
		}

		public bool Contains(KeyValuePair<TKey, TValue> item)
		{
			return ((ICollection<KeyValuePair<TKey, TValue>>)Dictionary).Contains(item);
		}

		public bool ContainsKey(TKey key)
		{
			return Dictionary.ContainsKey(key);
		}

		public void CopyTo(KeyValuePair<TKey, TValue>[] array, int arrayIndex)
		{
			((ICollection<KeyValuePair<TKey, TValue>>)Dictionary).CopyTo(array, arrayIndex);
		}

		public IEnumerator<KeyValuePair<TKey, TValue>> GetEnumerator()
		{
			return new OrderedDictionaryEnumerator<TKey, TValue>(this);
		}

		public bool Remove(KeyValuePair<TKey, TValue> item)
		{
			return Remove(item.Key);
		}

		public bool Remove(TKey key)
		{
			if (Dictionary.Remove(key))
			{
				return OrderedKeys.Remove(key);
			}
			return false;
		}

		public bool TryGetValue(TKey key, out TValue value)
		{
			if (Dictionary.ContainsKey(key))
			{
				value = Dictionary[key];
				return true;
			}
			value = default(TValue);
			return false;
		}

		IEnumerator IEnumerable.GetEnumerator()
		{
			return new OrderedDictionaryEnumerator<TKey, TValue>(this);
		}

		public override object KeyAtIndex(int index)
		{
			return this[index];
		}

		public override object ValueFromKey(object key)
		{
			return this[(TKey)key];
		}

		bool IDictionary.Contains(object key)
		{
			return Dictionary.ContainsKey((TKey)key);
		}

		void IDictionary.Add(object key, object value)
		{
			Add((TKey)key, (TValue)value);
		}

		void IDictionary.Clear()
		{
			Clear();
		}

		IDictionaryEnumerator IDictionary.GetEnumerator()
		{
			return ((IDictionary)Dictionary).GetEnumerator();
		}

		void IDictionary.Remove(object key)
		{
			((IDictionary)Dictionary).Remove(key);
		}

		void ICollection.CopyTo(Array array, int index)
		{
			((ICollection)Dictionary).CopyTo(array, index);
		}
	}
	internal class OrderedDictionaryEnumerator<TKey, TValue> : IEnumerator<KeyValuePair<TKey, TValue>>, IDisposable, IEnumerator
	{
		private int Index { get; set; }

		private OrderedDictionary<TKey, TValue> Dictionary { get; set; }

		public object Current => Dictionary[Dictionary[Index]];

		KeyValuePair<TKey, TValue> IEnumerator<KeyValuePair<TKey, TValue>>.Current
		{
			get
			{
				TKey key = Dictionary[Index];
				return new KeyValuePair<TKey, TValue>(key, Dictionary[key]);
			}
		}

		public OrderedDictionaryEnumerator(OrderedDictionary<TKey, TValue> dictionary)
		{
			Index = -1;
			Dictionary = dictionary;
		}

		public bool MoveNext()
		{
			Index++;
			return Index < Dictionary.Count;
		}

		public void Reset()
		{
			Index = -1;
		}

		public void Dispose()
		{
		}
	}
	internal abstract class OrderedDictionary

	public abstract class FrameExtended
	{
		private static Brush InterpolateBrushes(double p, Brush minBrush, Brush maxBrush, InterpolationMode interpolationMode)
		{
			return minBrush.GetInterpolation(p, maxBrush, interpolationMode);
		}

		protected internal static void Interpolate(List<Brush> ret, float p, List<Brush> min, List<Brush> max, InterpolationMode interpolationMode)
		{
			int count = min.Count;
			int count2 = max.Count;
			int num = Math.Max(count, count2);
			Brush brush = new SolidColorBrush(Colors.Transparent);
			if (ret.Count < num)
			{
				Brush[] array = new Brush[num - ret.Count];
				for (int i = 0; i < num - ret.Count; i++)
				{
					array[i] = new SolidColorBrush();
				}
				ret.InsertRange(ret.Count, array);
			}
			if (ret.Count > num)
			{
				ret.RemoveRange(num, ret.Count - num);
			}
			for (int j = 0; j < Math.Min(count, count2); j++)
			{
				ret[j] = InterpolateBrushes(p, min[j], max[j], interpolationMode);
			}
			if (count < count2)
			{
				Brush minBrush = ((count > 0) ? min[count - 1] : brush);
				for (int k = count; k < count2; k++)
				{
					ret[k] = InterpolateBrushes(p, minBrush, max[k], interpolationMode);
				}
			}
			if (count > count2)
			{
				Brush maxBrush = ((count2 > 0) ? max[count2 - 1] : brush);
				for (int l = count2; l < count; l++)
				{
					ret[l] = InterpolateBrushes(p, min[l], maxBrush, interpolationMode);
				}
			}
		}
	}

				SetValue(PlotAreaMarginProperty, value);
			}
		}

		protected double PlotAreaMarginRight => PlotAreaMargin.Right;

		protected double PlotAreaMarginBottom => PlotAreaMargin.Bottom;

		internal static int FindSeriesIndex(Series series)
		{
			if (series.SeriesViewer == null)
			{
				return -1;
			}
			if (!series.IsIndexed)
			{
				return -1;
			}
			List<Series> allSeries = SeriesViewerView.GetAllSeries(series);
			if (allSeries.Count == 0)
			{
				return -1;
			}
			int num = -1;
			for (int i = 0; i < allSeries.Count; i++)
			{
				num = Math.Max(num, allSeries[i].Index);
			}
			int result = num + 1;
			if (series.IsFragment)
			{
				result = series.GetFragmentIndex();
				if (result == -1)
				{
					return -1;
				}
				result = series.ResolveParentSeries().Index + result;
			}
			return result;
		}

		public XamDataChart()
		{
			if (DesignerProperties.GetIsInDesignMode(this))
			{
				new CommandBase();
			}
			base.DefaultStyleKey = typeof(XamDataChart);
			Axes.CollectionChanged += Axes_CollectionChanged;
			Axes.CollectionResetting += Axes_CollectionResetting;
			Utilities.ValidateLicense(typeof(XamDataChart), this);
		}

		public override void OnApplyTemplate()
		{
			base.OnApplyTemplate();
		}

		protected override void PropertyUpdatedOverride(object sender, string propertyName, object oldValue, object newValue)
		{
			base.PropertyUpdatedOverride(sender, propertyName, oldValue, newValue);
			switch (propertyName)
			{
			case "WindowScaleHorizontal":
				ActualWindowScaleHorizontal = WindowScaleHorizontal;
				break;
			case "WindowScaleVertical":
				ActualWindowScaleVertical = WindowScaleVertical;
				break;
			case "ActualWindowScaleHorizontal":
			case "ActualWindowScaleVertical":
				if (!base.SuspendWindowRect)
				{
					UpdateWindowRect(GetActualWindowScaleHorizontal(), GetActualWindowScaleVertical());
				}
				break;
			case "GridMode":
				((XamDataChartView)View).UpdateGridMode(newValue);
				if (oldValue == newValue || ((GridMode)oldValue != GridMode.None && (GridMode)newValue != GridMode.None))
				{
					break;
				}
				{
					foreach (Axis axis in Axes)
					{
						axis.RenderAxis();
					}
					break;
				}
			case "HorizontalZoomable":
				IsHorizontalZoomEnabled = HorizontalZoomable;
				break;
			case "VerticalZoomable":
				IsVerticalZoomEnabled = VerticalZoomable;
				break;
			case "IsHorizontalZoomEnabled":
			case "IsVerticalZoomEnabled":
				UpdateOverviewPlusDetailPaneControlPanelVisibility();
				break;
			case "AlignsGridLinesToPixels":
			case "ShouldClipGridlines":
				if (oldValue == newValue)
				{
					break;
				}
				{
					foreach (Axis axis2 in Axes)
					{
						axis2.MustInvalidateLabels = true;
						axis2.RenderAxis();
					}
					break;
				}
			case "PlotAreaMargin":
				OnPlotAreaMarginsChanged();
				break;
			case "DefaultPlotAreaBorderBrush":
				UpdateActualPlotAreaBorderBrush();
				break;
			case "DefaultAxisStroke":
			case "DefaultAxisMajorStroke":
			case "DefaultAxisMinorStroke":
			{
				foreach (Axis axis3 in Axes)
				{
					axis3.UpdateActualBrushes();
				}
				break;
			}
			case "ComputedPlotAreaMarginMode":
				OnPlotAreaMarginsChanged();
				break;
			}
		}

		protected override void OnComputedPlotAreaMarginInvalidated()
		{
			base.OnComputedPlotAreaMarginInvalidated();
			if (ComputedPlotAreaMarginMode == ComputedPlotAreaMarginMode.Series)
			{
				OnPlotAreaMarginsChanged();
			}
		}

		public void RefreshComputedPlotAreaMargin()
		{
			OnPlotAreaMarginsChanged();
		}

		private void OnPlotAreaMarginsChanged()
		{
			Thickness thickness = ResolvePlotAreaAutoMargin();
			_plotAreaMarginMutated = false;
			if (!double.IsNaN(PlotAreaMarginLeft))
			{
				ActualPlotAreaMarginLeft = PlotAreaMarginLeft;
			}
			else
			{
				ActualPlotAreaMarginLeft = thickness.Left;
			}
			if (!double.IsNaN(PlotAreaMarginTop))
			{
				ActualPlotAreaMarginTop = PlotAreaMarginTop;
			}
			else
			{
				ActualPlotAreaMarginTop = thickness.Top;
			}
			if (!double.IsNaN(PlotAreaMarginRight))
			{
				ActualPlotAreaMarginRight = PlotAreaMarginRight;
			}
			else
			{
				ActualPlotAreaMarginRight = thickness.Right;
			}
			if (!double.IsNaN(PlotAreaMarginBottom))
			{
				ActualPlotAreaMarginBottom = PlotAreaMarginBottom;
			}
			else
			{
				ActualPlotAreaMarginBottom = thickness.Bottom;
			}
			base.EffectiveViewport = ComputeEffectiveViewport(ViewportRect);
			if (!_plotAreaMarginMutated)
			{
				return;
			}
			_plotAreaMarginMutated = false;
			foreach (Axis axis in Axes)
			{
				axis.MustInvalidateLabels = true;
				axis.RenderAxis();
			}
			foreach (Series item in base.Series)
			{
				item.RenderSeries(animate: false);
			}
		}

		private Thickness ResolvePlotAreaAutoMargin()
		{
			ComputedPlotAreaMarginMode computedPlotAreaMarginMode = ComputedPlotAreaMarginMode;
			if (computedPlotAreaMarginMode == ComputedPlotAreaMarginMode.Series)
			{
				return ResolveSeriesAutoMargin();
			}
			return new Thickness(0.0, 0.0, 0.0, 0.0);
		}

		private Thickness ResolveSeriesAutoMargin()
		{
			Thickness result = new Thickness(0.0, 0.0, 0.0, 0.0);
			for (int i = 0; i < base.Series.Count; i++)
			{
				Thickness thickness = base.Series[i].ResolveDesiredAutoMargin();
				result = new Thickness(Math.Max(thickness.Left, result.Left), Math.Max(thickness.Top, result.Top), Math.Max(thickness.Right, result.Right), Math.Max(thickness.Bottom, result.Bottom));
			}
			return result;
		}

		public void RecalculateMarginAutoExpansion()
		{
			IsMarginAutoExpanded = false;
			MustRestAutoExpansion = true;
			for (int i = 0; i < Axes.Count; i++)
			{
				Axes[i].MustInvalidateLabels = true;
				Axes[i].RenderAxis();
			}
		}

		internal void PerformMarginAutoExpansion(AxisLabelPanelBase panel, Rect labelViewport, Rect firstBounds, Rect lastBounds)
		{
			if (panel.Axis == null || panel.Axis.MustInvalidateLabels || panel.Axis.ViewportRect.IsEmpty)
			{
				return;
			}
			bool flag = false;
			for (int i = 0; i < Axes.Count; i++)
			{
				double extent = Axes[i].LabelPanel.Extent;
				Axes[i].LabelPanel.EnsureExtentSet();
				if (Axes[i].LabelPanel.Extent != extent)
				{
					flag = true;
				}
			}
			if (flag)
			{
				return;
			}
			if (double.IsNaN(origPaddingLeft))
			{
				origPaddingLeft = base.Padding.Left;
				origPaddingRight = base.Padding.Right;
			}
			if (base.ActualWidth == 0.0 || base.ActualHeight == 0.0)
			{
				return;
			}
			bool flag2 = false;
			if (MustRestAutoExpansion)
			{
				MustRestAutoExpansion = false;
				flag2 = true;
			}
			IsMarginAutoExpanded = true;
			double num = 0.0;
			double num2 = 0.0;
			double x = 0.0;
			try
			{
				x = panel.TransformToVisual(this).Transform(new Point(x, 0.0)).X;
			}
			catch (Exception)
			{
				IsMarginAutoExpanded = false;
				return;
			}
			double num3 = firstBounds.Left + x;
			double num4 = lastBounds.Right + x;
			double num5 = 0.0;
			num5 = base.ActualWidth;
			if (num3 < 0.0)
			{
				num = 0.0 - num3;
				num += AutoExpandMarginExtraPadding;
			}
			if (num4 > num5)
			{
				num2 = num4 - num5;
				num2 += AutoExpandMarginExtraPadding;
			}
			if (flag2)
			{
				if (num3 > 0.0)
				{
					num = 0.0 - num3;
					num += AutoExpandMarginExtraPadding;
				}
				if (num4 < num5)
				{
					num2 = 0.0 - (num5 - num4);
					num2 += AutoExpandMarginExtraPadding;
				}
			}
			bool flag3 = false;
			bool flag4 = false;
			if (num == 0.0 && num2 == 0.0)
			{
				return;
			}
			flag3 = true;
			_extraMarginLeft += num;
			_extraMarginRight += num2;
			if (_extraMarginLeft > AutoExpandMarginMaximumValue)
			{
				_extraMarginLeft = AutoExpandMarginMaximumValue;
				flag4 = true;
			}
			if (_extraMarginRight > AutoExpandMarginMaximumValue)
			{
				_extraMarginRight = AutoExpandMarginMaximumValue;
				flag4 = true;
			}
			if (_extraMarginLeft < 0.0)
			{
				_extraMarginLeft = 0.0;
				flag4 = true;
			}
			if (_extraMarginRight < 0.0)
			{
				_extraMarginRight = 0.0;
				flag4 = true;
			}
			base.Padding = new Thickness(origPaddingLeft + _extraMarginLeft, base.Padding.Top, origPaddingRight + _extraMarginRight, base.Padding.Bottom);
			base.MarginsJustAltered = flag3;
			if (!flag4 && base.MarginsJustAltered)
			{
				for (int j = 0; j < Axes.Count; j++)
				{
					Axes[j].MustInvalidateLabels = true;
					Axes[j].RenderAxis(animate: false);
				}
				FlushInternal(forceLayout: true, forceOverlay: false, forceRender: false);
				IsMarginAutoExpanded = false;
				for (int k = 0; k < Axes.Count; k++)
				{
					Axes[k].MustInvalidateLabels = true;
					Axes[k].RenderAxis(animate: false);
				}
				FlushInternal(forceLayout: true, forceOverlay: false, forceRender: false);
			}
		}

		private void Axes_CollectionChanged(object sender, NotifyCollectionChangedEventArgs e)
		{
			if (e.OldItems != null)
			{
				foreach (Axis oldItem in e.OldItems)
				{
					if (oldItem == null)
					{
						continue;
					}
					oldItem.FastItemsSourceProvider = null;
					oldItem.SeriesViewer = null;
					RemoveDataSource(oldItem);
					View.RemoveAxis(oldItem);
					oldItem.RangeChanged -= Axis_RangeChanged;
					View.RemoveLabelPanel(oldItem);
					if (oldItem.Series == null)
					{
						continue;
					}
					foreach (Series item in oldItem.DirectSeries())
					{
						item.RenderSeries(animate: false);
					}
				}
				if (Axes.Count == 0)
				{
					ResetZoom();
				}
			}
			if (e.NewItems != null)
			{
				foreach (Axis newItem in e.NewItems)
				{
					if (newItem != null)
					{
						newItem.FastItemsSourceProvider = base.ActualSyncLink;
						newItem.SeriesViewer = this;
						View.AttachAxis(newItem);
						newItem.RangeChanged += Axis_RangeChanged;
						View.AddLabelPanel(newItem);
					}
				}
			}
			NotifyThumbnailAppearanceChanged();
		}

		private void Axes_CollectionResetting(object sender, EventArgs e)
		{
			List<Series> list = new List<Series>();
			foreach (Axis axis in Axes)
			{
				if (axis.Series != null)
				{
					foreach (Series item in axis.DirectSeries())
					{
						if (!list.Contains(item))
						{
							list.Add(item);
						}
					}
				}
				axis.FastItemsSourceProvider = null;
				axis.SeriesViewer = null;
				RemoveDataSource(axis);
				View.RemoveAxis(axis);
				axis.RangeChanged -= Axis_RangeChanged;
				View.RemoveLabelPanel(axis);
				ResetZoom();
			}
			foreach (Series item2 in base.Series)
			{
				if (!list.Contains(item2))
				{
					list.Add(item2);
				}
			}
			foreach (Series item3 in list)
			{
				item3.RenderSeries(animate: false);
			}
		}

		[Weak]
		private void Axis_RangeChanged(object sender, AxisRangeChangedEventArgs args)
		{
			if (!(sender is Axis axis))
			{
				return;
			}
			NotifyThumbnailAppearanceChanged();
			if (axis.CrossingAxis != null)
			{
				axis.CrossingAxis.Refresh();
			}
			axis.Refresh();
			bool animate = base.AnimateSeriesWhenAxisRangeChanges;
			if (axis is CategoryAxisBase)
			{
				animate = true;
			}
			foreach (Series item in axis.DirectSeries())
			{
				item.ThumbnailDirty = true;
				NotifyThumbnailAppearanceChanged();
				item.RenderSeries(animate);
			}
			if (axis.SeriesViewer != null)
			{
				foreach (Series item2 in axis.SeriesViewer.Series)
				{
					OnValueOverlayRangeChanged(axis, animate, item2);
				}
			}
			foreach (Axis axis2 in Axes)
			{
				if (axis2 != axis && axis2.CrossingAxis != null && axis2.CrossingAxis == axis)
				{
					axis2.Refresh();
				}
			}
		}

		private static void OnValueOverlayRangeChanged(Axis targetAxis, bool animate, Series series)
		{
			if (series is ValueOverlay valueOverlay)
			{
				if (valueOverlay.Axis == targetAxis)
				{
					valueOverlay.RenderSeries(animate);
				}
				else if (valueOverlay.Axis is NumericAngleAxis && ((NumericAngleAxis)valueOverlay.Axis).RadiusAxis == targetAxis)
				{
					valueOverlay.RenderSeries(animate);
				}
			}
		}

		protected override AutomationPeer OnCreateAutomationPeer()
		{
			return new XamDataChartAutomationPeer(this);
		}

		internal override void UpdateSyncLink(SyncLink oldLink, SyncLink newLink)
		{
			base.UpdateSyncLink(oldLink, newLink);
			if (Axes == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			foreach (Axis axis in Axes)
			{
				axis.FastItemsSourceProvider = base.ActualSyncLink;
				axis.SeriesViewer = this;
			}
		}

		protected internal override FontInfo GetFontInfo()
		{
			if (_fontInfo == null)
			{
				_fontInfo = new FontInfo();
			}
			_fontInfo.FontFamily = base.FontFamily;
			_fontInfo.FontSize = base.FontSize;
			_fontInfo.FontStyle = base.FontStyle;
			_fontInfo.FontStretch = base.FontStretch;
			_fontInfo.FontWeight = base.FontWeight;
			return _fontInfo;
		}

		protected internal override void UpdateActualPlotAreaBorderBrush()
		{
			Brush brush = base.PlotAreaBorderBrush;
			if (brush == null && base.Series.Any((Series series) => series.IsScatter))
			{
				brush = DefaultPlotAreaBorderBrush;
			}
			base.ActualPlotAreaBorderBrush = brush;
		}

		internal override bool EffectiveIsSquare()
		{
			if (IsSquare)
			{
				return true;
			}
			return HasPolarOrRadial();
		}

		private bool HasPolarOrRadial()
		{
			for (int i = 0; i < base.Series.Count; i++)
			{
				if (base.Series[i].IsRadial || base.Series[i].IsPolar)
				{
					return true;
				}
			}
			for (int j = 0; j < Axes.Count; j++)
			{
				if (Axes[j].IsAngular || Axes[j].IsRadial)
				{
					return true;
				}
			}
			return false;
		}

		protected override SeriesViewerView CreateView()
		{
			return new XamDataChartView(this);
		}

		protected override void OnViewCreated(SeriesViewerView view)
		{
			base.OnViewCreated(view);
			ChartView = (XamDataChartView)view;
		}

		protected internal override void RefreshAllContentAfterTiledZoom()
		{
			for (int i = 0; i < _axes.Count; i++)
			{
				_axes[i].MustInvalidateLabels = true;
				_axes[i].RenderAxis(animate: false);
			}
			base.RefreshAllContentAfterTiledZoom();
		}

		protected override Rect ComputeEffectiveViewport(Rect viewportRect)
		{
			base.ComputeEffectiveViewport(viewportRect);
			if (viewportRect.IsEmpty)
			{
				return Rect.Empty;
			}
			if (ActualPlotAreaMarginLeft == 0.0 && ActualPlotAreaMarginTop == 0.0 && ActualPlotAreaMarginRight == 0.0 && ActualPlotAreaMarginBottom == 0.0)
			{
				return Rect.Empty;
			}
			if (ActualPlotAreaMarginLeft + ActualPlotAreaMarginRight >= viewportRect.Width || ActualPlotAreaMarginTop + ActualPlotAreaMarginBottom >= viewportRect.Height)
			{
				return Rect.Empty;
			}
			return new Rect(viewportRect.Left + ActualPlotAreaMarginLeft, viewportRect.Top + ActualPlotAreaMarginTop, viewportRect.Width - ActualPlotAreaMarginLeft - ActualPlotAreaMarginRight, viewportRect.Height - ActualPlotAreaMarginTop - ActualPlotAreaMarginBottom);
		}

		internal override Rect GetSafeViewportForInitialZoom()
		{
			Rect viewportRect = ViewportRect;
			_ = base.WindowRect;
			Rect effectiveViewport = base.EffectiveViewport;
			if (effectiveViewport.IsEmpty || viewportRect.IsEmpty)
			{
				return viewportRect;
			}
			if (effectiveViewport.Contains(viewportRect))
			{
				return viewportRect;
			}
			if (viewportRect.Contains(effectiveViewport))
			{
				return effectiveViewport;
			}
			return viewportRect;
		}

		[JAVASuppressWidgetMember]
		[TSSuppressWidgetMember]
		[SwiftSuppressWidgetMember]
		public ChartVisualData ExportVisualData()
		{
			return (ChartVisualData)DataChartVisualDataManager.ExportVisualData(this);
		}

		protected internal override void PrepareAxesForTiledZoom()
		{
			base.PrepareAxesForTiledZoom();
			for (int i = 0; i < Axes.Count; i++)
			{
				Axis axis = Axes[i];
				double extentOverride = 50.0;
				if (!double.IsNaN(axis.LabelPanel.Extent))
				{
					extentOverride = axis.LabelPanel.Extent;
				}
				axis.ExtentOverride = extentOverride;
			}
		}

		protected internal override void ReleaseAxesFromTiledZoom()
		{
			base.ReleaseAxesFromTiledZoom();
			for (int i = 0; i < Axes.Count; i++)
			{
				Axis axis = Axes[i];
				axis.ExtentOverride = double.NaN;
				axis.MustInvalidateLabels = true;
				axis.RenderAxis(animate: false);
			}
		}

		internal List<Axis> FindMatchingAxes(Axis axis)
		{
			List<Axis> list = new List<Axis>();
			foreach (Series item in base.Series)
			{
				Axis matchingAxis = item.GetMatchingAxis(axis);
				if (matchingAxis != null)
				{
					list.Add(matchingAxis);
				}
			}
			return list;
		}
	}
	[WidgetIgnoreDepends("NumericAngleAxis")]
	[WidgetIgnoreDepends("NumericRadiusAxis")]
	[WidgetIgnoreDepends("CategoryAngleAxis")]
	[WidgetIgnoreDepends("RadialAxisLabelPanel")]
	[WidgetIgnoreDepends("AngleAxisLabelPanel")]
	internal class LabelPanelArranger
	{
		public static Rect PreparePanels(List<AxisLabelPanelBase> labelPanels, Rect gridAreaRect)
		{
			foreach (AxisLabelPanelBase labelPanel in labelPanels)
			{
				Axis axis = labelPanel.Axis;
				Axis crossingAxis = axis.CrossingAxis;
				crossingAxis = EnsurePolarCrossing(labelPanel, axis, crossingAxis);
				AxisLabelsLocation axisLabelsLocation = ResolveLabelLocation(labelPanel);
				double num = 0.0;
				double num2 = 0.0;
				double num3 = 0.0;
				if (axis.HasUserExtent())
				{
					labelPanel.View.BindExtentToSettings();
					num3 = labelPanel.Extent;
				}
				else
				{
					num3 = labelPanel.GetDesiredExtent(gridAreaRect);
				}
				num = num3;
				num2 = num3;
				if (labelPanel.Axis.LabelSettings != null && labelPanel.Axis.LabelSettings.Visibility != Visibility.Visible)
				{
					num2 = 0.0;
					num = 0.0;
				}
				if (labelPanel.IsHorizontalPanel())
				{
					switch (axisLabelsLocation)
					{
					case AxisLabelsLocation.OutsideTop:
						gridAreaRect.Y = Math.Max(0.0, gridAreaRect.Top + num2);
						gridAreaRect.Height = Math.Max(0.0, gridAreaRect.Height - num2);
						axis.LabelSettings.ActualLocation = AxisLabelsLocation.OutsideTop;
						break;
					case AxisLabelsLocation.InsideTop:
						if (crossingAxis != null && labelPanel.CrossingValue - gridAreaRect.Top < num2 && labelPanel is HorizontalAxisLabelPanel)
						{
							axis.LabelSettings.ActualLocation = AxisLabelsLocation.InsideBottom;
						}
						else
						{
							axis.LabelSettings.ActualLocation = AxisLabelsLocation.InsideTop;
						}
						break;
					case AxisLabelsLocation.InsideBottom:
						if (crossingAxis != null && gridAreaRect.Bottom - labelPanel.CrossingValue < num2 && labelPanel is HorizontalAxisLabelPanel)
						{
							if (axis.LabelSettings != null)
							{
								axis.LabelSettings.ActualLocation = AxisLabelsLocation.InsideTop;
							}
						}
						else if (axis.LabelSettings != null)
						{
							axis.LabelSettings.ActualLocation = AxisLabelsLocation.InsideBottom;
						}
						break;
					default:
						if (axis.LabelSettings != null)
						{
							axis.LabelSettings.ActualLocation = AxisLabelsLocation.OutsideBottom;
						}
						gridAreaRect.Height = Math.Max(0.0, gridAreaRect.Height - num2);
						break;
					}
				}
				if (labelPanel is VerticalAxisLabelPanel)
				{
					switch (axisLabelsLocation)
					{
					case AxisLabelsLocation.OutsideRight:
						gridAreaRect.Width = Math.Max(0.0, gridAreaRect.Width - num);
						axis.LabelSettings.ActualLocation = AxisLabelsLocation.OutsideRight;
						break;
					case AxisLabelsLocation.InsideLeft:
						if (crossingAxis != null && labelPanel.CrossingValue - gridAreaRect.Left < num)
						{
							axis.LabelSettings.ActualLocation = AxisLabelsLocation.InsideRight;
						}
						else
						{
							axis.LabelSettings.ActualLocation = AxisLabelsLocation.InsideLeft;
						}
						break;
					case AxisLabelsLocation.InsideRight:
						if (crossingAxis != null && gridAreaRect.Right - labelPanel.CrossingValue < num)
						{
							axis.LabelSettings.ActualLocation = AxisLabelsLocation.InsideLeft;
						}
						else
						{
							axis.LabelSettings.ActualLocation = AxisLabelsLocation.InsideRight;
						}
						break;
					default:
						if (axis.LabelSettings != null)
						{
							axis.LabelSettings.ActualLocation = AxisLabelsLocation.OutsideLeft;
						}
						gridAreaRect.X = Math.Max(0.0, gridAreaRect.Left + num);
						gridAreaRect.Width = Math.Max(0.0, gridAreaRect.Width - num);
						break;
					}
				}
				if (labelPanel.Axis.IsAngular && axis.LabelSettings != null)
				{
					axis.LabelSettings.ActualLocation = axisLabelsLocation;
				}
			}
			return gridAreaRect;
		}

		private static Axis EnsurePolarCrossing(AxisLabelPanelBase panel, Axis axis, Axis crossingAxis)
		{
			return axis.ResolveCrossingAxis();
		}

		internal static AxisLabelsLocation ResolveLabelLocation(AxisLabelPanelBase panel)
		{
			if (panel == null)
			{
				return AxisLabelsLocation.OutsideBottom;
			}
			Axis axis = panel.Axis;
			if (axis != null && axis.LabelSettings != null)
			{
				AxisLabelsLocation actualLocation = axis.LabelSettings.ActualLocation;
				if (!panel.ValidLocation(actualLocation))
				{
					return panel.GetDefaultLabelsLocation();
				}
				return actualLocation;
			}
			return panel.GetDefaultLabelsLocation();
		}

		private static void ArrangeLabelPanel(AxisLabelPanelBase panel, LabelPanelsArrangeState arrangeState, Rect gridAreaRect, Action<AxisLabelPanelBase, Rect> setBounds)
		{
			Axis axis = panel.Axis;
			Axis crossingAxis = axis.CrossingAxis;
			crossingAxis = EnsurePolarCrossing(panel, axis, crossingAxis);
			AxisLabelsLocation axisLabelsLocation = ResolveLabelLocation(panel);
			double desiredExtent = panel.GetDesiredExtent(gridAreaRect);
			double num = Math.Max(0.0, desiredExtent);
			double num2 = Math.Max(0.0, desiredExtent);
			if (panel.Axis != null && panel.Axis.LabelSettings != null && panel.Axis.LabelSettings.Visibility == Visibility.Collapsed)
			{
				return;
			}
			switch (axisLabelsLocation)
			{
			case AxisLabelsLocation.OutsideRight:
			{
				arrangeState.Right -= num2;
				arrangeState.InsideRight -= num2;
				Rect arg = new Rect(arrangeState.Right, gridAreaRect.Top, num2, gridAreaRect.Height);
				setBounds(panel, arg);
				break;
			}
			case AxisLabelsLocation.OutsideLeft:
			{
				Rect arg = new Rect(arrangeState.Left, gridAreaRect.Top, num2, gridAreaRect.Height);
				setBounds(panel, arg);
				arrangeState.Left += num2;
				arrangeState.InsideLeft += num2;
				break;
			}
			case AxisLabelsLocation.InsideRight:
			{
				Rect arg;
				if (crossingAxis != null)
				{
					arg = new Rect(arrangeState.Left + panel.CrossingValue, gridAreaRect.Top, num2, gridAreaRect.Height);
				}
				else
				{
					arrangeState.InsideRight -= num2;
					arg = new Rect(arrangeState.InsideRight, gridAreaRect.Top, num2, gridAreaRect.Height);
				}
				setBounds(panel, arg);
				break;
			}
			case AxisLabelsLocation.InsideLeft:
			{
				Rect arg;
				if (crossingAxis != null)
				{
					arg = new Rect(arrangeState.Left + panel.CrossingValue - num2, gridAreaRect.Top, num2, gridAreaRect.Height);
				}
				else
				{
					arg = new Rect(arrangeState.InsideLeft, gridAreaRect.Top, num2, gridAreaRect.Height);
					arrangeState.InsideLeft += num2;
				}
				setBounds(panel, arg);
				break;
			}
			case AxisLabelsLocation.OutsideBottom:
			{
				arrangeState.Bottom -= num;
				arrangeState.InsideBottom -= num;
				Rect arg = new Rect(gridAreaRect.Left, arrangeState.Bottom, gridAreaRect.Width, num);
				setBounds(panel, arg);
				break;
			}
			case AxisLabelsLocation.OutsideTop:
			{
				Rect arg = new Rect(gridAreaRect.Left, arrangeState.Top, gridAreaRect.Width, num);
				setBounds(panel, arg);
				arrangeState.Top += num;
				arrangeState.InsideTop += num;
				break;
			}
			case AxisLabelsLocation.InsideBottom:
			{
				Rect arg;
				if (crossingAxis != null)
				{
					arg = new Rect(gridAreaRect.Left, arrangeState.Top + panel.CrossingValue, gridAreaRect.Width, num);
				}
				else
				{
					arrangeState.InsideBottom -= num;
					arg = new Rect(gridAreaRect.Left, arrangeState.InsideBottom, gridAreaRect.Width, num);
				}
				setBounds(panel, arg);
				break;
			}
			case AxisLabelsLocation.InsideTop:
			{
				Rect arg;
				if (crossingAxis != null)
				{
					arg = new Rect(gridAreaRect.Left, arrangeState.Top + panel.CrossingValue - num, gridAreaRect.Width, num);
				}
				else
				{
					arg = new Rect(gridAreaRect.Left, arrangeState.InsideTop, gridAreaRect.Width, num);
					arrangeState.InsideTop += num;
				}
				setBounds(panel, arg);
				break;
			}
			}
			if (panel.Axis.IsAngular)
			{
				Rect arg = new Rect(gridAreaRect.Left, gridAreaRect.Top, gridAreaRect.Width, gridAreaRect.Height);
				setBounds(panel, arg);
			}
		}

		internal static void ArrangePanels(List<AxisLabelPanelBase> labelPanels, LabelPanelsArrangeState arrangeState, Rect gridAreaRect, Action<AxisLabelPanelBase, Rect> setBounds)
		{
			List<AxisLabelPanelBase> list = new List<AxisLabelPanelBase>();
			List<AxisLabelPanelBase> list2 = new List<AxisLabelPanelBase>();
			foreach (AxisLabelPanelBase labelPanel in labelPanels)
			{
				switch (ResolveLabelLocation(labelPanel))
				{
				case AxisLabelsLocation.OutsideTop:
				case AxisLabelsLocation.OutsideBottom:
				case AxisLabelsLocation.OutsideLeft:
				case AxisLabelsLocation.OutsideRight:
					list2.Add(labelPanel);
					break;
				case AxisLabelsLocation.InsideTop:
				case AxisLabelsLocation.InsideBottom:
				case AxisLabelsLocation.InsideLeft:
				case AxisLabelsLocation.InsideRight:
					list.Add(labelPanel);
					break;
				}
			}
			foreach (AxisLabelPanelBase item in list2)
			{
				ArrangeLabelPanel(item, arrangeState, gridAreaRect, setBounds);
			}
			foreach (AxisLabelPanelBase item2 in list)
			{
				ArrangeLabelPanel(item2, arrangeState, gridAreaRect, setBounds);
			}
		}
	}
	internal class LabelPanelsArrangeState
	{
		internal double Bottom { get; set; }

		internal double Top { get; set; }

		internal double InsideBottom { get; set; }

		internal double InsideTop { get; set; }

		internal double Left { get; set; }

		internal double Right { get; set; }

		internal double InsideLeft { get; set; }

		internal double InsideRight { get; set; }
	}
	[WidgetIgnoreDepends("FragmentBase")]
	[WidgetIgnoreDepends("SplineFragmentBase")]
	[WidgetIgnoreDepends("StackedSeriesBase")]
	[WidgetIgnoreDepends("StackedSeriesManager")]
	[WidgetIgnoreDepends("StackedFragmentSeries")]
	[WidgetIgnoreDepends("Axis")]
	internal class ChartContentManager : DependencyObject
	{
		[Weak]
		private SeriesViewer _owner;

		private Dictionary<ChartContentType, Dictionary<DependencyObject, ContentInfo>> _content = new Dictionary<ChartContentType, Dictionary<DependencyObject, ContentInfo>>();

		private List<Series> _seriesList = new List<Series>();

		private bool _pending;

		private bool _shouldRefreshOnCompositionRender;

		private bool _attached;

		private bool _attachedToOwner;

		private List<Series> SeriesList
		{
			get
			{
				return _seriesList;
			}
			set
			{
				_seriesList = value;
			}
		}

		public bool ShouldRefreshOnCompositionRender
		{
			get
			{
				return _shouldRefreshOnCompositionRender;
			}
			set
			{
				bool shouldRefreshOnCompositionRender = _shouldRefreshOnCompositionRender;
				_shouldRefreshOnCompositionRender = value;
				if (_shouldRefreshOnCompositionRender != shouldRefreshOnCompositionRender)
				{
					if (!_shouldRefreshOnCompositionRender)
					{
						DetachFromCompositionRender();
					}
					else
					{
						AttachToCompositionRender();
					}
				}
			}
		}

		private bool PreviewRefreshPending { get; set; }

		public bool FirstMeasure { get; set; }

		public bool FirstArrange { get; set; }

		public bool FirstTime { get; set; }

		public ChartContentManager(SeriesViewer owner)
		{
			FirstTime = true;
			FirstMeasure = true;
			FirstArrange = true;
			_content.Add(ChartContentType.Series, new Dictionary<DependencyObject, ContentInfo>());
			_content.Add(ChartContentType.Axis, new Dictionary<DependencyObject, ContentInfo>());
			_content.Add(ChartContentType.Background, new Dictionary<DependencyObject, ContentInfo>());
			_owner = owner;
		}

		public ContentInfo Subscribe(ChartContentType type, DependencyObject obj, Action<bool> refresh)
		{
			ContentInfo info = GetInfo(type, obj);
			info.Refresh = refresh;
			return info;
		}

		public void Unsubscribe(ChartContentType type, DependencyObject obj)
		{
			Dictionary<DependencyObject, ContentInfo> dictionary = _content[type];
			if (dictionary.ContainsKey(obj))
			{
				dictionary.Remove(obj);
			}
			if (obj is Series item && SeriesList.Contains(item))
			{
				SeriesList.Remove(item);
			}
		}

		private void DetachFromCompositionRender()
		{
			if (_attached)
			{
				_attached = false;
				CompositionTarget.Rendering -= CompositionTarget_Rendering;
			}
		}

		private void AttachToCompositionRender()
		{
			if (!_attachedToOwner)
			{
				_attachedToOwner = true;
				_owner.Loaded += _owner_Loaded;
				_owner.Unloaded += _owner_Unloaded;
			}
			if (!_attached && _owner.IsLoaded)
			{
				_attached = true;
				CompositionTarget.Rendering += CompositionTarget_Rendering;
			}
		}

		private void _owner_Unloaded(object sender, RoutedEventArgs e)
		{
			DetachFromCompositionRender();
		}

		private void _owner_Loaded(object sender, RoutedEventArgs e)
		{
			if (_shouldRefreshOnCompositionRender)
			{
				AttachToCompositionRender();
			}
		}

		private void CompositionTarget_Rendering(object sender, EventArgs e)
		{
			if (_pending)
			{
				DoRefresh();
			}
		}

		public void MakePending()
		{
			if (!_pending)
			{
				_pending = true;
				if (Utilities.AllowsAsyncOperations(_owner))
				{
					base.Dispatcher.BeginInvoke(new ThreadStart(DoRefresh), null);
				}
				else
				{
					DoRefresh();
				}
			}
		}

		public void Refresh(ChartContentType type, DependencyObject obj, ContentInfo info, bool animate)
		{
			if (!info.IsDirty)
			{
				info.DoAnimation = animate;
			}
			else if (!animate)
			{
				info.DoAnimation = false;
			}
			if (!info.IsDirty)
			{
				info.IsDirty = true;
				MakePending();
			}
		}

		private ContentInfo GetInfo(ChartContentType type, DependencyObject obj)
		{
			Dictionary<DependencyObject, ContentInfo> dictionary = _content[type];
			ContentInfo value = null;
			if (!dictionary.TryGetValue(obj, out value))
			{
				value = new ContentInfo();
				value.Content = obj;
				dictionary.Add(obj, value);
				if (obj is Series series && !SeriesList.Contains(series))
				{
					if (series.IsFragment)
					{
						Series series2 = series.ResolveParentSeries();
						int num = SeriesList.IndexOf(series2) + 1;
						num += series.GetLogicalFragmentIndex();
						if (SeriesList.Count <= num || series2.GetSubSeriesCount() == 0 || num == -1)
						{
							SeriesList.Add(series);
						}
						else
						{
							SeriesList.Insert(num, series);
						}
					}
					else
					{
						SeriesList.Add(series);
					}
				}
			}
			return value;
		}

		public void Force()
		{
			DoRefresh();
		}

		private void DoRefresh()
		{
			if (_owner == null || _content == null || !_pending)
			{
				return;
			}
			_pending = false;
			if (_owner != null)
			{
				_owner.BeforeContentRefresh();
			}
			foreach (ContentInfo item in InOrder())
			{
				item.DoRefresh();
			}
			if (!_pending)
			{
				_owner.RaiseRefreshCompleted();
			}
		}

		[CatchesAll]
		private IEnumerable<ContentInfo> InOrder()
		{
			Dictionary<DependencyObject, ContentInfo> dictionary = _content[ChartContentType.Background];
			foreach (ContentInfo value in dictionary.Values)
			{
				yield return value;
			}
			dictionary = _content[ChartContentType.Axis];
			foreach (ContentInfo value2 in dictionary.Values)
			{
				yield return value2;
			}
			dictionary = _content[ChartContentType.Series];
			List<ContentInfo> list = new List<ContentInfo>();
			foreach (Series series in SeriesList)
			{
				if (!series.IsAnnotationLayer)
				{
					list.Add(dictionary[series]);
				}
			}
			foreach (Series series2 in SeriesList)
			{
				if (series2.IsAnnotationLayer)
				{
					list.Add(dictionary[series2]);
				}
			}
			foreach (ContentInfo item in list)
			{
				yield return item;
			}
		}

		public void EnsureAxesRendered(Size plotSize)
		{
			foreach (ContentInfo value in _content[ChartContentType.Axis].Values)
			{
				((Axis)value.Content).OverrideViewport(plotSize);
			}
			foreach (ContentInfo value2 in _content[ChartContentType.Axis].Values)
			{
				value2.DoRefresh();
			}
			foreach (ContentInfo value3 in _content[ChartContentType.Axis].Values)
			{
				((Axis)value3.Content).UnOverrideViewport();
			}
		}

		internal void ViewportChanged(ChartContentType chartContentType, DependencyObject obj, ContentInfo info, Rect newViewportRect)
		{
			info.Viewport = newViewportRect;
			if (FirstTime && (from i in InOrder()
				where !i.IsViewportValid
				select i).Count() == 0)
			{
				FirstTime = false;
				Force();
			}
		}

		internal void RangeDirty(Axis axis, ContentInfo info)
		{
			if (!info.RangeDirty)
			{
				info.RangeDirty = true;
				MakePending();
			}
		}
	}
	internal class ContentInfo
	{
		public DependencyObject Content { get; set; }

		public Action<bool> Refresh { get; set; }

		public bool DoAnimation { get; set; }

		public bool IsDirty { get; set; }

		public Rect Viewport { get; set; }

		public bool IsViewportValid
		{
			get
			{
				if (Viewport.IsEmpty)
				{
					return false;
				}
				if (Viewport.Width == 0.0 && Viewport.Height == 0.0)
				{
					return false;
				}
				return true;
			}
		}

		public bool RangeDirty { get; set; }

		public void UndirtyRange()
		{
			if (RangeDirty && Content is Axis)
			{
				RangeDirty = false;
				bool isDirty = IsDirty;
				IsDirty = true;
				if (!((Axis)Content).UpdateRange(immediate: true))
				{
					IsDirty = isDirty;
				}
			}
		}

		public void DoRefresh()
		{
			UndirtyRange();
			if (Content is Axis)
			{
				Axis axis = Content as Axis;
				if (axis.CrossingAxis != null)
				{
					Axis crossingAxis = axis.CrossingAxis;
					if (crossingAxis.ContentInfo != null && crossingAxis.ContentInfo.RangeDirty)
					{
						crossingAxis.ContentInfo.UndirtyRange();
					}
				}
			}
			if (IsDirty)
			{
				IsDirty = false;
				Refresh(DoAnimation);
				DoAnimation = false;
			}
		}
	}
	internal enum ChartContentType
	{
		Series,
		Axis,
		Background
	}
	public abstract class Frame
	{
		public abstract void Interpolate(float p, Frame min, Frame max);

		protected static void Interpolate(List<Point> ret, float p, List<Point> min, List<Point> max)
		{
			int count = min.Count;
			int count2 = max.Count;
			int num = Math.Max(count, count2);
			double num2 = 1.0 - (double)p;
			if (ret.Count < num)
			{
				ret.InsertRange(ret.Count, new Point[num - ret.Count]);
			}
			if (ret.Count > num)
			{
				ret.RemoveRange(num, ret.Count - num);
			}
			for (int i = 0; i < Math.Min(count, count2); i++)
			{
				ret[i] = new Point(min[i].X * num2 + max[i].X * (double)p, min[i].Y * num2 + max[i].Y * (double)p);
			}
			if (count < count2)
			{
				Point point = ((count > 0) ? min[count - 1] : new Point(0.0, 0.0));
				for (int j = count; j < count2; j++)
				{
					ret[j] = new Point(point.X * num2 + max[j].X * (double)p, point.Y * num2 + max[j].Y * (double)p);
				}
			}
			if (count > count2)
			{
				Point point2 = ((count2 > 0) ? max[count2 - 1] : new Point(0.0, 0.0));
				for (int k = count2; k < count; k++)
				{
					ret[k] = new Point(min[k].X * num2 + point2.X * (double)p, min[k].Y * num2 + point2.Y * (double)p);
				}
			}
		}

		protected static void InterpolateWithSpeed(List<Point> ret, float p, List<Point> min, List<Point> max, List<double> speedModifiers)
		{
			int count = min.Count;
			int count2 = max.Count;
			int num = Math.Max(count, count2);
			if (ret.Count < num)
			{
				ret.InsertRange(ret.Count, new Point[num - ret.Count]);
			}
			if (ret.Count > num)
			{
				ret.RemoveRange(num, ret.Count - num);
			}
			for (int i = 0; i < Math.Min(count, count2); i++)
			{
				double num2 = (double)p * speedModifiers[i];
				num2 = ((num2 > 1.0) ? 1.0 : num2);
				double num3 = 1.0 - num2;
				ret[i] = new Point(min[i].X * num3 + max[i].X * num2, min[i].Y * num3 + max[i].Y * num2);
			}
			if (count < count2)
			{
				Point point = ((count > 0) ? min[count - 1] : new Point(0.0, 0.0));
				for (int j = count; j < count2; j++)
				{
					double num2 = (double)p * speedModifiers[j];
					num2 = ((num2 > 1.0) ? 1.0 : num2);
					double num3 = 1.0 - num2;
					ret[j] = new Point(point.X * num3 + max[j].X * num2, point.Y * num3 + max[j].Y * num2);
				}
			}
			if (count > count2)
			{
				Point point2 = ((count2 > 0) ? max[count2 - 1] : new Point(0.0, 0.0));
				for (int k = count2; k < count; k++)

		protected static void Interpolate(List<double> ret, float p, List<double> min, List<double> max)
		{
			int count = min.Count;
			int count2 = max.Count;
			int num = Math.Max(count, count2);
			double num2 = 1.0 - (double)p;
			if (ret.Count < num)
			{
				double[] collection = new double[num - ret.Count];
				ret.InsertRange(ret.Count, collection);
			}
			if (ret.Count > num)
			{
				ret.RemoveRange(num, ret.Count - num);
			}
			for (int i = 0; i < Math.Min(count, count2); i++)
			{
				ret[i] = min[i] * num2 + max[i] * (double)p;
			}
			if (count < count2)
			{
				double num3 = ((count > 0) ? min[count - 1] : 0.0);
				for (int j = count; j < count2; j++)
				{
					ret[j] = num3 * num2 + max[j] * (double)p;
				}
			}
			if (count > count2)
			{
				double num4 = ((count2 > 0) ? max[count2 - 1] : 0.0);
				for (int k = count2; k < count; k++)
				{
					ret[k] = min[k] * num2 + num4 * (double)p;
				}
			}
		}

		protected static void InterpolateWithSpeed(List<double> ret, float p, List<double> min, List<double> max, List<double> speedModifiers)

	[Browsable(false)]
	[EditorBrowsable(EditorBrowsableState.Never)]
	public class NumericMarkerManager : MarkerManagerBase
	{
		public bool PopulateColumnValues { get; set; }

		public Func<int, Point> GetColumnValues { get; set; }

		private Func<CollisionAvoidanceType> GetCollisionAvoidanceStrategy { get; set; }

		internal MarkerSeries Series { get; set; }

		public NumericMarkerManager(Func<object, Marker> provideMarkerStrategy, Func<int, object> provideItemStrategy, Action<IDictionary<object, OwnedPoint>> removeUnusedMarkers, Func<Point[]> getItemLocationsStrategy, Func<List<int>> activeMarkerIndexesStrategy)
			: this(provideMarkerStrategy, provideItemStrategy, removeUnusedMarkers, getItemLocationsStrategy, activeMarkerIndexesStrategy, () => CollisionAvoidanceType.None)
		{
		}

		public NumericMarkerManager(Func<object, Marker> provideMarkerStrategy, Func<int, object> provideItemStrategy, Action<IDictionary<object, OwnedPoint>> removeUnusedMarkers, Func<Point[]> getItemLocationsStrategy, Func<List<int>> activeMarkerIndexesStrategy, Func<CollisionAvoidanceType> getCollisionAvoidanceStrategy)
			: base(provideMarkerStrategy, provideItemStrategy, removeUnusedMarkers, getItemLocationsStrategy, activeMarkerIndexesStrategy)
		{
			PopulateColumnValues = false;
			GetColumnValues = (int i) => new Point(0.0, 0.0);
			GetCollisionAvoidanceStrategy = getCollisionAvoidanceStrategy;
		}

		public override void WinnowMarkers(IDictionary<object, OwnedPoint> markers, [SwiftMutableParameter] int maximumMarkers, Rect windowRect, Rect viewportRect, double currentResolution)
		{
			Point[] itemLocations = base.GetItemLocationsStrategy();
			markers.Clear();
			List<int> list = new List<int>();
			maximumMarkers = Math.Max(0, maximumMarkers);
			List<int> list2 = null;
			GetVisibleItems(windowRect, viewportRect, itemLocations, list);
			if (maximumMarkers >= list.Count)
			{
				list2 = list;
			}
			else
			{
				list2 = new List<int>();
				double resolution = Math.Max(8.0, currentResolution);
				Dictionary<int, MarkerManagerBucket> buckets = GetBuckets(viewportRect, list, resolution, itemLocations);
				List<int> list3 = new List<int>(buckets.Keys);
				if (MarkerManagerBase.UseDeterministicSelection)
				{
					list3.Sort();
				}
				SelectMarkerItems(maximumMarkers, buckets, list3, list2);
			}
			AssignMarkers(markers, itemLocations, list2);
		}

		internal static void InvalidateMeasure(DependencyObject v)
		{
			if (v is UIElement uIElement)
			{
				uIElement.InvalidateMeasure();
			}
			int i = 0;
			for (int childrenCount = VisualTreeHelper.GetChildrenCount(v); i < childrenCount; i++)
			{
				InvalidateMeasure(VisualTreeHelper.GetChild(v, i));
			}
		}

		private void AssignMarkers(IDictionary<object, OwnedPoint> markers, Point[] itemLocations, List<int> markerItems)
		{
			if (Series != null && !Series.UseLightweightMarkers && Series.SeriesViewer != null && Series.SeriesViewer.KnownMarkerTemplates != null && !Series.SeriesViewer.KnownMarkerTemplates.Contains(Series.ActualMarkerTemplate) && Series.View != null && Series.MarkerCanvas != null)
			{
				InvalidateMeasure(Series.View.MarkerCanvas);
			}
			for (int i = 0; i < markerItems.Count; i++)
			{
				int num = markerItems[i];
				Point point = itemLocations[num];
				object obj = base.ProvideItemStrategy(num);
				Marker marker = base.ProvideMarkerStrategy(obj);
				marker.CurrentIndex = num;
				if (marker.Content != null)
				{
					((DataContext)marker.Content).Item = obj;
				}
				OwnedPoint ownedPoint = new OwnedPoint();
				if (PopulateColumnValues)
				{
					ownedPoint.ColumnValues = GetColumnValues(num);
				}
				ownedPoint.OwnerItem = obj;
				ownedPoint.Point = new Point(point.X, point.Y);
				if (!markers.ContainsKey(obj))
				{
					markers.Add(obj, ownedPoint);
				}
			}
		}

		public override void Render(IDictionary<object, OwnedPoint> markers, bool lightweight)
		{
			IEnumerable<object> enumerable = markers.Keys;
			if (MarkerManagerBase.UseDeterministicSelection)
			{
				List<object> list = new List<object>(markers.Keys);
				list.Sort(delegate(object o1, object o2)
				{
					OwnedPoint ownedPoint2 = markers[o1];
					OwnedPoint ownedPoint3 = markers[o2];
					double num = Math.Pow(ownedPoint2.Point.X, 2.0) + Math.Pow(ownedPoint2.Point.Y, 2.0);
					double num2 = Math.Pow(ownedPoint3.Point.X, 2.0) + Math.Pow(ownedPoint3.Point.Y, 2.0);
					return ((IComparable)num).CompareTo((object)num2);
				});
				enumerable = list;
			}
			SmartPlacer smartPlacer = null;
			SmartPlaceableWrapper<Marker> smartPlaceableWrapper = null;
			switch (GetCollisionAvoidanceStrategy())
			{
			case CollisionAvoidanceType.Omit:
				smartPlacer = new SmartPlacer
				{
					Overlap = 0.3,
					Fade = 0.0
				};
				smartPlaceableWrapper = new SmartPlaceableWrapper<Marker>();
				smartPlaceableWrapper.NoWiggle = true;
				break;
			case CollisionAvoidanceType.Fade:
				smartPlacer = new SmartPlacer
				{
					Overlap = 0.6,
					Fade = 2.0
				};
				smartPlaceableWrapper = new SmartPlaceableWrapper<Marker>();
				smartPlaceableWrapper.NoWiggle = true;
				break;
			case CollisionAvoidanceType.OmitAndShift:
				smartPlacer = new SmartPlacer
				{
					Overlap = 0.3,
					Fade = 0.0
				};
				smartPlaceableWrapper = new SmartPlaceableWrapper<Marker>();
				break;
			case CollisionAvoidanceType.FadeAndShift:
				smartPlacer = new SmartPlacer
				{
					Overlap = 0.6,
					Fade = 2.0
				};
				smartPlaceableWrapper = new SmartPlaceableWrapper<Marker>();
				break;
			}
			foreach (object item in enumerable)
			{
				OwnedPoint ownedPoint = markers[item];
				Marker marker = base.ProvideMarkerStrategy(ownedPoint.OwnerItem);
				marker.IsHitTestVisible = true;
				if (smartPlacer != null && smartPlaceableWrapper != null)
				{
					smartPlaceableWrapper.Element = marker;
					smartPlaceableWrapper.OriginalLocation = ownedPoint.Point;
					smartPlacer.Place(smartPlaceableWrapper);
					if (smartPlaceableWrapper.Opacity == 0.0)
					{
						smartPlaceableWrapper.SmartPosition = smartPlaceableWrapper.SmartPosition;
						marker.IsHitTestVisible = false;
					}
					ownedPoint.Point = smartPlaceableWrapper.ElementLocationResult;
				}
				else
				{
					marker.Opacity = 1.0;
					marker.Visibility = Visibility.Visible;
				}
				UpdateMarkerPosition(marker, ownedPoint, lightweight);
			}
			base.RemoveUnusedMarkers(markers);
		}

		private void UpdateMarkerPosition(Marker marker, OwnedPoint point, bool lightweight)
		{
			if (!lightweight)
			{
				marker.Measure(new Size(double.PositiveInfinity, double.PositiveInfinity));
			}
			TranslateTransform translateTransform = marker.RenderTransform as TranslateTransform;
			double num = point.Point.X;
			double num2 = point.Point.Y;
			if (!lightweight)
			{
				num -= 0.5 * marker.DesiredSize.Width;
				num2 -= 0.5 * marker.DesiredSize.Height;
			}
			if (translateTransform == null || translateTransform.X != num || translateTransform.Y != num2)
			{
				marker.PositionX = num;
				marker.PositionY = num2;
				marker.RenderTransform = new TranslateTransform
				{
					X = num,
					Y = num2
				};
			}
		}
	}
	internal static class CategoryMarkerManager
	{
		internal static bool _cachedSize;

		internal static double _cachedWidth;

		internal static double _cachedHeight;

		internal static void RasterizeMarkers(MarkerSeries series, List<Point> markerLocations, Pool<Marker> markers, bool lightweight)
		{
			bool flag = series.ShouldDisplayMarkers();
			if (markers != null && flag)
			{
				bool flag2 = false;
				flag2 = series != null && !series.UseLightweightMarkers && series.SeriesViewer != null && series.SeriesViewer.KnownMarkerTemplates != null && series.SeriesViewer.KnownMarkerTemplates.Contains(series.ActualMarkerTemplate);
				_cachedSize = false;
				for (int i = 0; i < markerLocations.Count; i++)
				{
					PositionMarker(markers, i, markerLocations, lightweight, flag2);
				}
				_cachedSize = false;
				markers.Count = markerLocations.Count;
			}
		}

		private static void PositionMarker(Pool<Marker> markers, int i, List<Point> markerLocations, bool lightweight, bool isKnownTemplate)
		{
			double num = 0.0;
			double num2 = 0.0;
			num = markerLocations[i].X;
			num2 = markerLocations[i].Y;
			if (!lightweight)
			{
				if (isKnownTemplate && _cachedSize)
				{
					if (markers[i].DesiredSize.Width == 0.0 || markers[i].DesiredSize.Height == 0.0)
					{
						markers[i].Measure(new Size(double.PositiveInfinity, double.PositiveInfinity));
					}
					num -= 0.5 * _cachedWidth;
					num2 -= 0.5 * _cachedHeight;
				}
				else
				{
					markers[i].Measure(new Size(double.PositiveInfinity, double.PositiveInfinity));
					_cachedSize = true;
					_cachedWidth = markers[i].DesiredSize.Width;
					_cachedHeight = markers[i].DesiredSize.Height;
					num -= 0.5 * markers[i].DesiredSize.Width;
					num2 -= 0.5 * markers[i].DesiredSize.Height;
				}
			}
			if (markers[i].PositionX != num || markers[i].PositionY != num2)
			{
				markers[i].PositionX = num;
				markers[i].PositionY = num2;
				markers[i].RenderTransform = new TranslateTransform
				{
					X = num,
					Y = num2
				};
			}
		}
	}
	public abstract class MarkerManagerBase
	{
		public Func<Point[]> GetItemLocationsStrategy { get; set; }

		public Func<object, Marker> ProvideMarkerStrategy { get; set; }

		public Action<IDictionary<object, OwnedPoint>> RemoveUnusedMarkers { get; set; }

		public Func<int, object> ProvideItemStrategy { get; set; }

		public Func<IList<int>> ActiveMarkerIndexesStrategy { get; set; }

		internal static bool UseDeterministicSelection { get; set; }

		protected MarkerManagerBase(Func<object, Marker> provideMarkerStrategy, Func<int, object> provideItemStrategy, Action<IDictionary<object, OwnedPoint>> removeUnusedMarkers, Func<Point[]> getItemLocationsStrategy, Func<List<int>> activeMarkerIndexesStrategy)
		{
			ProvideMarkerStrategy = provideMarkerStrategy;
			ProvideItemStrategy = provideItemStrategy;
			RemoveUnusedMarkers = removeUnusedMarkers;
			GetItemLocationsStrategy = getItemLocationsStrategy;
			ActiveMarkerIndexesStrategy = activeMarkerIndexesStrategy;
		}

		public abstract void WinnowMarkers(IDictionary<object, OwnedPoint> markers, int maximumMarkers, Rect windowRect, Rect viewportRect, double currentResolution);

		public abstract void Render(IDictionary<object, OwnedPoint> markers, bool lightweight);

		protected virtual List<int> ActiveFirstKeys(Dictionary<int, MarkerManagerBucket> buckets, List<int> keys)
		{
			List<int> list = new List<int>();
			List<int> list2 = new List<int>();
			foreach (int key in keys)
			{
				if (buckets[key].PriorityItems.Count > 0)
				{
					list.Add(key);
				}
				else
				{
					list2.Add(key);
				}
			}
			List<int> list3 = new List<int>();
			list3.AddRange(list);
			list3.AddRange(list2);
			return list3;
		}

		protected virtual void SelectMarkerItems([SwiftMutableParameter] int numToSelect, Dictionary<int, MarkerManagerBucket> buckets, [SwiftMutableParameter] List<int> keys, List<int> markerItems)
		{
			while (numToSelect > 0)
			{
				if (numToSelect < keys.Count)
				{
					if (!UseDeterministicSelection)
					{
						keys.Shuffle();
					}
					keys = ActiveFirstKeys(buckets, keys);
					int num = numToSelect;
					for (int i = 0; i < num; i++)
					{
						int index = i;
						MarkerManagerBucket markerManagerBucket = buckets[keys[index]];
						bool wasPriority;
						int item = markerManagerBucket.GetItem(out wasPriority);
						markerItems.Add(item);
						numToSelect--;
						if (markerManagerBucket.IsEmpty)
						{
							buckets.Remove(keys[index]);
						}
					}
					continue;
				}
				foreach (int key in keys)
				{
					MarkerManagerBucket markerManagerBucket2 = buckets[key];
					bool wasPriority2;
					int item2 = markerManagerBucket2.GetItem(out wasPriority2);
					markerItems.Add(item2);
					numToSelect--;
					if (markerManagerBucket2.IsEmpty)
					{
						buckets.Remove(key);
					}
				}
				keys = new List<int>(buckets.Keys);
			}
		}

		protected virtual void GetVisibleItems(Rect windowRect, Rect viewportRect, IList<Point> itemLocations, List<int> visibleItems)
		{
			double left = viewportRect.Left;
			double right = viewportRect.Right;
			double top = viewportRect.Top;
			double bottom = viewportRect.Bottom;
			if (windowRect.IsEmpty || viewportRect.IsEmpty)
			{
				return;
			}
			for (int i = 0; i < itemLocations.Count; i++)
			{
				double x = itemLocations[i].X;
				if (!double.IsNaN(x))
				{
					double y = itemLocations[i].Y;
					if (!double.IsNaN(y) && !(x < left) && !(x > right) && !(y < top) && !(y > bottom))
					{
						visibleItems.Add(i);
					}
				}
			}
		}

		protected virtual Dictionary<int, MarkerManagerBucket> GetBuckets(Rect viewportRect, List<int> visibleItems, double resolution, IList<Point> itemLocations)
		{
			bool[] array = new bool[itemLocations.Count];
			foreach (int item in ActiveMarkerIndexesStrategy())
			{
				if (item != -1)
				{
					array[item] = true;
				}
			}
			int num = (int)Math.Floor(viewportRect.Width / resolution);
			Dictionary<int, MarkerManagerBucket> dictionary = new Dictionary<int, MarkerManagerBucket>();
			foreach (int visibleItem in visibleItems)
			{
				double x = itemLocations[visibleItem].X;
				int num2 = (int)Math.Floor(itemLocations[visibleItem].Y / resolution);
				int num3 = (int)Math.Floor(x / resolution);
				int key = num2 * num + num3;
				if (!dictionary.TryGetValue(key, out var value))
				{
					value = new MarkerManagerBucket();
					dictionary.Add(key, value);
				}
				if (array[visibleItem])
				{
					value.PriorityItems.Add(visibleItem);
				}
				else
				{
					value.Items.Add(visibleItem);
				}
			}
			return dictionary;
		}
	}
	[Browsable(false)]
	[EditorBrowsable(EditorBrowsableState.Never)]
	public class MarkerManagerBucket
	{
		private List<int> _items;

		private List<int> _priorityItems;

		public List<int> Items
		{
			get
			{
				if (_items == null)
				{
					_items = new List<int>();
				}
				return _items;
			}
		}

		public List<int> PriorityItems
		{
			get
			{
				if (_priorityItems == null)
				{
					_priorityItems = new List<int>();
				}
				return _priorityItems;
			}
		}

		public bool IsEmpty
		{
			get
			{
				if (Items.Count == 0)
				{
					return PriorityItems.Count == 0;
				}
				return false;
			}
		}

		public int GetItem(out bool wasPriority)
		{
			if (PriorityItems.Count > 0)
			{
				int result = PriorityItems[PriorityItems.Count - 1];
				PriorityItems.RemoveAt(PriorityItems.Count - 1);
				wasPriority = true;
				return result;
			}
			int result2 = Items[Items.Count - 1];
			Items.RemoveAt(Items.Count - 1);
			wasPriority = false;
			return result2;
		}
	}

		public override Thickness ResolveDesiredAutoMargin()
		{
			if (MarkerType != MarkerType.None && MarkerType != MarkerType.Hidden)
			{
				Size fullMarkerSize = MarkerView.GetFullMarkerSize();
				double num = fullMarkerSize.Width / 2.0 + MarkerThickness / 2.0;
				double num2 = fullMarkerSize.Height / 2.0 + MarkerThickness / 2.0;
				return new Thickness(num, num2, num, num2);
			}
			return new Thickness(0.0, 0.0, 0.0, 0.0);
		}

		protected internal virtual MarkerOutlineMode ResolveMarkerOutlineMode()

				return MarkerOutlineMode.Normal;
