		protected internal virtual bool ShouldDisplayMarkers()
		{
			if (CachedActualMarkerTemplate != null)
			{
				if (MarkerType == MarkerType.None || MarkerType == MarkerType.Unset)
				{
					return MarkerTemplate != null;
				}
				return true;
			}
			return false;
		}

		protected override void OnIndexChanged()
		{
			base.OnIndexChanged();
			CachedMarkerOutlineMode = ResolveMarkerOutlineMode();
			CachedMarkerFillMode = ResolveMarkerFillMode();
		}

		protected override void PropertyUpdatedOverride(object sender, string propertyName, object oldValue, object newValue)
		{
			base.PropertyUpdatedOverride(sender, propertyName, oldValue, newValue);
			switch (propertyName)
			{
			case "MarkerBrush":
			case "MarkerType":
			case "MarkerOutline":
			case "MarkerTemplate":
			case "MarkerThickness":
				UpdateIndexedProperties();
				OnVisualPropertiesChanged();
				break;
			case "MarkerOutlineMode":
				CachedMarkerOutlineMode = ResolveMarkerOutlineMode();
				UpdateIndexedProperties();
				OnVisualPropertiesChanged();
				break;
			case "MarkerFillMode":
				CachedMarkerFillMode = ResolveMarkerFillMode();
				UpdateIndexedProperties();
				OnVisualPropertiesChanged();
				break;
			case "ActualMarkerTemplate":
				CachedActualMarkerTemplate = (DataTemplate)newValue;
				if (oldValue == NullMarkerTemplate || newValue == NullMarkerTemplate || oldValue == null || newValue != null)
				{
					MarkerView.DoUpdateMarkerTemplates();
					if (base.ThumbnailView is MarkerSeriesView markerSeriesView)
					{
						markerSeriesView.DoUpdateMarkerTemplates();
					}
					RenderSeries(animate: false);
				}
				NotifyThumbnailAppearanceChanged();
				break;
			case "UseLightweightMarkers":
				MarkerView.SetUseLightweightMode(UseLightweightMarkers);
				RenderSeries(animate: false);
				break;
			case "ActualMarkerBrush":
			case "ActualMarkerOutline":
				if (HasOnlyMarkers)
				{
					base.ActualLegendItemBadgeBrush = GetActualMarkerBrush();
					base.ActualLegendItemBadgeOutline = GetActualMarkerOutlineBrush();
				}
				break;
			}
		}

		[EditorBrowsable(EditorBrowsableState.Never)]
		public static string GetMarkerTemplatePropertyName(MarkerType markerType)
		{
			switch (markerType)
			{
			case MarkerType.Circle:
			case MarkerType.Hidden:
				return "CircleMarkerTemplate";
			case MarkerType.Triangle:
				return "TriangleMarkerTemplate";
			case MarkerType.Pyramid:
				return "PyramidMarkerTemplate";
			case MarkerType.Square:
				return "SquareMarkerTemplate";
			case MarkerType.Diamond:
				return "DiamondMarkerTemplate";
			case MarkerType.Pentagon:
				return "PentagonMarkerTemplate";
			case MarkerType.Hexagon:
				return "HexagonMarkerTemplate";
			case MarkerType.Tetragram:
				return "TetragramMarkerTemplate";
			case MarkerType.Pentagram:
				return "PentagramMarkerTemplate";
			case MarkerType.Hexagram:
				return "HexagramMarkerTemplate";
			default:
				return null;
			}
		}

		[EditorBrowsable(EditorBrowsableState.Never)]
		public static MarkerType ResolveMarkerType(Series series, MarkerType seriesMarkerType)
		{
			MarkerType result = MarkerType.None;
			MarkerAutomaticBehavior markerAutomaticBehavior = MarkerAutomaticBehavior.CircleSmart;
			if (series != null && series.SeriesViewer != null)
			{
				markerAutomaticBehavior = series.SeriesViewer.MarkerAutomaticBehavior;
			}
			if (series == null || series.SeriesViewer == null)
			{
				return MarkerType.None;
			}
			if (seriesMarkerType != MarkerType.Automatic && seriesMarkerType != MarkerType.Unset)
			{
				result = seriesMarkerType;
			}
			else
			{
				switch (markerAutomaticBehavior)
				{
				case MarkerAutomaticBehavior.Circle:
					result = MarkerType.Circle;
					break;
				case MarkerAutomaticBehavior.Triangle:
					result = MarkerType.Triangle;
					break;
				case MarkerAutomaticBehavior.Pentagon:
					result = MarkerType.Pentagon;
					break;
				case MarkerAutomaticBehavior.Tetragram:
					result = MarkerType.Tetragram;
					break;
				case MarkerAutomaticBehavior.Diamond:
					result = MarkerType.Diamond;
					break;
				case MarkerAutomaticBehavior.Square:
					result = MarkerType.Square;
					break;
				case MarkerAutomaticBehavior.Hexagon:
					result = MarkerType.Hexagon;
					break;
				case MarkerAutomaticBehavior.Pentagram:
					result = MarkerType.Pentagram;
					break;
				case MarkerAutomaticBehavior.Pyramid:
					result = MarkerType.Pyramid;
					break;
				case MarkerAutomaticBehavior.Hexagram:
					result = MarkerType.Hexagram;
					break;
				case MarkerAutomaticBehavior.None:
					result = MarkerType.None;
					break;
				case MarkerAutomaticBehavior.CircleSmart:
					result = (series.IsMarkerlessDisplayPreferred ? MarkerType.None : MarkerType.Circle);
					break;
				case MarkerAutomaticBehavior.SmartIndexed:
				case MarkerAutomaticBehavior.Indexed:
				{
					if (markerAutomaticBehavior == MarkerAutomaticBehavior.SmartIndexed && series.IsMarkerlessDisplayPreferred)
					{
						return MarkerType.None;
					}
					if (series.Index < 0)
					{
						result = MarkerType.None;
						break;
					}
					MarkerType[] array = new MarkerType[10]
					{
						MarkerType.Circle,
						MarkerType.Triangle,
						MarkerType.Pentagon,
						MarkerType.Tetragram,
						MarkerType.Diamond,
						MarkerType.Square,
						MarkerType.Hexagon,
						MarkerType.Pentagram,
						MarkerType.Pyramid,
						MarkerType.Hexagram
					};
					result = array[series.Index % array.Length];
					break;
				}
				}
			}
			return result;
		}

		protected override void UpdateIndexedProperties()
		{
			base.UpdateIndexedProperties();
			if (base.Index < 0)
			{
				return;
			}
			if (MarkerView.HasCustomMarkerTemplate())
			{
				MarkerView.ClearActualMarkerTemplate();
				MarkerView.BindActualToCustomMarkerTemplate();
			}
			else
			{
				string markerTemplatePropertyName = GetMarkerTemplatePropertyName(ResolveMarkerType(this, MarkerType));
				if (markerTemplatePropertyName == null)
				{
					ActualMarkerTemplate = NullMarkerTemplate;
				}
				else
				{
					MarkerView.BindActualToMarkerTemplate(markerTemplatePropertyName);
				}
			}
			if (MarkerBrush != null && MarkerType != MarkerType.Hidden)
			{
				MarkerView.ClearActualMarkerBrush();
				MarkerView.BindActualToMarkerBrush();
			}
			else if (MarkerType == MarkerType.Hidden)
			{
				ActualMarkerBrush = base.View.GetTransparentBrush();
			}
			else if (CachedMarkerFillMode != MarkerFillMode.MatchMarkerOutline)
			{
				if (base.SeriesViewer != null)
				{
					Brush brush = base.SeriesViewer.GetMarkerBrushByIndex(base.Index);
					if (!double.IsNaN(base.ActualMarkerFillOpacity) && base.ActualMarkerFillOpacity != 1.0)
					{
						brush = brush.ModifyOpacity(base.ActualMarkerFillOpacity);
						if (base.ShouldFreezeBrushesCached && brush.CanFreeze)
						{
							brush.Freeze();
						}
					}
					ActualMarkerBrush = brush;
				}
				else
				{
					ActualMarkerBrush = null;
				}
			}
			if (MarkerOutline != null)
			{
				MarkerView.ClearActualMarkerOutline();
				MarkerView.BindActualToMarkerOutline();
			}
			else if (MarkerType == MarkerType.Hidden)
			{
				ActualMarkerOutline = base.View.GetTransparentBrush();
			}
			else if (CachedMarkerOutlineMode == MarkerOutlineMode.MatchMarkerBrush)
			{
				ActualMarkerOutline = ActualMarkerBrush;
			}
			else
			{
				ActualMarkerOutline = ((base.SeriesViewer == null) ? null : base.SeriesViewer.GetMarkerOutlineByIndex(base.Index));
			}
			if (CachedMarkerFillMode != MarkerFillMode.MatchMarkerOutline || MarkerBrush != null || MarkerType == MarkerType.Hidden)
			{
				return;
			}
			if (ActualMarkerOutline != null)
			{
				Brush brush2 = ActualMarkerOutline;
				if (!double.IsNaN(base.ActualMarkerFillOpacity) && base.ActualMarkerFillOpacity != 1.0)
				{
					brush2 = brush2.ModifyOpacity(base.ActualMarkerFillOpacity);
					if (base.ShouldFreezeBrushesCached && brush2.CanFreeze)
					{
						brush2.Freeze();
					}
				}
				ActualMarkerBrush = brush2;
			}
			else
			{
				ActualMarkerBrush = null;
			}
		}

		protected override void ExportVisualDataOverride(object svd)
		{
			base.ExportVisualDataOverride(svd);
			base.SeriesVisualDataManager.ExportMarkerVisualData(this, svd);
		}

		protected virtual bool TestMarkersOver(Point position, bool isFinger)
		{
			if (HasMarkers && ShouldDisplayMarkers())
			{
				Rect seriesValueMarkerBoundingBoxFromSeriesPixel = GetSeriesValueMarkerBoundingBoxFromSeriesPixel(position);
				if (seriesValueMarkerBoundingBoxFromSeriesPixel.IsEmpty)
				{
					return false;
				}
				if (seriesValueMarkerBoundingBoxFromSeriesPixel.Inflate(GetHitTestAllowance(isFinger)).Contains(position))
				{
					return true;
				}
			}
			return false;
		}
	}
	internal class PathRenderer
	{
		public IFlattener Flattener { get; set; }

		public UnknownValuePlotting UnknownValuePlotting { get; set; }

		public PathRenderer()
		{
			UnknownValuePlotting = UnknownValuePlotting.DontPlot;
		}

		public PathRenderer(IFlattener flattener)
		{
			Flattener = flattener;
		}

		public void Render(Path path, IList<Point> points, double resolution)
		{
			IList<IList<Point>> segments = NaNSegmenter.Segments(points, UnknownValuePlotting);
			IEnumerable<PathFigure> figures = GetFigures(segments, resolution);
			PathGeometry pathGeometry = new PathGeometry();
			foreach (PathFigure item in figures)
			{
				pathGeometry.Figures.Add(item);
			}
			path.Data = pathGeometry;
		}

		private IEnumerable<PathFigure> GetFigures(IList<IList<Point>> segments, double resolution)
		{
			for (int i = 0; i < segments.Count; i++)
			{
				IList<Point> list = segments[i];
				if (list.Count >= 2)
				{
					PathFigure pathFigure = new PathFigure();
					Point startPoint = list[0];
					pathFigure.StartPoint = startPoint;
					PolyLineSegment value = CreatePolylineSegment(list, resolution);
					pathFigure.Segments.Add(value);
					yield return pathFigure;
				}
			}
		}

		private PolyLineSegment CreatePolylineSegment(IList<Point> segment, double resolution)
		{
			PolyLineSegment polyLineSegment = new PolyLineSegment();
			if (Flattener == null)
			{
				for (int i = 1; i < segment.Count; i++)
				{
					Point value = segment[i];
					polyLineSegment.Points.Add(value);
				}
			}
			else
			{
				IList<Point> list = Flattener.Flatten(segment, resolution);
				for (int j = 1; j < list.Count; j++)
				{
					Point value2 = list[j];
					polyLineSegment.Points.Add(value2);
				}
			}
			return polyLineSegment;
		}
	}
	[WidgetIncludeDepends("System.Collections.ObjectModel.ReadOnlyCollection`1")]
	internal class NaNSegmenter
	{
		public static IList<IList<Point>> Segments(IList<Point> points, UnknownValuePlotting mode)
		{
			IList<IList<Point>> list = new List<IList<Point>>();
			IEnumerator<Point> enumerator = points.GetEnumerator();
			IList<Point> list2 = new List<Point>();
			bool flag = true;
			while (enumerator.MoveNext())
			{
				if (ShouldSkip(enumerator.Current))
				{
					if (!flag && mode == UnknownValuePlotting.DontPlot)
					{
						flag = true;
						IList<Point> list3 = list2;
						list2 = new List<Point>();
						list.Add(new ReadOnlyCollection<Point>(list3));
					}
				}
				else
				{
					flag = false;
					list2.Add(enumerator.Current);
				}
			}
			list.Add(new ReadOnlyCollection<Point>(list2));
			return list;
		}

		public static bool ShouldSkip(Point p)
		{
			if (!double.IsNaN(p.X) && !double.IsNaN(p.Y) && !double.IsInfinity(p.X))
			{
				return double.IsInfinity(p.Y);
			}
			return true;
		}

		public static bool ShouldTake(Point p)
		{
			return !ShouldSkip(p);
		}
	}
	internal interface IFlattener
	{
		IList<Point> Flatten(IList<Point> points, double resolution);
	}
	public class DefaultFlattener : IFlattener
	{
		private const int FlattenerChunking = 512;

		private IList<int> FlattenHelper(IList<int> result, Func<int, double> X, Func<int, double> Y, int b, int e, double E)
		{
			List<int> result2 = new List<int>();
			int num = b;
			for (int num2 = e - num + 1; num2 > 0; num2 = e - num + 1)
			{
				if (num2 <= 512)
				{
					Flattener.Flatten(result2, X, Y, num, e, E);
					num = e + 1;
				}
				else
				{
					int num3 = num + 512 - 1;
					Flattener.Flatten(result2, X, Y, num, num3, E);
					num = num3 + 1;
				}
			}
			return result2;
		}

		private List<int> FastFlattenHelper(double[] X, double[] Y, int b, int e, double E)
		{
			List<int> result = new List<int>();
			int num = b;
			for (int num2 = e - num + 1; num2 > 0; num2 = e - num + 1)
			{
				if (num2 <= 512)
				{
					FastFlattener.FastFlatten(result, X, Y, num, e, E);
					num = e + 1;
				}
				else
				{
					int num3 = num + 512 - 1;
					FastFlattener.FastFlatten(result, X, Y, num, num3, E);
					num = num3 + 1;
				}
			}
			return result;
		}

		public IList<Point> Flatten(IList<Point> points, double resolution)
		{
			Func<int, double> x = (int i) => GetX(points, i);
			Func<int, double> y = (int i) => GetY(points, i);
			return GetFlattened(points, resolution, x, y);
		}

		public List<Point> FastFlatten(double[] x, double[] y, int count, double resolution)
		{
			return GetFastFlattened(x, y, count, resolution);
		}

		public IList<Point> GetFlattened(IList<Point> pointsList, double resolution, Func<int, double> x, Func<int, double> y)
		{
			IList<int> indexes = FlattenHelper(new List<int>(), x, y, 0, pointsList.Count - 1, resolution);
			return new RearrangedList<Point>(pointsList, indexes);
		}

		public List<Point> GetFastFlattened(double[] x, double[] y, int count, double resolution)
		{
			List<int> list = FastFlattenHelper(x, y, 0, count - 1, resolution);
			List<Point> list2 = new List<Point>();
			for (int i = 0; i < list.Count; i++)
			{
				list2.Add(new Point(x[list[i]], y[list[i]]));
			}
			return list2;
		}

		private double GetX(IList<Point> list, int i)
		{
			return list[i].X;
		}

		private double GetY(IList<Point> list, int i)
		{
			return list[i].Y;
		}
	}
	internal class SeriesRenderingArguments
	{
		public Rect Viewport { get; set; }

		public Rect Window { get; set; }

		public TimeSpan TransitionDuration { get; set; }

		public bool Animate { get; set; }

		public FrameworkElement Container { get; set; }

		public bool SkipPrepare { get; set; }

		public SeriesRenderingArguments(Series series, Rect viewport, Rect window, bool animate, bool skipPrepare)
		{
			TransitionDuration = series.TransitionDuration;
			Container = series;
			Viewport = viewport;
			Window = window;
			Animate = animate;
			SkipPrepare = skipPrepare;
		}
	}
	internal class SeriesRenderer<TFrame, TView>
	{
		internal Action<TFrame, TView> PrepareFrame { get; set; }

		internal Action<TFrame, TView> RenderFrame { get; set; }

		internal Action<TFrame> CalculateBuckets { get; set; }

		internal Action StartupAnimation { get; set; }

		internal Func<bool> AnimationActive { get; set; }

		internal Action CheckFlush { get; set; }

		public SeriesRenderer(Action<TFrame, TView> prepare, Action<TFrame, TView> render, Func<bool> animationActive, Action startupAnimation, Action checkFlush)
		{
			PrepareFrame = prepare;
			RenderFrame = render;
			CalculateBuckets = delegate
			{
			};
			AnimationActive = animationActive;
			StartupAnimation = startupAnimation;
			CheckFlush = checkFlush;
		}

		public SeriesRenderer(Action<TFrame, TView> prepare, Action<TFrame, TView> render, Func<bool> animationActive, Action startupAnimation, Action checkFlush, Action<TFrame> calculateBuckets)
		{
			PrepareFrame = prepare;
			RenderFrame = render;
			CalculateBuckets = calculateBuckets;
			AnimationActive = animationActive;
			StartupAnimation = startupAnimation;
			CheckFlush = checkFlush;
		}

		public void Render(SeriesRenderingArguments args, ref TFrame previousFrame, ref TFrame currentFrame, ref TFrame transitionFrame, TView view)
		{
			int num = 0;
			num = (int)args.TransitionDuration.TotalMilliseconds;
			if (args.Animate && num > 0 && !args.SkipPrepare)
			{
				TFrame val = previousFrame;
				if (AnimationActive())
				{
					CheckFlush();
					previousFrame = transitionFrame;
					transitionFrame = val;
				}
				else
				{
					previousFrame = currentFrame;
					currentFrame = val;
				}
				CalculateBuckets(currentFrame);
				PrepareFrame(currentFrame, view);
				StartupAnimation();
			}
			else
			{
				if (!args.SkipPrepare)
				{
					CalculateBuckets(currentFrame);
					PrepareFrame(currentFrame, view);
				}
				RenderFrame(currentFrame, view);
			}
		}
	}
	public class SyncLink : FrameworkElement, INotifyPropertyChanged, IFastItemsSourceProvider
	{
		private Dictionary<IEnumerable, FastItemsSourceReference> fastItemsSources = new Dictionary<IEnumerable, FastItemsSourceReference>();

		public string SyncChannel { get; set; }

		public static Func<IEnumerable, IFastItemsSource> FastItemsSourceFactory { get; set; }

		internal Rect DefaultWindowRect { get; private set; }

		[EditorBrowsable(EditorBrowsableState.Never)]
		public IList<SeriesViewer> Charts => ChartsInternal;

		internal ChartCollection ChartsInternal { get; set; }

		public event PropertyChangedEventHandler PropertyChanged;

		public event PropertyUpdatedEventHandler PropertyUpdated;

		public SyncLink()
		{
			PropertyUpdated += delegate(object o, PropertyUpdatedEventArgs e)
			{
				PropertyUpdatedOverride(o, e.PropertyName, e.OldValue, e.NewValue);
			};
			ChartsInternal = new ChartCollection();
			ChartsInternal.CollectionChanged += Charts_CollectionChanged;
			DefaultWindowRect = new Rect(0.0, 0.0, 1.0, 1.0);
		}

		protected virtual void PropertyUpdatedOverride(object sender, string propertyName, object oldValue, object newValue)
		{
		}

		IFastItemsSource IFastItemsSourceProvider.ReleaseFastItemsSource(IEnumerable itemsSource)
		{
			if (itemsSource != null)
			{
				FastItemsSourceReference value = null;
				if (fastItemsSources.TryGetValue(itemsSource, out value))
				{
					value.References--;
					if (value.References == 0)
					{
						fastItemsSources.Remove(itemsSource);
					}
				}
			}
			return null;
		}

		private static IFastItemsSource CreateDefaultFastItemsSource(IEnumerable data)
		{
			return new FastItemsSource
			{
				ItemsSource = data
			};
		}

		IFastItemsSource IFastItemsSourceProvider.GetFastItemsSource(IEnumerable target)
		{
			if (FastItemsSourceFactory == null)
			{
				FastItemsSourceFactory = CreateDefaultFastItemsSource;
			}
			IFastItemsSource result = null;
			if (target != null)
			{
				FastItemsSourceReference value = null;
				if (!fastItemsSources.TryGetValue(target, out value))
				{
					result = FastItemsSourceFactory(target);
					value = new FastItemsSourceReference(result);
					fastItemsSources.Add(target, value);
				}
				value.References++;
				result = value.FastItemsSource;
			}
			return result;
		}

		public IFastItemsSource PeekItemsSource(IEnumerable itemsSource)
		{
			IFastItemsSource result = null;
			if (itemsSource != null)
			{
				FastItemsSourceReference value = null;
				if (!fastItemsSources.TryGetValue(itemsSource, out value))
				{
					return null;
				}
				result = value.FastItemsSource;
			}
			return result;
		}

		private Rect SynchroniseRect(SeriesViewer sender, SeriesViewer chart, Rect rect)
		{
			return SynchroniseRect(sender, chart, rect, force: false);
		}

		private Rect SynchroniseRect(SeriesViewer sender, SeriesViewer chart, [SwiftMutableParameter] Rect rect, bool force)
		{
			if (!rect.IsEmpty)
			{
				rect = new Rect(rect.Left, rect.Top, rect.Width, rect.Height);
				double windowRectMinWidth = sender.WindowRectMinWidth;
				if (chart == sender)
				{
					if (!force)
					{
						if (!chart.IsZoomingHorizontallyEnabled())
						{
							rect.X = chart.WindowRect.X;
							rect.Width = chart.WindowRect.Width;
						}
						if (!chart.IsZoomingVerticallyEnabled())
						{
							rect.Y = chart.WindowRect.Y;
							rect.Height = chart.WindowRect.Height;
						}
					}
				}
				else
				{
					SyncSettings syncSettings = SyncManager.GetSyncSettings(chart);
					if (syncSettings == null || !syncSettings.SynchronizeHorizontally)
					{
						rect.X = chart.WindowRect.X;
						rect.Width = chart.WindowRect.Width;
					}
					if (syncSettings == null || !syncSettings.SynchronizeVertically)
					{
						rect.Y = chart.WindowRect.Y;
						rect.Height = chart.WindowRect.Height;
					}
				}
				double num = 0.5 * (rect.Left + rect.Right);
				double num2 = 0.5 * (rect.Top + rect.Bottom);
				double width = rect.Width;
				double height = rect.Height;
				double width2 = MathUtil.Clamp(rect.Width, windowRectMinWidth, 1.0);
				double height2 = MathUtil.Clamp(rect.Height, windowRectMinWidth, 1.0);
				bool flag = false;
				if (sender.UseFixedAspectZoom() && !sender.ViewportRect.IsEmpty)
				{
					Rect viewportRect = sender.ViewportRect;
					double num3 = viewportRect.Width / viewportRect.Height;
					double num4 = width2 * viewportRect.Width;
					double num5 = height2 * viewportRect.Height;
					if (num4 / num5 != num3)
					{
						if (num5 * num3 > num4)
						{
							num4 = num5 * num3;
							width2 = num4 / viewportRect.Width;
						}
						else
						{
							num5 = num4 / num3;
							height2 = num5 / viewportRect.Height;
						}
					}
				}
				else if (sender.EffectiveIsSquare())
				{
					bool widthChanging = false;
					bool heightChanging = false;
					if (Math.Abs(width2 - sender.ActualWindowRect.Width) > windowRectMinWidth)
					{
						widthChanging = true;
					}
					if (Math.Abs(height2 - sender.ActualWindowRect.Height) > windowRectMinWidth)
					{
						heightChanging = true;
					}
					sender.MatchRatio(ref width2, ref height2, widthChanging, heightChanging);
					width2 = MathUtil.Clamp(width2, windowRectMinWidth, 1.0);
					height2 = MathUtil.Clamp(height2, windowRectMinWidth, 1.0);
				}
				else if (chart.ShouldSyncWithVerticalRange && rect.Width < 1.0)
				{
					double num6 = double.MaxValue;
					double num7 = double.MinValue;
					double num8 = rect.Left;
					double num9 = rect.Right;
					double num10 = rect.Top;
					double num11 = rect.Bottom;
					double width3 = rect.Width;
					double height3 = rect.Height;
					if (chart.CachedZoomCoercionMode == ZoomCoercionMode.AxisConstrained)
					{
						if (num8 < 0.0)
						{
							num8 = 0.0;
							num9 = num8 + width3;
						}
						if (num9 > 1.0)
						{
							num9 = 1.0;
							num8 = num9 - width3;
						}
						if (num10 < 0.0)
						{
							num10 = 0.0;
							num11 = num10 + height3;
						}
						if (num11 > 1.0)
						{
							num11 = 1.0;
							num10 = num11 - height3;
						}
					}
					Rect forWindow = new Rect(num8, num10, num9 - num8, num11 - num10);
					for (int i = 0; i < chart.Series.Count; i++)
					{
						Series series = chart.Series[i];
						if (series.IsAnnotationLayer)
						{
							continue;
						}
						Axis[] axes = series.GetAxes();
						Axis axis = null;
						for (int j = 0; j < axes.Length; j++)
						{
							if (axes[j].IsVertical)
							{
								axis = axes[j];
							}
						}
						if (axis == null)
						{
							continue;
						}
						Rect rect2 = new Rect(0.0, 0.0, 1.0, 1.0);
						ScalerParams scalerParams = new ScalerParams(rect2, rect2, axis.IsInverted, chart.GetScaledEffectiveViewport(rect2, chart.ViewportRect, chart.EffectiveViewport));
						scalerParams.ReferenceValue = series.GetReferenceValue();
						AxisRange visibleRange = series.GetVisibleRange(forWindow);
						if (visibleRange != null && visibleRange.Minimum != double.MaxValue && !double.IsNaN(visibleRange.Minimum))
						{
							double num12 = axis.GetScaledValue(visibleRange.Minimum, scalerParams);
							double num13 = axis.GetScaledValue(visibleRange.Maximum, scalerParams);
							if (axis.IsInverted)
							{
								double num14 = num12;
								num12 = num13;
								num13 = num14;
							}
							num7 = Math.Max(num7, num12);
							num6 = Math.Min(num6, num13);
							if (series.CachedVisibleRangeMode == SeriesVisibleRangeMode.IncludeReferenceValue && axis.IsNumeric)
							{
								double referenceValue = ((NumericAxisBase)axis).ReferenceValue;
								referenceValue = axis.ClampValue(referenceValue, scalerParams);
								double scaledValue = axis.GetScaledValue(referenceValue, scalerParams);
								num7 = Math.Max(num7, scaledValue);
								num6 = Math.Min(num6, scaledValue);
							}
						}
					}
					if (num6 != double.MaxValue && num7 != double.MinValue && !double.IsNaN(num6) && !double.IsNaN(num7))
					{
						rect = new Rect(rect.Left, num6, rect.Width, num7 - num6);
						width2 = rect.Width;
						height2 = rect.Height;
						flag = true;
					}
				}
				bool num15 = width2 != width;
				bool flag2 = height2 != height;
				double num16 = ((num15 && !flag) ? (num - 0.5 * width2) : rect.Left);
				double num17 = ((flag2 && !flag) ? (num2 - 0.5 * height2) : rect.Top);
				double num18 = ((num15 && !flag) ? (num + 0.5 * width2) : rect.Right);
				double num19 = ((flag2 && !flag) ? (num2 + 0.5 * height2) : rect.Bottom);
				if (chart.CachedZoomCoercionMode == ZoomCoercionMode.AxisConstrained)
				{
					if (num16 < 0.0)
					{
						num16 = 0.0;
						num18 = num16 + width2;
					}
					if (num18 > 1.0)
					{
						num18 = 1.0;
						num16 = num18 - width2;
					}
					if (num17 < 0.0)
					{
						num17 = 0.0;
						num19 = num17 + height2;
					}
					if (num19 > 1.0)
					{
						num19 = 1.0;
						num17 = num19 - height2;
					}
				}
				rect = new Rect(num16, num17, num18 - num16, num19 - num17);
			}
			return rect;
		}

		private void Charts_CollectionChanged(object sender, NotifyCollectionChangedEventArgs e)
		{
			if (e.NewItems == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			foreach (SeriesViewer newItem in e.NewItems)
			{
				if (newItem.WindowRect.IsEmpty)
				{
					newItem.WindowRect = SynchroniseRect(null, newItem, DefaultWindowRect);
				}
			}
		}

		internal void CrosshairNotify(SeriesViewer sender, Point crossHairPoint)
		{
			foreach (SeriesViewer chart in Charts)
			{
				if (chart == sender)
				{
					chart.CrosshairPoint = new Point(crossHairPoint.X, crossHairPoint.Y);
					continue;
				}
				Point crosshairPoint = new Point(crossHairPoint.X, crossHairPoint.Y);
				SyncSettings syncSettings = SyncManager.GetSyncSettings(chart);
				if (syncSettings == null || !syncSettings.SynchronizeHorizontally)
				{
					crosshairPoint.X = double.NaN;
				}
				if (syncSettings == null || !syncSettings.SynchronizeVertically)
				{
					crosshairPoint.Y = double.NaN;
				}
				chart.CrosshairPoint = crosshairPoint;
			}
		}

		internal void PreviewNotify(SeriesViewer sender, Rect previewRect)
		{
			foreach (SeriesViewer chart in Charts)
			{
				chart.PreviewRect = SynchroniseRect(sender, chart, previewRect);
			}
		}

		internal void WindowNotify(SeriesViewer sender, Rect windowRect)
		{
			WindowNotify(sender, windowRect, force: false);
		}

		internal void WindowNotify(SeriesViewer sender, Rect windowRect, bool force)
		{
			if (windowRect.IsEmpty || double.IsNaN(windowRect.X) || double.IsNaN(windowRect.Y) || double.IsNaN(windowRect.Width) || double.IsNaN(windowRect.Height) || sender.DontNotify)
			{
				return;
			}
			foreach (SeriesViewer chart in Charts)
			{
				chart.DontNotify = true;
				chart.WindowRect = SynchroniseRect(sender, chart, windowRect, force);
				chart.DontNotify = false;
			}
		}

		protected void RaisePropertyChanged(string name, object oldValue, object newValue)
		{
			if (this.PropertyChanged != null)
			{
				this.PropertyChanged(this, new PropertyChangedEventArgs(name));
			}
			if (this.PropertyUpdated != null)
			{
				this.PropertyUpdated(this, new PropertyUpdatedEventArgs(name, oldValue, newValue));
			}
		}
	}

	public class SyncSettingsConverter : TypeConverter
	{
		public override bool CanConvertFrom(ITypeDescriptorContext context, Type sourceType)
		{
			if (sourceType == typeof(string))
			{
				return true;
			}
			return base.CanConvertFrom(context, sourceType);
		}

		public override object ConvertFrom(ITypeDescriptorContext context, CultureInfo culture, object value)
		{
			if (value != null && value is string)
			{
				return new SyncSettings
				{
					SyncChannel = (value as string),
					SynchronizeVertically = true,
					SynchronizeHorizontally = true
				};
			}
			return base.ConvertFrom(context, culture, value);
		}
	}
	[DontObfuscate]
	internal class SyncLinkManager
	{
		private static SyncLinkManager _instance;

		private Dictionary<string, SyncLink> _links;

		internal int LinkCount => _links.Count;

		[DontObfuscate]
		public static SyncLinkManager Instance()
		{
			if (_instance == null)
			{
				_instance = new SyncLinkManager();
			}
			return _instance;
		}

		private SyncLinkManager()
		{
			_links = new Dictionary<string, SyncLink>();
		}

		[DontObfuscate]
		public SyncLink GetLink(string name)
		{
			if (_links.TryGetValue(name, out var value))
			{
				return value;
			}
			value = new SyncLink();
			value.SyncChannel = name;
			_links.Add(name, value);
			return value;
		}

		[DontObfuscate]
		public void ReleaseLink(SyncLink link)
		{
			if (link.Charts.Count == 0 && link.SyncChannel != null && _links.ContainsKey(link.SyncChannel))
			{
				_links.Remove(link.SyncChannel);
			}
		}
	}
	public class SyncManager
	{
		public static readonly DependencyProperty SyncSettingsProperty = DependencyProperty.RegisterAttached("SyncSettings", typeof(SyncSettings), typeof(SyncManager), new PropertyMetadata(null, delegate(DependencyObject o, DependencyPropertyChangedEventArgs e)
		{
			OnSyncSettingsChanged(o as SeriesViewer, e);
		}));

		internal static void SuspendSyncChannel(SeriesViewer chart)
		{
			SyncSettings syncSettings = GetSyncSettings(chart);
			if (syncSettings != null && chart.IsSyncReady && !(chart.SyncChannel != syncSettings.SyncChannel))
			{
				ChangeSyncChannel(chart, chart.SyncChannel, null);
			}
		}

		internal static void EnsureSyncChannel(SeriesViewer chart)
		{
			SyncSettings syncSettings = GetSyncSettings(chart);
			if (syncSettings != null && (!chart.IsSyncReady || !(chart.SyncChannel == syncSettings.SyncChannel)))
			{
				string oldSyncChannel = null;
				if (chart.IsSyncReady)
				{
					oldSyncChannel = chart.SyncChannel;
				}
				ChangeSyncChannel(chart, oldSyncChannel, syncSettings.SyncChannel);
			}
		}

		internal static void ChangeSyncChannel(SeriesViewer chart, string oldSyncChannel, string newSyncChannel)
		{
			if (chart == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(newSyncChannel))
			{
				SyncLink actualSyncLink = chart.ActualSyncLink;
				chart.ActualSyncLink = null;
				chart.ActualSyncLink = new SyncLink();
				if (actualSyncLink != null)
				{
					SyncLinkManager.Instance().ReleaseLink(actualSyncLink);
				}
				chart.SyncChannel = null;
				return;
			}
			if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(oldSyncChannel))
			{
				SyncLink actualSyncLink2 = chart.ActualSyncLink;
				chart.ActualSyncLink = null;
				if (actualSyncLink2 != null)
				{
					SyncLinkManager.Instance().ReleaseLink(actualSyncLink2);
				}
			}
			chart.ActualSyncLink = SyncLinkManager.Instance().GetLink(newSyncChannel);
			chart.SyncChannel = newSyncChannel;
		}

		private static void OnSyncSettingsChanged(SeriesViewer chart, DependencyPropertyChangedEventArgs e)
		{
			string oldSyncChannel = null;
			string newSyncChannel = null;
			if (e.OldValue != null)
			{
				((SyncSettings)e.OldValue).PropertyUpdated -= chart.UpdateSyncSettings;
				oldSyncChannel = ((SyncSettings)e.OldValue).SyncChannel;
			}
			if (e.NewValue != null)
			{
				((SyncSettings)e.NewValue).PropertyUpdated += chart.UpdateSyncSettings;
				newSyncChannel = ((SyncSettings)e.NewValue).SyncChannel;
			}
			ChangeSyncChannel(chart, oldSyncChannel, newSyncChannel);
		}

		public static void SetSyncSettings(DependencyObject target, SyncSettings syncSettings)
		{
			target.SetValue(SyncSettingsProperty, syncSettings);
		}

		public static SyncSettings GetSyncSettings(DependencyObject target)
		{
			return (SyncSettings)target.GetValue(SyncSettingsProperty);
		}
	}

	internal class TrendResolutionParams
	{
		public int FirstBucket { get; set; }

		public int LastBucket { get; set; }

		public int BucketSize { get; set; }

		public Rect Window { get; set; }

	internal class TrendFitCalculator
	{
		public static double[] CalculateFit(List<Point> trend, TrendLineType trendLineType, TrendResolutionParams trendResolutionParams, [SwiftMutableParameter] double[] trendCoefficients, int count, Func<int, double> GetUnscaledX, Func<int, double> GetUnscaledY, Func<double, double> GetScaledXValue, Func<double, double> GetScaledYValue, double xmin, double xmax)
		{
			if (trendCoefficients == null)
			{
				trendCoefficients = trendLineType switch
				{
					TrendLineType.LinearFit => LeastSquaresFit.LinearFit(count, GetUnscaledX, GetUnscaledY), 
					TrendLineType.QuadraticFit => LeastSquaresFit.QuadraticFit(count, GetUnscaledX, GetUnscaledY), 
					TrendLineType.CubicFit => LeastSquaresFit.CubicFit(count, GetUnscaledX, GetUnscaledY), 
					TrendLineType.QuarticFit => LeastSquaresFit.QuarticFit(count, GetUnscaledX, GetUnscaledY), 
					TrendLineType.QuinticFit => LeastSquaresFit.QuinticFit(count, GetUnscaledX, GetUnscaledY), 
					TrendLineType.ExponentialFit => LeastSquaresFit.ExponentialFit(count, GetUnscaledX, GetUnscaledY), 
					TrendLineType.LogarithmicFit => LeastSquaresFit.LogarithmicFit(count, GetUnscaledX, GetUnscaledY), 
					TrendLineType.PowerLawFit => LeastSquaresFit.PowerLawFit(count, GetUnscaledX, GetUnscaledY), 
					_ => throw new NotImplementedException(), 
				};
			}
			if (trendCoefficients == null)
			{
				return null;
			}
			for (int i = 0; (double)i < trendResolutionParams.Viewport.Width; i += 2)
			{
				double num = (double)i / (trendResolutionParams.Viewport.Width - 1.0);
				double num2 = xmin + num * (xmax - xmin);
				double num3 = double.NaN;
				num3 = trendLineType switch
				{
					TrendLineType.LinearFit => LeastSquaresFit.LinearEvaluate(trendCoefficients, num2), 
					TrendLineType.QuadraticFit => LeastSquaresFit.QuadraticEvaluate(trendCoefficients, num2), 
					TrendLineType.CubicFit => LeastSquaresFit.CubicEvaluate(trendCoefficients, num2), 
					TrendLineType.QuarticFit => LeastSquaresFit.QuarticEvaluate(trendCoefficients, num2), 
					TrendLineType.QuinticFit => LeastSquaresFit.QuinticEvaluate(trendCoefficients, num2), 
					TrendLineType.ExponentialFit => LeastSquaresFit.ExponentialEvaluate(trendCoefficients, num2), 
					TrendLineType.LogarithmicFit => LeastSquaresFit.LogarithmicEvaluate(trendCoefficients, num2), 
					TrendLineType.PowerLawFit => LeastSquaresFit.PowerLawEvaluate(trendCoefficients, num2), 
					_ => throw new NotImplementedException(), 
				};
				num2 = GetScaledXValue(num2);
				num3 = GetScaledYValue(num3);
				if (!double.IsNaN(num3) && !double.IsInfinity(num3))
				{
					trend.Add(new Point(num2 + trendResolutionParams.Offset, num3));
				}
			}
			return trendCoefficients;
		}
	}
	internal class TrendAverageCalculator
	{
		private static IEnumerable<double> GetAverage(TrendLineType trendLineType, IEnumerable<double> sourceColumn, [SwiftMutableParameter] int period)
		{
			switch (trendLineType)
			{
			case TrendLineType.SimpleAverage:
			case TrendLineType.ExponentialAverage:
			case TrendLineType.ModifiedAverage:
			case TrendLineType.WeightedAverage:
				if (period < 1)
				{
					period = 1;
				}
				break;
			}
			return trendLineType switch
			{
				TrendLineType.SimpleAverage => TrendCalculators.SMA(sourceColumn, period), 
				TrendLineType.ExponentialAverage => TrendCalculators.EMA(sourceColumn, period), 
				TrendLineType.ModifiedAverage => TrendCalculators.MMA(sourceColumn, period), 
				TrendLineType.CumulativeAverage => TrendCalculators.CMA(sourceColumn), 
				TrendLineType.WeightedAverage => TrendCalculators.WMA(sourceColumn, period), 
				_ => throw new NotImplementedException(), 
			};
		}

		public static void CalculateSingleValueAverage(TrendLineType trendLineType, IList<double> trendColumn, IList<double> valueColumn, int period)
		{
			if (trendColumn.Count != 0)
			{
				return;
			}
			foreach (double item in GetAverage(trendLineType, valueColumn, period))
			{
				trendColumn.Add(item);
			}
		}

		public static void CalculateXYAverage(TrendLineType trendLineType, IList<Point> trendColumn, IEnumerable<double> XColumn, IEnumerable<double> YColumn, int period)
		{
			if (trendColumn.Count == 0)
			{
				IEnumerator<double> enumerator = GetAverage(trendLineType, XColumn, period).GetEnumerator();
				IEnumerator<double> enumerator2 = GetAverage(trendLineType, YColumn, period).GetEnumerator();
				while (enumerator.MoveNext() && enumerator2.MoveNext())
				{
					trendColumn.Add(new Point(enumerator.Current, enumerator2.Current));
				}
			}
		}
	}

	internal abstract class TrendLineManagerBase<TTrendColumn> : ITrendLineManager
	{
		private readonly Polyline _trendPolyline = new Polyline
		{
			IsHitTestVisible = false
		};

		public abstract TrendLineManagerType ManagerType { get; }

		public List<TTrendColumn> TrendColumn { get; set; }

		protected double[] TrendCoefficients { get; set; }

		public Polyline TrendPolyline => _trendPolyline;

		public TrendLineManagerBase()
		{
			TrendColumn = new List<TTrendColumn>();
		}

		public virtual void RasterizeTrendLine(List<Point> trendPoints)
		{
			RasterizeTrendLine(trendPoints, null);
		}

		protected bool IsFit(TrendLineType type)
		{
			if (type != TrendLineType.LinearFit && type != TrendLineType.QuadraticFit && type != TrendLineType.CubicFit && type != TrendLineType.QuarticFit && type != TrendLineType.QuinticFit && type != TrendLineType.LogarithmicFit && type != TrendLineType.ExponentialFit)
			{
				return type == TrendLineType.PowerLawFit;
			}
			return true;
		}

		protected bool IsAverage(TrendLineType type)
		{
			if (type != TrendLineType.SimpleAverage && type != TrendLineType.ExponentialAverage && type != TrendLineType.ModifiedAverage && type != TrendLineType.CumulativeAverage)
			{
				return type == TrendLineType.WeightedAverage;
			}
			return true;
		}

		public virtual void RasterizeTrendLine(List<Point> trendPoints, Clipper clipper)
		{
			TrendPolyline.Points.Clear();
			if (clipper != null)
			{
				clipper.Target = TrendPolyline.Points;
			}
			if (trendPoints != null)
			{
				foreach (Point trendPoint in trendPoints)
				{
					if (!double.IsNaN(trendPoint.X) && !double.IsNaN(trendPoint.Y))
					{
						if (clipper != null)
						{
							clipper.Add(trendPoint);
						}
						else
						{
							TrendPolyline.Points.Add(trendPoint);
						}
					}
				}
			}
			TrendPolyline.IsHitTestVisible = TrendPolyline.Points.Count > 0;
		}

		protected virtual void FlattenTrendLine(IList<Point> trend, TrendResolutionParams trendResolutionParams, List<Point> flattenedPoints)
		{
			FlattenTrendLine(trend, trendResolutionParams, flattenedPoints, null);
		}

		protected virtual void FlattenTrendLine(IList<Point> trend, TrendResolutionParams trendResolutionParams, List<Point> flattenedPoints, Clipper clipper)
		{
			if (clipper != null)
			{
				clipper.Target = flattenedPoints;
			}
			foreach (int item in Flattener.Flatten(trend.Count, (int i) => trend[i].X, (int i) => trend[i].Y, trendResolutionParams.Resolution))
			{
				if (clipper != null)
				{
					clipper.Add(trend[item]);
				}
				else
				{
					flattenedPoints.Add(trend[item]);
				}
			}
		}

		public void AttachPolyLine(Canvas rootCanvas, Series owner)
		{
			if (rootCanvas != null && owner != null)
			{
				if (TrendPolyline.Parent != null)
				{
					Detach();
				}
				rootCanvas.Children.Add(TrendPolyline);
				TrendPolyline.SetBinding(Shape.StrokeProperty, new Binding("ActualTrendLineBrush")
				{
					Source = owner
				});
				TrendPolyline.SetBinding(Shape.StrokeThicknessProperty, new Binding("TrendLineThickness")
				{
					Source = owner
				});
				TrendPolyline.SetBinding(Shape.StrokeDashCapProperty, new Binding("TrendLineDashCap")
				{
					Source = owner
				});
				TrendPolyline.SetBinding(Panel.ZIndexProperty, new Binding("TrendLineZIndex")
				{
					Source = owner
				});
				TrendPolyline.SetBinding(Shape.StrokeDashArrayProperty, new Binding("TrendLineDashArray")
				{
					Source = owner,
					Converter = new DoubleCollectionDuplicator()
				});
				VisualInformationManager.SetIsTrendLineVisual(TrendPolyline, value: true);
			}
		}

		public void Detach()
		{
			if (TrendPolyline != null)
			{
				if (TrendPolyline.Parent is Panel panel)
				{
					panel.Children.Remove(TrendPolyline);
				}
				TrendPolyline.ClearValue(Shape.StrokeProperty);
				TrendPolyline.ClearValue(Shape.StrokeThicknessProperty);
				TrendPolyline.ClearValue(Shape.StrokeDashCapProperty);
				TrendPolyline.ClearValue(Panel.ZIndexProperty);
				TrendPolyline.ClearValue(Shape.StrokeDashArrayProperty);
			}
		}

		public void ClearPoints()
		{
			TrendPolyline.Points.Clear();
		}

		public void Reset()
		{
			TrendCoefficients = null;
			TrendColumn.Clear();
		}

		public void DataUpdated(FastItemsSourceEventAction action, int position, int count, string propertyName)
		{
			switch (action)
			{
			case FastItemsSourceEventAction.Remove:
			case FastItemsSourceEventAction.Insert:
			case FastItemsSourceEventAction.Replace:
			case FastItemsSourceEventAction.Change:
			case FastItemsSourceEventAction.Reset:
				Reset();
				break;
			}
		}

		public bool PropertyUpdated(object sender, string propertyName, object oldValue, object newValue)
		{
			bool result = false;
			switch (propertyName)
			{
			case "TrendLineType":
			case "TrendLinePeriod":
				Reset();
				result = true;
				break;
			case "TrendLineThickness":
				result = true;
				break;
			case "FastItemsSource":
				result = true;
				Reset();
				break;
			}
			return result;
		}
	}

		private void CategoryErrorBarSettings_PropertyUpdated(object sender, PropertyUpdatedEventArgs e)
		{
			switch (e.PropertyName)
			{
			case "Calculator":
				if (e.OldValue is IErrorBarCalculator errorBarCalculator)
				{
					errorBarCalculator.Changed -= Calculator_Changed;
				}
				if (Series != null)
				{
					Series.RenderSeries(animate: false);
					if (Series.SeriesViewer != null)
					{
						Series.NotifyThumbnailAppearanceChanged();
					}
				}
				if (e.NewValue is IErrorBarCalculator errorBarCalculator2)
				{
					errorBarCalculator2.Changed += Calculator_Changed;
				}
				break;
			case "EnableErrorBars":
			case "ErrorBarCapLength":
			case "ErrorBarStyle":
			case "Stroke":
			case "StrokeThickness":
				if (Series != null)
				{
					Series.RenderSeries(animate: false);
					if (Series.SeriesViewer != null)
					{
						Series.NotifyThumbnailAppearanceChanged();
					}
				}
				break;
			}
		}

		private void Calculator_Changed(object sender, EventArgs e)
		{
			if (sender is IErrorBarCalculator errorBarCalculator)
			{
				errorBarCalculator.Changed -= Calculator_Changed;
				if (Series != null)
				{
					Series.RenderSeries(animate: false);
				}
				errorBarCalculator.Changed += Calculator_Changed;
			}
		}

	internal class ErrorBarsHelper
	{
		private ISupportsErrorBars ErrorBarsHost { get; set; }

		private IProvidesViewport ViewportHost { get; set; }

		public ErrorBarsHelper(ISupportsErrorBars errorBarsHost, IProvidesViewport viewportHost)
		{
			ErrorBarsHost = errorBarsHost;
			ViewportHost = viewportHost;
		}

		internal bool IsCalculatorIndependent(IErrorBarCalculator calculator)
		{
			ErrorBarCalculatorType calculatorType = calculator.GetCalculatorType();
			if (calculatorType == ErrorBarCalculatorType.Percentage || calculatorType == ErrorBarCalculatorType.Data)
			{
				return false;
			}
			return true;
		}

		internal void CalculateIndependentErrorBarPosition(IErrorBarCalculator calculator, ref double position)
		{
			if (calculator.HasConstantPosition())
			{
				position = calculator.GetPosition();
			}
		}

		internal void CalculateStdDevErrorBarSize(double unscaledValue, IErrorBarCalculator calculator, NumericAxisBase axis, ref double positiveSize, ref double negativeSize)
		{
			ViewportHost.GetViewInfo(out var viewportRect, out var windowRect);
			Rect effectiveViewport = ViewportHost.GetEffectiveViewport();
			ScalerParams p = new ScalerParams(windowRect, viewportRect, axis.IsInverted, effectiveViewport);
			double scaledValue = axis.GetScaledValue(unscaledValue, p);
			double independentValue = calculator.GetIndependentValue();
			positiveSize = Math.Abs(Math.Round(axis.GetScaledValue(unscaledValue + independentValue, p) - scaledValue));
			negativeSize = Math.Abs(Math.Round(axis.GetScaledValue(unscaledValue - independentValue, p) - scaledValue));
		}

		internal void CalculateIndependentErrorBarSize(double scaledValue, IErrorBarCalculator calculator, NumericAxisBase axis, ref double positiveSize, ref double negativeSize)
		{
			ViewportHost.GetViewInfo(out var viewportRect, out var windowRect);
			ScalerParams p = new ScalerParams(windowRect, viewportRect, axis.IsInverted);
			double unscaledValue = axis.GetUnscaledValue(scaledValue, p);
			double independentValue = calculator.GetIndependentValue();
			positiveSize = Math.Abs(Math.Round(axis.GetScaledValue(unscaledValue + independentValue, p) - scaledValue));
			negativeSize = Math.Abs(Math.Round(axis.GetScaledValue(unscaledValue - independentValue, p) - scaledValue));
		}

		internal void CalculateDependentErrorBarSize(double scaledValue, IErrorBarCalculator calculator, NumericAxisBase axis, ref double positiveSize, ref double negativeSize)
		{
			ViewportHost.GetViewInfo(out var viewportRect, out var windowRect);
			ScalerParams p = new ScalerParams(windowRect, viewportRect, axis.IsInverted);
			double unscaledValue = axis.GetUnscaledValue(scaledValue, p);
			double dependentValue = calculator.GetDependentValue(unscaledValue);
			positiveSize = Math.Abs(Math.Round(axis.GetScaledValue(unscaledValue + dependentValue, p) - scaledValue));
			negativeSize = Math.Abs(Math.Round(axis.GetScaledValue(unscaledValue - dependentValue, p) - scaledValue));
		}

		internal void CalculateDependentErrorBarSize(double scaledValue, IErrorBarCalculator calculator, NumericAxisBase refAxis, NumericAxisBase targetAxis, ref double positiveSize, ref double negativeSize)
		{
			ViewportHost.GetViewInfo(out var viewportRect, out var windowRect);
			ScalerParams p = new ScalerParams(windowRect, viewportRect, refAxis.IsInverted);
			ScalerParams p2 = new ScalerParams(windowRect, viewportRect, targetAxis.IsInverted);
			double unscaledValue = refAxis.GetUnscaledValue(scaledValue, p);
			double dependentValue = calculator.GetDependentValue(unscaledValue);
			positiveSize = Math.Abs(Math.Round(refAxis.GetScaledValue(unscaledValue + dependentValue, p2) - scaledValue));
			negativeSize = Math.Abs(Math.Round(refAxis.GetScaledValue(unscaledValue - dependentValue, p2) - scaledValue));
		}

		internal void CalculateFromUnscaledErrorBarValue(double value, double unscaledErrorBarValue, NumericAxisBase axis, ref double positiveSize, ref double negativeSize)
		{
			ViewportHost.GetViewInfo(out var viewportRect, out var windowRect);
			ScalerParams p = new ScalerParams(windowRect, viewportRect, axis.IsInverted);
			double unscaledValue = axis.GetUnscaledValue(value, p);
			positiveSize = Math.Abs(Math.Round(axis.GetScaledValue(unscaledValue + unscaledErrorBarValue, p) - value));
			negativeSize = Math.Abs(Math.Round(axis.GetScaledValue(unscaledValue - unscaledErrorBarValue, p) - value));
		}

		internal void AddErrorBarVertical(PathGeometry errorBarsGeometry, Point position, double errorBarLength, bool positive)
		{
			if (!double.IsNaN(position.X) && !double.IsNaN(position.Y) && !double.IsNaN(errorBarLength))
			{
				double y = (positive ? (position.Y - errorBarLength) : (position.Y + errorBarLength));
				int num = (int)CategoryErrorBarSettings.ErrorBarCapLengthProperty.GetMetadata(typeof(CategoryErrorBarSettings)).DefaultValue;
				if (ErrorBarsHost.ErrorBarSettings is CategoryErrorBarSettings)
				{
					num = ((CategoryErrorBarSettings)ErrorBarsHost.ErrorBarSettings).ErrorBarCapLength;
				}
				else if (ErrorBarsHost.ErrorBarSettings is ScatterErrorBarSettings)
				{
					num = ((ScatterErrorBarSettings)ErrorBarsHost.ErrorBarSettings).VerticalErrorBarCapLength;
				}
				PathFigure pathFigure = new PathFigure();
				pathFigure.StartPoint = new Point
				{
					X = position.X,
					Y = position.Y
				};
				pathFigure.Segments.Add(new LineSegment
				{
					Point = new Point(position.X, y)
				});
				PathFigure pathFigure2 = new PathFigure();
				pathFigure2.StartPoint = new Point
				{
					X = position.X - (double)(num / 2),
					Y = y
				};
				pathFigure2.Segments.Add(new LineSegment
				{
					Point = new Point(position.X + (double)(num / 2), y)
				});
				errorBarsGeometry.Figures.Add(pathFigure);
				errorBarsGeometry.Figures.Add(pathFigure2);
			}
		}

		internal void AddErrorBarHorizontal(PathGeometry errorBarsGeomety, Point position, double errorBarLength, bool positive)
		{
			if (!double.IsNaN(position.X) && !double.IsNaN(position.Y) && !double.IsNaN(errorBarLength))
			{
				double x = (positive ? (position.X + errorBarLength) : (position.X - errorBarLength));
				int num = (int)CategoryErrorBarSettings.ErrorBarCapLengthProperty.GetMetadata(typeof(CategoryErrorBarSettings)).DefaultValue;
				if (ErrorBarsHost.ErrorBarSettings is CategoryErrorBarSettings)
				{
					num = ((CategoryErrorBarSettings)ErrorBarsHost.ErrorBarSettings).ErrorBarCapLength;
				}
				else if (ErrorBarsHost.ErrorBarSettings is ScatterErrorBarSettings)
				{
					num = ((ScatterErrorBarSettings)ErrorBarsHost.ErrorBarSettings).HorizontalErrorBarCapLength;
				}
				PathFigure pathFigure = new PathFigure();
				pathFigure.StartPoint = new Point
				{
					X = position.X,
					Y = position.Y
				};
				pathFigure.Segments.Add(new LineSegment
				{
					Point = new Point(x, position.Y)
				});
				PathFigure pathFigure2 = new PathFigure();
				pathFigure2.StartPoint = new Point
				{
					X = x,
					Y = position.Y - (double)(num / 2)
				};
				pathFigure2.Segments.Add(new LineSegment
				{
					Point = new Point(x, position.Y + (double)(num / 2))
				});
				errorBarsGeomety.Figures.Add(pathFigure);
				errorBarsGeomety.Figures.Add(pathFigure2);
			}
		}

		internal Point CalculateErrorBarCenterHorizontal(IErrorBarCalculator calculator, NumericAxisBase axis, Point point, double mean)
		{
			Point result = default(Point);
			if (calculator.GetCalculatorType() == ErrorBarCalculatorType.StandardDeviation)
			{
				ViewportHost.GetViewInfo(out var viewportRect, out var windowRect);
				Rect effectiveViewport = ViewportHost.GetEffectiveViewport();
				ScalerParams p = new ScalerParams(windowRect, viewportRect, axis.IsInverted, effectiveViewport);
				result.X = Math.Round(axis.GetScaledValue(mean, p));
				result.Y = Math.Round(point.Y);
			}
			else
			{
				result.X = Math.Round(point.X);
				result.Y = Math.Round(point.Y);
			}
			return result;
		}

		internal Point CalculateErrorBarCenterVertical(IErrorBarCalculator calculator, NumericAxisBase axis, Point point, double mean)
		{
			Point result = default(Point);
			if (calculator.GetCalculatorType() == ErrorBarCalculatorType.StandardDeviation)
			{
				ViewportHost.GetViewInfo(out var viewportRect, out var windowRect);
				Rect effectiveViewport = ViewportHost.GetEffectiveViewport();
				ScalerParams p = new ScalerParams(windowRect, viewportRect, axis.IsInverted, effectiveViewport);
				result.X = Math.Round(point.X);
				result.Y = Math.Round(axis.GetScaledValue(mean, p));
			}
			else
			{
				result.X = Math.Round(point.X);
				result.Y = Math.Round(point.Y);
			}
			return result;
		}
	}

		private void ScatterErrorBarSettings_PropertyUpdated(object sender, PropertyUpdatedEventArgs e)
		{
			switch (e.PropertyName)
			{
			case "HorizontalCalculator":
			case "VerticalCalculator":
				if (e.OldValue is IErrorBarCalculator errorBarCalculator)
				{
					errorBarCalculator.Changed -= Calculator_Changed;
				}
				if (Series != null)
				{
					Series.RenderSeries(animate: false);
					if (Series.SeriesViewer != null)
					{
						Series.NotifyThumbnailAppearanceChanged();
					}
				}
				if (e.NewValue is IErrorBarCalculator errorBarCalculator2)
				{
					errorBarCalculator2.Changed += Calculator_Changed;
				}
				break;
			case "EnableErrorBarsHorizontal":
			case "EnableErrorBarsVertical":
			case "HorizontalCalculatorReference":
			case "HorizontalErrorBarCapLength":
			case "HorizontalErrorBarStyle":
			case "HorizontalStroke":
			case "HorizontalStrokeThickness":
			case "VerticalCalculatorReference":
			case "VerticalErrorBarCapLength":
			case "VerticalErrorBarStyle":
			case "VerticalStroke":
			case "VerticalStrokeThickness":
				if (Series != null)
				{
					Series.RenderSeries(animate: false);
					if (Series.SeriesViewer != null)
					{
						Series.NotifyThumbnailAppearanceChanged();
					}
				}
				break;
			}
		}

		private void Calculator_Changed(object sender, EventArgs e)
		{
			if (sender is IErrorBarCalculator errorBarCalculator)
			{
				errorBarCalculator.Changed -= Calculator_Changed;
				if (Series != null)
				{
					Series.RenderSeries(animate: false);
				}
				errorBarCalculator.Changed += Calculator_Changed;
			}
		}
	}

	internal class Snapper
	{
		private double _resolution = 7.0;

		private bool _customResolution;

		protected double Resolution
		{
			get
			{
				return _resolution;
			}
			set
			{
				_resolution = value;
			}
		}

		protected bool CustomResolution
		{
			get
			{
				return _customResolution;
			}
			set
			{
				_customResolution = value;
			}
		}

		protected static double expt(double a, [SwiftMutableParameter] int n)
		{
			double num = 1.0;
			if (n > 0)
			{
				while (n > 0)
				{
					num *= a;
					n--;
				}
			}
			else
			{
				while (n < 0)
				{
					num /= a;
					n++;
				}
			}
			return num;
		}

		protected static double nicenum(double x, bool round)
		{
			int num = (int)Math.Floor(Math.Log10(x));
			double num2 = x / Math.Pow(10.0, num);
			if (round)
			{
				return ((num2 < 1.5) ? 1.0 : ((num2 < 3.0) ? 2.0 : ((num2 < 7.0) ? 5.0 : 10.0))) * Math.Pow(10.0, num);
			}
			return ((num2 <= 1.0) ? 1.0 : ((num2 <= 2.0) ? 2.0 : ((num2 <= 5.0) ? 5.0 : 10.0))) * Math.Pow(10.0, num);
		}

		protected static TimeSpan nicenum(TimeSpan span, bool round)
		{
			TimeSpan result = TimeSpan.Zero;
			if (span.TotalDays > 1.0)
			{
				result = TimeSpan.FromDays(Math.Ceiling(span.TotalDays));
			}
			else if (span.TotalHours > 1.0)
			{
				result = TimeSpan.FromHours(Math.Ceiling(span.TotalHours));
			}
			else if (span.TotalMinutes > 1.0)
			{
				result = TimeSpan.FromMinutes(Math.Ceiling(span.TotalMinutes));
			}
			else if (span.TotalSeconds > 1.0)
			{
				result = TimeSpan.FromSeconds(Math.Ceiling(span.TotalSeconds));
			}
			else if (span.TotalMilliseconds > 1.0)
			{
				result = TimeSpan.FromMilliseconds(Math.Ceiling(span.TotalMilliseconds));
			}
			return result;
		}
	}
	internal class LinearNumericSnapper : Snapper
	{
		public double Interval { get; private set; }

		public int Precision { get; private set; }

		public int MinorCount { get; private set; }

		public LinearNumericSnapper(double visibleMinimum, double visibleMaximum, double pixels, double resolution)
		{
			if (resolution > 0.0)
			{
				base.Resolution = resolution;
				base.CustomResolution = true;
			}
			Initialize(visibleMinimum, visibleMaximum, pixels, 10);
		}

		public LinearNumericSnapper(double visibleMinimum, double visibleMaximum, double pixels, int minTicks, double resolution)
		{
			if (resolution > 0.0)
			{
				base.Resolution = resolution;
				base.CustomResolution = true;
			}
			Initialize(visibleMinimum, visibleMaximum, pixels, minTicks);
		}

		private void Initialize(double visibleMinimum, double visibleMaximum, double pixels, int minTicks)
		{
			Interval = double.NaN;
			Precision = 0;
			MinorCount = 0;
			int num = 0;
			num = ((!(pixels < 100.0)) ? Math.Min(minTicks, (int)(pixels / base.Resolution)) : 4);
			if (num > 0)
			{
				int num2 = AdjustTicks(visibleMinimum, visibleMaximum, num);
				if (base.CustomResolution && num2 > num)
				{
					Interval = double.NaN;
					num2 = AdjustTicks(visibleMinimum, visibleMaximum, num - 1);
				}
				num = num2;
				if (pixels / (double)num > base.Resolution * 10.0)
				{
					MinorCount = 10;
				}
				else if (pixels / (double)num > base.Resolution * 5.0)
				{
					MinorCount = 5;
				}
				else if (pixels / (double)num > base.Resolution * 2.0)
				{
					MinorCount = 2;
				}
				Precision = Math.Max(-(int)Math.Floor(Math.Log10(Interval)), 0);
			}
		}

		private int AdjustTicks(double visibleMinimum, double visibleMaximum, int ticks)
		{
			double num = Snapper.nicenum(visibleMaximum - visibleMinimum, round: false);
			double num2 = Math.Max(1.0, ticks - 1);
			Interval = Snapper.nicenum(num / num2, round: true);
			double num3 = Math.Floor(visibleMinimum / Interval) * Interval;
			return (int)Math.Round((Math.Ceiling(visibleMaximum / Interval) * Interval - num3) / Interval);
		}
	}
	internal class LogarithmicNumericSnapper : Snapper
	{
		public double Interval { get; private set; }

		public double MinorCount { get; private set; }

		public LogarithmicNumericSnapper(double visibleMinimum, double visibleMaximum, int logarithmBase, double pixels)
		{
			Interval = 1.0;
			MinorCount = logarithmBase;
		}
	}
	internal class LinearCategorySnapper : Snapper
	{
		public double Interval { get; private set; }

		public double MinorCount { get; private set; }

		public LinearCategorySnapper(double visibleMinimum, double visibleMaximum, double pixels, double resolution)
			: this(visibleMinimum, visibleMaximum, pixels, double.NaN, CategoryMode.Mode0, resolution)
		{
		}

		public LinearCategorySnapper(double visibleMinimum, double visibleMaximum, double pixels, double interval, CategoryMode categoryMode, double resolution)
		{
			if (resolution > 0.0)
			{
				base.Resolution = resolution;
				base.CustomResolution = true;
			}
			Interval = interval;
			MinorCount = 0.0;
			int num = Math.Min(10, (int)(pixels / base.Resolution));
			if (num > 0)
			{
				int num2 = AdjustTicks(visibleMinimum, visibleMaximum, num);
				if (base.CustomResolution && num2 > num)
				{
					Interval = interval;
					num2 = AdjustTicks(visibleMinimum, visibleMaximum, num - 1);
				}
				num = num2;
				if (pixels / (double)num > base.Resolution * 10.0)
				{
					MinorCount = 10.0;
				}
				else if (pixels / (double)num > base.Resolution * 5.0)
				{
					MinorCount = 5.0;
				}
				else if (pixels / (double)num > base.Resolution * 2.0)
				{
					MinorCount = 2.0;
				}
			}
		}

		private int AdjustTicks(double visibleMinimum, double visibleMaximum, int ticks)
		{
			double num = Snapper.nicenum(visibleMaximum - visibleMinimum, round: false);
			if (double.IsNaN(Interval))
			{
				int num2 = Math.Max(ticks - 1, 1);
				Interval = Snapper.nicenum(num / (double)num2, round: true);
			}
			if (Interval < 1.0)
			{
				Interval = 1.0;
			}
			double num3 = Math.Floor(visibleMinimum / Interval) * Interval;
			return (int)Math.Round((Math.Ceiling(visibleMaximum / Interval) * Interval - num3) / Interval);
		}
	}
