	internal class DictInterpolator<TKey, TValue, TFrame> where TValue : new()
	{
		private TValue tDefault;

		private Action<TValue, float, TValue, TValue, TFrame, TFrame> InterpolatePointStrat { get; set; }

		private Func<TValue, TKey> GetKeyStrat { get; set; }

		private Func<TValue, bool> ValidPointStrat { get; set; }

		private Func<TValue> CreateValueStrat { get; set; }

		public DictInterpolator(Action<TValue, float, TValue, TValue, TFrame, TFrame> interpolatePointStrat, Func<TValue, TKey> getKeyStrat, Func<TValue, bool> validPointStrat, Func<TValue> createValueStrat)
		{
			InterpolatePointStrat = interpolatePointStrat;
			GetKeyStrat = getKeyStrat;
			ValidPointStrat = validPointStrat;
			CreateValueStrat = createValueStrat;
			tDefault = default(TValue);
		}

		public void Interpolate(IDictionary<TKey, TValue> target, float p, IDictionary<TKey, TValue> min, IDictionary<TKey, TValue> max, TFrame minFrame, TFrame maxFrame)
		{
			List<TKey> list = new List<TKey>();
			foreach (TKey key in target.Keys)
			{
				TValue value = tDefault;
				TValue value2 = tDefault;
				TValue val = target[key];
				bool num = min.TryGetValue(key, out value);
				bool flag = max.TryGetValue(key, out value2);
				if (!num && !flag)
				{
					list.Add(key);
					continue;
				}
				InterpolatePointStrat(val, p, value, value2, minFrame, maxFrame);
				if (!ValidPointStrat(val))
				{
					list.Add(key);
				}
			}
			foreach (TKey item in list)
			{
				target.Remove(item);
			}
			foreach (TKey key2 in min.Keys)
			{
				TValue arg = min[key2];
				TValue value3 = tDefault;
				TValue value4 = tDefault;
				max.TryGetValue(key2, out value3);
				if (!target.TryGetValue(key2, out value4))
				{
					value4 = CreateValueStrat();
					InterpolatePointStrat(value4, p, arg, value3, minFrame, maxFrame);
					if (ValidPointStrat(value4))
					{
						target.Add(GetKeyStrat(value4), value4);
					}
				}
			}
			foreach (TKey key3 in max.Keys)
			{
				TValue arg2 = max[key3];
				TValue value5 = tDefault;
				TValue value6 = tDefault;
				bool flag2 = min.TryGetValue(key3, out value5);
				if (!target.TryGetValue(key3, out value6) && !flag2)
				{
					value6 = CreateValueStrat();
					InterpolatePointStrat(value6, p, value5, arg2, minFrame, maxFrame);
					if (ValidPointStrat(value6))
					{
						target.Add(GetKeyStrat(value6), value6);
					}
				}
			}
		}
	}
	[Browsable(false)]
	[EditorBrowsable(EditorBrowsableState.Never)]
	public class OwnedPoint
	{
		public Point Point { get; set; }

		public object OwnerItem { get; set; }

		public Point ColumnValues { get; set; }

		public OwnedPoint()
		{
			ColumnValues = new Point(0.0, 0.0);
		}
	}
	[EditorBrowsable(EditorBrowsableState.Never)]
	internal class ScatterFrameBase<T> : Frame
	{
		internal DictInterpolator<object, OwnedPoint, ScatterFrameBase<T>> OwnedPointDictInterpolator { get; set; }

		public Func<OwnedPoint, ScatterFrameBase<T>, ScatterFrameBase<T>, OwnedPoint> GetNewMinValue { get; set; }

		public Dictionary<object, OwnedPoint> Markers { get; private set; }

		public Dictionary<object, OwnedPoint> CachedPoints { get; internal set; }

		public List<Point> Points { get; private set; }

		public List<Point> TrendLine { get; private set; }

		public Dictionary<object, OwnedPoint> HorizontalErrorBars { get; private set; }

		public Dictionary<object, OwnedPoint> VerticalErrorBars { get; private set; }

		public Dictionary<object, double[]> HorizontalErrorBarWidths { get; private set; }

		public Dictionary<object, double[]> VerticalErrorBarHeights { get; private set; }

		public ScatterFrameBase()
		{
			Points = new List<Point>();
			CachedPoints = new Dictionary<object, OwnedPoint>();
			Markers = new Dictionary<object, OwnedPoint>();
			TrendLine = new List<Point>();
			HorizontalErrorBars = new Dictionary<object, OwnedPoint>();
			VerticalErrorBars = new Dictionary<object, OwnedPoint>();
			HorizontalErrorBarWidths = new Dictionary<object, double[]>();
			VerticalErrorBarHeights = new Dictionary<object, double[]>();
			GetNewMinValue = (OwnedPoint maxPoint, ScatterFrameBase<T> minFrame, ScatterFrameBase<T> maxFrame) => maxPoint;
			OwnedPointDictInterpolator = new DictInterpolator<object, OwnedPoint, ScatterFrameBase<T>>(InterpolatePoint, (OwnedPoint p) => p.OwnerItem, (OwnedPoint p) => !double.IsNaN(p.Point.X) && !double.IsNaN(p.Point.Y), () => new OwnedPoint());
		}

		public override void Interpolate(float p, Frame min, Frame max)
		{
			ScatterFrameBase<T> scatterFrameBase = (ScatterFrameBase<T>)min;
			ScatterFrameBase<T> scatterFrameBase2 = (ScatterFrameBase<T>)max;
			if (scatterFrameBase != null && scatterFrameBase2 != null)
			{
				OwnedPointDictInterpolator.Interpolate(CachedPoints, p, scatterFrameBase.CachedPoints, scatterFrameBase2.CachedPoints, scatterFrameBase, scatterFrameBase2);
				Frame.Interpolate(Points, p, scatterFrameBase.Points, scatterFrameBase2.Points);
				OwnedPointDictInterpolator.Interpolate(Markers, p, scatterFrameBase.Markers, scatterFrameBase2.Markers, scatterFrameBase, scatterFrameBase2);
				OwnedPointDictInterpolator.Interpolate(HorizontalErrorBars, p, scatterFrameBase.HorizontalErrorBars, scatterFrameBase2.HorizontalErrorBars, scatterFrameBase, scatterFrameBase2);
				OwnedPointDictInterpolator.Interpolate(VerticalErrorBars, p, scatterFrameBase.VerticalErrorBars, scatterFrameBase2.VerticalErrorBars, scatterFrameBase, scatterFrameBase2);
				AddPointsThatSweepThroughTheView(Markers, p, scatterFrameBase, scatterFrameBase2);
				Frame.Interpolate(TrendLine, p, scatterFrameBase.TrendLine, scatterFrameBase2.TrendLine);
				HorizontalErrorBarWidths = scatterFrameBase2.HorizontalErrorBarWidths;
				VerticalErrorBarHeights = scatterFrameBase2.VerticalErrorBarHeights;
				InterpolateOverride(p, scatterFrameBase, scatterFrameBase2);
			}
		}

		protected virtual void InterpolateOverride(float p, Frame minFrame, Frame maxFrame)
		{
		}

		private void AddPointsThatSweepThroughTheView(Dictionary<object, OwnedPoint> markers, float p, ScatterFrameBase<T> minFrame, ScatterFrameBase<T> maxFrame)
		{
			foreach (OwnedPoint value2 in minFrame.CachedPoints.Values)
			{
				if (!markers.ContainsKey(value2.OwnerItem) && maxFrame.CachedPoints.TryGetValue(value2.OwnerItem, out var value) && (value.ColumnValues.X != value2.ColumnValues.X || value.ColumnValues.Y != value2.ColumnValues.Y))
				{
					OwnedPoint ownedPoint = new OwnedPoint();
					InterpolatePoint(ownedPoint, p, value2, value, minFrame, maxFrame);
					if (!double.IsNaN(ownedPoint.Point.X) && !double.IsNaN(ownedPoint.Point.Y))
					{
						markers.Add(ownedPoint.OwnerItem, ownedPoint);
					}
				}
			}
		}

		protected virtual void InterpolateColumnValues(OwnedPoint point, float p, OwnedPoint minPoint, OwnedPoint maxPoint)
		{
			if (minPoint != null)
			{
				point.ColumnValues = new Point(minPoint.ColumnValues.X, minPoint.ColumnValues.Y);
			}
			else if (maxPoint != null)
			{
				point.ColumnValues = new Point(maxPoint.ColumnValues.X, maxPoint.ColumnValues.Y);
			}
		}

		private void InterpolatePoint(OwnedPoint point, float p, OwnedPoint minPoint, OwnedPoint maxPoint, ScatterFrameBase<T> minFrame, ScatterFrameBase<T> maxFrame)
		{
			OwnedPoint ownedPoint;
			if (minPoint == null)
			{
				if (maxPoint == null)
				{
					point.Point = new Point(double.NaN, double.NaN);
					return;
				}
				ownedPoint = ((!minFrame.CachedPoints.TryGetValue(maxPoint.OwnerItem, out var value)) ? GetNewMinValue(maxPoint, minFrame, maxFrame) : value);
			}
			else
			{
				ownedPoint = minPoint;
				if (point.OwnerItem == null)
				{
					point.OwnerItem = minPoint.OwnerItem;
				}
			}
			OwnedPoint ownedPoint2;
			if (maxPoint == null)
			{
				if (minPoint == null)
				{
					point.Point = new Point(double.NaN, double.NaN);
					return;
				}
				if (!maxFrame.CachedPoints.TryGetValue(minPoint.OwnerItem, out var value2))
				{
					point.Point = new Point(double.NaN, double.NaN);
					return;
				}
				ownedPoint2 = value2;
			}
			else
			{
				ownedPoint2 = maxPoint;
				if (point.OwnerItem == null)
				{
					point.OwnerItem = maxPoint.OwnerItem;
				}
			}
			InterpolateColumnValues(point, p, ownedPoint, ownedPoint2);
			if (double.IsNaN(ownedPoint.Point.X) || double.IsNaN(ownedPoint.Point.Y))
			{
				ownedPoint = ownedPoint2;
			}
			InterpolatePointOverride(point, p, ownedPoint, ownedPoint2);
		}

		protected virtual void InterpolatePointOverride(OwnedPoint point, double p, OwnedPoint min, OwnedPoint max)
		{
			double num = 1.0 - p;
			point.Point = new Point(min.Point.X * num + max.Point.X * p, min.Point.Y * num + max.Point.Y * p);
		}
	}
	public class TileZoomManager
	{
		public const double TileSize = 512.0;

		private double _lastDimension = -1.0;

		private double _horizontalCorrectiveSkew = 1.0;

		private double _verticalCorrectiveSkew = 1.0;

		private const double MaxAllowedSkew = 3.0;

		private int tileID;

		private bool _hasContent;

		protected SeriesViewer Viewer { get; set; }

		protected Rect Viewport { get; set; }

		public Rect Window { get; private set; }

		public Rect TileViewport { get; private set; }

		protected bool Running { get; set; }

		protected double MinZoomLevel { get; set; }

		protected Dictionary<TileZoomTile, ITileZoomTile> ExistingTiles { get; set; }

		protected Dictionary<TileZoomTile, ITileZoomTile> PersistentTiles { get; set; }

		protected List<ITileZoomTile> NewTiles { get; set; }

		protected Rect ActualViewport { get; set; }

		protected List<TileZoomTileInfo> VisibleTiles { get; set; }

		protected List<TileZoomTile> CurrentTiles { get; set; }

		protected TileZoomTileCache TileCache { get; set; }

		public bool RoundDown { get; set; }

		public TileZoomManager(SeriesViewer viewer, bool roundDown, int cacheSize)
		{
			Viewer = viewer;
			Viewer.ActualWindowRectChanged += Viewer_ActualWindowRectChanged;
			Viewer.GridAreaRectChanged += Viewer_GridAreaRectChanged;
			TileCache = new TileZoomTileCache(cacheSize, this);
			VisibleTiles = new List<TileZoomTileInfo>();
			CurrentTiles = new List<TileZoomTile>();
			ExistingTiles = new Dictionary<TileZoomTile, ITileZoomTile>();
			PersistentTiles = new Dictionary<TileZoomTile, ITileZoomTile>();
			NewTiles = new List<ITileZoomTile>();
			RoundDown = roundDown;
			OnViewportChanged();
		}

		private void OnViewportChanged()
		{
			Viewport = Viewer.ViewportRect;
			ActualViewport = ApplySkew(Viewport);
			double dimension = GetDimension();
			ClearVisible();
			ClearTileCache();
			_lastDimension = dimension;
			MinZoomLevel = GetMinZoomLevel(dimension);
			TileViewport = new Rect(0.0, 0.0, dimension, dimension);
		}

		private Rect ApplySkew(Rect viewport)
		{
			return new Rect(viewport.Left, viewport.Top, viewport.Width * _horizontalCorrectiveSkew, viewport.Height * _verticalCorrectiveSkew);
		}

		private double GetMinZoomLevel(double dimension)
		{
			return Math.Log(dimension / 512.0, 2.0);
		}

		private double GetDimension()
		{
			double num = Math.Max(ActualViewport.Width, ActualViewport.Height);
			int num2 = 1;
			double num3;
			for (num3 = 512.0; num3 < num; num3 = 512.0 * (double)num2)
			{
				num2++;
			}
			return num3;
		}

		private void Viewer_GridAreaRectChanged(object sender, RectChangedEventArgs e)
		{
			OnViewportChanged();
			OnWindowChanged();
		}

		private void Viewer_ActualWindowRectChanged(object sender, RectChangedEventArgs e)
		{
			OnWindowChanged();
		}

		private void OnWindowChanged()
		{
			_hasContent = true;
			Window = Viewer.ActualWindowRect;
			if (Running)
			{
				if (UpdateCorrectiveSkew(Window))
				{
					OnViewportChanged();
				}
				DetermineVisibleTiles();
				ReadyVisibleTiles();
				DisplayVisibleTiles();
			}
		}

		private bool UpdateCorrectiveSkew(Rect window)
		{
			double num = 1.0;
			double num2 = 1.0;
			if (IsTooSkewed(window))
			{
				if (window.Width > window.Height)
				{
					double num3 = 1.0;
					if (window.Height != 0.0)
					{
						num3 = window.Width / window.Height;
					}
					int num4 = 0;
					int num5 = 1;
					while ((double)num5 < num3)
					{
						num4++;
						num5 = (int)Math.Pow(3.0, num4);
					}
					num5 = (int)Math.Pow(3.0, num4 - 1);
					num2 = num5;
					if (num2 == 0.0 || double.IsInfinity(num2) || double.IsNaN(num2))
					{
						num2 = 1.0;
					}
				}
				else
				{
					double num6 = 1.0;
					if (window.Width != 0.0)
					{
						num6 = window.Height / window.Width;
					}
					int num7 = 0;
					int num8 = 1;
					while ((double)num8 < num6)
					{
						num7++;
						num8 = (int)Math.Pow(3.0, num7);
					}
					num8 = (int)Math.Pow(3.0, num7 - 1);
					num = num8;
					if (double.IsInfinity(num) || double.IsNaN(num))
					{
						num = 1.0;
					}
				}
			}
			else
			{
				num = 1.0;
				num2 = 1.0;
			}
			bool result = num2 != _verticalCorrectiveSkew || num != _horizontalCorrectiveSkew;
			_horizontalCorrectiveSkew = num;
			_verticalCorrectiveSkew = num2;
			return result;
		}

		private bool IsTooSkewed(Rect window)
		{
			if (!(window.Width / window.Height > 3.0))
			{
				return window.Height / window.Width > 3.0;
			}
			return true;
		}

		private void DisplayVisibleTiles()
		{
			TileZoomInfo zoomInfo = GetZoomInfo();
			for (int i = 0; i < CurrentTiles.Count; i++)
			{
				AssignTileLocation(zoomInfo, CurrentTiles[i]);
			}
			Dictionary<object, ITileZoomTile> dictionary = new Dictionary<object, ITileZoomTile>();
			foreach (TileZoomTile key in PersistentTiles.Keys)
			{
				dictionary.Add(PersistentTiles[key].Content, PersistentTiles[key]);
			}
			Viewer.View.DisplayZoomTiles(dictionary, NewTiles, 512.0);
		}

		private void AssignTileLocation(TileZoomInfo info, TileZoomTile tile)
		{
			Rect tileWindow = GetTileWindow(tile, info);
			double num = tileWindow.Left * info.ActualWidth;
			double num2 = tileWindow.Top * info.ActualHeight;
			double num3 = tileWindow.Right * info.ActualWidth;
			double num4 = tileWindow.Bottom * info.ActualHeight;
			double num5 = num - info.ActualRect.Left;
			double num6 = num2 - info.ActualRect.Top;
			double num7 = num3 - num;
			double num8 = num4 - num2;
			tile.XPosition = num5 / _horizontalCorrectiveSkew;
			tile.YPosition = num6 / _verticalCorrectiveSkew;
			tile.Width = num7 / _horizontalCorrectiveSkew;
			tile.Height = num8 / _verticalCorrectiveSkew;
		}

		private void ReadyVisibleTiles()
		{
			TileZoomInfo zoomInfo = GetZoomInfo();
			ExistingTiles.Clear();
			for (int i = 0; i < CurrentTiles.Count; i++)
			{
				TileZoomTile tileZoomTile = CurrentTiles[i];
				ExistingTiles.Add(tileZoomTile, tileZoomTile);
			}
			CurrentTiles.Clear();
			PersistentTiles.Clear();
			NewTiles.Clear();
			for (int j = 0; j < VisibleTiles.Count; j++)
			{
				TileZoomTileInfo tileZoomTileInfo = VisibleTiles[j];
				TileZoomTile tileZoomTile2 = TileCache.GetTile(tileZoomTileInfo);
				if (tileZoomTile2 == null)
				{
					tileZoomTile2 = AcquireTile(tileZoomTileInfo, zoomInfo);
					TileCache.AddTile(tileZoomTile2);
				}
				if (ExistingTiles.ContainsKey(tileZoomTile2))
				{
					ExistingTiles.Remove(tileZoomTile2);
					PersistentTiles.Add(tileZoomTile2, tileZoomTile2);
				}
				else
				{
					ActivateTile(tileZoomTile2);
					NewTiles.Add(tileZoomTile2);
				}
				CurrentTiles.Add(tileZoomTile2);
			}
			foreach (TileZoomTile key in ExistingTiles.Keys)
			{
				DeactivateTile(key);
			}
		}

		private void DeactivateTile(TileZoomTile key)
		{
		}

		private void ActivateTile(TileZoomTile tile)
		{
		}

		private TileZoomTile AcquireTile(TileZoomTileInfo tileInfo, TileZoomInfo info)
		{
			TileZoomTile tileZoomTile = CreateTile(tileInfo);
			Rect tileWindow = GetTileWindow(tileZoomTile, info);
			Rect effectiveWindow = GetEffectiveWindow();
			double num = 1.0 / effectiveWindow.Width;
			double num2 = effectiveWindow.Height;
			if (effectiveWindow.Width > effectiveWindow.Height)
			{
				num = effectiveWindow.Width;
				num2 = 1.0 / effectiveWindow.Height;
			}
			double num3 = (tileWindow.Left - effectiveWindow.Left) * num;
			double num4 = (tileWindow.Top - effectiveWindow.Top) * num2;
			double num5 = (tileWindow.Right - effectiveWindow.Left) * num;
			double num6 = (tileWindow.Bottom - effectiveWindow.Top) * num2;
			tileWindow = new Rect(num3, num4, num5 - num3, num6 - num4);
			object content = Viewer.View.AcquireTileContent(tileWindow, tileZoomTile, 512);
			tileZoomTile.Content = content;
			return tileZoomTile;
		}

		private Rect GetEffectiveWindow()
		{
			Rect viewportRect = Viewer.ViewportRect;
			Rect effectiveViewport = Viewer.EffectiveViewport;
			if (effectiveViewport.IsEmpty)
			{
				return new Rect(0.0, 0.0, 1.0, 1.0);
			}
			double num = (effectiveViewport.Left - viewportRect.Left) / viewportRect.Width;
			double num2 = (effectiveViewport.Top - viewportRect.Top) / viewportRect.Height;
			double num3 = (effectiveViewport.Right - viewportRect.Left) / viewportRect.Width;
			double num4 = (effectiveViewport.Bottom - viewportRect.Top) / viewportRect.Height;
			return new Rect(num, num2, num3 - num, num4 - num2);
		}

		private Rect GetTileWindow(TileZoomTile tile, TileZoomInfo info)
		{
			double num = (double)tile.Info.XPosition * 512.0;
			double num2 = (double)tile.Info.YPosition * 512.0;
			double x = num / info.ZoomWidth;
			double y = num2 / info.ZoomHeight;
			double width = 512.0 / info.ZoomWidth;
			double height = 512.0 / info.ZoomHeight;
			return new Rect(x, y, width, height);
		}

		private TileZoomTile CreateTile(TileZoomTileInfo tileInfo)
		{
			int num = 0;
			num = tileID;
			tileID++;
			return new TileZoomTile
			{
				Info = tileInfo,
				ID = num
			};
		}

		private TileZoomInfo GetZoomInfo()
		{
			Rect actualWindow = GetActualWindow(Window);
			int zoomLevel = GetZoomLevel(actualWindow);
			double num = Math.Pow(2.0, zoomLevel) * 512.0;
			double num2 = num;
			double num3 = ActualViewport.Width / TileViewport.Width * num;
			double num4 = ActualViewport.Height / TileViewport.Height * num2;
			double num5 = ActualViewport.Width / actualWindow.Width;
			double num6 = ActualViewport.Height / actualWindow.Height;
			double num7 = actualWindow.Left * num5;
			double num8 = actualWindow.Top * num6;
			double num9 = actualWindow.Right * num5;
			double num10 = actualWindow.Bottom * num6;
			TileZoomInfo tileZoomInfo = new TileZoomInfo();
			tileZoomInfo.ActualRect = new Rect(num7, num8, num9 - num7, num10 - num8);
			Rect windowAtZoom = GetWindowAtZoom(Window, tileZoomInfo.ActualRect, zoomLevel, num5, num6, num3, num4);
			double num11 = windowAtZoom.Left * num3;
			double num12 = windowAtZoom.Top * num4;
			double num13 = windowAtZoom.Right * num3;
			double num14 = windowAtZoom.Bottom * num4;
			tileZoomInfo.ZoomRect = new Rect(num11, num12, num13 - num11, num14 - num12);
			tileZoomInfo.CurrentZoomLevel = zoomLevel;
			tileZoomInfo.ZoomWidth = num3;
			tileZoomInfo.ZoomHeight = num4;
			tileZoomInfo.ActualWidth = num5;
			tileZoomInfo.ActualHeight = num6;
			return tileZoomInfo;
		}

		private Rect GetActualWindow(Rect window)
		{
			return window;
		}

		private Rect GetWindowAtZoom(Rect window, Rect actualRect, int currentZoomLevel, double actualWidth, double actualHeight, double zoomWidth, double zoomHeight)
		{
			double num = (window.Left + window.Right) / 2.0;
			double num2 = (window.Top + window.Bottom) / 2.0;
			double width = window.Width;
			double height = window.Height;
			width = width * actualWidth / zoomWidth;
			height = height * actualHeight / zoomHeight;
			double num3 = width / 2.0;
			double num4 = height / 2.0;
			return new Rect(num - num3, num2 - num4, width, height);
		}

		private void DetermineVisibleTiles()
		{
			TileZoomInfo zoomInfo = GetZoomInfo();
			double num = 512.0 * zoomInfo.ActualWidth / zoomInfo.ZoomWidth;
			double num2 = 512.0 * zoomInfo.ActualHeight / zoomInfo.ZoomHeight;
			int num3 = (int)Math.Floor(zoomInfo.ActualRect.Left / num);
			int num4 = (int)Math.Floor(zoomInfo.ActualRect.Top / num2);
			int num5 = (int)Math.Floor(zoomInfo.ActualRect.Right / num);
			int num6 = (int)Math.Floor(zoomInfo.ActualRect.Bottom / num2);
			VisibleTiles.Clear();
			for (int i = num4; i <= num6; i++)
			{
				for (int j = num3; j <= num5; j++)
				{
					VisibleTiles.Add(new TileZoomTileInfo
					{
						XPosition = j,
						YPosition = i,
						ZoomLevel = zoomInfo.CurrentZoomLevel
					});
				}
			}
		}

		private int GetZoomLevel(Rect window)
		{
			double a = 1.0 / window.Width;
			double a2 = 1.0 / window.Height;
			double val;
			double val2;
			if (RoundDown)
			{
				val = Math.Floor(Math.Log(a, 2.0));
				val2 = Math.Floor(Math.Log(a2, 2.0));
			}
			else
			{
				val = Math.Ceiling(Math.Log(a, 2.0));
				val2 = Math.Ceiling(Math.Log(a2, 2.0));
			}
			return (int)(Math.Min(val, val2) + MinZoomLevel);
		}

		public void ClearTileCache()
		{
			if (_hasContent)
			{
				_hasContent = false;
				Viewer.View.DestroyAllTileContent();
				TileCache.Clear();
			}
		}

		public void Start()
		{
			Running = true;
		}

		public void End()
		{
			Running = false;
			Viewer.View.HideZoomTiles();
		}

		internal void DestroyTile(TileZoomTile tileZoomTile)
		{
			Viewer.View.DestroyTileContent(tileZoomTile);
		}

		internal void ClearVisible()
		{
			CurrentTiles.Clear();
			VisibleTiles.Clear();
			ExistingTiles.Clear();
		}
	}

		public int ZoomLevel { get; set; }

		public int XPosition { get; set; }

		public int YPosition { get; set; }

		public override string ToString()
		{
			return ZoomLevel + "_" + XPosition + "_" + YPosition;
		}
	}
	public class TileZoomTileCache
	{
		private Dictionary<string, TileZoomTile> _cache = new Dictionary<string, TileZoomTile>();

		private LinkedList<TileZoomTile> _mru = new LinkedList<TileZoomTile>();

		private int _maxTiles;

		[Weak]
		private TileZoomManager _owner;

		public TileZoomTileCache(int maxTiles, TileZoomManager owner)
		{
			_maxTiles = maxTiles;
			_owner = owner;
		}

		public void Clear()
		{
			_cache.Clear();
			_mru = new LinkedList<TileZoomTile>();
		}

		public void Touch(TileZoomTile tileZoomTile)
		{
			_mru.Remove(tileZoomTile.Node);
			_mru.AddLast(tileZoomTile);
			tileZoomTile.Node = _mru.Last;
		}

		public void AddTile(TileZoomTile tileZoomTile)
		{
			_mru.AddLast(tileZoomTile);
			_cache.Add(tileZoomTile.Info.ToString(), tileZoomTile);
			tileZoomTile.OwningCache = this;
			tileZoomTile.Node = _mru.Last;
			while (_cache.Count > _maxTiles)
			{
				RemoveTile(_mru.First.Value);
			}
		}

		private void RemoveTile(TileZoomTile tileZoomTile)
		{
			_mru.Remove(tileZoomTile.Node);
			_cache.Remove(tileZoomTile.Info.ToString());
			_owner.DestroyTile(tileZoomTile);
		}

		public TileZoomTile GetTile(TileZoomTileInfo info)
		{
			if (_cache.ContainsKey(info.ToString()))
			{
				TileZoomTile tileZoomTile = _cache[info.ToString()];
				tileZoomTile.Touch();
				return tileZoomTile;
			}
			return null;
		}
	}
	public class TileZoomTile : ITileZoomTile
	{
		public ITileZoomTileInfo Info { get; set; }

		[Weak]
		internal TileZoomTileCache OwningCache { get; set; }

		public LinkedListNode<TileZoomTile> Node { get; set; }

		public object Content { get; set; }

		public double XPosition { get; set; }

		public double Width { get; set; }

		public double YPosition { get; set; }

		public double Height { get; set; }

		public int ID { get; set; }

		public void Touch()
		{
			if (OwningCache != null)
			{
				OwningCache.Touch(this);
			}
		}
	}

		[TSSuppressWidgetMember]
		[SwiftSuppressWidgetMember]
		[JAVASuppressWidgetMember]
		[WidgetHighFrequencyEvent]
		public event PropertyChangedEventHandler PropertyChanged;

		[TSSuppressWidgetMember]
		[SwiftSuppressWidgetMember]
		[JAVASuppressWidgetMember]
		[WidgetHighFrequencyEvent]
		public event PropertyUpdatedEventHandler PropertyUpdated;

		[WidgetHighFrequencyEvent]
		public event EventHandler<RenderRequestedEventArgs> RenderRequested;

		protected internal Series()
		{
			AnnotationFactoryManager.Register();
			InteractivityFactoryManager.Register();
			VisualDataFactoryManager.Register();
			ThumbnailDirty = true;
			ShouldFreezeBrushesCached = true;
			CustomClipRect = Rect.Empty;
			View = CreateView();
			View.Viewport = Rect.Empty;
			OnViewCreated(View);
			View.DuringInit = true;
			View.OnInit();
			View.DuringInit = false;
			base.DefaultStyleKey = typeof(Series);
			SeriesViewer_WindowRectChanged = delegate(object o, RectChangedEventArgs e)
			{
				if (SeriesViewer == null || !SeriesViewer.IgnoreWindowChanges)
				{
					WindowRectChangedOverride(e.OldRect, e.NewRect);
				}
			};
			SeriesViewer_PropertyUpdated = delegate(object o, PropertyUpdatedEventArgs e)
			{
				PropertyUpdatedOverride(o, e.PropertyName, e.OldValue, e.NewValue);
			};
			FastItemsSource_Event = delegate(object o, FastItemsSourceEventArgs e)
			{
				if (SeriesViewer != null)
				{
					ThumbnailDirty = true;
					SeriesViewer.NotifyThumbnailDataChanged();
				}
				DataUpdatedOverride(e.Action, e.Position, e.Count, e.PropertyName);
			};
			PropertyUpdated += delegate(object o, PropertyUpdatedEventArgs e)
			{
				PropertyUpdatedOverride(o, e.PropertyName, e.OldValue, e.NewValue);
			};
			Animator = new DoubleAnimator(0.0, 1.0, (int)TransitionDuration.TotalMilliseconds);
			Animator.PropertyChanged += Animator_PropertyChanged;
			SetBinding(VisibilityProxyProperty, new Binding("Visibility")
			{
				Source = this
			});
			CachedVisibleRangeMode = ResolveVisibleRangeMode();
		}

		}

		}

		internal virtual void UpdateMarkerThickness(double markerThickness)

		}

		protected void Animator_PropertyChanged(object sender, PropertyChangedEventArgs e)
		{
			TransitionProgress = Animator.TransitionProgress;
		}

		protected internal virtual void OnViewCreated(SeriesView view)
		{
		}

		internal void OnSeriesAttached()
		{
			AssertLegendItems(ActualLegend, ActualLegend);
			if (FastItemsSource == null && SyncLink != null && ItemsSource != null)
			{
				FastItemsSource = ((IFastItemsSourceProvider)SyncLink).GetFastItemsSource(ItemsSource);
			}
			View.OnSeriesAttached();
		}

		internal void OnSeriesDetached()
		{
			ClearLegendItems();
			if (FastItemsSource != null && SyncLink != null && ItemsSource != null)
			{
				FastItemsSource = ((IFastItemsSourceProvider)SyncLink).ReleaseFastItemsSource(ItemsSource);
			}
			View.OnSeriesDetached();
		}

			if (IsHighlightingSupported && IsInteractivityLoaded && SeriesViewer != null && (SeriesViewer.LegendHighlightingMode == LegendHighlightingMode.Auto || SeriesViewer.LegendHighlightingMode == LegendHighlightingMode.MatchSeries) && ActualHighlightingMode != SeriesHighlightingMode.None)
			{
				SeriesInteractionManager.ModifyHighlights(this, item, new Point(double.NaN, double.NaN), fromFinger: false, directlyOver: true, leaving: false, item == null, this == SeriesViewer.ClosestSeries, isLeavingPlot: false);

			{

			}
		}

		protected string ResolveMemberPath(string memberPathName)
		{
			if (!_memberPathMap.ContainsKey(memberPathName))
			{
				string value = char.ToUpper(memberPathName[0]) + memberPathName.Substring(1);
				_memberPathMap.Add(memberPathName, value);
			}
			return _memberPathMap[memberPathName];
		}

		protected object GetItemValueByMemberPath(object item, string memberPathName, string memberPathValue)
		{
			FastReflectionHelper fastReflectionHelper = null;
			if (!_helpers.ContainsKey(memberPathName))
			{
				fastReflectionHelper = new FastReflectionHelper(useTraditionalReflection: false, memberPathValue);
				_helpers.Add(memberPathName, fastReflectionHelper);
			}
			else
			{
				fastReflectionHelper = _helpers[memberPathName];
			}
			fastReflectionHelper.PropertyName = memberPathValue;
			return fastReflectionHelper.GetPropertyValue(item);
		}

		public Point ToWorldPosition(Point seriesPoint)
		{
			Rect rect = ((SeriesViewer != null) ? SeriesViewer.ContentViewport : View.Viewport);
			Rect windowRect = View.WindowRect;
			return new Point(windowRect.Left + windowRect.Width * (seriesPoint.X - rect.Left) / rect.Width, windowRect.Top + windowRect.Height * (seriesPoint.Y - rect.Top) / rect.Height);
		}

		public Point FromWorldPosition(Point world)
		{
			Rect rect = ((SeriesViewer != null) ? SeriesViewer.ContentViewport : View.Viewport);
			Rect windowRect = View.WindowRect;
			double x = rect.Left + (world.X - windowRect.Left) / windowRect.Width * rect.Width;
			double y = rect.Top + (world.Y - windowRect.Top) / windowRect.Height * rect.Height;
			return new Point(x, y);
		}

		protected internal virtual object Item(object sender, Point point)
		{
			object obj = View.GetDataContextFromSender(sender)?.Item;
			if (obj == null)
			{
				Point world = ToWorldPosition(point);
				obj = GetItem(world);
			}
			return obj;
		}

		protected AxisRange ExpandRangeForMargin(AxisRange range, NumericAxisBase valueAxis, Rect forWindow)
		{
			EnsureVisibleRangeMargins();
			if (!IsVertical)
			{
				if (ActualVisibleRangeMarginBottom == 0.0 && ActualVisibleRangeMarginTop == 0.0)
				{
					return range;
				}
				ScalerParams scalerParams = new ScalerParams(forWindow, SeriesViewer.ViewportRect, valueAxis.IsInverted, GetEffectiveViewport());
				scalerParams.ReferenceValue = GetReferenceValue();
				double scaledValue = valueAxis.GetScaledValue(range.Minimum, scalerParams);
				double scaledValue2 = valueAxis.GetScaledValue(range.Maximum, scalerParams);
				if (valueAxis.IsInverted)
				{
					scaledValue2 += ActualVisibleRangeMarginBottom;
					scaledValue -= ActualVisibleRangeMarginTop;
				}
				else
				{
					scaledValue2 -= ActualVisibleRangeMarginTop;
					scaledValue += ActualVisibleRangeMarginBottom;
				}
				double unscaledValue = valueAxis.GetUnscaledValue(scaledValue, scalerParams);
				double unscaledValue2 = valueAxis.GetUnscaledValue(scaledValue2, scalerParams);
				return new AxisRange(unscaledValue, unscaledValue2);
			}
			return range;
		}

		protected void EnsureVisibleRangeMargins()
		{
			if (double.IsNaN(ActualVisibleRangeMarginTop))
			{
				ActualVisibleRangeMarginTop = ResolveDesiredAutoMargin().Top;
				if (double.IsNaN(ActualVisibleRangeMarginTop))
				{
					ActualVisibleRangeMarginTop = 0.0;
				}
			}
			if (double.IsNaN(ActualVisibleRangeMarginBottom))
			{
				ActualVisibleRangeMarginBottom = ResolveDesiredAutoMargin().Bottom;
				if (double.IsNaN(ActualVisibleRangeMarginBottom))
				{
					ActualVisibleRangeMarginBottom = 0.0;
				}
			}
			if (double.IsNaN(ActualVisibleRangeMarginLeft))
			{
				ActualVisibleRangeMarginLeft = ResolveDesiredAutoMargin().Left;
				if (double.IsNaN(ActualVisibleRangeMarginLeft))
				{
					ActualVisibleRangeMarginLeft = 0.0;
				}
			}
			if (double.IsNaN(ActualVisibleRangeMarginRight))
			{
				ActualVisibleRangeMarginRight = ResolveDesiredAutoMargin().Right;
				if (double.IsNaN(ActualVisibleRangeMarginRight))
				{
					ActualVisibleRangeMarginRight = 0.0;
				}
			}
		}

		public virtual void RenderSeries([SwiftMutableParameter] bool animate)
		{
			SkipPrepare = false;
			if (SeriesViewer != null)
			{
				SeriesViewer.ChartContentManager.Refresh(ChartContentType.Series, this, ContentInfo, animate);
				if (this.RenderRequested != null)
				{
					RenderRequestedEventArgs e = new RenderRequestedEventArgs();
					e.Animate = animate;
					this.RenderRequested(this, e);
					animate = e.Animate;
				}
			}
		}

		private void DoRenderSeries(bool animate)
		{
			RenderSeriesOverride(animate);
			SkipPrepare = false;
		}

		protected internal virtual void RenderSeriesOverride(bool animate)
		{
			if (TransitionInViableResolved && !ShouldTransitionIn())
			{
				TransitionInViable = false;
			}
		}

		protected void CheckTransitionInterrupted()
		{
			if (TransitionInIsInProgress && !TransitionInViableResolved)
			{
				Animator.IntervalMilliseconds = (int)Math.Max(GetTotalMilliseconds(), GetTotalTransitionInMilliseconds());
				ClearSpeedModifiers();
			}
		}

		{
		}

		[WFSuppressWidgetMember]
		protected internal virtual Rect GetEffectiveViewport(SeriesView view)
		{
			if (SeriesViewer == null)
			{
				return Rect.Empty;
			}
			if (view.IsAlternateView)
			{
				return SeriesViewer.EffectiveViewport;
			}
			if (view.IsThumbnailView)
			{
				if (SeriesViewer.EffectiveViewport.IsEmpty)
				{
					return SeriesViewer.EffectiveViewport;
				}
				return SeriesViewer.GetScaledEffectiveViewport(view.Viewport, SeriesViewer.ViewportRect, SeriesViewer.EffectiveViewport);
			}
			return SeriesViewer.EffectiveViewport;
		}

		internal virtual Rect GetContentViewport(SeriesView view)
		{
			if (SeriesViewer == null || SeriesViewer.ContentViewport.IsEmpty)
			{
				return view.Viewport;
			}
			if (view.IsAlternateView)
			{
				return view.Viewport;
			}
			if (view.IsThumbnailView)
			{
				if (SeriesViewer.EffectiveViewport.IsEmpty)
				{
					return view.Viewport;
				}
				if (SeriesViewer.ContentViewport.Equals(SeriesViewer.ViewportRect))
				{
					return view.Viewport;
				}
				Rect scaledEffectiveViewport = SeriesViewer.GetScaledEffectiveViewport(view.Viewport, SeriesViewer.ViewportRect, SeriesViewer.EffectiveViewport);
				return SeriesViewer.GetCurrentContentViewport(view.Viewport, scaledEffectiveViewport, SeriesViewer.ActualWindowRect);
			}
			return SeriesViewer.ContentViewport;
		}

		[WFSuppressWidgetMember]
		[XamSuppressWidgetMember]
		[UwpSuppressWidgetMember]
		[TSSuppressWidgetMember]
		[SwiftSuppressWidgetMember]
		[JAVASuppressWidgetMember]
		public Rect GetEffectiveViewportForViewport(Rect viewport)
		{
			if (!Viewport.Equals(viewport))
			{
				return Rect.Empty;
			}
			return GetEffectiveViewport();
		}

		[WFSuppressWidgetMember]
		protected internal virtual Rect GetEffectiveViewportForUnitViewport(SeriesView view)
		{
			if (SeriesViewer == null || SeriesViewer.EffectiveViewport.IsEmpty)
			{
				return Rect.Empty;
			}
			Rect effectiveViewport = SeriesViewer.EffectiveViewport;
			Rect viewport = view.Viewport;
			double num = (effectiveViewport.Left - viewport.Left) / viewport.Width;
			double num2 = (effectiveViewport.Top - viewport.Top) / viewport.Height;
			double num3 = (effectiveViewport.Right - viewport.Left) / viewport.Width;
			double num4 = (effectiveViewport.Bottom - viewport.Top) / viewport.Height;
			return new Rect(num, num2, num3 - num, num4 - num2);
		}

		public virtual Rect GetEffectiveViewport()
		{
			return GetEffectiveViewport(View);
		}

		[WFSuppressWidgetMember]
		[JAVASuppressWidgetMember]
		[XamSuppressWidgetMember]
		[UwpSuppressWidgetMember]
		public virtual void RemoveAllAlternateViews()
		{
			RemoveAllAlternateViews(null);
		}

		private void RemoveAllAlternateViews(SeriesViewer oldViewer)
		{
			if (IsInteractivityLoaded)
			{
				SeriesInteractionManager.RemoveAllAlternateViews(this, oldViewer);
			}
		}

		[WFSuppressWidgetMember]
		[JAVASuppressWidgetMember]
		[XamSuppressWidgetMember]
		[UwpSuppressWidgetMember]
		public virtual void RemoveAlternateView(string viewIdentifier)
		{
			if (IsInteractivityLoaded)
			{
				SeriesInteractionManager.RemoveAlternateView(this, viewIdentifier, SeriesViewer);
			}
		}

		protected internal virtual void GetViewInfo(out Rect viewportRect, out Rect windowRect)
		{
			viewportRect = View.Viewport;
			windowRect = View.WindowRect;
		}

		protected internal virtual bool ValidateSeries(Rect viewportRect, Rect windowRect)
		{
			return ValidateSeries(viewportRect, windowRect, View);
		}

		protected internal virtual bool ValidateSeries(Rect viewportRect, Rect windowRect, SeriesView view)
		{
			if (IsFragment)
			{
				return true;
			}
			return base.Visibility == Visibility.Visible;
		}

		protected internal virtual void ClearRendering(bool wipeClean)
		{
			ClearRendering(wipeClean, View);
		}

		protected internal virtual void ClearRendering(bool wipeClean, SeriesView view)
		{
			if (wipeClean)
			{
				ThumbnailDirty = true;
			}
		}

		protected virtual bool ClearAndAbortIfInvalid()
		{
			return ClearAndAbortIfInvalid(View);
		}

		protected internal virtual bool ClearAndAbortIfInvalid(SeriesView view)
		{
			Rect viewport = view.Viewport;
			Rect windowRect = view.WindowRect;
			if (!ValidateSeries(viewport, windowRect, view))
			{
				ClearRendering(wipeClean: true, view);
				return true;
			}
			return false;
		}

		internal virtual void OnViewportChanged(Rect oldViewportRect, Rect newViewportRect)
		{
			View.Viewport = newViewportRect;
			ViewportRectChangedOverride(oldViewportRect, newViewportRect);
			if (SeriesViewer != null)
			{
				SeriesViewer.ChartContentManager.ViewportChanged(ChartContentType.Series, this, ContentInfo, newViewportRect);
			}
		}

		protected virtual void WindowRectChangedOverride(Rect oldWindowRect, Rect newWindowRect)
		{
		}

		protected virtual void ViewportRectChangedOverride(Rect oldViewportRect, Rect newViewportRect)
		{
		}

		protected void ForceIndexUpdate(Series other)
		{
			other.DoUpdateIndexedProperties();
		}

		protected void NotifyThumbnailDataChanged()
		{
			SkipThumbnailPrepare = false;
			ThumbnailDirty = true;
			if (SeriesViewer != null)
			{
				SeriesViewer.NotifyThumbnailDataChanged();
			}
		}

		public virtual void NotifyIndexedPropertiesChanged()
		{
			UpdateIndexedProperties();
			OnVisualPropertiesChanged();
		}

		protected internal void NotifyThumbnailAppearanceChanged()
		{
			SkipThumbnailPrepare = false;
			ThumbnailDirty = true;
			if (SeriesViewer != null)
			{
				SeriesViewer.NotifyThumbnailAppearanceChanged();
			}
		}

		protected virtual void OnIsDropShadowEnabledChanged()
		{
			View.HandleIsDropShadowEnabledChanged();
		}

		public void NotifyVisualPropertiesChanged()
		{
			OnVisualPropertiesChanged();
		}

		protected void OnVisualPropertiesChanged()
		{
			View.OnVisualPropertiesChanged();
			OnVisualPropertiesChangedOverride(immediate: false);
			UpdateLegendItemVisuals();
		}

		protected internal void OnVisualPropertiesChangedImmediate()
		{
			View.OnVisualPropertiesChanged();
			OnVisualPropertiesChangedOverride(immediate: true);
		}

		protected virtual bool RequiresPrepare()
		{
			return false;
		}

		protected virtual void OnVisualPropertiesChangedOverride(bool immediate)
		{
			if (ContentInfo == null || ContentInfo.IsDirty)
			{
				return;
			}
			Rect viewport = View.Viewport;
			Rect windowRect = View.WindowRect;
			bool num = ValidateSeries(viewport, windowRect, View);
			bool flag = SeriesViewer != null && SeriesViewer.IsThumbnailRequired && ThumbnailView != null && ValidateSeries(ThumbnailView.Viewport, ThumbnailView.WindowRect, ThumbnailView);
			if (num)
			{
				if (immediate)
				{
					SkipPrepare = !RequiresPrepare();
					DoRenderSeries(animate: false);
				}
				else
				{
					RenderSeries(animate: false);
					SkipPrepare = !RequiresPrepare();
				}
			}
			if (flag && !ThumbnailDirty)
			{
				NotifyThumbnailAppearanceChanged();
				SkipThumbnailPrepare = true;
			}
		}

		protected virtual void OnIndexChanged()
		{
		}

		protected virtual void PropertyUpdatedOverride(object sender, string propertyName, object oldValue, object newValue)
		{
			switch (propertyName)
			{
			case "SyncLink":
				if (oldValue is SyncLink)
				{
					((SyncLink)oldValue).PropertyUpdated -= SeriesViewer_PropertyUpdated;
					ReleaseItemsSource(oldValue as IFastItemsSourceProvider);
				}
				if (newValue is SyncLink)
				{
					((SyncLink)newValue).PropertyUpdated += SeriesViewer_PropertyUpdated;
					RegisterItemsSource(newValue as IFastItemsSourceProvider);
				}
				if (Index == -1)
				{
					Index = XamDataChart.FindSeriesIndex(this);
				}
				break;
			case "OutlineMode":
				CachedOutlineMode = ResolveOutlineMode();
				UpdateActualThickness();
				DoUpdateIndexedProperties();
				OnVisualPropertiesChanged();
				break;
			case "Brushes":
			case "MarkerOutlines":
			case "MarkerBrushes":
			case "Outlines":
				DoUpdateIndexedProperties();
				break;
			case "HighlightingMode":
				ActualHighlightingMode = GetResolvedHighlightingMode();
				break;
			case "SeriesViewer":
				if (oldValue is SeriesViewer)
				{
					((SeriesViewer)oldValue).WindowRectChanged -= SeriesViewer_WindowRectChanged;
					((SeriesViewer)oldValue).Series.CollectionChanged -= SeriesViewer_SeriesCollectionChanged;
					((SeriesViewer)oldValue).PropertyUpdated -= SeriesViewer_PropertyUpdated;
					((SeriesViewer)oldValue).ChartContentManager.Unsubscribe(ChartContentType.Series, this);
					RemoveAllAlternateViews((SeriesViewer)oldValue);
					View.DetachFromChart((SeriesViewer)oldValue);
				}
				if (newValue is SeriesViewer)
				{
					((SeriesViewer)newValue).WindowRectChanged += SeriesViewer_WindowRectChanged;
					((SeriesViewer)newValue).Series.CollectionChanged += SeriesViewer_SeriesCollectionChanged;
					((SeriesViewer)newValue).PropertyUpdated += SeriesViewer_PropertyUpdated;
					ContentInfo = ((SeriesViewer)newValue).ChartContentManager.Subscribe(ChartContentType.Series, this, DoRenderSeries);
					View.AttachToChart((SeriesViewer)newValue);
					ActualHighlightingMode = GetResolvedHighlightingMode();
					UpdateActualAreaFillOpacity();
				}
				if (SeriesViewer == null)
				{
					Animator.Stop();
				}
				if (Index != -1)
				{
					UpdateIndexedProperties();
				}
				if (Index == -1 || newValue == null)
				{
					Index = XamDataChart.FindSeriesIndex(this);
				}
				ActualLegend = FindActualLegend();
				AssertLegendItems(oldValue as SeriesViewer, newValue as SeriesViewer);
				break;
			case "Title":
				if (View != null)
				{
					View.OnTitlePropertyChanged();
				}
				break;
			case "LegendItemBadgeTemplate":
			case "LegendItemTemplate":
			case "LegendItemBadgeShape":
			case "LegendItemBadgeMode":
				UpdateIndexedProperties();
				OnVisualPropertiesChanged();
				break;
			case "MarkerFillOpacity":
				UpdateActualMarkerFillOpacity();
				break;
			case "ActualMarkerFillOpacity":
			case "Brush":
			case "Outline":
			case "DashArray":
			case "DashCap":
				DoUpdateIndexedProperties();
				OnVisualPropertiesChanged();
				break;
			case "Index":
				if ((int)oldValue != (int)newValue)
				{
					OnIndexChanged();
					CachedOutlineMode = ResolveOutlineMode();
					UpdateActualThickness();
					UpdateActualMarkerFillOpacity();
					DoUpdateIndexedProperties();
					OnVisualPropertiesChanged();
				}
				break;
			case "RadiusX":
			case "RadiusY":
			case "RoundedCornersLocation":
				OnVisualPropertiesChanged();
				break;
			case "AreaFillOpacity":
				UpdateActualAreaFillOpacity();
				OnVisualPropertiesChanged();
				break;
			case "LineJoin":
			case "StartCap":
			case "EndCap":
			case "MiterLimit":
				OnVisualPropertiesChanged();
				break;
			case "IsDropShadowEnabled":
				OnIsDropShadowEnabledChanged();
				break;
			case "ShadowColor":
				View.UpdateShadowColor((Color)newValue);
				break;
			case "ShadowBlur":
				View.UpdateShadowBlur((double)newValue);
				break;
			case "ShadowDepth":
				View.UpdateShadowDepth((double)newValue);
				break;
			case "ShadowDirection":
				View.UpdateShadowDirection((double)newValue);
				break;
			case "ShadowOpacity":
				View.UpdateShadowOpacity((double)newValue);
				break;
			case "Thickness":
				UpdateActualThickness();
				if (LegendItemBadgeMode == LegendItemBadgeMode.MatchSeries)
				{
					UpdateLegendItemVisuals();
				}
				break;
			case "ActualLegendItemBadgeBrush":
			case "ActualLegendItemBadgeOutline":
				OnVisualPropertiesChanged();
				break;
			case "ActualBrush":
			case "ActualOutline":
			case "ActualThickness":
				CachedActualBrush = ActualBrush;
				CachedActualOutline = ActualOutline;
				CachedActualThickness = ActualThickness;
				ActualLegendItemBadgeOutline = ActualOutline;
				ActualLegendItemBadgeBrush = ActualBrush;
				OnVisualPropertiesChanged();
				break;
			case "ItemsSource":
				if (SyncLink != null)
				{
					RegisterItemsSource(SyncLink);
				}
				break;
			case "FastItemsSource":
				if (oldValue != newValue && newValue != null)
				{
					TransitionInViable = true;
				}
				NotifyThumbnailDataChanged();
				if (oldValue is IFastItemsSource)
				{
					((IFastItemsSource)oldValue).Event -= FastItemsSource_Event;
				}
				if (newValue is IFastItemsSource)
				{
					((IFastItemsSource)newValue).Event += FastItemsSource_Event;
				}
				break;
			case "Legend":
				if (newValue != null)
				{
					if (sender == this)
					{
						((LegendBase)newValue).SeriesOwner = this;
					}
					else if (sender is XamDataChart)
					{
						((LegendBase)newValue).ChartOwner = (ILegendOwner)sender;
					}
				}
				ActualLegend = FindActualLegend();
				break;
			case "ActualLegend":
				AssertLegendItems(oldValue as LegendBase, newValue as LegendBase);
				break;
			case "LegendItem":
				AssertLegendItems(oldValue as Control, newValue as Control);
				break;
			case "LegendItemVisibility":
				View.OnLegendItemVisibilityChanged();
				break;
			case "ToolTip":
				if (_seriesInteractionManager != null)
				{
					SeriesInteractionManager.UpdateToolTipValue(this, ToolTip);
				}
				break;
			case "CrosshairPoint":
				if (SeriesViewer != null)
				{
					UpdateProximityHighlights(SeriesViewer.CrosshairPoint);
				}
				if (SeriesViewer != null && !DisableCursorEvents)
				{
					SeriesViewer.RaiseSeriesCursorMouseMove(this, GetItem(SeriesViewer.CrosshairPoint));
				}
				break;
			case "Resolution":
				RenderSeries(animate: false);
				NotifyThumbnailAppearanceChanged();
				break;
			case "VisibleRangeMarginTop":
				ActualVisibleRangeMarginTop = VisibleRangeMarginTop;
				if (SeriesViewer != null)
				{
					SeriesViewer.InvalidateVisibleRangeSync();
				}
				break;
			case "VisibleRangeMarginBottom":
				ActualVisibleRangeMarginBottom = VisibleRangeMarginBottom;
				if (SeriesViewer != null)
				{
					SeriesViewer.InvalidateVisibleRangeSync();
				}
				break;
			case "TransitionDuration":
			case "TransitionEasingFunction":
				Animator.Stop();
				Animator.IntervalMilliseconds = (int)TransitionDuration.TotalMilliseconds;
				Animator.EasingFunction = TransitionEasingFunction;
				RenderSeries(animate: false);
				break;
			case "DiscreteLegendItemTemplate":
				RenderSeries(animate: false);
				break;
			case "VisibilityProxy":
				if (oldValue != newValue)
				{
					RenderSeries(animate: false);
				}
				NotifyThumbnailAppearanceChanged();
				View.VisibilityChanged();
				break;
			case "IsHighlightingEnabled":
				ActualHighlightingMode = GetResolvedHighlightingMode();
				RenderSeries(animate: false);
				break;
			case "HighlightingFadeOpacity":
				ActualHighlightingFadeOpacity = (double.IsNaN(HighlightingFadeOpacity) ? 0.2 : HighlightingFadeOpacity);
				break;
			case "ShouldFreezeBrushes":
				ShouldFreezeBrushesCached = ShouldFreezeBrushes;
				UpdateIndexedProperties();
				break;
			case "ShowDefaultTooltip":
				UpdateShowDefaultTooltip();
				break;
			case "FinalValue":
				UpdatePercentChange();
				break;
			case "VisibleRangeMode":
				CachedVisibleRangeMode = ResolveVisibleRangeMode();
				break;
			}
		}

		protected void UpdateActualThickness()
		{
			SeriesOutlineMode cachedOutlineMode = CachedOutlineMode;
			double num = Thickness;
			if (double.IsNaN(num))
			{
				num = DeviceUtils.ToPixelUnits(2.0);
			}
			if (cachedOutlineMode == SeriesOutlineMode.Collapsed)
			{
				num = 1.0;
			}
			if (ActualThickness != num)
			{
				ActualThickness = num;
			}
			CachedActualThickness = ActualThickness;
		}

		protected internal void UpdateProximityHighlights(Point crosshairPoint)
		{
			if (SeriesViewer != null && SeriesViewer.IsInteractivityLoaded && ActualHighlightingMode != SeriesHighlightingMode.None && SeriesViewer.IsHighlightingProximity)
			{
				if (double.IsNaN(crosshairPoint.X) || double.IsNaN(crosshairPoint.Y))
				{
					SeriesInteractionManager.ModifyHighlights(this, null, crosshairPoint, fromFinger: false, directlyOver: false, leaving: false, forceFullRange: false, SeriesViewer.ClosestSeries == this, isLeavingPlot: true);
				}
				else
				{
					SeriesInteractionManager.ModifyHighlights(this, GetItem(crosshairPoint), crosshairPoint, fromFinger: false, directlyOver: false, leaving: false, forceFullRange: false, SeriesViewer.ClosestSeries == this, isLeavingPlot: false);
				}
			}
		}

		protected virtual void DisableCursorEventsForSeries(Series series)
		{
			series.DisableCursorEvents = true;
		}

		protected virtual void DataUpdatedOverride(FastItemsSourceEventAction action, int position, int count, string propertyName)
		{
			if (SeriesViewer != null)
			{
				SeriesViewer.RaiseSeriesDataUpdated();
			}
		}

		internal object ProvideLegendItem()
		{
			return GetLegendItem();
		}

		protected virtual Control GetLegendItem()
		{
			ContentControl contentControl = _legendItem as ContentControl;
			DataTemplate legendItemTemplate = LegendItemTemplate;
			if (legendItemTemplate != null)
			{
				if (contentControl == null)
				{
					contentControl = new ContentControl();
					contentControl.SetBinding(UIElement.VisibilityProperty, new Binding("LegendItemVisibility")
					{
						Source = this
					});
				}
				contentControl.Content = new DataContext
				{
					Series = this,
					Item = null
				};
				contentControl.ContentTemplate = legendItemTemplate;
			}
			else
			{
				contentControl = null;
			}
			return contentControl;
		}

		private DataTemplate GetActualLegendItemBadgeTemplate()
		{
			if (LegendItemBadgeTemplate == null)
			{
				ActualLegendItemBadgeShape actualLegendItemBadgeShape = GetActualLegendItemBadgeShape();
				LegendItemBadgeMode legendItemBadgeMode = LegendItemBadgeMode;
				return LegendTemplatesDictionary.GetTemplate(actualLegendItemBadgeShape, legendItemBadgeMode);
			}
			return LegendItemBadgeTemplate;
		}

		internal void UpdateSeriesIndexedPropertiesInternal()
		{
			UpdateIndexedProperties();
		}

		protected internal void DoUpdateIndexedProperties()
		{
			UpdateIndexedProperties();
		}

		protected virtual void UpdateIndexedProperties()
		{
			NotifyThumbnailAppearanceChanged();
			if (Index >= 0)
			{
				if (Brush != null)
				{
					View.ResetActualBrush();
					View.BindActualToUserBrush();
				}
				else
				{
					ActualBrush = ((SeriesViewer == null) ? null : SeriesViewer.GetBrushByIndex(Index));
				}
				if (CachedOutlineMode == SeriesOutlineMode.Collapsed)
				{
					View.ResetActualOutlineBrush();
					ActualOutline = ActualBrush;
				}
				else if (Outline != null)
				{
					View.ResetActualOutlineBrush();
					View.BindActualToUserOutline();
				}
				else
				{
					ActualOutline = ((SeriesViewer == null) ? null : SeriesViewer.GetOutlineByIndex(Index));
				}
				if ((IsScatter || IsGeographic) && IsPolyline)
				{
					ActualBrush = ActualOutline;
				}
				else if ((IsScatter || IsGeographic) && IsArea)
				{
					ActualOutline = ActualBrush;
				}
				else if ((IsScatter || IsGeographic) && IsLineContour)
				{
					ActualOutline = ActualBrush;
				}
				else if (IsTile && LegendItemBadgeShape == LegendItemBadgeShape.Line)
				{
					ActualBrush = ActualOutline;
				}
			}
		}

		internal bool AnimationActive()
		{
			return Animator.AnimationActive();
		}

		internal void StartAnimation()
		{
			Animator.Start();
		}

		protected SeriesHighlightingMode GetResolvedHighlightingMode()
		{
			if (!IsHighlightingSupported)
			{
				return SeriesHighlightingMode.None;
			}
			if (SeriesViewer != null && SeriesViewer.HighlightingMode != SeriesHighlightingMode.None && SeriesViewer.HighlightingMode != SeriesHighlightingMode.Auto && !IsComponentHighlightingModeIgnored)
			{
				return SeriesViewer.HighlightingMode;
			}
			if (IsHighlightingEnabled)
			{
				return SeriesHighlightingMode.BrightenSpecific;
			}
			return SeriesHighlightingMode.None;
		}

		protected bool IsSpecificHighlightingMode(SeriesHighlightingMode mode)
		{
			if (mode == SeriesHighlightingMode.BrightenSpecific || mode == SeriesHighlightingMode.FadeOthersSpecific)
			{
				return true;
			}
			return false;
		}

		protected internal virtual void UpdateActualAreaFillOpacity()
		{
			if (SeriesViewer is XamDataChart xamDataChart)
			{
				ActualAreaFillOpacity = (double.IsNaN(AreaFillOpacity) ? xamDataChart.ChartView.DefaultAreaFillOpacity : AreaFillOpacity);
			}
		}

		protected internal virtual void UpdateActualMarkerFillOpacity()
		{
			ActualMarkerFillOpacity = (double.IsNaN(MarkerFillOpacity) ? ResolveDefaultMarkerFillOpacity() : MarkerFillOpacity);
		}

		protected virtual double ResolveDefaultMarkerFillOpacity()
		{
			return 1.0;
		}

		protected internal virtual SeriesVisibleRangeMode ResolveVisibleRangeMode()
		{
			if (VisibleRangeMode == SeriesVisibleRangeMode.Auto)
			{
				return SeriesVisibleRangeMode.ValuesOnly;
			}
			return VisibleRangeMode;
		}

		protected internal virtual SeriesOutlineMode ResolveOutlineMode()
		{
			if (OutlineMode == SeriesOutlineMode.Auto)
			{
				return SeriesOutlineMode.Visible;
			}
			return OutlineMode;
		}

		public void UpdateShowDefaultTooltip()
		{
			if (ToolTip != null && ShowDefaultTooltip)
			{
				_isDefaultToolTipSelected = true;
			}
			else if (ToolTip != null)
			{
				_isDefaultToolTipSelected = false;
			}
			if (ToolTip == null && ShowDefaultTooltip)
			{
				ResourceDictionary resourceDictionary = null;
				try
				{
					Uri source = CoreUtilities.BuildEmbeddedResourceUri(typeof(XamDataChart).Assembly, "themes/TooltipTemplates.xaml");
					resourceDictionary = new ResourceDictionary
					{
						Source = source
					};
				}
				catch
				{
				}
				if (resourceDictionary != null)
				{
					if (_defaultTooltipContentControl == null)
					{
						_defaultTooltipContentControl = new ContentControl();
						_defaultTooltipContentControl.ContentTemplate = (DataTemplate)resourceDictionary[DefaultTooltipTemplateName];
						_defaultTooltipContentControl.SetBinding(ContentControl.ContentProperty, new Binding());
					}
					ToolTip = _defaultTooltipContentControl;
					_isDefaultToolTipSelected = true;
				}
			}
			else if (!ShowDefaultTooltip && ToolTip == _defaultTooltipContentControl)
			{
				ToolTip = null;
				_isDefaultToolTipSelected = false;
			}
		}

		internal virtual DataContext GetTooltipContext(object item)
		{
			return new DataContext
			{
				Series = this,
				Item = item
			};
		}

		[SuppressWidgetMember]
		public static IEnumerable<double> ToEnumerableRange(Func<int, double> expression, int start, int length)
		{
			for (int i = start; i < length; i++)
			{
				yield return expression(i);
			}

		private void AssertLegendItems(SeriesViewer oldChart, SeriesViewer newChart)
		{
			if (ActualLegend != null && LegendItem != null)
			{
				if (newChart == null && ActualLegend.ContainsChild(LegendItem))
				{
					ActualLegend.RemoveChild(LegendItem);
				}
				if (newChart != null && !ActualLegend.ContainsChild(LegendItem))
				{
					ActualLegend.AddChildInOrder(LegendItem, this);
				}
			}
		}

		private void ClearLegendItems()
		{
			if (ActualLegend != null && LegendItem != null)
			{
				ActualLegend.RemoveChild(LegendItem);
			}
		}

		internal void AssertLegendItems(LegendBase oldLegend, LegendBase newLegend)
		{
			if (LegendItem != null)
			{
				if (oldLegend != null && oldLegend.ContainsChild(LegendItem))
				{
					oldLegend.RemoveChild(LegendItem);
				}
				if (SeriesViewer != null && newLegend != null && !newLegend.ContainsChild(LegendItem))
				{
					newLegend.AddChildInOrder(LegendItem, this);
				}
			}
		}

		private void AssertLegendItems(Control oldItem, Control newItem)
		{
			if (ActualLegend != null)
			{
				if (oldItem != null && ActualLegend.ContainsChild(oldItem))
				{
					ActualLegend.RemoveChild(oldItem);
				}
				if (SeriesViewer != null && newItem != null)
				{
					ActualLegend.AddChildInOrder(newItem, this);
				}
			}
		}

		internal virtual bool ShouldAnimate(bool animate)
		{
			if ((!animate || !(GetTotalMilliseconds() > 0.0)) && !AnimationActive())
			{
				if (TransitionInViableResolved && ShouldTransitionIn())
				{
					return GetTotalTransitionInMilliseconds() > 0.0;
				}
				return false;
			}
			return true;
		}

		protected internal virtual double GetReferenceValue()
		{
			return double.NaN;
		}

		internal static double GetReferenceValue(IList<double> column, ISortingAxis sortingAxis)
		{
			if (column == null || column.Count == 0)
			{
				return double.NaN;
			}
			if (sortingAxis != null && sortingAxis.SortedIndices != null)
			{
				if (sortingAxis.SortedIndices.Count != column.Count)
				{
					return double.NaN;
				}
				for (int i = 0; i < column.Count; i++)
				{
					if (!double.IsNaN(column[sortingAxis.SortedIndices[i]]) && column[sortingAxis.SortedIndices[i]] != 0.0)
					{
						return column[sortingAxis.SortedIndices[i]];
					}
				}
			}
			for (int j = 0; j < column.Count; j++)
			{
				if (!double.IsNaN(column[j]) && column[j] != 0.0)
				{
					return column[j];
				}
			}
			return double.NaN;
		}

		protected internal virtual void OnBeforeContentRefresh()
		{
		}

		protected void UpdatePercentChange()
		{
			double referenceValue = GetReferenceValue();
			PercentChange = (FinalValue - referenceValue) / referenceValue * 100.0;
		}

		protected void UpdateLegendItemVisuals()
		{
			ActualLegendItemBadgeTemplate = GetActualLegendItemBadgeTemplate();
		}

		internal ActualLegendItemBadgeShape GetActualLegendItemBadgeShape()
		{
			LegendItemBadgeShape legendItemBadgeShape = LegendItemBadgeShape;
			if (legendItemBadgeShape == LegendItemBadgeShape.Automatic)
			{
				legendItemBadgeShape = ResolveAutomaticLegendItemBadgeShape();
			}
			ActualLegendItemBadgeShape result = ActualLegendItemBadgeShape.CircleShape;
			switch (legendItemBadgeShape)
			{
			case LegendItemBadgeShape.Square:
				result = ((!IsFinancialSeries && !IsFinancialOverlay && !IsWaterfall) ? ((!IsFinancialIndicator) ? ActualLegendItemBadgeShape.SquareShape : ActualLegendItemBadgeShape.SquareIndicator) : ActualLegendItemBadgeShape.SquareFinancial);
				break;
			case LegendItemBadgeShape.Marker:
				result = (HasMarkers ? ActualLegendItemBadgeShape.MarkerShape : ActualLegendItemBadgeShape.CircleShape);
				break;
			case LegendItemBadgeShape.Line:
				result = ((HasMarkers && !IsAnnotationLayer) ? ActualLegendItemBadgeShape.LineWithMarker : ActualLegendItemBadgeShape.LineMarkerless);
				break;
			case LegendItemBadgeShape.Circle:
				result = ActualLegendItemBadgeShape.CircleShape;
				break;
			case LegendItemBadgeShape.Bar:
				result = ActualLegendItemBadgeShape.BarShape;
				break;
			case LegendItemBadgeShape.Column:
				result = ActualLegendItemBadgeShape.ColumnShape;
				break;
			case LegendItemBadgeShape.Hidden:
				result = ActualLegendItemBadgeShape.HiddenShape;
				break;
			}
			return result;
		}

		protected virtual LegendItemBadgeShape GetActualLegendBadgeOverride(LegendItemBadgeShape resolvedLegendItemBadgeShape)
		{
			return resolvedLegendItemBadgeShape;
		}

		private LegendItemBadgeShape ResolveAutomaticLegendItemBadgeShape()
		{
			if (IsArea || IsBar || IsColumn || IsPolygon || IsShapeControl || IsFinancialSeries || IsFinancialIndicator || IsFinancialOverlay || IsTile || IsWaterfall)
			{
				return GetActualLegendBadgeOverride(LegendItemBadgeShape.Square);
			}
			if (IsLineOnly || IsSpline || IsPolyline || IsLineContour || IsValueOverlay)
			{
				return GetActualLegendBadgeOverride(LegendItemBadgeShape.Line);
			}
			if (IsAnnotationLayer || IsPixel || IsPie)
			{
				return GetActualLegendBadgeOverride(LegendItemBadgeShape.Circle);
			}
			if (HasOnlyMarkers)
			{
				return GetActualLegendBadgeOverride(LegendItemBadgeShape.Marker);
			}
			return GetActualLegendBadgeOverride(LegendItemBadgeShape.Circle);
		}
	}
	[DontHide]
	[XamWidget]
	[UwpWidget]
	[HybridJavaWidget]
	[WFWidget]
	internal enum ActualLegendItemBadgeShape
	{
		CircleShape,
		LineWithMarker,
		LineMarkerless,
		BarShape,
		ColumnShape,
		SquareShape,
		SquareFinancial,
		SquareIndicator,
		MarkerShape,
		HiddenShape
	}
	public class LegendTemplatesDictionary : ResourceDictionary
	{
		private static ResourceDictionary _Instance;

		public static ResourceDictionary Instance
		{
			get
			{
				if (_Instance == null)
				{
					_Instance = Create();
				}
				return _Instance;
			}
		}

		public static DataTemplate GetTemplate(string templateName)
		{
			return Instance[templateName] as DataTemplate;
		}

		internal static DataTemplate GetTemplate(ActualLegendItemBadgeShape badgeShape, LegendItemBadgeMode badgeMode)
		{
			string text = "LegendBadgeTemplate";
			text = text + "_" + badgeShape;
			text = text + "_" + badgeMode;
			DataTemplate dataTemplate = null;
			try
			{
				return Instance[text] as DataTemplate;
			}
			catch (Exception innerException)
			{
				throw new Exception("LegendTemplates.xaml is missing: " + text, innerException);
			}
		}

		private static ResourceDictionary Create()
		{
			ResourceDictionary resourceDictionary = new ResourceDictionary();
			try
			{
				Uri source = CoreUtilities.BuildEmbeddedResourceUri(typeof(XamDataChart).Assembly, "themes/LegendTemplates.xaml");
				resourceDictionary.Source = source;
			}
			catch
			{
			}
			return resourceDictionary;
		}

		public LegendTemplatesDictionary()
		{
			base.Source = Instance.Source;
		}
	}

	[EditorBrowsable(EditorBrowsableState.Never)]
	public class AnnotationLayerView : SeriesView
	{
		private DispatcherTimer _timer = new DispatcherTimer
		{
			Interval = TimeSpan.FromMilliseconds(300.0)
		};

		private bool _clearDeferred;

		protected AnnotationLayer AnnotationModel { get; set; }

		public AnnotationLayerView(AnnotationLayer model)
			: base(model)
		{
			AnnotationModel = model;
			_timer.Tick += _timer_Tick;
		}

		private void _timer_Tick(object sender, EventArgs e)
		{
			if (_clearDeferred)
			{
				_clearDeferred = false;
				AnnotationModel.CurrentPosition = new Point(double.NaN, double.NaN);
				AnnotationModel.RenderSeries(animate: true);
			}
			_timer.Stop();
		}

		public void DeferPositionClear()
		{
			_clearDeferred = true;
			_timer.Start();
		}

		internal void ResetDeferredClear()
		{
			if (_clearDeferred)
			{
				_clearDeferred = false;
				_timer.Stop();
			}
		}

		public void OnRenderingFrame()
		{
		}
	}
	[EditorBrowsable(EditorBrowsableState.Never)]
	public class CategoryHighlightLayerView : AnnotationLayerView
	{
		private Canvas _rectCanvas = new Canvas
		{
			UseLayoutRounding = false
		};

		protected CategoryHighlightLayer HighlightModel { get; set; }

		protected internal Pool<Rectangle> RectPool { get; set; }

		public CategoryHighlightLayerView(CategoryHighlightLayer model)
			: base(model)
		{
			HighlightModel = model;
		}

		public override void OnInit()
		{
			base.OnInit();
			RectPool = new Pool<Rectangle>
			{
				Create = RectCreate,
				Activate = RectActivate,
				Disactivate = RectDisactivate,
				Destroy = RectDestroy
			};
		}

		protected internal override void OnTemplateProvided()
		{
			base.OnTemplateProvided();
			if (_rectCanvas != null)
			{
				_rectCanvas.Detach();
			}
			base.RootCanvas.Children.Add(_rectCanvas);
		}

		private Rectangle RectCreate()
		{
			Rectangle rectangle = new Rectangle();
			rectangle.IsHitTestVisible = false;
			_rectCanvas.Children.Add(rectangle);
			return rectangle;
		}

		private void RectActivate(Rectangle rect)
		{
			rect.Visibility = Visibility.Visible;
		}

		private void RectDisactivate(Rectangle rect)
		{
			rect.Visibility = Visibility.Collapsed;
		}

		private void RectDestroy(Rectangle rect)
		{
			_rectCanvas.Children.Remove(rect);
		}

		public Brush GetLightenedBrush(Brush brush)
		{
			return brush.GetLightened(0.1);
		}

		public Brush GetLightenedTranslucentBrush(Brush brush)
		{
			if (brush != null)
			{
				Brush lightened = brush.GetLightened(0.3);
				lightened.Opacity = 0.2;
				return lightened;
			}
			return null;
		}

		public void PositionRectangle(Rectangle rectVisual, double left, double top, double width, double height)
		{
			rectVisual.Visibility = Visibility.Visible;
			Canvas.SetLeft(rectVisual, left);
			Canvas.SetTop(rectVisual, top);
			rectVisual.Width = width;
			rectVisual.Height = height;
		}

		protected internal override void ExportViewShapes(object svd)
		{
			base.ExportViewShapes(svd);
			for (int i = 0; i < _rectCanvas.Children.Count; i++)
			{
				if (_rectCanvas.Children[i].Visibility == Visibility.Visible)
				{
					Model.SeriesVisualDataManager.ExportRectangleData(svd, (Rectangle)_rectCanvas.Children[i], "cihRect", new string[2] { "Main", "categoryItemHighlight" });
				}
			}
		}
	}

		}

		private void RectDestroy(Rectangle rect)
		{
			_rectCanvas.Children.Remove(rect);
		}

		private ContentControl MarkerCreate()
		{
			ContentControl contentControl = new ContentControl();
			contentControl.IsHitTestVisible = false;
			_markerCanvas.Children.Add(contentControl);
			return contentControl;
		}

		private void MarkerActivate(ContentControl marker)
		{
			marker.Visibility = Visibility.Visible;
		}

		private void MarkerDisactivate(ContentControl marker)
		{
			marker.Visibility = Visibility.Collapsed;
		}

		private void MarkerDestroy(ContentControl marker)
		{
			_markerCanvas.Children.Remove(marker);
		}

		public Brush GetLightenedBrush(Brush brush)
		{
			return brush?.GetLightened(0.3);
		}

		public Brush GetLightenedTranslucentBrush(Brush brush)
		{
			if (brush != null)
			{
				Brush lightened = brush.GetLightened(0.3);
				lightened.Opacity = 0.3;
				return lightened;
			}
			return null;
		}

		internal void PositionRectangle(Rectangle rectVisual, double left, double top, double width, double height)
		{
			rectVisual.Visibility = Visibility.Visible;
			Canvas.SetLeft(rectVisual, left);
			Canvas.SetTop(rectVisual, top);
			rectVisual.Width = width;
			rectVisual.Height = height;
		}

		internal void PositionMarker(ContentControl markerVisual, double x, double y)
		{
			markerVisual.Measure(new Size(double.PositiveInfinity, double.PositiveInfinity));
			double num = 0.0 - 0.5 * markerVisual.DesiredSize.Width;
			double num2 = 0.0 - 0.5 * markerVisual.DesiredSize.Height;
			Canvas.SetLeft(markerVisual, x + num);
			Canvas.SetTop(markerVisual, y + num2);
		}

		protected internal override void ExportViewShapes(object svd)
		{
			base.ExportViewShapes(svd);
			for (int i = 0; i < _rectCanvas.Children.Count; i++)
			{
				if (_rectCanvas.Children[i].Visibility == Visibility.Visible)
				{
					Model.SeriesVisualDataManager.ExportRectangleData(svd, (Rectangle)_rectCanvas.Children[i], "cihRect", new string[2] { "Main", "categoryItemHighlight" });
				}
			}
			for (int j = 0; j < _markerCanvas.Children.Count; j++)
			{
				if (_markerCanvas.Children[j].Visibility == Visibility.Visible)
				{
					Model.SeriesVisualDataManager.ExportMarkerVisualDataFromMarker(Model, svd, _markerCanvas.Children[j] as ContentControl);
				}
			}
		}
	}

		public CategoryToolTipLayer()
		{
			CategoryToolTipLayerFrame previousFrame = new CategoryToolTipLayerFrame();
			CategoryToolTipLayerFrame currentFrame = new CategoryToolTipLayerFrame();
			CategoryToolTipLayerFrame transitionFrame = new CategoryToolTipLayerFrame();
