			base.OnViewCreated(view);
			CategoryToolTipView = (CategoryToolTipLayerView)view;
		}

		protected override void PropertyUpdatedOverride(object sender, string propertyName, object oldValue, object newValue)
		{
			base.PropertyUpdatedOverride(sender, propertyName, oldValue, newValue);
			switch (propertyName)
			{
			case "TargetAxis":
				RenderSeries(animate: true);
				break;
			case "UseInterpolation":
				RenderSeries(animate: true);
				break;
			case "ToolTipStyle":
				RenderSeries(animate: true);
				break;
			case "PointerToolTipStyle":
				RenderSeries(animate: true);
				break;
			case "ToolTipPosition":
				RenderSeries(animate: true);
				break;
			case "SeriesViewer":
				CategoryToolTipView.OnSeriesViewerChanged();
				break;
			}
		}

		protected override void OnDependentAxisRender(Axis axis, bool animate)
		{
			if (TargetAxis == axis && !base.ContentInfo.IsDirty)
			{
				RenderSeries(animate);
			}
		}

		protected override void OnDependentSeriesRender(Series series, bool animate)
		{
			if (!base.ContentInfo.IsDirty)
			{
				RenderSeries(animate);
			}
		}

		protected override void PrepareFrame(Frame frame, SeriesView view)
		{
			base.PrepareFrame(frame, view);
			CategoryToolTipLayerFrame categoryToolTipLayerFrame = (CategoryToolTipLayerFrame)frame;
			bool useInterpolation = UseInterpolation;
			categoryToolTipLayerFrame.TooltipYCoord = double.NaN;
			categoryToolTipLayerFrame.TooltipXCoord = double.NaN;
			categoryToolTipLayerFrame.PointerPositionXCoord = double.NaN;
			categoryToolTipLayerFrame.PointerPositionYCoord = double.NaN;
			categoryToolTipLayerFrame.TooltipXCoord = double.NaN;
			categoryToolTipLayerFrame.TooltipYCoord = double.NaN;
			if (double.IsNaN(CurrentPosition.X) && double.IsNaN(CurrentPosition.Y))
			{
				CategoryToolTipView.HideContainer(CategoryToolTipView.GetContainer());
			}
			else if (TargetAxis != null)
			{
				Axis targetAxis = TargetAxis;
				if (targetAxis != null && targetAxis.IsCategory && !targetAxis.IsAngular && targetAxis.IsValid())
				{
					CategoryAxisBase categoryAxisBase = (CategoryAxisBase)targetAxis;
					CategoryTooltipSeriesInfo seriesInfo = GetSeriesInfo(categoryAxisBase.Series, useInterpolation);
					PrepareSeries(seriesInfo, categoryToolTipLayerFrame, useInterpolation);
				}
			}
			else
			{
				if (!(base.SeriesViewer is XamDataChart))
				{
					return;
				}
				XamDataChart obj = (XamDataChart)base.SeriesViewer;
				bool flag = true;
				bool flag2 = false;
				List<Series> list = new List<Series>();
				foreach (Axis axis in obj.Axes)
				{
					if (!axis.IsCategory || axis.IsAngular || !axis.IsValid())
					{
						continue;
					}
					if (flag)
					{
						flag = false;
						flag2 = axis.IsVertical;
					}
					else if (axis.IsVertical != flag2)
					{
						continue;
					}
					foreach (Series item in axis.Series)
					{
						list.Add(item);
					}
				}
				CategoryTooltipSeriesInfo seriesInfo2 = GetSeriesInfo(list, useInterpolation);
				PrepareSeries(seriesInfo2, categoryToolTipLayerFrame, useInterpolation);
			}
		}

		private CategoryTooltipSeriesInfo GetSeriesInfo(IList<Series> series, bool useInterpolation)
		{
			double num = double.MaxValue;
			double num2 = double.MinValue;
			List<DataContext> list = new List<DataContext>();
			List<object> list2 = new List<object>();
			bool flag = false;
			bool flag2 = true;
			for (int i = 0; i < series.Count; i++)
			{
				Series series2 = series[i];
				if ((!series2.IsFinancial && !series2.IsCategory) || series2.IsStacked || !((IHasCategoryAxis)series2).CategoryAxis.IsValid())
				{
					continue;
				}
				if (flag2)
				{
					flag = series2.IsVertical;
				}
				else if (flag != series2.IsVertical)
				{
					continue;
				}
				Tuple<bool, Point> categoryPosition = GetCategoryPosition(series2);
				if (!categoryPosition.Item1)
				{
					continue;
				}
				Point seriesValuePosition = series2.GetSeriesValuePosition(categoryPosition.Item2, useInterpolation, skipUnknowns: false);
				if (flag)
				{
					if (!double.IsNaN(seriesValuePosition.Y))
					{
						num = Math.Min(num, seriesValuePosition.Y);
						num2 = Math.Max(num2, seriesValuePosition.Y);
					}
				}
				else if (!double.IsNaN(seriesValuePosition.X))
				{
					num = Math.Min(num, seriesValuePosition.X);
					num2 = Math.Max(num2, seriesValuePosition.X);
				}
				object tooltipObject = GetTooltipObject(series2);
				if (tooltipObject != null)
				{
					DataContext dataContext = null;
					object item = series2.GetItem(CurrentPosition);
					if (series2.IsDefaultToolTipSelected && item != null)
					{
						dataContext = series2.GetTooltipContext(item);
					}
					else
					{
						dataContext = new DataContext();
						dataContext.Item = item;
						dataContext.Series = series2;
					}
					list.Add(dataContext);
					list2.Add(tooltipObject);
				}
			}
			double num3 = 0.0;
			double num4 = 0.0;
			if (flag)
			{
				num4 = (num + num2) / 2.0;
				num3 = base.Viewport.Right;
				if (ToolTipPosition == CategoryTooltipLayerPosition.InsideStart || ToolTipPosition == CategoryTooltipLayerPosition.OutsideStart)
				{
					num3 = base.Viewport.Left;
				}
				if (num4 < 0.0 || num4 > base.Viewport.Bottom)
				{
					num4 = double.NaN;
				}
			}
			else
			{
				num3 = (num + num2) / 2.0;
				num4 = base.Viewport.Top;
				if (ToolTipPosition == CategoryTooltipLayerPosition.InsideStart || ToolTipPosition == CategoryTooltipLayerPosition.OutsideStart)
				{
					num4 = base.Viewport.Bottom;
				}
				if (num3 < 0.0 || num3 > base.Viewport.Right)
				{
					num3 = double.NaN;
				}
			}
			return new CategoryTooltipSeriesInfo
			{
				Position = new Point(num3, num4),
				DataContexts = list,
				TooltipObjects = list2
			};
		}

		public override void HideToolTips()
		{
			CurrentPosition = new Point(double.NaN, double.NaN);
			base.View.HideTooltip();
		}

		private void PrepareSeries(CategoryTooltipSeriesInfo seriesInfo, CategoryToolTipLayerFrame f, bool useInterpolation)
		{
			Point position = seriesInfo.Position;
			List<DataContext> dataContexts = seriesInfo.DataContexts;
			List<object> tooltipObjects = seriesInfo.TooltipObjects;
			position = CategoryToolTipView.RelativeToAbsolute(position);
			int num = 0;
			_ = base.View.Viewport;
			object container = CategoryToolTipView.GetContainer();
			CategoryToolTipView.ClearTooltipContent();
			bool flag = false;
			if (dataContexts.Count == 0)
			{
				base.View.HideTooltip();
				return;
			}
			bool flag2 = false;
			for (int i = 0; i < dataContexts.Count; i++)
			{
				Series series = (Series)dataContexts[i].Series;
				flag = series.IsVertical;
				DataContext context = dataContexts[i];
				object obj = tooltipObjects[i];
				if (CategoryToolTipView.ConfigureTooltip(series, obj, context))
				{
					flag2 = true;
				}
				num++;
			}
			if (!flag2)
			{
				CategoryToolTipView.HideContainer(container);
				return;
			}
			Size tooltipSize = CategoryToolTipView.GetTooltipSize(container);
			double num2 = 0.0;
			double num3 = 0.0;
			double num4 = 0.0;
			double num5 = 0.0;
			bool flag3 = false;
			bool flag4 = false;
			CategoryTooltipLayerPosition toolTipPosition = ToolTipPosition;
			if (toolTipPosition == CategoryTooltipLayerPosition.InsideStart || toolTipPosition == CategoryTooltipLayerPosition.InsideEnd)
			{
				flag4 = true;
			}
			if (toolTipPosition == CategoryTooltipLayerPosition.InsideStart || toolTipPosition == CategoryTooltipLayerPosition.OutsideStart)
			{
				flag3 = true;
			}
			Size validAreaSize = CategoryToolTipView.GetValidAreaSize();
			if (flag)
			{
				if (!flag3 && !flag4 && position.X + (tooltipSize.Width + DeviceUtils.ToPixelUnits(10.0)) > validAreaSize.Width)
				{
					flag4 = true;
				}
				if (flag3 && !flag4 && position.X - (tooltipSize.Width + DeviceUtils.ToPixelUnits(10.0)) < 0.0)
				{
					flag4 = true;
				}
			}
			else
			{
				if (!flag3 && !flag4 && position.Y - (tooltipSize.Height + 10.0) < 0.0)
				{
					flag4 = true;
				}
				if (flag3 && !flag4 && position.Y + (tooltipSize.Height + 10.0) > validAreaSize.Height)
				{
					flag4 = true;
				}
			}
			double num6 = DeviceUtils.ToPixelUnits(10.0);
			double num7 = DeviceUtils.ToPixelUnits(5.0);
			if (!flag3)
			{
				if (!flag)
				{
					num7 = tooltipSize.Height + num6;
				}
				if (flag4)
				{
					num7 = ((!flag) ? 0.0 : (num7 + tooltipSize.Width + num6));
				}
			}
			else if (flag)
			{
				num7 = tooltipSize.Width + num6;
				if (flag4)
				{
					num7 = 0.0;
				}
			}
			else
			{
				num7 = DeviceUtils.ToPixelUnits(5.0);
				if (flag4)
				{
					num7 = num7 + tooltipSize.Height + num6;
				}
			}
			if (flag)
			{
				num3 = 0.0 - (num6 + DeviceUtils.ToPixelUnits(5.0));
				if (flag3)
				{
					num3 = num3 * -1.0 + tooltipSize.Width;
				}
				num2 = tooltipSize.Height / 2.0;
				num5 = position.Y - tooltipSize.Height / 2.0;
				num4 = position.X - num7;
			}
			else
			{
				num2 = tooltipSize.Height + DeviceUtils.ToPixelUnits(10.0) + DeviceUtils.ToPixelUnits(5.0);
				if (flag3)
				{
					num2 = 0.0 - (num6 + DeviceUtils.ToPixelUnits(5.0));
				}
				num3 = tooltipSize.Width / 2.0;
				num4 = position.X - tooltipSize.Width / 2.0;
				num5 = position.Y - num7;
			}
			if (flag)
			{
				if (num5 < 0.0)
				{
					num2 -= 0.0 - num5;
					num5 = 0.0;
				}
				if (num5 + tooltipSize.Height > validAreaSize.Height)
				{
					num2 += num5 + tooltipSize.Height - validAreaSize.Height;
					num5 = validAreaSize.Height - tooltipSize.Height;
				}
			}
			else
			{
				if (num4 < 0.0)
				{
					num3 -= 0.0 - num4;
					num4 = 0.0;
				}
				if (num4 + tooltipSize.Width > validAreaSize.Width)
				{
					num3 += num4 + tooltipSize.Width - validAreaSize.Width;
					num4 = validAreaSize.Width - tooltipSize.Width;
				}
			}
			f.TooltipXCoord = num4;
			f.TooltipYCoord = num5;
			f.PointerPositionXCoord = num3;
			f.PointerPositionYCoord = num2;
			f.TooltipWidth = tooltipSize.Width;
			f.TooltipHeight = tooltipSize.Height;
		}

		private object GetTooltipObject(Series series)
		{
			return series.ToolTip;
		}

		protected override void RenderFrame(Frame frame, SeriesView view)
		{
			base.RenderFrame(frame, view);
			CategoryToolTipLayerFrame categoryToolTipLayerFrame = (CategoryToolTipLayerFrame)frame;
			_ = view.Viewport.Left;
			_ = view.Viewport.Right;
			_ = view.Viewport.Top;
			_ = view.Viewport.Bottom;
			object container = CategoryToolTipView.GetContainer();
			if (double.IsNaN(categoryToolTipLayerFrame.TooltipXCoord) || double.IsNaN(categoryToolTipLayerFrame.TooltipYCoord) || double.IsNaN(categoryToolTipLayerFrame.PointerPositionXCoord) || double.IsNaN(categoryToolTipLayerFrame.PointerPositionYCoord))
			{
				CategoryToolTipView.HideContainer(container);
				return;
			}
			double tooltipXCoord = categoryToolTipLayerFrame.TooltipXCoord;
			double tooltipYCoord = categoryToolTipLayerFrame.TooltipYCoord;
			double pointerPositionXCoord = categoryToolTipLayerFrame.PointerPositionXCoord;
			double pointerPositionYCoord = categoryToolTipLayerFrame.PointerPositionYCoord;
			CategoryToolTipView.MoveTooltip(container, tooltipXCoord, tooltipYCoord, pointerPositionXCoord, pointerPositionYCoord);
		}

		protected override bool RequiresPrepare()
		{
			return true;
		}
	}

	[EditorBrowsable(EditorBrowsableState.Never)]
	public class CategoryToolTipLayerFrame : Frame
	{
		private double _y;

		public double TooltipYCoord
		{
			get
			{
				return _y;
			}
			set
			{
				_y = value;
			}
		}

		public double TooltipXCoord { get; set; }

		public double PointerPositionYCoord { get; set; }

		public double PointerPositionXCoord { get; set; }

		public double TooltipWidth { get; set; }

		public double TooltipHeight { get; set; }

		public CategoryToolTipLayerFrame()
		{
			TooltipXCoord = double.NaN;
			TooltipYCoord = double.NaN;
			PointerPositionXCoord = double.NaN;
			PointerPositionYCoord = double.NaN;
			TooltipWidth = double.NaN;
			TooltipHeight = double.NaN;
		}

		public override void Interpolate(float p, Frame min, Frame max)
		{
			CategoryToolTipLayerFrame categoryToolTipLayerFrame = (CategoryToolTipLayerFrame)min;
			CategoryToolTipLayerFrame categoryToolTipLayerFrame2 = (CategoryToolTipLayerFrame)max;
			if (double.IsNaN(categoryToolTipLayerFrame.TooltipXCoord))
			{
				TooltipXCoord = categoryToolTipLayerFrame2.TooltipXCoord;
			}
			else
			{
				TooltipXCoord = categoryToolTipLayerFrame.TooltipXCoord + (categoryToolTipLayerFrame2.TooltipXCoord - categoryToolTipLayerFrame.TooltipXCoord) * (double)p;
			}
			if (double.IsNaN(categoryToolTipLayerFrame.TooltipYCoord))
			{
				TooltipYCoord = categoryToolTipLayerFrame2.TooltipYCoord;
			}
			else
			{
				TooltipYCoord = categoryToolTipLayerFrame.TooltipYCoord + (categoryToolTipLayerFrame2.TooltipYCoord - categoryToolTipLayerFrame.TooltipYCoord) * (double)p;
			}
			if (double.IsNaN(categoryToolTipLayerFrame.PointerPositionXCoord))
			{
				PointerPositionXCoord = categoryToolTipLayerFrame2.PointerPositionXCoord;
			}
			else
			{
				PointerPositionXCoord = categoryToolTipLayerFrame.PointerPositionXCoord + (categoryToolTipLayerFrame2.PointerPositionXCoord - categoryToolTipLayerFrame.PointerPositionXCoord) * (double)p;
			}
			if (double.IsNaN(categoryToolTipLayerFrame.PointerPositionYCoord))
			{
				PointerPositionYCoord = categoryToolTipLayerFrame2.PointerPositionYCoord;
			}
			else
			{
				PointerPositionYCoord = categoryToolTipLayerFrame.PointerPositionYCoord + (categoryToolTipLayerFrame2.PointerPositionYCoord - categoryToolTipLayerFrame.PointerPositionYCoord) * (double)p;
			}
			if (double.IsNaN(categoryToolTipLayerFrame.TooltipWidth))
			{
				TooltipWidth = categoryToolTipLayerFrame2.TooltipWidth;
			}
			else
			{
				TooltipWidth = categoryToolTipLayerFrame.TooltipWidth + (categoryToolTipLayerFrame2.TooltipWidth - categoryToolTipLayerFrame.TooltipWidth) * (double)p;
			}
			if (double.IsNaN(categoryToolTipLayerFrame.TooltipHeight))
			{
				TooltipHeight = categoryToolTipLayerFrame2.TooltipXCoord;
			}
			else
			{
				TooltipHeight = categoryToolTipLayerFrame.TooltipHeight + (categoryToolTipLayerFrame2.TooltipHeight - categoryToolTipLayerFrame.TooltipHeight) * (double)p;
			}
		}
	}

	public class CategoryToolTipLayerView : AnnotationLayerView
	{
		private ToolTip _container = new ToolTip();

		private StackPanel _stack = new StackPanel();

		protected CategoryToolTipLayer CategoryToolTipModel { get; set; }

		public CategoryToolTipLayerView(CategoryToolTipLayer model)
			: base(model)
		{
			CategoryToolTipModel = model;
		}

		public object GetContainer()
		{
			return _container;
		}

		public override void OnInit()
		{
			base.OnInit();
			_container.IsOpen = false;
			_container.IsHitTestVisible = false;
			PointerTooltip pointerTooltip = new PointerTooltip();
			pointerTooltip.IsHitTestVisible = false;
			ControlTemplate controlTemplate = new ControlTemplate
			{
				TargetType = typeof(ToolTip)
			};
			FrameworkElementFactory visualTree = new FrameworkElementFactory(typeof(ContentPresenter));
			controlTemplate.VisualTree = visualTree;
			_container.Template = controlTemplate;
			_container.StaysOpen = true;
			ToolTipService.SetInitialShowDelay(_container, 0);
			_container.Content = pointerTooltip;
			_container.Opened += _container_Opened;
			ContentControl contentControl = new ContentControl();
			contentControl.Content = _stack;
			pointerTooltip.Content = contentControl;
		}

		private void _container_Opened(object sender, RoutedEventArgs e)
		{
			DependencyObject parent = LogicalTreeHelper.GetParent(_container);
			if (parent is Popup)
			{
				((Popup)parent).PopupAnimation = PopupAnimation.None;
			}
		}

		protected internal override void OnTemplateProvided()
		{
			base.OnTemplateProvided();
		}

		internal bool ConfigureTooltip(Series series, object obj, DataContext context)
		{
			PointerTooltip obj2 = (PointerTooltip)_container.Content;
			obj2.Style = CategoryToolTipModel.PointerToolTipStyle;
			obj2.ToolTipStyle = CategoryToolTipModel.ToolTipStyle;
			series.RemoveToolTipFromCurrentParent();
			ContentControl contentControl = new ContentControl
			{
				IsHitTestVisible = false
			};
			if (Model.SeriesViewer != null)
			{
				contentControl.ContentTemplate = Model.SeriesViewer.CrosshairTooltipItemTemplate;
			}
			contentControl.DataContext = context;
			contentControl.Content = new CategoryToolTipItemContext
			{
				SubContent = new ContentControl(),
				ItemContext = context
			};
			ContentControl contentControl2 = (ContentControl)((CategoryToolTipItemContext)contentControl.Content).SubContent;
			contentControl2.Content = obj;
			contentControl2.DataContext = context;
			series.CurrentToolTipParent = contentControl2;
			_stack.Children.Add(contentControl);
			return true;
		}

		internal Size GetTooltipSize(object container)
		{
			ToolTip toolTip = (ToolTip)container;
			PointerTooltip pointerTooltip = (PointerTooltip)toolTip.Content;
			_ = (ContentControl)pointerTooltip.Content;
			Size availableSize = new Size(double.PositiveInfinity, double.PositiveInfinity);
			bool flag = !toolTip.IsOpen;
			if (flag)
			{
				toolTip.Opacity = 0.0;
				toolTip.IsOpen = true;
			}
			pointerTooltip.UpdateLayout();
			pointerTooltip.InvalidateMeasure();
			pointerTooltip.Measure(availableSize);
			Size result = new Size(pointerTooltip.ActualBoxWidth, pointerTooltip.ActualBoxHeight);
			pointerTooltip.UpdateLayout();
			if (flag)
			{
				toolTip.IsOpen = false;
				toolTip.Opacity = 1.0;
			}
			return result;
		}

		public Point RelativeToAbsolute(Point pt)
		{
			_ = _container;
			UIElement rootVisual = PlatformProxy.GetRootVisual(Model);
			Point result = new Point(double.NaN, double.NaN);
			try
			{
				if (rootVisual != null && Model.SeriesViewer != null)
				{
					result = Model.TransformToVisual(rootVisual).Transform(pt);
					return result;
				}
			}
			catch
			{
			}
			return result;
		}

		public void MoveTooltip(object container, double x, double y, double pointerPosX, double pointerPosY)
		{
			ToolTip container2 = _container;
			PointerTooltip obj = (PointerTooltip)container2.Content;
			container2.PlacementTarget = PlatformProxy.GetRootVisual(Model);
			obj.PointerPosition = new Point(pointerPosX, pointerPosY);
			_ = (UIElement)container2.Parent;
			_ = Application.Current.MainWindow;
			if (SystemParameters.MenuDropAlignment)
			{
				x += container2.DesiredSize.Width;
			}
			container2.HorizontalOffset = x;
			container2.VerticalOffset = y;
			container2.IsOpen = true;
		}

		public Size GetValidAreaSize()
		{
			return PlatformProxy.GetRootVisual(Model).RenderSize;
		}

		public void HideContainer(object container)
		{
			((ToolTip)container).IsOpen = false;
		}

		public void ClearTooltipContent()
		{
			_stack.Children.Clear();
		}

		internal void OnSeriesViewerChanged()
		{
			if (Model.SeriesViewer != null)
			{
				_container.Placement = PlacementMode.Relative;
				_container.PlacementTarget = PlatformProxy.GetRootVisual(Model);
			}
			else
			{
				_container.PlacementTarget = null;
			}
		}

		protected internal override void ExportViewShapes(object svd)
		{
			base.ExportViewShapes(svd);
			ToolTip container = _container;
			PointerTooltip pointerTooltip = (PointerTooltip)container.Content;
			UIElement rootVisual = PlatformProxy.GetRootVisual(Model);
			double num = container.HorizontalOffset;
			if (SystemParameters.MenuDropAlignment)
			{
				num -= pointerTooltip.DesiredSize.Width;
			}
			Point point = rootVisual.TransformToVisual(Model).Transform(new Point(num, container.VerticalOffset));
			object obj = pointerTooltip.ExportVisualData();
			if (obj == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			double x = point.X;
			double y = point.Y;
			List<string> list = new List<string>();
			foreach (FrameworkElement child in _stack.Children)
			{
				TextBlock textBlock = child.VisualDescendantsOfType<TextBlock>().FirstOrDefault();
				if (textBlock != null)
				{
					list.Add(textBlock.Text);
				}
			}
			Model.SeriesVisualDataManager.AddPointerTooltipData(svd, obj, x, y, list);
		}
	}

		public object ItemContext { get; set; }
	}
	public class CalloutLayerView : AnnotationLayerView
	{
		private CalloutView _testView = new CalloutView();

		protected CalloutLayer CalloutModel { get; set; }

		internal HashPool<CalloutAnnotationWrapper, CalloutView> CalloutPool { get; set; }

		public CalloutLayerView(CalloutLayer model)
			: base(model)
		{
			CalloutModel = model;
		}

		internal Brush GetDefaultCalloutBackground(Series s)
		{
			if (s != null)
			{
				return GetBrightenedBrush(s.ActualBrush, 0.1);
			}
			return Model.ActualBrush;
		}

		internal Brush GetDefaultCalloutTextColor()
		{
			return new SolidColorBrush(Colors.White);
		}

		internal Brush GetDefaultCalloutOutline()
		{
			return new SolidColorBrush(Colors.White);
		}

		internal Brush GetDefaultCalloutLeaderBrush(Series s)
		{
			if (s != null)
			{
				return GetBrightenedBrush(s.ActualBrush, 0.1);
			}
			return Model.ActualBrush;
		}

		public override void OnInit()
		{
			base.OnInit();
			CalloutPool = new HashPool<CalloutAnnotationWrapper, CalloutView>
			{
				Create = CalloutCreate,
				Activate = CalloutActivate,
				Disactivate = CalloutDisactivate,
				Destroy = CalloutDestroy
			};
		}

		private CalloutView CalloutCreate()
		{
			CalloutView calloutView = new CalloutView();
			calloutView.RenderTransform = new TranslateTransform();
			base.RootCanvas.Children.Add(calloutView);
			return calloutView;
		}

		private void CalloutActivate(CalloutView Callout)
		{
			Callout.Visibility = Visibility.Visible;
		}

		private void CalloutDisactivate(CalloutView Callout)
		{
			Callout.Visibility = Visibility.Collapsed;
		}

		private void CalloutDestroy(CalloutView Callout)
		{
			base.RootCanvas.Children.Remove(Callout);
		}

		protected internal override void OnTemplateProvided()
		{
			Canvas rootCanvas = base.RootCanvas;
			if (rootCanvas != null && rootCanvas.Children.Contains(_testView))
			{
				rootCanvas.Children.Remove(_testView);
			}
			base.OnTemplateProvided();
			_testView.Opacity = 0.0;
			base.RootCanvas.Children.Add(_testView);
		}

		public Brush GetLightenedBrush(Brush brush)
		{
			return brush.GetLightened(0.1);
		}

		protected internal override void ExportViewShapes(object svd)
		{
			base.ExportViewShapes(svd);
			foreach (CalloutAnnotationWrapper activeKey in CalloutPool.ActiveKeys)
			{
				CalloutPool[activeKey].Export(CalloutModel, CalloutModel.FontInfo, svd);
			}
		}

		public Size GetSizeForContent(object content, Thickness calloutPadding)
		{
			_testView.Content = content;
			_testView.CalloutPadding = calloutPadding;
			Size size = _testView.GetSize();
			_testView.Content = null;
			return size;
		}

		internal void SetCalloutPosition(CalloutView callout, double x, double y)
		{
			Canvas.SetTop(callout, y);
			Canvas.SetLeft(callout, x);
			callout.PositionUpdated(x, y);
		}

		internal void UpdateContext(CalloutView callout, CalloutAnnotationWrapper wrapper, object v)
		{
			callout.SetContext(Model, wrapper, v);
		}
	}
	internal class CalloutView : Grid
	{
		private TextBlock _text;

		private Border _border;

		private Point _targetPoint = new Point(0.0, 0.0);

		private Line _line;

		private DataContext _context;

		private double _x = double.NaN;

		private double _y = double.NaN;

		public Point TargetPoint
		{
			get
			{
				return _targetPoint;
			}
			set
			{
				if (!_targetPoint.Equals(value))
				{
					double textHeight = _text.DesiredSize.Height + _border.Padding.Top + _border.Padding.Bottom;
					double textWidth = _text.DesiredSize.Width + _border.Padding.Left + _border.Padding.Right;
					_targetPoint = value;
					Thickness margin = CalloutViewHelper.UpdateLeader(TargetPoint, textWidth, textHeight, _line);
					_border.Margin = margin;
				}
			}
		}

		public Brush CalloutTextColor
		{
			get
			{
				return (Brush)_text.GetValue(TextBlock.ForegroundProperty);
			}
			set
			{
				_text.SetValue(TextBlock.ForegroundProperty, value);
			}
		}

		public Brush CalloutOutline
		{
			get
			{
				return _border.BorderBrush;
			}
			set
			{
				_border.BorderBrush = value;
			}
		}

		public Brush CalloutLeaderBrush
		{
			get
			{
				return _line.Stroke;
			}
			set
			{
				_line.Stroke = value;
			}
		}

		public Brush CalloutBackground
		{
			get
			{
				return _border.Background;
			}
			set
			{
				_border.Background = value;
			}
		}

		public double CalloutStrokeThickness
		{
			get
			{
				return _border.BorderThickness.Top;
			}
			set
			{
				_border.BorderThickness = new Thickness(value);
			}
		}

		public Thickness CalloutPadding
		{
			get
			{
				return _border.Padding;
			}
			set
			{
				_border.Padding = value;
			}
		}

		public object Content
		{
			get
			{
				return _text.Text;
			}
			set
			{
				string text = ((value != null) ? value.ToString() : "");
				if (!object.Equals(_text.Text, text))
				{
					_text.Text = text;
					_text.InvalidateMeasure();
					_text.Measure(new Size(double.PositiveInfinity, double.PositiveInfinity));
					double textHeight = _text.DesiredSize.Height + _border.Padding.Top + _border.Padding.Bottom;
					double textWidth = _text.DesiredSize.Width + _border.Padding.Top + _border.Padding.Bottom;
					Thickness margin = CalloutViewHelper.UpdateLeader(TargetPoint, textWidth, textHeight, _line);
					_border.Margin = margin;
				}
			}
		}

		public CalloutView()
		{
			_line = new Line();
			_line.IsHitTestVisible = false;
			_line.Stroke = new SolidColorBrush(Colors.Black);
			_line.StrokeThickness = 2.0;
			base.Children.Add(_line);
			TextBlock textBlock = new TextBlock();
			Border border = new Border
			{
				Child = textBlock
			};
			base.Children.Add(border);
			_text = textBlock;
			_text.IsHitTestVisible = false;
			_text.HorizontalAlignment = HorizontalAlignment.Left;
			_text.VerticalAlignment = VerticalAlignment.Top;
			_border = border;
			_border.HorizontalAlignment = HorizontalAlignment.Left;
			_border.VerticalAlignment = VerticalAlignment.Top;
		}

		public Size GetSize()
		{
			Visibility visibility = base.Visibility;
			if (visibility == Visibility.Collapsed)
			{
				base.Visibility = Visibility.Hidden;
			}
			_text.InvalidateMeasure();
			_text.Measure(new Size(double.PositiveInfinity, double.PositiveInfinity));
			Size desiredSize = _text.DesiredSize;
			Size result = new Size(desiredSize.Width + _border.Padding.Left + _border.Padding.Right, desiredSize.Height + _border.Padding.Top + _border.Padding.Bottom);
			base.Visibility = visibility;
			return result;
		}

		public void SetContext(Series series, CalloutAnnotationWrapper wrapper, object context)
		{
			if (_context == null)
			{
				_context = new DataContext();
				_border.DataContext = _context;
				_text.DataContext = _context;
			}
			_context.Series = series;
			_context.Item = context;
			if (wrapper.Label != null)
			{
				wrapper.Label.Data = _context;
			}
		}

		public void PositionUpdated(double x, double y)
		{
			if (_x != x || _y != y)
			{
				_ = 0;
			}
			_x = x;
			_y = y;
		}

		public void Export(CalloutLayer layer, FontInfo font, object svd)
		{
			Rectangle rectangle = new Rectangle();
			rectangle.Width = _border.ActualWidth;
			rectangle.Height = _border.ActualHeight;
			rectangle.Fill = _border.Background;
			rectangle.Stroke = _border.BorderBrush;
			rectangle.StrokeThickness = _border.BorderThickness.Top;
			layer.SeriesVisualDataManager.ExportCalloutData(Canvas.GetLeft(this), Canvas.GetTop(this), _border.Margin.Left, _border.Margin.Top, svd, rectangle, _text, font, _line, "callout", new string[2] { "Main", "Callout" });
		}
	}

	public class ItemToolTipLayer : AnnotationLayer
	{

		{
			((ItemToolTipLayer)sender).RaisePropertyChanged("TargetSeries", e.OldValue, e.NewValue);

		internal const string UseInterpolationPropertyName = "UseInterpolation";

			((ItemToolTipLayer)sender).RaisePropertyChanged("UseInterpolation", e.OldValue, e.NewValue);

		internal const string SkipUnknownValuesPropertyName = "SkipUnknownValues";

		public static readonly DependencyProperty SkipUnknownValuesProperty = DependencyProperty.Register("SkipUnknownValues", typeof(bool), typeof(ItemToolTipLayer), new PropertyMetadata(true, delegate(DependencyObject sender, DependencyPropertyChangedEventArgs e)
		{
			((ItemToolTipLayer)sender).RaisePropertyChanged("SkipUnknownValues", e.OldValue, e.NewValue);
		}));

		internal const string ToolTipStylePropertyName = "ToolTipStyle";

		public static readonly DependencyProperty ToolTipStyleProperty = DependencyProperty.Register("ToolTipStyle", typeof(Style), typeof(ItemToolTipLayer), new PropertyMetadata(null, delegate(DependencyObject sender, DependencyPropertyChangedEventArgs e)
		{
			(sender as ItemToolTipLayer).RaisePropertyChanged("ToolTipStyle", e.OldValue, e.NewValue);
		}));

		internal const string PointerToolTipStylePropertyName = "PointerToolTipStyle";

		public static readonly DependencyProperty PointerToolTipStyleProperty = DependencyProperty.Register("PointerToolTipStyle", typeof(Style), typeof(ItemToolTipLayer), new PropertyMetadata(null, delegate(DependencyObject sender, DependencyPropertyChangedEventArgs e)
		{
			(sender as ItemToolTipLayer).RaisePropertyChanged("PointerToolTipStyle", e.OldValue, e.NewValue);
		}));

		public override bool IsAnnotationHoverLayer => true;

		[TSSuppressSynthesizedInitializer]
		protected ItemToolTipLayerView ItemTooltipView { get; set; }

		public override bool IsDefaultTooltipBehaviorDisabled => true;

		public string TargetSeriesName

		public ItemToolTipLayer()
		{
			ItemTooltipLayerFrame previousFrame = new ItemTooltipLayerFrame();
			ItemTooltipLayerFrame currentFrame = new ItemTooltipLayerFrame();
			ItemTooltipLayerFrame transitionFrame = new ItemTooltipLayerFrame();
			_ = base.TransitionDuration.TotalSeconds;
			base.PreviousFrame = previousFrame;
			base.CurrentFrame = currentFrame;
			base.TransitionFrame = transitionFrame;
			base.DefaultStyleKey = typeof(ItemToolTipLayer);
		}

		protected override SeriesView CreateView()
		{
			return new ItemToolTipLayerView(this);
		}

		protected internal override void OnViewCreated(SeriesView view)
		{
			base.OnViewCreated(view);
			ItemTooltipView = (ItemToolTipLayerView)view;
		}

		protected override void PropertyUpdatedOverride(object sender, string propertyName, object oldValue, object newValue)
		{
			base.PropertyUpdatedOverride(sender, propertyName, oldValue, newValue);
			switch (propertyName)
			{
			case "TargetSeriesName":
			case "TargetSeries":
				RenderSeries(animate: true);
				break;
			case "UseInterpolation":
				RenderSeries(animate: true);
				break;
			case "ToolTipStyle":
				RenderSeries(animate: true);
				break;
			case "PointerToolTipStyle":
				RenderSeries(animate: true);
				break;
			case "SkipUnknownValues":
				RenderSeries(animate: true);
				break;
			}
		}

		protected override void OnDependentSeriesRender(Series series, bool animate)
		{
			if ((TargetSeries == null || TargetSeries == series) && !base.ContentInfo.IsDirty)
			{
				RenderSeries(animate);
			}
		}

		protected override bool IsSeriesValid(Series series)
		{
			if (!base.IsSeriesValid(series))
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (TargetSeriesName != null)
			{
				if (series.IsFragment)
				{
					string value = series.ResolveFragmentName();
					if (!TargetSeriesName.Equals(value))
					{
						return false;
					}
				}
				else if (!TargetSeriesName.Equals(series.Name))
				{
					return false;
				}
			}
			if (!GetCategoryPosition(series).Item1)
			{
				return false;
			}
			return true;
		}

		protected override void PrepareFrame(Frame frame, SeriesView view)
		{
			base.PrepareFrame(frame, view);
			ItemTooltipLayerFrame f = (ItemTooltipLayerFrame)frame;
			Pool<object> containerPool = ItemTooltipView.ContainerPool;
			bool useInterpolation = UseInterpolation;
			bool skipUnknowns = SkipUnknownValues;
			f.TooltipYCoords.Clear();
			f.TooltipContainers.Clear();
			f.TooltipXCoords.Clear();
			f.ActualTooltipYCoords.Clear();
			f.ActualTooltipXCoords.Clear();
			f.TooltipObjects.Clear();
			f.TooltipDataContexts.Clear();
			f.TooltipWidths.Clear();
			f.TooltipHeights.Clear();
			f.LeaderBrushes.Clear();
			if (double.IsNaN(CurrentPosition.X) && double.IsNaN(CurrentPosition.Y))
			{
				containerPool.Count = 0;
				return;
			}
			int i = 0;
			if (IsSeriesValid(TargetSeries))
			{
				PrepareSeries(TargetSeries, f, useInterpolation, skipUnknowns, 0);
				i++;
			}
			else
			{
				foreach (Series item in base.SeriesViewer.Series)
				{
					if (IsSeriesValid(item))
					{
						PrepareSeries(item, f, useInterpolation, skipUnknowns, i);
						i++;
					}
					if (!item.IsStacked)
					{
						continue;
					}
					item.ForSubVisualSeries(delegate(Series s)
					{
						if (IsSeriesValid(s))
						{
							PrepareSeries(s, f, useInterpolation, skipUnknowns, i);
							i++;
						}
						return true;
					});
				}
				AntiCollide(f);
			}
			containerPool.Count = i;
		}

		private void AntiCollide(ItemTooltipLayerFrame f)
		{
			List<ItemTooltipCollisionInfo> list = new List<ItemTooltipCollisionInfo>();
			for (int i = 0; i < f.ActualTooltipXCoords.Count; i++)
			{
				ItemTooltipCollisionInfo itemTooltipCollisionInfo = new ItemTooltipCollisionInfo();
				itemTooltipCollisionInfo.Index = i;
				itemTooltipCollisionInfo.Position = new Point(f.ActualTooltipXCoords[i], f.ActualTooltipYCoords[i]);
				itemTooltipCollisionInfo.Width = f.TooltipWidths[i];
				itemTooltipCollisionInfo.Height = f.TooltipHeights[i];
				itemTooltipCollisionInfo.Order = f.TooltipYCoords[i];
				if (!double.IsNaN(itemTooltipCollisionInfo.Position.X) && !double.IsNaN(itemTooltipCollisionInfo.Position.Y))
				{
					list.Add(itemTooltipCollisionInfo);
				}
			}
			list.Sort(delegate(ItemTooltipCollisionInfo itemTooltipCollisionInfo7, ItemTooltipCollisionInfo itemTooltipCollisionInfo8)
			{
				if (itemTooltipCollisionInfo7.Position.Y < itemTooltipCollisionInfo8.Position.Y)
				{
					return -1;
				}
				if (itemTooltipCollisionInfo7.Position.Y > itemTooltipCollisionInfo8.Position.Y)
				{
					return 1;
				}
				if (itemTooltipCollisionInfo7.Order < itemTooltipCollisionInfo8.Order)
				{
					return -1;
				}
				return (itemTooltipCollisionInfo7.Order > itemTooltipCollisionInfo8.Order) ? 1 : 0;
			});
			if (!CollisionsExist(list))
			{
				return;
			}
			for (int num = 0; num < list.Count - 1; num++)
			{
				ItemTooltipCollisionInfo itemTooltipCollisionInfo2 = list[num];
				ItemTooltipCollisionInfo itemTooltipCollisionInfo3 = list[num + 1];
				Rect rect = new Rect(itemTooltipCollisionInfo2.Position.X, itemTooltipCollisionInfo2.Position.Y, itemTooltipCollisionInfo2.Width, itemTooltipCollisionInfo2.Height);
				Rect rect2 = new Rect(itemTooltipCollisionInfo3.Position.X, itemTooltipCollisionInfo3.Position.Y, itemTooltipCollisionInfo3.Width, itemTooltipCollisionInfo3.Height);
				if (rect.IntersectsWith(rect2) || rect.Top > rect2.Bottom)
				{
					itemTooltipCollisionInfo3.Position = new Point(itemTooltipCollisionInfo3.Position.X, rect.Bottom + 1.0);
				}
			}
			if (list[list.Count - 1].Position.Y + list[list.Count - 1].Height > base.View.Viewport.Height)
			{
				list[list.Count - 1].Position = new Point(list[list.Count - 1].Position.X, list[list.Count - 1].Position.Y - (list[list.Count - 1].Position.Y + list[list.Count - 1].Height - base.View.Viewport.Height));
			}
			for (int num2 = list.Count - 1; num2 >= 1; num2--)
			{
				ItemTooltipCollisionInfo itemTooltipCollisionInfo4 = list[num2];
				ItemTooltipCollisionInfo itemTooltipCollisionInfo5 = list[num2 - 1];
				Rect rect3 = new Rect(itemTooltipCollisionInfo4.Position.X, itemTooltipCollisionInfo4.Position.Y, itemTooltipCollisionInfo4.Width, itemTooltipCollisionInfo4.Height);
				Rect rect4 = new Rect(itemTooltipCollisionInfo5.Position.X, itemTooltipCollisionInfo5.Position.Y, itemTooltipCollisionInfo5.Width, itemTooltipCollisionInfo5.Height);
				if (rect3.IntersectsWith(rect4) || rect3.Top < rect4.Bottom)
				{
					itemTooltipCollisionInfo5.Position = new Point(itemTooltipCollisionInfo5.Position.X, rect3.Top - (rect4.Height + 1.0));
				}
			}
			for (int num3 = 0; num3 < list.Count; num3++)
			{
				int index = list[num3].Index;
				ItemTooltipCollisionInfo itemTooltipCollisionInfo6 = list[num3];
				f.ActualTooltipXCoords[index] = itemTooltipCollisionInfo6.Position.X;
				f.ActualTooltipYCoords[index] = itemTooltipCollisionInfo6.Position.Y;
			}
		}

		private bool CollisionsExist(List<ItemTooltipCollisionInfo> items)
		{
			if (items.Count <= 1)
			{
				return false;
			}
			_ = base.View.Viewport;
			for (int i = 0; i < items.Count - 1; i++)
			{
				ItemTooltipCollisionInfo itemTooltipCollisionInfo = items[i];
				ItemTooltipCollisionInfo itemTooltipCollisionInfo2 = items[i + 1];
				Rect rect = new Rect(itemTooltipCollisionInfo.Position.X, itemTooltipCollisionInfo.Position.Y, itemTooltipCollisionInfo.Width, itemTooltipCollisionInfo.Height);
				Rect rect2 = new Rect(itemTooltipCollisionInfo2.Position.X, itemTooltipCollisionInfo2.Position.Y, itemTooltipCollisionInfo2.Width, itemTooltipCollisionInfo2.Height);
				if (rect.IntersectsWith(rect2))
				{
					return true;
				}
			}
			return false;
		}

		private void PrepareSeries(Series series, ItemTooltipLayerFrame f, bool useInterpolation, bool skipUnknowns, int i)
		{
			Tuple<bool, Point> categoryPosition = GetCategoryPosition(series);
			if (!categoryPosition.Item1)
			{
				return;
			}
			Point seriesValuePosition = series.GetSeriesValuePosition(categoryPosition.Item2, useInterpolation, skipUnknowns);
			Pool<object> containerPool = ItemTooltipView.ContainerPool;
			object tooltipObject = GetTooltipObject(series);
			Point world = CurrentPosition;
			if (!useInterpolation)
			{
				world = ToWorldPosition(seriesValuePosition);
			}
			object item = series.GetItem(world);
			object obj = containerPool[i];
			Rect viewport = base.View.Viewport;
			DataContext dataContext = null;
			if (series.IsDefaultToolTipSelected && item != null)
			{
				dataContext = series.GetTooltipContext(item);
			}
			else
			{
				dataContext = new DataContext();
				dataContext.Item = item;
				dataContext.Series = series;
			}
			if (ItemTooltipView.ConfigureTooltip(series, obj, tooltipObject, dataContext))
			{
				Size tooltipSize = ItemTooltipView.GetTooltipSize(obj, tooltipObject, dataContext);
				f.TooltipContainers.Add(obj);
				f.TooltipDataContexts.Add(dataContext);
				f.TooltipObjects.Add(tooltipObject);
				double x = seriesValuePosition.X;
				double x2 = seriesValuePosition.X;
				x2 = Math.Max(x2, viewport.Left);
				x2 = Math.Min(x2, viewport.Right);
				f.TooltipXCoords.Add(x2);
				double y = seriesValuePosition.Y;
				y = Math.Max(y, viewport.Top);
				y = Math.Min(y, viewport.Bottom);
				f.TooltipYCoords.Add(y);
				double num = DeviceUtils.ToPixelUnits(10.0);
				double num2 = seriesValuePosition.X + num;
				if (num2 + tooltipSize.Width > viewport.Right)
				{
					num2 = x - tooltipSize.Width - num;
				}
				if (num2 < viewport.Left)
				{
					num2 = viewport.Left;
				}
				f.ActualTooltipXCoords.Add(num2);
				double num3 = seriesValuePosition.Y - tooltipSize.Height - num;
				if (num3 + tooltipSize.Height > viewport.Bottom)
				{
					num3 = viewport.Bottom - tooltipSize.Height - num;
				}
				if (num3 < viewport.Top)
				{
					num3 = viewport.Top;
				}
				f.ActualTooltipYCoords.Add(num3);
				f.TooltipWidths.Add(tooltipSize.Width);
				f.TooltipHeights.Add(tooltipSize.Height);
				Brush brush = base.ActualBrush;
				if (brush == null)
				{
					brush = base.Brush;
				}
				if (brush == null)
				{
					brush = series.ActualBrush;
				}
				f.LeaderBrushes.Add(brush);
			}
		}

		private object GetTooltipObject(Series series)
		{
			return series.ToolTip;
		}

		public override void HideToolTips()
		{
			CurrentPosition = new Point(double.NaN, double.NaN);
			ItemTooltipView.HideTooltips();
		}

		protected override void RenderFrame(Frame frame, SeriesView view)
		{
			base.RenderFrame(frame, view);
			ItemTooltipLayerFrame itemTooltipLayerFrame = (ItemTooltipLayerFrame)frame;
			int count = itemTooltipLayerFrame.TooltipYCoords.Count;
			double left = view.Viewport.Left;
			double right = view.Viewport.Right;
			double top = view.Viewport.Top;
			double bottom = view.Viewport.Bottom;
			for (int i = 0; i < count; i++)
			{
				if (double.IsNaN(itemTooltipLayerFrame.TooltipXCoords[i]) || double.IsNaN(itemTooltipLayerFrame.TooltipYCoords[i]) || double.IsNaN(itemTooltipLayerFrame.ActualTooltipXCoords[i]) || double.IsNaN(itemTooltipLayerFrame.ActualTooltipYCoords[i]) || itemTooltipLayerFrame.TooltipObjects[i] == null || itemTooltipLayerFrame.TooltipDataContexts[i] == null)
				{
					ItemTooltipView.HideContainer(itemTooltipLayerFrame.TooltipContainers[i]);
					continue;
				}
				double num = itemTooltipLayerFrame.ActualTooltipXCoords[i];
				double num2 = itemTooltipLayerFrame.ActualTooltipYCoords[i];
				double num3 = itemTooltipLayerFrame.TooltipWidths[i];
				double num4 = itemTooltipLayerFrame.TooltipHeights[i];
				bool flag = false;
				if (num < left && Math.Abs(num - left) > 1.0)
				{
					flag = true;
				}
				if (num2 < top && Math.Abs(num2 - top) > 1.0)
				{
					flag = true;
				}
				if (num + num3 > right && Math.Abs(num + num3 - right) > 1.0)
				{
					flag = true;
				}
				if (num2 + num4 > bottom && Math.Abs(num2 + num4 - bottom) > 1.0)
				{
					flag = true;
				}
				if (flag)
				{
					ItemTooltipView.HideContainer(itemTooltipLayerFrame.TooltipContainers[i]);
					continue;
				}
				object container = itemTooltipLayerFrame.TooltipContainers[i];
				double x = Math.Min(itemTooltipLayerFrame.ActualTooltipXCoords[i], itemTooltipLayerFrame.TooltipXCoords[i]);
				double y = Math.Min(itemTooltipLayerFrame.ActualTooltipYCoords[i], itemTooltipLayerFrame.TooltipYCoords[i]);
				double pointerPosX = itemTooltipLayerFrame.TooltipXCoords[i] - itemTooltipLayerFrame.ActualTooltipXCoords[i];
				double pointerPosY = itemTooltipLayerFrame.TooltipYCoords[i] - itemTooltipLayerFrame.ActualTooltipYCoords[i];
				ItemTooltipView.MoveTooltip(container, x, y, pointerPosX, pointerPosY);
			}
		}

		protected override bool RequiresPrepare()
		{
			return true;
		}
	}
	internal class ItemTooltipCollisionInfo
	{
		public Point Position { get; set; }

		public int Index { get; set; }

		public double Width { get; set; }

		public double Height { get; set; }

		public double Order { get; set; }
	}
	[EditorBrowsable(EditorBrowsableState.Never)]
	public class ItemTooltipLayerFrame : Frame
	{
		public List<double> TooltipYCoords { get; set; }

		public List<double> TooltipXCoords { get; set; }

		public List<double> ActualTooltipYCoords { get; set; }

		public List<double> ActualTooltipXCoords { get; set; }

		public List<object> TooltipObjects { get; set; }

		public List<object> TooltipDataContexts { get; set; }

		public List<object> TooltipContainers { get; set; }

		public List<double> TooltipWidths { get; set; }

		public List<double> TooltipHeights { get; set; }

		public List<Brush> LeaderBrushes { get; set; }

		public ItemTooltipLayerFrame()
		{
			TooltipYCoords = new List<double>();
			TooltipXCoords = new List<double>();
			ActualTooltipYCoords = new List<double>();
			ActualTooltipXCoords = new List<double>();
			TooltipObjects = new List<object>();
			TooltipDataContexts = new List<object>();
			TooltipContainers = new List<object>();
			TooltipWidths = new List<double>();
			TooltipHeights = new List<double>();
			LeaderBrushes = new List<Brush>();
		}

		public override void Interpolate(float p, Frame min, Frame max)
		{
			ItemTooltipLayerFrame itemTooltipLayerFrame = (ItemTooltipLayerFrame)min;
			ItemTooltipLayerFrame itemTooltipLayerFrame2 = (ItemTooltipLayerFrame)max;
			Frame.Interpolate(TooltipYCoords, p, itemTooltipLayerFrame.TooltipYCoords, itemTooltipLayerFrame2.TooltipYCoords);
			Frame.Interpolate(TooltipXCoords, p, itemTooltipLayerFrame.TooltipXCoords, itemTooltipLayerFrame2.TooltipXCoords);
			Frame.Interpolate(ActualTooltipYCoords, p, itemTooltipLayerFrame.ActualTooltipYCoords, itemTooltipLayerFrame2.ActualTooltipYCoords);
			Frame.Interpolate(ActualTooltipXCoords, p, itemTooltipLayerFrame.ActualTooltipXCoords, itemTooltipLayerFrame2.ActualTooltipXCoords);
			Frame.Interpolate(TooltipWidths, p, itemTooltipLayerFrame.TooltipWidths, itemTooltipLayerFrame2.TooltipWidths);
			Frame.Interpolate(TooltipHeights, p, itemTooltipLayerFrame.TooltipHeights, itemTooltipLayerFrame2.TooltipHeights);
			FrameExtended.Interpolate(LeaderBrushes, p, itemTooltipLayerFrame.LeaderBrushes, itemTooltipLayerFrame2.LeaderBrushes, InterpolationMode.RGB);
			InterpolationUtil.InterpolateValues(TooltipObjects, p, itemTooltipLayerFrame.TooltipObjects, itemTooltipLayerFrame2.TooltipObjects, () => (object)null, (double ip, double iq, object minVal, object maxVal) => maxVal);
			InterpolationUtil.InterpolateValues(TooltipDataContexts, p, itemTooltipLayerFrame.TooltipDataContexts, itemTooltipLayerFrame2.TooltipDataContexts, () => (object)null, (double ip, double iq, object minVal, object maxVal) => maxVal);
			InterpolationUtil.InterpolateValues(TooltipContainers, p, itemTooltipLayerFrame.TooltipContainers, itemTooltipLayerFrame2.TooltipContainers, () => (object)null, (double ip, double iq, object minVal, object maxVal) => maxVal);
		}
	}
	public class ItemToolTipLayerView : AnnotationLayerView
	{
		private Canvas _lineCanvas = new Canvas
		{
			UseLayoutRounding = false
		};

		protected ItemToolTipLayer ItemTooltipModel { get; set; }

		protected internal Pool<object> ContainerPool { get; set; }

		public ItemToolTipLayerView(ItemToolTipLayer model)
			: base(model)
		{
			ItemTooltipModel = model;
		}

		public override void OnInit()
		{
			base.OnInit();
			ContainerPool = new Pool<object>
			{
				Create = ContainerCreate,
				Activate = ContainerActivate,
				Disactivate = ContainerDisactivate,
				Destroy = ContainerDestroy
			};
		}

		protected internal override void OnTemplateProvided()
		{
			base.OnTemplateProvided();
			if (_lineCanvas != null)
			{
				_lineCanvas.Detach();
			}
			base.RootCanvas.Children.Add(_lineCanvas);
		}

		private object ContainerCreate()
		{
			PointerTooltip pointerTooltip = new PointerTooltip();
			pointerTooltip.IsHitTestVisible = false;
			ContentControl contentControl = new ContentControl
			{
				IsHitTestVisible = false
			};
			if (Model.SeriesViewer != null)
			{
				contentControl.ContentTemplate = Model.SeriesViewer.CrosshairTooltipItemTemplate;
			}
			contentControl.Content = new ItemTooltipItemContext
			{
				SubContent = new ContentControl(),
				ItemContext = null
			};
			pointerTooltip.Content = contentControl;
			_lineCanvas.Children.Add(pointerTooltip);
			return pointerTooltip;
		}

		private void ContainerActivate(object container)
		{
			PointerTooltip pointerTooltip = (PointerTooltip)container;
			if (pointerTooltip.Visibility == Visibility.Collapsed)
			{
				pointerTooltip.Content = null;
				ContentControl contentControl = new ContentControl
				{
					IsHitTestVisible = false
				};
				if (Model.SeriesViewer != null)
				{
					contentControl.ContentTemplate = Model.SeriesViewer.CrosshairTooltipItemTemplate;
				}
				contentControl.Content = new ItemTooltipItemContext
				{
					SubContent = new ContentControl(),
					ItemContext = null
				};
				pointerTooltip.Content = contentControl;
			}
			pointerTooltip.Visibility = Visibility.Visible;
		}

		private void ContainerDisactivate(object container)
		{
			((PointerTooltip)container).Visibility = Visibility.Collapsed;
		}

		private void ContainerDestroy(object container)
		{
			_lineCanvas.Children.Remove((PointerTooltip)container);
		}

		public bool ConfigureTooltip(Series series, object container, object obj, DataContext context)
		{
			PointerTooltip obj2 = (PointerTooltip)container;
			ContentControl contentControl = (ContentControl)obj2.Content;
			obj2.Style = ItemTooltipModel.PointerToolTipStyle;
			obj2.ToolTipStyle = ItemTooltipModel.ToolTipStyle;
			ContentControl contentControl2 = (ContentControl)((ItemTooltipItemContext)contentControl.Content).SubContent;
			contentControl2.DataContext = context;
			ItemTooltipItemContext content = new ItemTooltipItemContext
			{
				ItemContext = context,
				SubContent = contentControl2
			};
			if (obj is UIElement && contentControl2.Content != obj)
			{
				series.RemoveToolTipFromCurrentParent();
				contentControl2.Content = obj;
				series.CurrentToolTipParent = contentControl2;
			}
			if (obj is string && contentControl2.Content != obj)
			{
				contentControl2.Content = obj;
			}
			contentControl.Content = content;
			return true;
		}

		public Size GetTooltipSize(object container, object obj, DataContext context)
		{
			PointerTooltip obj2 = (PointerTooltip)container;
			ContentControl contentControl = (ContentControl)obj2.Content;
			Size availableSize = new Size(double.PositiveInfinity, double.PositiveInfinity);
			obj2.PointerVisibility = Visibility.Collapsed;
			contentControl.UpdateLayout();
			obj2.InvalidateMeasure();
			obj2.Measure(availableSize);
			Size desiredSize = obj2.DesiredSize;
			obj2.PointerVisibility = Visibility.Visible;
			return desiredSize;
		}

		public void MoveTooltip(object container, double x, double y, double pointerPosX, double pointerPosY)
		{
			PointerTooltip obj = (PointerTooltip)container;
			_ = (ContentControl)obj.Content;
			obj.PointerPosition = new Point(pointerPosX, pointerPosY);
			obj.Visibility = Visibility.Visible;
			Canvas.SetLeft(obj, x);
			Canvas.SetTop(obj, y);
		}

		public void HideContainer(object container)
		{
			if (container != null)
			{
				((PointerTooltip)container).Visibility = Visibility.Collapsed;
			}
		}

		protected internal override void ExportViewShapes(object svd)
		{
			base.ExportViewShapes(svd);
			foreach (object item in ContainerPool.Active)
			{
				if (((FrameworkElement)item).Visibility == Visibility.Visible)
				{
					PointerTooltip obj = (PointerTooltip)item;
					object vd = obj.ExportVisualData();
					double left = Canvas.GetLeft(obj);
					double top = Canvas.GetTop(obj);
					List<string> list = new List<string>();
					TextBlock textBlock = obj.VisualDescendantsOfType<TextBlock>().FirstOrDefault();
					if (textBlock != null)
					{
						list.Add(textBlock.Text);
					}
					Model.SeriesVisualDataManager.AddPointerTooltipData(svd, vd, left, top, list);
				}
			}
		}

		internal void HideTooltips()
		{
			foreach (object item in ContainerPool.Active)
			{
				HideContainer(item);
			}
		}
	}

	public class CrosshairLayerView : AnnotationLayerView
	{
		private Canvas _lineCanvas = new Canvas
		{
			UseLayoutRounding = false
		};

		protected CrosshairLayer CrosshairModel { get; set; }

		protected internal Pool<Path> LinePool { get; set; }

		public CrosshairLayerView(CrosshairLayer model)
			: base(model)
		{
			CrosshairModel = model;
		}

		public override void OnInit()
		{
			base.OnInit();
			LinePool = new Pool<Path>
			{
				Create = LineCreate,
				Activate = LineActivate,
				Disactivate = LineDisactivate,
				Destroy = LineDestroy
			};
		}

		protected internal override void OnTemplateProvided()
		{
			base.OnTemplateProvided();
			if (_lineCanvas != null)
			{
				_lineCanvas.Detach();
			}
			base.RootCanvas.Children.Add(_lineCanvas);
		}

		private Path LineCreate()
		{
			Path path = new Path();
			path.IsHitTestVisible = false;
			path.RenderTransform = new TranslateTransform();
			_lineCanvas.Children.Add(path);
			return path;
		}

		private void LineActivate(Path line)
		{
			line.Visibility = Visibility.Visible;
		}

		private void LineDisactivate(Path line)
		{
			line.Visibility = Visibility.Collapsed;
		}

		private void LineDestroy(Path line)
		{
			_lineCanvas.Children.Remove(line);
		}

		public Brush GetLightenedBrush(Brush brush)
		{
			return brush.GetLightened(0.1);
		}

		protected internal override void ExportViewShapes(object svd)
		{
			base.ExportViewShapes(svd);
			for (int i = 0; i < _lineCanvas.Children.Count; i++)
			{
				if (_lineCanvas.Children[i].Visibility == Visibility.Visible)
				{
					Model.SeriesVisualDataManager.ExportPathData(svd, (Path)_lineCanvas.Children[i], "crosshairLine", new string[2] { "Main", "Crosshair" });
				}
			}
		}
	}

		protected internal ContentControl ContentControl { get; set; }

		protected internal Polygon PointerShape { get; set; }

		protected bool IsMeasureInvalid { get; set; }

		[SuppressWidgetMember]
		public event PropertyChangedEventHandler PropertyChanged;

		[SuppressWidgetMember]
		public event PropertyUpdatedEventHandler PropertyUpdated;

		public PointerTooltip()
		{
			VisualDataFactoryManager.Register();
			base.DefaultStyleKey = typeof(PointerTooltip);
			PropertyUpdated += delegate(object o, PropertyUpdatedEventArgs e)
			{
				PropertyUpdatedOverride(o, e.PropertyName, e.OldValue, e.NewValue);
			};
			View = new PointerTooltipView(this);
		}

		protected void RaisePropertyChanged(string name, object oldValue, object newValue)
		{
			if (this.PropertyChanged != null)
			{
				this.PropertyChanged(this, new PropertyChangedEventArgs(name));
			}
			if (this.PropertyUpdated != null)
			{
				this.PropertyUpdated(this, new PropertyUpdatedEventArgs(name, oldValue, newValue));
			}
		}

		protected virtual void PropertyUpdatedOverride(object sender, string propertyName, object oldValue, object newValue)
		{
			if (!(propertyName == "PointerPosition"))
			{
				if (propertyName == "PointerVisibility")
				{
					MeasureInvalid();
				}
			}
			else
			{
				MeasureInvalid();
			}
		}

		public override void OnApplyTemplate()
		{
			base.OnApplyTemplate();
			ContentControl = (ContentControl)GetTemplateChild("PART_CONTENT");
			PointerShape = GetTemplateChild("PART_POINTER") as Polygon;
			PointerOutlineShape = GetTemplateChild("PART_POINTEROUTLINE") as Polyline;
			_lastPosition = new Point(double.NaN, double.NaN);
		}

		internal void CheckContentSize()
		{
			if (View.ContentSizeChanged(base.Content))
			{
				MeasureInvalid();
			}
		}

		internal void MeasureInvalid()
		{
			IsMeasureInvalid = true;
			InvalidateMeasure();
		}

		private bool CloseEnough(double value1, double value2)
		{
			if (Math.Abs(value1 - value2) < 1E-05)
			{
				return true;
			}
			return false;
		}

		protected internal new Size MeasureCore(Size availableSize)
		{
			IsMeasureInvalid = false;
			double num = 0.0;
			double num2 = 0.0;
			Size desiredContentSize = View.GetDesiredContentSize(availableSize);
			num = desiredContentSize.Width;
			num2 = desiredContentSize.Height;
			if (_lastLocation == PointerLocation && CloseEnough(_lastPosition.X, PointerPosition.X) && CloseEnough(_lastPosition.Y, PointerPosition.Y))
			{
				ActualBoxWidth = num;
				ActualBoxHeight = num2;
				if (PointerVisibility == Visibility.Visible)
				{
					num += _lastWidthDelta;
					num2 += _lastHeightDelta;
					ActualBoxFullWidth = ActualBoxWidth + _lastWidthDelta;
					ActualBoxFullHeight = ActualBoxHeight + _lastHeightDelta;
				}
				return new Size(num, num2);
			}
			Point actualBoxTopLeftPosition = new Point(0.0, 0.0);
			Point point = new Point(num * 0.5, 0.0);
			Point actualBoxTopRightPosition = new Point(num, 0.0);
			Point actualBoxBottomRightPosition = new Point(num, num2);
			Point point2 = new Point(num * 0.5, num2);
			Point actualBoxBottomLeftPosition = new Point(0.0, num2);
			Point point3 = new Point(0.0, num2 * 0.5);
			Point point4 = new Point(num, num2 * 0.5);
			double num3 = num;
			double num4 = num2;
			double num5 = num;
			double num6 = num2;
			Point actualPointerFirstPosition = new Point(0.0, 0.0);
			Point actualPointerSecondPosition = new Point(0.0, 0.0);
			Point value = new Point(0.0, 0.0);
			Point value2 = new Point(0.0, 0.0);
			double pointerInset = PointerInset;
			double pointerWidth = PointerWidth;
			PointerTooltipPointerLocation pointerTooltipPointerLocation = PointerLocation;
			Point pointerPosition = PointerPosition;
			double num7 = 0.0;
			double num8 = 0.0;
			double num9 = Math.Pow(actualBoxTopLeftPosition.X - pointerPosition.X, 2.0) + Math.Pow(actualBoxTopLeftPosition.Y - pointerPosition.Y, 2.0);
			double num10 = Math.Pow(point.X - pointerPosition.X, 2.0) + Math.Pow(point.Y - pointerPosition.Y, 2.0);
			double num11 = Math.Pow(actualBoxTopRightPosition.X - pointerPosition.X, 2.0) + Math.Pow(actualBoxTopRightPosition.Y - pointerPosition.Y, 2.0);
			double num12 = Math.Pow(point4.X - pointerPosition.X, 2.0) + Math.Pow(point4.Y - pointerPosition.Y, 2.0);
			double num13 = Math.Pow(actualBoxBottomRightPosition.X - pointerPosition.X, 2.0) + Math.Pow(actualBoxBottomRightPosition.Y - pointerPosition.Y, 2.0);
			double num14 = Math.Pow(point2.X - pointerPosition.X, 2.0) + Math.Pow(point2.Y - pointerPosition.Y, 2.0);
			double num15 = Math.Pow(actualBoxBottomLeftPosition.X - pointerPosition.X, 2.0) + Math.Pow(actualBoxBottomLeftPosition.Y - pointerPosition.Y, 2.0);
			double num16 = Math.Pow(point3.X - pointerPosition.X, 2.0) + Math.Pow(point3.Y - pointerPosition.Y, 2.0);
			double val = double.MaxValue;
			val = Math.Min(val, num9);
			val = Math.Min(val, num10);
			val = Math.Min(val, num11);
			val = Math.Min(val, num12);
			val = Math.Min(val, num13);
			val = Math.Min(val, num14);
			val = Math.Min(val, num15);
			val = Math.Min(val, num16);
			if (pointerTooltipPointerLocation == PointerTooltipPointerLocation.Auto)
			{
				if (val == num9)
				{
					pointerTooltipPointerLocation = PointerTooltipPointerLocation.LeftTop;
					if (pointerPosition.X >= actualBoxTopLeftPosition.X)
					{
						pointerTooltipPointerLocation = PointerTooltipPointerLocation.TopLeft;
					}
				}
				if (val == num16)
				{
					pointerTooltipPointerLocation = PointerTooltipPointerLocation.LeftMiddle;
				}
				if (val == num15)
				{
					pointerTooltipPointerLocation = PointerTooltipPointerLocation.LeftBottom;
					if (pointerPosition.X >= actualBoxBottomLeftPosition.X)
					{
						pointerTooltipPointerLocation = PointerTooltipPointerLocation.BottomLeft;
					}
				}
				if (val == num11)
				{
					pointerTooltipPointerLocation = PointerTooltipPointerLocation.RightTop;
					if (pointerPosition.X <= actualBoxTopRightPosition.X)
					{
						pointerTooltipPointerLocation = PointerTooltipPointerLocation.TopRight;
					}
				}
				if (val == num12)
				{
					pointerTooltipPointerLocation = PointerTooltipPointerLocation.RightMiddle;
				}
				if (val == num13)
				{
					pointerTooltipPointerLocation = PointerTooltipPointerLocation.RightBottom;
					if (pointerPosition.X <= actualBoxBottomRightPosition.X)
					{
						pointerTooltipPointerLocation = PointerTooltipPointerLocation.BottomRight;
					}
				}
				if (val == num10)
				{
					pointerTooltipPointerLocation = PointerTooltipPointerLocation.TopMiddle;
				}
				if (val == num14)
				{
					pointerTooltipPointerLocation = PointerTooltipPointerLocation.BottomMiddle;
				}
			}
			double num17 = DeviceUtils.ToPixelUnits(3.0);
			switch (pointerTooltipPointerLocation)
			{
			case PointerTooltipPointerLocation.TopLeft:
				actualPointerFirstPosition = new Point(actualBoxTopLeftPosition.X + pointerInset, actualBoxTopLeftPosition.Y);
				actualPointerSecondPosition = new Point(actualBoxTopLeftPosition.X + pointerInset + pointerWidth, actualBoxTopLeftPosition.Y);
				value = new Point(actualBoxTopLeftPosition.X + pointerInset, actualBoxTopLeftPosition.Y + num17);
				value2 = new Point(actualBoxTopLeftPosition.X + pointerInset + pointerWidth, actualBoxTopLeftPosition.Y + num17);
				break;
			case PointerTooltipPointerLocation.TopMiddle:
				actualPointerFirstPosition = new Point((actualBoxTopLeftPosition.X + actualBoxTopRightPosition.X) / 2.0 - pointerWidth / 2.0, actualBoxTopLeftPosition.Y);
				actualPointerSecondPosition = new Point((actualBoxTopLeftPosition.X + actualBoxTopRightPosition.X) / 2.0 + pointerWidth / 2.0, actualBoxTopLeftPosition.Y);
				value = new Point((actualBoxTopLeftPosition.X + actualBoxTopRightPosition.X) / 2.0 - pointerWidth / 2.0, actualBoxTopLeftPosition.Y + num17);
				value2 = new Point((actualBoxTopLeftPosition.X + actualBoxTopRightPosition.X) / 2.0 + pointerWidth / 2.0, actualBoxTopLeftPosition.Y + num17);
				break;
			case PointerTooltipPointerLocation.TopRight:
				actualPointerFirstPosition = new Point(actualBoxTopRightPosition.X - pointerInset, actualBoxTopLeftPosition.Y);
				actualPointerSecondPosition = new Point(actualBoxTopRightPosition.X - pointerInset - pointerWidth, actualBoxTopLeftPosition.Y);
				value = new Point(actualBoxTopRightPosition.X - pointerInset, actualBoxTopLeftPosition.Y + num17);
				value2 = new Point(actualBoxTopRightPosition.X - pointerInset - pointerWidth, actualBoxTopLeftPosition.Y + num17);
				break;
			case PointerTooltipPointerLocation.RightTop:
				actualPointerFirstPosition = new Point(actualBoxTopRightPosition.X, actualBoxTopRightPosition.Y + pointerInset);
				actualPointerSecondPosition = new Point(actualBoxTopRightPosition.X, actualBoxTopRightPosition.Y + pointerInset + pointerWidth);
				value = new Point(actualBoxTopRightPosition.X - num17, actualBoxTopRightPosition.Y + pointerInset);
				value2 = new Point(actualBoxTopRightPosition.X - num17, actualBoxTopRightPosition.Y + pointerInset + pointerWidth);
				break;
			case PointerTooltipPointerLocation.RightMiddle:
				actualPointerFirstPosition = new Point(actualBoxTopRightPosition.X, (actualBoxTopRightPosition.Y + actualBoxBottomRightPosition.Y) / 2.0 - pointerWidth / 2.0);
				actualPointerSecondPosition = new Point(actualBoxTopRightPosition.X, (actualBoxTopRightPosition.Y + actualBoxBottomRightPosition.Y) / 2.0 + pointerWidth / 2.0);
				value = new Point(actualBoxTopRightPosition.X - num17, (actualBoxTopRightPosition.Y + actualBoxBottomRightPosition.Y) / 2.0 - pointerWidth / 2.0);
				value2 = new Point(actualBoxTopRightPosition.X - num17, (actualBoxTopRightPosition.Y + actualBoxBottomRightPosition.Y) / 2.0 + pointerWidth / 2.0);
				break;
			case PointerTooltipPointerLocation.RightBottom:
				actualPointerFirstPosition = new Point(actualBoxBottomRightPosition.X, actualBoxBottomRightPosition.Y - pointerInset);
				actualPointerSecondPosition = new Point(actualBoxBottomRightPosition.X, actualBoxBottomRightPosition.Y - pointerInset - pointerWidth);
				value = new Point(actualBoxBottomRightPosition.X - num17, actualBoxBottomRightPosition.Y - pointerInset);
				value2 = new Point(actualBoxBottomRightPosition.X - num17, actualBoxBottomRightPosition.Y - pointerInset - pointerWidth);
				break;
			case PointerTooltipPointerLocation.BottomRight:
				actualPointerFirstPosition = new Point(actualBoxBottomRightPosition.X - pointerInset, actualBoxBottomRightPosition.Y);
				actualPointerSecondPosition = new Point(actualBoxBottomRightPosition.X - pointerInset - pointerWidth, actualBoxBottomRightPosition.Y);
				value = new Point(actualBoxBottomRightPosition.X - pointerInset, actualBoxBottomRightPosition.Y - num17);
				value2 = new Point(actualBoxBottomRightPosition.X - pointerInset - pointerWidth, actualBoxBottomRightPosition.Y - num17);
				break;
			case PointerTooltipPointerLocation.BottomMiddle:
				actualPointerFirstPosition = new Point((actualBoxBottomLeftPosition.X + actualBoxBottomRightPosition.X) / 2.0 - pointerWidth / 2.0, actualBoxBottomRightPosition.Y);
				actualPointerSecondPosition = new Point((actualBoxBottomLeftPosition.X + actualBoxBottomRightPosition.X) / 2.0 + pointerWidth / 2.0, actualBoxBottomRightPosition.Y);
				value = new Point((actualBoxBottomLeftPosition.X + actualBoxBottomRightPosition.X) / 2.0 - pointerWidth / 2.0, actualBoxBottomRightPosition.Y - num17);
				value2 = new Point((actualBoxBottomLeftPosition.X + actualBoxBottomRightPosition.X) / 2.0 + pointerWidth / 2.0, actualBoxBottomRightPosition.Y - num17);
				break;
			case PointerTooltipPointerLocation.BottomLeft:
				actualPointerFirstPosition = new Point(actualBoxBottomLeftPosition.X + pointerInset, actualBoxBottomLeftPosition.Y);
				actualPointerSecondPosition = new Point(actualBoxBottomLeftPosition.X + pointerInset + pointerWidth, actualBoxBottomLeftPosition.Y);
				value = new Point(actualBoxBottomLeftPosition.X + pointerInset, actualBoxBottomLeftPosition.Y - num17);
				value2 = new Point(actualBoxBottomLeftPosition.X + pointerInset + pointerWidth, actualBoxBottomLeftPosition.Y - num17);
				break;
			case PointerTooltipPointerLocation.LeftBottom:
				actualPointerFirstPosition = new Point(actualBoxTopLeftPosition.X, actualBoxBottomLeftPosition.Y - pointerInset);
				actualPointerSecondPosition = new Point(actualBoxTopLeftPosition.X, actualBoxBottomLeftPosition.Y - pointerInset - pointerWidth);
				value = new Point(actualBoxTopLeftPosition.X + num17, actualBoxBottomLeftPosition.Y - pointerInset);
				value2 = new Point(actualBoxTopLeftPosition.X + num17, actualBoxBottomLeftPosition.Y - pointerInset - pointerWidth);
				break;
			case PointerTooltipPointerLocation.LeftMiddle:
				actualPointerFirstPosition = new Point(actualBoxTopLeftPosition.X, (actualBoxTopLeftPosition.Y + actualBoxBottomLeftPosition.Y) / 2.0 - pointerWidth / 2.0);
				actualPointerSecondPosition = new Point(actualBoxTopLeftPosition.X, (actualBoxTopLeftPosition.Y + actualBoxBottomLeftPosition.Y) / 2.0 + pointerWidth / 2.0);
				value = new Point(actualBoxTopLeftPosition.X + num17, (actualBoxTopLeftPosition.Y + actualBoxBottomLeftPosition.Y) / 2.0 - pointerWidth / 2.0);
				value2 = new Point(actualBoxTopLeftPosition.X + num17, (actualBoxTopLeftPosition.Y + actualBoxBottomLeftPosition.Y) / 2.0 + pointerWidth / 2.0);
				break;
			case PointerTooltipPointerLocation.LeftTop:
				actualPointerFirstPosition = new Point(actualBoxTopLeftPosition.X, actualBoxTopLeftPosition.Y + pointerInset);
				actualPointerSecondPosition = new Point(actualBoxTopLeftPosition.X, actualBoxTopLeftPosition.Y + pointerInset + pointerWidth);
				value = new Point(actualBoxTopLeftPosition.X + num17, actualBoxTopLeftPosition.Y + pointerInset);
				value2 = new Point(actualBoxTopLeftPosition.X + num17, actualBoxTopLeftPosition.Y + pointerInset + pointerWidth);
				break;
			}
			Point actualPointerStartPosition = new Point(pointerPosition.X, pointerPosition.Y);
			if (actualPointerStartPosition.Y < actualBoxTopLeftPosition.Y)
			{
				double num18 = actualBoxTopLeftPosition.Y - actualPointerStartPosition.Y;
				actualPointerStartPosition = new Point(actualPointerStartPosition.X, 0.0);
				num6 += num18;
				actualBoxTopLeftPosition = new Point(actualBoxTopLeftPosition.X, actualBoxTopLeftPosition.Y + num18);
				actualBoxTopRightPosition = new Point(actualBoxTopRightPosition.X, actualBoxTopRightPosition.Y + num18);
				actualBoxBottomLeftPosition = new Point(actualBoxBottomLeftPosition.X, actualBoxBottomLeftPosition.Y + num18);
				actualBoxBottomRightPosition = new Point(actualBoxBottomRightPosition.X, actualBoxBottomRightPosition.Y + num18);
				actualPointerFirstPosition = new Point(actualPointerFirstPosition.X, actualPointerFirstPosition.Y + num18);
				actualPointerSecondPosition = new Point(actualPointerSecondPosition.X, actualPointerSecondPosition.Y + num18);
				value = new Point(value.X, value.Y + num18);
				value2 = new Point(value2.X, value2.Y + num18);
			}
			else
			{
				num6 = Math.Max(actualPointerStartPosition.Y, num4);
			}
			if (actualPointerStartPosition.X < actualBoxTopLeftPosition.X)
			{
				double num19 = actualBoxTopLeftPosition.X - actualPointerStartPosition.X;
				actualPointerStartPosition = new Point(0.0, actualPointerStartPosition.Y);
				num5 += num19;
				actualBoxTopLeftPosition = new Point(actualBoxTopLeftPosition.X + num19, actualBoxTopLeftPosition.Y);
				actualBoxTopRightPosition = new Point(actualBoxTopRightPosition.X + num19, actualBoxTopRightPosition.Y);
				actualBoxBottomLeftPosition = new Point(actualBoxBottomLeftPosition.X + num19, actualBoxBottomLeftPosition.Y);
				actualBoxBottomRightPosition = new Point(actualBoxBottomRightPosition.X + num19, actualBoxBottomRightPosition.Y);
				actualPointerFirstPosition = new Point(actualPointerFirstPosition.X + num19, actualPointerFirstPosition.Y);
				actualPointerSecondPosition = new Point(actualPointerSecondPosition.X + num19, actualPointerSecondPosition.Y);
				value = new Point(value.X + num19, value.Y);
				value2 = new Point(value2.X + num19, value2.Y);
			}
			else
			{
				num5 = Math.Max(actualPointerStartPosition.X, num3);
			}
			num7 = num5 - num3;
			num8 = num6 - num4;
			_lastWidthDelta = num7;
			_lastHeightDelta = num8;
			_lastLocation = PointerLocation;
			_lastPosition = PointerPosition;
			ActualPointerStartPosition = actualPointerStartPosition;
			ActualPointerFirstPosition = actualPointerFirstPosition;
			ActualPointerSecondPosition = actualPointerSecondPosition;
			ActualBoxWidth = num3;
			ActualBoxHeight = num4;
			ActualBoxFullWidth = num5;
			ActualBoxFullHeight = num6;
			ActualBoxTopLeftPosition = actualBoxTopLeftPosition;
			ActualBoxTopRightPosition = actualBoxTopRightPosition;
			ActualBoxBottomRightPosition = actualBoxBottomRightPosition;
			ActualBoxBottomLeftPosition = actualBoxBottomLeftPosition;
			PointCollection pointCollection = new PointCollection();
			pointCollection.Add(value2);
			pointCollection.Add(ActualPointerSecondPosition);
			pointCollection.Add(ActualPointerStartPosition);
			pointCollection.Add(ActualPointerFirstPosition);
			pointCollection.Add(value);
			PointerPoints = pointCollection;
			if (PointerShape != null)
			{
				PointerShape.Points = pointCollection;
			}
			PointCollection pointCollection2 = new PointCollection();
			pointCollection2.Add(ActualPointerSecondPosition);
			pointCollection2.Add(ActualPointerStartPosition);
			pointCollection2.Add(ActualPointerFirstPosition);
			PointerOutlinePoints = pointCollection2;
			if (PointerOutlineShape != null)
			{
				PointerOutlineShape.Points = pointCollection2;
			}
			if (PointerVisibility == Visibility.Collapsed)
			{
				return new Size(num, num2);
			}
			return new Size(num5, num6);
		}

		protected override Size MeasureOverride(Size availableSize)
		{
			return MeasureCore(availableSize);
		}

		public object ExportVisualData()
		{
			if (base.Visibility == Visibility.Collapsed)
			{
				return null;
			}
			return View.ExportVisualData();
		}

	public class PointerTooltipView
	{
		private PointerTooltip Model { get; set; }

		public PointerTooltipView(PointerTooltip model)
		{
			Model = model;
		}

		public bool ContentSizeChanged(object Content)
		{
			return false;
		}

		public Size GetDesiredContentSize(Size availableSize)
		{
			ContentControl contentControl = Model.ContentControl;
			double width = 0.0;
			double height = 0.0;
			if (contentControl != null)
			{
				contentControl.Measure(availableSize);
				if (!double.IsNaN(contentControl.DesiredSize.Width) && !double.IsInfinity(contentControl.DesiredSize.Width))
				{
					width = contentControl.DesiredSize.Width;
				}
				if (!double.IsNaN(contentControl.DesiredSize.Height) && !double.IsInfinity(contentControl.DesiredSize.Height))
				{
					height = contentControl.DesiredSize.Height;
				}
			}
			return new Size(width, height);
		}

		public object ExportVisualData()
		{
			if (Model.PointerShape != null && Model.PointerOutlineShape != null)
			{
				return Model.SeriesVisualDataManager.ExportPointerTooltipData(Model.PointerShape, Model.PointerOutlineShape, new Rectangle(), new Rect(0.0, 0.0, Model.ActualBoxFullWidth, Model.ActualBoxFullHeight));
			}
			return null;
		}
	}

	internal class AngleAxisLabelPanelView : AxisLabelPanelBaseView
	{

		public AngleAxisLabelPanelView(AngleAxisLabelPanel model)
			: base(model)
		{
			AngleModel = model;
		}

		internal override void OnInit()
		{
			base.OnInit();
			AngleModel.ClipLabelsToBounds = true;
			AngleModel.SizeChanged += AngleLabelAxisPanel_SizeChanged;
			AngleModel.Loaded += AngleLabelAxisPanel_Loaded;
		}

		private void AngleLabelAxisPanel_Loaded(object sender, RoutedEventArgs e)
		{
			ClipToBounds();
		}

		private void ClipToBounds()
		{
			AngleModel.Clip = new RectangleGeometry
			{
				Rect = new Rect(0.0, 0.0, AngleModel.ActualWidth, AngleModel.ActualHeight)
			};
		}

		private void AngleLabelAxisPanel_SizeChanged(object sender, SizeChangedEventArgs e)
		{
			ClipToBounds();
		}

		internal void DetermineLargestLabels(List<Rect> rectangles, List<bool> isOverlayList)
		{
			AngleModel.LargestWidth = double.MinValue;
			AngleModel.LargestHeight = double.MinValue;
			for (int i = 0; i < base.Model.TextBlocks.Count; i++)
			{
				FrameworkElement frameworkElement = base.Model.TextBlocks[i];
				LabelPosition labelPosition = base.Model.LabelPositions[i];
				bool isOverlay = base.Model.LabelPositions[i].IsOverlay;
				Point point = AngleModel.GetPoint(labelPosition.Value);
				double x = point.X - frameworkElement.DesiredSize.Width / 2.0;
				double y = point.Y - frameworkElement.DesiredSize.Height / 2.0;
				double width = frameworkElement.DesiredSize.Width;
				double height = frameworkElement.DesiredSize.Height;
				if (!isOverlay)
				{
					AngleModel.LargestWidth = Math.Max(width, AngleModel.LargestWidth);
					AngleModel.LargestHeight = Math.Max(height, AngleModel.LargestHeight);
				}
				Rect item = new Rect(x, y, width, height);
				rectangles.Add(item);
				isOverlayList.Add(isOverlay);
			}
		}

		protected internal override double GetLabelBottomMargin()
		{
			return 0.0;
		}

		protected internal override double GetLabelLeftMargin()
		{
			return 0.0;
		}

		protected internal override double GetLabelRightMargin()
		{
			return 0.0;
		}

		protected internal override double GetLabelTopMargin()
		{
			return 0.0;
		}
