	public class AxisLabelPanelBaseView
	{
		protected AxisLabelPanelBase Model { get; set; }

		protected internal Path Ticks { get; private set; }

		internal GeometryCollection GetTicksGeometry()
		{
			return (Ticks.Data as GeometryGroup).Children;
		}

		public AxisLabelPanelBaseView(AxisLabelPanelBase model)
		{
			Model = model;
		}

		internal void EnsureContextFont()
		{
		}

		internal double GetHeightBounds(object element)
		{
			double labelTopMargin = GetLabelTopMargin();
			double labelBottomMargin = GetLabelBottomMargin();
			return GetDesiredHeight(element) + labelTopMargin + labelBottomMargin;
		}

		internal double GetWidthBounds(object element)
		{
			double num = ((Model.LabelSettings == null) ? 0.0 : Model.LabelSettings.Margin.Left);
			double num2 = ((Model.LabelSettings == null) ? 0.0 : Model.LabelSettings.Margin.Right);
			return GetDesiredWidth(element) + num + num2;
		}

		internal double GetDesiredWidth(object element)
		{
			return ((FrameworkElement)element).DesiredSize.Width;
		}

		internal double GetDesiredHeight(object element)
		{
			return ((FrameworkElement)element).DesiredSize.Height;
		}

		internal void DetermineLongestLabel()
		{
			foreach (object label in GetLabels())
			{
				if (label is FrameworkElement frameworkElement)
				{
					if (frameworkElement is TextBlock && frameworkElement.ReadLocalValue(FrameworkElement.WidthProperty) != DependencyProperty.UnsetValue)
					{
						frameworkElement.ClearValue(FrameworkElement.WidthProperty);
					}
					Model.OnProcessTextBlock(frameworkElement);
					frameworkElement.Measure(new Size(double.PositiveInfinity, double.PositiveInfinity));
					Model.ConsiderForLongestTextBlock(frameworkElement);
				}
			}
		}

		internal IEnumerable<object> GetLabels()
		{
			IEnumerable<object> textBlocks = Model.GetTextBlocks();
			IEnumerable<object> labels = Model.GetLabels();
			if (!Model.Axis.UsingTemplate)
			{
				return textBlocks;
			}
			return labels;
		}

		internal void ArrangeTextToBounds(object element, Rect rect, double marginLeft, double marginTop, double marginRight, double marginBottom)
		{
			FrameworkElement obj = (FrameworkElement)element;
			double num = rect.Height - (marginTop + marginBottom);
			double num2 = rect.Width - (marginLeft + marginRight);
			if (num2 < 0.0)
			{
				num2 = 0.0;
			}
			if (num < 0.0)
			{
				num = 0.0;
			}
			Rect finalRect = new Rect(rect.Left + marginLeft, rect.Top + marginTop, num2, num);
			obj.Arrange(finalRect);
		}

		internal void ArrangeBackingToText(Rectangle backing, TextBlock textBlock, LabelPosition position, Rect rect, double leftMargin, double topMargin, double rightMargin, double bottomMargin)
		{
			double num = Math.Max(leftMargin, Math.Max(topMargin, Math.Max(rightMargin, bottomMargin)));
			Thickness thickness = new Thickness(num);
			if (Model.UseRotation)
			{
				thickness = new Thickness(Math.Sqrt(num * num / 2.0));
			}
			Thickness thickness2 = position.OverlayPadding;
			if (double.IsNaN(thickness2.Left) || double.IsNaN(thickness2.Top) || double.IsNaN(thickness2.Right) || double.IsNaN(thickness2.Bottom))
			{
				thickness2 = thickness;
			}
			if (thickness2.Left > thickness.Left || thickness2.Top > thickness.Top || thickness2.Right > thickness.Right || thickness2.Bottom > thickness.Bottom)
			{
				thickness2 = thickness;
			}
			Rect rect2 = new Rect(rect.Left - thickness2.Left, rect.Top - thickness2.Top, rect.Width + thickness2.Left + thickness2.Right, rect.Height + thickness2.Top + thickness2.Bottom);
			ArrangeTextToBounds(backing, rect2, leftMargin, topMargin, rightMargin, bottomMargin);
		}

		internal void ClearTransforms(object element)
		{
			((FrameworkElement)element).RenderTransform = null;
		}

		internal void HandleSetLabelRotationTransform(object label, double angle)
		{
			FrameworkElement obj = label as FrameworkElement;
			double centerX = 0.0;
			double centerY = 0.0;
			RotateTransform renderTransform = new RotateTransform
			{
				Angle = angle,
				CenterX = centerX,
				CenterY = centerY
			};
			obj.RenderTransform = renderTransform;
		}

		internal void SetBackingRotationTransform(Rectangle backing, TextBlock textBlock, LabelPosition position, Rect rect, double leftMargin, double topMargin, double rightMargin, double bottomMargin, double angle)
		{
			double num = Math.Max(leftMargin, Math.Max(topMargin, Math.Max(rightMargin, bottomMargin)));
			Thickness thickness = new Thickness(num);
			if (Model.UseRotation)
			{
				thickness = new Thickness(Math.Sqrt(num * num / 2.0));
			}
			Thickness thickness2 = position.OverlayPadding;
			if (double.IsNaN(thickness2.Left) || double.IsNaN(thickness2.Top) || double.IsNaN(thickness2.Right) || double.IsNaN(thickness2.Bottom))
			{
				thickness2 = thickness;
			}
			if (thickness2.Left > thickness.Left || thickness2.Top > thickness.Top || thickness2.Right > thickness.Right || thickness2.Bottom > thickness.Bottom)
			{
				thickness2 = thickness;
			}
			Transform renderTransform = textBlock.RenderTransform;
			TransformGroup transformGroup = new TransformGroup();
			TranslateTransform value = new TranslateTransform
			{
				X = 0.0 - thickness2.Left,
				Y = 0.0 - thickness2.Top
			};
			TranslateTransform value2 = new TranslateTransform
			{
				X = thickness2.Left,
				Y = thickness2.Top
			};
			transformGroup.Children.Add(value);
			transformGroup.Children.Add(renderTransform);
			transformGroup.Children.Add(value2);
			backing.RenderTransform = transformGroup;
		}

		internal void HandleMeasureLabel(object element)
		{
			(element as FrameworkElement).Measure(new Size(double.PositiveInfinity, double.PositiveInfinity));
		}

		internal void HandleMeasureLabel(object element, Size availableSize)
		{
			(element as FrameworkElement).Measure(availableSize);
		}

		internal virtual string TrimTextBlock(TextBlock textblock, double availableWidth, double leftMargin, double rightMargin)
		{
			string text = textblock.Text;
			int num = text.Length;
			TextBlock textBlock = new TextBlock
			{
				Text = text,
				FontFamily = textblock.FontFamily,
				FontSize = textblock.FontSize,
				FontStretch = textblock.FontStretch,
				FontWeight = textblock.FontWeight,
				TextTrimming = textblock.TextTrimming,
				TextWrapping = textblock.TextWrapping
			};
			double num2 = 0.0;
			num2 = textBlock.ActualWidth;
			textBlock.Measure(new Size(double.PositiveInfinity, double.PositiveInfinity));
			num2 = textBlock.DesiredSize.Width;
			num2 = num2 + leftMargin + rightMargin;
			while (num2 - availableWidth > 0.0001 && num > 0)
			{
				num--;
				textBlock.Text = text.Substring(0, num) + "…";
				num2 = textBlock.ActualWidth + leftMargin + rightMargin;
				textBlock.Measure(new Size(double.PositiveInfinity, double.PositiveInfinity));
				num2 = textBlock.DesiredSize.Width + leftMargin + rightMargin;
			}
			return textBlock.Text;
		}

		internal virtual void OnInit()
		{
			Ticks = new Path
			{
				Data = new GeometryGroup(),
				IsHitTestVisible = false
			};
		}

		internal void BindExtentToSettings()
		{
			Model.Extent = Model.Axis.GetUserExtent();
		}

				return 0.0;
			}
			return Model.Axis.TitleTextBlock.DesiredSize.Height;
		}

		internal void ArrangeTicks(Size finalSize)
		{
			Ticks.Arrange(new Rect(0.0, 0.0, finalSize.Width, finalSize.Height));
		}

		internal double GetTitleTopMargin()
		{
			if (Model.Axis.TitleSettings != null && Model.Axis.TitleSettings.Margin.Top != 0.0)
			{
				return Math.Max(0.0, Model.Axis.TitleSettings.Margin.Top);
			}
			return 0.0;
		}

		internal double GetTitleBottomMargin()
		{
			if (Model.Axis.TitleSettings != null && Model.Axis.TitleSettings.Margin.Bottom != 0.0)
			{
				return Math.Max(0.0, Model.Axis.TitleSettings.Margin.Bottom);
			}
			return 0.0;
		}

		internal double GetTitleLeftMargin()
		{
			if (Model.Axis.TitleSettings != null && Model.Axis.TitleSettings.Margin.Left != 0.0)
			{
				return Math.Max(0.0, Model.Axis.TitleSettings.Margin.Left);
			}
			return 0.0;
		}

		internal double GetTitleRightMargin()
		{
			if (Model.Axis.TitleSettings != null && Model.Axis.TitleSettings.Margin.Right != 0.0)
			{
				return Math.Max(0.0, Model.Axis.TitleSettings.Margin.Right);
			}
			return 0.0;
		}

		internal PathRenderingInfo GetThicksRenderingInfo()
		{
			PathRenderingInfo pathRenderingInfo = new PathRenderingInfo
			{
				Stroke = Model.Axis.TickStroke,
				StrokeThickness = Model.Axis.TickStrokeThickness,
				DashArray = Model.Axis.TickStrokeDashArray
			};
			if (Model.Axis != null && Model.Axis.SeriesViewer is XamDataChart)
			{
				XamDataChart xamDataChart = (XamDataChart)Model.Axis.SeriesViewer;
				if (xamDataChart.AlignsGridLinesToPixels && xamDataChart.State != InteractionState.DragPan && xamDataChart.State != InteractionState.DragZoom)
				{
					pathRenderingInfo.AlignToPixels = true;
				}
			}
			return pathRenderingInfo;
		}

		protected internal virtual double GetLabelBottomMargin()
		{
			return Math.Max(0.0, (Model.LabelSettings == null) ? 0.0 : Model.LabelSettings.Margin.Bottom);
		}

		protected internal virtual double GetLabelTopMargin()

		}

			return Math.Max(0.0, (Model.LabelSettings == null) ? 0.0 : Model.LabelSettings.Margin.Left);
		}

		protected internal virtual double GetLabelRightMargin()
		{
			return Math.Max(0.0, (Model.LabelSettings == null) ? 0.0 : Model.LabelSettings.Margin.Right);
		}

		public WeakReferenceHelper<Axis> Axes { get; internal set; }

		internal AxisLabelsLocation ActualLocation { get; set; }

		internal bool HasFontInfo => _hasFontInfo;

		public event PropertyChangedEventHandler PropertyChanged;

		public event PropertyUpdatedEventHandler PropertyUpdated;

		public AxisLabelSettings()
		{
			Axes = new WeakReferenceHelper<Axis>();
			TextBlock textBlock = new TextBlock();
			FontFamily = textBlock.FontFamily;
			FontSize = textBlock.FontSize;
			Foreground = textBlock.Foreground;
			OpacityMask = textBlock.OpacityMask;
			TextDecorations = textBlock.TextDecorations;
			ActualLocation = AxisLabelsLocation.OutsideBottom;
			PropertyUpdated += delegate(object o, PropertyUpdatedEventArgs e)
			{
				PropertyUpdatedOverride(o, e.PropertyName, e.OldValue, e.NewValue);
			};
		}

		public void RegisterAxis(Axis axis)
		{
			if (!Axes.Contains(axis))
			{
				Axes.Add(axis);
			}
		}

		public void UnregisterAxis(Axis axis)
		{
			Axes.Remove(axis);
		}

		protected virtual void PropertyUpdatedOverride(object sender, string propertyName, object oldValue, object newValue)
		{
			string text = propertyName;
			if (text == "Location")
			{
				ActualLocation = Location;
			}
			Axes.ForEach(delegate(Axis axis)
			{
				if (axis == null || axis.SeriesViewer == null)
				{
					return true;
				}
				switch (propertyName)
				{
				case "Angle":
					axis.MustInvalidateLabels = true;
					axis.RenderAxis();
					break;
				case "ShowFirstLabel":
					axis.MustInvalidateLabels = true;
					axis.RenderAxis();
					break;
				case "VerticalAlignment":
				case "HorizontalAlignment":
					axis.MustInvalidateLabels = true;
					axis.RenderAxis();
					break;
				case "Location":
					axis.MustInvalidateLabels = true;
					axis.SeriesViewer.InvalidatePanels();
					axis.RenderAxis();
					break;
				case "Visibility":
					axis.MustInvalidateLabels = true;
					axis.SeriesViewer.InvalidatePanels();
					axis.RenderAxis();
					break;
				case "Extent":
					axis.MustInvalidateLabels = true;
					axis.SeriesViewer.InvalidatePanels();
					axis.RenderAxis();
					break;
				case "Margin":
					if (HasUserExtent())
					{
						axis.MustInvalidateLabels = true;
						axis.RenderAxis();
					}
					else
					{
						axis.MustInvalidateLabels = true;
						axis.SeriesViewer.InvalidatePanels();
						axis.RenderAxis();
					}
					break;
				case "FontFamily":
				case "FontSize":
				case "FontStretch":
				case "FontStyle":
				case "FontWeight":
					_hasFontInfo = true;
					_fontInfo = null;
					axis.MustInvalidateLabels = true;
					axis.RenderAxis();
					break;
				}
				axis.PropagateLabelSettings();
				return true;
			});
		}

		protected void RaisePropertyChanged(string name, object oldValue, object newValue)
		{
			if (this.PropertyChanged != null)
			{
				this.PropertyChanged(this, new PropertyChangedEventArgs(name));
			}
			if (this.PropertyUpdated != null)
			{
				this.PropertyUpdated(this, new PropertyUpdatedEventArgs(name, oldValue, newValue));
			}
		}

		internal bool HasUserAngle()
		{
			return ReadLocalValue(AngleProperty) != DependencyProperty.UnsetValue;
		}

		internal bool HasUserExtent()
		{
			return ReadLocalValue(ExtentProperty) != DependencyProperty.UnsetValue;
		}

		internal FontInfo GetFontInfo()
		{
			return FontInfo;
		}

		protected override Freezable CreateInstanceCore()
		{
			return new AxisLabelSettings();
		}
	}

				{
					return true;
				}
				switch (propertyName)
				{
				case "Angle":
				case "Position":
				case "VerticalAlignment":
				case "HorizontalAlignment":
				case "Margin":
					axis.MustInvalidateLabels = true;
					axis.RenderAxis();

	internal class CategoryDateTimeXAxisView : CategoryAxisBaseView
	{
		protected CategoryDateTimeXAxis XModel { get; set; }

		public CategoryDateTimeXAxisView(CategoryDateTimeXAxis model)
			: base(model)
		{
			XModel = model;
		}

		public override void OnTemplateProvided()
		{
			base.OnTemplateProvided();
			base.Model.RenderAxis(animate: false);
		}

		protected internal override string GetValueLabel(double value)
		{
			return GetDateLabelString(new DateTime((long)value)).ToString();
		}

		internal override object GetLabelValue(object dataItem)
		{
			DataTemplate dataTemplate = base.Model.Label as DataTemplate;
			if (dataTemplate == null)
			{
				new StringFormatter().FormatString = base.Model.Label as string;
			}
			if (dataTemplate != null)
			{
				return new ContentControl
				{
					DataContext = new AxisItemDataContext
					{
						Axis = base.Model,
						Item = dataItem
					},
					Content = dataTemplate.LoadContent(),
					HorizontalContentAlignment = HorizontalAlignment.Stretch,
					VerticalContentAlignment = VerticalAlignment.Stretch
				};
			}
			return GetDateLabelString(dataItem);
		}

		protected object GetDateLabelString(object dataItem)
		{
			StringFormatter stringFormatter = new StringFormatter
			{
				FormatString = (base.Model.Label as string)
			};
			try
			{
				if (base.Model.HasFormatLabel())
				{
					return base.Model.RaiseFormatLabel(dataItem);
				}
				if (XModel.DisplayType == TimeAxisDisplayType.Discrete || !(dataItem is DateTime))
				{
					return stringFormatter.Format(dataItem, null);
				}
				return (stringFormatter != null && stringFormatter.CompiledFormatString != null) ? string.Format(stringFormatter.CompiledFormatString, dataItem) : null;
			}
			catch (FormatException)
			{
				return base.Model.Label;
			}
		}
	}

		{

			{
				Source = Model
			});
			Path ticks = Model.LabelPanel.View.Ticks;
			ticks.SetBinding(Shape.StrokeProperty, new Binding("TickStroke")
			{
				Source = AxisPropertiesSource
			});
			ticks.SetBinding(Shape.StrokeThicknessProperty, new Binding("TickStrokeThickness")
			{
				Source = AxisPropertiesSource
			});
			ticks.SetBinding(Shape.StrokeDashArrayProperty, new Binding("TickStrokeDashArray")

			Model.HandleRectChanged(new Rect(new Point(0.0, 0.0), args.PreviousSize), new Rect(new Point(0.0, 0.0), args.NewSize));
		}

		{

			{
				Source = AxisPropertiesSource

			AxisLines.SetBinding(Shape.StrokeDashArrayProperty, new Binding("StrokeDashArray")
			{
				Source = AxisPropertiesSource,
				Converter = new DoubleCollectionDuplicator()
			});
			SetupStrips();
			MajorLines.Detach();
			RootCanvas.Children.Add(MajorLines);
			MajorLines.SetBinding(Shape.StrokeProperty, new Binding("ActualMajorStroke")
			{
				Source = AxisPropertiesSource
			});
			MajorLines.SetBinding(Shape.StrokeThicknessProperty, new Binding("MajorStrokeThickness")
			{
				Source = AxisPropertiesSource

			MajorLines.SetBinding(Shape.StrokeDashArrayProperty, new Binding("MajorStrokeDashArray")
			{
				Source = AxisPropertiesSource,
				Converter = new DoubleCollectionDuplicator()

			MinorLines.Detach();
			RootCanvas.Children.Add(MinorLines);
			MinorLines.SetBinding(Shape.StrokeProperty, new Binding("ActualMinorStroke")

		internal void ChangeLabelSettings(AxisLabelSettings settings)
		{
			foreach (object child in LabelPanel.Children)
			{
				if (child is TextBlock && child != Model.TitleTextBlock)
				{
					BindingOperations.ClearAllBindings(child as TextBlock);
					(child as TextBlock).DataContext = settings;
					AxisLabelManager.BindLabel(child as TextBlock, settings);
				}
			}
			foreach (TextBlock item in Model.TextBlocks.Inactive)
			{
				if (item != null && item != Model.TitleTextBlock)
				{
					BindingOperations.ClearAllBindings(item);
					item.DataContext = settings;
					AxisLabelManager.BindLabel(item, settings);
				}
			}
		}

		internal virtual object GetLabelValue(object dataItem)

			{
				return new ContentControl
				{
					Content = new AxisItemDataContext

						Axis = Model,
						Item = dataItem
					},
					ContentTemplate = contentTemplate,
					HorizontalContentAlignment = HorizontalAlignment.Stretch,
					VerticalContentAlignment = VerticalAlignment.Stretch
				};
			}
			return GetLabelString(dataItem);
		}

		protected string GetLabelString(object dataItem)
		{
			if (Model.HasFormatLabel())
			{
				return Model.RaiseFormatLabel(dataItem);
			}
			_ = Model.Label;
			if (_labelIsIndexer)
			{
				_frh.PropertyName = _indexerLabel;
				return _frh.GetPropertyValue(dataItem)?.ToString();
			}
			return new StringFormatter
			{
				FormatString = (Model.Label as string)
			}.Format(dataItem, null);
		}

		public void OnTitleChange()
		{
			if (Model.IsAngular || Model.IsRadial)
			{
				return;
			}
			if (Model.Title == null)
			{
				if (Model.TitleTextBlock != null)
				{
					Model.TitleTextBlock.Visibility = Visibility.Collapsed;
				}
				return;
			}
			if (Model.TitleTextBlock != null)
			{
				Model.TitleTextBlock.Visibility = Visibility.Visible;
			}
			if (Model.TitleTextBlock == null)
			{
				TextBlock textBlock = new TextBlock
				{
					DataContext = Model.TitleSettings
				};
				if (textBlock.Parent == null)
				{
					LabelPanel.Children.Add(textBlock);
				}
				Model.TitleTextBlock = textBlock;
			}
			if (Model.TitleTextBlock != null)
			{
				AxisLabelManager.BindTitleLabel(Model.TitleTextBlock, Model.TitleSettings);
			}
			if (Model.TitleTextBlock.DataContext != Model.TitleSettings)
			{
				Model.TitleTextBlock.DataContext = Model.TitleSettings;
			}
			Model.TitleTextBlock.Text = Model.Title;
		}

		protected internal void ApplyDefaultSettings()
		{
		}

		public Point ExportLabelPosition(TextBlock textBlock)
		{
			return new Point
			{
				X = textBlock.TransformToVisual(Model.LabelPanel).GetMatrix().OffsetX,
				Y = textBlock.TransformToVisual(Model.LabelPanel).GetMatrix().OffsetY
			};
		}

		public Point ExportLabelsPanelPosition()
		{
			if (Model.SeriesViewer is XamDataChart)
			{
				return new Point
				{
					X = Model.LabelPanel.TransformToVisual(Model.SeriesViewer).GetMatrix().OffsetX,
					Y = Model.LabelPanel.TransformToVisual(Model.SeriesViewer).GetMatrix().OffsetY
				};
			}
			return new Point(0.0, 0.0);
		}

		public Rect ExportLabelsPanelViewport()
		{
			ExportLabelsPanelPosition();
			return new Rect(0.0, 0.0, LabelPanel.ActualWidth, LabelPanel.ActualHeight);
		}

		public Point ExportTitlePosition(TextBlock textBlock)
		{
			return textBlock.TransformToVisual(Model.LabelPanel).Transform(new Point(0.0, 0.0));
		}

		public Rect ExportTitleBounds(TextBlock textBlock)
		{
			List<Point> corners = new Rect(0.0, 0.0, textBlock.ActualWidth, textBlock.ActualHeight).GetCorners();
			double num = double.MaxValue;
			double num2 = double.MaxValue;
			double num3 = double.MinValue;
			double num4 = double.MinValue;
			foreach (Point item in corners)
			{
				Point point = textBlock.TransformToVisual(Model.LabelPanel).Transform(item);
				num = Math.Min(num, point.Y);
				num2 = Math.Min(num2, point.X);
				num3 = Math.Max(num3, point.X);
				num4 = Math.Max(num4, point.Y);
			}
			return new Rect(num2, num, num3 - num2, num4 - num);
		}

		public FontInfo GetSmartAxisDefaultFont()
		{
			return FontUtil.GetDefaultFont();
		}

		public Thickness ExportTitleMargin(TextBlock textBlock)
		{
			double titleTopMargin = Model.LabelPanel.View.GetTitleTopMargin();
			double titleLeftMargin = Model.LabelPanel.View.GetTitleLeftMargin();
			double titleRightMargin = Model.LabelPanel.View.GetTitleRightMargin();
			double titleBottomMargin = Model.LabelPanel.View.GetTitleBottomMargin();
			return new Thickness(titleLeftMargin, titleTopMargin, titleRightMargin, titleBottomMargin);
		}

		public void OnLabelChanged()
		{
			_labelIsIndexer = false;
			if (Model.Label == null || !(Model.Label is string))
			{
				return;
			}
			string text = (string)Model.Label;
			if (text.StartsWith("{[") || text.StartsWith("["))
			{
				_indexerLabel = text;
				if (_indexerLabel.StartsWith("{") && _indexerLabel.EndsWith("}"))
				{
					_indexerLabel = _indexerLabel.Substring(1, _indexerLabel.Length - 2);
				}
				_labelIsIndexer = true;
			}
		}
	}

	internal class CategoryAxisBaseView : AxisView
	{
		protected CategoryAxisBase CategoryModel { get; set; }

		public CategoryAxisBaseView(CategoryAxisBase model)
			: base(model)
		{
			CategoryModel = model;
			Axis axis = model.GetAxisComponentsForView().Axis;
			axis.Loaded += CategoryAxisBase_Loaded;
			axis.Unloaded += CategoryAxisBase_Unloaded;
		}

		protected internal override string GetValueLabel(double value)
		{
			int num = 0;
			num = ((CategoryModel.CategoryMode != CategoryMode.Mode0) ? ((int)Math.Floor(value)) : ((int)Math.Round(value)));
			if (num == ((CategoryAxisBase)base.Model).ItemsCount)
			{
				num--;
			}
			if (num < 0 || num > ((CategoryAxisBase)base.Model).ItemsCount - 1)
			{
				return null;
			}
			object dataItem = ((CategoryAxisBase)base.Model).FastItemsSource[num];
			return GetLabelString(dataItem);
		}

		private void CategoryAxisBase_Unloaded(object sender, RoutedEventArgs e)
		{
			if ((base.Model.SeriesViewer == null || !base.Model.SeriesViewer.ShouldKeepResourcesOnUnload) && !Utilities.HasLoadedAncestor<FlowDocumentReader>(base.Model.SeriesViewer))
			{
				CategoryModel.OnDetached();
			}
		}

		private void CategoryAxisBase_Loaded(object sender, RoutedEventArgs e)
		{
			CategoryModel.OnAttached();
		}

		internal int AddLabels(List<object> list)
		{
			int num = 0;
			for (int i = 0; i < list.Count; i++)
			{
				if (!(list[i] is FrameworkElement element))
				{
					FrameworkElement frameworkElement = base.Model.TextBlocks[i];
					frameworkElement.SetValue(TextBlock.TextProperty, list[i]);
					frameworkElement.ClearValue(TextBlock.TextWrappingProperty);
					num++;
				}
				else
				{
					base.LabelPanel.Children.Add(element);
				}
			}
			base.Model.AddAnnotations();
			return num;
		}
	}

	internal class HorizontalAxisLabelPanelBaseView : AxisLabelPanelBaseView
	{
		protected HorizontalAxisLabelPanelBase HorizontalModel { get; set; }

		public HorizontalAxisLabelPanelBaseView(HorizontalAxisLabelPanelBase model)
			: base(model)
		{
			HorizontalModel = model;
		}

		internal void BindExtent()
		{
			base.Model.SetBinding(FrameworkElement.HeightProperty, new Binding("Extent")
			{
				Source = base.Model
			});
		}

		internal bool ShouldUseWrapping()
		{
			if (base.Model.LabelSettings != null && base.Model.LabelSettings.TextWrapping == TextWrapping.Wrap)
			{
				return base.Model.LabelSettings.VerticalAlignment == VerticalAlignment.Stretch;
			}
			return false;
		}

		internal void HandleVerticalAlignment(List<Rect> rectangles)
		{
			double labelTopOffset = HorizontalModel.GetLabelTopOffset();
			double labelBottomOffset = HorizontalModel.GetLabelBottomOffset();
			Rect labelViewport = base.Model.LabelViewport;
			double labelSpan = HorizontalModel.GetLabelSpan();
			double num = labelSpan / 2.0;
			for (int i = 0; i < base.Model.TextBlocks.Count; i++)
			{
				FrameworkElement frameworkElement = base.Model.TextBlocks[i];
				Rect value = rectangles[i];
				double num2 = Math.Min(labelSpan, value.Height) / 2.0;
				switch (frameworkElement.VerticalAlignment)
				{
				case VerticalAlignment.Top:
					value.Y = labelViewport.Top + labelTopOffset;
					break;
				case VerticalAlignment.Center:
					value.Y = labelViewport.Top + labelTopOffset + num - num2;
					break;
				case VerticalAlignment.Bottom:
					value.Y = labelViewport.Bottom - labelBottomOffset - value.Height;
					break;
				case VerticalAlignment.Stretch:
					value.Y = labelViewport.Top + labelTopOffset;
					value.Height = labelSpan;
					break;
				}
				rectangles[i] = value;
			}
		}
	}

	internal class NumericXAxisView : StraightNumericAxisBaseView

	internal class RadialAxisLabelPanelView : HorizontalAxisLabelPanelBaseView
	{
		protected RadialAxisLabelPanel RadialModel { get; set; }

		public RadialAxisLabelPanelView(RadialAxisLabelPanel model)
			: base(model)
		{
			RadialModel = model;
		}

		internal void SetLabelRotationalTransform(FrameworkElement label, double angle, double yFactor)
		{
			label.RenderTransformOrigin = new Point(0.5, 0.5);
			TransformGroup transformGroup = new TransformGroup();
			transformGroup.Children.Add(new RotateTransform
			{
				Angle = angle
			});
			transformGroup.Children.Add(new TranslateTransform
			{
				X = label.DesiredSize.Width / -2.0,
				Y = label.DesiredSize.Width / 2.0 * yFactor
			});
			label.RenderTransform = transformGroup;
		}

		internal void ClearPanelRotation()
		{
			base.Model.RenderTransform = null;
		}

		internal void ApplyPanelRotation(Size finalSize)
		{
			base.Model.RenderTransform = new RotateTransform
			{
				Angle = RadialModel.CrossingAngle * 180.0 / Math.PI,
				CenterX = RadialModel.RotationCenter.X,
				CenterY = RadialModel.RotationCenter.Y * finalSize.Height
			};
		}
	}

			{

			BindingOperations.SetBinding(StraightModel.ActualScaler, NumericScaler.ActualMaximumValueProperty, new Binding("ActualMaximumValue")

	internal class VerticalAxisLabelPanelView : AxisLabelPanelBaseView
	{
		protected VerticalAxisLabelPanel VerticalModel { get; set; }

		public VerticalAxisLabelPanelView(VerticalAxisLabelPanel model)
			: base(model)
		{
			VerticalModel = model;
		}

		internal void BindExtent()
		{
			base.Model.SetBinding(FrameworkElement.WidthProperty, new Binding("Extent")
			{
				Source = base.Model
			});
		}

		internal void HandleHorizontalAlignment(List<Rect> rectangles, double largestWidth)
		{
			double labelLeftOffset = VerticalModel.GetLabelLeftOffset();
			double labelRightOffset = VerticalModel.GetLabelRightOffset();
			if (base.Model.LabelSettings != null)
			{
				_ = base.Model.LabelSettings.HorizontalAlignment;
			}
			_ = base.Model.Extent;
			double labelSpan = VerticalModel.GetLabelSpan();
			double num = labelSpan / 2.0;
			Rect labelViewport = base.Model.LabelViewport;
			for (int i = 0; i < base.Model.TextBlocks.Count; i++)
			{
				FrameworkElement frameworkElement = base.Model.TextBlocks[i];
				Rect value = rectangles[i];
				double num2 = value.Width / 2.0;
				if (!(labelSpan < value.Height))
				{
					_ = value.Height;
				}
				switch (frameworkElement.HorizontalAlignment)
				{
				case HorizontalAlignment.Left:
					value.X = labelViewport.Left + labelLeftOffset;
					break;
				case HorizontalAlignment.Center:
					value.X = labelViewport.Left + labelLeftOffset + num - num2;
					break;
				case HorizontalAlignment.Right:
					value.X = labelViewport.Right - labelRightOffset - value.Width;
					break;
				case HorizontalAlignment.Stretch:
					value.X = labelViewport.Left + labelLeftOffset;
					value.Width = labelSpan;
					break;
				}
				rectangles[i] = value;
			}
		}
	}

	internal class AreaSeriesView : AnchoredCategorySeriesView
	{
		private Path polygon0 = new Path();

		private Path polyline0 = new Path();

		private Path polygon1 = new Path();

		private Path polyline1 = new Path();

		protected AreaSeries AreaModel { get; set; }

		public Path Line0 => polyline0;

		public Path Line1 => polyline1;

		public Path Polygon0 => polygon0;

		public Path Polygon1 => polygon1;

		public AreaSeriesView(AreaSeries model)
			: base(model)
		{
			AreaModel = model;
		}

		public override void AttachUI(Canvas rootCanvas)
		{
			base.AttachUI(rootCanvas);
			polygon0.Detach();
			rootCanvas.Children.Add(polygon0);
			polygon1.Detach();
			rootCanvas.Children.Add(polygon1);
			polygon1.Opacity = 0.5;
			VisualInformationManager.SetIsTranslucentPortionVisual(polygon1, value: true);
			polyline0.Detach();
			rootCanvas.Children.Add(polyline0);
			VisualInformationManager.SetIsOutlineVisual(polyline0, value: true);
			polyline1.Detach();
			rootCanvas.Children.Add(polyline1);
			VisualInformationManager.SetIsOutlineVisual(polyline1, value: true);
			if (!base.IsThumbnailView)
			{
				Model.RenderSeries(animate: false);
			}
		}

		internal void ClearAreaLines()
		{
			polygon0.Data = null;
			polygon1.Data = null;
			polyline0.Data = null;
			polyline1.Data = null;
		}

		internal void RasterizeArea(int count, List<double[]> buckets, bool useX0AsX1, int bucketSize, double resolution, Action<PointCollection, PointCollection, PointCollection, PointCollection, bool> terminatePolygon, UnknownValuePlotting unknownValuePlotting, Clipper clipper)
		{
			AreaModel.LineRasterizer.IsSortingAxis = base.CategoryModel.GetXAxis() is ISortingAxis;
			AreaModel.LineRasterizer.RasterizePolygonPaths(polygon0, polyline0, polygon1, polyline1, count, buckets, useX0AsX1, bucketSize, resolution, terminatePolygon, unknownValuePlotting, clipper);
		}

		protected internal override void ExportViewShapes(object svd)
		{
			base.ExportViewShapes(svd);
			Model.SeriesVisualDataManager.ExportPathData(svd, polyline0, "lowerShape", new string[1] { "Lower" });
			Model.SeriesVisualDataManager.ExportPathData(svd, polyline1, "upperShape", new string[2] { "Upper", "Main" });
			Model.SeriesVisualDataManager.ExportPathData(svd, polygon1, "translucentShape", new string[1] { "Translucent" });
			Model.SeriesVisualDataManager.ExportPathData(svd, polygon0, "fillShape", new string[1] { "Fill" });
		}
	}
	internal class BarSeriesView : AnchoredCategorySeriesView
	{
		protected internal BarSeries BarModel { get; set; }

		internal Pool<Rectangle> Columns { get; private set; }

		public BarSeriesView(BarSeries model)
			: base(model)
		{
			BarModel = model;
			Columns = new Pool<Rectangle>
			{
				Create = ColumnCreate,
				Activate = ColumnActivate,
				Disactivate = ColumnDisactivate,
				Destroy = ColumnDestroy
			};
			base.TrendLineManager = new BarTrendLineManager();
		}

		protected internal override void OnTemplateProvided()
		{
			base.OnTemplateProvided();
			Model.RenderSeries(animate: false);
		}

		internal Rectangle ColumnCreate()
		{
			return new Rectangle
			{
				DataContext = new DataContext
				{
					Series = Model
				}
			};
		}

		internal void ColumnActivate(Rectangle column)
		{
			column.Detach();
			base.RootCanvas.Children.Add(column);
		}

		internal void ColumnDisactivate(Rectangle column)
		{
			(column.DataContext as DataContext).Item = null;
			if (column.Parent is Panel)
			{
				base.RootCanvas.Children.Remove(column);
			}
		}

		internal void ColumnDestroy(Rectangle column)
		{
			column.ClearValue(Shape.FillProperty);
			column.ClearValue(Shape.StrokeProperty);
			column.ClearValue(Shape.StrokeThicknessProperty);
			column.ClearValue(Shape.StrokeDashCapProperty);
			column.ClearValue(Rectangle.RadiusXProperty);
			column.ClearValue(Rectangle.RadiusYProperty);
		}

		internal void SetColumnPosition(Rectangle column, double x, double y)
		{
			column.RenderTransform = new TranslateTransform
			{
				X = x,
				Y = y
			};
		}

		internal override CategoryBucketCalculator CreateBucketCalculator()
		{
			return new BarBucketCalculator(this);
		}

		protected internal override void ExportViewShapes(object svd)
		{
			base.ExportViewShapes(svd);
			int num = 0;
			List<Rectangle> list = new List<Rectangle>();
			foreach (Rectangle item in Columns.Active)
			{
				list.Add(item);
			}
			list.Sort(delegate(Rectangle c1, Rectangle c2)
			{
				TranslateTransform translateTransform = c1.RenderTransform as TranslateTransform;
				TranslateTransform translateTransform2 = c2.RenderTransform as TranslateTransform;
				if (translateTransform == null || translateTransform2 == null)
				{
					return 0;
				}
				if (translateTransform.Y < translateTransform2.Y)
				{
					return -1;
				}
				return (translateTransform.Y > translateTransform2.Y) ? 1 : 0;
			});
			foreach (Rectangle item2 in list)
			{
				Model.SeriesVisualDataManager.ExportRectangleData(svd, item2, "column" + num, new string[2] { "Main", "Fill" });
			}
			num++;
		}
	}
	internal class CategorySeriesView : MarkerSeriesView, ISupportsMarkers
	{
		internal CategorySeries CategoryModel { get; set; }

		public int FrameVersion { get; set; }

		private Path ErrorBarsPath { get; set; }

		internal CategoryBucketCalculator BucketCalculator { get; private set; }

		internal Pool<Marker> Markers { get; set; }

		bool ISupportsMarkers.ShouldDisplayMarkers => CategoryModel.ShouldDisplayMarkers();

		public bool CheckFrameDirty(CategoryFrame frame)
		{
			if (FrameVersion != frame.FrameVersion)
			{
				return true;
			}
			return false;
		}

		public void UpdateFrameVersion(CategoryFrame frame)
		{
			FrameVersion = frame.FrameVersion;
		}

		public CategorySeriesView(CategorySeries model)
			: base(model)
		{
			FrameVersion = -1;
			CategoryModel = model;
			BucketCalculator = CreateBucketCalculator();
			Markers = new Pool<Marker>
			{
				Create = base.MarkerCreate,
				Activate = base.MarkerActivate,
				Disactivate = base.MarkerDisactivate,
				Destroy = base.MarkerDestroy
			};
		}

		public override void OnInit()
		{
			base.OnInit();
			ErrorBarsPath = new Path();
			Panel.SetZIndex(ErrorBarsPath, 1000);
		}

		protected internal override void OnTemplateProvided()
		{
			base.OnTemplateProvided();
		}

		internal void HideErrorBars()
		{
			if (base.MarkerCanvas != null && base.MarkerCanvas.Children.Contains(ErrorBarsPath))
			{
				base.MarkerCanvas.Children.Remove(ErrorBarsPath);
			}
		}

		internal void ShowErrorBars()
		{
			CategorySeries categorySeries = Model.GetSeriesComponentsForView().Series as CategorySeries;
			if (categorySeries.ErrorBarSettings.Stroke != Shape.StrokeProperty.GetMetadata(typeof(Path)).DefaultValue as Brush)
			{
				ErrorBarsPath.Stroke = categorySeries.ErrorBarSettings.Stroke;
			}
			if (categorySeries.ErrorBarSettings.StrokeThickness != (double)Shape.StrokeThicknessProperty.GetMetadata(typeof(Path)).DefaultValue)
			{
				ErrorBarsPath.StrokeThickness = categorySeries.ErrorBarSettings.StrokeThickness;
			}
			if (categorySeries.ErrorBarSettings.ErrorBarStyle != null)
			{
				ErrorBarsPath.SetBinding(FrameworkElement.StyleProperty, new Binding("ErrorBarStyle")
				{
					Source = categorySeries.ErrorBarSettings
				});
			}
			else
			{
				ErrorBarsPath.SetBinding(FrameworkElement.StyleProperty, new Binding("DefaultErrorBarStyle")
				{
					Source = categorySeries.ErrorBarSettings
				});
			}
			if (!base.MarkerCanvas.Children.Contains(ErrorBarsPath))
			{
				base.MarkerCanvas.Children.Add(ErrorBarsPath);
			}
		}

		internal void UpdateErrorBars(PathGeometry errorBarsGeometry)
		{
			ErrorBarsPath.Data = errorBarsGeometry;
		}

		internal void UpdateMarkerTemplate(int markerCount, int itemIndex, int markerBucket)
		{
			if (!base.MarkerModel.UseLightweightMarkers)
			{
				Marker marker = Markers[markerCount];
				((DataContext)marker.Content).Item = Model.FastItemsSource[itemIndex];
				marker.CurrentIndex = itemIndex;
				marker.MarkerBucket = markerBucket;
			}
		}

		internal virtual CategoryBucketCalculator CreateBucketCalculator()
		{
			return new CategoryBucketCalculator(this);
		}

		void ISupportsMarkers.UpdateMarkerCount(int markerCount)
		{
			Markers.Count = markerCount;
		}

		void ISupportsMarkers.UpdateMarkerTemplate(int markerCount, int itemIndex, int markerBucket)
		{
			UpdateMarkerTemplate(markerCount, itemIndex, markerBucket);
		}

		protected internal override void DoToAllMarkers(Action<Marker> action)
		{
			Markers.DoToAll(action);
		}
	}

	internal class RangeAreaSeriesView : RangeCategorySeriesView
	{

		private Polyline polyline1 = new Polyline();

		protected RangeAreaSeries RangeAreaModel { get; set; }

		internal void RasterizeRangeArea(int count, List<double[]> buckets, bool useX0asX1)
		{
			RasterizePolygon(polyline0, polygon01, polyline1, count, buckets, useX0asX1);
		}

		protected internal override void ExportViewShapes(object svd)
		{
			base.ExportViewShapes(svd);
			Model.SeriesVisualDataManager.ExportPolylineData(svd, polyline0, "lowerShape", new string[1] { "Lower" });
			Model.SeriesVisualDataManager.ExportPolylineData(svd, polyline1, "upperShape", new string[2] { "Upper", "Main" });
			Model.SeriesVisualDataManager.ExportPolygonData(svd, polygon01, "fillShape", new string[1] { "Fill" });

	internal class RangeCategorySeriesView : CategorySeriesView
	{
		protected RangeCategorySeries RangeModel { get; set; }

		public RangeCategorySeriesView(RangeCategorySeries model)
			: base(model)
		{
			RangeModel = model;
		}

		internal void RasterizePolygon(Polyline polyline0, Polygon polygon01, Polyline polyline1, int count, List<double[]> buckets, bool useX0AsX1)
		{
			polyline0.Points.Clear();
			polygon01.Points.Clear();
			polyline1.Points.Clear();
			IList<int> list = FastFlattener.FastFlatten(count, buckets, point0: true, useX0AsX1, Model.Resolution);
			IList<int> list2 = FastFlattener.FastFlatten(count, buckets, point0: false, useX0AsX1, Model.Resolution);
			int count2 = list.Count;
			int count3 = list2.Count;
			for (int i = 0; i < count2; i++)
			{
				int index = list[i];
				double[] array = buckets[index];
				double x = array[0];
				double y = array[1];
				polyline0.Points.Add(new Point(x, y));
				polygon01.Points.Add(new Point(x, y));
			}
			for (int j = 0; j < count3; j++)
			{
				int index = list2[j];
				double[] array = buckets[index];
				double x2;
				double y2;
				if (useX0AsX1)
				{
					x2 = array[0];
					y2 = array[2];
				}
				else
				{
					x2 = array[2];
					y2 = array[3];
				}
				polyline1.Points.Add(new Point(x2, y2));
				polygon01.Points.Add(new Point(x2, y2));
			}
			polyline0.IsHitTestVisible = polyline0.Points.Count > 0;
			polygon01.IsHitTestVisible = polygon01.Points.Count > 0;
			polyline1.IsHitTestVisible = polyline1.Points.Count > 0;
		}

		internal override CategoryBucketCalculator CreateBucketCalculator()
		{
			return new RangeCategoryBucketCalculator(this);
		}
	}

				if (translateTransform == null || translateTransform2 == null)
				{
					return 0;
				}
				if (translateTransform.X < translateTransform2.X)
				{
					return -1;
				}
				return (translateTransform.X > translateTransform2.X) ? 1 : 0;
			});
			foreach (Rectangle item in list)
			{
				Model.SeriesVisualDataManager.ExportRectangleData(svd, item, "column" + num, new string[2] { "Main", "Fill" });
			}
			num++;

			{
				list.Add(item);
			}
			list.Sort(delegate(Rectangle c1, Rectangle c2)
			{
				TranslateTransform translateTransform = c1.RenderTransform as TranslateTransform;
				TranslateTransform translateTransform2 = c2.RenderTransform as TranslateTransform;

	public class EnumCollectionConverter<TEnum, TCollection> : TypeConverter where TEnum : struct, IConvertible where TCollection : IList, new()
	{
		public override bool CanConvertFrom(ITypeDescriptorContext context, Type sourceType)
		{
			if (!base.CanConvertFrom(context, sourceType))
			{
				return sourceType == typeof(string);
			}
			return true;
		}

		public override object ConvertFrom(ITypeDescriptorContext context, CultureInfo culture, object value)
		{
			if (!(value is string text))
			{
				return base.ConvertFrom(context, culture, value);
			}
			TCollection val = new TCollection();
			string text2 = Regex.Replace(text.Replace(',', ' '), "\\s\\s+", " ");
			string[] array = text2.Split(' ');
			foreach (string value2 in array)
			{
				TEnum val2 = (TEnum)Enum.Parse(typeof(TEnum), value2);
				val.Add(val2);
			}
			return val;
		}
	}
	public class ColorCollectionConverter : TypeConverter
	{
		public override bool CanConvertFrom(ITypeDescriptorContext context, Type sourceType)
		{
			if (!(sourceType == typeof(string)))
			{
				return base.CanConvertFrom(context, sourceType);
			}
			return true;
		}

		public override object ConvertFrom(ITypeDescriptorContext context, CultureInfo culture, object value)
		{
			if (!(value is string text))
			{
				return base.ConvertFrom(context, culture, value);
			}
			string text2 = text.Trim();
			string[] array = new string[0];
			if (text2.Contains(","))
			{
				array = text2.Split(',');
			}
			else if (text2.Contains(" "))
			{
				array = text2.Split(' ');
			}
			else if (text2.Length > 0)
			{
				array = new string[1] { text2 };
			}
			ObservableCollection<Color> observableCollection = new ObservableCollection<Color>();
			string[] array2 = array;
			for (int i = 0; i < array2.Length; i++)
			{
				Color item = ColorConverter.FromString(array2[i].Trim());
				observableCollection.Add(item);
			}
			return observableCollection;
		}

		public override bool CanConvertTo(ITypeDescriptorContext context, Type destinationType)
		{
			if (!(destinationType == typeof(string)))
			{
				return base.CanConvertTo(context, destinationType);
			}
			return true;
		}
	}
	public class PaletteConverter : IValueConverter
	{
		public Point StartPoint { get; set; }

		public Point EndPoint { get; set; }

		public PaletteConverter()
		{
			StartPoint = new Point(0.0, 0.0);
			EndPoint = new Point(1.0, 0.0);
		}

		public object Convert(object value, Type targetType, object parameter, CultureInfo culture)
		{
			if (value is Collection<Color> colors)
			{
				return CreateBrush(colors, parameter);
			}
			if (value is BrushCollection brushCollection)
			{
				Collection<Color> collection = new Collection<Color>();
				foreach (Brush item in brushCollection)
				{
					if (item is SolidColorBrush)
					{
						collection.Add(((SolidColorBrush)item).Color);
					}
				}
				return CreateBrush(collection, parameter);
			}
			return new SolidColorBrush(Colors.Transparent);
		}

		public object ConvertBack(object value, Type targetType, object parameter, CultureInfo culture)
		{
			throw new NotImplementedException();
		}

		internal Brush CreateBrush(IList<Color> colors, object parameter = null)
		{
			if (colors.Count == 0)
			{
				return new SolidColorBrush(Colors.Transparent);
			}
			if (colors.Count == 1)
			{
				return new SolidColorBrush(colors[0]);
			}
			if (parameter == null)
			{
				LinearGradientBrush linearGradientBrush = new LinearGradientBrush();
				linearGradientBrush.EndPoint = EndPoint;
				linearGradientBrush.StartPoint = StartPoint;
				double num = 0.0;
				double num2 = 1.0 / (double)(colors.Count - 1);
				{
					foreach (Color color in colors)
					{
						GradientStop value = new GradientStop
						{
							Color = color,
							Offset = num
						};
						linearGradientBrush.GradientStops.Add(value);
						num += num2;
					}
					return linearGradientBrush;
				}
			}
			string text = parameter.ToString().ToLower();
			if (text == "first")
			{
				return new SolidColorBrush(colors[0]);
			}
			if (text == "last")
			{
				return new SolidColorBrush(colors[colors.Count - 1]);
			}
			throw new Exception("PaletteConverter does not support " + text + " convert parameter");
		}
	}
	public class StyleVisibilityConverter : IValueConverter
	{
		public Visibility WhenNull { get; set; }

		public StyleVisibilityConverter()
		{
			WhenNull = Visibility.Collapsed;
		}

		public object Convert(object value, Type targetType, object parameter, CultureInfo culture)
		{
			if (parameter is string)
			{
				WhenNull = ((!(((string)parameter).ToLower() == "visible")) ? Visibility.Collapsed : Visibility.Visible);
			}
			if (!(value is Style style))
			{
				return WhenNull;
			}
			if (style.Setters.Count == 0)
			{
				return WhenNull;
			}
			if (style.Setters.Count == 1)
			{
				if (!(style.Setters[0] is Setter setter))
				{
					return WhenNull;
				}
				if (setter.Property.Name == "Template")
				{
					return WhenNull;
				}
			}
			return (WhenNull == Visibility.Visible) ? Visibility.Collapsed : Visibility.Visible;
		}

		public object ConvertBack(object value, Type targetType, object parameter, CultureInfo culture)
		{
			throw new NotImplementedException();
		}
	}

				axis = value;
				RaisePropertyChanged("Axis");
			}
		}

		public object Item
		{
			get
			{
				return item;
			}
			internal set
			{
				if (item != value)
				{
					item = value;
					RaisePropertyChanged("Item");
				}
			}
		}

		public event PropertyChangedEventHandler PropertyChanged;

		protected void RaisePropertyChanged(string propertyName)
		{
			if (this.PropertyChanged != null)
			{
				this.PropertyChanged(this, new PropertyChangedEventArgs(propertyName));
			}
		}
	}

		}));

		private const string PercentValuePropertyName = "PercentValue";

		public static readonly DependencyProperty PercentValueProperty = DependencyProperty.Register("PercentValue", typeof(double), typeof(PieSliceDataContext), new PropertyMetadata(double.NaN, delegate(DependencyObject sender, DependencyPropertyChangedEventArgs e)
		{
			(sender as PieSliceDataContext).RaisePropertyChanged("PercentValue", e.OldValue, e.NewValue);
		}));

		private const string IsOthersSlicePropertyName = "IsOthersSlice";

		public static readonly DependencyProperty IsOthersSliceProperty = DependencyProperty.Register("IsOthersSlice", typeof(bool), typeof(PieSliceDataContext), new PropertyMetadata(false, delegate(DependencyObject sender, DependencyPropertyChangedEventArgs e)
		{
			(sender as PieSliceDataContext).RaisePropertyChanged("IsOthersSlice", e.OldValue, e.NewValue);
		}));

		public FrameworkElement Slice
		{
			get
			{
				return (FrameworkElement)GetValue(SliceProperty);
			}
			internal set
			{
				SetValue(SliceProperty, value);
			}
		}

		public double PercentValue
		{
			get
			{
				return (double)GetValue(PercentValueProperty);
			}
			set
			{
				SetValue(PercentValueProperty, value);
			}
		}

		public bool IsOthersSlice
		{
			get
			{
				return (bool)GetValue(IsOthersSliceProperty);
			}
			set
			{
				SetValue(IsOthersSliceProperty, value);
			}
		}

		protected override void RaisePropertyChanged(string propertyName, object oldValue, object newValue)
		{
			switch (propertyName)
			{
			case "Series":
				if (newValue != null && base.ItemBrush == null)
				{
					BindingOperations.SetBinding(this, DataContext.ActualItemBrushProperty, new Binding("Slice.Background")
					{
						Source = this
					});
				}
				else
				{
					BindingOperations.SetBinding(this, DataContext.ActualItemBrushProperty, new Binding("ItemBrush")
					{
						Source = this
					});
				}
				break;
			case "ItemBrush":
				if (newValue == null && base.Series != null)
				{
					BindingOperations.SetBinding(this, DataContext.ActualItemBrushProperty, new Binding("Slice.Background")
					{
						Source = this
					});
				}
				else
				{
					BindingOperations.SetBinding(this, DataContext.ActualItemBrushProperty, new Binding("ItemBrush")
					{
						Source = this
					});
				}
				break;
			case "Slice":
				if (newValue != null && base.ItemBrush == null)
				{
					BindingOperations.SetBinding(this, DataContext.ActualItemBrushProperty, new Binding("Slice.Background")
					{
						Source = this
					});
				}
				else
				{
					BindingOperations.SetBinding(this, DataContext.ActualItemBrushProperty, new Binding("ItemBrush")
					{
						Source = this
					});
				}
				break;
			}
		}
	}
