	internal class FinancialIndicatorView : FinancialSeriesView
	{
		private readonly Pool<LineGeometry> Columns;

		public Path PositivePath0 = new Path
		{
			Data = new PathGeometry
			{
				FillRule = FillRule.Nonzero
			}
		};

		public Path NegativePath0 = new Path
		{
			Data = new PathGeometry
			{
				FillRule = FillRule.Nonzero
			}
		};

		public Path PositivePath01 = new Path
		{
			Data = new PathGeometry
			{
				FillRule = FillRule.Nonzero
			}
		};

		public Path NegativePath01 = new Path
		{
			Data = new PathGeometry
			{
				FillRule = FillRule.Nonzero
			}
		};

		public Path PositivePath1 = new Path
		{
			Data = new PathGeometry
			{
				FillRule = FillRule.Nonzero
			}
		};

		public Path NegativePath1 = new Path
		{
			Data = new PathGeometry
			{
				FillRule = FillRule.Nonzero
			}
		};

		public Path PositiveColumns = new Path
		{
			Data = new GeometryGroup()
		};

		public Path NegativeColumns = new Path
		{
			Data = new GeometryGroup()
		};

		private ITrendLineManager _trendLineManager;

		protected internal FinancialIndicator IndicatorModel { get; set; }

		internal ITrendLineManager TrendLineManager
		{
			get
			{
				if (_trendLineManager == null)
				{
					_trendLineManager = CategoryTrendLineManagerFactory.SelectManager(_trendLineManager, Model.GetCategoryAxisIfPresent(), Model.RootCanvas, Model, Model.Res);
				}
				return _trendLineManager;
			}
			set
			{
				_trendLineManager = value;
			}
		}

		internal bool HasTrendLineManager => _trendLineManager != null;

		public FinancialIndicatorView(FinancialIndicator model)
			: base(model)
		{
			IndicatorModel = model;
			Columns = new Pool<LineGeometry>
			{
				Create = CreateColumn,
				Destroy = DestroyColumn
			};
			TrendLineManager = new CategoryTrendLineManager();
		}

		protected override FinancialBucketCalculator CreateBucketCalculator()
		{
			return new FinancialIndicatorBucketCalculator(this);
		}

		private LineGeometry CreateColumn()
		{
			return new LineGeometry();
		}

		private void DestroyColumn(LineGeometry column)
		{
		}

		public override void AttachUI(Canvas rootCanvas)
		{
			base.AttachUI(rootCanvas);
			TrendLineManager.AttachPolyLine(rootCanvas, Model);
			PositivePath01.Detach();
			PositivePath0.Detach();
			PositivePath1.Detach();
			PositiveColumns.Detach();
			NegativePath01.Detach();
			NegativePath0.Detach();
			NegativePath1.Detach();
			NegativeColumns.Detach();
			rootCanvas.Children.Add(PositivePath01);
			VisualInformationManager.SetIsTranslucentPortionVisual(PositivePath01, value: true);
			rootCanvas.Children.Add(PositivePath0);
			VisualInformationManager.SetIsMultiColorLineVisual(PositivePath0, value: true);
			rootCanvas.Children.Add(PositivePath1);
			VisualInformationManager.SetIsMultiColorLineVisual(PositivePath1, value: true);
			rootCanvas.Children.Add(NegativePath01);
			VisualInformationManager.SetIsNegativeVisual(NegativePath01, value: true);
			VisualInformationManager.SetIsTranslucentPortionVisual(NegativePath01, value: true);
			rootCanvas.Children.Add(NegativePath0);
			VisualInformationManager.SetIsNegativeVisual(NegativePath0, value: true);
			VisualInformationManager.SetIsMultiColorLineVisual(NegativePath0, value: true);
			rootCanvas.Children.Add(NegativePath1);
			VisualInformationManager.SetIsNegativeVisual(NegativePath1, value: true);
			VisualInformationManager.SetIsMultiColorLineVisual(NegativePath1, value: true);
			rootCanvas.Children.Add(PositiveColumns);
			VisualInformationManager.SetIsMultiColorLineVisual(PositiveColumns, value: true);
			rootCanvas.Children.Add(NegativeColumns);
			VisualInformationManager.SetIsNegativeVisual(NegativeColumns, value: true);
			VisualInformationManager.SetIsMultiColorLineVisual(NegativeColumns, value: true);
			if (!base.IsThumbnailView)
			{
				Model.RenderSeries(animate: false);
			}
		}

		internal void ClearIndicatorVisual(bool wipeClean)
		{
			(PositivePath0.Data as PathGeometry).Reset();
			(PositivePath01.Data as PathGeometry).Reset();
			(PositivePath1.Data as PathGeometry).Reset();
			(NegativePath0.Data as PathGeometry).Reset();
			(NegativePath01.Data as PathGeometry).Reset();
			(NegativePath1.Data as PathGeometry).Reset();
			(PositiveColumns.Data as GeometryGroup).Reset();
			(NegativeColumns.Data as GeometryGroup).Reset();
			if (wipeClean)
			{
				Columns.Count = 0;
			}
		}

		internal void UpdateHitTests()
		{
			PositivePath0.IsHitTestVisible = (PositivePath0.Data as PathGeometry).Figures.Count > 0;
			PositivePath01.IsHitTestVisible = (PositivePath01.Data as PathGeometry).Figures.Count > 0;
			PositivePath1.IsHitTestVisible = (PositivePath1.Data as PathGeometry).Figures.Count > 0;
			NegativePath0.IsHitTestVisible = (NegativePath0.Data as PathGeometry).Figures.Count > 0;
			NegativePath01.IsHitTestVisible = (NegativePath01.Data as PathGeometry).Figures.Count > 0;
			NegativePath1.IsHitTestVisible = (NegativePath1.Data as PathGeometry).Figures.Count > 0;
		}

		internal void RasterizeLine(int count, Func<int, double> x0, Func<int, double> y0, bool colorByGradient, Clipper clipper)
		{
			IndicatorRenderer.RasterizeLine(count, x0, y0, colorByGradient, WindowRect, base.Viewport, PositivePath0, NegativePath0, base.BucketCalculator.BucketSize, Model.Resolution, clipper);
		}

		internal void RasterizeArea(int count, Func<int, double> x0, Func<int, double> y0, bool colorByGradient, double worldZero, Clipper clipper)
		{
			IndicatorRenderer.RasterizeArea(count, x0, y0, colorByGradient, WindowRect, base.Viewport, PositivePath0, PositivePath01, NegativePath0, NegativePath01, worldZero, base.BucketCalculator.BucketSize, Model.Resolution, clipper);
		}

		internal void RasterizeColumns(int count, Func<int, double> x0, Func<int, double> y0, bool colorByGradient, double worldZero)
		{
			IndicatorRenderer.RasterizeColumns(count, x0, y0, colorByGradient, base.Viewport, worldZero, Columns, PositiveColumns, NegativeColumns);
		}

		internal void UpdateTrendlineBrush()
		{
			Model.ClearValue(FinancialIndicator.ActualTrendLineBrushProperty);
			if (IndicatorModel.TrendLineBrush != null)
			{
				Model.SetBinding(FinancialIndicator.ActualTrendLineBrushProperty, new Binding("TrendLineBrush")
				{
					Source = Model
				});
			}
			else
			{
				Model.SetBinding(FinancialIndicator.ActualTrendLineBrushProperty, new Binding("ActualBrush")
				{
					Source = Model
				});
			}
		}

		public void SelectTrendlineManager()
		{
			TrendLineManager = CategoryTrendLineManagerFactory.SelectManager(TrendLineManager, IndicatorModel.XAxis, base.RootCanvas, IndicatorModel, Model.Res);
		}

		protected internal override void ExportViewShapes(object svd)
		{
			base.ExportViewShapes(svd);
			Model.SeriesVisualDataManager.ExportPathData(svd, PositiveColumns, "positiveColumnsShape", new string[2] { "Positive", "Main" });
			Model.SeriesVisualDataManager.ExportPathData(svd, NegativeColumns, "negativeColumnsShape", new string[1] { "Negative" });
			Model.SeriesVisualDataManager.ExportPathData(svd, PositivePath0, "positive0", new string[2] { "Positive", "Main" });
			Model.SeriesVisualDataManager.ExportPathData(svd, PositivePath1, "positive1", new string[1] { "Positive" });
			Model.SeriesVisualDataManager.ExportPathData(svd, PositivePath01, "positive01", new string[1] { "PositiveFill" });
			Model.SeriesVisualDataManager.ExportPathData(svd, NegativePath0, "negative0", new string[2] { "Negative", "Main" });
			Model.SeriesVisualDataManager.ExportPathData(svd, NegativePath1, "negative1", new string[1] { "Negative" });
			Model.SeriesVisualDataManager.ExportPathData(svd, NegativePath01, "negative01", new string[1] { "NegativeFill" });
		}
	}
	[TemplatePart(Name = "PART_LEFTOUTERLABELS", Type = typeof(Canvas))]
	[TemplatePart(Name = "PART_RIGHTOUTERLABELS", Type = typeof(Canvas))]
	[TemplatePart(Name = "PART_LEFTPANEL", Type = typeof(Panel))]
	[TemplatePart(Name = "PART_RIGHTPANEL", Type = typeof(Panel))]
	[TemplatePart(Name = "PART_PLOTAREA", Type = typeof(Panel))]
	[TemplatePart(Name = "PART_SLICEAREA", Type = typeof(Canvas))]
	[TemplatePart(Name = "PART_TOOLTIP", Type = typeof(Popup))]
	[TemplatePart(Name = "PART_TOOLTIPCONTENT", Type = typeof(ContentControl))]
	[EditorBrowsable(EditorBrowsableState.Never)]
	[DesignTimeVisible(false)]
	public class XamFunnelView : Control, IOuterLabelWidthDecider, IFunnelLabelSizeDecider
	{
		private MessageHandler _messageHandler;

		private ServiceProvider _serviceProvider;

		private ContentControl sizeWatcher;

		private bool _mustClearUnused = true;

		private Dictionary<int, XamFunnelSlice> _slicesByIndex = new Dictionary<int, XamFunnelSlice>();

		public static readonly DependencyProperty SliceUsedProperty = DependencyProperty.RegisterAttached("SliceUsed", typeof(bool), typeof(XamFunnelView), new PropertyMetadata(false));

		internal MessageHandler MessageHandler
		{
			get
			{
				return _messageHandler;
			}
			set
			{
				_messageHandler = value;
			}
		}

		internal ServiceProvider ServiceProvider
		{
			get
			{
				return _serviceProvider;
			}
			set
			{
				ServiceProvider serviceProvider = _serviceProvider;
				_serviceProvider = value;
				OnServiceProviderChanged(serviceProvider, _serviceProvider);
			}
		}

		internal MessageChannel InteractionMessages { get; set; }

		protected Canvas LeftLabels { get; set; }

		protected Canvas RightLabels { get; set; }

		protected Panel LeftPanel { get; set; }

		protected Panel RightPanel { get; set; }

		protected Panel PlotArea { get; set; }

		protected Canvas SliceArea { get; set; }

		protected Grid Root { get; set; }

		protected DataTemplate InnerLabelTemplate { get; set; }

		protected DataTemplate OuterLabelTemplate { get; set; }

		protected new Popup ToolTip { get; set; }

		protected ContentControl ToolTipContent { get; set; }

		protected object TooltipValue { get; set; }

		public XamFunnelView()
		{
			MessageHandler = new MessageHandler();
			MessageHandler.AddHandler(typeof(ClearMessage), ClearMessageReceived);
			MessageHandler.AddHandler(typeof(RenderSliceMessage), RenderSliceMessageReceived);
			MessageHandler.AddHandler(typeof(RenderOuterLabelMessage), RenderOuterLabelMessageReceived);
			MessageHandler.AddHandler(typeof(SetAreaSizeMessage), SetAreaSizeMessageReceived);
			MessageHandler.AddHandler(typeof(TemplateChangedMessage), TemplateChangedMessageReceived);
			MessageHandler.AddHandler(typeof(TooltipUpdateMessage), TooltipUpdateMessageReceived);
			MessageHandler.AddHandler(typeof(ClearTooltipMessage), ClearTooltipMessageReceived);
			MessageHandler.AddHandler(typeof(TooltipValueChangedMessage), TooltipValueChangedMessageReceived);
			MessageHandler.AddHandler(typeof(FrameRenderCompleteMessage), FrameRenderCompleteMessageReceived);
			InteractionMessages = new MessageChannel();
			base.DefaultStyleKey = typeof(XamFunnelView);
		}

		protected override void OnMouseMove(MouseEventArgs e)
		{
			base.OnMouseMove(e);
			Point position = e.GetPosition(PlotArea);
			MouseMoveMessage mouseMoveMessage = new MouseMoveMessage();
			mouseMoveMessage.Position = position;
			InteractionMessages.SendMessage(mouseMoveMessage);
		}

		protected override void OnMouseLeftButtonDown(MouseButtonEventArgs e)
		{
			base.OnMouseLeftButtonDown(e);
			Point position = e.GetPosition(PlotArea);
			MouseButtonMessage mouseButtonMessage = new MouseButtonMessage();
			mouseButtonMessage.Position = position;
			mouseButtonMessage.Action = MouseButtonAction.Down;
			mouseButtonMessage.Type = MouseButtonType.Left;
			InteractionMessages.SendMessage(mouseButtonMessage);
		}

		protected override void OnMouseLeftButtonUp(MouseButtonEventArgs e)
		{
			base.OnMouseLeftButtonUp(e);
			Point position = e.GetPosition(PlotArea);
			MouseButtonMessage mouseButtonMessage = new MouseButtonMessage();
			mouseButtonMessage.Position = position;
			mouseButtonMessage.Action = MouseButtonAction.Up;
			mouseButtonMessage.Type = MouseButtonType.Left;
			InteractionMessages.SendMessage(mouseButtonMessage);
		}

		protected override void OnMouseLeave(MouseEventArgs e)
		{
			base.OnMouseLeave(e);
			Point position = e.GetPosition(PlotArea);
			MouseLeaveMessage mouseLeaveMessage = new MouseLeaveMessage();
			mouseLeaveMessage.Position = position;
			InteractionMessages.SendMessage(mouseLeaveMessage);
		}

		private void OnServiceProviderChanged(ServiceProvider oldValue, ServiceProvider newValue)
		{
			if (oldValue != null)
			{
				if (oldValue.GetService("RenderingMessages") is MessageChannel messageChannel)
				{
					messageChannel.DetachTarget(MessageReceived);
				}
				InteractionMessages.DetachFromNext();
			}
			if (newValue != null)
			{
				if (newValue.GetService("RenderingMessages") is MessageChannel messageChannel2)
				{
					messageChannel2.AttachTarget(MessageReceived);
				}
				MessageChannel m = newValue.GetService("InteractionMessages") as MessageChannel;
				InteractionMessages.ConnectTo(m);
			}
		}

		private void MessageReceived(Message m)
		{
			MessageHandler.MessageReceived(m);
		}

		private void SendViewport()
		{
			InteractionMessages.SendMessage(new ViewportChangedMessage
			{
				NewWidth = PlotArea.ActualWidth,
				NewHeight = PlotArea.ActualHeight
			});
		}

		public override void OnApplyTemplate()
		{
			base.OnApplyTemplate();
			if (PlotArea != null)
			{
				PlotArea.SizeChanged -= PlotArea_SizeChanged;
			}
			if (Root != null)
			{
				if (sizeWatcher != null)
				{
					sizeWatcher.SizeChanged -= OuterLabel_SizeChanged;
				}
				sizeWatcher = null;
			}
			_slicesByIndex.Clear();
			LeftLabels = GetTemplateChild("PART_LEFTOUTERLABELS") as Canvas;
			RightLabels = GetTemplateChild("PART_RIGHTOUTERLABELS") as Canvas;
			LeftPanel = GetTemplateChild("PART_LEFTPANEL") as Panel;
			RightPanel = GetTemplateChild("PART_RIGHTPANEL") as Panel;
			PlotArea = GetTemplateChild("PART_PLOTAREA") as Panel;
			SliceArea = GetTemplateChild("PART_SLICEAREA") as Canvas;
			Root = GetTemplateChild("PART_ROOT") as Grid;
			if (PlotArea != null)
			{
				PlotArea.SizeChanged += PlotArea_SizeChanged;
			}
			if (Root != null)
			{
				sizeWatcher = new ContentControl
				{
					Content = "...",
					Foreground = new SolidColorBrush(Colors.Transparent),
					IsHitTestVisible = false,
					HorizontalAlignment = HorizontalAlignment.Left,
					VerticalAlignment = VerticalAlignment.Top
				};
				sizeWatcher.SizeChanged += OuterLabel_SizeChanged;
				Root.Children.Add(sizeWatcher);
			}
			ToolTip = GetTemplateChild("PART_TOOLTIP") as Popup;
			if (ToolTip != null)
			{
				if (SafeSetter.IsSafe)
				{
					ToolTip.AllowsTransparency = true;
				}
				ToolTip.PlacementTarget = PlotArea;
				ToolTip.Placement = PlacementMode.Relative;
			}
			ToolTipContent = GetTemplateChild("PART_TOOLTIPCONTENT") as ContentControl;
			SendViewport();
			SendWidthDecider();
			SendSizeDecider();
		}

		private void PlotArea_SizeChanged(object sender, SizeChangedEventArgs e)
		{
			PlotArea.Clip = new RectangleGeometry
			{
				Rect = new Rect(0.0, 0.0, PlotArea.ActualWidth, PlotArea.ActualHeight)
			};
			SendViewport();
		}

		private void SendWidthDecider()
		{
			ViewPropertyChangedMessage viewPropertyChangedMessage = new ViewPropertyChangedMessage();
			viewPropertyChangedMessage.PropertyName = "OuterLabelWidthDecider";
			viewPropertyChangedMessage.OldValue = null;
			viewPropertyChangedMessage.NewValue = this;
			InteractionMessages.SendMessage(viewPropertyChangedMessage);
		}

		private void SendSizeDecider()
		{
			ViewPropertyChangedMessage viewPropertyChangedMessage = new ViewPropertyChangedMessage();
			viewPropertyChangedMessage.PropertyName = "FunnelLabelSizeDecider";
			viewPropertyChangedMessage.OldValue = null;
			viewPropertyChangedMessage.NewValue = this;
			InteractionMessages.SendMessage(viewPropertyChangedMessage);
		}

		public double DecideWidth(ObjectColumn labels)
		{
			if (labels == null || labels.Values == null)
			{
				return 0.0;
			}
			double num = double.MinValue;
			LeftLabels.Children.Clear();
			foreach (object value in labels.Values)
			{
				ContentPresenter contentPresenter = new ContentPresenter
				{
					ContentTemplate = OuterLabelTemplate,
					Content = value
				};
				LeftLabels.Children.Add(contentPresenter);
				contentPresenter.InvalidateMeasure();
				contentPresenter.InvalidateArrange();
				contentPresenter.Measure(new Size(double.PositiveInfinity, double.PositiveInfinity));
				num = Math.Max(num, contentPresenter.DesiredSize.Width);
			}
			LeftLabels.Children.Clear();
			return num;
		}

		Size IFunnelLabelSizeDecider.DecideLabelSize(SliceInfo sliceInfo, bool inner)
		{
			if (sliceInfo == null)
			{
				return new Size(0.0, 0.0);
			}
			if (inner && sliceInfo.Slice.InnerLabel == null)
			{
				return new Size(0.0, 0.0);
			}
			if (!inner && sliceInfo.OuterLabel == null)
			{
				return new Size(0.0, 0.0);
			}
			DataTemplate contentTemplate = OuterLabelTemplate;
			if (inner)
			{
				contentTemplate = InnerLabelTemplate;
			}
			ContentControl contentControl = new ContentControl
			{
				ContentTemplate = contentTemplate,
				Content = (inner ? sliceInfo.Slice.InnerLabel : sliceInfo.OuterLabel)
			};
			PlotArea.Children.Add(contentControl);
			contentControl.InvalidateMeasure();
			contentControl.InvalidateArrange();
			contentControl.Measure(new Size(double.PositiveInfinity, double.PositiveInfinity));
			double height = contentControl.DesiredSize.Height;
			double width = contentControl.DesiredSize.Width;
			PlotArea.Children.Remove(contentControl);
			return new Size(width, height);
		}

		private void ClearMessageReceived(Message m)
		{
			ClearMessage m2 = (ClearMessage)m;
			if (GetTarget(m2) is Panel panel)
			{
				CleanupSlices(panel);
				CleanupLabels(panel);
				RemoveSlices(panel);
				RemoveLabels(panel);
			}
		}

		private void RemoveLabels(Panel panel)
		{
			if (panel != LeftLabels && panel != RightLabels)
			{
				return;
			}
			foreach (FrameworkElement item in panel.Children.OfType<FrameworkElement>())
			{
				item.SizeChanged -= OuterLabel_SizeChanged;
			}
			panel.Children.Clear();
		}

		private void RemoveSlices(Panel panel)
		{
			_mustClearUnused = true;
			foreach (XamFunnelSlice item in SliceArea.Children.OfType<XamFunnelSlice>())
			{
				SetSliceUsed(item, value: false);
			}
		}

		private void CleanupLabels(Panel panel)
		{
		}

		private void CleanupSlices(Panel panel)
		{
		}

		private FrameworkElement GetTarget(RenderingMessage m)
		{
			return m.AreaID switch
			{
				"RightPanel" => RightPanel, 
				"LeftPanel" => LeftPanel, 
				"LeftLabels" => LeftLabels, 
				"RightLabels" => RightLabels, 
				"SliceArea" => SliceArea, 
				"Plot" => PlotArea, 
				_ => null, 
			};
		}

		private void SetAreaSizeMessageReceived(Message m)
		{
			SetAreaSizeMessage setAreaSizeMessage = (SetAreaSizeMessage)m;
			if (GetTarget(setAreaSizeMessage) is Panel panel)
			{
				bool flag = false;
				if (setAreaSizeMessage.SettingHeight && panel.Height != setAreaSizeMessage.Height)
				{
					panel.Height = setAreaSizeMessage.Height;
					flag = true;
				}
				if (setAreaSizeMessage.SettingWidth && panel.Width != setAreaSizeMessage.Width)
				{
					panel.Width = setAreaSizeMessage.Width;
					flag = true;
				}
				if (flag)
				{
					panel.UpdateLayout();
				}
			}
		}

		private void RenderSliceMessageReceived(Message m)
		{
			RenderSliceMessage renderSliceMessage = (RenderSliceMessage)m;
			if (GetTarget(renderSliceMessage) is Canvas canvas && renderSliceMessage.Slice.Offset.X.IsPlottable() && renderSliceMessage.Slice.Offset.Y.IsPlottable())
			{
				XamFunnelSlice slice = GetSlice(renderSliceMessage.Slice.Index, canvas);
				renderSliceMessage.Slice.InnerLabelTemplate = InnerLabelTemplate;
				slice.Style = renderSliceMessage.Slice.Style;
				slice.DataContext = null;
				slice.DataContext = renderSliceMessage.Slice;
				slice.ContentTemplate = InnerLabelTemplate;
				slice.Content = renderSliceMessage.Slice.InnerLabel;
				slice.LabelVisibility = ((!renderSliceMessage.Slice.HasInnerLabel) ? Visibility.Collapsed : Visibility.Visible);
				Canvas.SetLeft(slice, renderSliceMessage.Slice.Offset.X);
				Canvas.SetTop(slice, renderSliceMessage.Slice.Offset.Y);
				SetSliceUsed(slice, value: true);
				if (!canvas.Children.Contains(slice))
				{
					canvas.Children.Add(slice);
				}
			}
		}

		private XamFunnelSlice GetSlice(int index, Canvas panel)
		{
			XamFunnelSlice value = null;
			if (!_slicesByIndex.TryGetValue(index, out value))
			{
				value = new XamFunnelSlice();
				_slicesByIndex.Add(index, value);
			}
			value.Owner = this;
			return value;
		}

		private void FrameRenderCompleteMessageReceived(Message m)
		{
			CleanupUnused();
		}

		private void CleanupUnused()
		{
			if (!_mustClearUnused || SliceArea == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			_mustClearUnused = false;
			List<XamFunnelSlice> list = new List<XamFunnelSlice>();
			foreach (XamFunnelSlice item in SliceArea.Children.OfType<XamFunnelSlice>())
			{
				if (!GetSliceUsed(item))
				{
					list.Add(item);
				}
			}
			foreach (XamFunnelSlice item2 in list)
			{
				SliceAppearance sliceAppearance = (SliceAppearance)item2.DataContext;
				_slicesByIndex.Remove(sliceAppearance.Index);
				SliceArea.Children.Remove(item2);
				item2.Owner = null;
			}
		}

		private void RenderOuterLabelMessageReceived(Message m)
		{
			RenderOuterLabelMessage renderOuterLabelMessage = (RenderOuterLabelMessage)m;
			if (GetTarget(renderOuterLabelMessage) is Canvas canvas)
			{
				ContentPresenter contentPresenter = new ContentPresenter
				{
					ContentTemplate = OuterLabelTemplate,
					Content = renderOuterLabelMessage.Label
				};
				contentPresenter.Width = renderOuterLabelMessage.OuterLabelWidth;
				canvas.Children.Add(contentPresenter);
				contentPresenter.InvalidateMeasure();
				contentPresenter.InvalidateArrange();
				contentPresenter.Measure(new Size(double.PositiveInfinity, double.PositiveInfinity));
				_ = contentPresenter.DesiredSize.Width;
				double height = contentPresenter.DesiredSize.Height;
				Canvas.SetTop(contentPresenter, renderOuterLabelMessage.Position.Y - height / 2.0);
				Canvas.SetLeft(contentPresenter, 0.0);
				contentPresenter.Tag = renderOuterLabelMessage.SliceInfo;
			}
		}

		private void OuterLabel_SizeChanged(object sender, SizeChangedEventArgs e)
		{
			FrameworkElement frameworkElement = sender as FrameworkElement;
			SliceInfo sliceInfo = null;
			int sliceIndex = -1;
			if (frameworkElement != null && frameworkElement.Tag is SliceInfo sliceInfo2)
			{
				sliceIndex = sliceInfo2.Index;
			}
			if (e.PreviousSize.Width > 0.0 && e.PreviousSize.Height > 0.0 && (e.NewSize.Width != e.PreviousSize.Width || e.NewSize.Height != e.NewSize.Height))
			{
				LabelSizeChanged(sliceIndex, e.NewSize, e.PreviousSize, isOuter: true);
			}
		}

		private void TemplateChangedMessageReceived(Message m)
		{
			TemplateChangedMessage templateChangedMessage = (TemplateChangedMessage)m;
			string templateName = templateChangedMessage.TemplateName;
			if (!(templateName == "InnerLabelTemplate"))
			{
				if (templateName == "OuterLabelTemplate")
				{
					OuterLabelTemplate = templateChangedMessage.Template;
				}
			}
			else
			{
				InnerLabelTemplate = templateChangedMessage.Template;
			}
		}

		private void TooltipValueChangedMessageReceived(Message m)
		{
			TooltipValueChangedMessage tooltipValueChangedMessage = (TooltipValueChangedMessage)m;
			TooltipValue = tooltipValueChangedMessage.Value;
		}

		private void TooltipUpdateMessageReceived(Message m)
		{
			TooltipUpdateMessage tooltipUpdateMessage = (TooltipUpdateMessage)m;
			if (ToolTipContent != null)
			{
				ToolTipContent.DataContext = tooltipUpdateMessage.Context;
				if (TooltipValue is FrameworkElement frameworkElement)
				{
					if (frameworkElement.Parent is Panel panel)
					{
						panel.Children.Remove(frameworkElement);
					}
					if (frameworkElement.Parent is ContentControl contentControl)
					{
						contentControl.Content = null;
					}
				}
				if (ToolTipContent.Content != TooltipValue)
				{
					ToolTipContent.Content = TooltipValue;
				}
			}
			if (ToolTip != null)
			{
				ToolTip.HorizontalOffset = tooltipUpdateMessage.Position.X;
				ToolTip.VerticalOffset = tooltipUpdateMessage.Position.Y;
				if (!ToolTip.IsOpen)
				{
					ToolTip.IsOpen = true;
				}
			}
		}

		private void ClearTooltipMessageReceived(Message m)
		{
			if (ToolTip != null)
			{
				ToolTip.IsOpen = false;
			}
		}

		public static bool GetSliceUsed(DependencyObject target)
		{
			return (bool)target.GetValue(SliceUsedProperty);
		}

		public static void SetSliceUsed(DependencyObject target, bool value)
		{
			target.SetValue(SliceUsedProperty, value);
		}

		internal void LabelSizeChanged(int sliceIndex, Size newSize, Size oldSize, bool isOuter)
		{
			LabelSizeChangedMessage labelSizeChangedMessage = new LabelSizeChangedMessage();
			labelSizeChangedMessage.SliceIndex = sliceIndex;
			labelSizeChangedMessage.NewSize = newSize;
			labelSizeChangedMessage.OldSize = oldSize;
			labelSizeChangedMessage.IsOuter = isOuter;
			InteractionMessages.SendMessage(labelSizeChangedMessage);
		}

		internal void InitializeScalingRatio(XamFunnelChart model)
		{
		}

		internal void OnAttachedToUI(XamFunnelChart xamFunnelChart)
		{
		}

		internal void OnDetachedFromUI()
		{
		}
	}
	internal class FinancialLegendView : LegendBaseView
	{
		internal const string PanelElementName = "panel";

		internal WrapPanel Panel { get; set; }

		public FinancialLegendView(FinancialLegend model)
			: base(model)
		{
		}

		internal void RemoveItemVisual(object item)
		{
			if (Panel != null)
			{
				UIElement uIElement = (UIElement)item;
				RemoveItemEvents(uIElement);
				Panel.Children.Remove(uIElement);
			}
		}

		internal void AddItemVisual(object item)
		{
			if (Panel != null)
			{
				UIElement uIElement = (UIElement)item;
				AttachItemEvents(uIElement);
				Panel.Children.Add(uIElement);
			}
		}
	}
	internal class RadialAreaSeriesView : AnchoredRadialSeriesView
	{
		internal Path polygon0 = new Path();

		internal Path polyline0 = new Path();

		internal Path polygon1 = new Path();

		internal Path polyline1 = new Path();

		protected RadialAreaSeries RadialAreaModel { get; set; }

		public RadialAreaSeriesView(RadialAreaSeries model)
			: base(model)
		{
			RadialAreaModel = model;
		}

		public override void AttachUI(Canvas rootCanvas)
		{
			base.AttachUI(rootCanvas);
			polygon0.Detach();
			polygon1.Detach();
			polyline0.Detach();
			polyline1.Detach();
			rootCanvas.Children.Add(polygon0);
			polygon0.SetBinding(Shape.FillProperty, new Binding("ActualBrush")
			{
				Source = RadialAreaModel
			});
			rootCanvas.Children.Add(polygon1);
			polygon1.SetBinding(Shape.FillProperty, new Binding("ActualBrush")
			{
				Source = RadialAreaModel
			});
			polygon1.Opacity = 0.5;
			VisualInformationManager.SetIsTranslucentPortionVisual(polygon1, value: true);
			rootCanvas.Children.Add(polyline0);
			polyline0.SetBinding(Shape.StrokeProperty, new Binding("ActualOutline")
			{
				Source = RadialAreaModel
			});
			polyline0.SetBinding(Shape.StrokeThicknessProperty, new Binding("ActualThickness")
			{
				Source = RadialAreaModel
			});
			polyline0.SetBinding(Shape.StrokeDashCapProperty, new Binding("DashCap")
			{
				Source = RadialAreaModel
			});
			polyline0.SetBinding(Shape.StrokeDashArrayProperty, new Binding("DashArray")
			{
				Source = RadialAreaModel,
				Converter = new DoubleCollectionDuplicator()
			});
			VisualInformationManager.SetIsOutlineVisual(polyline0, value: true);
			polyline0.SetBinding(Shape.StrokeLineJoinProperty, new Binding("LineJoin")
			{
				Source = RadialAreaModel
			});
			polyline0.SetBinding(Shape.StrokeMiterLimitProperty, new Binding("MiterLimit")
			{
				Source = RadialAreaModel
			});
			polyline0.SetBinding(Shape.StrokeStartLineCapProperty, new Binding("StartCap")
			{
				Source = RadialAreaModel
			});
			polyline0.SetBinding(Shape.StrokeEndLineCapProperty, new Binding("EndCap")
			{
				Source = RadialAreaModel
			});
			polyline0.SetBinding(Shape.StrokeLineJoinProperty, new Binding("LineJoin")
			{
				Source = RadialAreaModel
			});
			rootCanvas.Children.Add(polyline1);
			polyline1.SetBinding(Shape.StrokeProperty, new Binding("ActualOutline")
			{
				Source = RadialAreaModel
			});
			polyline1.SetBinding(Shape.StrokeThicknessProperty, new Binding("ActualThickness")
			{
				Source = RadialAreaModel
			});
			polyline1.SetBinding(Shape.StrokeDashCapProperty, new Binding("DashCap")
			{
				Source = RadialAreaModel
			});
			polyline1.SetBinding(Shape.StrokeDashArrayProperty, new Binding("DashArray")
			{
				Source = RadialAreaModel,
				Converter = new DoubleCollectionDuplicator()
			});
			VisualInformationManager.SetIsOutlineVisual(polyline1, value: true);
			VisualInformationManager.SetIsMainGeometryVisual(polyline1, value: true);
			polyline1.SetBinding(Shape.StrokeLineJoinProperty, new Binding("LineJoin")
			{
				Source = RadialAreaModel
			});
			polyline1.SetBinding(Shape.StrokeMiterLimitProperty, new Binding("MiterLimit")
			{
				Source = RadialAreaModel
			});
			polyline1.SetBinding(Shape.StrokeStartLineCapProperty, new Binding("StartCap")
			{
				Source = RadialAreaModel
			});
			polyline1.SetBinding(Shape.StrokeEndLineCapProperty, new Binding("EndCap")
			{
				Source = RadialAreaModel
			});
			polyline1.SetBinding(Shape.StrokeLineJoinProperty, new Binding("LineJoin")
			{
				Source = RadialAreaModel
			});
			if (!base.IsThumbnailView)
			{
				RadialAreaModel.RenderSeries(animate: false);
			}
		}

		protected internal override void ExportViewShapes(object svd)
		{
			base.ExportViewShapes(svd);
			Model.SeriesVisualDataManager.ExportPathData(svd, polyline0, "lowerShape", new string[1] { "Lower" });
			Model.SeriesVisualDataManager.ExportPathData(svd, polyline1, "upperShape", new string[2] { "Upper", "Main" });
			Model.SeriesVisualDataManager.ExportPathData(svd, polygon1, "translucentShape", new string[1] { "Translucent" });
			Model.SeriesVisualDataManager.ExportPathData(svd, polygon0, "fillShape", new string[1] { "Fill" });
		}
	}
	[WidgetModule("ScatterChart")]
	[HybridJavaSuppressWidget]
	public class HighDensityScatterSeries : Series
	{
		internal const string XAxisPropertyName = "XAxis";

		public static readonly DependencyProperty XAxisProperty = DependencyProperty.Register("XAxis", typeof(NumericXAxis), typeof(HighDensityScatterSeries), new PropertyMetadata(null, delegate(DependencyObject sender, DependencyPropertyChangedEventArgs e)
		{
			((HighDensityScatterSeries)sender).RaisePropertyChanged("XAxis", e.OldValue, e.NewValue);
		}));

		public HighDensityScatterSeries()
		{
			base.DefaultStyleKey = typeof(HighDensityScatterSeries);
			base.MouseOverEnabled = false;
		}

		public override object GetItemValue(object item, string memberPathName)
		{
			string text = ResolveMemberPath(memberPathName);
			if (text == "XMemberPath")
			{
				return GetItemValueByMemberPath(item, memberPathName, XMemberPath);
			}
			if (text == "YMemberPath")
			{
				return GetItemValueByMemberPath(item, memberPathName, YMemberPath);
			}
			return base.GetItemValue(item, memberPathName);
		}

		private void ResetTree()
		{
			if (_tree == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			lock (_tree.SyncLock)
			{
				_tree.CancelLoad();
				_tree.ProgressiveThunkCompleted -= _tree_ProgressiveThunkCompleted;
				_tree = null;
			}
		}

		protected override void PropertyUpdatedOverride(object sender, string propertyName, object oldValue, object newValue)
		{
			base.PropertyUpdatedOverride(sender, propertyName, oldValue, newValue);
			switch (propertyName)
			{
			case "SeriesViewer":
				if (base.SeriesViewer != null)
				{
					_hasEffectiveViewport = !GetEffectiveViewport(base.View).IsEmpty;
				}
				break;
			case "FastItemsSource":
				ResetTree();
				if (oldValue is IFastItemsSource)
				{
					((IFastItemsSource)oldValue).DeregisterColumn(XColumn);
					((IFastItemsSource)oldValue).DeregisterColumn(YColumn);
					XColumn = null;
					YColumn = null;
				}
				if (newValue is IFastItemsSource)
				{
					XColumn = RegisterDoubleColumn(XMemberPath);
					YColumn = RegisterDoubleColumn(YMemberPath);
				}
				if ((YAxis != null && !YAxis.UpdateRange()) || (XAxis != null && !XAxis.UpdateRange()))
				{
					RenderSeries(animate: false);
				}
				NotifyThumbnailDataChanged();
				break;
			case "XAxis":
			{
				NumericXAxis xAxis = _xAxis;
				_xAxis = XAxis;
				ResetTree();
				if (xAxis != null)
				{
					xAxis.RangeChanged -= Axis_RangeChanged;
				}
				if (_xAxis != null)
				{
					_xAxis.RangeChanged += Axis_RangeChanged;
				}
				if (oldValue != null)
				{
					((Axis)oldValue).DeregisterSeries(this);
				}
				if (newValue != null)
				{
					((Axis)newValue).RegisterSeries(this);
				}
				if ((XAxis != null && !XAxis.UpdateRange()) || (newValue == null && oldValue != null))
				{
					RenderSeries(animate: false);
				}
				break;
			}
			case "YAxis":
			{
				NumericYAxis yAxis = _yAxis;
				_yAxis = YAxis;
				ResetTree();
				if (yAxis != null)
				{
					yAxis.RangeChanged -= Axis_RangeChanged;
				}
				if (_yAxis != null)
				{
					_yAxis.RangeChanged += Axis_RangeChanged;
				}
				if (oldValue != null)
				{
					((Axis)oldValue).DeregisterSeries(this);
				}
				if (newValue != null)
				{
					((Axis)newValue).RegisterSeries(this);
				}
				if ((YAxis != null && !YAxis.UpdateRange()) || (newValue == null && oldValue != null))
				{
					RenderSeries(animate: false);
				}
				break;
			}
			case "MouseOverEnabled":
				_mouseOverEnabled = base.MouseOverEnabled;
				RenderSeries(animate: false);
				break;
			case "XMemberPath":
				if (base.FastItemsSource != null)
				{
					base.FastItemsSource.DeregisterColumn(XColumn);
					XColumn = RegisterDoubleColumn(XMemberPath);
				}
				break;
			case "XColumn":
				ResetTree();
				if (XAxis != null && !XAxis.UpdateRange())
				{
					RenderSeries(animate: false);
				}
				NotifyThumbnailDataChanged();
				break;
			case "YMemberPath":
				if (base.FastItemsSource != null)
				{
					base.FastItemsSource.DeregisterColumn(YColumn);
					YColumn = RegisterDoubleColumn(YMemberPath);
				}
				break;
			case "YColumn":
				ResetTree();
				if (YAxis != null && !YAxis.UpdateRange())
				{
					RenderSeries(animate: false);
				}
				NotifyThumbnailDataChanged();
				break;
			case "UseBruteForce":
				ResetTree();
				RenderSeries(animate: false);
				NotifyThumbnailAppearanceChanged();
				break;
			case "HeatMinimum":
				RenderSeries(animate: false);
				NotifyThumbnailAppearanceChanged();
				break;
			case "HeatMaximum":
				RenderSeries(animate: false);
				NotifyThumbnailAppearanceChanged();
				break;
			case "HeatMaximumColor":
			case "HeatMinimumColor":
				if (SuperView.ColorScaleValid(HeatMinimumColor, HeatMaximumColor))
				{
					OnHeatColorsChanged();
					RenderSeries(animate: false);
					NotifyThumbnailAppearanceChanged();
				}
				break;
			case "PointExtent":
				_pointExtent = Math.Max((int)newValue - 1, 0);
				_drawExtent = _pointExtent > 0;
				RenderSeries(animate: false);
				NotifyThumbnailAppearanceChanged();
				break;
			case "ProgressiveLoad":
				RenderSeries(animate: false);
				NotifyThumbnailAppearanceChanged();
				break;
			}
		}

		private void OnHeatColorsChanged()
		{
			_minA = (int)HeatMinimumColor.A;
			_minR = (int)HeatMinimumColor.R;
			_minG = (int)HeatMinimumColor.G;
			_minB = (int)HeatMinimumColor.B;
			_maxA = (int)HeatMaximumColor.A;
			_maxR = (int)HeatMaximumColor.R;
			_maxG = (int)HeatMaximumColor.G;
			_maxB = (int)HeatMaximumColor.B;
			base.Outline = BrushUtil.FromArgb((byte)_minA, (byte)_minR, (byte)_minG, (byte)_minB);
			base.Brush = BrushUtil.FromArgb((byte)_maxA, (byte)_maxR, (byte)_maxG, (byte)_maxB);
		}

		public bool CanUseAsYAxis(object axis)
		{
			if (axis is NumericYAxis)
			{
				return true;
			}
			return false;
		}

		public bool CanUseAsXAxis(object axis)
		{
			if (axis is NumericXAxis)
			{
				return true;
			}
			return false;
		}

		private void Axis_RangeChanged(object sender, AxisRangeChangedEventArgs e)
		{
			ResetTree();
			RenderSeries(animate: false);
		}

		protected internal override bool ValidateSeries(Rect viewportRect, Rect windowRect, SeriesView view)
		{
			bool result = base.ValidateSeries(viewportRect, windowRect, view);
			if (YAxis == null || XAxis == null || XAxis.SeriesViewer == null || YAxis.SeriesViewer == null || YColumn == null || XColumn == null || YColumn.Count < 1 || XColumn.Count < 1 || YColumn.Count != XColumn.Count || XAxis.ActualMinimumValue == XAxis.ActualMaximumValue || YAxis.ActualMinimumValue == YAxis.ActualMaximumValue || base.Viewport.IsEmpty)
			{
				result = false;
			}
			return result;
		}

		protected internal override void RenderSeriesOverride(bool animate)
		{
			base.RenderSeriesOverride(animate);
			DoRender(animate, base.View);
		}

		private void DoRender(bool animate, SeriesView view)
		{
			if (ClearAndAbortIfInvalid(view))
			{
				return;
			}
			if (_tree == null && !UseBruteForce)
			{
				List<KDPointData> list = new List<KDPointData>(XColumn.Count);
				NumericXAxis xAxis = XAxis;
				NumericYAxis yAxis = YAxis;
				Rect window = new Rect(0.0, 0.0, 1.0, 1.0);
				Rect viewport = new Rect(0.0, 0.0, 1.0, 1.0);
				ScalerParams p = new ScalerParams(window, viewport, xAxis.IsInverted);
				ScalerParams p2 = new ScalerParams(window, viewport, yAxis.IsInverted);
				for (int i = 0; i < XColumn.Count; i++)
				{
					double scaledValue = xAxis.GetScaledValue(XColumn[i], p);
					double scaledValue2 = yAxis.GetScaledValue(YColumn[i], p2);
					if (!double.IsNaN(scaledValue) && !double.IsNaN(scaledValue2) && !double.IsInfinity(scaledValue) && !double.IsInfinity(scaledValue2))
					{
						list.Add(new KDPointData
						{
							X = scaledValue,
							Y = scaledValue2,
							Index = i
						});
					}
				}
				if (ProgressiveLoad)
				{
					_currentLevel = 1;
					_expectedLevels = (int)Math.Log(list.Count, 2.0) + 3;
					ProgressiveStatus = (int)((double)_currentLevel / (double)_expectedLevels * 100.0);
					if (this.ProgressiveLoadStatusChanged != null)
					{
						this.ProgressiveLoadStatusChanged(this, new ProgressiveLoadStatusEventArgs(ProgressiveStatus));
					}
					_tree = KDTree2D.GetProgressive(list.ToArray(), 1);
					_tree.ProgressiveThunkCompleted += _tree_ProgressiveThunkCompleted;
					if (!_tree.ProgressiveStep())
					{
						_tree.ProgressiveThunkCompleted -= _tree_ProgressiveThunkCompleted;
					}
					NotifyThumbnailAppearanceChanged();
				}
				else
				{
					_ = DateTime.Now;
					_tree = new KDTree2D(list.ToArray(), 1);
					_ = DateTime.Now;
				}
			}
			if (ProgressiveLoad && !UseBruteForce)
			{
				LockedRender(view);
			}
			else
			{
				RenderBitmap(view);
			}
		}

		protected override void DataUpdatedOverride(FastItemsSourceEventAction action, int position, int count, string propertyName)
		{
			base.DataUpdatedOverride(action, position, count, propertyName);
			ResetTree();
			bool flag = false;
			if (XAxis != null && !XAxis.UpdateRange())
			{
				flag = true;
			}
			if (YAxis != null && !YAxis.UpdateRange())
			{
				flag = true;
			}
			if (flag)
			{
				RenderSeries(animate: false);
			}
			NotifyThumbnailDataChanged();
		}

		private void AssertMouseOver(SeriesView view)
		{
			_ = (HighDensityScatterSeriesView)view;
			int num = _imageWidth * _imageHeight;
			if (_mouseOverEnabled)
			{
				if (_itemIndexes == null || _itemIndexes.Length != num)
				{
					_itemIndexes = new int[num];
				}
				else
				{
					Array.Clear(_itemIndexes, 0, _itemIndexes.Length);
				}
			}
		}

		private void RenderBitmap(SeriesView view)
		{
			int[] itemIndexes = null;
			if (view.IsThumbnailView)
			{
				itemIndexes = _itemIndexes;
			}
			view.GetViewInfo(out var viewportRect, out var windowRect);
			HighDensityScatterSeriesView highDensityScatterSeriesView = (HighDensityScatterSeriesView)view;
			Rect effectiveViewport = GetEffectiveViewport(view);
			_scalerParamsX = new ScalerParams(windowRect, viewportRect, _xAxis.IsInverted, effectiveViewport);
			_scalerParamsY = new ScalerParams(windowRect, viewportRect, _yAxis.IsInverted, effectiveViewport);
			AssertBitmap(view);
			AssertMouseOver(view);
			int num = _imageWidth * _imageHeight;
			if (_values == null || _values.Length != num)
			{
				_values = new double[num];
				_alphas = new double[num];
			}
			_ = _values.Length;
			_ = _values;
			_ = _alphas;
			Array.Clear(_values, 0, _values.Length);
			Array.Clear(_alphas, 0, _alphas.Length);
			_resolution = (int)Math.Round(base.Resolution);
			_pixels = highDensityScatterSeriesView.GetPixelBuffer();
			_ = _pixels.Length;
			_ = _pixels;
			Array.Clear(_pixels, 0, _pixels.Length);
			double num2 = HeatMinimum;
			double num3 = HeatMaximum;
			if (double.IsNaN(num2) || double.IsInfinity(num2))
			{
				num2 = 0.0;
			}
			if (double.IsNaN(num3) || double.IsInfinity(num3))
			{
				num3 = 50.0;
			}
			_heatMinimum = Math.Min(num2, num3);
			_heatMaximum = Math.Max(num2, num3);
			if (_heatMinimum < 0.0)
			{
				_heatMinimum = 0.0;
			}
			if (_heatMaximum < 0.0)
			{
				_heatMaximum = 0.0;
			}
			_heatRange = _heatMaximum - _heatMinimum;
			if (UseBruteForce)
			{
				BruteForceRender(view);
			}
			else
			{
				UseTree(view);
			}
			highDensityScatterSeriesView.UpdateBitmap();
			if (view.IsThumbnailView)
			{
				_itemIndexes = itemIndexes;
				SuperView.UpdateImageValues();
			}
		}

		private void LockedRender(SeriesView view)
		{
			if (_tree == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			lock (_tree.SyncLock)
			{
				RenderBitmap(view);
			}
		}

		private void _tree_ProgressiveThunkCompleted(object sender, EventArgs e)
		{
			SuperView.Defer(delegate
			{
				if (_currentLevel < _expectedLevels - 1)
				{
					_currentLevel++;
				}
				ProgressiveStatus = (int)((double)_currentLevel / (double)_expectedLevels * 100.0);
				if (this.ProgressiveLoadStatusChanged != null)
				{
					this.ProgressiveLoadStatusChanged(this, new ProgressiveLoadStatusEventArgs(ProgressiveStatus));
				}
				LockedRender(base.View);
				NotifyThumbnailAppearanceChanged();
				if (_tree != null && !_tree.ProgressiveStep())
				{
					_tree.ProgressiveThunkCompleted -= _tree_ProgressiveThunkCompleted;
					ProgressiveStatus = 100;
					if (this.ProgressiveLoadStatusChanged != null)
					{
						this.ProgressiveLoadStatusChanged(this, new ProgressiveLoadStatusEventArgs(ProgressiveStatus));
					}
				}
			});
		}

		private void BruteForceRender(SeriesView view)

			_ = _minG;

				{

				}

							if (num8 >= 0 && num8 <= num - 1)
							{

								_rendered++;
								if (_mouseOverEnabled)
								{

								}
							}
						}
					}
				}
				else
				{
					int num9 = num3 * _imageWidth + num2;
					_values[num9] += 1.0;
					_alphas[num9] = 1.0;
					_rendered++;
					if (_mouseOverEnabled)

		private void UseTree(SeriesView view)
		{
			view.GetViewInfo(out var viewportRect, out var windowRect);
			if (_tree != null)
			{
				if (_nodes == null)
				{
					_nodes = new List<KDTreeNode2D>((int)Math.Round(viewportRect.Width * viewportRect.Height));
				}
				else
				{
					_nodes.Clear();
				}
				double num = windowRect.Left;
				double num2 = windowRect.Right;
				double num3 = windowRect.Top;
				double num4 = windowRect.Bottom;
				_windowTop = windowRect.Top;
				_windowHeight = windowRect.Height;
				_windowLeft = windowRect.Left;
				_windowWidth = windowRect.Width;
				_viewportTop = viewportRect.Top;
				_viewportHeight = viewportRect.Height;
				_viewportLeft = viewportRect.Left;
				_viewportWidth = viewportRect.Width;
				Rect effectiveViewport = GetEffectiveViewport(view);
				_effectiveViewportLeft = (effectiveViewport.Left - _viewportLeft) / _viewportWidth;
				_effectiveViewportTop = (effectiveViewport.Top - _viewportTop) / _viewportHeight;
				double num5 = (effectiveViewport.Right - _viewportLeft) / _viewportWidth;
				_effectiveViewportWidth = num5 - _effectiveViewportLeft;
				double num6 = (effectiveViewport.Bottom - _viewportTop) / _viewportHeight;
				_effectiveViewportHeight = num6 - _effectiveViewportTop;
				if (_hasEffectiveViewport)
				{
					num = (num - _effectiveViewportLeft) / _effectiveViewportWidth;
					num2 = (num2 - _effectiveViewportLeft) / _effectiveViewportWidth;
					num3 = (num3 - _effectiveViewportTop) / _effectiveViewportHeight;
					num4 = (num4 - _effectiveViewportTop) / _effectiveViewportHeight;
				}
				double num7 = base.Resolution / viewportRect.Width * windowRect.Width;
				double num8 = base.Resolution / viewportRect.Height * windowRect.Height;
				Math.Min(num7, num8);
				SearchArgs args = new SearchArgs
				{
					MinX = num,
					MaxX = num2,
					MinY = num3,
					MaxY = num4,
					PixelSizeX = num7,
					PixelSizeY = num8,
					MaxRenderDepth = int.MaxValue
				};
				_tree.GetVisible(_nodes, args, 0.0, 1.0, 0.0, 1.0);
				_rendered = 0;
				for (int i = 0; i < _nodes.Count; i++)
				{
					KDTreeNode2D current = _nodes[i];
					RenderNode(current);
				}
				RenderImage();
			}
		}

		private void RenderNode(KDTreeNode2D current)
		{
			if (current.Unfinished)
			{
				return;
			}
			bool flag = current.SearchData != null && current.SearchData.IsCutoff;
			int num = ((current.OtherPoints != null) ? current.OtherPoints.Length : 0);
			double num2 = (double)(current.DescendantCount - num) + 1.0;
			if (!flag || !(num2 > 0.0))
			{
				num2 = 1.0;
			}
			RenderPointData(current.Median, num2, flag, current.SearchData);
			if (num > 0 && !flag)
			{
				for (int i = 0; i < num; i++)
				{
					KDPointData pointData = current.OtherPoints[i];
					RenderPointData(pointData, num2, isCutoff: false, current.SearchData);
				}
			}
			if (current.SearchData != null)
			{
				current.SearchData.IsCutoff = false;
			}
		}

		public override bool ScrollIntoView(object item)
		{
			Rect windowRect = ((base.SeriesViewer != null) ? base.SeriesViewer.ActualWindowRect : Rect.Empty);
			Rect rect = ((base.SeriesViewer != null) ? base.SeriesViewer.ViewportRect : Rect.Empty);
			Rect rect2 = new Rect(0.0, 0.0, 1.0, 1.0);
			Rect effectiveViewportForUnitViewport = GetEffectiveViewportForUnitViewport(base.View);
			ScalerParams p = new ScalerParams(rect2, rect2, XAxis.IsInverted, effectiveViewportForUnitViewport);
			ScalerParams p2 = new ScalerParams(rect2, rect2, YAxis.IsInverted, effectiveViewportForUnitViewport);
			int num = ((!windowRect.IsEmpty && !rect.IsEmpty && base.FastItemsSource != null) ? base.FastItemsSource.IndexOf(item) : (-1));
			double num2 = ((XAxis != null && XColumn != null && num < XColumn.Count) ? XAxis.GetScaledValue(XColumn[num], p) : double.NaN);
			double num3 = ((YAxis != null && YColumn != null && num < YColumn.Count) ? YAxis.GetScaledValue(YColumn[num], p2) : double.NaN);
			if (!double.IsNaN(num2))
			{
				if (num2 < windowRect.Left + 0.1 * windowRect.Width)
				{
					num2 += 0.4 * windowRect.Width;
					windowRect.X = num2 - 0.5 * windowRect.Width;
				}
				if (num2 > windowRect.Right - 0.1 * windowRect.Width)
				{
					num2 -= 0.4 * windowRect.Width;
					windowRect.X = num2 - 0.5 * windowRect.Width;
				}
			}
			if (!double.IsNaN(num3))
			{
				if (num3 < windowRect.Top + 0.1 * windowRect.Height)
				{
					num3 += 0.4 * windowRect.Height;
					windowRect.Y = num3 - 0.5 * windowRect.Height;
				}
				if (num3 > windowRect.Bottom - 0.1 * windowRect.Height)
				{
					num3 -= 0.4 * windowRect.Height;
					windowRect.Y = num3 - 0.5 * windowRect.Height;
				}
			}
			if (base.SyncLink != null)
			{
				base.SyncLink.WindowNotify(base.SeriesViewer, windowRect, force: true);
			}
			return num >= 0;
		}

		private void RenderPointData(KDPointData pointData, double p, bool isCutoff, SearchData searchData)
		{
			GetColorFromValue(p);
			int index = pointData.Index;
			int pointExtent = _pointExtent;
			if (isCutoff)
			{
				double num = searchData.MinX;
				double num2 = searchData.MaxX;
				double num3 = searchData.MinY;
				double num4 = searchData.MaxY;
				if (_hasEffectiveViewport)
				{
					num = _effectiveViewportLeft + _effectiveViewportWidth * num;
					num2 = _effectiveViewportLeft + _effectiveViewportWidth * num2;
					num3 = _effectiveViewportTop + _effectiveViewportHeight * num3;
					num4 = _effectiveViewportTop + _effectiveViewportHeight * num4;
				}
				int num5 = (int)(_viewportLeft + _viewportWidth * (num - _windowLeft) / _windowWidth);
				int num6 = (int)(_viewportLeft + _viewportWidth * (num2 - _windowLeft) / _windowWidth);
				int num7 = (int)(_viewportTop + _viewportHeight * (num3 - _windowTop) / _windowHeight);
				int num8 = (int)(_viewportTop + _viewportHeight * (num4 - _windowTop) / _windowHeight);
				if (_drawExtent)
				{
					num5 -= pointExtent;
					num6 += pointExtent;
					num7 -= pointExtent;
					num8 += pointExtent;
				}
				double num9 = (num6 - num5 + 1) * (num8 - num7 + 1);
				double num10 = p / num9;
				double alpha = num10;
				for (int i = num5; i <= num6; i++)
				{
					for (int j = num7; j <= num8; j++)
					{
						RenderPixel(index, i, j, num10, alpha);
					}
				}
				return;
			}
			double num11 = pointData.X;
			double num12 = pointData.Y;
			if (_hasEffectiveViewport)
			{
				num11 = _effectiveViewportLeft + _effectiveViewportWidth * num11;
				num12 = _effectiveViewportTop + _effectiveViewportHeight * num12;
			}
			int num13 = (int)(_viewportLeft + _viewportWidth * (num11 - _windowLeft) / _windowWidth);
			int num14 = (int)(_viewportTop + _viewportHeight * (num12 - _windowTop) / _windowHeight);
			if (_drawExtent)
			{
				int num15 = num13 - pointExtent;
				int num16 = num13 + pointExtent;
				int num17 = num14 + pointExtent;
				int num18 = num14 - pointExtent;
				double num19 = (num16 - num15 + 1) * (num17 - num18 + 1);
				double num20 = p / num19;
				double alpha2 = num20;
				for (int k = num15; k <= num16; k++)
				{
					for (int l = num18; l <= num17; l++)
					{
						RenderPixel(index, k, l, num20, alpha2);
					}
				}
			}
			else
			{
				RenderPixel(index, num13, num14, p, 1.0);
			}
		}

		private int GetAlphaColorFromValue(double p, double alpha)
		{
			return ((int)(255.0 * alpha) << 24) | ((int)(alpha * (_minR + p * _rangeR)) << 16) | ((int)(alpha * (_minG + p * _rangeG)) << 8) | (int)(alpha * (_minB + p * _rangeB));
		}

		private int GetColorFromValue(double p)
		{
			return -16777216 | ((int)(_minR + p * _rangeR) << 16) | ((int)(_minG + p * _rangeG) << 8) | (int)(_minB + p * _rangeB);
		}

		private double GetValueFromColor(int color)
		{
			return (double)((color >> 24) & 0xFF) / 255.0;
		}

		private void RenderPixel(int index, int posX, int posY, double p, double alpha)
		{
			if (posX >= 0 && posX < _imageWidth && posY >= 0 && posY < _imageHeight)
			{
				int num = posY * _imageWidth + posX;
				_values[num] += p;
				_alphas[num] += alpha;
				if (_mouseOverEnabled)
				{
					_itemIndexes[num] = index + 1;
				}
				_rendered += (int)p;
			}
		}

		private void RenderImage()
		{
			double num = 0.0;
			double num2 = 0.0;
			double heatRange = _heatRange;
			double heatMinimum = _heatMinimum;
			double heatMaximum = _heatMaximum;
			int num3 = _values.Length;
			double[] values = _values;
			double[] alphas = _alphas;
			int[] pixels = _pixels;
			double num4 = double.NaN;
			double num5 = double.NaN;
			int num6 = 0;
			for (int i = 0; i < num3; i++)
			{
				num = values[i];
				if (num != 0.0)
				{
					num2 = alphas[i];
					num = ((num >= heatMaximum) ? 1.0 : ((!(num <= heatMinimum)) ? ((num - heatMinimum) / heatRange) : 0.0));
					if (num2 > 1.0)
					{
						num2 = 1.0;
					}
					if (num2 < 0.2)
					{
						num2 = 0.2;
					}
					if (num4 != num || num5 != num2)
					{
						num6 = GetAlphaColorFromValue(num, num2);
						num4 = num;
						num5 = num2;
					}
					pixels[i] = num6;
				}
			}
		}

		public override object GetItem(Point world)
		{
			if (!_mouseOverEnabled || _itemIndexes == null || base.SeriesViewer == null || base.FastItemsSource == null || _itemIndexes.Length != _imageWidth * _imageHeight)
			{
				return null;
			}
			Rect actualWindowRect = base.SeriesViewer.ActualWindowRect;
			double num = (world.X - actualWindowRect.Left) / actualWindowRect.Width;
			double num2 = (world.Y - actualWindowRect.Top) / actualWindowRect.Height;
			int pixelX = (int)Math.Round(base.Viewport.Width * num);
			int pixelY = (int)Math.Round(base.Viewport.Height * num2);
			int num3 = TryGetIndex(pixelX, pixelY);
			if (num3 < 0 || num3 > _itemIndexes.Length - 1)
			{
				return null;
			}
			int num4 = _itemIndexes[num3] - 1;
			if (num4 < 0 || num4 > base.FastItemsSource.Count)
			{
				return null;
			}
			return base.FastItemsSource[num4];
		}

		private int TryGetIndex(int pixelX, int pixelY)
		{
			int num = _imageWidth * pixelY + pixelX;
			if (num > 0 && num < _itemIndexes.Length && _itemIndexes[num] > 0)
			{
				return num;
			}
			int num2 = 1;
			num = _imageWidth * (pixelY - num2) + pixelX;
			if (num > 0 && num < _itemIndexes.Length && _itemIndexes[num] > 0)
			{
				return num;
			}
			num = _imageWidth * (pixelY + num2) + pixelX;
			if (num > 0 && num < _itemIndexes.Length && _itemIndexes[num] > 0)
			{
				return num;
			}
			num = _imageWidth * pixelY + pixelX - 1;
			if (num > 0 && num < _itemIndexes.Length && _itemIndexes[num] > 0)
			{
				return num;
			}
			num = _imageWidth * pixelY + pixelX + 1;
			if (num > 0 && num < _itemIndexes.Length && _itemIndexes[num] > 0)
			{
				return num;
			}
			num = _imageWidth * (pixelY - num2) + pixelX - 1;
			if (num > 0 && num < _itemIndexes.Length && _itemIndexes[num] > 0)
			{
				return num;
			}
			num = _imageWidth * (pixelY + num2) + pixelX + 1;
			if (num > 0 && num < _itemIndexes.Length && _itemIndexes[num] > 0)
			{
				return num;
			}
			num = _imageWidth * (pixelY - num2) + pixelX + 1;
			if (num > 0 && num < _itemIndexes.Length && _itemIndexes[num] > 0)
			{
				return num;
			}
			num = _imageWidth * (pixelY + num2) + pixelX - 1;
			if (num > 0 && num < _itemIndexes.Length && _itemIndexes[num] > 0)
			{
				return num;
			}
			return 0;
		}

	{

		{
			Stroke = new SolidColorBrush(Colors.Green),
			StrokeThickness = 1.0,
			Data = new PathGeometry()
		};

		private int[] _pixels;

		private int _imageWidth;

		private int _imageHeight;

		protected HighDensityScatterSeries HighDensityScatterModel { get; set; }

		public HighDensityScatterSeriesView(HighDensityScatterSeries model)
			: base(model)
		{
			HighDensityScatterModel = model;
		}

		{

		internal void AssertBitmap()
		{
			if (_bitmap == null || _bitmap.PixelWidth != (int)base.Viewport.Width || _bitmap.PixelHeight != (int)base.Viewport.Height)
			{
				_bitmap = new WriteableBitmap((int)base.Viewport.Width, (int)base.Viewport.Height, 96.0, 96.0, PixelFormats.Pbgra32, null);
				_pixels = new int[_bitmap.PixelHeight * _bitmap.PixelWidth];
				_image.Source = _bitmap;
				_imageWidth = _bitmap.PixelWidth;
				_imageHeight = _bitmap.PixelHeight;
			}
			HighDensityScatterModel.UpdateImageValues(_pixels, _imageWidth, _imageHeight);
		}

		internal void UpdateImageValues()
		{
			HighDensityScatterModel.UpdateImageValues(_pixels, _imageWidth, _imageHeight);
		}

		internal int[] GetPixelBuffer()
		{
			return _pixels;
		}

		private int[] ConvertStreamBytesToColor(byte[] Bytes)
		{
			int[] array = new int[Bytes.Length / 4];
			for (int i = 0; i < array.Length; i++)
			{
				array[i] = IntColorFromBytes(Bytes[i * 4 + 3], Bytes[i * 4 + 2], Bytes[i * 4 + 1], Bytes[i * 4]);
			}
			return array;
		}

		public static int IntColorFromBytes(byte a, byte r, byte g, byte b)
		{
			return (a << 24) | (r << 16) | (g << 8) | b;
		}

		internal void UpdateBitmap()
		{
			_bitmap.WritePixels(new Int32Rect(0, 0, _bitmap.PixelWidth, _bitmap.PixelHeight), _pixels, 4 * _bitmap.PixelWidth, 0);
		}

		private byte[] GetBytesFromColors(int[] pixels)
		{
			byte[] array = new byte[pixels.Length * 4];
			for (int i = 0; i < pixels.Length; i++)
			{
				int num = pixels[i];
				array[i * 4 + 3] = (byte)((num >> 24) & 0xFF);
				array[i * 4 + 2] = (byte)((num >> 16) & 0xFF);
				array[i * 4 + 1] = (byte)((num >> 8) & 0xFF);
				array[i * 4] = (byte)(num & 0xFF);
			}
			return array;
		}

		private byte GetValueFromColor(int color)
		{
			return (byte)((double)((color >> 24) & 0xFF) / 255.0);
		}

		internal void Defer(Action action)
		{
			Model.Dispatcher.BeginInvoke(new ThreadStart(action.Invoke));
		}

		internal bool ColorScaleValid(Color HeatMinimumColor, Color HeatMaximumColor)
		{
			return true;
		}

		protected internal override void ExportViewShapes(object svd)
		{
			base.ExportViewShapes(svd);
			Model.SeriesVisualDataManager.ExportSeriesPixelsData(svd, _pixels, _imageWidth, _imageHeight);
		}

		internal void ClearBitmap()
		{
			if (_pixels != null)
			{
				Array.Clear(_pixels, 0, _pixels.Length);
				UpdateBitmap();
			}
		}
	}
	internal class KDTree2D
	{
		protected KDPointData[] _progressivePoints;

		protected Stack<KDTreeThunk> _progressiveThunks;

		protected List<KDTreeThunk> _toProcess;

		private int _currentProgressiveLevel;

		private object _lock = new object();

		private bool _isCancelled;

		private Random _rand = new Random();

		public object SyncLock => _lock;

		protected KDTreeNode2D Root { get; set; }

		public event EventHandler<EventArgs> ProgressiveThunkCompleted;

		public KDTree2D(KDPointData[] points, int maxLeafSize)
		{
			lock (_lock)
			{
				Root = KDTreeHelper(points, 0, points.Length - 1, 0, maxLeafSize);
			}
		}

		public KDTree2D()
		{
		}

		public static KDTree2D GetProgressive(KDPointData[] points, int maxLeafSize)
		{
			KDTree2D kDTree2D = new KDTree2D();
			kDTree2D.Root = new KDTreeNode2D();
			kDTree2D.Root.Unfinished = true;
			kDTree2D._progressivePoints = points;
			kDTree2D._progressiveThunks = new Stack<KDTreeThunk>();
			kDTree2D._toProcess = new List<KDTreeThunk>();
			KDTreeThunk kDTreeThunk = new KDTreeThunk();
			kDTreeThunk.StartIndex = 0;
			kDTreeThunk.EndIndex = points.Length - 1;
			kDTreeThunk.Level = 0;
			kDTreeThunk.MaxLeafSize = maxLeafSize;
			kDTreeThunk.Node = kDTree2D.Root;
			kDTree2D._progressiveThunks.Push(kDTreeThunk);
			return kDTree2D;
		}

		public bool ProgressiveStep()
		{
			lock (_lock)
			{
				if (_progressiveThunks.Count == 0 && _toProcess.Count == 0)
				{
					_progressivePoints = null;
					return false;
				}
				if (_progressiveThunks.Count == 0 && _toProcess.Count > 0)
				{
					return true;
				}
				_currentProgressiveLevel = _progressiveThunks.Peek().Level;
				while (_progressiveThunks.Count > 0 && _progressiveThunks.Peek().Level == _currentProgressiveLevel)
				{
					_toProcess.Add(_progressiveThunks.Pop());
				}
				new Thread(ProcessThunks).Start();
				return true;
			}
		}

		internal void CancelLoad()
		{
			lock (_lock)
			{
				_isCancelled = true;
			}
		}

		private void ProcessThunks()
		{
			lock (_lock)
			{
				for (int i = 0; i < _toProcess.Count; i++)
				{
					if (_isCancelled || _progressivePoints == null)
					{
						return;
					}
					if (_progressivePoints.Length != 0)
					{
						KDTreeThunk kDTreeThunk = _toProcess[i];
						KDTreeHelperProgressive(kDTreeThunk.Node, _progressivePoints, kDTreeThunk.StartIndex, kDTreeThunk.EndIndex, kDTreeThunk.Level, kDTreeThunk.MaxLeafSize);
					}
				}
				_toProcess.Clear();
			}
			if (this.ProgressiveThunkCompleted != null)
			{
				this.ProgressiveThunkCompleted(this, new EventArgs());
			}
		}

		private void KDTreeHelperProgressive(KDTreeNode2D node, KDPointData[] points, int startIndex, int endIndex, int level, int maxLeafSize)
		{
			node.Unfinished = false;
			node.IsX = level % 2 == 0;
			node.DescendantCount = endIndex - startIndex;
			if (startIndex == endIndex)
			{
				node.Median = points[startIndex];
				return;
			}
			if (startIndex > endIndex)
			{
				node.Unfinished = true;
				return;
			}
			if (endIndex - startIndex + 1 <= maxLeafSize)
			{
				node.Median = points[startIndex];
				node.OtherPoints = new KDPointData[endIndex - startIndex + 1];
				int num = 0;
				for (int i = startIndex; i <= endIndex; i++)
				{
					node.OtherPoints[num++] = points[i];
				}
				return;
			}
			int k = Math.Max((endIndex - startIndex) / 2, 1);
			int num2 = Select(points, startIndex, endIndex, node.IsX, k);
			node.Median = points[num2];
			if (startIndex <= num2 - 1)
			{
				node.LeftChild = new KDTreeNode2D
				{
					Unfinished = true
				};
				node.LeftChild.DescendantCount = num2 - 1 - startIndex + 1;
				_progressiveThunks.Push(new KDTreeThunk
				{
					StartIndex = startIndex,
					EndIndex = num2 - 1,
					Level = level + 1,
					MaxLeafSize = maxLeafSize,
					Node = node.LeftChild
				});
			}
			else
			{
				node.LeftChild = null;
			}
			if (num2 + 1 <= endIndex)
			{
				node.RightChild = new KDTreeNode2D
				{
					Unfinished = true
				};
				node.RightChild.DescendantCount = endIndex - (num2 + 1) + 1;
				_progressiveThunks.Push(new KDTreeThunk
				{
					StartIndex = num2 + 1,
					EndIndex = endIndex,
					Level = level + 1,
					MaxLeafSize = maxLeafSize,
					Node = node.RightChild
				});
			}
			else
			{
				node.RightChild = null;
			}
		}

		private KDTreeNode2D KDTreeHelper(KDPointData[] points, int startIndex, int endIndex, int level, int maxLeafSize)
		{
			KDTreeNode2D kDTreeNode2D = new KDTreeNode2D();
			kDTreeNode2D.IsX = level % 2 == 0;
			kDTreeNode2D.DescendantCount = endIndex - startIndex;
			if (startIndex == endIndex)
			{
				kDTreeNode2D.Median = points[startIndex];
				return kDTreeNode2D;
			}
			if (startIndex > endIndex)
			{
				return null;
			}
			if (endIndex - startIndex + 1 <= maxLeafSize)
			{
				kDTreeNode2D.Median = points[startIndex];
				kDTreeNode2D.OtherPoints = new KDPointData[endIndex - startIndex + 1];
				int num = 0;
				for (int i = startIndex; i <= endIndex; i++)
				{
					kDTreeNode2D.OtherPoints[num++] = points[i];
				}
				return kDTreeNode2D;
			}
			int k = Math.Max((endIndex - startIndex) / 2, 1);
			int num2 = Select(points, startIndex, endIndex, kDTreeNode2D.IsX, k);
			kDTreeNode2D.Median = points[num2];
			kDTreeNode2D.LeftChild = KDTreeHelper(points, startIndex, num2 - 1, level + 1, maxLeafSize);
			kDTreeNode2D.RightChild = KDTreeHelper(points, num2 + 1, endIndex, level + 1, maxLeafSize);
			return kDTreeNode2D;
		}

		private int Partition(KDPointData[] points, bool isX, int startIndex, int endIndex, int pivotIndex)
		{
			double num = (isX ? points[pivotIndex].X : points[pivotIndex].Y);
			KDPointData kDPointData = points[pivotIndex];
			points[pivotIndex] = points[endIndex];
			points[endIndex] = kDPointData;
			int num2 = startIndex;
			for (int i = startIndex; i < endIndex; i++)
			{
				double num3 = ((!isX) ? points[i].Y : points[i].X);
				if (num3 <= num)
				{
					kDPointData = points[num2];
					points[num2] = points[i];
					points[i] = kDPointData;
					num2++;
				}
			}
			kDPointData = points[endIndex];
			points[endIndex] = points[num2];
			points[num2] = kDPointData;
			return num2;
		}

		private int Select(KDPointData[] points, int startIndex, int endIndex, bool isX, int k)
		{
			if (startIndex == endIndex)
			{
				return startIndex;
			}
			int pivotIndex = _rand.Next(startIndex, endIndex);
			int num = Partition(points, isX, startIndex, endIndex, pivotIndex);
			int num2 = num - startIndex + 1;
			if (num2 == k)
			{
				return num;
			}
			if (k < num2)
			{
				return Select(points, startIndex, num - 1, isX, k);
			}
			return Select(points, num + 1, endIndex, isX, k - num2);
		}

		public void KNearest(KNearestResults results, double xValue, double yValue, int k)
		{
			lock (_lock)
			{
				KNearestHelper(results, xValue, yValue, k, Root);
			}
		}

		private void KNearestHelper(KNearestResults results, double xValue, double yValue, int k, KDTreeNode2D current)
		{
			if (current == null || current.Unfinished)
			{
				return;
			}
			if (current.LeftChild == null && current.RightChild == null)
			{
				AddNearest(results, xValue, yValue, current, current.Median, isMedian: true, 0, k);
				if (results.BreakOut || current.OtherPoints == null || current.OtherPoints.Length == 0)
				{
					return;
				}
				for (int i = 0; i < current.OtherPoints.Length; i++)
				{
					AddNearest(results, xValue, yValue, current, current.OtherPoints[i], isMedian: false, i, k);
					if (results.BreakOut)
					{
						break;
					}
				}
				return;
			}
			AddNearest(results, xValue, yValue, current, current.Median, isMedian: true, 0, k);
			if (results.BreakOut)
			{
				return;
			}
			if (current.IsX)
			{
				if (xValue <= current.Median.X)
				{
					KNearestHelper(results, xValue, yValue, k, current.LeftChild);
					if (!results.BreakOut)
					{
						if (Dist(xValue, yValue, current.Median.X, yValue) < results.CurrentFurthestDist)
						{
							KNearestHelper(results, xValue, yValue, k, current.RightChild);
						}
						_ = results.BreakOut;
					}
					return;
				}
				KNearestHelper(results, xValue, yValue, k, current.RightChild);
				if (!results.BreakOut)
				{
					if (Dist(xValue, yValue, current.Median.X, yValue) < results.CurrentFurthestDist)
					{
						KNearestHelper(results, xValue, yValue, k, current.LeftChild);
					}
					_ = results.BreakOut;
				}
				return;
			}
			if (yValue <= current.Median.Y)
			{
				KNearestHelper(results, xValue, yValue, k, current.LeftChild);
				if (!results.BreakOut)
				{
					if (Dist(xValue, yValue, xValue, current.Median.Y) < results.CurrentFurthestDist)
					{
						KNearestHelper(results, xValue, yValue, k, current.RightChild);
					}
					_ = results.BreakOut;
				}
				return;
			}
			KNearestHelper(results, xValue, yValue, k, current.RightChild);
			if (!results.BreakOut)
			{
				if (Dist(xValue, yValue, xValue, current.Median.Y) < results.CurrentFurthestDist)
				{
					KNearestHelper(results, xValue, yValue, k, current.LeftChild);
				}
				_ = results.BreakOut;
			}
		}

		private void AddNearest(KNearestResults results, double xValue, double yValue, KDTreeNode2D current, KDPointData pointData, bool isMedian, int index, int k)
		{
			if (results.BreakOut)
			{
				return;
			}
			if (results.ConsideredCount > results.ConsideredCutoff)
			{
				results.BreakOut = true;
				return;
			}
			if (results.Results.Count < k)
			{
				if (double.IsNaN(results.CurrentNearestDist))
				{
					results.CurrentNearestDist = Dist(xValue, yValue, pointData.X, pointData.Y);
					results.CurrentFurthestDist = results.CurrentNearestDist;
					results.CurrentFurthestIndex = 0;
				}
				results.Results.Add(new KNearestResult
				{
					IsMedian = isMedian,
					Index = index,
					Node = current,
					X = pointData.X,
					Y = pointData.Y
				});
				results.ConsideredCount++;
				double num = Dist(xValue, yValue, pointData.X, pointData.Y);
				if (num < results.CurrentNearestDist)
				{
					results.CurrentNearestDist = num;
				}
				if (num > results.CurrentFurthestDist)
				{
					results.CurrentFurthestDist = num;
					results.CurrentFurthestIndex = results.Results.Count - 1;
				}
				return;
			}
			int num2 = 0;
			if (!((double)num2 < results.CurrentFurthestDist))
			{
				return;
			}
			if ((double)num2 < results.CurrentNearestDist)
			{
				results.CurrentNearestDist = num2;
			}
			results.Results[results.CurrentFurthestIndex] = new KNearestResult
			{
				IsMedian = isMedian,
				Index = index,
				Node = current,
				X = pointData.X,
				Y = pointData.Y
			};
			double num3 = 0.0;
			for (int i = 0; i < results.Results.Count; i++)
			{
				double num4 = Dist(xValue, yValue, results.Results[i].X, results.Results[i].Y);
				if (num4 > num3)
				{
					num3 = num4;
				}
			}
			results.ConsideredCount++;
		}

		private double Dist(double xValue, double yValue, double xValue2, double yValue2)
		{
			return (xValue - xValue2) * (xValue - xValue2) + (yValue - yValue2) * (yValue - yValue2);
		}

		public void GetVisible(IList<KDTreeNode2D> nodes, SearchArgs args, double xMinimum, double xMaximum, double yMinimum, double yMaximum)
		{
			lock (_lock)
			{
				GetVisibleHelper(nodes, Root, args, xMinimum, xMaximum, yMinimum, yMaximum, report: false, 0);
			}
		}

		private void GetVisibleHelper(IList<KDTreeNode2D> nodes, KDTreeNode2D currentNode, SearchArgs args, double currentXMinimum, double currentXMaximum, double currentYMinimum, double currentYMaximum, bool report, int depth)
		{
			if (currentNode == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			SearchData searchData = currentNode.SearchData;
			if (depth > args.MaxRenderDepth || (currentYMaximum - currentYMinimum < args.PixelSizeY && currentXMaximum - currentXMinimum < args.PixelSizeX))
			{
				if (currentNode.SearchData == null)
				{
					currentNode.SearchData = new SearchData();
				}
				searchData = currentNode.SearchData;
				searchData.IsCutoff = true;
				searchData.MinX = currentXMinimum;
				searchData.MaxX = currentXMaximum;
				searchData.MinY = currentYMinimum;
				searchData.MaxY = currentYMaximum;
				nodes.Add(currentNode);
				return;
			}
			if (searchData != null)
			{
				searchData.IsCutoff = false;
			}
			if (currentNode.LeftChild == null && currentNode.RightChild == null)
			{
				nodes.Add(currentNode);
				return;
			}
			double num;
			double num2;
			double num3;
			double num4;
			double num5;
			double num6;
			double num7;
			double num8;
			if (currentNode.IsX)
			{
				num = currentXMinimum;
				num2 = currentNode.Median.X;
				num3 = currentYMinimum;
				num4 = currentYMaximum;
				num5 = currentNode.Median.X;
				num6 = currentXMaximum;
				num7 = currentYMinimum;
				num8 = currentYMaximum;
			}
			else
			{
				num = currentXMinimum;
				num2 = currentXMaximum;
				num3 = currentYMinimum;
				num4 = currentNode.Median.Y;
				num5 = currentXMinimum;
				num6 = currentXMaximum;
				num7 = currentNode.Median.Y;
				num8 = currentYMaximum;
			}
			if (report)
			{
				nodes.Add(currentNode);
				GetVisibleHelper(nodes, currentNode.LeftChild, args, num, num2, num3, num4, report: true, depth + 1);
				GetVisibleHelper(nodes, currentNode.RightChild, args, num5, num6, num7, num8, report: true, depth + 1);
				return;
			}
			bool flag = false;
			if (num >= args.MinX && num2 <= args.MaxX && num3 >= args.MinY && num4 <= args.MaxY)
			{
				flag = true;
				nodes.Add(currentNode);
				GetVisibleHelper(nodes, currentNode.LeftChild, args, num, num2, num3, num4, report: true, depth + 1);
			}
			else if (!(args.MinX > num2) && !(args.MaxX < num) && !(args.MinY > num4) && !(args.MaxY < num3))
			{
				flag = true;
				nodes.Add(currentNode);
				GetVisibleHelper(nodes, currentNode.LeftChild, args, num, num2, num3, num4, report: false, depth + 1);
			}
			if (num5 >= args.MinX && num6 <= args.MaxX && num7 >= args.MinY && num8 <= args.MaxY)
			{
				if (!flag)
				{
					nodes.Add(currentNode);
				}
				GetVisibleHelper(nodes, currentNode.RightChild, args, num5, num6, num7, num8, report: true, depth + 1);
			}
			else if (!(args.MinX > num6) && !(args.MaxX < num5) && !(args.MinY > num8) && !(args.MaxY < num7))
			{
				if (!flag)
				{
					nodes.Add(currentNode);
				}
				GetVisibleHelper(nodes, currentNode.RightChild, args, num5, num6, num7, num8, report: false, depth + 1);
			}
		}

		internal void Validate()
		{
			ValidateHelper(Root);
		}

		private int ValidateHelper(KDTreeNode2D Root)
		{
			if (Root == null)
			{
				return 0;
			}
			_ = ValidateHelper(Root.LeftChild) + ValidateHelper(Root.RightChild);
			_ = Root.DescendantCount;
			return Root.DescendantCount + 1;
		}
	}

	[TSImportModule("igniteui-charts/XamDataChart", "XamDataChart")]
	[EditorBrowsable(EditorBrowsableState.Never)]
	public class SeriesViewerSurfaceViewer : DependencyObject, IOverviewPlusDetailControl, INotifyPropertyChanged
	{
		[Weak]
		private SeriesViewer _model;

		private bool _isDirty = true;

		private const string ZoomLevelPropertyName = "ZoomLevel";

		public static readonly DependencyProperty ZoomLevelProperty = DependencyProperty.Register("ZoomLevel", typeof(double), typeof(SeriesViewerSurfaceViewer), new PropertyMetadata(0.0, delegate(DependencyObject sender, DependencyPropertyChangedEventArgs e)
		{
			((SeriesViewerSurfaceViewer)sender).OnPropertyChanged("ZoomLevel", e.OldValue, e.NewValue);
		}));

		private const string ZoomLevelDisplayTextPropertyName = "ZoomLevelDisplayText";

		private string _zoomLevelDisplayText;

		private InteractionState _defaultInteraction;

		[Weak]
		private SeriesViewerView View { get; set; }

		private bool SuspendWindowRectChanges { get; set; }

		[Weak]
		private SeriesViewer Model
		{
			get
			{
				return _model;
			}
			set
			{
				if (_model != null)
				{
					INotifyPropertyChanged model = _model;
					if (model != null)
					{
						model.PropertyChanged -= Model_PropertyChanged;
					}
				}
				_model = value;
				if (_model != null)
				{
					INotifyPropertyChanged model2 = _model;
					if (model2 != null)
					{
						model2.PropertyChanged += Model_PropertyChanged;
					}
				}
			}
		}

		private Canvas PreviewCanvas { get; set; }

		public Rect WorldRect => SeriesViewer.StandardRect;

		public Rect ViewportRect => Model.ViewportRect;

		public double MinimumZoomLevel => 0.0;

		public double MaximumZoomLevel
		{
			get
			{
				if (Model.WindowRectMinWidth == 0.0001)
				{
					return 0.9;
				}
				return 1.0 - Model.WindowRectMinWidth;
			}
		}

		public bool IsDirty
		{
			get
			{
				return _isDirty;
			}
			set
			{
				_isDirty = value;
			}
		}

		public bool IsIsoScaled
		{
			get
			{
				if (_model == null)
				{
					return false;
				}
				return _model.IsIsoScaled;
			}
		}

		[DontObfuscate]
		public double ZoomLevel
		{
			get
			{
				return (double)GetValue(ZoomLevelProperty);
			}
			set
			{
				SetValue(ZoomLevelProperty, value);
			}
		}

		public string ZoomLevelDisplayText
		{
			get
			{
				return _zoomLevelDisplayText;
			}
			set
			{
				if (ZoomLevelDisplayText != value)
				{
					object zoomLevelDisplayText = ZoomLevelDisplayText;
					_zoomLevelDisplayText = value;
					OnPropertyChanged("ZoomLevelDisplayText", zoomLevelDisplayText, value);
				}
			}
		}

		public InteractionState DefaultInteraction
		{
			get
			{
				return _defaultInteraction;
			}
			set
