				Model.DefaultInteraction = value;
			}
		}

		public event PropertyChangedEventHandler PropertyChanged;

		public SeriesViewerSurfaceViewer(SeriesViewer model, SeriesViewerView view)
		{
			if (model == null || view == null)
			{
				throw new ArgumentNullException("model");
			}
			Model = model;
			Model.WindowRectChanged += Model_WindowRectChanged;
			View = view;
			PreviewCanvas = new Canvas();
			UpdateZoomLevelDisplayText();
		}

		private void Model_WindowRectChanged(object sender, RectChangedEventArgs e)
		{
			bool suspendWindowRectChanges = SuspendWindowRectChanges;
			SuspendWindowRectChanges = true;
			ZoomLevel = 1.0 - Math.Min(e.NewRect.Height, e.NewRect.Width);
			SuspendWindowRectChanges = suspendWindowRectChanges;
		}

		private void Model_PropertyChanged(object sender, PropertyChangedEventArgs e)
		{
			if (e.PropertyName == "DefaultInteraction")
			{
				_defaultInteraction = Model.DefaultInteraction;
				OnPropertyChanged(e.PropertyName, DefaultInteraction, DefaultInteraction);
			}
		}

		public void ZoomTo100()
		{
			Model.WindowRect = SeriesViewer.StandardRect;
		}

		public void ScaleToFit()
		{
			Model.WindowRect = SeriesViewer.StandardRect;
		}

		public void RenderPreview()
		{
			if (!IsDirty)
			{
				return;
			}
			XamOverviewPlusDetailPane overviewPlusDetailPane = View.OverviewPlusDetailPane;
			if (overviewPlusDetailPane == null || overviewPlusDetailPane.Visibility != Visibility.Visible || overviewPlusDetailPane.Viewport.IsEmpty || overviewPlusDetailPane.Window.IsNull())
			{
				return;
			}
			Rect previewViewportdRect = overviewPlusDetailPane.PreviewViewportdRect;
			double width = previewViewportdRect.Width;
			double height = previewViewportdRect.Height;
			RenderSurface renderSurface = new RenderSurface();
			renderSurface.Surface = PreviewCanvas;
			renderSurface.Surface.Clip = new RectangleGeometry
			{
				Rect = previewViewportdRect
			};
			renderSurface.Contained.Clear();
			if (!overviewPlusDetailPane.PreviewCanvas.Children.Contains(renderSurface.Surface))
			{
				overviewPlusDetailPane.PreviewCanvas.Children.Add(renderSurface.Surface);
			}
			View.GetThumbnail(width, height, renderSurface);
			for (int i = 0; i < PreviewCanvas.Children.Count; i++)
			{
				if (!renderSurface.Contained.ContainsKey(PreviewCanvas.Children[i]))
				{
					PreviewCanvas.Children.RemoveAt(i);
					i--;
				}
			}
			IsDirty = false;
		}

		private void OnPropertyChanged(string propertyName, object oldValue, object newValue)
		{
			if (this.PropertyChanged != null)
			{
				this.PropertyChanged(this, new PropertyChangedEventArgs(propertyName));
			}
			if (!(propertyName == "ZoomLevel"))
			{
				return;
			}
			if ((double)newValue - MinimumZoomLevel < -1E-05)
			{
				ZoomLevel = MinimumZoomLevel;
				return;
			}
			if ((double)newValue - MaximumZoomLevel > 0.0001)
			{
				ZoomLevel = MaximumZoomLevel;
				return;
			}
			bool flag = Model != null && Model.OverviewPlusDetailPane != null && Model.OverviewPlusDetailPane.UpdatingSliderRanges;
			if (!SuspendWindowRectChanges && !flag)
			{
				double num = 1.0 - ZoomLevel;
				Point center = Model.ActualWindowRect.GetCenter();
				Rect newRect = new Rect(center.X - num / 2.0, center.Y - num / 2.0, num, num);
				Model.WindowRect = ChangeRect(Model.WindowRect, newRect, Model.IsZoomingHorizontallyEnabled(), Model.IsZoomingVerticallyEnabled(), WorldRect);
			}
			UpdateZoomLevelDisplayText();
		}

		private void UpdateZoomLevelDisplayText()
		{
			double num = Math.Round(100.0 * (1.0 / (1.0 - ZoomLevel)));
			if (num <= 1000.0)
			{
				ZoomLevelDisplayText = num.ToString();
			}
			else
			{
				ZoomLevelDisplayText = "> 1000";
			}
		}

		internal static Rect ChangeRect(Rect oldRect, Rect newRect, bool horizontalZoomable, bool verticalZoomable, Rect worldRect)
		{
			double width;
			double left;
			if (horizontalZoomable)
			{
				left = newRect.Left;
				width = newRect.Width;
			}
			else
			{
				left = oldRect.Left;
				width = oldRect.Width;
			}
			double height;
			double top;
			if (verticalZoomable)
			{
				top = newRect.Top;
				height = newRect.Height;
			}
			else
			{
				top = oldRect.Top;
				height = oldRect.Height;
			}
			double num = left + width;
			double num2 = top + height;
			double num3 = Math.Max(0.0, worldRect.Left - left);
			double num4 = Math.Max(0.0, num - worldRect.Right);
			double num5 = Math.Max(0.0, worldRect.Top - top);
			double num6 = Math.Max(0.0, num2 - worldRect.Bottom);
			left += num3 - num4;
			top += num5 - num6;
			Rect result = new Rect(left, top, width, height);
			result.Intersect(worldRect);
			return result;
		}
	}
	internal class FinancialPriceSeriesView : FinancialSeriesView

		{

				FillRule = FillRule.Nonzero
			}
		};

		private ITrendLineManager _trendLineManager;

		protected FinancialPriceSeries FinancialPriceModel { get; set; }

		protected Canvas ShapeCanvas { get; set; }

		protected internal Pool<Path> Shapes { get; set; }

		protected List<Path> VisibleShapes { get; set; }

		internal ITrendLineManager TrendLineManager
		{
			get

					_trendLineManager = CategoryTrendLineManagerFactory.SelectManager(_trendLineManager, Model.GetCategoryAxisIfPresent(), Model.RootCanvas, Model, Model.Res);
				}
				return _trendLineManager;
			}
			set

				_trendLineManager = value;
			}
		}

		internal bool HasTrendLineManager => _trendLineManager != null;

		public FinancialPriceSeriesView(FinancialPriceSeries model)
			: base(model)
		{
			FinancialPriceModel = model;
			TrendLineManager = new CategoryTrendLineManager();
			ShapeCanvas = new Canvas();
			Shapes = new Pool<Path>
			{
				Create = ShapeCreate,
				Activate = ShapeActivate,
				Disactivate = ShapeDisactivate,
				Destroy = ShapeDestroy
			};

		internal Path ShapeCreate()
		{
			Path path = new Path();
			ShapeCanvas.Children.Add(path);
			path.Visibility = Visibility.Collapsed;
			return path;
		}

		internal void ShapeActivate(Path shape)
		{
			shape.Visibility = Visibility.Visible;
		}

		internal void ShapeDisactivate(Path shape)
		{
			shape.Visibility = Visibility.Collapsed;
		}

		internal void ShapeDestroy(Path shape)
		{
			ShapeCanvas.Children.Remove(shape);
		}

		protected override FinancialBucketCalculator CreateBucketCalculator()
		{
			return new FinancialPriceBucketCalculator(this);
		}

		public override void AttachUI(Canvas rootCanvas)
		{
			base.AttachUI(rootCanvas);
			TrendLineManager.AttachPolyLine(rootCanvas, Model);
			positivePath.Detach();
			negativePath.Detach();
			ShapeCanvas.Detach();
			rootCanvas.Children.Add(positivePath);
			positivePath.SetBinding(Shape.FillProperty, new Binding("ActualBrush")
			{
				Source = Model
			});
			positivePath.SetBinding(Shape.StrokeProperty, new Binding((FinancialPriceModel.DisplayType == PriceDisplayType.OHLC) ? "ActualBrush" : "ActualOutline")
			{
				Source = Model
			});
			positivePath.SetBinding(Shape.StrokeThicknessProperty, new Binding("ActualThickness")
			{
				Source = Model
			});
			positivePath.SetBinding(Shape.StrokeDashCapProperty, new Binding("DashCap")
			{
				Source = Model
			});
			positivePath.SetBinding(Shape.StrokeDashArrayProperty, new Binding("DashArray")
			{
				Source = Model,
				Converter = new DoubleCollectionDuplicator()
			});
			if (FinancialPriceModel.DisplayType != PriceDisplayType.OHLC)
			{
				VisualInformationManager.SetIsOutlineVisual(positivePath, value: true);
			}
			positivePath.SetBinding(Shape.StrokeLineJoinProperty, new Binding("LineJoin")
			{
				Source = Model
			});
			positivePath.SetBinding(Shape.StrokeMiterLimitProperty, new Binding("MiterLimit")
			{
				Source = Model
			});
			VisualInformationManager.SetIsMultiColorLineVisual(positivePath, value: true);
			rootCanvas.Children.Add(negativePath);
			negativePath.SetBinding(Shape.FillProperty, new Binding("NegativeBrush")
			{
				Source = Model
			});
			negativePath.SetBinding(Shape.StrokeProperty, new Binding((FinancialPriceModel.DisplayType == PriceDisplayType.OHLC) ? "NegativeBrush" : "NegativeOutline")
			{
				Source = Model
			});
			negativePath.SetBinding(Shape.StrokeThicknessProperty, new Binding("ActualThickness")
			{
				Source = Model
			});
			negativePath.SetBinding(Shape.StrokeDashCapProperty, new Binding("DashCap")
			{
				Source = Model
			});
			negativePath.SetBinding(Shape.StrokeDashArrayProperty, new Binding("DashArray")
			{
				Source = Model,
				Converter = new DoubleCollectionDuplicator()
			});
			if (FinancialPriceModel.DisplayType == PriceDisplayType.OHLC)
			{
				VisualInformationManager.SetIsNegativeVisual(negativePath, value: true);
			}
			else
			{
				VisualInformationManager.SetIsOutlineVisual(negativePath, value: true);
			}
			negativePath.SetBinding(Shape.StrokeLineJoinProperty, new Binding("LineJoin")
			{
				Source = Model
			});
			negativePath.SetBinding(Shape.StrokeMiterLimitProperty, new Binding("MiterLimit")
			{
				Source = Model
			});
			VisualInformationManager.SetIsMultiColorLineVisual(negativePath, value: true);
			rootCanvas.Children.Add(ShapeCanvas);
			if (!base.IsThumbnailView)
			{
				Model.RenderSeries(animate: false);
			}
		}

		internal void UpdatePathBrushes()
		{
			positivePath.SetBinding(Shape.StrokeProperty, new Binding((FinancialPriceModel.DisplayType == PriceDisplayType.OHLC) ? "ActualBrush" : "ActualOutline")
			{
				Source = Model
			});
			negativePath.SetBinding(Shape.StrokeProperty, new Binding((FinancialPriceModel.DisplayType == PriceDisplayType.OHLC) ? "NegativeBrush" : "ActualOutline")
			{
				Source = Model
			});
		}

		internal void ClearPriceSymbols()
		{
			Shapes.Count = 0;
			ClearGroupedPriceSymbols();
		}

		internal void ClearGroupedPriceSymbols()
		{
			PathGeometry geom = positivePath.Data as PathGeometry;
			PathGeometry geom2 = negativePath.Data as PathGeometry;
			geom.Reset();
			geom2.Reset();
		}

		internal PathGeometry GetPositiveGroup()
		{
			return positivePath.Data as PathGeometry;
		}

		internal PathGeometry GetNegativeGroup()
		{
			return negativePath.Data as PathGeometry;
		}

		internal void UpdateTrendlineBrush()
		{
			FinancialPriceModel.ClearValue(FinancialPriceSeries.ActualTrendLineBrushProperty);
			if (FinancialPriceModel.TrendLineBrush != null)
			{
				FinancialPriceModel.SetBinding(FinancialPriceSeries.ActualTrendLineBrushProperty, new Binding("TrendLineBrush")
				{
					Source = Model
				});
			}
			else
			{
				FinancialPriceModel.SetBinding(FinancialPriceSeries.ActualTrendLineBrushProperty, new Binding("ActualBrush")
				{
					Source = Model
				});
			}
		}

		internal void FrameRendered()
		{
		}

		public void SelectTrendlineManager()
		{
			TrendLineManager = CategoryTrendLineManagerFactory.SelectManager(TrendLineManager, base.FinancialModel.XAxis, base.RootCanvas, base.FinancialModel, Model.Res);
		}

		protected internal override void ExportViewShapes(object svd)
		{
			base.ExportViewShapes(svd);
			if (FinancialPriceModel.ShouldOverrideCategoryStyle())
			{
				for (int i = 0; i < ShapeCanvas.Children.Count; i++)
				{
					Path path = (Path)ShapeCanvas.Children[i];
					if (path.Visibility != Visibility.Collapsed)
					{
						if (path.Fill == FinancialPriceModel.NegativeBrush)
						{
							Model.SeriesVisualDataManager.ExportPathData(svd, path, "negativePathShape" + i, new string[1] { "Negative" });
						}
						else
						{
							Model.SeriesVisualDataManager.ExportPathData(svd, path, "positivePathShape" + i, new string[2] { "Positive", "Main" });
						}
					}
				}
			}
			else
			{
				Model.SeriesVisualDataManager.ExportPathData(svd, positivePath, "positivePathShape", new string[2] { "Positive", "Main" });
				Model.SeriesVisualDataManager.ExportPathData(svd, negativePath, "negativePathShape", new string[1] { "Negative" });
			}
		}
	}

	internal abstract class MarkerSeriesView : SeriesView
	{
		private bool _lightweightMode;

		private DataTemplate _widthTemplate;

		private Size _lastFullSize = new Size(0.0, 0.0);

		protected MarkerSeries MarkerModel { get; set; }

		protected MarkerSeries MarkerPropertiesSource => (MarkerSeries)Model.GetSeriesComponentsForView().Series;

		protected internal bool MarkerAppearanceHandled { get; set; }

		public MarkerSeriesView(MarkerSeries model)
			: base(model)
		{
			MarkerModel = model;
		}

		public Size GetFullMarkerSize()
		{
			if (MarkerModel.ActualMarkerTemplate != null)
			{
				if (_widthTemplate != MarkerModel.ActualMarkerTemplate)
				{
					_widthTemplate = MarkerModel.ActualMarkerTemplate;
					if (_widthTemplate.LoadContent() is FrameworkElement frameworkElement)
					{
						frameworkElement.Measure(new Size(double.PositiveInfinity, double.PositiveInfinity));
						_lastFullSize = frameworkElement.DesiredSize;
						return frameworkElement.DesiredSize;
					}
				}
				return _lastFullSize;
			}
			return new Size(0.0, 0.0);
		}

		protected internal Marker MarkerCreate()
		{
			Marker marker = new Marker();
			if (!_lightweightMode)
			{
				marker.Content = new DataContext
				{
					Series = MarkerPropertiesSource
				};
				SetMarkerStyle(marker);
			}
			marker.ContentTemplate = MarkerPropertiesSource.ActualMarkerTemplate;
			if (MarkerModel != null && (MarkerModel.MarkerStyle != null || (MarkerModel.SeriesViewer != null && MarkerModel.SeriesViewer.KnownMarkerTemplates != null && !MarkerModel.SeriesViewer.KnownMarkerTemplates.Contains(marker.ContentTemplate))))
			{
				marker.SizeChanged += HandleMarkerSizeChanged;
			}
			return marker;
		}

		protected internal abstract void DoToAllMarkers(Action<Marker> action);

		protected void UpdateMarkerTemplates()
		{
			DoToAllMarkers(delegate(Marker m)
			{
				m.ContentTemplate = MarkerPropertiesSource.ActualMarkerTemplate;
			});
			if (base.MarkerCanvas != null && MarkerPropertiesSource.ActualMarkerTemplate != MarkerSeries.NullMarkerTemplate)
			{
				base.MarkerCanvas.UpdateLayout();
			}
		}

		protected virtual void SetMarkerStyle(Marker marker)
		{
			marker.SetBinding(FrameworkElement.StyleProperty, new Binding("MarkerStyle")
			{
				Source = MarkerPropertiesSource
			});
		}

		protected internal void MarkerActivate(Marker marker)
		{
			marker.Visibility = Visibility.Visible;
			if (marker.Parent == null)
			{
				base.MarkerCanvas.Children.Add(marker);
			}
		}

		protected internal void MarkerDisactivate(Marker marker)
		{
			if (marker.Content != null)
			{
				(marker.Content as DataContext).Item = null;
			}
			marker.Visibility = Visibility.Collapsed;
		}

		private int NumVisible()
		{
			return (from c in base.MarkerCanvas.Children.OfType<UIElement>()
				where c.Visibility == Visibility.Visible
				select c).Count();
		}

		protected internal void MarkerDestroy(Marker marker)
		{
			marker.Content = null;
			marker.ClearValue(ContentControl.ContentTemplateProperty);
			base.MarkerCanvas.Children.Remove(marker);
			marker.SizeChanged -= HandleMarkerSizeChanged;
		}

		internal void DoUpdateMarkerTemplates()
		{
			UpdateMarkerTemplates();
		}

		internal void SetUseLightweightMode(bool useLightweight)
		{
			_lightweightMode = useLightweight;
		}

		internal bool HasCustomMarkerTemplate()
		{
			return MarkerModel.MarkerTemplate != null;
		}

		internal void ClearActualMarkerTemplate()
		{
			Model.ClearValue(MarkerSeries.ActualMarkerTemplateProperty);
		}

		internal void BindActualToCustomMarkerTemplate()
		{
			Model.SetBinding(MarkerSeries.ActualMarkerTemplateProperty, new Binding("MarkerTemplate")
			{
				Source = Model
			});
		}

		internal void BindActualToMarkerTemplate(string p)
		{
			Model.SetBinding(MarkerSeries.ActualMarkerTemplateProperty, new Binding(p)
			{
				Source = Model.SeriesViewer
			});
		}

		internal void ClearActualMarkerBrush()
		{
			Model.ClearValue(MarkerSeries.ActualMarkerBrushProperty);
		}

		internal void BindActualToMarkerBrush()
		{
			if (!double.IsNaN(Model.ActualMarkerFillOpacity) && Model.ActualMarkerFillOpacity != 1.0)
			{
				Brush brush = MarkerModel.MarkerBrush.ModifyOpacity(Model.ActualMarkerFillOpacity);
				if (Model.ShouldFreezeBrushesCached && brush.CanFreeze)
				{
					brush.Freeze();
				}
				MarkerModel.ActualMarkerBrush = brush;
				return;
			}
			Binding binding = new Binding("MarkerBrush")
			{
				Source = Model
			};
			if (Model.ShouldFreezeBrushesCached)
			{
				binding.Converter = new FreezeConverter();
			}
			Model.SetBinding(MarkerSeries.ActualMarkerBrushProperty, binding);
		}

		internal void ClearActualMarkerOutline()
		{
			Model.ClearValue(MarkerSeries.ActualMarkerOutlineProperty);
		}

		internal void BindActualToMarkerOutline()
		{
			Binding binding = new Binding("MarkerOutline")
			{
				Source = Model
			};
			if (Model.ShouldFreezeBrushesCached)
			{
				binding.Converter = new FreezeConverter();
			}
			Model.SetBinding(MarkerSeries.ActualMarkerOutlineProperty, binding);
		}

		internal void RenderMarkers()
		{
		}

		internal void InitMarkers(HashPool<object, Marker> Markers)
		{
			Markers.Create = MarkerCreate;
			Markers.Destroy = MarkerDestroy;
			Markers.Activate = MarkerActivate;
			Markers.Disactivate = MarkerDisactivate;
		}

		internal void InitMarkers(Pool<Marker> Markers)
		{
			Markers.Create = MarkerCreate;
			Markers.Destroy = MarkerDestroy;
			Markers.Activate = MarkerActivate;
			Markers.Disactivate = MarkerDisactivate;
		}

		public Marker GetHitMarker(Point point)
		{
			Marker hitMarkerWithBuffer = GetHitMarkerWithBuffer(point, 0.0);
			if (hitMarkerWithBuffer == null)
			{
				hitMarkerWithBuffer = GetHitMarkerWithBuffer(point, 3.0);
			}
			return hitMarkerWithBuffer;
		}

		private Marker GetHitMarkerWithBuffer(Point point, double buffer)
		{
			UIElementCollection children = base.MarkerCanvas.Children;
			bool flag = false;
			flag = MarkerModel.UseLightweightMarkers;
			for (int num = children.Count - 1; num >= 0; num--)
			{
				UIElement uIElement = children[num];
				if (uIElement.Visibility != Visibility.Collapsed && uIElement.Opacity != 0.0)
				{
					double num2 = ((FrameworkElement)uIElement).ActualWidth + buffer;
					double num3 = ((FrameworkElement)uIElement).ActualHeight + buffer;
					double num4 = ((FrameworkElement)uIElement).ActualWidth / 2.0 + buffer;
					double num5 = ((FrameworkElement)uIElement).ActualHeight / 2.0 + buffer;
					double num6 = 0.0;
					double num7 = 0.0;
					num6 = ((Marker)uIElement).PositionX;
					num7 = ((Marker)uIElement).PositionY;
					if (flag)
					{
						if (num6 - num4 <= point.X && num6 + num4 >= point.X && num7 - num5 <= point.Y && num7 + num5 >= point.Y)
						{
							return (Marker)uIElement;
						}
					}
					else if (num6 <= point.X && num6 + num2 >= point.X && num7 <= point.Y && num7 + num3 >= point.Y)
					{
						return (Marker)uIElement;
					}
				}
			}
			return null;
		}

		internal Rect GetBoundingBoxForMarker(Marker marker)
		{
			double actualWidth = marker.ActualWidth;
			double actualHeight = marker.ActualHeight;
			double num = 0.0;
			double num2 = 0.0;
			if (marker.RenderTransform != null)
			{
				if (marker.RenderTransform is MatrixTransform)
				{
					Point point = ((MatrixTransform)marker.RenderTransform).Transform(new Point(0.0, 0.0));
					num = point.X + marker.DesiredSize.Width / 2.0;
					num2 = point.Y + marker.DesiredSize.Height / 2.0;
				}
				else
				{
					TranslateTransform obj = (TranslateTransform)marker.RenderTransform;
					num = obj.X + marker.DesiredSize.Width / 2.0;
					num2 = obj.Y + marker.DesiredSize.Height / 2.0;
				}
			}
			if (MarkerModel.UseLightweightMarkers)
			{
				return new Rect(num - actualWidth / 2.0, num2 - actualWidth / 2.0, actualWidth, actualHeight);
			}
			return new Rect(num, num2, actualWidth, actualHeight);
		}

		private void HandleMarkerSizeChanged(object sender, SizeChangedEventArgs e)
		{
			DispatcherUtil.QueueSingleInvoke(delegate
			{
				if (MarkerModel != null)
				{
					MarkerModel.RenderSeries(animate: false);
				}
			});
		}
	}

				Model.MouseLeave += OnMouseLeave;
				Model.MouseMove += OnMouseMove;
				Model.MouseLeftButtonDown += OnMouseLeftButtonDown;
				Model.MouseLeftButtonUp += OnMouseLeftButtonUp;
				Model.LostMouseCapture += OnLostMouseCapture;
				Model.MouseRightButtonDown += OnMouseRightButtonDown;
				Model.MouseRightButtonUp += OnMouseRightButtonUp;
				Model.PreviewTouchDown += Model_TouchDown;

		private void Series_Unloaded(object sender, RoutedEventArgs e)
		{
			if ((Model.SeriesViewer == null || !Model.SeriesViewer.ShouldKeepResourcesOnUnload) && !Utilities.HasLoadedAncestor<FlowDocumentReader>(Model.SeriesViewer))
			{
				Model.OnSeriesDetached();

		public virtual void AttachUI(Canvas rootCanvas)
		{
			Canvas rootCanvas2 = RootCanvas;
			RootCanvas = rootCanvas;
			RootCanvas.SizeChanged += RootCanvas_SizeChanged;
			if (rootCanvas2 != null)
			{
				rootCanvas2.SizeChanged -= RootCanvas_SizeChanged;
				rootCanvas2.TransferChildrenTo(RootCanvas);
			}
			if (MarkerCanvas == null)
			{
				MarkerCanvas = new Canvas();
			}
			if (!RootCanvas.Children.Contains(MarkerCanvas) && !Model.UseParentMarkerCanvas() && MarkerCanvas.Parent == null)
			{
				RootCanvas.Children.Add(MarkerCanvas);
			}
			Panel.SetZIndex(MarkerCanvas, 1000);
			if (IsThumbnailView)
			{
				RootCanvas.SetBinding(UIElement.OpacityProperty, new Binding("Opacity")
				{
					Source = Model
				});
			}
			else
			{
				Model.DoUpdateIndexedProperties();
			}
		}

		internal void SetMarkerCanvas(Canvas canvas)
		{
			MarkerCanvas = canvas;
		}

		}

		protected void OnMouseEnter(object sender, MouseEventArgs e)
		{
			Point position = e.GetPosition(Model);
			Model.OnMouseEnter(position, e.OriginalSource, e, isFinger: false);
		}

		protected void OnMouseMove(object sender, MouseEventArgs e)
		{
			object source = e.OriginalSource;
			if (CapturedMouse)
			{
				source = MouseDownOriginalSource;
			}
			Point position = e.GetPosition(Model);
			if (Model.MouseOverEnabled && !_isTouched && !TouchUpPending)
			{
				Model.OnMouseMove(position, source, e);
			}
		}

		protected void OnMouseLeave(object sender, MouseEventArgs e)
		{
			Point position = e.GetPosition(Model);
			Model.OnMouseLeave(position, e.OriginalSource, e);
		}

		internal void Model_TouchUp(object sender, TouchEventArgs e)
		{
			_isTouched = false;
			Model.ReleaseTouchCapture(e.TouchDevice);
			Point position = e.GetTouchPoint(Model).Position;
			new MouseButtonEventArgs(Mouse.PrimaryDevice, e.Timestamp, MouseButton.Left);
			Model.OnMouseLeftButtonUp(position, e.OriginalSource, e);
		}

		internal void Model_TouchDown(object sender, TouchEventArgs e)
		{
			if (Model.CaptureTouch(e.TouchDevice))
			{
				_isTouched = true;
				Point position = e.GetTouchPoint(Model).Position;
				MouseButtonEventArgs data = new MouseButtonEventArgs(Mouse.PrimaryDevice, e.Timestamp, MouseButton.Left);
				Model.OnLeftButtonDown(position, e.OriginalSource, data);
			}
		}

		internal void FinishTouchUp(Point pt, TouchEventArgs e)
		{
			if (TouchUpPending)
			{
				TouchUpPending = false;
				MouseButtonEventArgs data = new MouseButtonEventArgs(Mouse.PrimaryDevice, (int)default(DateTime).TimeOfDay.Ticks, MouseButton.Left);
				Model.OnMouseLeftButtonUp(pt, Model, data);
			}
		}

		private void Model_LostTouchCapture(object sender, TouchEventArgs e)
		{
			_isTouched = false;
			TouchUpPending = true;
		}

		protected void OnMouseLeftButtonDown(object sender, MouseButtonEventArgs e)
		{
			if (Model.CaptureMouse())
			{
				CapturedMouse = true;
			}
			Point position = e.GetPosition(Model);
			MouseDownOriginalSource = e.OriginalSource;
			Model.OnLeftButtonDown(position, e.OriginalSource, e);
		}

		protected void OnMouseLeftButtonUp(object sender, MouseButtonEventArgs e)
		{
			object source = e.OriginalSource;
			if (CapturedMouse)
			{
				MouseButtonUserReleased = true;
				Model.ReleaseMouseCapture();
				CapturedMouse = false;
				MouseButtonUserReleased = false;
				source = MouseDownOriginalSource;
			}
			Point position = e.GetPosition(Model);
			Model.OnMouseLeftButtonUp(position, source, e);
			MouseDownOriginalSource = null;
		}

		protected void OnLostMouseCapture(object sender, MouseEventArgs e)
		{
			if (CapturedMouse)
			{
				CapturedMouse = false;
				Point position = e.GetPosition(Model);
				if (Model.SeriesViewer == null || !Model.SeriesViewer.View.StealingCapture)
				{
					Model.OnLostMouseCapture(position, e.OriginalSource, e);
				}
			}
		}

		protected void OnMouseRightButtonDown(object sender, MouseButtonEventArgs e)
		{
			Point position = e.GetPosition(Model);
			Model.OnRightButtonDown(position, e.OriginalSource, e);
		}

		protected void OnMouseRightButtonUp(object sender, MouseButtonEventArgs e)
		{
			Point position = e.GetPosition(Model);
			Model.OnRightButtonUp(position, e.OriginalSource, e);
		}

		public virtual void PrepSurface(RenderSurface surface)
		{
			if (_thumbnailCanvas == null)
			{
				_thumbnailCanvas = new Canvas();
				Model.ThumbnailView.AttachUI(_thumbnailCanvas);
			}
			if (surface.Surface == null)
			{
				surface.Surface = new Canvas();
			}
			if (!surface.Contained.ContainsKey(_thumbnailCanvas))
			{
				surface.Contained.Add(_thumbnailCanvas, _thumbnailCanvas);
			}
			if (!surface.Surface.Children.Contains(_thumbnailCanvas))
			{
				_thumbnailCanvas.Detach();
				surface.Surface.Children.Add(_thumbnailCanvas);
			}
		}

		public Brush GetTransparentBrush()
		{
			if (_transparent == null)
			{
				_transparent = new SolidColorBrush(Colors.Transparent);
			}
			return _transparent;
		}

		public void PrepAltSurface(RenderSurface surface)
		{
			if (_altCanvas == null)
			{
				_altCanvas = new Canvas();
				AttachUI(_altCanvas);
			}
			if (surface.Surface == null)
			{
				surface.Surface = new Canvas();
			}
			_altCanvas.InvalidateMeasure();
			if (!surface.Contained.ContainsKey(_altCanvas))
			{
				surface.Contained.Add(_altCanvas, _altCanvas);
			}
			if (!surface.Surface.Children.Contains(_altCanvas))
			{
				_altCanvas.Detach();
				surface.Surface.Children.Add(_altCanvas);
			}
		}

		private void Detach(FrameworkElement parent, UIElement child)
		{
			if (child != null)
			{
				if (parent is Panel panel)
				{
					panel.Children.Remove(child);
				}
				else if (parent is ContentControl contentControl)
				{
					contentControl.Content = null;
				}
				else if (parent is ContentPresenter contentPresenter)
				{
					contentPresenter.Content = null;
				}
			}
		}

			}
		}

		internal void HandleIsDropShadowEnabledChanged()
		{
			if (!Model.IsDropShadowSupported)
			{
				return;
			}
			if (!Model.IsDropShadowEnabled)
			{
				if (Model.Effect == dropShadowEffect)
				{
					Model.Effect = null;
				}
				dropShadowEffect = null;
			}
			else if (Model.Effect == null)
			{
				dropShadowEffect = GetDefaultDropShadowEffect();
				dropShadowEffect.Color = Model.ShadowColor;
				if (!double.IsNaN(Model.ShadowBlur))
				{
					dropShadowEffect.BlurRadius = Model.ShadowBlur;
				}
				if (!double.IsNaN(Model.ShadowDirection))
				{
					dropShadowEffect.Direction = Model.ShadowDirection;
				}
				if (!double.IsNaN(Model.ShadowOpacity))
				{
					dropShadowEffect.Opacity = Model.ShadowOpacity;
				}
				if (!double.IsNaN(Model.ShadowDepth))
				{
					dropShadowEffect.ShadowDepth = Model.ShadowDepth;
				}
				Model.Effect = dropShadowEffect;
			}
		}

		internal void UpdateShadowColor(Color color)
		{
			if (dropShadowEffect != null)
			{
				dropShadowEffect.Color = color;
			}
		}

		internal void UpdateShadowBlur(double blur)
		{
			if (dropShadowEffect != null)
			{
				dropShadowEffect.BlurRadius = blur;
			}
		}

		internal void UpdateShadowDirection(double direction)
		{
			if (dropShadowEffect != null)
			{
				dropShadowEffect.Direction = direction;
			}
		}

		internal void UpdateShadowOpacity(double opacity)
		{
			if (dropShadowEffect != null)
			{
				dropShadowEffect.Opacity = opacity;
			}
		}

		internal void UpdateShadowDepth(double depth)
		{
			if (dropShadowEffect != null)
			{
				dropShadowEffect.ShadowDepth = depth;
			}
		}

		protected virtual DropShadowEffect GetDefaultDropShadowEffect()
		{
			return new DropShadowEffect();
		}

		public Brush GetBrightenedBrush(Brush brush, double additionalBrightness)

		}

		public void OnRenderFrame()
		{
			if (!IsThumbnailView && !Model.CustomClipRect.IsEmpty && (Model.CustomClipRect.Width != 1.0 || Model.CustomClipRect.Height != 1.0))
			{
				Model.Clip = new RectangleGeometry
				{
					Rect = new Rect(Viewport.Left + Viewport.Width * Model.CustomClipRect.Left, Viewport.Top + Viewport.Height * Model.CustomClipRect.Top, Viewport.Width * Model.CustomClipRect.Width, Viewport.Height * Model.CustomClipRect.Height)
				};
			}
			else if (Model.Clip != null)
			{
				Model.Clip = null;
			}
		}

	internal class FreezeConverter : IValueConverter
	{
		public object Convert(object value, Type targetType, object parameter, CultureInfo culture)
		{
			if (targetType.IsSubclassOf(typeof(Freezable)) && value is Freezable && ((Freezable)value).CanFreeze)
			{
				return ((Freezable)value).GetAsFrozen();
			}
			return value;
		}

		public object ConvertBack(object value, Type targetType, object parameter, CultureInfo culture)
		{
			throw new NotImplementedException();
		}
	}
	internal class ItemLegendView : LegendBaseView
	{
		internal ItemLegend ItemModel { get; set; }

		private StackPanel StackPanel { get; set; }

		public ItemLegendView(ItemLegend model)
			: base(model)
		{
			ItemModel = model;
		}

		internal override void OnInit()
		{
			base.OnInit();
			StackPanel = new StackPanel
			{
				VerticalAlignment = VerticalAlignment.Stretch
			};
		}

		internal override void DetachContent()
		{
			if (ItemModel.ContentPresenter != null)
			{
				base.Model.ContentPresenter.Content = null;
			}
		}

		internal void AddItemVisual(object item)
		{
			UIElement uIElement = (UIElement)item;
			AttachItemEvents(uIElement);
			StackPanel.Children.Insert(base.Model.Children.IndexOf(uIElement), uIElement);
		}

		internal void RemoveItemVisual(object item)
		{
			UIElement uIElement = (UIElement)item;
			RemoveItemEvents(uIElement);
			StackPanel.Children.Remove(uIElement);
		}

		internal override void OnTemplateProvided()
		{
			base.OnTemplateProvided();
			if (base.Model.ContentPresenter != null)
			{
				base.Model.ContentPresenter.Content = StackPanel;
				StackPanel.SetBinding(StackPanel.OrientationProperty, new Binding("Orientation")
				{
					Source = base.Model
				});
			}
		}

		internal bool ContainsContext(ILegendContext dataContext)
		{
			foreach (object child in StackPanel.Children)
			{
				if (child is ContentControl { Content: not null, Content: ILegendContext content } && content.ItemLabel == dataContext.ItemLabel && content.LegendLabel == dataContext.LegendLabel && content.Series == dataContext.Series && content.ActualItemBrush == dataContext.ActualItemBrush)
				{
					return true;
				}
			}
			return false;
		}
	}

		protected LegendMouseButtonEventArgs CreateMouseButtonArgs(object legendItem, MouseButtonEventArgs e)
		{
			FetchLegendEnvironment(legendItem, out var chart, out var series, out var item);
			return new LegendMouseButtonEventArgs(chart, series, item, e, legendItem);
		}

		protected LegendMouseEventArgs CreateMouseArgs(object legendItem, MouseEventArgs e)
		{
			FetchLegendEnvironment(legendItem, out var chart, out var series, out var item);
			return new LegendMouseEventArgs(chart, series, item, e, legendItem);
		}

		protected internal virtual void FetchLegendEnvironment(object legendItem, out ILegendOwner chart, out ILegendSeries series, out object item)
		{
			chart = Model.Owner;
			series = null;
			item = null;
			if (legendItem != null && legendItem is ContentControl { Content: not null } contentControl && contentControl.Content is ILegendContext)
			{
				ILegendContext legendContext = contentControl.Content as ILegendContext;
				series = legendContext.Series as ILegendSeries;
				if (series != null)
				{
					chart = series.Container;
				}
				item = legendContext.Item;
			}
		}

		{
		}

		internal virtual void OnTemplateProvided()
		{
		}

		internal bool Ready()
		{
			if (Model.ContentPresenter == null)
			{
				return false;
			}
			return true;
		}

		internal void AttachItemEvents(UIElement uiElement)
		{
			uiElement.MouseLeftButtonDown += RaiseLegendItemMouseLeftButtonDown;
			uiElement.MouseLeftButtonUp += RaiseLegendItemMouseLeftButtonUp;
			uiElement.MouseEnter += RaiseLegendItemMouseEnter;
			uiElement.MouseLeave += RaiseLegendItemMouseLeave;
			uiElement.MouseMove += RaiseLegendItemMouseMove;
		}

		internal void RemoveItemEvents(UIElement uiElement)
		{
			uiElement.MouseLeftButtonDown -= RaiseLegendItemMouseLeftButtonDown;
			uiElement.MouseLeftButtonUp -= RaiseLegendItemMouseLeftButtonUp;
			uiElement.MouseEnter -= RaiseLegendItemMouseEnter;
			uiElement.MouseLeave -= RaiseLegendItemMouseLeave;
			uiElement.MouseMove -= RaiseLegendItemMouseMove;
		}

		internal void RaiseLegendItemMouseLeftButtonDown(object legendItem, MouseButtonEventArgs e)
		{
			LegendMouseButtonEventArgs args = CreateMouseButtonArgs(legendItem, e);
			Model.OnLegendItemMouseLeftButtonDown(args);
		}

		internal void RaiseLegendItemMouseLeftButtonUp(object legendItem, MouseButtonEventArgs e)
		{
			LegendMouseButtonEventArgs args = CreateMouseButtonArgs(legendItem, e);
			Model.OnLegendItemMouseLeftButtonUp(args);
		}

		internal void RaiseLegendItemMouseEnter(object legendItem, MouseEventArgs e)
		{
			LegendMouseEventArgs args = CreateMouseArgs(legendItem, e);
			Model.OnLegendItemMouseEnter(args);
		}

		internal void RaiseLegendItemMouseLeave(object legendItem, MouseEventArgs e)
		{
			LegendMouseEventArgs args = CreateMouseArgs(legendItem, e);
			Model.OnLegendItemMouseLeave(args);
		}

		internal void RaiseLegendItemMouseMove(object legendItem, MouseEventArgs e)
		{
			LegendMouseEventArgs args = CreateMouseArgs(legendItem, e);
			Model.OnLegendItemMouseMove(args);
		}

		internal void NotifyBeginUpdate()
		{
		}

		internal void NotifyEndUpate()
		{
		}

		internal LegendVisualData ExportVisualData()
		{
			LegendVisualData legendVisualData = new LegendVisualData();
			foreach (ContentControl item in Model.VisualDescendantsOfType<ContentControl>())
			{
				ContentControl contentControl = item;
				LegendItemVisualData legendItemVisualData = new LegendItemVisualData();
				if (!(contentControl.Content is ILegendContext legendContext))
				{
					continue;
				}
				if (legendContext.ActualItemBrush != null)
				{
					legendItemVisualData.Appearance.Fill = AppearanceHelper.FromBrush(legendContext.ActualItemBrush);
				}
				else
				{
					legendItemVisualData.Appearance.Fill = AppearanceHelper.FromBrush(legendContext.ItemBrush);
				}
				legendItemVisualData.Appearance.Opacity = item.Opacity;
				legendItemVisualData.Appearance.IsVisible = item.Visibility == Visibility.Visible;
				Func<UIElement, RectData> func = (UIElement el) => (el == null) ? null : RectData.FromRect(el.TransformToAncestor(Model).TransformBounds(new Rect(new Point(0.0, 0.0), el.RenderSize)));
				foreach (TextBlock item2 in from tt in contentControl.VisualDescendantsOfType<TextBlock>()
					where tt.IsVisible
					select tt)
				{
					legendItemVisualData.LabelBounds = (legendItemVisualData.LabelBounds.IsEmpty ? func(item2) : RectData.FromRect(Rect.Union(legendItemVisualData.LabelBounds.ToRect(), func(item2).ToRect())));
					legendItemVisualData.Label += item2.Text;
				}
				legendItemVisualData.Bounds = func(contentControl);
				using (IEnumerator<TextBlock> enumerator2 = contentControl.VisualDescendantsOfType<TextBlock>().GetEnumerator())
				{
					if (enumerator2.MoveNext())
					{
						Panel visualAncestor = PresentationUtilities.GetVisualAncestor(enumerator2.Current, (Panel panel) => true);
						legendItemVisualData.BadgeBounds = func(visualAncestor.Children[0]);
					}
				}
				legendVisualData.Items.Add(legendItemVisualData);
			}
			return legendVisualData;
		}
	}
	internal class LegendView : LegendBaseView
	{
		protected Legend LegendModel { get; set; }

		private StackPanel StackPanel { get; set; }

		public LegendView(Legend model)
			: base(model)
		{
			LegendModel = model;
		}

		internal override void OnInit()
		{
			base.OnInit();
			StackPanel = new StackPanel
			{
				VerticalAlignment = VerticalAlignment.Stretch
			};
		}

		internal void RemoveItemVisual(object item)
		{
			UIElement uIElement = (UIElement)item;
			RemoveItemEvents(uIElement);
			StackPanel.Children.Remove(uIElement);
		}

		internal void AddItemVisual(object item)
		{
			UIElement uIElement = (UIElement)item;
			AttachItemEvents(uIElement);
			StackPanel.Children.Insert(base.Model.Children.IndexOf(uIElement), uIElement);
			FrameworkElement frameworkElement = base.Model.ContentPresenter;
			while (frameworkElement != null && frameworkElement != base.Model)
			{
				frameworkElement.InvalidateMeasure();
				frameworkElement = VisualTreeHelper.GetParent(frameworkElement) as FrameworkElement;
			}
			if (frameworkElement == base.Model)
			{
				frameworkElement.InvalidateMeasure();
			}
		}

		internal override void OnTemplateProvided()
		{
			base.OnTemplateProvided();
			if (base.Model.ContentPresenter != null)
			{
				base.Model.ContentPresenter.Content = StackPanel;
				StackPanel.SetBinding(StackPanel.OrientationProperty, new Binding("Orientation")
				{
					Source = base.Model
				});
			}
		}

		internal override void DetachContent()
		{
			if (base.Model.ContentPresenter != null)
			{
				base.Model.ContentPresenter.Content = null;
			}
		}
	}
	internal class ScaleLegendView : LegendBaseView
	{
		private const string LegendScaleElementName = "LegendScale";

		internal ScaleLegend ScaleModel { get; set; }

		internal Brush OriginalScaleBrush { get; set; }

		internal string OriginalMinText { get; set; }

		internal string OriginalMaxText { get; set; }

		public UIElement LegendScaleElement { get; private set; }

		public TextBlock MinText { get; private set; }

		public TextBlock MaxText { get; private set; }

		public ScaleLegendView(ScaleLegend model)
			: base(model)
		{
			ScaleModel = model;
		}

		internal override void OnTemplateProvided()
		{
			base.OnTemplateProvided();
			LegendScaleElement = ScaleModel.GetTemplateElement("LegendScale") as UIElement;
			MinText = ScaleModel.GetTemplateElement("MinText") as TextBlock;
			MaxText = ScaleModel.GetTemplateElement("MaxText") as TextBlock;
			if (LegendScaleElement is Shape shape)
			{
				OriginalScaleBrush = shape.Fill;
			}
			if (MinText != null)
			{
				OriginalMinText = MinText.Text;
			}
			if (MaxText != null)
			{
				OriginalMaxText = MaxText.Text;
			}
			ScaleModel.RenderLegend();
		}

		internal void RestoreOriginalState()
		{
			if (LegendScaleElement is Shape shape)
			{
				shape.Fill = OriginalScaleBrush;
			}
			if (OriginalMinText != null)
			{
				MinText.Text = OriginalMinText;
			}
			if (OriginalMaxText != null)
			{
				MaxText.Text = OriginalMaxText;
			}
		}

		internal override void DetachContent()
		{
		}

		internal Color GetTransparentBrush()
		{
			return Colors.Transparent;
		}

		internal object BuildGradient()
		{
			return new LinearGradientBrush();
		}

		internal void AddGradientStop(object gradient, Color color, double colorOffset)
		{
			((LinearGradientBrush)gradient).GradientStops.Add(new GradientStop
			{
				Color = color,
				Offset = colorOffset
			});
		}

		internal void SetScaleFill(Shape legendScaleShapeElement, bool useSeriesBrush, object gradient)
		{
			legendScaleShapeElement.Fill = (useSeriesBrush ? ScaleModel.Series.ActualMarkerBrush : ((Brush)gradient));
		}
	}
	internal class PieChartBaseView
	{
		private MouseButtonEventHandler _mouseUpOverride;

		private MouseEventHandler _mouseEnterAndMoveOverride;

		private MouseEventHandler _mouseLeaveOverride;

		private MouseEventHandler _labelMouseLeaveOverride;

		private MouseEventHandler _labelMouseEnterAndMoveOverride;

		protected PieChartBase Model { get; set; }

		internal Canvas Root { get; set; }

		internal Canvas MainPieCanvas { get; set; }

		internal Canvas LabelCanvas { get; set; }

		internal StringFormatter ToolTipFormatter { get; set; }

		internal Popup ToolTipPopup { get; set; }

		public PieChartBaseView(PieChartBase model)
		{
			Model = model;
		}

		public virtual void OnInit()
		{
			Root = new Canvas();
			MainPieCanvas = new Canvas();
			LabelCanvas = new Canvas();
			Root.Children.Add(MainPieCanvas);
			ToolTipFormatter = new StringFormatter();
			_mouseUpOverride = delegate(object o, MouseButtonEventArgs e)
			{
				if (o is Slice slice)
				{
					Model.SliceClicked(slice, e);
				}
			};
			_mouseEnterAndMoveOverride = delegate(object o, MouseEventArgs e)
			{
				if (o is FrameworkElement { DataContext: not null })
				{
					Model.ItemEntered(o, e);
				}
			};
			_mouseLeaveOverride = delegate(object o, MouseEventArgs e)
			{
				Model.ItemMouseLeft(o, e);
			};
			_labelMouseEnterAndMoveOverride = delegate(object o, MouseEventArgs e)
			{
				if (o is PieLabel { Slice: not null } pieLabel && pieLabel.Slice.DataContext != null && pieLabel.ActualLabelPosition != LabelsPosition.OutsideEnd)
				{
					Model.ItemMouseMoved(pieLabel.Slice, e, fromLabel: true);
				}
			};
			_labelMouseLeaveOverride = delegate(object o, MouseEventArgs e)
			{
				Model.ItemMouseLeft(o, e);
			};
			ToolTipPopup = new Popup
			{
				DataContext = new PieSliceDataContext(),
				Child = new ContentControl
				{
					IsHitTestVisible = false
				}
			};
			Model.SizeChanged += delegate
			{
				SizeUpdated();
			};
			MainPieCanvas.SizeChanged += delegate
			{
				SizeUpdated();
			};
			Panel.SetZIndex(LabelCanvas, 100);
			Root.Children.Add(LabelCanvas);
		}

		public virtual void OnTemplateProvided()
		{
			if (ToolTipPopup.Child is ContentControl contentControl)
			{
				contentControl.SetBinding(FrameworkElement.StyleProperty, new Binding("ToolTipStyle")
				{
					Source = Model
				});
			}
			Model.RenderChart();
		}

		internal void OnAttachedToUI()
		{
		}

		internal void OnDetachedFromUI()
		{
		}

		private void SizeUpdated()
		{
			Model.OnSizeUpdated();
		}

		internal void InitToolTipManager(PieChartToolTipManager toolTipManager)
		{
			toolTipManager.GetChartInfo = delegate(FrameworkElement item)
			{
				Slice slice = item as Slice;
				StringFormatter stringFormatter = null;
				if (slice != null && slice.IsOthersSlice)
				{
					stringFormatter = new StringFormatter
					{
						FormatString = Model.OthersCategoryText
					};
				}
				toolTipManager.ToolTip = Model.ToolTip;
				toolTipManager.ToolTipFormatter = stringFormatter ?? ToolTipFormatter;
				toolTipManager.ToolTipPopup = ToolTipPopup;
			};
		}

		internal void CloseToolTip()
		{
			if (((ToolTipPopup != null) ? (ToolTipPopup.Child as ContentControl) : null) != null)
			{
				ToolTipPopup.IsOpen = false;
			}
		}

		internal void UpdateToolTip(object item, object args)
		{
			FrameworkElement item2 = item as FrameworkElement;
			MouseEventArgs e = args as MouseEventArgs;
			Model.ToolTipManager.UpdateToolTip(e, item2);
		}

		internal void OnContentPresenterProvided()
		{
			Model.ContentPresenter.Content = Root;
		}

		internal Slice SliceCreate()
		{
			Slice slice = new Slice();
			slice.Owner = Model;
			slice.SetBinding(Control.ForegroundProperty, new Binding("Foreground")
			{
				Source = Model
			});
			slice.SetBinding(Control.FontFamilyProperty, new Binding("FontFamily")
			{
				Source = Model
			});
			slice.SetBinding(Control.FontSizeProperty, new Binding("FontSize")
			{
				Source = Model
			});
			slice.SetBinding(Control.FontStretchProperty, new Binding("FontStretch")
			{
				Source = Model
			});
			slice.SetBinding(Control.FontStyleProperty, new Binding("FontStyle")
			{
				Source = Model
			});
			slice.SetBinding(Control.FontWeightProperty, new Binding("FontWeight")
			{
				Source = Model
			});
			slice.MouseLeftButtonUp += _mouseUpOverride;
			slice.MouseEnter += _mouseEnterAndMoveOverride;
			slice.MouseLeave += _mouseLeaveOverride;
			slice.MouseMove += _mouseEnterAndMoveOverride;
			return slice;
		}

		internal void SliceActivate(Slice slice)
		{
			slice.Detach();
			MainPieCanvas.Children.Add(slice);
		}

		internal void SliceDisactivate(Slice slice)
		{
			if (MainPieCanvas.Children.Contains(slice))
			{
				MainPieCanvas.Children.Remove(slice);
			}
		}

		internal void SliceDestroy(Slice slice)
		{
			slice.Owner = null;
			slice.Background = null;
			slice.ClearValue(Control.ForegroundProperty);
			slice.ClearValue(Control.FontFamilyProperty);
			slice.ClearValue(Control.FontSizeProperty);
			slice.ClearValue(Control.FontStretchProperty);
			slice.ClearValue(Control.FontStyleProperty);
			slice.ClearValue(Control.FontWeightProperty);
			slice.MouseLeftButtonUp -= _mouseUpOverride;
			slice.MouseEnter -= _mouseEnterAndMoveOverride;
			slice.MouseLeave -= _mouseLeaveOverride;
			slice.MouseMove -= _mouseEnterAndMoveOverride;
		}

		private void InitializeLeaderLine(Shape shape)
		{
			shape.SetBinding(UIElement.VisibilityProperty, new Binding("LeaderLineVisibility")
			{
				Source = Model
			});
			shape.SetBinding(FrameworkElement.StyleProperty, new Binding("LeaderLineStyle")
			{
				Source = Model
			});
			if (double.IsNaN(Model.LeaderLineOpacity))
			{
				shape.ClearValue(UIElement.OpacityProperty);
			}
			else
			{
				shape.Opacity = Model.LeaderLineOpacity;
			}
			if (Model.LeaderLineStroke == null)
			{
				shape.ClearValue(Shape.StrokeProperty);
			}
			else
			{
				shape.Stroke = Model.LeaderLineStroke;
			}
			if (double.IsNaN(Model.LeaderLineStrokeThickness))
			{
				shape.ClearValue(Shape.StrokeThicknessProperty);
			}
			else
			{
				shape.StrokeThickness = Model.LeaderLineStrokeThickness;
			}
		}

		private void InitializeLeaderLine(PieLabel label, bool isUpdate)
		{
			if (Model.LeaderLineType == LeaderLineType.Straight)
			{
				if (isUpdate && label.LeaderLinePath != null)
				{
					label.LeaderLinePath.Style = null;
					label.LeaderLinePath.Detach();
					LabelCanvas.Children.Remove(label.LeaderLinePath);
					label.LeaderLinePath = null;
				}
				bool num = label.LeaderLine == null;
				if (num)
				{
					label.LeaderLine = new Line();
				}
				InitializeLeaderLine(label.LeaderLine);
				if (num)
				{
					LabelCanvas.Children.Add(label.LeaderLine);
				}
				return;
			}
			if (isUpdate && label.LeaderLine != null)
			{
				label.LeaderLine.Style = null;
				label.LeaderLine.Detach();
				LabelCanvas.Children.Remove(label.LeaderLine);
				label.LeaderLine = null;
			}
			bool num2 = label.LeaderLinePath == null;
			if (num2)
			{
				label.LeaderLinePath = new Path();
			}
			PathGeometry pathGeometry = new PathGeometry();
			pathGeometry.Figures.Add(new PathFigure());
			pathGeometry.Figures[0].Segments.Add(new BezierSegment());
			label.LeaderLinePath.Data = pathGeometry;
			InitializeLeaderLine(label.LeaderLinePath);
			if (num2)
			{
				LabelCanvas.Children.Add(label.LeaderLinePath);
			}
		}

		internal PieLabel LabelCreate()
		{
			PieLabel pieLabel = new PieLabel
			{
				IsHitTestVisible = true
			};
			InitializeLeaderLine(pieLabel, isUpdate: false);
			pieLabel.MouseEnter += _labelMouseEnterAndMoveOverride;
			pieLabel.MouseMove += _labelMouseEnterAndMoveOverride;
			pieLabel.MouseLeave += _labelMouseLeaveOverride;
			return pieLabel;
		}

		internal void LabelActivate(PieLabel label)
		{
			label.Detach();
			if (Model.LeaderLineType == LeaderLineType.Straight)
			{
				label.LeaderLine.Detach();
				LabelCanvas.Children.Add(label.LeaderLine);
			}
			else
			{
				label.LeaderLinePath.Detach();
				LabelCanvas.Children.Add(label.LeaderLinePath);
			}
			LabelCanvas.Children.Add(label);
		}

		internal void LabelDisactivate(PieLabel label)
		{
			if (LabelCanvas.Children.Contains(label))
			{
				LabelCanvas.Children.Remove(label);
				if (Model.LeaderLineType == LeaderLineType.Straight)
				{
					LabelCanvas.Children.Remove(label.LeaderLine);
				}
				else
				{
					LabelCanvas.Children.Remove(label.LeaderLinePath);
				}
			}
		}

		internal void LabelDestroy(PieLabel label)
		{
			if (Model.LeaderLineType == LeaderLineType.Straight)
			{
				label.LeaderLine.ClearValue(UIElement.VisibilityProperty);
				label.LeaderLine.ClearValue(FrameworkElement.StyleProperty);
			}
			else
			{
				label.LeaderLinePath.ClearValue(UIElement.VisibilityProperty);
				label.LeaderLinePath.ClearValue(FrameworkElement.StyleProperty);
			}
			label.MouseEnter -= _labelMouseEnterAndMoveOverride;
			label.MouseMove -= _labelMouseEnterAndMoveOverride;
			label.MouseLeave -= _labelMouseLeaveOverride;
		}

		internal void UpdateLabelLeaderLine(PieLabel label)
		{
			InitializeLeaderLine(label, isUpdate: true);
		}

		private void ApplySliceProperty(Slice slice, DependencyProperty property, double value, ICollection<DependencyProperty> appliedProperties)
		{
			if (double.IsNaN(value))
			{
				slice.ClearValue(property);
				return;
			}
			slice.SetValue(property, value);
			appliedProperties.Add(property);
		}

		private void ApplySliceProperty(Slice slice, DependencyProperty property, object value, ICollection<DependencyProperty> appliedProperties)
		{
			if (value == null)
			{
				if (!appliedProperties.Contains(property))
				{
					slice.ClearValue(property);
				}
			}
			else
			{
				slice.SetValue(property, value);
				appliedProperties.Add(property);
			}
		}

		internal void SetSliceAppearance(Slice slice)
		{
			bool flag = false;
			bool flag2 = false;
			HashSet<DependencyProperty> hashSet = new HashSet<DependencyProperty>();
			Panel.SetZIndex(slice, 0);
			if (slice.IsOthersSlice)
			{
				if (Model.OthersCategoryStyle != null && Model.ReadLocalValue(PieChartBase.OthersCategoryStyleProperty) != DependencyProperty.UnsetValue)
				{
					foreach (Setter setter3 in Model.OthersCategoryStyle.Setters)
					{
						slice.ClearValue(setter3.Property);
						hashSet.Add(setter3.Property);
					}
					slice.Style = Model.OthersCategoryStyle;
					flag = true;
				}
				ApplySliceProperty(slice, UIElement.OpacityProperty, Model.OthersCategoryOpacity, hashSet);
				ApplySliceProperty(slice, Control.BorderBrushProperty, Model.OthersCategoryStroke, hashSet);
				ApplySliceProperty(slice, Slice.StrokeThicknessProperty, Model.OthersCategoryStrokeThickness, hashSet);
				ApplySliceProperty(slice, Control.BackgroundProperty, Model.OthersCategoryFill, hashSet);
			}
			if (!flag && slice.IsSelected && Model.AllowSliceSelection)
			{
				if (Model.SelectedStyle != null)
				{
					foreach (Setter setter4 in Model.SelectedStyle.Setters)
					{
						slice.ClearValue(setter4.Property);
						hashSet.Add(setter4.Property);
					}
					slice.Style = Model.SelectedStyle;
					flag2 = true;
				}
				ApplySliceProperty(slice, UIElement.OpacityProperty, Model.SelectedSliceOpacity, hashSet);
				ApplySliceProperty(slice, Control.BorderBrushProperty, Model.SelectedSliceStroke, hashSet);
				ApplySliceProperty(slice, Slice.StrokeThicknessProperty, Model.SelectedSliceStrokeThickness, hashSet);
				ApplySliceProperty(slice, Control.BackgroundProperty, Model.SelectedSliceFill, hashSet);
				Panel.SetZIndex(slice, 1);
			}
			if (!flag && !flag2)
			{
				slice.Style = null;
			}
			DependencyProperty[] array = new DependencyProperty[4]
			{
				UIElement.OpacityProperty,
				Control.BorderBrushProperty,
				Shape.StrokeThicknessProperty,
				Control.BackgroundProperty
			};
			foreach (DependencyProperty dependencyProperty in array)
			{
				if (!hashSet.Contains(dependencyProperty))
				{
					slice.ClearValue(dependencyProperty);
				}
			}
			if (!hashSet.Contains(Control.FontFamilyProperty))
			{
				slice.SetBinding(Control.FontFamilyProperty, new Binding("FontFamily")
				{
					Source = Model
				});
			}
			if (!hashSet.Contains(Control.FontSizeProperty))
			{
				slice.SetBinding(Control.FontSizeProperty, new Binding("FontSize")
				{
					Source = Model
				});
			}
			if (!hashSet.Contains(Control.FontStretchProperty))
			{
				slice.SetBinding(Control.FontStretchProperty, new Binding("FontStretch")
				{
					Source = Model
				});
			}
			if (!hashSet.Contains(Control.FontStyleProperty))
			{
				slice.SetBinding(Control.FontStyleProperty, new Binding("FontStyle")
				{
					Source = Model
				});
			}
			if (!hashSet.Contains(Control.FontWeightProperty))
			{
				slice.SetBinding(Control.FontWeightProperty, new Binding("FontWeight")
				{
					Source = Model
				});
			}
			if (slice.Background == null && Model.ActualBrushes != null && slice.Index >= 0 && Model.ActualBrushes.Count > 0)
			{
				slice.Background = Model.ActualBrushes[slice.Index % Model.ActualBrushes.Count];
			}
			if (slice.BorderBrush == null && Model.ActualOutlines != null && slice.Index >= 0 && Model.ActualOutlines.Count > 0)
			{
				slice.BorderBrush = Model.ActualOutlines[slice.Index % Model.ActualOutlines.Count];
			}
		}

		internal object GetLabel(Slice slice)
		{
			if (slice == null || slice.Label == null)
			{
				return string.Empty;
			}
			object label = slice.Label.Label;
			if (label is DataTemplate dataTemplate)
			{
				return new ContentControl
				{
					DataContext = slice.DataContext,
					Content = dataTemplate.LoadContent(),
					HorizontalContentAlignment = HorizontalAlignment.Stretch,
					VerticalContentAlignment = VerticalAlignment.Stretch
				};
			}
			if (label is TextBlock)
			{
				return (label as TextBlock).Text;
			}
			return label;
		}

		internal Rect GetLabelBounds(PieLabel label)
		{
			label.InvalidateMeasure();
			label.Measure(new Size(double.PositiveInfinity, double.PositiveInfinity));
			return new Rect(0.0, 0.0, label.DesiredSize.Width, label.DesiredSize.Height);
		}

		internal Size UpdatePieViewport()
		{
			MainPieCanvas.Width = Model.ContentPresenter.RenderSize.Width;
			MainPieCanvas.Height = Model.ContentPresenter.RenderSize.Height;
			return new Size(MainPieCanvas.Width, MainPieCanvas.Height);
		}

		internal void UpdateLabelPosition(PieLabel label, double x, double y)
		{
			label.RenderTransform = new TranslateTransform
			{
				X = x,
				Y = y
			};
		}

		internal void UpdateToolTipContent(object toolTip)
		{
			ToolTipFormatter = ((toolTip is string) ? new StringFormatter
			{
				FormatString = (toolTip as string)
			} : null);

	internal class SliceView
	{
		protected Slice Model { get; set; }

		internal Path SlicePath { get; private set; }

		public SliceView(Slice model)
		{
			Model = model;
		}

		public virtual void OnInit()
		{
			SlicePath = new Path();
			Model.Content = SlicePath;
			ApplyBindings();
		}

		internal void ApplyBindings()
		{
			if (SlicePath != null)
			{
				SlicePath.SetBinding(Shape.FillProperty, new Binding("Background")
				{
					Source = Model
				});
				SlicePath.SetBinding(Shape.StrokeProperty, new Binding("BorderBrush")
				{
					Source = Model
				});
				SlicePath.SetBinding(Shape.StrokeThicknessProperty, new Binding("StrokeThickness")
				{
					Source = Model
				});
				SlicePath.SetBinding(UIElement.OpacityProperty, new Binding("Opacity")
				{
					Source = Model
				});
			}
		}

		internal virtual void OnTemplateProvided()
		{
			Model.CreateShape();
		}

		internal Path GetSlicePath()
		{
			return SlicePath;
		}

		internal void PositionSlice(double x, double y)
		{
			SlicePath.RenderTransform = new TranslateTransform
			{
				X = x,
				Y = y
			};
		}

		internal void ResetSlicePosition()
		{
			SlicePath.RenderTransform = null;
		}

	internal class ChartToolTipManager
	{
		internal Control Owner { get; set; }

		internal object ToolTip { get; set; }

		internal StringFormatter ToolTipFormatter { get; set; }

		internal Popup ToolTipPopup { get; set; }

		internal Action<FrameworkElement> GetChartInfo { get; set; }

		public ChartToolTipManager(Control owner)
		{
			Owner = owner;
		}

		protected virtual void UpdateToolTipDataContext(Popup toolTipPopup, FrameworkElement item)
		{
			if (toolTipPopup != null)
			{
				Brush itemBrush = null;
				if (item is Shape)
				{
					itemBrush = (item as Shape).Fill;
				}
				if (item is Control)
				{
					itemBrush = (item as Control).Background;
				}
				toolTipPopup.DataContext = new DataContext
				{
					Series = Owner,
					Item = item.DataContext,
					ItemBrush = itemBrush
				};
			}
		}

		protected virtual void UpdateToolTipContent(ContentControl toolTipControl, DataContext dc)
		{
			object toolTip = ToolTip;
			if (toolTip is UIElement && toolTipControl.Content != toolTip)
			{
				toolTipControl.Content = toolTip as UIElement;
			}
			else if (toolTip is string && ToolTipFormatter != null && dc.Item != null)
			{
				toolTipControl.Content = ToolTipFormatter.Format(dc.Item, null);
			}
		}

		private void UpdateToolTipVisibility(Popup toolTipPopup, FrameworkElement item)
		{
			if (item.DataContext != null)
			{
				toolTipPopup.Visibility = Visibility.Visible;
			}
			else
			{
				toolTipPopup.Visibility = Visibility.Collapsed;
			}
		}

		private void EnsureTooltipMeasured(ContentControl toolTipControl)
		{
			Size availableSize = new Size(double.PositiveInfinity, double.PositiveInfinity);
			toolTipControl.Measure(availableSize);
		}

		public void UpdateToolTip(MouseEventArgs e, FrameworkElement item)
		{
			UpdateToolTip(e, item, clampToTargetBounds: true);
		}

		public void UpdateToolTip(MouseEventArgs e, FrameworkElement item, bool clampToTargetBounds)
		{
			if (item == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			GetChartInfo(item);
			Popup toolTipPopup = ToolTipPopup;
			ContentControl contentControl = ((toolTipPopup != null) ? (toolTipPopup.Child as ContentControl) : null);
			if (contentControl == null || toolTipPopup == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			DataContext dataContext = toolTipPopup.DataContext as DataContext;
			if (ToolTip != null)
			{
				UpdateToolTipDataContext(toolTipPopup, item);
				UpdateToolTipContent(contentControl, dataContext);
				UpdateToolTipVisibility(toolTipPopup, item);
			}
			else
			{
				dataContext.Item = null;
			}
			UIElement relativeTo = e.Source as UIElement;
			toolTipPopup.PlacementTarget = e.Source as UIElement;
			toolTipPopup.Placement = PlacementMode.Relative;
			if (SafeSetter.IsSafe)
			{
				toolTipPopup.AllowsTransparency = true;
			}
			bool num = !toolTipPopup.IsOpen;
			toolTipPopup.IsOpen = ToolTip != null && item != null;
			if (num && toolTipPopup.IsOpen)
			{
				EnsureTooltipMeasured(contentControl);
			}
			double num2 = e.GetPosition(relativeTo).X + 4.0;
			double num3 = e.GetPosition(relativeTo).Y - contentControl.DesiredSize.Height - 4.0;
			double horizontalOffset;
			double verticalOffset;
			try
			{
				Size renderSize = Window.GetWindow(e.Source as UIElement).RenderSize;
				if (SystemParameters.MenuDropAlignment)
				{
					num2 += contentControl.DesiredSize.Width;
				}
				if (clampToTargetBounds)
				{
					horizontalOffset = num2 - Math.Max(0.0, num2 + contentControl.DesiredSize.Width - renderSize.Width);
					verticalOffset = Math.Max(0.0, num3);
				}
				else
				{
					horizontalOffset = num2;
					verticalOffset = num3;
				}
			}
			catch
			{
				horizontalOffset = num2;
				verticalOffset = num3;
			}
			toolTipPopup.HorizontalOffset = horizontalOffset;
			toolTipPopup.VerticalOffset = verticalOffset;
		}
	}

			ContentControl contentControl = ((toolTipPopup != null) ? (toolTipPopup.Child as ContentControl) : null);

				contentControl.Content = null;
			}

		protected override void UpdateToolTipDataContext(Popup toolTipPopup, FrameworkElement item)
		{
			if (toolTipPopup != null)
			{

				if (item is Control)

				}

			}

	internal class SeriesToolTipManager
	{
		private Series Owner { get; set; }

		public ContentControl ToolTipControl { get; set; }

		public DataContext ToolTipDataContext { get; set; }

		public SeriesToolTipManager(Series owner)
		{
			Owner = owner;
			ToolTipControl = new ContentControl();
			ToolTipDataContext = new DataContext();
		}

		private void UpdateToolTipDataContext(Popup toolTipPopup, Series owner, object item)
		{
			if (toolTipPopup != null)
			{
				if (owner.IsDefaultToolTipSelected && item != null)
				{
					toolTipPopup.DataContext = owner.GetTooltipContext(item);
					return;
				}
				toolTipPopup.DataContext = new DataContext
				{
					Series = owner,
					Item = item
				};
			}
		}

		private void UpdateToolTipContent(ContentControl toolTipControl, Series owner, DataContext dc)
		{
			if (owner.ToolTip is UIElement && toolTipControl.Content != owner.ToolTip)
			{
				owner.RemoveToolTipFromCurrentParent();
				owner.CurrentToolTipParent = toolTipControl;
				toolTipControl.Content = owner.ToolTip as UIElement;
			}
			else if (owner.ToolTip is string && owner.ToolTipFormatter != null && dc.Item != null)
			{
				owner.CurrentToolTipParent = toolTipControl;
				toolTipControl.Content = owner.ToolTipFormatter.Format(dc, null);
			}
		}

		private void UpdateToolTipVisibility(Popup toolTipPopup, object item)
		{
			if (item != null)
			{
				toolTipPopup.Visibility = Visibility.Visible;
			}
			else
			{
				toolTipPopup.Visibility = Visibility.Collapsed;
			}
		}

		private void EnsureTooltipMeasured(ContentControl toolTipControl)
		{
			Size availableSize = new Size(double.PositiveInfinity, double.PositiveInfinity);
			toolTipControl.Measure(availableSize);
		}

		public void UpdateToolTip(Point pt, object item, object data)
		{
			Series series = Owner;
			if (Owner is StackedSeriesBase)
			{
				if (!(data is MouseEventArgs e) || e.OriginalSource is Rectangle || !(e.OriginalSource is FrameworkElement { DataContext: DataContext dataContext }) || !(dataContext.Series is Series))
				{
					return;
				}
				series = dataContext.Series as Series;
			}
			Popup popup = ((series.SeriesViewer != null) ? series.SeriesViewer.ToolTipPopup : null);
			ContentControl contentControl = ((popup != null) ? (popup.Child as ContentControl) : null);
			if (contentControl == null || popup == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			DataContext dataContext2 = popup.DataContext as DataContext;
			if (series.ToolTip != null)
			{
				UpdateToolTipDataContext(popup, series, item);
				popup.UpdateLayout();
				UpdateToolTipContent(contentControl, series, dataContext2);
				UpdateToolTipVisibility(popup, item);
			}
			else
			{
				dataContext2.Item = null;
			}
			MouseEventArgs e2 = (MouseEventArgs)data;
			UIElement uIElement;
			if (e2 == null)
			{
				uIElement = series;
			}
			else
			{
				uIElement = e2.Source as UIElement;
				popup.PlacementTarget = e2.Source as UIElement;
				popup.Placement = PlacementMode.Relative;
			}
			bool num = !popup.IsOpen;
			bool isInDragOperation = series.SeriesViewer.IsInDragOperation;
			popup.IsOpen = series.ToolTip != null && item != null && !isInDragOperation;
			if (num && popup.IsOpen)
			{
				EnsureTooltipMeasured(contentControl);
			}
			Point point = e2?.GetPosition(uIElement) ?? pt;
			double num2 = point.X + 4.0;
			double num3 = point.Y - contentControl.DesiredSize.Height - 4.0;
			double num5;
			double verticalOffset;
			try
			{
				Window window = Window.GetWindow(uIElement) ?? (PlatformProxy.GetRootVisual(uIElement) as Window) ?? ((Application.Current != null) ? Application.Current.MainWindow : null);
				Size size = window?.RenderSize ?? new Size(double.PositiveInfinity, double.PositiveInfinity);
				if (SystemParameters.MenuDropAlignment)
				{
					num2 += contentControl.DesiredSize.Width;
				}
				if (point.Y < contentControl.DesiredSize.Height && point.X > size.Width - contentControl.DesiredSize.Width)
				{
					num3 = point.Y + 10.0;
				}
				double num4 = size.Width;
				if (popup.PlacementTarget != null)
				{
					num4 -= popup.PlacementTarget.TranslatePoint(new Point(0.0, 0.0), window).X;
				}
				if (SystemParameters.MenuDropAlignment)
				{
					num4 += contentControl.DesiredSize.Width;
				}
				num5 = Math.Max(0.0, num2 + contentControl.DesiredSize.Width - num4);
				verticalOffset = Math.Max(0.0, num3);
			}
			catch
			{
				num5 = 0.0;
				verticalOffset = num3;
			}
			popup.HorizontalOffset = num2 - num5;
			popup.VerticalOffset = verticalOffset;
		}

		public void ShowTooltip(Point pt, Action<object> add)
		{
			Point world = ToWorldCoordinates(pt);
			object item = Owner.GetItem2(world);
			if (item != null && Owner.SeriesViewer != null && !Owner.ContentInfo.IsDirty)
			{
				UpdateToolTip(item);
			}
			if (ToolTipControl.Content != null)
			{
				add(ToolTipControl);
			}
		}

		public void UpdateToolTip(object item)
		{
			if (Owner is StackedSeriesBase && Owner.ToolTip == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			ContentControl toolTipControl = ToolTipControl;
			if (toolTipControl == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			if (Owner.ToolTip != null)
			{
				if (Owner.IsDefaultToolTipSelected && item != null)
				{
					ToolTipDataContext = Owner.GetTooltipContext(item);
				}
				else
				{
					ToolTipDataContext = new DataContext
					{
						Series = Owner,
						Item = item
					};
				}
				toolTipControl.DataContext = ToolTipDataContext;
				UpdateToolTipContent(toolTipControl, Owner, ToolTipDataContext);
				if (Owner.ToolTip is IProactiveTooltipContent)
				{
					((IProactiveTooltipContent)Owner.ToolTip).DataContextUpdated(ToolTipDataContext);
				}
			}
			else
			{
				ToolTipDataContext.Item = null;
				ToolTipControl.Content = null;
			}
		}

		private Point ToWorldCoordinates(Point point)
		{
			Rect rect = new Rect(0.0, 0.0, Owner.ActualWidth, Owner.ActualHeight);
			Rect rect2 = ((Owner.SeriesViewer != null) ? Owner.SeriesViewer.WindowRect : Rect.Empty);
			return new Point(rect2.Left + rect2.Width * (point.X - rect.Left) / rect.Width, rect2.Top + rect2.Height * (point.Y - rect.Top) / rect.Height);
		}
	}

		void DataContextUpdated(object dataContext);
	}
	public abstract class ViewportCalculator
	{
		protected virtual Rect CalculateViewportOverride(UIElement target, FrameworkElement xReference, FrameworkElement yReference)
		{
			if (xReference == null || yReference == null)
			{
				return Rect.Empty;
			}
			Rect result = new Rect(0.0, 0.0, xReference.ActualWidth, yReference.ActualHeight);
			if (result.Width < 1.0 || result.Height < 1.0 || xReference.Parent == null || yReference.Parent == null)
			{
				return Rect.Empty;
			}
			return result;
		}

		public virtual bool LocateAlternateReference(UIElement target, ref FrameworkElement xReference, ref FrameworkElement yReference)
		{
			return false;
		}

		public virtual Rect CalculateViewport(UIElement target, FrameworkElement xReference, FrameworkElement yReference)
		{
			Rect rect = CalculateViewportOverride(target, xReference, yReference);
			while (rect == Rect.Empty && LocateAlternateReference(target, ref xReference, ref yReference))
			{
				rect = CalculateViewportOverride(target, xReference, yReference);
			}
			return rect;
		}
	}
	internal class AxisBasedViewportCalculator : ViewportCalculator
	{
		public override bool LocateAlternateReference(UIElement target, ref FrameworkElement xReference, ref FrameworkElement yReference)
		{
			Axis axis = xReference as Axis;
			Axis axis2 = yReference as Axis;
			if (axis == null || axis2 == null)
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (axis.Parent is Grid { Parent: Grid parent })
			{
				xReference = parent;
				yReference = parent;
				return true;
			}
			return false;
		}
	}
	internal class PolarAxisBasedViewportCalculator : AxisBasedViewportCalculator
	{
		protected override Rect CalculateViewportOverride(UIElement target, FrameworkElement xReference, FrameworkElement yReference)
		{
			if (target is Series && xReference is Axis && yReference is Axis)
			{
				Series series = target as Series;
				Axis axis = xReference as Axis;
				Axis axis2 = yReference as Axis;
				if (axis.SeriesViewer != series.SeriesViewer || axis2.SeriesViewer != series.SeriesViewer)
				{
					Axis axis3 = null;
					if (axis.SeriesViewer == series.SeriesViewer)
					{
						axis3 = axis;
					}
					if (axis2.SeriesViewer == series.SeriesViewer)
					{
						axis3 = axis2;
					}
					if (axis3 == null)
					{
						return Rect.Empty;
					}
					return base.CalculateViewportOverride(target, axis3, axis3);
				}
			}
			return base.CalculateViewportOverride(target, xReference, yReference);
		}
	}
