	[EditorBrowsable(EditorBrowsableState.Never)]
	internal class ChartAreaPanel : Panel
	{
		private Size _titleMeasureSize = Size.Empty;

		private Size _subtitleMeasureSize = Size.Empty;

		public SeriesViewer SeriesViewer { get; private set; }

		internal ChartAreaPanel(SeriesViewer chart)
		{
			if (chart == null)
			{
				throw new ArgumentException(GetType().Name + " must be created with an owner " + typeof(XamDataChart).Name);
			}
			SeriesViewer = chart;
		}

		protected override Size MeasureOverride(Size availableSize)
		{
			if (!base.Children.Contains(SeriesViewer.TitlePresenter) && SeriesViewer.Title != null)
			{
				base.Children.Add(SeriesViewer.TitlePresenter);
			}
			if (!base.Children.Contains(SeriesViewer.SubtitlePresenter) && SeriesViewer.Title != null)
			{
				base.Children.Add(SeriesViewer.SubtitlePresenter);
			}
			Size size = GetDesiredSize(desiredSize: new Size(SeriesViewer.PlotAreaMinWidth, SeriesViewer.PlotAreaMinHeight), availableSize: availableSize, plotSize: new Size(0.0, 0.0));
			Size nonPlotDesiredSize = size;
			UIElement uIElement = null;
			foreach (UIElement child in base.Children)
			{
				if (child is XamOverviewPlusDetailPane)
				{
					uIElement = child;
				}
			}
			if (uIElement != null && uIElement is XamOverviewPlusDetailPane)
			{
				size = new Size((uIElement.DesiredSize.Width > size.Width) ? uIElement.DesiredSize.Width : size.Width, (uIElement.DesiredSize.Height > size.Height) ? uIElement.DesiredSize.Height : size.Height);
			}
			Size availableSize2 = EstimatePlotSize(nonPlotDesiredSize, availableSize);
			if (SeriesViewer.PlotAreaBorder != null)
			{
				SeriesViewer.PlotAreaBorder.Measure(availableSize2);
			}
			if (SeriesViewer.ChartContentManager.FirstMeasure && !double.IsInfinity(availableSize.Width) && !double.IsInfinity(availableSize.Height) && SeriesViewer.Series.Count > 0)
			{
				SeriesViewer.ChartContentManager.FirstMeasure = false;
				availableSize2 = EstimatePlotSize(nonPlotDesiredSize, availableSize);
				SeriesViewer.PlotAreaBorder.Measure(new Size(availableSize2.Width, availableSize2.Height));
				SeriesViewer.ChartContentManager.EnsureAxesRendered(availableSize2);
				if (SeriesViewer.EffectiveIsSquare())
				{
					if (availableSize.Width > availableSize.Height)
					{
						availableSize = new Size(availableSize.Height, availableSize.Height);
					}
					else if (availableSize.Height > availableSize.Width)
					{
						availableSize = new Size(availableSize.Width, availableSize.Width);
					}
				}
				size = GetDesiredSize(desiredSize: new Size(SeriesViewer.PlotAreaMinWidth, SeriesViewer.PlotAreaMinHeight), availableSize: availableSize, plotSize: availableSize2);
			}
			if (double.IsInfinity(size.Width))
			{
				size.Width = SeriesViewer.MinWidth;
				size.Height = SeriesViewer.MinHeight;
			}
			return size;
		}

		private Size EstimatePlotSize(Size nonPlotDesiredSize, Size availableSize)
		{
			Size size = new Size(nonPlotDesiredSize.Width - SeriesViewer.PlotAreaMinWidth, nonPlotDesiredSize.Height - SeriesViewer.PlotAreaMinHeight);
			double val = Math.Max(availableSize.Width - size.Width, 0.0);
			double val2 = Math.Max(availableSize.Height - size.Height, 0.0);
			double num = SeriesViewer.PlotAreaMinWidth;
			double num2 = SeriesViewer.PlotAreaMinHeight;
			if (SeriesViewer.VerticalAlignment == VerticalAlignment.Stretch)
			{
				num2 = Math.Max(num2, val2);
			}
			if (SeriesViewer.HorizontalAlignment == HorizontalAlignment.Stretch)
			{
				num = Math.Max(num, val);
			}
			if (SeriesViewer.EffectiveIsSquare())
			{
				if (num2 > num)
				{
					num2 = num;
				}
				else if (num > num2)
				{
					num = num2;
				}
			}
			return new Size(num, num2);
		}

		private Size GetDesiredSize(Size availableSize, Size desiredSize, Size plotSize)
		{
			foreach (UIElement child in base.Children)
			{
				if (child is XamZoombar)
				{
					child.Measure(new Size(double.PositiveInfinity, double.PositiveInfinity));
				}
				else
				{
					child.Measure(availableSize);
				}
				desiredSize = AccomodateElement(child, desiredSize);
			}
			return desiredSize;
		}

		private Size AccomodateElement(UIElement element, Size currentDesiredSize)
		{
			if (element == SeriesViewer.TitlePresenter)
			{
				return new Size(currentDesiredSize.Width, currentDesiredSize.Height + element.DesiredSize.Height);
			}
			if (element == SeriesViewer.SubtitlePresenter)
			{
				return new Size(currentDesiredSize.Width, currentDesiredSize.Height + element.DesiredSize.Height);
			}
			if (element == SeriesViewer.HorizontalZoombar)
			{
				return new Size(currentDesiredSize.Width, currentDesiredSize.Height + element.DesiredSize.Height);
			}
			if (element == SeriesViewer.VerticalZoombar)
			{
				return new Size(currentDesiredSize.Width + element.DesiredSize.Width, currentDesiredSize.Height);
			}
			if (element is AxisLabelPanelBase)
			{
				AxisLabelSettings labelSettings = (element as AxisLabelPanelBase).Axis.LabelSettings;
				if (labelSettings == null || labelSettings.Visibility == Visibility.Visible)
				{
					switch (LabelPanelArranger.ResolveLabelLocation(element as AxisLabelPanelBase))
					{
					case AxisLabelsLocation.OutsideRight:
						return new Size(currentDesiredSize.Width + element.DesiredSize.Width, currentDesiredSize.Height);
					case AxisLabelsLocation.OutsideLeft:
						return new Size(currentDesiredSize.Width + element.DesiredSize.Width, currentDesiredSize.Height);
					case AxisLabelsLocation.OutsideTop:
						return new Size(currentDesiredSize.Width, currentDesiredSize.Height + element.DesiredSize.Height);
					default:
						return new Size(currentDesiredSize.Width, currentDesiredSize.Height + element.DesiredSize.Height);
					case AxisLabelsLocation.InsideTop:
					case AxisLabelsLocation.InsideBottom:
					case AxisLabelsLocation.InsideLeft:
					case AxisLabelsLocation.InsideRight:
						break;
					}
				}
			}
			return currentDesiredSize;
		}

		protected override Size ArrangeOverride(Size finalSize)
		{
			Rect gridAreaRect = new Rect(new Point(0.0, 0.0), finalSize);
			List<AxisLabelPanelBase> list = new List<AxisLabelPanelBase>();
			foreach (UIElement child in base.Children)
			{
				if (child == SeriesViewer.HorizontalZoombar)
				{
					gridAreaRect.Height = Math.Max(0.0, gridAreaRect.Height - child.DesiredSize.Height);
				}
				if (child == SeriesViewer.VerticalZoombar)
				{
					gridAreaRect.Width = Math.Max(0.0, gridAreaRect.Width - child.DesiredSize.Width);
				}
				if (child == SeriesViewer.TitlePresenter)
				{
					gridAreaRect.Height = Math.Max(0.0, gridAreaRect.Height - child.DesiredSize.Height);
					gridAreaRect.Y += child.DesiredSize.Height;
				}
				if (child == SeriesViewer.SubtitlePresenter)
				{
					gridAreaRect.Height = Math.Max(0.0, gridAreaRect.Height - child.DesiredSize.Height);
					gridAreaRect.Y += child.DesiredSize.Height;
				}
				AxisLabelPanelBase axisLabelPanelBase = child as AxisLabelPanelBase;
				if (axisLabelPanelBase != null && axisLabelPanelBase.Axis != null && (axisLabelPanelBase.Axis.LabelSettings == null || axisLabelPanelBase.Axis.LabelSettings.Visibility == Visibility.Visible))
				{
					list.Add(axisLabelPanelBase);
					ResetPanelLocation(axisLabelPanelBase);
				}
				else
				{
					axisLabelPanelBase?.Arrange(new Rect(0.0, 0.0, 0.0, 0.0));
				}
			}
			gridAreaRect = LabelPanelArranger.PreparePanels(list, gridAreaRect);
			double num = 0.0;
			double num2 = 0.0;
			double num3 = 0.0;
			double num4 = 0.0;
			if (SeriesViewer.EffectiveIsSquare() && gridAreaRect.Width != gridAreaRect.Height)
			{
				if (gridAreaRect.Width < gridAreaRect.Height)
				{
					num3 += (gridAreaRect.Height - gridAreaRect.Width) / 2.0;
					num4 += (gridAreaRect.Height - gridAreaRect.Width) / 2.0;
					gridAreaRect.Height = gridAreaRect.Width;
				}
				else
				{
					num += (gridAreaRect.Width - gridAreaRect.Height) / 2.0;
					num2 += (gridAreaRect.Width - gridAreaRect.Height) / 2.0;
					gridAreaRect.Width = gridAreaRect.Height;
				}
			}
			LabelPanelsArrangeState labelPanelsArrangeState = new LabelPanelsArrangeState
			{
				Left = num,
				InsideLeft = num,
				Bottom = finalSize.Height - num4,
				InsideBottom = finalSize.Height - num4,
				Right = finalSize.Width - num2,
				InsideRight = finalSize.Width - num2,
				Top = num3,
				InsideTop = num3
			};
			gridAreaRect = new Rect(gridAreaRect.Left, gridAreaRect.Top + num3, gridAreaRect.Width, gridAreaRect.Height);
			gridAreaRect = new Rect(gridAreaRect.Left + num, gridAreaRect.Top, gridAreaRect.Width, gridAreaRect.Height);
			if (SeriesViewer.Title != null)
			{
				UIElement titlePresenter = SeriesViewer.TitlePresenter;
				labelPanelsArrangeState.Top += titlePresenter.DesiredSize.Height;
				labelPanelsArrangeState.InsideTop += titlePresenter.DesiredSize.Height;
				_titleMeasureSize = new Size(finalSize.Width, finalSize.Height);
				titlePresenter.Arrange(new Rect(0.0, 0.0, finalSize.Width, titlePresenter.DesiredSize.Height));
			}
			if (SeriesViewer.Subtitle != null)
			{
				UIElement subtitlePresenter = SeriesViewer.SubtitlePresenter;
				labelPanelsArrangeState.Top += subtitlePresenter.DesiredSize.Height;
				labelPanelsArrangeState.InsideTop += subtitlePresenter.DesiredSize.Height;
				_subtitleMeasureSize = new Size(finalSize.Width, finalSize.Height);
				double y = 0.0;
				if (SeriesViewer.TitlePresenter != null)
				{
					y = SeriesViewer.TitlePresenter.DesiredSize.Height;
				}
				subtitlePresenter.Arrange(new Rect(0.0, y, finalSize.Width, subtitlePresenter.DesiredSize.Height));
			}
			if (SeriesViewer.HorizontalZoombar != null)
			{
				UIElement horizontalZoombar = SeriesViewer.HorizontalZoombar;
				labelPanelsArrangeState.Bottom -= horizontalZoombar.DesiredSize.Height;
				labelPanelsArrangeState.InsideBottom -= horizontalZoombar.DesiredSize.Height;
				horizontalZoombar.Arrange(new Rect(gridAreaRect.Left, labelPanelsArrangeState.Bottom, gridAreaRect.Width, horizontalZoombar.DesiredSize.Height));
			}
			if (SeriesViewer.VerticalZoombar != null)
			{
				UIElement verticalZoombar = SeriesViewer.VerticalZoombar;
				labelPanelsArrangeState.Right -= verticalZoombar.DesiredSize.Width;
				labelPanelsArrangeState.InsideRight -= verticalZoombar.DesiredSize.Width;
				verticalZoombar.Arrange(new Rect(labelPanelsArrangeState.Right, gridAreaRect.Top, verticalZoombar.DesiredSize.Width, gridAreaRect.Height));
			}
			if (SeriesViewer.PlotAreaBorder != null)
			{
				SeriesViewer.PlotAreaBorder.Arrange(gridAreaRect);
			}
			if (SeriesViewer.OverviewPlusDetailPane != null)
			{
				FrameworkElement frameworkElement = (FrameworkElement)SeriesViewer.OverviewPlusDetailPane;
				double x = 0.0;
				double y2 = 0.0;
				switch (frameworkElement.HorizontalAlignment)
				{
				case HorizontalAlignment.Center:
				case HorizontalAlignment.Stretch:
					x = (gridAreaRect.Right - frameworkElement.DesiredSize.Width) / 2.0;
					break;
				case HorizontalAlignment.Right:
					x = gridAreaRect.Right - frameworkElement.DesiredSize.Width;
					break;
				}
				switch (frameworkElement.VerticalAlignment)
				{
				case VerticalAlignment.Center:
				case VerticalAlignment.Stretch:
					y2 = (gridAreaRect.Bottom - frameworkElement.DesiredSize.Height) / 2.0;
					break;
				case VerticalAlignment.Bottom:
					y2 = gridAreaRect.Bottom - frameworkElement.DesiredSize.Height;
					break;
				}
				frameworkElement.Arrange(new Rect(x, y2, frameworkElement.DesiredSize.Width, frameworkElement.DesiredSize.Height));
			}
			LabelPanelArranger.ArrangePanels(list, labelPanelsArrangeState, gridAreaRect, delegate(AxisLabelPanelBase p, Rect b)
			{
				p.FinalBoundsFromLabelArranger = b;
				p.Arrange(b);
			});
			if (SeriesViewer.ChartContentManager.FirstArrange && !SeriesViewer.ChartContentManager.FirstMeasure)
			{
				SeriesViewer.ChartContentManager.FirstArrange = false;
				SeriesViewer.ChartContentManager.EnsureAxesRendered(gridAreaRect.Size);
				finalSize = ArrangeOverride(finalSize);
			}
			return finalSize;
		}

		private void ResetPanelLocation(AxisLabelPanelBase labelPanel)
		{
			if (labelPanel.Axis != null && labelPanel.Axis.LabelSettings != null && labelPanel.Axis.LabelSettings.ReadLocalValue(AxisLabelSettings.LocationProperty) != DependencyProperty.UnsetValue)
			{
				labelPanel.Axis.LabelSettings.ActualLocation = labelPanel.Axis.LabelSettings.Location;
			}
		}
	}

		internal double GetAngleTo(Point world, Point center)
		{
			double num = Math.Sqrt(Math.Pow(world.X - center.X, 2.0) + Math.Pow(world.Y - center.Y, 2.0));
			double num2 = Math.Acos((world.X - center.X) / num);
			if (world.Y - center.Y < 0.0)
			{
				num2 = Math.PI * 2.0 - num2;
			}
			return num2;
		}

		public override Point GetSeriesValuePosition(Point world, bool useInterpolation, bool skipUnknowns)
		{
			if (Axis == null)
			{
				return new Point(double.NaN, double.NaN);
			}
			double num = PrepareValue();
			double x = double.NaN;
			double y = double.NaN;
			double num2 = double.NaN;
			Point center = new Point(0.5, 0.5);
			double num3 = double.NaN;
			switch (Axis.Orientation)
			{
			case AxisOrientation.Angular:
				num3 = Math.Sqrt(Math.Pow(world.X - center.X, 2.0) + Math.Pow(world.Y - center.Y, 2.0));
				num2 = num;
				x = center.X + Math.Cos(num2) * num3;
				y = center.Y + Math.Sin(num2) * num3;
				y = base.View.Viewport.Top + base.View.Viewport.Height * (y - base.View.WindowRect.Top) / base.View.WindowRect.Height;
				x = base.View.Viewport.Left + base.View.Viewport.Width * (x - base.View.WindowRect.Left) / base.View.WindowRect.Width;
				break;
			case AxisOrientation.Horizontal:
				x = num;
				y = world.Y;
				y = base.View.Viewport.Top + base.View.Viewport.Height * (y - base.View.WindowRect.Top) / base.View.WindowRect.Height;
				break;
			case AxisOrientation.Vertical:
				y = num;
				x = world.X;
				x = base.View.Viewport.Left + base.View.Viewport.Width * (x - base.View.WindowRect.Left) / base.View.WindowRect.Width;
				break;
			case AxisOrientation.Radial:
				num2 = GetAngleTo(world, center);
				num3 = num;
				x = center.X + Math.Cos(num2) * num3;
				y = center.Y + Math.Sin(num2) * num3;
				y = base.View.Viewport.Top + base.View.Viewport.Height * (y - base.View.WindowRect.Top) / base.View.WindowRect.Height;
				x = base.View.Viewport.Left + base.View.Viewport.Width * (x - base.View.WindowRect.Left) / base.View.WindowRect.Width;
				break;
			}
			return new Point(x, y);
		}

		protected internal override AxisRange GetRange(Axis axis)
		{
			double value = Value;
			if (double.IsNaN(value) || double.IsInfinity(value))
			{
				return null;
			}
			return new AxisRange(value, value);
		}

		protected internal override void RenderSeriesOverride(bool animate)
		{
			ClearRendering(wipeClean: true, base.View);
			if (!ShouldRenderOverlay())
			{
				if (_annotationFrame != null)
				{
					UpdateAnnotation(double.NaN, AnimationActive());
				}
			}
			else if (ShouldAnimate(animate))
			{
				if (AnimationActive())
				{
					if (base.Animator.NeedsFlush)
					{
						base.Animator.Flush();
					}
					double previousValue = PreviousValue;
					PreviousValue = TransitionValue;
					TransitionValue = previousValue;
				}
				else
				{
					PreviousValue = CurrentValue;
				}
				CurrentValue = PrepareValue();
				StartAnimation();
			}
			else
			{
				CurrentValue = PrepareValue();
				RenderValue(CurrentValue, ValueOverlayView);
			}
		}

		internal double PrepareValue()
		{
			GetViewInfo(out var viewportRect, out var windowRect);
			Rect effectiveViewport = GetEffectiveViewport(base.View);
			ScalerParams p = new ScalerParams(windowRect, viewportRect, Axis.IsInverted, effectiveViewport);
			return Axis.GetScaledValue(Value, p);
		}

		internal void RenderValue(double scaledValue, ValueOverlayView view)
		{
			if (Axis == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			if (Axis is CategoryAxisBase { IsDateTime: false } categoryAxisBase)
			{
				if (Value > (double)(categoryAxisBase.ItemsCount - 1))
				{
					return;
				}
				if (categoryAxisBase.CategoryMode != CategoryMode.Mode0)
				{
					Rect effectiveViewport = GetEffectiveViewport(view);
					double num = 0.5 * categoryAxisBase.GetCategorySize(view.WindowRect, view.Viewport, effectiveViewport);
					bool flag = false;
					if (categoryAxisBase.IsVertical && !categoryAxisBase.IsInverted)
					{
						flag = true;
					}
					if (categoryAxisBase is CategoryXAxis && categoryAxisBase.IsInverted)
					{
						flag = true;
					}
					if (flag)
					{
						num = 0.0 - num;
					}
					scaledValue += num;
				}
			}
			if (!(Axis is NumericAxisBase numericAxisBase) || (!(Value < numericAxisBase.ActualMinimumValue) && !(Value > numericAxisBase.ActualMaximumValue) && (!numericAxisBase.IsReallyLogarithmic || !(Value < 0.0))))
			{
				AxisOrientation orientation = Axis.Orientation;
				Geometry geometry = ((orientation != AxisOrientation.Angular && orientation != AxisOrientation.Radial) ? Axis.GetOverlayGeometry(scaledValue, view.WindowRect, view.Viewport) : Axis.GetOverlayGeometry(scaledValue, view.WindowRect, view.Viewport, GetEffectiveViewport(view), GetContentViewport(view)));
				if (geometry != null)
				{
					view.SetPathData(geometry);
				}
				if (!view.IsThumbnailView)
				{
					UpdateAnnotation(scaledValue, AnimationActive());
				}
			}
		}

		protected internal override bool ValidateSeries(Rect viewportRect, Rect windowRect, SeriesView view)
		{
			bool flag = true;
			flag = base.ValidateSeries(viewportRect, windowRect, view);
			if (!view.HasSurface() || windowRect.IsEmpty || viewportRect.IsEmpty || Axis == null || Axis.SeriesViewer == null)
			{
				flag = false;
			}
			return flag;
		}

		protected override void WindowRectChangedOverride(Rect oldWindowRect, Rect newWindowRect)
		{
			RenderSeries(animate: false);
		}

		protected override void ViewportRectChangedOverride(Rect oldViewportRect, Rect newViewportRect)
		{
			RenderSeries(animate: false);
		}

		protected override void DataUpdatedOverride(FastItemsSourceEventAction action, int position, int count, string propertyName)
		{
			throw new NotImplementedException();
		}

		protected override void PropertyUpdatedOverride(object sender, string propertyName, object oldValue, object newValue)
		{
			base.PropertyUpdatedOverride(sender, propertyName, oldValue, newValue);
			switch (propertyName)
			{
			case "Axis":
				if (oldValue != null)
				{
					((Axis)oldValue).DeregisterSeries(this);
				}
				if (newValue != null)
				{
					((Axis)newValue).RegisterSeries(this);
				}
				RenderSeries(animate: false);
				NotifyThumbnailAppearanceChanged();
				break;
			case "TransitionProgress":
				TransitionValue = PreviousValue + base.TransitionProgress * (CurrentValue - PreviousValue);
				if (!ClearAndAbortIfInvalid(base.View))
				{
					if (base.TransitionProgress == 1.0)
					{
						RenderValue(CurrentValue, ValueOverlayView);
					}
					else
					{
						RenderValue(TransitionValue, ValueOverlayView);
					}
					if (base.SeriesViewer != null)
					{
						base.SeriesViewer.RaiseSeriesAnimating(this);
					}
				}
				break;
			case "Value":
				if (Axis is NumericAxisBase numericAxisBase)
				{
					numericAxisBase.UpdateRange();
				}
				RenderSeries(animate: true);
				NotifyThumbnailDataChanged();
				break;
			case "IsAxisAnnotationEnabled":
			case "AxisAnnotationTextColor":
			case "AxisAnnotationBackground":
			case "AxisAnnotationInterpolatedValuePrecision":
			case "AxisAnnotationOutline":
			case "AxisAnnotationStrokeThickness":
				RenderSeries(animate: true);
				break;
			}
		}

		protected internal override void InvalidateAxes()
		{
			base.InvalidateAxes();
			if (Axis != null)
			{
				Axis.RenderAxis(animate: false);
			}
		}

		protected internal override void ClearRendering(bool wipeClean, SeriesView view)
		{
			base.ClearRendering(wipeClean, view);
			((ValueOverlayView)view).ClearRendering();
		}

		private bool ShouldRenderOverlay()
		{
			if (Axis == null || Axis.SeriesViewer == null || double.IsNaN(Value) || base.Visibility != Visibility.Visible)
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (Axis is CategoryAxisBase { ItemsCount: 0 })
			{
				return false;
			}
			return true;
		}

		CategoryMode IHasCategoryModePreference.PreferredCategoryMode(CategoryAxisBase axis)
		{
			return CategoryMode.Mode0;
		}

		protected override SeriesView CreateView()
		{
			return new ValueOverlayView(this);
		}

		protected internal override void OnViewCreated(SeriesView view)
		{
			base.OnViewCreated(view);
			ValueOverlayView = view as ValueOverlayView;
		}

		protected internal override void RenderThumbnail(Rect viewportRect, RenderSurface surface)
		{
			base.RenderThumbnail(viewportRect, surface);
			if (!base.ThumbnailDirty)
			{
				base.View.PrepSurface(surface);
				return;
			}
			base.View.PrepSurface(surface);
			if (!ClearAndAbortIfInvalid(base.ThumbnailView) && ShouldRenderOverlay())
			{
				Rect effectiveViewport = GetEffectiveViewport(base.View);
				double scaledValue = Axis.GetScaledValue(Value, new ScalerParams(base.ThumbnailView.WindowRect, viewportRect, Axis.IsInverted, effectiveViewport));
				RenderValue(scaledValue, base.ThumbnailView as ValueOverlayView);
				base.ThumbnailDirty = false;
			}
		}

		double IHasCategoryAxis.GetOffsetValue()
		{
			return 0.0;
		}

		double IHasCategoryAxis.GetCategoryWidth()
		{
			return 0.0;
		}

		internal bool HasAxisAnnotationFormatLabel()
		{
			return this.AxisAnnotationFormatLabel != null;
		}

		internal string RaiseAxisAnnotationFormatLabel(object item)
		{
			if (this.AxisAnnotationFormatLabel != null)
			{
				return this.AxisAnnotationFormatLabel(this, item);
			}
			return null;
		}

		public override Axis[] GetAxes()
		{
			return new Axis[1] { Axis };
		}

		protected void UpdateAnnotation(double value, bool forceAxisUpdate)
		{
			if (double.IsNaN(value))
			{
				if (_annotationFrame != null)
				{
					AxisAnnotationFrameManager.Clear(_annotationFrame);
					AxisAnnotationFrameManager.UpdateAnnoations(this, _annotationFrame, modified: true, _annotations, _annotatedAxes, forceAxisUpdate, AxisAnnotationInterpolatedValuePrecision, AxisAnnotationInterpolatedValuePrecision, this.AxisAnnotationFormatLabel, this.AxisAnnotationFormatLabel);
				}
				return;
			}
			bool modified = false;
			if (_annotations == null)
			{
				modified = true;
				_annotatedAxes = new List<Axis>();
				_annotations = new Dictionary<Axis, Pool<AxisAnnotation>>();
			}
			_annotationFrame = new AxisAnnotationFrame();
			Brush brush = base.ActualBrush;
			if (brush == null)
			{
				brush = base.Brush;
			}
			bool isVertical = Axis.IsVertical;
			AxisAnnotationFrameManager.Prepare(_annotationFrame, new Point(value, value), this, base.SeriesViewer, GetEffectiveViewport(), brush, AxisAnnotationBackground, AxisAnnotationTextColor, AxisAnnotationOutline, AxisAnnotationPadding, AxisAnnotationStrokeThickness, AxisAnnotationBackground, AxisAnnotationTextColor, AxisAnnotationOutline, AxisAnnotationPadding, AxisAnnotationStrokeThickness, !isVertical && IsAxisAnnotationEnabled, isVertical && IsAxisAnnotationEnabled);
			AxisAnnotationFrameManager.UpdateAnnoations(this, _annotationFrame, modified, _annotations, _annotatedAxes, forceAxisUpdate, AxisAnnotationInterpolatedValuePrecision, AxisAnnotationInterpolatedValuePrecision, this.AxisAnnotationFormatLabel, this.AxisAnnotationFormatLabel);
		}

		public string GetLabel(double value)
		{
			if (Axis != null)
			{
				return Axis.GetValueLabel(value);
			}
			return null;
		}
	}

	internal class PolarBaseView : MarkerSeriesView
	{
		protected PolarBase PolarModel { get; set; }

		internal MarkerManagerBase MarkerManager { get; set; }

		internal PolarTrendLineManager TrendLineManager { get; set; }

		internal HashPool<object, Marker> Markers { get; set; }

		public PolarBaseView(PolarBase model)
			: base(model)
		{
			PolarModel = model;
			Markers = new HashPool<object, Marker>();
			InitMarkers(Markers);
			TrendLineManager = new PolarTrendLineManager();
		}

		public override void OnInit()
		{
			base.OnInit();
			MarkerManager = CreateMarkerManager();
		}

		protected internal void DoToAllActiveMarkers(Action<Marker> action)
		{
			Markers.DoToAllActive(action);
		}

		protected virtual MarkerManagerBase CreateMarkerManager()
		{
			return new NumericMarkerManager((object o) => Markers[o], (int i) => PolarModel.AxisInfoCache.FastItemsSource[i], RemoveUnusedMarkers, GetMarkerLocations, GetActiveIndexes)
			{
				PopulateColumnValues = true,
				GetColumnValues = PolarModel.GetColumnValues
			};
		}

		protected virtual void RemoveUnusedMarkers(IDictionary<object, OwnedPoint> list)
		{
			PolarModel.RemoveUnusedMarkers(list, Markers);
		}

		protected virtual Point[] GetMarkerLocations()
		{
			return PolarModel.GetMarkerLocations(Markers, WindowRect, base.Viewport);
		}

		protected virtual List<int> GetActiveIndexes()
		{
			return PolarModel.GetActiveIndexes(Markers);
		}

		public override void AttachUI(Canvas rootCanvas)
		{
			base.AttachUI(rootCanvas);
			TrendLineManager.AttachPolyLine(rootCanvas, PolarModel);
		}

		internal void ApplyClipping(Rect viewportRect, Rect windowRect, Rect effectiveViewportRect, Rect contentViewport)
		{
			if (PolarModel.ClipSeriesToBounds)
			{
				GeometryGroup geometryGroup = new GeometryGroup();
				PolarModel.RadiusAxis.DefineClipRegion(geometryGroup, viewportRect, windowRect, effectiveViewportRect, contentViewport);
				base.RootCanvas.Clip = geometryGroup;
			}
			else if (base.RootCanvas.Clip != null)
			{
				base.RootCanvas.ClearValue(UIElement.ClipProperty);
			}
		}

		internal void UpdateTrendlineBrush()
		{
			PolarModel.ClearValue(PolarBase.ActualTrendLineBrushProperty);
			if (PolarModel.TrendLineBrush != null)
			{
				PolarModel.SetBinding(PolarBase.ActualTrendLineBrushProperty, new Binding("TrendLineBrush")
				{
					Source = PolarModel
				});
			}
			else
			{
				PolarModel.SetBinding(PolarBase.ActualTrendLineBrushProperty, new Binding("ActualBrush")
				{
					Source = PolarModel
				});
			}
		}

		protected internal override void DoToAllMarkers(Action<Marker> action)
		{
			Markers.DoToAll(action);
		}
	}

	internal class RadialColumnSeriesView : AnchoredRadialSeriesView
	{
		internal Pool<Rectangle> Columns;

		protected RadialColumnSeries RadialColumnModel { get; set; }

		public RadialColumnSeriesView(RadialColumnSeries model)
			: base(model)
		{
			RadialColumnModel = model;
			Columns = new Pool<Rectangle>
			{
				Create = ColumnCreate,
				Activate = ColumnActivate,
				Disactivate = ColumnDisactivate,
				Destroy = ColumnDestroy
			};
		}

		internal Rectangle ColumnCreate()
		{
			return new Rectangle
			{
				DataContext = new DataContext
				{
					Series = Model
				}
			};
		}

		internal void ColumnActivate(Rectangle column)
		{
			column.Detach();
			base.RootCanvas.Children.Add(column);
		}

		internal void ColumnDisactivate(Rectangle column)
		{
			(column.DataContext as DataContext).Item = null;
			if (column.Parent is Panel)
			{
				base.RootCanvas.Children.Remove(column);
			}
		}

		internal void ColumnDestroy(Rectangle column)
		{
			column.ClearValue(Shape.FillProperty);
			column.ClearValue(Shape.StrokeProperty);
			column.ClearValue(Shape.StrokeThicknessProperty);
			column.ClearValue(Shape.StrokeDashCapProperty);
			column.ClearValue(Rectangle.RadiusXProperty);
			column.ClearValue(Rectangle.RadiusYProperty);
		}

		internal void PositionRectangle(Rectangle column, double xpos, double ypos, double angle, double centerX, double centerY)
		{
			TranslateTransform value = new TranslateTransform
			{
				X = xpos,
				Y = ypos
			};
			RotateTransform value2 = new RotateTransform
			{
				Angle = angle,
				CenterX = centerX,
				CenterY = centerY
			};
			TransformGroup transformGroup = new TransformGroup();
			transformGroup.Children.Add(value);
			transformGroup.Children.Add(value2);
			column.RenderTransform = transformGroup;
		}

		internal void FinalizeColumns()
		{
		}

		protected internal override void ExportViewShapes(object svd)
		{
			base.ExportViewShapes(svd);
			int num = 0;
			foreach (Rectangle item in Columns.Active)
			{
				Model.SeriesVisualDataManager.ExportRectangleData(svd, item, "column" + num, new string[2] { "Main", "Fill" });
				num++;
			}
		}
	}

	internal class ScatterBaseView : MarkerSeriesView
	{
		protected internal MarkerManagerBase MarkerManager { get; set; }

		private Point[] Locations { get; set; }

		protected ScatterBase ScatterModel { get; set; }

		private List<int> Indexes { get; set; }

		private Path HorizontalErrorBarsPath { get; set; }

		private Path VerticalErrorBarsPath { get; set; }

		internal ScatterTrendLineManager TrendLineManager { get; set; }

		internal HashPool<object, Marker> Markers { get; set; }

		public ScatterBaseView(ScatterBase model)
			: base(model)
		{
			ScatterModel = model;
			Markers = new HashPool<object, Marker>();
			InitMarkers(Markers);
			TrendLineManager = new ScatterTrendLineManager();
		}

		public override void OnInit()
		{
			base.OnInit();
			HorizontalErrorBarsPath = new Path();
			VerticalErrorBarsPath = new Path();
			MarkerManager = CreateMarkerManager();
		}

		protected virtual MarkerManagerBase CreateMarkerManager()
		{
			return new NumericMarkerManager((object o) => Markers[o], (int i) => ScatterModel.AxisInfoCache.FastItemsSource[i], RemoveUnusedMarkers, GetMarkerLocations, GetActiveIndexes, () => ScatterModel.MarkerCollisionAvoidance)
			{
				Series = ScatterModel
			};
		}

		protected virtual void RemoveUnusedMarkers(IDictionary<object, OwnedPoint> list)
		{
			ScatterModel.RemoveUnusedMarkers(list, Markers);
		}

		protected virtual Point[] GetMarkerLocations()
		{
			Locations = ScatterModel.GetMarkerLocations(this, Markers, Locations, WindowRect, base.Viewport);
			return Locations;
		}

		protected virtual List<int> GetActiveIndexes()
		{
			Indexes = ScatterModel.GetActiveIndexes(Markers, Indexes);
			return Indexes;
		}

		public override void AttachUI(Canvas rootCanvas)
		{
			base.AttachUI(rootCanvas);
			TrendLineManager.AttachPolyLine(rootCanvas, Model);
		}

		internal void AttachHorizontalErrorBars()
		{
			if (ScatterModel.ErrorBarSettings.HorizontalStroke != Shape.StrokeProperty.GetMetadata(typeof(Path)).DefaultValue as Brush)
			{
				HorizontalErrorBarsPath.Stroke = ScatterModel.ErrorBarSettings.HorizontalStroke;
			}
			if (ScatterModel.ErrorBarSettings.HorizontalStrokeThickness != (double)Shape.StrokeThicknessProperty.GetMetadata(typeof(Path)).DefaultValue)
			{
				HorizontalErrorBarsPath.StrokeThickness = ScatterModel.ErrorBarSettings.HorizontalStrokeThickness;
			}
			if (ScatterModel.ErrorBarSettings.HorizontalErrorBarStyle != null)
			{
				HorizontalErrorBarsPath.SetBinding(FrameworkElement.StyleProperty, new Binding("HorizontalErrorBarStyle")
				{
					Source = ScatterModel.ErrorBarSettings
				});
			}
			else
			{
				HorizontalErrorBarsPath.SetBinding(FrameworkElement.StyleProperty, new Binding("DefaultErrorBarStyle")
				{
					Source = ScatterModel.ErrorBarSettings
				});
			}
			if (ScatterModel.ErrorBarSettings.EnableErrorBarsHorizontal == EnableErrorBars.None)
			{
				if (base.RootCanvas.Children.Contains(HorizontalErrorBarsPath))
				{
					base.RootCanvas.Children.Remove(HorizontalErrorBarsPath);
				}
			}
			else if (!base.RootCanvas.Children.Contains(HorizontalErrorBarsPath))
			{
				base.RootCanvas.Children.Add(HorizontalErrorBarsPath);
			}
		}

		internal void ProvideHorizontalErrorBarGeometry(PathGeometry horizontalErrorBarsGeometry)
		{
			HorizontalErrorBarsPath.Data = horizontalErrorBarsGeometry;
		}

		internal void AttachVerticalErrorBars()
		{
			if (ScatterModel.ErrorBarSettings.VerticalStroke != Shape.StrokeProperty.GetMetadata(typeof(Path)).DefaultValue as Brush)
			{
				VerticalErrorBarsPath.Stroke = ScatterModel.ErrorBarSettings.VerticalStroke;
			}
			if (ScatterModel.ErrorBarSettings.VerticalStrokeThickness != (double)Shape.StrokeThicknessProperty.GetMetadata(typeof(Path)).DefaultValue)
			{
				VerticalErrorBarsPath.StrokeThickness = ScatterModel.ErrorBarSettings.VerticalStrokeThickness;
			}
			if (ScatterModel.ErrorBarSettings.VerticalErrorBarStyle != null)
			{
				VerticalErrorBarsPath.SetBinding(FrameworkElement.StyleProperty, new Binding("VerticalErrorBarStyle")
				{
					Source = ScatterModel.ErrorBarSettings
				});
			}
			else
			{
				VerticalErrorBarsPath.SetBinding(FrameworkElement.StyleProperty, new Binding("DefaultErrorBarStyle")
				{
					Source = ScatterModel.ErrorBarSettings
				});
			}
			if (ScatterModel.ErrorBarSettings.EnableErrorBarsVertical == EnableErrorBars.None)
			{
				if (base.RootCanvas.Children.Contains(VerticalErrorBarsPath))
				{
					base.RootCanvas.Children.Remove(VerticalErrorBarsPath);
				}
			}
			else if (!base.RootCanvas.Children.Contains(VerticalErrorBarsPath))
			{
				base.RootCanvas.Children.Add(VerticalErrorBarsPath);
			}
		}

		internal void ProvideVerticalErrorBarGeometry(PathGeometry verticalErrorBarsGeometry)
		{
			VerticalErrorBarsPath.Data = verticalErrorBarsGeometry;
		}

		internal void HideErrorBars()
		{
			HorizontalErrorBarsPath.Data = null;
			VerticalErrorBarsPath.Data = null;
		}

		internal void UpdateTrendlineBrush()
		{
			ScatterModel.ClearValue(ScatterBase.ActualTrendLineBrushProperty);
			if (ScatterModel.TrendLineBrush != null)
			{
				ScatterModel.SetBinding(ScatterBase.ActualTrendLineBrushProperty, new Binding("TrendLineBrush")
				{
					Source = ScatterModel
				});
			}
			else
			{
				ScatterModel.SetBinding(ScatterBase.ActualTrendLineBrushProperty, new Binding("ActualBrush")
				{
					Source = ScatterModel
				});
			}
		}

		protected internal override void DoToAllMarkers(Action<Marker> action)
		{
			Markers.DoToAll(action);
		}

		protected internal void DoToAllActiveMarkers(Action<Marker> action)
		{
			Markers.DoToAllActive(action);
		}

		protected internal virtual void ClearRendering(bool wipeClean)
		{
			if (wipeClean)
			{
				HideErrorBars();
				Markers.Clear();
			}
			TrendLineManager.ClearPoints();
		}
	}

	internal class ScatterContourSeriesView : SeriesView
	{
		private double[] _contourValues;

		private List<Brush> _contourBrushes = new List<Brush>();

		private Pool<Path> Paths { get; set; }

		private ScatterContourSeries ContourLineModel { get; set; }

		public ScatterContourSeriesView(ScatterContourSeries model)
			: base(model)
		{
			ContourLineModel = model;
			Paths = new Pool<Path>
			{
				Create = PathCreate,
				Destroy = PathDestroy,
				Activate = PathActivate,
				Disactivate = PathDeactivate
			};
		}

		private Path PathCreate()
		{
			Path path = new Path();
			path.DataContext = new DataContext
			{
				Series = Model
			};
			path.SetBinding(Shape.StrokeProperty, new Binding("ActualOutline")
			{
				Source = Model
			});
			path.SetBinding(Shape.StrokeThicknessProperty, new Binding("Thickness")
			{
				Source = Model
			});
			path.SetBinding(Shape.StrokeDashArrayProperty, new Binding("DashArray")
			{
				Source = Model,
				Converter = new DoubleCollectionDuplicator()
			});
			path.SetBinding(Shape.StrokeDashCapProperty, new Binding("DashCap")
			{
				Source = Model
			});
			path.SetBinding(Shape.StrokeStartLineCapProperty, new Binding("StartCap")
			{
				Source = Model
			});
			path.SetBinding(Shape.StrokeEndLineCapProperty, new Binding("EndCap")
			{
				Source = Model
			});
			path.SetBinding(Shape.StrokeMiterLimitProperty, new Binding("MiterLimit")
			{
				Source = Model
			});
			path.SetBinding(Shape.StrokeLineJoinProperty, new Binding("LineJoin")
			{
				Source = Model
			});
			return path;
		}

		private void PathActivate(Path pth)
		{
			pth.Detach();
			base.RootCanvas.Children.Add(pth);
		}

		private void PathDeactivate(Path pth)
		{
			if (pth.Parent is Panel)
			{
				base.RootCanvas.Children.Remove(pth);
			}
		}

		private void PathDestroy(Path pth)
		{
			pth.ClearValue(Shape.StrokeProperty);
			pth.ClearValue(Shape.StrokeThicknessProperty);
			pth.ClearValue(Shape.StrokeDashArrayProperty);
			pth.ClearValue(Shape.StrokeDashCapProperty);
			pth.ClearValue(Shape.StrokeStartLineCapProperty);
			pth.ClearValue(Shape.StrokeEndLineCapProperty);
			pth.ClearValue(Shape.StrokeMiterLimitProperty);
			pth.ClearValue(Shape.StrokeLineJoinProperty);
		}

		internal void ApplyVisuals(List<List<List<Point>>> contours, double[] contourValues)
		{
			int num = 0;
			_contourValues = contourValues;
			_contourBrushes.Clear();
			ValueBrushScale actualFillScale = ContourLineModel.ActualFillScale;
			foreach (double num2 in contourValues)
			{
				List<List<Point>> list = contours[num];
				PathGeometry pathGeometry = new PathGeometry();
				foreach (List<Point> item in list)
				{
					if (item.Count != 0)
					{
						PointCollection pointCollection = item.ToPointCollection();
						PathFigure pathFigure = new PathFigure
						{
							IsClosed = false,
							IsFilled = false,
							StartPoint = pointCollection[0]
						};
						pathFigure.Segments.Add(new PolyLineSegment
						{
							Points = pointCollection
						});
						pathGeometry.Figures.Add(pathFigure);
					}
				}
				Paths[num].Data = pathGeometry;
				if (Paths[num].DataContext != null)
				{
					((DataContext)Paths[num].DataContext).Item = num2;
				}
				if (actualFillScale != null)
				{
					Brush brush = actualFillScale.GetBrushByValue(num2, ContourLineModel.ValueColumn);
					if (brush == null)
					{
						brush = Model.ActualBrush;
					}
					Paths[num].Stroke = brush;
					_contourBrushes.Add(brush);
				}
				else
				{
					Paths[num].Stroke = Model.ActualBrush;
					_contourBrushes.Add(Model.ActualBrush);
				}
				num++;
			}
			Paths.Count = num;
		}

		internal void ClearContours(bool wipeClean)
		{
			Paths.Count = 0;
		}

		protected internal override void ExportViewShapes(object visualData)
		{
			SeriesVisualData svd = (SeriesVisualData)visualData;
			base.ExportViewShapes(svd);
			List<Tuple<double, Path>> list = new List<Tuple<double, Path>>();
			if (_contourValues != null)
			{
				for (int i = 0; i < Paths.Count; i++)
				{
					list.Add(new Tuple<double, Path>(_contourValues[i], Paths[i]));
				}
			}
			list.Sort(delegate(Tuple<double, Path> p1, Tuple<double, Path> p2)
			{
				if (p1.Item1 < p2.Item1)
				{
					return -1;
				}
				return (p1.Item1 > p2.Item1) ? 1 : 0;
			});
			for (int num = 0; num < list.Count; num++)
			{
				Path item = list[num].Item2;
				if (item.Visibility != Visibility.Collapsed)
				{
					Model.SeriesVisualDataManager.ExportPathData(svd, item, "contour" + num, new string[1] { "Main " });
				}
			}
		}
	}

		}

			}

		internal WriteableBitmap Bitmap { get; private set; }

		private Image RootImage { get; set; }

		public ScatterAreaSeriesView(ScatterAreaSeries model)
			: base(model)

			ScatterAreaModel = model;

				RootImage.Source = Bitmap;
			}
		}

		{
			base.AttachUI(rootCanvas);
			if (base.IsAlternateView)

				RootImage = new Image();
				rootCanvas.Children.Add(RootImage);
			}
			else
			{
				AttachImage(ScatterAreaModel.RootImage);
			}
		}

		public void AttachImage(Image rootImage)
		{
			RootImage = rootImage;
		}

		internal void ClearBitmap()
		{
			Bitmap = null;
			if (RootImage != null)
			{
				RootImage.Source = null;
			}
		}

		internal TriangleRasterizer GetRasterizer(Rect viewportRect, ColorScale actualColorScale, IFastItemColumn<double> colorColumn)
		{
			return new TriangleRasterizer(new WriteableBitmap((int)Math.Round(viewportRect.Width), (int)Math.Round(viewportRect.Height), 96.0, 96.0, PixelFormats.Bgra32, null), actualColorScale, colorColumn.Minimum, colorColumn.Maximum, colorColumn);
		}

		internal void CloseRasterizer(TriangleRasterizer triceratops)
		{
			triceratops.PostRasterize();
			SetBitmap(triceratops.Bitmap);
		}

		protected internal override void ExportViewShapes(object svd)
		{
			base.ExportViewShapes(svd);
			int num;
			int num2;
			int[] pixels;
			if (Bitmap == null)
			{
				num = 0;
				num2 = 0;
				pixels = new int[0];
			}
			else
			{
				num = Bitmap.PixelHeight;
				num2 = Bitmap.PixelWidth;
				int stride = 4 * num2;
				pixels = new int[num2 * num];
				Bitmap.CopyPixels(pixels, stride, 0);
			}
			Model.SeriesVisualDataManager.ExportSeriesPixelsData(svd, pixels, num2, num);
		}
	}
	[TemplatePart(Name = "RootElement", Type = typeof(Path))]
	public class ShapeControl : Control
	{
		private const string RootElementName = "RootElement";

		private bool _dataUsed;

		private const string DataPropertyName = "Data";

		public static readonly DependencyProperty DataProperty = DependencyProperty.Register("Data", typeof(Geometry), typeof(ShapeControl), new PropertyMetadata(null, OnDataPropertyChanged));

		private Path Path { get; set; }

		public Geometry Data
		{
			get
			{
				return GetValue(DataProperty) as Geometry;
			}
			set
			{
				_dataUsed = false;
				SetValue(DataProperty, value);
			}
		}

		public ShapeControl()
		{
			base.DefaultStyleKey = typeof(ShapeControl);
		}

		public override void OnApplyTemplate()
		{
			base.OnApplyTemplate();
			if (_dataUsed && Data != null)
			{
				Data = Data.Duplicate();
			}
			Path = GetTemplateChild("RootElement") as Path;
			VisualStateManager.GoToState(this, "Normal", useTransitions: false);
		}

		protected override Size MeasureOverride(Size availableSize)
		{
			if (Path != null && Path.Data != Data)
			{
				try
				{
					Path.Data = Data;
					_dataUsed = true;
				}
				catch (ArgumentException)
				{
					Path.Data = Data.Duplicate();
				}
			}
			return base.MeasureOverride(availableSize);
		}

		private static void OnDataPropertyChanged(DependencyObject o, DependencyPropertyChangedEventArgs e)
		{
			if (o is ShapeControl shapeControl)
			{
				shapeControl.InvalidateMeasure();
			}
		}

		protected override void OnMouseEnter(MouseEventArgs e)
		{
			VisualStateManager.GoToState(this, "MouseOver", useTransitions: true);
			base.OnMouseEnter(e);
		}

		protected override void OnMouseLeave(MouseEventArgs e)
		{
			VisualStateManager.GoToState(this, "Normal", useTransitions: true);
			base.OnMouseLeave(e);
		}
	}
	[StyleTypedProperty(Property = "ShapeStyle", StyleTargetType = typeof(Path))]

		private const string ShapeStylePropertyName = "ShapeStyle";

		public static readonly DependencyProperty ShapeStyleProperty = DependencyProperty.Register("ShapeStyle", typeof(Style), typeof(ScatterControlSeries), new PropertyMetadata(null, delegate(DependencyObject sender, DependencyPropertyChangedEventArgs e)
		{
			((ScatterControlSeries)sender).RaisePropertyChanged("ShapeStyle", e.OldValue, e.NewValue);
		}));

		protected ScatterControlSeriesView ShapeControlView { get; set; }

		public override bool IsShapeControl => true;

		public StyleSelector ShapeStyleSelector
		{
			get
			{
				return (StyleSelector)GetValue(ShapeStyleSelectorProperty);
			}
			set
			{
				SetValue(ShapeStyleSelectorProperty, value);
			}
		}

		public Style ShapeStyle
		{
			get
			{
				return (Style)GetValue(ShapeStyleProperty);
			}
			set
			{
				SetValue(ShapeStyleProperty, value);
			}
		}

		public ScatterControlSeries()
		{
			base.DefaultStyleKey = typeof(ScatterControlSeries);
		}

		protected internal override void OnViewCreated(SeriesView view)
		{
			base.OnViewCreated(view);
			ShapeControlView = (ScatterControlSeriesView)view;
		}

		protected override SeriesView CreateView()
		{
			return new ScatterControlSeriesView(this);
		}

		protected override void PropertyUpdatedOverride(object sender, string propertyName, object oldValue, object newValue)
		{
			base.PropertyUpdatedOverride(sender, propertyName, oldValue, newValue);
			if (!(propertyName == "ShapeStyle"))
			{
				if (propertyName == "ShapeStyleSelector")
				{
					ShapeControlView.ShapeStyleSelectorChanged(ShapeStyleSelector);
					RenderSeries(animate: false);
					NotifyThumbnailAppearanceChanged();
				}
			}
			else
			{
				ShapeControlView.ShapeStyleChanged(ShapeStyle);
				RenderSeries(animate: false);
				NotifyThumbnailAppearanceChanged();
			}
		}

		protected override void RenderWithView(SeriesView view)
		{
			ScatterControlSeriesView obj = (ScatterControlSeriesView)view;
			obj.ShapeStyleChanged(ShapeStyle);
			obj.ShapeStyleSelectorChanged(ShapeStyleSelector);
			base.RenderWithView(view);
		}
	}

	public class ScatterPolygonSeriesView : ShapeSeriesViewBase
	{

		private NumericMarkerManager markerManager;

		private bool _lightweightMode;

		protected internal bool MarkerAppearanceHandled { get; set; }

		internal NumericMarkerManager MarkerManager => markerManager;

		private ScatterPolygonSeries ScatterPolygonSeriesModel { get; set; }

		internal HashPool<object, Marker> Markers { get; set; }

		public ScatterPolygonSeriesView(ScatterPolygonSeries model)
			: base(model)
		{
			ScatterPolygonSeriesModel = model;
			Markers = new HashPool<object, Marker>();
			InitMarkers(Markers);
			markerManager = new NumericMarkerManager((object o) => Markers[o], (int i) => ScatterPolygonSeriesModel.AxisInfoCache.FastItemsSource[i], RemoveUnusedMarkers, GetMarkerLocations, GetActiveIndexes, () => ScatterPolygonSeriesModel.MarkerCollisionAvoidance);
		}

		protected virtual void RemoveUnusedMarkers(IDictionary<object, OwnedPoint> list)
		{
			ScatterPolygonSeriesModel.RemoveUnusedMarkers(list, Markers);
		}

		protected virtual Point[] GetMarkerLocations()
		{
			Locations = ScatterPolygonSeriesModel.GetMarkerLocations(this, Markers, Locations, WindowRect, base.Viewport);
			return Locations;
		}

		protected virtual List<int> GetActiveIndexes()
		{
			Indexes = ScatterPolygonSeriesModel.GetActiveIndexes(Markers, Indexes);
			return Indexes;
		}

		public override Marker GetHitMarker(Point point)
		{
			Marker hitMarkerWithBuffer = GetHitMarkerWithBuffer(point, 0.0);
			if (hitMarkerWithBuffer == null)
			{
				hitMarkerWithBuffer = GetHitMarkerWithBuffer(point, 3.0);
			}
			return hitMarkerWithBuffer;
		}

		private Marker GetHitMarkerWithBuffer(Point point, double buffer)
		{
			UIElementCollection children = base.MarkerCanvas.Children;
			bool flag = false;
			for (int num = children.Count - 1; num >= 0; num--)
			{
				UIElement uIElement = children[num];
				if (uIElement.Visibility != Visibility.Collapsed && uIElement.Opacity != 0.0)
				{
					double num2 = ((FrameworkElement)uIElement).ActualWidth + buffer;
					double num3 = ((FrameworkElement)uIElement).ActualHeight + buffer;
					double num4 = ((FrameworkElement)uIElement).ActualWidth / 2.0 + buffer;
					double num5 = ((FrameworkElement)uIElement).ActualHeight / 2.0 + buffer;
					double num6 = 0.0;
					double num7 = 0.0;
					num6 = ((Marker)uIElement).PositionX;
					num7 = ((Marker)uIElement).PositionY;
					if (flag)
					{
						if (num6 - num4 <= point.X && num6 + num4 >= point.X && num7 - num5 <= point.Y && num7 + num5 >= point.Y)
						{
							return (Marker)uIElement;
						}
					}
					else if (num6 <= point.X && num6 + num2 >= point.X && num7 <= point.Y && num7 + num3 >= point.Y)
					{
						return (Marker)uIElement;
					}
				}
			}
			return null;
		}

		internal Rect GetBoundingBoxForMarker(Marker marker)
		{
			double actualWidth = marker.ActualWidth;
			double actualHeight = marker.ActualHeight;
			double num = 0.0;
			double num2 = 0.0;
			if (marker.RenderTransform != null)
			{
				TranslateTransform obj = (TranslateTransform)marker.RenderTransform;
				num = obj.X;
				num2 = obj.Y;
			}
			if (false)
			{
				return new Rect(num - actualWidth / 2.0, num2 - actualWidth / 2.0, actualWidth, actualHeight);
			}
			return new Rect(num, num2, actualWidth, actualHeight);
		}

		protected override PathGeometry GetShapeGeometry(int i, List<PointCollection> points)
		{
			return GetShapeGeometry(i, points, fill: true);
		}

		protected internal override void ApplyStyling(FrameworkElement shape, object item, bool shapeStyleOverride)
		{
			base.ApplyStyling(shape, item, shapeStyleOverride);
			ShapeSeriesViewBase.ApplyStyling(this, shape as Path, item);
		}

		protected override void ApplyData(FrameworkElement element, PathGeometry data)
		{
			if (element is Path path)
			{
				path.Data = data;
			}
		}

		internal void DoToAllMarkers(Action<Marker> action)
		{
			Markers.DoToAll(action);
		}

		internal void InitMarkers(HashPool<object, Marker> Markers)
		{
			Markers.Create = MarkerCreate;
			Markers.Destroy = MarkerDestroy;
			Markers.Activate = MarkerActivate;
			Markers.Disactivate = MarkerDisactivate;
		}

		protected internal Marker MarkerCreate()
		{
			Marker marker = new Marker();
			if (!_lightweightMode)
			{
				marker.Content = new DataContext
				{
					Series = Model
				};
			}
			marker.SetBinding(ContentControl.ContentTemplateProperty, new Binding("ActualMarkerTemplate")
			{
				Source = Model
			});
			return marker;
		}

		protected internal void MarkerDestroy(Marker marker)
		{
			marker.Content = null;
			marker.ClearValue(ContentControl.ContentTemplateProperty);
			if (marker.Parent is Panel)
			{
				base.MarkerCanvas.Children.Remove(marker);
			}
		}

		protected internal void MarkerActivate(Marker marker)
		{
			marker.Visibility = Visibility.Visible;
			if (marker.Parent == null)
			{
				base.MarkerCanvas.Children.Add(marker);
			}
		}

		protected internal void MarkerDisactivate(Marker marker)
		{
			if (marker.Content != null)
			{
				(marker.Content as DataContext).Item = null;
			}
			marker.Visibility = Visibility.Collapsed;
		}

		internal void SetUseLightweightMode(bool useLightweight)
		{
			_lightweightMode = useLightweight;
		}

		protected override void ClearValues(FrameworkElement element, bool shapeStyleOverride)
		{
			base.ClearValues(element, shapeStyleOverride);
			element.ClearValue(Shape.FillProperty);
			element.ClearValue(Shape.StrokeProperty);
		}

		internal void ClearActualMarkerTemplate()
		{
			Model.ClearValue(MarkerSeries.ActualMarkerTemplateProperty);
		}

		internal void BindMarkerTemplateToActual()
		{
			Model.ClearValue(ScatterPolygonSeries.ActualMarkerTemplateProperty);
			Model.SetBinding(ScatterPolygonSeries.ActualMarkerTemplateProperty, new Binding("MarkerTemplate")
			{
				Source = Model
			});
		}

		internal void ClearActualMarkerBrush()
		{
			Model.ClearValue(MarkerSeries.ActualMarkerBrushProperty);
		}

		internal void BindMarkerBrushToActual()
		{
			Model.ClearValue(ScatterPolygonSeries.ActualMarkerBrushProperty);
			if (!double.IsNaN(Model.ActualMarkerFillOpacity) && Model.ActualMarkerFillOpacity != 1.0)
			{
				Brush brush = ScatterPolygonSeriesModel.MarkerBrush.ModifyOpacity(Model.ActualMarkerFillOpacity);
				if (Model.ShouldFreezeBrushesCached && brush.CanFreeze)
				{
					brush.Freeze();
				}
				ScatterPolygonSeriesModel.ActualMarkerBrush = brush;
			}
			else
			{
				Model.SetBinding(ScatterPolygonSeries.ActualMarkerBrushProperty, new Binding("MarkerBrush")
				{
					Source = Model
				});
			}
		}

		internal void ClearActualMarkerOutline()
		{
			Model.ClearValue(MarkerSeries.ActualMarkerOutlineProperty);
		}

		internal void BindMarkerOutlineToActual()
		{
			Model.ClearValue(ScatterPolygonSeries.ActualMarkerOutlineProperty);
			Model.SetBinding(ScatterPolygonSeries.ActualMarkerOutlineProperty, new Binding("MarkerOutline")
			{
				Source = Model
			});
		}

		protected internal override void ClearRendering()
		{
			base.ClearRendering();
			Markers.Clear();
		}

		internal void BindActualToMarkerTemplate(string p)
		{
			Model.SetBinding(ScatterPolygonSeries.ActualMarkerTemplateProperty, new Binding(p)
			{
				Source = Model.SeriesViewer
			});
		}

		internal void DoUpdateMarkerTemplates()
		{
			DoToAllMarkers(delegate(Marker m)
			{
				m.ContentTemplate = ScatterPolygonSeriesModel.ActualMarkerTemplate;
				m.UpdateLayout();
			});
		}

		protected internal override void ExportViewShapes(object visualData)
		{
			SeriesVisualData seriesVisualData = (SeriesVisualData)visualData;
			base.ExportViewShapes((object)seriesVisualData);
			foreach (object activeKey in Markers.ActiveKeys)
			{
				Marker marker = Markers[activeKey];
				if (marker.Visibility != Visibility.Collapsed)
				{
					ScatterPolygonSeries scatterPolygonSeries = Model as ScatterPolygonSeries;
					object markerVisualData = Model.SeriesVisualDataManager.GetMarkerVisualData(scatterPolygonSeries, marker, scatterPolygonSeries.ActualMarkerTemplate);
					seriesVisualData.MarkerShapes.Add(markerVisualData as MarkerVisualData);
				}
			}
		}
	}
	public abstract class ShapeSeriesViewBase : SeriesView
	{
		private List<ShapeHitRegion> _shapeHitRegions = new List<ShapeHitRegion>();

		private Style _shapeStyle;

		private StyleSelector _shapeStyleSelector;

		private double[] _boundsLeft;

		private double[] _boundsTop;

		private double[] _boundsRight;

		private double[] _boundsBottom;

		protected internal Dictionary<int, FlattenedShape> MarkerPositions { get; set; }

		private Canvas ShapeCanvas { get; set; }

		protected ShapeSeriesBase ShapeModel { get; set; }

		protected Style ShapeStyle => _shapeStyle;

		public bool HasShapeStyle
		{
			get
			{
				if (_shapeStyle == null)
				{
					return _shapeStyleSelector != null;
				}
				return true;
			}
		}

		internal int ShapeCount { get; set; }

		protected Pool<FrameworkElement> Elements { get; set; }

		internal List<ShapeHitRegion> ShapeHitRegions => _shapeHitRegions;

		protected ShapeSeriesViewBase(ShapeSeriesBase model)
			: base(model)
		{
			ShapeModel = model;
			ShapeCanvas = new Canvas();
			Elements = CreateElementsPool();
			MarkerPositions = new Dictionary<int, FlattenedShape>();
		}

		public override void AttachUI(Canvas rootCanvas)
		{
			AttachShapeCanvas(rootCanvas);
			base.AttachUI(rootCanvas);
			if (base.RootCanvas != null)
			{
				base.RootCanvas.Visibility = Model.Visibility;
			}
		}

		protected virtual void AttachShapeCanvas(Canvas rootCanvas)
		{
			ShapeCanvas.Detach();
			rootCanvas.Children.Add(ShapeCanvas);
		}

		public virtual Marker GetHitMarker(Point point)
		{
			return null;
		}

		protected virtual Pool<FrameworkElement> CreateElementsPool()
		{
			return new Pool<FrameworkElement>
			{
				Create = ElementCreate,
				Activate = ElementActivate,
				Disactivate = ElementDeactivate,
				Destroy = ElementDestroy
			};
		}

		protected internal virtual bool ShouldRenderShape(Rect bounds)
		{
			if (bounds.Width >= ShapeModel.ShapeFilterResolutionCached)
			{
				return bounds.Height >= ShapeModel.ShapeFilterResolutionCached;
			}
			return false;
		}

		public static List<PointCollection> ToPointCollections(List<FlattenedShape> points)
		{
			List<PointCollection> list = new List<PointCollection>();
			int count = points.Count;
			for (int i = 0; i < count; i++)
			{
				FlattenedShape flattenedShape = points[i];
				PointCollection pointCollection = new PointCollection();
				int count2 = flattenedShape.Shape.Count;
				List<Point> shape = flattenedShape.Shape;
				for (int j = 0; j < count2; j++)
				{
					Point value = shape[j];
					pointCollection.Add(value);
				}
				list.Add(pointCollection);
			}
			return list;
		}

		internal void AddShape(int i, object item, Rect bounds, List<FlattenedShape> points)
		{
			if (points == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			List<PointCollection> points2 = ToPointCollections(points);
			bounds.Intersect(base.Viewport);
			if (!ShouldRenderShape(bounds))
			{
				return;
			}
			PathGeometry shapeGeometry = GetShapeGeometry(i, points2);
			if (shapeGeometry != null)
			{
				FrameworkElement shapeElement = GetShapeElement(i, item);
				for (int j = 0; j < points.Count; j++)
				{
					ShapeHitRegion shapeHitRegion = new ShapeHitRegion();
					shapeHitRegion.Bounds = points[j].Bounds;
					shapeHitRegion.Points = points[j].Shape;
					shapeHitRegion.Index = i;
					shapeHitRegion.Element = shapeElement;
					_shapeHitRegions.Add(shapeHitRegion);
				}
				ApplyData(shapeElement, shapeGeometry);
				ShapeCount++;
			}
		}

		protected virtual FrameworkElement GetShapeElement(int i, object item)
		{
			FrameworkElement frameworkElement = Elements[ShapeCount];
			if (frameworkElement.DataContext != null)
			{
				((DataContext)frameworkElement.DataContext).Item = item;
				((DataContext)frameworkElement.DataContext).CachedIndex = i;
			}
			return frameworkElement;
		}

		internal FrameworkElement GetHitShape(Point position, bool isFinger)
		{
			return GetHitShape(position, isFinger, polyline: false);
		}

		internal FrameworkElement GetHitShape(Point position, bool isFinger, bool polyline)
		{
			return GetHitRegion(position, isFinger, polyline)?.Element;
		}

		internal ShapeHitRegion GetHitRegion(Point position, bool isFinger, bool polyline)
		{
			if (_shapeHitRegions.Count == 0)
			{
				return null;
			}
			double x = position.X;
			double y = position.Y;
			int count = _shapeHitRegions.Count;
			List<ShapeHitRegion> shapeHitRegions = _shapeHitRegions;
			ShapeHitRegion shapeHitRegion = null;
			for (int i = 0; i < count; i++)
			{
				shapeHitRegion = shapeHitRegions[i];
				if (shapeHitRegion.Points == null || shapeHitRegion.Points.Count == 0 || !(x >= shapeHitRegion.Bounds.Left) || !(x <= shapeHitRegion.Bounds.Right) || !(y >= shapeHitRegion.Bounds.Top) || !(y <= shapeHitRegion.Bounds.Bottom))
				{
					continue;
				}
				if (polyline)
				{
					double closeness = ShapeModel.ActualThickness / 2.0 + ShapeModel.GetHitTestAllowance(isFinger);
					if (GeometryUtil.IsPointNearPolyline(position, shapeHitRegion.Points[0], shapeHitRegion.Points, closeness))
					{
						return shapeHitRegion;
					}
				}
				else if (PolygonUtil.PolygonContainsPoint(shapeHitRegion.Points, position))
				{
					return shapeHitRegion;
				}
			}
			return null;
		}

		protected abstract void ApplyData(FrameworkElement element, PathGeometry data);

		internal static void ApplyStyling(ShapeSeriesViewBase view, Path shape, object item)
		{
			if (shape.Fill == null)
			{
				shape.Fill = view.Model.ActualBrush;
			}
			if (shape.Stroke == null)
			{
				shape.Stroke = view.Model.ActualOutline;
			}
			bool flag = true;
			if (shape.Style != null)
			{
				foreach (SetterBase setter2 in shape.Style.Setters)
				{
					if (setter2 is Setter setter && (setter.Property.Name == "StrokeThickness" || setter.Property.Name == "BorderThickness"))
					{
						flag = false;
						break;
					}
				}
			}
			if (flag)
			{
				shape.StrokeThickness = view.Model.ActualThickness;
			}
		}

		public void DoToActiveElements(Action<FrameworkElement> act)
		{
			for (int i = 0; i < Elements.Active.Count; i++)
			{
				FrameworkElement obj = Elements.Active[i];
				act(obj);
			}
		}

		protected internal virtual void ApplyStyling(FrameworkElement shape, object item, bool shapeStyleOverride)
		{
			if (shape != null)
			{
				if (_shapeStyle != null || _shapeStyleSelector != null || !shapeStyleOverride)
				{
					ClearValues(shape, shapeStyleOverride);
				}
				Style style = null;
				if (_shapeStyleSelector != null)
				{
					style = _shapeStyleSelector.SelectStyle(item, shape);
				}
				if (style == null)
				{
					style = _shapeStyle;
				}
				if (shape.Style != style)
				{
					shape.Style = style;
				}
			}
		}

		protected virtual void ClearValues(FrameworkElement element, bool shapeStyleOverride)
		{
			element.ClearValue(FrameworkElement.StyleProperty);
		}

		protected abstract PathGeometry GetShapeGeometry(int i, List<PointCollection> points);

		protected internal virtual void InitializeShapes()
		{
			ShapeCount = 0;
		}

		protected internal virtual void FinalizeShapes()
		{
			Elements.Count = ShapeCount;
		}

		protected internal virtual void ClearRendering()
		{
			Elements.Count = 0;
		}

		internal FrameworkElement ElementCreate()
		{
			ShapeSeriesBase shapeModel = ShapeModel;
			Path path = new Path
			{
				DataContext = new DataContext
				{
					Series = shapeModel
				}
			};
			path.Detach();
			ShapeCanvas.Children.Add(path);
			return path;
		}

		internal void ElementActivate(FrameworkElement path)
		{
			path.Visibility = Visibility.Visible;
		}

		internal void ElementDeactivate(FrameworkElement path)
		{
			(path.DataContext as DataContext).Item = null;
			path.Visibility = Visibility.Collapsed;
		}

		internal void ElementDestroy(FrameworkElement path)
		{
			if (path.Parent is Panel)
			{
				ShapeCanvas.Children.Remove(path);
			}
		}

		protected internal PathGeometry GetShapeGeometry(int i, List<PointCollection> points, bool fill)
		{
			if (points == null)
			{
				return null;
			}
			PathGeometry pathGeometry = new PathGeometry();
			foreach (PointCollection point in points)
			{
				if (point.Count != 0 && (!fill || point.Count >= 3))
				{
					PolyLineSegment value = new PolyLineSegment
					{
						Points = point
					};
					PathFigure pathFigure = new PathFigure();
					pathFigure.IsFilled = fill;
					pathFigure.IsClosed = fill;
					pathFigure.StartPoint = point[0];
					pathFigure.Segments.Add(value);
					pathGeometry.Figures.Add(pathFigure);
				}
			}
			return pathGeometry;
		}

		internal void ShapeStyleSelectorChanged(StyleSelector styleSelector)
		{
			_shapeStyleSelector = styleSelector;
		}

		internal void ShapeStyleChanged(Style shapeStyle)
		{
			_shapeStyle = shapeStyle;
		}

		internal void ProvideBounds(double[] boundsLeft, double[] boundsTop, double[] boundsRight, double[] boundsBottom)
		{
			_boundsLeft = boundsLeft;
			_boundsTop = boundsTop;
			_boundsRight = boundsRight;
			_boundsBottom = boundsBottom;
			_shapeHitRegions.Clear();
		}

		internal virtual void UpdateClipRect()
		{
			Rect viewport = base.Viewport;
			Path path = new Path
			{
				Style = _shapeStyle
			};
			ShapeModel.ClipRect = viewport.Inflate(path.StrokeThickness);
		}

		public override void VisibilityChanged()
		{
			base.VisibilityChanged();
			if (base.RootCanvas != null)
			{
				base.RootCanvas.Visibility = Model.Visibility;
			}
		}

		protected internal override void ExportViewShapes(object svd)
		{
			if (Elements.Active == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			for (int i = 0; i < Elements.Active.Count; i++)
			{
				Path path = Elements.Active[i] as Path;
				if (path.Visibility != Visibility.Collapsed)
				{
					Model.SeriesVisualDataManager.ExportPathData(svd, path, "shape" + i, new string[1] { "Main " });
				}
			}
		}
	}
	internal class ShapeHitRegion
	{
		public Rect Bounds;

		public List<Point> Points;

		public int Index;

		public FrameworkElement Element;
	}
	public class StringToVisibilityConverter : IValueConverter
	{
		public object Convert(object value, Type targetType, object parameter, CultureInfo culture)
		{
			if (value == null)
			{
				return Visibility.Collapsed;
			}
			if (value is string && string.IsNullOrEmpty((string)value))
			{
				return Visibility.Collapsed;
			}
			return Visibility.Visible;
		}

		public object ConvertBack(object value, Type targetType, object parameter, CultureInfo culture)
		{
			throw new NotImplementedException();
		}
	}

	internal class ColumnFragmentView : AnchoredCategorySeriesView
	{
		[Weak]
		internal ColumnFragment ColumnFragmentModel { get; private set; }

		internal Pool<Rectangle> Columns { get; set; }

		internal List<double> High { get; set; }

		internal List<double> Low { get; set; }

		public ColumnFragmentView(ColumnFragment model)
			: base(model)
		{
			ColumnFragmentModel = model;
			High = new List<double>();
			Low = new List<double>();
			Columns = new Pool<Rectangle>
			{
				Create = ColumnCreate,
				Activate = ColumnActivate,
				Disactivate = ColumnDisactivate,
				Destroy = ColumnDestroy
			};
		}

		private Rectangle ColumnCreate()
		{
			return new Rectangle
			{
				DataContext = new DataContext
				{
					Series = Model
				}
			};
		}

		private void ColumnActivate(Rectangle column)
		{
			if (base.RootCanvas != null)
			{
				column.Detach();
				base.RootCanvas.Children.Add(column);
			}
		}

		private void ColumnDisactivate(Rectangle column)
		{
			if (base.RootCanvas != null)
			{
				(column.DataContext as DataContext).Item = null;
				if (column.Parent is Panel)
				{
					base.RootCanvas.Children.Remove(column);
				}
			}
		}

		private void ColumnDestroy(Rectangle column)
		{
			column.ClearValue(Shape.FillProperty);
			column.ClearValue(Shape.StrokeProperty);
			column.ClearValue(Shape.StrokeThicknessProperty);
			column.ClearValue(Shape.StrokeDashCapProperty);
			column.ClearValue(Rectangle.RadiusXProperty);
			column.ClearValue(Rectangle.RadiusYProperty);
		}

		internal void PositionRectangle(Rectangle column, double left, double top)
		{
			column.RenderTransform = new TranslateTransform
			{
				X = left,
				Y = top
			};
		}

		public override void AttachUI(Canvas rootCanvas)
		{
			base.AttachUI(rootCanvas);
		}

		protected internal override void OnTemplateProvided()
		{
			base.OnTemplateProvided();
			if (ColumnFragmentModel.ParentSeries != null && ColumnFragmentModel.ParentSeries.MarkerCanvas != null)
			{
				SetMarkerCanvas(ColumnFragmentModel.ParentSeries.MarkerCanvas);
			}
			Model.RenderSeries(animate: false);
		}

		protected internal override void OnSeriesDetached()
		{
			base.OnSeriesDetached();
			base.Markers.Count = 0;
			base.Markers.DoToAll(delegate(Marker m)
			{
				if (base.MarkerCanvas != null && base.MarkerCanvas.Children.Contains(m))
				{
					base.MarkerCanvas.Children.Remove(m);
				}
			});
			base.Markers.Active.Clear();
			base.Markers.Inactive.Clear();
		}

		protected internal override void OnSeriesAttached()
		{
			base.OnSeriesAttached();
			Model.RenderSeries(animate: false);
		}

		protected internal override void ExportViewShapes(object svd)
		{
			base.ExportViewShapes(svd);
			int num = 0;
			List<Rectangle> list = new List<Rectangle>();
			foreach (Rectangle item in Columns.Active)
			{
				list.Add(item);
			}
			list.Sort(delegate(Rectangle c1, Rectangle c2)
			{
				TranslateTransform translateTransform = c1.RenderTransform as TranslateTransform;
				TranslateTransform translateTransform2 = c2.RenderTransform as TranslateTransform;
				if (translateTransform == null || translateTransform2 == null)
				{
					return 0;
				}
				if (translateTransform.X < translateTransform2.X)
				{
					return -1;
				}
				return (translateTransform.X > translateTransform2.X) ? 1 : 0;
			});
			foreach (Rectangle item2 in list)
			{
				Model.SeriesVisualDataManager.ExportRectangleData(svd, item2, "column" + num, new string[2] { "Main", "Fill" });
			}
			num++;
		}
	}
