	internal class StackedSeriesManager
	{
		internal StackedSeriesBase ParentSeries { get; set; }

		internal ObservableCollection<AnchoredCategorySeries> SeriesVisual { get; set; }

		internal StackedSeriesCollection SeriesLogical { get; set; }

		internal ObservableCollection<AnchoredCategorySeries> PositiveSeries { get; set; }

		internal ObservableCollection<AnchoredCategorySeries> NegativeSeries { get; set; }

		internal Canvas PlotArea { get; set; }

		internal Grid SeriesPanel { get; set; }

		internal StackedSeriesManager(StackedSeriesBase parent)
		{
			StackedSeriesManager stackedSeriesManager = this;
			if (parent == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			ParentSeries = parent;
			SeriesVisual = new ObservableCollection<AnchoredCategorySeries>();
			SeriesLogical = new StackedSeriesCollection();
			PositiveSeries = new ObservableCollection<AnchoredCategorySeries>();
			NegativeSeries = new ObservableCollection<AnchoredCategorySeries>();
			PlotArea = parent.StackedView.PlotArea;
			SeriesPanel = parent.StackedView.SeriesPanel;
			SeriesLogical.CollectionChanged += delegate(object o, NotifyCollectionChangedEventArgs e)
			{
				if (e.OldItems != null)
				{
					foreach (StackedFragmentSeries oldItem in e.OldItems)
					{
						if (SeriesVisual.Contains(oldItem.VisualSeriesLink))
						{
							SeriesVisual.Remove(oldItem.VisualSeriesLink);
						}
					}
				}
				if (e.NewItems != null)
				{
					int num = e.NewStartingIndex;
					foreach (StackedFragmentSeries newItem in e.NewItems)
					{
						AnchoredCategorySeries item = CreateSeries(newItem);
						SeriesVisual.Insert(num, item);
						num++;
					}
				}
			};
			SeriesVisual.CollectionChanged += delegate(object o, NotifyCollectionChangedEventArgs e)
			{
				if (e.OldItems != null)
				{
					foreach (AnchoredCategorySeries oldItem2 in e.OldItems)
					{
						oldItem2.ClearRendering(wipeClean: true, oldItem2.View);
						oldItem2.SeriesViewer = null;
						oldItem2.SyncLink = null;
						oldItem2.ItemsSource = null;
						oldItem2.Legend = null;
						if (stackedSeriesManager.SeriesPanel != null && stackedSeriesManager.SeriesPanel.Children.Contains(oldItem2))
						{
							stackedSeriesManager.SeriesPanel.Children.Remove(oldItem2);
						}
					}
				}
				if (e.NewItems != null)
				{
					foreach (AnchoredCategorySeries newItem2 in e.NewItems)
					{
						newItem2.SeriesViewer = parent.SeriesViewer;
						newItem2.SyncLink = parent.SyncLink;
						if (!stackedSeriesManager.SeriesPanel.Children.Contains(newItem2))
						{
							stackedSeriesManager.SeriesPanel.Children.Add(newItem2);
						}
					}
				}
				stackedSeriesManager.RenderSeries();
			};
		}

		internal AnchoredCategorySeries CreateSeries(StackedFragmentSeries seriesFragment)
		{
			if (ParentSeries.IsStacked && ParentSeries.IsLineOnly)
			{
				LineFragment lineFragment = new LineFragment();
				lineFragment.ParentSeries = ParentSeries;
				seriesFragment.VisualSeriesLink = lineFragment;
				lineFragment.LogicalSeriesLink = seriesFragment;
				SetSeriesBindings(lineFragment, seriesFragment);
				return lineFragment;
			}
			if (ParentSeries.IsStacked && ParentSeries.IsColumn)
			{
				ColumnFragment columnFragment = new ColumnFragment();
				columnFragment.ParentSeries = ParentSeries;
				seriesFragment.VisualSeriesLink = columnFragment;
				columnFragment.LogicalSeriesLink = seriesFragment;
				SetSeriesBindings(columnFragment, seriesFragment);
				return columnFragment;
			}
			if (ParentSeries.IsStacked && ParentSeries.IsBar)
			{
				BarFragment barFragment = new BarFragment();
				barFragment.ParentSeries = ParentSeries as StackedBarSeries;
				seriesFragment.VisualSeriesLink = barFragment;
				barFragment.LogicalSeriesLink = seriesFragment;
				SetSeriesBindings(barFragment, seriesFragment);
				return barFragment;
			}
			if (ParentSeries.IsStacked && ParentSeries.IsArea && !ParentSeries.IsSpline)
			{
				AreaFragment areaFragment = new AreaFragment();
				areaFragment.ParentSeries = ParentSeries;
				seriesFragment.VisualSeriesLink = areaFragment;
				areaFragment.LogicalSeriesLink = seriesFragment;
				SetSeriesBindings(areaFragment, seriesFragment);
				return areaFragment;
			}
			if (ParentSeries.IsStacked && ParentSeries.IsSpline && !ParentSeries.IsArea)
			{
				SplineFragment splineFragment = new SplineFragment();
				splineFragment.ParentSeries = ParentSeries;
				seriesFragment.VisualSeriesLink = splineFragment;
				splineFragment.LogicalSeriesLink = seriesFragment;
				SetSeriesBindings(splineFragment, seriesFragment);
				return splineFragment;
			}
			if (ParentSeries.IsStacked && ParentSeries.IsSpline && ParentSeries.IsArea)
			{
				SplineAreaFragment splineAreaFragment = new SplineAreaFragment();
				splineAreaFragment.ParentSeries = ParentSeries;
				seriesFragment.VisualSeriesLink = splineAreaFragment;
				splineAreaFragment.LogicalSeriesLink = seriesFragment;
				SetSeriesBindings(splineAreaFragment, seriesFragment);
				return splineAreaFragment;
			}
			return null;
		}

		private void SetSeriesBindings(AnchoredCategorySeries visualSeries, StackedFragmentSeries logicalSeries)
		{
			if (logicalSeries.ItemsSource == null)
			{
				visualSeries.ItemsSource = ParentSeries.ItemsSource;
			}
			else
			{
				visualSeries.ItemsSource = logicalSeries.ItemsSource;
			}
			visualSeries.SetBinding(Series.BrushProperty, new Binding("ParentOrLocalBrush")
			{
				Source = logicalSeries
			});
			visualSeries.SetBinding(FrameworkElement.CursorProperty, new Binding("ActualCursor")
			{
				Source = logicalSeries
			});
			visualSeries.SetBinding(UIElement.EffectProperty, new Binding("ActualEffect")
			{
				Source = logicalSeries
			});
			visualSeries.SetBinding(Series.IsDropShadowEnabledProperty, new Binding("ActualIsDropShadowEnabled")
			{
				Source = logicalSeries
			});
			visualSeries.SetBinding(Series.ShadowBlurProperty, new Binding("ActualShadowBlur")
			{
				Source = logicalSeries
			});
			visualSeries.SetBinding(Series.ShadowColorProperty, new Binding("ActualShadowColor")
			{
				Source = logicalSeries
			});
			visualSeries.SetBinding(Series.ShadowDirectionProperty, new Binding("ActualShadowDirection")
			{
				Source = logicalSeries
			});
			visualSeries.SetBinding(Series.ShadowOpacityProperty, new Binding("ActualShadowOpacity")
			{
				Source = logicalSeries
			});
			visualSeries.SetBinding(Series.ShadowDepthProperty, new Binding("ActualShadowDepth")
			{
				Source = logicalSeries
			});
			visualSeries.SetBinding(Series.ShowDefaultTooltipProperty, new Binding("ActualShowDefaultTooltip")
			{
				Source = logicalSeries
			});
			visualSeries.SetBinding(Series.DashArrayProperty, new Binding("ActualDashArray")
			{
				Source = logicalSeries
			});
			visualSeries.SetBinding(Series.DashCapProperty, new Binding("ActualDashCap")
			{
				Source = logicalSeries
			});
			visualSeries.SetBinding(Series.EndCapProperty, new Binding("ActualEndCap")
			{
				Source = logicalSeries
			});
			visualSeries.SetBinding(UIElement.IsHitTestVisibleProperty, new Binding("ActualIsHitTestVisible")
			{
				Source = logicalSeries
			});
			visualSeries.SetBinding(Series.LegendProperty, new Binding("ActualLegend")
			{
				Source = ParentSeries
			});
			if (logicalSeries.ActualLegendItemBadgeTemplate != null || logicalSeries.LegendItemBadgeTemplate != null)
			{
				logicalSeries.UpdateLegendItemBadgeTemplate();
			}
			if (logicalSeries.ActualLegendItemTemplate != null || logicalSeries.LegendItemTemplate != null)
			{
				logicalSeries.UpdateLegendItemTemplate();
			}
			visualSeries.SetBinding(Series.LegendItemVisibilityProperty, new Binding("ActualLegendItemVisibility")
			{
				Source = logicalSeries
			});
			visualSeries.SetBinding(Series.LineJoinProperty, new Binding("LineJoin")
			{
				Source = ParentSeries
			});
			visualSeries.SetBinding(MarkerSeries.MarkerBrushProperty, new Binding("ActualMarkerBrush")
			{
				Source = logicalSeries
			});
			visualSeries.SetBinding(MarkerSeries.MarkerOutlineProperty, new Binding("ActualMarkerOutline")
			{
				Source = logicalSeries
			});
			visualSeries.SetBinding(MarkerSeries.MarkerStyleProperty, new Binding("ActualMarkerStyle")
			{
				Source = logicalSeries
			});
			visualSeries.SetBinding(MarkerSeries.MarkerTemplateProperty, new Binding("ActualMarkerTemplate")
			{
				Source = logicalSeries
			});
			visualSeries.SetBinding(MarkerSeries.MarkerTypeProperty, new Binding("ActualMarkerType")
			{
				Source = logicalSeries
			});
			visualSeries.SetBinding(MarkerSeries.MarkerThicknessProperty, new Binding("ActualMarkerThickness")
			{
				Source = logicalSeries
			});
			visualSeries.SetBinding(Series.MiterLimitProperty, new Binding("MiterLimit")
			{
				Source = ParentSeries
			});
			visualSeries.SetBinding(UIElement.OpacityProperty, new Binding("Opacity")
			{
				Source = logicalSeries
			});
			visualSeries.SetBinding(Series.HighlightingFadeOpacityProperty, new Binding("ActualHighlightingFadeOpacity")
			{
				Source = logicalSeries
			});
			visualSeries.SetBinding(Series.MarkerFillOpacityProperty, new Binding("ActualMarkerFillOpacity")
			{
				Source = logicalSeries
			});
			visualSeries.SetBinding(Series.OutlineModeProperty, new Binding("ActualOutlineMode")
			{
				Source = logicalSeries
			});
			visualSeries.SetBinding(UIElement.OpacityMaskProperty, new Binding("OpacityMask")
			{
				Source = logicalSeries
			});
			visualSeries.SetBinding(Series.OutlineProperty, new Binding("ActualOutline")
			{
				Source = logicalSeries
			});
			visualSeries.SetBinding(Series.ResolutionProperty, new Binding("Resolution")
			{
				Source = ParentSeries
			});
			visualSeries.SetBinding(Series.StartCapProperty, new Binding("ActualStartCap")
			{
				Source = logicalSeries
			});
			visualSeries.SetBinding(Series.ThicknessProperty, new Binding("ActualThickness")
			{
				Source = logicalSeries
			});
			visualSeries.SetBinding(Series.TitleProperty, new Binding("Title")
			{
				Source = logicalSeries
			});
			visualSeries.SetBinding(Series.ToolTipProperty, new Binding("ActualToolTip")
			{
				Source = logicalSeries
			});
			visualSeries.SetBinding(MarkerSeries.UseLightweightMarkersProperty, new Binding("ActualUseLightweightMarkers")
			{
				Source = logicalSeries
			});
			visualSeries.SetBinding(AnchoredCategorySeries.ValueMemberPathProperty, new Binding("ValueMemberPath")
			{
				Source = logicalSeries
			});
			visualSeries.SetBinding(UIElement.VisibilityProperty, new Binding("ActualVisibility")
			{
				Source = logicalSeries
			});
			if (visualSeries is AreaFragment)
			{
				visualSeries.SetBinding(Series.AreaFillOpacityProperty, new Binding("ActualAreaFillOpacity")
				{
					Source = logicalSeries
				});
			}
			if (visualSeries is SplineAreaFragment)
			{
				visualSeries.SetBinding(Series.AreaFillOpacityProperty, new Binding("ActualAreaFillOpacity")
				{
					Source = logicalSeries
				});
			}
			if (visualSeries is ColumnFragment)
			{
				visualSeries.SetBinding(ColumnFragment.RadiusXProperty, new Binding("ActualRadiusX")
				{
					Source = logicalSeries
				});
				visualSeries.SetBinding(ColumnFragment.RadiusYProperty, new Binding("ActualRadiusY")
				{
					Source = logicalSeries
				});
			}
			if (visualSeries is BarFragment)
			{
				visualSeries.SetBinding(ColumnFragment.RadiusXProperty, new Binding("ActualRadiusX")
				{
					Source = logicalSeries
				});
				visualSeries.SetBinding(ColumnFragment.RadiusYProperty, new Binding("ActualRadiusY")
				{
					Source = logicalSeries
				});
			}
		}

		internal void RenderSeries()
		{
			PositiveSeries.Clear();
			NegativeSeries.Clear();
			foreach (AnchoredCategorySeries item in SeriesVisual)
			{
				item.ThumbnailDirty = true;
				item.SeriesViewer = ParentSeries.SeriesViewer;
				item.SyncLink = ParentSeries.SyncLink;
				item.Index = ParentSeries.GetFragmentSeriesIndex(SeriesLogical[SeriesVisual.IndexOf(item)]);
				Panel.SetZIndex(item, SeriesVisual.Count - item.Index);
				if (SeriesLogical[SeriesVisual.IndexOf(item)].Positive)
				{
					PositiveSeries.Add(item);
				}
				else
				{
					NegativeSeries.Add(item);
				}
				if ((ParentSeries.IsStacked && ParentSeries.IsLineOnly) || (ParentSeries.IsStacked && ParentSeries.IsArea) || (ParentSeries.IsStacked && ParentSeries.IsSpline))
				{
					item.SetXAxis(ParentSeries.GetXAxis());
					item.SetYAxis(ParentSeries.GetYAxis());
				}
				item.RenderSeries(animate: false);
			}
		}
	}
	internal class StackedSeriesView : CategorySeriesView
	{
		private readonly Canvas _plotArea = new Canvas();

		private readonly Grid _seriesPanel = new Grid();

		internal StackedSeriesBase StackedModel { get; private set; }

		protected internal Canvas PlotArea => _plotArea;

		protected internal Grid SeriesPanel => _seriesPanel;

		protected internal override void HideTooltip()
		{
			base.HideTooltip();
			for (int i = 0; i < StackedModel.StackedSeriesManager.SeriesVisual.Count; i++)
			{
				StackedModel.StackedSeriesManager.SeriesVisual[i].View.HideTooltip();
			}
		}

		public StackedSeriesView(StackedSeriesBase model)
			: base(model)
		{
			StackedModel = model;
		}

		internal override CategoryBucketCalculator CreateBucketCalculator()
		{
			return new StackedBucketCalculator(this);
		}

		public override void OnInit()
		{
			base.OnInit();
			Model.SetBinding(StackedSeriesBase.SeriesVisibilityProperty, new Binding("Visibility")
			{
				Source = Model
			});
			Model.SetBinding(StackedSeriesBase.SeriesCursorProperty, new Binding("Cursor")
			{
				Source = Model
			});
			Model.SetBinding(StackedSeriesBase.SeriesEffectProperty, new Binding("Effect")
			{
				Source = Model
			});
			StackedModel.Loaded += delegate
			{
				StackedModel.GenerateSeries();
			};
		}

		protected internal override void OnTemplateProvided()
		{
			base.OnTemplateProvided();
			if (Model.RootCanvas != null)
			{
				if (!Model.RootCanvas.Children.Contains(PlotArea))
				{
					Model.RootCanvas.Children.Add(PlotArea);
				}
				if (!Model.RootCanvas.Children.Contains(SeriesPanel))
				{
					Model.RootCanvas.Children.Add(SeriesPanel);
				}
				Model.RootCanvas.SizeChanged += delegate(object o, SizeChangedEventArgs e)
				{
					SeriesPanel.Width = e.NewSize.Width;
					SeriesPanel.Height = e.NewSize.Height;
				};
			}
		}
	}

	public abstract class ConditionalStyleRule : DependencyObject
	{
		public Style StyleToApply { get; set; }

		public abstract Style EvaluateCondition(object item);
	}
	public class ConditionalStyleSelector : StyleSelector
	{
		public ObservableCollection<ConditionalStyleRule> Rules { get; set; }

		public ConditionalStyleSelector()
		{
			Rules = new ObservableCollection<ConditionalStyleRule>();
		}

		public override Style SelectStyle(object item, DependencyObject container)
		{
			foreach (ConditionalStyleRule rule in Rules)
			{
				Style style = rule.EvaluateCondition(item);
				if (style != null)
				{
					return style;
				}
			}
			return base.SelectStyle(item, container);
		}
	}
	public class EqualToConditionalStyleRule : PropertyValueConditionalStyleRule
	{
		private const string ComparisonValuePropertyName = "ComparisonValue";

		public static readonly DependencyProperty ComparisonValueProperty = DependencyProperty.Register("ComparisonValue", typeof(object), typeof(EqualToConditionalStyleRule), new PropertyMetadata(null, delegate
		{
		}));

		public object ComparisonValue
		{
			get
			{
				return GetValue(ComparisonValueProperty);
			}
			set
			{
				SetValue(ComparisonValueProperty, value);
			}
		}

		public override bool EvaluateConditionAgainstPropertyValue(object value)
		{
			if (ComparisonValue == null)
			{
				return value == null;
			}
			return ComparisonValue.Equals(value);
		}
	}
	public abstract class PropertyValueConditionalStyleRule : ConditionalStyleRule
	{
		private const string ValueMemberPathPropertyName = "ValueMemberPath";

		public static readonly DependencyProperty ValueMemberPathProperty = DependencyProperty.Register("ValueMemberPath", typeof(string), typeof(PropertyValueConditionalStyleRule), new PropertyMetadata(null, delegate
		{
		}));

		public string ValueMemberPath
		{
			get
			{
				return GetValue(ValueMemberPathProperty) as string;
			}
			set
			{
				SetValue(ValueMemberPathProperty, value);
			}
		}

		public override Style EvaluateCondition(object item)
		{
			object propertyValue = new FastReflectionHelper
			{
				PropertyName = ValueMemberPath
			}.GetPropertyValue(item);
			if (EvaluateConditionAgainstPropertyValue(propertyValue))
			{
				return base.StyleToApply;
			}
			return null;
		}

		public abstract bool EvaluateConditionAgainstPropertyValue(object value);
	}
	public class RandomFillStyleSelector : StyleSelector
	{
		public BrushCollection Brushes { get; set; }

		public RandomFillStyleSelector()
		{
			Brushes = new BrushCollection();
		}

		public override Style SelectStyle(object item, DependencyObject container)
		{
			if (Brushes != null && Brushes.Count > 0)
			{
				Style obj = new Style
				{
					TargetType = typeof(Path)
				};
				Brush value = Brushes[new Random(item.GetHashCode()).Next(0, Brushes.Count)];
				obj.Setters.Add(new Setter(Shape.FillProperty, value));
				return obj;
			}
			return base.SelectStyle(item, container);
		}
	}
	public class RandomSelectStyleSelector : StyleSelector
	{
		public ObservableCollection<Style> Styles { get; set; }

		public RandomSelectStyleSelector()
		{
			Styles = new ObservableCollection<Style>();
		}

		public override Style SelectStyle(object item, DependencyObject container)
		{
			if (Styles.Count > 0)
			{
				return Styles[new Random(item.GetHashCode()).Next(0, Styles.Count)];
			}
			return base.SelectStyle(item, container);
		}
	}
	internal class BrushOpacifyingConverter : IValueConverter
	{
		private Color Opacify(Color color)
		{
			return Color.FromArgb(byte.MaxValue, color.R, color.G, color.B);
		}

		private Brush Opacify(Brush brush)
		{
			Brush brush2 = brush.Duplicate();
			if (brush2 is SolidColorBrush solidColorBrush)
			{
				solidColorBrush.Color = Opacify(solidColorBrush.Color);
				return solidColorBrush;
			}
			if (brush2 is GradientBrush gradientBrush)
			{
				{
					foreach (GradientStop gradientStop in gradientBrush.GradientStops)
					{
						gradientStop.Color = Opacify(gradientStop.Color);
					}
					return gradientBrush;
				}
			}
			return brush2;
		}

		public object Convert(object value, Type targetType, object parameter, CultureInfo culture)
		{
			if (!(value is Brush))
			{
				return value;
			}
			return Opacify((Brush)value);
		}

		public object ConvertBack(object value, Type targetType, object parameter, CultureInfo culture)
		{
			return value;
		}
	}
	public class DoubleCollectionDuplicator : IValueConverter
	{
		public object Convert(object value, Type targetType, object parameter, CultureInfo culture)
		{
			if (value != null && value is DoubleCollection && targetType == typeof(DoubleCollection))
			{
				return (value as DoubleCollection).Duplicate();
			}
			return null;
		}

		public object ConvertBack(object value, Type targetType, object parameter, CultureInfo culture)
		{
			if (value != null && value is DoubleCollection && targetType == typeof(DoubleCollection))
			{
				return (value as DoubleCollection).Duplicate();
			}
			return null;
		}
	}

	internal class FunnelFrame
	{

		private bool _outerLabelsShown;

		private bool _outerAlignedLeft;

		private SliceInfoList _slices;

		{

		public SliceInfoList Slices
		{

			}

			}
		}

		public double OuterLabelWidth
		{
			get
			{
				return _outerLabelWidth;
			}
			set
			{
				_outerLabelWidth = value;
			}
		}

		public FunnelFrame()
		{
			Slices = new SliceInfoList();
		}

		internal static void Interpolate(FunnelFrame interpolatedFrame, FunnelFrame previousFrame, FunnelFrame nextFrame, double p)
		{
			double num = 1.0 - p;
			interpolatedFrame.InnerLabelsShown = nextFrame.InnerLabelsShown;
			interpolatedFrame.OuterAlignedLeft = nextFrame.OuterAlignedLeft;
			interpolatedFrame.OuterLabelsShown = nextFrame.OuterLabelsShown;
			interpolatedFrame.OuterLabelWidth = previousFrame.OuterLabelWidth * num + nextFrame.OuterLabelWidth * p;
			int count = previousFrame.Slices.Count;
			int count2 = nextFrame.Slices.Count;
			int num2 = Math.Max(count, count2);
			if (interpolatedFrame.Slices.Count < num2)
			{
				interpolatedFrame.Slices.InsertRange(interpolatedFrame.Slices.Count, new SliceInfo[num2 - interpolatedFrame.Slices.Count]);
			}
			if (interpolatedFrame.Slices.Count > num2)
			{
				interpolatedFrame.Slices.RemoveRange(num2, interpolatedFrame.Slices.Count - num2);
			}
			for (int i = 0; i < Math.Min(count, count2); i++)
			{
				interpolatedFrame.Slices[i] = SliceInfo.Interpolate(interpolatedFrame.Slices[i], previousFrame.Slices[i], nextFrame.Slices[i], p, num);
			}
			if (count < count2)
			{
				SliceInfo min = ((count > 0) ? previousFrame.Slices[count - 1] : new SliceInfo());
				for (int j = count; j < count2; j++)
				{
					interpolatedFrame.Slices[j] = SliceInfo.Interpolate(interpolatedFrame.Slices[j], min, nextFrame.Slices[j], p, num);
				}
			}
			if (count > count2)
			{
				SliceInfo max = ((count2 > 0) ? nextFrame.Slices[count2 - 1] : new SliceInfo());
				for (int k = count2; k < count; k++)
				{
					interpolatedFrame.Slices[k] = SliceInfo.Interpolate(interpolatedFrame.Slices[k], previousFrame.Slices[k], max, p, num);
				}
			}
		}
	}

		private void UpdatePoints()
		{
			PointCollection pointCollection = new PointCollection();
			if (RightBezierPoints != null)
			{
				foreach (Point rightBezierPoint in RightBezierPoints)
				{
					pointCollection.Add(rightBezierPoint);
				}
			}
			else
			{
				pointCollection.Add(UpperLeft);
				pointCollection.Add(UpperRight);
			}
			if (BezierPoints != null)
			{
				foreach (Point bezierPoint in BezierPoints)
				{
					pointCollection.Add(bezierPoint);
				}
				if (RightBezierPoints != null && RightBezierPoints.Count > 0)
				{
					pointCollection.Add(RightBezierPoints[0]);
				}
			}
			else
			{
				pointCollection.Add(LowerRight);
				pointCollection.Add(LowerLeft);
				pointCollection.Add(UpperLeft);
			}
			Points = pointCollection;
		}

		internal static SliceAppearance Interpolate([SwiftMutableParameter] SliceAppearance interpolated, SliceAppearance min, SliceAppearance max, double p, double q)
		{
			if (interpolated == null)
			{
				interpolated = new SliceAppearance();
			}
			interpolated.Fill = max.Fill;
			interpolated.HasInnerLabel = max.HasInnerLabel;
			interpolated.InnerLabel = max.InnerLabel;
			if (min.HasInnerLabel && max.HasInnerLabel)
			{
				interpolated.InnerLabelPosition = new Point(min.InnerLabelPosition.X * q + max.InnerLabelPosition.X * p, min.InnerLabelPosition.Y * q + max.InnerLabelPosition.Y * p);
			}
			else if (max.HasInnerLabel)
			{
				interpolated.InnerLabelPosition = new Point(max.InnerLabelPosition.X * p, max.InnerLabelPosition.Y * p);
			}
			interpolated.InnerLabelTemplate = max.InnerLabelTemplate;
			interpolated.LowerLeft = new Point(min.LowerLeft.X * q + max.LowerLeft.X * p, min.LowerLeft.Y * q + max.LowerLeft.Y * p);
			interpolated.LowerRight = new Point(min.LowerRight.X * q + max.LowerRight.X * p, min.LowerRight.Y * q + max.LowerRight.Y * p);
			interpolated.UpperLeft = new Point(min.UpperLeft.X * q + max.UpperLeft.X * p, min.UpperLeft.Y * q + max.UpperLeft.Y * p);
			interpolated.UpperRight = new Point(min.UpperRight.X * q + max.UpperRight.X * p, min.UpperRight.Y * q + max.UpperRight.Y * p);
			interpolated.Offset = new Point(min.Offset.X * q + max.Offset.X * p, min.Offset.Y * q + max.Offset.Y * p);
			if (max.BezierPoints != null)
			{
				PointList pointList = min.BezierPoints;
				if (pointList == null)
				{
					pointList = new PointList();
					pointList.Add(min.UpperLeft);
					pointList.Add(min.LowerLeft);
				}
				interpolated.BezierPoints = InterpolatePoints(interpolated.BezierPoints, pointList, max.BezierPoints, p, q);
			}
			else
			{
				interpolated.BezierPoints = null;
			}
			if (max.RightBezierPoints != null)
			{
				PointList pointList2 = min.RightBezierPoints;
				if (pointList2 == null)
				{
					pointList2 = new PointList();
					pointList2.Add(min.LowerRight);
					pointList2.Add(min.UpperRight);
				}
				interpolated.RightBezierPoints = InterpolatePoints(interpolated.RightBezierPoints, pointList2, max.RightBezierPoints, p, q);
			}
			else
			{
				interpolated.RightBezierPoints = null;
			}
			interpolated.Outline = max.Outline;
			interpolated.Style = max.Style;
			interpolated.Item = max.Item;
			interpolated.Index = max.Index;
			return interpolated;
		}

		private static PointList InterpolatePoints([SwiftMutableParameter] PointList interpolatedPoints, [SwiftMutableParameter] PointList minPoints, PointList maxPoints, double p, double q)
		{
			if (interpolatedPoints == null)
			{
				interpolatedPoints = new PointList();
			}
			if (minPoints == null)
			{
				minPoints = new PointList();
			}
			int count = minPoints.Count;
			int count2 = maxPoints.Count;
			int num = Math.Max(count, count2);
			if (interpolatedPoints.Count < num)
			{
				interpolatedPoints.InsertRange(interpolatedPoints.Count, new Point[num - interpolatedPoints.Count]);
			}
			if (interpolatedPoints.Count > num)
			{
				interpolatedPoints.RemoveRange(num, interpolatedPoints.Count - num);
			}
			for (int i = 0; i < Math.Min(count, count2); i++)
			{
				interpolatedPoints[i] = new Point(minPoints[i].X * q + maxPoints[i].X * p, minPoints[i].Y * q + maxPoints[i].Y * p);
			}
			if (count < count2)
			{
				Point point = ((count > 0) ? minPoints[count - 1] : new Point(0.0, 0.0));
				for (int j = count; j < count2; j++)
				{
					interpolatedPoints[j] = new Point(point.X * q + maxPoints[j].X * p, point.Y * q + maxPoints[j].Y * p);
				}
			}
			if (count > count2)
			{
				Point point2 = ((count2 > 0) ? maxPoints[count2 - 1] : new Point(0.0, 0.0));
				for (int k = count2; k < count; k++)
				{
					interpolatedPoints[k] = new Point(minPoints[k].X * q + point2.X * p, minPoints[k].Y * q + point2.Y * p);
				}
			}
			return interpolatedPoints;
		}
	}
	internal class SliceInfoList : List<SliceInfo>
	{
		public void IndexSort()
		{
			Sort(delegate(SliceInfo s1, SliceInfo s2)
			{
				if (s1.Index < s2.Index)
				{
					return -1;
				}
				return (s1.Index > s2.Index) ? 1 : 0;
			});
		}

		public void SortByY()
		{
			Sort(delegate(SliceInfo s1, SliceInfo s2)
			{
				if (s1.Slice.Offset.Y < s2.Slice.Offset.Y)
				{
					return -1;
				}
				return (s1.Slice.Offset.Y > s2.Slice.Offset.Y) ? 1 : 0;
			});
		}

		public int GetByYValue(double yValue)
		{
			SortByY();
			int num = BinarySearch(delegate(SliceInfo si)
			{
				if (yValue < si.Slice.UpperLeft.Y + si.Slice.Offset.Y)
				{
					return -1;
				}
				return (yValue > si.Slice.LowerLeft.Y + si.Slice.Offset.Y) ? 1 : 0;
			});
			num = ((num < 0) ? (-1) : base[num].Index);
			IndexSort();
			if (num >= 0)
			{
				return num;
			}
			return -1;
		}

		private int BinarySearch(SliceInfoUnaryComparison comparisonFunction)
		{
			int num = 0;
			int num2 = base.Count - 1;
			while (num <= num2)
			{
				int num3 = num + (num2 - num >> 1);
				int num4 = comparisonFunction(base[num3]);
				if (num4 < 0)
				{
					num2 = num3 - 1;
					continue;
				}
				if (num4 > 0)
				{
					num = num3 + 1;
					continue;
				}
				return num3;
			}
			return ~num;
		}
	}
	internal delegate int SliceInfoComparison(SliceInfo s1, SliceInfo s2);
	internal delegate int SliceInfoUnaryComparison(SliceInfo s1);

		internal static SliceInfo Interpolate([SwiftMutableParameter] SliceInfo interpolated, SliceInfo min, SliceInfo max, double p, double q)
		{
			if (interpolated == null)
			{
				interpolated = new SliceInfo();
			}
			interpolated.HasOuterLabel = max.HasOuterLabel;
			interpolated.HasSlice = max.HasSlice;
			interpolated.Index = max.Index;
			interpolated.OuterLabel = max.OuterLabel;
			interpolated.OuterLabelPosition = new Point(min.OuterLabelPosition.X * q + max.OuterLabelPosition.X * p, min.OuterLabelPosition.Y * q + max.OuterLabelPosition.Y * p);
			interpolated.Slice = SliceAppearance.Interpolate(interpolated.Slice, min.Slice, max.Slice, p, q);
			return interpolated;
		}

		public FunnelSliceVisualData ExportVisualData()
		{
			FunnelSliceVisualData funnelSliceVisualData = new FunnelSliceVisualData();
			funnelSliceVisualData.Appearance = new PrimitiveAppearanceData();
			funnelSliceVisualData.Appearance.Fill = AppearanceHelper.FromBrush(Slice.Fill);
			funnelSliceVisualData.Appearance.Stroke = AppearanceHelper.FromBrush(Slice.Outline);
			funnelSliceVisualData.Appearance.Opacity = Slice.Opacity;
			funnelSliceVisualData.Appearance.CanvasLeft = Slice.Offset.X;
			funnelSliceVisualData.Appearance.CanvasTop = Slice.Offset.Y;
			funnelSliceVisualData.Height = Slice.LowerLeft.Y - Slice.UpperLeft.Y;
			funnelSliceVisualData.UpperWidth = Slice.UpperRight.X - Slice.UpperLeft.X;
			funnelSliceVisualData.LowerWidth = Slice.LowerRight.X - Slice.LowerLeft.X;
			funnelSliceVisualData.IsSelected = Slice.IsSelected;
			funnelSliceVisualData.Top = Slice.CanvasTop;
			funnelSliceVisualData.Bottom = Slice.CanvasBottom;
			funnelSliceVisualData.Index = Index;
			funnelSliceVisualData.Height = Slice.CanvasBottom - Slice.CanvasTop;
			funnelSliceVisualData.SliceBorderBrush = AppearanceHelper.FromBrushExtended(Slice.Outline);
			if (Slice.InnerLabel == null)
			{
				funnelSliceVisualData.InnerLabel = string.Empty;
			}
			else
			{
				funnelSliceVisualData.InnerLabel = Slice.InnerLabel.ToString();
			}
			if (OuterLabel == null)
			{
				funnelSliceVisualData.OuterLabel = string.Empty;
			}
			else
			{
				funnelSliceVisualData.OuterLabel = OuterLabel.ToString();
			}
			funnelSliceVisualData.UpperLeft = PointData.FromPoint(Slice.UpperLeft);
			funnelSliceVisualData.UpperRight = PointData.FromPoint(Slice.UpperRight);
			funnelSliceVisualData.LowerLeft = PointData.FromPoint(Slice.LowerLeft);
			funnelSliceVisualData.LowerRight = PointData.FromPoint(Slice.LowerRight);
			PointData[] array = new PointData[Slice.Points.Count];
			for (int i = 0; i < Slice.Points.Count; i++)
			{
				array[i] = new PointData(Slice.Points[i].X, Slice.Points[i].Y);
			}
			funnelSliceVisualData.SlicePoints = array;
			funnelSliceVisualData.InnerLabelPosition = PointData.FromPoint(_slice.InnerLabelPosition);
			funnelSliceVisualData.OuterLabelPosition = PointData.FromPoint(_outerLabelPosition);
			funnelSliceVisualData.OuterLabelBounds = RectData.FromRect(Slice.OuterLabelBounds);
			funnelSliceVisualData.InnerLabelBounds = RectData.FromRect(Slice.InnerLabelBounds);
			funnelSliceVisualData.IsVisibile = Slice.Visibility == Visibility.Visible;
			funnelSliceVisualData.InnerLabelAppearance = new LabelAppearanceData();
			funnelSliceVisualData.InnerLabelAppearance.LabelBrush = AppearanceHelper.FromBrush(Slice.InnerLabelBrush);
			funnelSliceVisualData.InnerLabelAppearance.Text = funnelSliceVisualData.InnerLabel;
			funnelSliceVisualData.InnerLabelAppearance.Visibility = Slice.HasInnerLabel;
			funnelSliceVisualData.OuterLabelAppearance = new LabelAppearanceData();
			funnelSliceVisualData.OuterLabelAppearance.LabelBrush = AppearanceHelper.FromBrush(Slice.OuterLabelBrush);
			funnelSliceVisualData.OuterLabelAppearance.Text = funnelSliceVisualData.OuterLabel;
			funnelSliceVisualData.OuterLabelAppearance.Visibility = HasOuterLabel;
			return funnelSliceVisualData;
		}
	}
	internal class SliceSelectionManager
	{
		private Dictionary<int, object> _selected = new Dictionary<int, object>();

		public void ToggleSelection(int index, object item)
		{
			if (_selected.ContainsKey(index))
			{
				_selected.Remove(index);
			}
			else
			{
				_selected[index] = item;
			}
		}

		public bool IsSelected(int index)
		{
			return _selected.ContainsKey(index);
		}

		public bool Any()
		{
			return _selected.Count > 0;
		}

		public bool IsUnselected(int index)
		{
			if (!IsSelected(index))
			{
				return Any();
			}
			return false;
		}

		public void DataUpdated(DataUpdatedMessage m, DoubleColumn data)
		{
			switch (m.Action)
			{
			case ItemsSourceAction.Insert:
				ShiftUp(m.Position, m.Count);
				break;
			case ItemsSourceAction.Remove:
				Remove(m.Position, m.Count);
				break;
			case ItemsSourceAction.Replace:
			{
				for (int i = 0; i < m.Count; i++)
				{
					if (_selected.ContainsKey(i))
					{
						_selected[i] = data.Values[i];
					}
				}
				break;
			}
			case ItemsSourceAction.Reset:
				ClearSelection();
				break;
			case ItemsSourceAction.Change:
				break;
			}
		}

		private void Remove(int startingPosition, int count)
		{
			List<int> list = new List<int>();
			List<object> list2 = new List<object>();
			foreach (int key in _selected.Keys)
			{
				if (key >= startingPosition)
				{
					list.Add(key);
					list2.Add(_selected[key]);
				}
			}
			int num = 0;
			foreach (int item in list)
			{
				_selected.Remove(item);
				if (item - count > startingPosition)
				{
					_selected[item - count] = list2[num];
				}
				num++;
			}
		}

		private void ShiftUp(int startingPosition, int count)
		{
			List<int> list = new List<int>();
			List<object> list2 = new List<object>();
			foreach (int key in _selected.Keys)
			{
				if (key >= startingPosition)
				{
					list.Add(key);
					list2.Add(_selected[key]);
				}
			}
			int num = 0;
			foreach (int item in list)
			{
				_selected.Remove(item);
				_selected[item + count] = list2[num];
				num++;
			}
		}

		public void ClearSelection()
		{
			_selected.Clear();
		}

		internal int[] GetSelectedItems()
		{
			int[] array = new int[_selected.Count];
			int num = 0;
			foreach (int key in _selected.Keys)
			{
				array[num] = key;
				num++;
			}
			return array;
		}

		internal void SetSelectedItems(int[] indexes, DoubleColumn values)
		{
			ClearSelection();
			foreach (int index in indexes)
			{
				ToggleSelection(index, values.Values[index]);
			}
		}
	}

				_legendItemBadgeTemplate = value;
			}
		}

		public Rect HoveredSliceBounds { get; private set; }

		public XamFunnelController()
		{
			DoubleAnimator = new DoubleAnimator(0.0, 1.0, 2000);
			DoubleAnimator.PropertyChanged += DoubleAnimator_PropertyChanged;
			PreviousFrame = new FunnelFrame();
			InterpolatedFrame = new FunnelFrame();
			CurrentFrame = new FunnelFrame();
			SliceSelectionManager = new SliceSelectionManager();
			ValueColumn = new DoubleColumn();
			InnerLabelColumn = new ObjectColumn();
			OuterLabelColumn = new ObjectColumn();
			RenderingMessages = new MessageChannel();
			ModelUpdateMessages = new MessageChannel();
			MessageHandler = new MessageHandler();
			MessageHandler.AddHandler(typeof(PropertyChangedMessage), PropertyChangedMessageReceived);
			MessageHandler.AddHandler(typeof(DataUpdatedMessage), DataUpdatedMessageReceived);
			MessageHandler.AddHandler(typeof(ViewportChangedMessage), ViewportChangedMessageReceived);
			MessageHandler.AddHandler(typeof(ViewPropertyChangedMessage), ViewPropertyChangedMessageReceived);
			MessageHandler.AddHandler(typeof(MouseMoveMessage), MouseMoveMessageReceived);
			MessageHandler.AddHandler(typeof(MouseButtonMessage), MouseButtonMessageReceived);
			MessageHandler.AddHandler(typeof(MouseLeaveMessage), MouseLeaveMessageReceived);
			MessageHandler.AddHandler(typeof(UserSelectedItemsChangedMessage), UserSelectedItemsChangedMessageReceived);
			MessageHandler.AddHandler(typeof(LabelSizeChangedMessage), LabelSizeChangedMessageReceived);
			_brushesChangedOverride = delegate
			{
				RefreshRequired = true;
				RefreshVisuals();
			};
		}

		private void DoubleAnimator_PropertyChanged(object sender, PropertyChangedEventArgs e)
		{
			TransitionProgress = DoubleAnimator.TransitionProgress;
			if (TransitionProgress == 1.0)
			{
				AnimationInProgress = false;
				DisplayFrame(CurrentFrame);
			}
			if (AnimationInProgress)
			{
				_ = TransitionProgress;
				FunnelFrame.Interpolate(InterpolatedFrame, PreviousFrame, CurrentFrame, TransitionProgress);
				DisplayFrame(InterpolatedFrame);
			}
		}

		private void OnServiceProviderChanged(ServiceProvider oldValue, ServiceProvider newValue)
		{
			if (oldValue != null)
			{
				if (oldValue.GetService("ConfigurationMessages") is MessageChannel messageChannel)
				{
					messageChannel.DetachTarget(MessageReceived);
				}
				if (oldValue.GetService("InteractionMessages") is MessageChannel messageChannel2)
				{
					messageChannel2.DetachTarget(MessageReceived);
				}
				RenderingMessages.DetachFromNext();
				ModelUpdateMessages.DetachFromNext();
			}
			if (newValue != null)
			{
				if (newValue.GetService("ConfigurationMessages") is MessageChannel messageChannel3)
				{
					messageChannel3.AttachTarget(MessageReceived);
				}
				if (newValue.GetService("InteractionMessages") is MessageChannel messageChannel4)
				{
					messageChannel4.AttachTarget(MessageReceived);
				}
				MessageChannel m = newValue.GetService("RenderingMessages") as MessageChannel;
				RenderingMessages.ConnectTo(m);
				MessageChannel m2 = newValue.GetService("ModelUpdateMessages") as MessageChannel;
				ModelUpdateMessages.ConnectTo(m2);
			}
			RefreshRequired = true;
		}

		[Weak]
		private void MessageReceived(Message m)
		{
			MessageHandler.MessageReceived(m);
			if (m is RenderingMessage renderingMessage)
			{
				RefreshRequired = renderingMessage.RefreshRequired;
			}
			RefreshVisuals();
		}

		internal bool SizeValid()
		{
			if (ViewportHeight > 0.0 && !double.IsNaN(ViewportHeight) && !double.IsInfinity(ViewportHeight) && ViewportWidth > 0.0 && !double.IsNaN(ViewportWidth))
			{
				return !double.IsInfinity(ViewportWidth);
			}
			return false;
		}

		internal bool IsValid()
		{
			if (ValueColumn != null && ValueColumn.Values != null && ValueColumn.Values.Count > 0 && WidthDecider != null && SizeDecider != null && Brushes != null && Brushes.Count > 0 && Outlines != null && Outlines.Count > 0)
			{
				return SizeValid();
			}
			return false;
		}

		private void RefreshVisuals()
		{
			if (!RefreshRequired)
			{
				return;
			}
			if (!IsValid())
			{
				ClearRendering();
				return;
			}
			RefreshRequired = false;
			double num = WidthDecider.DecideWidth(GetOuterLabels());
			if (num > ViewportWidth)
			{
				num = 0.0;
			}
			if (!OuterLabelVisibility)
			{
				num = 0.0;
			}
			double num2 = ViewportWidth - num;
			bool flag = num > 0.0;
			bool innerLabelVisibility = InnerLabelVisibility;
			bool flag2 = num2 >= 0.0;
			if (flag2 || flag)
			{
				Plot(flag2, flag, innerLabelVisibility, num2, num);
			}
		}

		private void ClearRendering()
		{
			if (ShouldAnimate() && TransitionProgress > 0.0)
			{
				DoubleAnimator.Stop();
			}
			SendClearMessage("LeftLabels");
			SendClearMessage("RightLabels");
			SendClearMessage("SliceArea");
			CleanupUnused();
			if (Legend != null)
			{
				while (Legend.Children.Count > 0)
				{
					Legend.Children.RemoveAt(0);
				}
			}
			CurrentFrame.Slices.Clear();
			InterpolatedFrame.Slices.Clear();
			PreviousFrame.Slices.Clear();
		}

		private void CleanupUnused()
		{
			FrameRenderCompleteMessage message = new FrameRenderCompleteMessage();
			RenderingMessages.SendMessage(message);
		}

		private void Plot(bool plotSlices, bool plotOuterLabels, bool plotInnerLabels, double plotAreaWidth, double outerLabelWidth)
		{
			if (AnimationInProgress)
			{
				FunnelFrame previousFrame = PreviousFrame;
				PreviousFrame = InterpolatedFrame;
				InterpolatedFrame = previousFrame;
			}
			else
			{
				FunnelFrame previousFrame2 = PreviousFrame;
				PreviousFrame = CurrentFrame;
				CurrentFrame = previousFrame2;
			}
			PlotFrame(CurrentFrame, plotSlices, plotOuterLabels, plotInnerLabels, plotAreaWidth, outerLabelWidth);
			DoubleAnimator.Stop();
			TransitionProgress = 0.0;
			if (ShouldAnimate())
			{
				FunnelFrame.Interpolate(InterpolatedFrame, PreviousFrame, CurrentFrame, TransitionProgress);
				DisplayFrame(InterpolatedFrame);
				AnimationInProgress = true;
				DoubleAnimator.Start();
			}
			else
			{
				DisplayFrame(CurrentFrame);
			}
		}

		private double SafeGetValue(double value)
		{
			if (double.IsNaN(value))
			{
				return 0.0;
			}
			return Math.Abs(value);
		}

		private void PlotFrame(FunnelFrame frame, bool plotSlices, bool plotOuterLabels, bool plotInnerLabels, double plotAreaWidth, double outerLabelWidth)
		{
			double num = plotAreaWidth / 2.0;
			_effectiveUseBezierCurve = UseBezierCurve;
			if (_effectiveUseBezierCurve)
			{
				InitializeBezier(plotAreaWidth, num);
			}
			else
			{
				Bezier = null;
			}
			bool flag = FunnelSliceDisplay == FunnelSliceDisplay.Weighted;
			IntColumn sortedIndices = GetSortedIndices();
			double num2 = 0.0;
			foreach (int value in sortedIndices.Values)
			{
				num2 += SafeGetValue(ValueColumn.Values[value]);
			}
			if (num2 == 0.0)
			{
				flag = false;
			}
			double num3 = ViewportHeight / (double)sortedIndices.Values.Count;
			double num4 = 0.0;
			double num5 = 0.0;
			frame.OuterLabelWidth = outerLabelWidth;
			frame.InnerLabelsShown = plotInnerLabels;
			frame.OuterLabelsShown = plotOuterLabels;
			frame.OuterAlignedLeft = OuterLabelAlignment == OuterLabelAlignment.Left;
			frame.Slices = new SliceInfoList();
			int num6 = 0;
			foreach (int value2 in sortedIndices.Values)
			{
				double num7 = ((!flag) ? num3 : (SafeGetValue(ValueColumn.Values[value2]) / num2 * ViewportHeight));
				double widthAt = GetWidthAt(plotAreaWidth, num4 + num5);
				double num8 = num4 + num7;
				double widthAt2 = GetWidthAt(plotAreaWidth, num8 - num5);
				double num9 = widthAt / 2.0;
				double num10 = widthAt2 / 2.0;
				SliceInfo sliceInfo = new SliceInfo();
				SliceAppearance slice = sliceInfo.Slice;
				slice.CanvasTop = num4;
				slice.CanvasBottom = num8;
				Rect innerLabelBounds = default(Rect);
				Rect outerLabelBounds = default(Rect);
				double num11 = 0.0;
				num11 = ((!(num10 > num9)) ? (num - num9) : (num - num10));
				double num12 = num4;
				slice.Fill = GetSliceFill(value2);
				slice.Outline = GetSliceOutline(value2);
				slice.Style = GetSliceStyle(value2);
				slice.IsSelected = SliceSelectionManager.IsSelected(value2);
				if (plotSlices)
				{
					sliceInfo.HasSlice = true;
					slice.UpperLeft = new Point(num - num9 - num11 + num5, num4 - num12 + num5);
					slice.UpperRight = new Point(num + num9 - num11 - num5, num4 - num12 + num5);
					slice.LowerLeft = new Point(num - num10 - num11 + num5, num8 - num12 - num5);
					slice.LowerRight = new Point(num + num10 - num11 - num5, num8 - num12 - num5);
					if (_effectiveUseBezierCurve)
					{
						AddBezierPoints(slice, num4 + num5, num8 - num5, num, num11 - num5, num12);
					}
				}
				if (plotInnerLabels)
				{
					slice.HasInnerLabel = true;
					slice.InnerLabelPosition = new Point(num - num11, (num4 + num8) / 2.0 - num12);
					slice.InnerLabel = GetInnerLabel(value2);
					Size size = SizeDecider.DecideLabelSize(sliceInfo, inner: true);
					if (size.Width > plotAreaWidth)
					{
						slice.HasInnerLabel = false;
					}
					if (size.Height > num7)
					{
						slice.HasInnerLabel = false;
					}
					innerLabelBounds.Height = size.Height;
					innerLabelBounds.Width = size.Width;
					innerLabelBounds.X = slice.InnerLabelPosition.X;
					innerLabelBounds.Y = slice.InnerLabelPosition.Y;
					slice.InnerLabelBounds = innerLabelBounds;
				}
				else
				{
					slice.HasInnerLabel = false;
					slice.InnerLabel = GetInnerLabel(value2);
				}
				if (plotInnerLabels || plotSlices)
				{
					slice.Offset = new Point(num11, num12);
					slice.Item = ValueColumn.Values[value2];
					slice.Index = value2;
				}
				if (plotOuterLabels)
				{
					sliceInfo.HasOuterLabel = true;
					sliceInfo.OuterLabelPosition = new Point(0.0, (num4 + num8) / 2.0);
					sliceInfo.OuterLabel = GetOuterLabel(value2);
					Size size2 = SizeDecider.DecideLabelSize(sliceInfo, inner: false);
					if (size2.Height > num7)
					{
						sliceInfo.HasOuterLabel = false;
					}
					outerLabelBounds.Height = size2.Height;
					outerLabelBounds.Width = size2.Width;
					innerLabelBounds.X = sliceInfo.OuterLabelPosition.X;
					innerLabelBounds.Y = sliceInfo.OuterLabelPosition.Y;
					slice.OuterLabelBounds = outerLabelBounds;
				}
				else
				{
					sliceInfo.HasOuterLabel = false;
					sliceInfo.OuterLabel = GetOuterLabel(value2);
				}
				sliceInfo.Index = value2;
				frame.Slices.Add(sliceInfo);
				num4 += num7;
				num6++;
			}
			if ((InnerLabelColumn != null && InnerLabelColumn.Values != null && InnerLabelColumn.Values.Count > 0) || (OuterLabelColumn != null && OuterLabelColumn.Values != null && OuterLabelColumn.Values.Count > 0))
			{
				RenderLegend(frame);
			}
			frame.Slices.IndexSort();
		}

		private void AddBezierPoints(SliceAppearance sliceAppearance, double currentTop, double currentBottom, double plotAreaCenter, [SwiftMutableParameter] double offsetx, double offsety)
		{
			BezierPoint pointAt = Bezier.GetPointAt(currentTop);
			BezierPoint pointAt2 = Bezier.GetPointAt(currentBottom);
			PointList pointList = new PointList();
			PointList pointList2 = new PointList();
			int index = pointAt.Index;
			int index2 = pointAt2.Index;
			for (int i = index; i <= index2; i++)
			{
				pointList.Add(new Point(Bezier.Points[i].Point.X - offsetx, Bezier.Points[i].Point.Y - offsety));
			}
			for (int num = index2; num >= index; num--)
			{
				Point point = Bezier.Points[num].Point;
				pointList2.Add(new Point(plotAreaCenter + plotAreaCenter - point.X - offsetx, point.Y - offsety));
			}
			sliceAppearance.BezierPoints = pointList;
			sliceAppearance.RightBezierPoints = pointList2;
		}

		private bool PointDiffers(Point p1, Point p2)
		{
			if (p1.X != p2.X || p1.Y != p2.Y)
			{
				return true;
			}
			return false;
		}

		private void InitializeBezier(double plotAreaWidth, double plotAreaCenter)
		{
			double y = 0.0;
			double viewportHeight = ViewportHeight;
			Point point;
			Point point2;
			if (IsInverted)
			{
				point = new Point(plotAreaCenter - plotAreaWidth * BottomEdgeWidth / 2.0, y);
				point2 = new Point(plotAreaCenter - plotAreaWidth / 2.0, viewportHeight);
			}
			else
			{
				point = new Point(plotAreaCenter - plotAreaWidth / 2.0, y);
				point2 = new Point(plotAreaCenter - plotAreaWidth * BottomEdgeWidth / 2.0, viewportHeight);
			}
			Point point3 = ((UpperBezierControlPoint.Y < LowerBezierControlPoint.Y) ? UpperBezierControlPoint : LowerBezierControlPoint);
			Point point4 = ((LowerBezierControlPoint.Y > UpperBezierControlPoint.Y) ? LowerBezierControlPoint : UpperBezierControlPoint);
			if (point3.Y < 0.0)
			{
				point3.Y = 0.0;
			}
			if (point4.Y > 1.0)
			{
				point4.Y = 1.0;
			}
			if (IsInverted)
			{
				double x = point4.X;
				point4.X = point3.X;
				point3.X = x;
				x = point3.Y;
				point3.Y = 1.0 - point4.Y;
				point4.Y = 1.0 - x;
			}
			Point p = new Point(plotAreaWidth * point3.X, ViewportHeight * point3.Y);
			Point point5 = new Point(plotAreaWidth * point4.X, ViewportHeight * point4.Y);
			if (Bezier == null || PointDiffers(point, Bezier.P0) || PointDiffers(p, Bezier.P1) || PointDiffers(point5, Bezier.P2) || PointDiffers(point2, Bezier.P3))
			{
				Bezier = new Bezier(point, p, point5, point2, 2.0, plotAreaCenter);
			}
			if (Bezier == null)
			{
				_effectiveUseBezierCurve = false;
			}
			else
			{
				_effectiveUseBezierCurve = Bezier.Valid;
			}
		}

		private object GetOuterLabel(int index)
		{
			IList<object> list = OuterLabelColumn?.Values;
			if (list != null && index < list.Count)
			{
				return list[index];
			}
			return null;
		}

		private object GetInnerLabel(int index)
		{
			IList<object> list = InnerLabelColumn?.Values;
			if (list != null && index < list.Count)
			{
				return list[index];
			}
			return null;
		}

		private Style GetSliceStyle(int index)
		{
			if (SliceSelectionManager.IsSelected(index))
			{
				return SelectedSliceStyle;
			}
			if (SliceSelectionManager.IsUnselected(index) && UseUnselectedStyle)
			{
				return UnselectedSliceStyle;
			}
			return NormalSliceStyle;
		}

		private Brush GetSliceOutline(int index)
		{
			return Outlines[index % Outlines.Count];
		}

		private Brush GetSliceFill(int index)
		{
			return Brushes[index % Brushes.Count];
		}

		private double GetWidthAt(double plotAreaWidth, double currentTop)
		{
			double num = plotAreaWidth * BottomEdgeWidth;
			if (_effectiveUseBezierCurve)
			{
				double x = Bezier.GetPointAt(currentTop).Point.X;
				return (plotAreaWidth / 2.0 - x) * 2.0;
			}
			if (IsInverted)
			{
				return plotAreaWidth - (plotAreaWidth - num) * ((ViewportHeight - currentTop) / ViewportHeight);
			}
			return plotAreaWidth - (plotAreaWidth - num) * (currentTop / ViewportHeight);
		}

		private IntColumn GetSortedIndices()
		{
			IntColumn intColumn = new IntColumn();
			intColumn.Populate(ValueColumn.Values.Count);
			intColumn.Sort(delegate(int i1, int i2)
			{
				if (ValueColumn.Values[i1] < ValueColumn.Values[i2])
				{
					if (!IsInverted)
					{
						return 1;
					}
					return -1;
				}
				return (ValueColumn.Values[i1] > ValueColumn.Values[i2]) ? (IsInverted ? 1 : (-1)) : 0;
			});
			return intColumn;
		}

		private void DisplayFrame(FunnelFrame frame)
		{
			DisplayFrameCore(frame);
		}

		private void DoDisplayFrame()
		{
			if (ToDisplay != null)
			{
				DisplayFrameCore(ToDisplay);
			}
		}

		private void DisplayFrameCore(FunnelFrame frame)
		{
			SendClearMessage("LeftLabels");
			SendClearMessage("RightLabels");
			SendClearMessage("SliceArea");
			if (frame.OuterAlignedLeft)
			{
				UpdatePanelWidth("LeftPanel", frame.OuterLabelWidth);
				UpdatePanelWidth("RightPanel", 0.0);
			}
			else
			{
				UpdatePanelWidth("LeftPanel", 0.0);
				UpdatePanelWidth("RightPanel", frame.OuterLabelWidth);
			}
			Slices = frame.Slices;
			foreach (SliceInfo slice in frame.Slices)
			{
				if (slice.HasSlice)
				{
					RenderSliceMessage renderSliceMessage = new RenderSliceMessage();
					renderSliceMessage.AreaID = "SliceArea";
					renderSliceMessage.Slice = slice.Slice;
					RenderingMessages.SendMessage(renderSliceMessage);
				}
			}
			foreach (SliceInfo slice2 in frame.Slices)
			{
				if (slice2.HasOuterLabel)
				{
					RenderOuterLabelMessage renderOuterLabelMessage = new RenderOuterLabelMessage();
					if (frame.OuterAlignedLeft)
					{
						renderOuterLabelMessage.AreaID = "LeftLabels";
					}
					else
					{
						renderOuterLabelMessage.AreaID = "RightLabels";
					}
					renderOuterLabelMessage.Label = slice2.OuterLabel;
					renderOuterLabelMessage.Position = slice2.OuterLabelPosition;
					renderOuterLabelMessage.OuterLabelWidth = frame.OuterLabelWidth;
					renderOuterLabelMessage.SliceInfo = slice2;
					RenderingMessages.SendMessage(renderOuterLabelMessage);
				}
			}
			FrameRenderCompleteMessage message = new FrameRenderCompleteMessage();
			RenderingMessages.SendMessage(message);
		}

		private void UpdatePanelWidth(string panelName, double width)
		{
			SetAreaSizeMessage setAreaSizeMessage = new SetAreaSizeMessage();
			setAreaSizeMessage.AreaID = panelName;
			setAreaSizeMessage.SettingWidth = true;
			setAreaSizeMessage.Width = width;
			RenderingMessages.SendMessage(setAreaSizeMessage);
		}

		private bool ShouldAnimate()
		{
			return TransitionDuration > 0.0;
		}

		private void SendClearMessage(string areaID)
		{
			ClearMessage clearMessage = new ClearMessage();
			clearMessage.AreaID = areaID;
			RenderingMessages.SendMessage(clearMessage);
		}

		private ObjectColumn GetOuterLabels()
		{
			return OuterLabelColumn;
		}

		private void DataUpdatedMessageReceived(Message m)
		{
			RefreshRequired = true;
		}

		private int ConvertToInt(object obj)
		{
			return Convert.ToInt32(obj);
		}

		private void PropertyChangedMessageReceived(Message m)
		{
			PropertyChangedMessage propertyChangedMessage = (PropertyChangedMessage)m;
			object newValue = propertyChangedMessage.NewValue;
			switch (propertyChangedMessage.PropertyName)
			{
			case "TextStyle":
				RefreshRequired = true;
				break;
			case "OuterLabelTextStyle":
				RefreshRequired = true;
				break;
			case "ValueColumn":
				ValueColumn.SetValues(newValue);
				RefreshRequired = true;
				break;
			case "InnerLabelColumn":
				InnerLabelColumn.SetValues(newValue);
				RefreshRequired = true;
				break;
			case "InnerLabelVisibility":
				InnerLabelVisibility = (bool)newValue;
				RefreshRequired = true;
				break;
			case "OuterLabelVisibility":
				OuterLabelVisibility = (bool)newValue;
				RefreshRequired = true;
				break;
			case "OuterLabelColumn":
				OuterLabelColumn.SetValues(newValue);
				RefreshRequired = true;
				break;
			case "ValueMemberPath":
				ValueMemberPath = newValue as string;
				break;
			case "OuterLabelMemberPath":
				OuterLabelMemberPath = newValue as string;
				break;
			case "InnerLabelMemberPath":
				InnerLabelMemberPath = newValue as string;
				break;
			case "BottomEdgeWidth":
				BottomEdgeWidth = (double)newValue;
				if (BottomEdgeWidth > 1.0)
				{
					BottomEdgeWidth = 1.0;
				}
				if (BottomEdgeWidth < 0.001)
				{
					BottomEdgeWidth = 0.001;
				}
				RefreshRequired = true;
				break;
			case "Brushes":
				if (propertyChangedMessage.OldValue != null)
				{
					((BrushCollection)propertyChangedMessage.OldValue).CollectionChanged -= _brushesChangedOverride;
				}
				if (newValue != null)
				{
					((BrushCollection)newValue).CollectionChanged += _brushesChangedOverride;
				}
				Brushes = newValue as BrushCollection;
				RefreshRequired = true;
				break;
			case "Outlines":
				Outlines = newValue as BrushCollection;
				RefreshRequired = true;
				break;
			case "OuterLabelAlignment":
				OuterLabelAlignment = (OuterLabelAlignment)newValue;
				RefreshRequired = true;
				break;
			case "FunnelSliceDisplay":
				FunnelSliceDisplay = (FunnelSliceDisplay)newValue;
				RefreshRequired = true;
				break;
			case "InnerLabelTemplate":
			case "OuterLabelTemplate":
			{
				TemplateChangedMessage templateChangedMessage = new TemplateChangedMessage();
				templateChangedMessage.TemplateName = propertyChangedMessage.PropertyName;
				templateChangedMessage.Template = (DataTemplate)newValue;
				RenderingMessages.SendMessage(templateChangedMessage);
				RefreshRequired = true;
				break;
			}
			case "IsInverted":
				IsInverted = (bool)newValue;
				RefreshRequired = true;
				break;
			case "TransitionDuration":
				DoubleAnimator.IntervalMilliseconds = ConvertToInt(newValue);
				TransitionDuration = DoubleAnimator.IntervalMilliseconds;
				break;
			case "AllowSliceSelection":
				AllowSliceSelection = (bool)newValue;
				break;
			case "SelectedSliceStyle":
				SelectedSliceStyle = (Style)newValue;
				RefreshRequired = true;
				break;
			case "UnselectedSliceStyle":
				UnselectedSliceStyle = (Style)newValue;
				RefreshRequired = true;
				break;
			case "UseUnselectedStyle":
				UseUnselectedStyle = (bool)newValue;
				RefreshRequired = true;
				break;
			case "UseBezierCurve":
				UseBezierCurve = (bool)newValue;
				RefreshRequired = true;
				break;
			case "UpperBezierControlPoint":
				UpperBezierControlPoint = (Point)newValue;
				RefreshRequired = true;
				break;
			case "LowerBezierControlPoint":
				LowerBezierControlPoint = (Point)newValue;
				RefreshRequired = true;
				break;
			case "ItemProvider":
				ItemProvider = (IItemProvider)newValue;
				break;
			case "ToolTip":
			{
				TooltipValueChangedMessage tooltipValueChangedMessage = new TooltipValueChangedMessage();
				if (newValue != null)
				{
					HasTooltip = true;
				}
				else
				{
					HasTooltip = false;
					ClearTooltipMessage message = new ClearTooltipMessage();
					RenderingMessages.SendMessage(message);
				}
				tooltipValueChangedMessage.Value = newValue;
				RenderingMessages.SendMessage(tooltipValueChangedMessage);
				break;
			}
			case "Legend":
				OnLegendChanged(newValue);
				RefreshRequired = true;
				break;
			case "LegendItemTemplate":
				LegendItemTemplate = (DataTemplate)newValue;
				RefreshRequired = true;
				break;
			case "LegendItemBadgeTemplate":
				LegendItemBadgeTemplate = (DataTemplate)newValue;
				RefreshRequired = true;
				break;
			case "UseOuterLabelsForLegend":
				UserOuterLabelsForLegend = (bool)newValue;
				RefreshRequired = true;
				break;
			}
		}

		private void OnLegendChanged(object p)
		{
			if (Legend != null)
			{
				Legend.ClearLegendItemsForSeries((ILegendSeries)ServiceProvider.GetService("Model"));
			}
			Legend = (ItemLegend)p;
		}

		private void RenderLegend(FunnelFrame frame)
		{
			List<UIElement> list = new List<UIElement>();
			foreach (SliceInfo slice in frame.Slices)
			{
				ContentControl contentControl = new ContentControl();
				string itemLabel = "";
				if (slice.Slice.InnerLabel != null)
				{
					itemLabel = ((!UserOuterLabelsForLegend || slice.OuterLabel == null) ? slice.Slice.InnerLabel.ToString() : slice.OuterLabel.ToString());
				}
				else if (slice.OuterLabel != null)
				{
					itemLabel = slice.OuterLabel.ToString();
				}
				Brush brush = null;
				Brush brush2 = null;
				if (brush == null && slice.Slice.Fill != null)
				{
					brush = slice.Slice.Fill;
				}
				if (brush2 == null && slice.Slice.Outline != null)
				{
					brush2 = slice.Slice.Outline;
				}
				object item = null;
				if (ItemProvider != null)
				{
					item = ItemProvider.GetItem(slice.Slice.Index);
				}
				contentControl.Content = new FunnelSliceDataContext
				{
					Series = (Control)ServiceProvider.GetService("Model"),
					Item = item,
					ItemBrush = brush,
					ItemLabel = itemLabel,
					ItemOutline = brush2
				};
				contentControl.ContentTemplate = LegendItemTemplate;
				list.Add(contentControl);
			}
			if (Legend != null && Legend.IsItemwise)
			{
				((IChartItemLegend)Legend).CreateItemwiseLegendItems(list, (ILegendSeries)ServiceProvider.GetService("Model"));
			}
		}

		private void ViewPropertyChangedMessageReceived(Message m)
		{
			ViewPropertyChangedMessage viewPropertyChangedMessage = (ViewPropertyChangedMessage)m;
			string propertyName = viewPropertyChangedMessage.PropertyName;
			if (!(propertyName == "OuterLabelWidthDecider"))
			{
				if (propertyName == "FunnelLabelSizeDecider")
				{
					SizeDecider = viewPropertyChangedMessage.NewValue as IFunnelLabelSizeDecider;
					RefreshRequired = true;
				}
			}
			else
			{
				WidthDecider = viewPropertyChangedMessage.NewValue as IOuterLabelWidthDecider;
				RefreshRequired = true;
			}
		}

		private void ViewportChangedMessageReceived(Message m)
		{
			ViewportChangedMessage viewportChangedMessage = (ViewportChangedMessage)m;
			ViewportWidth = viewportChangedMessage.NewWidth;
			ViewportHeight = viewportChangedMessage.NewHeight;
			RefreshRequired = true;
		}

		private void MouseButtonMessageReceived(Message m)
		{
			MouseButtonMessage mouseButtonMessage = (MouseButtonMessage)m;
			if (mouseButtonMessage.Type == MouseButtonType.Right)
			{
				return;
			}
			if (mouseButtonMessage.Action == MouseButtonAction.Down)
			{
				PressedSliceIndex = HoveredSliceIndex;
			}
			else if (mouseButtonMessage.Action == MouseButtonAction.Up)
			{
				int pressedSliceIndex = PressedSliceIndex;
				PressedSliceIndex = -1;
				if (pressedSliceIndex == HoveredSliceIndex)
				{
					OnSliceClicked(pressedSliceIndex);
				}
			}
		}

		private void OnSliceClicked(int index)
		{
			if (index >= 0 && index <= ValueColumn.Values.Count - 1)
			{
				if (AllowSliceSelection)
				{
					SliceSelectionManager.ToggleSelection(index, ValueColumn.Values[index]);
					int[] selectedItems = SliceSelectionManager.GetSelectedItems();
					SelectedItemsChangedMessage selectedItemsChangedMessage = new SelectedItemsChangedMessage();
					selectedItemsChangedMessage.SelectedItems = selectedItems;
					ModelUpdateMessages.SendMessage(selectedItemsChangedMessage);
					RefreshRequired = true;
				}
				SliceClickedMessage sliceClickedMessage = new SliceClickedMessage();
				sliceClickedMessage.Index = index;
				sliceClickedMessage.Item = ValueColumn.Values[index];
				sliceClickedMessage.Bounds = HoveredSliceBounds;
				ModelUpdateMessages.SendMessage(sliceClickedMessage);
			}
		}

		private void OnSliceExited(int index)
		{
			if (ValueColumn != null && index >= 0 && index < ValueColumn.Values.Count)
			{
				SliceMouseMessage sliceMouseMessage = new SliceMouseMessage();
				sliceMouseMessage.Index = index;
				sliceMouseMessage.Item = ValueColumn.Values[index];
				sliceMouseMessage.Type = SliceMouseMessageType.Exited;
				sliceMouseMessage.Bounds = HoveredSliceBounds;
				ModelUpdateMessages.SendMessage(sliceMouseMessage);
			}
		}

		private void OnSliceHovered(int index)
		{
			if (ValueColumn != null && index >= 0 && index < ValueColumn.Values.Count)
			{
				SliceMouseMessage sliceMouseMessage = new SliceMouseMessage();
				sliceMouseMessage.Index = index;
				sliceMouseMessage.Item = ValueColumn.Values[index];
				sliceMouseMessage.Type = SliceMouseMessageType.Hovered;
				sliceMouseMessage.Bounds = HoveredSliceBounds;
				ModelUpdateMessages.SendMessage(sliceMouseMessage);
			}
		}

		private void OnSliceEntered(int index)
		{
			if (ValueColumn != null && index >= 0 && index < ValueColumn.Values.Count)
			{
				SliceMouseMessage sliceMouseMessage = new SliceMouseMessage();
				sliceMouseMessage.Index = index;
				sliceMouseMessage.Item = ValueColumn.Values[index];
				sliceMouseMessage.Type = SliceMouseMessageType.Entered;
				sliceMouseMessage.Bounds = HoveredSliceBounds;
				ModelUpdateMessages.SendMessage(sliceMouseMessage);
			}
		}

		private void MouseMoveMessageReceived(Message m)
		{
			MouseMoveMessage mouseMoveMessage = (MouseMoveMessage)m;
			int hoveredSliceIndex = HoveredSliceIndex;
			HoveredSliceIndex = GetHoveredSliceIndex(mouseMoveMessage.Position);
			if (hoveredSliceIndex != HoveredSliceIndex)
			{
				if (hoveredSliceIndex != -1)
				{
					OnSliceExited(hoveredSliceIndex);
				}
				if (HoveredSliceIndex != -1)
				{
					OnSliceEntered(HoveredSliceIndex);
				}
			}
			else if (HoveredSliceIndex != -1)
			{
				OnSliceHovered(HoveredSliceIndex);
			}
			if (HasTooltip)
			{
				UpdateToolTip(mouseMoveMessage.Position);
			}
		}

		private void MouseLeaveMessageReceived(Message m)
		{
			int hoveredSliceIndex = HoveredSliceIndex;
			HoveredSliceIndex = -1;
			if (hoveredSliceIndex != -1)
			{
				OnSliceExited(hoveredSliceIndex);
			}
			ClearTooltipMessage message = new ClearTooltipMessage();
			RenderingMessages.SendMessage(message);
		}

		private void UpdateToolTip(Point position)
		{
			FunnelDataContext funnelDataContext = new FunnelDataContext();
			if (ItemProvider != null && HoveredSliceIndex >= 0 && HoveredSliceIndex < ItemProvider.Count)
			{
				funnelDataContext.Item = ItemProvider.GetItem(HoveredSliceIndex);
			}
			funnelDataContext.Index = HoveredSliceIndex;
			if (funnelDataContext.Index < 0)
			{
				ClearTooltipMessage message = new ClearTooltipMessage();
				RenderingMessages.SendMessage(message);
				return;
			}
			TooltipUpdateMessage tooltipUpdateMessage = new TooltipUpdateMessage();
			tooltipUpdateMessage.Context = funnelDataContext;
			tooltipUpdateMessage.Position = GetTooltipPosition(position, funnelDataContext);
			RenderingMessages.SendMessage(tooltipUpdateMessage);
		}

		private Point GetTooltipPosition(Point position, object context)
		{
			return new Point(position.X + 10.0, position.Y + 10.0);
		}

		private int GetHoveredSliceIndex(Point point)
		{
			if (!IsValid())
			{
				return -1;
			}
			double y = point.Y;
			double num = point.X;
			FunnelFrame currentFunnelFrame = GetCurrentFunnelFrame();
			if (currentFunnelFrame.OuterAlignedLeft)
			{
				num -= currentFunnelFrame.OuterLabelWidth;
			}
			SliceInfo sliceByYValue = GetSliceByYValue(y);
			if (sliceByYValue == null)
			{
				return -1;
			}
			double plotAreaWidth = GetPlotAreaWidth();
			double num2 = GetWidthAt(plotAreaWidth, y) / 2.0;
			double num3 = plotAreaWidth / 2.0;
			Rect hoveredSliceBounds = new Rect(sliceByYValue.Slice.UpperLeft.X, sliceByYValue.Slice.UpperLeft.Y, Math.Max(sliceByYValue.Slice.LowerRight.X - sliceByYValue.Slice.UpperLeft.X, 0.0), Math.Max(sliceByYValue.Slice.LowerRight.Y - sliceByYValue.Slice.UpperLeft.Y, 0.0));
			if (num >= num3 - num2 && num <= num3 + num2)
			{
				HoveredSliceBounds = hoveredSliceBounds;
				return sliceByYValue.Index;
			}
			return -1;
		}

		private double GetPlotAreaWidth()
		{
			FunnelFrame currentFunnelFrame = GetCurrentFunnelFrame();
			return ViewportWidth - currentFunnelFrame.OuterLabelWidth;
		}

		private SliceInfo GetSliceByYValue(double yVal)
		{
			FunnelFrame currentFunnelFrame = GetCurrentFunnelFrame();
			int byYValue = currentFunnelFrame.Slices.GetByYValue(yVal);
			if (byYValue >= 0 && byYValue < currentFunnelFrame.Slices.Count)
			{
				return currentFunnelFrame.Slices[byYValue];
			}
			return null;
		}

		private FunnelFrame GetCurrentFunnelFrame()
		{
			FunnelFrame funnelFrame = null;
			if (AnimationInProgress)
			{
				return InterpolatedFrame;
			}
			return CurrentFrame;
		}

		private void UserSelectedItemsChangedMessageReceived(Message m)
		{
			UserSelectedItemsChangedMessage userSelectedItemsChangedMessage = (UserSelectedItemsChangedMessage)m;
			SliceSelectionManager.SetSelectedItems(userSelectedItemsChangedMessage.SelectedItems, ValueColumn);
			RefreshRequired = true;
		}

		private void LabelSizeChangedMessageReceived(Message m)
		{
			CheckLabelSizes((LabelSizeChangedMessage)m);
		}

		private void CheckLabelSizes(LabelSizeChangedMessage m)
		{
			FunnelFrame currentFunnelFrame = GetCurrentFunnelFrame();
			if (m.SliceIndex == -1)
			{
				RefreshRequired = true;
				return;
			}
			SliceInfo sliceInfo = currentFunnelFrame.Slices[m.SliceIndex];
			if (m.IsOuter)
			{
				if (m.NewSize.Width > currentFunnelFrame.OuterLabelWidth)
				{
					RefreshRequired = true;
				}
				if (m.NewSize.Height != m.OldSize.Height)
				{
					RefreshRequired = true;
				}
				if (m.NewSize.Height > sliceInfo.Slice.LowerRight.Y - sliceInfo.Slice.UpperRight.Y)
				{
					RefreshRequired = true;
				}
			}
			else if (m.NewSize.Height > sliceInfo.Slice.LowerRight.Y - sliceInfo.Slice.UpperRight.Y)
			{
				RefreshRequired = true;
			}
		}
	}

				if (_actualPixelScalingRatio != actualPixelScalingRatio)

					OnPropertyChanged("ActualPixelScalingRatio", actualPixelScalingRatio, _actualPixelScalingRatio);

		}

		public XamFunnelChart()
		{
			_actualPixelScalingRatio = 1.0;
			_pixelScalingRatio = double.NaN;
			if (DesignerProperties.GetIsInDesignMode(this))
			{
				new CommandBase();
			}
			_selectedItems.CollectionChanged += SelectedItems_CollectionChanged;
			MessageHandler = new MessageHandler();
			MessageHandler.AddHandler(typeof(SliceClickedMessage), SliceClickedMessageReceived);
			MessageHandler.AddHandler(typeof(SliceMouseMessage), SliceMouseMessageReceived);
			MessageHandler.AddHandler(typeof(SelectedItemsChangedMessage), SelectedItemsChangedMessageReceived);
			ConfigurationMessages = new MessageChannel();
			FastItemsSource_Event = delegate(object o, FastItemsSourceEventArgs e)
			{
				DataUpdated(e.Action, e.Position, e.Count, e.PropertyName);
			};
			SendDefaults();
			base.DefaultStyleKey = typeof(XamFunnelChart);
			Utilities.ValidateLicense(typeof(XamDataChart), this);
		}
