		private void SendDefaults()
		{
			OnPropertyChanged("BottomEdgeWidth", 0.0, BottomEdgeWidth);
			OnPropertyChanged("InnerLabelVisibility", InnerLabelVisibility, InnerLabelVisibility);
			OnPropertyChanged("OuterLabelAlignment", OuterLabelAlignment, OuterLabelAlignment);
			OnPropertyChanged("FunnelSliceDisplay", FunnelSliceDisplay, FunnelSliceDisplay);
			OnPropertyChanged("UpperBezierControlPoint", UpperBezierControlPoint, UpperBezierControlPoint);
			OnPropertyChanged("LowerBezierControlPoint", LowerBezierControlPoint, LowerBezierControlPoint);
			SendItemProvider();
		}

		private void OnViewChanged()
		{
			OnPropertyChanged("InnerLabelTemplate", InnerLabelTemplate, InnerLabelTemplate);
			OnPropertyChanged("OuterLabelTemplate", OuterLabelTemplate, OuterLabelTemplate);
			OnPropertyChanged("ToolTip", ToolTip, ToolTip);
		}

		private void SendItemProvider()
		{
			PropertyChangedMessage propertyChangedMessage = new PropertyChangedMessage();
			propertyChangedMessage.PropertyName = "ItemProvider";
			propertyChangedMessage.OldValue = null;
			propertyChangedMessage.NewValue = this;
			ConfigurationMessages.SendMessage(propertyChangedMessage);
		}

		private void OnServiceProviderChanged(ServiceProvider oldValue, ServiceProvider newValue)
		{
			if (oldValue != null)
			{
				if (oldValue.GetService("ModelUpdateMessages") is MessageChannel messageChannel)
				{
					messageChannel.DetachTarget(MessageReceived);
				}
				ConfigurationMessages.DetachFromNext();
			}
			if (newValue != null)
			{
				if (newValue.GetService("ModelUpdateMessages") is MessageChannel messageChannel2)
				{
					messageChannel2.AttachTarget(MessageReceived);
				}
				MessageChannel m = newValue.GetService("ConfigurationMessages") as MessageChannel;
				ConfigurationMessages.ConnectTo(m);
			}
		}

		[Weak]
		private void MessageReceived(Message m)
		{
			MessageHandler.MessageReceived(m);
		}

		public override void OnApplyTemplate()
		{
			base.OnApplyTemplate();
			if (Connector != null)
			{
				Connector.DisconnectView();
			}
			XamFunnelView xamFunnelView = GetTemplateChild("PART_VIEW") as XamFunnelView;
			if (xamFunnelView != null && Connector != null)
			{
				Connector.ReconnectView(xamFunnelView);
				OnViewChanged();
			}
			else if (xamFunnelView != null)
			{
				Connector = new XamFunnelConnector(xamFunnelView, this);
			}
		}

		protected void DataUpdated(FastItemsSourceEventAction action, int position, int count, string propertyName)
		{
			DataUpdatedMessage dataUpdatedMessage = new DataUpdatedMessage
			{
				Position = position,
				Count = count,
				PropertyName = propertyName
			};
			switch (action)
			{
			case FastItemsSourceEventAction.Change:
				dataUpdatedMessage.Action = ItemsSourceAction.Change;
				break;
			case FastItemsSourceEventAction.Insert:
				dataUpdatedMessage.Action = ItemsSourceAction.Insert;
				break;
			case FastItemsSourceEventAction.Remove:
				dataUpdatedMessage.Action = ItemsSourceAction.Remove;
				break;
			case FastItemsSourceEventAction.Replace:
				dataUpdatedMessage.Action = ItemsSourceAction.Replace;
				break;
			case FastItemsSourceEventAction.Reset:
				dataUpdatedMessage.Action = ItemsSourceAction.Reset;
				break;
			}
			OnPropertyChanged("ValueColumn", ValueColumn, ValueColumn);
			OnPropertyChanged("InnerLabelColumn", InnerLabelColumn, InnerLabelColumn);
			OnPropertyChanged("OuterLabelColumn", OuterLabelColumn, OuterLabelColumn);
			ConfigurationMessages.SendMessage(dataUpdatedMessage);
		}

		[DontObfuscate]
		internal void OnDetachedFromUI()
		{
			Connector.View.OnDetachedFromUI();
		}

		[DontObfuscate]
		internal void OnAttachedToUI()
		{
			Connector.View.OnAttachedToUI(this);
		}

		private void OnPropertyChanged(string propertyName, object oldValue, object newValue)
		{
			if (HandleItemsSourceChanges(propertyName, oldValue, newValue) || HandleBrushChanges(propertyName, oldValue, newValue) || HandleVisibilityChanges(propertyName, oldValue, newValue) || HandleTimespans(propertyName, oldValue, newValue))
			{
				return;
			}
			if (propertyName == "PixelScalingRatio")
			{
				if (double.IsNaN(DeviceUtils.ClampPixelScalingRatio(PixelScalingRatio)))
				{
					ActualPixelScalingRatio = 1.0;
				}
				else
				{
					ActualPixelScalingRatio = DeviceUtils.ClampPixelScalingRatio(PixelScalingRatio);
				}
			}
			ConfigurationMessages.SendMessage(new PropertyChangedMessage
			{
				PropertyName = propertyName,
				OldValue = oldValue,
				NewValue = newValue
			});
		}

		private bool HandleBrushChanges(string propertyName, object oldValue, object newValue)
		{
			if (propertyName == "Brushes" || propertyName == "Outlines")
			{
				ConfigurationMessages.SendMessage(new PropertyChangedMessage
				{
					PropertyName = propertyName,
					OldValue = ((oldValue == null) ? null : ((BrushCollection)oldValue)),
					NewValue = ((newValue == null) ? null : ((BrushCollection)newValue))
				});
				return true;
			}
			return false;
		}

		private bool HandleItemsSourceChanges(string propertyName, object oldValue, object newValue)
		{
			switch (propertyName)
			{
			case "ItemsSource":
				if (oldValue != null)
				{
					FastItemsSource = null;
				}
				if (newValue != null)
				{
					SelectedItems.Clear();
					FastItemsSource = new FastItemsSource
					{
						ItemsSource = ItemsSource
					};
				}
				return true;
			case "FastItemsSource":
				if (oldValue != null)
				{
					((FastItemsSource)oldValue).Event -= FastItemsSource_Event;
				}
				if (newValue != null)
				{
					((FastItemsSource)newValue).Event += FastItemsSource_Event;
				}
				HandleValueMemberPathChange(propertyName, oldValue, newValue);
				return true;
			case "ValueMemberPath":
			case "InnerLabelMemberPath":
			case "OuterLabelMemberPath":
				HandleValueMemberPathChange(propertyName, oldValue, newValue);
				return false;
			default:
				return false;
			}
		}

		private IFastItemColumn<double> RegisterDoubleColumn(FastItemsSource itemsSource, string columnName)
		{
			return itemsSource.RegisterColumn(columnName);
		}

		private IFastItemColumn<object> RegisterObjectColumn(FastItemsSource itemsSource, string columnName)
		{
			return itemsSource.RegisterColumnObject(columnName);
		}

		private void HandleValueMemberPathChange(string propertyName, object oldValue, object newValue)
		{
			if (FastItemsSource == null)
			{
				if (oldValue is FastItemsSource fastItemsSource)
				{
					if (ValueColumn != null)
					{
						fastItemsSource.DeregisterColumn(ValueColumn);
					}
					if (InnerLabelColumn != null)
					{
						fastItemsSource.DeregisterColumn(InnerLabelColumn);
					}
					if (OuterLabelColumn != null)
					{
						fastItemsSource.DeregisterColumn(OuterLabelColumn);
					}
					ValueColumn = null;
					InnerLabelColumn = null;
					OuterLabelColumn = null;
				}
				return;
			}
			if (oldValue != null && oldValue is string)
			{
				switch (propertyName)
				{
				case "ValueMemberPath":
					FastItemsSource.DeregisterColumn(ValueColumn);
					ValueColumn = null;
					break;
				case "InnerLabelMemberPath":
					FastItemsSource.DeregisterColumn(InnerLabelColumn);
					InnerLabelColumn = null;
					break;
				case "OuterLabelMemberPath":
					FastItemsSource.DeregisterColumn(OuterLabelColumn);
					OuterLabelColumn = null;
					break;
				}
			}
			if (newValue != null && newValue is FastItemsSource)
			{
				if (ValueMemberPath != null)
				{
					ValueColumn = RegisterDoubleColumn((FastItemsSource)newValue, ValueMemberPath);
				}
				if (InnerLabelMemberPath != null)
				{
					InnerLabelColumn = RegisterObjectColumn((FastItemsSource)newValue, InnerLabelMemberPath);
				}
				if (OuterLabelMemberPath != null)
				{
					OuterLabelColumn = RegisterObjectColumn((FastItemsSource)newValue, OuterLabelMemberPath);
				}
			}
			if (newValue != null && newValue is string)
			{
				switch (propertyName)
				{
				case "ValueMemberPath":
					ValueColumn = RegisterDoubleColumn(FastItemsSource, ValueMemberPath);
					break;
				case "InnerLabelMemberPath":
					InnerLabelColumn = RegisterObjectColumn(FastItemsSource, InnerLabelMemberPath);
					break;
				case "OuterLabelMemberPath":
					OuterLabelColumn = RegisterObjectColumn(FastItemsSource, OuterLabelMemberPath);
					break;
				}
			}
		}

		private bool HandleVisibilityChanges(string propertyName, object oldValue, object newValue)
		{
			if (propertyName == "InnerLabelVisibility" || propertyName == "OuterLabelVisibility")
			{
				bool flag = (Visibility)oldValue == Visibility.Visible;
				bool flag2 = (Visibility)newValue == Visibility.Visible;
				ConfigurationMessages.SendMessage(new PropertyChangedMessage
				{
					PropertyName = propertyName,
					NewValue = flag2,
					OldValue = flag
				});
				return true;
			}
			return false;
		}

		private bool HandleTimespans(string propertyName, object oldValue, object newValue)
		{
			if (propertyName == "TransitionDuration")
			{
				PropertyChangedMessage propertyChangedMessage = new PropertyChangedMessage();
				propertyChangedMessage.PropertyName = propertyName;
				if (oldValue != null)
				{
					propertyChangedMessage.OldValue = ((TimeSpan)oldValue).TotalMilliseconds;
				}
				if (newValue != null)
				{
					propertyChangedMessage.NewValue = ((TimeSpan)newValue).TotalMilliseconds;
				}
				ConfigurationMessages.SendMessage(propertyChangedMessage);
				return true;
			}
			return false;
		}

		private void SliceClickedMessageReceived(Message m)
		{
			SliceClickedMessage sliceClickedMessage = (SliceClickedMessage)m;
			if (this.SliceClicked != null)
			{
				FunnelSliceClickedEventArgs e = new FunnelSliceClickedEventArgs();
				e.Index = sliceClickedMessage.Index;
				e.Bounds = sliceClickedMessage.Bounds;
				if (FastItemsSource.Count > sliceClickedMessage.Index && sliceClickedMessage.Index >= 0)
				{
					e.Item = FastItemsSource[sliceClickedMessage.Index];
				}
				this.SliceClicked(this, e);
			}
		}

		private void SliceMouseMessageReceived(Message m)
		{
			SliceMouseMessage sliceMouseMessage = (SliceMouseMessage)m;
			switch (sliceMouseMessage.Type)
			{
			case SliceMouseMessageType.Entered:
				if (this.SliceEnter != null)
				{
					FunnelSliceEventArgs e2 = new FunnelSliceEventArgs();
					e2.Index = sliceMouseMessage.Index;
					e2.Bounds = sliceMouseMessage.Bounds;
					if (FastItemsSource.Count > sliceMouseMessage.Index && sliceMouseMessage.Index >= 0)
					{
						e2.Item = FastItemsSource[sliceMouseMessage.Index];
					}
					this.SliceEnter(this, e2);
				}
				break;
			case SliceMouseMessageType.Exited:
				if (this.SliceLeave != null)
				{
					FunnelSliceEventArgs e3 = new FunnelSliceEventArgs();
					e3.Index = sliceMouseMessage.Index;
					e3.Bounds = sliceMouseMessage.Bounds;
					if (FastItemsSource.Count > sliceMouseMessage.Index && sliceMouseMessage.Index >= 0)
					{
						e3.Item = FastItemsSource[sliceMouseMessage.Index];
					}
					this.SliceLeave(this, e3);
				}
				break;
			case SliceMouseMessageType.Hovered:
				if (this.SliceHover != null)
				{
					FunnelSliceEventArgs e = new FunnelSliceEventArgs();
					e.Index = sliceMouseMessage.Index;
					e.Bounds = sliceMouseMessage.Bounds;
					if (FastItemsSource.Count > sliceMouseMessage.Index && sliceMouseMessage.Index >= 0)
					{
						e.Item = FastItemsSource[sliceMouseMessage.Index];
					}
					this.SliceHover(this, e);
				}
				break;
			}
		}

		private void SelectedItemsChangedMessageReceived(Message m)
		{
			SelectedItemsChangedMessage obj = (SelectedItemsChangedMessage)m;
			Dictionary<object, object> dictionary = new Dictionary<object, object>();
			List<object> list = (from index in obj.SelectedItems
				where index >= 0 && index < FastItemsSource.Count
				select FastItemsSource[index]).ToList();
			foreach (object item in list)
			{
				if (!dictionary.ContainsKey(item))
				{
					dictionary.Add(item, item);
				}
			}
			MergeItems(_selectedItems, _selectedItemsDict, list, dictionary);
		}

		private void SelectedItems_CollectionChanged(object sender, NotifyCollectionChangedEventArgs e)
		{
			UserSelectedItemsChangedMessage userSelectedItemsChangedMessage = new UserSelectedItemsChangedMessage();
			userSelectedItemsChangedMessage.SelectedItems = (from item in _selectedItems.Distinct()
				select FastItemsSource.IndexOf(item)).ToArray();
			ConfigurationMessages.SendMessage(userSelectedItemsChangedMessage);
		}

		private void MergeItems(IList<object> listA, Dictionary<object, object> dictA, IList<object> listB, Dictionary<object, object> dictB)
		{
			List<object> list = new List<object>();
			foreach (object listum in listA)
			{
				if (!dictB.ContainsKey(listum))
				{
					list.Add(listum);
				}
			}
			foreach (object item in list)
			{
				listA.Remove(item);
				dictA.Remove(item);
			}
			foreach (object item2 in listB)
			{
				if (!dictA.ContainsKey(item2))
				{
					listA.Add(item2);
					dictA.Add(item2, item2);
				}
			}
		}

		object IItemProvider.GetItem(int index)
		{
			return FastItemsSource[index];
		}

			FunnelChartVisualData funnelChartVisualData = new FunnelChartVisualData();

				{
					FunnelSliceVisualData item = slices[i].ExportVisualData();
					funnelChartVisualData.Slices.Add(item);
				}
			}
			funnelChartVisualData.BackgroundColor = AppearanceHelper.FromBrush(base.Background);
			funnelChartVisualData.ForegroundColor = AppearanceHelper.FromBrush(base.Foreground);
			funnelChartVisualData.BorderBrush = AppearanceHelper.FromBrush(base.BorderBrush);
			funnelChartVisualData.Opacity = base.Opacity;
			funnelChartVisualData.IsInverted = IsInverted;
			funnelChartVisualData.SelectedItems = SelectedItems;
			funnelChartVisualData.Name = base.Name;

		}

	internal class XamFunnelConnector
	{
		private XamFunnelView _view;

		private XamFunnelController _controller;

		[Weak]
		private XamFunnelChart _model;

		internal XamFunnelView View => _view;

		internal XamFunnelController Controller => _controller;

		public void OnResize()
		{
		}

		public XamFunnelConnector(XamFunnelView view, XamFunnelChart model)
		{
			ServiceProvider serviceProvider = new ServiceProvider();
			serviceProvider.AddService("ConfigurationMessages", new MessageChannel());
			serviceProvider.AddService("RenderingMessages", new MessageChannel());
			serviceProvider.AddService("InteractionMessages", new MessageChannel());
			serviceProvider.AddService("ModelUpdateMessages", new MessageChannel());
			view.InitializeScalingRatio(model);
			XamFunnelController controller = new XamFunnelController
			{
				ServiceProvider = serviceProvider
			};
			view.ServiceProvider = serviceProvider;
			_controller = controller;
			_view = view;
			model.ServiceProvider = serviceProvider;
			_model = model;
			serviceProvider.AddService("Model", _model);
		}

		public void ReconnectView(XamFunnelView view)
		{
			_view = view;
			ServiceProvider serviceProvider = _controller.ServiceProvider;
			_controller.ServiceProvider = null;
			_controller.ServiceProvider = serviceProvider;
			_view.ServiceProvider = serviceProvider;
		}

		public void DisconnectView()
		{
			if (_view != null)
			{
				_view.ServiceProvider = null;
			}
		}
	}

		private void LabelControl_SizeChanged(object sender, SizeChangedEventArgs e)
		{
			if (Owner != null && e.PreviousSize.Width > 0.0 && e.PreviousSize.Height > 0.0 && e.NewSize.Width > 0.0 && e.NewSize.Height > 0.0 && (e.NewSize.Width != e.PreviousSize.Width || e.NewSize.Height != e.PreviousSize.Height))
			{

				int sliceIndex = -1;
				if (sliceAppearance != null)

					sliceIndex = sliceAppearance.Index;

			}
		}

		protected override void SelectedIndicesChangedOverride(NotifyCollectionChangedEventArgs args)
		{

			{
				PrepareSlices();
				RenderSlices();
				RenderLegendItems();
			}

		protected internal override void PrepareSlices()
		{
			if (base.ActualItemsSource == null || base.FastItemsSource == null)
			{
				Slices.Count = 0;
				return;
			}
			int num = base.ValueIndices.Count;
			bool flag = base.OthersValueIndices.Count > 0;
			double startAngle = PieChartBase.RoundAngle(base.ActualStartAngle);
			double num2 = PieChartBase.RoundAngle(base.ActualStartAngle);
			base.TotalSliceCount = num;
			if (flag)
			{
				num++;
			}
			for (int i = 0; i < num; i++)
			{
				bool flag2 = false;
				double value;
				if (i == num - 1 && flag)
				{
					value = base.OthersTotal;
					flag2 = true;
				}
				else
				{
					value = base.ValueColumn[base.ValueIndices[i]];
				}
				num2 = ((base.SweepDirection != SweepDirection.Clockwise) ? (num2 - PieChartBase.RoundAngle(Math.Abs(value) * EndAngle / base.Total)) : (num2 + PieChartBase.RoundAngle(Math.Abs(value) * EndAngle / base.Total)));
				Slice slice = Slices[i];
				if (base.ActualInnerExtent >= 100.0)
				{
					slice.Visibility = Visibility.Collapsed;
				}
				else
				{
					slice.Visibility = Visibility.Visible;
				}
				slice.SuspendCreation = true;
				slice.StartAngle = startAngle;
				slice.EndAngle = num2;
				double innerExtentStart = (slice.InnerExtentEnd = base.ActualInnerExtent);
				slice.InnerExtentStart = innerExtentStart;
				slice.IsOthersSlice = flag2;
				slice.ExplodedRadius = base.ActualExplodedRadius;
				slice.Index = i;
				slice.DataContext = (flag2 ? base.Others : base.FastItemsSource[base.ValueIndices[i]]);
				slice.IsExploded = base.ExplodedSlices.Contains(i);
				slice.IsSelected = base.SelectedSlices.Contains(i);
				startAngle = num2;
				slice.SuspendCreation = false;
			}
			Slices.Count = num;
			if (ArcItem != null)
			{
				ArcItem.UpdateSliceItems(this);
			}
		}

		protected internal override void RenderLegendItems()
		{
			if (!(base.Legend is ItemLegend itemLegend))
			{
				return;
			}
			if (base.LabelColumn == null || base.LabelColumn.Count == 0 || (Ring != null && Ring.RingSeries != null && Ring.Owner != null && !Ring.Owner.Series.Contains(Ring.RingSeries)))
			{
				itemLegend.ClearLegendItemsForSeries(Ring.RingSeries);
				return;
			}
			base.LegendItems = new List<UIElement>();
			foreach (Slice item in Slices.Active)
			{
				ContentControl contentControl = new ContentControl();
				contentControl.SetBinding(UIElement.VisibilityProperty, new Binding("Visibility")
				{
					Source = Ring.Owner,
					Mode = BindingMode.OneWay
				});
				object label = GetLabel(item);
				Brush background = item.Background;
				object obj = (item.IsOthersSlice ? base.OthersCategoryText : ((base.LegendLabelColumn != null && base.LegendLabelColumn.Count > 0) ? base.LegendLabelColumn[base.ValueIndices[item.Index]] : null));
				obj = ((obj == null && base.LabelColumn.Count > 0) ? base.LabelColumn[base.ValueIndices[item.Index]] : obj);
				contentControl.Content = new PieSliceDataContext
				{
					Series = Ring.RingSeries,
					Slice = item,
					Item = item.DataContext,
					ItemBrush = background,
					LegendLabel = obj?.ToString(),
					ItemLabel = label?.ToString(),
					PercentValue = GetPercentValue(item),
					IsOthersSlice = item.IsOthersSlice
				};
				PieSliceDataContext pieSliceDataContext = (PieSliceDataContext)contentControl.Content;
				if (base.LegendBindingFormatter != null && !pieSliceDataContext.IsOthersSlice)
				{
					string legendLabel = base.LegendBindingFormatter.Format(pieSliceDataContext);
					pieSliceDataContext.LegendLabel = legendLabel;
				}
				if (base.LegendOthersBindingFormatter != null && pieSliceDataContext.IsOthersSlice)
				{
					string legendLabel2 = base.LegendOthersBindingFormatter.Format(pieSliceDataContext);
					pieSliceDataContext.LegendLabel = legendLabel2;
				}
				if (base.LegendItemTemplate != null)
				{
					contentControl.ContentTemplate = base.LegendItemTemplate;
				}
				base.LegendItems.Add(contentControl);
			}
			if (itemLegend.IsItemwise)
			{
				((IChartItemLegend)itemLegend).CreateLegendItemsInsert(base.LegendItems, (ILegendSeries)Ring.RingSeries);
			}
		}

		protected override void PropertyUpdatedOverride(object sender, string propertyName, object oldValue, object newValue)
		{
			base.PropertyUpdatedOverride(sender, propertyName, oldValue, newValue);
			switch (propertyName)
			{
			case "EndAngle":
				ActualEndAngle = (double)newValue;
				PrepareSlices();
				PrepareLabels();
				RenderSlices();
				RenderLabels();
				break;
			case "RadiusFactor":
				if (Ring != null && Ring.Owner != null)
				{
					Ring.Owner.PrepareCenterPresenter();
				}
				break;
			case "Legend":
				if (oldValue is ItemLegend itemLegend && Ring != null && Ring.RingSeries != null)
				{
					itemLegend.ClearLegendItemsForSeries(Ring.RingSeries);
				}
				break;
			}
		}
	}
	public class ArcItem
	{
		[Weak]
		public Ring Ring { get; internal set; }

		[Weak]
		public ArcItem Parent { get; internal set; }

		public string ValueMemberPath { get; internal set; }

		public int Index { get; internal set; }

		public int LevelDepth { get; internal set; }

		public double StartAngle { get; internal set; }

		public double EndAngle { get; internal set; }

		public double OthersCategoryThreshold { get; internal set; }

		public OthersCategoryType OthersCategoryType { get; internal set; }

		public BrushCollection Brushes { get; internal set; }

		public List<SliceItem> SliceItems { get; internal set; }

		[Weak]
		internal SliceItem ParentSlice { get; set; }

		internal IEnumerable ItemSource { get; set; }

		public ArcItem()
		{
			StartAngle = 0.0;
			EndAngle = 360.0;
			SliceItems = new List<SliceItem>();
		}

		protected internal virtual void PrepareData(double startAngleParam, double endAngleParam)
		{
			double num = 0.0;
			double num2 = 0.0;
			List<int> list = new List<int>();
			List<int> list2 = new List<int>();
			List<object> list3 = new List<object>();
			SliceItems.Clear();
			if (ItemSource == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			FastItemsSource fastItemsSource = new FastItemsSource();
			fastItemsSource.ItemsSource = ItemSource;
			IFastItemColumn<double> fastItemColumn = RegisterDoubleColumn(fastItemsSource, ValueMemberPath);
			if (fastItemColumn == null || fastItemColumn.Count == 0)
			{
				fastItemsSource.DeregisterColumn(fastItemColumn);
				fastItemsSource.Detach();
				return;
			}
			foreach (double item in fastItemColumn)
			{
				if (!double.IsNaN(item) && !double.IsInfinity(item) && !(item <= 0.0))
				{
					num += item;
				}
			}
			for (int i = 0; i < fastItemColumn.Count; i++)
			{
				double num3 = fastItemColumn[i];
				if (!double.IsNaN(num3) && !double.IsInfinity(num3) && !(num3 <= 0.0))
				{
					double num4 = ((OthersCategoryType == OthersCategoryType.Percent) ? (num3 / num) : num3);
					double num5 = ((OthersCategoryType == OthersCategoryType.Percent) ? (OthersCategoryThreshold / 100.0) : OthersCategoryThreshold);
					if (num4 <= num5)
					{
						num2 += num3;
						list2.Add(i);
						list3.Add(fastItemsSource[i]);
					}
					else
					{
						list.Add(i);
					}
				}
			}
			int num6 = list.Count;
			bool flag = list2.Count > 0;
			double num7 = PieChartBase.RoundAngle(startAngleParam);
			double num8 = PieChartBase.RoundAngle(startAngleParam);
			if (flag)
			{
				num6++;
			}
			for (int j = 0; j < num6; j++)
			{
				bool flag2 = false;
				double value;
				if (j == num6 - 1 && flag)
				{
					value = num2;
					flag2 = true;
				}
				else
				{
					value = fastItemColumn[list[j]];
				}
				num8 = ((1 != 1) ? (num8 - PieChartBase.RoundAngle(Math.Abs(value) * endAngleParam / num)) : (num8 + PieChartBase.RoundAngle(Math.Abs(value) * endAngleParam / num)));
				SliceItems.Add(new SliceItem
				{
					StartAngle = num7,
					EndAngle = num8 - num7,
					Data = (flag2 ? list3 : fastItemsSource[list[j]])
				});
				num7 = num8;
			}
			fastItemsSource.DeregisterColumn(fastItemColumn);
			fastItemsSource.Detach();
		}

		private IFastItemColumn<double> RegisterDoubleColumn(FastItemsSource fs, string memberPath)
		{
			return fs.RegisterColumn(memberPath);
		}

		internal void PrepareSliceItems(double seriesStartAngle)
		{
			double startAngleParam = ((ParentSlice == null) ? seriesStartAngle : ParentSlice.StartAngle);
			double endAngleParam = ((ParentSlice == null) ? 360.0 : ParentSlice.EndAngle);
			PrepareData(startAngleParam, endAngleParam);
		}

		internal void UpdateSliceItems(Arc arc)
		{
			SliceItems.Clear();
			for (int i = 0; i < arc.Slices.Count; i++)
			{
				Slice slice = arc.Slices[i];
				SliceItems.Add(new SliceItem
				{
					StartAngle = slice.StartAngle,
					EndAngle = slice.EndAngle - slice.StartAngle,
					Index = i,
					ArcItem = this,
					Data = slice.DataContext,
					IsOther = slice.IsOthersSlice,
					Slice = slice
				});
			}
		}
	}
	internal class Node
	{
		public Node Next;

		public object Value;

		public Node(object value, Node next)
		{
			Next = next;
			Value = value;
		}
	}
	public class IgQueue<T> where T : class
	{
		private int count;

		private Node front;

		private Node end;

		private Node temp;

		public bool empty => count == 0;

		public int Count => count;

		public void Enqueue(T obj)
		{
			if (count == 0)
			{
				front = (end = new Node(obj, front));
			}
			else
			{
				end.Next = new Node(obj, end.Next);
				end = end.Next;
			}
			count++;
		}

		public void Dequeue(out T value)
		{
			temp = front;
			if (count == 0)
			{
				throw new Exception("tried to serve from an empty Queue");
			}
			front = front.Next;
			count--;
			value = temp.Value as T;
		}
	}
	[WFSuppressWidgetMember]
	[XamSuppressWidgetMember]
	[UwpSuppressWidgetMember]
	public class HierarchicalRingSeries : RingSeriesBase
	{
		internal const string ChildrenMemberPathPropertyName = "ChildrenMemberPath";

		public static readonly DependencyProperty ChildrenMemberPathProperty = DependencyProperty.Register("ChildrenMemberPath", typeof(string), typeof(HierarchicalRingSeries), new PropertyMetadata(delegate(DependencyObject o, DependencyPropertyChangedEventArgs e)
		{
			(o as HierarchicalRingSeries).RaisePropertyChanged("ChildrenMemberPath", e.OldValue, e.NewValue);
		}));

		[TSSuppressWidgetMember]
		[WFSuppressWidgetMember]
		public RingCollection Rings { get; internal set; }

		[SuppressWidgetMember]
		public string ChildrenMemberPath
		{
			get
			{
				return (string)GetValue(ChildrenMemberPathProperty);
			}
			set
			{
				SetValue(ChildrenMemberPathProperty, value);
			}
		}

		public HierarchicalRingSeries()
		{
			base.DefaultStyleKey = typeof(HierarchicalRingSeries);
		}

		protected internal override RingCollection AnalyzeRings()
		{
			if (base.ItemsSource == null)
			{
				return new RingCollection();
			}
			Rings = TraverseTree(base.ItemsSource);
			return Rings;
		}

		protected override void PropertyUpdatedOverride(object sender, string propertyName, object oldValue, object newValue)
		{
			base.PropertyUpdatedOverride(sender, propertyName, oldValue, newValue);
			switch (propertyName)
			{
			case "StartAngle":
			{
				double num = (double)oldValue;
				double num2 = (double)newValue - num;
				if (Rings == null || Rings.Count <= 0)
				{
					break;
				}
				for (int i = 0; i < Rings.Count; i++)
				{
					foreach (ArcItem arcItem in Rings[i].ArcItems)
					{
						arcItem.StartAngle += num2;
					}
				}
				break;
			}
			case "Brushes":
				PrepareBrushes();
				break;
			case "ChildrenMemberPath":
				PrepareData();
				break;
			}
			if (Rings == null || !base.View.IsReady())
			{
				return;
			}
			bool flag = false;
			foreach (Ring ring in Rings)
			{
				ring.PrepareArcs();
				if (ring.RenderArcs())
				{
					flag = true;
				}
			}
			if (!flag)
			{
				return;
			}
			foreach (Ring ring2 in Rings)
			{
				ring2.RingSeries.View.OnSizeChanged();
			}
		}

		protected internal override void PrepareData()
		{
			if (base.Chart != null)
			{
				base.Chart.PrepareRingCollection();
				base.Chart.RenderChart();
			}
		}

		protected internal override void PrepareBrushes()
		{
			if (Rings == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			foreach (Ring ring in Rings)
			{
				foreach (ArcItem arcItem in ring.ArcItems)
				{
					SetBrush(arcItem);
				}
			}
		}

		protected internal override void RenderSeries()
		{
			if (Rings != null && Rings.Count > 0)
			{
				Ring ring = Rings[Rings.Count - 1];
				base.Width = ring.ControlSize.Width;
				base.Height = ring.ControlSize.Height;
				base.View.PositionSeries(ring.Center.X, ring.Center.Y);
			}
		}

		protected internal override void RenderLegendItems()
		{
			for (int i = 0; i < Rings.Count; i++)
			{
				foreach (Arc item in Rings[i].RingControl.Arcs.Active)
				{
					item.RenderLegendItems();
				}
			}
		}

		private IEnumerable ReflectItemSource(object obj_)
		{
			if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(ChildrenMemberPath))
			{
				return null;
			}
			PropertyInfo property = obj_.GetType().GetProperty(ChildrenMemberPath);
			if (property != null)
			{
				return property.GetValue(obj_, null) as IEnumerable;
			}
			return null;
		}

		private RingCollection TraverseTree(IEnumerable root)
		{
			IgQueue<ArcItem> igQueue = new IgQueue<ArcItem>();
			IgQueue<ArcItem> igQueue2 = new IgQueue<ArcItem>();
			ArcItem arcItem = new ArcItem
			{
				LevelDepth = 0,
				ItemSource = root,
				ValueMemberPath = base.ValueMemberPath,
				OthersCategoryType = base.OthersCategoryType,
				OthersCategoryThreshold = base.OthersCategoryThreshold
			};
			arcItem.PrepareSliceItems(base.StartAngle);
			ArcItem obj = new ArcItem
			{
				LevelDepth = -1,
				ItemSource = null
			};
			igQueue2.Enqueue(arcItem);
			igQueue.Enqueue(obj);
			RingCollection ringCollection = new RingCollection();
			Ring ring = null;
			int prevLevelDepth = -1;
			while (igQueue2.Count > 0)
			{
				igQueue2.Dequeue(out var value);
				igQueue.Dequeue(out var value2);
				if (value == null)
				{
					continue;
				}
				int num = 0;
				foreach (SliceItem sliceItem in value.SliceItems)
				{
					IEnumerable enumerable = ReflectItemSource(sliceItem.Data);
					if ((enumerable != null && !IsEmpty(enumerable)) || sliceItem.IsOther)
					{
						ArcItem obj2 = new ArcItem
						{
							LevelDepth = value.LevelDepth + 1
						};
						IEnumerable itemSource;
						if (!sliceItem.IsOther)
						{
							itemSource = enumerable;
						}
						else
						{
							IEnumerable enumerable2 = new List<int> { 0 };
							itemSource = enumerable2;
						}
						obj2.ItemSource = itemSource;
						obj2.Index = num;
						obj2.Parent = value;
						obj2.ValueMemberPath = base.ValueMemberPath;
						obj2.ParentSlice = sliceItem;
						ArcItem arcItem2 = obj2;
						arcItem2.PrepareSliceItems(base.StartAngle);
						igQueue2.Enqueue(arcItem2);
						igQueue.Enqueue(value);
					}
					num++;
				}
				Ring ring2 = DoSomething(value, value2, prevLevelDepth, ring);
				if (ring2 != ring)
				{
					ringCollection.Add(ring2);
					ring = ring2;
				}
				prevLevelDepth = value.LevelDepth;
			}
			return ringCollection;
		}

		private Ring DoSomething(ArcItem current, ArcItem parent, int prevLevelDepth, Ring currentRing)
		{
			current.StartAngle = ((current.ParentSlice == null) ? base.StartAngle : current.ParentSlice.StartAngle);
			current.EndAngle = ((current.ParentSlice == null) ? 360.0 : current.ParentSlice.EndAngle);
			SetBrush(current);
			if (current.LevelDepth != prevLevelDepth)
			{
				Ring ring = new Ring
				{
					RingSeries = this
				};
				ring.ArcItems.Add(current);
				current.Ring = ring;
				return ring;
			}
			current.Ring = currentRing;
			currentRing.ArcItems.Add(current);
			return currentRing;
		}

		private bool IsEmpty(IEnumerable en)
		{
			IEnumerator enumerator = en.GetEnumerator();
			try
			{
				if (enumerator.MoveNext())
				{
					_ = enumerator.Current;
					return false;
				}
			}
			finally
			{
				IDisposable disposable = enumerator as IDisposable;
				if (disposable != null)
				{
					disposable.Dispose();
				}
			}
			return true;
		}

		private void SetBrush(ArcItem arcItem)
		{
			if (arcItem.Parent == null)
			{
				arcItem.Brushes = base.Brushes;
			}
			else if (arcItem.Parent.LevelDepth == 0)
			{
				arcItem.Brushes = new BrushCollection();
				if (arcItem.Parent.Brushes != null)
				{
					arcItem.Brushes.Add(arcItem.Parent.Brushes[arcItem.Index % arcItem.Parent.Brushes.Count]);
				}
			}
			else
			{
				arcItem.Brushes = arcItem.Parent.Brushes;
			}
		}
	}

	[TSWidget]
	public class Ring
	{
		[Weak]
		private RingSeriesBase _ringSeries;

		public int Index { get; internal set; }

		public double InnerExtend { get; internal set; }

		public Size ControlSize { get; internal set; }

		public Point Center { get; internal set; }

		[Weak]
		[TSSuppressWidgetMember]
		[DontObfuscate]
		public RingControl RingControl { get; internal set; }

		[Weak]
		public RingSeriesBase RingSeries
		{
			get
			{
				return _ringSeries;
			}
			internal set
			{
				_ringSeries = value;
				_ringSeries.View.AddRing(RingControl);
				if (RingControl != null)
				{
					RingControl.View.OnSeriesProvided(value);
				}
			}
		}

		public double RingBreadth { get; internal set; }

		[TSSuppressWidgetMember]
		public List<ArcItem> ArcItems { get; internal set; }

		[Weak]
		internal XamDoughnutChart Owner { get; set; }

		internal bool ClearContent { get; set; }

		public Ring()
		{
			Center = new Point(0.0, 0.0);
			ControlSize = new Size(0.0, 0.0);
			RingControl = new RingControl
			{
				Ring = this
			};
			ArcItems = new List<ArcItem>();
			ClearContent = true;
		}

		public bool RenderArcs()
		{
			if (RingControl != null && RingControl.View.IsReady())
			{
				double x = Center.X - RingSeries.Location.X;
				double y = Center.Y - RingSeries.Location.Y;
				RingControl.View.PositionRingControl(x, y);
				return RingControl.RenderControl();
			}
			return false;
		}

		public void PrepareArcs()
		{
			if (RingControl != null)
			{
				RingControl.Width = ControlSize.Width;
				RingControl.Height = ControlSize.Height;
				RingSeries.View.AddRing(RingControl);
				RingControl.ItemsSource = ArcItems;
			}
		}
	}
	public class RingCollection : ObservableCollection<Ring>
	{
		protected override void ClearItems()
		{
			using (IEnumerator<Ring> enumerator = GetEnumerator())
			{
				while (enumerator.MoveNext())
				{
					Ring current = enumerator.Current;
					if (current.ClearContent)
					{
						int i = 0;
						for (int count = current.RingControl.Arcs.Count; i < count; i++)
						{
							current.RingControl.Arcs.Destroy(current.RingControl.Arcs[i]);
						}
						current.RingControl.Arcs.Count = 0;
						current.RingControl = null;
					}
				}
			}
			base.ClearItems();
		}

		protected override void RemoveItem(int index)
		{
			Ring ring = base[index];
			if (ring.ClearContent)
			{
				ring.RingControl.Arcs.Destroy(ring.RingControl.Arcs[index]);
				ring.RingControl.Arcs.Count = 0;
				ring.RingControl = null;
			}
			base.RemoveItem(index);
		}
	}
	public class RingControl : Control, INotifyPropertyChanged
	{
		private Ring _ring;

		[DontObfuscate]
		internal Pool<Arc> Arcs;

		private const string RootCanvasName = "RootCanvas";

		internal RingSeriesBase Series => Ring.RingSeries;

		internal RingControlView View { get; set; }

		internal Ring Ring
		{
			get
			{
				return _ring;
			}
			set
			{
				_ring = value;
				if (_ring == null)
				{
					View.OnSeriesProvided(null);
				}
				else
				{
					View.OnSeriesProvided(_ring.RingSeries);
				}
			}
		}

		internal List<ArcItem> ItemsSource { get; set; }

		public Canvas RootCanvas { get; private set; }

		public event PropertyChangedEventHandler PropertyChanged;

		public event PropertyUpdatedEventHandler PropertyUpdated;

		public RingControl()
		{
			base.DefaultStyleKey = typeof(RingControl);
			View = CreateView();
			OnViewCreated(View);
			View.OnInit();
			Arcs = new Pool<Arc>
			{
				Create = View.ArcCreate,
				Activate = View.ArcActivate,
				Disactivate = View.ArcDisactivate,
				Destroy = View.ArcDestroy
			};
		}

		public override void OnApplyTemplate()
		{
			base.OnApplyTemplate();
			Canvas canvas = GetTemplateChild("RootCanvas") as Canvas;
			if (RootCanvas != null && canvas != null)
			{
				for (int num = RootCanvas.Children.Count - 1; num > -1; num--)
				{
					UIElement element = RootCanvas.Children[num];
					RootCanvas.Children.RemoveAt(num);
					canvas.Children.Insert(0, element);
				}
			}
			RootCanvas = canvas;
			View.OnTemplateProvided();
		}

		internal virtual RingControlView CreateView()
		{
			return new RingControlView(this);
		}

		internal virtual void OnViewCreated(RingControlView view)
		{
		}

		protected void RaisePropertyChanged(string propertyName, object oldValue, object newValue)
		{
			if (this.PropertyChanged != null)
			{
				this.PropertyChanged(this, new PropertyChangedEventArgs(propertyName));
			}
			if (this.PropertyUpdated != null)
			{
				this.PropertyUpdated(this, new PropertyUpdatedEventArgs(propertyName, oldValue, newValue));
			}
		}

		protected internal virtual void OnSizeUpdated()
		{
			RenderControl();
		}

		internal bool RenderControl()
		{
			if (ItemsSource == null)
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (!View.IsReady())
			{
				return false;
			}
			int num = 0;
			bool result = false;
			foreach (ArcItem item in ItemsSource)
			{
				Arc arc = Arcs[num];
				arc.ArcItem = item;
				if (arc.InnerExtent != Ring.InnerExtend)
				{
					arc.InnerExtent = Ring.InnerExtend;
				}
				if ((arc.Width != Ring.ControlSize.Width || arc.Height != Ring.ControlSize.Height) && arc.View.Ready())
				{
					arc.Width = Ring.ControlSize.Width;
					arc.Height = Ring.ControlSize.Height;
					View.UpdateArcSize(arc);
					result = true;
				}
				if (arc.StartAngle != item.StartAngle)
				{
					arc.StartAngle = item.StartAngle;
				}
				if (arc.EndAngle != item.EndAngle)
				{
					arc.EndAngle = item.EndAngle;
				}
				if (arc.ItemsSource != item.ItemSource)
				{
					arc.ItemsSource = item.ItemSource;
				}
				if (arc.Brushes != item.Brushes)
				{
					arc.Brushes = item.Brushes;
				}
				View.PositionArc(arc, 0.0, 0.0);
				num++;
			}
			Arcs.Count = num;
			return result;
		}
	}
	public class RingSeries : RingSeriesBase
	{
		[WFSuppressWidgetMember]
		[XamSuppressWidgetMember]
		[UwpSuppressWidgetMember]
		public Ring Ring { get; private set; }

		public RingSeries()
		{
			Ring = new Ring
			{
				RingSeries = this,
				ClearContent = false
			};
			ArcItem item = new ArcItem
			{
				StartAngle = base.StartAngle,
				Ring = Ring,
				ValueMemberPath = base.ValueMemberPath,
				OthersCategoryType = base.OthersCategoryType,
				OthersCategoryThreshold = base.OthersCategoryThreshold
			};
			Ring.ArcItems.Add(item);
			base.DefaultStyleKey = typeof(RingSeries);
		}

		protected override void PropertyUpdatedOverride(object sender, string propertyName, object oldValue, object newValue)
		{
			base.PropertyUpdatedOverride(sender, propertyName, oldValue, newValue);
			if (propertyName == "LabelFormat")
			{
				for (int i = 0; i < Ring.RingControl.Arcs.Count; i++)
				{
					Ring.RingControl.Arcs[i].LabelFormat = (string)newValue;
				}
			}
			if (propertyName == "LabelFormatSpecifiers")
			{
				for (int j = 0; j < Ring.RingControl.Arcs.Count; j++)
				{
					Ring.RingControl.Arcs[j].LabelFormatSpecifiers = (object[])newValue;
				}
			}
			if (propertyName == "OthersLabelFormat")
			{
				for (int k = 0; k < Ring.RingControl.Arcs.Count; k++)
				{
					Ring.RingControl.Arcs[k].OthersLabelFormat = (string)newValue;
				}
			}
			if (propertyName == "OthersLabelFormatSpecifiers")
			{
				for (int l = 0; l < Ring.RingControl.Arcs.Count; l++)
				{
					Ring.RingControl.Arcs[l].OthersLabelFormatSpecifiers = (object[])newValue;
				}
			}
			if (propertyName == "LegendLabelFormat")
			{
				for (int m = 0; m < Ring.RingControl.Arcs.Count; m++)
				{
					Ring.RingControl.Arcs[m].LegendLabelFormat = (string)newValue;
				}
			}
			if (propertyName == "LegendLabelFormatSpecifiers")
			{
				for (int n = 0; n < Ring.RingControl.Arcs.Count; n++)
				{
					Ring.RingControl.Arcs[n].LegendLabelFormatSpecifiers = (object[])newValue;
				}
			}
			if (propertyName == "LegendOthersLabelFormat")
			{
				for (int num = 0; num < Ring.RingControl.Arcs.Count; num++)
				{
					Ring.RingControl.Arcs[num].LegendOthersLabelFormat = (string)newValue;
				}
			}
			if (propertyName == "LegendOthersLabelFormatSpecifiers")
			{
				for (int num2 = 0; num2 < Ring.RingControl.Arcs.Count; num2++)
				{
					Ring.RingControl.Arcs[num2].LegendOthersLabelFormatSpecifiers = (object[])newValue;
				}
			}
			if (propertyName == "Brushes")
			{
				PrepareBrushes();
			}
			if (propertyName == "StartAngle" && Ring.ArcItems != null && Ring.ArcItems.Count > 0)
			{
				Ring.ArcItems[0].StartAngle = base.StartAngle;
			}
			if (propertyName == "ValueMemberPath" && Ring.ArcItems != null && Ring.ArcItems.Count > 0)
			{
				Ring.ArcItems[0].ValueMemberPath = base.ValueMemberPath;
				PrepareData();
			}
			if (Ring != null && base.View.IsReady())
			{
				Ring.PrepareArcs();
				if (Ring.RenderArcs())
				{
					Ring.RingSeries.View.OnSizeChanged();
				}
			}
		}

		protected internal override RingCollection AnalyzeRings()
		{
			RingCollection ringCollection = new RingCollection();
			if (Ring.ArcItems[0].SliceItems.Count > 0)
			{
				ringCollection.Add(Ring);
			}
			return ringCollection;
		}

		protected internal override void PrepareData()
		{
			if (Ring != null)
			{
				Ring.ArcItems[0].ItemSource = base.ItemsSource;
				Ring.ArcItems[0].PrepareSliceItems(base.StartAngle);
				if (base.Chart != null)
				{
					base.Chart.PrepareRingCollection();
					base.Chart.RenderChart();
				}
			}
		}

		protected internal override void PrepareBrushes()
		{
			if (Ring != null)
			{
				Ring.ArcItems[0].Brushes = base.Brushes;
			}
		}

		protected internal override void RenderSeries()
		{
			if (Ring != null)
			{
				base.Width = Ring.ControlSize.Width;
				base.Height = Ring.ControlSize.Height;
				base.View.PositionSeries(Ring.Center.X, Ring.Center.Y);
			}
		}

		protected internal override void RenderLegendItems()
		{
			if (Ring == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			foreach (Arc item in Ring.RingControl.Arcs.Active)
			{
				item.RenderLegendItems();
			}
		}
	}

		[SuppressWidgetMember]
		public Style SelectedStyleResolved
		{
			get
			{
				if (SelectedStyle != null)
				{
					return SelectedStyle;
				}
				if (Chart != null && Chart.SelectedStyle != null)
				{
					return Chart.SelectedStyle;
				}
				return null;
			}
			set
			{
				Style selectedStyleResolved = SelectedStyleResolved;
				if (SelectedStyle != null && value != SelectedStyle)
				{
					value = SelectedStyle;
				}
				RaisePropertyChanged("SelectedStyleResolved", selectedStyleResolved, value);
			}
		}

		internal bool IsSurfaceInteractionDisabledResolved
		{
			get
			{
				if (ReadLocalValue(IsSurfaceInteractionDisabledProperty) == DependencyProperty.UnsetValue && !_isSurfaceInteractionUserSet)
				{
					return Chart.IsSurfaceInteractionDisabled;
				}
				return IsSurfaceInteractionDisabled;
			}
		}

		internal SRProvider SR
		{

		public event PropertyChangedEventHandler PropertyChanged;

		public event PropertyUpdatedEventHandler PropertyUpdated;

		public RingSeriesBase()
		{
			Location = new Point(0.0, 0.0);
			_propertyUpdatedOverride = delegate(object o, PropertyUpdatedEventArgs e)
			{
				PropertyUpdatedOverride(o, e.PropertyName, e.OldValue, e.NewValue);
			};
			PropertyUpdated += _propertyUpdatedOverride;
			View = CreateView();
			OnViewCreated(View);
			View.OnInit();
			FastItemsSource_Event = delegate(object o, FastItemsSourceEventArgs e)
			{
				DataUpdatedOverride(e.Action, e.Position, e.Count, e.PropertyName);
			};
			base.Loaded += RingSeriesBase_Loaded;
			base.Unloaded += RingSeriesBase_Unloaded;
		}

		private void RingSeriesBase_Unloaded(object sender, RoutedEventArgs e)
		{
			if (FastItemsSource != null && _fastItemsSourceAttached)
			{
				FastItemsSource.Event -= FastItemsSource_Event;
				_fastItemsSourceAttached = false;
			}
		}

		private void RingSeriesBase_Loaded(object sender, RoutedEventArgs e)
		{
			if (FastItemsSource != null && !_fastItemsSourceAttached)
			{
				FastItemsSource.Event += FastItemsSource_Event;
				_fastItemsSourceAttached = true;
			}
		}

		protected void RaisePropertyChanged(string propertyName, object oldValue, object newValue)
		{
			if (this.PropertyChanged != null)
			{
				this.PropertyChanged(this, new PropertyChangedEventArgs(propertyName));
			}
			if (this.PropertyUpdated != null)
			{
				this.PropertyUpdated(this, new PropertyUpdatedEventArgs(propertyName, oldValue, newValue));
			}
		}

		protected virtual void PropertyUpdatedOverride(object sender, string propertyName, object oldValue, object newValue)
		{
			if (propertyName == "ItemsSource")
			{
				FastItemsSource = new FastItemsSource
				{
					ItemsSource = (IEnumerable)newValue
				};
			}
			if (propertyName == "FastItemsSource")
			{
				if (oldValue is FastItemsSource)
				{
					(oldValue as FastItemsSource).Event -= FastItemsSource_Event;
					_fastItemsSourceAttached = false;
				}
				if (newValue is FastItemsSource)
				{
					(newValue as FastItemsSource).Event += FastItemsSource_Event;
					_fastItemsSourceAttached = true;
				}
				PrepareData();
			}
			if (!(propertyName == "SelectedStyle"))
			{
				if (propertyName == "ValueMemberPath")
				{
					PrepareData();
				}
			}
			else
			{
				SelectedStyleResolved = (Style)newValue;
			}
		}

		public override void OnApplyTemplate()
		{
			base.OnApplyTemplate();
			if (RootCanvas != null)
			{
				RootCanvas.Children.Clear();
			}
			RootCanvas = GetTemplateChild("RootCanvas") as Canvas;
			View.OnTemplateProvided();
		}

		protected virtual void DataUpdatedOverride(FastItemsSourceEventAction action, int position, int count, string propertyName)
		{
			PrepareData();
		}

		internal virtual RingSeriesBaseView CreateView()
		{
			return new RingSeriesBaseView(this);
		}

		internal virtual void OnViewCreated(RingSeriesBaseView view)
		{
		}

		protected internal abstract RingCollection AnalyzeRings();

		protected internal abstract void PrepareData();

		protected internal abstract void PrepareBrushes();

		internal void ClearView()
		{
			if (View != null)
			{
				View.ClearView();
			}
		}

		protected internal abstract void RenderSeries();

		protected internal abstract void RenderLegendItems();

		int ILegendSeries.ResolveLegendIndex()
		{
			return -1;
		}

		void ILegendSeries.ForSubItems(Action<object> action)
		{
		}

		internal string ResolveOthersCategoryText()
		{
			string text = SR.PieChart_Others;
			if (string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(text))
			{
				text = "Others";
			}
			if (OthersCategoryText == null)
			{
				return text;
			}
			return OthersCategoryText;
		}

	public class SliceItem
	{
		public double StartAngle { get; internal set; }

		public double EndAngle { get; internal set; }

		[Weak]
		public ArcItem ArcItem { get; internal set; }

		public int Index { get; internal set; }

		public Slice Slice { get; internal set; }

		internal object Data { get; set; }

		internal bool IsOther { get; set; }
	}
	public class SliceCollection : ObservableCollection<SliceItem>
	{
		internal bool IsAttached { get; set; }

		internal bool UseForSelection { get; set; }

		protected override void InsertItem(int index, SliceItem item)
		{
			if (Contains(item))
			{
				return;
			}
			int num = FindSliceItemIndexBySlice(item.Slice);
			if (num != -1)
			{
				base.SetItem(num, item);
				return;
			}
			base.InsertItem(index, item);
			if (IsAttached)
			{
				if (UseForSelection)
				{
					item.Slice.IsSelected = true;
				}
				else
				{
					item.Slice.IsExploded = true;
				}
			}
		}

		protected override void SetItem(int index, SliceItem item)
		{
			if (IsAttached)
			{
				if (UseForSelection)
				{
					base[index].Slice.IsSelected = false;
				}
				else
				{
					base[index].Slice.IsExploded = false;
				}
			}
			base.SetItem(index, item);
		}

		protected override void RemoveItem(int index)
		{
			SliceItem sliceItem = base[index];
			base.RemoveItem(index);
			if (IsAttached)
			{
				if (UseForSelection)
				{
					sliceItem.Slice.IsSelected = false;
				}
				else
				{
					sliceItem.Slice.IsExploded = false;
				}
			}
		}

		public new bool Remove(SliceItem item)
		{
			int num = FindSliceItemIndexBySlice(item.Slice);
			if (num != -1)
			{
				RemoveItem(num);
				return true;
			}
			return false;
		}

		protected override void ClearItems()
		{
			while (base.Count > 0)
			{
				RemoveItem(0);
			}
		}

		private int FindSliceItemIndexBySlice(Slice slice)
		{
			for (int i = 0; i < base.Count; i++)
			{
				if (base[i].Slice == slice)
				{
					return i;
				}
			}
			return -1;
		}
	}

		static XamDoughnutChart()
		{
			AllowSliceSelectionProperty = DependencyProperty.Register("AllowSliceSelection", typeof(bool), typeof(XamDoughnutChart), new PropertyMetadata(true, delegate(DependencyObject o, DependencyPropertyChangedEventArgs e)
			{
				(o as XamDoughnutChart).RaisePropertyChanged("AllowSliceSelection", e.OldValue, e.NewValue);
			}));
			IsSurfaceInteractionDisabledProperty = DependencyProperty.Register("IsSurfaceInteractionDisabled", typeof(bool), typeof(XamDoughnutChart), new PropertyMetadata(false, delegate(DependencyObject o, DependencyPropertyChangedEventArgs e)
			{
				(o as XamDoughnutChart).RaisePropertyChanged("IsSurfaceInteractionDisabled", e.OldValue, e.NewValue);
			}));
			AllowSliceExplosionProperty = DependencyProperty.Register("AllowSliceExplosion", typeof(bool), typeof(XamDoughnutChart), new PropertyMetadata(true, delegate(DependencyObject o, DependencyPropertyChangedEventArgs e)
			{
				(o as XamDoughnutChart).RaisePropertyChanged("AllowSliceExplosion", e.OldValue, e.NewValue);
			}));
			InnerExtentProperty = DependencyProperty.Register("InnerExtent", typeof(double), typeof(XamDoughnutChart), new PropertyMetadata(40.0, delegate(DependencyObject o, DependencyPropertyChangedEventArgs e)
			{
				double num = (double)e.NewValue;
				if (num < 0.0 || num > 100.0)
				{
					if (e.OldValue != null)
					{
						((XamDoughnutChart)o).InnerExtent = (double)e.OldValue;
					}
				}
				else
				{
					((XamDoughnutChart)o).RenderChart();
					((XamDoughnutChart)o).RaisePropertyChanged("InnerExtent", e.OldValue, e.NewValue);
				}
			}));
			SelectedStyleProperty = DependencyProperty.Register("SelectedStyle", typeof(Style), typeof(XamDoughnutChart), new PropertyMetadata(null, delegate(DependencyObject o, DependencyPropertyChangedEventArgs e)
			{
				(o as XamDoughnutChart).RaisePropertyChanged("SelectedStyle", e.OldValue, e.NewValue);
			}));
			CenterDataProperty = DependencyProperty.Register("CenterData", typeof(object), typeof(XamDoughnutChart), new PropertyMetadata(null, delegate(DependencyObject o, DependencyPropertyChangedEventArgs e)
			{
				(o as XamDoughnutChart).RaisePropertyChanged("CenterData", e.OldValue, e.NewValue);
			}));
			CenterDataTemplateProperty = DependencyProperty.Register("CenterDataTemplate", typeof(DataTemplate), typeof(XamDoughnutChart), new PropertyMetadata(null, delegate(DependencyObject o, DependencyPropertyChangedEventArgs e)
			{
				(o as XamDoughnutChart).RaisePropertyChanged("CenterDataTemplate", e.OldValue, e.NewValue);
			}));
			ThemeManager.RegisterControl(typeof(XamDoughnutChart));
		}

		private void Series_CollectionChanged(object sender, NotifyCollectionChangedEventArgs e)
		{
			new List<RingSeriesBase>();
			if (e.OldItems != null)
			{
				foreach (object oldItem in e.OldItems)
				{
					if (e.NewItems == null || !e.NewItems.Contains(oldItem))
					{
						((RingSeriesBase)oldItem).ClearView();
						View.RemoveSeries((RingSeriesBase)oldItem);
					}
				}
			}
			PrepareRingCollection();
			RenderChart();
		}

		protected virtual void PropertyUpdatedOverride(object sender, string propertyName, object oldValue, object newValue)
		{
			switch (propertyName)
			{
			case "SelectedStyle":
			{
				foreach (RingSeriesBase item in Series)
				{
					item.SelectedStyleResolved = (Style)newValue;
				}
				break;
			}
			case "AllowSliceExplosion":
			{
				for (int j = 0; j < _rings.Count; j++)
				{
					foreach (Arc item2 in _rings[j].RingControl.Arcs.Active)
					{
						item2.AllowSliceExplosion = AllowSliceExplosion;
					}
				}
				break;
			}
			case "AllowSliceSelection":
			{
				for (int i = 0; i < _rings.Count; i++)
				{
					foreach (Arc item3 in _rings[i].RingControl.Arcs.Active)
					{
						item3.AllowSliceSelection = AllowSliceSelection;
					}
				}
				break;
			}
			}
		}

		internal void RenderChart()
		{
			PrepareRings();
			RenderSeries();
			RenderRings();
			PrepareCenterPresenter();
			View.UpdateView();
		}

		internal void RenderSeries()
		{
			foreach (RingSeriesBase item in Series)
			{
				item.RenderSeries();
			}
		}

		internal void PrepareCenterPresenter()
		{
			Rect viewport = View.Viewport;
			if (viewport.IsEmpty || viewport.Width == 0.0 || viewport.Height == 0.0)
			{
				return;
			}
			Point point = new Point(viewport.Width / 2.0, viewport.Height / 2.0);
			double num = Math.Min(viewport.Width / 2.0, viewport.Height / 2.0);
			double num2 = 0.9;
			if (Series.Count > 0)
			{
				num2 = Series[0].RadiusFactor;
				if (double.IsNaN(num2) || double.IsInfinity(num2) || num2 < 0.0)
				{
					num2 = 0.0;
				}
				else if (num2 > 1.0)
				{
					num2 = 1.0;
				}
			}
			double num3 = InnerExtent * num / 100.0 * num2;
			View.SetCenterPresenterSize(num3 * 2.0, num3 * 2.0);
			View.PositonCenterPresenter(point.X - num3, point.Y - num3);
		}

		internal void RenderRings()
		{
			bool flag = false;
			foreach (Ring ring in _rings)
			{
				if (ring.RenderArcs())
				{
					flag = true;
				}
			}
			if (!flag)
			{
				return;
			}
			foreach (Ring ring2 in _rings)
			{
				ring2.RingSeries.View.OnSizeChanged();
			}
		}

		internal void PrepareRings()
		{
			Rect viewport = View.Viewport;
			if (viewport.IsEmpty || viewport.Width == 0.0 || viewport.Height == 0.0)
			{
				return;
			}
			Point point = new Point(viewport.Width / 2.0, viewport.Height / 2.0);
			double num = Math.Min(viewport.Width / 2.0, viewport.Height / 2.0);
			double num2 = Math.Max(viewport.Width / 2.0, viewport.Height / 2.0);
			if (viewport.Width > viewport.Height)
			{
				num += num2;
				num2 = num - num2;
				num -= num2;
			}
			double num3 = (100.0 - InnerExtent) / 100.0 * num / (double)_rings.Count;
			double num4 = (100.0 - InnerExtent) / 100.0 * num2 / (double)_rings.Count;
			double num5 = InnerExtent * num / 100.0;
			double num6 = InnerExtent * num2 / 100.0;
			int num7 = 1;
			foreach (Ring ring in _rings)
			{
				double num8 = num5 + num3 * (double)num7;
				double num9 = num6 + num4 * (double)num7;
				ring.RingBreadth = num3;
				ring.ControlSize = new Size(num8 * 2.0, num9 * 2.0);
				ring.Center = new Point(point.X - num8, point.Y - num9);
				ring.InnerExtend = 100.0 - num3 / num8 * 100.0;
				ring.PrepareArcs();
				num7++;
			}
		}

		internal void PrepareRingCollection()
		{
			ExplodedSlices.Clear();
			SelectedSlices.Clear();
			_rings.Clear();
			View.EnsureCenterPresenter();
			View.ClearSeries();
			int num = 0;
			for (int i = 0; i < Series.Count; i++)
			{
				RingSeriesBase ringSeriesBase = Series[i];
				ringSeriesBase.Chart = this;
				View.AddSeries(ringSeriesBase);
				foreach (Ring item in ringSeriesBase.AnalyzeRings())
				{
					item.Owner = this;
					item.Index = num;
					_rings.Add(item);
					num++;
				}
			}
		}

		protected internal virtual void OnSizeUpdated()
		{
			RenderChart();
		}

		[WFSuppressWidgetMember]
		internal void OnSliceClick(object sender, SliceClickEventArgs e)
		{
			if (!((Arc)sender).Ring.RingSeries.IsSurfaceInteractionDisabledResolved && this.SliceClick != null)
			{
				this.SliceClick(sender, e);
			}
		}

		protected void RaisePropertyChanged(string name, object oldValue, object newValue)
		{
			if (this.PropertyChanged != null)
			{
				this.PropertyChanged(this, new PropertyChangedEventArgs(name));
			}
			if (this.PropertyUpdated != null)
			{
				this.PropertyUpdated(this, new PropertyUpdatedEventArgs(name, oldValue, newValue));
			}
		}

		[DontObfuscate]
		internal void OnDetachedFromUI()
		{
			View.OnDetachedFromUI();
			for (int i = 0; i < _rings.Count; i++)
			{
				foreach (Arc item in _rings[i].RingControl.Arcs.Active)
				{
					item.OnDetachedFromUI();
				}
				foreach (Arc item2 in _rings[i].RingControl.Arcs.Inactive)
				{
					item2.OnDetachedFromUI();
				}
			}
		}

		[DontObfuscate]
		internal void OnAttachedToUI()
		{
			View.OnAttachedToUI();
			for (int i = 0; i < _rings.Count; i++)
			{
				foreach (Arc item in _rings[i].RingControl.Arcs.Active)
				{
					item.OnAttachedToUI();
				}
				foreach (Arc item2 in _rings[i].RingControl.Arcs.Inactive)
				{
					item2.OnAttachedToUI();
				}
			}
		}

		[TSSuppressWidgetMember]
		public DoughnutChartVisualData ExportVisualData()
		{
			DoughnutChartVisualData doughnutChartVisualData = new DoughnutChartVisualData();
			doughnutChartVisualData.Series = new RingSeriesVisualDataList();
			doughnutChartVisualData.Viewport = RectData.FromRect(View.Viewport);
			View.ExportViewShapes(doughnutChartVisualData);
			return doughnutChartVisualData;
		}
	}

	[WidgetModuleParent("AnnotationChart")]
	[TSEmitModuleDefinitions("IgxAnnotationLayerProxyModule:./igx-annotation-layer-proxy-module")]
	[HybridJavaSuppressWidget]
	[AutoModuleName("DataChartAnnotation")]
	public abstract class AnnotationLayer : Series
	{
		internal const string UseIndexPropertyName = "UseIndex";

		public static readonly DependencyProperty UseIndexProperty = DependencyProperty.Register("UseIndex", typeof(bool), typeof(AnnotationLayer), new PropertyMetadata(false, delegate(DependencyObject sender, DependencyPropertyChangedEventArgs e)
		{
			((AnnotationLayer)sender).RaisePropertyChanged("UseIndex", e.OldValue, e.NewValue);
		}));

		internal const string UseLegendPropertyName = "UseLegend";

		public static readonly DependencyProperty UseLegendProperty = DependencyProperty.Register("UseLegend", typeof(bool), typeof(AnnotationLayer), new PropertyMetadata(false, delegate(DependencyObject sender, DependencyPropertyChangedEventArgs e)
		{
			((AnnotationLayer)sender).RaisePropertyChanged("UseLegend", e.OldValue, e.NewValue);
		}));

		internal const string CursorPositionPropertyName = "CursorPosition";

		public static readonly DependencyProperty CursorPositionProperty = DependencyProperty.Register("CursorPosition", typeof(Point), typeof(AnnotationLayer), new PropertyMetadata(new Point(double.NaN, double.NaN), delegate(DependencyObject sender, DependencyPropertyChangedEventArgs e)
		{
			((AnnotationLayer)sender).RaisePropertyChanged("CursorPosition", e.OldValue, e.NewValue);
		}));

		internal const string IsDefaultCrosshairDisabledPropertyName = "IsDefaultCrosshairDisabled";

		public static readonly DependencyProperty IsDefaultCrosshairDisabledProperty = DependencyProperty.Register("IsDefaultCrosshairDisabled", typeof(bool), typeof(AnnotationLayer), new PropertyMetadata(true, delegate(DependencyObject sender, DependencyPropertyChangedEventArgs e)
		{
			((AnnotationLayer)sender).RaisePropertyChanged("IsDefaultCrosshairDisabled", e.OldValue, e.NewValue);
		}));

		protected internal Point CurrentPosition = new Point(double.NaN, double.NaN);

		[TSSuppressSynthesizedInitializer]
		protected AnnotationLayerView AnnotationView { get; set; }

		[WidgetDefaultBoolean(false)]
		public bool UseIndex
		{
			get
			{
				return (bool)GetValue(UseIndexProperty);
			}
			set
			{
				SetValue(UseIndexProperty, value);
			}
		}

		[WidgetDefaultBoolean(false)]
		public bool UseLegend
		{
			get
			{
				return (bool)GetValue(UseLegendProperty);
			}
			set
			{
				SetValue(UseLegendProperty, value);
			}
		}

		public Point CursorPosition
		{
			get
			{
				return (Point)GetValue(CursorPositionProperty);
			}
			set
			{
				SetValue(CursorPositionProperty, value);
			}
		}

		[WidgetDefaultBoolean(true)]
		public bool IsDefaultCrosshairDisabled
		{
			get
			{
				return (bool)GetValue(IsDefaultCrosshairDisabledProperty);
			}
			set
			{
				SetValue(IsDefaultCrosshairDisabledProperty, value);
			}
		}

		public override bool IsDefaultCrosshairBehaviorDisabled => IsDefaultCrosshairDisabled;

		public override bool IsIndexed
		{
			get
			{
				if (!UseIndex)
				{
					return UseLegend;
				}
				return true;
			}
		}

		public override bool IsUsableInLegend => UseLegend;

		protected Point UserCursorPosition { get; set; }

		protected Frame PreviousFrame { get; set; }

		protected Frame CurrentFrame { get; set; }

		protected Frame TransitionFrame { get; set; }

		public override bool IsAnnotationLayer => true;

		public AnnotationLayer()
		{
			UserCursorPosition = new Point(double.NaN, double.NaN);
		}

		protected override SeriesView CreateView()
		{
			return new AnnotationLayerView(this);
		}

		protected internal override void OnViewCreated(SeriesView view)
		{
			base.OnViewCreated(view);
			AnnotationView = (AnnotationLayerView)view;
		}

		protected virtual bool IsSeriesValid(Series series)
		{
			if (series == null)
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (series.IsAnnotationLayer)
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (series.IsValueOverlay)
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (series == this)
			{
				return false;
			}
			return series.ValidateSeries(series.View.Viewport, series.View.WindowRect, series.View);
		}

		protected override void PropertyUpdatedOverride(object sender, string propertyName, object oldValue, object newValue)
		{
			base.PropertyUpdatedOverride(sender, propertyName, oldValue, newValue);
			switch (propertyName)
			{
			case "SeriesViewer":
			{
				SeriesViewer seriesViewer = (SeriesViewer)oldValue;
				SeriesViewer seriesViewer2 = (SeriesViewer)newValue;
				if (seriesViewer != null)
				{
					UnregisterSeries(seriesViewer.Series);
					seriesViewer.Series.CollectionChanged -= Series_CollectionChanged;
					if (seriesViewer is XamDataChart)
					{
						XamDataChart xamDataChart = (XamDataChart)seriesViewer;
						UnregisterAxes(xamDataChart.Axes);
						xamDataChart.Axes.CollectionChanged -= Axes_CollectionChanged;
					}
				}
				if (seriesViewer2 != null)
				{
					RegisterSeries(seriesViewer2.Series);
					seriesViewer2.Series.CollectionChanged += Series_CollectionChanged;
					if (seriesViewer2 is XamDataChart)
					{
						XamDataChart xamDataChart2 = (XamDataChart)seriesViewer2;
						RegisterAxes(xamDataChart2.Axes);
						xamDataChart2.Axes.CollectionChanged += Axes_CollectionChanged;
					}
				}
				break;
			}
			case "UseLegend":
			case "UseIndex":
				if (IsIndexed)
				{
					if (base.Index == -1)
					{
						base.Index = XamDataChart.FindSeriesIndex(this);
					}
				}
				else
				{
					base.Index = -1;
					base.ActualBrush = null;
					base.ActualOutline = null;
				}
				if (base.SeriesViewer != null)
				{
					base.SeriesViewer.OnLegendSortChanged();
				}
				RenderSeries(animate: true);
				break;
			case "TransitionProgress":
				TransitionFrame.Interpolate((float)base.TransitionProgress, PreviousFrame, CurrentFrame);
				if (!ClearAndAbortIfInvalid(base.View))
				{
					if (base.TransitionProgress == 1.0)
					{
						RenderFrame(CurrentFrame, base.View);
					}
					else
					{
						RenderFrame(TransitionFrame, base.View);
					}
					if (base.SeriesViewer != null)
					{
						base.SeriesViewer.RaiseSeriesAnimating(this);
					}
				}
				break;
			case "IsDefaultCrosshairDisabled":
				if (base.SeriesViewer != null)
				{
					base.SeriesViewer.OnHoverBehaviorOverridesChanged();
				}
				break;
			case "CursorPosition":
				UserCursorPosition = CursorPosition;
				OnCursorPointMoved(CursorPosition);
				break;
			}
		}

		private void UnregisterSeries(SeriesCollection seriesCollection)
		{
			foreach (Series item in seriesCollection)
			{
				if (item != this)
				{
					item.RenderRequested -= series_RenderRequested;
				}
			}
			RenderSeries(animate: true);
		}

		private void UnregisterAxes(AxisCollection axisCollection)
		{
			foreach (Axis item in axisCollection)
			{
				item.RenderRequested -= axis_RenderRequested;
			}
			RenderSeries(animate: true);
		}

		private void RegisterSeries(SeriesCollection seriesCollection)
		{
			foreach (Series item in seriesCollection)
			{
				if (item != this)
				{
					item.RenderRequested += series_RenderRequested;
				}
			}
			RenderSeries(animate: true);
		}

		private void RegisterAxes(AxisCollection axisCollection)
		{
			foreach (Axis item in axisCollection)
			{
				item.RenderRequested += axis_RenderRequested;
			}
			RenderSeries(animate: true);
		}

		protected virtual bool IsDependentOnAxis(Axis axis)
		{
			if (axis == null)
			{
				return false;
			}
			return true;
		}

		private void axis_RenderRequested(object sender, RenderRequestedEventArgs e)
		{
			if (IsDependentOnAxis((Axis)sender))
			{
				OnDependentAxisRender((Axis)sender, e.Animate);
			}
		}

		protected virtual bool IsDependentOnSeries(Series series)
		{
			if (series == null)
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (series.IsAnnotationLayer)
			{
				return false;
			}
			return true;
		}

		private void series_RenderRequested(object sender, RenderRequestedEventArgs e)
		{
			if (IsDependentOnSeries((Series)sender))
			{
				OnDependentSeriesRender((Series)sender, e.Animate);
			}
		}

		protected virtual void OnDependentAxisRender(Axis axis, bool animate)
		{
		}

		protected virtual void OnDependentSeriesRender(Series series, bool animate)
		{
		}

		private void Series_CollectionChanged(object sender, NotifyCollectionChangedEventArgs e)
		{
			OnSeriesCollectionChanged(e);
		}

		private void Axes_CollectionChanged(object sender, NotifyCollectionChangedEventArgs e)
		{
			OnAxisCollectionChanged(e);
		}

		protected virtual Brush GetBrush()
		{
			if (base.ActualBrush != null)
			{
				return base.ActualBrush;
			}
			return base.Brush;
		}

		protected virtual Brush GetOutline()
		{
			if (base.ActualOutline != null)
			{
				return base.ActualOutline;
			}
			return base.Outline;
		}

		protected virtual void OnAxisCollectionChanged(NotifyCollectionChangedEventArgs e)
		{
			if (e.OldItems != null)
			{
				foreach (Axis oldItem in e.OldItems)
				{
					oldItem.RenderRequested -= axis_RenderRequested;
				}
			}
			if (e.NewItems != null)
			{
				foreach (Axis newItem in e.NewItems)
				{
					newItem.RenderRequested += axis_RenderRequested;
				}
			}
			RenderSeries(animate: true);
		}

		protected virtual void OnSeriesCollectionChanged(NotifyCollectionChangedEventArgs e)
		{
			if (e.OldItems != null)
			{
				foreach (Series oldItem in e.OldItems)
				{
					oldItem.RenderRequested -= series_RenderRequested;
				}
			}
			if (e.NewItems != null)
			{
				foreach (Series newItem in e.NewItems)
				{
					newItem.RenderRequested += series_RenderRequested;
				}
			}
			RenderSeries(animate: true);
		}

		protected override void WindowRectChangedOverride(Rect oldWindowRect, Rect newWindowRect)
		{
			RenderSeries(animate: false);
		}

		protected override void ViewportRectChangedOverride(Rect oldViewportRect, Rect newViewportRect)
		{
			RenderSeries(animate: true);
		}

		protected internal override void RenderSeriesOverride(bool animate)
		{
			base.RenderSeriesOverride(animate);
			if (ClearAndAbortIfInvalid(base.View))
			{
				return;
			}
			if (ShouldAnimate(animate) && !base.SkipPrepare)
			{
				Frame previousFrame = PreviousFrame;
				if (AnimationActive())
				{
					if (base.Animator.NeedsFlush)
					{
						base.Animator.Flush();
					}
					PreviousFrame = TransitionFrame;
					TransitionFrame = previousFrame;
				}
				else
				{
					PreviousFrame = CurrentFrame;
					CurrentFrame = previousFrame;
				}
				PrepareFrame(CurrentFrame, base.View);
				StartAnimation();
			}
			else
			{
				if (!base.SkipPrepare)
				{
					PrepareFrame(CurrentFrame, base.View);
				}
				RenderFrame(CurrentFrame, base.View);
			}
		}

		protected virtual void PrepareFrame(Frame frame, SeriesView view)
		{
		}

		protected virtual void RenderFrame(Frame frame, SeriesView view)
		{
			AnnotationView.OnRenderingFrame();
		}

		protected virtual Tuple<bool, Point> GetCategoryPosition(Series series)
		{
			Point item = new Point(CurrentPosition.X, CurrentPosition.Y);
			if (series.IsVertical)
			{
				if (double.IsNaN(CurrentPosition.Y))
				{
					return new Tuple<bool, Point>(item1: false, item);
				}
				if (double.IsNaN(CurrentPosition.X))
				{
					item.X = 0.0;
					return new Tuple<bool, Point>(item1: true, item);
				}
			}
			else
			{
				if (double.IsNaN(CurrentPosition.X))
				{
					return new Tuple<bool, Point>(item1: false, item);
				}
				if (double.IsNaN(CurrentPosition.Y))
				{
					item.Y = 0.0;
					return new Tuple<bool, Point>(item1: true, item);
				}
			}
			return new Tuple<bool, Point>(item1: true, item);
		}

		protected override void OnCursorPointMoved(Point point)
		{
			base.OnCursorPointMoved(point);
			if (double.IsNaN(UserCursorPosition.X) && double.IsNaN(UserCursorPosition.Y))
			{
				if (double.IsNaN(point.X) && double.IsNaN(point.Y))
				{
					AnnotationView.DeferPositionClear();
					return;
				}
				AnnotationView.ResetDeferredClear();
				CurrentPosition = point;
			}
			else
			{
				AnnotationView.ResetDeferredClear();
				CurrentPosition = UserCursorPosition;
			}
			RenderSeries(animate: true);
		}

		protected internal override bool ValidateSeries(Rect viewportRect, Rect windowRect, SeriesView view)
		{
			bool result = base.ValidateSeries(viewportRect, windowRect, view);
			if (!base.View.Ready())
			{
				return false;
			}
			return result;
		}
	}

		internal BindingFormatter BindingFormatter { get; private set; }

		public event PropertyChangedEventHandler PropertyChanged;

		public event AxisFormatLabelEventHandler FormatLabel;

		protected override Freezable CreateInstanceCore()
		{
			return new AxisAnnotation();
		}

		public void ResetCachedExtent()
		{
			ShouldResetExtent = true;
		}

		void IAxisAnnotation.CheckForExtentReset(Action act)
		{
			if (ShouldResetExtent)
			{
				ShouldResetExtent = false;
				act();
			}
		}

		private void RaisePropertyChanged(string propertyName, object oldValue, object newValue)
		{
			PropertyUpdatedOverride(propertyName, oldValue, newValue);
			if (this.PropertyChanged != null)
			{
				this.PropertyChanged(this, new PropertyChangedEventArgs(propertyName));
			}
		}

		private void PropertyUpdatedOverride(string propertyName, object oldValue, object newValue)
		{
			CheckDirty = true;
			if (propertyName == "LabelFormat" || propertyName == "LabelFormatSpecifiers")
			{
				if (LabelFormat != null)
				{
					BindingFormatter = new BindingFormatter();
					BindingFormatter.FormatString = LabelFormat;
					BindingFormatter.FormatSpecifiers = LabelFormatSpecifiers;
				}
				else
				{
					BindingFormatter = null;
				}
			}
		}

		public string ResolveLabelValue()
		{
			if (Text != null)
			{
				return Text;
			}
			if (this.FormatLabel != null)
			{
				return this.FormatLabel(this, Value);
			}
			if (BindingFormatter != null)
			{
				return BindingFormatter.Format(Value);
			}
			if (Value == null)
			{
				return null;
			}
			return Value.ToString();
		}
	}
	internal class AxisAnnotationManager : IAxisAnnotationManager
	{
		public Axis Owner { get; set; }

		public void OnAddAnnotations(Axis axis)
		{
			int num = 0;
			for (int i = 0; i < axis.AutoAnnotations.Count; i++)
			{
				num = AddAnnotation(axis, axis.AutoAnnotations[i], num);
			}
			for (int j = 0; j < axis.Annotations.Count; j++)
			{
				num = AddAnnotation(axis, axis.Annotations[j], num);
			}
			axis.AnnotationBackings.Count = num;
			axis.AnnotationTextBlocks.Count = num;
		}

		private int AddAnnotation(Axis axis, IAxisAnnotation axisAnnotation, [SwiftMutableParameter] int textBlockCount)
		{
			double num = double.NaN;
			num = ((!(axisAnnotation.Value is DateTime)) ? Convert.ToDouble(axisAnnotation.Value) : ((double)((DateTime)axisAnnotation.Value).Ticks));
			LabelPosition pos = new LabelPosition(axis.ScaleValue(num));
			if (axis.IsCategoryDateTime)
			{
				CategoryAxisBase categoryAxisBase = (CategoryAxisBase)axis;
				if (categoryAxisBase.CategoryMode == CategoryMode.Mode2)
				{
					Rect actualWindowRect = axis.SeriesViewer.ActualWindowRect;
					Rect viewportRect = axis.ViewportRect;
					Rect currentEffectiveViewport = axis.GetCurrentEffectiveViewport();
					pos.Value += (axis.IsInverted ? ((0.0 - categoryAxisBase.GetCategorySize(actualWindowRect, viewportRect, currentEffectiveViewport)) * 0.5) : (categoryAxisBase.GetCategorySize(actualWindowRect, viewportRect, currentEffectiveViewport) * 0.5));
				}
			}
			_ = pos.Value;
			if (axis.IsVertical)
			{
				if (pos.Value > axis.ViewportRect.Bottom || pos.Value < axis.ViewportRect.Top)
				{
					return textBlockCount;
				}
			}
			else if (pos.Value > axis.ViewportRect.Right || pos.Value < axis.ViewportRect.Left)
			{
				return textBlockCount;
			}
			Rectangle rectangle = axis.AnnotationBackings[textBlockCount];
			TextBlock textBlock = axis.AnnotationTextBlocks[textBlockCount];
			int num2 = 100 + textBlockCount * 2;
			textBlockCount++;
			textBlock.Text = axisAnnotation.ResolveLabelValue();
			if (axisAnnotation.Foreground != null)
			{
				textBlock.Foreground = axisAnnotation.Foreground;
			}
			rectangle.Fill = axisAnnotation.Background;
			rectangle.Stroke = axisAnnotation.Outline;
			rectangle.StrokeThickness = axisAnnotation.StrokeThickness;
			Panel.SetZIndex(rectangle, num2);
			Panel.SetZIndex(textBlock, num2 + 1);
			axisAnnotation.CheckForExtentReset(delegate
			{
				pos.ResetOverlayExtent = true;
			});
			pos.IsOverlay = true;
			pos.OverlayPadding = axisAnnotation.BackgroundPadding;
			axis.LabelPositions.Add(pos);
			axis.LabelDataContext.Add(textBlock.Text);
			return textBlockCount;
		}

		public void ArrangeAnnotations(Axis axis, AxisLabelPanelBaseView view, List<FrameworkElement> textBlocks, List<Rect> labelBounds, bool useRotation, double effectiveAngle, double leftMargin, double topMargin, double rightMargin, double bottomMargin)
		{
			for (int i = 0; i < axis.AnnotationTextBlocks.Count; i++)
			{
				Rectangle backing = axis.AnnotationBackings[i];
				int num = -1;
				for (int num2 = textBlocks.Count - 1; num2 >= 0; num2--)
				{
					if (textBlocks[num2] == axis.AnnotationTextBlocks[i])
					{
						num = num2;
						break;
					}
				}
				if (num != -1)
				{
					if (useRotation)
					{
						view.ArrangeBackingToText(backing, axis.AnnotationTextBlocks[i], axis.LabelPositions[num], labelBounds[num], leftMargin, topMargin, rightMargin, bottomMargin);
						view.SetBackingRotationTransform(backing, axis.AnnotationTextBlocks[i], axis.LabelPositions[num], labelBounds[num], leftMargin, topMargin, rightMargin, bottomMargin, effectiveAngle);
					}
					else
					{
						view.ArrangeBackingToText(backing, axis.AnnotationTextBlocks[i], axis.LabelPositions[num], labelBounds[num], leftMargin, topMargin, rightMargin, bottomMargin);
					}
				}
			}
		}

		private void Annotation_PropertyChanged(object sender, PropertyChangedEventArgs e)
		{
			Owner.MustInvalidateLabels = true;
			Owner.RenderAxis();
		}

		private void OnAnnotationsCollectionChanged(NotifyCollectionChangedEventArgs e)
		{
			if (e.OldItems != null)
			{
				for (int i = 0; i < e.OldItems.Count; i++)
				{
					object obj = e.OldItems[i];
					if (obj != null)
					{
						((IAxisAnnotation)obj).PropertyChanged -= Annotation_PropertyChanged;
					}
				}
			}
			if (e.NewItems != null)
			{
				for (int j = 0; j < e.NewItems.Count; j++)
				{
					object obj2 = e.NewItems[j];
					if (obj2 != null)
					{
						((IAxisAnnotation)obj2).PropertyChanged += Annotation_PropertyChanged;
					}
				}
			}
			Owner.MustInvalidateLabels = true;
			Owner.RenderAxis();
		}

		public void OnAnnotionsChanged(Axis axis, AxisAnnotationCollection annotations, NotifyCollectionChangedEventArgs e)
		{
			OnAnnotationsCollectionChanged(e);
		}

		public void OnAnnotionsReset(Axis axis, AxisAnnotationCollection annotations, EventArgs e)
		{
			foreach (AxisAnnotation annotation in annotations)
			{
				annotation.PropertyChanged -= Annotation_PropertyChanged;
			}
		}

		public void OnAutoAnnotionsChanged(Axis axis, AxisAnnotationCollection autoAnnotations, NotifyCollectionChangedEventArgs e)
		{
			OnAnnotationsCollectionChanged(e);
		}

		public void OnAutoAnnotionsReset(Axis axis, AxisAnnotationCollection autoAnnotations, EventArgs e)
		{
			foreach (AxisAnnotation autoAnnotation in autoAnnotations)
			{
				autoAnnotation.PropertyChanged -= Annotation_PropertyChanged;
			}
		}
	}

				break;
			case "BackgroundPadding":
				CachedBackgroundPadding = (Thickness)newValue;
				break;
			}
			CheckDirty = true;
		}
