	internal class CalloutAnnotationWrapper
	{
		private CalloutAnnotation _callout;

		public CalloutAnnotation Callout
		{
			get
			{
				return _callout;
			}
			set
			{
				_callout = value;
				_callout.Wrapper = this;
			}
		}

		public LabelCollisionInfo Label { get; set; }

		public override bool Equals(object other)
		{
			if (!(other is CalloutAnnotationWrapper calloutAnnotationWrapper))
			{
				return base.Equals(other);
			}
			if (calloutAnnotationWrapper.Callout == null && Callout == null)
			{
				return base.Equals(other);
			}
			if (calloutAnnotationWrapper.Callout == null)
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (Callout.CachedKey != null || calloutAnnotationWrapper.Callout.CachedKey != null)
			{
				return object.Equals(Callout.CachedKey, calloutAnnotationWrapper.Callout.CachedKey);
			}
			return base.Equals(other);
		}

		public override int GetHashCode()
		{
			if (Callout == null || Callout.CachedKey == null)
			{
				return base.GetHashCode();
			}
			return Callout.CachedKey.GetHashCode();
		}
	}
	[EditorBrowsable(EditorBrowsableState.Never)]
	public class CategoryHighlightFrameRect
	{
		public long TimeStamp { get; set; }

		public double Top { get; set; }

		public double Left { get; set; }

		public double Right { get; set; }

		public double Bottom { get; set; }

		public Brush Brush { get; set; }

		public Brush Outline { get; set; }

		public double StrokeThickness { get; set; }

		public CategoryHighlightFrameRect()
		{
			TimeStamp = 0L;
			Top = double.NaN;
			Left = double.NaN;
			Right = double.NaN;
			Left = double.NaN;
			Bottom = double.NaN;
			StrokeThickness = double.NaN;
		}
	}
	[EditorBrowsable(EditorBrowsableState.Never)]
	public class CategoryHighlightLayerFrame : Frame
	{
		private DictInterpolator<long, CategoryHighlightFrameRect, CategoryHighlightLayerFrame> _interpolator;

		public Dictionary<long, CategoryHighlightFrameRect> Rects { get; set; }

		public CategoryHighlightLayerFrame()
		{
			Rects = new Dictionary<long, CategoryHighlightFrameRect>();
			_interpolator = new DictInterpolator<long, CategoryHighlightFrameRect, CategoryHighlightLayerFrame>(InterpolateRect, (CategoryHighlightFrameRect r) => r.TimeStamp, (CategoryHighlightFrameRect r) => true, () => new CategoryHighlightFrameRect());
		}

		protected void InterpolateRect(CategoryHighlightFrameRect interpolated, float p, CategoryHighlightFrameRect min, CategoryHighlightFrameRect max, CategoryHighlightLayerFrame minFrame, CategoryHighlightLayerFrame maxFrame)
		{
			if (max != null)
			{
				interpolated.TimeStamp = max.TimeStamp;
			}
			else if (min != null)
			{
				interpolated.TimeStamp = min.TimeStamp;
			}
			else
			{
				interpolated.TimeStamp = 0L;
			}
			if (min == null || double.IsNaN(min.Top))
			{
				interpolated.Top = max?.Top ?? double.NaN;
			}
			else if (max == null || double.IsNaN(max.Top))
			{
				interpolated.Top = double.NaN;
			}
			else
			{
				interpolated.Top = min.Top + (double)p * (max.Top - min.Top);
			}
			if (min == null || double.IsNaN(min.Left))
			{
				interpolated.Left = max?.Left ?? double.NaN;
			}
			else if (max == null || double.IsNaN(max.Left))
			{
				interpolated.Left = double.NaN;
			}
			else
			{
				interpolated.Left = min.Left + (double)p * (max.Left - min.Left);
			}
			if (min == null || double.IsNaN(min.Right))
			{
				interpolated.Right = max?.Right ?? double.NaN;
			}
			else if (max == null || double.IsNaN(max.Right))
			{
				interpolated.Right = double.NaN;
			}
			else
			{
				interpolated.Right = min.Right + (double)p * (max.Right - min.Right);
			}
			if (min == null || double.IsNaN(min.Bottom))
			{
				interpolated.Bottom = max?.Bottom ?? double.NaN;
			}
			else if (max == null || double.IsNaN(max.Bottom))
			{
				interpolated.Bottom = double.NaN;
			}
			else
			{
				interpolated.Bottom = min.Bottom + (double)p * (max.Bottom - min.Bottom);
			}
			if (min == null || double.IsNaN(min.StrokeThickness))
			{
				interpolated.StrokeThickness = max?.StrokeThickness ?? double.NaN;
			}
			else if (max == null || double.IsNaN(max.StrokeThickness))
			{
				interpolated.StrokeThickness = double.NaN;
			}
			else
			{
				interpolated.StrokeThickness = min.StrokeThickness + (double)p * (max.StrokeThickness - min.StrokeThickness);
			}
			if (min == null || min.Brush == null)
			{
				interpolated.Brush = max?.Brush;
			}
			else if (max == null || max.Brush == null)
			{
				interpolated.Brush = null;
			}
			else
			{
				interpolated.Brush = min.Brush.GetInterpolation(p, max.Brush, InterpolationMode.RGB);
			}
			if (min == null || min.Outline == null)
			{
				interpolated.Outline = max?.Outline;
			}
			else if (max == null || max.Outline == null)
			{
				interpolated.Outline = null;
			}
			else
			{
				interpolated.Outline = min.Outline.GetInterpolation(p, max.Outline, InterpolationMode.RGB);
			}
		}

		public override void Interpolate(float p, Frame min, Frame max)
		{
			CategoryHighlightLayerFrame categoryHighlightLayerFrame = (CategoryHighlightLayerFrame)min;
			CategoryHighlightLayerFrame categoryHighlightLayerFrame2 = (CategoryHighlightLayerFrame)max;
			_interpolator.Interpolate(Rects, p, categoryHighlightLayerFrame.Rects, categoryHighlightLayerFrame2.Rects, categoryHighlightLayerFrame, categoryHighlightLayerFrame2);
		}
	}
	[WidgetIgnoreDepends("CategoryAxisBase")]
	public class CategoryHighlightLayer : AnnotationLayer
	{
		internal const string TargetAxisPropertyName = "TargetAxis";

		public CategoryHighlightLayer()
		{
			CategoryHighlightLayerFrame previousFrame = new CategoryHighlightLayerFrame();
			CategoryHighlightLayerFrame currentFrame = new CategoryHighlightLayerFrame();
			CategoryHighlightLayerFrame transitionFrame = new CategoryHighlightLayerFrame();
			_ = base.TransitionDuration.TotalSeconds;
			base.PreviousFrame = previousFrame;
			base.CurrentFrame = currentFrame;
			base.TransitionFrame = transitionFrame;
			base.DefaultStyleKey = typeof(CategoryHighlightLayer);
		}

		protected override SeriesView CreateView()
		{
			return new CategoryHighlightLayerView(this);
		}

		protected internal override void OnViewCreated(SeriesView view)
		{
			base.OnViewCreated(view);
			HighlightView = (CategoryHighlightLayerView)view;
		}

		protected override void OnDependentAxisRender(Axis axis, bool animate)
		{
			if ((TargetAxis == null || TargetAxis == axis) && !base.ContentInfo.IsDirty)
			{
				RenderSeries(animate);
			}
		}

		private bool IsAxisValid(CategoryAxisBase axis)
		{
			return axis?.IsValid() ?? false;
		}

		protected override void PrepareFrame(Frame frame, SeriesView view)
		{
			base.PrepareFrame(frame, view);
			CategoryHighlightLayerFrame categoryHighlightLayerFrame = (CategoryHighlightLayerFrame)frame;
			categoryHighlightLayerFrame.Rects.Clear();
			bool useInterpolation = UseInterpolation;
			if (double.IsNaN(CurrentPosition.X) && double.IsNaN(CurrentPosition.Y))
			{
				return;
			}
			if (TargetAxis != null)
			{
				if (IsAxisValid(TargetAxis))
				{
					PrepareSeries(TargetAxis, categoryHighlightLayerFrame, useInterpolation);
				}
			}
			else
			{
				if (!(base.SeriesViewer is XamDataChart))
				{
					return;
				}
				foreach (Axis axis in ((XamDataChart)base.SeriesViewer).Axes)
				{
					if (axis is CategoryAxisBase && IsAxisValid((CategoryAxisBase)axis))
					{
						PrepareSeries((CategoryAxisBase)axis, categoryHighlightLayerFrame, useInterpolation);
					}
				}
			}
		}

		private void PrepareSeries(CategoryAxisBase axis, CategoryHighlightLayerFrame f, bool useInterpolation)
		{
			if (base.View != null && !base.View.WindowRect.IsEmpty && !base.View.Viewport.IsEmpty)
			{
				double num = CurrentPosition.X;
				if (axis.IsVertical && double.IsNaN(num))
				{
					num = 0.0;
				}
				num = base.View.Viewport.Left + base.View.Viewport.Width * (num - base.View.WindowRect.Left) / base.View.WindowRect.Width;
				double num2 = CurrentPosition.Y;
				if (!axis.IsVertical && double.IsNaN(num2))
				{
					num2 = 0.0;
				}
				num2 = base.View.Viewport.Top + base.View.Viewport.Height * (num2 - base.View.WindowRect.Top) / base.View.WindowRect.Height;
				Rect categoryBoundingBox = axis.GetCategoryBoundingBox(new Point(num, num2), useInterpolation, BandHighlightWidth);
				PrepareRect(categoryBoundingBox, f, axis);
			}
		}

		internal virtual void PrepareRect(Rect rect, CategoryHighlightLayerFrame frame, Axis target)
		{
			CategoryHighlightFrameRect categoryHighlightFrameRect = new CategoryHighlightFrameRect();
			categoryHighlightFrameRect.Left = rect.Left;
			categoryHighlightFrameRect.Top = rect.Top;
			categoryHighlightFrameRect.Right = rect.Right;
			categoryHighlightFrameRect.Bottom = rect.Bottom;
			categoryHighlightFrameRect.Brush = GetBrush();
			categoryHighlightFrameRect.Outline = GetOutline();
			if (categoryHighlightFrameRect.Brush == null)
			{
				categoryHighlightFrameRect.Brush = HighlightView.GetLightenedTranslucentBrush(target.ActualStroke);
			}
			if (categoryHighlightFrameRect.Outline == null)
			{
				categoryHighlightFrameRect.Outline = HighlightView.GetLightenedTranslucentBrush(target.ActualStroke);
			}
			categoryHighlightFrameRect.StrokeThickness = base.ActualThickness;
			categoryHighlightFrameRect.TimeStamp = target.GetHashCode();
			if (!rect.IsEmpty)
			{
				frame.Rects.Add(categoryHighlightFrameRect.TimeStamp, categoryHighlightFrameRect);
			}
		}

		protected override void RenderFrame(Frame frame, SeriesView view)
		{
			base.RenderFrame(frame, view);
			Pool<Rectangle> rectPool = HighlightView.RectPool;
			CategoryHighlightLayerFrame obj = (CategoryHighlightLayerFrame)frame;
			int num = 0;
			foreach (CategoryHighlightFrameRect value in obj.Rects.Values)
			{
				Rectangle rectVisual = rectPool[num];
				RenderRect(value, rectVisual);
				num++;
			}
			rectPool.Count = num;
		}

		protected override bool RequiresPrepare()
		{
			return true;
		}

		internal virtual void RenderRect(CategoryHighlightFrameRect rect, Rectangle rectVisual)
		{
			if (double.IsNaN(rect.Left) || double.IsNaN(rect.Top) || double.IsNaN(rect.Bottom) || double.IsNaN(rect.Right) || double.IsNaN(rect.StrokeThickness))
			{
				rectVisual.Visibility = Visibility.Collapsed;
				return;
			}
			HighlightView.PositionRectangle(rectVisual, rect.Left, rect.Top, rect.Right - rect.Left, rect.Bottom - rect.Top);
			rectVisual.Fill = rect.Brush;
			rectVisual.Stroke = rect.Outline;
			rectVisual.StrokeThickness = rect.StrokeThickness;
			if (base.DashArray != null)
			{
				rectVisual.StrokeDashArray = base.DashArray.Duplicate();
			}
			else
			{
				rectVisual.StrokeDashArray = null;
			}
			rectVisual.StrokeDashCap = base.DashCap;
			rectVisual.StrokeLineJoin = base.LineJoin;
			rectVisual.StrokeStartLineCap = base.StartCap;
			rectVisual.StrokeEndLineCap = base.EndCap;
			rectVisual.StrokeMiterLimit = base.MiterLimit;
		}

		protected override void PropertyUpdatedOverride(object sender, string propertyName, object oldValue, object newValue)
		{
			base.PropertyUpdatedOverride(sender, propertyName, oldValue, newValue);
			if (!(propertyName == "TargetAxis"))
			{
				if (propertyName == "UseInterpolation")
				{
					RenderSeries(animate: true);
				}
			}
			else
			{
				RenderSeries(animate: true);
			}
		}
	}

		public CalloutLayer()
		{
			base.UseIndex = true;
			CalloutLayerFrame previousFrame = new CalloutLayerFrame();
			CalloutLayerFrame currentFrame = new CalloutLayerFrame();
			CalloutLayerFrame transitionFrame = new CalloutLayerFrame();
			_ = base.TransitionDuration.TotalSeconds;
			base.PreviousFrame = previousFrame;
			base.CurrentFrame = currentFrame;
			base.TransitionFrame = transitionFrame;
			base.DefaultStyleKey = typeof(CalloutLayer);
		}

		private void _callouts_CollectionResetting(object sender, EventArgs e)
		{
			_userCallouts.Clear();
			RenderSeries(animate: false);
		}

		protected override void DataUpdatedOverride(FastItemsSourceEventAction action, int position, int count, string propertyName)
		{
			base.DataUpdatedOverride(action, position, count, propertyName);
			Dictionary<string, Series> seriesMap = GetSeriesMap();
			switch (action)
			{
			case FastItemsSourceEventAction.Change:
				UpdateCallout(position, seriesMap);
				break;
			case FastItemsSourceEventAction.Insert:
			{
				for (int j = position; j < position + count; j++)
				{
					CalloutAnnotation callout2 = new CalloutAnnotation();
					CalloutAnnotationWrapper calloutAnnotationWrapper2 = new CalloutAnnotationWrapper();
					calloutAnnotationWrapper2.Callout = callout2;
					calloutAnnotationWrapper2.Callout.Series = TargetSeries;
					_userCallouts.Insert(j, calloutAnnotationWrapper2);
					UpdateCallout(j, seriesMap);
				}
				break;
			}
			case FastItemsSourceEventAction.Remove:
				_userCallouts.RemoveRange(position, count);
				break;
			case FastItemsSourceEventAction.Replace:
			{
				for (int k = position; k < position + count; k++)
				{
					UpdateCallout(k, seriesMap);
				}
				break;
			}
			case FastItemsSourceEventAction.Reset:
			{
				_userCallouts.Clear();
				for (int i = 0; i < base.FastItemsSource.Count; i++)
				{
					CalloutAnnotation callout = new CalloutAnnotation();
					CalloutAnnotationWrapper calloutAnnotationWrapper = new CalloutAnnotationWrapper();
					calloutAnnotationWrapper.Callout = callout;
					calloutAnnotationWrapper.Callout.Series = TargetSeries;
					_userCallouts.Add(calloutAnnotationWrapper);
					UpdateCallout(i, seriesMap);
				}
				break;
			}
			}
			RenderSeries(animate: true);
		}

		internal override bool ShouldAnimate(bool animate)
		{
			return false;
		}

		private Dictionary<string, Series> GetSeriesMap()
		{
			Dictionary<string, Series> dictionary = new Dictionary<string, Series>();
			if (base.SeriesViewer != null)
			{
				for (int i = 0; i < base.SeriesViewer.Series.Count; i++)
				{
					Series series = base.SeriesViewer.Series[i];
					if (series.Name != null && !dictionary.ContainsKey(series.Name))
					{
						dictionary.Add(series.Name, series);
					}
				}
			}
			return dictionary;
		}

		private void UpdateCallout(int position, Dictionary<string, Series> seriesMap)
		{
			if (YColumn == null || LabelColumn == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			object xValue = position;
			if (XColumn != null)
			{
				xValue = XColumn[position];
			}
			object yValue = YColumn[position];
			object obj = LabelColumn[position];
			CalloutAnnotationWrapper calloutAnnotationWrapper = _userCallouts[position];
			if (KeyColumn != null && calloutAnnotationWrapper.Callout.CachedKey != KeyColumn[position])
			{
				calloutAnnotationWrapper.Callout.Key = KeyColumn[position];
			}
			if (_currentCalloutsMap.ContainsKey(calloutAnnotationWrapper))
			{
				calloutAnnotationWrapper.Callout = _currentCalloutsMap[calloutAnnotationWrapper].Value.Callout;
			}
			calloutAnnotationWrapper.Callout.XValue = xValue;
			calloutAnnotationWrapper.Callout.YValue = yValue;
			if (this.CalloutLabelUpdating != null)
			{
				CalloutLabelUpdatingEventArgs e = new CalloutLabelUpdatingEventArgs
				{
					XValue = xValue,
					YValue = yValue,
					Item = base.FastItemsSource[position]
				};
				this.CalloutLabelUpdating(this, e);
				if (e.Label != null && !object.Equals(e.Label, calloutAnnotationWrapper.Callout.CachedText))
				{
					object label = e.Label;
					calloutAnnotationWrapper.Callout.Text = ((label != null) ? label.ToString() : "");
				}
			}
			else
			{
				calloutAnnotationWrapper.Callout.Text = ((obj != null) ? obj.ToString() : "");
			}
			if (ContentColumn != null)
			{
				calloutAnnotationWrapper.Callout.Content = ContentColumn[position];
			}
			else
			{
				calloutAnnotationWrapper.Callout.Content = base.FastItemsSource[position];
			}
			if (this.CalloutSeriesSelecting != null)
			{
				CalloutSeriesSelectingEventArgs e2 = new CalloutSeriesSelectingEventArgs
				{
					XValue = xValue,
					YValue = yValue,
					Item = base.FastItemsSource[position]
				};
				this.CalloutSeriesSelecting(this, e2);
				if (e2.Series != null)
				{
					calloutAnnotationWrapper.Callout.Series = e2.Series;
				}
				else if (e2.SeriesName != null && seriesMap.ContainsKey(e2.SeriesName))
				{
					calloutAnnotationWrapper.Callout.Series = seriesMap[e2.SeriesName];
				}
			}
			UpdateCalloutVisuals(calloutAnnotationWrapper);
		}

		private void UpdateCalloutVisuals(CalloutAnnotationWrapper callout)
		{
			Thickness thickness = new Thickness(3.0);
			thickness = ((!double.IsNaN(CalloutPadding.Left) && !double.IsNaN(CalloutPadding.Top) && !double.IsNaN(CalloutPadding.Right) && !double.IsNaN(CalloutPadding.Bottom)) ? CalloutPadding : new Thickness(3.0));
			Brush background = ((CalloutBackground != null) ? CalloutBackground : CalloutView.GetDefaultCalloutBackground(callout.Callout.CachedSeries));
			Brush foreground = ((CalloutTextColor != null) ? CalloutTextColor : CalloutView.GetDefaultCalloutTextColor());
			Brush outline = ((CalloutOutline != null) ? CalloutOutline : CalloutView.GetDefaultCalloutOutline());
			Brush leaderBrush = ((CalloutLeaderBrush != null) ? CalloutLeaderBrush : CalloutView.GetDefaultCalloutLeaderBrush(callout.Callout.CachedSeries));
			double strokeThickness = (double.IsNaN(CalloutStrokeThickness) ? 0.0 : CalloutStrokeThickness);
			if (IsCustomCalloutStyleEnabled && this.CalloutStyleUpdating != null)
			{
				CalloutStyleUpdatingEventArgs e = new CalloutStyleUpdatingEventArgs();
				e.Item = callout.Callout.CachedContent;
				e.XValue = callout.Callout.CachedXValue;
				e.YValue = callout.Callout.CachedYValue;
				e.Series = callout.Callout.CachedSeries;
				e.Background = background;
				e.Foreground = foreground;
				e.Outline = outline;
				e.LeaderBrush = leaderBrush;
				e.StrokeThickness = strokeThickness;
				this.CalloutStyleUpdating(this, e);
				background = e.Background;
				foreground = e.Foreground;
				outline = e.Outline;
				leaderBrush = e.LeaderBrush;
				strokeThickness = e.StrokeThickness;
			}
			callout.Callout.BackgroundPadding = thickness;
			callout.Callout.Background = background;
			callout.Callout.Foreground = foreground;
			callout.Callout.Outline = outline;
			callout.Callout.LeaderBrush = leaderBrush;
			callout.Callout.StrokeThickness = strokeThickness;
		}

		public override object GetItemValue(object item, string memberPathName)
		{
			return ResolveMemberPath(memberPathName) switch
			{
				"LabelMemberPath" => GetItemValueByMemberPath(item, memberPathName, LabelMemberPath), 
				"XMemberPath" => GetItemValueByMemberPath(item, memberPathName, XMemberPath), 
				"YMemberPath" => GetItemValueByMemberPath(item, memberPathName, YMemberPath), 
				"KeyMemberPath" => GetItemValueByMemberPath(item, memberPathName, KeyMemberPath), 
				"ContentMemberPath" => GetItemValueByMemberPath(item, memberPathName, ContentMemberPath), 
				_ => base.GetItemValue(item, memberPathName), 
			};
		}

		private void Callout_PropertyChanged(object sender, PropertyChangedEventArgs e)
		{
			if (e.PropertyName == "XValue" || e.PropertyName == "YValue")
			{
				CalloutAnnotationWrapper wrapper = ((CalloutAnnotation)sender).Wrapper;
				if (!_repositionedCalloutsSet.Contains(wrapper))
				{
					_repositionedCalloutsSet.Add(wrapper);
					_repositionedCallouts.Add(wrapper);
					RenderSeries(animate: false);
				}
			}
		}

			if ((TargetSeries == null || TargetSeries == series) && !base.ContentInfo.IsDirty)
			{
				RenderSeries(animate);
			}
		}

		protected override void PrepareFrame(Frame frame, SeriesView view)
		{
			base.PrepareFrame(frame, view);
			CalloutLayerFrame calloutLayerFrame = (CalloutLayerFrame)frame;
			calloutLayerFrame.Contents.Clear();
			calloutLayerFrame.Contexts.Clear();
			calloutLayerFrame.Callouts.Clear();
			calloutLayerFrame.CalloutBackgrounds.Clear();
			calloutLayerFrame.CalloutOutlines.Clear();
			calloutLayerFrame.CalloutLeaderBrushes.Clear();
			calloutLayerFrame.CalloutPaddingsLeft.Clear();
			calloutLayerFrame.CalloutPaddingsTop.Clear();
			calloutLayerFrame.CalloutPaddingsRight.Clear();
			calloutLayerFrame.CalloutPaddingsBottom.Clear();
			calloutLayerFrame.CalloutStrokeThicknesses.Clear();
			calloutLayerFrame.CalloutTextColors.Clear();
			calloutLayerFrame.TargetXPositions.Clear();
			calloutLayerFrame.TargetYPositions.Clear();
			calloutLayerFrame.LabelXPositions.Clear();
			calloutLayerFrame.LabelYPositions.Clear();
			List<CalloutAnnotationWrapper> activeUserCallouts = GetActiveUserCallouts();
			List<CalloutAnnotationWrapper> activeSeriesCallouts = new List<CalloutAnnotationWrapper>();
			if (IsAutoCalloutBehaviorEnabled)
			{
				if (IsSeriesValid(TargetSeries))
				{
					PrepareSeries(TargetSeries, calloutLayerFrame, activeSeriesCallouts);
				}
				else
				{
					foreach (Series item in base.SeriesViewer.Series)
					{
						if (IsSeriesValid(item))
						{
							PrepareSeries(item, calloutLayerFrame, activeSeriesCallouts);
						}
					}
				}
			}
			PrepareCallouts(calloutLayerFrame, activeUserCallouts, activeSeriesCallouts);
		}

		protected override void WindowRectChangedOverride(Rect oldWindowRect, Rect newWindowRect)
		{
			base.WindowRectChangedOverride(oldWindowRect, newWindowRect);
			double num = newWindowRect.Width - _lastPrepareWindow.Width;
			double num2 = newWindowRect.Height - _lastPrepareWindow.Height;
			double num3 = 0.0;
			if (Math.Abs(num) > Math.Abs(num2))
			{
				num3 = num;
				_zoomPixelChange = num * base.Viewport.Width;
			}
			else
			{
				num3 = num2;
				_zoomPixelChange = num2 * base.Viewport.Height;
			}
			if (num3 > 0.0 && _zoomPixelChange > 5.0)
			{
				_zoomedOut = true;
			}
			if (num3 < 0.0 && _zoomPixelChange > 5.0)
			{
				_zoomedIn = true;
			}
		}

		protected override void ViewportRectChangedOverride(Rect oldViewportRect, Rect newViewportRect)
		{
			base.ViewportRectChangedOverride(oldViewportRect, newViewportRect);
			if (!oldViewportRect.Equals(newViewportRect))
			{
				_viewportChanged = true;
			}
		}

		private void PrepareCallouts(CalloutLayerFrame f, List<CalloutAnnotationWrapper> activeUserCallouts, List<CalloutAnnotationWrapper> activeSeriesCallouts)
		{
			if (base.SeriesViewer != null)
			{
				_lastPrepareWindow = base.SeriesViewer.ActualWindowRect;
			}
			if (base.Viewport.IsEmpty)
			{
				return;
			}
			CalloutsViewport = new Rect(base.Viewport.Left, base.Viewport.Top, base.Viewport.Width, base.Viewport.Height);
			if (_collisionManager != null && CollisionChannel != null && CollisionChannel != _collisionManager.CollisionChannel)
			{
				DetachCollisionManager();
			}
			if (_collisionManager == null)
			{
				LabelCollisionManager channelManager = GetChannelManager();
				if (channelManager != null)
				{
					_collisionManager = channelManager;
					_collisionManager.LabelsMoved += _collisionManager_LabelsMoved;
				}
				else
				{
					GetContentViewport(base.View);
					LabelCollisionPlacementPositions topPriority = LabelCollisionPlacementPositions.Top;
					if (TargetSeries != null)
					{
						if (TargetSeries.IsVertical)
						{
							topPriority = LabelCollisionPlacementPositions.Right;
						}
					}
					else
					{
						bool flag = false;
						if (base.SeriesViewer != null && base.SeriesViewer.Series.Count > 0)
						{
							flag = true;
							foreach (Series item in base.SeriesViewer.Series)
							{
								if (!item.IsAnnotationLayer && !item.IsVertical)
								{
									flag = false;
								}
							}
						}
						if (flag)
						{
							topPriority = LabelCollisionPlacementPositions.Right;
						}
					}
					_collisionManager = new LabelCollisionManager(base.Viewport.Right, base.Viewport.Bottom, base.Viewport, CalloutView.GetExecutionContext(), CalloutPositionPadding, ResolveCollisionMode(), topPriority, ResolveAnnealingStepCount(), ResolveAnnealingMilliseconds(), IsCalloutOffsettingEnabled);
					if (CollisionChannel != null)
					{
						_collisionManager.CollisionChannel = CollisionChannel;
						_collisionManager.Owner = this;
					}
					_collisionManager.LabelsMoved += _collisionManager_LabelsMoved;
				}
			}
			if (_zoomedIn)
			{
				_zoomedIn = false;
				if (_collisionManager.CollisionsCount > 2)
				{
					_needsCollision = true;
				}
			}
			if (_zoomedOut)
			{
				_zoomedOut = false;
				if (_zoomPixelChange > 5.0)
				{
					_needsCollision = true;
				}
			}
			if (_viewportChanged)
			{
				_viewportChanged = false;
				_collisionManager.Resize(base.Viewport.Right, base.Viewport.Bottom, base.Viewport);
				_needsCollision = true;
			}
			HashSet<CalloutAnnotationWrapper> hashSet = new HashSet<CalloutAnnotationWrapper>();
			HashSet<CalloutAnnotationWrapper> hashSet2 = new HashSet<CalloutAnnotationWrapper>();
			List<CalloutAnnotationWrapper> list = new List<CalloutAnnotationWrapper>();
			List<CalloutAnnotationWrapper> list2 = new List<CalloutAnnotationWrapper>();
			HashSet<CalloutAnnotationWrapper> hashSet3 = new HashSet<CalloutAnnotationWrapper>();
			for (int i = 0; i < activeUserCallouts.Count; i++)
			{
				hashSet3.Add(activeUserCallouts[i]);
			}
			for (int j = 0; j < activeSeriesCallouts.Count; j++)
			{
				hashSet3.Add(activeSeriesCallouts[j]);
			}
			LinkedListNode<CalloutAnnotationWrapper> linkedListNode = _currentCallouts.First;
			while (linkedListNode != null)
			{
				LinkedListNode<CalloutAnnotationWrapper> next = linkedListNode.Next;
				if (!hashSet3.Contains(linkedListNode.Value))
				{
					list2.Add(linkedListNode.Value);
					hashSet2.Add(linkedListNode.Value);
					linkedListNode.Value.Callout.PropertyChanged -= Callout_PropertyChanged;
					_currentCallouts.Remove(linkedListNode);
					_currentCalloutsMap.Remove(linkedListNode.Value);
					_collisionManager.RemoveLabel(linkedListNode.Value.Label);
				}
				linkedListNode = next;
			}
			for (int k = 0; k < activeUserCallouts.Count; k++)
			{
				if (!_currentCalloutsMap.ContainsKey(activeUserCallouts[k]))
				{
					_currentCallouts.AddLast(activeUserCallouts[k]);
					activeUserCallouts[k].Callout.PropertyChanged += Callout_PropertyChanged;
					_currentCalloutsMap.Add(activeUserCallouts[k], _currentCallouts.Last);
					list.Add(activeUserCallouts[k]);
					hashSet.Add(activeUserCallouts[k]);
					_needsCollision = true;
				}
			}
			for (int l = 0; l < activeSeriesCallouts.Count; l++)
			{
				if (!_currentCalloutsMap.ContainsKey(activeSeriesCallouts[l]))
				{
					_currentCallouts.AddLast(activeSeriesCallouts[l]);
					_currentCalloutsMap.Add(activeSeriesCallouts[l], _currentCallouts.Last);
					activeSeriesCallouts[l].Callout.PropertyChanged += Callout_PropertyChanged;
					list.Add(activeSeriesCallouts[l]);
					hashSet.Add(activeSeriesCallouts[l]);
					_needsCollision = true;
				}
			}
			if (_dataSourceChanged)
			{
				_dataSourceChanged = false;
				_needsCollision = true;
			}
			if (_repositionedCallouts.Count > 0)
			{
				_needsCollision = true;
				_repositionedCallouts.Clear();
				_repositionedCalloutsSet.Clear();
			}
			for (linkedListNode = _currentCallouts.First; linkedListNode != null; linkedListNode = linkedListNode.Next)
			{
				QuadTreeBoundingBox targetBox = GetTargetBox(linkedListNode.Value);
				if (targetBox == null)
				{
					return;
				}
				if (!targetBox.Equals(linkedListNode.Value.Label.TargetBox))
				{
					bool flag2 = false;
					if (linkedListNode.Value.Label.TargetBox == null)
					{
						flag2 = true;
					}
					LabelCollisionInfo label = linkedListNode.Value.Label;
					label.TargetX = targetBox.CenterX;
					label.TargetY = targetBox.CenterY;
					if (!double.IsNaN(label.TargetX) && !double.IsNaN(label.TargetY))
					{
						label.TargetHalfWidth = targetBox.HalfWidth;
						label.TargetHalfHeight = targetBox.HalfHeight;
						if (label.ActualLabelBox == null)
						{
							_collisionManager.FindOptimisticPosition(label);
						}
						if (flag2)
						{
							_collisionManager.AddLabel(label);
						}
						else
						{
							_collisionManager.MoveTarget(label);
						}
					}
				}
			}
			int currentCollisionCount = _collisionManager.GetCurrentCollisionCount();
			bool flag3 = _collisionManager.HasBoundaryCollisions();
			if (_needsCollision && (currentCollisionCount != 0 || flag3))
			{
				_needsCollision = false;
				_currentColliding = int.MaxValue;
				if (CollisionChannel != null)
				{
					bool flag4 = true;
					for (int m = 0; m < base.SeriesViewer.Series.Count; m++)
					{
						Series series = base.SeriesViewer.Series[m];
						if (series.IsAnnotationLayer && series is CalloutLayer)
						{
							CalloutLayer calloutLayer = (CalloutLayer)series;
							if (calloutLayer.CollisionChannel == CollisionChannel && !calloutLayer.CalloutsViewport.Equals(_collisionManager.Viewport))
							{
								flag4 = false;
								break;
							}
						}
					}
					if (flag4)
					{
						_collisionManager.StartCollision();
					}
					else
					{
						_collisionManager.Cancel();
						_collisionManager.ClearMovedLabelsCache();
					}
				}
				else
				{
					_collisionManager.StartCollision();
				}
			}
			else
			{
				_collisionManager.ClearMovedLabelsCache();
			}
			for (LinkedListNode<CalloutAnnotationWrapper> linkedListNode2 = _currentCallouts.First; linkedListNode2 != null; linkedListNode2 = linkedListNode2.Next)
			{
				CalloutAnnotationWrapper value = linkedListNode2.Value;
				f.Callouts.Add(value);
				f.CalloutBackgrounds.Add(value.Callout.CachedBackground);
				f.CalloutOutlines.Add(value.Callout.CachedOutline);
				f.CalloutLeaderBrushes.Add(value.Callout.CachedLeaderBrush);
				f.CalloutPaddingsLeft.Add(value.Callout.BackgroundPadding.Left);
				f.CalloutPaddingsTop.Add(value.Callout.BackgroundPadding.Top);
				f.CalloutPaddingsRight.Add(value.Callout.BackgroundPadding.Right);
				f.CalloutPaddingsBottom.Add(value.Callout.BackgroundPadding.Bottom);
				f.CalloutStrokeThicknesses.Add(value.Callout.CachedStrokeThickness);
				f.CalloutTextColors.Add(value.Callout.CachedForeground);
				f.Contents.Add(value.Callout.CachedText);
				f.Contexts.Add(value.Callout.CachedContent);
				_ = value.Label;
				f.TargetXPositions.Add(value.Label.TargetX - (value.Label.ActualCenterX - value.Label.LabelHalfWidth));
				f.TargetYPositions.Add(value.Label.TargetY - (value.Label.ActualCenterY - value.Label.LabelHalfHeight));
				f.LabelXPositions.Add(value.Label.ActualCenterX - value.Label.LabelHalfWidth);
				f.LabelYPositions.Add(value.Label.ActualCenterY - value.Label.LabelHalfHeight);
			}
		}

		private void DetachCollisionManager()
		{
			if (_collisionManager != null)
			{
				for (LinkedListNode<CalloutAnnotationWrapper> linkedListNode = _currentCallouts.First; linkedListNode != null; linkedListNode = linkedListNode.Next)
				{
					LabelCollisionInfo label = linkedListNode.Value.Label;
					if (label != null)
					{
						_collisionManager.RemoveLabel(label);
					}
				}
				_collisionManager.LabelsMoved -= _collisionManager_LabelsMoved;
				_collisionManager = null;
			}
			ClearCallouts();
		}

		private LabelCollisionManager GetChannelManager()
		{
			if (base.SeriesViewer == null)
			{
				return null;
			}
			for (int i = 0; i < base.SeriesViewer.Series.Count; i++)
			{
				Series series = base.SeriesViewer.Series[i];
				if (series.IsAnnotationLayer && series is CalloutLayer)
				{
					CalloutLayer calloutLayer = (CalloutLayer)series;
					if (calloutLayer != this && calloutLayer.CollisionChannel != null && calloutLayer.CollisionChannel == CollisionChannel && calloutLayer._collisionManager != null)
					{
						return calloutLayer._collisionManager;
					}
				}
			}
			return null;
		}

		private int ResolveAnnealingMilliseconds()
		{
			return 20000;
		}

		private int ResolveAnnealingStepCount()
		{
			return 300;
		}

		private LabelCollisionManagerCollisionMode ResolveCollisionMode()
		{
			return CalloutCollisionMode switch
			{
				CalloutCollisionMode.Auto => LabelCollisionManagerCollisionMode.GreedyCenterOfMass, 
				CalloutCollisionMode.Greedy => LabelCollisionManagerCollisionMode.Greedy, 
				CalloutCollisionMode.GreedyCenterOfMass => LabelCollisionManagerCollisionMode.GreedyCenterOfMass, 
				CalloutCollisionMode.SimulatedAnnealing => LabelCollisionManagerCollisionMode.SimulatedAnnealing, 
				_ => LabelCollisionManagerCollisionMode.GreedyCenterOfMass, 
			};
		}

		private void _collisionManager_LabelsMoved(List<LabelCollisionInfo> obj)
		{
			int currentCollisionCount = _collisionManager.GetCurrentCollisionCount();
			if (currentCollisionCount < _currentColliding)
			{
				_currentColliding = currentCollisionCount;
				RenderSeries(animate: false);
			}
		}

		private QuadTreeBoundingBox GetTargetBox(CalloutAnnotationWrapper value)
		{
			Series series = TargetSeries;
			if (value.Callout.CachedSeries != null)
			{
				series = value.Callout.CachedSeries;
			}
			if (series == null)
			{
				for (int i = 0; i < base.SeriesViewer.Series.Count; i++)
				{
					Series series2 = base.SeriesViewer.Series[i];
					if (!series2.IsAnnotationLayer)
					{
						series = series2;
						break;
					}
				}
			}
			if (series == null)
			{
				return null;
			}
			Axis[] axes = series.GetAxes();
			double referenceValue = series.GetReferenceValue();
			Axis axis = null;
			Axis axis2 = null;
			bool flag = false;
			for (int j = 0; j < axes.Length; j++)
			{
				if (axes[j].IsAngular)
				{
					flag = true;
					axis = axes[j];
				}
				else if (axes[j].IsRadial)
				{
					flag = true;
					axis2 = axes[j];
				}
				else if (axes[j].IsVertical)
				{
					axis2 = axes[j];
				}
				else
				{
					axis = axes[j];
				}
			}
			if (axis == null || axis2 == null)
			{
				return null;
			}
			if (!axis.IsValid() || !axis2.IsValid())
			{
				return null;
			}
			double num = 0.0;
			double num2 = 0.0;
			if (axis.IsCategory && ((CategoryAxisBase)axis).CategoryMode != CategoryMode.Mode0)
			{
				if (series.IsFinancial)
				{
					num = ((IHasCategoryAxis)series).GetOffsetValue();
				}
				else if (series.IsCategory)
				{
					num = ((IHasCategoryAxis)series).GetOffsetValue();
				}
			}
			if (axis2.IsCategory && ((CategoryAxisBase)axis2).CategoryMode != CategoryMode.Mode0 && series.IsCategory)
			{
				num2 = ((IHasCategoryAxis)series).GetOffsetValue();
			}
			ScalerParams scalerParams = new ScalerParams(base.SeriesViewer.ActualWindowRect, axis.ViewportRect, axis.IsInverted, axis.GetCurrentEffectiveViewport());
			scalerParams.ReferenceValue = referenceValue;
			ScalerParams scalerParams2 = new ScalerParams(base.SeriesViewer.ActualWindowRect, axis2.ViewportRect, axis2.IsInverted, axis2.GetCurrentEffectiveViewport());
			scalerParams2.ReferenceValue = referenceValue;
			double num3 = 0.0;
			double num4 = 0.0;
			if (flag)
			{
				num3 = axis.GetScaledValue(ConvertToDouble(value.Callout.CachedXValue), scalerParams) + num;
				num4 = axis2.GetScaledValue(ConvertToDouble(value.Callout.CachedYValue), scalerParams2) + num2;
				double num5 = num3;
				double num6 = num4;
				Point point = new Point(0.5, 0.5);
				num3 = ViewportUtils.TransformXToViewport(point.X + num6 * Math.Cos(num5), scalerParams.WindowRect, scalerParams.ViewportRect);
				num4 = ViewportUtils.TransformYToViewport(point.Y + num6 * Math.Sin(num5), scalerParams2.WindowRect, scalerParams2.ViewportRect);
			}
			else
			{
				num3 = axis.GetScaledValue(ConvertToDouble(value.Callout.CachedXValue), scalerParams) + num;
				num4 = axis2.GetScaledValue(ConvertToDouble(value.Callout.CachedYValue), scalerParams2) + num2;
			}
			return new QuadTreeBoundingBox
			{
				CenterX = num3,
				CenterY = num4,
				HalfWidth = 3.0,
				HalfHeight = 3.0,
				Data = value.Callout
			};
		}

		private double ConvertToDouble(object x)
		{
			if (x is DateTime dateTime)
			{
				return dateTime.Ticks;
			}
			return Convert.ToDouble(x);
		}

		private List<CalloutAnnotationWrapper> GetActiveUserCallouts()
		{
			List<CalloutAnnotationWrapper> list = new List<CalloutAnnotationWrapper>();
			for (int i = 0; i < _userCallouts.Count; i++)
			{
				if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(_userCallouts[i].Callout.CachedText))
				{
					if (_userCallouts[i].Label == null)
					{
						LabelCollisionInfo labelCollisionInfo = new LabelCollisionInfo();
						_userCallouts[i].Label = labelCollisionInfo;
						Size sizeForContent = CalloutView.GetSizeForContent(ResolveContent(_userCallouts[i]), _userCallouts[i].Callout.BackgroundPadding);
						labelCollisionInfo.LabelHalfHeight = sizeForContent.Height / 2.0;
						labelCollisionInfo.LabelHalfWidth = sizeForContent.Width / 2.0;
					}
					QuadTreeBoundingBox targetBox = GetTargetBox(_userCallouts[i]);
					if (targetBox != null && !(targetBox.CenterX < base.Viewport.Left) && !(targetBox.CenterX > base.Viewport.Right) && !(targetBox.CenterY < base.Viewport.Top) && !(targetBox.CenterY > base.Viewport.Bottom))
					{
						list.Add(_userCallouts[i]);
					}
				}
			}
			return list;
		}

		private object ResolveContent(CalloutAnnotationWrapper calloutAnnotationWrapper)
		{
			return calloutAnnotationWrapper.Callout.CachedText;
		}

		protected override bool IsSeriesValid(Series series)
		{
			if (!base.IsSeriesValid(series))
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (TargetSeriesName != null)
			{
				if (series.IsFragment)
				{
					string value = series.ResolveFragmentName();
					if (!TargetSeriesName.Equals(value))
					{
						return false;
					}
				}
				else if (!TargetSeriesName.Equals(series.Name))
				{
					return false;
				}
			}
			return true;
		}

		protected internal override void OnBeforeContentRefresh()
		{
			base.OnBeforeContentRefresh();
			if (base.ContentInfo.IsDirty || AnimationActive())
			{
				if (_calloutsDirty)
				{
					_calloutsDirty = false;
					EnsureCallouts();
				}
				if (AnimationActive())
				{
					UpdateAnnotations((CalloutLayerFrame)base.TransitionFrame, forceAxisUpdate: false);
				}
				else
				{
					UpdateAnnotations((CalloutLayerFrame)base.CurrentFrame, forceAxisUpdate: false);
				}
			}
		}

		public void InvalidateCalloutContent()
		{
			if (!_mustInvalidateContent)
			{
				_mustInvalidateContent = true;
				RenderSeries(animate: true);
			}
		}

		private void PrepareSeries(Series series, CalloutLayerFrame f, List<CalloutAnnotationWrapper> activeSeriesCallouts)
		{
			bool flag = false;
			if (_mustInvalidateContent)
			{
				_mustInvalidateContent = false;
				flag = true;
			}
			if (!series.GetVisiblePointsOfInterest(_points, UseValueForAutoCalloutLabels, AutoCalloutLabelPrecision))
			{
				return;
			}
			List<SeriesPointOfInterest> points = _points;
			for (int i = 0; i < _points.Count; i++)
			{
				SeriesPointOfInterest seriesPointOfInterest = points[i];
				object obj = ((seriesPointOfInterest.DataContext.Item != null) ? seriesPointOfInterest.DataContext.Item : seriesPointOfInterest.DataContext);
				CalloutKey key = new CalloutKey(obj, series);
				CalloutAnnotationWrapper calloutAnnotationWrapper = new CalloutAnnotationWrapper();
				CalloutAnnotation calloutAnnotation = (calloutAnnotationWrapper.Callout = new CalloutAnnotation());
				calloutAnnotation.Key = key;
				bool flag2 = false;
				if (_currentCalloutsMap.ContainsKey(calloutAnnotationWrapper))
				{
					calloutAnnotationWrapper = _currentCalloutsMap[calloutAnnotationWrapper].Value;
					calloutAnnotation = calloutAnnotationWrapper.Callout;
					flag2 = flag;
				}
				else
				{
					flag2 = true;
				}
				object cachedXValue = calloutAnnotation.CachedXValue;
				object cachedYValue = calloutAnnotation.CachedYValue;
				if (ConvertToDouble(cachedXValue) != ConvertToDouble(seriesPointOfInterest.XValue))
				{
					calloutAnnotation.XValue = seriesPointOfInterest.XValue;
				}
				if (ConvertToDouble(cachedYValue) != ConvertToDouble(seriesPointOfInterest.YValue))
				{
					calloutAnnotation.YValue = seriesPointOfInterest.YValue;
				}
				calloutAnnotation.Series = series;
				bool flag3 = false;
				if (seriesPointOfInterest.Label != calloutAnnotation.UnformattedText)
				{
					calloutAnnotation.UnformattedText = seriesPointOfInterest.Label;
					flag3 = true;
				}
				if (flag2 || flag3)
				{
					if (this.CalloutLabelUpdating != null)
					{
						CalloutLabelUpdatingEventArgs e = new CalloutLabelUpdatingEventArgs
						{
							XValue = calloutAnnotation.CachedXValue,
							YValue = calloutAnnotation.CachedYValue,
							Item = obj
						};
						this.CalloutLabelUpdating(this, e);
						if (e.Label != null && !object.Equals(e.Label, calloutAnnotationWrapper.Callout.CachedText))
						{
							object label = e.Label;
							calloutAnnotationWrapper.Callout.Text = ((label != null) ? label.ToString() : "");
						}
					}
					else if (seriesPointOfInterest.Label != null)
					{
						calloutAnnotation.Text = seriesPointOfInterest.Label;
					}
				}
				if (calloutAnnotation.CachedText == null)
				{
					continue;
				}
				if (flag2 || flag3)
				{
					if (this.CalloutContentUpdating != null)
					{
						CalloutContentUpdatingEventArgs e2 = new CalloutContentUpdatingEventArgs
						{
							XValue = calloutAnnotation.CachedXValue,
							YValue = calloutAnnotation.CachedYValue,
							Item = obj,
							Content = obj
						};
						this.CalloutContentUpdating(this, e2);
						if (e2.Content != null && e2.Content != calloutAnnotationWrapper.Callout.CachedContent)
						{
							calloutAnnotationWrapper.Callout.Content = e2.Content;
						}
					}
					else if (obj != null && obj != calloutAnnotationWrapper.Callout.CachedContent)
					{
						calloutAnnotationWrapper.Callout.Content = obj;
					}
				}
				if (flag2)
				{
					UpdateCalloutVisuals(calloutAnnotationWrapper);
				}
				if (calloutAnnotationWrapper.Label == null)
				{
					LabelCollisionInfo labelCollisionInfo = (calloutAnnotationWrapper.Label = new LabelCollisionInfo());
					Size sizeForContent = CalloutView.GetSizeForContent(ResolveContent(calloutAnnotationWrapper), calloutAnnotationWrapper.Callout.BackgroundPadding);
					labelCollisionInfo.LabelHalfHeight = sizeForContent.Height / 2.0;
					labelCollisionInfo.LabelHalfWidth = sizeForContent.Width / 2.0;
				}
				QuadTreeBoundingBox targetBox = GetTargetBox(calloutAnnotationWrapper);
				if (targetBox != null && !(targetBox.CenterX < base.Viewport.Left) && !(targetBox.CenterX > base.Viewport.Right) && !(targetBox.CenterY < base.Viewport.Top) && !(targetBox.CenterY > base.Viewport.Bottom))
				{
					activeSeriesCallouts.Add(calloutAnnotationWrapper);
				}
			}
		}

		public override bool TestHit(Point position, bool isFinger)
		{
			if (_collisionManager == null)
			{
				return false;
			}
			return _collisionManager.TestHit(position, isFinger) != null;
		}

		protected void UpdateAnnotations(CalloutLayerFrame frame, bool forceAxisUpdate)
		{
			int num = 0;
			HashSet<CalloutAnnotationWrapper> hashSet = new HashSet<CalloutAnnotationWrapper>();
			for (num = 0; num < frame.Contents.Count; num++)
			{
				CalloutAnnotationWrapper calloutAnnotationWrapper = (CalloutAnnotationWrapper)frame.Callouts[num];
				if (!double.IsNaN(frame.TargetXPositions[num]) && !double.IsNaN(frame.TargetYPositions[num]))
				{
					CalloutView calloutView = CalloutView.CalloutPool[calloutAnnotationWrapper];
					hashSet.Add(calloutAnnotationWrapper);
					if (calloutView.Content != frame.Contents[num])
					{
						calloutView.Content = frame.Contents[num];
						calloutView.GetSize();
					}
					calloutView.CalloutStrokeThickness = frame.CalloutStrokeThicknesses[num];
					calloutView.CalloutBackground = frame.CalloutBackgrounds[num];
					calloutView.CalloutTextColor = frame.CalloutTextColors[num];
					calloutView.CalloutOutline = ((calloutView.CalloutStrokeThickness > 0.0) ? frame.CalloutOutlines[num] : base.View.GetTransparentBrush());
					calloutView.CalloutLeaderBrush = frame.CalloutLeaderBrushes[num];
					calloutView.CalloutPadding = new Thickness(frame.CalloutPaddingsLeft[num], frame.CalloutPaddingsTop[num], frame.CalloutPaddingsRight[num], frame.CalloutPaddingsBottom[num]);
					CalloutView.SetCalloutPosition(calloutView, Math.Min(frame.LabelXPositions[num], frame.LabelXPositions[num] + frame.TargetXPositions[num]), Math.Min(frame.LabelYPositions[num], frame.LabelYPositions[num] + frame.TargetYPositions[num]));
					CalloutView.UpdateContext(calloutView, calloutAnnotationWrapper, frame.Contexts[num]);
					calloutView.TargetPoint = new Point(frame.TargetXPositions[num], frame.TargetYPositions[num]);
				}
			}
			List<CalloutAnnotationWrapper> list = new List<CalloutAnnotationWrapper>();
			foreach (CalloutAnnotationWrapper activeKey in CalloutView.CalloutPool.ActiveKeys)
			{
				if (!hashSet.Contains(activeKey))
				{
					list.Add(activeKey);
				}
			}
			for (int i = 0; i < list.Count; i++)
			{
				CalloutView.CalloutPool.Remove(list[i]);
			}
		}

		protected override void RenderFrame(Frame frame, SeriesView view)
		{
			base.RenderFrame(frame, view);
			if (AnimationActive())
			{
				UpdateAnnotations((CalloutLayerFrame)base.TransitionFrame, forceAxisUpdate: true);
			}
			else
			{
				UpdateAnnotations((CalloutLayerFrame)base.CurrentFrame, forceAxisUpdate: false);
			}
		}

		protected override bool RequiresPrepare()
		{
			return true;
		}

		protected override void PropertyUpdatedOverride(object sender, string propertyName, object oldValue, object newValue)
		{
			base.PropertyUpdatedOverride(sender, propertyName, oldValue, newValue);
			switch (propertyName)
			{
			case "TargetSeriesName":
			case "TargetSeries":
				RenderSeries(animate: true);
				break;
			case "CollisionChannel":
				RenderSeries(animate: true);
				break;
			case "SeriesViewer":
				if (oldValue != null)
				{
					((SeriesViewer)oldValue).SeriesAnimating -= SeriesAnimating;
				}
				if (newValue != null)
				{
					((SeriesViewer)newValue).SeriesAnimating += SeriesAnimating;
				}
				if (newValue == null)
				{
					DetachCollisionManager();
				}
				break;
			case "IsAutoCalloutBehaviorEnabled":
			case "IsCalloutOffsettingEnabled":
			case "CalloutBackground":
			case "CalloutOutline":
			case "CalloutLeaderBrush":
			case "CalloutPadding":
			case "CalloutStrokeThickness":
			case "CalloutTextColor":
				DirtyCallouts();
				break;
			case "LabelMemberPath":
				if (base.FastItemsSource != null)
				{
					base.FastItemsSource.DeregisterColumn(LabelColumn);
					LabelColumn = RegisterObjectColumn(LabelMemberPath);
				}
				break;
			case "LabelColumn":
				DirtyCallouts();
				break;
			case "ContentMemberPath":
				if (base.FastItemsSource != null)
				{
					base.FastItemsSource.DeregisterColumn(ContentColumn);
					ContentColumn = RegisterObjectColumn(ContentMemberPath);
				}
				break;
			case "ContentColumn":
				DirtyCallouts();
				break;
			case "XMemberPath":
				if (base.FastItemsSource != null)
				{
					base.FastItemsSource.DeregisterColumn(XColumn);
					XColumn = ((!string.IsNullOrEmpty(XMemberPath)) ? RegisterObjectColumn(XMemberPath) : null);
				}
				break;
			case "XColumn":
				DirtyCallouts();
				break;
			case "YMemberPath":
				if (base.FastItemsSource != null)
				{
					base.FastItemsSource.DeregisterColumn(YColumn);
					YColumn = RegisterObjectColumn(YMemberPath);
				}
				break;
			case "YColumn":
				DirtyCallouts();
				break;
			case "KeyMemberPath":
				if (base.FastItemsSource != null)
				{
					base.FastItemsSource.DeregisterColumn(KeyColumn);
					KeyColumn = RegisterObjectColumn(KeyMemberPath);
				}
				break;
			case "KeyColumn":
				DirtyCallouts();
				break;
			case "FastItemsSource":
				_dataSourceChanged = true;
				if (oldValue is IFastItemsSource)
				{
					((IFastItemsSource)oldValue).DeregisterColumn(LabelColumn);
					((IFastItemsSource)oldValue).DeregisterColumn(ContentColumn);
					((IFastItemsSource)oldValue).DeregisterColumn(XColumn);
					((IFastItemsSource)oldValue).DeregisterColumn(YColumn);
					((IFastItemsSource)oldValue).DeregisterColumn(KeyColumn);
					LabelColumn = null;
					ContentColumn = null;
					XColumn = null;
					YColumn = null;
					KeyColumn = null;
					_userCallouts.Clear();
				}
				if (newValue is IFastItemsSource)
				{
					LabelColumn = RegisterObjectColumn(LabelMemberPath);
					ContentColumn = RegisterObjectColumn(ContentMemberPath);
					if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(XMemberPath))
					{
						XColumn = RegisterObjectColumn(XMemberPath);
					}
					YColumn = RegisterObjectColumn(YMemberPath);
					KeyColumn = RegisterObjectColumn(KeyMemberPath);
				}
				DirtyCallouts();
				break;
			}
		}

		private void SeriesAnimating(Series s)
		{
			if (!s.IsAnnotationLayer && (s == TargetSeries || TargetSeries == null) && IsAutoCalloutBehaviorEnabled)
			{
				RenderSeries(animate: false);
			}
		}

		private void DirtyCallouts()
		{
			if (!_calloutsDirty)
			{
				_calloutsDirty = true;
				RenderSeries(animate: false);
			}
		}

		private void ClearCallouts()
		{
			CalloutView.CalloutPool.Clear();
			_currentCallouts.Clear();
			_currentCalloutsMap.Clear();
		}

		private void EnsureCallouts()
		{
			if (YColumn == null || LabelColumn == null)
			{
				for (LinkedListNode<CalloutAnnotationWrapper> linkedListNode = _currentCallouts.First; linkedListNode != null; linkedListNode = linkedListNode.Next)
				{
					UpdateCalloutVisuals(linkedListNode.Value);
				}
				return;
			}
			Dictionary<string, Series> seriesMap = GetSeriesMap();
			for (int i = 0; i < YColumn.Count; i++)
			{
				if (_userCallouts.Count <= i)
				{
					CalloutAnnotation callout = new CalloutAnnotation();
					CalloutAnnotationWrapper calloutAnnotationWrapper = new CalloutAnnotationWrapper();
					calloutAnnotationWrapper.Callout = callout;
					calloutAnnotationWrapper.Callout.Series = TargetSeries;
					_userCallouts.Add(calloutAnnotationWrapper);
				}
				else
				{
					CalloutAnnotationWrapper calloutAnnotationWrapper = _userCallouts[i];
				}
				UpdateCallout(i, seriesMap);
			}
		}
	}

	internal class CalloutViewHelper
	{
		internal static double IntersectSegment(double rx1, double ry1, double rx2, double ry2, double sx1, double sy1, double sx2, double sy2)
		{
			double num = Math.Sqrt((rx2 - rx1) * (rx2 - rx1) + (ry2 - ry1) * (ry2 - ry1));
			double num2 = (rx2 - rx1) / num;
			double num3 = (ry2 - ry1) / num;
			double num4 = rx1 - sx1;
			double num5 = ry1 - sy1;
			double num6 = sx2 - sx1;
			double num7 = sy2 - sy1;
			double num8 = 0.0 - num3;
			double num9 = num2;
			double num10 = num6 * num8 + num7 * num9;
			double num11 = num6 * num5 - num7 * num4;
			double num12 = num4 * num8 + num5 * num9;
			double num13 = num11 / num10;
			double num14 = num12 / num10;
			if (num13 >= 0.0 && num14 >= 0.0 && num14 <= 1.0)
			{
				return num13;
			}
			return double.PositiveInfinity;
		}

		internal static Thickness UpdateLeader(Point targetPoint, double textWidth, double textHeight, Line line)
		{
			double num = targetPoint.X;
			double num2 = targetPoint.Y;
			double num3 = 0.0;
			double num4 = 0.0;
			double right = 0.0;
			double bottom = 0.0;
			double num5 = 0.0;
			double num6 = 0.0;
			if (num < 0.0)
			{
				num3 = 0.0 - num;
				num5 = num3;
				num = 0.0;
			}
			if (num2 < 0.0)
			{
				num4 = 0.0 - num2;
				num6 = num4;
				num2 = 0.0;
			}
			if (num > textWidth)
			{
				right = num - textWidth;
			}
			if (num2 > textHeight)
			{
				bottom = num2 - textHeight;
			}
			Thickness result = new Thickness(num3, num4, right, bottom);
			double val = IntersectSegment(num, num2, num5 + textWidth / 2.0, num6 + textHeight / 2.0, num5, num6, num5, num6 + textHeight);
			double val2 = IntersectSegment(num, num2, num5 + textWidth / 2.0, num6 + textHeight / 2.0, num5, num6, num5 + textWidth, num6);
			double val3 = IntersectSegment(num, num2, num5 + textWidth / 2.0, num6 + textHeight / 2.0, num5, num6 + textHeight, num5 + textWidth, num6 + textHeight);
			double val4 = IntersectSegment(num, num2, num5 + textWidth / 2.0, num6 + textHeight / 2.0, num5 + textWidth, num6, num5 + textWidth, num6 + textHeight);
			double num7 = Math.Min(val, Math.Min(val2, Math.Min(val3, val4)));
			double num8 = 0.0;
			double num9 = 0.0;
			if (double.IsInfinity(num7))
			{
				num8 = num;
				num9 = num2;
			}
			else
			{
				double num10 = num5 + textWidth / 2.0;
				double num11 = num6 + textHeight / 2.0;
				double num12 = num;
				double num13 = num2;
				double num14 = Math.Sqrt((num10 - num12) * (num10 - num12) + (num11 - num13) * (num11 - num13));
				double num15 = (num10 - num12) / num14;
				double num16 = (num11 - num13) / num14;
				num8 = num12 + num15 * num7;
				num9 = num13 + num16 * num7;
			}
			line.X1 = num;
			line.Y1 = num2;
			line.X2 = num8;
			line.Y2 = num9;
			return result;
		}
	}
	internal class CalloutKey
	{
		public object Item { get; set; }

		public Series Series { get; set; }

		public CalloutKey(object item, Series series)
		{
			Item = item;
			Series = series;
		}

		public override int GetHashCode()
		{
			return Item.GetHashCode() ^ Series.GetHashCode();
		}

		public override bool Equals(object other)
		{
			if (!(other is CalloutKey calloutKey))
			{
				return base.Equals(other);
			}
			if (Item == calloutKey.Item)
			{
				return Series == calloutKey.Series;
			}
			return false;
		}
	}

		public override void Interpolate(float p, Frame min, Frame max)
		{
			CalloutLayerFrame calloutLayerFrame = (CalloutLayerFrame)min;
			CalloutLayerFrame calloutLayerFrame2 = (CalloutLayerFrame)max;
			FrameExtended.Interpolate(CalloutTextColors, p, calloutLayerFrame.CalloutTextColors, calloutLayerFrame2.CalloutTextColors, InterpolationMode.RGB);
			FrameExtended.Interpolate(CalloutBackgrounds, p, calloutLayerFrame.CalloutBackgrounds, calloutLayerFrame2.CalloutBackgrounds, InterpolationMode.RGB);
			FrameExtended.Interpolate(CalloutOutlines, p, calloutLayerFrame.CalloutOutlines, calloutLayerFrame2.CalloutOutlines, InterpolationMode.RGB);
			FrameExtended.Interpolate(CalloutLeaderBrushes, p, calloutLayerFrame.CalloutLeaderBrushes, calloutLayerFrame2.CalloutLeaderBrushes, InterpolationMode.RGB);
			Frame.Interpolate(CalloutPaddingsLeft, p, calloutLayerFrame.CalloutPaddingsLeft, calloutLayerFrame2.CalloutPaddingsLeft);
			Frame.Interpolate(CalloutPaddingsTop, p, calloutLayerFrame.CalloutPaddingsTop, calloutLayerFrame2.CalloutPaddingsTop);
			Frame.Interpolate(CalloutPaddingsRight, p, calloutLayerFrame.CalloutPaddingsRight, calloutLayerFrame2.CalloutPaddingsRight);
			Frame.Interpolate(CalloutPaddingsBottom, p, calloutLayerFrame.CalloutPaddingsBottom, calloutLayerFrame2.CalloutPaddingsBottom);
			Frame.Interpolate(CalloutStrokeThicknesses, p, calloutLayerFrame.CalloutStrokeThicknesses, calloutLayerFrame2.CalloutStrokeThicknesses);
			Frame.Interpolate(TargetXPositions, p, calloutLayerFrame.TargetXPositions, calloutLayerFrame2.TargetXPositions);
			Frame.Interpolate(TargetYPositions, p, calloutLayerFrame.TargetYPositions, calloutLayerFrame2.TargetYPositions);
			Frame.Interpolate(LabelXPositions, p, calloutLayerFrame.LabelXPositions, calloutLayerFrame2.LabelXPositions);
			Frame.Interpolate(LabelYPositions, p, calloutLayerFrame.LabelYPositions, calloutLayerFrame2.LabelYPositions);
			InterpolateContents(Contents, p, calloutLayerFrame.Contents, calloutLayerFrame2.Contents);
			InterpolateContents(Callouts, p, calloutLayerFrame.Callouts, calloutLayerFrame2.Callouts);
			InterpolateContents(Contexts, p, calloutLayerFrame.Contexts, calloutLayerFrame2.Contexts);
		}

		protected static void InterpolateContents(List<object> ret, float p, List<object> min, List<object> max)
		{
			int count = min.Count;
			int count2 = max.Count;
			int num = Math.Max(count, count2);
			if (ret.Count < num)
			{
				object[] collection = new object[num - ret.Count];
				ret.InsertRange(ret.Count, collection);
			}
			if (ret.Count > num)
			{
				ret.RemoveRange(num, ret.Count - num);
			}
			for (int i = 0; i < Math.Min(count, count2); i++)
			{
				if (p == 0f)
				{
					ret[i] = min[i];
				}
				else
				{
					ret[i] = max[i];
				}
			}
			if (count < count2)
			{
				object value = ((count > 0) ? min[count - 1] : null);
				for (int j = count; j < count2; j++)
				{
					if (p == 0f)
					{
						ret[j] = value;
					}
					else
					{
						ret[j] = max[j];
					}
				}
			}
			if (count <= count2)
			{
				return;
			}
			object value2 = ((count2 > 0) ? max[count2 - 1] : null);
			for (int k = count2; k < count; k++)
			{
				if (p == 0f)
				{
					ret[k] = min[k];
				}
				else
				{
					ret[k] = value2;
				}
			}
		}

		public CalloutLayerFrame()
		{
			Contents = new List<object>();
			Callouts = new List<object>();
			Contexts = new List<object>();
			CalloutTextColors = new List<Brush>();
			CalloutOutlines = new List<Brush>();
			CalloutLeaderBrushes = new List<Brush>();
			CalloutBackgrounds = new List<Brush>();
			CalloutStrokeThicknesses = new List<double>();
			CalloutPaddingsLeft = new List<double>();
			CalloutPaddingsTop = new List<double>();
			CalloutPaddingsRight = new List<double>();
			CalloutPaddingsBottom = new List<double>();
			TargetXPositions = new List<double>();
			TargetYPositions = new List<double>();
			LabelXPositions = new List<double>();
			LabelYPositions = new List<double>();
		}
	}

		public FinalValueLayer()
		{
			FinalValueLayerFrame previousFrame = new FinalValueLayerFrame();
			FinalValueLayerFrame currentFrame = new FinalValueLayerFrame();
			FinalValueLayerFrame transitionFrame = new FinalValueLayerFrame();
			_ = base.TransitionDuration.TotalSeconds;
			base.PreviousFrame = previousFrame;
			base.CurrentFrame = currentFrame;
			base.TransitionFrame = transitionFrame;
			base.DefaultStyleKey = typeof(FinalValueLayer);
		}

		protected override SeriesView CreateView()
		{
			return new FinalValueLayerView(this);
		}

		protected internal override void OnViewCreated(SeriesView view)
		{
			base.OnViewCreated(view);
			FinalValueView = (FinalValueLayerView)view;
		}

		internal bool HasAxisAnnotationFormatLabel()
		{
			return this.AxisAnnotationFormatLabel != null;
		}

		protected override void OnDependentSeriesRender(Series series, bool animate)
		{
			if ((TargetSeries == null || TargetSeries == series) && !base.ContentInfo.IsDirty)
			{
				RenderSeries(animate);
			}
		}

		protected override void PrepareFrame(Frame frame, SeriesView view)
		{
			base.PrepareFrame(frame, view);
			FinalValueLayerFrame f = (FinalValueLayerFrame)frame;
			f.XAxes.Clear();
			f.YAxes.Clear();
			f.XAxisValues.Clear();
			f.YAxisValues.Clear();
			f.XAxisValuePositions.Clear();
			f.YAxisValuePositions.Clear();
			f.XAxisAnnotationBackgrounds.Clear();
			f.XAxisAnnotationOutlines.Clear();
			f.XAxisAnnotationPaddingsLeft.Clear();
			f.XAxisAnnotationPaddingsTop.Clear();
			f.XAxisAnnotationPaddingsRight.Clear();
			f.XAxisAnnotationPaddingsBottom.Clear();
			f.XAxisAnnotationStrokeThicknesses.Clear();
			f.XAxisAnnotationTextColors.Clear();
			f.YAxisAnnotationBackgrounds.Clear();
			f.YAxisAnnotationOutlines.Clear();
			f.YAxisAnnotationPaddingsLeft.Clear();
			f.YAxisAnnotationPaddingsTop.Clear();
			f.YAxisAnnotationPaddingsRight.Clear();
			f.YAxisAnnotationPaddingsBottom.Clear();
			f.YAxisAnnotationStrokeThicknesses.Clear();
			f.YAxisAnnotationTextColors.Clear();
			if (IsSeriesValid(TargetSeries))
			{
				PrepareSeries(TargetSeries, f);
				return;
			}
			foreach (Series item in base.SeriesViewer.Series)
			{
				if (IsSeriesValid(item))
				{
					PrepareSeries(item, f);
				}
				if (!item.IsStacked)
				{
					continue;
				}
				item.ForSubVisualSeries(delegate(Series s)
				{
					if (IsSeriesValid(s))
					{
						PrepareSeries(s, f);
					}
					return true;
				});
			}
		}

		protected override bool IsSeriesValid(Series series)
		{
			if (!base.IsSeriesValid(series))
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (TargetSeriesName != null)
			{
				if (series.IsFragment)
				{
					string value = series.ResolveFragmentName();
					if (!TargetSeriesName.Equals(value))
					{
						return false;
					}
				}
				else if (!TargetSeriesName.Equals(series.Name))
				{
					return false;
				}
			}
			return true;
		}

		protected internal override void OnBeforeContentRefresh()
		{
			base.OnBeforeContentRefresh();
			if (base.ContentInfo.IsDirty || AnimationActive())
			{
				if (AnimationActive())
				{
					UpdateAnnotations((FinalValueLayerFrame)base.TransitionFrame, forceAxisUpdate: false);
				}
				else
				{
					UpdateAnnotations((FinalValueLayerFrame)base.CurrentFrame, forceAxisUpdate: false);
				}
			}
		}

		private Point GetFinalValuePosition(Series series)
		{
			double x = double.NaN;
			double y = double.NaN;
			FinalValueSelectionMode finalValueSelectionMode = FinalValueSelectionMode;
			if (finalValueSelectionMode == FinalValueSelectionMode.Auto)
			{
				finalValueSelectionMode = FinalValueSelectionMode.FinalVisible;
			}
			bool useInterpolation = false;
			if (finalValueSelectionMode == FinalValueSelectionMode.FinalVisibleInterpolated)
			{
				useInterpolation = true;
			}
			if (series.IsVertical)
			{
				CategoryAxisBase categoryAxisIfPresent = series.GetCategoryAxisIfPresent();
				if (categoryAxisIfPresent != null)
				{
					y = ((finalValueSelectionMode == FinalValueSelectionMode.FinalVisible || finalValueSelectionMode == FinalValueSelectionMode.FinalVisibleInterpolated) ? ((!categoryAxisIfPresent.IsInverted) ? series.ToWorldPosition(new Point(base.Viewport.Right, base.Viewport.Top)).Y : series.ToWorldPosition(new Point(base.Viewport.Right, base.Viewport.Bottom)).Y) : ((!categoryAxisIfPresent.IsInverted) ? 0.0 : 1.0));
				}
				return series.GetSeriesValuePosition(new Point(0.0, y), useInterpolation, skipUnknowns: true);
			}
			CategoryAxisBase categoryAxisIfPresent2 = series.GetCategoryAxisIfPresent();
			if (categoryAxisIfPresent2 != null)
			{
				x = ((finalValueSelectionMode == FinalValueSelectionMode.FinalVisible || finalValueSelectionMode == FinalValueSelectionMode.FinalVisibleInterpolated) ? ((!categoryAxisIfPresent2.IsInverted) ? series.ToWorldPosition(new Point(base.Viewport.Right, base.Viewport.Top)).X : series.ToWorldPosition(new Point(base.Viewport.Left, base.Viewport.Top)).X) : ((!categoryAxisIfPresent2.IsInverted) ? 1.0 : 0.0));
			}
			_ = series.IsFinancial;
			return series.GetSeriesValuePosition(new Point(x, 0.0), useInterpolation, skipUnknowns: true);
		}

		private void PrepareSeries(Series series, FinalValueLayerFrame f)
		{
			Point finalValuePosition = GetFinalValuePosition(series);
			ToWorldPosition(finalValuePosition);
			Brush brush = base.ActualBrush;
			if (brush == null)
			{
				brush = base.Brush;
			}
			if (brush == null)
			{
				brush = series.ActualBrush;
				if (brush != null)
				{
					brush = FinalValueView.GetLightenedBrush(brush);
				}
			}
			AxisAnnotationFrameManager.Prepare(f, finalValuePosition, series, base.SeriesViewer, GetEffectiveViewport(), brush, AxisAnnotationBackground, AxisAnnotationTextColor, AxisAnnotationOutline, AxisAnnotationPadding, AxisAnnotationStrokeThickness, AxisAnnotationBackground, AxisAnnotationTextColor, AxisAnnotationOutline, AxisAnnotationPadding, AxisAnnotationStrokeThickness, series.IsVertical, !series.IsVertical);
		}

		protected void UpdateAnnotations(FinalValueLayerFrame frame, bool forceAxisUpdate)
		{
			bool modified = false;
			if (_annotations == null)
			{
				modified = true;
				_annotatedAxes = new List<Axis>();
				_annotations = new Dictionary<Axis, Pool<AxisAnnotation>>();
			}
			AxisAnnotationFrameManager.UpdateAnnoations(this, frame, modified, _annotations, _annotatedAxes, forceAxisUpdate, AxisAnnotationInterpolatedValuePrecision, AxisAnnotationInterpolatedValuePrecision, this.AxisAnnotationFormatLabel, this.AxisAnnotationFormatLabel);
		}

		protected override void RenderFrame(Frame frame, SeriesView view)
		{
			base.RenderFrame(frame, view);
			if (AnimationActive())
			{
				UpdateAnnotations((FinalValueLayerFrame)base.TransitionFrame, forceAxisUpdate: true);
			}
			else
			{
				UpdateAnnotations((FinalValueLayerFrame)base.CurrentFrame, forceAxisUpdate: false);
			}
		}

		protected override bool RequiresPrepare()
		{
			return true;
		}

		protected override void PropertyUpdatedOverride(object sender, string propertyName, object oldValue, object newValue)
		{
			base.PropertyUpdatedOverride(sender, propertyName, oldValue, newValue);
			switch (propertyName)
			{
			case "TargetSeriesName":
			case "TargetSeries":
				RenderSeries(animate: true);
				break;
			case "AxisAnnotationBackground":
			case "AxisAnnotationOutline":
			case "AxisAnnotationPadding":
			case "AxisAnnotationStrokeThickness":
			case "AxisAnnotationTextColor":
			case "FinalValueSelectionMode":
				RenderSeries(animate: true);
				break;
			case "SeriesViewer":
			{
				List<Axis> annotatedAxes = _annotatedAxes;
				Dictionary<Axis, Pool<AxisAnnotation>> annotations = _annotations;
				if (annotations == null)
				{
					break;
				}
				foreach (KeyValuePair<Axis, Pool<AxisAnnotation>> keypair in annotations)
				{
					Pool<AxisAnnotation> value = keypair.Value;
					value.DoToAll(delegate(AxisAnnotation annotation)
					{
						keypair.Key.Annotations.Remove(annotation);
					});
					value.Clear();
				}
				annotatedAxes.Clear();
				annotations.Clear();
				break;
			}
			}
		}
	}

		public List<double> XAxisValues { get; set; }

		public List<double> YAxisValues { get; set; }

		public List<double> XAxisValuePositions { get; set; }

		public List<double> YAxisValuePositions { get; set; }

		public List<Axis> XAxes { get; set; }

		public List<Axis> YAxes { get; set; }

		protected static void InterpolateAxes(List<Axis> ret, float p, List<Axis> min, List<Axis> max)
		{
			int count = min.Count;
			int count2 = max.Count;
			int num = Math.Max(count, count2);
			if (ret.Count < num)
			{
				Axis[] collection = new Axis[num - ret.Count];
				ret.InsertRange(ret.Count, collection);
			}
			if (ret.Count > num)
			{
				ret.RemoveRange(num, ret.Count - num);
			}
			for (int i = 0; i < Math.Min(count, count2); i++)
			{
				if (p == 0f)
				{
					ret[i] = min[i];
				}
				else
				{
					ret[i] = max[i];
				}
			}
			if (count < count2)
			{
				Axis value = ((count > 0) ? min[count - 1] : null);
				for (int j = count; j < count2; j++)
				{
					if (p == 0f)
					{
						ret[j] = value;
					}
					else
					{
						ret[j] = max[j];
					}
				}
			}
			if (count <= count2)
			{
				return;
			}
			Axis value2 = ((count2 > 0) ? max[count2 - 1] : null);
			for (int k = count2; k < count; k++)
			{
				if (p == 0f)
				{
					ret[k] = min[k];
				}
				else
				{
					ret[k] = value2;
				}
			}
		}

		{
			XAxisAnnotationTextColors = new List<Brush>();
			XAxisAnnotationBackgrounds = new List<Brush>();
			XAxisAnnotationOutlines = new List<Brush>();

			XAxisAnnotationPaddingsRight = new List<double>();
			XAxisAnnotationPaddingsTop = new List<double>();
			XAxisAnnotationPaddingsBottom = new List<double>();
			XAxisAnnotationStrokeThicknesses = new List<double>();
			YAxisAnnotationTextColors = new List<Brush>();
			YAxisAnnotationBackgrounds = new List<Brush>();
			YAxisAnnotationOutlines = new List<Brush>();
			YAxisAnnotationPaddingsLeft = new List<double>();
			YAxisAnnotationPaddingsRight = new List<double>();
			YAxisAnnotationPaddingsTop = new List<double>();
			YAxisAnnotationPaddingsBottom = new List<double>();
			YAxisAnnotationStrokeThicknesses = new List<double>();
			XAxes = new List<Axis>();
			YAxes = new List<Axis>();
			XAxisValues = new List<double>();
			XAxisValuePositions = new List<double>();
			YAxisValues = new List<double>();
			YAxisValuePositions = new List<double>();
		}

		public override void Interpolate(float p, Frame min, Frame max)
		{
			AxisAnnotationFrame axisAnnotationFrame = (AxisAnnotationFrame)min;
			AxisAnnotationFrame axisAnnotationFrame2 = (AxisAnnotationFrame)max;
			FrameExtended.Interpolate(XAxisAnnotationTextColors, p, axisAnnotationFrame.XAxisAnnotationTextColors, axisAnnotationFrame2.XAxisAnnotationTextColors, InterpolationMode.RGB);
			FrameExtended.Interpolate(XAxisAnnotationBackgrounds, p, axisAnnotationFrame.XAxisAnnotationBackgrounds, axisAnnotationFrame2.XAxisAnnotationBackgrounds, InterpolationMode.RGB);
			FrameExtended.Interpolate(XAxisAnnotationOutlines, p, axisAnnotationFrame.XAxisAnnotationOutlines, axisAnnotationFrame2.XAxisAnnotationOutlines, InterpolationMode.RGB);
			Frame.Interpolate(XAxisAnnotationPaddingsLeft, p, axisAnnotationFrame.XAxisAnnotationPaddingsLeft, axisAnnotationFrame2.XAxisAnnotationPaddingsLeft);
			Frame.Interpolate(XAxisAnnotationPaddingsRight, p, axisAnnotationFrame.XAxisAnnotationPaddingsRight, axisAnnotationFrame2.XAxisAnnotationPaddingsRight);
			Frame.Interpolate(XAxisAnnotationPaddingsTop, p, axisAnnotationFrame.XAxisAnnotationPaddingsTop, axisAnnotationFrame2.XAxisAnnotationPaddingsTop);
			Frame.Interpolate(XAxisAnnotationPaddingsBottom, p, axisAnnotationFrame.XAxisAnnotationPaddingsBottom, axisAnnotationFrame2.XAxisAnnotationPaddingsBottom);
			Frame.Interpolate(XAxisAnnotationStrokeThicknesses, p, axisAnnotationFrame.XAxisAnnotationStrokeThicknesses, axisAnnotationFrame2.XAxisAnnotationStrokeThicknesses);
			FrameExtended.Interpolate(YAxisAnnotationTextColors, p, axisAnnotationFrame.YAxisAnnotationTextColors, axisAnnotationFrame2.YAxisAnnotationTextColors, InterpolationMode.RGB);
			FrameExtended.Interpolate(YAxisAnnotationBackgrounds, p, axisAnnotationFrame.YAxisAnnotationBackgrounds, axisAnnotationFrame2.YAxisAnnotationBackgrounds, InterpolationMode.RGB);
			FrameExtended.Interpolate(YAxisAnnotationOutlines, p, axisAnnotationFrame.YAxisAnnotationOutlines, axisAnnotationFrame2.YAxisAnnotationOutlines, InterpolationMode.RGB);
			Frame.Interpolate(YAxisAnnotationPaddingsLeft, p, axisAnnotationFrame.YAxisAnnotationPaddingsLeft, axisAnnotationFrame2.YAxisAnnotationPaddingsLeft);
			Frame.Interpolate(YAxisAnnotationPaddingsRight, p, axisAnnotationFrame.YAxisAnnotationPaddingsRight, axisAnnotationFrame2.YAxisAnnotationPaddingsRight);
			Frame.Interpolate(YAxisAnnotationPaddingsTop, p, axisAnnotationFrame.YAxisAnnotationPaddingsTop, axisAnnotationFrame2.YAxisAnnotationPaddingsTop);
			Frame.Interpolate(YAxisAnnotationPaddingsBottom, p, axisAnnotationFrame.YAxisAnnotationPaddingsBottom, axisAnnotationFrame2.YAxisAnnotationPaddingsBottom);
			Frame.Interpolate(YAxisAnnotationStrokeThicknesses, p, axisAnnotationFrame.YAxisAnnotationStrokeThicknesses, axisAnnotationFrame2.YAxisAnnotationStrokeThicknesses);
			InterpolateAxes(XAxes, p, axisAnnotationFrame.XAxes, axisAnnotationFrame2.XAxes);
			InterpolateAxes(YAxes, p, axisAnnotationFrame.YAxes, axisAnnotationFrame2.YAxes);
		}

	[EditorBrowsable(EditorBrowsableState.Never)]
	public class CategoryItemHighlightLayerFrame : Frame
	{
		private DictInterpolator<long, ItemHighlightFrameRect, CategoryItemHighlightLayerFrame> _interpolator;

		public Dictionary<long, ItemHighlightFrameRect> Rects { get; set; }

		public CategoryItemHighlightLayerFrame()
		{
			Rects = new Dictionary<long, ItemHighlightFrameRect>();
			_interpolator = new DictInterpolator<long, ItemHighlightFrameRect, CategoryItemHighlightLayerFrame>(InterpolateRect, (ItemHighlightFrameRect r) => r.TimeStamp, (ItemHighlightFrameRect r) => true, () => new ItemHighlightFrameRect());
		}

		protected void InterpolateRect(ItemHighlightFrameRect interpolated, float p, ItemHighlightFrameRect min, ItemHighlightFrameRect max, CategoryItemHighlightLayerFrame minFrame, CategoryItemHighlightLayerFrame maxFrame)
		{
			if (max != null)
			{
				interpolated.TimeStamp = max.TimeStamp;
			}
			else if (min != null)
			{
				interpolated.TimeStamp = min.TimeStamp;
			}
			else
			{
				interpolated.TimeStamp = 0L;
			}
			if (min == null || double.IsNaN(min.Top))
			{
				interpolated.Top = max?.Top ?? double.NaN;
			}
			else if (max == null || double.IsNaN(max.Top))
			{
				interpolated.Top = double.NaN;
			}
			else
			{
				interpolated.Top = min.Top + (double)p * (max.Top - min.Top);
			}
			if (min == null || double.IsNaN(min.Left))
			{
				interpolated.Left = max?.Left ?? double.NaN;
			}
			else if (max == null || double.IsNaN(max.Left))
			{
				interpolated.Left = double.NaN;
			}
			else
			{
				interpolated.Left = min.Left + (double)p * (max.Left - min.Left);
			}
			if (min == null || double.IsNaN(min.Right))
			{
				interpolated.Right = max?.Right ?? double.NaN;
			}
			else if (max == null || double.IsNaN(max.Right))
			{
				interpolated.Right = double.NaN;
			}
			else
			{
				interpolated.Right = min.Right + (double)p * (max.Right - min.Right);
			}
			if (min == null || double.IsNaN(min.Bottom))
			{
				interpolated.Bottom = max?.Bottom ?? double.NaN;
			}
			else if (max == null || double.IsNaN(max.Bottom))
			{
				interpolated.Bottom = double.NaN;
			}
			else
			{
				interpolated.Bottom = min.Bottom + (double)p * (max.Bottom - min.Bottom);
			}
			if (min == null || double.IsNaN(min.StrokeThickness))
			{
				interpolated.StrokeThickness = max?.StrokeThickness ?? double.NaN;
			}
			else if (max == null || double.IsNaN(max.StrokeThickness))
			{
				interpolated.StrokeThickness = double.NaN;
			}
			else
			{
				interpolated.StrokeThickness = min.StrokeThickness + (double)p * (max.StrokeThickness - min.StrokeThickness);
			}
			if (min == null || min.Brush == null)
			{
				interpolated.Brush = max?.Brush;
			}
			else if (max == null || max.Brush == null)
			{
				interpolated.Brush = null;
			}
			else
			{
				interpolated.Brush = min.Brush.GetInterpolation(p, max.Brush, InterpolationMode.RGB);
			}
			if (min == null || min.Outline == null)
			{
				interpolated.Outline = max?.Outline;
			}
			else if (max == null || max.Outline == null)
			{
				interpolated.Outline = null;
			}
			else
			{
				interpolated.Outline = min.Outline.GetInterpolation(p, max.Outline, InterpolationMode.RGB);
			}
			if (min == null || min.MarkerTemplate == null)
			{
				interpolated.MarkerTemplate = max?.MarkerTemplate;
			}
			else if (max == null || max.Outline == null)
			{
				interpolated.MarkerTemplate = null;
			}
			else
			{
				interpolated.MarkerTemplate = max.MarkerTemplate;
			}
			if (min == null || min.DataItem == null)
			{
				interpolated.DataItem = max?.DataItem;
			}
			else if (max == null || max.Outline == null)
			{
				interpolated.DataItem = null;
			}
			else
			{
				interpolated.DataItem = max.DataItem;
			}
		}

		public override void Interpolate(float p, Frame min, Frame max)
		{
			CategoryItemHighlightLayerFrame categoryItemHighlightLayerFrame = (CategoryItemHighlightLayerFrame)min;
			CategoryItemHighlightLayerFrame categoryItemHighlightLayerFrame2 = (CategoryItemHighlightLayerFrame)max;
			_interpolator.Interpolate(Rects, p, categoryItemHighlightLayerFrame.Rects, categoryItemHighlightLayerFrame2.Rects, categoryItemHighlightLayerFrame, categoryItemHighlightLayerFrame2);
		}
	}
