		public CategoryItemHighlightLayer()
		{
			CategoryItemHighlightLayerFrame previousFrame = new CategoryItemHighlightLayerFrame();
			CategoryItemHighlightLayerFrame currentFrame = new CategoryItemHighlightLayerFrame();
			CategoryItemHighlightLayerFrame transitionFrame = new CategoryItemHighlightLayerFrame();
			base.PreviousFrame = previousFrame;
			base.CurrentFrame = currentFrame;
			base.TransitionFrame = transitionFrame;
			base.DefaultStyleKey = typeof(CategoryItemHighlightLayer);
		}

		protected override SeriesView CreateView()
		{
			return new CategoryItemHighlightLayerView(this);
		}

		protected internal override void OnViewCreated(SeriesView view)
		{
			base.OnViewCreated(view);
			ItemView = (CategoryItemHighlightLayerView)view;
		}

		protected override void OnDependentSeriesRender(Series series, bool animate)
		{
			if ((TargetSeries == null || TargetSeries == series) && !base.ContentInfo.IsDirty)
			{
				RenderSeries(animate);
			}
		}

		protected override bool IsSeriesValid(Series series)
		{
			if (!base.IsSeriesValid(series))
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (TargetSeriesName != null)
			{
				if (series.IsFragment)
				{
					string value = series.ResolveFragmentName();
					if (!TargetSeriesName.Equals(value))
					{
						return false;
					}
				}
				else if (!TargetSeriesName.Equals(series.Name))
				{
					return false;
				}
			}
			if (!GetCategoryPosition(series).Item1)
			{
				return false;
			}
			return true;
		}

		protected override void PrepareFrame(Frame frame, SeriesView view)
		{
			base.PrepareFrame(frame, view);
			CategoryItemHighlightLayerFrame f = (CategoryItemHighlightLayerFrame)frame;
			bool useInterpolation = UseInterpolation;
			f.Rects.Clear();
			if (double.IsNaN(CurrentPosition.X) && double.IsNaN(CurrentPosition.Y))
			{
				return;
			}
			if (IsSeriesValid(TargetSeries))
			{
				PrepareSeries(TargetSeries, f, useInterpolation);
				return;
			}
			foreach (Series item in base.SeriesViewer.Series)
			{
				if (IsSeriesValid(item))
				{
					PrepareSeries(item, f, useInterpolation);
				}
				if (!item.IsStacked)
				{
					continue;
				}
				item.ForSubVisualSeries(delegate(Series s)
				{
					if (IsSeriesValid(s))
					{
						PrepareSeries(s, f, useInterpolation);
					}
					return true;
				});
			}
		}

		protected override void PropertyUpdatedOverride(object sender, string propertyName, object oldValue, object newValue)
		{
			base.PropertyUpdatedOverride(sender, propertyName, oldValue, newValue);
			switch (propertyName)
			{
			case "MarkerTemplate":
			case "MarkerType":
			case "MarkerBrush":
			case "MarkerOutline":
				RenderSeries(animate: true);
				break;
			case "TargetSeriesName":
			case "TargetSeries":
				RenderSeries(animate: true);
				break;
			case "UseInterpolation":
				_useInterpolation = (bool)newValue;
				RenderSeries(animate: true);
				break;
			case "HighlightType":
				RenderSeries(animate: true);
				break;
			case "BandHighlightWidth":
				_mode0HighlightWidth = BandHighlightWidth;
				RenderSeries(animate: true);
				break;
			case "SkipUnknownValues":
				_skipUnknownValues = (bool)newValue;
				RenderSeries(animate: true);
				break;
			}
		}

		private void PrepareSeries(Series series, CategoryItemHighlightLayerFrame f, bool useInterpolation)
		{
			if (base.View == null || base.View.WindowRect.IsEmpty || base.View.Viewport.IsEmpty || (!series.IsCategory && !series.IsFinancial))
			{
				return;
			}
			IHasCategoryAxis hasCategoryAxis = (IHasCategoryAxis)series;
			if (hasCategoryAxis.CategoryAxis == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			double x = CurrentPosition.X;
			x = base.View.Viewport.Left + base.View.Viewport.Width * (x - base.View.WindowRect.Left) / base.View.WindowRect.Width;
			double y = CurrentPosition.Y;
			y = base.View.Viewport.Top + base.View.Viewport.Height * (y - base.View.WindowRect.Top) / base.View.WindowRect.Height;
			bool skipUnknownValues = SkipUnknownValues;
			bool flag = true;
			IHasCategoryModePreference hasCategoryModePreference = series as IHasCategoryModePreference;
			CategoryMode categoryMode = CategoryMode.Mode0;
			if (hasCategoryModePreference != null)
			{
				categoryMode = hasCategoryModePreference.PreferredCategoryMode(hasCategoryAxis.CategoryAxis);
				if (categoryMode == CategoryMode.Mode2)
				{
					flag = false;
				}
			}
			bool flag2 = true;
			if (!flag || HighlightType == CategoryItemHighlightType.Shape)
			{
				flag2 = false;
			}
			if (HighlightType == CategoryItemHighlightType.Marker)
			{
				flag2 = true;
			}
			Tuple<bool, Point> categoryPosition = GetCategoryPosition(series);
			if (!categoryPosition.Item1)
			{
				return;
			}
			if (flag2)
			{
				Point point = series.GetSeriesValuePosition(categoryPosition.Item2, UseInterpolation, skipUnknownValues);
				if (categoryMode != CategoryMode.Mode0 && !hasCategoryAxis.CategoryAxis.IsSorting)
				{
					double x2 = point.X;
					if (series.IsFinancial)
					{
						x2 -= ((IHasCategoryAxis)series).GetOffsetValue();
						x2 += ((IHasCategoryAxis)series).GetCategoryWidth() * 0.5;
						point = new Point(x2, point.Y);
					}
					else if (series.IsCategory)
					{
						x2 -= ((IHasCategoryAxis)series).GetOffsetValue();
						x2 += ((IHasCategoryAxis)series).GetCategoryWidth() * 0.5;
						point = new Point(x2, point.Y);
					}
				}
				if (!double.IsNaN(point.X) && !double.IsNaN(point.Y))
				{
					point = ToWorldPosition(point);
				}
				PreparePoint(point, f, series);
				return;
			}
			Point seriesValuePosition = series.GetSeriesValuePosition(categoryPosition.Item2, UseInterpolation, skipUnknownValues);
			Rect effectiveViewport = GetEffectiveViewport(base.View);
			Rect rect;
			if (series.IsVertical)
			{
				double y2 = seriesValuePosition.Y;
				CategoryAxisBase categoryAxis = hasCategoryAxis.CategoryAxis;
				double num = _mode0HighlightWidth;
				if (categoryMode != CategoryMode.Mode0)
				{
					num = categoryAxis.GetGroupSize(base.View.WindowRect, base.View.Viewport, effectiveViewport);
				}
				if (double.IsNaN(num) || double.IsInfinity(num))
				{
					return;
				}
				rect = new Rect(base.Viewport.Left, y2 - num / 2.0, base.Viewport.Width, num);
			}
			else
			{
				double x3 = seriesValuePosition.X;
				CategoryAxisBase categoryAxis2 = hasCategoryAxis.CategoryAxis;
				double num2 = _mode0HighlightWidth;
				if (categoryMode != CategoryMode.Mode0)
				{
					num2 = categoryAxis2.GetGroupSize(base.View.WindowRect, base.View.Viewport, effectiveViewport);
				}
				if (double.IsNaN(num2) || double.IsInfinity(num2))
				{
					return;
				}
				rect = new Rect(x3 - num2 / 2.0, base.Viewport.Top, num2, base.Viewport.Height);
			}
			rect.Intersect(base.View.Viewport);
			PrepareRect(rect, f, series);
		}

		internal virtual void PreparePoint(Point pt, CategoryItemHighlightLayerFrame frame, Series target)
		{
			ItemHighlightFrameRect itemHighlightFrameRect = new ItemHighlightFrameRect();
			itemHighlightFrameRect.Left = pt.X;
			itemHighlightFrameRect.Top = pt.Y;
			itemHighlightFrameRect.Brush = GetBrush();
			if (MarkerBrush != null)
			{
				itemHighlightFrameRect.Brush = MarkerBrush;
			}
			itemHighlightFrameRect.Outline = GetOutline();
			if (MarkerOutline != null)
			{
				itemHighlightFrameRect.Outline = MarkerOutline;
			}
			if (itemHighlightFrameRect.Brush == null)
			{
				if (target.HasMarkers)
				{
					itemHighlightFrameRect.Brush = ItemView.GetLightenedBrush(target.GetActualMarkerBrush());
				}
				else
				{
					itemHighlightFrameRect.Brush = ItemView.GetLightenedBrush(target.ActualBrush);
				}
			}
			if (itemHighlightFrameRect.Outline == null)
			{
				if (target.HasMarkers)
				{
					itemHighlightFrameRect.Outline = ItemView.GetLightenedBrush(target.GetActualMarkerOutlineBrush());
				}
				else
				{
					itemHighlightFrameRect.Outline = ItemView.GetLightenedBrush(target.ActualOutline);
				}
			}
			itemHighlightFrameRect.StrokeThickness = base.ActualThickness;
			itemHighlightFrameRect.TimeStamp = target.GetHashCode();
			itemHighlightFrameRect.DataItem = GetDataItem(target, pt);
			DataTemplate dataTemplate = ((target is MarkerSeries) ? ((MarkerSeries)target).ActualMarkerTemplate : null);
			if (dataTemplate == null || dataTemplate == MarkerSeries.NullMarkerTemplate || (MarkerType != MarkerType.Automatic && MarkerType != MarkerType.Unset))
			{
				MarkerType markerType = MarkerSeries.ResolveMarkerType(target, MarkerType.Automatic);
				if (MarkerType != MarkerType.Automatic && MarkerType != MarkerType.Unset)
				{
					markerType = MarkerType;
				}
				switch (markerType)
				{
				case MarkerType.Circle:
				case MarkerType.Hidden:
					dataTemplate = base.SeriesViewer.CircleMarkerTemplate;
					break;
				case MarkerType.Triangle:
					dataTemplate = base.SeriesViewer.TriangleMarkerTemplate;
					break;
				case MarkerType.Pyramid:
					dataTemplate = base.SeriesViewer.PyramidMarkerTemplate;
					break;
				case MarkerType.Square:
					dataTemplate = base.SeriesViewer.SquareMarkerTemplate;
					break;
				case MarkerType.Diamond:
					dataTemplate = base.SeriesViewer.DiamondMarkerTemplate;
					break;
				case MarkerType.Pentagon:
					dataTemplate = base.SeriesViewer.PentagonMarkerTemplate;
					break;
				case MarkerType.Hexagon:
					dataTemplate = base.SeriesViewer.HexagonMarkerTemplate;
					break;
				case MarkerType.Tetragram:
					dataTemplate = base.SeriesViewer.TetragramMarkerTemplate;
					break;
				case MarkerType.Pentagram:
					dataTemplate = base.SeriesViewer.PentagramMarkerTemplate;
					break;
				case MarkerType.Hexagram:
					dataTemplate = base.SeriesViewer.HexagramMarkerTemplate;
					break;
				}
			}
			itemHighlightFrameRect.MarkerTemplate = ((MarkerTemplate != null) ? MarkerTemplate : dataTemplate);
			if (!double.IsNaN(itemHighlightFrameRect.Left) && !double.IsNaN(itemHighlightFrameRect.Top))
			{
				frame.Rects.Add(itemHighlightFrameRect.TimeStamp, itemHighlightFrameRect);
			}
		}

		private DataContext GetDataItem(Series target, Point pt)
		{
			object item = target.GetItem(pt);
			double exactItemIndex = target.GetExactItemIndex(pt);
			if (UseInterpolation && exactItemIndex != Math.Floor(exactItemIndex))
			{
				item = null;
			}
			return new DataContext
			{
				Series = target,
				Item = item
			};
		}

		internal virtual void PrepareRect(Rect rect, CategoryItemHighlightLayerFrame frame, Series target)
		{
			ItemHighlightFrameRect itemHighlightFrameRect = new ItemHighlightFrameRect();
			itemHighlightFrameRect.Left = rect.Left;
			itemHighlightFrameRect.Top = rect.Top;
			itemHighlightFrameRect.Right = rect.Right;
			itemHighlightFrameRect.Bottom = rect.Bottom;
			itemHighlightFrameRect.Brush = GetBrush();
			itemHighlightFrameRect.Outline = GetOutline();
			if (itemHighlightFrameRect.Brush == null && target != null)
			{
				itemHighlightFrameRect.Brush = ItemView.GetLightenedTranslucentBrush(target.ActualBrush);
			}
			if (itemHighlightFrameRect.Outline == null && target != null)
			{
				itemHighlightFrameRect.Outline = ItemView.GetLightenedTranslucentBrush(target.ActualOutline);
			}
			itemHighlightFrameRect.StrokeThickness = base.ActualThickness;
			itemHighlightFrameRect.TimeStamp = target.GetHashCode();
			if (!rect.IsEmpty)
			{
				frame.Rects.Add(itemHighlightFrameRect.TimeStamp, itemHighlightFrameRect);
			}
		}

		protected override void RenderFrame(Frame frame, SeriesView view)
		{
			base.RenderFrame(frame, view);
			Pool<Rectangle> rectPool = ItemView.RectPool;
			Pool<ContentControl> markerPool = ItemView.MarkerPool;
			int num = 0;
			int num2 = 0;
			foreach (ItemHighlightFrameRect value in ((CategoryItemHighlightLayerFrame)frame).Rects.Values)
			{
				if (value.MarkerTemplate != null)
				{
					ContentControl markerVisual = markerPool[num2];
					RenderPoint(value, markerVisual);
					num2++;
				}
				else
				{
					Rectangle rectVisual = rectPool[num];
					RenderRect(value, rectVisual);
					num++;
				}
			}
			rectPool.Count = num;
			markerPool.Count = num2;
		}

		internal virtual void RenderPoint(ItemHighlightFrameRect rect, ContentControl markerVisual)
		{
			if (double.IsNaN(rect.Left) || double.IsNaN(rect.Top) || double.IsNaN(rect.StrokeThickness) || rect.DataItem == null)
			{
				markerVisual.Visibility = Visibility.Collapsed;
				return;
			}
			Point world = new Point(rect.Left, rect.Top);
			DataContext obj = (DataContext)rect.DataItem;
			obj.ItemBrush = rect.Brush;
			Point seriesValuePosition = ((Series)obj.Series).GetSeriesValuePosition(world, AnimationActive() || _useInterpolation, _skipUnknownValues);
			if (double.IsNaN(seriesValuePosition.X) || double.IsNaN(seriesValuePosition.Y))
			{
				markerVisual.Visibility = Visibility.Collapsed;
				return;
			}
			ItemView.PositionMarker(markerVisual, seriesValuePosition.X, seriesValuePosition.Y);
			markerVisual.ContentTemplate = rect.MarkerTemplate;
			markerVisual.Content = rect.DataItem;
		}

		internal virtual void RenderRect(ItemHighlightFrameRect rect, Rectangle rectVisual)
		{
			if (double.IsNaN(rect.Left) || double.IsNaN(rect.Top) || double.IsNaN(rect.Bottom) || double.IsNaN(rect.Right) || double.IsNaN(rect.StrokeThickness))
			{
				rectVisual.Visibility = Visibility.Collapsed;
				return;
			}
			ItemView.PositionRectangle(rectVisual, rect.Left, rect.Top, rect.Right - rect.Left, rect.Bottom - rect.Top);
			rectVisual.Fill = rect.Brush;
			rectVisual.Stroke = rect.Outline;
			rectVisual.StrokeThickness = rect.StrokeThickness;
			if (base.DashArray != null)
			{
				rectVisual.StrokeDashArray = base.DashArray.Duplicate();
			}
			else
			{
				rectVisual.StrokeDashArray = null;
			}
			rectVisual.StrokeDashCap = base.DashCap;
			rectVisual.StrokeLineJoin = base.LineJoin;
			rectVisual.StrokeStartLineCap = base.StartCap;
			rectVisual.StrokeEndLineCap = base.EndCap;
			rectVisual.StrokeMiterLimit = base.MiterLimit;
		}

		protected override bool RequiresPrepare()
		{
			return true;
		}
	}

		[WFSuppressWidgetMember]
		[XamSuppressWidgetMember]
		public event AxisFormatLabelEventHandler XAxisAnnotationFormatLabel;

		[WFSuppressWidgetMember]
		[XamSuppressWidgetMember]
		public event AxisFormatLabelEventHandler YAxisAnnotationFormatLabel;

		public CrosshairLayer()
		{
			CrosshairLayerFrame previousFrame = new CrosshairLayerFrame();
			CrosshairLayerFrame currentFrame = new CrosshairLayerFrame();
			CrosshairLayerFrame transitionFrame = new CrosshairLayerFrame();
			_ = base.TransitionDuration.TotalSeconds;
			base.PreviousFrame = previousFrame;
			base.CurrentFrame = currentFrame;
			base.TransitionFrame = transitionFrame;
			base.DefaultStyleKey = typeof(CrosshairLayer);
		}

		protected override SeriesView CreateView()
		{
			return new CrosshairLayerView(this);
		}

		protected internal override void OnViewCreated(SeriesView view)
		{
			base.OnViewCreated(view);
			CrosshairView = (CrosshairLayerView)view;
		}

		internal bool HasXAxisAnnotationFormatLabel()
		{
			return this.XAxisAnnotationFormatLabel != null;
		}

		internal bool HasYAxisAnnotationFormatLabel()
		{
			return this.YAxisAnnotationFormatLabel != null;
		}

		protected override void OnDependentSeriesRender(Series series, bool animate)
		{
			if ((TargetSeries == null || TargetSeries == series) && !base.ContentInfo.IsDirty)
			{
				RenderSeries(animate);
			}
		}

		protected override void PrepareFrame(Frame frame, SeriesView view)
		{
			base.PrepareFrame(frame, view);
			CrosshairLayerFrame f = (CrosshairLayerFrame)frame;
			bool useInterpolation = UseInterpolation;
			bool skipUnknowns = SkipUnknownValues;
			f.LineHeights.Clear();
			f.LineWidths.Clear();
			f.HorizontalLineBrushes.Clear();
			f.VerticalLineBrushes.Clear();
			AxisAnnotationFrameManager.Clear(f);
			if (IsSeriesValid(TargetSeries))
			{
				PrepareSeries(TargetSeries, f, useInterpolation, skipUnknowns);
				return;
			}
			foreach (Series item in base.SeriesViewer.Series)
			{
				if (IsSeriesValid(item))
				{
					PrepareSeries(item, f, useInterpolation, skipUnknowns);
				}
				if (!item.IsStacked)
				{
					continue;
				}
				item.ForSubVisualSeries(delegate(Series s)
				{
					if (IsSeriesValid(s))
					{
						PrepareSeries(s, f, useInterpolation, skipUnknowns);
					}
					return true;
				});
			}
		}

		protected override bool IsSeriesValid(Series series)
		{
			if (!base.IsSeriesValid(series))
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (TargetSeriesName != null)
			{
				if (series.IsFragment)
				{
					string value = series.ResolveFragmentName();
					if (!TargetSeriesName.Equals(value))
					{
						return false;
					}
				}
				else if (!TargetSeriesName.Equals(series.Name))
				{
					return false;
				}
			}
			if (!GetCategoryPosition(series).Item1)
			{
				return false;
			}
			return true;
		}

		protected internal override void OnBeforeContentRefresh()
		{
			base.OnBeforeContentRefresh();
			if (base.ContentInfo.IsDirty || AnimationActive())
			{
				if (AnimationActive())
				{
					UpdateAnnotations((CrosshairLayerFrame)base.TransitionFrame, forceAxisUpdate: false);
				}
				else
				{
					UpdateAnnotations((CrosshairLayerFrame)base.CurrentFrame, forceAxisUpdate: false);
				}
			}
		}

		private void PrepareSeries(Series series, CrosshairLayerFrame f, bool useInterpolation, bool skipUnknowns)
		{
			Tuple<bool, Point> categoryPosition = GetCategoryPosition(series);
			if (!categoryPosition.Item1)
			{
				return;
			}
			Point item = categoryPosition.Item2;
			item = series.GetSeriesValuePosition(item, useInterpolation, skipUnknowns);
			Brush brush = base.ActualBrush;
			if (brush == null)
			{
				brush = base.Brush;
			}
			if (brush == null)
			{
				brush = series.ActualBrush;
				if (brush != null)
				{
					brush = CrosshairView.GetLightenedBrush(brush);
				}
			}
			Brush item2 = brush;
			Brush item3 = brush;
			if (HorizontalLineStroke != null)
			{
				item2 = HorizontalLineStroke;
			}
			if (VerticalLineStroke != null)
			{
				item3 = VerticalLineStroke;
			}
			f.HorizontalLineBrushes.Add(item2);
			f.VerticalLineBrushes.Add(item3);
			f.LineHeights.Add(item.Y);
			f.LineWidths.Add(item.X);
			if (IsAxisAnnotationEnabled && !double.IsNaN(item.Y))
			{
				AxisAnnotationFrameManager.Prepare(f, item, series, base.SeriesViewer, GetEffectiveViewport(), brush, XAxisAnnotationBackground, XAxisAnnotationTextColor, XAxisAnnotationOutline, XAxisAnnotationPadding, XAxisAnnotationStrokeThickness, YAxisAnnotationBackground, YAxisAnnotationTextColor, YAxisAnnotationOutline, YAxisAnnotationPadding, YAxisAnnotationStrokeThickness, VerticalLineVisibility == Visibility.Visible, HorizontalLineVisibility == Visibility.Visible);
			}
		}

		protected void UpdateAnnotations(CrosshairLayerFrame frame, bool forceAxisUpdate)
		{
			bool modified = false;
			if (_annotations == null)
			{
				modified = true;
				_annotatedAxes = new List<Axis>();
				_annotations = new Dictionary<Axis, Pool<AxisAnnotation>>();
			}
			AxisAnnotationFrameManager.UpdateAnnoations(this, frame, modified, _annotations, _annotatedAxes, forceAxisUpdate, XAxisAnnotationInterpolatedValuePrecision, YAxisAnnotationInterpolatedValuePrecision, this.XAxisAnnotationFormatLabel, this.YAxisAnnotationFormatLabel);
		}

		private Tuple<Path, int> FetchPath(Pool<Path> linePool, [SwiftMutableParameter] int lineCount, int i, CrosshairLayerFrame f, bool isVertical)
		{
			Path path = linePool[lineCount];
			lineCount++;
			if (isVertical)
			{
				path.Stroke = f.VerticalLineBrushes[i];
				path.Fill = f.VerticalLineBrushes[i];
			}
			else
			{
				path.Stroke = f.HorizontalLineBrushes[i];
				path.Fill = f.HorizontalLineBrushes[i];
			}
			path.StrokeThickness = base.ActualThickness;
			path.StrokeLineJoin = base.LineJoin;
			path.StrokeStartLineCap = base.StartCap;
			path.StrokeEndLineCap = base.EndCap;
			path.StrokeDashCap = base.DashCap;
			path.StrokeMiterLimit = base.MiterLimit;
			if (base.DashArray != null)
			{
				path.StrokeDashArray = base.DashArray.Duplicate();
			}
			else
			{
				path.StrokeDashArray = null;
			}
			return new Tuple<Path, int>(path, lineCount);
		}

		protected override void RenderFrame(Frame frame, SeriesView view)
		{
			base.RenderFrame(frame, view);
			Pool<Path> linePool = CrosshairView.LinePool;
			CrosshairLayerFrame crosshairLayerFrame = (CrosshairLayerFrame)frame;
			int count = crosshairLayerFrame.LineHeights.Count;
			int num = 0;
			double left = view.Viewport.Left;
			double right = view.Viewport.Right;
			double top = view.Viewport.Top;
			double bottom = view.Viewport.Bottom;
			bool flag = VerticalLineVisibility == Visibility.Visible;
			bool flag2 = HorizontalLineVisibility == Visibility.Visible;
			for (int i = 0; i < count; i++)
			{
				double num2 = Math.Floor(crosshairLayerFrame.LineHeights[i]);
				double x = Math.Floor(crosshairLayerFrame.LineWidths[i]);
				Path path = null;
				if (flag)
				{
					if (double.IsNaN(num2))
					{
						continue;
					}
					Tuple<Path, int> tuple = FetchPath(linePool, num, i, crosshairLayerFrame, isVertical: true);
					path = tuple.Item1;
					num = tuple.Item2;
					PathGeometry pathGeometry = new PathGeometry();
					PathFigure pathFigure = new PathFigure();
					pathFigure.StartPoint = new Point(x, top);
					LineSegment lineSegment = new LineSegment();
					lineSegment.Point = new Point(x, bottom);
					pathFigure.Segments.Add(lineSegment);
					pathGeometry.Figures.Add(pathFigure);
					path.Data = pathGeometry;
				}
				if (flag2 && !double.IsNaN(num2))
				{
					Tuple<Path, int> tuple2 = FetchPath(linePool, num, i, crosshairLayerFrame, isVertical: false);
					path = tuple2.Item1;
					num = tuple2.Item2;
					PathGeometry pathGeometry2 = new PathGeometry();
					PathFigure pathFigure2 = new PathFigure();
					pathFigure2.StartPoint = new Point(left, num2);
					LineSegment lineSegment2 = new LineSegment();
					lineSegment2.Point = new Point(right, num2);
					pathFigure2.Segments.Add(lineSegment2);
					pathGeometry2.Figures.Add(pathFigure2);
					path.Data = pathGeometry2;
				}
			}
			linePool.Count = num;
			if (AnimationActive())
			{
				UpdateAnnotations((CrosshairLayerFrame)base.TransitionFrame, forceAxisUpdate: true);
			}
			else
			{
				UpdateAnnotations((CrosshairLayerFrame)base.CurrentFrame, forceAxisUpdate: false);
			}
		}

		protected override bool RequiresPrepare()
		{
			return true;
		}

		protected override void PropertyUpdatedOverride(object sender, string propertyName, object oldValue, object newValue)
		{
			base.PropertyUpdatedOverride(sender, propertyName, oldValue, newValue);
			switch (propertyName)
			{
			case "HorizontalLineVisibility":
				RenderSeries(animate: true);
				break;
			case "VerticalLineVisibility":
				RenderSeries(animate: true);
				break;
			case "TargetSeriesName":
			case "TargetSeries":
				RenderSeries(animate: true);
				break;
			case "IsAxisAnnotationEnabled":
			case "XAxisAnnotationBackground":
			case "XAxisAnnotationOutline":
			case "XAxisAnnotationPadding":
			case "XAxisAnnotationStrokeThickness":
			case "XAxisAnnotationTextColor":
			case "YAxisAnnotationBackground":
			case "YAxisAnnotationOutline":
			case "YAxisAnnotationPadding":
			case "YAxisAnnotationStrokeThickness":
			case "YAxisAnnotationTextColor":
			case "HorizontalLineStroke":
			case "VerticalLineStroke":
			case "UseInterpolation":
				RenderSeries(animate: true);
				break;
			}
		}
	}
	internal class AxisAnnotationFrameManager
	{
		public static Brush GetContrasting(Brush brush, Color darkColor, Color lightColor)
		{
			Color color;
			if (brush is RadialGradientBrush)
			{
				if (((RadialGradientBrush)brush).GradientStops == null || ((RadialGradientBrush)brush).GradientStops.Count < 1)
				{
					return new SolidColorBrush(darkColor);
				}
				color = ((RadialGradientBrush)brush).GradientStops[0].Color;
			}
			else if (brush is LinearGradientBrush)
			{
				if (((LinearGradientBrush)brush).GradientStops == null || ((LinearGradientBrush)brush).GradientStops.Count < 1)
				{
					return new SolidColorBrush
					{
						Color = darkColor
					};
				}
				color = ((LinearGradientBrush)brush).GradientStops[0].Color;
			}
			else
			{
				color = ((SolidColorBrush)brush).Color;
			}
			double[] aHSL = color.GetAHSL();
			double[] aHSL2 = lightColor.GetAHSL();
			double[] aHSL3 = darkColor.GetAHSL();
			double num = (aHSL[3] + 0.05) / (aHSL3[3] + 0.05);
			double num2 = (aHSL2[3] + 0.05) / (aHSL[3] + 0.05);
			if (num > num2)
			{
				new SolidColorBrush().Color = darkColor;
			}
			return new SolidColorBrush
			{
				Color = lightColor
			};
		}

		public static void Prepare(AxisAnnotationFrame f, Point pos, Series series, SeriesViewer seriesViewer, Rect effectiveViewportRect, Brush seriesBrush, Brush xAxisAnnotationBackground, Brush xAxisAnnotationTextColor, Brush xAxisAnnotationOutline, Thickness xAxisAnnotationPadding, double xAxisAnnotationStrokeThickness, Brush yAxisAnnotationBackground, Brush yAxisAnnotationTextColor, Brush yAxisAnnotationOutline, Thickness yAxisAnnotationPadding, double yAxisAnnotationStrokeThickness, bool showXAnnotation, bool showYAnnotation)
		{
			Axis[] axes = series.GetAxes();
			Axis axis = null;
			Axis axis2 = null;
			for (int i = 0; i < axes.Length; i++)
			{
				if (axes[i].IsVertical)
				{
					axis2 = axes[i];
				}
				else
				{
					axis = axes[i];
				}
			}
			Color darkColor = Color.FromArgb(byte.MaxValue, 102, 102, 102);
			Color lightColor = Color.FromArgb(byte.MaxValue, byte.MaxValue, byte.MaxValue, byte.MaxValue);
			if (axis != null)
			{
				ScalerParams scalerParams = new ScalerParams(seriesViewer.ActualWindowRect, axis.ViewportRect, axis.IsInverted);
				scalerParams.EffectiveViewportRect = effectiveViewportRect;
				double unscaledValue = axis.GetUnscaledValue(pos.X, scalerParams);
				f.XAxisValues.Add(unscaledValue);
				f.XAxisValuePositions.Add(unscaledValue);
				if (xAxisAnnotationBackground != null)
				{
					f.XAxisAnnotationBackgrounds.Add(xAxisAnnotationBackground);
				}
				else
				{
					f.XAxisAnnotationBackgrounds.Add(seriesBrush);
				}
				if (xAxisAnnotationTextColor != null)
				{
					f.XAxisAnnotationTextColors.Add(xAxisAnnotationTextColor);
				}
				else
				{
					f.XAxisAnnotationTextColors.Add(GetContrasting(f.XAxisAnnotationBackgrounds[f.XAxisAnnotationBackgrounds.Count - 1], darkColor, lightColor));
				}
				f.XAxisAnnotationPaddingsLeft.Add(xAxisAnnotationPadding.Left);
				f.XAxisAnnotationPaddingsTop.Add(xAxisAnnotationPadding.Top);
				f.XAxisAnnotationPaddingsRight.Add(xAxisAnnotationPadding.Right);
				f.XAxisAnnotationPaddingsBottom.Add(xAxisAnnotationPadding.Bottom);
				if (!double.IsNaN(xAxisAnnotationStrokeThickness))
				{
					f.XAxisAnnotationStrokeThicknesses.Add(xAxisAnnotationStrokeThickness);
				}
				else
				{
					f.XAxisAnnotationStrokeThicknesses.Add(double.NaN);
				}
				if (xAxisAnnotationOutline != null)
				{
					f.XAxisAnnotationOutlines.Add(xAxisAnnotationOutline);
				}
				else
				{
					f.XAxisAnnotationOutlines.Add(null);
				}
				if (showXAnnotation)
				{
					f.XAxes.Add(axis);
				}
				else
				{
					f.XAxes.Add(null);
				}
			}
			if (axis2 != null)
			{
				ScalerParams scalerParams2 = new ScalerParams(seriesViewer.ActualWindowRect, axis2.ViewportRect, axis2.IsInverted);
				scalerParams2.EffectiveViewportRect = effectiveViewportRect;
				double unscaledValue2 = axis2.GetUnscaledValue(pos.Y, scalerParams2);
				f.YAxisValues.Add(unscaledValue2);
				f.YAxisValuePositions.Add(unscaledValue2);
				if (yAxisAnnotationBackground != null)
				{
					f.YAxisAnnotationBackgrounds.Add(yAxisAnnotationBackground);
				}
				else
				{
					f.YAxisAnnotationBackgrounds.Add(seriesBrush);
				}
				if (yAxisAnnotationTextColor != null)
				{
					f.YAxisAnnotationTextColors.Add(yAxisAnnotationTextColor);
				}
				else
				{
					f.YAxisAnnotationTextColors.Add(GetContrasting(f.YAxisAnnotationBackgrounds[f.YAxisAnnotationBackgrounds.Count - 1], darkColor, lightColor));
				}
				f.YAxisAnnotationPaddingsLeft.Add(yAxisAnnotationPadding.Left);
				f.YAxisAnnotationPaddingsTop.Add(yAxisAnnotationPadding.Top);
				f.YAxisAnnotationPaddingsRight.Add(yAxisAnnotationPadding.Right);
				f.YAxisAnnotationPaddingsBottom.Add(yAxisAnnotationPadding.Bottom);
				if (!double.IsNaN(yAxisAnnotationStrokeThickness))
				{
					f.YAxisAnnotationStrokeThicknesses.Add(yAxisAnnotationStrokeThickness);
				}
				else
				{
					f.YAxisAnnotationStrokeThicknesses.Add(double.NaN);
				}
				if (yAxisAnnotationOutline != null)
				{
					f.YAxisAnnotationOutlines.Add(yAxisAnnotationOutline);
				}
				else
				{
					f.YAxisAnnotationOutlines.Add(null);
				}
				if (showYAnnotation)
				{
					f.YAxes.Add(axis2);
				}
				else
				{
					f.YAxes.Add(null);
				}
			}
		}

		public static void Clear(AxisAnnotationFrame f)
		{
			f.XAxes.Clear();
			f.YAxes.Clear();
			f.XAxisValues.Clear();
			f.YAxisValues.Clear();
			f.XAxisValuePositions.Clear();
			f.YAxisValuePositions.Clear();
			f.XAxisAnnotationBackgrounds.Clear();
			f.XAxisAnnotationOutlines.Clear();
			f.XAxisAnnotationPaddingsLeft.Clear();
			f.XAxisAnnotationPaddingsTop.Clear();
			f.XAxisAnnotationPaddingsRight.Clear();
			f.XAxisAnnotationPaddingsBottom.Clear();
			f.XAxisAnnotationStrokeThicknesses.Clear();
			f.XAxisAnnotationTextColors.Clear();
			f.YAxisAnnotationBackgrounds.Clear();
			f.YAxisAnnotationOutlines.Clear();
			f.YAxisAnnotationPaddingsLeft.Clear();
			f.YAxisAnnotationPaddingsTop.Clear();
			f.YAxisAnnotationPaddingsRight.Clear();
			f.YAxisAnnotationPaddingsBottom.Clear();
			f.YAxisAnnotationStrokeThicknesses.Clear();
			f.YAxisAnnotationTextColors.Clear();
		}

		private static double ApplyPrecision(double val, Axis axis, int fixedPrecision)
		{
			if (!axis.IsNumeric)
			{
				return val;
			}
			int num = 0;
			if (fixedPrecision >= 0)
			{
				num = fixedPrecision;
			}
			else
			{
				double num2 = axis.ResolveActualInterval();
				num = ((num2 != 0.0) ? ((int)Math.Max(0.0 - Math.Floor(Math.Log10(num2)), 0.0)) : 0);
				num++;
			}
			return Math.Round(val, num);
		}

		public static void UpdateAnnoations(object owner, AxisAnnotationFrame frame, [SwiftMutableParameter] bool modified, Dictionary<Axis, Pool<AxisAnnotation>> annotationPools, List<Axis> currentAxes, bool forceAxisUpdate, int xFixedPrecision, int yFixedPrecision, AxisFormatLabelEventHandler xAxisFormat, AxisFormatLabelEventHandler yAxisFormat)
		{
			List<Axis> list = new List<Axis>();
			HashSet<Axis> hashSet = new HashSet<Axis>();
			Dictionary<Axis, int> dictionary = new Dictionary<Axis, int>();
			for (int i = 0; i < frame.XAxisValues.Count; i++)
			{
				Axis xAxis = frame.XAxes[i];
				if (xAxis == null)
				{
					continue;
				}
				if (!hashSet.Contains(xAxis))
				{
					list.Add(xAxis);
					dictionary[xAxis] = 0;
					hashSet.Add(xAxis);
				}
				Pool<AxisAnnotation> pool;
				if (!annotationPools.ContainsKey(xAxis))
				{
					pool = new Pool<AxisAnnotation>();
					pool.Create = () => new AxisAnnotation();
					pool.Destroy = delegate
					{
					};
					pool.Activate = delegate(AxisAnnotation a)
					{
						xAxis.AutoAnnotations.Add(a);
					};
					pool.Disactivate = delegate(AxisAnnotation a)
					{
						xAxis.AutoAnnotations.Remove(a);
					};
					annotationPools[xAxis] = pool;
					currentAxes.Add(xAxis);
				}
				else
				{
					pool = annotationPools[xAxis];
				}
				AxisAnnotation axisAnnotation = pool[dictionary[xAxis]];
				dictionary[xAxis] += 1;
				axisAnnotation.CheckDirty = false;
				axisAnnotation.Value = frame.XAxisValuePositions[i];
				double num = frame.XAxisValues[i];
				if (xAxisFormat != null)
				{
					string text = xAxisFormat(owner, num);
					axisAnnotation.Text = text;
				}
				else
				{
					num = ApplyPrecision(num, xAxis, xFixedPrecision);
					if (xAxis.SeriesViewer != null)
					{
						axisAnnotation.Text = xAxis.GetValueLabel(num);
					}
				}
				axisAnnotation.Foreground = frame.XAxisAnnotationTextColors[i];
				axisAnnotation.Background = frame.XAxisAnnotationBackgrounds[i];
				axisAnnotation.BackgroundPadding = new Thickness(frame.XAxisAnnotationPaddingsLeft[i], frame.XAxisAnnotationPaddingsTop[i], frame.XAxisAnnotationPaddingsRight[i], frame.XAxisAnnotationPaddingsBottom[i]);
				axisAnnotation.Outline = frame.XAxisAnnotationOutlines[i];
				axisAnnotation.StrokeThickness = frame.XAxisAnnotationStrokeThicknesses[i];
				if (axisAnnotation.CheckDirty)
				{
					axisAnnotation.CheckDirty = false;
					modified = true;
				}
			}
			for (int num2 = 0; num2 < frame.YAxisValues.Count; num2++)
			{
				Axis yAxis = frame.YAxes[num2];
				if (yAxis == null)
				{
					continue;
				}
				if (!hashSet.Contains(yAxis))
				{
					list.Add(yAxis);
					dictionary[yAxis] = 0;
					hashSet.Add(yAxis);
				}
				Pool<AxisAnnotation> pool2;
				if (!annotationPools.ContainsKey(yAxis))
				{
					pool2 = new Pool<AxisAnnotation>();
					pool2.Create = () => new AxisAnnotation();
					pool2.Destroy = delegate
					{
					};
					pool2.Activate = delegate(AxisAnnotation a)
					{
						yAxis.AutoAnnotations.Add(a);
					};
					pool2.Disactivate = delegate(AxisAnnotation a)
					{
						yAxis.AutoAnnotations.Remove(a);
					};
					annotationPools[yAxis] = pool2;
					currentAxes.Add(yAxis);
				}
				else
				{
					pool2 = annotationPools[yAxis];
				}
				AxisAnnotation axisAnnotation2 = pool2[dictionary[yAxis]];
				dictionary[yAxis] += 1;
				axisAnnotation2.CheckDirty = false;
				double num3 = frame.YAxisValues[num2];
				axisAnnotation2.Value = frame.YAxisValuePositions[num2];
				if (yAxisFormat != null)
				{
					string text2 = yAxisFormat(owner, num3);
					axisAnnotation2.Text = text2;
				}
				else
				{
					num3 = ApplyPrecision(num3, yAxis, yFixedPrecision);
					if (yAxis.SeriesViewer != null)
					{
						axisAnnotation2.Text = yAxis.GetValueLabel(num3);
					}
				}
				axisAnnotation2.Foreground = frame.YAxisAnnotationTextColors[num2];
				axisAnnotation2.Background = frame.YAxisAnnotationBackgrounds[num2];
				axisAnnotation2.BackgroundPadding = new Thickness(frame.YAxisAnnotationPaddingsLeft[num2], frame.YAxisAnnotationPaddingsTop[num2], frame.YAxisAnnotationPaddingsRight[num2], frame.YAxisAnnotationPaddingsBottom[num2]);
				axisAnnotation2.Outline = frame.YAxisAnnotationOutlines[num2];
				axisAnnotation2.StrokeThickness = frame.YAxisAnnotationStrokeThicknesses[num2];
				if (axisAnnotation2.CheckDirty)
				{
					axisAnnotation2.CheckDirty = false;
					modified = true;
				}
			}
			for (int num4 = 0; num4 < list.Count; num4++)
			{
				if (annotationPools.ContainsKey(list[num4]))
				{
					annotationPools[list[num4]].Count = dictionary[list[num4]];
				}
			}
			for (int num5 = currentAxes.Count - 1; num5 >= 0; num5--)
			{
				if (!hashSet.Contains(currentAxes[num5]))
				{
					modified = true;
					Pool<AxisAnnotation> pool3 = annotationPools[currentAxes[num5]];
					pool3.Count = 0;
					pool3.Activate = null;
					pool3.Create = null;
					pool3.Destroy = null;
					pool3.Disactivate = null;
					annotationPools.Remove(currentAxes[num5]);
					currentAxes.RemoveAt(num5);
				}
			}
			if (!(modified && forceAxisUpdate))
			{
				return;
			}
			for (int num6 = 0; num6 < list.Count; num6++)
			{
				Axis axis = list[num6];
				if (axis.ContentInfo.IsDirty)
				{
					axis.DoRenderAxis(animate: true);
					axis.ContentInfo.IsDirty = false;
				}
			}
		}
	}
	internal class CategoryBucketCalculator : IBucketizer
	{
		protected internal int FirstBucket;

		protected internal int LastBucket;

		protected internal int BucketSize;

		[Weak]
		protected CategorySeriesView View { get; private set; }

		internal CategoryBucketCalculator(CategorySeriesView view)
		{
			if (view == null)
			{
				throw new ArgumentNullException("view");
			}
			View = view;
			FirstBucket = -1;
			BucketSize = 0;
		}

		internal virtual double[] GetBucket(int index)
		{
			return null;
		}

		internal virtual double[] GetBucketWithoutUnknowns(int index)
		{
			return GetBucket(index);
		}

		public virtual double GetErrorBucket(int index, IFastItemColumn<double> column)
		{
			return double.NaN;
		}

		protected internal virtual void CalculateBuckets(double resolution)
		{
			Rect windowRect = View.WindowRect;
			Rect viewport = View.Viewport;
			CategorySeries categoryModel = View.CategoryModel;
			CategoryAxisBase categoryAxisBase = categoryModel.GetXAxis() as CategoryAxisBase;
			IFastItemsSource fastItemsSource = categoryModel.FastItemsSource;
			if (windowRect.IsEmpty || viewport.IsEmpty || categoryAxisBase == null || fastItemsSource == null || fastItemsSource.Count == 0)
			{
				BucketSize = 0;
				return;
			}
			Rect effectiveViewport = categoryModel.GetEffectiveViewport(View);
			Rect contentViewport = categoryModel.GetContentViewport(View);
			if (categoryAxisBase is ISortingAxis { SortedIndices: not null } sortingAxis)
			{
				FirstBucket = sortingAxis.GetFirstVisibleIndex(windowRect, viewport, effectiveViewport, contentViewport);
				LastBucket = sortingAxis.GetLastVisibleIndex(windowRect, viewport, effectiveViewport, contentViewport);
				BucketSize = 1;
				return;
			}
			ScalerParams p = new ScalerParams(windowRect, viewport, categoryAxisBase.IsInverted, effectiveViewport);
			double num = Math.Floor(categoryAxisBase.GetUnscaledValue(contentViewport.Left, p, CategoryMode.Mode0));
			double num2 = Math.Ceiling(categoryAxisBase.GetUnscaledValue(contentViewport.Right, p, CategoryMode.Mode0));
			if (categoryAxisBase.IsInverted)
			{
				num2 = Math.Ceiling(categoryAxisBase.GetUnscaledValue(contentViewport.Left, p, CategoryMode.Mode0));
				num = Math.Floor(categoryAxisBase.GetUnscaledValue(contentViewport.Right, p, CategoryMode.Mode0));
			}
			double val = Math.Floor((num2 - num + 1.0) * resolution / contentViewport.Width);
			BucketSize = (int)Math.Max(1.0, val);
			FirstBucket = (int)Math.Max(0.0, Math.Floor(num / (double)BucketSize) - 1.0);
			LastBucket = (int)Math.Ceiling(num2 / (double)BucketSize);
		}

		double[] IBucketizer.GetBucket(int index)
		{
			return GetBucket(index);
		}

		double[] IBucketizer.GetBucketWithoutUnknowns(int index)
		{
			return GetBucketWithoutUnknowns(index);
		}

		void IBucketizer.GetBucketInfo(out int firstBucket, out int lastBucket, out int bucketSize, out double resolution)
		{
			firstBucket = FirstBucket;
			lastBucket = LastBucket;
			bucketSize = BucketSize;
			resolution = View.CategoryModel.Resolution;
		}
	}

	internal class SortingTrendLineManager : CategoryTrendLineManagerBase
	{
		public override TrendLineManagerType ManagerType => TrendLineManagerType.Sorting;

		public Func<int, double> GetUnscaledValueFromUnsortedIndex { get; set; }

		public Func<double, Rect, Rect, double> GetUnscaledXValue { get; set; }

		public SortingTrendLineManager(Func<int, double> getUnscaledXValueFromUnsortedIndex, Func<double, Rect, Rect, double> getUnscaledXValue)
		{
			GetUnscaledValueFromUnsortedIndex = getUnscaledXValueFromUnsortedIndex;
			GetUnscaledXValue = getUnscaledXValue;
		}

		public override void PrepareLineCore(List<Point> flattenedPoints, TrendLineType trendLineType, IList<double> valueColumn, int period, Func<double, double> GetScaledXValue, Func<double, double> GetScaledYValue, TrendResolutionParams trendResolutionParams)
		{
			double xmin = trendResolutionParams.FirstBucket * trendResolutionParams.BucketSize;
			double xmax = trendResolutionParams.LastBucket * trendResolutionParams.BucketSize;
			List<Point> list = new List<Point>();
			if (trendLineType == TrendLineType.None)
			{
				base.TrendCoefficients = null;
				base.TrendColumn.Clear();
				return;
			}
			if (IsFit(trendLineType))
			{
				base.TrendColumn.Clear();
				base.TrendCoefficients = TrendFitCalculator.CalculateFit(list, trendLineType, trendResolutionParams, base.TrendCoefficients, valueColumn.Count, (int x) => x + 1, (int i) => valueColumn[i], delegate(double x)
				{
					int num4 = (int)Math.Floor(x);
					int num5 = (int)Math.Ceiling(x);
					double num6 = x - (double)num4;
					double arg2 = ((!((double)num5 <= xmax)) ? (GetUnscaledValueFromUnsortedIndex(num4) + num6 * (GetUnscaledValueFromUnsortedIndex((int)xmax) - GetUnscaledValueFromUnsortedIndex(num4))) : (GetUnscaledValueFromUnsortedIndex(num4) + num6 * (GetUnscaledValueFromUnsortedIndex(num5) - GetUnscaledValueFromUnsortedIndex(num4))));
					return GetScaledXValue(arg2);
				}, GetScaledYValue, xmin, xmax);
			}
			if (IsAverage(trendLineType))
			{
				base.TrendCoefficients = null;
				TrendAverageCalculator.CalculateSingleValueAverage(trendLineType, base.TrendColumn, valueColumn, period);
				for (int num = trendResolutionParams.FirstBucket; num <= trendResolutionParams.LastBucket; num++)
				{
					int num2 = num * trendResolutionParams.BucketSize;
					double arg = GetUnscaledValueFromUnsortedIndex(num2);
					if (num2 >= 0 && num2 < base.TrendColumn.Count)
					{
						double num3 = GetScaledXValue(arg);
						double y = GetScaledYValue(base.TrendColumn[num2]);
						list.Add(new Point(num3 + trendResolutionParams.Offset, y));
					}
				}
			}
			FlattenTrendLine(list, trendResolutionParams, flattenedPoints);
		}
	}
	[TSImportModule("igniteui-core/type", "TypeRegistrar")]
	[TSImportModule("igniteui-core/type", "NotSupportedException")]
	internal class CategoryTrendLineManagerFactory
	{
		internal static ITrendLineManager SelectManager(ITrendLineManager trendLineManager, CategoryAxisBase xAxis, Canvas rootCanvas, Series series, SRProvider sr)
		{
			if (xAxis != null && xAxis is ISortingAxis)
			{
				trendLineManager?.Detach();
				SortingTrendLineManager sortingTrendLineManager = new SortingTrendLineManager(delegate(int x)
				{
					int num = x;
					int index = num;
					ISortingAxis sortingAxis = xAxis as ISortingAxis;
					if (sortingAxis != null)
					{
						num = Math.Min(num, sortingAxis.SortedIndices.Count - 1);
						index = sortingAxis.SortedIndices[num];
					}
					return sortingAxis.GetUnscaledValueAt(index);
				}, delegate(double x, Rect viewport, Rect window)
				{
					Rect effectiveViewport = series.GetEffectiveViewport(series.View);
					ScalerParams p = new ScalerParams(window, viewport, xAxis.IsInverted, effectiveViewport);
					return xAxis.GetUnscaledValue(x, p);
				});
				sortingTrendLineManager.AttachPolyLine(rootCanvas, series);
				return sortingTrendLineManager;
			}
			if (trendLineManager == null || trendLineManager.ManagerType != TrendLineManagerType.Category)
			{
				trendLineManager?.Detach();
				CategoryTrendLineManager categoryTrendLineManager = new CategoryTrendLineManager();
				((ITrendLineManager)categoryTrendLineManager).AttachPolyLine(rootCanvas, series);
				return categoryTrendLineManager;
			}
			return trendLineManager;
		}
	}
	internal abstract class CategoryTrendLineManagerBase : TrendLineManagerBase<double>, IPreparesCategoryTrendline
	{
		public override TrendLineManagerType ManagerType => TrendLineManagerType.Category;

		public virtual void PrepareLine(IHasCategoryTrendline trendlineHost, PreparationParams p, ValuesHolder h, double offset)
		{
			Rect effectiveViewportRect = p.EffectiveViewportRect;
			ScalerParams xParams = new ScalerParams(p.WindowRect, p.ViewportRect, p.Scaler.IsInverted, effectiveViewportRect);
			ScalerParams yParams = new ScalerParams(p.WindowRect, p.ViewportRect, p.YScaler.IsInverted, effectiveViewportRect);
			if (trendlineHost is Series)
			{
				yParams.ReferenceValue = ((Series)trendlineHost).GetReferenceValue();
			}
			IList<double> list = ((SingleValuesHolder)h).Values;
			if (p.SortingScaler != null && p.SortingScaler.SortedIndices != null)
			{
				list = new SafeSortedReadOnlyDoubleCollection(list, p.SortingScaler.SortedIndices);
			}
			TrendResolutionParams trendResolutionParams = new TrendResolutionParams
			{
				BucketSize = p.BucketSize,
				FirstBucket = p.FirstBucket,
				LastBucket = p.LastBucket,
				Offset = offset,
				Resolution = p.Resolution,
				Viewport = p.ViewportRect
			};
			if (trendlineHost.TrendLineType == TrendLineType.None)
			{
				return;
			}
			if (trendlineHost.IsVertical)
			{
				PrepareLineCore(p.Frame.Trend, trendlineHost.TrendLineType, list, trendlineHost.TrendLinePeriod, (double y) => p.YScaler.GetScaledValue(y, yParams), (double x) => p.Scaler.GetScaledValue(x, xParams), trendResolutionParams);
			}
			else
			{
				PrepareLineCore(p.Frame.Trend, trendlineHost.TrendLineType, list, trendlineHost.TrendLinePeriod, (double x) => p.Scaler.GetScaledValue(x, xParams), (double y) => p.YScaler.GetScaledValue(y, yParams), trendResolutionParams);
			}
		}

		public abstract void PrepareLineCore(List<Point> flattenedPoints, TrendLineType trendLineType, IList<double> valueColumn, int period, Func<double, double> GetScaledXValue, Func<double, double> GetScaledYValue, TrendResolutionParams trendResolutionParams);
	}
	internal class RangeValueList : IList<double>, ICollection<double>, IEnumerable<double>, IEnumerable
	{
		private IList<double> _highColumn;

		private IList<double> _lowColumn;

		public double this[int index]
		{
			get
			{
				double num = double.NaN;
				double num2 = double.NaN;
				if (_highColumn != null && index >= 0 && index < _highColumn.Count)
				{
					num = _highColumn[index];
				}
				if (_lowColumn != null && index >= 0 && index < _lowColumn.Count)
				{
					num2 = _lowColumn[index];
				}
				bool flag = double.IsNaN(num);
				bool flag2 = double.IsNaN(num2);
				if (!flag && !flag2)
				{
					return (num + num2) / 2.0;
				}
				if (!flag)
				{
					return num;
				}
				if (!flag2)
				{
					return num2;
				}
				return double.NaN;
			}
			set
			{
			}
		}

		public int Count

					val = _highColumn.Count;

				if (_lowColumn != null)
				{
					val2 = _lowColumn.Count;
				}
				return Math.Max(Math.Max(0, val), val2);
			}
		}

	internal class CategoryTransitionSourceFramePreparer
	{
		private Random _rand = new Random();

		public void PrepareSourceFrame(CategoryFrame previousFrame, CategoryFrame currentFrame, bool isVertical, Axis xAxis, Axis yAxis, CategoryTransitionInMode mode, CategoryTransitionInMode defaultMode, [SwiftMutableParameter] TransitionInSpeedType speedType, TransitionInSpeedType defaultSpeedType, Func<double> getZeroValue, Rect viewport)
		{
			previousFrame.CustomClip = new Rect(0.0, 0.0, 1.0, 1.0);
			previousFrame.Buckets.Clear();
			previousFrame.ErrorBuckets.Clear();
			previousFrame.Markers.Clear();
			previousFrame.Trend.Clear();
			previousFrame.ErrorBars.Clear();
			previousFrame.ErrorBarPositiveSizes.Clear();
			previousFrame.ErrorBarNegativeSizes.Clear();
			bool flag = false;
			bool flag2 = false;
			if (yAxis != null)
			{
				flag = yAxis.IsInverted;
			}
			if (xAxis != null)
			{
				flag2 = xAxis.IsInverted;
			}
			CategoryTransitionInMode categoryTransitionInMode = mode;
			if (categoryTransitionInMode == CategoryTransitionInMode.Auto)
			{
				categoryTransitionInMode = defaultMode;
			}
			switch (categoryTransitionInMode)
			{
			case CategoryTransitionInMode.FromZero:
			{
				double zeroValue = getZeroValue();
				PrepareSourceFrameFromZero(previousFrame, currentFrame, zeroValue, isVertical);
				break;
			}
			case CategoryTransitionInMode.AccordionFromLeft:
				PrepareSourceFrameFromLeftOrRight(previousFrame, currentFrame, isRight: false, isVertical, viewport);
				break;
			case CategoryTransitionInMode.AccordionFromTop:
				PrepareSourceFrameFromTopOrBottom(previousFrame, currentFrame, isTop: true, isVertical, viewport);
				break;
			case CategoryTransitionInMode.AccordionFromBottom:
				PrepareSourceFrameFromTopOrBottom(previousFrame, currentFrame, isTop: false, isVertical, viewport);
				break;
			case CategoryTransitionInMode.AccordionFromRight:
				PrepareSourceFrameFromLeftOrRight(previousFrame, currentFrame, isRight: true, isVertical, viewport);
				break;
			case CategoryTransitionInMode.SweepFromLeft:
				PrepareSourceFrameSweepFromLeftOrRight(previousFrame, currentFrame, isRight: false);
				break;
			case CategoryTransitionInMode.SweepFromRight:
				PrepareSourceFrameSweepFromLeftOrRight(previousFrame, currentFrame, isRight: true);
				break;
			case CategoryTransitionInMode.SweepFromTop:
				PrepareSourceFrameSweepFromTopOrBottom(previousFrame, currentFrame, isTop: true);
				break;
			case CategoryTransitionInMode.SweepFromBottom:
				PrepareSourceFrameSweepFromTopOrBottom(previousFrame, currentFrame, isTop: false);
				break;
			case CategoryTransitionInMode.SweepFromCenter:
				CopyFrame(previousFrame, currentFrame);
				previousFrame.CustomClip = new Rect(0.5, 0.5, 0.0, 0.0);
				break;
			case CategoryTransitionInMode.AccordionFromCategoryAxisMinimum:
				if (isVertical)
				{
					PrepareSourceFrameFromTopOrBottom(previousFrame, currentFrame, flag, isVertical, viewport);
				}
				else
				{
					PrepareSourceFrameFromLeftOrRight(previousFrame, currentFrame, flag2, isVertical, viewport);
				}
				break;
			case CategoryTransitionInMode.AccordionFromCategoryAxisMaximum:
				if (isVertical)
				{
					PrepareSourceFrameFromTopOrBottom(previousFrame, currentFrame, !flag, isVertical, viewport);
				}
				else
				{
					PrepareSourceFrameFromLeftOrRight(previousFrame, currentFrame, !flag2, isVertical, viewport);
				}
				break;
			case CategoryTransitionInMode.AccordionFromValueAxisMinimum:
				if (isVertical)
				{
					PrepareSourceFrameFromLeftOrRight(previousFrame, currentFrame, flag2, isVertical, viewport);
				}
				else
				{
					PrepareSourceFrameFromTopOrBottom(previousFrame, currentFrame, flag, isVertical, viewport);
				}
				break;
			case CategoryTransitionInMode.AccordionFromValueAxisMaximum:
				if (isVertical)
				{
					PrepareSourceFrameFromLeftOrRight(previousFrame, currentFrame, !flag2, isVertical, viewport);
				}
				else
				{
					PrepareSourceFrameFromTopOrBottom(previousFrame, currentFrame, !flag, isVertical, viewport);
				}
				break;
			case CategoryTransitionInMode.SweepFromCategoryAxisMinimum:
				if (isVertical)
				{
					PrepareSourceFrameSweepFromTopOrBottom(previousFrame, currentFrame, flag);
				}
				else
				{
					PrepareSourceFrameSweepFromLeftOrRight(previousFrame, currentFrame, flag2);
				}
				break;
			case CategoryTransitionInMode.SweepFromCategoryAxisMaximum:
				if (isVertical)
				{
					PrepareSourceFrameSweepFromTopOrBottom(previousFrame, currentFrame, !flag);
				}
				else
				{
					PrepareSourceFrameSweepFromLeftOrRight(previousFrame, currentFrame, !flag2);
				}
				break;
			case CategoryTransitionInMode.SweepFromValueAxisMinimum:
				if (isVertical)
				{
					PrepareSourceFrameSweepFromLeftOrRight(previousFrame, currentFrame, flag2);
				}
				else
				{
					PrepareSourceFrameSweepFromTopOrBottom(previousFrame, currentFrame, flag);
				}
				break;
			case CategoryTransitionInMode.SweepFromValueAxisMaximum:
				if (isVertical)
				{
					PrepareSourceFrameSweepFromLeftOrRight(previousFrame, currentFrame, !flag2);
				}
				else
				{
					PrepareSourceFrameSweepFromTopOrBottom(previousFrame, currentFrame, !flag);
				}
				break;
			case CategoryTransitionInMode.Expand:
				PrepareSourceFrameExpand(previousFrame, currentFrame);
				break;
			}
			if (speedType == TransitionInSpeedType.Auto)
			{
				speedType = defaultSpeedType;
			}
			previousFrame.ClearSpeedModifiers();
			currentFrame.ClearSpeedModifiers();
			switch (speedType)
			{
			case TransitionInSpeedType.IndexScaled:
				ApplyIndexScaledSpeedModifiers(previousFrame.Buckets.Count, categoryTransitionInMode, previousFrame.SpeedModifiers, currentFrame.SpeedModifiers, xAxis, yAxis, isVertical, viewport);
				ApplyIndexScaledSpeedModifiers(previousFrame.Markers.Count, categoryTransitionInMode, previousFrame.MarkerSpeedModifiers, currentFrame.MarkerSpeedModifiers, xAxis, yAxis, isVertical, viewport);
				ApplyIndexScaledSpeedModifiers(previousFrame.Trend.Count, categoryTransitionInMode, previousFrame.TrendSpeedModifiers, currentFrame.TrendSpeedModifiers, xAxis, yAxis, isVertical, viewport);
				ApplyIndexScaledSpeedModifiers(previousFrame.ErrorBars.Count, categoryTransitionInMode, previousFrame.ErrorSpeedModifiers, currentFrame.ErrorSpeedModifiers, xAxis, yAxis, isVertical, viewport);
				ApplyIndexScaledSpeedModifiers(previousFrame.ErrorBarPositiveSizes.Count, categoryTransitionInMode, previousFrame.ErrorBarsSpeedModifiers, currentFrame.ErrorBarsSpeedModifiers, xAxis, yAxis, isVertical, viewport);
				break;
			case TransitionInSpeedType.ValueScaled:
			{
				double zeroValue2 = getZeroValue();
				ApplyValueScaledSpeedModifiersFromBuckets(previousFrame.Buckets.Count, zeroValue2, categoryTransitionInMode, previousFrame.Buckets, currentFrame.Buckets, previousFrame.SpeedModifiers, currentFrame.SpeedModifiers, xAxis, yAxis, isVertical, viewport);
				ApplyValueScaledSpeedModifiersFromPoints(previousFrame.Markers.Count, zeroValue2, categoryTransitionInMode, previousFrame.Markers, currentFrame.Markers, previousFrame.MarkerSpeedModifiers, currentFrame.MarkerSpeedModifiers, xAxis, yAxis, isVertical, viewport);
				ApplyValueScaledSpeedModifiersFromPoints(previousFrame.Trend.Count, zeroValue2, categoryTransitionInMode, previousFrame.Trend, currentFrame.Trend, previousFrame.TrendSpeedModifiers, currentFrame.TrendSpeedModifiers, xAxis, yAxis, isVertical, viewport);
				ApplyValueScaledSpeedModifiersFromPoints(previousFrame.ErrorBars.Count, zeroValue2, categoryTransitionInMode, previousFrame.ErrorBars, currentFrame.ErrorBars, previousFrame.ErrorSpeedModifiers, currentFrame.ErrorSpeedModifiers, xAxis, yAxis, isVertical, viewport);
				ApplyValueScaledSpeedModifiersFromDoubles(previousFrame.ErrorBarPositiveSizes.Count, zeroValue2, categoryTransitionInMode, previousFrame.ErrorBarPositiveSizes, currentFrame.ErrorBarPositiveSizes, previousFrame.ErrorBarsSpeedModifiers, currentFrame.ErrorBarsSpeedModifiers, xAxis, yAxis, isVertical, viewport);
				break;
			}
			case TransitionInSpeedType.Random:
				ApplyRandomSpeedModifiers(previousFrame.Buckets.Count, categoryTransitionInMode, previousFrame.SpeedModifiers, currentFrame.SpeedModifiers);
				ApplyRandomSpeedModifiers(previousFrame.Markers.Count, categoryTransitionInMode, previousFrame.MarkerSpeedModifiers, currentFrame.MarkerSpeedModifiers);
				ApplyRandomSpeedModifiers(previousFrame.Trend.Count, categoryTransitionInMode, previousFrame.TrendSpeedModifiers, currentFrame.TrendSpeedModifiers);
				ApplyRandomSpeedModifiers(previousFrame.ErrorBars.Count, categoryTransitionInMode, previousFrame.ErrorSpeedModifiers, currentFrame.ErrorSpeedModifiers);
				ApplyRandomSpeedModifiers(previousFrame.ErrorBarPositiveSizes.Count, categoryTransitionInMode, previousFrame.ErrorBarsSpeedModifiers, currentFrame.ErrorBarsSpeedModifiers);
				break;
			}
		}

		private void ApplyRandomSpeedModifiers(int count, CategoryTransitionInMode transitionMode, List<double> previousModifiers, List<double> currentModifiers)
		{
			if (count != 0)
			{
				for (int i = 0; i < count; i++)
				{
					previousModifiers.Add(1.0 + _rand.NextDouble());
					currentModifiers.Add(1.0 + _rand.NextDouble());
				}
			}
		}

		private void ApplyValueScaledSpeedModifiersFromBuckets(int count, [SwiftMutableParameter] double zeroValue, CategoryTransitionInMode transitionMode, List<double[]> previousBuckets, List<double[]> currentBuckets, List<double> previousModifiers, List<double> currentModifiers, Axis xAxis, Axis yAxis, bool isVertical, Rect viewport)
		{
			if (count == 0)
			{
				return;
			}
			bool flag = false;
			Axis axis = yAxis;
			if (isVertical)
			{
				axis = xAxis;
			}
			if (axis != null)
			{
				flag = axis.IsInverted;
			}
			double bottom = viewport.Bottom;
			double val = viewport.Bottom;
			double val2 = viewport.Top;
			if (isVertical)
			{
				val = viewport.Right;
				val2 = viewport.Left;
			}
			if (flag)
			{
				val = viewport.Top;
				val2 = viewport.Bottom;
				if (isVertical)
				{
					val = viewport.Left;
					val2 = viewport.Right;
				}
			}
			zeroValue = Math.Max(zeroValue, Math.Min(val2, val));
			zeroValue = Math.Min(zeroValue, Math.Max(val2, val));
			bottom = 0.0;
			for (int i = 0; i < count; i++)
			{
				double[] array = currentBuckets[i];
				for (int j = 1; j < array.Length; j++)
				{
					if (!double.IsNaN(array[j]) && !double.IsInfinity(array[j]))
					{
						bottom = Math.Max(bottom, Math.Abs(zeroValue - array[j]));
					}
				}
			}
			for (int k = 0; k < count; k++)
			{
				double[] array = currentBuckets[k];
				double num = Math.Abs(array[1] - zeroValue);
				double num2 = Math.Abs(array[1] - zeroValue);
				for (int l = 1; l < array.Length; l++)
				{
					if (!double.IsNaN(array[l]) && !double.IsInfinity(array[l]))
					{
						num = Math.Max(Math.Abs(array[l] - zeroValue), num);
						num2 = Math.Min(Math.Abs(array[l] - zeroValue), num2);
					}
				}
				double num3 = (num + num2) / 2.0;
				double num4 = ((!double.IsNaN(num3) && bottom != 0.0) ? (num3 / bottom) : 1.0);
				previousModifiers.Add(2.0 - num4);
				currentModifiers.Add(2.0 - num4);
			}
		}

		private void ApplyValueScaledSpeedModifiersFromPoints(int count, [SwiftMutableParameter] double zeroValue, CategoryTransitionInMode transitionMode, List<Point> previousPoints, List<Point> currentPoints, List<double> previousModifiers, List<double> currentModifiers, Axis xAxis, Axis yAxis, bool isVertical, Rect viewport)
		{
			if (count == 0)
			{
				return;
			}
			bool flag = false;
			Axis axis = yAxis;
			if (isVertical)
			{
				axis = xAxis;
			}
			if (axis != null)
			{
				flag = axis.IsInverted;
			}
			double bottom = viewport.Bottom;
			double val = viewport.Bottom;
			double val2 = viewport.Top;
			if (isVertical)
			{
				val = viewport.Right;
				val2 = viewport.Left;
			}
			if (flag)
			{
				val = viewport.Top;
				val2 = viewport.Bottom;
				if (isVertical)
				{
					val = viewport.Left;
					val2 = viewport.Right;
				}
			}
			zeroValue = Math.Max(zeroValue, Math.Min(val2, val));
			zeroValue = Math.Min(zeroValue, Math.Max(val2, val));
			bottom = 0.0;
			for (int i = 0; i < count; i++)
			{
				Point point = currentPoints[i];
				if (isVertical)
				{
					if (!double.IsNaN(point.X) && !double.IsInfinity(point.X))
					{
						bottom = Math.Max(bottom, Math.Abs(point.X - zeroValue));
					}
				}
				else if (!double.IsNaN(point.Y) && !double.IsInfinity(point.Y))
				{
					bottom = Math.Max(bottom, Math.Abs(point.Y - zeroValue));
				}
			}
			for (int j = 0; j < count; j++)
			{
				Point point = currentPoints[j];
				double num = ((!isVertical) ? point.Y : point.X);
				double num2 = ((!double.IsNaN(num) && !double.IsInfinity(num) && bottom != 0.0) ? (Math.Abs(num - zeroValue) / bottom) : 1.0);
				previousModifiers.Add(2.0 - num2);
				currentModifiers.Add(2.0 - num2);
			}
		}

		private void ApplyValueScaledSpeedModifiersFromDoubles(int count, [SwiftMutableParameter] double zeroValue, CategoryTransitionInMode transitionMode, List<double> previousDoubles, List<double> currentDoubles, List<double> previousModifiers, List<double> currentModifiers, Axis xAxis, Axis yAxis, bool isVertical, Rect viewport)
		{
			if (count == 0)
			{
				return;
			}
			bool flag = false;
			Axis axis = yAxis;
			if (isVertical)
			{
				axis = xAxis;
			}
			if (axis != null)
			{
				flag = axis.IsInverted;
			}
			double bottom = viewport.Bottom;
			double val = viewport.Bottom;
			double val2 = viewport.Top;
			if (isVertical)
			{
				val = viewport.Right;
				val2 = viewport.Left;
			}
			if (flag)
			{
				val = viewport.Top;
				val2 = viewport.Bottom;
				if (isVertical)
				{
					val = viewport.Left;
					val2 = viewport.Right;
				}
			}
			zeroValue = Math.Max(zeroValue, Math.Min(val2, val));
			zeroValue = Math.Min(zeroValue, Math.Max(val2, val));
			bottom = 0.0;
			for (int i = 0; i < count; i++)
			{
				double num = currentDoubles[i];
				if (!double.IsNaN(num) && !double.IsInfinity(num))
				{
					bottom = Math.Max(bottom, Math.Abs(num - zeroValue));
				}
			}
			for (int j = 0; j < count; j++)
			{
				double num = currentDoubles[j];
				double num2 = num;
				double num3 = ((bottom != 0.0 && !double.IsNaN(num2) && !double.IsInfinity(num2)) ? (Math.Abs(num2 - zeroValue) / bottom) : 1.0);
				previousModifiers.Add(2.0 - num3);
				currentModifiers.Add(2.0 - num3);
			}
		}

		private void ApplyIndexScaledSpeedModifiers(int count, CategoryTransitionInMode transitionMode, List<double> previousModifiers, List<double> currentModifiers, Axis xAxis, Axis yAxis, bool isVertical, Rect viewport)
		{
			if (count != 0)
			{
				Axis axis = xAxis;
				if (isVertical)
				{
					axis = yAxis;
				}
				_ = axis?.IsInverted;
				for (int i = 0; i < count; i++)
				{
					double num = ((count != 1) ? ((double)i / (double)(count - 1)) : 1.0);
					num = 1.0 - num;
					previousModifiers.Add(1.0 + num);
					currentModifiers.Add(1.0 + num);
				}
			}
		}

		private void PrepareSourceFrameExpand(CategoryFrame previousFrame, CategoryFrame currentFrame)
		{
			previousFrame.Buckets.Clear();
			previousFrame.ErrorBuckets.Clear();
			previousFrame.Markers.Clear();
			previousFrame.Trend.Clear();
			previousFrame.ErrorBars.Clear();
			previousFrame.ErrorBarPositiveSizes.Clear();
			previousFrame.ErrorBarNegativeSizes.Clear();
			CopyBucketList(previousFrame.Buckets, currentFrame.Buckets);
			CopyDoubleList(previousFrame.ErrorBuckets, currentFrame.ErrorBuckets);
			CopyPointList(previousFrame.Markers, currentFrame.Markers);
			CopyPointList(previousFrame.Trend, currentFrame.Trend);
			CopyPointList(previousFrame.ErrorBars, currentFrame.ErrorBars);
			CopyDoubleList(previousFrame.ErrorBarPositiveSizes, currentFrame.ErrorBarPositiveSizes);
			CopyDoubleList(previousFrame.ErrorBarNegativeSizes, currentFrame.ErrorBarNegativeSizes);
			int count = previousFrame.Buckets.Count;
			List<double[]> buckets = previousFrame.Buckets;
			for (int i = 0; i < count; i++)
			{
				double[] array = buckets[i];
				double num = array[1];
				double num2 = array[1];
				for (int j = 2; j < array.Length; j++)
				{
					num = Math.Min(num, array[j]);
					num2 = Math.Max(num2, array[j]);
				}
				double num3 = (num + num2) / 2.0;
				for (int k = 1; k < array.Length; k++)
				{
					array[k] = num3;
				}
			}
			int count2 = previousFrame.ErrorBarPositiveSizes.Count;
			List<double> errorBarPositiveSizes = previousFrame.ErrorBarPositiveSizes;
			List<double> errorBarNegativeSizes = previousFrame.ErrorBarNegativeSizes;
			for (int l = 0; l < count2; l++)
			{
				errorBarPositiveSizes[l] = 0.0;
				errorBarNegativeSizes[l] = 0.0;
			}
		}

		private void PrepareSourceFrameSweepFromLeftOrRight(CategoryFrame previousFrame, CategoryFrame currentFrame, bool isRight)
		{
			if (isRight)
			{
				CopyFrame(previousFrame, currentFrame);
				previousFrame.CustomClip = new Rect(1.0, 0.0, 0.0, 1.0);
			}
			else
			{
				CopyFrame(previousFrame, currentFrame);
				previousFrame.CustomClip = new Rect(0.0, 0.0, 0.0, 1.0);
			}
		}

		private void PrepareSourceFrameSweepFromTopOrBottom(CategoryFrame previousFrame, CategoryFrame currentFrame, bool isTop)
		{
			if (isTop)
			{
				CopyFrame(previousFrame, currentFrame);
				previousFrame.CustomClip = new Rect(0.0, 0.0, 1.0, 0.0);
			}
			else
			{
				CopyFrame(previousFrame, currentFrame);
				previousFrame.CustomClip = new Rect(0.0, 1.0, 1.0, 0.0);
			}
		}

		private void CopyFrame(CategoryFrame previousFrame, CategoryFrame currentFrame)
		{
			previousFrame.Buckets.Clear();
			previousFrame.ErrorBuckets.Clear();
			previousFrame.Markers.Clear();
			previousFrame.Trend.Clear();
			previousFrame.ErrorBars.Clear();
			previousFrame.ErrorBarPositiveSizes.Clear();
			previousFrame.ErrorBarNegativeSizes.Clear();
			CopyBucketList(previousFrame.Buckets, currentFrame.Buckets);
			CopyDoubleList(previousFrame.ErrorBuckets, currentFrame.ErrorBuckets);
			CopyPointList(previousFrame.Markers, currentFrame.Markers);
			CopyPointList(previousFrame.Trend, currentFrame.Trend);
			CopyPointList(previousFrame.ErrorBars, currentFrame.ErrorBars);
			CopyDoubleList(previousFrame.ErrorBarPositiveSizes, currentFrame.ErrorBarPositiveSizes);
			CopyDoubleList(previousFrame.ErrorBarNegativeSizes, currentFrame.ErrorBarNegativeSizes);
		}

		private void PreparePointListFromValue(List<Point> sourceItems, List<Point> targetItems, bool isVertical, double value, bool isValueAxis)
		{
			int count = targetItems.Count;
			for (int i = 0; i < count; i++)
			{
				Point point = targetItems[i];
				Point item = ((!isValueAxis) ? ((!isVertical) ? new Point(value, point.Y) : new Point(point.X, value)) : ((!isVertical) ? new Point(point.X, value) : new Point(value, point.Y)));
				sourceItems.Add(item);
			}
		}

		private void CopyPointList(List<Point> sourceItems, List<Point> targetItems)
		{
			int count = targetItems.Count;
			for (int i = 0; i < count; i++)
			{
				Point point = targetItems[i];
				Point item = new Point(point.X, point.Y);
				sourceItems.Add(item);
			}
		}

		private void CopyBucketList(List<double[]> sourceItems, List<double[]> targetItems)
		{
			int count = targetItems.Count;
			for (int i = 0; i < count; i++)
			{
				double[] array = targetItems[i];
				double[] array2 = new double[array.Length];
				for (int j = 0; j < array2.Length; j++)
				{
					array2[j] = array[j];
				}
				sourceItems.Add(array2);
			}
		}

		private void PrepareBucketListFromValue(List<double[]> sourceItems, List<double[]> targetItems, bool isVertical, double value, bool isValueAxis)
		{
			int count = targetItems.Count;
			for (int i = 0; i < count; i++)
			{
				double[] array = targetItems[i];
				double[] array2 = new double[array.Length];
				if (isValueAxis)
				{
					array2[0] = array[0];
					for (int j = 1; j < array2.Length; j++)
					{
						array2[j] = value;
					}
				}
				else
				{
					array2[0] = value;
					for (int k = 1; k < array2.Length; k++)
					{
						array2[k] = array[k];
					}
				}
				sourceItems.Add(array2);
			}
		}

		private void PrepareSourceFrameFromLeftOrRight(CategoryFrame previousFrame, CategoryFrame currentFrame, bool isRight, bool isVertical, Rect viewport)
		{
			double value = viewport.Right;
			if (!isRight)
			{
				value = viewport.Left;
			}
			bool isValueAxis = false;
			if (isVertical)
			{
				isValueAxis = true;
			}
			PrepareBucketListFromValue(previousFrame.Buckets, currentFrame.Buckets, isVertical, value, isValueAxis);
			PrepareDoubleListFromValue(previousFrame.ErrorBuckets, currentFrame.ErrorBuckets, isVertical, value, isValueAxis);
			PreparePointListFromValue(previousFrame.Markers, currentFrame.Markers, isVertical, value, isValueAxis);
			PreparePointListFromValue(previousFrame.Trend, currentFrame.Trend, isVertical, value, isValueAxis);
			PreparePointListFromValue(previousFrame.ErrorBars, currentFrame.ErrorBars, isVertical, value, isValueAxis);
			PrepareDoubleListFromValue(previousFrame.ErrorBarPositiveSizes, currentFrame.ErrorBarPositiveSizes, isVertical, value, isValueAxis);
			PrepareDoubleListFromValue(previousFrame.ErrorBarNegativeSizes, currentFrame.ErrorBarNegativeSizes, isVertical, value, isValueAxis);
		}

		private void PrepareSourceFrameFromTopOrBottom(CategoryFrame previousFrame, CategoryFrame currentFrame, bool isTop, bool isVertical, Rect viewport)
		{
			double value = viewport.Bottom;
			if (isTop)
			{
				value = viewport.Top;
			}
			bool isValueAxis = true;
			if (isVertical)
			{
				isValueAxis = false;
			}
			PrepareBucketListFromValue(previousFrame.Buckets, currentFrame.Buckets, isVertical, value, isValueAxis);
			PrepareDoubleListFromValue(previousFrame.ErrorBuckets, currentFrame.ErrorBuckets, isVertical, value, isValueAxis);
			PreparePointListFromValue(previousFrame.Markers, currentFrame.Markers, isVertical, value, isValueAxis);
			PreparePointListFromValue(previousFrame.Trend, currentFrame.Trend, isVertical, value, isValueAxis);
			PreparePointListFromValue(previousFrame.ErrorBars, currentFrame.ErrorBars, isVertical, value, isValueAxis);
			PrepareDoubleListFromValue(previousFrame.ErrorBarPositiveSizes, currentFrame.ErrorBarPositiveSizes, isVertical, value, isValueAxis);
			PrepareDoubleListFromValue(previousFrame.ErrorBarNegativeSizes, currentFrame.ErrorBarNegativeSizes, isVertical, value, isValueAxis);
		}

		private void PrepareSourceFrameFromZero(CategoryFrame previousFrame, CategoryFrame currentFrame, double zeroValue, bool isVertical)
		{
			PrepareBucketListFromValue(previousFrame.Buckets, currentFrame.Buckets, isVertical, zeroValue, isValueAxis: true);
			PrepareDoubleListFromValue(previousFrame.ErrorBuckets, currentFrame.ErrorBuckets, isVertical, zeroValue, isValueAxis: true);
			PreparePointListFromValue(previousFrame.Markers, currentFrame.Markers, isVertical, zeroValue, isValueAxis: true);
			PreparePointListFromValue(previousFrame.Trend, currentFrame.Trend, isVertical, zeroValue, isValueAxis: true);
			PreparePointListFromValue(previousFrame.ErrorBars, currentFrame.ErrorBars, isVertical, zeroValue, isValueAxis: true);
			PrepareDoubleListFromValue(previousFrame.ErrorBarPositiveSizes, currentFrame.ErrorBarPositiveSizes, isVertical, zeroValue, isValueAxis: true);
			PrepareDoubleListFromValue(previousFrame.ErrorBarNegativeSizes, currentFrame.ErrorBarNegativeSizes, isVertical, zeroValue, isValueAxis: true);
		}
	}

	[WidgetIgnoreDepends("MarkerSeries")]
	[WidgetIgnoreDepends("CategorySeries")]
	[WidgetIgnoreDepends("CategoryAxisBase")]
	[WidgetIgnoreDepends("CategoryDateTimeXAxis")]
	public class CategorySeriesRenderManager : SeriesRenderManager
	{
		public int BucketSize;

		public int FirstBucket;

		public AssigningCategoryMarkerStyleEventArgs CategoryMarkerOverrideArgs;

		public AssigningCategoryStyleEventArgs CategoryOverrideArgs;

		protected override AssigningSeriesStyleEventArgsBase CreateMarkerOverrideArgs()
		{
			CategoryMarkerOverrideArgs = new AssigningCategoryMarkerStyleEventArgs();
			return CategoryMarkerOverrideArgs;
		}

		protected override AssigningSeriesShapeStyleEventArgsBase CreateShapeStyleOverrideArgs()
		{
			CategoryOverrideArgs = new AssigningCategoryStyleEventArgs();
			return CategoryOverrideArgs;
		}

		public void InitCategoryMarkerRenderSettings(MarkerSeries source, bool shouldOverrideMarkerStyle, GetCategoryItemsHandler getItems, int size, int first)
		{
			BucketSize = size;
			FirstBucket = first;
			InitMarkerRenderSettings(source, shouldOverrideMarkerStyle, getItems);
		}

		public void InitCategoryRenderSettings(Series source, bool shouldOverrideCategoryStyle, GetCategoryItemsHandler getItems, int size, int first)
		{
			BucketSize = size;
			FirstBucket = first;
			InitRenderSettings(source, shouldOverrideCategoryStyle, getItems);
		}

		protected internal int[] GetBucketBounds(int count, int bucket)
		{
			int bucketSize = BucketSize;
			int num = Math.Min(bucket * bucketSize, count - 1);
			int num2 = Math.Min(num + bucketSize - 1, count - 1);
			return new int[2]
			{
				Math.Min(num + FirstBucket * bucketSize, count - 1),
				Math.Min(num2 + FirstBucket * bucketSize, count - 1)
			};
		}

		public void PopulateArgsBounds(AssigningSeriesStyleEventArgsBase args, bool isSorting, List<double[]> buckets, int currentIndex, int valueCount, CategoryAxisBase categoryAxis, ScalerParams axisParams, bool isThumbnail, bool isMarker)
		{
			if (currentIndex == -1)
			{
				if (isSorting)
				{
					args.HasDateRange = true;
					args.StartDate = (DateTime)categoryAxis.ResolveActualMinimumValue();
					args.EndDate = (DateTime)categoryAxis.ResolveActualMaximumValue();
				}
				else
				{
					args.HasDateRange = false;
					args.StartIndex = 0;
					args.EndIndex = valueCount - 1;
				}
			}
			else if (isSorting)
			{
				long num = (long)categoryAxis.GetUnscaledValue(buckets[currentIndex][0], axisParams);
				long val = num;
				if (currentIndex + 1 < buckets.Count)
				{
					val = (long)categoryAxis.GetUnscaledValue(buckets[currentIndex + 1][0], axisParams);
				}
				args.HasDateRange = true;
				args.StartDate = new DateTime(Math.Min(DateTime.MaxValue.Ticks, Math.Max(DateTime.MinValue.Ticks, num)));
				args.EndDate = new DateTime(Math.Min(DateTime.MaxValue.Ticks, Math.Max(DateTime.MinValue.Ticks, val)));
				if (categoryAxis.IsInverted)
				{
					DateTime endDate = args.EndDate;
					args.EndDate = args.StartDate;
					args.StartDate = endDate;
				}
				if (isMarker)
				{
					args.StartIndex = currentIndex;
					args.EndIndex = currentIndex;
				}
				else
				{
					int[] bucketBounds = GetBucketBounds(valueCount, currentIndex);
					args.StartIndex = bucketBounds[0];
					args.EndIndex = bucketBounds[1];
				}
			}
			else if (isMarker)
			{
				args.StartIndex = currentIndex;
				args.EndIndex = currentIndex;
			}
			else
			{
				int[] bucketBounds2 = GetBucketBounds(valueCount, currentIndex);
				args.HasDateRange = false;
				args.StartIndex = bucketBounds2[0];
				args.EndIndex = bucketBounds2[1];
			}
		}
	}
