	internal class CategoryFramePreparer : CategoryFramePreparerBase
	{
		private DefaultCategoryTrendlineHost _defaultTrendlineHost = new DefaultCategoryTrendlineHost();

		private DefaultSingleValueProvider _defaultSingleValueProvider = new DefaultSingleValueProvider();

		[Weak]
		protected IHasCategoryTrendline TrendlineHost { get; set; }

		[Weak]
		protected IHasSingleValueCategory ValuesProvider { get; set; }

		public CategoryFramePreparer(IIsCategoryBased host)
			: this(host, host as ISupportsMarkers, host as IProvidesViewport, host as ISupportsErrorBars, host as IBucketizer)
		{
		}

		public CategoryFramePreparer(IIsCategoryBased host, ISupportsMarkers markersHost, IProvidesViewport viewportHost, ISupportsErrorBars errorBarsHost, IBucketizer bucketizingHost)
			: base(host, markersHost, viewportHost, errorBarsHost, bucketizingHost)
		{
			TrendlineHost = _defaultTrendlineHost;
			if (host is IHasCategoryTrendline)
			{
				TrendlineHost = host as IHasCategoryTrendline;
			}
			ValuesProvider = _defaultSingleValueProvider;
			if (host is IHasSingleValueCategory)
			{
				ValuesProvider = host as IHasSingleValueCategory;
			}
		}

		protected override bool PrepareMarker(CategoryFrame frame, double[] bucket, IDetectsCollisions collisionAvoider, int itemIndex, int markerCount, int markerBucket)
		{
			double num = bucket[0];
			double num2 = bucket[1];
			Rect rc = new Rect(num - 5.0, num2 - 5.0, 11.0, 11.0);
			if (!double.IsNaN(num) && !double.IsNaN(num2) && !double.IsInfinity(num) && !double.IsInfinity(num2) && collisionAvoider.TryAdd(rc))
			{
				frame.Markers.Add(new Point(num, num2));
				base.MarkersHost.UpdateMarkerTemplate(markerCount, itemIndex, markerBucket);
				return true;
			}
			return false;
		}

		protected override ValuesHolder GetValues(PreparationParams p)
		{
			SingleValuesHolder singleValuesHolder = new SingleValuesHolder();
			IList<double> valueColumn = ValuesProvider.ValueColumn;
			singleValuesHolder.Values = valueColumn;
			return singleValuesHolder;
		}

		protected override void ScaleBucketValues(PreparationParams p, double[] bucket, double offset, bool isSortingScaler, ScalerParams xParams, ScalerParams yParams)
		{
			if (isSortingScaler)
			{
				bucket[0] += offset;
			}
			else
			{
				bucket[0] = p.Scaler.GetScaledValue(bucket[0], xParams) + offset;
			}
			bucket[1] = p.YScaler.GetScaledValue(bucket[1], yParams);
			if (p.BucketSize > 1 || isSortingScaler)
			{
				bucket[2] = p.YScaler.GetScaledValue(bucket[2], yParams);
			}
			else
			{
				bucket[2] = bucket[1];
			}
		}

		protected override void ScaleFrameBucketValues(PreparationParams pp, double offset, bool isSortingScaler, ScalerParams xParams, ScalerParams yParams, bool errorBars, bool markers)
		{
			base.ScaleFrameBucketValues(pp, offset, isSortingScaler, xParams, yParams, errorBars, markers);
			int bucketSize = pp.BucketSize;
			int count = pp.Frame.Buckets.Count;
			List<double[]> buckets = pp.Frame.Buckets;
			List<double[]> markerBuckets = base.MarkerBuckets;
			int count2 = markerBuckets.Count;
			List<int> list = new List<int>();
			if (!isSortingScaler)
			{
				list.Add(0);
			}
			List<int> list2 = new List<int>();
			list2.Add(1);
			if (isSortingScaler || bucketSize > 1)
			{
				list2.Add(2);
			}
			pp.Scaler.GetScaledBucketValueList(buckets, list, 0, count, xParams);
			pp.YScaler.GetScaledBucketValueList(buckets, list2, 0, count, yParams);
			for (int i = 0; i < count; i++)
			{
				buckets[i][0] = buckets[i][0] + offset;
			}
			if (bucketSize == 1 && !isSortingScaler)
			{
				for (int j = 0; j < count; j++)
				{
					buckets[j][2] = buckets[j][1];
				}
			}
			if (!markers)
			{
				return;
			}
			pp.Scaler.GetScaledBucketValueList(markerBuckets, list, 0, count2, xParams);
			pp.YScaler.GetScaledBucketValueList(markerBuckets, list2, 0, count2, yParams);
			for (int k = 0; k < count2; k++)
			{
				markerBuckets[k][0] = markerBuckets[k][0] + offset;
			}
			if (bucketSize == 1 && !isSortingScaler)
			{
				for (int l = 0; l < count2; l++)
				{
					markerBuckets[l][2] = markerBuckets[l][1];
				}
			}
		}

		protected override void PrepareTrendline(PreparationParams p, ValuesHolder h, double offset)
		{
			if (TrendlineHost.TrendLineType != TrendLineType.None && TrendlineHost.TrendlinePreparer != null && TrendlineHost.TrendLinePeriod >= 1)
			{
				TrendlineHost.TrendlinePreparer.PrepareLine(TrendlineHost, p, h, offset);
			}
		}

		protected override void StoreYValues(ValuesHolder h, int index, bool useTemp, bool isFragment)
		{
			SingleValuesHolder singleValuesHolder = (SingleValuesHolder)h;
			double num = singleValuesHolder.Values[index];
			double num2 = num;
			if (isFragment)
			{
				double[] bucket = base.BucketizingHost.GetBucket(index);
				num = bucket[1];
				num2 = bucket[1];
			}
			if (useTemp)
			{
				singleValuesHolder.TempY0 = num;
				singleValuesHolder.TempY1 = num2;
			}
			else
			{
				singleValuesHolder.BucketY0 = num;
				singleValuesHolder.BucketY1 = num2;
			}
		}

		protected override void MinMaxYValues(ValuesHolder h, int index, bool isFragment)
		{
			SingleValuesHolder singleValuesHolder = (SingleValuesHolder)h;
			IList<double> values = singleValuesHolder.Values;
			if (index < values.Count)
			{
				double val = ((!isFragment) ? values[index] : base.BucketizingHost.GetBucket(index)[1]);
				singleValuesHolder.BucketY0 = Math.Min(singleValuesHolder.BucketY0, val);
				singleValuesHolder.BucketY1 = Math.Max(singleValuesHolder.BucketY1, val);
			}
		}

		protected override double[] GetBucketSorting(double xVal, ValuesHolder h)
		{
			SingleValuesHolder singleValuesHolder = (SingleValuesHolder)h;
			return new double[3] { xVal, singleValuesHolder.BucketY0, singleValuesHolder.BucketY1 };
		}
	}
	[WidgetIgnoreDepends("CategorySeries")]
	[WidgetIgnoreDepends("AnchoredCategorySeries")]
	[WidgetIgnoreDepends("RangeCategorySeries")]
	[WidgetIgnoreDepends("RangeAreaSeries")]
	[WidgetIgnoreDepends("LineSeries")]
	[WidgetIgnoreDepends("SplineSeriesBase")]
	[WidgetIgnoreDepends("AreaSeries")]
	[WidgetIgnoreDepends("StepLineSeries")]
	[WidgetIgnoreDepends("StepAreaSeries")]
	[WidgetIgnoreDepends("CategoryDateTimeXAxis")]
	[WidgetIgnoreDepends("CategoryYAxis")]
	[WidgetIgnoreDepends("FragmentBase")]
	internal abstract class CategoryFramePreparerBase : FramePreparer
	{
		private List<double[]> _markerBuckets = new List<double[]>();

		private List<int> _markerItemIndexes = new List<int>();

		private List<int> _markerBucketIndexes = new List<int>();

		[Weak]
		protected internal IBucketizer BucketizingHost { get; set; }

		[Weak]
		protected internal IIsCategoryBased CategoryBasedHost { get; set; }

		public bool SkipUnknowns { get; set; }

		protected List<double[]> MarkerBuckets => _markerBuckets;

		public CategoryFramePreparerBase(IIsCategoryBased host)
			: this(host, host as ISupportsMarkers, host as IProvidesViewport, host as ISupportsErrorBars, host as IBucketizer)
		{
		}

		public CategoryFramePreparerBase(IIsCategoryBased host, ISupportsMarkers markersHost, IProvidesViewport viewportHost, ISupportsErrorBars errorBarsHost, IBucketizer bucketizingHost)
			: base(markersHost, viewportHost, errorBarsHost)
		{
			CategoryBasedHost = host;
			BucketizingHost = bucketizingHost;
		}

		protected abstract bool PrepareMarker(CategoryFrame frame, double[] bucket, IDetectsCollisions collisionAvoider, int itemIndex, int markerCount, int markerBucket);

		private PreparationParams GetParams(Frame inputFrame)
		{
			PreparationParams preparationParams = new PreparationParams();
			preparationParams.UseHighMarkerFidelity = CategoryBasedHost.UseHighMarkerFidelity;
			preparationParams.Scaler = CategoryBasedHost.Scaler;
			preparationParams.YScaler = CategoryBasedHost.YScaler;
			preparationParams.SortingScaler = preparationParams.Scaler as ISortingAxis;
			preparationParams.Frame = inputFrame as CategoryFrame;
			if (preparationParams.Frame == null || preparationParams.Scaler == null || preparationParams.YScaler == null)
			{
				return null;
			}
			BucketizingHost.GetBucketInfo(out var firstBucket, out var lastBucket, out var bucketSize, out var resolution);
			preparationParams.FirstBucket = firstBucket;
			preparationParams.LastBucket = lastBucket;
			preparationParams.BucketSize = bucketSize;
			preparationParams.Resolution = resolution;
			if (preparationParams.LastBucket < preparationParams.FirstBucket)
			{
				return null;
			}
			base.ViewportHost.GetViewInfo(out var viewportRect, out var windowRect);
			Rect effectiveViewport = base.ViewportHost.GetEffectiveViewport();
			preparationParams.WindowRect = windowRect;
			preparationParams.ViewportRect = viewportRect;
			preparationParams.EffectiveViewportRect = effectiveViewport;
			if (preparationParams.WindowRect == Rect.Empty || preparationParams.ViewportRect == Rect.Empty)
			{
				return null;
			}
			if (CategoryBasedHost != null && CategoryBasedHost is Series && ((Series)CategoryBasedHost).IsFragment && BucketizingHost != null)
			{
				preparationParams.IsFragment = true;
			}
			return preparationParams;
		}

		public double GetOffset(ICategoryScaler scaler, Rect windowRect, Rect viewportRect, Rect effectiveViewportRect)
		{
			return scaler.GetSeriesOffset(windowRect, viewportRect, effectiveViewportRect, CategoryBasedHost.CurrentMode2Index, (int)CategoryBasedHost.CurrentCategoryMode);
		}

		private double GetOffset(PreparationParams p)
		{
			return GetOffset(p.Scaler, p.WindowRect, p.ViewportRect, p.EffectiveViewportRect);
		}

		public override void PrepareFrame(Frame frame, SeriesView view)
		{
			PreparationParams preparationParams = GetParams(frame);
			if (preparationParams == null || BucketizingHost == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			preparationParams.Frame.Buckets.Clear();
			preparationParams.Frame.ErrorBuckets.Clear();
			preparationParams.Frame.Markers.Clear();
			preparationParams.Frame.Trend.Clear();
			preparationParams.Frame.ErrorBars.Clear();
			preparationParams.Frame.ErrorBarPositiveSizes.Clear();
			preparationParams.Frame.ErrorBarNegativeSizes.Clear();
			bool shouldDisplayMarkers = base.MarkersHost.ShouldDisplayMarkers;
			bool errorBars = base.ErrorBarsHost.ShouldDisplayErrorBars();
			double offset = GetOffset(preparationParams);
			ValuesHolder values = GetValues(preparationParams);
			if (preparationParams.SortingScaler != null && preparationParams.SortingScaler.SortedIndices != null && preparationParams.SortingScaler.SortedIndices.Count != values.Count)
			{
				return;
			}
			if (preparationParams.SortingScaler != null && preparationParams.SortingScaler.IsDateTime)
			{
				preparationParams.SortingScaler.EnsureActualMinimumAndMaximum();
			}
			if (SkipUnknowns && preparationParams.SortingScaler != null && preparationParams.SortingScaler.SortedIndices.Count > 0)
			{
				int index = preparationParams.SortingScaler.SortedIndices[preparationParams.FirstBucket];
				StoreYValues(values, index, useTemp: true, preparationParams.IsFragment);
				while ((double.IsNaN(values.TempY0) || double.IsNaN(values.TempY1)) && preparationParams.FirstBucket > 0)
				{
					preparationParams.FirstBucket--;
					index = preparationParams.SortingScaler.SortedIndices[preparationParams.FirstBucket];
					StoreYValues(values, index, useTemp: true, preparationParams.IsFragment);
				}
				int index2 = preparationParams.SortingScaler.SortedIndices[preparationParams.LastBucket];
				StoreYValues(values, index2, useTemp: true, preparationParams.IsFragment);
				while ((double.IsNaN(values.TempY0) || double.IsNaN(values.TempY1)) && preparationParams.LastBucket < values.Count - 1)
				{
					preparationParams.LastBucket++;
					index2 = preparationParams.SortingScaler.SortedIndices[preparationParams.LastBucket];
					StoreYValues(values, index2, useTemp: true, preparationParams.IsFragment);
				}
			}
			if (SkipUnknowns && preparationParams.SortingScaler == null)
			{
				int firstBucket = preparationParams.FirstBucket;
				double[] bucket = BucketizingHost.GetBucket(firstBucket);
				while ((double.IsNaN(bucket[1]) || double.IsNaN(bucket[2])) && preparationParams.FirstBucket > 0)
				{
					preparationParams.FirstBucket--;
					firstBucket = preparationParams.FirstBucket;
					bucket = BucketizingHost.GetBucket(firstBucket);
				}
				int lastBucket = preparationParams.LastBucket;
				bucket = BucketizingHost.GetBucket(lastBucket);
				while ((double.IsNaN(bucket[1]) || double.IsNaN(bucket[2])) && preparationParams.LastBucket < values.Count / preparationParams.BucketSize)
				{
					preparationParams.LastBucket++;
					lastBucket = preparationParams.LastBucket;
					bucket = BucketizingHost.GetBucket(lastBucket);
				}
			}
			PrepareTrendline(preparationParams, values, offset);
			int markerCount = PrepareData(preparationParams, values, offset, shouldDisplayMarkers, errorBars);
			base.MarkersHost.UpdateMarkerCount(markerCount);
			PrepareErrorBars(frame as CategoryFrame, view);
		}

		protected void PrepareErrorBars(CategoryFrame frame, SeriesView view)
		{
			frame.ErrorBars.Clear();
			frame.ErrorBarPositiveSizes.Clear();
			frame.ErrorBarNegativeSizes.Clear();
			if (frame == null || !base.ErrorBarsHost.ShouldDisplayErrorBars())
			{
				return;
			}
			CategoryErrorBarSettings categoryErrorBarSettings = base.ErrorBarsHost.ErrorBarSettings as CategoryErrorBarSettings;
			NumericAxisBase numericAxisBase = ((!(base.ErrorBarsHost is IBarSeries)) ? (base.ErrorBarsHost.YAxis as NumericAxisBase) : ((BarSeries)base.ErrorBarsHost).XAxis);
			if (categoryErrorBarSettings == null || numericAxisBase == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			IDetectsCollisions detectsCollisions = CategoryBasedHost.ProvideCollisionDetector();
			ErrorBarsHelper errorBarsHelper = new ErrorBarsHelper(base.ErrorBarsHost, view);
			double positiveSize = 0.0;
			double negativeSize = 0.0;
			double position = 0.0;
			int num = ((!base.ErrorBarsHost.ShouldSyncErrorBarsWithMarkers()) ? frame.Buckets.Count : frame.Markers.Count);
			for (int i = 0; i < num; i++)
			{
				double num2;
				double num3;
				double num4;
				if (base.ErrorBarsHost.ShouldSyncErrorBarsWithMarkers())
				{
					num2 = Math.Round(frame.Markers[i].X);
					num3 = Math.Round(frame.Markers[i].Y);
					num4 = num3;
				}
				else if (base.ErrorBarsHost is IBarSeries)
				{
					num2 = Math.Round(frame.Buckets[i][1]);
					num3 = Math.Round(frame.Buckets[i][0]);
					num4 = num2;
				}
				else
				{
					num2 = Math.Round(frame.Buckets[i][0]);
					num3 = Math.Round(frame.Buckets[i][1]);
					num4 = num3;
				}
				switch (categoryErrorBarSettings.Calculator.GetCalculatorType())
				{
				case ErrorBarCalculatorType.Percentage:
					errorBarsHelper.CalculateDependentErrorBarSize(num4, categoryErrorBarSettings.Calculator, numericAxisBase, ref positiveSize, ref negativeSize);
					break;
				case ErrorBarCalculatorType.Data:
				{
					IFastItemColumn<double> itemColumn = categoryErrorBarSettings.Calculator.GetItemColumn();
					if (itemColumn != null && i < itemColumn.Count)
					{
						errorBarsHelper.CalculateFromUnscaledErrorBarValue(num4, itemColumn[i], numericAxisBase, ref positiveSize, ref negativeSize);
					}
					break;
				}
				case ErrorBarCalculatorType.Fixed:
					errorBarsHelper.CalculateIndependentErrorBarSize(num4, categoryErrorBarSettings.Calculator, numericAxisBase, ref positiveSize, ref negativeSize);
					break;
				case ErrorBarCalculatorType.StandardDeviation:
					errorBarsHelper.CalculateIndependentErrorBarPosition(categoryErrorBarSettings.Calculator, ref position);
					errorBarsHelper.CalculateStdDevErrorBarSize(position, categoryErrorBarSettings.Calculator, numericAxisBase, ref positiveSize, ref negativeSize);
					break;
				case ErrorBarCalculatorType.StandardError:
					errorBarsHelper.CalculateIndependentErrorBarSize(num4, categoryErrorBarSettings.Calculator, numericAxisBase, ref positiveSize, ref negativeSize);
					break;
				}
				Point point = ((!(base.ErrorBarsHost is IBarSeries)) ? errorBarsHelper.CalculateErrorBarCenterVertical(categoryErrorBarSettings.Calculator, numericAxisBase, new Point
				{
					X = num2,
					Y = num3
				}, position) : errorBarsHelper.CalculateErrorBarCenterHorizontal(categoryErrorBarSettings.Calculator, numericAxisBase, new Point
				{
					X = num2,
					Y = num3
				}, position));
				if (base.ErrorBarsHost.ShouldSyncErrorBarsWithMarkers())
				{
					frame.ErrorBars.Add(new Point
					{
						X = point.X,
						Y = point.Y
					});
					frame.ErrorBarPositiveSizes.Add(positiveSize);
					frame.ErrorBarNegativeSizes.Add(negativeSize);
					continue;
				}
				Rect rc = new Rect(point.X - 3.0, point.Y - 3.0, 7.0, 7.0);
				if (detectsCollisions.TryAdd(rc))
				{
					frame.ErrorBars.Add(new Point
					{
						X = point.X,
						Y = point.Y
					});
					frame.ErrorBarPositiveSizes.Add(positiveSize);
					frame.ErrorBarNegativeSizes.Add(negativeSize);
				}
			}
		}

		protected virtual int PrepareData(PreparationParams p, ValuesHolder h, double offset, bool markers, bool errorBars)
		{
			int num = 0;
			bool isCluster = false;
			double[] endBucket = null;
			bool flag = false;
			bool flag2 = p.SortingScaler != null;
			Rect windowRect = p.WindowRect;
			Rect viewportRect = p.ViewportRect;
			bool flag3 = p.YScaler is NumericAxisBase && ((NumericAxisBase)p.YScaler).IsReallyLogarithmic;
			bool useHighMarkerFidelity = p.UseHighMarkerFidelity;
			bool mayContainUnknowns = CategoryBasedHost.MayContainUnknowns;
			List<double[]> markerBuckets = _markerBuckets;
			List<int> markerBucketIndexes = _markerBucketIndexes;
			List<int> markerItemIndexes = _markerItemIndexes;
			markerBuckets.Clear();
			markerBucketIndexes.Clear();
			markerItemIndexes.Clear();
			IBucketizer bucketizingHost = BucketizingHost;
			IDetectsCollisions collisionAvoider = CategoryBasedHost.ProvideCollisionDetector();
			double singlePixelSpan = 0.0;
			Rect effectiveViewportRect = p.EffectiveViewportRect;
			ScalerParams scalerParams = new ScalerParams(windowRect, viewportRect, p.Scaler.IsInverted, effectiveViewportRect);
			ScalerParams yParams = new ScalerParams(windowRect, viewportRect, p.YScaler.IsInverted, effectiveViewportRect)
			{
				ReferenceValue = ((CategoryBasedHost is Series) ? ((Series)CategoryBasedHost).GetReferenceValue() : double.NaN)
			};
			if (flag2)
			{
				singlePixelSpan = p.Scaler.GetUnscaledValue(2.0, scalerParams) - p.Scaler.GetUnscaledValue(1.0, scalerParams);
				flag = IsAreaOrLine();
			}
			IFastItemColumn<double> fastItemColumn = null;
			if (base.ErrorBarsHost != null && base.ErrorBarsHost.ErrorBarSettings is CategoryErrorBarSettings { Calculator: not null } categoryErrorBarSettings)
			{
				fastItemColumn = categoryErrorBarSettings.Calculator.GetItemColumn();
			}
			int firstBucket = p.FirstBucket;
			int lastBucket = p.LastBucket;
			List<double[]> buckets = p.Frame.Buckets;
			IDateTimeAxis dateTimeAxis = p.Scaler as IDateTimeAxis;
			dateTimeAxis?.StartCursor();
			for (int i = firstBucket; i <= lastBucket; i++)
			{
				double num2 = double.NaN;
				double[] array;
				if (!flag2)
				{
					array = (mayContainUnknowns ? bucketizingHost.GetBucket(i) : bucketizingHost.GetBucketWithoutUnknowns(i));
					if (errorBars && fastItemColumn != null)
					{
						num2 = bucketizingHost.GetErrorBucket(i, fastItemColumn);
					}
				}
				else
				{
					array = SortingBucketize(p, ref i, h, singlePixelSpan, out isCluster, out endBucket, offset);
				}
				bool flag4 = !flag3 || (flag3 && array[1] > 0.0);
				double num3 = array[0];
				if (flag2 && double.IsNaN(array[0]))
				{
					continue;
				}
				buckets.Add(array);
				if (isCluster && flag && endBucket != null)
				{
					buckets.Add(endBucket);
				}
				if (markers && flag4)
				{
					int num4 = i * p.BucketSize;
					if (flag2 && p.SortingScaler.SortedIndices != null && num4 >= 0 && num4 < p.SortingScaler.SortedIndices.Count)
					{
						num4 = p.SortingScaler.SortedIndices[num4];
					}
					double[] array2 = new double[array.Length];
					array2[0] = array[0];
					array2[1] = array[1];
					array2[2] = array[2];
					if (useHighMarkerFidelity && num4 < h.Count)
					{
						array2 = new double[array.Length];
						array2[0] = num3;
						StoreYValues(h, num4, useTemp: true, p.IsFragment);
						array2[1] = h.TempY0;
						array2[2] = h.TempY1;
					}
					markerBuckets.Add(array2);
					markerBucketIndexes.Add(p.Frame.Buckets.Count - 1);
					markerItemIndexes.Add(num4);
					if (errorBars && !double.IsNaN(num2) && p.YScaler is NumericAxisBase)
					{
						p.Frame.ErrorBuckets.Add(num2);
					}
				}
				else if (errorBars && !double.IsNaN(num2) && p.YScaler is NumericAxisBase)
				{
					p.Frame.ErrorBuckets.Add(num2);
				}
			}
			dateTimeAxis?.ResetCursor();
			ScaleFrameBucketValues(p, offset, flag2, scalerParams, yParams, errorBars, markers);
			if (markers)
			{
				int count = markerBuckets.Count;
				for (int j = 0; j < count; j++)
				{
					double[] bucket = markerBuckets[j];
					if (PrepareMarker(p.Frame, bucket, collisionAvoider, Math.Min(markerItemIndexes[j], h.Count - 1), num, markerBucketIndexes[j]))
					{
						num++;
					}
				}
			}
			return num;
		}

		protected bool IsAreaOrLine()
		{
			if (CategoryBasedHost is Series)
			{
				return ((Series)CategoryBasedHost).IsAreaOrLine;
			}
			return false;
		}

		protected abstract void StoreYValues(ValuesHolder h, int index, bool useTemp, bool isFragment);

		protected abstract void MinMaxYValues(ValuesHolder h, int index, bool isFragment);

		protected abstract double[] GetBucketSorting(double xVal, ValuesHolder h);

		protected virtual double[] SortingBucketize(PreparationParams p, ref int currentIndex, ValuesHolder h, double singlePixelSpan, out bool isCluster, out double[] endBucket, double offset)
		{
			endBucket = null;
			isCluster = false;
			CategorySeries categorySeries = CategoryBasedHost as CategorySeries;
			Rect viewportRect = p.ViewportRect;
			Rect windowRect = p.WindowRect;
			Rect effectiveViewportRect = p.EffectiveViewportRect;
			ScalerParams p2 = new ScalerParams(windowRect, viewportRect, p.Scaler.IsInverted, effectiveViewportRect);
			new ScalerParams(windowRect, viewportRect, p.YScaler.IsInverted, effectiveViewportRect);
			bool isFragment = p.IsFragment;
			if (p.SortingScaler == null || p.SortingScaler.SortedIndices == null || p.SortingScaler.SortedIndices.Count == 0)
			{
				return new double[3]
				{
					double.NaN,
					double.NaN,
					double.NaN
				};
			}
			if (categorySeries != null && categorySeries.FastItemsSource != null && categorySeries.FastItemsSource.Count < p.SortingScaler.SortedIndices.Count)
			{
				return new double[3]
				{
					double.NaN,
					double.NaN,
					double.NaN
				};
			}
			int index = p.SortingScaler.SortedIndices[currentIndex];
			double unscaledValueAt = p.SortingScaler.GetUnscaledValueAt(index);
			StoreYValues(h, index, useTemp: false, isFragment);
			while (currentIndex < p.LastBucket)
			{
				index = p.SortingScaler.SortedIndices[currentIndex + 1];
				double unscaledValueAt2 = p.SortingScaler.GetUnscaledValueAt(index);
				StoreYValues(h, index, useTemp: true, isFragment);
				if (unscaledValueAt2 - unscaledValueAt >= singlePixelSpan || double.IsNaN(h.TempY0) || double.IsNaN(h.TempY1))
				{
					if (isCluster)
					{
						int index2 = p.SortingScaler.SortedIndices[currentIndex];
						StoreYValues(h, index2, useTemp: true, isFragment);
						endBucket = new double[3]
						{
							p.Scaler.GetScaledValue(unscaledValueAt, p2),
							h.TempY0,
							h.TempY1
						};
					}
					break;
				}
				if (!isCluster && IsAreaOrLine())
				{
					int index3 = p.SortingScaler.SortedIndices[currentIndex];
					StoreYValues(h, index3, useTemp: true, isFragment);
					double[] array = new double[3]
					{
						p.Scaler.GetScaledValue(unscaledValueAt, p2),
						h.TempY0,
						h.TempY1
					};
					if (!double.IsNaN(array[0]))
					{
						if (double.IsNaN(array[1]) || double.IsNaN(array[2]))
						{
							break;
						}
						if (p.SortingScaler != null)
						{
							array[0] += offset;
						}
						p.Frame.Buckets.Add(array);
						isCluster = true;
					}
				}
				currentIndex++;
				MinMaxYValues(h, index, isFragment);
			}
			double xVal = double.NaN;
			if (!double.IsNaN(unscaledValueAt))
			{
				xVal = p.Scaler.GetScaledValue(unscaledValueAt, p2);
			}
			return GetBucketSorting(xVal, h);
		}

		protected virtual void ScaleFrameBucketValues(PreparationParams pp, double offset, bool isSortingScaler, ScalerParams xParams, ScalerParams yParams, bool errorBars, bool markers)
		{
			_ = pp.BucketSize;
			_ = pp.Frame.Buckets.Count;
			_ = pp.Frame.Buckets;
			_ = _markerBuckets.Count;
			if (errorBars)
			{
				double scaledValue = pp.YScaler.GetScaledValue(((NumericAxisBase)pp.YScaler).ReferenceValue, yParams);
				pp.YScaler.GetScaledValueList(pp.Frame.ErrorBuckets, 0, pp.Frame.ErrorBuckets.Count, yParams);
				List<double> errorBuckets = pp.Frame.ErrorBuckets;
				_ = errorBuckets.Count;
				for (int i = 0; i < errorBuckets.Count; i++)
				{
					errorBuckets[i] = Math.Abs(errorBuckets[i] - scaledValue);
				}
			}
		}

		protected abstract void ScaleBucketValues(PreparationParams p, double[] bucket, double offset, bool isSortingScaler, ScalerParams xParams, ScalerParams yParams);

		protected virtual void PrepareTrendline(PreparationParams p, ValuesHolder h, double offset)
		{
		}

		protected abstract ValuesHolder GetValues(PreparationParams p);
	}
	internal class CategoryLineRasterizer
	{
		private PointCollection _flattenedLinePoints = new PointCollection();

		internal bool IsSortingAxis { get; set; }

		internal PointCollection FlattenedLinePoints
		{
			get
			{
				return _flattenedLinePoints;
			}
			set
			{
				_flattenedLinePoints = value;
			}
		}

		public void RasterizePolylinePaths(Path polylines0, Path polygons01, Path polylines1, int count, List<double[]> buckets, bool useX0AsX1, UnknownValuePlotting unknownValuePlotting, Clipper clipper, int bucketSize, double resolution)
		{
			PathGeometry pathGeometry = new PathGeometry();
			PathGeometry pathGeometry2 = new PathGeometry();
			PathGeometry pathGeometry3 = new PathGeometry();
			polylines0.Data = pathGeometry;
			polygons01.Data = pathGeometry2;
			polylines1.Data = pathGeometry3;
			pathGeometry.Figures = new PathFigureCollection();
			pathGeometry2.Figures = new PathFigureCollection();
			pathGeometry3.Figures = new PathFigureCollection();
			List<PolyLineSegment> list = new List<PolyLineSegment>();
			List<PolyLineSegment> list2 = new List<PolyLineSegment>();
			List<PolyLineSegment> list3 = new List<PolyLineSegment>();
			List<PolyLineSegment> list4 = new List<PolyLineSegment>();
			if (unknownValuePlotting == UnknownValuePlotting.LinearInterpolate || unknownValuePlotting == UnknownValuePlotting.DontPlot)
			{
				Clipper clipper2 = ((unknownValuePlotting == UnknownValuePlotting.DontPlot) ? clipper : null);
				int num = 0;
				for (int i = 0; i < count; i++)
				{
					if (!double.IsNaN(buckets[i][1]))
					{
						continue;
					}
					int num2 = i - num;
					if ((unknownValuePlotting == UnknownValuePlotting.LinearInterpolate && num2 > 0) || (unknownValuePlotting == UnknownValuePlotting.DontPlot && num2 > 1))
					{
						if (unknownValuePlotting == UnknownValuePlotting.DontPlot || list.Count == 0)
						{
							PolyLineSegment item = new PolyLineSegment();
							PolyLineSegment item2 = new PolyLineSegment();
							PolyLineSegment item3 = new PolyLineSegment();
							PolyLineSegment item4 = new PolyLineSegment();
							list.Add(item);
							list2.Add(item2);
							list3.Add(item3);
							list4.Add(item4);
						}
						RasterizePolyline(list[list.Count - 1].Points, list2[list2.Count - 1].Points, list3[list3.Count - 1].Points, list4[list4.Count - 1].Points, num, i - 1, buckets, useX0AsX1, clipper2, bucketSize, resolution);
					}
					num = i + 1;
				}
				if (unknownValuePlotting == UnknownValuePlotting.DontPlot || list.Count == 0)
				{
					PolyLineSegment item5 = new PolyLineSegment();
					PolyLineSegment item6 = new PolyLineSegment();
					PolyLineSegment item7 = new PolyLineSegment();
					PolyLineSegment item8 = new PolyLineSegment();
					list.Add(item5);
					list2.Add(item8);
					list3.Add(item6);
					list4.Add(item7);
				}
				RasterizePolyline(list[list.Count - 1].Points, list2[list2.Count - 1].Points, list3[list3.Count - 1].Points, list4[list4.Count - 1].Points, num, count - 1, buckets, useX0AsX1, clipper2, bucketSize, resolution);
				if (clipper2 == null && list.Count == 1 && clipper != null)
				{
					ClipSegment(list[0], clipper);
					if (list2.Count == 1)
					{
						ClipSegment(list2[0], clipper);
					}
				}
			}
			else
			{
				list.Add(new PolyLineSegment());
				list2.Add(new PolyLineSegment());
				list3.Add(new PolyLineSegment());
				list4.Add(new PolyLineSegment());
				RasterizePolyline(list[0].Points, list2[0].Points, list3[0].Points, list4[0].Points, count, buckets, useX0AsX1, clipper, bucketSize, resolution);
			}
			for (int j = 0; j < list.Count; j++)
			{
				PolyLineSegment polyLineSegment = list[j];
				PolyLineSegment polyLineSegment2 = list2[j];
				PolyLineSegment polyLineSegment3 = list3[j];
				PolyLineSegment polyLineSegment4 = list4[j];
				if (polyLineSegment.Points.Count > 0)
				{
					PathFigure pathFigure = new PathFigure
					{
						StartPoint = polyLineSegment.Points[0]
					};
					pathFigure.Segments.Add(polyLineSegment);
					pathGeometry.Figures.Add(pathFigure);
				}
				if (polyLineSegment2.Points.Count > 0)
				{
					PathFigure pathFigure2 = new PathFigure
					{
						StartPoint = polyLineSegment2.Points[0]
					};
					pathFigure2.Segments.Add(polyLineSegment2);
					pathGeometry3.Figures.Add(pathFigure2);
				}
				if (polyLineSegment3.Points.Count <= 0 || polyLineSegment4.Points.Count <= 0)
				{
					continue;
				}
				PolyLineSegment polyLineSegment5 = new PolyLineSegment();
				if (clipper != null)
				{
					bool isClosed = clipper.IsClosed;
					clipper.IsClosed = true;
					clipper.Target = polyLineSegment5.Points;
					clipper.BulkAdd(polyLineSegment3.Points, inReverseOrder: false);
					clipper.BulkAdd(polyLineSegment4.Points, inReverseOrder: true);
					clipper.Target = null;
					clipper.IsClosed = isClosed;
				}
				else
				{
					foreach (Point point in polyLineSegment3.Points)
					{
						polyLineSegment5.Points.Add(point);
					}
					for (int num3 = polyLineSegment4.Points.Count - 1; num3 >= 0; num3--)
					{
						polyLineSegment5.Points.Add(polyLineSegment4.Points[num3]);
					}
				}
				if (polyLineSegment5.Points.Count > 0)
				{
					PathFigure pathFigure3 = new PathFigure
					{
						StartPoint = polyLineSegment5.Points[0]
					};
					pathFigure3.Segments.Add(polyLineSegment5);
					pathGeometry2.Figures.Add(pathFigure3);
				}
			}
		}

		private void ClipSegment(PolyLineSegment segment, Clipper clipper)
		{
			PointCollection points = segment.Points;
			segment.Points = new PointCollection();
			clipper.Target = segment.Points;
			clipper.BulkAdd(points, inReverseOrder: false);
			clipper.Target = null;
		}

		public void RasterizePolyline(PointCollection polylinePoints0, PointCollection polylinePoints1, PointCollection polygonPoints0, PointCollection polygonPoints1, int count, List<double[]> buckets, bool useX0AsX1, Clipper clipper, int bucketSize, double resolution)
		{
			RasterizePolyline(polylinePoints0, polylinePoints1, polygonPoints0, polygonPoints1, 0, count - 1, buckets, useX0AsX1, clipper, bucketSize, resolution);
		}

		private void FlattenPoints(PointCollection points, int startIndex, int endIndex, List<double[]> buckets, bool point0, bool useX0AsX1, double resolution)
		{
			IList<int> list = FastFlattener.ChunkedFastFlatten(new List<int>(), buckets, point0, useX0AsX1, startIndex, endIndex, resolution);
			int[] array = ArrayAccessHelper.AsIntArray(list);
			double[][] array2 = ArrayAccessHelper.AsBucketArray(buckets);
			bool flag = array != null;
			bool flag2 = array2 != null;
			int num = 0;
			int count = list.Count;
			if (point0)
			{
				for (int i = 0; i < count; i++)
				{
					num = (flag ? array[i] : list[i]);
					double[] obj = (flag2 ? array2[num] : buckets[num]);
					double x = obj[0];
					double y = obj[1];
					Point value = new Point(x, y);
					points.Add(value);
				}
			}
			else if (useX0AsX1)
			{
				for (int j = 0; j < count; j++)
				{
					num = (flag ? array[j] : list[j]);
					double[] obj2 = (flag2 ? array2[num] : buckets[num]);
					double x = obj2[0];
					double y = obj2[2];
					Point value2 = new Point(x, y);
					points.Add(value2);
				}
			}
			else
			{
				for (int k = 0; k < count; k++)
				{
					num = (flag ? array[k] : list[k]);
					double[] obj3 = (flag2 ? array2[num] : buckets[num]);
					double x = obj3[2];
					double y = obj3[3];
					Point value3 = new Point(x, y);
					points.Add(value3);
				}
			}
		}

		private void ClipPoints(PointCollection points, PointCollection pointsToClip, Clipper clipper, double resolution)
		{
			clipper.Target = points;
			clipper.BulkAdd(pointsToClip, inReverseOrder: false);
			clipper.Target = null;
		}

		private void ClipPoints(PointCollection points, PointCollection pointsToClip, Clipper clipper, double resolution, bool closed)
		{
			bool isClosed = clipper.IsClosed;
			clipper.IsClosed = closed;
			ClipPoints(points, pointsToClip, clipper, resolution);
			clipper.IsClosed = isClosed;
		}

		public void RasterizePolyline(PointCollection polylinePoints0, PointCollection polylinePoints1, PointCollection polygonPoints0, PointCollection polygonPoints1, int startIndex, int endIndex, List<double[]> buckets, bool useX0AsX1, Clipper clipper, int bucketSize, double resolution)
		{
			if (endIndex <= -1)
			{
				return;
			}
			if (bucketSize == 1 && !IsSortingAxis)
			{
				PointCollection pointCollection = new PointCollection();
				FlattenPoints(pointCollection, startIndex, endIndex, buckets, point0: true, useX0AsX1, resolution);
				if (clipper != null)
				{
					ClipPoints(polylinePoints0, pointCollection, clipper, resolution);
				}
				else
				{
					PopulatePointCollectionFrom(polylinePoints0, pointCollection);
				}
				return;
			}
			PointCollection pointCollection2 = new PointCollection();
			PointCollection pointCollection3 = new PointCollection();
			FlattenPoints(pointCollection2, startIndex, endIndex, buckets, point0: true, useX0AsX1, resolution);
			FlattenPoints(pointCollection3, startIndex, endIndex, buckets, point0: false, useX0AsX1, resolution);
			PopulatePointCollectionFrom(polygonPoints0, pointCollection2);
			PopulatePointCollectionFrom(polygonPoints1, pointCollection3);
			if (clipper != null)
			{
				ClipPoints(polylinePoints0, pointCollection2, clipper, resolution);
				ClipPoints(polylinePoints1, pointCollection3, clipper, resolution);
			}
			else
			{
				PopulatePointCollectionFrom(polylinePoints0, pointCollection2);
				PopulatePointCollectionFrom(polylinePoints1, pointCollection3);
			}
		}

		public void RasterizePolygonPaths(Path polygons0, Path polylines0, Path polygons01, Path polylines1, int count, List<double[]> buckets, bool useX0AsX1, int bucketSize, double resolution, Action<PointCollection, PointCollection, PointCollection, PointCollection, bool> terminatePolygon, UnknownValuePlotting unknownValuePlotting)

							list3.Add(item3);

							pointCollection3 = new PointCollection();

								ClipPoints(list2[list2.Count - 1].Points, pointCollection2, clipper, resolution, closed: false);
								ClipPoints(list3[list3.Count - 1].Points, pointCollection3, clipper, resolution, closed: true);
								ClipPoints(list4[list4.Count - 1].Points, pointCollection4, clipper, resolution, closed: false);
							}
						}

		public void RasterizePolygon(PointCollection polygonPoints0, PointCollection polylinePoints0, PointCollection polygonPoints01, PointCollection polylinePoints1, int startIndex, int endIndex, List<double[]> buckets, bool useX0AsX1, int bucketSize, double resolution)
		{
			RasterizePolygon(polygonPoints0, polylinePoints0, polygonPoints01, polylinePoints1, startIndex, endIndex, buckets, useX0AsX1, null, bucketSize, resolution);
		}

		public void RasterizePolygon(PointCollection polygonPoints0, PointCollection polylinePoints0, PointCollection polygonPoints01, PointCollection polylinePoints1, int startIndex, int endIndex, List<double[]> buckets, bool useX0AsX1, Clipper clipper, int bucketSize, double resolution)
		{
			FlattenedLinePoints.Clear();
			if (bucketSize == 1 && !IsSortingAxis)
			{
				IList<int> list = FastFlattener.ChunkedFastFlatten(new List<int>(), buckets, point0: true, useX0AsX1, startIndex, endIndex, resolution);
				int count = list.Count;
				int num = 0;
				PointCollection pointCollection = new PointCollection();
				for (int i = 0; i < count; i++)
				{
					num = list[i];
					double[] array = buckets[num];
					double x = array[0];
					double y = array[1];
					pointCollection.Add(new Point(x, y));
				}
				if (clipper != null)
				{
					ClipPoints(polygonPoints0, pointCollection, clipper, resolution, closed: true);
					ClipPoints(polylinePoints1, pointCollection, clipper, resolution, closed: false);
					ClipPoints(FlattenedLinePoints, pointCollection, clipper, resolution, closed: false);
				}
				else
				{
					PopulatePointCollectionFrom(polygonPoints0, pointCollection);
					PopulatePointCollectionFrom(polylinePoints1, pointCollection);
					PopulatePointCollectionFrom(FlattenedLinePoints, pointCollection);
				}
				return;
			}
			IList<int> list2 = FastFlattener.ChunkedFastFlatten(new List<int>(), buckets, point0: true, useX0AsX1, startIndex, endIndex, resolution);
			IList<int> list3 = FastFlattener.ChunkedFastFlatten(new List<int>(), buckets, point0: false, useX0AsX1, startIndex, endIndex, resolution);
			int count2 = list2.Count;
			int count3 = list3.Count;
			int num2 = 0;
			PointCollection pointCollection2 = new PointCollection();
			PointCollection pointCollection3 = new PointCollection();
			for (int j = 0; j < count2; j++)
			{
				num2 = list2[j];
				double[] array2 = buckets[num2];
				double x2 = array2[0];
				double y2 = array2[1];
				pointCollection2.Add(new Point(x2, y2));
				pointCollection3.Add(new Point(x2, y2));
			}
			PointCollection pointCollection4 = new PointCollection();
			for (int num3 = count3 - 1; num3 >= 0; num3--)
			{
				num2 = list3[num3];
				double[] array2 = buckets[num2];
				double x3;
				double y3;
				if (useX0AsX1)
				{
					x3 = array2[0];
					y3 = array2[2];
				}
				else
				{
					x3 = array2[2];
					y3 = array2[3];
				}
				pointCollection4.Add(new Point(x3, y3));
				pointCollection3.Add(new Point(x3, y3));
			}
			if (clipper != null)
			{
				ClipPoints(polygonPoints0, pointCollection2, clipper, resolution, closed: true);
				ClipPoints(polylinePoints0, pointCollection2, clipper, resolution, closed: false);
				ClipPoints(polylinePoints1, pointCollection4, clipper, resolution, closed: false);
				ClipPoints(polygonPoints01, pointCollection3, clipper, resolution, closed: true);
				ClipPoints(FlattenedLinePoints, pointCollection2, clipper, resolution, closed: false);
			}
			else
			{
				PopulatePointCollectionFrom(polygonPoints0, pointCollection2);
				PopulatePointCollectionFrom(polylinePoints0, pointCollection2);
				PopulatePointCollectionFrom(polylinePoints1, pointCollection4);
				PopulatePointCollectionFrom(polygonPoints01, pointCollection3);
				PopulatePointCollectionFrom(FlattenedLinePoints, pointCollection2);
			}
		}

		private void PopulatePointCollectionFrom(PointCollection target, PointCollection source)
		{
			int count = source.Count;
			for (int i = 0; i < count; i++)
			{
				target.Add(source[i]);
			}
		}
	}

		public override bool GetVisiblePointsOfInterest(List<SeriesPointOfInterest> points, bool useValueAsLabel, int labelPrecision)
		{
			if (!HasMarkers)
			{
				return false;
			}
			Rect effectiveViewport = GetEffectiveViewport(base.View);
			Axis xAxis = GetXAxis();
			ScalerParams xParams = new ScalerParams(base.SeriesViewer.ActualWindowRect, base.Viewport, xAxis.IsInverted);
			xParams.EffectiveViewportRect = effectiveViewport;
			Axis yAxis = GetYAxis();
			ScalerParams yParams = new ScalerParams(base.SeriesViewer.ActualWindowRect, base.Viewport, yAxis.IsInverted);
			yParams.EffectiveViewportRect = effectiveViewport;
			Rect actualWindowRect = base.SeriesViewer.ActualWindowRect;
			Rect viewport = base.Viewport;
			int currentMode2Index = ((IIsCategoryBased)this).CurrentMode2Index;
			if (xAxis.IsDateTime && xAxis.IsCategoryDateTime)
			{
				((ICategoryScaler)xAxis).GetSeriesOffset(actualWindowRect, viewport, effectiveViewport, currentMode2Index, (int)((ICategoryScaler)xAxis).CategoryMode);
			}
			points.Clear();
			base.MarkerView.DoToAllMarkers(delegate(Marker m)
			{
				if (m.Visibility == Visibility.Visible)
				{
					SeriesPointOfInterest seriesPointOfInterest = new SeriesPointOfInterest();
					double num;
					double num2;
					if (m.RenderTransform is MatrixTransform)
					{
						Point point = ((MatrixTransform)m.RenderTransform).Transform(new Point(0.0, 0.0));
						num = point.X + m.DesiredSize.Width / 2.0;
						num2 = point.Y + m.DesiredSize.Height / 2.0;
					}
					else
					{
						TranslateTransform obj = (TranslateTransform)m.RenderTransform;
						num = obj.X + m.DesiredSize.Width / 2.0;
						num2 = obj.Y + m.DesiredSize.Height / 2.0;
					}
					if (!(num < base.Viewport.Left) && !(num > base.Viewport.Right) && !(num2 < base.Viewport.Top) && !(num2 > base.Viewport.Bottom))
					{
						if (xAxis.IsCategory && !xAxis.IsDateTime && ((CategoryAxisBase)xAxis).CategoryMode != CategoryMode.Mode0)
						{
							seriesPointOfInterest.XValue = m.CurrentIndex;
						}
						else
						{
							seriesPointOfInterest.XValue = xAxis.GetUnscaledValue(num, xParams);
						}
						if (yAxis.IsCategory && !yAxis.IsDateTime && ((CategoryAxisBase)yAxis).CategoryMode != CategoryMode.Mode0)
						{
							seriesPointOfInterest.YValue = m.CurrentIndex;
						}
						else
						{
							seriesPointOfInterest.YValue = yAxis.GetUnscaledValue(num2, yParams);
						}
						seriesPointOfInterest.DataContext = (DataContext)m.Content;
						if (useValueAsLabel)
						{
							seriesPointOfInterest.Label = ApplyLabelPrecision((double)seriesPointOfInterest.YValue, labelPrecision);
						}
						else
						{
							seriesPointOfInterest.Label = xAxis.GetValueLabel(m.CurrentIndex);
						}
						points.Add(seriesPointOfInterest);
					}
				}
			});
			return true;
		}

		private string ApplyLabelPrecision(double val, int fixedPrecision)
		{
			if (fixedPrecision >= 0)
			{
				return Math.Round(val, fixedPrecision).ToString();
			}
			return val.ToString();
		}

		protected override void ViewportRectChangedOverride(Rect oldViewportRect, Rect newViewportRect)
		{
			if (base.TransitionInIsInProgress && base.TransitionProgress < 0.05 && (base.SeriesViewer == null || !base.SeriesViewer.JustZoomed()))
			{
				base.TransitionInViable = true;
			}
			base.ViewportRectChangedOverride(oldViewportRect, newViewportRect);
			CategoryView.BucketCalculator.CalculateBuckets(base.Resolution);
			RenderSeries(animate: false);
		}

		protected override void PropertyUpdatedOverride(object sender, string propertyName, object oldValue, object newValue)
		{
			base.PropertyUpdatedOverride(sender, propertyName, oldValue, newValue);
			switch (propertyName)
			{
			case "SeriesViewer":
			{
				Axis yAxis = GetYAxis();
				Axis xAxis = GetXAxis();
				if (oldValue != null && newValue == null)
				{
					DeregisterForAxis(xAxis);
					DeregisterForAxis(yAxis);
				}
				if (oldValue == null && newValue != null)
				{
					RegisterForAxis(xAxis);
					RegisterForAxis(yAxis);
				}
				CategoryView.BucketCalculator.CalculateBuckets(base.Resolution);
				RenderSeries(animate: false);
				break;
			}
			case "SyncLink":
				if (base.SyncLink != null && base.SeriesViewer != null)
				{
					CategoryView.BucketCalculator.CalculateBuckets(base.Resolution);
				}
				RenderSeries(animate: false);
				break;
			case "TransitionProgress":
				TransitionFrame.Interpolate((float)base.TransitionProgress, PreviousFrame, CurrentFrame);
				if (ClearAndAbortIfInvalid(base.View))
				{
					break;
				}
				if (base.TransitionProgress == 1.0)
				{
					CurrentFrame.ClearSpeedModifiers();
					RenderFrame(CurrentFrame, CategoryView);
					if (base.TransitionInIsInProgress)
					{
						base.TransitionInIsInProgress = false;
						ClearSpeedModifiers();
						base.Animator.IntervalMilliseconds = (int)GetTotalMilliseconds();
						base.Animator.EasingFunction = base.TransitionEasingFunction;
					}
				}
				else
				{
					RenderFrame(TransitionFrame, CategoryView);
				}
				if (base.SeriesViewer != null)
				{
					base.SeriesViewer.RaiseSeriesAnimating(this);
				}
				break;
			case "ErrorBarSettings":
				if (ErrorBarSettings != null)
				{
					ErrorBarSettings.Series = this;
				}
				NotifyThumbnailAppearanceChanged();
				break;
			case "UseHighMarkerFidelity":
				RenderSeries(animate: false);
				break;
			case "IsCustomCategoryStyleAllowed":
				ActualIsCustomCategoryStyleAllowed = GetIsCustomCategoryStyleAllowed();
				RenderSeries(animate: false);
				break;
			case "IsCustomCategoryMarkerStyleAllowed":
				ActualIsCustomCategoryMarkerStyleAllowed = GetIsCustomCategoryMarkerStyleAllowed();
				RenderSeries(animate: false);
				break;
			}
		}

		protected internal override HighlightingInfo GetMarkerHighlightingInfo(object item, Point world, bool forceFullRange)
		{
			if (IsSpecificHighlightingMode(base.ActualHighlightingMode) && !forceFullRange)
			{
				return PrevMarkerHighlightingInfo = GetSpecificMarkerHighlightingInfo(item, world, PrevMarkerHighlightingInfo);
			}
			HighlightingInfo fullSeriesInfo = GetFullSeriesInfo(item, world, PrevMarkerHighlightingInfo);
			fullSeriesInfo.IsMarker = true;
			PrevMarkerHighlightingInfo = fullSeriesInfo;
			return fullSeriesInfo;
		}

		{
			base.ClearHighlights();
			PrevHighlightingInfo = null;
			PrevMarkerHighlightingInfo = null;
		}

		protected internal override HighlightingInfo GetHighlightingInfo(object item, Point world, bool forceFullRange)
		{
			if (HasIndividualElements && IsSpecificHighlightingMode(base.ActualHighlightingMode) && !forceFullRange)
			{
				return PrevHighlightingInfo = GetSpecificHighlightingInfo(item, world, PrevHighlightingInfo);
			}
			return PrevHighlightingInfo = GetFullSeriesInfo(item, world, PrevHighlightingInfo);
		}

		}

		protected HighlightingInfo GetSpecificMarkerHighlightingInfo(object item, Point world, HighlightingInfo prevValue)
		{
			if (!ShouldDisplayMarkers())
			{
				return null;
			}
			CategoryFrame activeFrame = GetActiveFrame();
			List<Marker> activeMarkers = GetActiveMarkers();
			return CategorySeriesInteractionManager.GetSpecificMarkerHighlightingInfo(this, activeMarkers, GetFirstBucket(base.View), GetBucketSize(base.View), activeFrame.Buckets, item, world, prevValue);
		}

		protected HighlightingInfo GetSpecificHighlightingInfo(object item, Point world, HighlightingInfo prevValue)
		{
			int firstBucket = GetFirstBucket(base.View);
			int lastBucket = GetLastBucket(base.View);
			int bucketSize = GetBucketSize(base.View);
			CategoryFrame activeFrame = GetActiveFrame();
			return CategorySeriesInteractionManager.GetSpecificHighlightingInfo(this, activeFrame.Buckets, firstBucket, lastBucket, bucketSize, item, world, prevValue);
		}

		protected HighlightingInfo GetFullSeriesInfo(object item, Point world, HighlightingInfo prevValue)
		{
			HighlightingInfo highlightingInfo = new HighlightingInfo();
			highlightingInfo.Series = this;
			highlightingInfo.StartIndex = 0;
			highlightingInfo.EndIndex = base.FastItemsSource.Count - 1;
			highlightingInfo.IsFullRange = true;
			if (prevValue != null && prevValue.StartIndex == highlightingInfo.StartIndex && prevValue.EndIndex == highlightingInfo.EndIndex)
			{
				return prevValue;
			}
			return highlightingInfo;
		}

		internal CategoryFrame GetActiveFrame()
		{
			CategoryFrame result = CurrentFrame;
			if (AnimationActive())
			{
				if (base.Animator.NeedsFlush)
				{
					base.Animator.Flush();
				}
				result = TransitionFrame;
			}
			return result;
		}

		protected void PerformCategoryMarkerStyleOverride(List<double[]> buckets, int currentIndex, int valueCount, CategoryAxisBase categoryAxis, ScalerParams axisParams, bool isThumbnail)
		{
			bool flag = base.ActualHighlightingMode != SeriesHighlightingMode.None;
			RenderManager.PopulateArgsBounds(RenderManager.MarkerOverrideArgs, categoryAxis.IsSorting, buckets, currentIndex, valueCount, categoryAxis, axisParams, isThumbnail, isMarker: true);
			RenderManager.PrePerformMarkerStyleOverride(base.ActualHighlightingFadeOpacity);
			AssigningCategoryMarkerStyleEventArgs categoryMarkerOverrideArgs = RenderManager.CategoryMarkerOverrideArgs;
			HighlightingInfo highlightingInfo = null;
			IFastItemsSource fastItemsSource = base.FastItemsSource;
			if (flag && base.SeriesViewer != null)
			{
				highlightingInfo = base.SeriesViewer.HighlightingManager.GetHighlightingInfo(this, fastItemsSource, categoryMarkerOverrideArgs.StartIndex, categoryMarkerOverrideArgs.EndIndex, isMarker: true);
				if (base.SeriesViewer.HighlightingManager.IsCrossSeriesHighlight(this))
				{
					base.SeriesViewer.HighlightingManager.GetHighlightingInfo(this, fastItemsSource, categoryMarkerOverrideArgs.StartIndex, categoryMarkerOverrideArgs.EndIndex, isMarker: true);
				}
				categoryMarkerOverrideArgs.HighlightingInfo = highlightingInfo;
			}
			categoryMarkerOverrideArgs.IsThumbnail = isThumbnail;
			RaiseAssigningCategoryMarkerStyles(categoryMarkerOverrideArgs);
			RenderManager.PostPerformMarkerStyleOverride(this, highlightingInfo, isThumbnail, flag, categoryMarkerOverrideArgs.TotalAllSeriesHighlightingProgress, base.SeriesViewer.HighlightingManager.TotalHighlightingProgress);
		}

		protected internal void PerformCategoryStyleOverride(List<double[]> buckets, int currentIndex, int valueCount, CategoryAxisBase categoryAxis, ScalerParams axisParams, bool isThumbnail)
		{
			bool flag = base.ActualHighlightingMode != SeriesHighlightingMode.None;
			RenderManager.PopulateArgsBounds(RenderManager.OverrideArgs, categoryAxis.IsSorting, buckets, currentIndex, valueCount, categoryAxis, axisParams, isThumbnail, isMarker: false);
			RenderManager.PrePerformStyleOverride(base.ActualHighlightingFadeOpacity);
			AssigningCategoryStyleEventArgs categoryOverrideArgs = RenderManager.CategoryOverrideArgs;
			HighlightingInfo info = null;
			IFastItemsSource fastItemsSource = base.FastItemsSource;
			if (flag && base.SeriesViewer != null)
			{
				info = (categoryOverrideArgs.HighlightingInfo = base.SeriesViewer.HighlightingManager.GetHighlightingInfo(this, fastItemsSource, categoryOverrideArgs.StartIndex, categoryOverrideArgs.EndIndex, isMarker: false));
			}
			categoryOverrideArgs.IsThumbnail = isThumbnail;
			RaiseAssigningCategoryStyles(categoryOverrideArgs);
			RenderManager.PostPerformStyleOverride(this, info, isThumbnail, flag, currentIndex < 0);
		}

		protected internal override bool ValidateSeries(Rect viewportRect, Rect windowRect, SeriesView view)
		{
			bool flag = base.ValidateSeries(viewportRect, windowRect, view) && ValidateAxis(GetXAxis()) && ValidateAxis(GetYAxis());
			CategorySeriesView categorySeriesView = (CategorySeriesView)view;
			if (!view.HasSurface() || windowRect.IsEmpty || viewportRect.IsEmpty || base.FastItemsSource == null)
			{
				flag = false;
			}
			if (!flag)
			{
				categorySeriesView.BucketCalculator.BucketSize = 0;
			}
			return flag;
		}

		private bool ValidateAxis(Axis axis)
		{
			if (axis == null || axis.SeriesViewer == null)
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (axis is CategoryAxisBase categoryAxisBase)
			{
				if (categoryAxisBase.ItemsSource == null)
				{
					return false;
				}
				if (categoryAxisBase.CachedItemsCount < 1)
				{
					return false;
				}
			}
			else if (axis is NumericAxisBase numericAxisBase)
			{
				return numericAxisBase.ActualMinimumValue != numericAxisBase.ActualMaximumValue;
			}
			return true;
		}

		protected override bool ShouldTransitionIn()
		{
			return IsTransitionInEnabled;
		}

		protected virtual CategoryTransitionInMode GetDefaultTransitionInMode()
		{
			return CategoryTransitionInMode.SweepFromCategoryAxisMinimum;
		}

		protected override void ClearSpeedModifiers()
		{
			base.ClearSpeedModifiers();
			PreviousFrame.ClearSpeedModifiers();
			CurrentFrame.ClearSpeedModifiers();
			TransitionFrame.ClearSpeedModifiers();
		}

		protected internal override void RenderSeriesOverride(bool animate)
		{
			base.RenderSeriesOverride(animate);
			CategoryView.BucketCalculator.CalculateBuckets(base.Resolution);
			if (ClearAndAbortIfInvalid(base.View))
			{
				CurrentFrame.ResetFrame();
				TransitionFrame.ResetFrame();
				PreviousFrame.ResetFrame();
			}
			else if (base.SkipPrepare)
			{
				if (AnimationActive())
				{
					if (base.Animator.NeedsFlush)
					{
						base.Animator.Flush();
					}
					RenderFrame(TransitionFrame, CategoryView);
				}
				else
				{
					RenderFrame(CurrentFrame, CategoryView);
				}
			}
			else if (ShouldAnimate(animate))
			{
				CategoryFrame previousFrame = PreviousFrame;
				if (AnimationActive())
				{
					if (base.Animator.NeedsFlush)
					{
						base.Animator.Flush();
					}
					PreviousFrame = TransitionFrame;
					TransitionFrame = previousFrame;
				}
				else
				{
					PreviousFrame = CurrentFrame;
					CurrentFrame = previousFrame;
				}
				PrepareFrame(CurrentFrame, CategoryView);
				if (base.TransitionInViableResolved)
				{
					base.Animator.Stop();
					base.Animator.IntervalMilliseconds = (int)GetTotalTransitionInMilliseconds();
					base.Animator.EasingFunction = ((base.TransitionInEasingFunction != null) ? base.TransitionInEasingFunction : base.TransitionEasingFunction);
					SourceFramePreparer.PrepareSourceFrame(PreviousFrame, CurrentFrame, IsVertical, GetXAxis(), GetYAxis(), TransitionInMode, GetDefaultTransitionInMode(), base.TransitionInSpeedType, GetDefaultTransitionInSpeedType(), GetTransitionFromZeroValue, CategoryView.Viewport);
				}
				CheckTransitionInterrupted();
				StartAnimation();
				if (base.TransitionInViableResolved)
				{
					base.TransitionInViable = false;
					base.TransitionInIsInProgress = true;
				}
			}
			else
			{
				PrepareFrame(CurrentFrame, CategoryView);
				RenderFrame(CurrentFrame, CategoryView);
			}
		}

		protected override TransitionInSpeedType GetDefaultTransitionInSpeedType()
		{
			return TransitionInSpeedType.IndexScaled;
		}

		protected virtual double GetTransitionFromZeroValue()
		{
			if (IsVertical)
			{
				return base.Viewport.Left;
			}
			return base.Viewport.Bottom;
		}

		protected internal virtual int GetMode2Index()
		{
			int num = 0;
			Axis xAxis = GetXAxis();
			foreach (Series item in base.SeriesViewer.Series)
			{
				if (item == this)
				{
					return num;
				}
				if (item is CategorySeries categorySeries)
				{
					CategoryAxisBase categoryAxisBase = categorySeries.GetXAxis() as CategoryAxisBase;
					if (categoryAxisBase == xAxis && categorySeries.PreferredCategoryMode(categoryAxisBase) == CategoryMode.Mode2)
					{
						num++;
					}
				}
			}
			return -1;
		}

		bool ISupportsErrorBars.ShouldDisplayErrorBars()
		{
			if (ErrorBarSettings == null || ErrorBarSettings.Calculator == null || !base.View.Ready())
			{
				return false;
			}
			return true;
		}

		bool ISupportsErrorBars.ShouldSyncErrorBarsWithMarkers()
		{
			return ShouldDisplayMarkers();
		}

		internal void ColorizeMarkers(CategorySeriesView view, CategoryFrame frame)
		{
			RenderManager.InitCategoryMarkerRenderSettings(this, ShouldOverrideMarkerStyle(), GetCategoryItems, GetBucketSize(view), GetFirstBucket(view));
			bool flag = RenderManager.MarkerOverrideArgs != null;
			CategoryAxisBase categoryAxis = GetCategoryAxis();
			if (categoryAxis == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			Rect effectiveViewport = GetEffectiveViewport(view);
			ScalerParams axisParams = new ScalerParams(view.WindowRect, view.Viewport, categoryAxis.IsInverted, effectiveViewport);
			int valueCount = ((base.FastItemsSource != null) ? base.FastItemsSource.Count : 0);
			List<double[]> buckets = frame.Buckets;
			int firstBucket = view.BucketCalculator.FirstBucket;
			_ = view.BucketCalculator.LastBucket;
			int bucketSize = view.BucketCalculator.BucketSize;
			for (int i = 0; i < view.Markers.Count; i++)
			{
				Marker marker = view.Markers[i];
				DataContext context = (DataContext)marker.Content;
				if (flag)
				{
					int markerBucket = marker.MarkerBucket;
					PerformCategoryMarkerStyleOverride(buckets, markerBucket, valueCount, categoryAxis, axisParams, view.IsThumbnailView);
				}
				RenderManager.SetMarkerAppearance(marker, context);
			}
		}

		internal virtual void RenderFrame(CategoryFrame frame, CategorySeriesView view)
		{
			base.CustomClipRect = frame.CustomClip;
			view.OnRenderFrame();
		}

		internal virtual void PrepareFrame(CategoryFrame frame, CategorySeriesView view)
		{
			frame.ClearFrame();
		}

		protected internal virtual int GetBucketSize(SeriesView view)
		{
			return ((CategorySeriesView)view).BucketCalculator.BucketSize;
		}

		protected internal virtual int GetFirstBucket(SeriesView view)
		{
			return ((CategorySeriesView)view).BucketCalculator.FirstBucket;
		}

		protected internal virtual int GetLastBucket(SeriesView view)
		{
			return ((CategorySeriesView)view).BucketCalculator.LastBucket;
		}

		internal void ClearMarkers(SeriesView view)
		{
			((CategorySeriesView)view).Markers.Count = 0;
		}

		protected internal override void RenderThumbnail(Rect viewportRect, RenderSurface surface)
		{
			base.RenderThumbnail(viewportRect, surface);
			if (!base.ThumbnailDirty)
			{
				base.View.PrepSurface(surface);
				return;
			}
			(base.ThumbnailView as CategorySeriesView).BucketCalculator.CalculateBuckets(base.Resolution);
			base.View.PrepSurface(surface);
			if (!ClearAndAbortIfInvalid(base.ThumbnailView))
			{
				RenderThumbnailFrame();
				base.ThumbnailDirty = false;
			}
		}

		internal virtual void RenderThumbnailFrame()
		{
			CategorySeriesView view = base.ThumbnailView as CategorySeriesView;
			if (!base.SkipThumbnailPrepare)
			{
				PrepareFrame(ThumbnailFrame, view);
			}
			base.SkipThumbnailPrepare = false;
			RenderFrame(ThumbnailFrame, view);
		}

		[TSClientName("fetchYAxis")]
		internal abstract Axis GetYAxis();

		internal abstract bool UpdateNumericAxisRange();

		[JAVAClientName("GetFramePreparerForView")]
		internal virtual CategoryFramePreparer GetFramePreparer(CategorySeriesView view)
		{
			if (view != null && view.IsThumbnailView)
			{
				if (view.IsAlternateView)
				{
					return new CategoryFramePreparer(this as IIsCategoryBased, view, view, this, view.BucketCalculator);
				}
				return new CategoryFramePreparer(this as IIsCategoryBased, view, base.SeriesViewer.View.OverviewPlusDetailViewportHost, this, view.BucketCalculator);
			}
			return FramePreparer;
		}

		protected internal override Axis GetMatchingAxis(Axis axis)
		{
			if (GetXAxis() == axis)
			{
				return GetYAxis();
			}
			if (GetYAxis() == axis)
			{
				return GetXAxis();
			}
			return null;
		}

		public override Axis[] GetAxes()
		{
			return new Axis[2]
			{
				GetXAxis(),
				GetYAxis()
			};
		}

		internal static Clipper GetClipper(List<double[]> buckets, int endIndex, Rect viewportRect, Rect windowRect, bool closed)
		{
			Clipper result = null;
			if (endIndex > -1 && !windowRect.IsEmpty && !viewportRect.IsEmpty)
			{
				double left = ((buckets[0][0] < viewportRect.Left - 2000.0) ? (viewportRect.Left - 10.0) : double.NaN);
				double bottom = viewportRect.Bottom + 10.0;
				double right = ((buckets[endIndex][0] > viewportRect.Right + 2000.0) ? (viewportRect.Right + 10.0) : double.NaN);
				double top = viewportRect.Top - 10.0;
				result = new Clipper(left, bottom, right, top, closed);
			}
			return result;
		}
	}
	internal class CategoryTrendLineManager : CategoryTrendLineManagerBase
	{
		public override void PrepareLineCore(List<Point> flattenedPoints, TrendLineType trendLineType, IList<double> valueColumn, int period, Func<double, double> GetScaledXValue, Func<double, double> GetScaledYValue, TrendResolutionParams trendResolutionParams)
		{
			double num = trendResolutionParams.FirstBucket * trendResolutionParams.BucketSize;
			double num2 = trendResolutionParams.LastBucket * trendResolutionParams.BucketSize;
			List<Point> list = new List<Point>();
			if (trendLineType == TrendLineType.None)
			{
				base.TrendCoefficients = null;
				base.TrendColumn.Clear();
				return;
			}
			if (IsFit(trendLineType))
			{
				base.TrendColumn.Clear();
				base.TrendCoefficients = TrendFitCalculator.CalculateFit(list, trendLineType, trendResolutionParams, base.TrendCoefficients, valueColumn.Count, (int i) => i + 1, (int i) => valueColumn[i], (double x) => GetScaledXValue(x - 1.0), GetScaledYValue, num + 1.0, num2 + 1.0);
			}
			if (IsAverage(trendLineType))
			{
				base.TrendCoefficients = null;
				TrendAverageCalculator.CalculateSingleValueAverage(trendLineType, base.TrendColumn, valueColumn, period);
				for (int num3 = trendResolutionParams.FirstBucket; num3 <= trendResolutionParams.LastBucket; num3++)
				{
					int num4 = num3 * trendResolutionParams.BucketSize;
					if (num4 >= 0 && num4 < base.TrendColumn.Count)
					{
						double num5 = GetScaledXValue(num4);
						double y = GetScaledYValue(base.TrendColumn[num4]);
						list.Add(new Point(num5 + trendResolutionParams.Offset, y));
					}
				}
			}
			FlattenTrendLine(list, trendResolutionParams, flattenedPoints);
		}
	}

		}

		{
			MarkersHost = new DefaultSupportsMarkers();

				MarkersHost = markersHost;
			}
			if (viewportHost != null)
			{
				ViewportHost = viewportHost;
			}
			if (errorBarsHost != null)
			{
				ErrorBarsHost = errorBarsHost;
			}
		}

	}

		protected override void PropertyUpdatedOverride(object sender, string propertyName, object oldValue, object newValue)
		{
			if (!(propertyName == "XAxis"))
			{
				if (propertyName == "TrendLineType" && (TrendLineType)newValue != TrendLineType.None)
				{
					base.AnchoredView.TrendLineManager = CategoryTrendLineManagerFactory.SelectManager(base.AnchoredView.TrendLineManager, CachedXAxis, base.RootCanvas, this, base.Res);
				}
			}
			else
			{
				CacheXAxis(XAxis);
				if (base.AnchoredView.HasTrendLineManager)
				{
					base.AnchoredView.TrendLineManager = CategoryTrendLineManagerFactory.SelectManager(base.AnchoredView.TrendLineManager, CachedXAxis, base.RootCanvas, this, base.Res);
				}
			}
			base.PropertyUpdatedOverride(sender, propertyName, oldValue, newValue);
			switch (propertyName)
			{
			case "XAxis":
				if (oldValue != newValue)
				{
					DeregisterForAxis(oldValue as Axis);
					RegisterForAxis(newValue as Axis);
					CacheXAxis(XAxis);
					base.CategoryView.BucketCalculator.CalculateBuckets(base.Resolution);
					RenderSeries(animate: false);
					NotifyThumbnailAppearanceChanged();
				}
				break;
			case "YAxis":
				if (oldValue != newValue)
				{
					DeregisterForAxis(oldValue as Axis);
					RegisterForAxis(newValue as Axis);
					CacheYAxis(YAxis);
					base.CategoryView.BucketCalculator.CalculateBuckets(base.Resolution);
					UpdateNumericAxisRange();
					RenderSeries(animate: false);
					NotifyThumbnailAppearanceChanged();
				}
				break;
			case "CategoryMode":
				if (XAxis != null)
				{
					XAxis.Spread(propagate: true);
				}
				break;
			}
		}

		protected override void DataUpdatedOverride(FastItemsSourceEventAction action, int position, int count, string propertyName)
		{
			base.DataUpdatedOverride(action, position, count, propertyName);
			if (CachedXAxis != null && CachedXAxis is ISortingAxis)
			{
				((ISortingAxis)CachedXAxis).NotifyDataChanged();
			}
			switch (action)
			{
			case FastItemsSourceEventAction.Reset:
				if (CachedXAxis != null)
				{
					CachedXAxis.UpdateRange();
				}
				if (CachedYAxis != null && !CachedYAxis.UpdateRange())
				{
					RenderSeries(animate: true);
				}
				break;
			case FastItemsSourceEventAction.Insert:
				if (CachedXAxis != null)
				{
					CachedXAxis.UpdateRange();
				}
				if (CachedYAxis != null && !CachedYAxis.UpdateRange())
				{
					RenderSeries(animate: true);
				}
				break;
			case FastItemsSourceEventAction.Remove:
				if (CachedXAxis != null)
				{
					CachedXAxis.UpdateRange();
				}
				if (CachedYAxis != null && !CachedYAxis.UpdateRange())
				{
					RenderSeries(animate: true);
				}
				break;
			case FastItemsSourceEventAction.Replace:
				if (base.CachedValueMemberPath != null && base.AnchoredView.BucketCalculator.BucketSize > 0 && CachedYAxis != null && !CachedYAxis.UpdateRange())
				{
					RenderSeries(animate: true);
				}
				break;
			case FastItemsSourceEventAction.Change:
				if (propertyName == base.CachedValueMemberPath)
				{
					if (CachedXAxis != null)
					{
						CachedXAxis.UpdateRange();
					}
					if (CachedYAxis != null && !CachedYAxis.UpdateRange())
					{
						RenderSeries(animate: true);
					}
				}
				break;
			}
		}

		[XamSuppressWidgetMember]

		}

	internal class AnchoredCategoryBucketCalculator : CategoryBucketCalculator
	{
		[Weak]
		protected AnchoredCategorySeriesView AnchoredView { get; private set; }

		internal AnchoredCategoryBucketCalculator(AnchoredCategorySeriesView view)
			: base(view)
		{
			AnchoredView = view;
		}

		internal override double[] GetBucketWithoutUnknowns(int index)
		{
			IFastItemColumn<double> valueColumn = AnchoredView.AnchoredModel.ValueColumn;
			int count = valueColumn.Count;
			int num = index * BucketSize;
			int num2 = num + BucketSize - 1;
			int num3 = count - 1;
			num = ((num < num3) ? num : num3);
			num2 = ((num2 < num3) ? num2 : num3);
			double num4 = double.MaxValue;
			double num5 = double.MinValue;
			bool flag = true;
			for (int i = num; i <= num2; i++)
			{
				double num6 = valueColumn[i];
				num4 = ((num4 < num6) ? num4 : num6);
				num5 = ((num5 > num6) ? num5 : num6);
				flag = false;
			}
			if (flag)
			{
				return new double[3]
				{
					0.5 * (double)(num + num2),
					double.NaN,
					double.NaN
				};
			}
			return new double[3]
			{
				0.5 * (double)(num + num2),
				num4,
				num5
			};
		}

		internal override double[] GetBucket(int index)
		{
			IFastItemColumn<double> valueColumn = AnchoredView.AnchoredModel.ValueColumn;
			int count = valueColumn.Count;
			int num = index * BucketSize;
			int num2 = num + BucketSize - 1;
			int num3 = count - 1;
			num = ((num < num3) ? num : num3);
			num2 = ((num2 < num3) ? num2 : num3);
			double num4 = 0.0;
			double num5 = 0.0;
			bool flag = true;
			for (int i = num; i <= num2; i++)
			{
				double num6 = valueColumn[i];
				if (!flag)
				{
					if (!double.IsNaN(num6))
					{
						num4 = ((num4 < num6) ? num4 : num6);
						num5 = ((num5 > num6) ? num5 : num6);
					}
				}
				else if (!double.IsNaN(num6))
				{
					num4 = num6;
					num5 = num6;
					flag = false;
				}
			}
			if (flag)
			{
				return new double[3]
				{
					0.5 * (double)(num + num2),
					double.NaN,
					double.NaN
				};
			}
			return new double[3]
			{
				0.5 * (double)(num + num2),
				num4,
				num5
			};
		}

		public override double GetErrorBucket(int bucket, IFastItemColumn<double> column)
		{
			int count = column.Count;
			int num = Math.Min(bucket * BucketSize, count - 1);
			int num2 = Math.Min(num + BucketSize - 1, count - 1);
			double num3 = double.NaN;
			for (int i = num; i <= num2; i++)
			{
				double num4 = column[i];
				if (!double.IsNaN(num3))
				{
					if (!double.IsNaN(num4))
					{
						num3 = Math.Min(num3, num4);
					}
				}
				else
				{
					num3 = num4;
				}
			}
			if (!double.IsNaN(num3))
			{
				return num3;
			}
			return double.NaN;
		}
	}
