		public override object GetItemValue(object item, string memberPathName)
		{
			if (ResolveMemberPath(memberPathName) == "ValueMemberPath")
			{
				return GetItemValueByMemberPath(item, memberPathName, ValueMemberPath);
			}
			return base.GetItemValue(item, memberPathName);
		}

		public override bool ScrollIntoView(object item)
		{
			Rect rect = new Rect(0.0, 0.0, 1.0, 1.0);
			Axis xAxis = GetXAxis();
			Axis yAxis = GetYAxis();
			Rect effectiveViewportForUnitViewport = GetEffectiveViewportForUnitViewport(base.View);
			double offset = ((xAxis != null) ? base.FramePreparer.GetOffset(xAxis as ICategoryScaler, rect, rect, effectiveViewportForUnitViewport) : 0.0);
			return AnchoredCategorySeriesInteractionManager.ScrollIntoView(this, ValueColumn, xAxis, yAxis, offset, item);
		}

		protected object[] GetCategoryItemsHelper(int orderedStartIndex, int orderedEndIndex, Axis axis)
		{
			if (orderedEndIndex < orderedStartIndex || orderedStartIndex < 0 || orderedStartIndex > ValueColumn.Count || orderedEndIndex < 0 || orderedEndIndex > ValueColumn.Count || axis == null)
			{
				return null;
			}
			object[] array = new object[orderedEndIndex - orderedStartIndex + 1];
			bool isSorting = axis.IsSorting;
			List<int> list = null;
			if (isSorting)
			{
				list = ((ISortingAxis)axis).SortedIndices;
			}
			for (int i = orderedStartIndex; i <= orderedEndIndex; i++)
			{
				int index = i;
				if (isSorting)
				{
					index = list[index];
				}
				array[i - orderedStartIndex] = base.FastItemsSource[i];
			}
			return array;
		}

		protected override void PropertyUpdatedOverride(object sender, string propertyName, object oldValue, object newValue)
		{
			base.PropertyUpdatedOverride(sender, propertyName, oldValue, newValue);
			if (AnchoredView.HasTrendLineManager && AnchoredView.TrendLineManager.PropertyUpdated(sender, propertyName, oldValue, newValue))
			{
				RenderSeries(animate: false);
				NotifyThumbnailAppearanceChanged();
			}
			switch (propertyName)
			{
			case "FastItemsSource":
				if (oldValue is IFastItemsSource)
				{
					((IFastItemsSource)oldValue).DeregisterColumn(ValueColumn);
					ValueColumn = null;
				}
				if (newValue is IFastItemsSource)
				{
					ValueColumn = RegisterDoubleColumn(ValueMemberPath);
				}
				if (GetYAxis() is NumericAxisBase numericAxisBase2 && !numericAxisBase2.UpdateRange())
				{
					AnchoredView.BucketCalculator.CalculateBuckets(base.Resolution);
					RenderSeries(animate: false);
				}
				break;
			case "ValueMemberPath":
				if (base.FastItemsSource != null)
				{
					base.FastItemsSource.DeregisterColumn(ValueColumn);
					ValueColumn = RegisterDoubleColumn(ValueMemberPath);
				}
				CachedValueMemberPath = ValueMemberPath;
				break;
			case "ValueColumn":
				if (AnchoredView.HasTrendLineManager)
				{
					AnchoredView.TrendLineManager.Reset();
				}
				if (GetYAxis() is NumericAxisBase numericAxisBase && !numericAxisBase.UpdateRange())
				{
					AnchoredView.BucketCalculator.CalculateBuckets(base.Resolution);
					RenderSeries(animate: false);
				}
				UpdateFinalValue();
				UpdatePercentChange();
				break;
			case "TrendLineBrush":
				UpdateIndexedProperties();
				break;
			case "ErrorBarSettings":
				RenderSeries(animate: false);
				break;
			case "TrendLineType":
				NotifyThumbnailAppearanceChanged();
				break;
			case "MarkerCollisionAvoidance":
				RenderSeries(animate: false);
				break;
			}
		}

		protected internal override AxisRange GetRange(Axis axis)
		{
			if (ValueColumn == null || ValueColumn.Count == 0)
			{
				return null;
			}
			if (axis == GetXAxis())
			{
				return new AxisRange(0.0, ValueColumn.Count - 1);
			}
			if (axis == GetYAxis())
			{
				return new AxisRange(ValueColumn.Minimum, ValueColumn.Maximum);
			}
			return null;
		}

		protected override void DataUpdatedOverride(FastItemsSourceEventAction action, int position, int count, string propertyName)
		{
			switch (action)
			{
			case FastItemsSourceEventAction.Remove:
			case FastItemsSourceEventAction.Insert:
			case FastItemsSourceEventAction.Reset:
				AnchoredView.BucketCalculator.CalculateBuckets(base.Resolution);
				break;
			}
			if (AnchoredView.HasTrendLineManager)
			{
				AnchoredView.TrendLineManager.DataUpdated(action, position, count, propertyName);
			}
			UpdateFinalValue();
			UpdatePercentChange();
		}

		protected override double GetTransitionFromZeroValue()
		{
			return GetWorldZeroValue(base.CategoryView);
		}

		internal virtual double GetWorldZeroValue(CategorySeriesView view)
		{
			double result = 0.0;
			Rect windowRect = view.WindowRect;
			Rect viewport = view.Viewport;
			Rect effectiveViewport = GetEffectiveViewport(view);
			NumericYAxis numericYAxis = GetYAxis() as NumericYAxis;
			if (!windowRect.IsEmpty && !viewport.IsEmpty && numericYAxis != null)
			{
				ScalerParams scalerParams = new ScalerParams(windowRect, viewport, numericYAxis.IsInverted, effectiveViewport);
				if (numericYAxis.IsVertical)
				{
					scalerParams.ReferenceValue = GetReferenceValue();
				}
				result = numericYAxis.GetScaledValue(numericYAxis.ReferenceValue, scalerParams);
			}
			return result;
		}

		internal void TerminatePolygon(PointCollection polygon, int count, CategorySeriesView view)
		{
			double worldZeroValue = GetWorldZeroValue(view);
			if (polygon.Count > 0)
			{
				double y = worldZeroValue;
				polygon.Add(new Point(polygon[polygon.Count - 1].X, y));
				polygon.Add(new Point(polygon[0].X, y));
			}
		}

		internal Clipper GetLineClipper(List<double[]> buckets, int endIndex, Rect viewportRect, Rect windowRect)
		{
			return GetLineClipper(buckets, endIndex, viewportRect, windowRect, closed: false);
		}

		internal Clipper GetLineClipper(List<double[]> buckets, int endIndex, Rect viewportRect, Rect windowRect, bool closed)
		{
			return CategorySeries.GetClipper(buckets, endIndex, viewportRect, windowRect, closed);
		}

		protected internal override bool ValidateSeries(Rect viewportRect, Rect windowRect, SeriesView view)
		{
			bool result = base.ValidateSeries(viewportRect, windowRect, view);
			AnchoredCategorySeriesView anchoredCategorySeriesView = (AnchoredCategorySeriesView)view;
			if (ValueColumn == null || ValueColumn.Count == 0 || anchoredCategorySeriesView.BucketCalculator.BucketSize < 1)
			{
				result = false;
			}
			return result;
		}

		protected internal override void ClearRendering(bool wipeClean, SeriesView view)
		{
			base.ClearRendering(wipeClean, view);
			AnchoredCategorySeriesView anchoredCategorySeriesView = (AnchoredCategorySeriesView)view;
			anchoredCategorySeriesView.HideErrorBars();
			if (anchoredCategorySeriesView.HasTrendLineManager)
			{
				anchoredCategorySeriesView.TrendLineManager.ClearPoints();
			}
		}

		internal override void PrepareFrame(CategoryFrame frame, CategorySeriesView view)
		{
			base.PrepareFrame(frame, view);
			GetFramePreparer(view).PrepareFrame(frame, view);
		}

		internal override void RenderFrame(CategoryFrame frame, CategorySeriesView view)
		{
			base.RenderFrame(frame, view);
			AnchoredCategorySeriesView anchoredCategorySeriesView = view as AnchoredCategorySeriesView;
			anchoredCategorySeriesView.MarkerAppearanceHandled = true;
			if (anchoredCategorySeriesView.HasTrendLineManager)
			{
				anchoredCategorySeriesView.TrendLineManager.RasterizeTrendLine(frame.Trend);
			}
			if (ShouldDisplayMarkers())
			{
				CategoryMarkerManager.RasterizeMarkers(this, frame.Markers, view.Markers, base.UseLightweightMarkers);
				ColorizeMarkers(view, frame);
				view.RenderMarkers();
			}
			RenderErrorBars(frame, view);
		}

		public override void RenderAlternateView(Rect viewportRect, Rect windowRect, RenderSurface surface, string viewIdentifier, double effectiveScalingRatio)
		{
			base.RenderAlternateView(viewportRect, windowRect, surface, viewIdentifier, effectiveScalingRatio);
			SeriesView seriesView = base.SeriesInteractionManager.AlternateViews[viewIdentifier];
			CategorySeriesView categorySeriesView = (CategorySeriesView)seriesView;
			categorySeriesView.BucketCalculator.CalculateBuckets(base.Resolution);
			seriesView.PrepAltSurface(surface);
			if (!ClearAndAbortIfInvalid(categorySeriesView))
			{
				if (AlternateFrame == null)
				{
					AlternateFrame = new CategoryFrame(3);
				}
				AlternateFrame.ClearFrame();
				PrepareFrame(AlternateFrame, categorySeriesView);
				RenderFrame(AlternateFrame, categorySeriesView);
			}
		}

		internal void RenderErrorBars(CategoryFrame frame, CategorySeriesView view)
		{
			if (frame == null || !((ISupportsErrorBars)this).ShouldDisplayErrorBars() || base.ErrorBarSettings.EnableErrorBars == EnableErrorBars.None)
			{
				view.HideErrorBars();
				return;
			}
			view.ShowErrorBars();
			PathGeometry pathGeometry = new PathGeometry();
			ErrorBarsHelper errorBarsHelper = new ErrorBarsHelper(this, view);
			double num = 0.0;
			double num2 = 0.0;
			Action<PathGeometry, Point, double, bool> action;
			if (IsColumn || IsSpline || IsLineOnly || IsArea || IsStep || IsSpline || HasOnlyMarkers)
			{
				GetYAxis();
				action = errorBarsHelper.AddErrorBarVertical;
			}
			else
			{
				if (!IsBar)
				{
					return;
				}
				_ = ((BarSeries)this).XAxis;
				action = errorBarsHelper.AddErrorBarHorizontal;
			}
			for (int i = 0; i < frame.ErrorBars.Count && i < frame.ErrorBarPositiveSizes.Count; i++)
			{
				Point arg = frame.ErrorBars[i];
				num = frame.ErrorBarPositiveSizes[i];
				num2 = frame.ErrorBarNegativeSizes[i];
				if (base.ErrorBarSettings.EnableErrorBars == EnableErrorBars.Both || base.ErrorBarSettings.EnableErrorBars == EnableErrorBars.Positive)
				{
					action(pathGeometry, arg, num, arg4: true);
				}
				if (base.ErrorBarSettings.EnableErrorBars == EnableErrorBars.Both || base.ErrorBarSettings.EnableErrorBars == EnableErrorBars.Negative)
				{
					action(pathGeometry, arg, num2, arg4: false);
				}
			}
			view.UpdateErrorBars(pathGeometry);
		}

		protected override void UpdateIndexedProperties()
		{
			base.UpdateIndexedProperties();
			if (base.Index >= 0)
			{
				AnchoredView.ResetTrendlineBrush();
				if (TrendLineBrush != null)
				{
					AnchoredView.BindTrendlineBrushToActualTrendlineBrush();
				}
				else
				{
					AnchoredView.BindTrendlineBrushToActualBrush();
				}
			}
		}

		protected internal override object Item(object sender, Point point)
		{
			if (AnchoredView.HasTrendLineManager && sender == AnchoredView.TrendLineManager.TrendPolyline)
			{
				return null;
			}
			return base.Item(sender, point);
		}

		IDetectsCollisions IIsCategoryBased.ProvideCollisionDetector()
		{
			if (MarkerCollisionAvoidance == CategorySeriesMarkerCollisionAvoidance.Omit)
			{
				return new CollisionAvoider();
			}
			return NonCollisionAvoider.Instance;
		}

		internal abstract void SetXAxis(Axis xAxis);

		internal abstract void SetYAxis(Axis yAxis);

		protected override void ExportVisualDataOverride(object svd)
		{
			base.ExportVisualDataOverride(svd);
			if (AnchoredView.HasTrendLineManager)
			{
				base.SeriesVisualDataManager.ExportTrendlineData(this, svd, AnchoredView.TrendLineManager.TrendPolyline);
			}
		}

		internal override DataContext GetTooltipContext(object item)
		{
			if (item != null)
			{
				FastReflectionHelper fastReflectionHelper = new FastReflectionHelper(useTraditionalReflection: false, ValueMemberPath);
				object propertyValue = fastReflectionHelper.GetPropertyValue(item.GetType(), item);
				AnchoredCategorySeriesDataContext anchoredCategorySeriesDataContext = new AnchoredCategorySeriesDataContext
				{
					Series = this,
					Item = item,
					ItemValue = propertyValue
				};
				Axis xAxis = GetXAxis();
				if (xAxis != null)
				{
					if (!(xAxis is CategoryDateTimeXAxis categoryDateTimeXAxis))
					{
						anchoredCategorySeriesDataContext.XAxisLabel = xAxis.GetLabel(item);
					}
					else
					{
						fastReflectionHelper.PropertyName = categoryDateTimeXAxis.DateTimeMemberPath;
						object propertyValue2 = fastReflectionHelper.GetPropertyValue(item.GetType(), item);
						anchoredCategorySeriesDataContext.XAxisLabel = $"{propertyValue2:D}";
					}
				}
				Axis yAxis = GetYAxis();
				if (yAxis != null)
				{
					if (!(yAxis is CategoryDateTimeXAxis categoryDateTimeXAxis2))
					{
						anchoredCategorySeriesDataContext.YAxisLabel = yAxis.GetLabel(item);
					}
					else
					{
						fastReflectionHelper.PropertyName = categoryDateTimeXAxis2.DateTimeMemberPath;
						object propertyValue3 = fastReflectionHelper.GetPropertyValue(item.GetType(), item);
						anchoredCategorySeriesDataContext.YAxisLabel = $"{propertyValue3:D}";
					}
				}
				return anchoredCategorySeriesDataContext;
			}
			return new DataContext
			{
				Series = this,
				Item = item
			};
		}

		public override object GetItem(Point world)
		{
			Axis xAxis = GetXAxis();
			Axis yAxis = GetYAxis();
			return AnchoredCategorySeriesInteractionManager.GetItem(this, world, GetBucketSize(base.View), ValueColumn, xAxis, yAxis, ConsolidatedItemHitTestBehavior == ConsolidatedItemHitTestBehavior.NearestY, (Point pp) => base.GetItem(pp));
		}

		protected internal override double GetReferenceValue()
		{
			return Series.GetReferenceValue(ValueColumn, GetXAxis() as ISortingAxis);
		}

		protected internal override AxisRange GetVisibleRange([SwiftMutableParameter] Rect forWindow)
		{
			if (forWindow.IsEmpty && base.SeriesViewer != null)
			{
				forWindow = base.SeriesViewer.ActualWindowRect;
			}
			if (ValueColumn == null)
			{
				return null;
			}
			Rect contentViewport = GetContentViewport(base.View);
			CategoryAxisBase categoryAxis = GetCategoryAxis();
			ScalerParams p = new ScalerParams(forWindow, base.SeriesViewer.ViewportRect, categoryAxis.IsInverted, GetEffectiveViewport());
			double num = categoryAxis.GetUnscaledValue(contentViewport.Left, p);
			double num2 = categoryAxis.GetUnscaledValue(contentViewport.Right, p);
			if (categoryAxis.IsInverted)
			{
				double num3 = num;
				num = num2;
				num2 = num3;
			}
			num -= (double)VisibleRangeExtension;
			num2 += (double)VisibleRangeExtension;
			ISortingAxis sortingAxis = null;
			if (categoryAxis.IsSorting)
			{
				sortingAxis = (ISortingAxis)categoryAxis;
				num = sortingAxis.GetIndexClosestToUnscaledValue(num);
				num2 = sortingAxis.GetIndexClosestToUnscaledValue(num2);
			}
			else
			{
				num = Math.Floor(num);
				num2 = Math.Ceiling(num2);
			}
			if (double.IsNaN(num) || double.IsNaN(num2))
			{
				return null;
			}
			num = Math.Max(0.0, Math.Min(ValueColumn.Count - 1, num));
			num2 = Math.Max(0.0, Math.Min(ValueColumn.Count - 1, num2));
			double num4 = double.MaxValue;
			double num5 = double.MinValue;
			if ((int)num <= (int)num2)
			{
				for (int i = (int)num; i <= (int)num2; i++)
				{
					int index = i;
					if (sortingAxis != null)
					{
						index = sortingAxis.SortedIndices[i];
					}
					double num6 = ValueColumn[index];
					if (!ValueColumn.MayContainUnknowns || (!double.IsInfinity(num6) && !double.IsNaN(num6)))
					{
						num4 = Math.Min(num4, num6);
						num5 = Math.Max(num5, num6);
					}
				}
			}
			AxisRange range = new AxisRange(num4, num5);
			return ExpandRangeForMargin(range, GetValueAxis(), forWindow);
		}

		private void UpdateFinalValue()
		{
			base.FinalValue = ((ValueColumn == null || ValueColumn.Count == 0) ? double.NaN : ValueColumn[ValueColumn.Count - 1]);
		}
	}
	public sealed class AreaSeries : HorizontalAnchoredCategorySeries, IUnknownValuePlotting
	{
		private const string UnknownValuePlottingPropertyName = "UnknownValuePlotting";

		public static readonly DependencyProperty UnknownValuePlottingProperty = DependencyProperty.Register("UnknownValuePlotting", typeof(UnknownValuePlotting), typeof(AreaSeries), new PropertyMetadata(UnknownValuePlotting.DontPlot, delegate(DependencyObject sender, DependencyPropertyChangedEventArgs e)

		}));

		[TSSuppressSynthesizedInitializer]
		internal AreaSeriesView AreaView { get; set; }

		public override bool IsArea => true;

		internal CategoryLineRasterizer LineRasterizer { get; set; }

		[WidgetDefaultString("dontPlot")]
		public UnknownValuePlotting UnknownValuePlotting
		{
			get
			{
				return (UnknownValuePlotting)GetValue(UnknownValuePlottingProperty);
			}
			set
			{
				SetValue(UnknownValuePlottingProperty, value);
			}
		}

		protected override SeriesView CreateView()
		{
			return new AreaSeriesView(this);
		}

		protected override CategoryTransitionInMode GetDefaultTransitionInMode()
		{
			return CategoryTransitionInMode.FromZero;
		}

		protected internal override SeriesVisibleRangeMode ResolveVisibleRangeMode()
		{
			if (base.VisibleRangeMode == SeriesVisibleRangeMode.Auto)
			{
				return SeriesVisibleRangeMode.IncludeReferenceValue;
			}
			return base.ResolveVisibleRangeMode();
		}

		protected internal override void OnViewCreated(SeriesView view)
		{
			base.OnViewCreated(view);
			AreaView = (AreaSeriesView)view;
		}

		public AreaSeries()
		{
			LineRasterizer = new CategoryLineRasterizer();
			base.DefaultStyleKey = typeof(AreaSeries);
			base.CategoryMode = CategoryMode.Mode0;
		}

		internal override CategoryMode PreferredCategoryMode(CategoryAxisBase axis)
		{
			return base.CategoryMode;
		}

		public override bool TestHit(Point position, bool isFinger)
		{
			Point seriesValuePosition = GetSeriesValuePosition(ToWorldPosition(position), useInterpolation: true, skipUnknowns: false);
			if (TestAreaOver(position, seriesValuePosition, isFinger))
			{
				return true;
			}
			if (TestHighLowStrokeOver(position, isFinger))
			{
				return true;
			}
			if (TestMarkersOver(position, isFinger))
			{
				return true;
			}
			return false;
		}

		protected internal override void ClearRendering(bool wipeClean, SeriesView view)
		{
			base.ClearRendering(wipeClean, view);
			((AreaSeriesView)view).ClearAreaLines();
		}

		internal override void RenderFrame(CategoryFrame frame, CategorySeriesView view)
		{
			base.RenderFrame(frame, view);
			int bucketSize = view.BucketCalculator.BucketSize;
			AreaSeriesView areaSeriesView = view as AreaSeriesView;
			List<double[]> buckets = frame.Buckets;
			Rect effectiveViewport = GetEffectiveViewport(areaSeriesView);
			RenderManager.InitCategoryRenderSettings(this, ShouldOverrideCategoryStyle(), GetCategoryItems, GetBucketSize(view), GetFirstBucket(view));
			bool flag = false;
			if (RenderManager.OverrideArgs != null)
			{
				flag = true;
			}
			if (flag)
			{
				ScalerParams axisParams = new ScalerParams(view.WindowRect, view.Viewport, CachedXAxis.IsInverted, effectiveViewport);
				PerformCategoryStyleOverride(buckets, -1, base.ValueColumn.Count, CachedXAxis, axisParams, view.IsThumbnailView);
			}
			Path line = areaSeriesView.Line0;
			Path line2 = areaSeriesView.Line1;
			Path polygon = areaSeriesView.Polygon0;
			Path polygon2 = areaSeriesView.Polygon1;
			RenderManager.SetShapeAppearance(line, strokeOnly: true, fillOnly: false, extended: true, useOutline: true);
			RenderManager.SetShapeAppearance(line2, strokeOnly: true, fillOnly: false, extended: true, useOutline: true);
			RenderManager.SetShapeAppearance(polygon, strokeOnly: false, fillOnly: true, extended: false, useOutline: false);
			RenderManager.SetShapeAppearance(polygon2, strokeOnly: false, fillOnly: true, extended: false, useOutline: false);
			if (view.CheckFrameDirty(frame))
			{
				areaSeriesView.RasterizeArea(buckets.Count, buckets, useX0AsX1: true, bucketSize, base.Resolution, delegate(PointCollection p0, PointCollection l0, PointCollection p01, PointCollection l1, bool f)
				{
					TerminatePolygon(p0, frame.Buckets.Count, view);
				}, UnknownValuePlotting, (buckets.Count == 1) ? null : GetLineClipper(buckets, buckets.Count - 1, view.Viewport, view.WindowRect, closed: true));
				view.UpdateFrameVersion(frame);
			}
			_ = (NumericYAxis)GetYAxis();
			polygon.Opacity = RenderManager.ActualRenderOpacity * base.ActualAreaFillOpacity;
			polygon2.Opacity = 0.5 * RenderManager.ActualRenderOpacity * base.ActualAreaFillOpacity;
		}

		protected override void PropertyUpdatedOverride(object sender, string propertyName, object oldValue, object newValue)
		{
			base.PropertyUpdatedOverride(sender, propertyName, oldValue, newValue);
			if (propertyName == "UnknownValuePlotting")
			{
				base.FramePreparer.SkipUnknowns = UnknownValuePlotting == UnknownValuePlotting.LinearInterpolate;
				RenderSeries(animate: false);
				NotifyThumbnailAppearanceChanged();
			}
		}
	}
	public sealed class ColumnSeries : HorizontalAnchoredCategorySeries
	{
		internal const string RadiusXPropertyName = "RadiusX";

		public static readonly DependencyProperty RadiusXProperty = DependencyProperty.Register("RadiusX", typeof(double), typeof(ColumnSeries), new PropertyMetadata(0.0, delegate(DependencyObject sender, DependencyPropertyChangedEventArgs e)
		{
			((ColumnSeries)sender).RaisePropertyChanged("RadiusX", e.OldValue, e.NewValue);
		}));

		internal const string RadiusYPropertyName = "RadiusY";

		public static readonly DependencyProperty RadiusYProperty = DependencyProperty.Register("RadiusY", typeof(double), typeof(ColumnSeries), new PropertyMetadata(0.0, delegate(DependencyObject sender, DependencyPropertyChangedEventArgs e)
		{
			((ColumnSeries)sender).RaisePropertyChanged("RadiusY", e.OldValue, e.NewValue);
		}));

		private Func<double[], double> _getBucketValue;

		private const string ConsolidatedColumnVerticalPositionPropertyName = "ConsolidatedColumnVerticalPosition";

		private ConsolidatedItemsPosition _ConsolidatedColumnVerticalPosition;

		public override bool IsColumn => true;

		public override bool IsMarkerlessDisplayPreferred => true;

		[TSSuppressSynthesizedInitializer]
		internal ColumnSeriesView ColumnView { get; set; }

		[WidgetDefaultNumber(0.0)]
		public double RadiusX
		{
			get
			{
				return (double)GetValue(RadiusXProperty);
			}
			set

				SetValue(RadiusXProperty, value);
			}
		}

		[WidgetDefaultNumber(0.0)]
		public double RadiusY
		{
			get
			{
				return (double)GetValue(RadiusYProperty);
			}
			set
			{
				SetValue(RadiusYProperty, value);
			}
		}

		protected internal override bool HasIndividualElements => true;

		public ConsolidatedItemsPosition ConsolidatedColumnVerticalPosition
		{
			get
			{
				return _ConsolidatedColumnVerticalPosition;
			}
			set
			{
				if (ConsolidatedColumnVerticalPosition != value)
				{
					ConsolidatedItemsPosition consolidatedColumnVerticalPosition = ConsolidatedColumnVerticalPosition;
					_ConsolidatedColumnVerticalPosition = value;
					RaisePropertyChanged("ConsolidatedColumnVerticalPosition", consolidatedColumnVerticalPosition, ConsolidatedColumnVerticalPosition);
				}
			}
		}

		protected override SeriesView CreateView()
		{
			return new ColumnSeriesView(this);
		}

		protected internal override void OnViewCreated(SeriesView view)
		{
			base.OnViewCreated(view);
			ColumnView = (ColumnSeriesView)view;
		}

		protected internal override SeriesVisibleRangeMode ResolveVisibleRangeMode()
		{
			if (base.VisibleRangeMode == SeriesVisibleRangeMode.Auto)
			{
				return SeriesVisibleRangeMode.IncludeReferenceValue;
			}
			return base.ResolveVisibleRangeMode();
		}

		protected override CategoryTransitionInMode GetDefaultTransitionInMode()
		{
			return CategoryTransitionInMode.FromZero;
		}

		public ColumnSeries()
		{
			base.DefaultStyleKey = typeof(ColumnSeries);
			base.CategoryMode = CategoryMode.Mode2;
		}

		internal override CategoryMode PreferredCategoryMode(CategoryAxisBase axis)
		{
			return base.CategoryMode;
		}

		public override Rect GetSeriesValueBoundingBox(Point world)
		{
			if (_getBucketValue == null)
			{
				_getBucketValue = GetBucketValue;
			}
			NumericAxisBase yAxis = ((CachedYAxis != null) ? CachedYAxis : base.YAxis);
			CategoryAxisBase cachedXAxis = CachedXAxis;
			return base.AnchoredCategorySeriesInteractionManager.GetColumnShapeBoundingBox(this, world, cachedXAxis, yAxis, CurrentFrame, GetBucketSize(base.View), GetFirstBucket(base.View), _getBucketValue);
		}

		public override bool TestHit(Point position, bool isFinger)
		{
			if (TestShapesOver(position, isFinger))
			{
				return true;
			}
			if (TestMarkersOver(position, isFinger))
			{
				return true;
			}
			return false;
		}

		protected internal override void ClearRendering(bool wipeClean, SeriesView view)
		{
			base.ClearRendering(wipeClean, view);
			ColumnSeriesView columnSeriesView = (ColumnSeriesView)view;
			if (wipeClean && columnSeriesView.Columns != null)
			{
				columnSeriesView.Columns.Count = 0;
			}
		}

		public override double GetItemSpan()
		{
			return CachedXAxis.GetGroupSize(base.View.WindowRect, base.View.Viewport, GetEffectiveViewport(base.View));
		}

		internal override void RenderFrame(CategoryFrame frame, CategorySeriesView view)
		{
			base.RenderFrame(frame, view);
			List<double[]> buckets = frame.Buckets;
			if (!view.Ready())
			{
				return;
			}
			Rect windowRect = view.WindowRect;
			Rect viewport = view.Viewport;
			Rect effectiveViewport = GetEffectiveViewport(view);
			ScalerParams scalerParams = new ScalerParams(windowRect, viewport, CachedYAxis.IsInverted, effectiveViewport);
			scalerParams.ReferenceValue = GetReferenceValue();
			ScalerParams axisParams = new ScalerParams(windowRect, viewport, CachedXAxis.IsInverted, effectiveViewport);
			NumericAxisBase cachedYAxis = CachedYAxis;
			double scaledValue = cachedYAxis.GetScaledValue(cachedYAxis.ReferenceValue, scalerParams);
			double groupSize = CachedXAxis.GetGroupSize(windowRect, viewport, effectiveViewport);
			CategoryAxisBase cachedXAxis = CachedXAxis;
			ColumnSeriesView columnSeriesView = (ColumnSeriesView)view;
			if (double.IsNaN(groupSize) || double.IsInfinity(groupSize))
			{
				columnSeriesView.Columns.Count = 0;
				return;
			}
			RenderManager.InitCategoryRenderSettings(this, ShouldOverrideCategoryStyle(), GetCategoryItems, GetBucketSize(view), GetFirstBucket(view));
			RenderManager.InitialRenderRadiusX = RadiusX;
			RenderManager.InitialRenderRadiusY = RadiusY;
			RenderManager.ActualRenderRadiusX = RadiusX;
			RenderManager.ActualRenderRadiusY = RadiusY;
			bool flag = false;
			if (RenderManager.OverrideArgs != null)
			{
				flag = true;
			}
			ISortingAxis sortingAxis = (CachedXAxis.IsSorting ? ((ISortingAxis)CachedXAxis) : null);
			int count = base.ValueColumn.Count;
			int bucketSize = GetBucketSize(view);
			int num = 0;
			for (int i = 0; i < buckets.Count; i++)
			{
				double left = buckets[i][0] - 0.5 * groupSize;
				double bucketValue = GetBucketValue(buckets[i]);
				double val = scaledValue;
				bucketValue = Math.Max(bucketValue, -100.0);
				val = Math.Min(val, viewport.Bottom + 100.0);
				double num2 = Math.Abs(val - bucketValue);
				if (double.IsInfinity(num2))
				{
					continue;
				}
				Rectangle rectangle = columnSeriesView.Columns[num];
				num++;
				rectangle.Width = groupSize;
				rectangle.Height = num2;
				if (flag)
				{
					PerformCategoryStyleOverride(buckets, i, count, cachedXAxis, axisParams, view.IsThumbnailView);
				}
				if (rectangle.DataContext != null)
				{
					DataContext dataContext = (DataContext)rectangle.DataContext;
					if (bucketSize == 1)
					{
						int num3 = RenderManager.GetBucketBounds(count, i)[0];
						if (num3 >= 0 && num3 < base.FastItemsSource.Count)
						{
							if (sortingAxis != null && sortingAxis.SortedIndices != null && sortingAxis.SortedIndices.Count > num3)
							{
								num3 = sortingAxis.SortedIndices[num3];
							}
							dataContext.Item = base.FastItemsSource[num3];
						}
					}
					else
					{
						dataContext.Item = null;
					}
				}
				RenderManager.SetShapeAppearance(rectangle, strokeOnly: false, fillOnly: false, extended: false, useOutline: false);
				rectangle.RadiusX = RenderManager.ActualRenderRadiusX;
				rectangle.RadiusY = RenderManager.ActualRenderRadiusY;
				columnSeriesView.PositionRectangle(rectangle, left, Math.Min(val, bucketValue));
			}
			columnSeriesView.Columns.Count = num;
			view.UpdateFrameVersion(frame);
		}

		private double GetBucketValue(double[] bucket)
		{
			if (bucket == null || bucket.Length < 3)
			{
				return double.NaN;
			}
			switch (ConsolidatedColumnVerticalPosition)
			{
			case ConsolidatedItemsPosition.Minimum:
				return bucket[1];
			case ConsolidatedItemsPosition.Maximum:
				return bucket[2];
			case ConsolidatedItemsPosition.Median:
				return (bucket[1] + bucket[2]) / 2.0;
			case ConsolidatedItemsPosition.RelativeMinimum:
			{
				double num2 = (bucket[1] + bucket[2]) / 2.0;
				if (base.YAxis == null)
				{
					return num2;
				}
				if (base.YAxis.GetUnscaledValue(num2, new ScalerParams(base.SeriesViewer.WindowRect, base.SeriesViewer.ViewportRect, base.YAxis.IsInverted)) < base.YAxis.ReferenceValue)
				{
					return bucket[2];
				}
				return bucket[1];
			}
			case ConsolidatedItemsPosition.RelativeMaximum:
			{
				double num = (bucket[1] + bucket[2]) / 2.0;
				double unscaledValue = base.YAxis.GetUnscaledValue(num, new ScalerParams(base.SeriesViewer.WindowRect, base.SeriesViewer.ViewportRect, base.YAxis.IsInverted));
				if (base.YAxis == null)
				{
					return num;
				}
				if (unscaledValue < base.YAxis.ReferenceValue)
				{
					return bucket[1];
				}
				return bucket[2];
			}
			default:
				return (bucket[1] + bucket[2]) / 2.0;
			}
		}
	}

		internal override void RenderFrame(CategoryFrame frame, CategorySeriesView view)

			base.RenderFrame(frame, view);
			int bucketSize = view.BucketCalculator.BucketSize;
			LineSeriesView lineSeriesView = view as LineSeriesView;
			List<double[]> buckets = frame.Buckets;
			Rect effectiveViewport = GetEffectiveViewport(view);
			RenderManager.InitCategoryRenderSettings(this, ShouldOverrideCategoryStyle(), GetCategoryItems, GetBucketSize(view), GetFirstBucket(view));
			bool flag = false;
			if (RenderManager.OverrideArgs != null)

				flag = true;

			if (flag)
			{
				ScalerParams axisParams = new ScalerParams(view.WindowRect, view.Viewport, CachedXAxis.IsInverted, effectiveViewport);
				PerformCategoryStyleOverride(buckets, -1, base.ValueColumn.Count, CachedXAxis, axisParams, view.IsThumbnailView);
			}
			Path line = lineSeriesView.Line0;
			Path line2 = lineSeriesView.Line1;
			Path fillArea = lineSeriesView.FillArea;
			RenderManager.SetShapeAppearance(line, strokeOnly: true, fillOnly: false, extended: true, useOutline: false);
			RenderManager.SetShapeAppearance(line2, strokeOnly: true, fillOnly: false, extended: true, useOutline: false);
			RenderManager.SetShapeAppearance(fillArea, strokeOnly: false, fillOnly: true, extended: false, useOutline: false);
			fillArea.Opacity = 0.75 * RenderManager.ActualRenderOpacity;
			if (view.CheckFrameDirty(frame))
			{
				lineSeriesView.RasterizeLine(buckets.Count, buckets, useX0AsX1: true, UnknownValuePlotting, GetLineClipper(buckets, buckets.Count - 1, view.Viewport, view.WindowRect), bucketSize, base.Resolution);
				view.UpdateFrameVersion(frame);
			}
		}

		protected override void PropertyUpdatedOverride(object sender, string propertyName, object oldValue, object newValue)
		{
			base.PropertyUpdatedOverride(sender, propertyName, oldValue, newValue);
			if (propertyName == "UnknownValuePlotting")
			{
				base.FramePreparer.SkipUnknowns = UnknownValuePlotting == UnknownValuePlotting.LinearInterpolate;

		internal void PrepareDateTimeFrame(CategoryFrame frame, Rect windowRect, Rect viewportRect, CategoryAxisBase xaxis, NumericAxisBase yaxis, CategorySeriesView view)
		{
			ISortingAxis sortingXAxis = xaxis as ISortingAxis;
			Rect effectiveViewport = GetEffectiveViewport(view);
			if (sortingXAxis == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			ScalerParams p = new ScalerParams(windowRect, viewportRect, xaxis.IsInverted, effectiveViewport);
			ScalerParams scalerParams = new ScalerParams(windowRect, viewportRect, yaxis.IsInverted, effectiveViewport);
			scalerParams.ReferenceValue = GetReferenceValue();
			bool flag = ShouldDisplayMarkers();
			int num = 0;
			double offset = GetOffset(xaxis, windowRect, viewportRect, effectiveViewport);
			Func<int, double> func = (int i) => i;
			Func<int, double> func2 = (int i) => base.ValueColumn[sortingXAxis.SortedIndices[i]];
			int lastBucket = base.CategoryView.BucketCalculator.LastBucket;
			int firstBucket = base.CategoryView.BucketCalculator.FirstBucket;
			int num2 = (int)Math.Ceiling(viewportRect.Width / (double)(lastBucket - firstBucket));
			CollisionAvoider collisionAvoider = new CollisionAvoider();
			int bucketSize = base.CategoryView.BucketCalculator.BucketSize;
			if (bucketSize <= 0 || (firstBucket <= 0 && lastBucket <= 0))
			{
				base.CategoryView.Markers.Count = num;
				return;
			}
			int num3 = 0;
			int num4 = 0;
			for (int num5 = firstBucket; num5 < lastBucket + 1; num5++)
			{
				double[] bucket = null;
				int num6 = num5 * bucketSize;
				if (sortingXAxis != null && sortingXAxis.SortedIndices != null && num6 >= 0 && num6 < sortingXAxis.SortedIndices.Count)
				{
					num6 = sortingXAxis.SortedIndices[num6];
				}
				if (num5 >= base.ValueColumn.Count - 1)
				{
					if (flag && PrepareMarker(frame, frame.Buckets[frame.Buckets.Count - 1], collisionAvoider, Math.Min(num6, base.FastItemsSource.Count - 1), num, view, num3 - 1))
					{
						num++;
					}
					break;
				}
				double num7 = func(num5);
				double num8 = func2(num5);
				double num9 = func(num5 + 1);
				double num10 = func2(num5 + 1);
				double num11 = num9 - num7;
				double num12 = UColumn[num5];
				double num13 = UColumn[num5 + 1];
				double unscaledValueAt = sortingXAxis.GetUnscaledValueAt(sortingXAxis.SortedIndices[num5]);
				double num14 = xaxis.GetScaledValue(unscaledValueAt, p) + offset;
				double scaledValue = yaxis.GetScaledValue(num8, scalerParams);
				frame.Buckets.Add(new double[3] { num14, scaledValue, scaledValue });
				num3++;
				num4 = num3;
				for (int num15 = 1; num15 < num2; num15++)
				{
					double num16 = (double)num15 / (double)num2;
					double num17 = num7 + num11 * num16;
					double num18 = (num9 - num17) / num11;
					double num19 = (num17 - num7) / num11;
					double unscaledValue = num18 * num8 + num19 * num10 + ((num18 * num18 * num18 - num18) * num12 + (num19 * num19 * num19 - num19) * num13) * (num11 * num11) / 6.0;
					double unscaledValueAt2 = sortingXAxis.GetUnscaledValueAt(sortingXAxis.SortedIndices[num5]);
					double unscaledValueAt3 = sortingXAxis.GetUnscaledValueAt(sortingXAxis.SortedIndices[num5 + 1]);
					double unscaledValue2 = unscaledValueAt2 + (unscaledValueAt3 - unscaledValueAt2) * num16;
					num17 = xaxis.GetScaledValue(unscaledValue2, p) + offset;
					unscaledValue = yaxis.GetScaledValue(unscaledValue, scalerParams);
					frame.Buckets.Add(new double[3] { num17, unscaledValue, unscaledValue });

		internal virtual bool PrepareMarker(CategoryFrame frame, double[] bucket, CollisionAvoider collisionAvoider, int itemIndex, int markerCount, CategorySeriesView view, int bucketIndex)
		{
			double num = bucket[0];
			double num2 = bucket[1];
			Rect rc = new Rect(num - 5.0, num2 - 5.0, 11.0, 11.0);
			if (!double.IsNaN(num) && !double.IsNaN(num2) && collisionAvoider.TryAdd(rc))
			{
				frame.Markers.Add(new Point(num, num2));
				Marker marker = view.Markers[markerCount];
				((DataContext)marker.Content).Item = base.FastItemsSource[itemIndex];
				marker.MarkerBucket = bucketIndex;
				return true;
			}
			return false;
		}

		protected internal override double[][] GetMatchingBuckets(CategoryAxisBase categoryAxis, List<double[]> buckets, int bucketSize, int firstBucket, Point world, bool skipUnknowns)
		{
			if (categoryAxis == null || categoryAxis.IsSorting || GetBucketSize(base.View) > 1 || GetBucketSize(base.View) == 0)
			{
				return base.GetMatchingBuckets(GetCategoryAxis(), CurrentFrame.Buckets, GetBucketSize(base.View), GetFirstBucket(base.View), world, skipUnknowns);
			}
			if (CurrentFrame.Buckets.Count == 0)
			{
				return null;
			}
			int lastBucket = SplineBaseView.BucketCalculator.LastBucket;
			Rect viewport = base.View.Viewport;
			int num = (int)Math.Ceiling(viewport.Width);
			if (lastBucket != firstBucket)
			{
				num = (int)Math.Ceiling(viewport.Width / (double)(lastBucket - firstBucket));
			}
			int num2 = -1;
			int num3 = -1;
			double exactItemIndex = GetExactItemIndex(world);
			int previousOrExactIndex = GetPreviousOrExactIndex(world, skipUnknowns);
			int nextOrExactIndex = GetNextOrExactIndex(world, skipUnknowns);
			int num4 = (int)Math.Floor((double)previousOrExactIndex / (double)GetBucketSize(base.View));
			int num5 = (int)Math.Floor((double)nextOrExactIndex / (double)GetBucketSize(base.View));
			num2 = num4 - GetFirstBucket(base.View);
			num3 = num5 - GetFirstBucket(base.View);
			int num6 = num2 * num;
			int num7 = num3 * num;
			double num8 = 0.0;
			if (previousOrExactIndex != nextOrExactIndex)
			{
				num8 = (exactItemIndex - (double)previousOrExactIndex) / (double)(nextOrExactIndex - previousOrExactIndex);
			}
			num3 = (num2 = (int)Math.Floor((double)num6 + num8 * (double)(num7 - num6))) + 1;
			if (num2 < 0)
			{
				num2 = 0;
			}
			if (num2 > CurrentFrame.Buckets.Count - 1)
			{
				num2 = CurrentFrame.Buckets.Count - 1;
			}
			if (num3 < 0)
			{
				num3 = 0;
			}
			if (num3 > CurrentFrame.Buckets.Count - 1)
			{
				num3 = CurrentFrame.Buckets.Count - 1;
			}
			double[] array = CurrentFrame.Buckets[num2];
			double[] array2 = CurrentFrame.Buckets[num3];
			return new double[2][] { array, array2 };
		}

		internal override void PrepareFrame(CategoryFrame frame, CategorySeriesView view)
		{
			base.PrepareFrame(frame, view);
			if (frame.Buckets.Count <= 1 || view.BucketCalculator.BucketSize == 0)
			{
				return;
			}
			Rect windowRect = view.WindowRect;
			Rect viewport = view.Viewport;
			Rect effectiveViewport = GetEffectiveViewport(view);
			CategoryAxisBase cachedXAxis = CachedXAxis;
			NumericAxisBase cachedYAxis = CachedYAxis;
			ScalerParams p = new ScalerParams(windowRect, viewport, cachedXAxis.IsInverted, effectiveViewport);
			ScalerParams p2 = new ScalerParams(windowRect, viewport, cachedYAxis.IsInverted, effectiveViewport)
			{
				ReferenceValue = GetReferenceValue()
			};
			frame.Buckets.Clear();
			frame.Markers.Clear();
			bool flag = ShouldDisplayMarkers();
			int num = 0;
			ISortingAxis sortingAxis = CachedXAxis as ISortingAxis;
			if (sortingAxis != null && sortingAxis.SortedIndices.Count != base.FastItemsSource.Count)
			{
				return;
			}
			double offset = GetOffset(cachedXAxis, windowRect, viewport, effectiveViewport);
			int bucketSize = view.BucketCalculator.BucketSize;
			EnsureSplineShape(view);
			int lastBucket = view.BucketCalculator.LastBucket;
			int firstBucket = view.BucketCalculator.FirstBucket;
			int num2 = (int)Math.Ceiling(viewport.Width / (double)(lastBucket - firstBucket));
			CollisionAvoider collisionAvoider = new CollisionAvoider();
			if (sortingAxis != null)
			{
				PrepareDateTimeFrame(frame, windowRect, viewport, cachedXAxis, cachedYAxis, view);
				return;
			}
			Func<int, double> func = (int i) => i;
			Func<int, double> func2 = (int i) => base.ValueColumn[i];
			int num3 = 0;
			int num4 = 0;
			for (int num5 = firstBucket; num5 <= lastBucket; num5++)
			{
				double[] array = null;
				if (bucketSize == 1)
				{
					if (num5 >= base.ValueColumn.Count - 1)
					{
						if (flag && PrepareMarker(frame, frame.Buckets[frame.Buckets.Count - 1], collisionAvoider, Math.Min(num5 * bucketSize, base.FastItemsSource.Count - 1), num, view, num3 - 1))
						{
							num++;
						}
						break;
					}
					double num6 = func(num5);
					double num7 = func2(num5);
					double num8 = func(num5 + 1);
					double num9 = func2(num5 + 1);
					double num10 = num8 - num6;
					double num11 = UColumn[num5];
					double num12 = UColumn[num5 + 1];
					double num13 = cachedXAxis.GetScaledValue(num6, p) + offset;
					double scaledValue = cachedYAxis.GetScaledValue(num7, p2);
					frame.Buckets.Add(new double[3] { num13, scaledValue, scaledValue });
					num3++;
					num4 = num3;
					for (int num14 = 1; num14 < num2; num14++)
					{
						double num15 = num6 + num10 * (double)num14 / (double)num2;
						double num16 = (num8 - num15) / num10;
						double num17 = (num15 - num6) / num10;
						double unscaledValue = num16 * num7 + num17 * num9 + ((num16 * num16 * num16 - num16) * num11 + (num17 * num17 * num17 - num17) * num12) * (num10 * num10) / 6.0;
						num15 = cachedXAxis.GetScaledValue(num15, p) + offset;
						unscaledValue = cachedYAxis.GetScaledValue(unscaledValue, p2);
						frame.Buckets.Add(new double[3] { num15, unscaledValue, unscaledValue });
						num3++;
					}
					if (flag)
					{
						array = view.BucketCalculator.GetBucket(num5);
						array[0] = cachedXAxis.GetScaledValue(array[0], p) + offset;
						array[1] = cachedYAxis.GetScaledValue(array[1], p2);
						array[2] = cachedYAxis.GetScaledValue(array[2], p2);
					}
				}
				else
				{
					array = view.BucketCalculator.GetBucket(num5);
					if (!double.IsNaN(array[0]))
					{
						array[0] = cachedXAxis.GetScaledValue(array[0], p) + offset;
						array[1] = cachedYAxis.GetScaledValue(array[1], p2);
						array[2] = cachedYAxis.GetScaledValue(array[2], p2);
						frame.Buckets.Add(array);
						num3++;
						num4 = num3;
					}
				}
				if (flag && PrepareMarker(frame, array, collisionAvoider, Math.Min(num5 * bucketSize, base.FastItemsSource.Count - 1), num, view, num4 - 1))
				{
					num++;
				}
			}
			view.Markers.Count = num;
		}

		internal virtual void EnsureSplineShape(CategorySeriesView view)
		{
			int bucketSize = view.BucketCalculator.BucketSize;
			Func<int, double> x = (int i) => i;
			Func<int, double> y = (int i) => base.ValueColumn[i];
			if (bucketSize < 1 || base.ValueColumn == null || base.ValueColumn.Count == 0 || (UColumn != null && UColumn.Length == base.ValueColumn.Count) || bucketSize != 1)
			{
				return;
			}
			double num = ((SplineType == SplineType.Natural) ? double.NaN : 0.0);
			if (CachedXAxis != null && CachedXAxis is ISortingAxis && ((ISortingAxis)CachedXAxis).SortedIndices != null)
			{
				SafeSortedReadOnlyDoubleCollection sorted = new SafeSortedReadOnlyDoubleCollection(base.ValueColumn, ((ISortingAxis)CachedXAxis).SortedIndices, double.NaN);
				y = (int i) => sorted[i];
			}
			UColumn = Numeric.SafeCubicSplineFit(base.ValueColumn.Count, x, y, num, num);
			if (!IsSplineShapePartOfRange)
			{
				return;
			}
			double num2 = double.MinValue;
			double num3 = double.MaxValue;
			double[][] rasterizedYAxisValues = GetRasterizedYAxisValues(view);
			if (rasterizedYAxisValues == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			for (int num4 = 0; num4 < rasterizedYAxisValues.Length; num4++)
			{
				if (!double.IsNaN(rasterizedYAxisValues[num4][0]) && !double.IsNaN(rasterizedYAxisValues[num4][1]))
				{
					if (rasterizedYAxisValues[num4][1] > num2)
					{
						num2 = rasterizedYAxisValues[num4][1];
					}
					if (rasterizedYAxisValues[num4][0] < num3)
					{
						num3 = rasterizedYAxisValues[num4][0];
					}
				}
			}
			UColumnMinValue = num3;
			UColumnMaxValue = num2;
		}

		private double CalculateSplineValue(double p, double x1, double y1, double x2, double y2, double u1, double u2)
		{
			double num = x2 - x1;
			double num2 = x1 + num * p;
			double num3 = (x2 - num2) / num;
			double num4 = (num2 - x1) / num;
			return num3 * y1 + num4 * y2 + ((num3 * num3 * num3 - num3) * u1 + (num4 * num4 * num4 - num4) * u2) * (num * num) / 6.0;
		}

		protected internal override double GetInterpolatedSeriesValue(double p, IList<double> column, int prevItem, int nextItem, int unsortedPrevItem, int unsortedNextItem, double offset, bool isSorting)
		{
			double num = double.NaN;
			if (prevItem >= 0 && prevItem < column.Count)
			{
				num = column[prevItem];
			}
			double num2 = double.NaN;
			if (nextItem >= 0 && nextItem < column.Count)
			{
				num2 = column[nextItem];
			}
			if (unsortedNextItem == 0)
			{
				return num2;
			}
			if (unsortedPrevItem == column.Count - 1)
			{
				return num;
			}
			if (double.IsNaN(num2) && offset != 0.0 && p <= 0.5 && !isSorting)
			{
				return num;
			}
			if (double.IsNaN(num) && offset != 0.0 && p >= 0.5 && !isSorting)
			{
				return num2;
			}
			double y = num;
			double y2 = num2;
			double u = double.NaN;
			double u2 = double.NaN;
			if (UColumn != null && unsortedPrevItem >= 0 && unsortedPrevItem < UColumn.Length)
			{
				u = UColumn[unsortedPrevItem];
			}
			if (UColumn != null && unsortedNextItem >= 0 && unsortedNextItem < UColumn.Length)
			{
				u2 = UColumn[unsortedNextItem];
			}
			return CalculateSplineValue(p, unsortedPrevItem, y, unsortedNextItem, y2, u, u2);
		}

		internal double GetOffset(CategoryAxisBase axis, Rect windowRect, Rect viewportRect, Rect effectiveViewportRect)
		{
			CategoryMode categoryMode = PreferredCategoryMode(axis);
			if (categoryMode == CategoryMode.Mode0 && axis.CategoryMode != CategoryMode.Mode0)
			{
				categoryMode = CategoryMode.Mode1;
			}
			double num = 0.0;
			switch (categoryMode)
			{
			case CategoryMode.Mode0:
				num = 0.0;
				break;
			case CategoryMode.Mode1:
				num = 0.5 * axis.GetCategorySize(windowRect, viewportRect, effectiveViewportRect);
				break;
			case CategoryMode.Mode2:
				num = axis.GetGroupCenter(base.Index, windowRect, viewportRect, effectiveViewportRect);
				break;
			}
			if (axis.IsInverted)
			{
				num = 0.0 - num;
			}
			return num;
		}

		protected void SplineFitMustBeRecalculated()
		{
			UColumn = null;
			UColumnMinValue = double.NaN;
			UColumnMaxValue = double.NaN;
			if (base.YAxis != null)
			{
				base.YAxis.UpdateRange();
			}
		}

		protected override void PropertyUpdatedOverride(object sender, string propertyName, object oldValue, object newValue)
		{
			if (propertyName == "ValueColumn" || propertyName == "FastItemsSource")
			{
				SplineFitMustBeRecalculated();
			}
			base.PropertyUpdatedOverride(sender, propertyName, oldValue, newValue);
			if (propertyName == "SplineType")
			{
				SplineFitMustBeRecalculated();
				RenderSeries(animate: false);
				NotifyThumbnailAppearanceChanged();
			}
		}

		protected override void DataUpdatedOverride(FastItemsSourceEventAction action, int position, int count, string propertyName)
		{
			SplineFitMustBeRecalculated();
			base.DataUpdatedOverride(action, position, count, propertyName);
		}
	}

		private double GetXValue(int i, bool fromEnd, CategoryFrame frame, double width, bool isSorting)
		{
			if (fromEnd)
			{
				if (isSorting)
				{
					if ((i & 1) == 0 || i / 2 + 1 >= frame.Buckets.Count)
					{
						return frame.Buckets[i / 2][0];
					}
					return frame.Buckets[i / 2 + 1][0];
				}
				return frame.Buckets[i / 2][0] + (((i & 1) == 1) ? (0.0 - width) : width);
			}
			if (isSorting)
			{
				if ((i & 1) == 0 || i / 2 + 1 >= frame.Buckets.Count)
				{
					return frame.Buckets[i / 2][0];
				}
				return frame.Buckets[i / 2 + 1][0];
			}
			return frame.Buckets[i / 2][0] + (((i & 1) == 0) ? (0.0 - width) : width);
		}

		protected override CategoryTransitionInMode GetDefaultTransitionInMode()
		{
			return CategoryTransitionInMode.FromZero;
		}

		protected internal override double GetInterpolatedSeriesValue(double p, IList<double> column, int prevItem, int nextItem, int unsortedPrevItem, int unsortedNextItem, double offset, bool isSorting)
		{
			double num = double.NaN;
			if (prevItem >= 0 && prevItem < column.Count)
			{
				num = column[prevItem];
			}
			double num2 = double.NaN;
			if (nextItem >= 0 && nextItem < column.Count)
			{
				num2 = column[nextItem];
			}
			if (unsortedNextItem == 0)
			{
				return num2;
			}
			if (unsortedPrevItem == column.Count - 1)
			{
				return num;
			}
			if (double.IsNaN(num2) && offset != 0.0 && p <= 0.5 && !isSorting)
			{
				return num;
			}
			if (double.IsNaN(num) && offset != 0.0 && p >= 0.5 && !isSorting)
			{
				return num2;
			}
			if (p > 0.5)
			{
				return num2;
			}
			return num;
		}

		internal override void RenderFrame(CategoryFrame frame, CategorySeriesView view)
		{
			base.RenderFrame(frame, view);
			Rect windowRect = view.WindowRect;
			Rect viewport = view.Viewport;
			Rect effectiveViewport = GetEffectiveViewport(view);
			bool isSorting = CachedXAxis is ISortingAxis;
			double num = ((CachedXAxis != null) ? (0.5 * CachedXAxis.GetCategorySize(windowRect, viewport, effectiveViewport)) : 0.0);
			if (CachedXAxis != null && CachedXAxis.IsInverted)
			{
				num = 0.0 - num;
			}
			int num2 = frame.Buckets.Count * 2;
			List<double[]> list = new List<double[]>(num2);
			RenderManager.InitCategoryRenderSettings(this, ShouldOverrideCategoryStyle(), GetCategoryItems, GetBucketSize(view), GetFirstBucket(view));
			bool flag = false;
			if (RenderManager.OverrideArgs != null)
			{
				flag = true;
			}
			for (int i = 0; i < num2; i++)
			{
				list.Add(new double[4]
				{
					GetXValue(i, fromEnd: false, frame, num, isSorting),
					frame.Buckets[i / 2][1],
					GetXValue(i, fromEnd: true, frame, num, isSorting),
					frame.Buckets[i / 2][2]
				});
			}
			int bucketSize = base.CategoryView.BucketCalculator.BucketSize;
			if (flag)
			{
				ScalerParams axisParams = new ScalerParams(view.WindowRect, view.Viewport, CachedXAxis.IsInverted, effectiveViewport);
				PerformCategoryStyleOverride(list, -1, base.ValueColumn.Count, CachedXAxis, axisParams, view.IsThumbnailView);
			}
			StepAreaSeriesView stepAreaSeriesView = view as StepAreaSeriesView;
			Path polyline = stepAreaSeriesView.Polyline0;
			Path polyline2 = stepAreaSeriesView.Polyline1;
			Path polygon = stepAreaSeriesView.Polygon0;
			Path polygon2 = stepAreaSeriesView.Polygon1;
			RenderManager.SetShapeAppearance(polyline, strokeOnly: true, fillOnly: false, extended: true, useOutline: true);
			RenderManager.SetShapeAppearance(polyline2, strokeOnly: true, fillOnly: false, extended: true, useOutline: true);
			RenderManager.SetShapeAppearance(polygon, strokeOnly: false, fillOnly: true, extended: false, useOutline: false);
			RenderManager.SetShapeAppearance(polygon2, strokeOnly: false, fillOnly: true, extended: false, useOutline: false);
			if (view.CheckFrameDirty(frame))
			{
				stepAreaSeriesView.RasterizeStepArea(num2, list, useX0AsX1: false, bucketSize, base.Resolution, delegate(PointCollection p0, PointCollection l0, PointCollection p01, PointCollection l1, bool f)
				{
					TerminatePolygon(p0, 2 * frame.Buckets.Count, view);
				}, UnknownValuePlotting.DontPlot, GetLineClipper(list, list.Count - 1, view.Viewport, view.WindowRect, closed: true));
				view.UpdateFrameVersion(frame);
			}
			_ = (NumericYAxis)GetYAxis();
			stepAreaSeriesView.Polygon0.Opacity = base.ActualAreaFillOpacity;
			stepAreaSeriesView.Polygon1.Opacity = 0.5 * base.ActualAreaFillOpacity;
		}

		protected internal override double GetInterpolatedSeriesValue(double p, IList<double> column, int prevItem, int nextItem, int unsortedPrevItem, int unsortedNextItem, double offset, bool isSorting)
		{
			double num = double.NaN;
			if (prevItem >= 0 && prevItem < column.Count)
			{
				num = column[prevItem];
			}
			double num2 = double.NaN;
			if (nextItem >= 0 && nextItem < column.Count)
			{
				num2 = column[nextItem];
			}
			if (unsortedNextItem == 0)
			{
				return num2;
			}
			if (unsortedPrevItem == column.Count - 1)
			{
				return num;
			}
			if (double.IsNaN(num2) && offset != 0.0 && p <= 0.5 && !isSorting)
			{
				return num;
			}
			if (double.IsNaN(num) && offset != 0.0 && p >= 0.5 && !isSorting)
			{
				return num2;
			}
			if (p > 0.5)
			{
				return num2;
			}

		private double GetXValue(int i, bool fromEnd, CategoryFrame frame, double width, bool xInverted, bool isSorting)
		{
			bool flag;
			if (fromEnd)
			{
				if (isSorting)
				{
					if ((i & 1) == 0 || i / 2 + 1 < 0)
					{
						return frame.Buckets[i / 2][0];
					}
					if (frame.Buckets.Count == i / 2 + 1)
					{
						return frame.Buckets[i / 2][0];
					}
					return frame.Buckets[i / 2 + 1][0];
				}
				flag = (i & 1) == 0;
				return frame.Buckets[i / 2][0] + (flag ? width : (0.0 - width));
			}
			if (isSorting)
			{
				if ((i & 1) == 0 || i / 2 + 1 >= frame.Buckets.Count)
				{
					return frame.Buckets[i / 2][0];
				}
				if (frame.Buckets.Count == i / 2 + 1)
				{
					return frame.Buckets[i / 2][0];
				}
				return frame.Buckets[i / 2 + 1][0];
			}
			flag = (i & 1) == 0;
			return frame.Buckets[i / 2][0] + (flag ? (0.0 - width) : width);
		}

		internal override void RenderFrame(CategoryFrame frame, CategorySeriesView view)
		{
			base.RenderFrame(frame, view);
			Rect windowRect = view.WindowRect;
			Rect viewport = view.Viewport;
			Rect effectiveViewport = GetEffectiveViewport(view);
			bool isSorting = CachedXAxis is ISortingAxis;
			bool isInverted = CachedXAxis.IsInverted;
			double width = 0.0;
			if (CachedXAxis != null)
			{
				width = 0.5 * CachedXAxis.GetCategorySize(windowRect, viewport, effectiveViewport);
			}
			List<double[]> buckets = frame.Buckets;
			int num = 2 * buckets.Count;
			List<double[]> list = new List<double[]>(num);
			if (!CachedXAxis.IsInverted)
			{
				for (int i = 0; i < num; i++)
				{
					list.Add(new double[4]
					{
						GetXValue(i, fromEnd: false, frame, width, isInverted, isSorting),
						frame.Buckets[i / 2][1],
						GetXValue(i, fromEnd: true, frame, width, isInverted, isSorting),
						frame.Buckets[i / 2][2]
					});
				}
			}
			else
			{
				for (int j = 0; j < num; j++)
				{
					list.Add(new double[4]
					{
						GetXValue(j, fromEnd: true, frame, width, isInverted, isSorting),
						frame.Buckets[j / 2][1],
						GetXValue(j, fromEnd: true, frame, width, isInverted, isSorting),
						frame.Buckets[j / 2][2]
					});
				}
			}
			StepLineSeriesView stepLineSeriesView = view as StepLineSeriesView;
			int bucketSize = stepLineSeriesView.BucketCalculator.BucketSize;
			RenderManager.InitCategoryRenderSettings(this, ShouldOverrideCategoryStyle(), GetCategoryItems, GetBucketSize(view), GetFirstBucket(view));
			bool flag = false;
			if (RenderManager.OverrideArgs != null)
			{
				flag = true;
			}
			if (flag)
			{
				ScalerParams axisParams = new ScalerParams(view.WindowRect, view.Viewport, CachedXAxis.IsInverted, effectiveViewport);
				PerformCategoryStyleOverride(buckets, -1, base.ValueColumn.Count, CachedXAxis, axisParams, view.IsThumbnailView);
			}
			Path line = stepLineSeriesView.Line0;
			Path line2 = stepLineSeriesView.Line1;
			Path fillArea = stepLineSeriesView.FillArea;
			RenderManager.SetShapeAppearance(line, strokeOnly: true, fillOnly: false, extended: true, useOutline: false);
			RenderManager.SetShapeAppearance(line2, strokeOnly: true, fillOnly: false, extended: true, useOutline: false);
			RenderManager.SetShapeAppearance(fillArea, strokeOnly: false, fillOnly: true, extended: false, useOutline: false);
			fillArea.Opacity = 0.75 * RenderManager.ActualRenderOpacity;
			if (view.CheckFrameDirty(frame))
			{
				stepLineSeriesView.RasterizeStepLine(num, list, useX0AsX1: false, UnknownValuePlotting.DontPlot, GetLineClipper(list, num - 1, view.Viewport, view.WindowRect), bucketSize, base.Resolution);
				view.UpdateFrameVersion(frame);
			}
		}
	}

		public override Rect GetSeriesValueBoundingBox(Point world)
		{
			if (WaterfallView == null || WaterfallView.Columns == null || WaterfallView.Columns.Count == 0 || base.XAxis == null)
			{
				return Rect.Empty;
			}
			Pool<Rectangle> columns = WaterfallView.Columns;
			Point pos = FromWorldPosition(world);
			int num = -1;
			bool isInverted = base.XAxis.IsInverted;
			double maxPosition = base.Viewport.Right * 2.0;
			num = ((!isInverted) ? columns.BinarySearch(delegate(Rectangle item)
			{
				Rect columnBoundingBoxFromColumn = WaterfallView.GetColumnBoundingBoxFromColumn(item);
				return (!(pos.X < columnBoundingBoxFromColumn.Left + columnBoundingBoxFromColumn.Width / 2.0)) ? ((pos.X > columnBoundingBoxFromColumn.Left + columnBoundingBoxFromColumn.Width / 2.0) ? 1 : 0) : (-1);
			}) : columns.BinarySearch(delegate(Rectangle item)
			{
				Rect columnBoundingBoxFromColumn = WaterfallView.GetColumnBoundingBoxFromColumn(item);
				return (!(maxPosition - pos.X < maxPosition - (columnBoundingBoxFromColumn.Left + columnBoundingBoxFromColumn.Width / 2.0))) ? ((maxPosition - pos.X > maxPosition - (columnBoundingBoxFromColumn.Left + columnBoundingBoxFromColumn.Width / 2.0)) ? 1 : 0) : (-1);
			}));
			if (num < 0)
			{
				num = ~num;
				num--;
			}
			if (num < 0)
			{
				num = 0;
			}
			if (num > columns.Count - 1)
			{
				num = columns.Count - 1;
			}
			int num2 = num;
			int num3 = num;
			if (num2 < 0)
			{
				num2--;
			}
			if (num3 < columns.Count - 1)
			{
				num3++;
			}
			Rect columnBoundingBox = GetColumnBoundingBox(num2);
			Rect columnBoundingBox2 = GetColumnBoundingBox(num);
			Rect columnBoundingBox3 = GetColumnBoundingBox(num3);
			double num4 = columnBoundingBox.Left + columnBoundingBox.Width / 2.0;
			double num5 = columnBoundingBox2.Left + columnBoundingBox2.Width / 2.0;
			double num6 = columnBoundingBox3.Left + columnBoundingBox3.Width / 2.0;
			double num7 = Math.Abs(num4 - pos.X);
			double num8 = Math.Abs(num5 - pos.X);
			double num9 = Math.Abs(num6 - pos.X);
			bool flag = columnBoundingBox.Contains(pos);
			bool flag2 = columnBoundingBox2.Contains(pos);
			bool flag3 = columnBoundingBox3.Contains(pos);
			if (num8 <= num7 && num8 <= num9)
			{
				if (!isInverted && flag3)
				{
					return columnBoundingBox3;
				}
				if (isInverted && flag)
				{
					return columnBoundingBox;
				}
				return columnBoundingBox2;
			}
			if (num7 <= num8 && num7 <= num9)
			{
				if (!isInverted && flag2)
				{
					return columnBoundingBox2;
				}
				return columnBoundingBox;
			}
			if (num9 <= num8 && num9 <= num7)
			{
				if (isInverted && flag2)
				{
					return columnBoundingBox2;
				}
				return columnBoundingBox3;
			}
			return Rect.Empty;
		}

		internal override void RenderFrame(CategoryFrame frame, CategorySeriesView view)
		{
			WaterfallSeriesView waterfallSeriesView = (WaterfallSeriesView)view;
			base.RenderFrame(frame, view);
			Rect windowRect = view.WindowRect;
			Rect viewport = view.Viewport;
			Rect effectiveViewport = GetEffectiveViewport(view);
			double groupSize = CachedXAxis.GetGroupSize(windowRect, viewport, effectiveViewport);
			_ = RadiusX;
			_ = RadiusY;
			double worldZeroValue = GetWorldZeroValue(view);
			double num = double.NaN;
			Pool<Rectangle> columns = waterfallSeriesView.Columns;
			int num2 = 0;
			RenderManager.InitCategoryRenderSettings(this, ShouldOverrideCategoryStyle(), GetCategoryItems, GetBucketSize(view), GetFirstBucket(view));
			RenderManager.InitialRenderRadiusX = RadiusX;
			RenderManager.InitialRenderRadiusY = RadiusY;
			RenderManager.ActualRenderRadiusX = RadiusX;
			RenderManager.ActualRenderRadiusY = RadiusY;
			bool flag = false;
			if (RenderManager.OverrideArgs != null)
			{
				flag = true;
			}
			_ = CachedXAxis.IsSorting;
			int count = base.ValueColumn.Count;
			List<double[]> buckets = frame.Buckets;
			CategoryAxisBase cachedXAxis = CachedXAxis;
			ScalerParams axisParams = new ScalerParams(windowRect, viewport, CachedXAxis.IsInverted, effectiveViewport);
			Brush actualBrush = base.ActualBrush;
			Brush negativeBrush = NegativeBrush;
			Brush actualOutline = base.ActualOutline;
			Brush brush = NegativeOutline ?? actualOutline;
			if (frame.Buckets.Count > 0)
			{
				double left = frame.Buckets[0][0] - 0.5 * groupSize;
				double num3 = frame.Buckets[0][1];
				if (!double.IsNaN(num3))
				{
					if (num3 > worldZeroValue)
					{
						Rectangle rectangle = columns[num2];
						num2++;
						waterfallSeriesView.PositionRectangle(rectangle, left, worldZeroValue);
						rectangle.Width = groupSize;
						rectangle.Height = Math.Abs(worldZeroValue - num3);
						RenderManager.InitialRenderFill = negativeBrush;
						RenderManager.ActualRenderFill = negativeBrush;
						RenderManager.InitialRenderOutline = brush;
						RenderManager.ActualRenderOutline = brush;
						RenderManager.ActualNegativeShape = true;
						if (flag)
						{
							PerformCategoryStyleOverride(buckets, 0, count, cachedXAxis, axisParams, view.IsThumbnailView);
						}
						RenderManager.SetShapeAppearance(rectangle, strokeOnly: false, fillOnly: false, extended: false, useOutline: false);
						rectangle.RadiusX = RenderManager.ActualRenderRadiusX;
						rectangle.RadiusY = RenderManager.ActualRenderRadiusY;
					}
					else
					{
						Rectangle rectangle = columns[num2];
						num2++;
						waterfallSeriesView.PositionRectangle(rectangle, left, num3);
						rectangle.Width = groupSize;
						rectangle.Height = Math.Abs(num3 - worldZeroValue);
						RenderManager.InitialRenderFill = actualBrush;
						RenderManager.ActualRenderFill = actualBrush;
						RenderManager.InitialRenderOutline = actualOutline;
						RenderManager.ActualRenderOutline = actualOutline;
						RenderManager.ActualNegativeShape = false;
						if (flag)
						{
							PerformCategoryStyleOverride(buckets, 0, count, cachedXAxis, axisParams, view.IsThumbnailView);
						}
						RenderManager.SetShapeAppearance(rectangle, strokeOnly: false, fillOnly: false, extended: false, useOutline: false);
						rectangle.RadiusX = RenderManager.ActualRenderRadiusX;
						rectangle.RadiusY = RenderManager.ActualRenderRadiusY;
					}
					num = num3;
				}
				else
				{
					num = worldZeroValue;
				}
			}
			for (int i = 1; i < frame.Buckets.Count; i++)
			{
				double[] array = frame.Buckets[i];
				double left = frame.Buckets[i][0] - 0.5 * groupSize;
				double num4 = array[1];
				if (double.IsNaN(num4))
				{
					continue;
				}
				Rectangle rectangle = columns[num2];
				num2++;
				waterfallSeriesView.PositionRectangle(rectangle, left, Math.Min(num, num4));
				rectangle.Width = groupSize;
				rectangle.Height = Math.Abs(num - num4);
				RenderManager.InitialRenderFill = actualBrush;
				RenderManager.ActualRenderFill = actualBrush;
				RenderManager.InitialRenderOutline = actualOutline;
				RenderManager.ActualRenderOutline = actualOutline;
				RenderManager.ActualNegativeShape = false;
				if (num > num4)
				{
					if (flag)
					{
						PerformCategoryStyleOverride(buckets, i, count, cachedXAxis, axisParams, view.IsThumbnailView);
					}
				}
				else
				{
					RenderManager.InitialRenderFill = negativeBrush;
					RenderManager.ActualRenderFill = negativeBrush;
					RenderManager.InitialRenderOutline = brush;
					RenderManager.ActualRenderOutline = brush;
					RenderManager.ActualNegativeShape = true;
					if (flag)
					{
						PerformCategoryStyleOverride(buckets, i, count, cachedXAxis, axisParams, view.IsThumbnailView);
					}
				}
				RenderManager.SetShapeAppearance(rectangle, strokeOnly: false, fillOnly: false, extended: false, useOutline: false);
				rectangle.RadiusX = RenderManager.ActualRenderRadiusX;
				rectangle.RadiusY = RenderManager.ActualRenderRadiusY;
				num = num4;
			}
			columns.Count = num2;
			view.UpdateFrameVersion(frame);
		}
	}
	[WidgetIgnoreDepends("NumericAngleAxis")]
	[WidgetIgnoreDepends("CategoryAngleAxis")]
	public class AngleAxisLabelPanel : AxisLabelPanelBase
	{
		[TSSuppressSynthesizedInitializer]
		internal AngleAxisLabelPanelView AngleView { get; set; }

		public bool ClipLabelsToBounds { get; set; }

		public Func<double, Point> GetPoint { get; set; }

		internal double LargestWidth { get; set; }

		internal double LargestHeight { get; set; }

		internal double LargestRenderWidth { get; set; }

		internal double LargestRenderHeight { get; set; }

		internal override AxisLabelPanelBaseView CreateView()
		{
			return new AngleAxisLabelPanelView(this);
		}

		internal override void OnViewCreated(AxisLabelPanelBaseView view)
		{
			base.OnViewCreated(view);
			AngleView = (AngleAxisLabelPanelView)view;
		}

		protected internal override bool ShouldDisplay(int index, Rect bounds)
		{
			if (!bounds.IsPlottable())
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (base.Axis == null || base.Axis.ViewportRect.IsEmpty)
			{
				return base.ShouldDisplay(index, bounds);
			}
			return true;
		}

		protected internal override List<Rect> CreateBoundsRectangles()
		{
			List<Rect> list = new List<Rect>();
			List<bool> list2 = new List<bool>();
			if (base.TextBlocks.Count != base.LabelPositions.Count)
			{
				return list;
			}
			AngleView.DetermineLargestLabels(list, list2);
			bool flag = false;
			base.FoundCollisions = DetectCollisions(list, list2);
			if (!base.Axis.HasUserExtent())
			{
				flag = true;
				base.Extent = LargestWidth / 2.0;
				base.Extent += OtherExtentValues();
			}
			else
			{
				flag = true;
				AngleView.BindExtentToSettings();
			}
			if (flag)
			{
				for (int i = 0; i < list.Count; i++)
				{
					FrameworkElement element = base.TextBlocks[i];
					LabelPosition labelPosition = base.LabelPositions[i];
					Rect value = list[i];
					Point point = GetPoint(labelPosition.Value);
					double x = point.X - GetDesiredWidth(element) / 2.0;
					double y = point.Y - GetDesiredHeight(element) / 2.0;
					value.X = x;
					value.Y = y;
					list[i] = value;
				}
			}
			return list;
		}

		private double OtherExtentValues()
		{
			Axis axis = base.Axis;
			XamDataChart xamDataChart = null;
			if (axis != null)
			{
				xamDataChart = axis.SeriesViewer as XamDataChart;
			}
			if (xamDataChart == null || axis == null)
			{
				return 0.0;
			}
			List<Axis> list = new List<Axis>();
			for (int i = 0; i < xamDataChart.Axes.Count; i++)
			{
				Axis axis2 = xamDataChart.Axes[i];
				if ((axis2 is NumericAngleAxis || axis2 is CategoryAngleAxis) && axis2.LabelPanel is AngleAxisLabelPanel && ((AngleAxisLabelPanel)axis2.LabelPanel).TextBlocks.Count > 0 && !axis2.HasUserExtent() && !axis2.HasCrossingValue() && (axis2.CrossingAxis == null || base.Axis.CrossingAxis == null || ((NumericRadiusAxis)axis2.CrossingAxis).ActualRadiusExtentScale == ((NumericRadiusAxis)axis.CrossingAxis).ActualRadiusExtentScale))
				{
					list.Add(axis2);
				}
			}
			int num = list.IndexOf(axis);
			if (num == -1)
			{
				return 0.0;
			}
			double num2 = 0.0;
			double num3 = 5.0;
			if (num == 0)
			{
				return num2 + num3;
			}
			num2 += list[num - 1].LabelPanel.Extent;
			return num2 + (list[num].LabelPanel.Extent * 2.0 + num3);
		}

		internal override AxisLabelsLocation GetDefaultLabelsLocation()
		{
			return AxisLabelsLocation.InsideTop;
		}

		internal override bool ValidLocation(AxisLabelsLocation location)
		{
			if (location != AxisLabelsLocation.InsideTop)
			{
				return location == AxisLabelsLocation.InsideBottom;
			}
			return true;
		}
	}
