		private CategoryAxisRenderer CreateRenderer()
		{
			AxisLabelManager labelManager = new AxisLabelManager
			{
				Axis = this,
				LabelPositions = base.LabelPositions,
				LabelDataContext = base.LabelDataContext,
				TargetPanel = base.LabelPanel
			};
			if (base.LabelSettings != null)
			{
				base.LabelSettings.RegisterAxis(this);
			}
			return new CategoryAxisRenderer(labelManager)
			{
				Clear = delegate
				{
					GeometryCollection axisLinesGeometry = View.GetAxisLinesGeometry();
					GeometryCollection stripsGeometry = View.GetStripsGeometry();
					GeometryCollection majorLinesGeometry = View.GetMajorLinesGeometry();
					GeometryCollection minorLinesGeometry = View.GetMinorLinesGeometry();
					UpdateLineVisibility();
					ClearMarks(axisLinesGeometry);
					ClearMarks(stripsGeometry);
					ClearMarks(majorLinesGeometry);
					ClearMarks(minorLinesGeometry);
				},
				ShouldRender = (Rect viewport, Rect window) => !window.IsEmpty && !viewport.IsEmpty && RadiusAxis != null,
				CreateRenderingParams = (Rect viewport, Rect window, Rect effectiveViewportRect, Rect contentViewport) => CreateRenderingParams(viewport, window, effectiveViewportRect, contentViewport),
				OnRendering = delegate
				{
					if (!_preventReentry)
					{
						_preventReentry = true;
						RadiusAxis.UpdateRange();
						_preventReentry = false;
					}
				},
				GetLabelForItem = delegate(object item)
				{
					int num = (int)item;
					if (num > base.FastItemsSource.Count - 1)
					{
						num -= base.FastItemsSource.Count;
					}
					object dataItem = base.FastItemsSource[num];
					return GetLabel(dataItem);
				},
				LabelManager = 
				{
					FloatPanelAction = delegate(double crossing)
					{
						if ((base.LabelSettings == null || base.LabelSettings.Visibility == Visibility.Visible) && RadiusAxis != null && _lastCrossing != crossing && base.SeriesViewer is XamDataChart xamDataChart)
						{
							_lastCrossing = crossing;
							base.LabelPanel.CrossingValue = crossing;
							xamDataChart.InvalidatePanels();
							foreach (Axis axis in xamDataChart.Axes)
							{
								if (axis != this && axis.LabelPanel is AngleAxisLabelPanel)
								{
									axis.View.LabelNeedRearrange();
								}
							}
						}
					}
				},
				Line = delegate(AxisRenderingParametersBase p, GeometryCollection g, double value)
				{
					RadialAxisRenderingParameters radialAxisRenderingParameters = p as RadialAxisRenderingParameters;
					renderingManager.RadialLine(g, value, p.ViewportRect, p.WindowRect, radialAxisRenderingParameters.MinLength, radialAxisRenderingParameters.MaxLength, radialAxisRenderingParameters.Center);
				},
				Strip = delegate(AxisRenderingParametersBase p, GeometryCollection g, double start, double end)
				{
					RadialAxisRenderingParameters radialAxisRenderingParameters = p as RadialAxisRenderingParameters;
					renderingManager.RadialStrip(g, start, end, radialAxisRenderingParameters.ViewportRect, p.WindowRect, radialAxisRenderingParameters.MinLength, radialAxisRenderingParameters.MaxLength, radialAxisRenderingParameters.Center);
				},
				Scaling = (AxisRenderingParametersBase p, double unscaled) => GetScaledAngle(unscaled),
				ShouldRenderLines = delegate(AxisRenderingParametersBase p, double value)
				{
					if (Round10(value - _startAngleOffsetRadians) < 0.0)
					{
						return false;
					}
					return !(Round10(value - _startAngleOffsetRadians - Math.PI * 2.0) > 0.0);
				},
				AxisLine = delegate(AxisRenderingParametersBase p)
				{
					RadialAxisRenderingParameters radialAxisRenderingParameters = p as RadialAxisRenderingParameters;
					if (radialAxisRenderingParameters.CurrentRangeInfo == radialAxisRenderingParameters.RangeInfos[0])
					{
						renderingManager.ConcentricLine(p.AxisGeometry, p.CrossingValue, p.ViewportRect, p.WindowRect, radialAxisRenderingParameters.Center, radialAxisRenderingParameters.MinAngle, radialAxisRenderingParameters.MaxAngle);
					}
				},
				DetermineCrossingValue = delegate(AxisRenderingParametersBase p)
				{
					p.CrossingValue = GetCrossingValue();
					p.RelativeCrossingValue = p.CrossingValue;
				},
				ShouldRenderLabel = delegate(AxisRenderingParametersBase p, double value, bool last)
				{
					RadialAxisRenderingParameters radialAxisRenderingParameters = p as RadialAxisRenderingParameters;
					if (last)
					{
						return false;
					}
					Point labelLocationPoint = GetLabelLocationPoint(value, radialAxisRenderingParameters.Center, p.WindowRect, p.ViewportRect, 0.0);
					return (labelLocationPoint.X < p.ViewportRect.Right && labelLocationPoint.X >= p.ViewportRect.Left && labelLocationPoint.Y < p.ViewportRect.Bottom && labelLocationPoint.Y >= p.ViewportRect.Top) ? true : false;
				},
				AdjustMajorValue = delegate(AxisRenderingParametersBase p, double value, int i, double interval)
				{
					Rect effectiveViewportRect = p.EffectiveViewportRect;
					ScalerParams p2 = new ScalerParams(p.WindowRect, p.ViewportRect, base.IsInverted, effectiveViewportRect);
					double result = value;
					if (base.CategoryMode != CategoryMode.Mode0)
					{
						double val = (double)i * interval + 1.0;
						val = Math.Min(val, CachedItemsCount);
						double scaledValue = GetScaledValue(val, p2);
						result = (value + scaledValue) / 2.0;
					}
					return result;
				},
				GetGroupCenter = GetGroupCenter,
				GetUnscaledGroupCenter = GetUnscaledGroupCenter
			};
		}

		private Point GetLabelLocationPoint(double angleValue, Point center, Rect windowRect, Rect viewportRect, double extent)
		{
			double crossingValue = GetCrossingValue();
			double num = ViewportUtils.TransformXFromViewportLength(extent, windowRect, viewportRect);
			if (base.LabelSettings != null && (base.LabelSettings.ActualLocation == AxisLabelsLocation.InsideBottom || base.LabelSettings.ActualLocation == AxisLabelsLocation.OutsideBottom))
			{
				num *= -1.0;
			}
			double xValue = center.X + (crossingValue + num) * Math.Cos(angleValue);
			double yValue = center.Y + (crossingValue + num) * Math.Sin(angleValue);
			double x = ViewportUtils.TransformXToViewport(xValue, windowRect, viewportRect);
			yValue = ViewportUtils.TransformYToViewport(yValue, windowRect, viewportRect);
			return new Point(x, yValue);
		}

		private double GetCrossingValue()
		{
			if (RadiusAxis == null)
			{
				return 0.0;
			}
			if (!HasCrossingValue())
			{
				return RadiusAxis.GetEffectiveMaximumLength();
			}
			return RadiusAxis.GetScaledValue(Convert.ToDouble(base.CrossingValue));
		}

		private AxisRenderingParametersBase CreateRenderingParams(Rect viewportRect, Rect windowRect, Rect effectiveViewportRect, Rect contentViewport)
		{
			if (base.FastItemsSource == null)
			{
				return null;
			}
			RadialAxisRenderingParameters radialAxisRenderingParameters = new RadialAxisRenderingParameters();
			int num = base.FastItemsSource.Count - 1;
			GeometryCollection axisLinesGeometry = View.GetAxisLinesGeometry();
			GeometryCollection stripsGeometry = View.GetStripsGeometry();
			GeometryCollection majorLinesGeometry = View.GetMajorLinesGeometry();
			GeometryCollection minorLinesGeometry = View.GetMinorLinesGeometry();
			radialAxisRenderingParameters.AxisGeometry = axisLinesGeometry;
			radialAxisRenderingParameters.Strips = stripsGeometry;
			radialAxisRenderingParameters.Major = majorLinesGeometry;
			radialAxisRenderingParameters.Minor = minorLinesGeometry;
			radialAxisRenderingParameters.ActualMaximumValue = num;
			radialAxisRenderingParameters.ActualMinimumValue = 0.0;
			radialAxisRenderingParameters.HasUserMax = false;
			radialAxisRenderingParameters.ViewportRect = viewportRect;
			radialAxisRenderingParameters.EffectiveViewportRect = effectiveViewportRect;
			radialAxisRenderingParameters.ContentViewport = contentViewport;
			radialAxisRenderingParameters.WindowRect = windowRect;
			radialAxisRenderingParameters.HasUserInterval = HasUserInterval();
			radialAxisRenderingParameters.Interval = Interval;
			radialAxisRenderingParameters.HeuristicResolution = ResolveHeuristicResolution();
			radialAxisRenderingParameters.MinorInterval = MinorInterval;
			radialAxisRenderingParameters.Label = base.Label;
			double closestRadiusValue = renderingManager.GetClosestRadiusValue(windowRect);
			double furthestRadiusValue = renderingManager.GetFurthestRadiusValue(windowRect);
			double num2 = 0.5 * RadiusAxis.ActualRadiusExtentScale;
			double num3 = 0.5 * RadiusAxis.ActualInnerRadiusExtentScale;
			double num4 = closestRadiusValue;
			double num5 = furthestRadiusValue;
			double effectiveMaximumLength = RadiusAxis.GetEffectiveMaximumLength();
			if (double.IsNaN(effectiveMaximumLength) || double.IsInfinity(effectiveMaximumLength))
			{
				return null;
			}
			if (num5 >= num2)
			{
				num5 = effectiveMaximumLength;
			}
			if (num4 < num3)
			{
				num4 = num3;
			}
			double width = viewportRect.Width;
			renderingManager.DetermineView(windowRect, radialAxisRenderingParameters, 0.0, base.FastItemsSource.Count, base.IsInverted, GetUnscaledAngle, width);
			Point center = new Point(0.5, 0.5);
			radialAxisRenderingParameters.Center = center;
			radialAxisRenderingParameters.MaxLength = num5;
			radialAxisRenderingParameters.MinLength = num4;
			radialAxisRenderingParameters.EffectiveMaximum = effectiveMaximumLength;
			radialAxisRenderingParameters.Count = base.FastItemsSource.Count;
			radialAxisRenderingParameters.CategoryMode = base.CategoryMode;
			radialAxisRenderingParameters.WrapAround = true;
			radialAxisRenderingParameters.IsInverted = base.IsInverted;
			radialAxisRenderingParameters.Mode2GroupCount = base.Mode2GroupCount;
			radialAxisRenderingParameters.TickmarkValues = new CategoryTickmarkValues();
			radialAxisRenderingParameters.ShouldRenderMinorLines = base.ShouldRenderMinorLines;
			return radialAxisRenderingParameters;
		}

		void IAngleScaler.GetMinMaxAngle(Rect windowRect, out double minAngle, out double maxAngle)
		{
			GetMinMaxAngle(windowRect, out minAngle, out maxAngle);
		}

		internal void GetMinMaxAngle(Rect windowRect, out double minAngle, out double maxAngle)
		{
			renderingManager.GetMinMaxAngle(windowRect, out minAngle, out maxAngle);
		}

		[JAVASuppressWidgetMember]
		[TSSuppressWidgetMember]
		[SwiftSuppressWidgetMember]
		public override void OnApplyTemplate()
		{
			base.OnApplyTemplate();
			RenderAxis(animate: false);
		}

		protected internal override Axis ResolveCrossingAxis()
		{
			return RadiusAxis;
		}

		internal override double GetCategorySize(Rect windowRect, Rect viewportRect, Rect effectiveViewportRect)
		{
			return Math.PI * 2.0 / (double)CachedItemsCount;
		}

		internal override double GetGroupSize(Rect windowRect, Rect viewportRect, Rect effectiveViewportRect)
		{
			double num = ((!double.IsNaN(base.Gap)) ? MathUtil.Clamp(base.Gap, 0.0, 1.0) : 0.0);
			double num2 = 0.0;
			if (!double.IsNaN(base.Overlap))
			{
				num2 = Math.Min(base.Overlap, 1.0);
			}
			double num3 = 1.0 - 0.5 * num;
			return GetCategorySize(windowRect, viewportRect, effectiveViewportRect) * num3 / ((double)base.Mode2GroupCount - (double)(base.Mode2GroupCount - 1) * num2);
		}

		internal override double GetGroupCenter(int index, Rect windowRect, Rect viewportRect, Rect effectiveViewportRect)
		{
			double num = 0.5;
			if (base.Mode2GroupCount > 1)
			{
				double num2 = ((!double.IsNaN(base.Gap)) ? MathUtil.Clamp(base.Gap, 0.0, 1.0) : 0.0);
				double num3 = 0.0;
				if (!double.IsNaN(base.Overlap))
				{
					num3 = Math.Min(base.Overlap, 1.0);
				}
				double num4 = 1.0 - 0.5 * num2;
				double num5 = num4 / ((double)base.Mode2GroupCount - (double)(base.Mode2GroupCount - 1) * num3);
				double num6 = (num4 - num5) / (double)(base.Mode2GroupCount - 1);
				num = 0.25 * num2 + 0.5 * num5 + (double)index * num6;
			}
			return GetCategorySize(windowRect, viewportRect, effectiveViewportRect) * num;
		}

		internal double GetUnscaledGroupCenter(int groupIndex)
		{
			double result = 0.5;
			if (base.Mode2GroupCount > 1)
			{
				double num = ((!double.IsNaN(base.Gap)) ? MathUtil.Clamp(base.Gap, 0.0, 1.0) : 0.0);
				double num2 = 0.0;
				if (!double.IsNaN(base.Overlap))
				{
					num2 = Math.Min(base.Overlap, 1.0);
				}
				double num3 = 1.0 - 0.5 * num;
				double num4 = num3 / ((double)base.Mode2GroupCount - (double)(base.Mode2GroupCount - 1) * num2);
				double num5 = (num3 - num4) / (double)(base.Mode2GroupCount - 1);
				result = 0.25 * num + 0.5 * num4 + (double)groupIndex * num5;
			}
			return result;
		}

		protected override void RenderAxisOverride(bool animate)
		{
			base.RenderAxisOverride(animate);
			Rect windowRect = ((base.SeriesViewer != null) ? base.SeriesViewer.ActualWindowRect : Rect.Empty);
			Rect viewportRect = ((!windowRect.IsEmpty) ? base.ViewportRect : Rect.Empty);
			Rect currentEffectiveViewport = GetCurrentEffectiveViewport();
			Rect contentViewport = GetContentViewport();
			AxisRenderingParametersBase axisRenderingParametersBase = Renderer.Render(animate, viewportRect, windowRect, currentEffectiveViewport, contentViewport);
			if (axisRenderingParametersBase != null)
			{
				ActualInterval = axisRenderingParametersBase.TickmarkValues.Interval;
				ActualMinorInterval = axisRenderingParametersBase.TickmarkValues.ActualMinorInterval;
			}
		}

		internal double GetMinimumViewable(Rect viewportRect, Rect windowRect)
		{
			renderingManager.GetMinMaxAngle(windowRect, out var minAngle, out var _);
			if (minAngle == 0.0)
			{
				if (base.IsInverted)
				{
					return CachedItemsCount;
				}
				return 0.0;
			}
			double unscaledAngle = GetUnscaledAngle(minAngle);
			if (unscaledAngle < 0.0 || unscaledAngle > (double)CachedItemsCount)
			{
				unscaledAngle = GetUnscaledAngle(minAngle + Math.PI * 2.0);
			}
			return unscaledAngle;
		}

		internal double GetMaximumViewable(Rect viewportRect, Rect windowRect)
		{
			renderingManager.GetMinMaxAngle(windowRect, out var _, out var maxAngle);
			if (maxAngle > Math.PI * 2.0)
			{
				maxAngle -= Math.PI * 2.0;
			}
			if (maxAngle == Math.PI * 2.0)
			{
				if (base.IsInverted)
				{
					return 0.0;
				}
				return CachedItemsCount;
			}
			double unscaledAngle = GetUnscaledAngle(maxAngle);
			if (unscaledAngle < 0.0 || unscaledAngle > (double)CachedItemsCount)
			{
				unscaledAngle = GetUnscaledAngle(maxAngle + Math.PI * 2.0);
			}
			return unscaledAngle;
		}

		public double GetScaledAngle(double unscaledAngle)
		{
			int cachedItemsCount = CachedItemsCount;
			double num = ((cachedItemsCount >= 2) ? (unscaledAngle / (double)cachedItemsCount) : ((cachedItemsCount == 1) ? 0.5 : double.NaN));
			if (base.IsInvertedCached)
			{
				num = 1.0 - num;
			}
			return num * 2.0 * Math.PI + _startAngleOffsetRadians;
		}

		public double GetUnscaledAngle([SwiftMutableParameter] double scaledAngle)
		{
			if (scaledAngle < _startAngleOffsetRadians)
			{
				scaledAngle += Math.PI * 2.0;
			}
			double num = (scaledAngle - _startAngleOffsetRadians) / (Math.PI * 2.0);
			if (base.IsInverted)
			{
				num = 1.0 - num;
			}
			return num * (double)CachedItemsCount;
		}

		[JAVASuppressWidgetMember]
		[TSSuppressWidgetMember]
		[SwiftSuppressWidgetMember]
		[TreatAsNumber]
		public override double GetScaledValue(double unscaledValue, ScalerParams p)
		{
			return ((IAngleScaler)this).GetScaledAngle(unscaledValue);
		}

		public override double GetUnscaledValue([TreatAsNumber] double scaledValue, ScalerParams p)
		{
			return ((IAngleScaler)this).GetUnscaledAngle(scaledValue);
		}

		protected override void PropertyUpdatedOverride(object sender, string propertyName, object oldValue, object newValue)
		{
			base.PropertyUpdatedOverride(sender, propertyName, oldValue, newValue);
			XamDataChart xamDataChart = base.SeriesViewer as XamDataChart;
			switch (propertyName)
			{
			case "CrossingAxis":
			{
				NumericRadiusAxis numericRadiusAxis = newValue as NumericRadiusAxis;
				OnRadiusAxisChanged(numericRadiusAxis);
				numericRadiusAxis?.OnAngleAxisChanged(this);
				base.MustInvalidateLabels = true;
				RenderAxis(animate: false);
				break;
			}
			case "StartAngleOffset":
				for (_startAngleOffsetRadians = StartAngleOffset; _startAngleOffsetRadians < 0.0; _startAngleOffsetRadians += 360.0)
				{
				}
				while (_startAngleOffsetRadians >= 360.0)
				{
					_startAngleOffsetRadians -= 360.0;
				}
				_startAngleOffsetRadians = _startAngleOffsetRadians * Math.PI / 180.0;
				base.MustInvalidateLabels = true;
				RenderAxis(animate: false);
				{
					foreach (Series item in base.Series)
					{
						item.RenderSeries(animate: false);
						item.NotifyThumbnailAppearanceChanged();
					}
					break;
				}
			case "Label":
				if (xamDataChart == null)
				{
					break;
				}
				{
					foreach (Axis axis in xamDataChart.Axes)
					{
						axis.MustInvalidateLabels = true;
						axis.RenderAxis();
					}
					break;
				}
			case "CrossingValue":
				if (xamDataChart == null)
				{
					break;
				}
				{
					foreach (Axis axis2 in xamDataChart.Axes)
					{
						if (axis2 is NumericAngleAxis || axis2 is CategoryAngleAxis)
						{
							axis2.MustInvalidateLabels = true;
							axis2.RenderAxis();
						}
					}
					break;
				}
			case "LabelSettings":
				Renderer = CreateRenderer();
				ForcePanelRefloat();
				base.MustInvalidateLabels = true;
				RenderAxis(animate: false);
				break;
			}
		}

		private void ForcePanelRefloat()
		{
			_lastCrossing = double.NaN;
		}

		internal void OnRadiusAxisChanged(NumericRadiusAxis radiusAxis)
		{
			RadiusAxis = radiusAxis;
		}

		protected internal override double ResolveActualInterval()
		{
			return ActualInterval;
		}

		protected bool HasUserInterval()
		{
			return !double.IsNaN(Interval);
		}

		internal override bool UpdateRangeOverride()
		{
			if (base.MustInvalidateLabels && base.UseEnhancedIntervalManagement)
			{
				base.LabelFontHeuristics = GatherLabelFontHeuristics();
			}
			if (base.FastItemsSource == null)
			{
				return false;
			}
			int count = base.FastItemsSource.Count;
			if (count != ActualMaximum)
			{
				AxisRangeChangedEventArgs ea = new AxisRangeChangedEventArgs(1.0, 1.0, ActualMaximum, count);
				ActualMaximum = count;
				RaiseRangeChanged(ea);
				return true;
			}
			return false;
		}

		protected internal override Geometry GetOverlayGeometry(double scaledValue, Rect windowRect, Rect viewport, object effectiveViewport = null, object contentViewport = null)
		{
			if (!(Renderer.CreateRenderingParams(viewport, windowRect, (Rect)effectiveViewport, (Rect)contentViewport) is RadialAxisRenderingParameters radialAxisRenderingParameters))
			{
				return null;
			}
			double num = Math.Cos(scaledValue);
			double num2 = Math.Sin(scaledValue);
			double xValue = radialAxisRenderingParameters.Center.X + num * radialAxisRenderingParameters.MinLength;
			double yValue = radialAxisRenderingParameters.Center.Y + num2 * radialAxisRenderingParameters.MinLength;
			double xValue2 = radialAxisRenderingParameters.Center.X + num * radialAxisRenderingParameters.MaxLength;
			double yValue2 = radialAxisRenderingParameters.Center.Y + num2 * radialAxisRenderingParameters.MaxLength;
			xValue = ViewportUtils.TransformXToViewport(xValue, windowRect, viewport);
			yValue = ViewportUtils.TransformYToViewport(yValue, windowRect, viewport);
			xValue2 = ViewportUtils.TransformXToViewport(xValue2, windowRect, viewport);
			yValue2 = ViewportUtils.TransformYToViewport(yValue2, windowRect, viewport);
			return new LineGeometry
			{
				StartPoint = new Point(xValue, yValue),
				EndPoint = new Point(xValue2, yValue2)
			};
		}
	}

		protected override void RenderAxisOverride(bool animate)
		{
			base.RenderAxisOverride(animate);
			Rect rect = ((base.SeriesViewer != null) ? base.SeriesViewer.ActualWindowRect : Rect.Empty);
			Rect rect2 = ((!rect.IsEmpty) ? base.ViewportRect : Rect.Empty);
			Rect currentEffectiveViewport = GetCurrentEffectiveViewport();
			Rect contentViewport = GetContentViewport();
			ScalerParams p = new ScalerParams(rect, rect2, base.IsInverted, currentEffectiveViewport);
			if ((base.DateTimeColumn == null && !MaximumValueIsSet() && !MinimumValueIsSet()) || rect.IsEmpty || rect2.IsEmpty || (DisplayType == TimeAxisDisplayType.Discrete && base.DateTimeColumn == null))
			{
				return;
			}
			double crossingValue = rect2.Bottom;
			double relativeCrossingValue = crossingValue - rect2.Top;
			if (base.CrossingAxis != null && base.CrossingAxis is NumericYAxis)
			{
				ScaleCrossingValue(out crossingValue, out relativeCrossingValue, rect, rect2, currentEffectiveViewport, rect2.Top, rect2.Bottom);
			}
			if (double.IsNaN(crossingValue))
			{
				crossingValue = 0.0;
			}
			HorizontalLine(View.GetAxisLinesGeometry(), crossingValue, rect2, View.GetAxisLinesPathInfo(), isAxisLine: true);
			base.LabelPanel.CrossingValue = relativeCrossingValue;
			GeometryCollection stripsGeometry = View.GetStripsGeometry();
			PathRenderingInfo majorLinesPathInfo = View.GetMajorLinesPathInfo();
			GeometryCollection majorLinesGeometry = View.GetMajorLinesGeometry();
			GeometryCollection minorLinesGeometry = View.GetMinorLinesGeometry();
			PathRenderingInfo minorLinesPathInfo = View.GetMinorLinesPathInfo();
			if (DisplayType == TimeAxisDisplayType.Discrete)
			{
				int firstVisibleIndex = ((ISortingAxis)this).GetFirstVisibleIndex(rect, rect2, currentEffectiveViewport, contentViewport);
				int lastVisibleIndex = ((ISortingAxis)this).GetLastVisibleIndex(rect, rect2, currentEffectiveViewport, contentViewport);
				if (firstVisibleIndex < 0 || lastVisibleIndex < 0)
				{
					return;
				}
				double num = double.NaN;
				for (int i = firstVisibleIndex; i <= lastVisibleIndex; i++)
				{
					int index = ((base.SortedDateTimeIndices == null) ? i : base.SortedDateTimeIndices[i]);
					double num2 = GetScaledValue(base.DateTimeColumn[index].Ticks, p);
					if (num2 == num)
					{
						continue;
					}
					num = num2;
					if (base.CategoryMode == CategoryMode.Mode2)
					{
						num2 += (base.IsInverted ? (0.0 - GetGroupCenter(i, rect, rect2, currentEffectiveViewport)) : GetGroupCenter(i, rect, rect2, currentEffectiveViewport));
					}
					if (num2 < contentViewport.Left || num2 > contentViewport.Right)
					{
						continue;
					}
					VerticalLine(majorLinesGeometry, num2, rect2, majorLinesPathInfo, isAxisLine: false);
					base.MajorLinePositions.Add(num2);
					if (base.FastItemsSource != null && i < base.FastItemsSource.Count)
					{
						object dataItem = base.FastItemsSource[index];
						object label = base.GetLabel(dataItem);
						if (!double.IsNaN(num2) && !double.IsInfinity(num2) && label != null && (!(label is string) || !((string)label).Equals("")))
						{
							base.LabelDataContext.Add(label);
							base.LabelPositions.Add(new LabelPosition(num2));
						}
					}
				}
			}
			else
			{
				double unscaledValue = GetUnscaledValue(contentViewport.Left, p);
				double unscaledValue2 = GetUnscaledValue(contentViewport.Right, p);
				double num3 = Math.Min(unscaledValue, unscaledValue2);
				double num4 = Math.Max(unscaledValue, unscaledValue2);
				LinearNumericSnapper linearNumericSnapper = new LinearNumericSnapper(num3, num4, contentViewport.Width, ResolveHeuristicResolution());
				double num5 = (HasUserInterval ? GetUserIntervalTicks() : linearNumericSnapper.Interval);
				SetActualIntervalInternal((long)num5);
				int num6 = (int)Math.Floor((num3 - (double)base.ActualMinimumValue.Ticks) / num5);
				int num7 = (int)Math.Ceiling((num4 - (double)base.ActualMinimumValue.Ticks) / num5);
				double num8 = 0.0;
				if (base.CategoryMode == CategoryMode.Mode2)
				{
					num8 = GetGroupCenter(0, rect, rect2, currentEffectiveViewport);
					num8 = (base.IsInverted ? (0.0 - num8) : num8);
				}
				int num9 = (int)Math.Ceiling(contentViewport.Right);
				int num10 = (int)Math.Floor(contentViewport.Left);
				double num11 = GetScaledValue((double)base.ActualMinimumValue.Ticks + (double)num6 * num5, p) + num8;
				for (int j = num6; j <= num7; j++)
				{
					double num12 = GetScaledValue((double)base.ActualMinimumValue.Ticks + (double)(j + 1) * num5, p) + num8;
					if (!double.IsNaN(num11) && !double.IsInfinity(num11))
					{
						int num13 = (int)Math.Round(num11);
						if (num13 <= num9)
						{
							if (j % 2 == 0)
							{
								VerticalStrip(stripsGeometry, num11, num12, rect2);
							}
							VerticalLine(majorLinesGeometry, num11, rect2, majorLinesPathInfo, isAxisLine: false);
							base.MajorLinePositions.Add(num11);
							if (base.ShouldRenderMinorLines)
							{
								long minorIntervalTicks = GetMinorIntervalTicks();
								if (minorIntervalTicks > 0 && (double)minorIntervalTicks < num5)
								{
									if (num5 / (double)minorIntervalTicks < 20.0)
									{
										double num14 = num11;
										double num15 = Math.Abs(GetScaledValue(base.ActualMinimumValue.Ticks + minorIntervalTicks, p) - GetScaledValue(base.ActualMinimumValue.Ticks, p));
										while (num14 + num15 < num12 && !(Math.Abs(num14 + num15 - num12) < 0.0001))
										{
											num14 += num15;
											if (num14 > 0.0)
											{
												VerticalLine(minorLinesGeometry, num14, rect2, minorLinesPathInfo, isAxisLine: false);
											}
										}
										SetActualMinorIntervalInternal(minorIntervalTicks);
									}
								}
								else
								{
									for (int k = 1; k < linearNumericSnapper.MinorCount; k++)
									{
										double x = GetScaledValue((double)base.ActualMinimumValue.Ticks + (double)j * num5 + (double)k * num5 / (double)linearNumericSnapper.MinorCount, p) + num8;
										VerticalLine(minorLinesGeometry, x, rect2, minorLinesPathInfo, isAxisLine: false);
									}
									if (linearNumericSnapper.MinorCount > 0)
									{
										SetActualMinorIntervalInternal((long)(num5 / (double)linearNumericSnapper.MinorCount));
									}
								}
							}
						}
						if (num13 >= num10 && num13 <= num9)
						{
							long val = (long)Math.Floor((double)base.ActualMinimumValue.Ticks + (double)j * num5);
							val = Math.Min(DateTime.MaxValue.Ticks, val);
							DateTime dateTime = new DateTime(val);
							object label2 = GetLabel(dateTime);
							if (label2 != null)
							{
								base.LabelDataContext.Add(label2);
								base.LabelPositions.Add(new LabelPosition(num11));
							}
						}
					}
					num11 = num12;
				}
			}
			if ((base.LabelSettings == null || base.LabelSettings.Visibility == Visibility.Visible) && base.CrossingAxis != null && base.LabelSettings != null && (base.LabelSettings.Location == AxisLabelsLocation.InsideTop || base.LabelSettings.Location == AxisLabelsLocation.InsideBottom))
			{
				base.SeriesViewer.InvalidatePanels();
			}
			base.LabelPanel.LabelDataContext = base.LabelDataContext;
			base.LabelPanel.LabelPositions = base.LabelPositions;
			RenderLabels();
		}

		protected virtual double GetUserIntervalTicks()
		{
			return ActualInterval.Ticks;
		}

		private long GetMinorIntervalTicks()
		{
			return MinorInterval.Ticks;
		}

		private void SetActualIntervalInternal(long ticks)
		{
			ActualInterval = new TimeSpan(ticks);
		}

		private void SetActualMinorIntervalInternal(long ticks)
		{
			ActualMinorInterval = new TimeSpan(ticks);
		}

		private bool IntervalIsSet()
		{
			return Interval != TimeSpan.Zero;
		}

		private bool ActualIntervalIsEmpty()
		{
			return ActualInterval == TimeSpan.Zero;
		}

		private DateTime GetDate(int index)
		{
			if (base.DateTimeColumn != null)
			{
				return base.DateTimeColumn[index];
			}
			return DateTime.MinValue;
		}

		[WCWidgetMemberName("scrollDateRangeIntoView")]
		public void ScrollIntoView(DateTime minimum, DateTime maximum)
		{
			if (!(minimum > maximum) && base.FastItemsSource != null && base.FastItemsSource.Count != 0)
			{
				double num = ((double)minimum.Ticks - (double)base.ActualMinimumValue.Ticks) / (double)(base.ActualMaximumValue.Ticks - base.ActualMinimumValue.Ticks);
				double num2 = ((double)maximum.Ticks - (double)base.ActualMinimumValue.Ticks) / (double)(base.ActualMaximumValue.Ticks - base.ActualMinimumValue.Ticks);
				base.SeriesViewer.WindowRect = new Rect(num, base.SeriesViewer.WindowRect.Y, num2 - num, base.SeriesViewer.WindowRect.Height);
			}
		}

		protected override void PropertyUpdatedOverride(object sender, string propertyName, object oldValue, object newValue)
		{
			base.PropertyUpdatedOverride(sender, propertyName, oldValue, newValue);
			if (!(propertyName == "DisplayType"))
			{
				if (propertyName == "Interval")
				{
					base.MustInvalidateLabels = true;
					RenderAxis(animate: false);
				}
			}
			else
			{
				base.MustInvalidateLabels = true;
				base.LabelPanel.AreLabelsUnevenlySpaced = DisplayType == TimeAxisDisplayType.Discrete;
				RenderAxis(animate: false);
			}
		}

		protected internal override void InitializeActualMinimumAndMaximum()
		{
			base.InitializeActualMinimumAndMaximum();
			if (IntervalIsSet())
			{
				ActualInterval = Interval;
				Rect rect = ((base.SeriesViewer != null) ? base.SeriesViewer.ActualWindowRect : Rect.Empty);
				Rect rect2 = ((!rect.IsEmpty) ? base.ViewportRect : Rect.Empty);
				long num = Math.Abs(base.ActualMaximumValue.Ticks - base.ActualMinimumValue.Ticks);
				HasUserInterval = ((!ActualIntervalIsEmpty() && DisplayType != TimeAxisDisplayType.Discrete && !(1.0 * (double)num / GetUserIntervalTicks() > rect2.Width / rect.Width)) ? true : false);
			}
			else
			{
				HasUserInterval = false;
			}
		}

		protected override TimeSpan Mode2TimeOffset(DateTime min, DateTime max)
		{
			TimeSpan timeSpan = TimeSpan.FromTicks((long)((double)((max.Ticks - min.Ticks) / base.ItemsCount) / 2.0));
			if (timeSpan == TimeSpan.Zero)
			{
				timeSpan = TimeSpan.FromMilliseconds(1.0);
			}
			return timeSpan;
		}
	}
	[WidgetModule("PolarChart")]
	[WidgetIgnoreDepends("XamDataChart")]
	public class NumericAngleAxis : NumericAxisBase, IAngleScaler
	{
		private bool _preventReentry;

		private double _lastCrossing = double.NaN;

		private double _startAngleOffsetRadians;

		internal const string StartAngleOffsetPropertyName = "StartAngleOffset";

		public static readonly DependencyProperty StartAngleOffsetProperty = DependencyProperty.Register("StartAngleOffset", typeof(double), typeof(NumericAngleAxis), new PropertyMetadata(0.0, delegate(DependencyObject sender, DependencyPropertyChangedEventArgs e)
		{
			((NumericAngleAxis)sender).RaisePropertyChanged("StartAngleOffset", e.OldValue, e.NewValue);
		}));

		private NumericRadiusAxis _radiusAxis;

		[TSSuppressSynthesizedInitializer]
		internal NumericAngleAxisView NumericAngleView { get; set; }

		internal PolarAxisRenderingManager RenderingManager { get; set; }

		public override bool IsAngular => true;

		[WidgetDefaultNumber(0.0)]
		public double StartAngleOffset
		{
			get
			{
				return (double)GetValue(StartAngleOffsetProperty);
			}
			set
			{
				SetValue(StartAngleOffsetProperty, value);
			}
		}

		protected internal NumericRadiusAxis RadiusAxis
		{
			get
			{
				if (_radiusAxis != null)
				{
					return _radiusAxis;
				}
				if (base.SeriesViewer is XamDataChart xamDataChart)
				{
					for (int i = 0; i < xamDataChart.Axes.Count; i++)
					{
						if (xamDataChart.Axes[i].IsRadial)
						{
							return (NumericRadiusAxis)xamDataChart.Axes[i];
						}
					}
				}
				return _radiusAxis;
			}
			set
			{
				_radiusAxis = value;
			}
		}

		protected internal override AxisOrientation Orientation => AxisOrientation.Angular;

		internal override AxisView CreateView()
		{
			return new NumericAngleAxisView(this);
		}

		internal override void OnViewCreated(AxisView view)
		{
			base.OnViewCreated(view);
			NumericAngleView = (NumericAngleAxisView)view;
		}

		public NumericAngleAxis()
		{
			base.DefaultStyleKey = typeof(NumericAngleAxis);
			RenderingManager = new PolarAxisRenderingManager();
			base.Renderer = CreateRenderer();
		}

		internal override AxisLabelPanelBase CreateLabelPanel()
		{
			return new AngleAxisLabelPanel
			{
				GetPoint = delegate(double v)
				{
					Rect windowRect = ((base.SeriesViewer != null) ? base.SeriesViewer.ActualWindowRect : Rect.Empty);
					Rect viewportRect = ((!windowRect.IsEmpty) ? base.ViewportRect : Rect.Empty);
					return GetLabelLocationPoint(v, new Point(0.5, 0.5), windowRect, viewportRect, base.LabelPanel.Extent);
				}
			};
		}

		private double GetCrossingValue()
		{
			if (RadiusAxis == null)
			{
				return 0.0;
			}
			if (!HasCrossingValue())
			{
				return RadiusAxis.GetEffectiveMaximumLength();
			}
			return RadiusAxis.GetScaledValue(Convert.ToDouble(base.CrossingValue));
		}

		private double Round10(double value)
		{
			return Math.Round(value, 10);
		}

		internal override NumericAxisRenderer CreateRenderer()
		{
			NumericAxisRenderer numericAxisRenderer = base.CreateRenderer();
			numericAxisRenderer.LabelManager.FloatPanelAction = delegate(double crossing)
			{
				if ((base.LabelSettings == null || base.LabelSettings.Visibility == Visibility.Visible) && RadiusAxis != null && _lastCrossing != crossing && base.SeriesViewer is XamDataChart xamDataChart)
				{
					_lastCrossing = crossing;
					base.LabelPanel.CrossingValue = crossing;
					xamDataChart.InvalidatePanels();
					foreach (Axis axis in xamDataChart.Axes)
					{
						if (axis != this && axis.LabelPanel is AngleAxisLabelPanel)
						{
							axis.View.LabelNeedRearrange();
						}
					}
				}
			};
			numericAxisRenderer.DetermineCrossingValue = delegate(AxisRenderingParametersBase p)
			{
				p.CrossingValue = GetCrossingValue();
				p.RelativeCrossingValue = p.CrossingValue;
			};
			numericAxisRenderer.AxisLine = delegate(AxisRenderingParametersBase p)
			{
				PolarAxisRenderingParameters polarAxisRenderingParameters = p as PolarAxisRenderingParameters;
				if (polarAxisRenderingParameters.CurrentRangeInfo == polarAxisRenderingParameters.RangeInfos[0])
				{
					RenderingManager.ConcentricLine(p.AxisGeometry, p.CrossingValue, p.ViewportRect, p.WindowRect, polarAxisRenderingParameters.Center, polarAxisRenderingParameters.MinAngle, polarAxisRenderingParameters.MaxAngle);
				}
			};
			numericAxisRenderer.Line = delegate(AxisRenderingParametersBase p, GeometryCollection g, double value)
			{
				PolarAxisRenderingParameters polarAxisRenderingParameters = p as PolarAxisRenderingParameters;
				RenderingManager.RadialLine(g, value, p.ViewportRect, p.WindowRect, polarAxisRenderingParameters.MinLength, polarAxisRenderingParameters.MaxLength, polarAxisRenderingParameters.Center);
			};
			numericAxisRenderer.Strip = delegate(AxisRenderingParametersBase p, GeometryCollection g, double start, double end)
			{
				PolarAxisRenderingParameters polarAxisRenderingParameters = p as PolarAxisRenderingParameters;
				RenderingManager.RadialStrip(g, start, end, polarAxisRenderingParameters.ViewportRect, p.WindowRect, polarAxisRenderingParameters.MinLength, polarAxisRenderingParameters.MaxLength, polarAxisRenderingParameters.Center);
			};
			numericAxisRenderer.CreateRenderingParams = (Rect viewportRect, Rect windowRect, Rect effectiveViewportRect, Rect contentViewport) => CreateRenderingParams(viewportRect, windowRect, effectiveViewportRect, contentViewport) as PolarAxisRenderingParameters;
			numericAxisRenderer.OnRendering = delegate
			{
				if (!_preventReentry)
				{
					_preventReentry = true;
					RadiusAxis.UpdateRange();
					_preventReentry = false;
				}
			};
			numericAxisRenderer.Scaling = (AxisRenderingParametersBase p, double unscaled) => GetScaledAngle(unscaled);
			numericAxisRenderer.ShouldRender = (Rect viewport, Rect window) => !window.IsEmpty && !viewport.IsEmpty && RadiusAxis != null;
			numericAxisRenderer.ShouldRenderLines = delegate(AxisRenderingParametersBase p, double value)
			{
				if (Round10(value - _startAngleOffsetRadians) < 0.0)
				{
					return false;
				}
				return !(Round10(value - _startAngleOffsetRadians - Math.PI * 2.0) > 0.0);
			};
			numericAxisRenderer.ShouldRenderLabel = delegate(AxisRenderingParametersBase p, double value, bool last)
			{
				PolarAxisRenderingParameters polarAxisRenderingParameters = p as PolarAxisRenderingParameters;
				Point labelLocationPoint = GetLabelLocationPoint(GetScaledAngle(polarAxisRenderingParameters.ActualMaximumValue), polarAxisRenderingParameters.Center, p.WindowRect, p.ViewportRect, 0.0);
				Point labelLocationPoint2 = GetLabelLocationPoint(value, polarAxisRenderingParameters.Center, p.WindowRect, p.ViewportRect, 0.0);
				if (last && MathUtil.Hypot(labelLocationPoint.X - labelLocationPoint2.X, labelLocationPoint.Y - labelLocationPoint2.Y) < 2.0)
				{
					return false;
				}
				return (labelLocationPoint2.X < p.ViewportRect.Right && labelLocationPoint2.X >= p.ViewportRect.Left && labelLocationPoint2.Y < p.ViewportRect.Bottom && labelLocationPoint2.Y >= p.ViewportRect.Top) ? true : false;
			};
			numericAxisRenderer.SnapMajorValue = delegate(AxisRenderingParametersBase p, double value, int i, double interval)
			{
				if (value < p.ActualMinimumValue && p.TickmarkValues is LogarithmicTickmarkValues)
				{
					return p.ActualMinimumValue;
				}
				return (value > p.ActualMaximumValue && (p.TickmarkValues is LogarithmicTickmarkValues || p.HasUserMax)) ? p.ActualMaximumValue : value;
			};
			return numericAxisRenderer;
		}

		private Point GetLabelLocationPoint(double angleValue, Point center, Rect windowRect, Rect viewportRect, double extent)
		{
			double crossingValue = GetCrossingValue();
			double num = ViewportUtils.TransformXFromViewportLength(extent, windowRect, viewportRect);
			if (base.LabelSettings != null && (base.LabelSettings.ActualLocation == AxisLabelsLocation.InsideBottom || base.LabelSettings.ActualLocation == AxisLabelsLocation.OutsideBottom))
			{
				num *= -1.0;
			}
			double xValue = center.X + (crossingValue + num) * Math.Cos(angleValue);
			double yValue = center.Y + (crossingValue + num) * Math.Sin(angleValue);
			double x = ViewportUtils.TransformXToViewport(xValue, windowRect, viewportRect);
			yValue = ViewportUtils.TransformYToViewport(yValue, windowRect, viewportRect);
			return new Point(x, yValue);
		}

		[JAVASuppressWidgetMember]
		[TSSuppressWidgetMember]
		[SwiftSuppressWidgetMember]
		[TreatAsNumber]
		public override double GetScaledValue(double unscaledValue, ScalerParams p)
		{
			return GetScaledAngle(unscaledValue);
		}

		internal double GetScaledAngle(double unscaledValue, bool isLogarithmic, bool isInverted)
		{
			double num = 0.0;
			num = ((!isLogarithmic) ? ((unscaledValue - base.ActualMinimumValue) / (base.ActualMaximumValue - base.ActualMinimumValue)) : ((Math.Log(unscaledValue) - base.logActualMinimumValue) / (base.logActualMaximumValue - base.logActualMinimumValue)));
			if (isInverted)
			{
				num = 1.0 - num;
			}
			return num * 2.0 * Math.PI + _startAngleOffsetRadians;
		}

		public double GetScaledAngle(double unscaledAngle)
		{
			return GetScaledAngle(unscaledAngle, base.IsReallyLogarithmic, base.IsInvertedCached);
		}

		[WFSuppressWidgetMember]
		public override double GetUnscaledValue([TreatAsNumber] double scaledValue, ScalerParams p)
		{
			return GetUnscaledAngle(scaledValue);
		}

		public double GetUnscaledAngle(double scaledAngle)
		{
			double num = (scaledAngle - _startAngleOffsetRadians) / (Math.PI * 2.0);
			if (base.IsInverted)
			{
				num = 1.0 - num;
			}
			if (base.IsReallyLogarithmic)
			{
				return Math.Exp(num * (base.logActualMaximumValue - base.logActualMinimumValue) + base.logActualMinimumValue);
			}
			return base.ActualMinimumValue + num * (base.ActualMaximumValue - base.ActualMinimumValue);
		}

		protected override void PropertyUpdatedOverride(object sender, string propertyName, object oldValue, object newValue)
		{
			base.PropertyUpdatedOverride(sender, propertyName, oldValue, newValue);
			XamDataChart xamDataChart = base.SeriesViewer as XamDataChart;
			switch (propertyName)
			{
			case "CrossingAxis":
			{
				NumericRadiusAxis numericRadiusAxis = newValue as NumericRadiusAxis;
				OnRadiusAxisChanged(numericRadiusAxis);
				numericRadiusAxis?.OnAngleAxisChanged(this);
				RenderAxis(animate: false);
				break;
			}
			case "StartAngleOffset":
				for (_startAngleOffsetRadians = StartAngleOffset; _startAngleOffsetRadians < 0.0; _startAngleOffsetRadians += 360.0)
				{
				}
				while (_startAngleOffsetRadians >= 360.0)
				{
					_startAngleOffsetRadians -= 360.0;
				}
				_startAngleOffsetRadians = StartAngleOffset * Math.PI / 180.0;
				RenderAxis(animate: false);
				{
					foreach (Series item in DirectSeries())
					{
						item.RenderSeries(animate: false);
						item.NotifyThumbnailAppearanceChanged();
					}
					break;
				}
			case "Label":
				if (xamDataChart == null)
				{
					break;
				}
				{
					foreach (Axis axis in xamDataChart.Axes)
					{
						axis.RenderAxis();
					}
					break;
				}
			case "CrossingValue":
				if (xamDataChart == null)
				{
					break;
				}
				{
					foreach (Axis axis2 in xamDataChart.Axes)
					{
						if (axis2 is NumericAngleAxis || axis2 is CategoryAngleAxis)
						{
							axis2.RenderAxis();
						}
					}
					break;
				}
			case "LabelSettings":
				base.Renderer = CreateRenderer();
				ForcePanelRefloat();
				base.MustInvalidateLabels = true;
				RenderAxis(animate: false);
				break;
			}
		}

		private void ForcePanelRefloat()
		{
			_lastCrossing = double.NaN;
		}

		internal override NumericAxisRenderingParameters CreateRenderingParamsInstance()
		{
			return new PolarAxisRenderingParameters();
		}

		internal override NumericAxisRenderingParameters CreateRenderingParams(Rect viewportRect, Rect windowRect, Rect effectiveViewportRect, Rect contentViewport)
		{
			PolarAxisRenderingParameters polarAxisRenderingParameters = base.CreateRenderingParams(viewportRect, windowRect, effectiveViewportRect, contentViewport) as PolarAxisRenderingParameters;
			double closestRadiusValue = RenderingManager.GetClosestRadiusValue(windowRect);
			double furthestRadiusValue = RenderingManager.GetFurthestRadiusValue(windowRect);
			double num = 0.5 * RadiusAxis.ActualRadiusExtentScale;
			double num2 = 0.5 * RadiusAxis.ActualInnerRadiusExtentScale;
			double num3 = closestRadiusValue;
			double num4 = furthestRadiusValue;
			double effectiveMaximumLength = RadiusAxis.GetEffectiveMaximumLength();
			if (double.IsNaN(effectiveMaximumLength) || double.IsInfinity(effectiveMaximumLength))
			{
				return null;
			}
			if (num4 >= num)
			{
				num4 = effectiveMaximumLength;
			}
			if (num3 < num2)
			{
				num3 = num2;
			}
			double width = viewportRect.Width;
			RenderingManager.DetermineView(windowRect, polarAxisRenderingParameters, base.ActualMinimumValue, base.ActualMaximumValue, base.IsInverted, GetUnscaledAngle, width);
			Point center = new Point(0.5, 0.5);
			polarAxisRenderingParameters.Center = center;
			polarAxisRenderingParameters.MaxLength = num4;
			polarAxisRenderingParameters.MinLength = num3;
			polarAxisRenderingParameters.EffectiveMaximum = effectiveMaximumLength;
			return polarAxisRenderingParameters;
		}

		internal void GetMinMaxAngle(Rect windowRect, out double minAngle, out double maxAngle)
		{
			RenderingManager.GetMinMaxAngle(windowRect, out minAngle, out maxAngle);
		}

		void IAngleScaler.GetMinMaxAngle(Rect windowRect, out double minAngle, out double maxAngle)
		{
			GetMinMaxAngle(windowRect, out minAngle, out maxAngle);
		}

		protected override void RenderAxisOverride(bool animate)
		{
			base.RenderAxisOverride(animate);
			Rect windowRect = ((base.SeriesViewer != null) ? base.SeriesViewer.ActualWindowRect : Rect.Empty);
			Rect viewportRect = ((!windowRect.IsEmpty) ? base.ViewportRect : Rect.Empty);
			Rect currentEffectiveViewport = GetCurrentEffectiveViewport();
			Rect contentViewport = GetContentViewport();
			AxisRenderingParametersBase axisRenderingParametersBase = base.Renderer.Render(animate, viewportRect, windowRect, currentEffectiveViewport, contentViewport);
			if (axisRenderingParametersBase != null)
			{
				base.ActualInterval = axisRenderingParametersBase.TickmarkValues.Interval;
				base.ActualMinorInterval = axisRenderingParametersBase.TickmarkValues.ActualMinorInterval;
			}
		}

		protected internal override Axis ResolveCrossingAxis()
		{
			return RadiusAxis;
		}

		internal void OnRadiusAxisChanged(NumericRadiusAxis numericRadiusAxis)
		{
			RadiusAxis = numericRadiusAxis;
		}

		protected override void ViewportChangedOverride(Rect oldRect, Rect newRect)
		{
			base.ViewportChangedOverride(oldRect, newRect);
			if (newRect.Height != oldRect.Height || newRect.Width != oldRect.Width)
			{
				UpdateRange();
			}
		}

		protected internal override Geometry GetOverlayGeometry(double scaledValue, Rect windowRect, Rect viewport, object effectiveViewport = null, object contentViewport = null)
		{
			if (RadiusAxis == null)
			{
				return null;
			}
			if (!(CreateRenderingParams(viewport, windowRect, (Rect)effectiveViewport, (Rect)contentViewport) is PolarAxisRenderingParameters polarAxisRenderingParameters))
			{
				return null;
			}
			double num = Math.Cos(scaledValue);
			double num2 = Math.Sin(scaledValue);
			double xValue = polarAxisRenderingParameters.Center.X + num * polarAxisRenderingParameters.MinLength;
			double yValue = polarAxisRenderingParameters.Center.Y + num2 * polarAxisRenderingParameters.MinLength;
			double xValue2 = polarAxisRenderingParameters.Center.X + num * polarAxisRenderingParameters.MaxLength;
			double yValue2 = polarAxisRenderingParameters.Center.Y + num2 * polarAxisRenderingParameters.MaxLength;
			xValue = ViewportUtils.TransformXToViewport(xValue, windowRect, viewport);
			yValue = ViewportUtils.TransformYToViewport(yValue, windowRect, viewport);
			xValue2 = ViewportUtils.TransformXToViewport(xValue2, windowRect, viewport);
			yValue2 = ViewportUtils.TransformYToViewport(yValue2, windowRect, viewport);
			return new LineGeometry
			{
				StartPoint = new Point(xValue, yValue),
				EndPoint = new Point(xValue2, yValue2)
			};
		}
	}
	[WidgetModule("PolarChart")]
	[WidgetModule("RadialChart")]
	[WidgetIgnoreDepends("XamDataChart")]
	[WidgetIgnoreDepends("NumericAngleAxis")]
	[WidgetIgnoreDepends("CategoryAngleAxis")]
	public class NumericRadiusAxis : NumericAxisBase
	{
		private PolarAxisRenderingManager renderingManager;

		private double _lastCrossing = double.NaN;

		internal const string RadiusExtentScalePropertyName = "RadiusExtentScale";

		public static readonly DependencyProperty RadiusExtentScaleProperty = DependencyProperty.Register("RadiusExtentScale", typeof(double), typeof(NumericRadiusAxis), new PropertyMetadata(0.75, delegate(DependencyObject sender, DependencyPropertyChangedEventArgs e)
		{
			((NumericRadiusAxis)sender).RaisePropertyChanged("RadiusExtentScale", e.OldValue, e.NewValue);
		}));

		internal const string InnerRadiusExtentScalePropertyName = "InnerRadiusExtentScale";

		public static readonly DependencyProperty InnerRadiusExtentScaleProperty = DependencyProperty.Register("InnerRadiusExtentScale", typeof(double), typeof(NumericRadiusAxis), new PropertyMetadata(0.0, delegate(DependencyObject sender, DependencyPropertyChangedEventArgs e)
		{
			((NumericRadiusAxis)sender).RaisePropertyChanged("InnerRadiusExtentScale", e.OldValue, e.NewValue);
		}));

		private Axis _angleAxis;

		[TSSuppressSynthesizedInitializer]
		internal NumericRadiusAxisView NumericRadiusView { get; set; }

		public override bool IsRadial => true;

		internal bool Suppress { get; set; }

		[WidgetDefaultNumber(0.75)]
		public double RadiusExtentScale
		{
			get
			{
				return (double)GetValue(RadiusExtentScaleProperty);
			}
			set
			{
				SetValue(RadiusExtentScaleProperty, value);
			}
		}

		internal double ActualRadiusExtentScale { get; set; }

		[WidgetDefaultNumber(0.0)]
		public double InnerRadiusExtentScale
		{
			get
			{
				return (double)GetValue(InnerRadiusExtentScaleProperty);
			}
			set
			{
				SetValue(InnerRadiusExtentScaleProperty, value);
			}
		}

		internal double ActualInnerRadiusExtentScale { get; set; }

		protected double CrossingValueRadians { get; set; }

		protected internal Axis AngleAxis
		{
			get
			{
				if (_angleAxis != null)
				{
					return _angleAxis;
				}
				if (base.SeriesViewer is XamDataChart xamDataChart)
				{
					for (int i = 0; i < xamDataChart.Axes.Count; i++)
					{
						if (xamDataChart.Axes[i] is NumericAngleAxis || xamDataChart.Axes[i] is CategoryAngleAxis)
						{
							return xamDataChart.Axes[i];
						}
					}
				}
				return _angleAxis;
			}
			set
			{
				_angleAxis = value;
			}
		}

		protected internal override AxisOrientation Orientation => AxisOrientation.Radial;

		internal override AxisView CreateView()
		{
			return new NumericRadiusAxisView(this);
		}

		internal override void OnViewCreated(AxisView view)
		{
			base.OnViewCreated(view);
			NumericRadiusView = (NumericRadiusAxisView)view;
		}

		protected internal override double GetResolutionExtent()
		{
			double actualRadiusExtentScale = ActualRadiusExtentScale;
			double actualInnerRadiusExtentScale = ActualInnerRadiusExtentScale;
			return Math.Max(Math.Min(GetAxisWidth(), GetAxisHeight()) * (actualRadiusExtentScale - actualInnerRadiusExtentScale) / 2.0, 14.0);
		}

		private double GetAxisWidth()
		{
			return base.ActualWidth;
		}

		private double GetAxisHeight()
		{
			return base.ActualHeight;
		}

		public NumericRadiusAxis()
		{
			base.DefaultStyleKey = typeof(NumericRadiusAxis);
			ActualRadiusExtentScale = RadiusExtentScale;
			ActualInnerRadiusExtentScale = InnerRadiusExtentScale;
			renderingManager = new PolarAxisRenderingManager();
			base.Renderer = CreateRenderer();
		}

		internal override AxisLabelPanelBase CreateLabelPanel()
		{
			return new RadialAxisLabelPanel();
		}

		private double ConvertToDouble(object x)
		{
			return Convert.ToDouble(x);
		}

		internal override NumericAxisRenderer CreateRenderer()
		{
			NumericAxisRenderer numericAxisRenderer = base.CreateRenderer();
			numericAxisRenderer.LabelManager.FloatPanelAction = delegate(double crossing)
			{
				if ((base.LabelSettings == null || base.LabelSettings.Visibility == Visibility.Visible) && AngleAxis != null && (base.LabelSettings == null || base.LabelSettings.ActualLocation == AxisLabelsLocation.InsideTop || base.LabelSettings.ActualLocation == AxisLabelsLocation.InsideBottom) && _lastCrossing != crossing)
				{
					_lastCrossing = crossing;
					base.LabelPanel.CrossingValue = crossing;
					base.SeriesViewer.InvalidatePanels();
				}
			};
			numericAxisRenderer.Line = delegate(AxisRenderingParametersBase p, GeometryCollection g, double value)
			{
				PolarAxisRenderingParameters polarAxisRenderingParameters = p as PolarAxisRenderingParameters;
				renderingManager.ConcentricLine(g, value, polarAxisRenderingParameters.ViewportRect, polarAxisRenderingParameters.WindowRect, polarAxisRenderingParameters.Center, polarAxisRenderingParameters.MinAngle, polarAxisRenderingParameters.MaxAngle);
			};
			numericAxisRenderer.Strip = delegate(AxisRenderingParametersBase p, GeometryCollection g, double start, double end)
			{
				if (start != end)
				{
					PolarAxisRenderingParameters polarAxisRenderingParameters = p as PolarAxisRenderingParameters;
					renderingManager.ConcentricStrip(g, start, end, polarAxisRenderingParameters.ViewportRect, polarAxisRenderingParameters.WindowRect, polarAxisRenderingParameters.Center, polarAxisRenderingParameters.MinAngle, polarAxisRenderingParameters.MaxAngle);
				}
			};
			numericAxisRenderer.Scaling = (AxisRenderingParametersBase p, double unscaled) => GetScaledValue(unscaled);
			numericAxisRenderer.ShouldRenderLines = delegate(AxisRenderingParametersBase p, double value)
			{
				PolarAxisRenderingParameters polarAxisRenderingParameters = p as PolarAxisRenderingParameters;
				return value <= polarAxisRenderingParameters.EffectiveMaximum;
			};
			numericAxisRenderer.ShouldRenderContent = delegate(AxisRenderingParametersBase p, double value)
			{
				PolarAxisRenderingParameters polarAxisRenderingParameters = p as PolarAxisRenderingParameters;
				return value <= polarAxisRenderingParameters.EffectiveMaximum;
			};
			numericAxisRenderer.AxisLine = delegate(AxisRenderingParametersBase p)
			{
				PolarAxisRenderingParameters polarAxisRenderingParameters = p as PolarAxisRenderingParameters;
				renderingManager.RadialLine(p.AxisGeometry, polarAxisRenderingParameters.CrossingAngleRadians, p.ViewportRect, p.WindowRect, polarAxisRenderingParameters.MinLength, polarAxisRenderingParameters.MaxLength, polarAxisRenderingParameters.Center);
			};
			numericAxisRenderer.DetermineCrossingValue = delegate(AxisRenderingParametersBase p)
			{
				p.CrossingValue = ((base.LabelSettings == null || base.LabelSettings.ActualLocation == AxisLabelsLocation.InsideTop || base.LabelSettings.ActualLocation == AxisLabelsLocation.OutsideTop) ? p.ViewportRect.Top : p.ViewportRect.Bottom);
				p.RelativeCrossingValue = p.CrossingValue;
				PolarAxisRenderingParameters polarAxisRenderingParameters = p as PolarAxisRenderingParameters;
				polarAxisRenderingParameters.CrossingAngleRadians = ConvertToDouble(base.CrossingValue) * Math.PI / 180.0;
				if (base.LabelSettings == null || base.LabelSettings.ActualLocation == AxisLabelsLocation.InsideTop || base.LabelSettings.ActualLocation == AxisLabelsLocation.InsideBottom)
				{
					polarAxisRenderingParameters.CrossingValue = ViewportUtils.TransformYToViewport(0.5, polarAxisRenderingParameters.WindowRect, polarAxisRenderingParameters.ViewportRect) - p.ViewportRect.Top;
					polarAxisRenderingParameters.RelativeCrossingValue = polarAxisRenderingParameters.CrossingValue;
					if (base.LabelPanel is RadialAxisLabelPanel radialAxisLabelPanel)
					{
						double y = 0.0;
						if (base.LabelSettings != null && base.LabelSettings.ActualLocation == AxisLabelsLocation.InsideTop)
						{
							y = 1.0;
						}
						radialAxisLabelPanel.RotationCenter = new Point(ViewportUtils.TransformXToViewport(0.5, polarAxisRenderingParameters.WindowRect, polarAxisRenderingParameters.ViewportRect), y);
						radialAxisLabelPanel.CrossingAngle = polarAxisRenderingParameters.CrossingAngleRadians;
					}
				}
			};
			numericAxisRenderer.ShouldRenderLabel = delegate(AxisRenderingParametersBase p, double v, bool last)
			{
				PolarAxisRenderingParameters polarAxisRenderingParameters = p as PolarAxisRenderingParameters;
				if (AngleAxis == null)
				{
					return false;
				}
				if (v > polarAxisRenderingParameters.EffectiveMaximum)
				{
					return false;
				}
				bool flag = false;
				flag = base.LabelSettings == null || base.LabelSettings.ActualLocation == AxisLabelsLocation.InsideTop || base.LabelSettings.ActualLocation == AxisLabelsLocation.InsideBottom;
				double num = 0.0;
				if (flag)
				{
					num = CrossingValueRadians;
				}
				double xValue = polarAxisRenderingParameters.Center.X + v * Math.Cos(num);
				double yValue = polarAxisRenderingParameters.Center.Y + v * Math.Sin(num);
				xValue = ViewportUtils.TransformXToViewport(xValue, polarAxisRenderingParameters.WindowRect, polarAxisRenderingParameters.ViewportRect);
				yValue = ViewportUtils.TransformYToViewport(yValue, polarAxisRenderingParameters.WindowRect, polarAxisRenderingParameters.ViewportRect);
				return (xValue <= p.ViewportRect.Right && xValue >= p.ViewportRect.Left && ((yValue <= p.ViewportRect.Bottom && yValue >= p.ViewportRect.Top) || !flag)) ? true : false;
			};
			numericAxisRenderer.GetLabelLocation = delegate(AxisRenderingParametersBase p, double value)
			{
				PolarAxisRenderingParameters polarAxisRenderingParameters = p as PolarAxisRenderingParameters;
				return new LabelPosition(ViewportUtils.TransformXToViewport(polarAxisRenderingParameters.Center.X + value, polarAxisRenderingParameters.WindowRect, polarAxisRenderingParameters.ViewportRect));
			};
			numericAxisRenderer.SnapMajorValue = delegate(AxisRenderingParametersBase p, double value, int i, double interval)
			{
				if (value < p.ActualMinimumValue)
				{
					return p.ActualMinimumValue;
				}
				return (value > p.ActualMaximumValue) ? p.ActualMaximumValue : value;
			};
			return numericAxisRenderer;
		}

		[WFSuppressWidgetMember]
		[JAVASuppressWidgetMember]
		[TSSuppressWidgetMember]
		[SwiftSuppressWidgetMember]
		public override double GetScaledValue(double unscaledValue, ScalerParams p)
		{
			return GetScaledValue(unscaledValue);
		}

		internal double GetScaledValue(double unscaledValue, bool isLogarithmic, bool isInverted, double radiusExtentScale, double innerRadiusExtentScale)
		{
			double num = 0.0;
			num = ((!isLogarithmic) ? ((unscaledValue - base.ActualMinimumValue) / (base.ActualMaximumValue - base.ActualMinimumValue)) : ((!(unscaledValue <= 0.0)) ? ((Math.Log(unscaledValue) - base.logActualMinimumValue) / (base.logActualMaximumValue - base.logActualMinimumValue)) : ((Math.Log(base.ActualMinimumValue) - base.logActualMinimumValue) / (base.logActualMaximumValue - base.logActualMinimumValue))));
			if (isInverted)
			{
				num = 1.0 - num;
			}
			num = innerRadiusExtentScale + num * (radiusExtentScale - innerRadiusExtentScale);
			return num / 2.0;
		}

		[TreatAsPX]
		public double GetScaledValue(double unscaledValue)
		{
			return GetScaledValue(unscaledValue, base.IsReallyLogarithmic, base.IsInvertedCached, ActualRadiusExtentScale, ActualInnerRadiusExtentScale);
		}

		[WFSuppressWidgetMember]
		public double GetUnscaledValue(double scaledValue)
		{
			double num = scaledValue * 2.0;
			num = (num - ActualInnerRadiusExtentScale) / (ActualRadiusExtentScale - ActualInnerRadiusExtentScale);
			if (base.IsInverted)
			{
				num = 1.0 - num;
			}
			if (base.IsReallyLogarithmic)
			{
				return Math.Exp(num * (base.logActualMaximumValue - base.logActualMinimumValue) + base.logActualMinimumValue);
			}
			return base.ActualMinimumValue + num * (base.ActualMaximumValue - base.ActualMinimumValue);
		}

		[WFSuppressWidgetMember]
		[JAVASuppressWidgetMember]
		[TSSuppressWidgetMember]
		[SwiftSuppressWidgetMember]
		public override double GetUnscaledValue(double scaledValue, ScalerParams p)
		{
			return GetUnscaledValue(scaledValue);
		}

		protected override void PropertyUpdatedOverride(object sender, string propertyName, object oldValue, object newValue)
		{
			if (propertyName == "CrossingValue")
			{
				CrossingValueRadians = ConvertToDouble(base.CrossingValue) * Math.PI / 180.0;
			}
			base.PropertyUpdatedOverride(sender, propertyName, oldValue, newValue);
			switch (propertyName)
			{
			case "RadiusExtentScale":
				ActualRadiusExtentScale = RadiusExtentScale;
				if (ActualRadiusExtentScale < 0.0)
				{
					ActualRadiusExtentScale = 0.1;
				}
				if (ActualRadiusExtentScale > 1.0)
				{
					ActualRadiusExtentScale = 1.0;
				}
				if (ActualInnerRadiusExtentScale >= ActualRadiusExtentScale)
				{
					ActualInnerRadiusExtentScale = ActualRadiusExtentScale - 0.01;
					if (ActualInnerRadiusExtentScale < 0.0)
					{
						ActualInnerRadiusExtentScale = 0.0;
						ActualRadiusExtentScale = 0.01;
					}
				}
				base.MustInvalidateLabels = true;
				RenderAxis(animate: false);
				if (AngleAxis != null)
				{
					AngleAxis.RenderAxis();
					foreach (Series item in AngleAxis.Series)
					{
						if (item is ValueOverlay)
						{
							item.RenderSeries(animate: false);
						}
					}
				}
				{
					foreach (Series item2 in DirectSeries())
					{
						item2.RenderSeries(animate: false);
					}
					break;
				}
			case "InnerRadiusExtentScale":
				ActualInnerRadiusExtentScale = InnerRadiusExtentScale;
				if (ActualInnerRadiusExtentScale < 0.0)
				{
					ActualInnerRadiusExtentScale = 0.1;
				}
				if (ActualInnerRadiusExtentScale > 1.0)
				{
					ActualInnerRadiusExtentScale = 1.0;
				}
				if (ActualInnerRadiusExtentScale >= ActualRadiusExtentScale)
				{
					ActualInnerRadiusExtentScale = ActualRadiusExtentScale - 0.01;
					if (ActualInnerRadiusExtentScale < 0.0)
					{
						ActualInnerRadiusExtentScale = 0.0;
						ActualRadiusExtentScale = 0.01;
					}
				}
				base.MustInvalidateLabels = true;
				RenderAxis(animate: false);
				if (AngleAxis != null)
				{
					AngleAxis.RenderAxis();
					foreach (Series item3 in AngleAxis.Series)
					{
						if (item3 is ValueOverlay)
						{
							item3.RenderSeries(animate: false);
						}
					}
				}
				foreach (Series item4 in DirectSeries())
				{
					item4.ThumbnailDirty = true;
					item4.RenderSeries(animate: false);
				}
				if (base.SeriesViewer != null)
				{
					base.SeriesViewer.NotifyThumbnailAppearanceChanged();
				}
				break;
			case "CrossingAxis":
			{
				NumericAngleAxis numericAngleAxis = newValue as NumericAngleAxis;
				CategoryAngleAxis categoryAngleAxis = newValue as CategoryAngleAxis;
				if (numericAngleAxis == null && categoryAngleAxis == null)
				{
					OnAngleAxisChanged(null);
				}
				if (numericAngleAxis != null)
				{
					OnAngleAxisChanged(numericAngleAxis);
					numericAngleAxis.OnRadiusAxisChanged(this);
				}
				if (categoryAngleAxis != null)
				{
					OnAngleAxisChanged(categoryAngleAxis);
					categoryAngleAxis.OnRadiusAxisChanged(this);
				}
				base.MustInvalidateLabels = true;
				RenderAxis(animate: false);
				break;
			}
			case "IsInverted":
				if (AngleAxis != null)
				{
					AngleAxis.MustInvalidateLabels = true;
					AngleAxis.RenderAxis(animate: false);
				}
				break;
			}
		}

		protected internal virtual void OnAngleAxisChanged(Axis angleAxis)
		{
			AngleAxis = angleAxis;
		}

		protected internal override Axis ResolveCrossingAxis()
		{
			return AngleAxis;
		}

		internal override NumericAxisRenderingParameters CreateRenderingParamsInstance()
		{
			return new PolarAxisRenderingParameters();
		}

		internal override NumericAxisRenderingParameters CreateRenderingParams(Rect viewportRect, Rect windowRect, Rect effectiveViewportRect, Rect contentViewport)
		{
			PolarAxisRenderingParameters polarAxisRenderingParameters = base.CreateRenderingParams(viewportRect, windowRect, effectiveViewportRect, contentViewport) as PolarAxisRenderingParameters;
			double closestRadiusValue = renderingManager.GetClosestRadiusValue(windowRect);
			double furthestRadiusValue = renderingManager.GetFurthestRadiusValue(windowRect);
			double num = 0.5 * ActualRadiusExtentScale;
			double num2 = 0.5 * ActualInnerRadiusExtentScale;
			double visibleMinimum;
			double visibleMaximum;
			if (windowRect == SeriesViewer.StandardRect)
			{
				visibleMaximum = base.ActualMaximumValue;
				visibleMinimum = base.ActualMinimumValue;
			}
			else
			{
				visibleMaximum = Math.Min(furthestRadiusValue, num);
				visibleMinimum = GetUnscaledValue(closestRadiusValue);
				visibleMaximum = GetUnscaledValue(visibleMaximum);
				SnapVisibleExtents(viewportRect, windowRect, ref visibleMinimum, ref visibleMaximum);
			}
			Point center = new Point(0.5, 0.5);
			double num3 = closestRadiusValue;
			double num4 = furthestRadiusValue;
			double resolution = Math.Min(viewportRect.Width, viewportRect.Height) * (ActualRadiusExtentScale - ActualInnerRadiusExtentScale) / 2.0;
			polarAxisRenderingParameters.Center = center;
			double maxLength = Math.Max(num4, num3);
			double minLength = Math.Min(num3, num4);
			polarAxisRenderingParameters.MaxLength = maxLength;
			polarAxisRenderingParameters.MinLength = minLength;
			double num5 = Math.Min(visibleMinimum, visibleMaximum);
			double num6 = Math.Max(visibleMinimum, visibleMaximum);
			if (num5 < base.ActualMinimumValue)
			{
				num5 = base.ActualMinimumValue;
			}
			if (num6 > base.ActualMaximumValue)
			{
				num6 = base.ActualMaximumValue;
			}
			base.ActualVisibleMinimumValue = num5;
			base.ActualVisibleMaximumValue = num6;
			polarAxisRenderingParameters.RangeInfos.Add(new RangeInfo
			{
				VisibleMinimum = num5,
				VisibleMaximum = num6,
				Resolution = resolution
			});
			if (AngleAxis is IAngleScaler angleScaler)
			{
				angleScaler.GetMinMaxAngle(windowRect, out var minAngle, out var maxAngle);
				polarAxisRenderingParameters.MinAngle = Math.Min(minAngle, maxAngle);
				polarAxisRenderingParameters.MaxAngle = Math.Max(minAngle, maxAngle);
			}
			double effectiveMaximumLength = GetEffectiveMaximumLength();
			if (num4 >= num)
			{
				num4 = effectiveMaximumLength;
			}
			if (num3 < num2)
			{
				num3 = num2;
			}
			polarAxisRenderingParameters.MinLength = num3;
			polarAxisRenderingParameters.MaxLength = num4;
			polarAxisRenderingParameters.EffectiveMaximum = effectiveMaximumLength;
			polarAxisRenderingParameters.TickmarkValues = base.ActualTickmarkValues;
			if (polarAxisRenderingParameters.TickmarkValues is LinearTickmarkValues linearTickmarkValues)
			{
				linearTickmarkValues.MinTicks = GetMinTicks(center, polarAxisRenderingParameters.MinLength, polarAxisRenderingParameters.MaxLength, windowRect, viewportRect);
			}
			return polarAxisRenderingParameters;
		}

		private void SnapVisibleExtents(Rect viewportRect, Rect windowRect, ref double visibleMinimum, ref double visibleMaximum)
		{
			Point point = new Point(0.5, 0.5);
			double num = 0.0;
			num = ((!base.IsInverted) ? GetScaledValue(base.ActualMaximumValue) : GetScaledValue(base.ActualMinimumValue));
			double num2 = 0.0;
			if (base.CrossingValue != null)
			{
				num2 = CrossingValueRadians;
			}
			double xValue = point.X + num * Math.Cos(num2);
			double yValue = point.Y + num * Math.Sin(num2);
			point.X = ViewportUtils.TransformXToViewport(point.X, windowRect, viewportRect);
			point.Y = ViewportUtils.TransformYToViewport(point.Y, windowRect, viewportRect);
			xValue = ViewportUtils.TransformXToViewport(xValue, windowRect, viewportRect);
			yValue = ViewportUtils.TransformYToViewport(yValue, windowRect, viewportRect);
			if (xValue >= viewportRect.Left && xValue <= viewportRect.Right && yValue >= viewportRect.Top && yValue <= viewportRect.Bottom)
			{
				if (base.IsInverted)
				{
					visibleMaximum = base.ActualMinimumValue;
				}
				else
				{
					visibleMaximum = base.ActualMaximumValue;
				}
			}
			if (point.X >= viewportRect.Left && point.X <= viewportRect.Right && point.Y >= viewportRect.Top && point.Y <= viewportRect.Bottom)
			{
				if (base.IsInverted)
				{
					visibleMinimum = base.ActualMaximumValue;
				}
				else
				{
					visibleMinimum = base.ActualMinimumValue;
				}
			}
		}

		private int GetMinTicks(Point center, double minLen, double maxLen, Rect windowRect, Rect viewportRect)
		{

		}

			{

			}
		}

		protected internal override Geometry GetOverlayGeometry(double scaledValue, Rect windowRect, Rect viewport, object effectiveViewport = null, object contentViewport = null)
		{
			PolarAxisRenderingParameters polarAxisRenderingParameters = CreateRenderingParams(viewport, windowRect, (Rect)effectiveViewport, (Rect)contentViewport) as PolarAxisRenderingParameters;
			PathGeometry pathGeometry = new PathGeometry();
			double num = ViewportUtils.TransformXToViewportLength(scaledValue, windowRect, viewport);
			double num2 = ViewportUtils.TransformYToViewportLength(scaledValue, windowRect, viewport);
			if (num <= 0.0 || num2 <= 0.0)
			{
				return null;
			}
			double x = ViewportUtils.TransformXToViewport(polarAxisRenderingParameters.Center.X, windowRect, viewport);
			double num3 = ViewportUtils.TransformYToViewport(polarAxisRenderingParameters.Center.Y, windowRect, viewport);
			if (polarAxisRenderingParameters.MaxAngle - polarAxisRenderingParameters.MinAngle < Math.PI && polarAxisRenderingParameters.MaxAngle - polarAxisRenderingParameters.MinAngle > 0.0)
			{
				Point startPoint = new Point(ViewportUtils.TransformXToViewport(polarAxisRenderingParameters.Center.X + scaledValue * Math.Cos(polarAxisRenderingParameters.MinAngle), windowRect, viewport), ViewportUtils.TransformYToViewport(polarAxisRenderingParameters.Center.Y + scaledValue * Math.Sin(polarAxisRenderingParameters.MinAngle), windowRect, viewport));
				Point point = new Point(ViewportUtils.TransformXToViewport(polarAxisRenderingParameters.Center.X + scaledValue * Math.Cos(polarAxisRenderingParameters.MaxAngle), windowRect, viewport), ViewportUtils.TransformYToViewport(polarAxisRenderingParameters.Center.Y + scaledValue * Math.Sin(polarAxisRenderingParameters.MaxAngle), windowRect, viewport));
				PathFigure pathFigure = new PathFigure();
				pathFigure.StartPoint = startPoint;
				pathFigure.IsClosed = false;
				pathFigure.Segments.Add(new ArcSegment
				{
					IsLargeArc = false,
					Point = point,
					Size = new Size(num, num2),
					SweepDirection = SweepDirection.Clockwise
				});
				pathGeometry.Figures.Add(pathFigure);
			}
			else
			{
				PathFigure pathFigure2 = new PathFigure();
				pathFigure2.StartPoint = new Point(x, num3 - num2);
				pathFigure2.IsClosed = true;
				pathFigure2.Segments.Add(new ArcSegment
				{
					IsLargeArc = false,
					Point = new Point(x, num3 + num2),
					Size = new Size(num, num2),
					SweepDirection = SweepDirection.Clockwise
				});
				pathFigure2.Segments.Add(new ArcSegment
				{
					IsLargeArc = false,
					Point = new Point(x, num3 - num2),
					Size = new Size(num, num2),
					SweepDirection = SweepDirection.Clockwise
				});
				pathGeometry.Figures.Add(pathFigure2);
			}
			return pathGeometry;
		}

		public override double GetScaledValue(double unscaledValue, ScalerParams p)
		{
			if (!p.EffectiveViewportRect.IsEmpty)
			{
				double scaledValueHelper = GetScaledValueHelper(unscaledValue, NumericScaler.UnitRect, p.EffectiveViewportRect);
				scaledValueHelper = (scaledValueHelper - p.ViewportRect.Left) / p.ViewportRect.Width;
				return p.ViewportRect.Left + p.ViewportRect.Width * (scaledValueHelper - p.WindowRect.Left) / p.WindowRect.Width;
			}
			return GetScaledValueHelper(unscaledValue, p.WindowRect, p.ViewportRect);
		}

		private double GetScaledValueHelper(double unscaledValue, Rect windowRect, Rect viewportRect)
		{
			double num = base.ActualMaximum;

			if (base.IsInvertedCached)
			{
				num4 = 1.0 - num4;
			}
			return viewportRect.Left + viewportRect.Width * (num4 - windowRect.Left) / windowRect.Width;
		}

			}

		}

		private double GetUnscaledValueHelper(double scaledValue, Rect windowRect, Rect viewportRect)

		}

		protected override void PropertyUpdatedOverride(object sender, string propertyName, object oldValue, object newValue)
		{
			base.PropertyUpdatedOverride(sender, propertyName, oldValue, newValue);
			switch (propertyName)
			{
			case "FastItemsSource":
				if (oldValue is IFastItemsSource fastItemsSource)
				{
					fastItemsSource.DeregisterColumn(DateTimeColumn);
					DateTimeColumn = null;
				}
				if (base.FastItemsSource != null)
				{
					DateTimeColumn = TimeAxisBase.RegisterDateTimeColumn(DateTimeMemberPath, this);
				}
				break;
			case "DateTimeMemberPath":
				if (base.FastItemsSource != null)
				{
					base.FastItemsSource.DeregisterColumn(DateTimeColumn);
					DateTimeColumn = TimeAxisBase.RegisterDateTimeColumn(DateTimeMemberPath, this);
				}
				break;
			case "DateTimeColumn":
				UpdateRange();
				InferredInterval = InferInterval();
				break;
			case "MinimumValue":
			case "MaximumValue":
				UpdateRange();
				RenderAxis();
				break;
			case "LabellingMode":
				RenderAxis();
				break;
			}
		}

		private void UpdateActualRange()
		{
			if (DateTimeColumn == null || DateTimeColumn.Count == 0 || DateTimeColumn.Count < base.ActualMinimum - 1)
			{
				ActualMinimumValue = DateTime.MinValue;
				ActualMaximumValue = DateTime.MaxValue;
				return;
			}
			int index = Math.Max(0, Math.Min(base.ActualMinimum, DateTimeColumn.Count - 1));
			int index2 = Math.Max(0, Math.Min(base.ActualMaximum, DateTimeColumn.Count - 1));
			if (ActualMinimumValue != DateTimeColumn[index] || ActualMaximumValue != DateTimeColumn[index2])
			{
				_ = ActualMinimumValue;
				_ = ActualMaximumValue;
				ActualMinimumValue = DateTimeColumn[index];
				ActualMaximumValue = DateTimeColumn[index2];
				UpdateVisibleRange();
			}
		}

		private void UpdateVisibleRange()
		{
			if (DateTimeColumn == null || DateTimeColumn.Count == 0 || base.SeriesViewer == null)
			{
				bool num = VisibleMinimum != ActualMinimumValue || VisibleMaximum != ActualMaximumValue;
				VisibleMinimum = ActualMinimumValue;
				VisibleMaximum = ActualMaximumValue;
				AdjustedVisibleMinimum = VisibleMinimum;
				AdjustedVisibleMaximum = VisibleMaximum;
				if (num && this.VisibleRangeChanged != null)
				{
					this.VisibleRangeChanged(this, EventArgs.Empty);
				}
				return;
			}
			Rect contentViewport = GetContentViewport();
			ScalerParams scalerParams = new ScalerParams(base.SeriesViewer.WindowRect, base.SeriesViewer.ViewportRect, base.IsInverted);
			scalerParams.EffectiveViewportRect = GetCurrentEffectiveViewport();
			double unscaledValue = GetUnscaledValue(contentViewport.Left, scalerParams);
			double unscaledValue2 = GetUnscaledValue(contentViewport.Right, scalerParams);
			int num2 = (int)Math.Floor(unscaledValue);
			int num3 = (int)Math.Ceiling(unscaledValue2);
			DateTime dateTime = ((num2 >= 0 && num2 < DateTimeColumn.Count) ? DateTimeColumn[num2] : ActualMinimumValue);
			DateTime dateTime2 = ((num3 >= 0 && num3 < DateTimeColumn.Count) ? DateTimeColumn[num3] : ActualMaximumValue);
			DateTime adjustedVisibleMinimum = dateTime;
			DateTime adjustedVisibleMaximum = dateTime2;
			if (unscaledValue > (double)num2)
			{
				int num4 = num2 + 1;
				DateTime dateTime3 = ((num4 >= 0 && num4 < DateTimeColumn.Count) ? DateTimeColumn[num4] : dateTime2);
				adjustedVisibleMinimum = dateTime + TimeSpan.FromMilliseconds((dateTime3 - dateTime).TotalMilliseconds * (unscaledValue - (double)num2));
			}
			if (unscaledValue2 < (double)num3)
			{
				int num5 = num3 - 1;
				DateTime dateTime4 = ((num5 >= 0 && num5 < DateTimeColumn.Count) ? DateTimeColumn[num5] : dateTime);
				adjustedVisibleMaximum = dateTime2 - TimeSpan.FromMilliseconds((dateTime2 - dateTime4).TotalMilliseconds * ((double)num3 - unscaledValue2));
			}
			AdjustedVisibleMinimum = adjustedVisibleMinimum;
			AdjustedVisibleMaximum = adjustedVisibleMaximum;
			bool num6 = VisibleMinimum != dateTime || VisibleMaximum != dateTime2;
			VisibleMinimum = dateTime;
			VisibleMaximum = dateTime2;
			if (num6 && this.VisibleRangeChanged != null)
			{
				this.VisibleRangeChanged(this, EventArgs.Empty);
			}
		}

			DateTime prior = DateTime.MinValue;
			bool hasPrior = false;
			if (base.PriorDataItem != null && base.PriorDataItem is DateTime)

				prior = (DateTime)base.PriorDataItem;

			}
			return base.GetLabel(dataItem);
		}
