		internal override bool UpdateRangeOverride()
		{
			if (MinimumValue == DateTime.MaxValue || MaximumValue == DateTime.MinValue)
			{
				return base.UpdateRangeOverride();
			}
			if (base.MustInvalidateLabels && base.UseEnhancedIntervalManagement)
			{
				base.LabelFontHeuristics = GatherLabelFontHeuristics();
			}
			if (base.FastItemsSource == null || DateTimeColumn == null)
			{
				return false;
			}
			int num = base.ActualMinimum;
			if (MinimumValue != DateTime.MinValue)
			{
				int num2 = -1;
				while (num2++ <= DateTimeColumn.Count && !(DateTimeColumn[num2] >= MinimumValue))
				{
				}
				num = num2;
			}
			int num3 = ((base.CategoryMode == CategoryMode.Mode0) ? (base.FastItemsSource.Count - 1) : base.FastItemsSource.Count);
			if (MaximumValue != DateTime.MaxValue)
			{
				int count = base.FastItemsSource.Count;
				while (count-- > 0 && !(DateTimeColumn[count] <= MaximumValue))
				{
				}
				num3 = count;
			}
			if (num != base.ActualMinimum || num3 != base.ActualMaximum)
			{
				AxisRangeChangedEventArgs ea = new AxisRangeChangedEventArgs(base.ActualMinimum, num, base.ActualMaximum, num3);
				base.ActualMinimum = num;
				base.ActualMaximum = num3;
				RaiseRangeChanged(ea);
				UpdateActualRange();
				ForceSeriesUpdate();
				return true;
			}
			return false;
		}

		protected override void OnFastItemsSourceEvent(FastItemsSourceEventArgs e)
		{
			base.OnFastItemsSourceEvent(e);
			UpdateRange(immediate: true);
		}
	}
	internal class PercentChangeAxisRenderer : NumericAxisRenderer
	{
		public PercentChangeAxisRenderer(AxisLabelManager labelManager)
			: base(labelManager)
		{
		}

		protected internal override object GetLabel(AxisRenderingParametersBase renderingParams, double unscaledValue, int index, double interval)
		{
			object obj = base.GetLabel(renderingParams, unscaledValue, index, interval);
			if (renderingParams.Label == null)
			{
				obj = obj.ToString() + "%";
			}
			return obj;
		}
	}
	[TSWidgetIncludeDepends("System.Collections.Generic.IList`1")]
	public class PercentChangeYAxis : NumericYAxis
	{
		protected internal override NumericScaler CreateScalerOverride()
		{
			return new VerticalPercentChangeScaler(this);
		}

		protected internal override AxisRange GetAxisRange()
		{
			double num = double.MaxValue;
			double num2 = double.MinValue;
			foreach (Series item in DirectSeries())
			{
				AxisRange range = item.GetRange(this);
				if (range != null)
				{
					double referenceValue = item.GetReferenceValue();
					if (!double.IsNaN(referenceValue) && referenceValue != 0.0)
					{
						double num3 = range.Maximum - referenceValue;
						double num4 = referenceValue - range.Minimum;
						double val = Math.Abs(num3 / referenceValue * 100.0);
						double num5 = Math.Abs(num4 / referenceValue * 100.0);
						num = Math.Min(num, 0.0 - num5);
						num2 = Math.Max(num2, val);
					}
				}
			}
			return new AxisRange(num, num2);
		}

		internal override NumericAxisRenderer InstantiateRenderer(AxisLabelManager labelManager)
		{
			return new PercentChangeAxisRenderer(labelManager);
		}

		internal override double ClampValue(double value, ScalerParams p)
		{
			double num = (value - p.ReferenceValue) / p.ReferenceValue * 100.0;
			if (num < base.ActualMinimumValue)
			{
				return base.ActualMinimumValue / 100.0 * p.ReferenceValue + p.ReferenceValue;
			}
			if (num > base.ActualMaximumValue)
			{
				return base.ActualMaximumValue / 100.0 * p.ReferenceValue + p.ReferenceValue;
			}
			return value;
		}
	}

	internal class PolarAxisRenderingManager
	{
		public PathFigure DrawEllipse(double radius, Point center, double minAngle, double maxAngle, Rect windowRect, Rect viewportRect)
		{
			double width = ViewportUtils.TransformXToViewportLength(radius, windowRect, viewportRect);
			double num = ViewportUtils.TransformYToViewportLength(radius, windowRect, viewportRect);
			double x = ViewportUtils.TransformXToViewport(center.X, windowRect, viewportRect);
			double num2 = ViewportUtils.TransformYToViewport(center.Y, windowRect, viewportRect);
			if (maxAngle - minAngle < Math.PI && maxAngle - minAngle > 0.0)
			{
				Point startPoint = new Point(ViewportUtils.TransformXToViewport(center.X + radius * Math.Cos(minAngle), windowRect, viewportRect), ViewportUtils.TransformYToViewport(center.Y + radius * Math.Sin(minAngle), windowRect, viewportRect));
				Point point = new Point(ViewportUtils.TransformXToViewport(center.X + radius * Math.Cos(maxAngle), windowRect, viewportRect), ViewportUtils.TransformYToViewport(center.Y + radius * Math.Sin(maxAngle), windowRect, viewportRect));
				return new PathFigure
				{
					StartPoint = startPoint,
					IsClosed = false,
					Segments = { (PathSegment)new ArcSegment
					{
						IsLargeArc = false,
						Point = point,
						Size = new Size(width, num),
						SweepDirection = SweepDirection.Clockwise
					} }
				};
			}
			return new PathFigure
			{
				StartPoint = new Point(x, num2 - num),
				IsClosed = true,
				Segments = 
				{
					(PathSegment)new ArcSegment
					{
						IsLargeArc = false,
						Point = new Point(x, num2 + num),
						Size = new Size(width, num),
						SweepDirection = SweepDirection.Clockwise
					},
					(PathSegment)new ArcSegment
					{
						IsLargeArc = false,
						Point = new Point(x, num2 - num),
						Size = new Size(width, num),
						SweepDirection = SweepDirection.Clockwise
					}
				}
			};
		}

		public void ConcentricStrip(GeometryCollection geometry, double radius0, double radius1, Rect viewportRect, Rect windowRect, Point center, double minAngle, double maxAngle)
		{
			double num = Math.Min(radius0, radius1);
			double num2 = Math.Max(radius0, radius1);
			PathGeometry pathGeometry = new PathGeometry();
			PathFigure pathFigure = null;
			LineSegment lineSegment = null;
			PathFigure pathFigure2 = null;
			LineSegment lineSegment2 = null;
			if (num > 0.0)
			{
				pathFigure = DrawEllipse(num, center, minAngle, maxAngle, windowRect, viewportRect);
				if (maxAngle - minAngle < Math.PI && maxAngle - minAngle > 0.0 && pathFigure.Segments[0] is ArcSegment)
				{
					Point point = new Point(ViewportUtils.TransformXToViewport(center.X + num2 * Math.Cos(maxAngle), windowRect, viewportRect), ViewportUtils.TransformYToViewport(center.Y + num2 * Math.Sin(maxAngle), windowRect, viewportRect));
					lineSegment = new LineSegment
					{
						Point = point
					};
				}
			}
			if (num2 > 0.0)
			{
				pathFigure2 = DrawEllipse(num2, center, minAngle, maxAngle, windowRect, viewportRect);
			}
			if (num > 0.0 && maxAngle - minAngle < Math.PI && maxAngle - minAngle > 0.0)
			{
				Point startPoint = pathFigure2.StartPoint;
				if (pathFigure2.Segments[0] is ArcSegment arcSegment)
				{
					pathFigure2.StartPoint = arcSegment.Point;
					arcSegment.Point = startPoint;
					arcSegment.SweepDirection = SweepDirection.Counterclockwise;
					Point point2 = new Point(ViewportUtils.TransformXToViewport(center.X + num * Math.Cos(minAngle), windowRect, viewportRect), ViewportUtils.TransformYToViewport(center.Y + num * Math.Sin(minAngle), windowRect, viewportRect));
					lineSegment2 = new LineSegment
					{
						Point = point2
					};
				}
			}
			if (lineSegment != null && lineSegment2 != null)
			{
				pathFigure.Segments.Add(lineSegment);
				PathSegment value = pathFigure2.Segments[0];
				pathFigure2.Segments.Remove(value);
				pathFigure.Segments.Add(value);
				pathFigure.Segments.Add(lineSegment2);
				pathFigure.IsClosed = true;
				pathGeometry.Figures.Add(pathFigure);
			}
			else
			{
				if (pathFigure != null)
				{
					pathGeometry.Figures.Add(pathFigure);
				}
				if (pathFigure2 != null)
				{
					pathGeometry.Figures.Add(pathFigure2);
				}
			}
			geometry.Add(pathGeometry);
		}

		private void ReverseArcFigure(PathFigure figure)
		{
			if (figure.Segments.Count > 1)
			{
				ArcSegment arcSegment = figure.Segments[0] as ArcSegment;
				ArcSegment arcSegment2 = figure.Segments[1] as ArcSegment;
				figure.Segments[0] = arcSegment2;
				figure.Segments[1] = arcSegment;
				Point point = arcSegment2.Point;
				Point startPoint = figure.StartPoint;
				Point point2 = arcSegment.Point;
				figure.StartPoint = point;
				arcSegment2.Point = point2;
				arcSegment.Point = startPoint;
				arcSegment.SweepDirection = SweepDirection.Counterclockwise;
				arcSegment2.SweepDirection = SweepDirection.Counterclockwise;
			}
			else
			{
				Point startPoint2 = figure.StartPoint;
				if (figure.Segments[0] is ArcSegment arcSegment3)
				{
					figure.StartPoint = arcSegment3.Point;
					arcSegment3.Point = startPoint2;
					arcSegment3.SweepDirection = SweepDirection.Counterclockwise;
				}
			}
		}

		public void ConcentricLine(GeometryCollection geometry, double radius, Rect viewportRect, Rect windowRect, Point center, double startAngle, double endAngle)
		{
			if (radius > 0.0)
			{
				PathGeometry pathGeometry = new PathGeometry();
				pathGeometry.Figures.Add(DrawEllipse(radius, center, startAngle, endAngle, windowRect, viewportRect));
				geometry.Add(pathGeometry);
			}
		}

		public void RadialStrip(GeometryCollection geometry, double startAngle, double endAngle, Rect viewportRect, Rect windowRect, double minLength, double maxLength, Point center)
		{
			double num = Math.Min(startAngle, endAngle);
			double num2 = Math.Max(startAngle, endAngle);
			bool isLargeArc = false;
			if (num2 - num > Math.PI)
			{
				isLargeArc = true;
			}
			double num3 = Math.Cos(num);
			double num4 = Math.Sin(num);
			double xValue = center.X + num3 * minLength;
			double yValue = center.Y + num4 * minLength;
			double xValue2 = center.X + num3 * maxLength;
			double yValue2 = center.Y + num4 * maxLength;
			double num5 = Math.Cos(num2);
			double num6 = Math.Sin(num2);
			double xValue3 = center.X + num5 * minLength;
			double yValue3 = center.Y + num6 * minLength;
			double xValue4 = center.X + num5 * maxLength;
			double yValue4 = center.Y + num6 * maxLength;
			xValue = ViewportUtils.TransformXToViewport(xValue, windowRect, viewportRect);
			yValue = ViewportUtils.TransformYToViewport(yValue, windowRect, viewportRect);
			xValue2 = ViewportUtils.TransformXToViewport(xValue2, windowRect, viewportRect);
			yValue2 = ViewportUtils.TransformYToViewport(yValue2, windowRect, viewportRect);
			xValue3 = ViewportUtils.TransformXToViewport(xValue3, windowRect, viewportRect);
			yValue3 = ViewportUtils.TransformYToViewport(yValue3, windowRect, viewportRect);
			xValue4 = ViewportUtils.TransformXToViewport(xValue4, windowRect, viewportRect);
			yValue4 = ViewportUtils.TransformYToViewport(yValue4, windowRect, viewportRect);
			PathFigure pathFigure = new PathFigure();
			pathFigure.StartPoint = new Point(xValue, yValue);
			pathFigure.IsClosed = true;
			pathFigure.Segments.Add(new LineSegment
			{
				Point = new Point(xValue2, yValue2)
			});
			pathFigure.Segments.Add(new ArcSegment
			{
				Point = new Point(xValue4, yValue4),
				Size = new Size(ViewportUtils.TransformXToViewportLength(maxLength, windowRect, viewportRect), ViewportUtils.TransformYToViewportLength(maxLength, windowRect, viewportRect)),
				SweepDirection = SweepDirection.Clockwise,
				IsLargeArc = isLargeArc
			});
			pathFigure.Segments.Add(new LineSegment
			{
				Point = new Point(xValue3, yValue3)
			});
			pathFigure.Segments.Add(new ArcSegment
			{
				Point = new Point(xValue, yValue),
				Size = new Size(ViewportUtils.TransformXToViewportLength(minLength, windowRect, viewportRect), ViewportUtils.TransformYToViewportLength(minLength, windowRect, viewportRect)),
				SweepDirection = SweepDirection.Counterclockwise,
				IsLargeArc = isLargeArc
			});
			PathGeometry pathGeometry = new PathGeometry();
			pathGeometry.Figures.Add(pathFigure);
			geometry.Add(pathGeometry);
		}

		public void RadialLine(GeometryCollection geometry, double angle, Rect viewportRect, Rect windowRect, double minLength, double maxLength, Point center)
		{
			LineGeometry lineGeometry = new LineGeometry();
			double num = Math.Cos(angle);
			double num2 = Math.Sin(angle);
			double xValue = center.X + num * minLength;
			double yValue = center.Y + num2 * minLength;
			double xValue2 = center.X + num * maxLength;
			double yValue2 = center.Y + num2 * maxLength;
			xValue = ViewportUtils.TransformXToViewport(xValue, windowRect, viewportRect);
			yValue = ViewportUtils.TransformYToViewport(yValue, windowRect, viewportRect);
			xValue2 = ViewportUtils.TransformXToViewport(xValue2, windowRect, viewportRect);
			yValue2 = ViewportUtils.TransformYToViewport(yValue2, windowRect, viewportRect);
			lineGeometry.StartPoint = new Point(xValue, yValue);
			lineGeometry.EndPoint = new Point(xValue2, yValue2);
			geometry.Add(lineGeometry);
		}

		public bool InXBand(Point center, Rect bounds)
		{
			if (center.X >= bounds.Left)
			{
				return center.X <= bounds.Right;
			}
			return false;
		}

		public bool InYBand(Point center, Rect bounds)
		{
			if (center.Y >= bounds.Top)
			{
				return center.Y <= bounds.Bottom;
			}
			return false;
		}

		public double ClosestCorner(Point center, Rect bounds)
		{
			double val = Math.Sqrt(Math.Pow(center.X - bounds.Left, 2.0) + Math.Pow(center.Y - bounds.Top, 2.0));
			double val2 = Math.Sqrt(Math.Pow(center.X - bounds.Right, 2.0) + Math.Pow(center.Y - bounds.Top, 2.0));
			double val3 = Math.Sqrt(Math.Pow(center.X - bounds.Right, 2.0) + Math.Pow(center.Y - bounds.Bottom, 2.0));
			double val4 = Math.Sqrt(Math.Pow(center.X - bounds.Left, 2.0) + Math.Pow(center.Y - bounds.Bottom, 2.0));
			return Math.Min(val, Math.Min(val2, Math.Min(val3, val4)));
		}

		public double FurthestCorner(Point center, Rect bounds)
		{
			double val = Math.Sqrt(Math.Pow(center.X - bounds.Left, 2.0) + Math.Pow(center.Y - bounds.Top, 2.0));
			double val2 = Math.Sqrt(Math.Pow(center.X - bounds.Right, 2.0) + Math.Pow(center.Y - bounds.Top, 2.0));
			double val3 = Math.Sqrt(Math.Pow(center.X - bounds.Right, 2.0) + Math.Pow(center.Y - bounds.Bottom, 2.0));
			double val4 = Math.Sqrt(Math.Pow(center.X - bounds.Left, 2.0) + Math.Pow(center.Y - bounds.Bottom, 2.0));
			return Math.Max(val, Math.Max(val2, Math.Max(val3, val4)));
		}

		public double GetClosestRadiusValue(Rect windowRect)
		{
			Point center = new Point(0.5, 0.5);
			if (InXBand(center, windowRect) && InYBand(center, windowRect))
			{
				return 0.0;
			}
			if (InXBand(center, windowRect))
			{
				if (center.Y < windowRect.Top)
				{
					return windowRect.Top - center.Y;
				}
				return center.Y - windowRect.Bottom;
			}
			if (InYBand(center, windowRect))
			{
				if (center.X < windowRect.Left)
				{
					return windowRect.Left - center.X;
				}
				return center.X - windowRect.Right;
			}
			return ClosestCorner(center, windowRect);
		}

		public double GetFurthestRadiusValue(Rect windowRect)
		{
			Point center = new Point(0.5, 0.5);
			return FurthestCorner(center, windowRect);
		}

		protected double GetAngleTo(Point center, Point toPoint)
		{
			double num = Math.Sqrt(Math.Pow(toPoint.X - center.X, 2.0) + Math.Pow(toPoint.Y - center.Y, 2.0));
			double num2 = Math.Acos((toPoint.X - center.X) / num);
			if (toPoint.Y - center.Y < 0.0)
			{
				num2 = Math.PI * 2.0 - num2;
			}
			return num2;
		}

		private double LineCheck(Point maxValueRadiusPoint, Point rectPoint)
		{
			return (maxValueRadiusPoint.Y - 0.5) * rectPoint.X + (0.5 - maxValueRadiusPoint.X) * rectPoint.Y + (maxValueRadiusPoint.X * 0.5 - 0.5 * maxValueRadiusPoint.Y);
		}

		public void GetMinMaxAngle(Rect windowRect, out double minAngle, out double maxAngle)
		{
			Point center = new Point(0.5, 0.5);
			if (InXBand(center, windowRect) && InYBand(center, windowRect))
			{
				minAngle = 0.0;
				maxAngle = Math.PI * 2.0;
				return;
			}
			double angleTo = GetAngleTo(center, new Point(windowRect.Left, windowRect.Top));
			double angleTo2 = GetAngleTo(center, new Point(windowRect.Right, windowRect.Top));
			double angleTo3 = GetAngleTo(center, new Point(windowRect.Right, windowRect.Bottom));
			double angleTo4 = GetAngleTo(center, new Point(windowRect.Left, windowRect.Bottom));
			if (InYBand(center, windowRect) && windowRect.Left > center.X)
			{
				minAngle = angleTo;
				maxAngle = Math.PI * 2.0 + angleTo4;
			}
			else
			{
				minAngle = Math.Min(angleTo, Math.Min(angleTo2, Math.Min(angleTo3, angleTo4)));
				maxAngle = Math.Max(angleTo, Math.Max(angleTo2, Math.Max(angleTo3, angleTo4)));
			}
		}

		public void DetermineView(Rect windowRect, AxisRenderingParametersBase renderingParams, double actualMinimumValue, double actualMaximumValue, bool isInverted, Func<double, double> getUnscaledAngle, double resolution)
		{
			GetMinMaxAngle(windowRect, out var minAngle, out var maxAngle);
			double minAngle2 = Math.Min(minAngle, maxAngle);
			double maxAngle2 = Math.Max(minAngle, maxAngle);
			if (renderingParams is PolarAxisRenderingParameters)
			{
				((PolarAxisRenderingParameters)renderingParams).MinAngle = minAngle2;
				((PolarAxisRenderingParameters)renderingParams).MaxAngle = maxAngle2;
			}
			else if (renderingParams is RadialAxisRenderingParameters)
			{
				((RadialAxisRenderingParameters)renderingParams).MinAngle = minAngle2;
				((RadialAxisRenderingParameters)renderingParams).MaxAngle = maxAngle2;
			}
			if (minAngle == 0.0 && maxAngle == Math.PI * 2.0)
			{
				double visibleMinimum = Math.Min(actualMinimumValue, actualMaximumValue);
				double visibleMaximum = Math.Max(actualMinimumValue, actualMaximumValue);
				renderingParams.RangeInfos.Add(new RangeInfo
				{
					VisibleMinimum = visibleMinimum,
					VisibleMaximum = visibleMaximum,
					Resolution = resolution
				});
				return;
			}
			if (maxAngle > Math.PI * 2.0)
			{
				maxAngle -= Math.PI * 2.0;
			}
			double num = getUnscaledAngle(minAngle);
			double num2 = getUnscaledAngle(maxAngle);
			if (num < actualMinimumValue || num > actualMaximumValue)
			{
				num = getUnscaledAngle(minAngle + Math.PI * 2.0);
			}
			if (num2 < actualMinimumValue || num2 > actualMaximumValue)
			{
				num2 = getUnscaledAngle(maxAngle + Math.PI * 2.0);
			}
			double num3 = Math.Min(num, num2);
			double num4 = Math.Max(num, num2);
			if ((!isInverted && num > num2) || (isInverted && num < num2))
			{
				double num5 = actualMaximumValue - num4;
				double num6 = num3 - actualMinimumValue;
				renderingParams.RangeInfos.Add(new RangeInfo
				{
					VisibleMinimum = num4,
					VisibleMaximum = actualMaximumValue,
					Resolution = num5 / (num5 + num6) * resolution
				});
				renderingParams.RangeInfos.Add(new RangeInfo
				{
					VisibleMinimum = actualMinimumValue,
					VisibleMaximum = num3,
					Resolution = num6 / (num5 + num6) * resolution
				});
			}
			else
			{
				renderingParams.RangeInfos.Add(new RangeInfo
				{
					VisibleMinimum = num3,
					VisibleMaximum = num4,
					Resolution = resolution
				});
			}
		}
	}
	internal class PolarAxes
	{
		private Point center = new Point(0.5, 0.5);

		public NumericRadiusAxis RadiusAxis { get; set; }

		public NumericAngleAxis AngleAxis { get; set; }

		public PolarAxes(NumericRadiusAxis radiusAxis, NumericAngleAxis angleAxis)
		{
			RadiusAxis = radiusAxis;
			AngleAxis = angleAxis;
		}

		public double GetXValue(double angle, double radius, Rect windowRect, Rect viewportRect, Func<double, double> cosStrategy)
		{
			return ViewportUtils.TransformXToViewport(center.X + radius * cosStrategy(angle), windowRect, viewportRect);
		}

		public Point GetScaledPoint(double angleValue, double radiusValue, Rect windowRect, Rect viewportRect, bool angleLogarithmic, bool angleInverted, bool radiusLogarithmic, bool radiusInverted, double radiusExtentScale, double innerRadiusExtentScale)
		{
			double scaledAngle = AngleAxis.GetScaledAngle(angleValue, angleLogarithmic, angleInverted);
			double scaledValue = RadiusAxis.GetScaledValue(radiusValue, radiusLogarithmic, radiusInverted, radiusExtentScale, innerRadiusExtentScale);
			double x = center.X;
			double y = center.Y;
			double num = x + scaledValue * Math.Cos(scaledAngle);
			double num2 = y + scaledValue * Math.Sin(scaledAngle);
			num = viewportRect.Left + viewportRect.Width * (num - windowRect.Left) / windowRect.Width;
			num2 = viewportRect.Top + viewportRect.Height * (num2 - windowRect.Top) / windowRect.Height;
			return new Point(num, num2);
		}

		public void GetScaledPoints(IList<Point> points, IList<double> angleColumn, IList<double> radiusColumn, Rect windowRect, Rect viewportRect, Func<int, double, double> cosStrategy, Func<int, double, double> sinStrategy, bool excludeOutOfRange)
		{
			int num = Math.Min(angleColumn?.Count ?? 0, radiusColumn?.Count ?? 0);
			points.Clear();
			double x = center.X;
			double y = center.Y;
			double num2 = Math.Min(AngleAxis.ActualMinimumValue, AngleAxis.ActualMaximumValue);
			double num3 = Math.Max(AngleAxis.ActualMinimumValue, AngleAxis.ActualMaximumValue);
			double num4 = Math.Min(RadiusAxis.ActualMaximumValue, RadiusAxis.ActualMinimumValue);
			double num5 = Math.Max(RadiusAxis.ActualMaximumValue, RadiusAxis.ActualMinimumValue);
			bool isReallyLogarithmic = AngleAxis.IsReallyLogarithmic;
			bool isInverted = AngleAxis.IsInverted;
			bool isReallyLogarithmic2 = RadiusAxis.IsReallyLogarithmic;
			bool isInverted2 = RadiusAxis.IsInverted;
			double actualRadiusExtentScale = RadiusAxis.ActualRadiusExtentScale;
			double actualInnerRadiusExtentScale = RadiusAxis.ActualInnerRadiusExtentScale;
			for (int i = 0; i < num; i++)
			{
				if ((angleColumn[i] <= num3 && angleColumn[i] >= num2 && radiusColumn[i] <= num5 && radiusColumn[i] >= num4) || double.IsNaN(angleColumn[i]) || double.IsNaN(radiusColumn[i]))
				{
					double scaledAngle = AngleAxis.GetScaledAngle(angleColumn[i], isReallyLogarithmic, isInverted);
					double scaledValue = RadiusAxis.GetScaledValue(radiusColumn[i], isReallyLogarithmic2, isInverted2, actualRadiusExtentScale, actualInnerRadiusExtentScale);
					double num6 = x + scaledValue * cosStrategy(i, scaledAngle);
					double num7 = y + scaledValue * sinStrategy(i, scaledAngle);
					num6 = viewportRect.Left + viewportRect.Width * (num6 - windowRect.Left) / windowRect.Width;
					num7 = viewportRect.Top + viewportRect.Height * (num7 - windowRect.Top) / windowRect.Height;
					points.Add(new Point(num6, num7));
				}
				else
				{
					points.Add(new Point(double.NaN, double.NaN));
				}
			}
		}

		public void GetUnscaledValues(double scaledXValue, double scaledYValue, Rect windowRect, Rect viewportRect, out double unscaledAngle, out double unscaledRadius)
		{
			double num = ViewportUtils.TransformXFromViewport(scaledXValue, windowRect, viewportRect);
			double num2 = ViewportUtils.TransformYFromViewport(scaledYValue, windowRect, viewportRect);
			double num3 = Math.Sqrt(Math.Pow(num - center.X, 2.0) + Math.Pow(num2 - center.Y, 2.0));
			double num4 = Math.Acos((num - center.X) / num3);
			if (num2 - center.Y < 0.0)
			{
				num4 = Math.PI * 2.0 - num4;
			}
			unscaledAngle = AngleAxis.GetUnscaledAngle(num4);
			unscaledRadius = RadiusAxis.GetUnscaledValue(num3);
		}

		public double GetYValue(double angle, double radius, Rect windowRect, Rect viewportRect, Func<double, double> sinStrategy)
		{
			return ViewportUtils.TransformYToViewport(center.Y + radius * sinStrategy(angle), windowRect, viewportRect);
		}
	}
	internal class RadialAxes
	{
		private Point center = new Point(0.5, 0.5);

		public NumericRadiusAxis RadiusAxis { get; set; }

		public CategoryAngleAxis AngleAxis { get; set; }

		public RadialAxes(NumericRadiusAxis radiusAxis, CategoryAngleAxis angleAxis)
		{
			RadiusAxis = radiusAxis;
			AngleAxis = angleAxis;
		}

		public double GetXValue(double angle, double radius, Rect windowRect, Rect viewportRect)
		{
			return ViewportUtils.TransformXToViewport(center.X + radius * Math.Cos(angle), windowRect, viewportRect);
		}

		public void GetScaledPoints(IList<Point> points, IList<double> angleColumn, IList<double> radiusColumn, Rect windowRect, Rect viewportRect, Func<int, double, double> cosStrategy, Func<int, double, double> sinStrategy)
		{
			int num = Math.Min(angleColumn?.Count ?? 0, radiusColumn?.Count ?? 0);
			bool flag = false;
			if (points.Count == num)
			{
				flag = true;
			}
			double x = center.X;
			double y = center.Y;
			for (int i = 0; i < num; i++)
			{
				double scaledAngle = AngleAxis.GetScaledAngle(angleColumn[i]);
				double scaledValue = RadiusAxis.GetScaledValue(radiusColumn[i]);
				double num2 = x + scaledValue * cosStrategy(i, scaledAngle);
				double num3 = y + scaledValue * sinStrategy(i, scaledAngle);
				num2 = viewportRect.Left + viewportRect.Width * (num2 - windowRect.Left) / windowRect.Width;
				num3 = viewportRect.Top + viewportRect.Height * (num3 - windowRect.Top) / windowRect.Height;
				if (!flag)
				{
					points.Add(new Point(num2, num3));
				}
				else
				{
					points[i] = new Point(num2, num3);
				}
			}
		}

		public void GetUnscaledValues(double scaledXValue, double scaledYValue, Rect windowRect, Rect viewportRect, out double unscaledAngle, out double unscaledRadius)
		{
			double num = ViewportUtils.TransformXFromViewport(scaledXValue, windowRect, viewportRect);
			double num2 = ViewportUtils.TransformYFromViewport(scaledYValue, windowRect, viewportRect);
			double num3 = Math.Sqrt(Math.Pow(num - center.X, 2.0) + Math.Pow(num2 - center.Y, 2.0));
			double num4 = Math.Acos((num - center.X) / num3);
			if (num2 - center.Y < 0.0)
			{
				num4 = Math.PI * 2.0 - num4;
			}
			unscaledAngle = AngleAxis.GetUnscaledAngle(num4);
			unscaledRadius = RadiusAxis.GetUnscaledValue(num3);
		}

		public double GetYValue(double angle, double radius, Rect windowRect, Rect viewportRect)
		{
			return ViewportUtils.TransformYToViewport(center.Y + radius * Math.Sin(angle), windowRect, viewportRect);
		}

		internal double GetAngleTo(Point world)
		{
			double num = Math.Sqrt(Math.Pow(world.X - center.X, 2.0) + Math.Pow(world.Y - center.Y, 2.0));
			double num2 = Math.Acos((world.X - center.X) / num);
			if (world.Y - center.Y < 0.0)
			{
				num2 = Math.PI * 2.0 - num2;
			}
			return num2;
		}
	}
	public class RadialAxisLabelPanel : HorizontalAxisLabelPanelBase
	{
		private List<int> _toHide = new List<int>();

		[TSSuppressSynthesizedInitializer]
		internal RadialAxisLabelPanelView RadialView { get; set; }

		public Point RotationCenter { get; set; }

		public double CrossingAngle { get; set; }

		protected bool AxisIsEmbedded => !base.AxisIsNotEmbedded;

		internal override AxisLabelPanelBaseView CreateView()
		{
			return new RadialAxisLabelPanelView(this);
		}

		internal override void OnViewCreated(AxisLabelPanelBaseView view)
		{
			base.OnViewCreated(view);
			RadialView = (RadialAxisLabelPanelView)view;
		}

		protected internal override bool ShouldTryStagger()
		{
			if (base.FoundCollisions)
			{
				if (base.UseRotation)
				{
					return GetEffectiveAngle() == -180.0;
				}
				return true;
			}
			return false;
		}

		protected override bool ShouldVerticalAlign()
		{
			return !base.UseStaggering;
		}

		protected internal override void ApplyPanelRotation(Size finalSize)
		{
			base.ApplyPanelRotation(finalSize);
			if (CrossingAngle % 360.0 == 0.0 || base.AxisIsNotEmbedded)
			{
				RadialView.ClearPanelRotation();
			}
			else
			{
				RadialView.ApplyPanelRotation(finalSize);
			}
		}

		protected internal override double GetEffectiveAngle()
		{
			double num = base.GetEffectiveAngle();
			if (AxisIsEmbedded)
			{
				num -= CrossingAngle * 180.0 / Math.PI;
			}
			return num;
		}

		protected internal override bool ShouldRotate()
		{
			return GetEffectiveAngle() % 360.0 != 0.0;
		}

		protected override bool ShouldClip()
		{
			if (base.AxisIsNotEmbedded)
			{
				return true;
			}
			double num = CrossingAngle * 180.0 / Math.PI;
			if (num < 30.0 || num > 330.0 || (num > 150.0 && num < 210.0))
			{
				return true;
			}
			return false;
		}

		protected internal override void SetLabelRotationTransform(FrameworkElement label, double angle)
		{
			double num = Math.Abs(Math.Sin(angle * Math.PI / 180.0));
			if (base.Axis.LabelSettings != null && base.Axis.LabelSettings.ActualLocation == AxisLabelsLocation.InsideTop)
			{
				num *= -1.0;
			}
			RadialView.SetLabelRotationalTransform(label, angle, num);
		}

		protected double MinimumPosition()
		{
			double num = double.MaxValue;
			foreach (LabelPosition labelPosition in base.LabelPositions)
			{
				num = Math.Min(labelPosition.Value, num);
			}
			return num;
		}

		protected double MaximumPosition()
		{
			double num = double.MinValue;
			foreach (LabelPosition labelPosition in base.LabelPositions)
			{
				num = Math.Max(labelPosition.Value, num);
			}
			return num;
		}

		protected override void HideOptionalLabels(List<Rect> rectangles, List<bool> isOverlayList)
		{
			double num = ((!base.Axis.IsInverted) ? MaximumPosition() : MinimumPosition());
			List<int> list = new List<int>();
			List<bool> list2 = new List<bool>();
			for (int i = 0; i < base.LabelPositions.Count; i++)
			{
				LabelPosition labelPosition = base.LabelPositions[i];
				if (labelPosition.Value == num && !labelPosition.IsOverlay)
				{
					list.Add(base.LabelPositions.IndexOf(labelPosition));
				}
			}
			_toHide = list;
			List<Rect> list3 = new List<Rect>();
			for (int j = 0; j < rectangles.Count; j++)
			{
				Rect item = rectangles[j];
				bool isOverlay = base.LabelPositions[j].IsOverlay;
				if (!_toHide.Contains(j))
				{
					list3.Add(item);
					list2.Add(isOverlay);
				}
			}
			base.FoundCollisions = DetectCollisions(list3, list2);
		}

		protected internal override bool ShouldDisplay(int index, Rect bounds)
		{
			if (_toHide.Contains(index))
			{
				return false;
			}
			return base.ShouldDisplay(index, bounds);
		}

		protected override void ShowOptionalLabels()
		{
			_toHide = new List<int>();
			base.ShowOptionalLabels();
		}

		internal override AxisLabelsLocation GetDefaultLabelsLocation()
		{
			return AxisLabelsLocation.InsideBottom;
		}

		internal override bool ValidLocation(AxisLabelsLocation location)
		{
			if (location != AxisLabelsLocation.InsideBottom && location != AxisLabelsLocation.InsideTop && location != AxisLabelsLocation.OutsideBottom)
			{
				return location == AxisLabelsLocation.OutsideTop;
			}
			return true;
		}

		protected override void CreateTicks()
		{
		}
	}

		public override double GetScaledValue(double unscaledValue, ScalerParams p)
		{

			{
				double scaledValueHelper = GetScaledValueHelper(unscaledValue, NumericScaler.UnitRect, p.EffectiveViewportRect, Rect.Empty);
				scaledValueHelper = (scaledValueHelper - p.ViewportRect.Left) / p.ViewportRect.Width;
				return p.ViewportRect.Left + p.ViewportRect.Width * (scaledValueHelper - p.WindowRect.Left) / p.WindowRect.Width;

		}

		private double GetScaledValueHelper(double unscaledValue, Rect windowRect, Rect viewportRect, Rect effectiveViewportRect)
		{
			double num = ((!(ActualMaximumValue == ActualMinimumValue)) ? ((unscaledValue - (double)ActualMinimumValue.Ticks) / (double)(ActualMaximumValue.Ticks - ActualMinimumValue.Ticks)) : (-1.0));
			double num2 = 0.0;
			if (base.CategoryMode == CategoryMode.Mode2)
			{
				num2 = GetGroupCenter(0, windowRect, viewportRect, effectiveViewportRect);
			}
			if (base.IsInverted)
			{
				num = 1.0 - num;
				num2 = 0.0 - num2;
			}
			return viewportRect.Left + viewportRect.Width * (num - windowRect.Left) / windowRect.Width - num2;
		}

		private double GetScaledValueHelper1(double unscaledValue, Rect windowRect, Rect viewportRect)
		{
			double num = ((!(ActualMaximumValue == ActualMinimumValue)) ? ((unscaledValue - (double)ActualMinimumValue.Ticks) / (double)(ActualMaximumValue.Ticks - ActualMinimumValue.Ticks)) : (-1.0));
			double num2 = 0.0;
			if (base.IsInverted)
			{
				num = 1.0 - num;
				num2 = 0.0 - num2;
			}
			return viewportRect.Left + viewportRect.Width * (num - windowRect.Left) / windowRect.Width - num2;
		}

		[JAVASuppressWidgetMember]
		[TSSuppressWidgetMember]
		[SwiftSuppressWidgetMember]
		public override double GetUnscaledValue(double scaledValue, ScalerParams p)
		{
			if (!p.EffectiveViewportRect.IsEmpty)
			{
				double num = p.ViewportRect.Left;
				double width = p.ViewportRect.Width;
				if (base.CategoryMode != CategoryMode.Mode0)
				{
					double categorySize = GetCategorySize(p.WindowRect, p.ViewportRect, p.EffectiveViewportRect);
					num += categorySize / 2.0;
					width -= categorySize;
				}
				double num2 = p.WindowRect.Left + p.WindowRect.Width * (scaledValue - num) / p.ViewportRect.Width;
				num2 = num2 * p.ViewportRect.Width + p.ViewportRect.Left;
				return GetUnscaledValue(num2, NumericScaler.UnitRect, p.EffectiveViewportRect, base.CategoryMode);
			}
			return GetUnscaledValue(scaledValue, p.WindowRect, p.ViewportRect, base.CategoryMode);
		}

		internal override double GetUnscaledValue(double scaledValue, Rect windowRect, Rect viewportRect, CategoryMode categoryMode)

			if (base.IsInverted)
			{
				num = 1.0 - num;
			}
			return (long)Math.Floor((double)ActualMinimumValue.Ticks + num * (double)(ActualMaximumValue.Ticks - ActualMinimumValue.Ticks));
		}

		void ISortingAxis.EnsureActualMinimumAndMaximum()
		{
			InitializeActualMinimumAndMaximum();
		}

		protected internal virtual void InitializeActualMinimumAndMaximum()
		{
			Rect rect = ((base.SeriesViewer != null) ? base.SeriesViewer.ActualWindowRect : Rect.Empty);
			Rect rect2 = ((!rect.IsEmpty) ? base.ViewportRect : Rect.Empty);
			DateTime dateTime = DateTime.MinValue;
			DateTime dateTime2 = DateTime.MaxValue;
			bool flag = false;
			if (!rect.IsEmpty && !rect2.IsEmpty && DateTimeColumn != null)
			{
				if (DateTimeColumn is FastItemDateTimeColumn)
				{
					if (SortedDateTimeIndices == null)
					{
						PopulateSortedIndices();
					}
				}
				else
				{
					SortedDateTimeIndices = null;
				}
				if (DateTimeColumn.Count > 0)
				{
					flag = true;
					int index = ((SortedDateTimeIndices != null) ? SortedDateTimeIndices[0] : 0);
					int index2 = ((SortedDateTimeIndices == null) ? (DateTimeColumn.Count - 1) : SortedDateTimeIndices[DateTimeColumn.Count - 1]);
					dateTime = DateTimeColumn[index];
					dateTime2 = DateTimeColumn[index2];
					HasUserInterval = false;
					if (base.CategoryMode == CategoryMode.Mode2)
					{
						TimeSpan timeSpan = Mode2TimeOffset(dateTime, dateTime2);
						if (dateTime != DateTime.MinValue)
						{
							dateTime -= timeSpan;
						}
						dateTime2 += timeSpan;
					}
				}
			}
			if (MinimumValueIsSet())
			{
				flag = true;
				dateTime = MinimumValue;
			}
			if (MaximumValueIsSet())
			{
				flag = true;
				dateTime2 = MaximumValue;
			}
			bool flag2 = ActualMinimumValue != dateTime || ActualMaximumValue != dateTime2;
			if (flag && flag2)
			{
				_ = ActualMinimumValue;
				_ = ActualMaximumValue;
				ActualMinimumValue = dateTime;
				ActualMaximumValue = dateTime2;
				UpdateVisibleRange();
			}
		}

		protected virtual void UpdateVisibleRange()
		{
		}

		protected virtual void PopulateSortedIndices()
		{
			if (IsDataPreSorted)
			{
				SortedDateTimeIndices = new List<int>();
				List<int> sortedDateTimeIndices = SortedDateTimeIndices;
				int count = DateTimeColumn.Count;
				for (int i = 0; i < count; i++)
				{
					sortedDateTimeIndices.Add(i);
				}
			}
			else
			{
				FastItemDateTimeColumn fastItemDateTimeColumn = DateTimeColumn as FastItemDateTimeColumn;
				SortedDateTimeIndices = fastItemDateTimeColumn.GetSortedIndices();
			}
		}

		int ISortingAxis.GetFirstVisibleIndex(Rect windowRect, Rect viewportRect, Rect effectiveViewport, Rect contentViewport)
		{
			return FirstVisibleIndex(windowRect, viewportRect, effectiveViewport, contentViewport);
		}

		protected virtual int FirstVisibleIndex(Rect windowRect, Rect viewportRect, Rect effectiveViewport, Rect contentViewport)
		{
			if (viewportRect.IsEmpty)
			{
				return -1;
			}
			Rect rect = contentViewport;
			ScalerParams p = new ScalerParams(windowRect, viewportRect, base.IsInverted, effectiveViewport);
			double unscaledValue;
			if (base.IsInverted)
			{
				GetUnscaledValue(rect.Left, p);
				unscaledValue = GetUnscaledValue(rect.Right, p);
			}
			else
			{
				unscaledValue = GetUnscaledValue(rect.Left, p);
				GetUnscaledValue(rect.Right, p);
			}
			long ticks = Math.Max(DateTime.MinValue.Ticks, Math.Min(DateTime.MaxValue.Ticks, (long)unscaledValue));
			return FirstVisibleIndex(new DateTime(ticks));
		}

		protected int FirstVisibleIndex(DateTime fromDate)
		{
			if (DateTimeColumn == null || SortedDateTimeIndices.Count != DateTimeColumn.Count)
			{
				return -1;
			}
			SortedListView<DateTime> view = new SortedListView<DateTime>(DateTimeColumn, SortedDateTimeIndices);
			int num = GetSearchResult(fromDate, view);
			if (num >= 0 && num < SortedDateTimeIndices.Count)
			{
				if (DateTimeColumn[SortedDateTimeIndices[num]] > fromDate)
				{
					num--;
					if (num < 0)
					{
						num = 0;
					}
				}
				return num;
			}
			return SortedDateTimeIndices.Count - 1;
		}

		int ISortingAxis.GetLastVisibleIndex(Rect windowRect, Rect viewportRect, Rect effectiveViewport, Rect contentViewport)
		{
			return LastVisibleIndex(windowRect, viewportRect, effectiveViewport, contentViewport);
		}

		protected virtual int LastVisibleIndex(Rect windowRect, Rect viewportRect, Rect effectiveViewportRect, Rect contentViewport)
		{
			if (viewportRect.IsEmpty)
			{
				return -1;
			}
			Rect rect = contentViewport;
			ScalerParams p = new ScalerParams(windowRect, viewportRect, base.IsInverted, effectiveViewportRect);
			double unscaledValue;
			if (base.IsInverted)
			{
				unscaledValue = GetUnscaledValue(rect.Left, p);
				GetUnscaledValue(rect.Right, p);
			}
			else
			{
				GetUnscaledValue(rect.Left, p);
				unscaledValue = GetUnscaledValue(rect.Right, p);
			}
			long ticks = Math.Max(DateTime.MinValue.Ticks, Math.Min(DateTime.MaxValue.Ticks, (long)unscaledValue));
			return LastVisibleIndex(new DateTime(ticks));
		}

		protected int LastVisibleIndex(DateTime toDate)
		{
			if (DateTimeColumn == null || SortedDateTimeIndices.Count != DateTimeColumn.Count)
			{
				return -1;
			}
			SortedListView<DateTime> view = new SortedListView<DateTime>(DateTimeColumn, SortedDateTimeIndices);
			int num = GetSearchResult(toDate, view);
			if (num >= SortedDateTimeIndices.Count)
			{
				num = SortedDateTimeIndices.Count - 1;
			}
			if (num >= 0 && num < SortedDateTimeIndices.Count)
			{
				if (DateTimeColumn[SortedDateTimeIndices[num]] < toDate)
				{
					num++;
					if (num > SortedDateTimeIndices.Count - 1)
					{
						num = SortedDateTimeIndices.Count - 1;
					}
				}
				return num;
			}
			return 0;
		}

		double ISortingAxis.GetUnscaledValueAt(int index)
		{
			if (DateTimeColumn == null)
			{
				return double.NaN;
			}
			return _dateTimeColumn[index].Ticks;
		}

		double ISortingAxis.GetExactUnsortedIndexClosestToUnscaledValue(double unscaledValue)
		{
			if (((ISortingAxis)this).SortedIndices == null)
			{
				return -1.0;
			}
			SortedListView<DateTime> sortedListView = new SortedListView<DateTime>(DateTimeColumn, ((ISortingAxis)this).SortedIndices);
			DateTime target = new DateTime((long)unscaledValue);
			int searchResult = GetSearchResult(target, sortedListView);
			if (searchResult >= 0 && searchResult < ((ISortingAxis)this).SortedIndices.Count && searchResult - 1 >= 0 && searchResult - 1 < ((ISortingAxis)this).SortedIndices.Count)
			{
				long num = target.Ticks - sortedListView[searchResult - 1].Ticks;
				long num2 = sortedListView[searchResult].Ticks - target.Ticks;
				int num3 = searchResult - 1;
				int num4 = searchResult;
				if (num3 < 0 && num4 >= 0)
				{
					return num4;
				}
				if (num4 > ((ISortingAxis)this).SortedIndices.Count - 1 && num3 < ((ISortingAxis)this).SortedIndices.Count)
				{
					return num3;
				}
				if (num3 < 0 && num4 < 0)
				{
					return -1.0;
				}
				if (num3 > ((ISortingAxis)this).SortedIndices.Count - 1 && num4 > ((ISortingAxis)this).SortedIndices.Count - 1)
				{
					return -1.0;
				}
				double num5 = (double)num / (double)(num + num2);
				if (double.IsNaN(num5))
				{
					num5 = 0.0;
				}
				return (double)num3 + num5;
			}
			if (searchResult >= 0 && searchResult < ((ISortingAxis)this).SortedIndices.Count)
			{
				return searchResult;
			}
			Rect currentEffectiveViewport = GetCurrentEffectiveViewport();
			if (searchResult == ((ISortingAxis)this).SortedIndices.Count && base.SeriesViewer != null && GetScaledValue(unscaledValue, new ScalerParams(base.SeriesViewer.ActualWindowRect, base.ViewportRect, base.IsInverted, currentEffectiveViewport)) < base.ViewportRect.Right + 2.0)
			{
				return searchResult - 1;
			}
			if (searchResult == -1 && base.SeriesViewer != null && Math.Abs(GetScaledValue(unscaledValue, new ScalerParams(base.SeriesViewer.ActualWindowRect, base.ViewportRect, base.IsInverted, currentEffectiveViewport)) - base.ViewportRect.Left) < 2.0)
			{
				return 0.0;
			}
			return -1.0;
		}

		protected int GetSearchResult(DateTime target, SortedListView<DateTime> view)
		{
			if (DateTimeColumn == null || ((ISortingAxis)this).SortedIndices == null)
			{
				return -1;
			}
			int num = -1;
			int num2 = view.BinarySearch(delegate(DateTime item)
			{
				if (target < item)
				{
					return -1;
				}
				return (target > item) ? 1 : 0;
			});
			num = ((num2 < 0) ? (~num2) : num2);
			while (num >= 0 && num < view.Count && num - 1 >= 0 && view[num] == view[num - 1])
			{
				num--;
			}
			return num;
		}

		public virtual int GetIndexClosestToUnscaledValue(double unscaledValue)
		{
			if (((ISortingAxis)this).SortedIndices == null || DateTimeColumn == null || ((ISortingAxis)this).SortedIndices.Count != DateTimeColumn.Count)
			{
				return -1;
			}
			SortedListView<DateTime> sortedListView = new SortedListView<DateTime>(DateTimeColumn, ((ISortingAxis)this).SortedIndices);
			if (unscaledValue < (double)DateTime.MinValue.Ticks || unscaledValue > (double)DateTime.MaxValue.Ticks)
			{
				return -1;
			}
			DateTime dateTime = new DateTime((long)unscaledValue);
			int num = GetSearchResult(dateTime, sortedListView);
			Rect currentEffectiveViewport = GetCurrentEffectiveViewport();
			if (num >= 0 && num < ((ISortingAxis)this).SortedIndices.Count && num - 1 >= 0 && num - 1 < ((ISortingAxis)this).SortedIndices.Count)
			{
				TimeSpan timeSpan = dateTime - sortedListView[num - 1];
				TimeSpan timeSpan2 = sortedListView[num] - dateTime;
				if (timeSpan < timeSpan2)
				{
					num--;
				}
			}
			if (num >= 0 && num < ((ISortingAxis)this).SortedIndices.Count)
			{
				return ((ISortingAxis)this).SortedIndices[num];
			}
			if (num == ((ISortingAxis)this).SortedIndices.Count && base.SeriesViewer != null && GetScaledValue(unscaledValue, new ScalerParams(base.SeriesViewer.ActualWindowRect, base.ViewportRect, base.IsInverted, currentEffectiveViewport)) < base.ViewportRect.Right + 2.0)
			{
				return num - 1;
			}
			if (num == -1 && base.SeriesViewer != null && Math.Abs(GetScaledValue(unscaledValue, new ScalerParams(base.SeriesViewer.ActualWindowRect, base.ViewportRect, base.IsInverted, currentEffectiveViewport)) - base.ViewportRect.Left) < 2.0)
			{
				return 0;
			}
			return -1;
		}

		internal override bool UpdateRangeOverride()
		{
			if (base.MustInvalidateLabels && base.UseEnhancedIntervalManagement)
			{
				base.LabelFontHeuristics = GatherLabelFontHeuristics();
			}
			long ticks = ActualMinimumValue.Ticks;
			long ticks2 = ActualMaximumValue.Ticks;
			InitializeActualMinimumAndMaximum();
			long num = ((!MinimumValueIsSet()) ? ActualMinimumValue.Ticks : MinimumValue.Ticks);
			long num2 = ((!MaximumValueIsSet()) ? ActualMaximumValue.Ticks : MaximumValue.Ticks);
			AxisRangeChangedEventArgs ea = new AxisRangeChangedEventArgs(ticks, num, ticks2, num2);
			RaiseRangeChanged(ea);
			return true;
		}

		protected bool MinimumValueIsSet()
		{
			if (MinimumValue == DateTime.MinValue)
			{
				return false;
			}
			return MinimumValue != DateTime.MinValue;
		}

		protected bool MaximumValueIsSet()
		{
			if (MaximumValue == DateTime.MaxValue)
			{
				return false;
			}
			return MaximumValue != DateTime.MaxValue;
		}

		}

		protected internal override object ResolveActualMaximumValue()

		}

		private void RenderAxisAndSeries(bool animate)
		{
			RenderAxisOverride(animate);
			if (base.FastItemsSource == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			foreach (Series item in DirectSeries())
			{
				item.RenderSeries(animate);
			}
		}

		protected override void PropertyUpdatedOverride(object sender, string propertyName, object oldValue, object newValue)
		{
			base.PropertyUpdatedOverride(sender, propertyName, oldValue, newValue);
			switch (propertyName)
			{
			case "FastItemsSource":
				if (oldValue is IFastItemsSource fastItemsSource)
				{
					fastItemsSource.DeregisterColumn(DateTimeColumn);
					DateTimeColumn = null;
					fastItemsSource.Event -= fastItemsSource_Event;
				}
				if (newValue is IFastItemsSource fastItemsSource2)
				{
					SortedDateTimeIndices = null;
					DateTimeColumn = RegisterDateTimeColumn(DateTimeMemberPath);
					fastItemsSource2.Event += fastItemsSource_Event;
				}
				RenderAxisAndSeries(animate: false);
				break;
			case "DateTimeMemberPath":
				if (base.FastItemsSource != null)
				{
					base.FastItemsSource.DeregisterColumn(DateTimeColumn);
					DateTimeColumn = RegisterDateTimeColumn(DateTimeMemberPath);
					SortedDateTimeIndices = null;
				}
				break;
			case "MinimumValue":
				UpdateRange();
				RenderAxisAndSeries(animate: false);
				break;
			case "MaximumValue":
				UpdateRange();
				RenderAxisAndSeries(animate: false);
				break;
			case "DateTimeColumn":
				InitializeActualMinimumAndMaximum();
				break;
			}
		}

		private void fastItemsSource_Event(object sender, FastItemsSourceEventArgs e)
		{
			SortedDateTimeIndices = null;
		}

		protected IFastItemColumn<DateTime> RegisterDateTimeColumn(string memberPath)
		{
			return RegisterDateTimeColumn(memberPath, this);
		}

		}

		internal override AxisLabelPanelBase CreateLabelPanel()
		{
			if (base.UseSmartAxis)
			{
				return new HorizontalSmartAxisLabelPanel();
			}
			return new HorizontalAxisLabelPanel();
		}

		protected override void RenderAxisOverride(bool animate)
		{
			base.RenderAxisOverride(animate);
			GeometryCollection axisLinesGeometry = View.GetAxisLinesGeometry();
			GeometryCollection stripsGeometry = View.GetStripsGeometry();
			GeometryCollection majorLinesGeometry = View.GetMajorLinesGeometry();
			GeometryCollection minorLinesGeometry = View.GetMinorLinesGeometry();
			View.GetAxisLinesPathInfo();
			View.GetMajorLinesPathInfo();
			View.GetMinorLinesPathInfo();
			UpdateLineVisibility();
			ClearMarks(axisLinesGeometry);
			ClearMarks(stripsGeometry);
			ClearMarks(majorLinesGeometry);
			ClearMarks(minorLinesGeometry);
			base.LabelDataContext.Clear();
			base.LabelPositions.Clear();
			base.MajorLinePositions.Clear();
			base.LabelPanel.Axis = this;
			Rect windowRect = ((base.SeriesViewer != null) ? base.SeriesViewer.ActualWindowRect : Rect.Empty);
			Rect viewportRect = ((!windowRect.IsEmpty) ? base.ViewportRect : Rect.Empty);
			base.LabelPanel.WindowRect = windowRect;
			base.LabelPanel.ViewportRect = viewportRect;
			if (windowRect.IsEmpty || viewportRect.IsEmpty)
			{
				base.TextBlocks.Count = 0;
				base.AnnotationTextBlocks.Count = 0;
				base.AnnotationBackings.Count = 0;
			}
			if (base.TextBlocks.Count == 0)
			{
				base.LabelPanel.Children.Clear();
			}
			if (base.LabelSettings != null)
			{
				base.LabelSettings.RegisterAxis(this);
			}
			InitializeActualMinimumAndMaximum();
		}

		internal override double GetCategorySize(Rect windowRect, Rect viewportRect, Rect effectiveViewportRect)
		{
			if (CachedItemsCount == 0)
			{
				return 0.0;
			}
			return GetInitialSafeViewport(viewportRect, effectiveViewportRect).Width / ((double)CachedItemsCount * windowRect.Width);
		}

		internal override double GetGroupCenter(int index, Rect windowRect, Rect viewportRect, Rect effectiveViewportRect)
		{
			return GetCategorySize(windowRect, viewportRect, effectiveViewportRect) * 0.5;
		}

		internal override double GetGroupSize(Rect windowRect, Rect viewportRect, Rect effectiveViewportRect)
		{
			double num = ((!double.IsNaN(base.Gap)) ? MathUtil.Clamp(base.Gap, 0.0, 1.0) : 0.0);
			double num2 = 1.0 - 0.5 * num;
			double val = GetCategorySize(windowRect, viewportRect, effectiveViewportRect) * num2;
			return Math.Max(1.0, val);
		}

		protected virtual TimeSpan Mode2TimeOffset(DateTime min, DateTime max)
		{
			return TimeSpan.Zero;
		}

		CategoryMode IDateTimeAxis.PreferredCategoryMode(Series series)
		{
			if (!IsCategoryDateTime)
			{
				return CategoryMode.Mode1;
			}
			return CategoryMode.Mode0;
		}

	[Widget]
	[WFWidget]
	[TSWidget]
	[XamWrapper]
	[TSEmitModuleDefinitions]
	[TSRegisterModuleCollection]
	public class TimeAxisInterval : INotifyPropertyChanged
	{
		private const string RangePropertyName = "Range";

		private TimeSpan _Range = TimeSpan.Zero;

		private const string IntervalPropertyName = "Interval";

		private double _Interval;

		private const string IntervalTypePropertyName = "IntervalType";

		private TimeAxisIntervalType _IntervalType;

		public TimeSpan Range
		{
			get
			{
				return _Range;
			}
			set
			{
				TimeSpan range = Range;
				if (value != range)
				{
					_Range = value;
					OnPropertyUpdated("Range", range, Range);
				}
			}
		}

		public double Interval
		{
			get
			{
				return _Interval;
			}
			set
			{
				double interval = Interval;
				if (value != interval)
				{
					_Interval = value;
					OnPropertyUpdated("Interval", interval, Interval);
				}
			}
		}

		public TimeAxisIntervalType IntervalType
		{
			get
			{
				return _IntervalType;
			}
			set
			{
				TimeAxisIntervalType intervalType = IntervalType;
				if (value != intervalType)
				{
					_IntervalType = value;
					OnPropertyUpdated("Interval", intervalType, IntervalType);
				}
			}
		}

		public event PropertyChangedEventHandler PropertyChanged;

		internal DateTime NextTime(DateTime start)
		{
			switch (IntervalType)
			{
			case TimeAxisIntervalType.Ticks:
				return start.AddSeconds(0.0001);
			case TimeAxisIntervalType.Milliseconds:
			{
				DateTime dateTime = start.AddSeconds(0.001);
				return new DateTime(dateTime.Year, dateTime.Month, dateTime.Day, dateTime.Hour, dateTime.Minute, dateTime.Second, dateTime.Millisecond);
			}
			case TimeAxisIntervalType.Seconds:
			{
				DateTime dateTime = start.AddSeconds(1.0);
				return new DateTime(dateTime.Year, dateTime.Month, dateTime.Day, dateTime.Hour, dateTime.Minute, dateTime.Second);
			}
			case TimeAxisIntervalType.Minutes:
			{
				DateTime dateTime = start.AddMinutes(1.0);
				return new DateTime(dateTime.Year, dateTime.Month, dateTime.Day, dateTime.Hour, dateTime.Minute, 0);
			}
			case TimeAxisIntervalType.Hours:
			case TimeAxisIntervalType.Days:
			{
				DateTime dateTime = start.AddHours(1.0);
				return new DateTime(dateTime.Year, dateTime.Month, dateTime.Day, dateTime.Hour, 0, 0);
			}
			case TimeAxisIntervalType.Weeks:
			case TimeAxisIntervalType.Months:
			case TimeAxisIntervalType.Years:
			{
				DateTime dateTime = start.AddDays(1.0);
				return new DateTime(dateTime.Year, dateTime.Month, dateTime.Day);
			}
			default:
				return start;
			}
		}

		internal DateTime AddTo(DateTime start)
		{
			TimeSpan timeSpan = DateTime.MaxValue - start;
			switch (IntervalType)
			{
			case TimeAxisIntervalType.Ticks:
				if (timeSpan > TimeSpan.FromTicks((int)Interval))
				{
					return start.AddSeconds(Interval / 10000.0);
				}
				return DateTime.MaxValue;
			case TimeAxisIntervalType.Milliseconds:
				if (timeSpan > TimeSpan.FromMilliseconds(Interval))
				{
					return start.AddSeconds(Interval / 1000.0);
				}
				return DateTime.MaxValue;
			case TimeAxisIntervalType.Seconds:
				if (timeSpan > TimeSpan.FromSeconds(Interval))
				{
					return start.AddSeconds(Interval);
				}
				return DateTime.MaxValue;
			case TimeAxisIntervalType.Minutes:
				if (timeSpan > TimeSpan.FromMinutes(Interval))
				{
					return start.AddMinutes(Interval);
				}
				return DateTime.MaxValue;
			case TimeAxisIntervalType.Hours:
				if (timeSpan > TimeSpan.FromHours(Interval))
				{
					return start.AddHours(Interval);
				}
				return DateTime.MaxValue;
			case TimeAxisIntervalType.Days:
				if (timeSpan > TimeSpan.FromDays(Interval))
				{
					return start.AddDays(Interval);
				}
				return DateTime.MaxValue;
			case TimeAxisIntervalType.Weeks:
				if (timeSpan > TimeSpan.FromDays(7.0 * Interval))
				{
					return start.AddDays(Interval * 7.0);
				}
				return DateTime.MaxValue;
			case TimeAxisIntervalType.Months:
				if (timeSpan > TimeSpan.FromDays(31 * (int)Interval))
				{
					return start.AddMonths((int)Interval);
				}
				return DateTime.MaxValue;
			case TimeAxisIntervalType.Years:
				if (timeSpan > TimeSpan.FromDays(365 * (int)Interval))
				{
					return start.AddYears((int)Interval);
				}
				return DateTime.MaxValue;
			default:
				return start;
			}
		}

		private void OnPropertyUpdated(string propertyName, object oldValue, object newValue)
		{
			PropertyUpdateOverride(propertyName, oldValue, newValue);
			if (this.PropertyChanged != null)
			{
				this.PropertyChanged(this, new PropertyChangedEventArgs(propertyName));
			}
		}

		protected virtual void PropertyUpdateOverride(string propertyName, object oldValue, object newValue)
		{
		}

		public override double GetScaledValue(double unscaledValue, ScalerParams p)
		{
			if (!p.EffectiveViewportRect.IsEmpty)
			{
				double timeScaledValueHelper = GetTimeScaledValueHelper(unscaledValue, NumericScaler.UnitRect, p.EffectiveViewportRect, Rect.Empty);
				timeScaledValueHelper = (timeScaledValueHelper - p.ViewportRect.Left) / p.ViewportRect.Width;
				return p.ViewportRect.Left + p.ViewportRect.Width * (timeScaledValueHelper - p.WindowRect.Left) / p.WindowRect.Width;
			}
			return GetTimeScaledValueHelper(unscaledValue, p.WindowRect, p.ViewportRect, p.EffectiveViewportRect);
		}

		private double GetTimeScaledValueHelper(double unscaledValue, Rect windowRect, Rect viewportRect, Rect effectiveViewportRect)
		{
			KeyValuePair<TimeAxisBreak, double> keyValuePair = default(KeyValuePair<TimeAxisBreak, double>);
			int i = ((ScaledValueCursor != int.MinValue) ? ScaledValueCursor : 0);
			for (int num = ((BreakPositions != null) ? BreakPositions.Count : 0); i < num; i++)
			{
				TimeAxisBreak timeAxisBreak = BreakPositions[i];
				if ((double)timeAxisBreak.Start.Ticks <= unscaledValue && (double)timeAxisBreak.End.Ticks >= unscaledValue)
				{
					return double.NaN;
				}
				if (!((double)timeAxisBreak.End.Ticks <= unscaledValue))
				{
					break;
				}
				keyValuePair = new KeyValuePair<TimeAxisBreak, double>(timeAxisBreak, BreakPositions[timeAxisBreak]);
			}
			if (i > 0)
			{
				i--;
			}
			if (ScaledValueCursor != int.MinValue)
			{
				ScaledValueCursor = i;
			}
			double num2;
			DateTime dateTime;
			if (keyValuePair.Key != null)
			{
				num2 = keyValuePair.Value;
				dateTime = keyValuePair.Key.End;
			}
			else
			{
				num2 = 0.0;
				dateTime = base.ActualMinimumValue;
			}
			double num3 = (double)(new DateTime((long)unscaledValue) - dateTime).Ticks / (double)(base.ActualMaximumValue - base.ActualMinimumValue - Omission).Ticks;
			double num4 = num2 + num3;
			num4 -= windowRect.Left;
			num4 /= windowRect.Width;
			double num5 = viewportRect.Left;
			double num6 = viewportRect.Right;
			double num7 = viewportRect.Width;
			if (base.CategoryMode != CategoryMode.Mode0)
			{
				double categorySize = GetCategorySize(windowRect, viewportRect, effectiveViewportRect);
				num5 += categorySize / 2.0;
				num6 -= categorySize / 2.0;
				num7 -= categorySize;
			}
			if (base.IsInverted)
			{
				return num6 - num7 * num4;
			}
			return num5 + num7 * num4;
		}

		public override void GetScaledValueList(IList<double> unscaledValues, int startIndex, int count, ScalerParams p)
		{
			ScaledValueCursor = 0;
			for (int i = startIndex; i < count; i++)
			{
				unscaledValues[i] = GetScaledValue(unscaledValues[i], p);
			}
			ScaledValueCursor = int.MinValue;
		}

		protected override void StartCursor()
		{
			ScaledValueCursor = 0;
		}

		protected override void ResetCursor()
		{
			ScaledValueCursor = int.MinValue;
		}

		public override double GetUnscaledValue(double scaledValue, ScalerParams p)
		{
			if (!p.EffectiveViewportRect.IsEmpty)
			{
				double num = p.WindowRect.Left + p.WindowRect.Width * (scaledValue - p.ViewportRect.Left) / p.ViewportRect.Width;
				num = num * p.ViewportRect.Width + p.ViewportRect.Left;
				return GetUnscaledValue(num, NumericScaler.UnitRect, p.EffectiveViewportRect, base.CategoryMode);
			}
			return GetUnscaledValueHelper(scaledValue, p.WindowRect, p.ViewportRect, p.EffectiveViewportRect);
		}

		private double GetUnscaledValueHelper(double scaledValue, Rect windowRect, Rect viewportRect, Rect effectiveViewportRect)
		{
			double num = viewportRect.Left;
			double num2 = viewportRect.Width;
			if (base.CategoryMode != CategoryMode.Mode0)
			{
				double categorySize = GetCategorySize(windowRect, viewportRect, effectiveViewportRect);
				num += categorySize / 2.0;
				num2 -= categorySize;
			}
			double num3 = windowRect.Left + windowRect.Width * (scaledValue - num) / num2;
			if (base.IsInverted)
			{
				num3 = 1.0 - num3;
			}
			KeyValuePair<TimeAxisBreak, double> keyValuePair = default(KeyValuePair<TimeAxisBreak, double>);
			if (BreakPositions != null)
			{
				foreach (KeyValuePair<TimeAxisBreak, double> breakPosition in BreakPositions)
				{
					if (breakPosition.Value >= num3 && breakPosition.Value <= num3)
					{
						return breakPosition.Key.Start.Ticks;
					}
					if (breakPosition.Value < num3 && breakPosition.Value > keyValuePair.Value)
					{
						keyValuePair = breakPosition;
					}
				}
			}
			double num4;
			DateTime dateTime;
			if (keyValuePair.Key != null)
			{
				num4 = keyValuePair.Value;
				dateTime = keyValuePair.Key.End;
			}
			else
			{
				num4 = 0.0;
				dateTime = base.ActualMinimumValue;
			}
			double num5 = num3 - num4;
			TimeSpan timeSpan = base.ActualMaximumValue - base.ActualMinimumValue - Omission;
			return (double)dateTime.Ticks + num5 * (double)timeSpan.Ticks;
		}

		protected override void PropertyUpdatedOverride(object sender, string propertyName, object oldValue, object newValue)
		{
			base.PropertyUpdatedOverride(sender, propertyName, oldValue, newValue);
			switch (propertyName)
			{
			case "ActualMaximumValue":
				CalculateOmission();
				break;
			case "DateTimeColumn":
				InferredInterval = InferInterval();
				break;
			case "LabellingMode":
				RenderAxis(animate: false);
				break;
			}
		}

		private void CalculateOmission()
		{
			IEnumerable<TimeAxisBreak> enumerable = UnrollRepeats(Breaks);
			TimeSpan zero = TimeSpan.Zero;
			foreach (TimeAxisBreak item in enumerable)
			{
				zero += item.End - item.Start;
			}
			Omission = zero;
		}

		private IEnumerable<TimeAxisBreak> UnrollRepeats(IEnumerable breaks)
		{
			List<TimeAxisBreak> list = new List<TimeAxisBreak>();
			if (breaks == null || base.ActualMaximumValue == DateTime.MaxValue)
			{
				return list;
			}
			foreach (TimeAxisBreak @break in breaks)
			{
				if (@break.End >= base.ActualMinimumValue && @break.Start <= base.ActualMaximumValue)
				{
					list.Add(@break);
				}
				if (!(@break.Interval != TimeSpan.Zero))
				{
					continue;
				}
				TimeSpan timeSpan = @break.End - @break.Start;
				DateTime dateTime = @break.Start + @break.Interval;
				while (dateTime <= base.ActualMaximumValue)
				{
					DateTime end = dateTime + timeSpan;
					TimeAxisBreak timeAxisBreak2 = new TimeAxisBreak
					{
						Start = dateTime,
						End = end
					};
					if (timeAxisBreak2.End >= base.ActualMinimumValue && timeAxisBreak2.Start <= base.ActualMaximumValue)
					{
						list.Add(timeAxisBreak2);
					}
					if (DateTime.MaxValue - @break.Interval < timeAxisBreak2.Start)
					{
						break;
					}
					dateTime = timeAxisBreak2.Start + @break.Interval;
				}
			}
			return list;
		}

		private void CalculateBreakPositions()
		{
			BreakPositions = new OrderedDictionary<TimeAxisBreak, double>();
			if (base.ActualMaximumValue == DateTime.MaxValue || Breaks == null || Breaks.Count == 0 || base.SeriesViewer == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			List<TimeAxisBreak> list = new List<TimeAxisBreak>(UnrollRepeats(Breaks));
			list.Sort((TimeAxisBreak a, TimeAxisBreak b) => (!(a.Start < b.Start)) ? ((a.Start > b.Start) ? 1 : 0) : (-1));
			_ = base.SeriesViewer.ActualWindowRect;
			new ScalerParams(base.SeriesViewer.ActualWindowRect, base.SeriesViewer.ViewportRect, base.IsInverted, base.SeriesViewer.EffectiveViewport);
			TimeSpan timeSpan = base.ActualMaximumValue - base.ActualMinimumValue - Omission;
			double num = 0.0;
			foreach (TimeAxisBreak item in list)
			{
				double num2 = (double)(item.Start - base.ActualMinimumValue).Ticks / (double)timeSpan.Ticks;
				double num3 = (double)(item.End - base.ActualMinimumValue).Ticks / (double)timeSpan.Ticks;
				if (!(num3 < 0.0) && !(num2 - num > 1.0))
				{
					BreakPositions.Add(item, num2 - num);
					num += num3 - num2;
				}
			}
		}

		public override string GetValueLabel(double value)
		{
			if (double.IsNaN(value))
			{
				return null;
			}
			long val = (long)value;
			val = Math.Min(DateTime.MaxValue.Ticks, val);
			DateTime dateTime = new DateTime(val);
			return GetLabel(dateTime)?.ToString();
		}

		protected internal override object GetLabel(object dataItem)
		{
			if (!(dataItem is DateTime))
			{
				return base.GetLabel(dataItem);
			}
			DateTime prior = DateTime.MinValue;
			bool hasPrior = false;
			if (PriorDataItem != null && PriorDataItem is DateTime)
			{
				prior = (DateTime)PriorDataItem;
				hasPrior = true;
			}
			object label = GetLabel((DateTime)dataItem, hasPrior, prior, LabellingMode, VisibleRange, LabelFormats, base.Culture);
			if (label != null)
			{
				return label;
			}
			return base.GetLabel(dataItem);
		}

		internal static object GetLabel(DateTime time, bool hasPrior, DateTime prior, TimeAxisLabellingMode mode, TimeSpan visibleRange, IList<TimeAxisLabelFormat> labelFormats, CultureInfo culture)
		{
			string labelFormat = GetLabelFormat(time, hasPrior, prior, mode, visibleRange, labelFormats, culture);
			return time.ToString(labelFormat, culture);
		}

		internal static string GetLabelFormat(DateTime time, bool hasPrior, DateTime prior, TimeAxisLabellingMode mode, TimeSpan visibleRange, IList<TimeAxisLabelFormat> labelFormats, CultureInfo culture)
		{
			TimeRepetitionLevel timeRepetitionLevel = TimeRepetitionLevel.None;
			if (hasPrior)
			{
				timeRepetitionLevel = GetTimeRepetitionLevel(time, prior);
			}
			TimeAxisLabelFormat timeAxisLabelFormat = null;
			if (labelFormats == null || labelFormats.Count == 0)
			{
				return GetAutoFormat(visibleRange, timeRepetitionLevel, mode);
			}
			TimeSpan timeSpan = TimeSpan.MaxValue;
			TimeAxisLabelFormat timeAxisLabelFormat2 = null;
			foreach (TimeAxisLabelFormat labelFormat in labelFormats)
			{
				if (labelFormat.Range < timeSpan)
				{
					timeSpan = labelFormat.Range;
					timeAxisLabelFormat2 = labelFormat;
				}
				if (!(labelFormat.Range > visibleRange) && (timeAxisLabelFormat == null || labelFormat.Range > timeAxisLabelFormat.Range))
				{
					timeAxisLabelFormat = labelFormat;
				}
			}
			if (timeAxisLabelFormat == null)
			{
				timeAxisLabelFormat = timeAxisLabelFormat2;
			}
			if (timeAxisLabelFormat == null)
			{
				return null;
			}
			switch (timeRepetitionLevel)
			{
			case TimeRepetitionLevel.Day:
				if (timeAxisLabelFormat.RepeatedDayFormat != null)
				{
					return timeAxisLabelFormat.RepeatedDayFormat;
				}
				if (timeAxisLabelFormat.RepeatedMonthFormat != null)
				{
					return timeAxisLabelFormat.RepeatedMonthFormat;
				}
				if (timeAxisLabelFormat.RepeatedYearFormat != null)
				{
					return timeAxisLabelFormat.RepeatedYearFormat;
				}
				return timeAxisLabelFormat.Format;
			case TimeRepetitionLevel.Month:
				if (timeAxisLabelFormat.RepeatedMonthFormat != null)
				{
					return timeAxisLabelFormat.RepeatedMonthFormat;
				}
				if (timeAxisLabelFormat.RepeatedYearFormat != null)
				{
					return timeAxisLabelFormat.RepeatedYearFormat;
				}
				return timeAxisLabelFormat.Format;
			case TimeRepetitionLevel.Year:
				if (timeAxisLabelFormat.RepeatedYearFormat != null)
				{
					return timeAxisLabelFormat.RepeatedYearFormat;
				}
				return timeAxisLabelFormat.Format;
			default:
				return timeAxisLabelFormat.Format;
			}
		}

		private static TimeRepetitionLevel GetTimeRepetitionLevel(DateTime time, DateTime prior)
		{
			if (time.Year == prior.Year && time.Month == prior.Month && time.Day == prior.Day)
			{
				return TimeRepetitionLevel.Day;
			}
			if (time.Year == prior.Year && time.Month == prior.Month)
			{
				return TimeRepetitionLevel.Month;
			}
			if (time.Year == prior.Year)
			{
				return TimeRepetitionLevel.Year;
			}
			return TimeRepetitionLevel.None;
		}

		private string GetAutoFormat(TimeRepetitionLevel level, TimeAxisLabellingMode mode)
		{
			return GetAutoFormat(VisibleRange, level, mode);
		}

		internal static string GetAutoFormat([SwiftMutableParameter] TimeSpan visibleRange, [SwiftMutableParameter] TimeRepetitionLevel level, TimeAxisLabellingMode mode)
		{
			if (mode != TimeAxisLabellingMode.Compressed)
			{
				level = TimeRepetitionLevel.None;
			}
			visibleRange = visibleRange.Duration();
			if (visibleRange > new TimeSpan(1825, 0, 0, 0))
			{
				return "yyyy";
			}
			if (visibleRange > new TimeSpan(365, 0, 0, 0))
			{
				switch (level)
				{
				case TimeRepetitionLevel.Year:
				case TimeRepetitionLevel.Month:
				case TimeRepetitionLevel.Day:
					return "MMM";
				default:
					return "MMM yyyy";
				}
			}
			if (visibleRange > new TimeSpan(4, 0, 0, 0))
			{
				if (level == TimeRepetitionLevel.Month || level == TimeRepetitionLevel.Day)
				{
					return "dd";
				}
				return "MMM dd";
			}
			if (visibleRange > new TimeSpan(1, 0, 0, 0))
			{
				return level switch
				{
					TimeRepetitionLevel.Day => "hh:mmtt", 
					TimeRepetitionLevel.Month => "dd hh:mmtt", 
					_ => "MMM dd hh:mmtt", 
				};
			}
			if (visibleRange > new TimeSpan(0, 10, 0))
			{
				return "hh:mm";
			}
			return "hh:mm:ss";
		}

					{

					{

						new TimeAxisInterval

							IntervalType = TimeAxisIntervalType.Years,
							Interval = 1.0
						}

					{
						TimeSpan.FromDays(3650.0),
						new TimeAxisInterval
						{
							IntervalType = TimeAxisIntervalType.Years,
							Interval = 10.0
						}
					}
				};
			}
			return _GoodIntervals;
		}

		private TimeAxisInterval GetAutoInterval()
		{
			if (base.UseEnhancedIntervalManagement && (base.LabelSettings == null || base.LabelSettings.Angle == 0.0))
			{
				double num = ResolveHeuristicHorizontalResolution();
				int num2 = (int)Math.Floor(base.ViewportRect.Width / num);
				TimeSpan maxValue = TimeSpan.MaxValue;
				TimeSpan timeSpan = ((num2 == 0) ? maxValue : TimeSpan.FromTicks(VisibleRange.Ticks / num2));
				TimeAxisInterval timeAxisInterval = null;
				foreach (KeyValuePair<TimeSpan, TimeAxisInterval> item in GoodIntervals())
				{
					timeAxisInterval = item.Value;
					if (item.Key > timeSpan)
					{
						break;
					}
				}

		private KeyValuePair<TimeAxisBreak, double> GetContainingBreak(DateTime time)
		{

				}
			}

		}

					dictionary.Add(timeSpan, 0);
				}
				dictionary[timeSpan]++;

				{
					num2 = dictionary[timeSpan];
					result = timeSpan;
				}
				dateTime = dateTime2;
			}

		}

	public class VerticalPercentChangeScaler : NumericScaler
	{
		private PercentChangeYAxis Axis { get; set; }

		public VerticalPercentChangeScaler(PercentChangeYAxis axis)
		{
			Axis = axis;
		}

		public override void CalculateRange(NumericAxisBase target, double minimumValue, double maximumValue, out double actualMinimumValue, out double actualMaximumValue)
		{
			AutoRangeCalculator.CalculateRange(Axis, minimumValue, maximumValue, isLogarithmic: false, -1, out actualMinimumValue, out actualMaximumValue);
		}

		public override double GetScaledValue(double unscaledValue, ScalerParams p)
		{
			if (!p.EffectiveViewportRect.IsEmpty)
			{
				double scaledPercentageValueHelper = GetScaledPercentageValueHelper(unscaledValue, NumericScaler.UnitRect, p.EffectiveViewportRect, p.ReferenceValue, p.IsInverted);
				scaledPercentageValueHelper = (scaledPercentageValueHelper - p.ViewportRect.Top) / p.ViewportRect.Height;
				return p.ViewportRect.Top + p.ViewportRect.Height * (scaledPercentageValueHelper - p.WindowRect.Top) / p.WindowRect.Height;
			}
			return GetScaledPercentageValueHelper(unscaledValue, p.WindowRect, p.ViewportRect, p.ReferenceValue, p.IsInverted);
		}

		private double GetScaledPercentageValueHelper(double unscaledValue, Rect windowRect, Rect viewportRect, double referenceValue, bool isInverted)
		{
			double num = ((!double.IsNaN(referenceValue)) ? ((unscaledValue - referenceValue) / Math.Abs(referenceValue) * 100.0) : unscaledValue);
			double num2 = (num - CachedActualMinimumValue) / base.ActualRange;
			if (!isInverted)
			{
				num2 = 1.0 - num2;
			}
			return viewportRect.Top + viewportRect.Height * (num2 - windowRect.Top) / windowRect.Height;
		}

		public override double GetUnscaledValue([TreatAsPX] double scaledValue, ScalerParams p)
		{
			double referenceValue = p.ReferenceValue;
			double num = p.WindowRect.Top + p.WindowRect.Height * (scaledValue - p.ViewportRect.Top) / p.ViewportRect.Height;
			if (!p.IsInverted)
			{
				num = 1.0 - num;
			}
			double num2 = CachedActualMinimumValue + num * base.ActualRange;
			if (double.IsNaN(referenceValue))
			{
				return num2;
			}
			return num2 * Math.Abs(referenceValue) / 100.0 + referenceValue;
		}
	}
	internal class AngleRadiusPair
	{
		public int Index { get; set; }

		public double Angle { get; set; }

		public double Radius { get; set; }
	}
	internal class PolarLinePlanner
	{
		private Rect _viewport;

		private Rect _window;

		public bool UseCartesianInterpolation { get; set; }

		public UnknownValuePlotting UnknownValuePlotting { get; set; }

		public Func<int, double> AngleProvider { get; set; }

		public Func<int, double> RadiusProvider { get; set; }

		public Func<int, double> TransformedXProvider { get; set; }

		public Func<int, double> TransformedYProvider { get; set; }

		public double Resolution { get; set; }

		public int Count { get; set; }

		public Rect Viewport
		{
			get
			{
				return _viewport;
			}
			set
			{
				_viewport = value;
			}
		}

		public Rect Window
		{
			get
			{
				return _window;
			}
			set
			{
				_window = value;
			}
		}

		public Clipper Clipper { get; set; }

		public bool ClippingDisabled { get; set; }

		public bool IsClosed { get; set; }

		private IList<Point> Target { get; set; }

		protected bool Valid()
		{
			if (AngleProvider == null || RadiusProvider == null || TransformedXProvider == null || TransformedYProvider == null || Viewport == Rect.Empty || Window == Rect.Empty)
			{
				return false;
			}
			return true;
		}

		protected double Measure(Func<int, double> X, Func<int, double> Y, int a, int b)
		{
			double num = X(b) - X(a);
			double num2 = Y(b) - Y(a);
			return num * num + num2 * num2;
		}

		internal IList<AngleRadiusPair> Reduce(IEnumerable<int> viableIndices)
		{
			List<AngleRadiusPair> list = new List<AngleRadiusPair>();
			double num = Resolution * Resolution;
			IEnumerable<int> enumerable;
			if (viableIndices != null)
			{
				enumerable = viableIndices;
			}
			else
			{
				List<int> list2 = new List<int>();
				for (int i = 0; i < Count; i++)
				{
					list2.Add(i);
				}
				enumerable = list2;
			}
			IEnumerator<int> enumerator = enumerable.GetEnumerator();
			bool flag = true;
			flag = enumerator.MoveNext();
			int num2 = 0;
			if (flag)
			{
				num2 = enumerator.Current;
			}
			while (flag)
			{
				int num3 = num2;
				flag = enumerator.MoveNext();
				num2 = enumerator.Current;
				while (flag && Measure(TransformedXProvider, TransformedYProvider, num3, num2) < num)
				{
					flag = enumerator.MoveNext();
					num2 = enumerator.Current;
				}
				AngleRadiusPair angleRadiusPair = new AngleRadiusPair();
				angleRadiusPair.Index = num3;
				if (!UseCartesianInterpolation)
				{
					angleRadiusPair.Angle = AngleProvider(num3);
					angleRadiusPair.Radius = RadiusProvider(num3);
				}
				list.Add(angleRadiusPair);
			}
			return list;
		}

		private void PrepareCartesian(IEnumerable<int> viableIndices)
		{
			foreach (AngleRadiusPair item in Reduce(viableIndices))
			{
				if (double.IsNaN(item.Angle) || double.IsInfinity(item.Angle) || double.IsNaN(item.Radius) || double.IsInfinity(item.Radius))
				{
					AddPoint(new Point(double.NaN, double.NaN));
				}
				else
				{
					AddPoint(new Point(TransformedXProvider(item.Index), TransformedYProvider(item.Index)));
				}
			}
		}

		private double GetErrorTolerance()
		{
			return Math.Pow(Resolution / Math.Max(Viewport.Width / Window.Width, Viewport.Height / Window.Height), 2.0);
		}

		private void AddFromPolar(double angle, double radius)
		{
			double num = 0.5 + radius * Math.Cos(angle);
			double num2 = 0.5 + radius * Math.Sin(angle);
			num = _viewport.Left + _viewport.Width * (num - _window.Left) / _window.Width;
			num2 = _viewport.Top + _viewport.Height * (num2 - _window.Top) / _window.Height;
			AddPoint(new Point(num, num2));
		}

		private void PreparePolar(IEnumerable<int> viableIndices)
		{
			double errorTolerance = GetErrorTolerance();
			IList<AngleRadiusPair> list = Reduce(viableIndices);
			double a = list[0].Angle;
			double r = list[0].Radius;
			double num = list[0].Index;
			for (int i = 1; i < list.Count; i++)
			{
				double angle = list[i].Angle;
				double radius = list[i].Radius;
				double num2 = list[i].Index;
				if (double.IsNaN(angle) || double.IsInfinity(angle) || double.IsNaN(radius) || double.IsInfinity(radius))
				{
					AddPoint(new Point(double.NaN, double.NaN));
					if (UnknownValuePlotting != UnknownValuePlotting.LinearInterpolate)
					{
						i++;
						if (i < list.Count)
						{
							a = list[i].Angle;
							r = list[i].Radius;
						}
					}
				}
				else
				{
					CreateSpiralPoints(angle, radius, a, r, i, errorTolerance, num > num2);
					a = angle;
					r = radius;
					num = num2;
				}
			}
		}

		private void CreateSpiralPoints([SwiftMutableParameter] double ai, [SwiftMutableParameter] double ri, [SwiftMutableParameter] double a0, [SwiftMutableParameter] double r0, int index, double error, bool wrapAround)
		{
			bool flag = false;
			if ((ai < a0 && !wrapAround) || (ai > a0 && wrapAround))
			{
				flag = true;
				double num = ai;
				ai = a0;
				a0 = num;
				double num2 = ri;
				ri = r0;
				r0 = num2;
			}
			List<double> list = SpiralFlattener.Spiral(a0, r0, ai, ri, error);
			if (flag)
			{
				List<double> list2 = new List<double>(list.Count);
				for (int num3 = list.Count - 1; num3 >= 0; num3--)
				{
					list2.Add(list[num3]);
				}
				list = list2;
			}
			for (int i = 0; i < list.Count; i++)
			{
				double num4 = list[i];
				double angle = a0 + num4 * (ai - a0);
				double radius = r0 + num4 * (ri - r0);
				AddFromPolar(angle, radius);
			}
		}

		private void EnsureClipper(IList<Point> target)
		{
			double top = Viewport.Top - 10.0;
			double bottom = Viewport.Bottom + 10.0;
			double left = Viewport.Left - 10.0;
			double right = Viewport.Right + 10.0;
			if (Clipper == null)
			{
				Clipper = new Clipper(left, bottom, right, top, IsClosed)
				{
					Target = target
				};
			}
		}

		private bool IsPlottable(Point point)
		{
			if (!double.IsNaN(point.X) && !double.IsNaN(point.Y) && !double.IsInfinity(point.X))
			{
				return !double.IsInfinity(point.Y);
			}
			return false;
		}

		private void AddPoint(Point point)
		{
			if (UnknownValuePlotting != UnknownValuePlotting.LinearInterpolate || IsPlottable(point))
			{
				if (ClippingDisabled)
				{
					Target.Add(point);
				}
				else
				{
					Clipper.Add(point);
				}
			}
		}

		public void PrepareLine(IEnumerable<int> viableIndices)
		{
			PrepareLine(null, null);
		}

		public void PrepareLine(IList<Point> target, IEnumerable<int> viableIndices)
		{
			Target = target;
			if (Valid() && Count > 1)
			{
				EnsureClipper(target);
				if (UseCartesianInterpolation)
				{
					PrepareCartesian(viableIndices);
				}
				else
				{
					PreparePolar(viableIndices);
				}
				Clipper.Target = null;
			}
		}
	}
