	public class BollingerBandsOverlay : FinancialOverlay
	{
		internal const string PeriodPropertyName = "Period";

		public static readonly DependencyProperty PeriodProperty = DependencyProperty.Register("Period", typeof(int), typeof(BollingerBandsOverlay), new PropertyMetadata(14, delegate(DependencyObject sender, DependencyPropertyChangedEventArgs e)
		{
			((BollingerBandsOverlay)sender).RaisePropertyChanged("Period", e.OldValue, e.NewValue);
		}));

		internal const string MultiplierPropertyName = "Multiplier";

		public static readonly DependencyProperty MultiplierProperty = DependencyProperty.Register("Multiplier", typeof(double), typeof(BollingerBandsOverlay), new PropertyMetadata(2.0, delegate(DependencyObject sender, DependencyPropertyChangedEventArgs e)
		{
			((BollingerBandsOverlay)sender).RaisePropertyChanged("Multiplier", e.OldValue, e.NewValue);
		}));

		private double _maxBandWidth;

		private double _minBandWidth;

		internal List<double> AverageColumn = new List<double>();

		internal List<double> DeviationColumn = new List<double>();

		[WidgetDefaultNumber(14.0)]
		public int Period
		{
			get
			{
				return (int)GetValue(PeriodProperty);
			}
			set
			{
				SetValue(PeriodProperty, value);
			}
		}

		[WidgetDefaultNumber(2.0)]
		public double Multiplier
		{
			get
			{
				return (double)GetValue(MultiplierProperty);
			}
			set
			{
				SetValue(MultiplierProperty, value);
			}
		}

		[TSSuppressSynthesizedInitializer]
		private BollingerBandsOverlayView BollingerBandsView { get; set; }

		public BollingerBandsOverlay()
		{
			base.DefaultStyleKey = typeof(BollingerBandsOverlay);
			PreviousFrame = new CategoryFrame(4);
			TransitionFrame = new CategoryFrame(4);
			CurrentFrame = new CategoryFrame(4);
		}

		protected override void PropertyUpdatedOverride(object sender, string propertyName, object oldValue, object newValue)
		{
			if (GetTypicalBasedOn().Contains(propertyName))
			{
				base.OverlayValid = false;
			}
			base.PropertyUpdatedOverride(sender, propertyName, oldValue, newValue);
			if (!(propertyName == "Period"))
			{
				if (propertyName == "Multiplier")
				{
					RenderSeries(animate: false);
				}
			}
			else
			{
				base.OverlayValid = false;
				RenderSeries(animate: false);
			}
		}

		protected override bool ValidateOverlay()
		{
			AverageColumn.Clear();
			DeviationColumn.Clear();
			IEnumerator<double> enumerator = TrendCalculators.SMA(new SafeEnumerable(base.TypicalColumn), Period).GetEnumerator();
			IEnumerator<double> enumerator2 = TrendCalculators.STDEV(new SafeEnumerable(base.TypicalColumn), Period).GetEnumerator();
			_minBandWidth = double.MaxValue;
			_maxBandWidth = double.MinValue;
			bool flag = true;
			bool flag2 = true;
			double multiplier = Multiplier;
			while (flag || flag2)
			{
				if (enumerator.MoveNext())
				{
					AverageColumn.Add(enumerator.Current);
				}
				else
				{
					flag = false;
				}
				if (enumerator2.MoveNext())
				{
					DeviationColumn.Add(enumerator2.Current);
				}
				else
				{
					flag2 = false;
				}
				if (flag && flag2)
				{
					_minBandWidth = Math.Min(_minBandWidth, enumerator.Current - enumerator2.Current * multiplier);
					_maxBandWidth = Math.Max(_maxBandWidth, enumerator.Current + enumerator2.Current * multiplier);
				}
			}
			return true;
		}

		protected internal override AxisRange GetRange(Axis axis)
		{
			if (AverageColumn == null || DeviationColumn == null || axis == null || base.FastItemsSource == null || axis != base.YAxis)
			{
				return null;
			}
			return new AxisRange(_minBandWidth, _maxBandWidth);
		}

		internal override void PrepareFrame(CategoryFrame frame, FinancialSeriesView view)
		{
			base.PrepareFrame(frame, view);
			Rect windowRect = view.WindowRect;
			Rect viewport = view.Viewport;
			Rect effectiveViewport = GetEffectiveViewport(view);
			CategoryAxisBase xAxis = base.XAxis;
			NumericYAxis yAxis = base.YAxis;
			ScalerParams p = new ScalerParams(windowRect, viewport, xAxis.IsInverted, effectiveViewport);
			ScalerParams scalerParams = new ScalerParams(windowRect, viewport, yAxis.IsInverted, effectiveViewport);
			frame.Buckets.Clear();
			frame.Markers.Clear();
			frame.Trend.Clear();
			ISortingAxis sortingAxis = base.XAxis as ISortingAxis;
			if (sortingAxis != null && sortingAxis.SortedIndices.Count != base.FastItemsSource.Count)
			{
				return;
			}
			double num = 0.0;
			num = GetOffset(windowRect, viewport, effectiveViewport);
			if (!base.OverlayValid)
			{
				base.OverlayValid = ValidateOverlay();
				if (base.YAxis != null)
				{
					base.YAxis.UpdateRange(immediate: true);
				}
			}
			scalerParams.ReferenceValue = GetReferenceValue();
			double num2 = base.XAxis.GetUnscaledValue(2.0, p) - base.XAxis.GetUnscaledValue(1.0, p);
			for (int i = view.BucketCalculator.FirstBucket; i <= view.BucketCalculator.LastBucket; i++)
			{
				double[] array;
				if (sortingAxis == null)
				{
					array = view.BucketCalculator.GetBucket(i);
				}
				else
				{
					int index = sortingAxis.SortedIndices[i];
					double unscaledValueAt = sortingAxis.GetUnscaledValueAt(index);
					double num3 = AverageColumn[i];
					double num4 = DeviationColumn[i];
					double num5 = num3;
					double num6 = num4;
					int num7 = 1;
					while (i < view.BucketCalculator.LastBucket)
					{
						index = sortingAxis.SortedIndices[i + 1];
						if (sortingAxis.GetUnscaledValueAt(index) - unscaledValueAt > num2)
						{
							break;
						}
						i++;
						num5 += AverageColumn[i];
						num6 += DeviationColumn[i];
						num7++;
					}
					num5 /= (double)num7;
					num6 /= (double)num7;
					double num8 = num5 - num6 * Multiplier;
					double num9 = num5;
					double num10 = num5 + num6 * Multiplier;
					double num11 = double.NaN;
					if (!double.IsNaN(unscaledValueAt))
					{
						num11 = base.XAxis.GetScaledValue(unscaledValueAt, p);
					}
					array = new double[4] { num11, num8, num9, num10 };
				}
				double num12 = Math.Max(1.0, num2);
				if (!double.IsNaN(array[0]) && (double)i * num12 >= (double)base.IgnoreFirst)
				{
					if (base.XAxis != null && base.XAxis is ISortingAxis)
					{
						array[0] += num;
					}
					else
					{
						array[0] = xAxis.GetScaledValue(array[0], p) + num;
					}
					array[1] = yAxis.GetScaledValue(array[1], scalerParams);
					array[2] = yAxis.GetScaledValue(array[2], scalerParams);
					array[3] = yAxis.GetScaledValue(array[3], scalerParams);
					frame.Buckets.Add(array);
				}
			}
		}

		protected internal override void ClearRendering(bool wipeClean, SeriesView view)
		{
			base.ClearRendering(wipeClean, view);
			((BollingerBandsOverlayView)view)?.ClearRendering();
		}

			ScalerParams scalerParams = new ScalerParams(base.View.WindowRect, base.View.Viewport, base.XAxis.IsInverted, effectiveViewport);
			scalerParams.EffectiveViewportRect = base.SeriesViewer.ViewportRect;
			return GetSeriesValueHelper(AverageColumn, world, base.XAxis, scalerParams, offset, GetExactUnsortedItemIndex, useInterpolation, skipUnknowns);
		}

		internal override void RenderFrame(CategoryFrame frame, FinancialSeriesView view)
		{
			base.RenderFrame(frame, view);
			BollingerBandsOverlayView bollingerBandsOverlayView = view as BollingerBandsOverlayView;
			Rect effectiveViewport = GetEffectiveViewport(view);
			if (view.CheckFrameDirty(frame))
			{
				bollingerBandsOverlayView.ClearRendering();
				int count = frame.Buckets.Count;
				Func<int, double> px = (int i) => frame.Buckets[i][0];
				Func<int, double> nx = (int i) => frame.Buckets[count - 1 - i][0];
				Func<int, double> y = (int i) => frame.Buckets[i][1];
				Func<int, double> y2 = (int i) => frame.Buckets[i][2];
				Func<int, double> y3 = (int i) => frame.Buckets[count - 1 - i][3];
				bollingerBandsOverlayView.RenderBands(count, px, nx, y, y2, y3);
				view.UpdateFrameVersion(frame);
			}
			RenderManager.InitCategoryRenderSettings(this, ShouldOverrideCategoryStyle(), GetCategoryItems, GetBucketSize(view), GetFirstBucket(view));
			bool flag = false;
			AssigningSeriesShapeStyleEventArgsBase overrideArgs = RenderManager.OverrideArgs;
			List<double[]> buckets = frame.Buckets;
			int count2 = base.FastItemsSource.Count;
			if (overrideArgs != null)
			{
				flag = true;
			}
			if (flag)
			{
				ScalerParams axisParams = new ScalerParams(view.WindowRect, view.Viewport, base.XAxis.IsInverted, effectiveViewport);
				PerformCategoryStyleOverride(buckets, -1, count2, base.XAxis, axisParams, view.IsThumbnailView);
			}
			Polyline line = bollingerBandsOverlayView.Line0;
			Polyline line2 = bollingerBandsOverlayView.Line1;
			Polyline line3 = bollingerBandsOverlayView.Line2;
			Polygon fillArea = bollingerBandsOverlayView.FillArea;
			RenderManager.SetShapeAppearance(line2, strokeOnly: true, fillOnly: false, extended: true, useOutline: true);
			RenderManager.InitialRenderDashArray = null;
			RenderManager.ActualRenderDashArray = null;
			RenderManager.SetShapeAppearance(line, strokeOnly: true, fillOnly: false, extended: false, useOutline: true);
			RenderManager.SetShapeAppearance(line3, strokeOnly: true, fillOnly: false, extended: false, useOutline: true);
			RenderManager.SetShapeAppearance(fillArea, strokeOnly: false, fillOnly: true, extended: false, useOutline: false);
			fillArea.Opacity = RenderManager.ActualRenderOpacity * base.ActualAreaFillOpacity;
		}

	internal class BollingerBandsBucketCalculator : FinancialBucketCalculator
	{
		[Weak]
		protected BollingerBandsOverlayView BollingerView { get; set; }

		public BollingerBandsBucketCalculator(FinancialSeriesView view)
			: base(view)
		{
			BollingerView = (BollingerBandsOverlayView)view;
		}

		public override double[] GetBucket(int index)
		{
			int num = index * base.BucketSize;
			int num2 = Math.Min(num + base.BucketSize - 1, base.View.FinancialModel.FastItemsSource.Count - 1);
			if (num <= num2)
			{
				double multiplier = BollingerView.BollingerBandsOverlayModel.Multiplier;
				double num3 = 0.0;
				double num4 = 0.0;
				int num5 = 0;
				for (int i = num; i <= num2; i++)
				{
					if (!double.IsNaN(BollingerView.BollingerBandsOverlayModel.AverageColumn[i]) && !double.IsNaN(BollingerView.BollingerBandsOverlayModel.DeviationColumn[i]))
					{
						num3 += BollingerView.BollingerBandsOverlayModel.AverageColumn[i];
						num4 += BollingerView.BollingerBandsOverlayModel.DeviationColumn[i];
						num5++;
					}
				}
				if (num5 > 0)
				{
					num3 /= (double)num5;
					num4 /= (double)num5;
					return new double[4]
					{
						0.5 * (double)(num + num2),
						num3 - num4 * multiplier,
						num3,
						num3 + num4 * multiplier
					};
				}
			}
			return new double[4]
			{
				double.NaN,
				double.NaN,
				double.NaN,
				double.NaN
			};
		}
	}
	internal class BollingerBandsOverlayView : FinancialSeriesView
	{
		private Polygon polygon = new Polygon();

		private Polyline polyline0 = new Polyline();

		private Polyline polyline1 = new Polyline();

		private Polyline polyline2 = new Polyline();

		protected internal BollingerBandsOverlay BollingerBandsOverlayModel { get; set; }

		public Polygon FillArea => polygon;

		public Polyline Line0 => polyline0;

		public Polyline Line1 => polyline1;

		public Polyline Line2 => polyline2;

		internal BollingerBandsOverlayView(BollingerBandsOverlay model)
			: base(model)
		{
			BollingerBandsOverlayModel = model;
		}

		protected override FinancialBucketCalculator CreateBucketCalculator()
		{
			return new BollingerBandsBucketCalculator(this);
		}

		internal void RenderBands(int count, Func<int, double> px, Func<int, double> nx, Func<int, double> y0, Func<int, double> y1, Func<int, double> y2)
		{
			foreach (int item in Flattener.Flatten(count, px, y0, Model.Resolution))
			{
				polygon.Points.Add(new Point(px(item), y0(item)));
				polyline0.Points.Add(new Point(px(item), y0(item)));
			}
			foreach (int item2 in Flattener.Flatten(count, px, y1, Model.Resolution))
			{
				polyline1.Points.Add(new Point(px(item2), y1(item2)));
			}
			foreach (int item3 in Flattener.Flatten(count, nx, y2, Model.Resolution))
			{
				polygon.Points.Add(new Point(nx(item3), y2(item3)));
				polyline2.Points.Add(new Point(nx(item3), y2(item3)));
			}
		}

		internal void ClearRendering()
		{
			polygon.Points.Clear();
			polyline0.Points.Clear();
			polyline1.Points.Clear();
			polyline2.Points.Clear();
		}

		public override void AttachUI(Canvas rootCanvas)
		{
			base.AttachUI(rootCanvas);
			polygon.Detach();
			polyline0.Detach();
			polyline1.Detach();
			polyline2.Detach();
			rootCanvas.Children.Add(polygon);
			rootCanvas.Children.Add(polyline0);
			VisualInformationManager.SetIsOutlineVisual(polyline0, value: true);
			VisualInformationManager.SetIsSolidOutlineVisual(polyline0, value: true);
			VisualInformationManager.SetIsMainGeometryVisual(polyline0, value: true);
			rootCanvas.Children.Add(polyline1);
			VisualInformationManager.SetIsOutlineVisual(polyline1, value: true);
			rootCanvas.Children.Add(polyline2);
			VisualInformationManager.SetIsOutlineVisual(polyline2, value: true);
			VisualInformationManager.SetIsSolidOutlineVisual(polyline2, value: true);
		}

		protected internal override void ExportViewShapes(object svd)
		{
			base.ExportViewShapes(svd);
			Model.SeriesVisualDataManager.ExportPolygonData(svd, polygon, "FillShape", new string[1] { "Fill" });
			Model.SeriesVisualDataManager.ExportPolylineData(svd, polyline0, "BottomLine", new string[2] { "Lower", "Main" });
			Model.SeriesVisualDataManager.ExportPolylineData(svd, polyline1, "CentralLine", new string[1] { "Central" });
			Model.SeriesVisualDataManager.ExportPolylineData(svd, polyline2, "TopLine", new string[1] { "Upper" });
		}

	public class CustomIndicator : StrategyBasedIndicator
	{
		protected override IndicatorCalculationStrategy CalculationStrategy => new CustomIndicatorStrategy();

		protected override Type StyleKeyType => typeof(CustomIndicator);

		private event FinancialEventHandler _indicator;

		public event FinancialEventHandler Indicator
		{
			add
			{
				_indicator += value;
				FullIndicatorRefresh();
			}
			remove
			{
				_indicator -= value;
				FullIndicatorRefresh();
			}
		}

		private event FinancialEventHandler _basedOnColumns;

		public event FinancialEventHandler BasedOnColumns
		{
			add
			{
				_basedOnColumns += value;
				FullIndicatorRefresh();
			}
			remove
			{
				_basedOnColumns -= value;
				FullIndicatorRefresh();
			}
		}

		protected override IList<string> BasedOn(int position, int count)
		{
			FinancialCalculationDataSource financialCalculationDataSource = ProvideDataSource(position, count);
			FinancialCalculationSupportingCalculations supportingCalculations = ProvideSupportingCalculations(financialCalculationDataSource);
			List<string> list = new List<string>();
			if (this._basedOnColumns != null)
			{
				FinancialEventArgs e = new FinancialEventArgs(financialCalculationDataSource.CalculateFrom, financialCalculationDataSource.CalculateCount, financialCalculationDataSource, supportingCalculations);
				this._basedOnColumns(this, e);
				if (e.BasedOn != null)
				{
					foreach (string item in e.BasedOn)
					{
						list.Add(item);
					}
				}
			}
			return list;
		}

		protected override bool IndicatorOverride(int position, int count)
		{
			base.IndicatorOverride(position, count);
			if (this._indicator != null)
			{
				FinancialCalculationDataSource dataSource = ProvideDataSource(position, count);
				if (count == 0)
				{
					return false;
				}
				if (!ValidateBasedOn(BasedOn(position, count)))
				{
					return false;
				}
				this._indicator(this, new FinancialEventArgs(position, count, dataSource, ProvideSupportingCalculations(dataSource)));
				if (UpdateRange(dataSource) && base.YAxis != null)
				{
					base.YAxis.UpdateRange();
				}
				return true;
			}
			return false;
		}
	}
	public class CustomIndicatorStrategy : IndicatorCalculationStrategy

		public override bool CalculateIndicator(FinancialCalculationDataSource dataSource, FinancialCalculationSupportingCalculations supportingCalculations)
		{
			return true;
		}

		public override IList<string> BasedOn(FinancialCalculationDataSource dataSource, FinancialCalculationSupportingCalculations supportingCalculations)
		{
			return new List<string>();
		}
	}

			TransitionFrame = new CategoryFrame(3);

		internal void EnsureYRangeThenRender(bool animate)
		{
			if (base.YAxis != null && !base.YAxis.UpdateRange())
			{
				RenderSeries(animate: true);
			}
		}

		protected virtual bool TestAreaOver(Point position, Point snapPosition, bool isFinger)
		{
			if (double.IsNaN(snapPosition.X) || double.IsNaN(snapPosition.Y))
			{
				return false;
			}
			NumericYAxis yAxis = base.YAxis;
			double num = 0.0;
			if (yAxis != null)
			{
				num = yAxis.ScaleValue(yAxis.ReferenceValue);
			}
			if ((position.Y >= num && position.Y <= snapPosition.Y) || (position.Y <= num && position.Y >= snapPosition.Y))
			{
				return true;
			}
			return false;
		}

		public override Rect GetSeriesValueBoundingBox(Point world)
		{
			if (base.XAxis == null || base.YAxis == null)
			{
				return Rect.Empty;
			}
			Point point = FromWorldPosition(world);
			ScalerParams scalerParams = new ScalerParams(base.View.WindowRect, base.View.Viewport, effectiveViewport: GetEffectiveViewport(base.View), inverted: base.YAxis.IsInverted);
			scalerParams.ReferenceValue = GetReferenceValue();
			double[][] matchingBuckets = GetMatchingBuckets(base.XAxis, CurrentFrame.Buckets, GetBucketSize(base.View), GetFirstBucket(base.View), world, skipUnknowns: true);
			if (matchingBuckets == null)
			{
				return Rect.Empty;
			}
			double[] array = matchingBuckets[0];
			double[] array2 = matchingBuckets[1];
			double num = Math.Abs(point.X - array[0]);
			double num2 = Math.Abs(point.X - array2[0]);
			double scaledValue = base.YAxis.GetScaledValue(base.YAxis.ReferenceValue, scalerParams);
			double num3 = 1.0;
			if (num < num2)
			{
				double x = array[0] - 0.5 * num3;
				double val = array[1];
				double val2 = scaledValue;
				return new Rect(x, Math.Min(val, val2), num3, Math.Max(val, val2) - Math.Min(val, val2));
			}
			double x2 = array2[0] - 0.5 * num3;
			double val3 = array2[1];
			double val4 = scaledValue;
			return new Rect(x2, Math.Min(val3, val4), num3, Math.Max(val3, val4) - Math.Min(val3, val4));
		}

		public override bool TestHit(Point position, bool isFinger)
		{
			Point seriesValuePosition = GetSeriesValuePosition(ToWorldPosition(position), useInterpolation: true, skipUnknowns: false);
			if (DisplayType == IndicatorDisplayType.Area && TestAreaOver(position, seriesValuePosition, isFinger))
			{
				return true;
			}
			if ((DisplayType == IndicatorDisplayType.Area || DisplayType == IndicatorDisplayType.Line) && TestHighLowStrokeOver(position, isFinger))
			{
				return true;
			}
			if (DisplayType == IndicatorDisplayType.Column && TestShapesOver(position, isFinger))
			{
				return true;
			}
			return false;
		}

		protected override void DataUpdatedOverride([SwiftMutableParameter] FastItemsSourceEventAction action, [SwiftMutableParameter] int position, [SwiftMutableParameter] int count, [SwiftMutableParameter] string propertyName)
		{
			base.DataUpdatedOverride(action, position, count, propertyName);
			if (base.XAxis != null && base.XAxis is ISortingAxis)
			{
				((ISortingAxis)base.XAxis).NotifyDataChanged();
			}
			if (IndicatorView.HasTrendLineManager)
			{
				IndicatorView.TrendLineManager.DataUpdated(action, position, count, propertyName);
			}
			if (propertyName != null && mappingToColumnName.ContainsKey(propertyName))
			{
				mappingToColumnName.TryGetValue(propertyName, out propertyName);
			}
			if (base.XAxis != null && base.XAxis is ISortingAxis)
			{
				action = FastItemsSourceEventAction.Reset;
				position = 0;
				count = base.FastItemsSource.Count;
			}
			switch (action)
			{
			case FastItemsSourceEventAction.Change:
				if (ShouldUpdateIndicator(position, count, propertyName))
				{
					UpdateIndicator(position, count, propertyName);
					EnsureYRangeThenRender(animate: true);
				}
				break;
			case FastItemsSourceEventAction.Replace:
				if (ShouldUpdateIndicator(position, base.FastItemsSource.Count - position, propertyName))
				{
					UpdateIndicator(position, base.FastItemsSource.Count - position, propertyName);
					EnsureYRangeThenRender(animate: true);
				}
				break;
			case FastItemsSourceEventAction.Insert:
				if (ShouldUpdateIndicator(position, base.FastItemsSource.Count - position, propertyName))
				{
					double[] collection2 = new double[count];
					IndicatorColumn.InsertRange(position, collection2);
					UpdateIndicator(position, base.FastItemsSource.Count - position, propertyName);
					EnsureYRangeThenRender(animate: true);
				}
				break;
			case FastItemsSourceEventAction.Remove:
				if (ShouldUpdateIndicator(position, base.FastItemsSource.Count - position, propertyName))
				{
					IndicatorColumn.RemoveRange(position, count);
					UpdateIndicator(position, base.FastItemsSource.Count - position, propertyName);
					EnsureYRangeThenRender(animate: true);
				}
				break;
			case FastItemsSourceEventAction.Reset:
				if (ShouldUpdateIndicator(position, base.FastItemsSource.Count - position, propertyName))
				{
					IndicatorColumn = new List<double>(base.FastItemsSource.Count);
					double[] collection = new double[count];
					IndicatorColumn.InsertRange(0, collection);
					UpdateIndicator(position, base.FastItemsSource.Count - position, propertyName);
					EnsureYRangeThenRender(animate: true);
				}
				break;
			}
		}

		protected virtual int TrendPeriodOverride()
		{
			return -1;
		}

		protected abstract bool IndicatorOverride(int position, int count);

		protected abstract IList<string> BasedOn(int position, int count);

		protected override void PropertyUpdatedOverride(object sender, string propertyName, object oldValue, object newValue)
		{
			if (!(propertyName == "XAxis"))
			{
				if (propertyName == "TrendLineType" && (TrendLineType)newValue != TrendLineType.None)
				{
					IndicatorView.TrendLineManager = CategoryTrendLineManagerFactory.SelectManager(IndicatorView.TrendLineManager, base.XAxis, base.RootCanvas, this, base.Res);
				}
			}
			else
			{
				IndicatorView.SelectTrendlineManager();
			}
			base.PropertyUpdatedOverride(sender, propertyName, oldValue, newValue);
			if (IndicatorView.HasTrendLineManager && IndicatorView.TrendLineManager.PropertyUpdated(sender, propertyName, oldValue, newValue))
			{
				RenderSeries(animate: false);
				if (base.ThumbnailView is FinancialIndicatorView { HasTrendLineManager: not false } financialIndicatorView)
				{
					financialIndicatorView.TrendLineManager.PropertyUpdated(sender, propertyName, oldValue, newValue);
				}
				NotifyThumbnailAppearanceChanged();
			}
			switch (propertyName)
			{
			case "FastItemsSource":
				if (base.FastItemsSource != null)
				{
					IndicatorColumn = new List<double>(base.FastItemsSource.Count);
					double[] collection = new double[base.FastItemsSource.Count];
					IndicatorColumn.InsertRange(0, collection);
					UpdateIndicator(0, base.FastItemsSource.Count, null);
					if (base.YAxis != null && !base.YAxis.UpdateRange())
					{
						base.FinancialView.BucketCalculator.CalculateBuckets(base.Resolution);
						RenderSeries(animate: false);
					}
				}
				break;
			case "TrendLineBrush":
				UpdateIndexedProperties();
				break;
			case "DisplayType":
				ClearRendering(wipeClean: true, base.View);
				UpdateLegendItemVisuals();
				RenderSeries(animate: false);
				NotifyThumbnailAppearanceChanged();
				break;
			case "OpenColumn":
			case "HighColumn":
			case "LowColumn":
			case "CloseColumn":
			case "VolumeColumn":
				if (base.FastItemsSource != null)
				{
					if (IndicatorColumn.Count != base.FastItemsSource.Count)
					{
						IndicatorColumn = new List<double>(base.FastItemsSource.Count);
						double[] collection2 = new double[base.FastItemsSource.Count];
						IndicatorColumn.InsertRange(0, collection2);
					}
					if (ShouldUpdateIndicator(0, base.FastItemsSource.Count - 1, propertyName))
					{
						FullIndicatorRefresh();
					}
				}
				break;
			case "XAxis":
				if (base.XAxis != null && (base.XAxis is ISortingAxis || oldValue is ISortingAxis))
				{
					FullIndicatorRefresh();
				}
				break;
			case "YAxis":
			case "IgnoreFirst":
				FullIndicatorRefresh();
				NotifyThumbnailAppearanceChanged();
				break;
			case "TrendLineType":
				NotifyThumbnailAppearanceChanged();
				break;
			}
		}

		public override double GetSeriesValue(Point world, bool useInterpolation, bool skipUnknowns)
		{
			if (IndicatorColumn == null)
			{
				return base.GetSeriesValue(world, useInterpolation, skipUnknowns);
			}
			Rect effectiveViewport = GetEffectiveViewport(base.View);
			double offset = GetOffset(base.View.WindowRect, base.View.Viewport, effectiveViewport);
			ScalerParams scalerParams = new ScalerParams(base.View.WindowRect, base.View.Viewport, base.XAxis.IsInverted, effectiveViewport);
			scalerParams.EffectiveViewportRect = base.SeriesViewer.ViewportRect;
			return GetSeriesValueHelper(IndicatorColumn, world, base.XAxis, scalerParams, offset, GetExactUnsortedItemIndex, useInterpolation, skipUnknowns);
		}

		}

		private bool ShouldUpdateIndicator(int position, int count, string updatedPropertyName)
		{
			if (updatedPropertyName == null)
			{
				return true;
			}
			if (BasedOn(position, count).Contains(updatedPropertyName))
			{
				return true;
			}
			return false;
		}

		}

		public override bool ScrollIntoView(object item)
		{
			int num = ((base.FastItemsSource != null) ? base.FastItemsSource.IndexOf(item) : (-1));
			Rect windowRect = base.View.WindowRect;
			_ = base.View.Viewport;
			Rect rect = new Rect(0.0, 0.0, 1.0, 1.0);
			Rect effectiveViewportForUnitViewport = GetEffectiveViewportForUnitViewport(base.View);
			if (num >= 0)
			{
				if (base.XAxis != null)
				{
					ScalerParams p = new ScalerParams(rect, rect, base.XAxis.IsInverted, effectiveViewportForUnitViewport);
					double num2 = base.XAxis.GetScaledValue(num, p);
					if (num2 < windowRect.Left + 0.1 * windowRect.Width)
					{
						num2 += 0.4 * windowRect.Width;
					}
					if (num2 > windowRect.Right - 0.1 * windowRect.Width)
					{
						num2 -= 0.4 * windowRect.Width;
					}
					windowRect.X = num2 - 0.5 * windowRect.Width;
				}
				if (base.YAxis != null && IndicatorColumn != null && num < IndicatorColumn.Count)
				{
					ScalerParams scalerParams = new ScalerParams(rect, rect, base.YAxis.IsInverted, effectiveViewportForUnitViewport);
					scalerParams.ReferenceValue = GetReferenceValue();
					double num3 = base.YAxis.GetScaledValue(IndicatorColumn[num], scalerParams);
					if (num3 < windowRect.Top + 0.1 * windowRect.Height)
					{
						num3 += 0.4 * windowRect.Height;
					}
					if (num3 > windowRect.Bottom - 0.1 * windowRect.Height)
					{
						num3 -= 0.4 * windowRect.Height;
					}
					windowRect.Y = num3 - 0.5 * windowRect.Height;
				}
				base.SyncLink.WindowNotify(base.SeriesViewer, windowRect, force: true);
			}
			return num >= 0;
		}

		protected internal override bool ValidateSeries(Rect viewportRect, Rect windowRect, SeriesView view)
		{
			bool result = base.ValidateSeries(viewportRect, windowRect, view);
			if (IndicatorColumn == null || IndicatorColumn.Count == 0)
			{
				result = false;
			}
			return result;
		}

		internal override void PrepareFrame(CategoryFrame frame, FinancialSeriesView view)
		{
			base.PrepareFrame(frame, view);
			Rect windowRect = view.WindowRect;
			Rect viewport = view.Viewport;
			Rect effectiveViewport = GetEffectiveViewport(view);
			CategoryAxisBase xAxis = base.XAxis;
			NumericYAxis yAxis = base.YAxis;
			ScalerParams xParams = new ScalerParams(windowRect, viewport, xAxis.IsInverted, effectiveViewport);
			ScalerParams yParams = new ScalerParams(windowRect, viewport, yAxis.IsInverted, effectiveViewport);
			yParams.ReferenceValue = GetReferenceValue();
			frame.Buckets.Clear();
			frame.Markers.Clear();
			frame.Trend.Clear();
			double num = 0.0;
			ISortingAxis sortingAxis = base.XAxis as ISortingAxis;
			if (sortingAxis != null && sortingAxis.SortedIndices.Count != base.FastItemsSource.Count)
			{
				return;
			}
			num = GetOffset(windowRect, viewport, effectiveViewport);
			int num2 = TrendPeriodOverride();
			if (num2 == -1)
			{
				num2 = TrendLinePeriod;
			}
			FinancialIndicatorView financialIndicatorView = view as FinancialIndicatorView;
			if (financialIndicatorView.HasTrendLineManager)
			{
				((IPreparesCategoryTrendline)financialIndicatorView.TrendLineManager).PrepareLineCore(frame.Trend, TrendLineType, IndicatorColumn, num2, (double x) => base.XAxis.GetScaledValue(x, xParams), (double y) => base.YAxis.GetScaledValue(y, yParams), new TrendResolutionParams
				{
					BucketSize = view.BucketCalculator.BucketSize,
					FirstBucket = view.BucketCalculator.FirstBucket,
					LastBucket = view.BucketCalculator.LastBucket,
					Offset = num,
					Resolution = base.Resolution,
					Viewport = viewport,
					Window = windowRect
				});
			}
			double num3 = base.XAxis.GetUnscaledValue(2.0, xParams) - base.XAxis.GetUnscaledValue(1.0, xParams);
			for (int num4 = view.BucketCalculator.FirstBucket; num4 <= view.BucketCalculator.LastBucket; num4++)
			{
				double[] array;
				if (sortingAxis == null)
				{
					array = view.BucketCalculator.GetBucket(num4);
				}
				else
				{
					int index = sortingAxis.SortedIndices[num4];
					double unscaledValueAt = sortingAxis.GetUnscaledValueAt(index);
					double num5 = IndicatorColumn[num4];
					double num6 = num5;
					while (num4 < view.BucketCalculator.LastBucket)
					{
						index = sortingAxis.SortedIndices[num4 + 1];
						if (sortingAxis.GetUnscaledValueAt(index) - unscaledValueAt > num3)
						{
							break;
						}
						num4++;
						double val = IndicatorColumn[num4];
						num5 = Math.Min(num5, val);
						num6 = Math.Max(num6, val);
					}
					double num7 = double.NaN;
					if (!double.IsNaN(unscaledValueAt))
					{
						num7 = base.XAxis.GetScaledValue(unscaledValueAt, xParams);
					}
					array = new double[3] { num7, num5, num6 };
				}
				if (!double.IsNaN(array[0]))
				{
					if (base.XAxis != null && base.XAxis is ISortingAxis)
					{
						array[0] += num;
					}
					else
					{
						array[0] = xAxis.GetScaledValue(array[0], xParams) + num;
					}
					array[1] = yAxis.GetScaledValue(array[1], yParams);
					if (view.BucketCalculator.BucketSize > 1 || sortingAxis != null)
					{
						array[2] = yAxis.GetScaledValue(array[2], yParams);
					}
					else
					{
						array[2] = array[1];
					}
					frame.Buckets.Add(array);
				}
			}
		}

		protected internal override void ClearRendering(bool wipeClean, SeriesView view)
		{
			base.ClearRendering(wipeClean, view);
			FinancialIndicatorView financialIndicatorView = (FinancialIndicatorView)view;
			financialIndicatorView.ClearIndicatorVisual(wipeClean);
			if (financialIndicatorView.HasTrendLineManager)
			{
				financialIndicatorView.TrendLineManager.ClearPoints();
			}
		}

		protected override CategoryTransitionInMode GetDefaultTransitionInMode()
		{
			return DisplayType switch
			{
				IndicatorDisplayType.Area => CategoryTransitionInMode.FromZero, 
				IndicatorDisplayType.Column => CategoryTransitionInMode.FromZero, 
				IndicatorDisplayType.Line => CategoryTransitionInMode.SweepFromCategoryAxisMinimum, 
				_ => CategoryTransitionInMode.FromZero, 
			};
		}

		internal override void RenderFrame(CategoryFrame frame, FinancialSeriesView view)
		{
			base.RenderFrame(frame, view);
			FinancialIndicatorView financialIndicatorView = view as FinancialIndicatorView;
			Func<int, double> x = (int i) => frame.Buckets[i][0];
			Func<int, double> y = (int i) => frame.Buckets[i][1];
			if (financialIndicatorView.HasTrendLineManager)
			{
				financialIndicatorView.TrendLineManager.ClearPoints();
				financialIndicatorView.TrendLineManager.RasterizeTrendLine(frame.Trend);
			}
			Rect viewport = view.Viewport;
			Rect effectiveViewport = GetEffectiveViewport(view);
			double num = 0.0;
			Brush actualBrush = base.ActualBrush;
			Brush negativeBrush = base.NegativeBrush;
			if (view.CheckFrameDirty(frame))
			{
				financialIndicatorView.ClearIndicatorVisual(wipeClean: false);
				if (frame.Buckets.Count > 0)
				{
					switch (DisplayType)
					{
					case IndicatorDisplayType.Line:
					{
						Clipper clipper2 = CategorySeries.GetClipper(frame.Buckets, frame.Buckets.Count - 1, viewport, view.WindowRect, closed: false);
						financialIndicatorView.RasterizeLine(frame.Buckets.Count, x, y, colorByGradient: true, clipper2);
						break;
					}
					case IndicatorDisplayType.Area:
					{
						num = ((base.YAxis == null) ? (0.5 * (viewport.Top + viewport.Bottom)) : GetWorldZeroValue(view));
						Clipper clipper = CategorySeries.GetClipper(frame.Buckets, frame.Buckets.Count - 1, viewport, view.WindowRect, closed: false);
						financialIndicatorView.RasterizeArea(frame.Buckets.Count, x, y, colorByGradient: true, num, clipper);
						break;
					}
					case IndicatorDisplayType.Column:
						num = GetWorldZeroValue(view);
						financialIndicatorView.RasterizeColumns(frame.Buckets.Count, x, y, colorByGradient: true, num);
						break;
					default:
						throw new NotImplementedException();
					}
				}
				view.UpdateFrameVersion(frame);
			}
			List<double[]> buckets = frame.Buckets;
			int count = base.FastItemsSource.Count;
			RenderManager.InitCategoryRenderSettings(this, ShouldOverrideCategoryStyle(), GetCategoryItems, GetBucketSize(view), GetFirstBucket(view));
			bool flag = false;
			if (RenderManager.OverrideArgs != null)
			{
				flag = true;
			}
			RenderManager.InitialRenderFill = actualBrush;
			RenderManager.ActualRenderFill = actualBrush;
			if (flag)
			{
				ScalerParams axisParams = new ScalerParams(view.WindowRect, view.Viewport, base.XAxis.IsInverted, effectiveViewport);
				RenderManager.ActualNegativeShape = false;
				PerformCategoryStyleOverride(buckets, -1, count, base.XAxis, axisParams, view.IsThumbnailView);
			}
			RenderManager.SetShapeAppearance(financialIndicatorView.PositivePath0, strokeOnly: true, fillOnly: false, extended: true, useOutline: false);
			RenderManager.SetShapeAppearance(financialIndicatorView.PositivePath1, strokeOnly: true, fillOnly: false, extended: true, useOutline: false);
			RenderManager.SetShapeAppearance(financialIndicatorView.PositivePath01, strokeOnly: false, fillOnly: true, extended: false, useOutline: false);
			financialIndicatorView.PositivePath01.Opacity = 0.8 * RenderManager.ActualRenderOpacity * base.ActualAreaFillOpacity;
			RenderManager.SetShapeAppearance(financialIndicatorView.PositiveColumns, strokeOnly: true, fillOnly: false, extended: false, useOutline: false);
			RenderManager.InitialRenderFill = negativeBrush;
			RenderManager.ActualRenderFill = negativeBrush;
			if (flag)
			{
				ScalerParams axisParams2 = new ScalerParams(view.WindowRect, view.Viewport, base.XAxis.IsInverted, effectiveViewport);
				RenderManager.ActualNegativeShape = true;
				PerformCategoryStyleOverride(buckets, -1, count, base.XAxis, axisParams2, view.IsThumbnailView);
			}
			RenderManager.SetShapeAppearance(financialIndicatorView.NegativePath0, strokeOnly: true, fillOnly: false, extended: true, useOutline: false);
			RenderManager.SetShapeAppearance(financialIndicatorView.NegativePath1, strokeOnly: true, fillOnly: false, extended: true, useOutline: false);
			RenderManager.SetShapeAppearance(financialIndicatorView.NegativePath01, strokeOnly: false, fillOnly: true, extended: false, useOutline: false);
			financialIndicatorView.NegativePath01.Opacity = 0.8 * RenderManager.ActualRenderOpacity * base.ActualAreaFillOpacity;
			RenderManager.SetShapeAppearance(financialIndicatorView.NegativeColumns, strokeOnly: true, fillOnly: false, extended: false, useOutline: false);
			financialIndicatorView.UpdateHitTests();
		}

		protected override void UpdateIndexedProperties()
		{
			base.UpdateIndexedProperties();
			if (base.Index >= 0 && IndicatorView.HasTrendLineManager)
			{
				IndicatorView.UpdateTrendlineBrush();
			}
		}

		protected void FullIndicatorRefresh()
		{
			if (IndicatorView.HasTrendLineManager)
			{
				IndicatorView.TrendLineManager.Reset();
			}
			IndicatorOverride(0, IndicatorColumn.Count);
			if (base.YAxis != null && !base.YAxis.UpdateRange())
			{
				RenderSeries(animate: false);
			}
		}

		protected override void ExportVisualDataOverride(object svd)
		{
			base.ExportVisualDataOverride(svd);
			base.SeriesVisualDataManager.ExportTrendlineData(this, svd, IndicatorView.TrendLineManager.TrendPolyline);
		}

		protected override LegendItemBadgeShape GetActualLegendBadgeOverride(LegendItemBadgeShape resolvedLegendItemBadgeShape)
		{
			if (DisplayType == IndicatorDisplayType.Area || DisplayType == IndicatorDisplayType.Column)
			{
				return LegendItemBadgeShape.Square;
			}
			if (DisplayType == IndicatorDisplayType.Line)
			{
				return LegendItemBadgeShape.Line;
			}
			return resolvedLegendItemBadgeShape;
		}
	}
	internal class FinancialIndicatorBucketCalculator : FinancialBucketCalculator
	{
		[Weak]
		protected FinancialIndicatorView IndicatorView { get; set; }

		internal FinancialIndicatorBucketCalculator(FinancialSeriesView view)
			: base(view)
		{
			IndicatorView = (FinancialIndicatorView)view;
		}

		public override double[] GetBucket(int index)
		{
			int num = index * base.BucketSize;
			int num2 = Math.Min(num + base.BucketSize - 1, IndicatorView.IndicatorModel.IndicatorColumn.Count - 1);
			double num3 = double.NaN;
			double num4 = double.NaN;
			for (int i = num; i <= num2; i++)
			{
				double num5 = IndicatorView.IndicatorModel.IndicatorColumn[i];
				if (!double.IsNaN(num3))
				{
					if (!double.IsNaN(num5))
					{
						num3 = Math.Min(num3, num5);
						num4 = Math.Max(num4, num5);
					}
				}
				else
				{
					num3 = num5;
					num4 = num5;
				}
			}
			if (double.IsNaN(num3))
			{
				return new double[3]
				{
					double.NaN,
					double.NaN,
					double.NaN
				};
			}
			return new double[3]
			{
				0.5 * (double)(num + num2),
				num3,
				num4
			};
		}
	}
	[WidgetModuleParent("FinancialChart")]
	[AutoModuleName("DataChartFinancialOverlays")]
	[TSEmitModuleDefinitions("IgxOverlayProxyModule:./igx-overlay-proxy-module")]
	public abstract class FinancialOverlay : FinancialSeries
	{
		internal const string IgnoreFirstPropertyName = "IgnoreFirst";

		public static readonly DependencyProperty IgnoreFirstProperty = DependencyProperty.Register("IgnoreFirst", typeof(int), typeof(FinancialOverlay), new PropertyMetadata(0, delegate(DependencyObject sender, DependencyPropertyChangedEventArgs e)
		{
			((FinancialOverlay)sender).RaisePropertyChanged("IgnoreFirst", e.OldValue, e.NewValue);
		}));

		public override bool IsFinancialOverlay => true;

		[WidgetDefaultNumber(0.0)]
		public int IgnoreFirst
		{
			get
			{
				return (int)GetValue(IgnoreFirstProperty);
			}
			set
			{
				SetValue(IgnoreFirstProperty, value);
			}
		}

		protected internal override bool UsesPresortedValueColumn => true;

		protected bool OverlayValid { get; set; }

		protected FinancialOverlay()
		{
			OverlayValid = false;
		}

		protected override void DataUpdatedOverride(FastItemsSourceEventAction action, int position, int count, string propertyName)
		{
			base.DataUpdatedOverride(action, position, count, propertyName);
			if (base.XAxis != null && base.XAxis is ISortingAxis)
			{
				((ISortingAxis)base.XAxis).NotifyDataChanged();
			}
			base.FinancialView.BucketCalculator.CalculateBuckets(base.Resolution);
			ValidateOverlay();
			if (base.YAxis != null)
			{
				base.YAxis.UpdateRange();
			}
			RenderSeries(animate: true);
		}

		protected override void PropertyUpdatedOverride(object sender, string propertyName, object oldValue, object newValue)
		{
			switch (propertyName)
			{
			case "FastItemsSource":
				OverlayValid = false;
				break;
			case "IgnoreFirst":
				OverlayValid = false;
				RenderSeries(animate: false);
				NotifyThumbnailAppearanceChanged();
				break;
			case "XAxis":
				OverlayValid = false;
				break;
			}
			base.PropertyUpdatedOverride(sender, propertyName, oldValue, newValue);
		}

		public override bool TestHit(Point position, bool isFinger)
		{
			if (TestHighLowStrokeOver(position, isFinger))
			{
				return true;
			}
			return false;
		}

		[JAVASuppressWidgetMember]
		[TSSuppressWidgetMember]
		[SwiftSuppressWidgetMember]
		public override void OnApplyTemplate()
		{
			base.OnApplyTemplate();
			RenderSeries(animate: false);
		}

		public override bool ScrollIntoView(object item)
		{
			int num = ((base.FastItemsSource != null) ? base.FastItemsSource.IndexOf(item) : (-1));
			Rect windowRect = base.View.WindowRect;
			_ = base.View.Viewport;
			Rect rect = new Rect(0.0, 0.0, 1.0, 1.0);
			Rect effectiveViewportForUnitViewport = GetEffectiveViewportForUnitViewport(base.View);
			ScalerParams p = new ScalerParams(rect, rect, base.XAxis.IsInverted, effectiveViewportForUnitViewport);
			ScalerParams scalerParams = new ScalerParams(rect, rect, base.YAxis.IsInverted, effectiveViewportForUnitViewport);
			scalerParams.ReferenceValue = GetReferenceValue();
			if (num >= 0)
			{
				if (base.XAxis != null)
				{
					double num2 = base.XAxis.GetScaledValue(num, p);
					if (num2 < windowRect.Left + 0.1 * windowRect.Width)
					{
						num2 += 0.4 * windowRect.Width;
					}
					if (num2 > windowRect.Right - 0.1 * windowRect.Width)
					{
						num2 -= 0.4 * windowRect.Width;
					}
					windowRect.X = num2 - 0.5 * windowRect.Width;
				}
				if (base.YAxis != null && base.LowColumn != null && base.HighColumn != null && num < base.LowColumn.Count && num < base.HighColumn.Count)
				{
					double num3 = base.YAxis.GetScaledValue(base.LowColumn[num], scalerParams);
					double scaledValue = base.YAxis.GetScaledValue(base.HighColumn[num], scalerParams);
					if (!double.IsNaN(num3) && !double.IsNaN(scaledValue))
					{
						double num4 = Math.Abs(num3 - scaledValue);
						if (windowRect.Height < num4)
						{
							windowRect.Height = num4;
							windowRect.Y = Math.Min(num3, scaledValue);
						}
						else
						{
							if (num3 < windowRect.Top + 0.1 * windowRect.Height)
							{
								num3 += 0.4 * windowRect.Height;
							}
							if (num3 > windowRect.Bottom - 0.1 * windowRect.Height)
							{
								num3 -= 0.4 * windowRect.Height;
							}
							windowRect.Y = num3 - 0.5 * windowRect.Height;
						}
					}
				}
				base.SyncLink.WindowNotify(base.SeriesViewer, windowRect, force: true);
			}
			return num >= 0;
		}

		protected internal override AxisRange GetRange(Axis axis)
		{
			if (axis != null && axis == base.YAxis && base.LowColumn != null && base.HighColumn != null)
			{
				return new AxisRange(base.LowColumn.Minimum, base.HighColumn.Maximum);
			}
			return null;
		}

		protected abstract bool ValidateOverlay();
	}

				});

			pathFigure.StartPoint = ((LineSegment)pathFigure.Segments[0]).Point;
			return pathFigure;
		}

		public static void RasterizeLine([SwiftMutableParameter] int count, [SwiftMutableParameter] Func<int, double> x0, [SwiftMutableParameter] Func<int, double> y0, bool colorByGradient, Rect windowRect, Rect viewportRect, Path positivePath0, Path negativePath0, double bucketSize, double resolution, Clipper clipper)

				list18.Add(new Point(list17[0].X, worldZero));
				list13.Add(list17);
				list14.Add(list18);

			{
				list = new List<List<Point>>(EnumerableSelect(list, (List<Point> points) => ClipPoints(clipper, points, isClosed: false)));
				list2 = new List<List<Point>>(EnumerableSelect(list2, (List<Point> points) => ClipPoints(clipper, points, isClosed: true)));
				list3 = new List<List<Point>>(EnumerableSelect(list3, (List<Point> points) => ClipPoints(clipper, points, isClosed: false)));

		public static void RasterizeColumns(int count, [SwiftMutableParameter] Func<int, double> x0, [SwiftMutableParameter] Func<int, double> y0, bool colorByGradient, Rect viewportRect, [SwiftMutableParameter] double worldZero, Pool<LineGeometry> Columns, Path positiveColumns, Path negativeColumns)
		{
			GeometryGroup geometryGroup = positiveColumns.Data as GeometryGroup;
			GeometryGroup geometryGroup2 = negativeColumns.Data as GeometryGroup;
			Func<int, double> originalY0 = y0;
			Func<int, double> originalX0 = x0;
			Func<double, double> clipToViewportX = (double value) => Math.Max(viewportRect.Left, Math.Min(viewportRect.Right, value));
			Func<double, double> clipToViewportY = (double value) => Math.Max(viewportRect.Top, Math.Min(viewportRect.Bottom, value));
			x0 = (int ii) => clipToViewportX(originalX0(ii));
			y0 = (int ii) => clipToViewportY(originalY0(ii));
			worldZero = clipToViewportY(worldZero);
			for (int num = 0; num < count; num++)
			{
				LineGeometry lineGeometry = Columns[num];
				lineGeometry.StartPoint = new Point(x0(num), worldZero);
				lineGeometry.EndPoint = new Point(x0(num), y0(num));
				bool flag = false;
				if (num > 0)
				{
					if (y0(num) <= y0(num - 1))
					{
						flag = true;
					}
				}
				else if (count > 1 && y0(num + 1) <= y0(num))
				{
					flag = true;
				}
				if (flag)
				{
					geometryGroup.Children.Add(lineGeometry);
				}
				else
				{
					geometryGroup2.Children.Add(lineGeometry);
				}
			}
			Columns.Count = count;
		}

		private static IEnumerable<Point> Flatten(List<int> segments, Func<int, double> x0, Func<int, double> y0, double resolution)
		{
			IList<int> flattenedIndices = Flattener.Flatten(new List<int>(), segments, x0, y0, 0, segments.Count - 1, resolution);
			for (int j = 0; j < flattenedIndices.Count; j++)
			{
				int arg = flattenedIndices[j];
				yield return new Point(x0(arg), y0(arg));
			}
		}

		private static void Populate(PathFigureCollection target, List<List<Point>> points)
		{
			foreach (List<Point> point in points)
			{
				if (point.Count == 0)
				{
					continue;
				}
				PathFigure pathFigure = new PathFigure
				{
					StartPoint = point[0]
				};
				foreach (Point item in point)
				{
					pathFigure.Segments.Add(new LineSegment
					{
						Point = item
					});
				}
				target.Add(pathFigure);
			}
		}

		private static List<Point> ClipPoints(Clipper clipper, List<Point> points, bool isClosed)
		{
			bool isClosed2 = clipper.IsClosed;
			clipper.IsClosed = isClosed;
			List<Point> result = (List<Point>)(clipper.Target = new List<Point>());
			clipper.BulkAdd(points, inReverseOrder: false);
			clipper.Target = null;
			clipper.IsClosed = isClosed2;
			return result;
		}

		[CatchesAll]
		private static IEnumerable<TResult> EnumerableSelect<TSource, TResult>(IEnumerable<TSource> source, Func<TSource, TResult> selector)
		{
			foreach (TSource item in source)
			{
				yield return selector(item);
			}
		}
	}

	public abstract class ItemwiseIndicatorCalculationStrategy
	{
		public abstract bool CalculateIndicatorItem(FinancialCalculationDataSource dataSource, FinancialCalculationSupportingCalculations supportingCalculations, int currentIndex);

		public abstract IList<string> BasedOn(FinancialCalculationDataSource dataSource, FinancialCalculationSupportingCalculations supportingCalculations);
	}
	public abstract class ItemwiseStrategyBasedIndicator : StrategyBasedIndicator
	{
		[TSSuppressSynthesizedInitializer]
		internal ItemwiseIndicatorCalculationStrategy ActualItemwiseStrategy { get; set; }

		internal abstract ItemwiseIndicatorCalculationStrategy ItemwiseStrategy { get; }

		protected override IndicatorCalculationStrategy CalculationStrategy => new ItemwiseStrategyCalculationStrategy();

		public ItemwiseStrategyBasedIndicator()
		{
		}

		protected override void InitializeIndicator()
		{
			base.InitializeIndicator();
			ActualItemwiseStrategy = ItemwiseStrategy;
			((ItemwiseStrategyCalculationStrategy)base.ActualCalculationStrategy).ItemwiseStrategy = ActualItemwiseStrategy;
		}
	}
	public class ItemwiseStrategyCalculationStrategy : IndicatorCalculationStrategy
	{
		public ItemwiseIndicatorCalculationStrategy ItemwiseStrategy { get; set; }

		public override IList<string> BasedOn(FinancialCalculationDataSource dataSource, FinancialCalculationSupportingCalculations supportingCalculations)
		{
			return ItemwiseStrategy.BasedOn(dataSource, supportingCalculations);
		}

		public override bool CalculateIndicator(FinancialCalculationDataSource dataSource, FinancialCalculationSupportingCalculations supportingCalculations)
		{
			bool flag = true;
			for (int i = dataSource.CalculateFrom; i < dataSource.CalculateFrom + dataSource.CalculateCount; i++)
			{
				flag = ItemwiseStrategy.CalculateIndicatorItem(dataSource, supportingCalculations, i);
				if (!flag)
				{
					return false;
				}
			}
			return flag;
		}
	}

	public class PriceChannelOverlay : FinancialOverlay
	{
		internal const string PeriodPropertyName = "Period";

		public static readonly DependencyProperty PeriodProperty = DependencyProperty.Register("Period", typeof(int), typeof(PriceChannelOverlay), new PropertyMetadata(14, delegate(DependencyObject sender, DependencyPropertyChangedEventArgs e)
		{
			((PriceChannelOverlay)sender).RaisePropertyChanged("Period", e.OldValue, e.NewValue);
		}));

		internal List<double> ChannelTopColumn = new List<double>();

		internal List<double> ChannelBottomColumn = new List<double>();

		[WidgetDefaultNumber(14.0)]
		public int Period
		{
			get
			{
				return (int)GetValue(PeriodProperty);
			}
			set
			{
				SetValue(PeriodProperty, value);
			}
		}

		[TSSuppressSynthesizedInitializer]
		private PriceChannelOverlayView PriceChannelOverlayView { get; set; }

		public PriceChannelOverlay()
		{
			base.DefaultStyleKey = typeof(PriceChannelOverlay);
			PreviousFrame = new CategoryFrame(3);
			TransitionFrame = new CategoryFrame(3);
			CurrentFrame = new CategoryFrame(3);
		}

		protected override void PropertyUpdatedOverride(object sender, string propertyName, object oldValue, object newValue)
		{
			if (propertyName == "HighColumn" || propertyName == "LowColumn")
			{
				base.OverlayValid = false;
			}
			base.PropertyUpdatedOverride(sender, propertyName, oldValue, newValue);
			if (propertyName == "Period")
			{
				base.OverlayValid = false;
				RenderSeries(animate: false);
			}
		}

		protected internal override bool ValidateSeries(Rect viewportRect, Rect windowRect, SeriesView view)
		{
			bool result = base.ValidateSeries(viewportRect, windowRect, view);
			if (base.HighColumn == null || base.LowColumn == null)
			{
				result = false;
			}
			return result;
		}

		protected override bool ValidateOverlay()
		{
			ChannelTopColumn.Clear();
			ChannelBottomColumn.Clear();
			int val = (int)MathUtil.Clamp(Period, 0.0, base.FastItemsSource.Count);
			int num = Math.Min(base.HighColumn.Count, base.LowColumn.Count);
			IList<double> list = MakeReadOnlyAndEnsureSorted(base.HighColumn);
			IList<double> list2 = MakeReadOnlyAndEnsureSorted(base.LowColumn);
			for (int i = 0; i < num; i++)
			{
				int num2 = Math.Min(val, i);
				double num3 = double.MinValue;
				double num4 = double.MaxValue;
				for (int j = 0; j < num2; j++)
				{
					if (!double.IsNaN(list[i - j]))
					{
						num3 = Math.Max(num3, list[i - j]);
					}
					if (!double.IsNaN(list2[i - j]))
					{
						num4 = Math.Min(num4, list2[i - j]);
					}
				}
				if (i == 0)
				{
					num4 = list2[0];
					num3 = list[0];
				}
				ChannelTopColumn.Add(num3);
				ChannelBottomColumn.Add(num4);
			}
			return true;
		}

		internal override void PrepareFrame(CategoryFrame frame, FinancialSeriesView view)
		{
			base.PrepareFrame(frame, view);
			Rect windowRect = view.WindowRect;
			Rect viewport = view.Viewport;
			Rect effectiveViewport = GetEffectiveViewport(view);
			ScalerParams p = new ScalerParams(windowRect, viewport, base.XAxis.IsInverted, effectiveViewport);
			ScalerParams scalerParams = new ScalerParams(windowRect, viewport, base.YAxis.IsInverted, effectiveViewport);
			scalerParams.ReferenceValue = GetReferenceValue();
			CategoryAxisBase xAxis = base.XAxis;
			NumericYAxis yAxis = base.YAxis;
			frame.Buckets.Clear();
			frame.Markers.Clear();
			frame.Trend.Clear();
			double num = 0.0;
			ISortingAxis sortingAxis = base.XAxis as ISortingAxis;
			if (sortingAxis != null && sortingAxis.SortedIndices.Count != base.FastItemsSource.Count)
			{
				return;
			}
			num = GetOffset(windowRect, viewport, effectiveViewport);
			if (!base.OverlayValid)
			{
				base.OverlayValid = ValidateOverlay();
			}
			scalerParams.ReferenceValue = GetReferenceValue();
			double num2 = base.XAxis.GetUnscaledValue(2.0, p) - base.XAxis.GetUnscaledValue(1.0, p);
			for (int i = view.BucketCalculator.FirstBucket; i <= view.BucketCalculator.LastBucket; i++)
			{
				double[] array;
				if (sortingAxis == null)
				{
					array = view.BucketCalculator.GetBucket(i);
				}
				else
				{
					int index = sortingAxis.SortedIndices[i];
					double unscaledValueAt = sortingAxis.GetUnscaledValueAt(index);
					double num3 = ChannelTopColumn[i];
					double num4 = ChannelBottomColumn[i];
					double num5 = num3;
					double num6 = num4;
					while (i < view.BucketCalculator.LastBucket)
					{
						index = sortingAxis.SortedIndices[i + 1];
						if (sortingAxis.GetUnscaledValueAt(index) - unscaledValueAt > num2)
						{
							break;
						}
						i++;
						num5 = Math.Max(num3, ChannelTopColumn[i]);
						num6 = Math.Min(num4, ChannelBottomColumn[i]);
					}
					if (!double.IsInfinity(num6) && !double.IsInfinity(num5))
					{
						double num7 = double.NaN;
						if (!double.IsNaN(unscaledValueAt))
						{
							num7 = base.XAxis.GetScaledValue(unscaledValueAt, p);
						}
						array = new double[3] { num7, num6, num5 };
					}
					else
					{
						array = new double[3]
						{
							double.NaN,
							double.NaN,
							double.NaN
						};
					}
				}
				double num8 = Math.Max(1.0, num2);
				if (!double.IsNaN(array[0]) && (double)i * num8 >= (double)base.IgnoreFirst)
				{
					if (base.XAxis != null && base.XAxis is ISortingAxis)
					{
						array[0] += num;
					}
					else
					{
						array[0] = xAxis.GetScaledValue(array[0], p) + num;
					}
					array[1] = yAxis.GetScaledValue(array[1], scalerParams);
					array[2] = yAxis.GetScaledValue(array[2], scalerParams);
					frame.Buckets.Add(array);
				}
			}
		}

		protected internal override void ClearRendering(bool wipeClean, SeriesView view)
		{
			base.ClearRendering(wipeClean, view);
			((PriceChannelOverlayView)view)?.ClearRendering();
		}

		internal override void RenderFrame(CategoryFrame frame, FinancialSeriesView view)
		{
			base.RenderFrame(frame, view);
			if (!(view is PriceChannelOverlayView priceChannelOverlayView))
			{
				return;
			}
			Rect effectiveViewport = GetEffectiveViewport(view);
			if (view.CheckFrameDirty(frame))
			{
				priceChannelOverlayView.ClearRendering();
				int count = frame.Buckets.Count;
				Func<int, double> px = (int i) => frame.Buckets[i][0];
				Func<int, double> nx = (int i) => frame.Buckets[count - 1 - i][0];
				Func<int, double> y = (int i) => frame.Buckets[i][1];
				Func<int, double> y2 = (int i) => frame.Buckets[count - 1 - i][2];
				priceChannelOverlayView.RenderChannel(count, px, nx, y, y2);
				view.UpdateFrameVersion(frame);
			}
			RenderManager.InitCategoryRenderSettings(this, ShouldOverrideCategoryStyle(), GetCategoryItems, GetBucketSize(view), GetFirstBucket(view));
			bool flag = false;
			AssigningSeriesShapeStyleEventArgsBase overrideArgs = RenderManager.OverrideArgs;
			List<double[]> buckets = frame.Buckets;
			int count2 = base.FastItemsSource.Count;
			if (overrideArgs != null)
			{
				flag = true;
			}
			if (flag)
			{
				ScalerParams axisParams = new ScalerParams(view.WindowRect, view.Viewport, base.XAxis.IsInverted, effectiveViewport);
				PerformCategoryStyleOverride(buckets, -1, count2, base.XAxis, axisParams, view.IsThumbnailView);
			}
			Polyline line = priceChannelOverlayView.Line0;
			Polyline line2 = priceChannelOverlayView.Line1;
			Polygon fillArea = priceChannelOverlayView.FillArea;
			RenderManager.SetShapeAppearance(line, strokeOnly: true, fillOnly: false, extended: true, useOutline: true);
			RenderManager.SetShapeAppearance(line2, strokeOnly: true, fillOnly: false, extended: true, useOutline: true);
			RenderManager.SetShapeAppearance(fillArea, strokeOnly: false, fillOnly: true, extended: false, useOutline: false);
			fillArea.Opacity = RenderManager.ActualRenderOpacity * base.ActualAreaFillOpacity;
		}

		protected override SeriesView CreateView()
		{
			return new PriceChannelOverlayView(this);
		}

		protected internal override void OnViewCreated(SeriesView view)
		{
			base.OnViewCreated(view);
			PriceChannelOverlayView = view as PriceChannelOverlayView;
		}

		public override double GetSeriesValue(Point world, bool useInterpolation, bool skipUnknowns)
		{
			if (base.SeriesViewer == null)
			{
				return double.NaN;
			}
			Rect effectiveViewport = GetEffectiveViewport(base.View);
			ScalerParams pars = new ScalerParams(base.SeriesViewer.ActualWindowRect, base.View.Viewport, base.XAxis.IsInverted, effectiveViewport);
			double offset = GetOffset(base.SeriesViewer.ActualWindowRect, base.View.Viewport, effectiveViewport);
			return GetSeriesValueHelper(new RangeValueList(ChannelTopColumn, ChannelBottomColumn), world, base.XAxis, pars, offset, GetExactUnsortedItemIndex, useInterpolation, skipUnknowns);
		}

		public override int GetNextOrExactIndex(Point world, bool skipUnknowns)
		{
			if (ChannelTopColumn == null || ChannelBottomColumn == null)
			{
				return base.GetNextOrExactIndex(world, skipUnknowns);
			}
			return GetNextOrExactIndexHelper(world, skipUnknowns, base.XAxis, GetExactUnsortedItemIndex, new RangeValueList(ChannelTopColumn, ChannelBottomColumn));
		}

		public override int GetPreviousOrExactIndex(Point world, bool skipUnknowns)
		{
			if (ChannelTopColumn == null || ChannelBottomColumn == null)
			{
				return base.GetPreviousOrExactIndex(world, skipUnknowns);
			}
			return GetPreviousOrExactIndexHelper(world, skipUnknowns, base.XAxis, GetExactUnsortedItemIndex, new RangeValueList(ChannelTopColumn, ChannelBottomColumn));
		}

		protected internal override double GetReferenceValue()
		{
			return Series.GetReferenceValue(ChannelBottomColumn, null);
		}
	}
	internal class PriceChannelBucketCalculator : FinancialBucketCalculator
	{
		[Weak]
		protected PriceChannelOverlayView PriceChannelView { get; set; }

		public PriceChannelBucketCalculator(FinancialSeriesView view)
			: base(view)
		{
			PriceChannelView = (PriceChannelOverlayView)view;
		}

		public override double[] GetBucket(int index)
		{
			int num = index * base.BucketSize;
			int num2 = Math.Min(num + base.BucketSize - 1, base.View.FinancialModel.FastItemsSource.Count - 1);
			if (num <= num2)
			{
				double num3 = double.MinValue;
				double num4 = double.MaxValue;
				int num5 = 0;
				for (int i = num; i <= num2; i++)
				{
					if (!double.IsNaN(PriceChannelView.PriceChannelOverlayModel.ChannelTopColumn[i]) && !double.IsNaN(PriceChannelView.PriceChannelOverlayModel.ChannelBottomColumn[i]))
					{
						num3 = Math.Max(num3, PriceChannelView.PriceChannelOverlayModel.ChannelTopColumn[i]);
						num4 = Math.Min(num4, PriceChannelView.PriceChannelOverlayModel.ChannelBottomColumn[i]);
						num5++;
					}
				}
				if (num5 > 0 && num4 != double.MaxValue && num3 != double.MinValue)
				{
					return new double[3]
					{
						0.5 * (double)(num + num2),
						num4,
						num3
					};
				}
			}
			return new double[3]
			{
				double.NaN,
				double.NaN,
				double.NaN
			};
		}
	}
	internal class PriceChannelOverlayView : FinancialSeriesView
	{
		private Polygon polygon = new Polygon();

		private Polyline polyline0 = new Polyline();

		private Polyline polyline1 = new Polyline();

		public Polygon FillArea => polygon;

		public Polyline Line0 => polyline0;

		public Polyline Line1 => polyline1;

		protected internal PriceChannelOverlay PriceChannelOverlayModel { get; set; }

		internal PriceChannelOverlayView(PriceChannelOverlay model)
			: base(model)
		{
			PriceChannelOverlayModel = model;
		}

		protected override FinancialBucketCalculator CreateBucketCalculator()
		{
			return new PriceChannelBucketCalculator(this);
		}

		internal void ClearRendering()
		{
			polygon.Points.Clear();
			polyline0.Points.Clear();
			polyline1.Points.Clear();
		}

		internal void RenderChannel(int count, Func<int, double> px, Func<int, double> nx, Func<int, double> y0, Func<int, double> y1)
		{
			foreach (int item in Flattener.Flatten(count, px, y0, Model.Resolution))
			{
				polygon.Points.Add(new Point(px(item), y0(item)));
				polyline0.Points.Add(new Point(px(item), y0(item)));
			}
			foreach (int item2 in Flattener.Flatten(count, nx, y1, Model.Resolution))
			{
				polygon.Points.Add(new Point(nx(item2), y1(item2)));
				polyline1.Points.Add(new Point(nx(item2), y1(item2)));
			}
		}

		public override void AttachUI(Canvas rootCanvas)
		{
			base.AttachUI(rootCanvas);
			polygon.Detach();
			polyline0.Detach();
			polyline1.Detach();
			rootCanvas.Children.Add(polygon);
			rootCanvas.Children.Add(polyline0);
			VisualInformationManager.SetIsOutlineVisual(polyline0, value: true);
			rootCanvas.Children.Add(polyline1);
			VisualInformationManager.SetIsOutlineVisual(polyline1, value: true);
		}

		protected internal override void ExportViewShapes(object svd)
		{
			base.ExportViewShapes(svd);
			Model.SeriesVisualDataManager.ExportPolygonData(svd, polygon, "fill", new string[1] { "Fill" });
			Model.SeriesVisualDataManager.ExportPolylineData(svd, polyline0, "bottom", new string[2] { "Lower", "Main" });
			Model.SeriesVisualDataManager.ExportPolylineData(svd, polyline1, "top", new string[1] { "Upper" });
		}
	}

	public abstract class IndicatorCalculationStrategy
	{
		public abstract bool CalculateIndicator(FinancialCalculationDataSource dataSource, FinancialCalculationSupportingCalculations supportingCalculations);

		public abstract IList<string> BasedOn(FinancialCalculationDataSource dataSource, FinancialCalculationSupportingCalculations supportingCalculations);
	}
	public abstract class StreamingIndicatorCalculationStrategy : IndicatorCalculationStrategy
	{
		public abstract IEnumerable<double> ProvideStream(FinancialCalculationDataSource dataSource, FinancialCalculationSupportingCalculations supportingCalculations);
	}
	public abstract class StrategyBasedIndicator : FinancialIndicator
	{
		internal static List<string> invalidatesSeries = new List<string>();

		internal const string PeriodPropertyName = "Period";

		internal const string LongPeriodPropertyName = "LongPeriod";

		internal const string ShortPeriodPropertyName = "ShortPeriod";

		private const string MultiplerPropertyName = "Multiplier";

		[TSSuppressSynthesizedInitializer]
		protected IndicatorCalculationStrategy ActualCalculationStrategy { get; set; }

		protected abstract IndicatorCalculationStrategy CalculationStrategy { get; }

		protected abstract Type StyleKeyType { get; }

		public StrategyBasedIndicator()
		{
			InitializeIndicator();
		}

		protected virtual void InitializeIndicator()
		{
			ActualCalculationStrategy = CalculationStrategy;
			base.DefaultStyleKey = StyleKeyType;
		}

		protected virtual int PeriodOverride()
		{
			return int.MinValue;
		}

		protected internal virtual void SetPeriodOverride(int period)
		{
		}

		protected virtual int ShortPeriodOverride()
		{
			return int.MinValue;
		}

		protected virtual int LongPeriodOverride()
		{
			return int.MinValue;
		}

		internal static DependencyProperty CreatePeriodPropertyHelper(int defaultValue, Type ownerType, string propertyName)
		{
			DependencyProperty result = DependencyProperty.Register(propertyName, typeof(int), ownerType, new PropertyMetadata(defaultValue, delegate(DependencyObject sender, DependencyPropertyChangedEventArgs e)
			{
				(sender as StrategyBasedIndicator).RaisePropertyChanged(propertyName, e.OldValue, e.NewValue);
			}));
			invalidatesSeries.Add(propertyName);
			return result;
		}

		protected static DependencyProperty CreatePeriodProperty(int defaultValue, Type ownerType)
		{
			return CreatePeriodPropertyHelper(defaultValue, ownerType, "Period");
		}

		protected static DependencyProperty CreateLongPeriodProperty(int defaultValue, Type ownerType)
		{
			return CreatePeriodPropertyHelper(defaultValue, ownerType, "LongPeriod");
		}

		protected static DependencyProperty CreateShortPeriodProperty(int defaultValue, Type ownerType)
		{
			return CreatePeriodPropertyHelper(defaultValue, ownerType, "ShortPeriod");
		}

		protected override IList<string> BasedOn(int position, int count)
		{
			FinancialCalculationDataSource dataSource = ProvideDataSource(position, count);
			FinancialCalculationSupportingCalculations supportingCalculations = ProvideSupportingCalculations(dataSource);
			return ActualCalculationStrategy.BasedOn(dataSource, supportingCalculations);
		}

		protected override bool IndicatorOverride(int position, int count)
		{
			FinancialCalculationDataSource financialCalculationDataSource = ProvideDataSource(position, count);
			if (count == 0)
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (!ValidateBasedOn(BasedOn(position, count)))
			{
				return false;
			}
			FinancialCalculationSupportingCalculations supportingCalculations = ProvideSupportingCalculations(financialCalculationDataSource);
			if (base.IndicatorRange != null)
			{
				financialCalculationDataSource.MinimumValue = base.IndicatorRange.Minimum;
				financialCalculationDataSource.MaximumValue = base.IndicatorRange.Maximum;
			}
			bool result = ActualCalculationStrategy.CalculateIndicator(financialCalculationDataSource, supportingCalculations);
			for (int i = 0; i < base.IgnoreFirst && i < financialCalculationDataSource.IndicatorColumn.Count; i++)
			{
				financialCalculationDataSource.IndicatorColumn[i] = double.NaN;
			}
			if (base.YAxis != null && UpdateRange(financialCalculationDataSource))
			{
				base.YAxis.UpdateRange();
			}
			return result;
		}

		protected bool UpdateRange(FinancialCalculationDataSource dataSource)
		{
			if (!double.IsNaN(dataSource.MinimumValue) && !double.IsNaN(dataSource.MaximumValue) && dataSource.SpecifiesRange)
			{
				AxisRange indicatorRange = base.IndicatorRange;
				base.IndicatorRange = new AxisRange(dataSource.MinimumValue, dataSource.MaximumValue);
				return RangesDiffer(indicatorRange, base.IndicatorRange);
			}
			double num = double.MaxValue;
			double num2 = double.MinValue;
			foreach (double item in dataSource.IndicatorColumn)
			{
				if (!double.IsNaN(item))
				{
					num = Math.Min(num, item);
					num2 = Math.Max(num2, item);
				}
			}
			AxisRange indicatorRange2 = base.IndicatorRange;
			base.IndicatorRange = new AxisRange(num, num2);
			return RangesDiffer(indicatorRange2, base.IndicatorRange);
		}

		private bool RangesDiffer(AxisRange prevRange, AxisRange indicatorRange)
		{
			if (prevRange == null || indicatorRange == null)
			{
				return true;
			}
			if (prevRange.Minimum != indicatorRange.Minimum)
			{
				return true;
			}
			if (prevRange.Maximum != indicatorRange.Maximum)
			{
				return true;
			}
			return false;
		}

		protected int SanitizePeriod([SwiftMutableParameter] int periodValue)
		{
			if (periodValue == int.MinValue)
			{
				return 0;
			}
			if (periodValue > base.IndicatorColumn.Count && base.IndicatorColumn.Count > 0)
			{
				periodValue = base.IndicatorColumn.Count - 1;
			}
			if (periodValue < 1)
			{
				return 1;
			}
			return periodValue;
		}

		protected override FinancialCalculationDataSource ProvideDataSource(int position, int count)
		{
			FinancialCalculationDataSource financialCalculationDataSource = base.ProvideDataSource(position, count);
			financialCalculationDataSource.IndicatorColumn = base.IndicatorColumn;
			financialCalculationDataSource.Period = SanitizePeriod(PeriodOverride());
			financialCalculationDataSource.ShortPeriod = SanitizePeriod(ShortPeriodOverride());
			financialCalculationDataSource.LongPeriod = SanitizePeriod(LongPeriodOverride());
			financialCalculationDataSource.Multiplier = MultiplierOverride();
			return financialCalculationDataSource;
		}

		protected virtual double MultiplierOverride()
		{
			return 1.0;
		}

		protected static DependencyProperty CreateMultiplierProperty(double defaultValue, Type ownerType)
		{
			DependencyProperty result = DependencyProperty.Register("Multiplier", typeof(double), ownerType, new PropertyMetadata(defaultValue, delegate(DependencyObject sender, DependencyPropertyChangedEventArgs e)
			{
				(sender as StrategyBasedIndicator).RaisePropertyChanged("Multiplier", e.OldValue, e.NewValue);
			}));
			invalidatesSeries.Add("Multiplier");
			return result;
		}

		protected override void PropertyUpdatedOverride(object sender, string propertyName, object oldValue, object newValue)
		{
			base.PropertyUpdatedOverride(sender, propertyName, oldValue, newValue);
			if (invalidatesSeries.Contains(propertyName) && base.YAxis != null && !base.YAxis.UpdateRange())
			{
				base.FinancialView.BucketCalculator.CalculateBuckets(base.Resolution);
				IndicatorOverride(0, base.IndicatorColumn.Count);
				if (base.IndicatorView.HasTrendLineManager)
				{
					base.IndicatorView.TrendLineManager.Reset();
				}
				RenderSeries(animate: false);
			}
		}
	}

	internal class FinancialPriceBucketCalculator : FinancialBucketCalculator
	{
		public FinancialPriceBucketCalculator(FinancialSeriesView view)
			: base(view)
		{
		}

		public override double[] GetBucket(int index)
		{
			int num = index * base.BucketSize;
			int num2 = Math.Min(num + base.BucketSize - 1, base.View.FinancialModel.FastItemsSource.Count - 1);
			if (num <= num2 && num >= 0 && num2 >= 0)
			{
				double num3 = base.View.FinancialModel.OpenColumn[num];
				double num4 = double.NegativeInfinity;
				double num5 = double.PositiveInfinity;
				double num6 = base.View.FinancialModel.CloseColumn[num2];
				for (int i = num; i <= num2; i++)
				{
					num4 = Math.Max(num4, base.View.FinancialModel.HighColumn[i]);
					num5 = Math.Min(num5, base.View.FinancialModel.LowColumn[i]);
				}
				num5 = Math.Min(num3, num5);
				num4 = Math.Max(num6, num4);
				return new double[5]
				{
					0.5 * (double)(num + num2),
					num3,
					num4,
					num5,
					num6
				};
			}
			return new double[5]
			{
				double.NaN,
				double.NaN,
				double.NaN,
				double.NaN,
				double.NaN
			};
		}
	}
