		public override Rect GetSeriesValueBoundingBox(Point world)
		{
			if (CurrentFrame == null || CurrentFrame.Buckets.Count == 0)
			{
				return Rect.Empty;
			}
			Point point = FromWorldPosition(world);
			_ = base.View.WindowRect;
			_ = base.View.Viewport;
			Rect effectiveViewport = GetEffectiveViewport(base.View);
			double[][] matchingBuckets = GetMatchingBuckets(base.XAxis, CurrentFrame.Buckets, GetBucketSize(base.View), GetFirstBucket(base.View), world, skipUnknowns: true);
			double[] array = matchingBuckets[0];
			double[] array2 = matchingBuckets[1];
			double num = Math.Abs(point.X - array[0]);
			double num2 = Math.Abs(point.X - array2[0]);
			double num3 = (Math.Max(GetItemWidth(base.FinancialView, effectiveViewport), 3.0) - 1.0) / 2.0;
			if (num < num2)
			{
				double num4 = array[0] - num3;
				_ = array[0];
				double num5 = array[0] + num3;
				double val = array[1];
				double val2 = array[2];
				double val3 = array[3];
				double val4 = array[4];
				double num6 = Math.Min(Math.Min(Math.Min(val, val2), val3), val4);
				double num7 = Math.Max(Math.Max(Math.Max(val, val2), val3), val4);
				return new Rect(num4, num6, Math.Abs(num5 - num4), num7 - num6);
			}
			double num8 = array2[0] - num3;
			_ = array2[0];
			double num9 = array2[0] + num3;
			double val5 = array2[1];
			double val6 = array2[2];
			double val7 = array2[3];
			double val8 = array2[4];
			double num10 = Math.Min(Math.Min(Math.Min(val5, val6), val7), val8);
			double num11 = Math.Max(Math.Max(Math.Max(val5, val6), val7), val8);
			return new Rect(num8, num10, Math.Abs(num9 - num8), num11 - num10);
		}

		private Rect[] GetFineGrainedBoxes(double[] bucket, double distanceFromCenter)
		{
			double x = bucket[0] - distanceFromCenter;
			double x2 = bucket[0];
			_ = bucket[0];
			double num = bucket[1];
			double num2 = bucket[2];
			double val = bucket[3];
			double num3 = bucket[4];
			Math.Min(Math.Min(Math.Min(num, num2), val), num3);
			Math.Max(Math.Max(Math.Max(num, num2), val), num3);
			double num4 = Math.Min(num2, val);
			double num5 = Math.Max(num2, val);
			double num6 = Math.Min(num, num3);
			double num7 = Math.Max(num, num3);
			if (DisplayType == PriceDisplayType.OHLC)
			{
				Rect[] array = new Rect[3];
				Rect rect = new Rect(x, num, distanceFromCenter, 0.0);
				Rect rect2 = new Rect(x2, num3, distanceFromCenter, 0.0);
				Rect rect3 = new Rect(x2, num4, 0.0, num5 - num4);
				array[0] = rect;
				array[1] = rect2;
				array[2] = rect3;
				return array;
			}
			Rect[] array2 = new Rect[2];
			Rect rect4 = new Rect(x2, num4, 0.0, num5 - num4);
			Rect rect5 = new Rect(x, num6, distanceFromCenter * 2.0, num7 - num6);
			array2[0] = rect4;
			array2[1] = rect5;
			return array2;
		}

		[JAVASuppressWidgetMember]
		[TSSuppressWidgetMember]
		[SwiftSuppressWidgetMember]
		public override Rect[] GetSeriesValueFineGrainedBoundingBoxes(Point world)
		{
			new List<Rect>();
			Point point = FromWorldPosition(world);
			_ = base.View.WindowRect;
			_ = base.View.Viewport;
			Rect effectiveViewport = GetEffectiveViewport(base.View);
			double[][] matchingBuckets = GetMatchingBuckets(base.XAxis, CurrentFrame.Buckets, GetBucketSize(base.View), GetFirstBucket(base.View), world, skipUnknowns: true);
			double[] array = matchingBuckets[0];
			double[] array2 = matchingBuckets[1];
			double num = Math.Abs(point.X - array[0]);
			double num2 = Math.Abs(point.X - array2[0]);
			double distanceFromCenter = (Math.Max(GetItemWidth(base.FinancialView, effectiveViewport), 3.0) - 1.0) / 2.0;
			if (num < num2)
			{
				return GetFineGrainedBoxes(array, distanceFromCenter);
			}
			return GetFineGrainedBoxes(array2, distanceFromCenter);
		}

		public override bool TestHit(Point position, bool isFinger)
		{
			if (TestShapesOver(position, isFinger))
			{
				return true;
			}
			return false;
		}

		protected override bool TestShapesOver(Point position, bool isFinger)
		{
			Rect seriesValueBoundingBoxFromSeriesPixel = GetSeriesValueBoundingBoxFromSeriesPixel(position);
			if (seriesValueBoundingBoxFromSeriesPixel.IsEmpty)
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (seriesValueBoundingBoxFromSeriesPixel.Inflate(base.ActualThickness / 2.0 + GetHitTestAllowance(isFinger)).Contains(position))
			{
				Rect[] seriesValueFineGrainedBoundingBoxesFromSeriesPixel = GetSeriesValueFineGrainedBoundingBoxesFromSeriesPixel(position);
				if (seriesValueFineGrainedBoundingBoxesFromSeriesPixel != null)
				{
					for (int i = 0; i < seriesValueFineGrainedBoundingBoxesFromSeriesPixel.Length; i++)
					{
						if (seriesValueFineGrainedBoundingBoxesFromSeriesPixel[i].Inflate(base.ActualThickness / 2.0 + GetHitTestAllowance(isFinger)).Contains(position))
						{
							return true;
						}
					}
				}
			}
			return false;
		}

		protected override void PropertyUpdatedOverride(object sender, string propertyName, object oldValue, object newValue)
		{
			if (!(propertyName == "XAxis"))
			{
				if (propertyName == "TrendLineType" && (TrendLineType)newValue != TrendLineType.None)
				{
					FinancialPriceView.TrendLineManager = CategoryTrendLineManagerFactory.SelectManager(FinancialPriceView.TrendLineManager, base.XAxis, base.RootCanvas, this, base.Res);
				}
			}
			else
			{
				FinancialPriceView.SelectTrendlineManager();
				if (base.SeriesViewer != null)
				{
					base.SeriesViewer.InvalidateComputedPlotAreaMargin();
				}
			}
			base.PropertyUpdatedOverride(sender, propertyName, oldValue, newValue);
			if (FinancialPriceView.HasTrendLineManager && FinancialPriceView.TrendLineManager != null && FinancialPriceView.TrendLineManager.PropertyUpdated(sender, propertyName, oldValue, newValue))
			{
				RenderSeries(animate: false);
				NotifyThumbnailAppearanceChanged();
			}
			switch (propertyName)
			{
			case "DisplayType":
				if (base.RootCanvas != null)
				{
					UpdatePathBrushes();
					UpdateLegendItemVisuals();
					CurrentFrame.IncrementFrameVersion();
					RenderFrame(CurrentFrame, FinancialPriceView);
				}
				NotifyThumbnailAppearanceChanged();
				break;
			case "ActualHighlightingMode":
				RenderSeries(animate: true);
				break;
			case "TrendLineBrush":
				UpdateIndexedProperties();
				break;
			case "TrendLineType":
				NotifyThumbnailAppearanceChanged();
				break;
			case "NegativeBrush":
			case "NegativeOutline":
				OnVisualPropertiesChanged();
				break;
			}
		}

		private void UpdatePathBrushes()
		{
			FinancialPriceView.UpdatePathBrushes();
			if (base.ThumbnailView != null)
			{
				((FinancialPriceSeriesView)base.ThumbnailView).UpdatePathBrushes();
			}
		}

		protected internal override AxisRange GetRange(Axis axis)
		{
			if (axis != null && axis == base.YAxis && base.LowColumn != null && !double.IsNaN(base.LowColumn.Minimum) && base.HighColumn != null && !double.IsNaN(base.HighColumn.Maximum))
			{
				return new AxisRange(base.LowColumn.Minimum, base.HighColumn.Maximum);
			}
			return null;
		}

		protected internal override AxisRange GetVisibleRange([SwiftMutableParameter] Rect forWindow)
		{
			if (forWindow.IsEmpty && base.SeriesViewer != null)
			{
				forWindow = base.SeriesViewer.ActualWindowRect;
			}
			if (base.LowColumn == null || base.HighColumn == null)
			{
				return null;
			}
			Rect contentViewport = GetContentViewport(base.View);
			ScalerParams p = new ScalerParams(forWindow, base.SeriesViewer.ViewportRect, base.XAxis.IsInverted, GetEffectiveViewport());
			double num = base.XAxis.GetUnscaledValue(contentViewport.Left, p);
			double num2 = base.XAxis.GetUnscaledValue(contentViewport.Right, p);
			if (base.XAxis.IsInverted)
			{
				double num3 = num;
				num = num2;
				num2 = num3;
			}
			ISortingAxis sortingAxis = null;
			if (base.XAxis.IsSorting)
			{
				sortingAxis = (ISortingAxis)base.XAxis;
				num = sortingAxis.GetIndexClosestToUnscaledValue(num);
				num2 = sortingAxis.GetIndexClosestToUnscaledValue(num2);
			}
			else
			{
				num = Math.Floor(num);
				num2 = Math.Ceiling(num2);
			}
			num = Math.Max(0.0, Math.Min(base.LowColumn.Count - 1, num));
			num2 = Math.Max(0.0, Math.Min(base.LowColumn.Count - 1, num2));
			double num4 = double.MaxValue;
			double num5 = double.MinValue;
			for (int i = (int)num; i <= (int)num2; i++)
			{
				int index = i;
				if (sortingAxis != null)
				{
					index = sortingAxis.SortedIndices[i];
				}
				double num6 = base.LowColumn[index];
				if (!base.LowColumn.MayContainUnknowns || (!double.IsInfinity(num6) && !double.IsNaN(num6)))
				{
					double num7 = base.HighColumn[index];
					if (!base.HighColumn.MayContainUnknowns || (!double.IsInfinity(num7) && !double.IsNaN(num7)))
					{
						num4 = Math.Min(num4, num6);
						num5 = Math.Max(num5, num7);
					}
				}
			}
			AxisRange range = new AxisRange(num4, num5);
			return ExpandRangeForMargin(range, base.YAxis, forWindow);
		}

		protected internal override double GetReferenceValue()
		{
			return Series.GetReferenceValue(base.OpenColumn, base.XAxis as ISortingAxis);
		}

		public override bool ScrollIntoView(object item)
		{
			int num = ((base.FastItemsSource != null) ? base.FastItemsSource.IndexOf(item) : (-1));
			Rect windowRect = base.View.WindowRect;
			_ = base.View.Viewport;
			Rect rect = new Rect(0.0, 0.0, 1.0, 1.0);
			Rect effectiveViewportForUnitViewport = GetEffectiveViewportForUnitViewport(base.View);
			if (num >= 0)
			{
				if (base.XAxis != null)
				{
					ScalerParams p = new ScalerParams(rect, rect, base.XAxis.IsInverted, effectiveViewportForUnitViewport);
					double num2 = base.XAxis.GetScaledValue(num, p);
					if (num2 < windowRect.Left + 0.1 * windowRect.Width)
					{
						num2 += 0.4 * windowRect.Width;
					}
					if (num2 > windowRect.Right - 0.1 * windowRect.Width)
					{
						num2 -= 0.4 * windowRect.Width;
					}
					windowRect.X = num2 - 0.5 * windowRect.Width;
				}
				if (base.YAxis != null && base.LowColumn != null && base.HighColumn != null && num < base.LowColumn.Count && num < base.HighColumn.Count)
				{
					ScalerParams scalerParams = new ScalerParams(rect, rect, base.YAxis.IsInverted, effectiveViewportForUnitViewport);
					scalerParams.ReferenceValue = GetReferenceValue();
					double num3 = base.YAxis.GetScaledValue(base.LowColumn[num], scalerParams);
					double scaledValue = base.YAxis.GetScaledValue(base.HighColumn[num], scalerParams);
					if (!double.IsNaN(num3) && !double.IsNaN(scaledValue))
					{
						double num4 = Math.Abs(num3 - scaledValue);
						if (windowRect.Height < num4)
						{
							windowRect.Height = num4;
							windowRect.Y = Math.Min(num3, scaledValue);
						}
						else
						{
							if (num3 < windowRect.Top + 0.1 * windowRect.Height)
							{
								num3 += 0.4 * windowRect.Height;
							}
							if (num3 > windowRect.Bottom - 0.1 * windowRect.Height)
							{
								num3 -= 0.4 * windowRect.Height;
							}
							windowRect.Y = num3 - 0.5 * windowRect.Height;
						}
					}
				}
				base.SyncLink.WindowNotify(base.SeriesViewer, windowRect, force: true);
			}
			return num >= 0;
		}

		protected internal override bool ValidateSeries(Rect viewportRect, Rect windowRect, SeriesView view)
		{
			bool result = base.ValidateSeries(viewportRect, windowRect, view);
			if (base.OpenColumn == null || base.CloseColumn == null || base.HighColumn == null || base.LowColumn == null)
			{
				result = false;
			}
			return result;
		}

		internal override void PrepareFrame(CategoryFrame frame, FinancialSeriesView view)
		{
			base.PrepareFrame(frame, view);
			Rect windowRect = view.WindowRect;
			Rect viewport = view.Viewport;
			Rect effectiveViewport = GetEffectiveViewport(view);
			CategoryAxisBase xAxis = base.XAxis;
			NumericYAxis yAxis = base.YAxis;
			ScalerParams xParams = new ScalerParams(windowRect, viewport, xAxis.IsInverted, effectiveViewport);
			ScalerParams yParams = new ScalerParams(windowRect, viewport, yAxis.IsInverted, effectiveViewport)
			{
				ReferenceValue = GetReferenceValue()
			};
			frame.Buckets.Clear();
			frame.Markers.Clear();
			frame.Trend.Clear();
			double num = 0.0;
			ISortingAxis sortingAxis = base.XAxis as ISortingAxis;
			if (sortingAxis != null && (sortingAxis.SortedIndices == null || sortingAxis.SortedIndices.Count != base.FastItemsSource.Count))
			{
				return;
			}
			num = GetOffset(windowRect, viewport, effectiveViewport);
			double resolution = base.Resolution;
			if (TrendLineType != TrendLineType.None)
			{
				double[] array = new double[base.FastItemsSource.Count];
				int num2 = 0;
				foreach (double item in base.TypicalColumn)
				{
					array[num2] = item;
					num2++;
				}
				if (FinancialPriceView.HasTrendLineManager)
				{
					((IPreparesCategoryTrendline)FinancialPriceView.TrendLineManager).PrepareLineCore(frame.Trend, TrendLineType, array, TrendLinePeriod, (double x) => base.XAxis.GetScaledValue(x, xParams), (double y) => base.YAxis.GetScaledValue(y, yParams), new TrendResolutionParams
					{
						BucketSize = view.BucketCalculator.BucketSize,
						FirstBucket = view.BucketCalculator.FirstBucket,
						LastBucket = view.BucketCalculator.LastBucket,
						Offset = num,
						Resolution = resolution,
						Viewport = viewport
					});
				}
			}
			double num3 = base.XAxis.GetUnscaledValue(2.0, xParams) - base.XAxis.GetUnscaledValue(1.0, xParams);
			for (int num4 = view.BucketCalculator.FirstBucket; num4 <= view.BucketCalculator.LastBucket; num4++)
			{
				double[] array2;
				if (sortingAxis == null)
				{
					array2 = view.BucketCalculator.GetBucket(num4);
				}
				else
				{
					int index = sortingAxis.SortedIndices[num4];
					double unscaledValueAt = sortingAxis.GetUnscaledValueAt(index);
					double num5 = base.OpenColumn[index];
					double num6 = base.HighColumn[index];
					double num7 = base.LowColumn[index];
					double num8 = base.CloseColumn[index];
					double num9 = num5;
					double num10 = num6;
					double num11 = num7;
					double num12 = num8;
					while (num4 < view.BucketCalculator.LastBucket)
					{
						index = sortingAxis.SortedIndices[num4 + 1];
						if (sortingAxis.GetUnscaledValueAt(index) - unscaledValueAt > num3 * resolution)
						{
							break;
						}
						num4++;
						num10 = Math.Max(num10, base.HighColumn[index]);
						num11 = Math.Min(num11, base.LowColumn[index]);
						num12 = base.CloseColumn[index];
					}
					double num13 = double.NaN;
					if (!double.IsNaN(unscaledValueAt))
					{
						num13 = base.XAxis.GetScaledValue(unscaledValueAt, xParams);
					}
					array2 = new double[5] { num13, num9, num10, num11, num12 };
				}
				if (!double.IsNaN(array2[0]))
				{
					if (sortingAxis != null)
					{
						array2[0] += num;
					}
					else
					{
						array2[0] = xAxis.GetScaledValue(array2[0], xParams) + num;
					}
					array2[1] = yAxis.GetScaledValue(array2[1], yParams);
					array2[2] = yAxis.GetScaledValue(array2[2], yParams);
					array2[3] = yAxis.GetScaledValue(array2[3], yParams);
					array2[4] = yAxis.GetScaledValue(array2[4], yParams);
					frame.Buckets.Add(array2);
				}
			}
		}

		internal override void RenderFrame(CategoryFrame frame, FinancialSeriesView view)
		{
			base.RenderFrame(frame, view);
			if (base.XAxis != null && base.YAxis != null)
			{
				bool isDirty = false;
				if (view.CheckFrameDirty(frame))
				{
					isDirty = true;
					view.UpdateFrameVersion(frame);
				}
				RenderManager.InitCategoryRenderSettings(this, ShouldOverrideCategoryStyle(), GetCategoryItems, GetBucketSize(view), GetFirstBucket(view));
				bool flag = false;
				if (RenderManager.OverrideArgs != null)
				{
					flag = true;
				}
				FinancialPriceSeriesView financialPriceSeriesView = view as FinancialPriceSeriesView;
				financialPriceSeriesView.ClearGroupedPriceSymbols();
				financialPriceSeriesView.SeparateMode = false;
				if (financialPriceSeriesView.HasTrendLineManager)
				{
					financialPriceSeriesView.TrendLineManager.ClearPoints();
				}
				if (TrendLineType != TrendLineType.None)
				{
					financialPriceSeriesView.TrendLineManager.RasterizeTrendLine(frame.Trend);
				}
				if (flag)
				{
					RenderSeparate(frame, view, isDirty);
					return;
				}
				financialPriceSeriesView.Shapes.Count = 0;
				RenderCombinedGrouping(frame, view);
			}
		}

		private void RenderSeparate(CategoryFrame frame, FinancialSeriesView view, bool isDirty)
		{
			PriceDisplayType displayType = DisplayType;
			Rect effectiveViewport = GetEffectiveViewport(view);
			double num = (GetItemWidth(view, effectiveViewport) - 1.0) / 2.0;
			FinancialPriceSeriesView financialPriceSeriesView = view as FinancialPriceSeriesView;
			financialPriceSeriesView.SeparateMode = true;
			List<double[]> buckets = frame.Buckets;
			int num2 = 0;
			int count = base.FastItemsSource.Count;
			CategoryAxisBase xAxis = base.XAxis;
			ScalerParams axisParams = new ScalerParams(view.WindowRect, view.Viewport, xAxis.IsInverted, effectiveViewport);
			Brush actualBrush = base.ActualBrush;
			Brush brush = base.NegativeBrush;
			if (brush == null)
			{
				brush = actualBrush;
			}
			Brush actualOutline = base.ActualOutline;
			Brush brush2 = NegativeOutline;
			if (brush2 == null)
			{
				brush2 = actualOutline;
			}
			for (int i = 0; i < buckets.Count; i++)
			{
				double x = buckets[i][0] - num;
				double x2 = buckets[i][0];
				double x3 = buckets[i][0] + num;
				double num3 = buckets[i][1];
				double num4 = buckets[i][2];
				double num5 = buckets[i][3];
				double num6 = buckets[i][4];
				if (double.IsNaN(num3) || double.IsNaN(num4) || double.IsNaN(num5) || double.IsNaN(num6))
				{
					continue;
				}
				Path path = financialPriceSeriesView.Shapes[num2];
				num2++;
				bool flag = num3 < num6;
				PathGeometry pathGeometry = new PathGeometry();
				if (isDirty)
				{
					switch (displayType)
					{
					case PriceDisplayType.Candlestick:
					{
						if (flag)
						{
							double num7 = num3;
							num3 = num6;
							num6 = num7;
						}
						PathFigure pathFigure4 = new PathFigure();
						pathFigure4.StartPoint = new Point(x2, num5);
						pathFigure4.Segments.Add(new LineSegment
						{
							Point = new Point(x2, num3)
						});
						PathFigure pathFigure5 = new PathFigure();
						pathFigure5.StartPoint = new Point(x, num6);
						pathFigure5.Segments.Add(new LineSegment
						{
							Point = new Point(x3, num6)
						});
						pathFigure5.Segments.Add(new LineSegment
						{
							Point = new Point(x3, num3)
						});
						pathFigure5.Segments.Add(new LineSegment
						{
							Point = new Point(x, num3)
						});
						pathFigure5.Segments.Add(new LineSegment
						{
							Point = new Point(x, num6)
						});
						PathFigure pathFigure6 = new PathFigure();
						pathFigure6.StartPoint = new Point(x2, num6);
						pathFigure6.Segments.Add(new LineSegment
						{
							Point = new Point(x2, num4)
						});
						pathGeometry.Figures.Add(pathFigure4);
						pathGeometry.Figures.Add(pathFigure5);
						pathGeometry.Figures.Add(pathFigure6);
						break;
					}
					case PriceDisplayType.OHLC:
					{
						PathFigure pathFigure = new PathFigure();
						pathFigure.StartPoint = new Point(x, num3);
						pathFigure.Segments.Add(new LineSegment
						{
							Point = new Point(x2, num3)
						});
						PathFigure pathFigure2 = new PathFigure();
						pathFigure2.StartPoint = new Point(x2, num5);
						pathFigure2.Segments.Add(new LineSegment
						{
							Point = new Point(x2, num4)
						});
						PathFigure pathFigure3 = new PathFigure();
						pathFigure3.StartPoint = new Point(x2, num6);
						pathFigure3.Segments.Add(new LineSegment
						{
							Point = new Point(x3, num6)
						});
						pathGeometry.Figures.Add(pathFigure);
						pathGeometry.Figures.Add(pathFigure2);
						pathGeometry.Figures.Add(pathFigure3);
						break;
					}
					}
				}
				if (flag)
				{
					RenderManager.InitialRenderFill = brush;
					RenderManager.ActualRenderFill = brush;
					RenderManager.ActualRenderOutline = brush2;
					RenderManager.InitialRenderOutline = brush2;
					RenderManager.ActualNegativeShape = true;
				}
				else
				{
					RenderManager.InitialRenderFill = actualBrush;
					RenderManager.ActualRenderFill = actualBrush;
					RenderManager.ActualRenderOutline = actualOutline;
					RenderManager.InitialRenderOutline = actualOutline;
					RenderManager.ActualNegativeShape = false;
				}
				PerformCategoryStyleOverride(buckets, i, count, xAxis, axisParams, view.IsThumbnailView);
				if (displayType == PriceDisplayType.OHLC)
				{
					RenderManager.SetShapeAppearance(path, strokeOnly: true, fillOnly: false, extended: false, useOutline: false);
				}
				else
				{
					RenderManager.SetShapeAppearance(path, strokeOnly: false, fillOnly: false, extended: false, useOutline: false);
				}
				if (isDirty)
				{
					path.Data = pathGeometry;
				}
			}
			financialPriceSeriesView.Shapes.Count = num2;
			financialPriceSeriesView.FrameRendered();
		}

		private double GetItemWidth(FinancialSeriesView view, Rect effectiveViewport)

					{
						Point = new Point(x, num5)
					});
					PathFigure pathFigure6 = new PathFigure();
					pathFigure6.StartPoint = new Point(x2, num5);
					pathFigure6.Segments.Add(new LineSegment
					{

	internal class FinancialBucketCalculator : IBucketizer
	{
		[Weak]
		protected FinancialSeriesView View { get; private set; }

		protected internal int FirstBucket { get; set; }

		protected internal int LastBucket { get; set; }

		protected internal int BucketSize { get; set; }

		internal FinancialBucketCalculator(FinancialSeriesView view)
		{
			if (view == null)
			{
				throw new ArgumentNullException("view");
			}
			View = view;
			FirstBucket = -1;
			LastBucket = LastBucket;
			BucketSize = 0;
		}

		public virtual double[] GetBucket(int index)
		{
			return null;
		}

		public virtual double[] GetBucketWithoutUnknowns(int index)
		{
			return GetBucket(index);
		}

		public virtual double GetErrorBucket(int index, IFastItemColumn<double> column)
		{
			return double.NaN;
		}

		public void GetBucketInfo(out int firstBucket, out int lastBucket, out int bucketSize, out double resolution)
		{
			firstBucket = FirstBucket;
			lastBucket = LastBucket;
			bucketSize = BucketSize;
			resolution = View.FinancialModel.Resolution;
		}

		protected internal virtual void CalculateBuckets(double resolution)
		{
			Rect windowRect = View.WindowRect;
			Rect viewport = View.Viewport;
			Rect effectiveViewport = View.Viewport;
			if (View.FinancialModel != null)
			{
				effectiveViewport = View.FinancialModel.GetEffectiveViewport(View);
			}
			if (windowRect.IsEmpty || viewport.IsEmpty || View.FinancialModel.XAxis == null)
			{
				BucketSize = 0;
				return;
			}
			bool inverted = View.FinancialModel.XAxis != null && View.FinancialModel.XAxis.IsInverted;
			ScalerParams p = new ScalerParams(windowRect, viewport, inverted, effectiveViewport);
			Rect contentViewport = View.FinancialModel.GetContentViewport(View);
			if (View.FinancialModel.XAxis is ISortingAxis { SortedIndices: not null } sortingAxis)
			{
				FirstBucket = sortingAxis.GetFirstVisibleIndex(windowRect, viewport, effectiveViewport, contentViewport);
				LastBucket = sortingAxis.GetLastVisibleIndex(windowRect, viewport, effectiveViewport, contentViewport);
				BucketSize = 1;
				return;
			}
			double num = Math.Floor(View.FinancialModel.XAxis.GetUnscaledValue(contentViewport.Left, p));
			double num2 = Math.Ceiling(View.FinancialModel.XAxis.GetUnscaledValue(contentViewport.Right, p));
			if (View.FinancialModel.XAxis.IsInverted)
			{
				num2 = Math.Ceiling(View.FinancialModel.XAxis.GetUnscaledValue(contentViewport.Left, p));
				num = Math.Floor(View.FinancialModel.XAxis.GetUnscaledValue(contentViewport.Right, p));
			}
			double val = Math.Floor((num2 - num + 1.0) * resolution / contentViewport.Width);
			BucketSize = (int)Math.Max(1.0, val);
			FirstBucket = (int)Math.Floor(num / (double)BucketSize);
			LastBucket = (int)Math.Ceiling(num2 / (double)BucketSize);
		}
	}
	internal class FinancialValueList : IList<double>, ICollection<double>, IEnumerable<double>, IEnumerable
	{
		private IList<double> _openColumn;

		private IList<double> _highColumn;

		private IList<double> _closeColumn;

		private IList<double> _lowColumn;

		private IList<double> _volumeColumn;

		public double this[int index]
		{
			get
			{
				double num = double.NaN;
				double num2 = double.NaN;
				double num3 = double.NaN;
				double num4 = double.NaN;
				double d = double.NaN;
				if (_openColumn != null && index >= 0 && index < _openColumn.Count)
				{
					num = _openColumn[index];
				}
				if (_highColumn != null && index >= 0 && index < _highColumn.Count)
				{
					num2 = _highColumn[index];
				}
				if (_lowColumn != null && index >= 0 && index < _lowColumn.Count)
				{
					num3 = _lowColumn[index];
				}
				if (_closeColumn != null && index >= 0 && index < _closeColumn.Count)
				{
					num4 = _closeColumn[index];
				}
				if (_volumeColumn != null && index >= 0 && index < _volumeColumn.Count)
				{
					d = _volumeColumn[index];
				}
				bool flag = double.IsNaN(num);
				bool flag2 = double.IsNaN(num2);
				bool flag3 = double.IsNaN(num3);
				bool flag4 = double.IsNaN(num4);
				double.IsNaN(d);
				if (!flag2 && !flag3 && !flag4)
				{
					return (num2 + num3 + num4) / 3.0;
				}
				if (!flag2 && !flag3)
				{
					return (num2 + num3) / 2.0;
				}
				if (!flag && !flag4)
				{
					return (num + num4) / 2.0;
				}
				if (!flag)
				{
					return num;
				}
				if (!flag2)
				{
					return num2;
				}
				if (!flag3)
				{
					return num3;
				}
				if (!flag4)
				{
					return num4;
				}
				return double.NaN;
			}
			set
			{
			}
		}

		public int Count
		{
			get
			{
				int val = 0;
				int val2 = 0;
				int val3 = 0;
				int val4 = 0;
				int val5 = 0;
				if (_openColumn != null)
				{
					val = _openColumn.Count;
				}
				if (_highColumn != null)
				{
					val2 = _highColumn.Count;
				}
				if (_lowColumn != null)
				{
					val3 = _lowColumn.Count;
				}
				if (_closeColumn != null)
				{
					val4 = _closeColumn.Count;
				}
				if (_volumeColumn != null)
				{
					val5 = _volumeColumn.Count;
				}
				return Math.Max(Math.Max(Math.Max(Math.Max(Math.Max(0, val), val2), val3), val4), val5);
			}
		}

		public bool IsReadOnly => true;

		public FinancialValueList(IList<double> openColumn, IList<double> highColumn, IList<double> lowColumn, IList<double> closeColumn, IList<double> volumeColumn)

		public override object GetItemValue(object item, string memberPathName)
		{
			return ResolveMemberPath(memberPathName) switch
			{
				"OpenMemberPath" => GetItemValueByMemberPath(item, memberPathName, OpenMemberPath), 
				"HighMemberPath" => GetItemValueByMemberPath(item, memberPathName, HighMemberPath), 
				"LowMemberPath" => GetItemValueByMemberPath(item, memberPathName, LowMemberPath), 
				"CloseMemberPath" => GetItemValueByMemberPath(item, memberPathName, CloseMemberPath), 
				"VolumeMemberPath" => GetItemValueByMemberPath(item, memberPathName, VolumeMemberPath), 
				_ => base.GetItemValue(item, memberPathName), 
			};
		}

		protected internal override Point[][] GetHighStrokeSegments(Point position)
		{
			double[][] matchingBuckets = GetMatchingBuckets(XAxis, CurrentFrame.Buckets, GetBucketSize(base.View), GetFirstBucket(base.View), ToWorldPosition(position), skipUnknowns: true);
			if (matchingBuckets == null)
			{
				return null;
			}
			double[] array = matchingBuckets[0];
			double[] array2 = matchingBuckets[1];
			Point[][] array3 = new Point[1][];
			Point[] array4 = new Point[2];
			int highIndexInBucket = GetHighIndexInBucket();
			array4[0] = new Point(array[0], array[highIndexInBucket]);
			array4[1] = new Point(array2[0], array2[highIndexInBucket]);
			array3[0] = array4;
			return array3;
		}

		protected internal override Point[][] GetLowStrokeSegments(Point position)
		{
			double[][] matchingBuckets = GetMatchingBuckets(XAxis, CurrentFrame.Buckets, GetBucketSize(base.View), GetFirstBucket(base.View), ToWorldPosition(position), skipUnknowns: true);
			if (matchingBuckets == null)
			{
				return null;
			}
			double[] array = matchingBuckets[0];
			double[] array2 = matchingBuckets[1];
			return new Point[1][] { new Point[2]
			{
				new Point(array[0], array[1]),
				new Point(array2[0], array2[1])
			} };
		}

			}
		}

		protected void PerformCategoryStyleOverride(List<double[]> buckets, int currentIndex, int valueCount, CategoryAxisBase categoryAxis, ScalerParams axisParams, bool isThumbnail)
		{
			bool flag = base.ActualHighlightingMode != SeriesHighlightingMode.None;
			RenderManager.PopulateArgsBounds(RenderManager.OverrideArgs, categoryAxis.IsSorting, buckets, currentIndex, valueCount, categoryAxis, axisParams, isThumbnail, isMarker: false);
			RenderManager.PrePerformStyleOverride(base.ActualHighlightingFadeOpacity);
			AssigningCategoryStyleEventArgs categoryOverrideArgs = RenderManager.CategoryOverrideArgs;
			HighlightingInfo info = null;
			IFastItemsSource fastItemsSource = base.FastItemsSource;
			if (flag && base.SeriesViewer != null)
			{
				info = (categoryOverrideArgs.HighlightingInfo = base.SeriesViewer.HighlightingManager.GetHighlightingInfo(this, fastItemsSource, categoryOverrideArgs.StartIndex, categoryOverrideArgs.EndIndex, isMarker: false));
			}
			categoryOverrideArgs.IsThumbnail = isThumbnail;
			RaiseAssigningCategoryStyles(categoryOverrideArgs);
			RenderManager.PostPerformStyleOverride(this, info, isThumbnail, flag, currentIndex < 0);
		}

			double offset = GetOffset(base.View.WindowRect, base.View.Viewport, effectiveViewport);
			ScalerParams pars = new ScalerParams(base.View.WindowRect, base.View.Viewport, XAxis.IsInverted, effectiveViewport);
			return GetSeriesValueHelper(VolumeColumn, world, XAxis, pars, offset, GetExactUnsortedItemIndex, useInterpolation, skipUnknowns);
		}

		}

		protected internal override void InvalidateAxes()
		{
			base.InvalidateAxes();
			if (XAxis != null)
			{
				XAxis.RenderAxis(animate: false);
			}
			if (YAxis != null)
			{
				YAxis.RenderAxis(animate: false);
			}
		}

		protected override void WindowRectChangedOverride(Rect oldWindowRect, Rect newWindowRect)
		{
			FinancialView.BucketCalculator.CalculateBuckets(base.Resolution);
			RenderSeries(animate: false);
		}

		protected override void ViewportRectChangedOverride(Rect oldViewportRect, Rect newViewportRect)
		{
			if (base.TransitionInIsInProgress && base.TransitionProgress < 0.05)
			{
				base.TransitionInViable = true;
			}
			FinancialView.BucketCalculator.CalculateBuckets(base.Resolution);
			RenderSeries(animate: false);
		}

		private IFastItemColumn<double> RegisterColumn(IFastItemsSource itemsSource, string mapping, string propertyName)
		{
			IFastItemColumn<double> fastItemColumn = RegisterDoubleColumn(mapping);
			columnToMapping.Add(fastItemColumn, mapping);
			mappingToColumnName.Add(mapping, propertyName);
			return fastItemColumn;
		}

		private void DeRegisterColumn(IFastItemsSource itemsSource, IFastItemColumn<double> column)
		{
			if (column != null)
			{
				itemsSource.DeregisterColumn(column);
				string key = columnToMapping[column];
				mappingToColumnName.Remove(key);
				columnToMapping.Remove(column);
			}
		}

		protected override void PropertyUpdatedOverride(object sender, string propertyName, object oldValue, object newValue)
		{
			base.PropertyUpdatedOverride(sender, propertyName, oldValue, newValue);
			switch (propertyName)
			{
			case "SyncLink":
				if (base.SyncLink != null && base.SeriesViewer != null)
				{
					FinancialView.BucketCalculator.CalculateBuckets(base.Resolution);
					RenderSeries(animate: false);
				}
				break;
			case "SeriesViewer":
				if (oldValue != null && newValue == null)
				{
					if (XAxis != null)
					{
						XAxis.DeregisterSeries(this);
					}
					if (YAxis != null)
					{
						YAxis.DeregisterSeries(this);
					}
				}
				if (oldValue == null && newValue != null)
				{
					if (XAxis != null)
					{
						XAxis.RegisterSeries(this);
					}
					if (YAxis != null)
					{
						YAxis.RegisterSeries(this);
					}
				}
				FinancialView.BucketCalculator.CalculateBuckets(base.Resolution);
				RenderSeries(animate: false);
				break;
			case "FastItemsSource":
				_ignoreColumnChanges = true;
				if (oldValue is IFastItemsSource)
				{
					DeRegisterColumn(oldValue as IFastItemsSource, OpenColumn);
					DeRegisterColumn(oldValue as IFastItemsSource, HighColumn);
					DeRegisterColumn(oldValue as IFastItemsSource, LowColumn);
					DeRegisterColumn(oldValue as IFastItemsSource, CloseColumn);
					DeRegisterColumn(oldValue as IFastItemsSource, VolumeColumn);
					OpenColumn = null;
					HighColumn = null;
					LowColumn = null;
					CloseColumn = null;
					VolumeColumn = null;
				}
				if (newValue is IFastItemsSource)
				{
					if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(OpenMemberPath))
					{
						OpenColumn = RegisterColumn(newValue as IFastItemsSource, OpenMemberPath, "OpenColumn");
					}
					if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(HighMemberPath))
					{
						HighColumn = RegisterColumn(newValue as IFastItemsSource, HighMemberPath, "HighColumn");
					}
					if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(LowMemberPath))
					{
						LowColumn = RegisterColumn(newValue as IFastItemsSource, LowMemberPath, "LowColumn");
					}
					if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(CloseMemberPath))
					{
						CloseColumn = RegisterColumn(newValue as IFastItemsSource, CloseMemberPath, "CloseColumn");
					}
					if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(VolumeMemberPath))
					{
						VolumeColumn = RegisterColumn(newValue as IFastItemsSource, VolumeMemberPath, "VolumeColumn");
					}
				}
				_ignoreColumnChanges = false;
				if (YAxis != null && !YAxis.UpdateRange())
				{
					FinancialView.BucketCalculator.CalculateBuckets(base.Resolution);
					RenderSeries(animate: false);
				}
				break;
			case "OpenMemberPath":
				if (base.FastItemsSource != null)
				{
					DeRegisterColumn(base.FastItemsSource, OpenColumn);
					OpenColumn = RegisterColumn(base.FastItemsSource, OpenMemberPath, "OpenColumn");
				}
				break;
			case "OpenColumn":
				if (YAxis != null && !YAxis.UpdateRange() && !_ignoreColumnChanges)
				{
					FinancialView.BucketCalculator.CalculateBuckets(base.Resolution);
					RenderSeries(animate: false);
				}
				break;
			case "HighMemberPath":
				if (base.FastItemsSource != null)
				{
					DeRegisterColumn(base.FastItemsSource, HighColumn);
					HighColumn = RegisterColumn(base.FastItemsSource, HighMemberPath, "HighColumn");
				}
				break;
			case "HighColumn":
				if (YAxis != null && !YAxis.UpdateRange() && !_ignoreColumnChanges)
				{
					FinancialView.BucketCalculator.CalculateBuckets(base.Resolution);
					RenderSeries(animate: false);
				}
				break;
			case "LowMemberPath":
				if (base.FastItemsSource != null)
				{
					DeRegisterColumn(base.FastItemsSource, LowColumn);
					LowColumn = RegisterColumn(base.FastItemsSource, LowMemberPath, "LowColumn");
				}
				break;
			case "LowColumn":
				if (YAxis != null && !YAxis.UpdateRange() && !_ignoreColumnChanges)
				{
					FinancialView.BucketCalculator.CalculateBuckets(base.Resolution);
					RenderSeries(animate: false);
				}
				break;
			case "CloseMemberPath":
				if (base.FastItemsSource != null)
				{
					DeRegisterColumn(base.FastItemsSource, CloseColumn);
					CloseColumn = RegisterColumn(base.FastItemsSource, CloseMemberPath, "CloseColumn");
				}
				break;
			case "CloseColumn":
				if (YAxis != null && !YAxis.UpdateRange() && !_ignoreColumnChanges)
				{
					FinancialView.BucketCalculator.CalculateBuckets(base.Resolution);
					RenderSeries(animate: false);
				}
				UpdateFinalValue();
				break;
			case "VolumeMemberPath":
				if (base.FastItemsSource != null)
				{
					DeRegisterColumn(base.FastItemsSource, VolumeColumn);
					VolumeColumn = RegisterColumn(base.FastItemsSource, VolumeMemberPath, "VolumeColumn");
				}
				break;
			case "VolumeColumn":
				if (YAxis != null && !YAxis.UpdateRange() && !_ignoreColumnChanges)
				{
					FinancialView.BucketCalculator.CalculateBuckets(base.Resolution);
					RenderSeries(animate: false);
				}
				break;
			case "XAxis":
				if (oldValue != null)
				{
					((Axis)oldValue).DeregisterSeries(this);
				}
				if (newValue != null)
				{
					((Axis)newValue).RegisterSeries(this);
				}
				FinancialView.BucketCalculator.CalculateBuckets(base.Resolution);
				RenderSeries(animate: false);
				NotifyThumbnailAppearanceChanged();
				TimeXAxis = XAxis as ITimeRangeSelectorAxis;
				break;
			case "YAxis":
				if (oldValue != null)
				{
					((Axis)oldValue).DeregisterSeries(this);
				}
				if (newValue != null)
				{
					((Axis)newValue).RegisterSeries(this);
				}
				FinancialView.BucketCalculator.CalculateBuckets(base.Resolution);
				if (YAxis != null)
				{
					YAxis.UpdateRange();
				}
				RenderSeries(animate: false);
				NotifyThumbnailAppearanceChanged();
				break;
			case "TransitionProgress":
				TransitionFrame.Interpolate((float)base.TransitionProgress, PreviousFrame, CurrentFrame);
				if (ClearAndAbortIfInvalid(base.View))
				{
					break;
				}
				if (base.TransitionProgress == 1.0)
				{
					CurrentFrame.ClearSpeedModifiers();
					RenderFrame(CurrentFrame, FinancialView);
					if (base.TransitionInIsInProgress)
					{
						base.TransitionInIsInProgress = false;
						ClearSpeedModifiers();
						base.Animator.IntervalMilliseconds = (int)GetTotalMilliseconds();
						base.Animator.EasingFunction = base.TransitionEasingFunction;
					}
				}
				else
				{
					RenderFrame(TransitionFrame, FinancialView);
				}
				if (base.SeriesViewer != null)
				{
					base.SeriesViewer.RaiseSeriesAnimating(this);
				}
				break;
			case "NegativeBrush":
				RenderSeries(animate: false);
				break;
			case "IsCustomCategoryStyleAllowed":
				ActualIsCustomCategoryStyleAllowed = GetIsCustomCategoryStyleAllowed();
				RenderSeries(animate: false);
				break;
			case "CategoryMode":
				if (XAxis != null)
				{
					XAxis.Spread(propagate: true);
				}
				break;
			}
		}

		[XamSuppressWidgetMember]
		[UwpSuppressWidgetMember]
		public bool CanUseAsYAxis(object axis)
		{
			if (axis is NumericYAxis)
			{
				return true;
			}
			return false;
		}

		[XamSuppressWidgetMember]
		[UwpSuppressWidgetMember]
		public bool CanUseAsXAxis(object axis)
		{
			if (axis is CategoryXAxis || ((Axis)axis).IsDateTime)
			{
				return true;
			}
			return false;
		}

		protected object[] GetCategoryItemsHelper(int orderedStartIndex, int orderedEndIndex, Axis axis)
		{
			if (orderedEndIndex < orderedStartIndex || orderedStartIndex < 0 || orderedStartIndex > base.FastItemsSource.Count || orderedEndIndex < 0 || orderedEndIndex > base.FastItemsSource.Count || axis == null)
			{
				return null;
			}
			object[] array = new object[orderedEndIndex - orderedStartIndex + 1];
			bool isSorting = axis.IsSorting;
			List<int> list = null;
			if (isSorting)
			{
				list = ((ISortingAxis)axis).SortedIndices;
			}
			for (int i = orderedStartIndex; i <= orderedEndIndex; i++)
			{
				int index = i;
				if (isSorting)
				{
					index = list[index];
				}
				array[i - orderedStartIndex] = base.FastItemsSource[i];
			}
			return array;
		}

		protected internal override void ClearHighlights()
		{
			base.ClearHighlights();
			PrevHighlightingInfo = null;
		}

		protected internal override HighlightingInfo GetHighlightingInfo(object item, Point world, bool forceFullRange)
		{
			if (HasIndividualElements && IsSpecificHighlightingMode(base.ActualHighlightingMode) && !forceFullRange)
			{
				return PrevHighlightingInfo = GetSpecificHighlightingInfo(item, world, PrevHighlightingInfo);
			}
			return PrevHighlightingInfo = GetFullSeriesInfo(item, world, PrevHighlightingInfo);
		}

		internal virtual int GetSortingCategoryBucketIndex(Point world)
		{
			CategoryFrame activeFrame = GetActiveFrame();
			Rect viewport = base.View.Viewport;
			Rect windowRect = base.View.WindowRect;
			CategoryAxisBase xAxis = XAxis;
			double num = 0.0;
			num = ((!xAxis.IsVertical) ? ((world.X - windowRect.Left) / windowRect.Width * viewport.Width + viewport.Left) : ((world.Y - windowRect.Top) / windowRect.Height * viewport.Height + viewport.Top));
			int count = activeFrame.Buckets.Count;
			int num2 = 0;
			for (num2 = 0; num2 < count; num2++)
			{
				double[] array = activeFrame.Buckets[num2];
				double[] array2 = null;
				if (num2 < count - 1)
				{
					array2 = activeFrame.Buckets[num2 + 1];
				}
				if ((!(array[0] <= num) || array2 != null) && !(array2[0] >= num))
				{
					continue;
				}
				if (array2 != null)
				{
					if (Math.Abs(array[0] - num) < Math.Abs(array2[0] - num))
					{
						return num2;
					}
					return num2 + 1;
				}
				return num2;
			}
			return num2;
		}

		protected HighlightingInfo GetSpecificHighlightingInfo(object item, Point world, HighlightingInfo prevValue)
		{
			_ = base.FastItemsSource.Count;
			_ = FinancialView.BucketCalculator.FirstBucket;
			_ = FinancialView.BucketCalculator.LastBucket;
			int bucketSize = FinancialView.BucketCalculator.BucketSize;
			CategoryAxisBase xAxis = XAxis;
			int num = -1;
			int num2 = -1;
			if (xAxis.IsSorting)
			{
				GetActiveFrame();
				num2 = (num = GetSortingCategoryBucketIndex(world));
			}
			else
			{
				num = (int)Math.Floor((double)(GetItemIndex(world) / bucketSize)) * bucketSize;
				num2 = num + (bucketSize - 1);
			}
			if (prevValue != null && prevValue.StartIndex == num && prevValue.EndIndex == num2)
			{
				return prevValue;
			}
			return new HighlightingInfo
			{
				Series = this,
				StartIndex = num,
				EndIndex = num2
			};
		}

		protected HighlightingInfo GetFullSeriesInfo(object item, Point world, HighlightingInfo prevValue)
		{
			HighlightingInfo highlightingInfo = new HighlightingInfo();
			highlightingInfo.Series = this;
			highlightingInfo.StartIndex = 0;
			highlightingInfo.EndIndex = base.FastItemsSource.Count - 1;
			highlightingInfo.IsFullRange = true;
			if (prevValue != null && prevValue.StartIndex == highlightingInfo.StartIndex && prevValue.EndIndex == highlightingInfo.EndIndex)
			{
				return prevValue;
			}
			return highlightingInfo;
		}

		protected virtual bool GetIsCustomCategoryStyleAllowed()

			return IsCustomCategoryStyleAllowed;
		}

		public override double GetExactItemIndex(Point world)
		{
			Rect windowRect = base.View.WindowRect;
			Rect viewport = base.View.Viewport;
			double result = -1.0;
			if (!windowRect.IsEmpty && !viewport.IsEmpty && XAxis != null)
			{
				Rect effectiveViewport = GetEffectiveViewport(base.View);
				ScalerParams p = new ScalerParams(windowRect, viewport, XAxis.IsInverted, effectiveViewport);
				Rect contentViewport = GetContentViewport(base.View);
				double unscaledValue = XAxis.GetUnscaledValue(contentViewport.Left, p);
				double unscaledValue2 = XAxis.GetUnscaledValue(contentViewport.Right, p);
				double num = (world.X - windowRect.Left) / windowRect.Width;
				double num2 = unscaledValue + num * (unscaledValue2 - unscaledValue);
				if (XAxis.CategoryMode != CategoryMode.Mode0)
				{
					num2 -= 0.5;
				}
				result = num2;
			}
			return result;
		}

		public override int GetItemIndex(Point world)
		{
			return (int)Math.Round(GetExactItemIndex(world));
		}

		protected internal override CategoryAxisBase GetCategoryAxisIfPresent()
		{
			return XAxis;
		}

		protected internal override int GetItemIndexSorted(Point world)
		{
			Rect windowRect = base.View.WindowRect;
			Rect viewport = base.View.Viewport;
			Rect effectiveViewport = GetEffectiveViewport(base.View);
			if (windowRect.IsEmpty || viewport.IsEmpty)
			{
				return -1;
			}
			new Rect(0.0, 0.0, 1.0, 1.0);
			ScalerParams p = new ScalerParams(windowRect, viewport, XAxis.IsInverted, effectiveViewport);
			ISortingAxis sortingAxis = XAxis as ISortingAxis;
			Rect contentViewport = GetContentViewport(base.View);
			double left = contentViewport.Left;
			double right = contentViewport.Right;
			double x = FromWorldPosition(world).X;
			double unscaledValue = XAxis.GetUnscaledValue(x, p);
			double unscaledValue2 = XAxis.GetUnscaledValue(left, p);
			double unscaledValue3 = XAxis.GetUnscaledValue(right, p);
			unscaledValue = Math.Max(unscaledValue2, Math.Min(unscaledValue3, unscaledValue));
			if ((long)unscaledValue <= DateTime.MinValue.Ticks || (long)unscaledValue >= DateTime.MaxValue.Ticks)
			{
				return -1;
			}
			return sortingAxis.GetIndexClosestToUnscaledValue(unscaledValue);
		}

		public override object GetItem(Point world)
		{
			int num = 0;
			if (XAxis is ISortingAxis)
			{
				num = GetItemIndexSorted(world);
				if (num == -1)
				{
					return null;
				}
			}
			else
			{
				num = GetItemIndex(world);
			}
			if (num < 0 || base.FastItemsSource == null || num >= base.FastItemsSource.Count)
			{
				return null;
			}
			return base.FastItemsSource[num];
		}

		internal CategoryFrame GetActiveFrame()
		{
			CategoryFrame result = CurrentFrame;
			if (AnimationActive())
			{
				if (base.Animator.NeedsFlush)
				{
					base.Animator.Flush();
				}
				result = TransitionFrame;
			}
			return result;
		}

			{
				return 0.0;
			}
			return XAxis.GetOffset(windowRect, viewportRect, effectiveViewportRect, base.Index);
		}

		protected internal override bool ValidateSeries(Rect viewportRect, Rect windowRect, SeriesView view)
		{
			bool result = base.ValidateSeries(viewportRect, windowRect, view);
			FinancialSeriesView financialSeriesView = (FinancialSeriesView)view;
			if (base.FastItemsSource == null || base.FastItemsSource.Count == 0 || !view.HasSurface() || windowRect.IsEmpty || viewportRect.IsEmpty || XAxis == null || YAxis == null || financialSeriesView.BucketCalculator.BucketSize < 1 || XAxis.SeriesViewer == null || YAxis.SeriesViewer == null || YAxis.ActualMinimumValue == YAxis.ActualMaximumValue || XAxis.ItemsSource == null || XAxis.CachedItemsCount < 1)
			{
				financialSeriesView.BucketCalculator.BucketSize = 0;
				result = false;
			}
			return result;
		}

			viewportRect = base.View.Viewport;
		}

		internal virtual double GetWorldZeroValue(FinancialSeriesView view)
		{
			double result = 0.0;
			Rect windowRect = view.WindowRect;
			Rect viewport = view.Viewport;
			Rect effectiveViewport = GetEffectiveViewport(base.View);
			if (!windowRect.IsEmpty && !viewport.IsEmpty && YAxis != null)
			{
				ScalerParams scalerParams = new ScalerParams(windowRect, viewport, YAxis.IsInverted, effectiveViewport);
				scalerParams.ReferenceValue = GetReferenceValue();
				result = YAxis.GetScaledValue(YAxis.ReferenceValue, scalerParams);
			}
			return result;
		}

		protected override void ClearSpeedModifiers()
		{
			base.ClearSpeedModifiers();
			PreviousFrame.ClearSpeedModifiers();
			CurrentFrame.ClearSpeedModifiers();
			TransitionFrame.ClearSpeedModifiers();
		}

		protected internal override void RenderSeriesOverride(bool animate)
		{
			base.RenderSeriesOverride(animate);
			FinancialView.BucketCalculator.CalculateBuckets(base.Resolution);
			if (ClearAndAbortIfInvalid(base.View))
			{
				return;
			}
			if (base.SkipPrepare)
			{
				if (AnimationActive())
				{
					RenderFrame(TransitionFrame, FinancialView);
				}
				else
				{
					RenderFrame(CurrentFrame, FinancialView);
				}
			}
			else if (ShouldAnimate(animate))
			{
				CategoryFrame previousFrame = PreviousFrame;
				if (AnimationActive())
				{
					if (base.Animator.NeedsFlush)
					{
						base.Animator.Flush();
					}
					PreviousFrame = TransitionFrame;
					TransitionFrame = previousFrame;
				}
				else
				{
					PreviousFrame = CurrentFrame;
					CurrentFrame = previousFrame;
				}
				PrepareFrame(CurrentFrame, FinancialView);
				if (base.TransitionInViableResolved)
				{
					base.Animator.Stop();
					base.Animator.IntervalMilliseconds = (int)GetTotalTransitionInMilliseconds();
					base.Animator.EasingFunction = ((base.TransitionInEasingFunction != null) ? base.TransitionInEasingFunction : base.TransitionEasingFunction);
					SourceFramePreparer.PrepareSourceFrame(PreviousFrame, CurrentFrame, IsVertical, XAxis, YAxis, TransitionInMode, GetDefaultTransitionInMode(), base.TransitionInSpeedType, GetDefaultTransitionInSpeedType(), () => GetWorldZeroValue(FinancialView), FinancialView.Viewport);
				}
				CheckTransitionInterrupted();
				StartAnimation();
				if (base.TransitionInViableResolved)
				{
					base.TransitionInViable = false;
					base.TransitionInIsInProgress = true;
				}
			}
			else
			{
				PrepareFrame(CurrentFrame, FinancialView);
				RenderFrame(CurrentFrame, FinancialView);
			}
		}

		protected bool ValidateBasedOn(IList<string> basedOn)
		{
			using (IEnumerator<string> enumerator = basedOn.GetEnumerator())
			{
				while (enumerator.MoveNext())
				{
					switch (enumerator.Current)
					{
					case "HighColumn":
						if (HighColumn == null)
						{
							return false;
						}
						break;
					case "LowColumn":
						if (LowColumn == null)
						{
							return false;
						}
						break;
					case "OpenColumn":
						if (OpenColumn == null)
						{
							return false;
						}
						break;
					case "CloseColumn":
						if (CloseColumn == null)
						{
							return false;
						}
						break;
					case "VolumeColumn":
						if (VolumeColumn == null)
						{
							return false;
						}
						break;
					}
				}
			}
			return true;
		}

		protected bool HasTypical()
		{
			return this.Typical != null;
		}

		protected void CallTypical(FinancialEventArgs args)
		{
			this.Typical(this, args);
		}

		[CatchesAll]
		private IEnumerable<double> CalculateTypicalColumn()
		{
			bool userSpecified = false;
			if (HasTypical())
			{
				FinancialCalculationDataSource financialCalculationDataSource = ProvideDataSource(0, FastItemsSource.Count);
				CallTypical(new FinancialEventArgs(0, FastItemsSource.Count, financialCalculationDataSource, ProvideSupportingCalculations(financialCalculationDataSource)));
				if (financialCalculationDataSource.TypicalColumn != null)
				{
					userSpecified = true;
					foreach (double item in financialCalculationDataSource.TypicalColumn)
					{
						yield return item;
					}
				}
			}
			if (userSpecified)
			{
				yield break;
			}
			if (XAxisSortRequired && ((ISortingAxis)XAxis).SortedIndices != null)
			{
				int count = FastItemsSource.Count;
				IList<int> sorted = ((ISortingAxis)XAxis).SortedIndices;
				int i = 0;
				while (i < count)
				{
					yield return (HighColumn[sorted[i]] + LowColumn[sorted[i]] + CloseColumn[sorted[i]]) / 3.0;
					int num = i + 1;
					i = num;
				}
			}
			else
			{
				int count2 = FastItemsSource.Count;
				int i2 = 0;
				while (i2 < count2)
				{
					yield return (HighColumn[i2] + LowColumn[i2] + CloseColumn[i2]) / 3.0;
					int num = i2 + 1;
					i2 = num;
				}
			}
		}

		private IEnumerable<double> CalculateTR()
		{
			if (XAxisSortRequired && ((ISortingAxis)XAxis).SortedIndices != null)
			{
				int count = HighColumn.Count;
				IList<int> sorted = ((ISortingAxis)XAxis).SortedIndices;
				if (count > 0)
				{
					yield return MakeSafe(HighColumn[sorted[0]] - LowColumn[sorted[0]]);
				}
				int i = 1;
				while (i < count)
				{
					yield return Math.Max(MakeSafe(HighColumn[sorted[i]] - LowColumn[sorted[i]]), Math.Max(MakeSafe(Math.Abs(HighColumn[sorted[i]] - CloseColumn[sorted[i - 1]])), MakeSafe(Math.Abs(LowColumn[sorted[i]] - CloseColumn[sorted[i - 1]]))));
					int num = i + 1;
					i = num;
				}
			}
			else
			{
				int count2 = HighColumn.Count;
				if (count2 > 0)
				{
					yield return MakeSafe(HighColumn[0] - LowColumn[0]);
				}
				int i2 = 1;
				while (i2 < count2)
				{
					yield return Math.Max(MakeSafe(HighColumn[i2] - LowColumn[i2]), Math.Max(MakeSafe(Math.Abs(HighColumn[i2] - CloseColumn[i2 - 1])), MakeSafe(Math.Abs(LowColumn[i2] - CloseColumn[i2 - 1]))));
					int num = i2 + 1;
					i2 = num;
				}
			}
		}

		private IEnumerable<double> CalculateTL()
		{
			if (XAxisSortRequired && ((ISortingAxis)XAxis).SortedIndices != null)
			{
				int count = LowColumn.Count;
				IList<int> sorted = ((ISortingAxis)XAxis).SortedIndices;
				if (count > 0)
				{
					yield return MakeSafe(LowColumn[sorted[0]]);
				}
				for (int i = 1; i < count; i++)
				{
					yield return Math.Min(MakeSafe(LowColumn[sorted[i]]), MakeSafe(CloseColumn[sorted[i - 1]]));
				}
			}
			else
			{
				int count2 = LowColumn.Count;
				if (count2 > 0)
				{
					yield return MakeSafe(LowColumn[0]);
				}
				for (int j = 1; j < count2; j++)
				{
					yield return Math.Min(MakeSafe(LowColumn[j]), MakeSafe(CloseColumn[j - 1]));
				}
			}
		}

		internal IList<double> MakeReadOnlyAndEnsureSorted(IList<double> column)
		{
			if (column == null)
			{
				return null;
			}
			if (XAxisSortRequired && ((ISortingAxis)XAxis).SortedIndices != null)
			{
				return new SafeSortedReadOnlyDoubleCollection(column, ((ISortingAxis)XAxis).SortedIndices);
			}
			return new SafeReadOnlyDoubleCollection(column);
		}

		protected IList<string> GetTypicalBasedOn()
		{
			IList<string> list = new List<string>();
			list.Add("HighColumn");
			list.Add("LowColumn");
			list.Add("CloseColumn");
			if (this.TypicalBasedOn != null && base.FastItemsSource != null && !_dontRenderTypical)
			{
				_dontRenderTypical = true;
				FinancialCalculationDataSource dataSource = ProvideDataSource(0, base.FastItemsSource.Count);
				_dontRenderTypical = false;
				FinancialEventArgs e = new FinancialEventArgs(0, base.FastItemsSource.Count, dataSource, ProvideSupportingCalculations(dataSource));
				this.TypicalBasedOn(this, e);
				if (e.BasedOn != null && e.BasedOn.Count > 0)
				{
					return e.BasedOn;
				}
			}
			return list;
		}

		protected override void DataUpdatedOverride(FastItemsSourceEventAction action, int position, int count, string propertyName)
		{
			base.DataUpdatedOverride(action, position, count, propertyName);
			UpdateFinalValue();
			UpdatePercentChange();
		}

		protected virtual FinancialCalculationDataSource ProvideDataSource(int position, int count)
		{
			IList<double> openColumn = MakeReadOnlyAndEnsureSorted(OpenColumn);
			IList<double> closeColumn = MakeReadOnlyAndEnsureSorted(CloseColumn);
			IList<double> highColumn = MakeReadOnlyAndEnsureSorted(HighColumn);
			IList<double> lowColumn = MakeReadOnlyAndEnsureSorted(LowColumn);
			IList<double> volumeColumn = MakeReadOnlyAndEnsureSorted(VolumeColumn);
			return new FinancialCalculationDataSource
			{
				TypicalColumn = new CalculatedColumn(new SafeEnumerable(TypicalColumn), GetTypicalBasedOn()),
				TrueRange = new CalculatedColumn(new SafeEnumerable(TR), new List<string> { "HighColumn", "LowColumn", "CloseColumn" }),
				TrueLow = new CalculatedColumn(new SafeEnumerable(TL), new List<string> { "LowColumn", "CloseColumn" }),
				OpenColumn = openColumn,
				CloseColumn = closeColumn,
				HighColumn = highColumn,
				LowColumn = lowColumn,
				VolumeColumn = volumeColumn,
				CalculateFrom = position,
				CalculateCount = count,
				MinimumValue = double.NaN,
				MaximumValue = double.NaN,
				Count = ((base.FastItemsSource != null) ? base.FastItemsSource.Count : 0)
			};
		}

		internal double MakeSafe(double value)
		{
			if (double.IsInfinity(value) || double.IsNaN(value))
			{
				return 0.0;
			}
			return value;
		}

		protected virtual FinancialCalculationSupportingCalculations ProvideSupportingCalculations(FinancialCalculationDataSource dataSource)
		{
			return new FinancialCalculationSupportingCalculations
			{
				EMA = new ColumnSupportingCalculation(TrendCalculators.EMA, new List<string>()),
				SMA = new ColumnSupportingCalculation(TrendCalculators.SMA, new List<string>()),
				STDEV = new ColumnSupportingCalculation(TrendCalculators.STDEV, new List<string>()),
				MovingSum = new ColumnSupportingCalculation(TrendCalculators.MovingSum, new List<string>()),
				ShortVolumeOscillatorAverage = new DataSourceSupportingCalculation((FinancialCalculationDataSource ds1) => TrendCalculators.EMA(ds1.VolumeColumn, ds1.ShortPeriod), new List<string> { "VolumeColumn" }),
				LongVolumeOscillatorAverage = new DataSourceSupportingCalculation((FinancialCalculationDataSource ds2) => TrendCalculators.EMA(ds2.VolumeColumn, ds2.LongPeriod), new List<string> { "VolumeColumn" }),
				ShortPriceOscillatorAverage = new DataSourceSupportingCalculation((FinancialCalculationDataSource ds3) => TrendCalculators.EMA(ds3.TypicalColumn, ds3.ShortPeriod), dataSource.TypicalColumn.BasedOn),
				LongPriceOscillatorAverage = new DataSourceSupportingCalculation((FinancialCalculationDataSource ds4) => TrendCalculators.EMA(ds4.TypicalColumn, ds4.LongPeriod), dataSource.TypicalColumn.BasedOn),
				ToEnumerableRange = Series.ToEnumerableRange,
				ToEnumerable = Series.ToEnumerable,
				MakeSafe = MakeSafe
			};
		}

		protected internal override void RenderThumbnail(Rect viewportRect, RenderSurface surface)
		{
			base.RenderThumbnail(viewportRect, surface);
			if (!base.ThumbnailDirty)
			{
				base.View.PrepSurface(surface);
				return;
			}
			FinancialSeriesView financialSeriesView = base.ThumbnailView as FinancialSeriesView;
			base.View.PrepSurface(surface);
			financialSeriesView.BucketCalculator.CalculateBuckets(base.Resolution);
			if (!ClearAndAbortIfInvalid(base.ThumbnailView))
			{
				if (!base.SkipThumbnailPrepare)
				{
					PrepareFrame(ThumbnailFrame, financialSeriesView);
				}
				base.SkipThumbnailPrepare = false;
				RenderFrame(ThumbnailFrame, financialSeriesView);
				base.ThumbnailDirty = false;
			}
		}

		public override void RenderAlternateView(Rect viewportRect, Rect windowRect, RenderSurface surface, string viewIdentifier, double effectiveScalingRatio)
		{
			base.RenderAlternateView(viewportRect, windowRect, surface, viewIdentifier, effectiveScalingRatio);
			SeriesView seriesView = base.SeriesInteractionManager.AlternateViews[viewIdentifier];
			FinancialSeriesView financialSeriesView = (FinancialSeriesView)seriesView;
			financialSeriesView.BucketCalculator.CalculateBuckets(base.Resolution);
			seriesView.PrepAltSurface(surface);
			if (!ClearAndAbortIfInvalid(financialSeriesView))
			{
				if (AlternateFrame == null)
				{
					AlternateFrame = new CategoryFrame(3);
				}
				AlternateFrame.ClearFrame();
				PrepareFrame(AlternateFrame, financialSeriesView);
				RenderFrame(AlternateFrame, financialSeriesView);
			}
		}

		protected internal override Axis GetMatchingAxis(Axis axis)
		{
			if (XAxis == axis)
			{
				return YAxis;
			}
			if (YAxis == axis)
			{
				return XAxis;
			}
			return null;
		}

		internal override DataContext GetTooltipContext(object item)
		{
			if (item != null)
			{
				Type type = item.GetType();
				FastReflectionHelper fastReflectionHelper = new FastReflectionHelper(useTraditionalReflection: false, HighMemberPath);
				object propertyValue = fastReflectionHelper.GetPropertyValue(type, item);
				fastReflectionHelper.PropertyName = OpenMemberPath;
				object propertyValue2 = fastReflectionHelper.GetPropertyValue(type, item);
				fastReflectionHelper.PropertyName = LowMemberPath;
				object propertyValue3 = fastReflectionHelper.GetPropertyValue(type, item);
				fastReflectionHelper.PropertyName = CloseMemberPath;
				object propertyValue4 = fastReflectionHelper.GetPropertyValue(type, item);
				object itemVolume = null;
				if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(VolumeMemberPath))
				{
					fastReflectionHelper.PropertyName = VolumeMemberPath;
					itemVolume = fastReflectionHelper.GetPropertyValue(type, item);
				}
				FinancialSeriesDataContext financialSeriesDataContext = new FinancialSeriesDataContext
				{
					Series = this,
					Item = item,
					ItemHigh = propertyValue,
					ItemLow = propertyValue3,
					ItemOpen = propertyValue2,
					ItemClose = propertyValue4,
					ItemVolume = itemVolume,
					YAxisLabel = YAxis.GetLabel(item)
				};
				CategoryAxisBase xAxis = XAxis;
				if (xAxis != null)
				{
					if (!(xAxis is CategoryDateTimeXAxis categoryDateTimeXAxis))
					{
						financialSeriesDataContext.XAxisLabel = xAxis.GetLabel(item);
					}
					else
					{
						fastReflectionHelper.PropertyName = categoryDateTimeXAxis.DateTimeMemberPath;
						object propertyValue5 = fastReflectionHelper.GetPropertyValue(item.GetType(), item);
						financialSeriesDataContext.XAxisLabel = $"{propertyValue5:D}";
					}
				}
				return financialSeriesDataContext;
			}
			return new DataContext
			{
				Series = this,
				Item = item
			};
		}

		CategoryMode IHasCategoryModePreference.PreferredCategoryMode(CategoryAxisBase axis)
		{
			if (!(XAxis is IDateTimeAxis dateTimeAxis))
			{
				return CategoryMode;
			}
			return dateTimeAxis.PreferredCategoryMode(this);
		}

		public override void SetNegativeColors(Brush negativeBrush, Brush negativeOutline)
		{
			base.SetNegativeColors(negativeBrush, negativeOutline);
			NegativeBrush = negativeBrush;
		}

		private void UpdateFinalValue()
		{
			base.FinalValue = ((CloseColumn == null || CloseColumn.Count == 0) ? double.NaN : CloseColumn[CloseColumn.Count - 1]);
		}

		protected internal override object GetItemLabel(object dataItem)
		{
			if (TimeXAxis != null && dataItem != null)
			{
				if (ItemTimeGetter == null || ItemTimeGetter.PropertyName != TimeXAxis.DateTimeMemberPath)
				{
					ItemTimeGetter = new FastReflectionHelper(useTraditionalReflection: false, TimeXAxis.DateTimeMemberPath);
				}
				if (ItemTimeGetter.GetPropertyValue(dataItem) is DateTime dateTime)
				{
					return dateTime.ToString(TimeXAxis.ItemLabelFormat());
				}
			}
			return base.GetItemLabel(dataItem);
		}
	}

	[WFWidget("UltraItemLegend", IsLicensed = true)]
	public class ItemLegend : LegendBase, IChartItemLegend, IChartLegend
	{
		public static readonly DependencyProperty OrientationProperty = DependencyProperty.Register("Orientation", typeof(Orientation), typeof(ItemLegend), new PropertyMetadata(Orientation.Vertical, delegate(DependencyObject sender, DependencyPropertyChangedEventArgs e)
		{
			((ItemLegend)sender).RaisePropertyChanged("Orientation", e.OldValue, e.NewValue);
		}));

		internal const string OrientationPropertyName = "Orientation";

		internal ItemLegendView ItemView { get; set; }

		public override bool IsItemwise => true;

		internal IFastItemColumn<double> FillColumn { get; set; }

		public Orientation Orientation
		{
			get
			{
				return (Orientation)GetValue(OrientationProperty);
			}
			set
			{
				SetValue(OrientationProperty, value);
			}
		}

		internal override LegendBaseView CreateView()
		{
			return new ItemLegendView(this);
		}

		internal override void OnViewCreated(LegendBaseView view)
		{
			base.OnViewCreated(view);
			ItemView = (ItemLegendView)view;
		}

		public ItemLegend()
		{
			base.DefaultStyleKey = typeof(ItemLegend);
			base.Children.CollectionChanged += delegate(object o, NotifyCollectionChangedEventArgs e)
			{
				if (e.OldItems != null)
				{
					foreach (object oldItem in e.OldItems)
					{
						ItemView.RemoveItemVisual(oldItem);
					}
				}
				if (e.NewItems != null)
				{
					foreach (object newItem in e.NewItems)
					{
						ItemView.AddItemVisual(newItem);
					}
				}
			};
		}

		protected internal override void AddChildInOrder(UIElement legendItem, ILegendSeries series)
		{
			if (base.View.Ready())
			{
				RenderLegend(series);
			}
		}

		void IChartItemLegend.CreateItemwiseLegendItems(List<UIElement> legendItems, ILegendSeries series)
		{
			CreateItemwiseLegendItemsInternal(legendItems, series);
		}

		protected internal override void CreateItemwiseLegendItemsInternal(List<UIElement> legendItems, ILegendSeries itemsHost)
		{
			base.View.NotifyBeginUpdate();
			ClearLegendItemsForSeries(itemsHost);
			if (itemsHost == null || legendItems == null || legendItems.Count == 0)
			{
				return;
			}
			foreach (UIElement legendItem in legendItems)
			{
				if (legendItem is ContentControl { Content: not null, Content: ILegendContext content } && !ContainsContext(content))
				{
					base.Children.Add(legendItem);
					new LegendItemInfo
					{
						DataContext = content,
						LegendItem = legendItem,
						Series = itemsHost,
						Text = (string)content.ItemLabel
					};
				}
			}
			base.View.NotifyEndUpate();
		}

		void IChartItemLegend.CreateLegendItemsInsert(List<UIElement> legendItems, ILegendSeries itemsHost)
		{
			CreateLegendItemsInsertInternal(legendItems, itemsHost);
		}

		protected internal void CreateLegendItemsInsertInternal(List<UIElement> legendItems, ILegendSeries itemsHost)
		{
			base.View.NotifyBeginUpdate();
			try
			{
				int num = ClearLegendItemsAndReturnInsertIndex(itemsHost);
				if (itemsHost == null || legendItems == null || legendItems.Count == 0)
				{
					return;
				}
				foreach (UIElement legendItem in legendItems)
				{
					if (legendItem is ContentControl { Content: not null, Content: ILegendContext content } && !ContainsContext(content))
					{
						base.Children.Insert(num, legendItem);
						num++;
						new LegendItemInfo
						{
							DataContext = content,
							LegendItem = legendItem,
							Series = itemsHost,
							Text = ((content.LegendLabel != null) ? content.LegendLabel.ToString() : ((string)content.ItemLabel))
						};
					}
				}
			}
			finally
			{
				base.View.NotifyEndUpate();
			}
		}

		void IChartItemLegend.RenderItemwiseContent(ILegendSeries itemsHost)
		{
			RenderLegend(itemsHost);
		}

		internal void RenderLegend(ILegendSeries itemsHost)
		{
			ClearLegendItemsForSeries(itemsHost);
			if (!itemsHost.HasSubItems)
			{
				return;
			}
			itemsHost.ForSubItems(delegate(object legendItem)
			{
				if (legendItem is ContentControl { Content: not null, Content: ILegendContext content } && !ContainsContext(content))
				{
					base.Children.Add((UIElement)legendItem);
					new LegendItemInfo
					{
						DataContext = content,
						LegendItem = legendItem,
						Series = itemsHost,
						Text = (string)content.ItemLabel
					};
				}
			});
		}

		internal int ClearLegendItemsAndReturnInsertIndex(ILegendSeries itemsHost)
		{
			if (itemsHost == null || base.Children == null || base.Children.Count == 0)
			{
				return 0;
			}
			ObservableCollection<UIElement> observableCollection = new ObservableCollection<UIElement>();
			int num = -1;
			int num2 = 0;
			foreach (UIElement child in base.Children)
			{
				if (child is ContentControl { Content: not null, Content: ILegendContext content } && content.Series == itemsHost)
				{
					if (num == -1)
					{
						num = num2;
					}
					observableCollection.Add(child);
				}
				num2++;
			}
			foreach (UIElement item in observableCollection)
			{
				base.Children.Remove(item);
			}
			if (num == -1)
			{
				return base.Children.Count;
			}
			return num;
		}

		private bool ContainsContext(ILegendContext dataContext)
		{
			return ItemView.ContainsContext(dataContext);
		}
	}

	[WFWidget("UltraLegend", IsLicensed = true)]
	public sealed class Legend : LegendBase
	{
		public static readonly DependencyProperty OrientationProperty = DependencyProperty.Register("Orientation", typeof(Orientation), typeof(Legend), new PropertyMetadata(Orientation.Vertical, delegate(DependencyObject sender, DependencyPropertyChangedEventArgs e)
		{
			((Legend)sender).RaisePropertyChanged("Orientation", e.OldValue, e.NewValue);
		}));

		internal const string OrientationPropertyName = "Orientation";

		public static readonly DependencyProperty SortOrderProperty = DependencyProperty.RegisterAttached("SortOrder", typeof(int), typeof(Legend), new PropertyMetadata(-1, delegate(DependencyObject o, DependencyPropertyChangedEventArgs e)
		{
			if (o != null && o is XamDataChart)
			{
				((XamDataChart)o).OnLegendSortChanged();
			}
		}));

		[TSSuppressSynthesizedInitializer]
		internal LegendView LegendView { get; set; }

		public Orientation Orientation
		{
			get
			{
				return (Orientation)GetValue(OrientationProperty);
			}
			set
			{
				SetValue(OrientationProperty, value);
			}
		}

		internal override LegendBaseView CreateView()
		{
			return new LegendView(this);
		}

		internal override void OnViewCreated(LegendBaseView view)
		{
			base.OnViewCreated(view);
			LegendView = (LegendView)view;
		}

		public Legend()
		{
			base.DefaultStyleKey = typeof(Legend);
			base.Children.CollectionChanged += delegate(object o, NotifyCollectionChangedEventArgs e)
			{
				if (e.OldItems != null)
				{
					foreach (object oldItem in e.OldItems)
					{
						LegendView.RemoveItemVisual(oldItem);
					}
				}
				if (e.NewItems != null)
				{
					foreach (object newItem in e.NewItems)
					{
						LegendView.AddItemVisual(newItem);
					}
				}
			};
		}

		private int GetSeriesIndex(ILegendSeries series)
		{
			return series.ResolveLegendIndex();
		}

		private int ResolveSortOrder(object container)
		{
			return GetSortOrder(container as DependencyObject);
		}

		protected internal override void AddChildInOrder(UIElement legendItem, ILegendSeries series)
		{
			if (series.IsStacked || !series.IsUsableInLegend)
			{
				return;
			}
			int num = 0;
			foreach (UIElement child in base.Children)
			{
				base.View.FetchLegendEnvironment(child, out var chart, out var series2, out var _);
				if (series.Container != null && chart != null && (ResolveSortOrder(series.Container) < ResolveSortOrder(chart) || (ResolveSortOrder(series.Container) == -1 && ResolveSortOrder(chart) == -1 && series.Container.GetHashCode() < chart.GetHashCode())))
				{
					break;
				}
				if (series.Container != null && chart != null && series.Container == chart && series2 != null)
				{
					int seriesIndex = GetSeriesIndex(series);
					int seriesIndex2 = GetSeriesIndex(series2);
					int num2 = ResolveSortOrder(series);
					int num3 = ResolveSortOrder(series2);
					if (series2.IsVertical && !series2.IsStacked)
					{
						if (num3 == -1 && num2 == -1)
						{
							num = 0;
							break;
						}
						if (num2 < num3 || num3 == -1)
						{
							break;
						}
					}
					if (seriesIndex <= seriesIndex2)
					{
						break;
					}
				}
				num++;
			}
			base.Children.Insert(num, legendItem);
			LegendItemInfo legendItemInfo = new LegendItemInfo();
			legendItemInfo.LegendItem = legendItem;
			legendItemInfo.Series = series;
			if (legendItem is ContentControl { Content: not null, Content: ILegendContext content })
			{
				legendItemInfo.DataContext = content;
				legendItemInfo.Text = (string)content.ItemLabel;
			}
		}

		protected override AutomationPeer OnCreateAutomationPeer()
		{
			return new LegendAutomationPeer(this);
		}

		public static void SetSortOrder(DependencyObject target, int sortOrder)
		{
			target.SetValue(SortOrderProperty, sortOrder);
		}

		public static int GetSortOrder(DependencyObject target)
		{
			return (int)target.GetValue(SortOrderProperty);
		}
	}

		[XamSuppressWidgetMember]
		[UwpSuppressWidgetMember]
		[TSSuppressWidgetMember]
		[SwiftSuppressWidgetMember]
		[JAVASuppressWidgetMember]
		public void ClearLegendItemsForSeries(ILegendSeries itemsHost)
		{
			if (itemsHost == null || Children == null || Children.Count == 0)
			{
				return;
			}
			ObservableCollection<UIElement> observableCollection = new ObservableCollection<UIElement>();
			foreach (UIElement child in Children)
			{
				if (child is ContentControl { Content: not null, Content: ILegendContext content } && content.Series == itemsHost)
				{
					observableCollection.Add(child);
				}
			}
			foreach (UIElement item in observableCollection)
			{
				Children.Remove(item);
			}
		}

		protected internal bool ContainsChild(UIElement child)
		{
			return Children.Contains(child);
		}

		[SwiftForceEmit]
		bool IChartLegend.ContainsChild(object child)
		{
			return ContainsChild((UIElement)child);
		}

		protected internal void RemoveChild(UIElement child)
		{
			Children.Remove(child);
		}

		[SwiftForceEmit]
		void IChartLegend.RemoveChild(object child)
		{
			RemoveChild((UIElement)child);
		}

		protected void RaisePropertyChanged(string name, object oldValue, object newValue)
		{
			if (this.PropertyChanged != null)
			{
				this.PropertyChanged(this, new PropertyChangedEventArgs(name));
			}
			if (this.PropertyUpdated != null)
			{
				this.PropertyUpdated(this, new PropertyUpdatedEventArgs(name, oldValue, newValue));
			}
		}

	public class FinancialLegend : LegendBase
	{
		private FinancialLegendView FinancialView => (FinancialLegendView)base.View;

		public override bool IsFinancial => true;

		internal override LegendBaseView CreateView()
		{
			return new FinancialLegendView(this);
		}

		public FinancialLegend()
		{
			base.DefaultStyleKey = typeof(FinancialLegend);
			base.Children.CollectionChanged += delegate(object o, NotifyCollectionChangedEventArgs e)
			{
				if (e.OldItems != null)
				{
					foreach (object oldItem in e.OldItems)
					{
						FinancialView.RemoveItemVisual(oldItem);
					}
				}
				if (e.NewItems != null)
				{
					foreach (object newItem in e.NewItems)
					{
						FinancialView.AddItemVisual(newItem);
					}
				}
			};
		}

		public override void OnApplyTemplate()
		{
			base.OnApplyTemplate();
			WrapPanel panel = FinancialView.Panel;
			WrapPanel wrapPanel = GetTemplateChild("panel") as WrapPanel;
			if (panel != null && wrapPanel != null && panel != wrapPanel)
			{
				for (int num = panel.Children.Count - 1; num > -1; num--)
				{
					UIElement element = panel.Children[num];
					panel.Children.RemoveAt(num);
					wrapPanel.Children.Insert(0, element);
				}
			}
			FinancialView.Panel = wrapPanel;
		}

		protected internal override void AddChildInOrder(UIElement legendItem, ILegendSeries series)
		{
			base.Children.Add(legendItem);
		}
	}

	[DontObfuscate]
	[WidgetModule("ScatterChart")]
	[WFWidget("UltraScaleLegend", IsLicensed = true)]
	public class ScaleLegend : LegendBase, IChartScaleLegend, IChartLegend
	{
		private IScaleLegendSeries _series;

		internal ScaleLegendView ScaleView { get; set; }

		[SuppressWidgetMember]
		public UIElement LegendScaleElement => ScaleView.LegendScaleElement;

		[SuppressWidgetMember]
		public TextBlock MinText => ScaleView.MinText;

		[SuppressWidgetMember]
		public TextBlock MaxText => ScaleView.MaxText;

		internal double MinimumValue { get; set; }

		internal double MaximumValue { get; set; }

		internal IScaleLegendSeries Series
		{
			get
			{
				return _series;
			}
			set
			{
				_series = value;
			}
		}

		public override bool IsScale => true;

		internal override LegendBaseView CreateView()
		{
			return new ScaleLegendView(this);
		}

		internal override void OnViewCreated(LegendBaseView view)
		{
			base.OnViewCreated(view);
			ScaleView = (ScaleLegendView)view;
		}

		public ScaleLegend()
		{
			base.DefaultStyleKey = typeof(ScaleLegend);
		}

		internal DependencyObject GetTemplateElement(string partName)
		{
			return GetTemplateChild(partName);
		}

		internal void RestoreOriginalStateInternal()
		{
			ScaleView.RestoreOriginalState();
		}

		void IChartScaleLegend.RestoreOriginalState()
		{
			RestoreOriginalStateInternal();
		}

		private Color GetFirstColor(Brush brush)
		{
			if (brush == null)
			{
				return ScaleView.GetTransparentBrush();
			}
			return ColorUtil.GetColor(brush);
		}

		internal void InitializeLegendInternal(IScaleLegendSeries series)
		{
			Series = series;
			RenderLegend();
		}

		void IChartScaleLegend.InitializeLegend(IScaleLegendSeries series)
		{
			InitializeLegendInternal(series);
		}

		internal void RenderLegend()
		{
			if (LegendScaleElement == null || Series == null || !Series.LegendReady || Series == null || !Series.IsAttachedTo(this))
			{
				return;
			}
			bool useSeriesBrush = false;
			if (LegendScaleElement is Shape legendScaleShapeElement)
			{
				object gradient = ScaleView.BuildGradient();
				if (!Series.ForScaleColors(delegate(Brush color, double colorOffset)
				{
					ScaleView.AddGradientStop(gradient, GetFirstColor(color), colorOffset);
				}))
				{
					useSeriesBrush = true;
				}
				ScaleView.SetScaleFill(legendScaleShapeElement, useSeriesBrush, gradient);
			}
			if (MinText != null)
			{
				MinText.Text = Series.MinScaleText;
			}
			if (MaxText != null)
			{
				MaxText.Text = Series.MaxScaleText;
			}
		}
	}
