	internal class PieLabel : ContentPresenter
	{
		[Weak]
		internal Slice Slice { get; set; }

		internal Rect Bounds { get; set; }

		internal double Angle { get; set; }

		internal object Label { get; set; }

		internal Line LeaderLine { get; set; }

		internal Path LeaderLinePath { get; set; }

		internal LabelsPosition ActualLabelPosition { get; set; }

		internal PieLabel()
		{
			base.SizeChanged += delegate(object o, SizeChangedEventArgs e)
			{
				if (e.NewSize.Width != 0.0 && e.NewSize.Height != 0.0 && Slice != null && Slice.Owner != null)
				{
					Slice.Owner.PrepareLabels();
					Slice.Owner.RenderLabels();
				}
			};
			base.MouseUp += delegate(object o, MouseButtonEventArgs e)
			{
				if (Slice != null && Slice.Owner != null)
				{
					LabelClickEventArgs e2 = new LabelClickEventArgs(Slice, e);
					Slice.Owner.OnLabelClick(Slice.Owner, e2);
					if (e2.AllowSliceClick)
					{
						Slice.Owner.SliceClicked(Slice, e, ActualLabelPosition == LabelsPosition.OutsideEnd);
					}
				}
			};
		}

		internal void CreateContent(PieChartBaseView view)
		{
			TextBlock textBlock = Label as TextBlock;
			if (textBlock != null && Slice != null)
			{
				textBlock.SetBinding(TextBlock.ForegroundProperty, new Binding("Foreground")
				{
					Source = Slice
				});
				textBlock.SetBinding(TextBlock.FontFamilyProperty, new Binding("FontFamily")
				{
					Source = Slice
				});
				textBlock.SetBinding(TextBlock.FontSizeProperty, new Binding("FontSize")
				{
					Source = Slice
				});
				textBlock.SetBinding(TextBlock.FontStretchProperty, new Binding("FontStretch")
				{
					Source = Slice
				});
				textBlock.SetBinding(TextBlock.FontStyleProperty, new Binding("FontStyle")
				{
					Source = Slice
				});
				textBlock.SetBinding(TextBlock.FontWeightProperty, new Binding("FontWeight")
				{
					Source = Slice
				});
				textBlock.TextTrimming = TextTrimming.WordEllipsis;
			}
			base.Content = textBlock;
		}

		internal void UpdateCascadingLeaderLineStroke()
		{
			Shape shape = ((Slice.Owner.LeaderLineType != LeaderLineType.Straight) ? ((Shape)LeaderLinePath) : ((Shape)LeaderLine));
			if (shape != null)
			{
				if (Slice.Owner.LeaderLineStroke != null)
				{
					shape.Stroke = Slice.Owner.LeaderLineStroke;
				}
				else if (shape.Style == null)
				{
					shape.SetBinding(Shape.StrokeProperty, new Binding("Background")
					{
						Source = Slice
					});
				}
				else
				{
					shape.ClearValue(Shape.StrokeProperty);
				}
			}
		}

		internal void UpdateLeaderLine()
		{
			LeaderLine.Visibility = ((Slice.Owner.LeaderLineVisibility != Visibility.Visible) ? Slice.Owner.LeaderLineVisibility : Slice.Label.Visibility);
			double leaderLineMargin = Slice.Owner.LeaderLineMargin;
			Point point = GeometryUtil.FindRadialPoint(Slice.GetSliceOrigin(), Angle, Slice.Radius);
			LeaderLine.X1 = point.X;
			LeaderLine.Y1 = point.Y;
			Point point2 = ((!(Angle < 90.0) && !(Angle >= 270.0)) ? new Point(Bounds.Right, (Bounds.Top + Bounds.Bottom) / 2.0) : new Point(Bounds.Left, (Bounds.Top + Bounds.Bottom) / 2.0));
			if (leaderLineMargin > 0.0)
			{
				double segmentLength = GeometryUtil.GetSegmentLength(point, point2);
				point2 = ((!(leaderLineMargin < segmentLength)) ? point : GeometryUtil.PointAtDistance(point2, point, leaderLineMargin));
			}
			LeaderLine.X2 = point2.X;
			LeaderLine.Y2 = point2.Y;
		}

		internal void UpdateLeaderLinePath()
		{
			LeaderLinePath.Visibility = ((Slice.Owner.LeaderLineVisibility != Visibility.Visible) ? Slice.Owner.LeaderLineVisibility : Slice.Label.Visibility);
			Point sliceOrigin = Slice.GetSliceOrigin();
			PathFigure pathFigure = ((PathGeometry)LeaderLinePath.Data).Figures[0];
			BezierSegment bezierSegment = (BezierSegment)pathFigure.Segments[0];
			double leaderLineMargin = Slice.Owner.LeaderLineMargin;
			double num = (Bounds.Top + Bounds.Bottom) / 2.0;
			Point point = GeometryUtil.FindRadialPoint(sliceOrigin, Angle, Slice.Radius);
			Point point2 = GeometryUtil.FindRadialPoint(sliceOrigin, Angle, Slice.Radius + Slice.Owner.LabelExtent / 2.0);
			double y = num;
			Point point3;
			Point point4;
			if (Angle < 90.0 && Angle >= 0.0)
			{
				point3 = new Point(Bounds.Left - 30.0, y);
				point4 = new Point(Bounds.Left, num);
			}
			else if (Angle < 180.0 && Angle >= 90.0)
			{
				point3 = new Point(Bounds.Right + 30.0, y);
				point4 = new Point(Bounds.Right, num);
			}
			else if (Angle < 270.0 && Angle >= 180.0)
			{
				point3 = new Point(Bounds.Right + 30.0, y);
				point4 = new Point(Bounds.Right, num);
			}
			else
			{
				point3 = new Point(Bounds.Left - 30.0, y);
				point4 = new Point(Bounds.Left, num);
			}
			Point point5;
			if (leaderLineMargin > 0.0)
			{
				double segmentLength = GeometryUtil.GetSegmentLength(point, point4);
				if (!(leaderLineMargin < segmentLength))
				{
					LeaderLinePath.Visibility = Visibility.Collapsed;
					return;
				}
				point5 = GeometryUtil.PointAtDistance(point4, point, leaderLineMargin);
				double num2 = point2.X - point.X;
				double num3 = point2.Y - point.Y;
				point2 = GeometryUtil.PointAtDistance(point2, point, leaderLineMargin);
				double num4 = point2.X - point.X;
				double num5 = point2.Y - point.Y;
				if ((num2 > 0.0 && num4 < 0.0) || (num2 < 0.0 && num4 > 0.0) || (num3 > 0.0 && num5 < 0.0) || (num3 < 0.0 && num5 > 0.0))
				{
					point2 = point;
				}
				point3 = GeometryUtil.PointAtDistance(point3, point, leaderLineMargin);
				double num6 = GeometryUtil.GetSegmentLength(point, point5) / GeometryUtil.GetSegmentLength(point, point4);
				point3.X = point.X + (point3.X - point.X) * num6;
				point3.Y = point.Y + (point3.Y - point.Y) * num6;
			}
			else
			{
				point5 = point4;
			}
			if (Angle < 180.0 && Angle >= 0.0)
			{
				if (point2.Y > point3.Y)
				{
					point2.Y = point.Y;
				}
			}
			else if (point2.Y < point3.Y)
			{
				point2.Y = point.Y;
			}
			pathFigure.StartPoint = point;
			if (Slice.Owner.LeaderLineType == LeaderLineType.Arc)
			{
				bezierSegment.Point1 = point;
			}
			else
			{
				bezierSegment.Point1 = point2;
			}
			bezierSegment.Point2 = point3;
			bezierSegment.Point3 = point5;
		}

		protected override Size MeasureOverride(Size constraint)
		{
			if (!double.IsNaN(constraint.Width) && !double.IsInfinity(constraint.Width))
			{
				base.Width = constraint.Width;
			}
			if (!double.IsNaN(constraint.Height) && !double.IsInfinity(constraint.Height))
			{
				base.Height = constraint.Height;
			}
			return base.MeasureOverride(constraint);
		}
	}
	[TSWidget]
	[JAVAWidget]
	[SwiftWidget]
	public class IndexCollection : ObservableCollection<int>
	{
		protected override void InsertItem(int index, int newItem)
		{
			if (!Contains(newItem))
			{
				base.InsertItem(index, newItem);
			}
		}

		protected override void SetItem(int index, int newItem)
		{
			if (Contains(newItem))
			{
				Remove(newItem);
				InsertItem(index, newItem);
			}
			else
			{
				base.SetItem(index, newItem);
			}
		}
	}
	public class IndexCollectionTypeConverter : TypeConverter
	{
		public override bool CanConvertFrom(ITypeDescriptorContext context, Type sourceType)
		{
			return sourceType == typeof(string);
		}

		public override object ConvertFrom(ITypeDescriptorContext context, CultureInfo culture, object value)
		{
			IndexCollection indexCollection = new IndexCollection();
			char[] separator = new char[2] { ' ', ',' };
			string[] array = value.ToString().Split(separator, StringSplitOptions.RemoveEmptyEntries);
			foreach (string text in array)
			{
				indexCollection.Add(Convert.ToInt32(text.Trim()));
			}
			return indexCollection;
		}
	}

		[WidgetDefaultString("straight")]
		public LeaderLineType LeaderLineType
		{

		[WidgetDefaultNumber(0.2)]
		public double ExplodedRadius
		{
			get
			{
				return (double)GetValue(ExplodedRadiusProperty);
			}
			set
			{
				SetValue(ExplodedRadiusProperty, value);
			}
		}

		internal double ActualExplodedRadius
		{
			get
			{
				double explodedRadius = ExplodedRadius;
				if (double.IsNaN(explodedRadius) || double.IsInfinity(explodedRadius) || explodedRadius < 0.0)
				{
					return 0.0;
				}
				if (explodedRadius > 1.0)
				{
					return 1.0;
				}
				return explodedRadius;
			}
		}

		[WidgetDefaultNumber(0.9)]
		public double RadiusFactor
		{
			get
			{
				return (double)GetValue(RadiusFactorProperty);
			}
			set
			{
				SetValue(RadiusFactorProperty, value);
			}
		}

		internal double ActualRadiusFactor
		{
			get
			{
				double radiusFactor = RadiusFactor;
				if (double.IsNaN(radiusFactor) || double.IsInfinity(radiusFactor) || radiusFactor < 0.0)
				{
					return 0.0;
				}
				if (radiusFactor > 1.0)
				{
					return 1.0;
				}
				return radiusFactor;
			}
		}

		public event PieChartFormatLabelEventHandler FormatLabel
		{
			add
			{
				_formatLabel = (PieChartFormatLabelEventHandler)Delegate.Combine(_formatLabel, value);
				PropertyUpdatedOverride(this, "FormatLabel", _formatLabel, _formatLabel);
			}
			remove
			{
				_formatLabel = (PieChartFormatLabelEventHandler)Delegate.Remove(_formatLabel, value);
				PropertyUpdatedOverride(this, "FormatLabel", _formatLabel, _formatLabel);
			}
		}

		internal virtual PieChartBaseView CreateView()
		{
			return new PieChartBaseView(this);
		}

		internal virtual void OnViewCreated(PieChartBaseView view)
		{
			View = view;
		}

		[DontObfuscate]
		internal void OnDetachedFromUI()
		{
			View.OnDetachedFromUI();
		}

		[DontObfuscate]
		internal void OnAttachedToUI()
		{
			View.OnAttachedToUI();
		}

		public PieChartBase()
		{
			Viewport = Rect.Empty;
			PieChartBaseView pieChartBaseView = CreateView();
			OnViewCreated(pieChartBaseView);
			pieChartBaseView.OnInit();
			base.DefaultStyleKey = typeof(PieChartBase);
			ValueIndices = new List<int>();
			OthersValueIndices = new List<int>();
			Others = new List<object>();
			ToolTipManager = new PieChartToolTipManager(this);
			View.InitToolTipManager(ToolTipManager);
			_propertyUpdatedOverride = delegate(object o, PropertyUpdatedEventArgs e)
			{
				PropertyUpdatedOverride(o, e.PropertyName, e.OldValue, e.NewValue);
			};
			_brushesChangedOverride = delegate
			{
				RenderSlices();
				RenderLegendItems();
			};
			_explodedIndicesChangedOverride = delegate
			{
				if (AllowSliceExplosion)
				{
					PrepareSlices();
					PrepareLabels();
					RenderSlices();
					RenderLabels();
				}
			};
			_selectedIndicesChangedOverride = delegate(object o, NotifyCollectionChangedEventArgs e)
			{
				SelectedIndicesChangedOverride(e);
			};
			_selectedItemsChangedOverride = delegate(object o, NotifyCollectionChangedEventArgs e)
			{
				OnSelectedItemsChangedOverride(e);
			};
			FastItemsSource_Event = delegate(object o, FastItemsSourceEventArgs e)
			{
				DataUpdatedOverride(e.Action, e.Position, e.Count, e.PropertyName);
			};
			PropertyUpdated += _propertyUpdatedOverride;
			SelectedSlices.CollectionChanged += _selectedIndicesChangedOverride;
			_selectedAttached = true;
			ExplodedSlices.CollectionChanged += _explodedIndicesChangedOverride;
			_explodedAttached = true;
			SelectedItems = new ObservableCollection<object>();
			SelectedItems.CollectionChanged += _selectedItemsChangedOverride;
			Slices = new Pool<Slice>
			{
				Create = View.SliceCreate,
				Activate = View.SliceActivate,
				Disactivate = View.SliceDisactivate,
				Destroy = View.SliceDestroy
			};
			Labels = new Pool<PieLabel>
			{
				Create = View.LabelCreate,
				Activate = View.LabelActivate,
				Disactivate = View.LabelDisactivate,
				Destroy = View.LabelDestroy
			};
			SliceSelector = new PieChartSliceSelector(this);
			base.Loaded += PieChartBase_Loaded;
			base.Unloaded += PieChartBase_Unloaded;
			SetBinding(FontSizeProxyProperty, new Binding("FontSize")
			{
				Source = this
			});
		}

		private void PieChartBase_Unloaded(object sender, RoutedEventArgs e)
		{
			if (ActualBrushes != null && _brushesAttached)
			{
				ActualBrushes.CollectionChanged -= _brushesChangedOverride;
				_brushesAttached = false;
			}
			if (ActualOutlines != null && _outlinesAttached)
			{
				ActualOutlines.CollectionChanged -= _brushesChangedOverride;
				_outlinesAttached = false;
			}
			if (FastItemsSource != null && _fastItemsSourceAttached)
			{
				FastItemsSource.Event -= FastItemsSource_Event;
				_fastItemsSourceAttached = false;
			}
			if (ExplodedSlices != null && _explodedAttached)
			{
				ExplodedSlices.CollectionChanged -= _explodedIndicesChangedOverride;
				_explodedAttached = false;
			}
			if (SelectedSlices != null && _selectedAttached)
			{
				SelectedSlices.CollectionChanged -= _selectedIndicesChangedOverride;
				_selectedAttached = false;
			}
			View.CloseToolTip();
		}

		private void PieChartBase_Loaded(object sender, RoutedEventArgs e)
		{
			bool flag = false;
			if (ActualBrushes != null && !_brushesAttached)
			{
				ActualBrushes.CollectionChanged += _brushesChangedOverride;
				_brushesAttached = true;
				flag = true;
			}
			if (ActualOutlines != null && !_outlinesAttached)
			{
				ActualOutlines.CollectionChanged += _brushesChangedOverride;
				_outlinesAttached = true;
				flag = true;
			}
			if (FastItemsSource != null && !_fastItemsSourceAttached)
			{
				FastItemsSource.Event += FastItemsSource_Event;
				_fastItemsSourceAttached = true;
				flag = true;
			}
			if (ExplodedSlices != null && !_explodedAttached)
			{
				ExplodedSlices.CollectionChanged += _explodedIndicesChangedOverride;
				_explodedAttached = true;
				flag = true;
			}
			if (SelectedSlices != null && !_selectedAttached)
			{
				SelectedSlices.CollectionChanged += _selectedIndicesChangedOverride;
				_selectedAttached = true;
				flag = true;
			}
			if (flag)
			{
				RenderChart();
			}
		}

		public override void OnApplyTemplate()
		{
			base.OnApplyTemplate();
			ContentPresenter = GetTemplateChild("ContentPresenter") as ContentPresenter;
			if (ContentPresenter != null)
			{
				View.OnTemplateProvided();
			}
		}

		protected override void OnPropertyChanged(DependencyPropertyChangedEventArgs e)
		{
			base.OnPropertyChanged(e);
			if (e.Property == FrameworkElement.ToolTipProperty)
			{
				PropertyUpdatedOverride(this, "ToolTip", e.OldValue, e.NewValue);
			}
		}

		internal virtual void ExplodeSlice(Slice slice, bool explode)
		{
			if (_explodedAttached)
			{
				if (!ExplodedSlices.Contains(slice.Index) && explode)
				{
					ExplodedSlices.Add(slice.Index);
				}
				if (ExplodedSlices.Contains(slice.Index) && !explode)
				{
					ExplodedSlices.Remove(slice.Index);
				}
			}
		}

		internal virtual void SelectSlice(Slice slice, bool shouldSelect)
		{
			_stopSelectedItemsUpdate = true;
			if (!SelectedSlices.Contains(slice.Index) && shouldSelect)
			{
				SelectedSlices.Add(slice.Index);
			}
			if (SelectedSlices.Contains(slice.Index) && !shouldSelect)
			{
				SelectedSlices.Remove(slice.Index);
			}
			_stopSelectedItemsUpdate = false;
		}

		internal virtual void SetSliceAppearance(Slice slice)
		{
			View.SetSliceAppearance(slice);
		}

		protected internal virtual object GetLabel(Slice slice)
		{
			return View.GetLabel(slice);
		}

		internal Rect GetSliceInnerBounds(Slice slice, LabelsPosition position)
		{
			return new Rect(0.0, 0.0, 0.0, 0.0);
		}

		internal bool FitsInsideBounds(PieLabel label, Point center)
		{
			Slice slice = label.Slice;
			if (slice == null)
			{
				return false;
			}
			Point sliceOrigin = slice.GetSliceOrigin();
			double angle = ((SweepDirection == SweepDirection.Clockwise) ? slice.StartAngle : slice.EndAngle);
			double angle2 = ((SweepDirection == SweepDirection.Clockwise) ? slice.EndAngle : slice.StartAngle);
			bool flag = false;
			bool flag2 = false;
			Point point = GeometryUtil.FindRadialPoint(sliceOrigin, angle, slice.Radius);
			Point point2 = GeometryUtil.FindRadialPoint(sliceOrigin, angle2, slice.Radius);
			angle = FindAngle(point.X, sliceOrigin.X, point.Y, sliceOrigin.Y);
			angle2 = FindAngle(point2.X, sliceOrigin.X, point2.Y, sliceOrigin.Y);
			if (IsCircle(slice))
			{
				flag2 = true;
			}
			if (MathUtil.Hypot(label.Bounds.Right - sliceOrigin.X, label.Bounds.Top - sliceOrigin.Y) > slice.Radius)
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (MathUtil.Hypot(label.Bounds.Right - sliceOrigin.X, label.Bounds.Bottom - sliceOrigin.Y) > slice.Radius)
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (MathUtil.Hypot(label.Bounds.Left - sliceOrigin.X, label.Bounds.Top - sliceOrigin.Y) > slice.Radius)
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (MathUtil.Hypot(label.Bounds.Left - sliceOrigin.X, label.Bounds.Bottom - sliceOrigin.Y) > slice.Radius)
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (flag2)
			{
				return true;
			}
			if (angle > angle2)
			{
				angle -= 360.0;
				flag = true;
			}
			double num = FindAngle(label.Bounds.Right, sliceOrigin.X, label.Bounds.Top, sliceOrigin.Y);
			if (flag && num > 180.0 && num < 360.0)
			{
				num -= 360.0;
			}
			if (num < angle || num > angle2)
			{
				return false;
			}
			num = FindAngle(label.Bounds.Right, sliceOrigin.X, label.Bounds.Bottom, sliceOrigin.Y);
			if (flag && num > 180.0 && num < 360.0)
			{
				num -= 360.0;
			}
			if (num < angle || num > angle2)
			{
				return false;
			}
			num = FindAngle(label.Bounds.Left, sliceOrigin.X, label.Bounds.Top, sliceOrigin.Y);
			if (flag && num > 180.0 && num < 360.0)
			{
				num -= 360.0;
			}
			if (num < angle || num > angle2)
			{
				return false;
			}
			num = FindAngle(label.Bounds.Left, sliceOrigin.X, label.Bounds.Bottom, sliceOrigin.Y);
			if (flag && num > 180.0 && num < 360.0)
			{
				num -= 360.0;
			}
			if (num < angle || num > angle2)
			{
				return false;
			}
			return true;
		}

		internal static double RoundAngle(double angle)
		{
			return Math.Round(angle, 5);
		}

		private bool IsCircle(Slice slice)
		{
			return RoundAngle(Math.Abs(slice.EndAngle - slice.StartAngle)) == 360.0;
		}

		private static double FindAngle(double x, double centerX, double y, double centerY)
		{
			double num = MathUtil.Hypot(x - centerX, y - centerY);
			double num2 = Math.Asin((y - centerY) / num) * 180.0 / Math.PI;
			if (x < centerX)
			{
				num2 = 180.0 - num2;
			}
			if (x > centerX)
			{
				num2 = 360.0 + num2;
			}
			if (num2 == 360.0)
			{
				num2 = 0.0;
			}
			return GeometryUtil.SimplifyAngle(num2);
		}

		internal static void SortLabels(List<PieLabel> labels)
		{
			double[] array = new double[labels.Count];
			for (int i = 0; i < labels.Count; i++)
			{
				PieLabel pieLabel = labels[i];
				Slice slice = pieLabel.Slice;
				array[i] = GeometryUtil.FindRadialPoint(slice.Origin, pieLabel.Angle, slice.Radius).Y;
			}
			for (int j = 0; j < labels.Count; j++)
			{
				for (int k = j + 1; k < labels.Count; k++)
				{
					if (array[j] >= array[k])
					{
						PieLabel value = labels[j];
						labels[j] = labels[k];
						labels[k] = value;
						double num = array[j];
						array[j] = array[k];
						array[k] = num;
					}
				}
			}
		}

		internal void ResolveCollisions(List<PieLabel> labels)
		{
			if (labels.Count == 0)
			{
				return;
			}
			double width = base.RenderSize.Width;
			double height = base.RenderSize.Height;
			int count = labels.Count;
			double radius = labels[0].Slice.Radius;
			Point sliceOrigin = labels[0].Slice.GetSliceOrigin();
			bool flag = true;
			int num = 0;
			double num2 = double.PositiveInfinity;
			double val = double.NegativeInfinity;
			for (int i = 0; i < count - 1; i++)
			{
				PieLabel pieLabel = labels[i];
				PieLabel pieLabel2 = labels[i + 1];
				if (pieLabel.Bounds.IntersectsWith(pieLabel2.Bounds))
				{
					num++;
				}
			}
			double num3 = 0.0;
			foreach (PieLabel label in labels)
			{
				num2 = Math.Min(num2, label.Bounds.Height);
				val = Math.Max(val, label.Bounds.Height);
				num3 += label.Bounds.Height;
			}
			if (num3 > height)
			{
				flag = false;
			}
			if (flag && num > 0)
			{
				for (int j = 0; j < count - 1; j++)
				{
					for (int k = j + 1; k < count; k++)
					{
						PieLabel pieLabel3 = labels[j];
						PieLabel pieLabel4 = labels[k];
						if (pieLabel3.Bounds.IntersectsWith(pieLabel4.Bounds))
						{
							Rect bounds = pieLabel4.Bounds;
							bounds.Y = Math.Min(pieLabel3.Bounds.Bottom + 0.01, height - num2);
							double num4 = LabelExtent + radius;
							double num5 = Math.Abs(sliceOrigin.Y - (bounds.Y + num2 / 2.0));
							double num6 = Math.Sqrt(Math.Abs(num4 * num4 - num5 * num5));
							double num7 = GeometryUtil.SimplifyAngle(pieLabel4.Angle);
							if (num7 > 90.0 && num7 < 270.0)
							{
								num6 = (bounds.Width + num6) * -1.0;
							}
							bounds.X = sliceOrigin.X + num6;
							pieLabel4.Bounds = bounds;
						}
					}
				}
				for (int num8 = count - 1; num8 > 0; num8--)
				{
					for (int num9 = num8 - 1; num9 >= 0; num9--)
					{
						PieLabel pieLabel5 = labels[num8];
						PieLabel pieLabel6 = labels[num9];
						if (pieLabel5.Bounds.IntersectsWith(pieLabel6.Bounds))
						{
							Rect bounds2 = pieLabel6.Bounds;
							bounds2.Y = Math.Max(pieLabel5.Bounds.Top - num2 - 0.01, 0.0);
							double num10 = LabelExtent + radius;
							double num11 = Math.Abs(sliceOrigin.Y - (bounds2.Y + num2 / 2.0));
							double num12 = Math.Sqrt(Math.Abs(num10 * num10 - num11 * num11));
							double num13 = GeometryUtil.SimplifyAngle(pieLabel6.Angle);
							if (num13 > 90.0 && num13 < 270.0)
							{
								num12 = (bounds2.Width + num12) * -1.0;
							}
							bounds2.X = sliceOrigin.X + num12;
							pieLabel6.Bounds = bounds2;
						}
					}
				}
			}
			foreach (PieLabel label2 in labels)
			{
				Rect bounds3 = label2.Bounds;
				if (bounds3.Left > width || bounds3.Right < 0.0)
				{
					label2.Visibility = Visibility.Collapsed;
					if (LeaderLineType == LeaderLineType.Straight)
					{
						label2.LeaderLine.Visibility = Visibility.Collapsed;
					}
					else
					{
						label2.LeaderLinePath.Visibility = Visibility.Collapsed;
					}
				}
				else if (bounds3.Left < 0.0)
				{
					double num14 = Math.Abs(bounds3.X);
					bounds3.X = 0.0;
					if (num14 > bounds3.Width)
					{
						bounds3.Width = 0.0;
					}
					else
					{
						bounds3.Width -= num14;
					}
					label2.Bounds = bounds3;
					label2.Measure(new Size(bounds3.Width, bounds3.Height));
				}
				else if (bounds3.Right > width)
				{
					double num15 = bounds3.Right - width;
					if (num15 > bounds3.Width)
					{
						bounds3.Width = 0.0;
					}
					else
					{
						bounds3.Width -= num15;
					}
					label2.Bounds = bounds3;
					label2.Measure(new Size(bounds3.Width, bounds3.Height));
				}
			}
		}

		}

		protected internal virtual void RenderChart()
		{
			PrepareData();

			PrepareLabels();
			RenderSlices();
			RenderLabels();
			RenderLegendItems();
			View.UpdateView();
		}

		protected internal virtual void PrepareData()
		{
			Total = 0.0;
			OthersTotal = 0.0;
			ValueIndices.Clear();
			OthersValueIndices.Clear();
			Others.Clear();
			if (ActualItemsSource == null || FastItemsSource == null || ValueColumn == null || ValueColumn.Count == 0)
			{
				return;
			}
			foreach (double item in ValueColumn)
			{
				if (!double.IsNaN(item) && !double.IsInfinity(item) && !(item <= 0.0))
				{
					Total += item;
				}
			}
			for (int i = 0; i < ValueColumn.Count; i++)
			{
				double num = ValueColumn[i];
				bool flag = num <= 0.0;
				if (!(double.IsNaN(num) || double.IsInfinity(num) || flag))
				{
					double num2 = ((OthersCategoryType == OthersCategoryType.Percent) ? (num / Total) : num);
					double num3 = ((OthersCategoryType == OthersCategoryType.Percent) ? (OthersCategoryThreshold / 100.0) : OthersCategoryThreshold);
					bool flag2 = true;
					if (num2 <= num3 && flag2)
					{
						OthersTotal += num;
						OthersValueIndices.Add(i);
						Others.Add(FastItemsSource[i]);
					}
					else
					{
						ValueIndices.Add(i);
					}
				}
			}
		}

		protected internal virtual void PrepareSlices()
		{
			if (ActualItemsSource == null || FastItemsSource == null)
			{
				Slices.Count = 0;
				return;
			}
			int num = ValueIndices.Count;
			bool flag = OthersValueIndices.Count > 0;
			double startAngle = RoundAngle(ActualStartAngle);
			double num2 = RoundAngle(ActualStartAngle);
			if (flag)
			{
				num++;
			}
			TotalSliceCount = num;
			for (int i = 0; i < num; i++)
			{
				bool flag2 = false;
				double value;
				if (i == num - 1 && flag)
				{
					value = OthersTotal;
					flag2 = true;
				}
				else
				{
					value = ValueColumn[ValueIndices[i]];
				}
				num2 = ((SweepDirection != SweepDirection.Clockwise) ? (num2 - RoundAngle(Math.Abs(value) * 360.0 / Total)) : (num2 + RoundAngle(Math.Abs(value) * 360.0 / Total)));
				Slice slice = Slices[i];
				slice.SuspendCreation = true;
				slice.StartAngle = startAngle;
				slice.EndAngle = num2;
				slice.InnerExtentStart = ActualInnerExtent;
				slice.InnerExtentEnd = ActualInnerExtent;
				slice.IsOthersSlice = flag2;
				slice.ExplodedRadius = ActualExplodedRadius;
				slice.Index = i;
				slice.DataContext = (flag2 ? Others : FastItemsSource[ValueIndices[i]]);
				SliceSelector.SetSliceSelectionState(slice);
				slice.IsExploded = _explodedAttached && ExplodedSlices.Contains(i);
				startAngle = num2;
				slice.SuspendCreation = false;
			}
			Slices.Count = num;
		}

		private string ResolveOthersCategoryText()
		{
			string text = SRProvider.PieChart_Others;
			if (string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(text))
			{
				text = "Others";
			}
			if (OthersCategoryText == null)
			{
				return text;
			}
			return OthersCategoryText;
		}

		protected internal virtual void RenderSlices()
		{
			if (base.RenderSize.Height == 0.0 || base.RenderSize.Width == 0.0 || ActualItemsSource == null || FastItemsSource == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			Size size = View.UpdatePieViewport();
			Viewport = new Rect(0.0, 0.0, size.Width, size.Height);
			double unselectedStrokeThickness = View.GetUnselectedStrokeThickness();
			double strokeThicknessFromStyle = View.GetStrokeThicknessFromStyle(SelectedStyle);
			unselectedStrokeThickness = (double.IsNaN(unselectedStrokeThickness) ? 0.0 : (unselectedStrokeThickness / 2.0));
			strokeThicknessFromStyle = (double.IsNaN(strokeThicknessFromStyle) ? 0.0 : (strokeThicknessFromStyle / 2.0));
			unselectedStrokeThickness = Math.Max(strokeThicknessFromStyle, unselectedStrokeThickness);
			double num = Math.Min(size.Width / 2.0, size.Height / 2.0);
			Point origin = new Point(size.Width / 2.0, size.Height / 2.0);
			double num2 = num * ActualRadiusFactor;
			double num3 = num2 + unselectedStrokeThickness;
			if (num3 > num)
			{
				double num4 = num3 - num;
				num2 -= num4;
			}
			foreach (Slice item in Slices.Active)
			{
				Point explodedOrigin = GeometryUtil.FindCenter(size.Width, size.Height, exploded: true, (item.StartAngle + item.EndAngle) / 2.0, num2 * ActualExplodedRadius);
				item.SuspendCreation = true;
				item.InnerExtentStart = ActualInnerExtent;
				item.InnerExtentEnd = ActualInnerExtent;
				item.Radius = num2;
				item.ExplodedRadius = ActualExplodedRadius;
				item.Origin = origin;
				item.ExplodedOrigin = explodedOrigin;
				SetSliceAppearance(item);
				item.SuspendCreation = false;
			}
			View.UpdateView();
		}

		protected internal virtual void RenderLabels()
		{
			double width = base.RenderSize.Width;
			double height = base.RenderSize.Height;
			if (height == 0.0 || width == 0.0)
			{
				return;
			}
			if (Labels.Active.Count == 0 || LabelsPosition == LabelsPosition.None)
			{
				Labels.Count = 0;
				return;
			}
			List<PieLabel> list = new List<PieLabel>();
			List<PieLabel> list2 = new List<PieLabel>();
			List<PieLabel> list3 = new List<PieLabel>();
			List<PieLabel> list4 = new List<PieLabel>();
			foreach (PieLabel item in Labels.Active)
			{
				Slice slice = item.Slice;
				if (slice == null)
				{
					continue;
				}
				Point sliceOrigin = slice.GetSliceOrigin();
				double width2 = item.Bounds.Width;
				double height2 = item.Bounds.Height;
				if (LabelsPosition == LabelsPosition.Center || LabelsPosition == LabelsPosition.BestFit)
				{
					double num = slice.Radius * slice.InnerExtentStart / 100.0;
					Point center = GeometryUtil.FindRadialPoint(sliceOrigin, item.Angle, slice.Radius - (slice.Radius - num) / 2.0);
					item.Bounds = new Rect(center.X - width2 / 2.0, center.Y - height2 / 2.0, width2, height2);
					bool flag = FitsInsideBounds(item, center);
					if (flag || LabelsPosition == LabelsPosition.Center)
					{
						if (ActualLabelInnerColor == null)
						{
							slice.ClearValue(Control.ForegroundProperty);
						}
						else
						{
							slice.Foreground = ActualLabelInnerColor;
						}
						slice.LabelInside = true;
						list3.Add(item);
						item.ActualLabelPosition = LabelsPosition.Center;
						if (item.Slice.Owner.LeaderLineType == LeaderLineType.Straight)
						{
							item.LeaderLine.Visibility = Visibility.Collapsed;
						}
						else
						{
							item.LeaderLinePath.Visibility = Visibility.Collapsed;
						}
						if (!flag && LabelsPosition == LabelsPosition.Center)
						{
							item.Visibility = Visibility.Collapsed;
						}
						else
						{
							item.Visibility = Visibility.Visible;
						}
						continue;
					}
				}
				if (LabelsPosition == LabelsPosition.InsideEnd || LabelsPosition == LabelsPosition.BestFit)
				{
					double radius = FindLabelOffset(sliceOrigin, slice.Radius, item);
					Point center2 = GeometryUtil.FindRadialPoint(sliceOrigin, item.Angle, radius);
					item.Bounds = new Rect(center2.X - width2 / 2.0, center2.Y - height2 / 2.0, width2, height2);
					bool flag2 = FitsInsideBounds(item, center2);
					if (flag2 || LabelsPosition == LabelsPosition.InsideEnd)
					{
						if (ActualLabelInnerColor == null)
						{
							slice.ClearValue(Control.ForegroundProperty);
						}
						else
						{
							slice.Foreground = ActualLabelInnerColor;
						}
						slice.LabelInside = true;
						list4.Add(item);
						item.ActualLabelPosition = LabelsPosition.InsideEnd;
						if (item.Slice.Owner.LeaderLineType == LeaderLineType.Straight)
						{
							item.LeaderLine.Visibility = Visibility.Collapsed;
						}
						else
						{
							item.LeaderLinePath.Visibility = Visibility.Collapsed;
						}
						if (!flag2 && LabelsPosition == LabelsPosition.InsideEnd)
						{
							item.Visibility = Visibility.Collapsed;
						}
						else
						{
							item.Visibility = Visibility.Visible;
						}
						continue;
					}
				}
				if (ActualLabelOuterColor == null)
				{
					slice.ClearValue(Control.ForegroundProperty);
				}
				else
				{
					slice.Foreground = ActualLabelOuterColor;
				}
				slice.LabelInside = false;
				Point point = GeometryUtil.FindRadialPoint(sliceOrigin, item.Angle, slice.Radius + LabelExtent);
				item.ActualLabelPosition = LabelsPosition.OutsideEnd;
				item.Visibility = Visibility.Visible;
				item.UpdateCascadingLeaderLineStroke();
				if (item.Angle < 90.0 && item.Angle >= 0.0)
				{
					item.Bounds = new Rect(point.X, point.Y, width2, height2);
					list.Add(item);
				}
				else if (item.Angle < 180.0 && item.Angle >= 90.0)
				{
					item.Bounds = new Rect(point.X - width2, point.Y, width2, height2);
					list2.Add(item);
				}
				else if (item.Angle < 270.0 && item.Angle >= 180.0)
				{
					item.Bounds = new Rect(point.X - width2, point.Y - height2, width2, height2);
					list2.Add(item);
				}
				else
				{
					item.Bounds = new Rect(point.X, point.Y - height2, width2, height2);
					list.Add(item);
				}
				if (item.Bounds.Y < 0.0)
				{
					item.Bounds = new Rect(item.Bounds.X, 0.0, item.Bounds.Width, item.Bounds.Height);
				}
				if (item.Bounds.Bottom > height)
				{
					item.Bounds = new Rect(item.Bounds.X, height - item.Bounds.Height, item.Bounds.Width, item.Bounds.Height);
				}
			}
			SortLabels(list);
			ResolveCollisions(list);
			SortLabels(list2);
			ResolveCollisions(list2);
			foreach (PieLabel item2 in list3)
			{
				View.UpdateLabelPosition(item2, item2.Bounds.X, item2.Bounds.Y);
			}
			foreach (PieLabel item3 in list4)
			{
				View.UpdateLabelPosition(item3, item3.Bounds.X, item3.Bounds.Y);
			}
			foreach (PieLabel item4 in list)
			{
				View.UpdateLabelPosition(item4, item4.Bounds.X, item4.Bounds.Y);
				if (item4.Slice.Owner.LeaderLineType == LeaderLineType.Straight)
				{
					item4.UpdateLeaderLine();
				}
				else
				{
					item4.UpdateLeaderLinePath();
				}
			}
			foreach (PieLabel item5 in list2)
			{
				View.UpdateLabelPosition(item5, item5.Bounds.X, item5.Bounds.Y);
				if (item5.Slice.Owner.LeaderLineType == LeaderLineType.Straight)
				{
					item5.UpdateLeaderLine();
				}
				else
				{
					item5.UpdateLeaderLinePath();
				}
			}
			View.UpdateView();
		}

		private static double FindLabelOffset(Point center, double radius, PieLabel label)
		{
			double num = label.Angle * Math.PI / 180.0;
			double radius2 = 1.0;
			Point point = GeometryUtil.FindRadialPoint(new Point(0.0, 0.0), label.Angle, radius2);
			Point collisionPoint = GetCollisionPoint(label);
			double num2 = Math.Sqrt(collisionPoint.X * collisionPoint.X + collisionPoint.Y * collisionPoint.Y);
			Point point2 = new Point(collisionPoint.X / num2, collisionPoint.Y / num2);
			double angleBetween = GetAngleBetween(point, point2);
			double num3 = num2 / radius;
			double num4 = angleBetween * num3;
			double angleTo = GeometryUtil.GetAngleTo(new Point(0.0, 0.0), point);
			if (GeometryUtil.GetAngleTo(new Point(0.0, 0.0), point2) < angleTo)
			{
				num4 = 0.0 - num4;
			}
			Point collisionPointAtEnd = GeometryUtil.FindRadialPoint(center, (num + num4) * 180.0 / Math.PI, radius);
			Point centerFromCollisionPoint = GetCenterFromCollisionPoint(label, collisionPointAtEnd);
			return Math.Sqrt((centerFromCollisionPoint.X - center.X) * (centerFromCollisionPoint.X - center.X) + (centerFromCollisionPoint.Y - center.Y) * (centerFromCollisionPoint.Y - center.Y)) - 5.0;
		}

		private static Point GetCenterFromCollisionPoint(PieLabel label, Point collisionPointAtEnd)
		{
			double num = GeometryUtil.SimplifyAngle(label.Angle);
			double num2 = label.Bounds.Width / 2.0;
			double num3 = label.Bounds.Height / 2.0;
			if (num >= 0.0 && num <= 90.0)
			{
				return new Point(collisionPointAtEnd.X - num2, collisionPointAtEnd.Y - num3);
			}
			if (num >= 90.0 && num <= 180.0)
			{
				return new Point(collisionPointAtEnd.X + num2, collisionPointAtEnd.Y - num3);
			}
			if (num >= 180.0 && num <= 270.0)
			{
				return new Point(collisionPointAtEnd.X + num2, collisionPointAtEnd.Y + num3);
			}
			return new Point(collisionPointAtEnd.X - num2, collisionPointAtEnd.Y + num3);
		}

		private static double GetAngleBetween(Point rectCenter, Point collisionVect)
		{
			double num = rectCenter.X * collisionVect.X + rectCenter.Y * collisionVect.Y;
			double num2 = Math.Sqrt(rectCenter.X * rectCenter.X + rectCenter.Y * rectCenter.Y);
			double num3 = Math.Sqrt(collisionVect.X * collisionVect.X + collisionVect.Y * collisionVect.Y);
			return Math.Acos(num / (num2 * num3));
		}

		private static Point GetCollisionPoint(PieLabel label)
		{
			double num = GeometryUtil.SimplifyAngle(label.Angle);
			double num2 = label.Bounds.Width / 2.0;
			double num3 = label.Bounds.Height / 2.0;
			if (num >= 0.0 && num <= 90.0)
			{
				return new Point(num2, num3);
			}
			if (num >= 90.0 && num <= 180.0)
			{
				return new Point(0.0 - num2, num3);
			}
			if (num >= 180.0 && num <= 270.0)
			{
				return new Point(0.0 - num2, 0.0 - num3);
			}
			return new Point(num2, 0.0 - num3);
		}

		protected internal virtual void RenderLegendItems()
		{
			if (Legend == null || !((IChartLegend)Legend).IsItemwise)
			{
				return;
			}
			if ((LabelColumn == null || LabelColumn.Count == 0) && (LegendLabelColumn == null || LegendLabelColumn.Count == 0))
			{
				Legend.ClearLegendItemsForSeries(this);
				return;
			}
			LegendItems = new List<UIElement>();
			foreach (Slice item in Slices.Active)
			{
				ContentControl contentControl = new ContentControl();
				object label = GetLabel(item);
				Brush actualBackground = View.GetActualBackground(item);
				Brush actualOutline = View.GetActualOutline(item);
				contentControl.Content = new PieSliceDataContext
				{
					Series = this,
					Slice = item,
					Item = item.DataContext,
					ItemBrush = actualBackground,
					Outline = actualOutline,
					Thickness = item.StrokeThickness,
					ItemLabel = label?.ToString(),
					LegendLabel = (item.IsOthersSlice ? ResolveOthersCategoryText() : ((item.LegendLabel != null) ? item.LegendLabel : label?.ToString())),
					PercentValue = GetPercentValue(item),
					IsOthersSlice = item.IsOthersSlice
				};
				PieSliceDataContext pieSliceDataContext = (PieSliceDataContext)contentControl.Content;
				if (HasFormatLegendLabel() || LegendBindingFormatter != null || LegendOthersBindingFormatter != null)
				{
					object obj = null;
					if (HasFormatLegendLabel())
					{
						PieChartFormatLabelEventArgs e = new PieChartFormatLabelEventArgs();
						e.Item = pieSliceDataContext;
						e.Label = obj?.ToString();
						_formatLegendLabel(this, e);
						obj = e.Label;
					}
					if (LegendBindingFormatter != null && !pieSliceDataContext.IsOthersSlice)
					{
						obj = LegendBindingFormatter.Format(contentControl.Content);
					}
					if (LegendOthersBindingFormatter != null && pieSliceDataContext.IsOthersSlice)
					{
						obj = LegendOthersBindingFormatter.Format(contentControl.Content);
					}
					if (obj != null)
					{
						pieSliceDataContext.LegendLabel = obj.ToString();
					}
				}
				if (LegendItemTemplate != null)
				{
					contentControl.ContentTemplate = LegendItemTemplate;
				}
				LegendItems.Add(contentControl);
			}
			if (Legend.IsItemwise)
			{
				((IChartItemLegend)Legend).CreateItemwiseLegendItems(LegendItems, this);
			}
		}

		[JAVASuppressWidgetMember]
		[SwiftSuppressWidgetMember]
		[TSSuppressWidgetMember]
		public PieChartVisualData ExportVisualData()
		{
			PieChartVisualData pieChartVisualData = new PieChartVisualData();
			pieChartVisualData.Viewport = RectData.FromRect(Viewport);
			View.ExportViewData(pieChartVisualData);
			for (int i = 0; i < Slices.Count; i++)
			{
				PieSliceVisualData item = Slices[i].ExportVisualData();
				pieChartVisualData.Slices.Add(item);
				if (Slices[i].IsOthersSlice)
				{
					pieChartVisualData.OthersSlice = Slices[i].ExportVisualData();
				}
			}
			pieChartVisualData.Others = Others;
			pieChartVisualData.Name = base.Name;
			pieChartVisualData.RadiusFactor = ActualRadiusFactor;
			pieChartVisualData.LeaderLineMargin = LeaderLineMargin;
			return pieChartVisualData;
		}

		protected IFastItemColumn<double> RegisterDoubleColumn(string memberPath)
		{
			return FastItemsSource.RegisterColumn(memberPath);
		}

		protected IFastItemColumn<object> RegisterObjectColumn(string memberPath)
		{
			return FastItemsSource.RegisterColumnObject(memberPath);
		}

		protected virtual void PropertyUpdatedOverride(object sender, string propertyName, object oldValue, object newValue)
		{
			switch (propertyName)
			{
			case "ItemsSource":
				ActualItemsSource = ResolveItemsSource();
				break;
			case "ShouldDisplayMockData":
			case "ShouldUseSkeletonStyleForMockData":
				ActualLabelInnerColor = ResolvePossiblyTransparentBrush(LabelInnerColor);
				ActualLabelOuterColor = ResolvePossiblyTransparentBrush(LabelOuterColor);
				ActualBrushes = ResolveBrushCollection(Brushes);
				ActualOutlines = ResolveBrushCollection(ActualOutlines);
				ActualItemsSource = ResolveItemsSource();
				break;
			case "ActualItemsSource":
				if (ShouldDisplayMockData)
				{
					ActualBrushes = ResolveBrushCollection(Brushes);
					ActualOutlines = ResolveBrushCollection(ActualOutlines);
					ActualLabelInnerColor = ResolvePossiblyTransparentBrush(LabelInnerColor);
					ActualLabelOuterColor = ResolvePossiblyTransparentBrush(LabelOuterColor);
				}
				FastItemsSource = new FastItemsSource
				{
					ItemsSource = (IEnumerable)newValue
				};
				break;
			case "LabelFormat":
			case "LabelFormatSpecifiers":
				if (LabelFormat != null)
				{
					BindingFormatter = new BindingFormatter();
					BindingFormatter.FormatString = LabelFormat;
					BindingFormatter.FormatSpecifiers = LabelFormatSpecifiers;
				}
				else
				{
					BindingFormatter = null;
				}
				break;
			case "OthersLabelFormat":
			case "OthersLabelFormatSpecifiers":
				if (OthersLabelFormat != null)
				{
					OthersBindingFormatter = new BindingFormatter();
					OthersBindingFormatter.FormatString = OthersLabelFormat;
					OthersBindingFormatter.FormatSpecifiers = OthersLabelFormatSpecifiers;
				}
				else
				{
					OthersBindingFormatter = null;
				}
				break;
			case "LegendLabelFormat":
			case "LegendLabelFormatSpecifiers":
				if (LegendLabelFormat != null)
				{
					LegendBindingFormatter = new BindingFormatter();
					LegendBindingFormatter.FormatString = LegendLabelFormat;
					LegendBindingFormatter.FormatSpecifiers = LegendLabelFormatSpecifiers;
				}
				else
				{
					LegendBindingFormatter = null;
				}
				break;
			case "LegendOthersLabelFormat":
			case "LegendOthersLabelFormatSpecifiers":
				if (LegendOthersLabelFormat != null)
				{
					LegendOthersBindingFormatter = new BindingFormatter();
					LegendOthersBindingFormatter.FormatString = LegendOthersLabelFormat;
					LegendOthersBindingFormatter.FormatSpecifiers = LegendOthersLabelFormatSpecifiers;
				}
				else
				{
					LegendOthersBindingFormatter = null;
				}
				break;
			case "FastItemsSource":
				if (oldValue is FastItemsSource)
				{
					((FastItemsSource)oldValue).Event -= FastItemsSource_Event;
					_fastItemsSourceAttached = false;
					((FastItemsSource)oldValue).DeregisterColumn(ValueColumn);
					((FastItemsSource)oldValue).DeregisterColumn(LabelColumn);
					ValueColumn = null;
					LabelColumn = null;
					SelectedItem = null;
					SelectedItems.Clear();
					if (SelectedSlices != null)
					{
						SelectedSlices.Clear();
					}
					(oldValue as FastItemsSource).DeregisterColumn(LegendLabelColumn);
					LegendLabelColumn = null;
				}
				if (newValue is FastItemsSource)
				{
					((FastItemsSource)newValue).Event += FastItemsSource_Event;
					_fastItemsSourceAttached = true;
					ValueColumn = RegisterDoubleColumn(ResolveValueMemberPath(ValueMemberPath));
					LabelColumn = RegisterObjectColumn(ResolveLabelMemberPath(LabelMemberPath));
					LegendLabelColumn = RegisterObjectColumn(LegendLabelMemberPath);
					PrepareSlices();
					if (SelectedItem != null || SelectedItems.Count > 0)
					{
						SyncSelectionIndices();
					}
					else if (SelectedSlices != null && SelectedSlices.Count > 0)
					{
						SyncSelectionProperties();
					}
				}
				RenderChart();
				break;
			case "ValueMemberPath":
				if (FastItemsSource != null)
				{
					FastItemsSource.DeregisterColumn(ValueColumn);
					ValueColumn = RegisterDoubleColumn(ResolveValueMemberPath(ValueMemberPath));
				}
				break;
			case "LegendLabelMemberPath":
				if (FastItemsSource != null)
				{
					FastItemsSource.DeregisterColumn(LegendLabelColumn);
					LegendLabelColumn = RegisterObjectColumn(LegendLabelMemberPath);
					PrepareLabels();
					RenderLabels();
					RenderLegendItems();
				}
				break;
			case "FormatLegendLabel":
				RenderLegendItems();
				break;
			case "FormatLabel":
			case "LabelMemberPath":
				if (FastItemsSource != null)
				{
					FastItemsSource.DeregisterColumn(LabelColumn);
					LabelColumn = RegisterObjectColumn(ResolveLabelMemberPath(LabelMemberPath));
					PrepareLabels();
					RenderLabels();
					RenderLegendItems();
				}
				break;
			case "StartAngle":
				ActualStartAngle = (double)newValue;
				PrepareSlices();
				PrepareLabels();
				RenderSlices();
				RenderLabels();
				break;
			case "ToolTip":
				View.UpdateToolTipContent(base.ToolTip);
				break;
			case "Legend":
				if (oldValue is LegendBase legendBase)
				{
					legendBase.ClearLegendItemsForSeries(this);
				}
				RenderLegendItems();
				break;
			case "LegendItemBadgeTemplate":
			case "LegendItemTemplate":
				RenderLegendItems();
				break;
			case "RadiusFactor":
			case "ExplodedRadius":
			case "SweepDirection":
				PrepareSlices();
				PrepareLabels();
				RenderSlices();
				RenderLabels();
				break;
			case "OthersCategoryOpacity":
			case "SelectedSliceOpacity":
			case "OthersCategoryFill":
			case "SelectedSliceFill":
			case "OthersCategoryStroke":
			case "SelectedSliceStroke":
			case "OthersCategoryStrokeThickness":
			case "SelectedSliceStrokeThickness":
			case "OthersCategoryStyle":
			case "SelectedStyle":
				RenderSlices();
				RenderLegendItems();
				break;
			case "Brushes":
				ActualBrushes = ResolveBrushCollection(Brushes);
				break;
			case "Outlines":
				ActualOutlines = ResolveBrushCollection(Outlines);
				break;
			case "ActualBrushes":
				if (oldValue != null)
				{
					((BrushCollection)oldValue).CollectionChanged -= _brushesChangedOverride;
					_brushesAttached = false;
				}
				if (newValue != null)
				{
					((BrushCollection)newValue).CollectionChanged += _brushesChangedOverride;
					_brushesAttached = true;
				}
				RenderSlices();
				RenderLegendItems();
				break;
			case "ActualOutlines":
				if (oldValue != null)
				{
					((BrushCollection)oldValue).CollectionChanged -= _brushesChangedOverride;
					_outlinesAttached = false;
				}
				if (newValue != null)
				{
					((BrushCollection)newValue).CollectionChanged += _brushesChangedOverride;
					_outlinesAttached = true;
				}
				RenderSlices();
				RenderLegendItems();
				break;
			case "ValueColumn":
			case "OthersCategoryThreshold":
			case "OthersCategoryType":
				RenderChart();
				SyncSelectionIndices();
				SyncSelectionProperties();
				break;
			case "AllowSliceExplosion":
			case "AllowSliceSelection":
				RenderChart();
				break;
			case "LabelsPosition":
				PrepareLabels();
				RenderLabels();
				View.UpdateView();
				break;
			case "LabelInnerColor":
				ActualLabelInnerColor = ResolvePossiblyTransparentBrush(LabelInnerColor);
				break;
			case "LabelOuterColor":
				ActualLabelOuterColor = ResolvePossiblyTransparentBrush(LabelOuterColor);
				break;
			case "ActualLabelInnerColor":
			case "ActualLabelOuterColor":
			case "LabelExtent":
				PrepareLabels();
				RenderLabels();
				break;
			case "OthersCategoryText":
				PrepareLabels();
				RenderLabels();
				RenderLegendItems();
				break;
			case "LeaderLineVisibility":
				RenderLabels();
				break;
			case "LeaderLineStyle":
				base.Dispatcher.BeginInvoke((Action)delegate
				{
					foreach (PieLabel item in Labels.Active)
					{
						item.UpdateCascadingLeaderLineStroke();
					}
				});
				break;
			case "LabelTemplate":
				PrepareLabels();
				RenderLabels();
				break;
			case "LeaderLineOpacity":
			case "LeaderLineStroke":
			case "LeaderLineStrokeThickness":
			case "LeaderLineType":
			case "LeaderLineMargin":
				Labels.DoToAll(View.UpdateLabelLeaderLine);
				RenderLabels();
				break;
			case "IsSurfaceInteractionDisabled":
				View.OnIsSurfaceInteractionDisabledChanged();
				break;
			case "InnerExtent":
				RenderChart();
				break;
			case "SelectedItem":
				if (!_stopSelectedItemsUpdate)
				{
					PrepareSlices();
					RenderSlices();
					RenderLegendItems();
				}
				break;
			case "SelectionMode":
				if ((SliceSelectionMode)newValue == SliceSelectionMode.Single && SelectedItems != null && SelectedItems.Count > 1)
				{
					SelectedItems.Clear();
				}
				else if ((SliceSelectionMode)newValue == SliceSelectionMode.Multiple && SelectedItem != null && SelectedItems != null && !SelectedItems.Contains(SelectedItem))
				{
					if (SelectedItem is PieSliceOthersContext)
					{
						foreach (object datum in (SelectedItem as PieSliceOthersContext).Data)
						{
							SelectedItems.Add(datum);
						}
					}
					else
					{
						SelectedItems.Add(SelectedItem);
					}
					SyncSelectionProperties();
				}
				SyncSelectionIndices();
				PrepareSlices();
				RenderSlices();
				break;
			}
		}

		protected BrushCollection ResolveBrushCollection(BrushCollection brushes)
		{
			if (!ShouldDisplayMockData || !ShouldUseSkeletonStyleForMockData || ItemsSource != null)
			{
				return brushes;
			}
			if (brushes == null)
			{
				return null;
			}
			BrushCollection brushCollection = new BrushCollection();
			foreach (Brush brush in brushes)
			{
				Brush item = BrushUtil.ToGrayscale(brush);
				brushCollection.Add(item);
			}
			return brushCollection;
		}

		protected Brush ResolvePossiblyTransparentBrush(Brush brush)
		{
			if (!ShouldDisplayMockData || !ShouldUseSkeletonStyleForMockData || ItemsSource != null)
			{
				return brush;
			}
			return BrushUtil.FromArgb(0, 0, 0, 0);
		}

		private string ResolveLabelMemberPath(string labelMemberPath)
		{
			if (ShouldDisplayMockData && ItemsSource == null)
			{
				return "Label";
			}
			return labelMemberPath;
		}

		private string ResolveValueMemberPath(string valueMemberPath)
		{
			if (ShouldDisplayMockData && ItemsSource == null)
			{
				return "Value";
			}
			return valueMemberPath;
		}

		protected IEnumerable ResolveItemsSource()
		{
			if (ItemsSource != null)
			{
				return ItemsSource;
			}
			if (!ShouldDisplayMockData)
			{
				return null;
			}
			if (_mockData == null)
			{
				_mockData = PieChartMockDataGenerator.Generate();
			}
			return _mockData;
		}

		protected virtual void SelectedIndicesChangedOverride(NotifyCollectionChangedEventArgs args)
		{
			if (!_stopSelectedSlicesUpdate)
			{
				SyncSelectionProperties();
				if (AllowSliceSelection)
				{
					PrepareSlices();
					RenderSlices();
					RenderLegendItems();
				}
			}
		}

		protected virtual void OnSelectedItemsChangedOverride(NotifyCollectionChangedEventArgs args)
		{
			if ((args.Action != NotifyCollectionChangedAction.Reset || args.NewItems != null || args.OldItems != null) && !_stopSelectedItemsUpdate)
			{
				SyncSelectionIndices();
				if (AllowSliceSelection)
				{
					PrepareSlices();
					RenderSlices();
					RenderLegendItems();
				}
				IList oldItems = args.OldItems;
				IList newItems = args.NewItems;
				ObservableCollection<object> selectedItems = SelectedItems;
				OnSelectedItemsChanged(this, new SelectedItemsChangedEventArgs(oldItems, newItems, selectedItems));
			}
		}

		protected void RaisePropertyChanged(string name, object oldValue, object newValue)
		{
			if (this.PropertyChanged != null)
			{
				this.PropertyChanged(this, new PropertyChangedEventArgs(name));
			}
			if (this.PropertyUpdated != null)
			{
				this.PropertyUpdated(this, new PropertyUpdatedEventArgs(name, oldValue, newValue));
			}
		}

		private void SyncSelectionProperties()
		{
			if (ActualItemsSource == null || Slices.Active.Count == 0)
			{
				return;
			}
			_stopSelectedItemsUpdate = true;
			int count = SelectedSlices.Count;
			if (count == 0)
			{
				if (SelectedItems.Count > 0)
				{
					SelectedItems.Clear();
				}
				if (SelectedItem != null)
				{
					SelectedItem = null;
				}
			}
			if (SelectionMode == SliceSelectionMode.Single)
			{
				if (count != 0)
				{
					Slice slice = Slices.Active[SelectedSlices[count - 1]];
					if (slice.IsOthersSlice)
					{
						SelectedItem = new PieSliceOthersContext
						{
							Data = (slice.DataContext as IList),
							Slice = slice
						};
					}
					else
					{
						SelectedItem = slice.DataContext;
					}
				}
			}
			else if (SelectionMode == SliceSelectionMode.Multiple && count != 0)
			{
				SelectedItems.Clear();
				foreach (int selectedSlice in SelectedSlices)
				{
					Slice slice2 = Slices.Active[selectedSlice];
					if (slice2.IsOthersSlice)
					{
						foreach (object item in slice2.DataContext as IEnumerable)
						{
							SliceSelector.MultiSelectItem(item);
						}
					}
					else
					{
						SliceSelector.MultiSelectItem(slice2.DataContext);
					}
				}
				SelectedItem = Slices.Active[SelectedSlices[count - 1]].DataContext;
			}
			_stopSelectedItemsUpdate = false;
		}

		private void SyncSelectionIndices()
		{
			if (ActualItemsSource == null || Slices.Active.Count == 0)
			{
				return;
			}
			_stopSelectedSlicesUpdate = true;
			SelectedSlices.Clear();
			foreach (Slice item in Slices.Active)
			{
				if (SliceSelector.IsSliceDataSelected(item))
				{
					SelectedSlices.Add(item.Index);
				}
			}
			_stopSelectedSlicesUpdate = false;
		}

		internal void SliceClicked(Slice slice, MouseEventArgs args)
		{
			SliceClicked(slice, args, fromLabel: false);
		}

		internal void SliceClicked(Slice slice, MouseEventArgs args, bool fromLabel)
		{
			if (AllowSliceSelection)
			{
				if (SelectionMode == SliceSelectionMode.Single)
				{
					SliceSelector.SingleSelectSlice(slice);
				}
				else if (SelectionMode == SliceSelectionMode.Multiple)
				{
					SliceSelector.MultiSelectSlice(slice);
				}
			}
			SliceClickEventArgs e = new SliceClickEventArgs(slice, View.GetOriginalEvent(args));
			OnSliceClick(this, e);
			if (!fromLabel)
			{
				View.UpdateToolTip(slice, args);
			}
		}

		internal bool LabelClicked(Slice slice, MouseEventArgs args)
		{
			LabelClickEventArgs e = new LabelClickEventArgs(slice, View.GetOriginalEvent(args));
			OnLabelClick(this, e);
			return e.AllowSliceClick;
		}

		internal void ItemEntered(object item, object args)
		{
			if (item != _currentItem)
			{
				_currentItem = item;
				if (item != null)
				{
					OnSliceEntered(item, args);
				}
			}
			ToolTipManager.UpdateToolTip((MouseEventArgs)args, (FrameworkElement)item);
		}

		private SliceEventArgs GetArgs(object item, object args)
		{
			return new SliceEventArgs((Slice)item, args);
		}

		private void OnSliceEntered(object item, object args)
		{
			if (this.SliceEnter != null)
			{
				this.SliceEnter(item, GetArgs(item, args));
			}
		}

		private void OnSliceExited(object item, object args)
		{
			if (this.SliceLeave != null)
			{
				this.SliceLeave(item, GetArgs(item, args));
			}
		}

		private void OnSliceHover(object item, object args)
		{
			if (this.SliceHover != null)
			{
				this.SliceHover(item, GetArgs(item, args));
			}
		}

		internal void ItemMouseMoved(object item, object args, bool fromLabel)
		{
			if (item != _currentItem)
			{
				object currentItem = _currentItem;
				if (currentItem != null)
				{
					OnSliceExited(currentItem, args);
				}
				_currentItem = item;
				if (_currentItem != null)
				{
					OnSliceEntered(item, args);
				}
			}
			else if (_currentItem != null)
			{
				OnSliceHover(item, args);
			}
			ToolTipManager.UpdateToolTip((MouseEventArgs)args, (FrameworkElement)item, !fromLabel);
		}

		internal void ItemMouseMoved(object item, object args)
		{
			ItemMouseMoved(item, args, fromLabel: false);
		}

		internal void ItemMouseLeft(object o, MouseEventArgs e)
		{
			View.CloseToolTip();
			if (_currentItem != null)
			{
				if (_currentItem != null)
				{
					OnSliceExited(_currentItem, e);
				}
				_currentItem = null;
			}
		}

		internal void OnSizeUpdated()
		{
			RenderChart();
		}

		internal double GetPercentValue(Slice slice)
		{
			if (slice == null || ValueColumn == null || ValueIndices == null)
			{
				return double.NaN;
			}
			if (slice.IsOthersSlice)
			{
				return OthersTotal / Total * 100.0;
			}
			return ValueColumn[ValueIndices[slice.Index]] / Total * 100.0;
		}

		int ILegendSeries.ResolveLegendIndex()
		{
			return -1;
		}

		void ILegendSeries.ForSubItems(Action<object> action)
		{
		}
	}
	internal class PieChartSliceSelector
	{
		[Weak]
		private PieChartBase _pieChart;

		public PieChartSliceSelector(PieChartBase pieChart)
		{
			_pieChart = pieChart;
		}

		internal bool IsSliceDataSelected(Slice slice)
		{
			object dataContext = slice.DataContext;
			if (_pieChart.SelectionMode == SliceSelectionMode.Single)
			{
				if (slice.IsOthersSlice)
				{
					if (dataContext is IList list && list.Contains(_pieChart.SelectedItem))
					{
						return true;
					}
					if (_pieChart.SelectedItem is PieSliceOthersContext)
					{
						return true;
					}
				}
				if (dataContext == _pieChart.SelectedItem)
				{
					return true;
				}
			}
			else if (_pieChart.SelectionMode == SliceSelectionMode.Multiple)
			{
				if (IsSliceDataInSelectedItems(slice))
				{
					return true;
				}
			}
			else if (_pieChart.SelectionMode == SliceSelectionMode.Manual && _pieChart.SelectedSlices.Contains(slice.Index))
			{
				return true;
			}
			return false;
		}

		internal bool IsSliceDataInSelectedItems(Slice slice)
		{
			object dataContext = slice.DataContext;
			if (slice.IsOthersSlice)
			{
				foreach (object item in (IList)dataContext)
				{
					if (_pieChart.SelectedItems.Contains(item))
					{
						return true;
					}
				}
			}
			else if (_pieChart.SelectedItems.Contains(dataContext))
			{
				return true;
			}
			return false;
		}

		internal object GetSliceItemForSingleSelect(Slice slice)
		{
			object dataContext = slice.DataContext;
			if (!slice.IsOthersSlice)
			{
				if (_pieChart.SelectedItem != dataContext)
				{
					return dataContext;
				}
				return null;
			}
			if (_pieChart.SelectedItem is PieSliceOthersContext)
			{
				return null;
			}
			return new PieSliceOthersContext
			{
				Data = (slice.DataContext as IList),
				Slice = slice
			};
		}

		internal bool MultiSelectItem(object item, bool forceRemove)
		{
			bool result = false;
			if (!forceRemove)
			{
				result = (_pieChart.SelectedItems.Contains(item) ? RemoveFromSelectedItems(item) : AddToSelectedItems(item));
			}
			else if (_pieChart.SelectedItems.Contains(item))
			{
				result = RemoveFromSelectedItems(item);
			}
			return result;
		}

		internal bool MultiSelectItem(object item)
		{
			return MultiSelectItem(item, forceRemove: false);
		}

		internal bool RemoveFromSelectedItems(object item)
		{
			SelectedItemsChangingEventArgs e = new SelectedItemsChangingEventArgs(_pieChart.SelectedItems, new ObservableCollection<object>(), _pieChart.SelectedItems);
			_pieChart.OnSelectedItemsChanging(this, e);
			if (!e.Cancel)
			{
				_pieChart.SelectedItems.Remove(item);
			}
			return e.Cancel;
		}

		internal bool AddToSelectedItems(object item)
		{
			SelectedItemsChangingEventArgs e = new SelectedItemsChangingEventArgs(_pieChart.SelectedItems, new ObservableCollection<object> { item }, _pieChart.SelectedItems);
			_pieChart.OnSelectedItemsChanging(this, e);
			if (!e.Cancel)
			{
				_pieChart.SelectedItems.Add(item);
			}
			return e.Cancel;
		}

		internal void SingleSelectSlice(Slice slice)
		{
			_pieChart.SelectedItem = GetSliceItemForSingleSelect(slice);
		}

		internal void MultiSelectSlice(Slice slice)
		{
			new List<object>(_pieChart.SelectedItems);
			if (slice.IsOthersSlice)
			{
				IList list = slice.DataContext as IList;
				int num = 0;
				foreach (object item in list)
				{
					if (_pieChart.SelectedItems.Contains(item))
					{
						num++;
					}
				}
				bool forceRemove = num > 0 && num < list.Count;
				foreach (object item2 in list)
				{
					MultiSelectItem(item2, forceRemove);
				}
				if (IsSliceDataInSelectedItems(slice))
				{
					_pieChart.SelectedItem = new PieSliceOthersContext
					{
						Data = (slice.DataContext as IList),
						Slice = slice
					};
				}
				else
				{
					_pieChart.SelectedItem = ((_pieChart.SelectedItems.Count > 0) ? _pieChart.SelectedItems[_pieChart.SelectedItems.Count - 1] : null);
				}
			}
			else
			{
				MultiSelectItem(slice.DataContext);
				_pieChart.SelectedItem = ((_pieChart.SelectedItems.Count > 0) ? _pieChart.SelectedItems[_pieChart.SelectedItems.Count - 1] : null);
			}
		}

		internal void SetSliceSelectionState(Slice slice)
		{
			if (slice != null)
			{
				slice.StopSelectionNotify = true;
				slice.IsSelected = IsSliceDataSelected(slice);
				slice.StopSelectionNotify = false;
			}
		}
	}

		internal double GetActualRadius()
		{
			_ = Math.Abs(PieChartBase.RoundAngle(EndAngle - StartAngle)) == 360.0;
			return Radius;
		}

		[JAVAClientName("fetchSliceBounds")]
		private Rect GetSliceBounds()
		{
			bool flag = ((Owner != null && Owner.AllowSliceExplosion) ? true : false);
			double actualRadius = GetActualRadius();
			if (IsExploded && flag && Owner.TotalSliceCount > 1)
			{
				return new Rect(ExplodedOrigin.X - actualRadius, ExplodedOrigin.Y - actualRadius, actualRadius * 2.0, actualRadius * 2.0);
			}
			return new Rect(Origin.X - actualRadius, Origin.Y - actualRadius, actualRadius * 2.0, actualRadius * 2.0);
		}

		internal Point GetSliceOrigin()
		{
			if (IsExploded && Owner != null && Owner.AllowSliceExplosion && Owner.TotalSliceCount > 1)
			{
				if (HasCorrecttedBounds)
				{
					return CorrectedExplodedOrigin;
				}
				return ExplodedOrigin;
			}
			return Origin;
		}

		internal void CreateShape()
		{
			if (SuspendCreation)
			{
				return;
			}
			Path slicePath = View.GetSlicePath();
			Rect viewport = Owner.Viewport;
			if (double.IsNaN(StartAngle) || double.IsNaN(EndAngle) || double.IsNaN(Radius) || double.IsNaN(ExplodedRadius) || Index < 0 || Owner == null || viewport.Width == 0.0 || viewport.Height == 0.0 || (Origin.X == 0.0 && Origin.Y == 0.0) || (ExplodedOrigin.X == 0.0 && ExplodedOrigin.Y == 0.0) || StartAngle == EndAngle)
			{
				return;
			}
			Bounds = GetSliceBounds();
			double eccentricity = GeometryUtil.Eccentricity(Bounds);
			double halfHeight = Bounds.Height / 2.0;
			double actualRadius = GetActualRadius();
			Point center = Bounds.GetCenter();
			Point point = EllipsePointAlternate(MathUtil.Radians(StartAngle), eccentricity, center, halfHeight, 100.0);
			Point point2 = EllipsePointAlternate(MathUtil.Radians(EndAngle), eccentricity, center, halfHeight, 100.0);
			Point point3 = EllipsePointAlternate(MathUtil.Radians(EndAngle), eccentricity, center, Radius, InnerExtentEnd);
			Point point4 = EllipsePointAlternate(MathUtil.Radians(StartAngle), eccentricity, center, Radius, InnerExtentStart);
			if (Math.Abs(PieChartBase.RoundAngle(EndAngle - StartAngle)) == 360.0)
			{
				if (InnerExtentEnd == 0.0)
				{
					EllipseGeometry data = new EllipseGeometry
					{
						Center = center,
						RadiusX = Radius,
						RadiusY = Radius
					};
					slicePath.Data = data;
				}
				else if (InnerExtentEnd > 0.0)
				{
					Size size = new Size(Radius, Radius);
					Size size2 = new Size(Radius * InnerExtentEnd / 100.0, Radius * InnerExtentEnd / 100.0);
					Point startPoint = new Point
					{
						X = center.X - Radius,
						Y = center.Y
					};
					Point point5 = new Point
					{
						X = center.X + Radius,
						Y = center.Y
					};
					Point point6 = new Point
					{
						X = center.X - Radius * InnerExtentEnd / 100.0,
						Y = center.Y
					};
					Point startPoint2 = new Point
					{
						X = center.X + Radius * InnerExtentEnd / 100.0,
						Y = center.Y
					};
					PathFigure pathFigure = new PathFigure
					{
						StartPoint = startPoint
					};
					PathSegmentCollection pathSegmentCollection = new PathSegmentCollection();
					ArcSegment value = new ArcSegment
					{
						Size = size,
						SweepDirection = SweepDirection.Clockwise,
						Point = point5
					};
					pathSegmentCollection.Add(value);
					pathFigure.Segments = pathSegmentCollection;
					PathFigure pathFigure2 = new PathFigure
					{
						StartPoint = startPoint2
					};
					PathSegmentCollection pathSegmentCollection2 = new PathSegmentCollection();
					ArcSegment value2 = new ArcSegment
					{
						Size = size2,
						SweepDirection = SweepDirection.Counterclockwise,
						Point = point6
					};
					pathSegmentCollection2.Add(value2);
					pathFigure2.Segments = pathSegmentCollection2;
					PathFigure pathFigure3 = new PathFigure
					{
						StartPoint = startPoint
					};
					PathSegmentCollection pathSegmentCollection3 = new PathSegmentCollection();
					ArcSegment value3 = new ArcSegment
					{
						Size = size,
						SweepDirection = SweepDirection.Counterclockwise,
						Point = point5
					};
					pathSegmentCollection3.Add(value3);
					pathFigure3.Segments = pathSegmentCollection3;
					PathFigure pathFigure4 = new PathFigure
					{
						StartPoint = startPoint2
					};
					PathSegmentCollection pathSegmentCollection4 = new PathSegmentCollection();
					ArcSegment value4 = new ArcSegment
					{
						Size = size2,
						SweepDirection = SweepDirection.Clockwise,
						Point = point6
					};
					pathSegmentCollection4.Add(value4);
					pathFigure4.Segments = pathSegmentCollection4;
					PathFigureCollection figures = new PathFigureCollection { pathFigure, pathFigure2, pathFigure3, pathFigure4 };
					PathGeometry value5 = new PathGeometry
					{
						Figures = figures
					};
					GeometryGroup geometryGroup = new GeometryGroup();
					geometryGroup.Children.Add(value5);
					slicePath.Data = geometryGroup;
				}
				else
				{
					GeometryGroup geometryGroup2 = new GeometryGroup
					{
						FillRule = FillRule.EvenOdd
					};
					geometryGroup2.Children.Add(new EllipseGeometry
					{
						Center = center,
						RadiusX = Radius,
						RadiusY = Radius
					});
					geometryGroup2.Children.Add(new EllipseGeometry
					{
						Center = center,
						RadiusX = Radius * InnerExtentEnd / 100.0,
						RadiusY = Radius * InnerExtentEnd / 100.0
					});
					slicePath.Data = geometryGroup2;
				}
				return;
			}
			PathGeometry pathGeometry = (PathGeometry)(slicePath.Data = new PathGeometry());
			PathFigure pathFigure5 = new PathFigure
			{
				IsClosed = true
			};
			pathGeometry.Figures = new PathFigureCollection();
			pathGeometry.Figures.Add(pathFigure5);
			pathFigure5.StartPoint = point;
			bool isLargeArc = Math.Abs(EndAngle - StartAngle) > 180.0;
			ArcSegment arcSegment = new ArcSegment();
			arcSegment.Point = point2;
			arcSegment.Size = new Size(Bounds.Width / 2.0, Bounds.Height / 2.0);
			arcSegment.IsLargeArc = isLargeArc;
			if (EndAngle > StartAngle)
			{
				arcSegment.SweepDirection = SweepDirection.Clockwise;
			}
			else
			{
				arcSegment.SweepDirection = SweepDirection.Counterclockwise;
			}
			pathFigure5.Segments = new PathSegmentCollection();
			pathFigure5.Segments.Add(arcSegment);
			LineSegment lineSegment = new LineSegment();
			lineSegment.Point = point3;
			pathFigure5.Segments.Add(lineSegment);
			double num = Math.Sqrt(Math.Pow(point3.X - point2.X, 2.0) + Math.Pow(point3.Y - point2.Y, 2.0));
			double num2 = actualRadius - num;
			ArcSegment arcSegment2 = new ArcSegment();
			arcSegment2.Point = point4;
			if (num2 < 0.0)
			{
				num2 = 0.1;
			}
			arcSegment2.Size = new Size(num2, num2);
			arcSegment2.IsLargeArc = arcSegment.IsLargeArc;
			arcSegment2.SweepDirection = SweepDirection.Counterclockwise;
			pathFigure5.Segments.Add(arcSegment2);
			Rect rect = (SliceBounds = GetBounds(slicePath, point, point2, StartAngle, EndAngle, center, actualRadius));
			if (true && Bounds.Height > 0.0 && Bounds.Width > 0.0 && !viewport.Contains(rect))
			{
				Rect rect2 = rect;
				Rect rect3 = new Rect(0.0, 0.0, viewport.Width, viewport.Height);
				rect3.Intersect(rect2);
				double num3 = GeometryUtil.SimplifyAngle((StartAngle + EndAngle) / 2.0);
				double num4 = num3 / 180.0 * Math.PI;
				double num5 = Math.Abs((rect2.Height - rect3.Height) / Math.Sin(num4));
				double num6 = Math.Abs((rect2.Width - rect3.Width) / Math.Cos(num4));
				if (double.IsNaN(num5) || double.IsInfinity(num5))
				{
					num5 = 0.0;
				}
				if (double.IsNaN(num6) || double.IsInfinity(num6))
				{
					num6 = 0.0;
				}
				double num7 = Math.Max(num5, num6);
				Point correctedExplodedOrigin = GeometryUtil.FindCenter(Owner.Viewport.Width, Owner.Viewport.Height, exploded: true, num3, Radius * Owner.ActualExplodedRadius - num7);
				View.PositionSlice(correctedExplodedOrigin.X - ExplodedOrigin.X, correctedExplodedOrigin.Y - ExplodedOrigin.Y);
				HasCorrecttedBounds = true;
				CorrectedExplodedOrigin = correctedExplodedOrigin;
				CorrectedExplodedBounds = new Rect(rect2.X - (correctedExplodedOrigin.X - ExplodedOrigin.X), rect2.Y - (correctedExplodedOrigin.Y - ExplodedOrigin.Y), rect2.Width, rect2.Height);
			}
			else
			{
				HasCorrecttedBounds = false;
				View.ResetSlicePosition();
			}
		}

		public bool ContainsPoint(Point p)
		{
			Rect viewport = Owner.Viewport;
			if (base.Visibility == Visibility.Collapsed)
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (double.IsNaN(StartAngle) || double.IsNaN(EndAngle) || double.IsNaN(Radius) || double.IsNaN(ExplodedRadius) || Index < 0 || Owner == null || viewport.Width == 0.0 || viewport.Height == 0.0 || (Origin.X == 0.0 && Origin.Y == 0.0) || (ExplodedOrigin.X == 0.0 && ExplodedOrigin.Y == 0.0))
			{
				return false;
			}
			double actualRadius = GetActualRadius();
			double num = InnerExtentEnd / 100.0 * actualRadius;
			double num2 = actualRadius;
			Point point = Origin;
			if (IsExploded && Owner.AllowSliceExplosion && Owner.TotalSliceCount > 1)
			{
				point = ExplodedOrigin;
				if (HasCorrecttedBounds)
				{
					point = CorrectedExplodedOrigin;
				}
			}
			double num3 = num * num;
			double num4 = num2 * num2;
			double num5 = Math.Pow(p.X - point.X, 2.0) + Math.Pow(p.Y - point.Y, 2.0);
			if (num5 < num3 || num5 > num4)
			{
				return false;
			}
			double num6 = Math.Atan2(p.Y - point.Y, p.X - point.X);
			num6 = num6 * 180.0 / Math.PI;
			return ContainsAngle(num6);
		}

		private bool ContainsAngle([SwiftMutableParameter] double angle)
		{
			angle = GeometryUtil.SimplifyAngle(angle);
			double num = Math.Min(StartAngle, EndAngle);
			double num2 = Math.Max(StartAngle, EndAngle);
			if ((!(angle > num) || !(angle < num2)) && (!(angle - 360.0 > num) || !(angle - 360.0 < num2)))
			{
				if (angle + 360.0 > num)
				{
					return angle + 360.0 < num2;
				}
				return false;
			}
			return true;
		}

		private Rect GetBounds(Path slicePath, Point outerStart, Point outerEnd, [SwiftMutableParameter] double startAngle, [SwiftMutableParameter] double endAngle, Point center, double radius)
		{
			if (Bounds.Width > 0.0 && Bounds.Height > 0.0)
			{
				return slicePath.Data.Bounds;
			}
			return new Rect(0.0, 0.0, 0.0, 0.0);
		}

		public PieSliceVisualData ExportVisualData()
		{
			PieSliceVisualData pieSliceVisualData = new PieSliceVisualData();
			pieSliceVisualData.Appearance = new PrimitiveAppearanceData();
			pieSliceVisualData.LabelAppearance = new LabelAppearanceData();
			pieSliceVisualData.LeaderLineAppearance = new PrimitiveAppearanceData();
			pieSliceVisualData.StartAngle = StartAngle;
			pieSliceVisualData.EndAngle = EndAngle;
			pieSliceVisualData.ExplodedOrigin = PointData.FromPoint(ExplodedOrigin);
			pieSliceVisualData.ExplodedRadius = ExplodedRadius;
			pieSliceVisualData.Origin = PointData.FromPoint(Origin);
			pieSliceVisualData.Radius = GetActualRadius();
			pieSliceVisualData.Index = Index;
			pieSliceVisualData.InnerExtentEnd = InnerExtentEnd;
			pieSliceVisualData.InnerExtentStart = InnerExtentStart;
			pieSliceVisualData.IsExploded = IsExploded;
			pieSliceVisualData.IsOthersSlice = IsOthersSlice;
			pieSliceVisualData.IsSelected = IsSelected;
			if (Label != null)
			{
				pieSliceVisualData.LabelAppearance.Angle = Label.Angle;
				pieSliceVisualData.LabelBounds = RectData.FromRect(Label.Bounds);
				pieSliceVisualData.LabelAngle = Label.Angle;
				if (Label.Label is TextBlock)
				{
					TextBlock textBlock = Label.Label as TextBlock;
					pieSliceVisualData.Label = textBlock.Text;
					FontInfo fontInfo = null;
					fontInfo = FontUtil.GetFontInfo(textBlock, null);
					pieSliceVisualData.LabelAppearance = AppearanceHelper.FromTextElement(textBlock, fontInfo);
					pieSliceVisualData.LabelAppearance.Visibility = Label.Visibility == Visibility.Visible;
					if (Label.Parent == null)
					{
						pieSliceVisualData.LabelAppearance.Visibility = false;
					}
				}
				else
				{
					pieSliceVisualData.Label = Label.Label.ToString();
				}
				if (Label.LeaderLine != null)
				{
					pieSliceVisualData.LeaderLineAppearance.Fill = AppearanceHelper.FromBrush(Label.LeaderLine.Fill);
					pieSliceVisualData.LeaderLineAppearance.Opacity = Label.LeaderLine.Opacity;
					pieSliceVisualData.LeaderLineAppearance.Stroke = AppearanceHelper.FromBrush(Label.LeaderLine.Stroke);
					pieSliceVisualData.LeaderLineAppearance.StrokeThickness = Label.LeaderLine.StrokeThickness;
					pieSliceVisualData.LeaderLineAppearance.IsVisible = Label.LeaderLine.Visibility == Visibility.Visible;
					pieSliceVisualData.LeaderLinePath = new PathVisualData("leaderLine", Label.LeaderLine);
				}
				else if (Label.LeaderLinePath != null)
				{
					pieSliceVisualData.LeaderLineAppearance.Fill = AppearanceHelper.FromBrush(Label.LeaderLinePath.Fill);
					pieSliceVisualData.LeaderLineAppearance.Opacity = Label.LeaderLinePath.Opacity;
					pieSliceVisualData.LeaderLineAppearance.Stroke = AppearanceHelper.FromBrush(Label.LeaderLinePath.Stroke);
					pieSliceVisualData.LeaderLineAppearance.StrokeThickness = Label.LeaderLinePath.StrokeThickness;
					pieSliceVisualData.LeaderLineAppearance.IsVisible = Label.LeaderLinePath.Visibility == Visibility.Visible;
					pieSliceVisualData.LeaderLinePath = new PathVisualData("leaderLine", Label.LeaderLinePath);
				}
			}
			if (View != null)
			{
				Path slicePath = View.GetSlicePath();
				pieSliceVisualData.SlicePath = new PathVisualData("slicePath", slicePath);
				pieSliceVisualData.Appearance.Fill = AppearanceHelper.FromBrush(slicePath.Fill);
				pieSliceVisualData.Appearance.Opacity = slicePath.Opacity;
				pieSliceVisualData.Appearance.Stroke = AppearanceHelper.FromBrush(slicePath.Stroke);
				pieSliceVisualData.Appearance.StrokeThickness = slicePath.StrokeThickness;
				pieSliceVisualData.Appearance.IsVisible = slicePath.Visibility == Visibility.Visible;
			}
			return pieSliceVisualData;
		}

		private static Point EllipsePointAlternate(double theta, double eccentricity, Point center, double halfHeight, double extent)
		{
			if (halfHeight == 0.0)
			{
				return center;
			}
			double num = Math.Cos(theta);
			double num2 = Math.Sin(theta);
			double num3 = Math.Sqrt(halfHeight * halfHeight / (1.0 - eccentricity * Math.Pow(num, 2.0)));
			num3 *= extent / 100.0;
			return new Point(num3 * num + center.X, num3 * num2 + center.Y);
		}
	}

		internal override void RenderPoints(PolarFrame frame, PolarBaseView view)
		{
			if (frame.Points.Count > 0)
			{
				Point point = frame.Points[0];
				Point point2 = frame.Points[frame.Points.Count - 1];
				if (point.X != point2.X || point.Y != point2.Y)
				{
					frame.Points.Add(frame.Points[0]);
				}
			}
			PolarAreaSeriesView obj = (PolarAreaSeriesView)view;
			obj.RenderPolarArea(frame.Points, base.Resolution);
			RenderManager.InitPolarRenderSettings(this, ShouldOverridePolarStyle(), GetPolarItems);
			bool flag = false;
			if (RenderManager.OverrideArgs != null)
			{
				flag = true;
			}
			if (flag)
			{
				PerformPolarStyleOverride(-1, base.AngleColumn.Count, view.IsThumbnailView);
			}
			Path polyline = obj.Polyline;
			Path polygon = obj.Polygon;
			RenderManager.SetShapeAppearance(polyline, strokeOnly: true, fillOnly: false, extended: true, useOutline: true);
			RenderManager.SetShapeAppearance(polygon, strokeOnly: false, fillOnly: true, extended: false, useOutline: false);
			polygon.Opacity = RenderManager.ActualRenderOpacity * base.ActualAreaFillOpacity;
		}

		internal override UnknownValuePlotting GetUnknownValuePlotting()
		{
			return UnknownValuePlotting;
		}

		public bool ClipSeriesToBounds
		{
			get
			{
				return (bool)GetValue(ClipSeriesToBoundsProperty);
			}
			set
			{
				SetValue(ClipSeriesToBoundsProperty, value);
			}
		}

				_actualItemSearchMode = value;
				if (actualItemSearchMode != _actualItemSearchMode)

					RaisePropertyChanged("ActualItemSearchMode", actualItemSearchMode, _actualItemSearchMode);
				}
			}
		}

			base.OnViewCreated(view);
			PolarView = (PolarBaseView)view;
