			RadiusAxis = null;
		}

		[SuppressWidgetMember]
		public override bool GetVisiblePointsOfInterest(List<SeriesPointOfInterest> points, bool useValueAsLabel, int labelPrecision)
		{
			if (!HasMarkers)
			{
				return false;
			}
			NumericAngleAxis angleAxis = AngleAxis;
			new ScalerParams(base.SeriesViewer.ActualWindowRect, base.Viewport, angleAxis.IsInverted).EffectiveViewportRect = GetEffectiveViewport(base.View);
			NumericRadiusAxis radiusAxis = RadiusAxis;
			new ScalerParams(base.SeriesViewer.ActualWindowRect, base.Viewport, radiusAxis.IsInverted).EffectiveViewportRect = GetEffectiveViewport(base.View);
			points.Clear();
			base.MarkerView.DoToAllMarkers(delegate(Marker m)
			{
				if (m.Visibility == Visibility.Visible)
				{
					SeriesPointOfInterest seriesPointOfInterest = new SeriesPointOfInterest();
					double num = 0.0;
					double num2 = 0.0;
					if (m.RenderTransform is MatrixTransform)
					{
						Point point = ((MatrixTransform)m.RenderTransform).Transform(new Point(0.0, 0.0));
						num = point.X + m.DesiredSize.Width / 2.0;
						num2 = point.Y + m.DesiredSize.Height / 2.0;
					}
					else
					{
						TranslateTransform obj = (TranslateTransform)m.RenderTransform;
						num = obj.X + m.DesiredSize.Width / 2.0;
						num2 = obj.Y + m.DesiredSize.Height / 2.0;
					}
					if (!(num < base.Viewport.Left) && !(num > base.Viewport.Right) && !(num2 < base.Viewport.Top) && !(num2 > base.Viewport.Bottom))
					{
						PolarAxes.GetUnscaledValues(num, num2, base.View.WindowRect, base.View.Viewport, out var unscaledAngle, out var unscaledRadius);
						seriesPointOfInterest.XValue = unscaledAngle;
						seriesPointOfInterest.YValue = unscaledRadius;
						seriesPointOfInterest.DataContext = (DataContext)m.Content;
						points.Add(seriesPointOfInterest);
					}
				}
			});
			return true;
		}

		public PolarBase()
		{
			RenderManager = new PolarSeriesRenderManager();
			ActualItemSearchMode = GetResolvedItemSearchMode();
			ThumbnailFrame = new PolarFrame();
			TransitionFrame.Retransform = RetransformPoint;
			PreviousFrame.Retransform = RetransformPoint;
			CurrentFrame.Retransform = RetransformPoint;
			SeriesRenderer = new SeriesRenderer<PolarFrame, PolarBaseView>(PrepareFrame, RenderFrame, base.AnimationActive, base.StartAnimation, CheckFlush);
		}

		private void CheckFlush()
		{
			if (base.Animator.NeedsFlush)
			{
				base.Animator.Flush();
			}
		}

		private void DoGetScaledPoints()
		{
			PolarAxes.GetScaledPoints(_operatingFrame.Transformed, AngleColumn, RadiusColumn, _operatingWindowRect, _operatingViewportRect, (int j, double a) => Math.Cos(a), (int j, double a) => Math.Sin(a), excludeOutOfRange: true);
		}

		internal PolarFrame GetActiveFrame()
		{
			PolarFrame result = CurrentFrame;
			if (AnimationActive())
			{
				if (base.Animator.NeedsFlush)
				{
					base.Animator.Flush();
				}
				result = TransitionFrame;
			}
			return result;
		}

		protected internal override void InvalidateAxes()
		{
			base.InvalidateAxes();
			if (RadiusAxis != null)
			{
				RadiusAxis.RenderAxis(animate: false);
			}
			if (AngleAxis != null)
			{
				AngleAxis.RenderAxis(animate: false);
			}
		}

		protected override void DataUpdatedOverride(FastItemsSourceEventAction action, int position, int count, string propertyName)
		{
			bool flag = false;
			PolarView.TrendLineManager.DataUpdated(action, position, count, propertyName);
			if (AngleAxis != null && !AngleAxis.UpdateRange())
			{
				flag = true;
			}
			if (RadiusAxis != null && !RadiusAxis.UpdateRange())
			{
				flag = true;
			}
			if (flag)
			{
				RenderSeries(animate: true);
			}
		}

		protected override void ViewportRectChangedOverride(Rect oldViewportRect, Rect newViewportRect)
		{
			RenderSeries(animate: false);
		}

		protected override void WindowRectChangedOverride(Rect oldWindowRect, Rect newWindowRect)
		{
			RenderSeries(animate: false);
		}

		protected internal override bool ValidateSeries(Rect viewportRect, Rect windowRect, SeriesView view)
		{
			bool result = true;
			if (!base.ValidateSeries(viewportRect, windowRect, view) || !view.HasSurface() || windowRect.IsEmpty || viewportRect.IsEmpty || AngleAxis == null || RadiusAxis == null || AngleColumn == null || RadiusColumn == null || AngleColumn.Count == 0 || RadiusColumn.Count == 0 || base.FastItemsSource == null || base.FastItemsSource.Count != AngleColumn.Count || base.FastItemsSource.Count != RadiusColumn.Count || PolarAxes == null || AngleAxis.SeriesViewer == null || RadiusAxis.SeriesViewer == null || AngleAxis.ActualMinimumValue == AngleAxis.ActualMaximumValue || RadiusAxis.ActualMinimumValue == RadiusAxis.ActualMaximumValue)
			{
				result = false;
			}
			return result;
		}

		protected internal override void RenderSeriesOverride(bool animate)
		{
			GetViewInfo(out var viewportRect, out var windowRect);
			if (!ValidateSeries(viewportRect, windowRect, base.View))
			{
				ClearRendering(wipeClean: true, base.View);
				return;
			}
			_operatingWindowRect = windowRect;
			_operatingViewportRect = viewportRect;
			AxisInfoCache = new PolarAxisInfoCache(AngleAxis, RadiusAxis, base.FastItemsSource);
			SeriesRenderingArguments args = new SeriesRenderingArguments(this, viewportRect, windowRect, animate, base.SkipPrepare);
			SeriesRenderer.Render(args, ref PreviousFrame, ref CurrentFrame, ref TransitionFrame, PolarView);
		}

		private Point RetransformPoint(Point from)
		{
			return PolarAxes.GetScaledPoint(from.X, from.Y, _operatingWindowRect, _operatingViewportRect, AxisInfoCache.AngleAxisIsLogarithmic, AxisInfoCache.AngleAxisIsInverted, AxisInfoCache.RadiusAxisIsLogarithmic, AxisInfoCache.RadiusAxisIsInverted, AxisInfoCache.RadiusExtentScale, AxisInfoCache.InnerRadiusExtentScale);
		}

		protected internal override AxisRange GetRange(Axis axis)
		{
			if (axis != null && axis == AngleAxis && AngleColumn != null)
			{
				return new AxisRange(AngleColumn.Minimum, AngleColumn.Maximum);
			}
			if (axis != null && axis == RadiusAxis && RadiusColumn != null)
			{
				return new AxisRange(RadiusColumn.Minimum, RadiusColumn.Maximum);
			}
			return null;
		}

		public override bool ScrollIntoView(object item)
		{
			Rect windowRect = base.View.WindowRect;
			Rect viewport = base.View.Viewport;
			int num = ((!windowRect.IsEmpty && !viewport.IsEmpty && base.FastItemsSource != null) ? base.FastItemsSource.IndexOf(item) : (-1));
			if (AngleAxis == null || AngleColumn == null || RadiusAxis == null || RadiusColumn == null)
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (num < 0 || num > AngleColumn.Count - 1 || num > RadiusColumn.Count - 1)
			{
				return false;
			}
			double scaledAngle = AngleAxis.GetScaledAngle(AngleColumn[num]);
			double scaledValue = RadiusAxis.GetScaledValue(RadiusColumn[num]);
			double num2 = 0.5 + Math.Cos(scaledAngle) * scaledValue;
			double num3 = 0.5 + Math.Sin(scaledAngle) * scaledValue;
			if (!double.IsNaN(num2))
			{
				if (num2 < windowRect.Left + 0.1 * windowRect.Width)
				{
					num2 += 0.4 * windowRect.Width;
					windowRect.X = num2 - 0.5 * windowRect.Width;
				}
				if (num2 > windowRect.Right - 0.1 * windowRect.Width)
				{
					num2 -= 0.4 * windowRect.Width;
					windowRect.X = num2 - 0.5 * windowRect.Width;
				}
			}
			if (!double.IsNaN(num3))
			{
				if (num3 < windowRect.Top + 0.1 * windowRect.Height)
				{
					num3 += 0.4 * windowRect.Height;
					windowRect.Y = num3 - 0.5 * windowRect.Height;
				}
				if (num3 > windowRect.Bottom - 0.1 * windowRect.Height)
				{
					num3 -= 0.4 * windowRect.Height;
					windowRect.Y = num3 - 0.5 * windowRect.Height;
				}
			}
			if (base.SyncLink != null)
			{
				base.SyncLink.WindowNotify(base.SeriesViewer, windowRect, force: true);
			}
			return num >= 0;
		}

		public override object GetItem(Point world)
		{
			int itemIndex = GetItemIndex(world);
			if (base.FastItemsSource != null && itemIndex >= 0 && itemIndex < base.FastItemsSource.Count)
			{
				return base.FastItemsSource[itemIndex];
			}
			return null;
		}

		public override int GetItemIndex(Point world)
		{
			return (int)Math.Round(GetExactItemIndex(world));
		}

		public override double GetExactItemIndex(Point world)
		{
			return ActualItemSearchMode switch
			{
				ScatterItemSearchMode.ClosestVisiblePoint => GetExactItemIndexForClosestVisiblePoint(world), 
				ScatterItemSearchMode.ClosestVisiblePointOnClosestLine => GetExactItemIndexForClosestVisiblePointOnClosestLine(world), 
				ScatterItemSearchMode.ClosestPoint => GetExactItemIndexForClosestPoint(world), 
				ScatterItemSearchMode.ClosestPointOnClosestLine => GetExactItemIndexForClosestPointOnClosestLine(world), 
				_ => -1.0, 
			};
		}

		protected virtual double GetExactItemIndexForClosestPointOnClosestLine(Point world)
		{
			return PointAlongLineHelper(world, visibleOnly: false);
		}

		protected virtual double GetExactItemIndexForClosestPoint(Point world)
		{
			Point point = FromWorldPosition(world);
			double x = point.X;
			double y = point.Y;
			if (base.FastItemsSource == null || AngleAxis == null || RadiusAxis == null || AngleColumn == null || RadiusColumn == null)
			{
				return -1.0;
			}
			if (base.FastItemsSource.Count > ItemSearchThreshold)
			{
				return -1.0;
			}
			EnsureCachedArrays();
			List<Point> transformedPoints = _transformedPoints;
			double num = double.MaxValue;
			int num2 = -1;
			for (int i = 0; i < AngleColumn.Count; i++)
			{
				double x2 = transformedPoints[i].X;
				double y2 = transformedPoints[i].Y;
				double num3 = (x - x2) * (x - x2) + (y - y2) * (y - y2);
				if (num3 < num)
				{
					num = num3;
					num2 = i;
				}
			}
			return num2;
		}

		private bool EnsureCachedArrays()
		{
			PolarFrame polarFrame = CurrentFrame;
			if (AnimationActive())
			{
				polarFrame = TransitionFrame;
			}
			if (polarFrame == null || polarFrame.Transformed.Count == 0)
			{
				return false;
			}
			_transformedPoints = polarFrame.Transformed;
			return true;
		}

		private double PointAlongLineHelper(Point world, bool visibleOnly)
		{
			if (!IsLineOrSpline)
			{
				return -1.0;
			}
			Point startPoint = new Point(0.0, 0.0);
			PolarFrame polarFrame = CurrentFrame;
			if (AnimationActive())
			{
				polarFrame = TransitionFrame;
			}
			if (polarFrame == null)
			{
				return -1.0;
			}
			if (polarFrame.Points == null)
			{
				return -1.0;
			}
			if (base.FastItemsSource.Count > ItemSearchThreshold)
			{
				return -1.0;
			}
			EnsureCachedArrays();
			List<Point> transformedPoints = _transformedPoints;
			Point targetPoint = FromWorldPosition(world);
			double num = double.MaxValue;
			int num2 = -1;
			for (int i = 0; i < transformedPoints.Count; i++)
			{
				Point point = transformedPoints[i];
				if (i > 0)
				{
					if (double.IsNaN(point.X) || double.IsNaN(point.Y) || double.IsNaN(startPoint.X) || double.IsNaN(startPoint.Y))
					{
						startPoint = point;
						continue;
					}
					if (!visibleOnly || polarFrame.Markers.ContainsKey(base.FastItemsSource[i]) || polarFrame.Markers.ContainsKey(base.FastItemsSource[i - 1]))
					{
						double num3 = GeometryUtil.DistSquaredToLineSegment(targetPoint, startPoint, point);
						if (num3 < num)
						{
							num = num3;
							num2 = i;
						}
					}
				}
				startPoint = point;
			}
			if (num2 >= 0)
			{
				Point endPoint = transformedPoints[num2];
				Point startPoint2 = transformedPoints[num2 - 1];
				if (!visibleOnly || (polarFrame.Markers.ContainsKey(base.FastItemsSource[num2]) && polarFrame.Markers.ContainsKey(base.FastItemsSource[num2 - 1])))
				{
					double num4 = GeometryUtil.ProjectPointToLineSegment(targetPoint, startPoint2, endPoint);
					return (double)(num2 - 1) + num4;
				}
				if (polarFrame.Markers.ContainsKey(base.FastItemsSource[num2]))
				{
					return num2;
				}
				return num2 - 1;
			}
			return -1.0;
		}

		protected virtual double GetExactItemIndexForClosestVisiblePointOnClosestLine(Point world)
		{
			return PointAlongLineHelper(world, visibleOnly: true);
		}

		protected virtual double GetExactItemIndexForClosestVisiblePoint(Point world)
		{
			Marker minDistMarker = null;
			double minDistance = double.MaxValue;
			Point point = FromWorldPosition(world);
			double posX = point.X;
			double posY = point.Y;
			if (PolarView.Markers.ActiveCount > ItemSearchThreshold)
			{
				return -1.0;
			}
			PolarView.DoToAllActiveMarkers(delegate(Marker m)
			{
				if (m.Visibility == Visibility.Visible)
				{
					Rect boundingBoxForMarker = PolarView.GetBoundingBoxForMarker(m);
					double num = boundingBoxForMarker.Left + boundingBoxForMarker.Width / 2.0;
					double num2 = boundingBoxForMarker.Top + boundingBoxForMarker.Height / 2.0;
					double num3 = (posX - num) * (posX - num) + (posY - num2) * (posY - num2);
					if (num3 < minDistance)
					{
						minDistance = num3;
						minDistMarker = m;
					}
				}
			});
			if (minDistMarker != null)
			{
				return minDistMarker.CurrentIndex;
			}
			return -1.0;
		}

		public override Point GetSeriesValuePosition(Point world, bool useInterpolation, bool skipUnknowns)
		{
			if (AngleAxis == null || RadiusAxis == null || AngleColumn == null || RadiusColumn == null)
			{
				return new Point(double.NaN, double.NaN);
			}
			Rect windowRect = base.View.WindowRect;
			Rect viewport = base.View.Viewport;
			Rect effectiveViewport = GetEffectiveViewport();
			new ScalerParams(windowRect, viewport, AngleAxis.IsInverted, effectiveViewport);
			new ScalerParams(windowRect, viewport, RadiusAxis.IsInverted, effectiveViewport).ReferenceValue = GetReferenceValue();
			if (useInterpolation)
			{
				double exactItemIndex = GetExactItemIndex(world);
				if (exactItemIndex == -1.0)
				{
					return new Point(double.NaN, double.NaN);
				}
				int num = (int)Math.Floor(exactItemIndex);
				int num2 = (int)Math.Ceiling(exactItemIndex);
				if (num < 0)
				{
					num = 0;
				}
				if (num2 < 0)
				{
					num2 = 0;
				}
				if (num2 > base.FastItemsSource.Count - 1)
				{
					num2 = base.FastItemsSource.Count - 1;
				}
				if (num > base.FastItemsSource.Count - 1)
				{
					num = base.FastItemsSource.Count - 1;
				}
				if (num2 == num)
				{
					return PolarAxes.GetScaledPoint(AngleColumn[num], RadiusColumn[num], windowRect, viewport, AxisInfoCache.AngleAxisIsLogarithmic, AxisInfoCache.AngleAxisIsInverted, AxisInfoCache.RadiusAxisIsLogarithmic, AxisInfoCache.RadiusAxisIsInverted, AxisInfoCache.RadiusExtentScale, AxisInfoCache.InnerRadiusExtentScale);
				}
				double num3 = exactItemIndex - Math.Floor(exactItemIndex);
				Point scaledPoint = PolarAxes.GetScaledPoint(AngleColumn[num], RadiusColumn[num], windowRect, viewport, AxisInfoCache.AngleAxisIsLogarithmic, AxisInfoCache.AngleAxisIsInverted, AxisInfoCache.RadiusAxisIsLogarithmic, AxisInfoCache.RadiusAxisIsInverted, AxisInfoCache.RadiusExtentScale, AxisInfoCache.InnerRadiusExtentScale);
				Point scaledPoint2 = PolarAxes.GetScaledPoint(AngleColumn[num2], RadiusColumn[num2], windowRect, viewport, AxisInfoCache.AngleAxisIsLogarithmic, AxisInfoCache.AngleAxisIsInverted, AxisInfoCache.RadiusAxisIsLogarithmic, AxisInfoCache.RadiusAxisIsInverted, AxisInfoCache.RadiusExtentScale, AxisInfoCache.InnerRadiusExtentScale);
				double x = scaledPoint.X;
				double y = scaledPoint.Y;
				double x2 = scaledPoint2.X;
				double y2 = scaledPoint2.Y;
				double num4 = x2 - x;
				double num5 = y2 - y;
				return new Point(x + num4 * num3, y + num5 * num3);
			}
			int itemIndex = GetItemIndex(world);
			if (itemIndex == -1)
			{
				return new Point(double.NaN, double.NaN);
			}
			return PolarAxes.GetScaledPoint(AngleColumn[itemIndex], RadiusColumn[itemIndex], windowRect, viewport, AxisInfoCache.AngleAxisIsLogarithmic, AxisInfoCache.AngleAxisIsInverted, AxisInfoCache.RadiusAxisIsLogarithmic, AxisInfoCache.RadiusAxisIsInverted, AxisInfoCache.RadiusExtentScale, AxisInfoCache.InnerRadiusExtentScale);
		}

		public override Axis[] GetAxes()
		{
			return new Axis[2] { AngleAxis, RadiusAxis };
		}

		public override object GetItemValue(object item, string memberPathName)
		{
			string text = ResolveMemberPath(memberPathName);
			if (text == "AngleMemberPath")
			{
				return GetItemValueByMemberPath(item, memberPathName, AngleMemberPath);
			}
			if (text == "RadiusMemberPath")
			{
				return GetItemValueByMemberPath(item, memberPathName, RadiusMemberPath);
			}
			return base.GetItemValue(item, memberPathName);
		}

		protected override void PropertyUpdatedOverride(object sender, string propertyName, object oldValue, object newValue)
		{
			base.PropertyUpdatedOverride(sender, propertyName, oldValue, newValue);
			if (PolarView.TrendLineManager.PropertyUpdated(sender, propertyName, oldValue, newValue))
			{
				RenderSeries(animate: false);
				NotifyThumbnailAppearanceChanged();
			}
			switch (propertyName)
			{
			case "FastItemsSource":
				if (oldValue is IFastItemsSource)
				{
					((IFastItemsSource)oldValue).DeregisterColumn(AngleColumn);
					((IFastItemsSource)oldValue).DeregisterColumn(RadiusColumn);
					AngleColumn = null;
					RadiusColumn = null;
				}
				if (newValue is IFastItemsSource)
				{
					AngleColumn = RegisterDoubleColumn(AngleMemberPath);
					RadiusColumn = RegisterDoubleColumn(RadiusMemberPath);
				}
				if ((RadiusAxis != null && !RadiusAxis.UpdateRange()) || (AngleAxis != null && !AngleAxis.UpdateRange()))
				{
					RenderSeries(animate: false);
				}
				break;
			case "AngleAxis":
				if (AngleAxis != null && RadiusAxis != null)
				{
					PolarAxes = new PolarAxes(RadiusAxis, AngleAxis);
				}
				if (oldValue != null)
				{
					((Axis)oldValue).DeregisterSeries(this);
				}
				if (newValue != null)
				{
					((Axis)newValue).RegisterSeries(this);
				}
				if (AngleAxis != null && !AngleAxis.UpdateRange())
				{
					RenderSeries(animate: false);
				}
				else if (oldValue != null && newValue == null)
				{
					ClearRendering(wipeClean: true, base.View);
				}
				break;
			case "RadiusAxis":
				if (AngleAxis != null && RadiusAxis != null)
				{
					PolarAxes = new PolarAxes(RadiusAxis, AngleAxis);
				}
				if (oldValue != null)
				{
					((Axis)oldValue).DeregisterSeries(this);
				}
				if (newValue != null)
				{
					((Axis)newValue).RegisterSeries(this);
				}
				if (RadiusAxis != null && !RadiusAxis.UpdateRange())
				{
					RenderSeries(animate: false);
				}
				else if (oldValue != null && newValue == null)
				{
					ClearRendering(wipeClean: true, base.View);
				}
				if (AngleAxis != null && !AngleAxis.UpdateRange())
				{
					AngleAxis.Refresh();
				}
				break;
			case "AngleMemberPath":
				if (base.FastItemsSource != null)
				{
					base.FastItemsSource.DeregisterColumn(AngleColumn);
					AngleColumn = RegisterDoubleColumn(AngleMemberPath);
				}
				break;
			case "AngleColumn":
				PolarView.TrendLineManager.Reset();
				if (AngleAxis != null && !AngleAxis.UpdateRange())
				{
					RenderSeries(animate: false);
				}
				break;
			case "RadiusMemberPath":
				if (base.FastItemsSource != null)
				{
					base.FastItemsSource.DeregisterColumn(RadiusColumn);
					RadiusColumn = RegisterDoubleColumn(RadiusMemberPath);
				}
				break;
			case "RadiusColumn":
				PolarView.TrendLineManager.Reset();
				if (RadiusAxis != null && !RadiusAxis.UpdateRange())
				{
					RenderSeries(animate: false);
				}
				break;
			case "UseCartesianInterpolation":
				RenderSeries(animate: false);
				NotifyThumbnailAppearanceChanged();
				break;
			case "MaximumMarkers":
				RenderSeries(animate: false);
				NotifyThumbnailAppearanceChanged();
				break;
			case "TransitionProgress":
				AxisInfoCache = new PolarAxisInfoCache(AngleAxis, RadiusAxis, base.FastItemsSource);
				_operatingWindowRect = base.View.WindowRect;
				_operatingViewportRect = base.View.Viewport;
				TransitionFrame.UseCartesianInterpolation = UseCartesianInterpolation;
				TransitionFrame.Interpolate((float)base.TransitionProgress, PreviousFrame, CurrentFrame);
				if (!ClearAndAbortIfInvalid(base.View))
				{
					if (base.TransitionProgress == 1.0)
					{
						RenderFrame(CurrentFrame, PolarView);
					}
					else
					{
						RenderFrame(TransitionFrame, PolarView);
					}
					if (base.SeriesViewer != null)
					{
						base.SeriesViewer.RaiseSeriesAnimating(this);
					}
				}
				break;
			case "TrendLineBrush":
				UpdateIndexedProperties();
				break;
			case "ClipSeriesToBounds":
				RenderSeries(animate: false);
				NotifyThumbnailAppearanceChanged();
				break;
			case "TrendLineType":
				NotifyThumbnailAppearanceChanged();
				break;
			case "IsCustomPolarStyleAllowed":
				ActualIsCustomPolarStyleAllowed = ResolveIsCustomPolarStyleAllowed();
				RenderSeries(animate: false);
				break;
			case "IsCustomPolarMarkerStyleAllowed":
				ActualIsCustomPolarMarkerStyleAllowed = ResolveIsCustomPolarMarkerStyleAllowed();
				RenderSeries(animate: false);
				break;
			case "ItemSearchMode":
				ActualItemSearchMode = GetResolvedItemSearchMode();
				break;
			}
		}

		protected virtual ScatterItemSearchMode GetResolvedItemSearchMode()
		{
			if (ItemSearchMode != ScatterItemSearchMode.Auto)
			{
				return ItemSearchMode;
			}
			if (!IsLineOrSpline)
			{
				return ScatterItemSearchMode.ClosestVisiblePoint;
			}
			return ScatterItemSearchMode.ClosestPointOnClosestLine;
		}

		protected virtual bool ResolveIsCustomPolarStyleAllowed()
		{
			return IsCustomPolarStyleAllowed;
		}

		protected virtual bool ResolveIsCustomPolarMarkerStyleAllowed()
		{
			return IsCustomPolarMarkerStyleAllowed;
		}

		[UwpSuppressWidgetMember]

				return true;
			}
			return false;
		}

		protected internal override void ClearRendering(bool wipeClean, SeriesView view)
		{
			base.ClearRendering(wipeClean, view);
			PolarBaseView polarBaseView = (PolarBaseView)view;
			if (wipeClean)
			{
				polarBaseView.Markers.Clear();
			}
			polarBaseView.TrendLineManager.ClearPoints();
		}

		private Clipper GetTrendlineClipper(Rect viewportRect, IList<Point> target)
		{
			double top = viewportRect.Top - 10.0;
			double bottom = viewportRect.Bottom + 10.0;
			double left = viewportRect.Left - 10.0;
			double right = viewportRect.Right + 10.0;
			return new Clipper(left, bottom, right, top, isClosed: false)
			{
				Target = target
			};
		}

		internal virtual void CalculateCachedPoints(PolarFrame frame, int count, Rect windowRect, Rect viewportRect)
		{
			frame.CachedPoints = new Dictionary<object, OwnedPoint>(count);
			IFastItemsSource fastItemsSource = base.FastItemsSource;
			for (int i = 0; i < count; i++)
			{
				Point point = frame.Transformed[i];
				if (!double.IsInfinity(point.X) && !double.IsInfinity(point.Y))
				{
					Point columnValues = new Point(AngleColumn[i], RadiusColumn[i]);
					Point point2 = new Point(point.X, point.Y);
					frame.CachedPoints.Add(fastItemsSource[i], new OwnedPoint
					{
						OwnerItem = fastItemsSource[i],
						ColumnValues = columnValues,
						Point = point2
					});
				}
			}
		}

		internal virtual void PrepareFrame(PolarFrame frame, PolarBaseView view)
		{
			Rect windowRect = view.WindowRect;
			Rect viewportRect = view.Viewport;
			frame.Markers.Clear();
			frame.TrendLine.Clear();
			int num = Math.Min((AngleColumn != null) ? AngleColumn.Count : 0, (RadiusColumn != null) ? RadiusColumn.Count : 0);
			if (num < 1)
			{
				return;
			}
			AxisInfoCache = new PolarAxisInfoCache(AngleAxis, RadiusAxis, base.FastItemsSource);
			_operatingFrame = frame;
			_operatingViewportRect = viewportRect;
			_operatingWindowRect = windowRect;
			view.MarkerManager.WinnowMarkers(frame.Markers, MaximumMarkers, windowRect, viewportRect, base.Resolution);
			if (num <= MaximumMarkers)
			{
				CalculateCachedPoints(frame, num, windowRect, viewportRect);
			}
			Clipper trendlineClipper = GetTrendlineClipper(viewportRect, frame.TrendLine);
			double num2 = Math.Min(AngleAxis.ActualMinimumValue, AngleAxis.ActualMaximumValue);
			double num3 = Math.Max(AngleAxis.ActualMaximumValue, AngleAxis.ActualMinimumValue);
			view.TrendLineManager.UseCartesianInterpolation = UseCartesianInterpolation;
			view.TrendLineManager.UnknownValuePlotting = UnknownValuePlotting.LinearInterpolate;
			view.TrendLineManager.RadiusExtentScale = RadiusAxis.ActualRadiusExtentScale;
			view.TrendLineManager.InnerRadiusExtentScale = RadiusAxis.ActualInnerRadiusExtentScale;
			view.TrendLineManager.ProjectX = (double angle, double radius) => PolarAxes.GetXValue(angle, radius, windowRect, viewportRect, Math.Cos);
			view.TrendLineManager.ProjectY = (double angle, double radius) => PolarAxes.GetYValue(angle, radius, windowRect, viewportRect, Math.Sin);
			List<double> list = new List<double>();
			for (int num4 = 0; num4 < AngleColumn.Count; num4++)
			{
				if (AngleColumn[num4] >= num2 && AngleColumn[num4] <= num3)
				{
					list.Add(AngleColumn[num4]);
				}
			}
			IList<double> list2 = RadiusColumn;
			if (list.Count != AngleColumn.Count)
			{
				list2 = new List<double>();
				for (int num5 = 0; num5 < AngleColumn.Count; num5++)
				{
					if (AngleColumn[num5] >= num2 && AngleColumn[num5] <= num3)
					{
						list2.Add(RadiusColumn[num5]);
					}
				}
			}
			view.TrendLineManager.PrepareLine(frame.TrendLine, TrendLineType, list, list2, TrendLinePeriod, AngleAxis.GetScaledAngle, RadiusAxis.GetScaledValue, new TrendResolutionParams
			{
				Resolution = base.Resolution,
				Viewport = viewportRect,
				Window = windowRect
			}, trendlineClipper, num2, num3);
		}

		protected virtual HighlightingInfo GetSpecificHighlightingInfo(object item, Point world, HighlightingInfo prevValue)
		{
			return null;
		}

		protected HighlightingInfo GetSpecificMarkerHighlightingInfo(object item, Point world, HighlightingInfo prevValue)
		{
			GetActiveFrame();
			Marker hitMarker = PolarView.GetHitMarker(FromWorldPosition(world));
			int num = -1;
			if (hitMarker == null)
			{
				if (item == null)
				{
					return null;
				}
				num = base.FastItemsSource.IndexOf(item);
			}
			else
			{
				num = hitMarker.CurrentIndex;
			}
			if (num == -1)
			{
				return null;
			}
			HighlightingInfo highlightingInfo = new HighlightingInfo();
			highlightingInfo.Series = this;
			highlightingInfo.StartIndex = num;
			highlightingInfo.EndIndex = num;
			highlightingInfo.IsFullRange = false;
			highlightingInfo.IsMarker = true;
			if (prevValue != null && prevValue.StartIndex == highlightingInfo.StartIndex && prevValue.EndIndex == highlightingInfo.EndIndex)
			{
				return prevValue;
			}
			return highlightingInfo;
		}

		protected HighlightingInfo GetFullSeriesInfo(object item, Point world, HighlightingInfo prevValue)
		{
			HighlightingInfo highlightingInfo = new HighlightingInfo();
			highlightingInfo.Series = this;
			highlightingInfo.StartIndex = 0;
			highlightingInfo.EndIndex = base.FastItemsSource.Count - 1;
			highlightingInfo.IsFullRange = true;
			if (prevValue != null && prevValue.StartIndex == highlightingInfo.StartIndex && prevValue.EndIndex == highlightingInfo.EndIndex)
			{
				return prevValue;
			}
			return highlightingInfo;
		}

		protected internal override HighlightingInfo GetHighlightingInfo(object item, Point world, bool forceFullRange)
		{
			if (HasIndividualElements && IsSpecificHighlightingMode(base.ActualHighlightingMode) && !forceFullRange)
			{
				return PrevHighlightingInfo = GetSpecificHighlightingInfo(item, world, PrevHighlightingInfo);
			}
			return PrevHighlightingInfo = GetFullSeriesInfo(item, world, PrevHighlightingInfo);
		}

		protected internal override HighlightingInfo GetMarkerHighlightingInfo(object item, Point world, bool forceFullRange)
		{
			if (IsSpecificHighlightingMode(base.ActualHighlightingMode) && !forceFullRange)
			{
				return PrevMarkerHighlightingInfo = GetSpecificMarkerHighlightingInfo(item, world, PrevMarkerHighlightingInfo);
			}
			HighlightingInfo fullSeriesInfo = GetFullSeriesInfo(item, world, PrevMarkerHighlightingInfo);
			fullSeriesInfo.IsMarker = true;
			PrevMarkerHighlightingInfo = fullSeriesInfo;
			return fullSeriesInfo;
		}

		protected bool ShouldOverridePolarStyle()
		{
			if (this.AssigningPolarStyle == null || !ActualIsCustomPolarStyleAllowed)
			{
				return base.ActualHighlightingMode != SeriesHighlightingMode.None;
			}
			return true;
		}

		protected bool ShouldOverrideMarkerStyle()
		{
			if (this.AssigningPolarMarkerStyle == null || !ActualIsCustomPolarMarkerStyleAllowed)
			{
				return base.ActualHighlightingMode != SeriesHighlightingMode.None;
			}
			return true;
		}

		internal virtual void RenderFrame(PolarFrame frame, PolarBaseView view)
		{
			Rect windowRect = view.WindowRect;
			Rect viewport = view.Viewport;
			Rect effectiveViewport = GetEffectiveViewport(view);
			Rect contentViewport = GetContentViewport(view);
			AxisInfoCache = new PolarAxisInfoCache(AngleAxis, RadiusAxis, base.FastItemsSource);
			if (ShouldDisplayMarkers())
			{
				view.MarkerManager.Render(frame.Markers, base.UseLightweightMarkers);
				if (ShouldOverrideMarkerStyle())
				{
					ColorizeMarkers(view, frame);
				}
			}
			view.RenderMarkers();
			Clipper trendlineClipper = GetTrendlineClipper(viewport, view.TrendLineManager.TrendPolyline.Points);
			view.TrendLineManager.RasterizeTrendLine(frame.TrendLine, trendlineClipper);
			ApplyClipping(viewport, windowRect, effectiveViewport, contentViewport, view);
		}

		[SuppressWidgetMember]
		public virtual object[] GetPolarItems(int startIndex, int endIndex)
		{
			return GetPolarItemsHelper(startIndex, endIndex);
		}

		protected object[] GetPolarItemsHelper(int orderedStartIndex, int orderedEndIndex)
		{
			if (orderedEndIndex < orderedStartIndex || orderedStartIndex < 0 || orderedStartIndex > AngleColumn.Count || orderedEndIndex < 0 || orderedEndIndex > AngleColumn.Count)
			{
				return null;
			}
			object[] array = new object[orderedEndIndex - orderedStartIndex + 1];
			for (int i = orderedStartIndex; i <= orderedEndIndex; i++)
			{
				array[i - orderedStartIndex] = base.FastItemsSource[i];
			}
			return array;
		}

		internal void ColorizeMarkers(PolarBaseView view, PolarFrame frame)
		{
			view.MarkerAppearanceHandled = true;
			RenderManager.InitPolarMarkerRenderSettings(this, ShouldOverrideMarkerStyle(), GetPolarItems);
			AssigningSeriesStyleEventArgsBase markerOverrideArgs = RenderManager.MarkerOverrideArgs;
			bool areMarkerStylesOverriden = markerOverrideArgs != null;
			GetEffectiveViewport(view);
			int valueCount = ((base.FastItemsSource != null) ? base.FastItemsSource.Count : 0);
			PolarView.DoToAllMarkers(delegate(Marker marker)
			{
				if (marker.Visibility == Visibility.Visible)
				{
					int currentIndex = marker.CurrentIndex;
					DataContext dataContext = (DataContext)marker.Content;
					if (dataContext == null)
					{
						dataContext = (DataContext)(marker.Content = new DataContext());
					}
					if (areMarkerStylesOverriden)
					{
						PerformPolarMarkerStyleOverride(currentIndex, valueCount, view.IsThumbnailView);
					}
					RenderManager.SetMarkerAppearance(marker, dataContext);
				}
			});
		}

		protected void PerformPolarStyleOverride(int currentIndex, int valueCount, bool isThumbnail)
		{
			bool flag = base.ActualHighlightingMode != SeriesHighlightingMode.None;
			RenderManager.PopulateArgsBounds(RenderManager.OverrideArgs, currentIndex, valueCount, isMarker: false);
			RenderManager.PrePerformStyleOverride(base.ActualHighlightingFadeOpacity);
			AssigningPolarStyleEventArgs polarOverrideArgs = RenderManager.PolarOverrideArgs;
			HighlightingInfo info = null;
			IFastItemsSource fastItemsSource = base.FastItemsSource;
			if (flag && base.SeriesViewer != null)
			{
				info = (polarOverrideArgs.HighlightingInfo = base.SeriesViewer.HighlightingManager.GetHighlightingInfo(this, fastItemsSource, polarOverrideArgs.StartIndex, polarOverrideArgs.EndIndex, isMarker: false));
			}
			polarOverrideArgs.IsThumbnail = isThumbnail;
			RaiseAssigningPolarStyles(polarOverrideArgs);
			RenderManager.PostPerformStyleOverride(this, info, isThumbnail, flag, currentIndex < 0);
		}

		protected void PerformPolarMarkerStyleOverride(int currentIndex, int valueCount, bool isThumbnail)
		{
			bool flag = base.ActualHighlightingMode != SeriesHighlightingMode.None;
			RenderManager.PopulateArgsBounds(RenderManager.MarkerOverrideArgs, currentIndex, valueCount, isMarker: true);
			RenderManager.PrePerformMarkerStyleOverride(base.ActualHighlightingFadeOpacity);
			AssigningPolarMarkerStyleEventArgs polarMarkerOverrideArgs = RenderManager.PolarMarkerOverrideArgs;
			HighlightingInfo highlightingInfo = null;
			IFastItemsSource fastItemsSource = base.FastItemsSource;
			if (flag && base.SeriesViewer != null)
			{
				highlightingInfo = base.SeriesViewer.HighlightingManager.GetHighlightingInfo(this, fastItemsSource, polarMarkerOverrideArgs.StartIndex, polarMarkerOverrideArgs.EndIndex, isMarker: true);
				if (base.SeriesViewer.HighlightingManager.IsCrossSeriesHighlight(this))
				{
					base.SeriesViewer.HighlightingManager.GetHighlightingInfo(this, fastItemsSource, polarMarkerOverrideArgs.StartIndex, polarMarkerOverrideArgs.EndIndex, isMarker: true);
				}
				polarMarkerOverrideArgs.HighlightingInfo = highlightingInfo;
			}
			polarMarkerOverrideArgs.IsThumbnail = isThumbnail;
			RaiseAssigningPolarMarkerStyles(polarMarkerOverrideArgs);
			RenderManager.PostPerformMarkerStyleOverride(this, highlightingInfo, isThumbnail, flag, polarMarkerOverrideArgs.SumAllSeriesHighlightingProgress, base.SeriesViewer.HighlightingManager.SumHighlightingProgress);
		}

		protected void RaiseAssigningPolarStyles(AssigningPolarStyleEventArgs args)
		{
			if (this.AssigningPolarStyle != null && ActualIsCustomPolarStyleAllowed)
			{
				this.AssigningPolarStyle(this, args);
			}
		}

		protected void RaiseAssigningPolarMarkerStyles(AssigningPolarMarkerStyleEventArgs args)
		{
			if (this.AssigningPolarMarkerStyle != null && ActualIsCustomPolarMarkerStyleAllowed)
			{
				this.AssigningPolarMarkerStyle(this, args);
			}
		}

		private void ApplyClipping(Rect viewportRect, Rect windowRect, Rect effectiveViewportRect, Rect contentViewport, PolarBaseView view)
		{
			view.ApplyClipping(viewportRect, windowRect, effectiveViewportRect, contentViewport);
		}

		protected override void UpdateIndexedProperties()
		{
			base.UpdateIndexedProperties();
			if (base.Index >= 0)
			{
				PolarView.UpdateTrendlineBrush();
			}
		}

		protected internal override void RenderThumbnail(Rect viewportRect, RenderSurface surface)
		{
			base.RenderThumbnail(viewportRect, surface);
			if (!base.ThumbnailDirty)
			{
				base.View.PrepSurface(surface);
				return;
			}
			base.View.PrepSurface(surface);
			if (!ClearAndAbortIfInvalid(base.ThumbnailView))
			{
				PolarBaseView view = (PolarBaseView)base.ThumbnailView;
				if (!base.SkipThumbnailPrepare)
				{
					ThumbnailFrame = new PolarFrame();
					PrepareFrame(ThumbnailFrame, view);
				}
				base.SkipThumbnailPrepare = false;
				RenderFrame(ThumbnailFrame, view);
				base.ThumbnailDirty = false;
			}
		}

		public override void RenderAlternateView(Rect viewportRect, Rect windowRect, RenderSurface surface, string viewIdentifier, double effectiveScalingRatio)
		{
			base.RenderAlternateView(viewportRect, windowRect, surface, viewIdentifier, effectiveScalingRatio);
			SeriesView seriesView = base.SeriesInteractionManager.AlternateViews[viewIdentifier];
			PolarBaseView view = (PolarBaseView)seriesView;
			seriesView.PrepAltSurface(surface);
			if (!ClearAndAbortIfInvalid(view))
			{
				if (AlternateFrame == null)
				{
					AlternateFrame = new PolarFrame();
				}
				PrepareFrame(AlternateFrame, view);
				RenderFrame(AlternateFrame, view);
			}
		}

		internal void RemoveUnusedMarkers(IDictionary<object, OwnedPoint> list, HashPool<object, Marker> markers)
		{
			List<object> list2 = new List<object>();
			foreach (object activeKey in markers.ActiveKeys)
			{
				if (!list.ContainsKey(activeKey))
				{
					list2.Add(activeKey);
				}
			}
			foreach (object item in list2)
			{
				markers.Remove(item);
			}
		}

		internal Point[] GetMarkerLocations(HashPool<object, Marker> Markers, Rect WindowRect, Rect Viewport)
		{
			DoGetScaledPoints();
			return _operatingFrame.Transformed.ToArray();
		}

		internal List<int> GetActiveIndexes(HashPool<object, Marker> Markers)
		{
			List<int> list = new List<int>();
			IFastItemsSource fastItemsSource = base.FastItemsSource;
			foreach (object activeKey in PolarView.Markers.ActiveKeys)
			{
				list.Add(fastItemsSource.IndexOf(activeKey));
			}
			return list;
		}

		internal Point GetColumnValues(int i)
		{
			return new Point(AngleColumn[i], RadiusColumn[i]);
		}

		protected override void ExportVisualDataOverride(object svd)
		{
			base.ExportVisualDataOverride(svd);
			base.SeriesVisualDataManager.ExportTrendlineData(this, svd, PolarView.TrendLineManager.TrendPolyline);
		}

		internal override DataContext GetTooltipContext(object item)
		{
			if (item != null)
			{
				Type type = item.GetType();
				FastReflectionHelper fastReflectionHelper = new FastReflectionHelper(useTraditionalReflection: false, AngleMemberPath);
				object propertyValue = fastReflectionHelper.GetPropertyValue(type, item);
				fastReflectionHelper.PropertyName = RadiusMemberPath;
				object propertyValue2 = fastReflectionHelper.GetPropertyValue(type, item);
				return new PolarBaseDataContext
				{
					Series = this,
					Item = item,
					ItemAngle = propertyValue,
					ItemRadius = propertyValue2
				};
			}
			return new DataContext
			{
				Series = this,
				Item = item
			};
		}
	}
	internal class PolarFrame : ScatterFrameBase<PolarFrame>
	{
		public List<Point> Transformed { get; set; }

		public bool UseCartesianInterpolation { get; set; }

		public Func<Point, Point> Retransform { get; set; }

		public PolarFrame()
		{
			Transformed = new List<Point>();
			UseCartesianInterpolation = true;
		}

		protected override void InterpolateOverride(float p, Frame minFrame, Frame maxFrame)
		{
			PolarFrame polarFrame = minFrame as PolarFrame;
			PolarFrame polarFrame2 = maxFrame as PolarFrame;
			if (polarFrame != null && polarFrame2 != null)
			{
				Frame.Interpolate(Transformed, p, polarFrame.Transformed, polarFrame2.Transformed);
			}
		}

		protected override void InterpolateColumnValues(OwnedPoint point, float p, OwnedPoint minPoint, OwnedPoint maxPoint)
		{
			if (UseCartesianInterpolation)
			{
				base.InterpolateColumnValues(point, p, minPoint, maxPoint);
				return;
			}
			base.InterpolateColumnValues(point, p, minPoint, maxPoint);
			if (minPoint != null && maxPoint != null && (minPoint.ColumnValues.X != maxPoint.ColumnValues.X || minPoint.ColumnValues.Y != maxPoint.ColumnValues.Y))
			{
				double num = 1.0 - (double)p;
				point.ColumnValues = new Point(minPoint.ColumnValues.X * num + maxPoint.ColumnValues.X * (double)p, minPoint.ColumnValues.Y * num + maxPoint.ColumnValues.Y * (double)p);
			}
		}

		private bool IsPlottable(Point point)
		{
			if (!double.IsNaN(point.X) && !double.IsNaN(point.Y) && !double.IsInfinity(point.X))
			{
				return !double.IsInfinity(point.Y);
			}
			return false;
		}

		protected override void InterpolatePointOverride(OwnedPoint point, double p, OwnedPoint min, OwnedPoint max)
		{
			if (UseCartesianInterpolation)
			{
				base.InterpolatePointOverride(point, p, min, max);
			}
			else if (min != null && max != null && (min.Point.X != max.Point.X || min.Point.Y != max.Point.Y) && IsPlottable(point.ColumnValues))
			{
				point.Point = Retransform(point.ColumnValues);
			}
			else
			{
				base.InterpolatePointOverride(point, p, min, max);
			}
		}
	}
	public sealed class PolarLineSeries : PolarLineSeriesBase
	{
		private const string UnknownValuePlottingPropertyName = "UnknownValuePlotting";

		public static readonly DependencyProperty UnknownValuePlottingProperty = DependencyProperty.Register("UnknownValuePlotting", typeof(UnknownValuePlotting), typeof(PolarLineSeries), new PropertyMetadata(UnknownValuePlotting.DontPlot, delegate(DependencyObject sender, DependencyPropertyChangedEventArgs e)
		{
			((PolarLineSeries)sender).RaisePropertyChanged("UnknownValuePlotting", e.OldValue, e.NewValue);
		}));

		public override bool IsLineOnly => true;

		[TSSuppressSynthesizedInitializer]
		internal PolarLineSeriesView PolarLineView { get; set; }

		[WidgetDefaultString("dontPlot")]
		public UnknownValuePlotting UnknownValuePlotting
		{
			get
			{
				return (UnknownValuePlotting)GetValue(UnknownValuePlottingProperty);
			}
			set
			{
				SetValue(UnknownValuePlottingProperty, value);
			}
		}

		protected override SeriesView CreateView()
		{
			return new PolarLineSeriesView(this);
		}

		protected internal override void OnViewCreated(SeriesView view)
		{
			base.OnViewCreated(view);
			PolarLineView = (PolarLineSeriesView)view;
		}

		public PolarLineSeries()
		{
			base.DefaultStyleKey = typeof(PolarLineSeries);
		}

		protected override void ClearPoints(SeriesView view)
		{
			((PolarLineSeriesView)view).ClearPolarLine();
		}

		internal override void RenderPoints(PolarFrame frame, PolarBaseView view)
		{
			((PolarLineSeriesView)view).RenderPolarLine(frame.Points, base.Resolution);
			RenderManager.InitPolarRenderSettings(this, ShouldOverridePolarStyle(), GetPolarItems);
			bool flag = false;
			if (RenderManager.OverrideArgs != null)
			{
				flag = true;
			}
			if (flag)
			{
				PerformPolarStyleOverride(-1, base.AngleColumn.Count, view.IsThumbnailView);
			}
			RenderManager.SetShapeAppearance(((PolarLineSeriesView)view).polyline, strokeOnly: true, fillOnly: false, extended: true, useOutline: false);
		}

		internal override UnknownValuePlotting GetUnknownValuePlotting()
		{
			return UnknownValuePlotting;
		}

		protected override void PropertyUpdatedOverride(object sender, string propertyName, object oldValue, object newValue)
		{
			base.PropertyUpdatedOverride(sender, propertyName, oldValue, newValue);
			if (propertyName == "UnknownValuePlotting")
			{
				RenderSeries(animate: false);
				NotifyThumbnailAppearanceChanged();
			}
		}
	}
	public abstract class PolarLineSeriesBase : PolarBase
	{
		protected override bool IsLineOrSpline => true;

		[TSSuppressSynthesizedInitializer]
		internal PolarLineSeriesBaseView PolarLineBaseView { get; set; }

		internal PathRenderer CartesianRenderer { get; set; }

		internal PathRenderer PolarRenderer { get; set; }

		protected virtual bool ClippingDisabled => false;

		protected virtual bool IsClosed => false;

		internal PathRenderer CurrentRenderer { get; set; }

		protected override SeriesView CreateView()
		{
			return new PolarLineSeriesBaseView(this);
		}

		protected internal override void OnViewCreated(SeriesView view)
		{
			base.OnViewCreated(view);
			PolarLineBaseView = (PolarLineSeriesBaseView)view;
		}

		public PolarLineSeriesBase()
		{
			CartesianRenderer = new PathRenderer(new DefaultFlattener());
			PolarRenderer = new PathRenderer();
		}

		internal virtual UnknownValuePlotting GetUnknownValuePlotting()
		{
			return UnknownValuePlotting.DontPlot;
		}

		internal override void PrepareFrame(PolarFrame frame, PolarBaseView view)
		{
			base.PrepareFrame(frame, view);
			frame.Points.Clear();
			Rect windowRect = view.WindowRect;
			Rect viewport = view.Viewport;
			int val = ((base.AngleColumn != null) ? base.AngleColumn.Count : 0);
			int val2 = ((base.RadiusColumn != null) ? base.RadiusColumn.Count : 0);
			int num = Math.Min(val, val2);
			PolarLinePlanner polarLinePlanner = new PolarLinePlanner
			{
				AngleProvider = (int i) => base.AxisInfoCache.AngleAxis.GetScaledAngle(base.AngleColumn[i], base.AxisInfoCache.AngleAxisIsLogarithmic, base.AxisInfoCache.AngleAxisIsInverted),
				Count = num,
				RadiusProvider = (int i2) => base.RadiusAxis.GetScaledValue(base.RadiusColumn[i2], base.AxisInfoCache.RadiusAxisIsLogarithmic, base.AxisInfoCache.RadiusAxisIsInverted, base.AxisInfoCache.RadiusExtentScale, base.AxisInfoCache.InnerRadiusExtentScale),
				Resolution = base.Resolution,
				UseCartesianInterpolation = base.UseCartesianInterpolation,
				UnknownValuePlotting = GetUnknownValuePlotting(),
				TransformedXProvider = (int i3) => GetTransformedX(frame, i3),
				TransformedYProvider = (int i4) => GetTransformedY(frame, i4),
				Viewport = viewport,
				Window = windowRect,
				IsClosed = IsClosed,
				ClippingDisabled = ClippingDisabled
			};
			List<int> list = new List<int>();
			for (int num2 = 0; num2 < num; num2++)
			{
				if (IndexViable(num2))
				{
					list.Add(num2);
				}
			}
			if (IsClosed && list.Count > 0)
			{
				list.Add(list[0]);
			}
			polarLinePlanner.PrepareLine(frame.Points, list);
		}

		private double GetTransformedX(PolarFrame frame, int i)
		{
			return frame.Transformed[i].X;
		}

		private double GetTransformedY(PolarFrame frame, int i)
		{
			return frame.Transformed[i].Y;
		}

		private bool CenterVisible()
		{
			return !CenterNotVisible();
		}

		private bool CenterNotVisible()
		{
			return !base.SeriesViewer.ActualWindowRect.Contains(new Point(0.5, 0.5));
		}

		private bool IndexViable(int i)
		{
			if (!(base.AngleColumn[i] >= base.AxisInfoCache.AngleAxis.ActualMinimumValue) || !(base.AngleColumn[i] <= base.AxisInfoCache.AngleAxis.ActualMaximumValue) || !(base.RadiusColumn[i] >= base.AxisInfoCache.RadiusAxis.ActualMinimumValue) || !(base.RadiusColumn[i] <= base.AxisInfoCache.RadiusAxis.ActualMaximumValue))
			{
				if (!double.IsNaN(base.AngleColumn[i]))
				{
					return double.IsNaN(base.RadiusColumn[i]);
				}
				return true;
			}
			return true;
		}

		protected abstract void ClearPoints(SeriesView view);

		internal abstract void RenderPoints(PolarFrame frame, PolarBaseView view);

		protected internal override void ClearRendering(bool wipeClean, SeriesView view)
		{
			base.ClearRendering(wipeClean, view);
			ClearPoints(view);
		}

		internal override void RenderFrame(PolarFrame frame, PolarBaseView view)
		{
			base.RenderFrame(frame, view);
			if (base.UseCartesianInterpolation)
			{
				CurrentRenderer = CartesianRenderer;
			}
			else
			{
				CurrentRenderer = PolarRenderer;
			}
			CurrentRenderer.UnknownValuePlotting = GetUnknownValuePlotting();
			ClearPoints(view);
			RenderPoints(frame, view);
		}
	}

	internal class PolarTrendLineManager : TrendLineManagerBase<Point>
	{
		public override TrendLineManagerType ManagerType => TrendLineManagerType.Polar;

		public bool UseCartesianInterpolation { get; set; }

		public UnknownValuePlotting UnknownValuePlotting { get; set; }

		public double RadiusExtentScale { get; set; }

		public double InnerRadiusExtentScale { get; set; }

		public Func<double, double, double> ProjectX { get; set; }

		public Func<double, double, double> ProjectY { get; set; }

		public void PrepareLine(List<Point> flattenedPoints, TrendLineType trendLineType, IList<double> angleColumn, IList<double> radiusColumn, int period, Func<double, double> getScaledAngleValue, Func<double, double> getScaledRadiusValue, TrendResolutionParams trendResolutionParams, Clipper clipper, double min, double max)
		{
			List<Point> list = new List<Point>();
			if (trendResolutionParams.Window.IsEmpty || trendResolutionParams.Viewport.IsEmpty)
			{
				return;
			}
			IList<double> angleList = angleColumn;
			IList<double> radiusList = radiusColumn;
			int num = 0;
			if (angleList != null)
			{
				num = angleList.Count;
			}
			if (radiusList != null)
			{
				num = Math.Min(num, radiusList.Count);
			}
			if (trendLineType == TrendLineType.None)
			{
				base.TrendCoefficients = null;
				base.TrendColumn.Clear();
				return;
			}
			if (IsFit(trendLineType))
			{
				base.TrendColumn.Clear();
				base.TrendCoefficients = TrendFitCalculator.CalculateFit(list, trendLineType, trendResolutionParams, base.TrendCoefficients, num, (int i) => angleList[i], (int i) => radiusList[i], getScaledAngleValue, getScaledRadiusValue, min, max);
			}
			if (IsAverage(trendLineType))
			{
				base.TrendCoefficients = null;
				TrendAverageCalculator.CalculateXYAverage(trendLineType, base.TrendColumn, angleColumn, radiusColumn, period);
				foreach (Point item in base.TrendColumn)
				{
					double num2 = getScaledAngleValue(item.X);
					double num3 = getScaledRadiusValue(item.Y);
					if (!double.IsNaN(num2) && !double.IsNaN(num3))
					{
						list.Add(new Point(num2, num3));
					}
				}
			}
			if (list.Count > 0)
			{
				FlattenTrendLine(list, trendResolutionParams, flattenedPoints, clipper);
			}
		}

		protected override void FlattenTrendLine(IList<Point> trend, TrendResolutionParams trendResolutionParams, List<Point> flattenedPoints, Clipper clipper)
		{
			if (clipper != null)
			{
				clipper.Target = flattenedPoints;
			}
			PolarLinePlanner polarLinePlanner = new PolarLinePlanner();
			polarLinePlanner.AngleProvider = (int i) => trend[i].X;
			polarLinePlanner.RadiusProvider = (int i2) => trend[i2].Y;
			polarLinePlanner.Clipper = clipper;
			polarLinePlanner.Count = trend.Count;
			polarLinePlanner.Resolution = trendResolutionParams.Resolution;
			polarLinePlanner.TransformedXProvider = (int i3) => ProjectX(trend[i3].X, trend[i3].Y);
			polarLinePlanner.TransformedYProvider = (int i4) => ProjectY(trend[i4].X, trend[i4].Y);
			polarLinePlanner.UseCartesianInterpolation = UseCartesianInterpolation;
			polarLinePlanner.UnknownValuePlotting = UnknownValuePlotting;
			polarLinePlanner.Viewport = trendResolutionParams.Viewport;
			polarLinePlanner.Window = trendResolutionParams.Window;
			polarLinePlanner.PrepareLine(null, null);
		}
	}
	internal class AnchoredRadialBucketCalculator : RadialBucketCalculator
	{
		[Weak]
		private AnchoredRadialSeriesView AnchoredView { get; set; }

		public AnchoredRadialBucketCalculator(AnchoredRadialSeriesView view)
			: base(view)
		{
			AnchoredView = view;
		}

		public override double[] GetBucket(int index)
		{
			IFastItemColumn<double> valueColumn = AnchoredView.AnchoredRadialModel.ValueColumn;
			int num = Math.Min(index * base.BucketSize, valueColumn.Count - 1);
			int num2 = Math.Min(num + base.BucketSize - 1, valueColumn.Count - 1);
			double num3 = double.NaN;
			double num4 = double.NaN;
			for (int i = num; i <= num2; i++)
			{
				double num5 = valueColumn[i];
				if (!double.IsNaN(num3))
				{
					if (!double.IsNaN(num5))
					{
						num3 = Math.Min(num3, num5);
						num4 = Math.Max(num4, num5);
					}
				}
				else
				{
					num3 = num5;
					num4 = num5;
				}
			}
			if (double.IsNaN(num3))
			{
				return new double[3]
				{
					0.5 * (double)(num + num2),
					double.NaN,
					double.NaN
				};
			}
			return new double[3]
			{
				0.5 * (double)(num + num2),
				num3,
				num4
			};
		}
	}

			return new AnchoredRadialSeriesView(this);
		}

		protected internal override void ClearAxes()
		{
			base.ClearAxes();
			base.AngleAxis = null;
			base.ValueAxis = null;
		}

		public override object GetItemValue(object item, string memberPathName)
		{
			if (ResolveMemberPath(memberPathName) == "ValueMemberPath")
			{
				return GetItemValueByMemberPath(item, memberPathName, ValueMemberPath);
			}
			return base.GetItemValue(item, memberPathName);
		}

		protected internal override void OnViewCreated(SeriesView view)
		{
			base.OnViewCreated(view);
			AnchoredRadialView = (AnchoredRadialSeriesView)view;
		}

		public AnchoredRadialSeries()
		{
			ThumbnailFrame = new RadialFrame(3);
			LineRasterizer = new CategoryLineRasterizer();
		}

		public override int GetPreviousOrExactIndex(Point world, bool skipUnknowns)
		{
			return GetPreviousOrExactIndexHelper(world, skipUnknowns, base.AngleAxis, null, ValueColumn);
		}

		public override int GetNextOrExactIndex(Point world, bool skipUnknowns)
		{
			return GetNextOrExactIndexHelper(world, skipUnknowns, base.AngleAxis, null, ValueColumn);
		}

		protected internal override double GetDistanceToIndex(Point world, int index, Axis axis, ScalerParams p, double offset)
		{
			if (ValueColumn == null)
			{
				return double.PositiveInfinity;
			}
			return GetDistanceToIndexHelper(world, index, base.AngleAxis, p, offset, ValueColumn.Count, null);
		}

		public override double GetSeriesValue(Point world, bool useInterpolation, bool skipUnknowns)
		{
			Rect effectiveViewport = GetEffectiveViewport(base.View);
			double offset = GetOffset(base.AngleAxis, base.View.WindowRect, base.View.Viewport, effectiveViewport);
			ScalerParams scalerParams = new ScalerParams(base.View.WindowRect, base.View.Viewport, base.AngleAxis.IsInverted, effectiveViewport);
			scalerParams.EffectiveViewportRect = base.SeriesViewer.ViewportRect;
			return GetSeriesValueHelper(ValueColumn, world, base.AngleAxis, scalerParams, offset, null, useInterpolation, skipUnknowns);
		}

		public override Point GetSeriesValuePosition(Point world, bool useInterpolation, bool skipUnknowns)
		{
			if (base.ValueAxis == null || base.AngleAxis == null || base.View == null || base.View.WindowRect.IsEmpty || base.View.Viewport.IsEmpty)
			{
				return new Point(double.NaN, double.NaN);
			}
			Rect effectiveViewport = GetEffectiveViewport(base.View);
			ScalerParams scalerParams = new ScalerParams(base.View.WindowRect, base.View.Viewport, base.ValueAxis.IsInverted, effectiveViewport);
			scalerParams.EffectiveViewportRect = GetEffectiveViewport(base.View);
			double seriesValue = GetSeriesValue(world, useInterpolation, skipUnknowns);
			seriesValue = base.ValueAxis.GetScaledValue(seriesValue, scalerParams);
			double angle = _axes.GetAngleTo(world);
			if (!useInterpolation && base.AngleAxis != null)
			{
				int previousOrExactIndex = GetPreviousOrExactIndex(world, skipUnknowns);
				int nextOrExactIndex = GetNextOrExactIndex(world, skipUnknowns);
				double offset = GetOffset(base.AngleAxis, base.View.WindowRect, base.View.Viewport, effectiveViewport);
				ScalerParams scalerParams2 = new ScalerParams(base.View.WindowRect, base.View.Viewport, base.AngleAxis.IsInverted, effectiveViewport);
				scalerParams2.EffectiveViewportRect = base.SeriesViewer.ViewportRect;
				double distanceToIndex = GetDistanceToIndex(world, previousOrExactIndex, base.AngleAxis, scalerParams2, offset);
				angle = ((!(GetDistanceToIndex(world, nextOrExactIndex, base.AngleAxis, scalerParams2, offset) <= distanceToIndex)) ? (base.AngleAxis.GetScaledValue(previousOrExactIndex, scalerParams2) + offset) : (base.AngleAxis.GetScaledValue(nextOrExactIndex, scalerParams2) + offset));
			}
			double xValue = _axes.GetXValue(angle, seriesValue, base.View.WindowRect, base.View.Viewport);
			double yValue = _axes.GetYValue(angle, seriesValue, base.View.WindowRect, base.View.Viewport);
			return new Point(xValue, yValue);
		}

		protected internal override AxisRange GetRange(Axis axis)
		{
			if (axis != null && axis == base.AngleAxis && ValueColumn != null && ValueColumn.Count > 0)
			{
				return new AxisRange(0.0, ValueColumn.Count - 1);
			}
			if (axis != null && axis == base.ValueAxis && ValueColumn != null && ValueColumn.Count > 0)
			{
				return new AxisRange(ValueColumn.Minimum, ValueColumn.Maximum);
			}
			return null;
		}

		protected override void PropertyUpdatedOverride(object sender, string propertyName, object oldValue, object newValue)
		{
			base.PropertyUpdatedOverride(sender, propertyName, oldValue, newValue);
			if (AnchoredRadialView.TrendLineManager.PropertyUpdated(sender, propertyName, oldValue, newValue))
			{
				RenderSeries(animate: false);
				NotifyThumbnailAppearanceChanged();
			}
			NumericAxisBase valueAxis = base.ValueAxis;
			switch (propertyName)
			{
			case "FastItemsSource":
				if (oldValue is IFastItemsSource)
				{
					((IFastItemsSource)oldValue).DeregisterColumn(ValueColumn);
					ValueColumn = null;
				}
				if (newValue is IFastItemsSource)
				{
					ValueColumn = RegisterDoubleColumn(ValueMemberPath);
					AnchoredRadialView.BucketCalculator.CalculateBuckets(base.Resolution);
				}
				if (valueAxis != null && !valueAxis.UpdateRange())
				{
					AnchoredRadialView.BucketCalculator.CalculateBuckets(base.Resolution);
					RenderSeries(animate: false);
				}
				break;
			case "ValueMemberPath":
				if (base.FastItemsSource != null)
				{
					base.FastItemsSource.DeregisterColumn(ValueColumn);
					ValueColumn = RegisterDoubleColumn(ValueMemberPath);
				}
				break;
			case "ValueColumn":
				if (valueAxis != null && !valueAxis.UpdateRange())
				{
					AnchoredRadialView.BucketCalculator.CalculateBuckets(base.Resolution);
					RenderSeries(animate: false);
				}
				break;
			case "TrendLineBrush":
				UpdateIndexedProperties();
				break;
			case "TrendLineType":
				NotifyThumbnailAppearanceChanged();
				break;
			}
		}

		protected override void DataUpdatedOverride(FastItemsSourceEventAction action, int position, int count, string propertyName)
		{
			switch (action)
			{
			case FastItemsSourceEventAction.Remove:
			case FastItemsSourceEventAction.Insert:
			case FastItemsSourceEventAction.Reset:
				AnchoredRadialView.BucketCalculator.CalculateBuckets(base.Resolution);
				break;
			}
			AnchoredRadialView.TrendLineManager.DataUpdated(action, position, count, propertyName);
			switch (action)
			{
			case FastItemsSourceEventAction.Reset:
				if (base.ValueAxis != null && !base.ValueAxis.UpdateRange())
				{
					RenderSeries(animate: true);
				}
				break;
			case FastItemsSourceEventAction.Insert:
				if (base.ValueAxis != null && !base.ValueAxis.UpdateRange())
				{
					RenderSeries(animate: true);
				}
				break;
			case FastItemsSourceEventAction.Remove:
				if (base.ValueAxis != null && !base.ValueAxis.UpdateRange())
				{
					RenderSeries(animate: true);
				}
				break;
			case FastItemsSourceEventAction.Replace:
				if (ValueMemberPath != null && AnchoredRadialView.BucketCalculator.BucketSize > 0 && base.ValueAxis != null && !base.ValueAxis.UpdateRange())
				{
					RenderSeries(animate: true);
				}
				break;
			case FastItemsSourceEventAction.Change:
				if (propertyName == ValueMemberPath && base.ValueAxis != null && !base.ValueAxis.UpdateRange())
				{
					RenderSeries(animate: true);
				}
				break;
			}
		}

		protected internal override bool ValidateSeries(Rect viewportRect, Rect windowRect, SeriesView view)
		{
			bool result = base.ValidateSeries(viewportRect, windowRect, view);
			AnchoredRadialSeriesView anchoredRadialSeriesView = (AnchoredRadialSeriesView)view;
			if (base.FastItemsSource == null || base.FastItemsSource.Count == 0 || base.AngleAxis == null || ValueColumn == null || base.AngleAxis.CachedItemsCount == 0 || base.ValueAxis == null || double.IsInfinity(base.ValueAxis.ActualMinimumValue) || double.IsInfinity(base.ValueAxis.ActualMaximumValue) || anchoredRadialSeriesView.BucketCalculator.BucketSize < 1)
			{
				result = false;
			}
			return result;
		}

		public override double GetOffsetValue()
		{
			return GetOffset(base.AngleAxis, base.View.WindowRect, base.View.Viewport, GetEffectiveViewport(base.View));
		}

		public override double GetCategoryWidth()
		{
			return base.AngleAxis.GetCategorySize(base.View.WindowRect, base.View.Viewport, GetEffectiveViewport(base.View));
		}

		protected virtual double GetOffset(CategoryAngleAxis angleAxis, Rect windowRect, Rect viewportRect, Rect effectiveViewportRect)
		{
			double num = 0.0;
			CategoryMode categoryMode = PreferredCategoryMode(angleAxis);
			if (categoryMode == CategoryMode.Mode0 && angleAxis.CategoryMode != CategoryMode.Mode0)
			{
				categoryMode = CategoryMode.Mode1;
			}
			switch (categoryMode)
			{
			case CategoryMode.Mode0:
				num = 0.0;
				break;
			case CategoryMode.Mode1:
				num = 0.5 * angleAxis.GetCategorySize(windowRect, viewportRect, effectiveViewportRect);
				break;
			case CategoryMode.Mode2:
				num = angleAxis.GetGroupCenter(GetMode2Index(), windowRect, viewportRect, effectiveViewportRect);
				break;
			}
			if (angleAxis.IsInverted)
			{
				num = 0.0 - num;
			}
			return num;
		}

		internal override void PrepareFrame(RadialFrame radialFrame, RadialBaseView view)
		{
			Rect windowRect = view.WindowRect;
			Rect viewportRect = view.Viewport;
			Rect effectiveViewport = GetEffectiveViewport(view);
			CategoryAngleAxis angleAxis = base.AngleAxis;
			NumericRadiusAxis valueAxis = base.ValueAxis;
			double actualMinimumValue = valueAxis.ActualMinimumValue;
			double actualMaximumValue = valueAxis.ActualMaximumValue;
			radialFrame.Buckets.Clear();
			radialFrame.Markers.Clear();
			radialFrame.Trend.Clear();
			bool flag = ShouldDisplayMarkers();
			int num = 0;
			AnchoredRadialSeriesView obj = (AnchoredRadialSeriesView)view;
			CollisionAvoider collisionAvoider = new CollisionAvoider();
			double num2 = 0.0;
			int num3 = view.BucketCalculator.LastBucket;
			num2 = GetOffset(angleAxis, windowRect, viewportRect, effectiveViewport);
			obj.TrendLineManager.RadiusExtentScale = base.ValueAxis.ActualRadiusExtentScale;
			obj.TrendLineManager.InnerRadiusExtentScale = base.ValueAxis.ActualInnerRadiusExtentScale;
			obj.TrendLineManager.ProjectX = (double angle, double radius) => ProjectX(angle, radius, windowRect, viewportRect);
			obj.TrendLineManager.ProjectY = (double angle, double radius) => ProjectY(angle, radius, windowRect, viewportRect);
			Clipper clipper = new Clipper(viewportRect, isClosed: false)
			{
				Target = radialFrame.Trend
			};
			TrendResolutionParams trendResolutionParams = new TrendResolutionParams
			{
				BucketSize = view.BucketCalculator.BucketSize,
				FirstBucket = view.BucketCalculator.FirstBucket,
				LastBucket = num3,
				Offset = num2,
				Resolution = base.Resolution,
				Viewport = viewportRect,
				Window = windowRect
			};
			obj.TrendLineManager.PrepareLine(radialFrame.Trend, TrendLineType, ValueColumn, TrendLinePeriod, (double a) => base.AngleAxis.GetScaledAngle(a), (double r) => base.ValueAxis.GetScaledValue(r), trendResolutionParams, clipper);
			bool flag2 = true;
			if (RepeatExists(view))
			{
				num3--;
			}
			for (int num4 = view.BucketCalculator.FirstBucket; num4 <= num3; num4++)
			{
				int num5 = num4;
				if (num5 * view.BucketCalculator.BucketSize >= base.AngleAxis.CachedItemsCount)
				{
					num5 -= base.AngleAxis.CachedItemsCount / view.BucketCalculator.BucketSize;
				}
				double[] bucket = view.BucketCalculator.GetBucket(num5);
				if (!double.IsNaN(bucket[0]))
				{
					bucket[0] = angleAxis.GetScaledAngle(bucket[0]) + num2;
					if (bucket[1] < actualMinimumValue || bucket[1] > actualMaximumValue)
					{
						continue;
					}
					bucket[1] = valueAxis.GetScaledValue(bucket[1]);
					if (view.BucketCalculator.BucketSize > 1)
					{
						if (bucket[2] < actualMinimumValue || bucket[2] > actualMaximumValue)
						{
							continue;
						}
						bucket[2] = valueAxis.GetScaledValue(bucket[2]);
					}
					else
					{
						bucket[2] = bucket[1];
					}
					if ((double.IsNaN(bucket[1]) || double.IsNaN(bucket[2])) && flag2 && IsClosed && CenterVisible())
					{
						num3++;
					}
					else
					{
						flag2 = false;
					}
					radialFrame.Buckets.Add(bucket);
					if (flag)
					{
						int num6 = Math.Min(num5 * view.BucketCalculator.BucketSize, base.FastItemsSource.Count - 1);
						double xValue = _axes.GetXValue(bucket[0], bucket[1], windowRect, viewportRect);
						double yValue = _axes.GetYValue(bucket[0], bucket[1], windowRect, viewportRect);
						Rect rc = new Rect(xValue - 5.0, yValue - 5.0, 11.0, 11.0);
						if (!double.IsNaN(xValue) && !double.IsNaN(yValue) && !double.IsInfinity(xValue) && !double.IsInfinity(yValue) && collisionAvoider.TryAdd(rc))
						{
							radialFrame.Markers.Add(new Point(xValue, yValue));
							Marker marker = view.Markers[num];
							marker.MarkerBucket = num5;
							marker.CurrentIndex = num6;
							((DataContext)marker.Content).Item = base.FastItemsSource[num6];
							num++;
						}
					}
				}
				else if (flag2 && IsClosed && CenterVisible())
				{
					num3++;
				}
			}
			view.Markers.Count = num;
		}

		private double ProjectX(double angle, double radius, Rect windowRect, Rect viewportRect)
		{
			return _axes.GetXValue(angle, radius, windowRect, viewportRect);
		}

		private double ProjectY(double angle, double radius, Rect windowRect, Rect viewportRect)
		{
			return _axes.GetYValue(angle, radius, windowRect, viewportRect);
		}

		private bool RepeatExists(RadialBaseView view)
		{
			AnchoredRadialSeriesView anchoredRadialSeriesView = (AnchoredRadialSeriesView)view;
			if (!IsClosed && anchoredRadialSeriesView.BucketCalculator.FirstBucket == 0)
			{
				return anchoredRadialSeriesView.BucketCalculator.LastBucket == base.AngleAxis.CachedItemsCount;
			}
			return false;
		}

		internal Clipper GetLineClipper(List<double[]> buckets, int endIndex, SeriesView view)
		{
			Clipper result = null;
			Rect windowRect = view.WindowRect;
			Rect viewport = view.Viewport;
			if (endIndex > -1 && !windowRect.IsEmpty && !viewport.IsEmpty)
			{
				double left = ((buckets[0][0] < viewport.Left - 2000.0) ? (viewport.Left - 10.0) : double.NaN);
				double bottom = viewport.Bottom + 10.0;
				double right = ((buckets[endIndex][0] > viewport.Right + 2000.0) ? (viewport.Right + 10.0) : double.NaN);
				double top = viewport.Top - 10.0;
				result = new Clipper(left, bottom, right, top, isClosed: false);
			}
			return result;
		}

		internal void TerminatePolygon(PointCollection polygon0, PointCollection line0, PointCollection polygon01, PointCollection line1, bool finished)
		{
			if (polygon0.Count > 0 && line1.Count > 0 && (!finished || CenterNotVisible()))
			{
				polygon0.Add(TerminationPoint);
				polygon0.Add(polygon0[0]);
				line1.Add(TerminationPoint);
				line1.Add(line1[0]);
			}
		}

		private bool CenterVisible()
		{
			return !CenterNotVisible();
		}

		private bool CenterNotVisible()
		{
			return !base.View.WindowRect.Contains(new Point(0.5, 0.5));
		}

		protected internal override void ClearRendering(bool wipeClean, SeriesView view)
		{
			base.ClearRendering(wipeClean, view);
			AnchoredRadialSeriesView anchoredRadialSeriesView = (AnchoredRadialSeriesView)view;
			if (wipeClean)
			{
				anchoredRadialSeriesView.Markers.Clear();
			}
			anchoredRadialSeriesView.TrendLineManager.ClearPoints();
		}

		internal override void RenderFrame(RadialFrame radialFrame, RadialBaseView view)
		{
			Rect windowRect = view.WindowRect;
			Rect viewport = view.Viewport;
			Rect effectiveViewport = GetEffectiveViewport(view);
			Rect contentViewport = GetContentViewport(view);
			AnchoredRadialSeriesView anchoredRadialSeriesView = (AnchoredRadialSeriesView)view;
			anchoredRadialSeriesView.TrendLineManager.RasterizeTrendLine(radialFrame.Trend);
			CategoryMarkerManager.RasterizeMarkers(this, radialFrame.Markers, anchoredRadialSeriesView.Markers, base.UseLightweightMarkers);
			ColorizeMarkers(view, radialFrame);
			anchoredRadialSeriesView.RenderMarkers();
			ApplyClipping(viewport, windowRect, effectiveViewport, contentViewport, anchoredRadialSeriesView);
		}

		protected object[] GetCategoryItemsHelper(int orderedStartIndex, int orderedEndIndex, Axis axis)
		{
			if (orderedEndIndex < orderedStartIndex || orderedStartIndex < 0 || orderedStartIndex > ValueColumn.Count || orderedEndIndex < 0 || orderedEndIndex > ValueColumn.Count || axis == null)
			{
				return null;
			}
			object[] array = new object[orderedEndIndex - orderedStartIndex + 1];
			bool isSorting = axis.IsSorting;
			List<int> list = null;
			if (isSorting)
			{
				list = ((ISortingAxis)axis).SortedIndices;
			}
			for (int i = orderedStartIndex; i <= orderedEndIndex; i++)
			{
				int index = i;
				if (isSorting)
				{
					index = list[index];
				}
				array[i - orderedStartIndex] = base.FastItemsSource[i];
			}
			return array;
		}

		protected void PerformRadialMarkerStyleOverride(List<double[]> buckets, int currentIndex, int valueCount, CategoryAxisBase categoryAxis, ScalerParams axisParams, bool isThumbnail)
		{
			bool flag = base.ActualHighlightingMode != SeriesHighlightingMode.None;
			RenderManager.PopulateArgsBounds(RenderManager.MarkerOverrideArgs, categoryAxis.IsSorting, buckets, currentIndex, valueCount, categoryAxis, axisParams, isThumbnail, isMarker: true);
			RenderManager.PrePerformMarkerStyleOverride(base.ActualHighlightingFadeOpacity);
			AssigningRadialMarkerStyleEventArgs radialMarkerOverrideArgs = RenderManager.RadialMarkerOverrideArgs;
			HighlightingInfo highlightingInfo = null;
			IFastItemsSource fastItemsSource = base.FastItemsSource;
			if (flag && base.SeriesViewer != null)
			{
				highlightingInfo = base.SeriesViewer.HighlightingManager.GetHighlightingInfo(this, fastItemsSource, radialMarkerOverrideArgs.StartIndex, radialMarkerOverrideArgs.EndIndex, isMarker: true);
				if (base.SeriesViewer.HighlightingManager.IsCrossSeriesHighlight(this))
				{
					base.SeriesViewer.HighlightingManager.GetHighlightingInfo(this, fastItemsSource, radialMarkerOverrideArgs.StartIndex, radialMarkerOverrideArgs.EndIndex, isMarker: true);
				}
				radialMarkerOverrideArgs.HighlightingInfo = highlightingInfo;
			}
			radialMarkerOverrideArgs.IsThumbnail = isThumbnail;
			RaiseAssigningRadialMarkerStyles(radialMarkerOverrideArgs);
			RenderManager.PostPerformMarkerStyleOverride(this, highlightingInfo, isThumbnail, flag, radialMarkerOverrideArgs.TotalAllSeriesHighlightingProgress, base.SeriesViewer.HighlightingManager.TotalHighlightingProgress);
		}

		protected void PerformRadialStyleOverride(List<double[]> buckets, int currentIndex, int valueCount, CategoryAxisBase categoryAxis, ScalerParams axisParams, bool isThumbnail)
		{
			bool flag = base.ActualHighlightingMode != SeriesHighlightingMode.None;
			RenderManager.PopulateArgsBounds(RenderManager.OverrideArgs, categoryAxis.IsSorting, buckets, currentIndex, valueCount, categoryAxis, axisParams, isThumbnail, isMarker: false);
			RenderManager.PrePerformStyleOverride(base.ActualHighlightingFadeOpacity);
			AssigningRadialStyleEventArgs radialOverrideArgs = RenderManager.RadialOverrideArgs;
			HighlightingInfo info = null;
			IFastItemsSource fastItemsSource = base.FastItemsSource;
			if (flag && base.SeriesViewer != null)
			{
				info = (radialOverrideArgs.HighlightingInfo = base.SeriesViewer.HighlightingManager.GetHighlightingInfo(this, fastItemsSource, radialOverrideArgs.StartIndex, radialOverrideArgs.EndIndex, isMarker: false));
			}
			radialOverrideArgs.IsThumbnail = isThumbnail;
			RaiseAssigningRadialStyles(radialOverrideArgs);
			RenderManager.PostPerformStyleOverride(this, info, isThumbnail, flag, currentIndex < 0);
		}

		internal void ColorizeMarkers(RadialBaseView view, RadialFrame frame)
		{
			view.MarkerAppearanceHandled = true;
			RenderManager.InitRadialMarkerRenderSettings(this, ShouldOverrideMarkerStyle(), GetCategoryItems, GetBucketSize(view), GetFirstBucket(view));
			bool flag = RenderManager.MarkerOverrideArgs != null;
			CategoryAngleAxis angleAxis = base.AngleAxis;
			if (angleAxis == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			Rect effectiveViewport = GetEffectiveViewport(view);
			ScalerParams axisParams = new ScalerParams(view.WindowRect, view.Viewport, angleAxis.IsInverted, effectiveViewport);
			int valueCount = ((base.FastItemsSource != null) ? base.FastItemsSource.Count : 0);
			AnchoredRadialSeriesView obj = (AnchoredRadialSeriesView)view;
			List<double[]> buckets = frame.Buckets;
			int firstBucket = obj.BucketCalculator.FirstBucket;
			_ = obj.BucketCalculator.LastBucket;
			int bucketSize = obj.BucketCalculator.BucketSize;
			for (int i = 0; i < view.Markers.Count; i++)
			{
				Marker marker = view.Markers[i];
				DataContext context = (DataContext)marker.Content;
				if (flag)
				{
					int markerBucket = marker.MarkerBucket;
					PerformRadialMarkerStyleOverride(buckets, markerBucket, valueCount, angleAxis, axisParams, view.IsThumbnailView);
				}
				RenderManager.SetMarkerAppearance(marker, context);
			}
		}

		private void ApplyClipping(Rect viewportRect, Rect windowRect, Rect effectiveViewportRect, Rect contentViewport, AnchoredRadialSeriesView view)
		{
			view.ApplyClipping(viewportRect, windowRect, effectiveViewportRect, contentViewport);
		}

		{
			base.UpdateIndexedProperties();
			if (base.Index >= 0)
			{
				AnchoredRadialView.UpdateTrendlineBrush();
			}
		}

		{
			if (sender == AnchoredRadialView.TrendLineManager.TrendPolyline)
			{
				return null;
			}
			return base.Item(sender, point);
		}

		public override bool ScrollIntoView(object item)
		{
			Rect windowRect = base.View.WindowRect;
			Rect viewport = base.View.Viewport;
			int num = ((!windowRect.IsEmpty && !viewport.IsEmpty && base.FastItemsSource != null) ? base.FastItemsSource.IndexOf(item) : (-1));
			if (base.AngleAxis == null || ValueColumn == null || base.ValueAxis == null)
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (num < 0 || num > ValueColumn.Count - 1)
			{
				return false;
			}
			double scaledAngle = base.AngleAxis.GetScaledAngle(num);
			double num2 = base.ValueAxis.GetScaledValue(ValueColumn[num]);
			if (double.IsNaN(num2))
			{
				num2 = (base.ValueAxis.ActualInnerRadiusExtentScale + base.ValueAxis.ActualRadiusExtentScale) / 2.0;
			}
			double num3 = 0.5 + Math.Cos(scaledAngle) * num2;
			double num4 = 0.5 + Math.Sin(scaledAngle) * num2;
			if (!double.IsNaN(num3))
			{
				if (num3 < windowRect.Left + 0.1 * windowRect.Width)
				{
					num3 += 0.4 * windowRect.Width;
					windowRect.X = num3 - 0.5 * windowRect.Width;
				}
				if (num3 > windowRect.Right - 0.1 * windowRect.Width)
				{
					num3 -= 0.4 * windowRect.Width;
					windowRect.X = num3 - 0.5 * windowRect.Width;
				}
			}
			if (!double.IsNaN(num4))
			{
				if (num4 < windowRect.Top + 0.1 * windowRect.Height)
				{
					num4 += 0.4 * windowRect.Height;
					windowRect.Y = num4 - 0.5 * windowRect.Height;
				}
				if (num4 > windowRect.Bottom - 0.1 * windowRect.Height)
				{
					num4 -= 0.4 * windowRect.Height;
					windowRect.Y = num4 - 0.5 * windowRect.Height;
				}
			}
			if (base.SyncLink != null)
			{
				base.SyncLink.WindowNotify(base.SeriesViewer, windowRect, force: true);
			}
			return num >= 0;
		}

		protected internal override void RenderThumbnail(Rect viewportRect, RenderSurface surface)
		{
			base.RenderThumbnail(viewportRect, surface);
			if (!base.ThumbnailDirty)
			{
				base.View.PrepSurface(surface);
				return;
			}
			base.View.PrepSurface(surface);
			AnchoredRadialSeriesView anchoredRadialSeriesView = base.ThumbnailView as AnchoredRadialSeriesView;
			anchoredRadialSeriesView.BucketCalculator.CalculateBuckets(base.Resolution);
			if (!ClearAndAbortIfInvalid(base.ThumbnailView))
			{
				if (!base.SkipThumbnailPrepare)
				{
					ThumbnailFrame = new RadialFrame(3);
					PrepareFrame(ThumbnailFrame, anchoredRadialSeriesView);
				}
				base.SkipThumbnailPrepare = false;
				RenderFrame(ThumbnailFrame, anchoredRadialSeriesView);
				base.ThumbnailDirty = false;
			}
		}

		public override void RenderAlternateView(Rect viewportRect, Rect windowRect, RenderSurface surface, string viewIdentifier, double effectiveScalingRatio)
		{
			base.RenderAlternateView(viewportRect, windowRect, surface, viewIdentifier, effectiveScalingRatio);
			SeriesView seriesView = base.SeriesInteractionManager.AlternateViews[viewIdentifier];
			AnchoredRadialSeriesView anchoredRadialSeriesView = (AnchoredRadialSeriesView)seriesView;
			anchoredRadialSeriesView.BucketCalculator.CalculateBuckets(base.Resolution);
			seriesView.PrepAltSurface(surface);
			if (!ClearAndAbortIfInvalid(anchoredRadialSeriesView))
			{
				if (AlternateFrame == null)
				{
					AlternateFrame = new RadialFrame(3);
				}
				AlternateFrame.ClearFrame();
				PrepareFrame(AlternateFrame, anchoredRadialSeriesView);
				RenderFrame(AlternateFrame, anchoredRadialSeriesView);
			}
		}

		protected override void ExportVisualDataOverride(object svd)
		{
			base.ExportVisualDataOverride(svd);
			base.SeriesVisualDataManager.ExportTrendlineData(this, svd, AnchoredRadialView.TrendLineManager.TrendPolyline);
		}

		internal override DataContext GetTooltipContext(object item)
		{
			if (item != null)
			{
				Type type = item.GetType();
				object propertyValue = new FastReflectionHelper(useTraditionalReflection: false, ValueMemberPath).GetPropertyValue(type, item);
				AnchoredRadialSeriesDataContext anchoredRadialSeriesDataContext = new AnchoredRadialSeriesDataContext
				{
					Series = this,
					Item = item,
					ItemValue = propertyValue
				};
				if (base.AngleAxis != null)
				{
					anchoredRadialSeriesDataContext.AngleAxisLabel = base.AngleAxis.GetLabel(item);
				}
				return anchoredRadialSeriesDataContext;
			}
			return new DataContext
			{
				Series = this,
				Item = item
			};
		}
	}
