		protected internal override void ClearRendering(bool wipeClean, SeriesView view)
		{
			base.ClearRendering(wipeClean, view);
			RadialAreaSeriesView obj = (RadialAreaSeriesView)view;
			obj.polygon0.Data = null;
			obj.polygon1.Data = null;
			obj.polyline0.Data = null;
			obj.polyline1.Data = null;
		}

		internal override void RenderFrame(RadialFrame radialFrame, RadialBaseView view)
		{
			base.RenderFrame(radialFrame, view);
			Rect windowRect = view.WindowRect;
			Rect viewport = view.Viewport;
			RadialAreaSeriesView radialAreaSeriesView = (RadialAreaSeriesView)view;
			if (!view.HasSurface() || windowRect.IsEmpty || viewport.IsEmpty || base.AngleAxis == null || base.ValueAxis == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			List<double[]> buckets = radialFrame.Buckets;
			int count = buckets.Count;
			List<double[]> list = new List<double[]>(count);
			double num = 0.0;
			for (int i = 0; i < count; i++)
			{
				double[] array = new double[4];
				list.Add(array);
				array[0] = _axes.GetXValue(radialFrame.Buckets[i][0], radialFrame.Buckets[i][1], windowRect, viewport);
				array[1] = _axes.GetYValue(radialFrame.Buckets[i][0], radialFrame.Buckets[i][1], windowRect, viewport);
				array[2] = _axes.GetXValue(radialFrame.Buckets[i][0], radialFrame.Buckets[i][2], windowRect, viewport);
				double num2 = radialFrame.Buckets[i][2];
				array[3] = _axes.GetYValue(radialFrame.Buckets[i][0], num2, windowRect, viewport);
				if (num2 > num)
				{
					num = num2;
				}
			}
			double x = ViewportUtils.TransformXToViewport(0.5, windowRect, viewport);
			double y = ViewportUtils.TransformYToViewport(0.5, windowRect, viewport);
			TerminationPoint = new Point(x, y);
			Rect effectiveViewport = GetEffectiveViewport(radialAreaSeriesView);
			RenderManager.InitRadialRenderSettings(this, ShouldOverrideRadialStyle(), GetCategoryItems, GetBucketSize(view), GetFirstBucket(view));
			bool flag = false;
			if (RenderManager.OverrideArgs != null)
			{
				flag = true;
			}
			if (flag)
			{
				ScalerParams axisParams = new ScalerParams(view.WindowRect, view.Viewport, base.AngleAxis.IsInverted, effectiveViewport);
				PerformRadialStyleOverride(buckets, -1, base.ValueColumn.Count, base.AngleAxis, axisParams, view.IsThumbnailView);
			}
			Path polyline = radialAreaSeriesView.polyline0;
			Path polyline2 = radialAreaSeriesView.polyline1;
			Path polygon = radialAreaSeriesView.polygon0;
			Path polygon2 = radialAreaSeriesView.polygon1;
			RenderManager.SetShapeAppearance(polyline, strokeOnly: true, fillOnly: false, extended: true, useOutline: true);
			RenderManager.SetShapeAppearance(polyline2, strokeOnly: true, fillOnly: false, extended: true, useOutline: true);
			RenderManager.SetShapeAppearance(polygon, strokeOnly: false, fillOnly: true, extended: false, useOutline: false);
			RenderManager.SetShapeAppearance(polygon2, strokeOnly: false, fillOnly: true, extended: false, useOutline: false);
			base.LineRasterizer.RasterizePolygonPaths(radialAreaSeriesView.polygon0, radialAreaSeriesView.polyline0, radialAreaSeriesView.polygon1, radialAreaSeriesView.polyline1, radialFrame.Buckets.Count, list, useX0AsX1: false, radialAreaSeriesView.BucketCalculator.BucketSize, base.Resolution, base.TerminatePolygon, UnknownValuePlotting);
			polygon.Opacity = RenderManager.ActualRenderOpacity * base.ActualAreaFillOpacity;
			polygon2.Opacity = 0.5 * RenderManager.ActualRenderOpacity * base.ActualAreaFillOpacity;
		}

		protected override void PropertyUpdatedOverride(object sender, string propertyName, object oldValue, object newValue)
		{
			base.PropertyUpdatedOverride(sender, propertyName, oldValue, newValue);
			if (propertyName == "UnknownValuePlotting")
			{
				RenderSeries(animate: false);
				NotifyThumbnailAppearanceChanged();
			}
		}
	}

	internal abstract class RadialBucketCalculator : IBucketizer
	{
		[Weak]
		protected RadialBaseView View { get; private set; }

		protected internal int FirstBucket { get; private set; }

		protected internal int LastBucket { get; private set; }

		protected internal int BucketSize { get; set; }

		internal RadialBucketCalculator(RadialBaseView view)
		{
			View = view;
		}

		public virtual double[] GetBucket(int index)
		{
			throw new NotImplementedException();
		}

		public virtual double[] GetBucketWithoutUnknowns(int index)
		{
			return GetBucket(index);
		}

		public double GetErrorBucket(int index, IFastItemColumn<double> column)
		{
			return double.NaN;
		}

		public void GetBucketInfo(out int firstBucket, out int lastBucket, out int bucketSize, out double resolution)
		{
			firstBucket = FirstBucket;
			lastBucket = LastBucket;
			bucketSize = BucketSize;
			resolution = View.RadialModel.Resolution;
		}

		protected internal void CalculateBuckets(double resolution)
		{
			Rect windowRect = View.WindowRect;
			Rect viewport = View.Viewport;
			CategoryAngleAxis angleAxis = View.RadialModel.AngleAxis;
			if (windowRect.IsEmpty || viewport.IsEmpty || angleAxis == null || View.RadialModel.FastItemsSource == null || View.RadialModel.FastItemsSource.Count == 0)
			{
				BucketSize = 0;
				return;
			}
			double num = Math.Floor(angleAxis.GetMinimumViewable(viewport, windowRect));
			double num2 = Math.Ceiling(angleAxis.GetMaximumViewable(viewport, windowRect));
			if (angleAxis.IsInverted)
			{
				num2 = Math.Ceiling(angleAxis.GetMinimumViewable(viewport, windowRect));
				num = Math.Floor(angleAxis.GetMaximumViewable(viewport, windowRect));
			}
			if (num2 < num)
			{
				num2 = (double)angleAxis.CachedItemsCount + num2;
			}
			double num3 = View.RadialModel.ValueAxis?.ActualRadiusExtentScale ?? 0.75;
			double num4 = Math.Min(viewport.Width, viewport.Height) * 0.5 * num3 * 2.0 * Math.PI;
			double val = Math.Floor((num2 - num + 1.0) * resolution / num4);
			BucketSize = (int)Math.Max(1.0, val);
			FirstBucket = (int)Math.Max(0.0, Math.Floor(num / (double)BucketSize) - 1.0);
			LastBucket = (int)Math.Ceiling(num2 / (double)BucketSize);
		}
	}

		[SuppressWidgetMember]
		public override bool GetVisiblePointsOfInterest(List<SeriesPointOfInterest> points, bool useValueAsLabel, int labelPrecision)
		{
			if (!HasMarkers)
			{
				return false;
			}
			CategoryAngleAxis xAxis = AngleAxis;
			new ScalerParams(base.SeriesViewer.ActualWindowRect, base.Viewport, xAxis.IsInverted).EffectiveViewportRect = GetEffectiveViewport(base.View);
			NumericRadiusAxis valueAxis = ValueAxis;
			new ScalerParams(base.SeriesViewer.ActualWindowRect, base.Viewport, valueAxis.IsInverted).EffectiveViewportRect = GetEffectiveViewport(base.View);
			points.Clear();
			base.MarkerView.DoToAllMarkers(delegate(Marker m)
			{
				if (m.Visibility == Visibility.Visible)
				{
					SeriesPointOfInterest seriesPointOfInterest = new SeriesPointOfInterest();
					double num = 0.0;
					double num2 = 0.0;
					if (m.RenderTransform is MatrixTransform)
					{
						Point point = ((MatrixTransform)m.RenderTransform).Transform(new Point(0.0, 0.0));
						num = point.X + m.DesiredSize.Width / 2.0;
						num2 = point.Y + m.DesiredSize.Height / 2.0;
					}
					else
					{
						TranslateTransform obj = (TranslateTransform)m.RenderTransform;
						num = obj.X + m.DesiredSize.Width / 2.0;
						num2 = obj.Y + m.DesiredSize.Height / 2.0;
					}
					if (!(num < base.Viewport.Left) && !(num > base.Viewport.Right) && !(num2 < base.Viewport.Top) && !(num2 > base.Viewport.Bottom))
					{
						_axes.GetUnscaledValues(num, num2, base.View.WindowRect, base.View.Viewport, out var unscaledAngle, out var unscaledRadius);
						seriesPointOfInterest.XValue = unscaledAngle;
						seriesPointOfInterest.YValue = unscaledRadius;
						if (useValueAsLabel)
						{
							seriesPointOfInterest.Label = ApplyLabelPrecision((double)seriesPointOfInterest.YValue, labelPrecision);
						}
						else
						{
							seriesPointOfInterest.Label = xAxis.GetValueLabel(m.CurrentIndex);
						}
						seriesPointOfInterest.DataContext = (DataContext)m.Content;
						points.Add(seriesPointOfInterest);
					}
				}
			});
			return true;
		}

		private string ApplyLabelPrecision(double val, int fixedPrecision)
		{
			if (fixedPrecision >= 0)
			{
				return Math.Round(val, fixedPrecision).ToString();
			}
			return val.ToString();
		}

		protected HighlightingInfo GetFullSeriesInfo(object item, Point world, HighlightingInfo prevValue)
		{
			HighlightingInfo highlightingInfo = new HighlightingInfo();
			highlightingInfo.Series = this;
			highlightingInfo.StartIndex = 0;
			highlightingInfo.EndIndex = base.FastItemsSource.Count - 1;
			highlightingInfo.IsFullRange = true;
			if (prevValue != null && prevValue.StartIndex == highlightingInfo.StartIndex && prevValue.EndIndex == highlightingInfo.EndIndex)
			{
				return prevValue;
			}
			return highlightingInfo;
		}

		protected virtual HighlightingInfo GetSpecificHighlightingInfo(object item, Point world, HighlightingInfo prevValue)
		{
			_ = RadialView.BucketCalculator.FirstBucket;
			_ = RadialView.BucketCalculator.LastBucket;
			int bucketSize = RadialView.BucketCalculator.BucketSize;
			GetActiveFrame();
			_ = base.FastItemsSource.Count;
			_ = AngleAxis;
			int num = -1;
			int num2 = -1;
			num = (int)Math.Floor((double)(GetItemIndex(world) / bucketSize)) * bucketSize;
			num2 = num + (bucketSize - 1);
			if (prevValue != null && prevValue.StartIndex == num && prevValue.EndIndex == num2)
			{
				return prevValue;
			}
			return new HighlightingInfo
			{
				Series = this,
				StartIndex = num,
				EndIndex = num2
			};
		}

		protected HighlightingInfo GetSpecificMarkerHighlightingInfo(object item, Point world, HighlightingInfo prevValue)
		{
			_ = RadialView.BucketCalculator.FirstBucket;
			_ = RadialView.BucketCalculator.LastBucket;
			int bucketSize = RadialView.BucketCalculator.BucketSize;
			GetActiveFrame();
			_ = base.FastItemsSource.Count;
			_ = AngleAxis;
			int num = -1;
			int num2 = -1;
			num = (int)Math.Floor((double)(GetItemIndex(world) / bucketSize)) * bucketSize;
			num2 = num + (bucketSize - 1);
			if (prevValue != null && prevValue.StartIndex == num && prevValue.EndIndex == num2)
			{
				return prevValue;
			}
			return new HighlightingInfo
			{
				IsMarker = true,
				Series = this,
				StartIndex = num,
				EndIndex = num2
			};
		}

		protected internal override HighlightingInfo GetHighlightingInfo(object item, Point world, bool forceFullRange)
		{
			if (HasIndividualElements && IsSpecificHighlightingMode(base.ActualHighlightingMode) && !forceFullRange)
			{
				return PrevHighlightingInfo = GetSpecificHighlightingInfo(item, world, PrevHighlightingInfo);
			}
			return PrevHighlightingInfo = GetFullSeriesInfo(item, world, PrevHighlightingInfo);
		}

		protected internal override HighlightingInfo GetMarkerHighlightingInfo(object item, Point world, bool forceFullRange)
		{
			if (IsSpecificHighlightingMode(base.ActualHighlightingMode) && !forceFullRange)
			{
				return PrevMarkerHighlightingInfo = GetSpecificMarkerHighlightingInfo(item, world, PrevMarkerHighlightingInfo);
			}
			HighlightingInfo fullSeriesInfo = GetFullSeriesInfo(item, world, PrevMarkerHighlightingInfo);
			fullSeriesInfo.IsMarker = true;
			PrevMarkerHighlightingInfo = fullSeriesInfo;
			return fullSeriesInfo;
		}

		protected bool ShouldOverrideRadialStyle()
		{
			if (this.AssigningRadialStyle == null || !ActualIsCustomRadialStyleAllowed)
			{
				return base.ActualHighlightingMode != SeriesHighlightingMode.None;
			}
			return true;
		}

		protected bool ShouldOverrideMarkerStyle()
		{
			if (this.AssigningRadialMarkerStyle == null || !ActualIsCustomRadialMarkerStyleAllowed)
			{
				return base.ActualHighlightingMode != SeriesHighlightingMode.None;
			}
			return true;
		}

			{
				this.AssigningRadialStyle(this, args);
			}
		}

		{
			if (this.AssigningRadialMarkerStyle != null && ActualIsCustomRadialMarkerStyleAllowed)
			{
				this.AssigningRadialMarkerStyle(this, args);
			}
		}

		{
			return ((RadialBaseView)view).BucketCalculator.BucketSize;
		}

		protected internal virtual int GetFirstBucket(SeriesView view)
		{
			return ((RadialBaseView)view).BucketCalculator.FirstBucket;
		}

		{
			return new Axis[2] { AngleAxis, ValueAxis };
		}

			RadialView.BucketCalculator.CalculateBuckets(base.Resolution);
			RenderSeries(animate: false);

		}

		internal abstract CategoryMode PreferredCategoryMode(CategoryAxisBase axis);

		protected override void PropertyUpdatedOverride(object sender, string propertyName, object oldValue, object newValue)
		{
			base.PropertyUpdatedOverride(sender, propertyName, oldValue, newValue);
			switch (propertyName)
			{
			case "SeriesViewer":
				if (oldValue != null && newValue == null)
				{
					if (AngleAxis != null)
					{
						AngleAxis.DeregisterSeries(this);
					}
					if (ValueAxis != null)
					{
						ValueAxis.DeregisterSeries(this);
					}
				}
				if (oldValue == null && newValue != null)
				{
					if (AngleAxis != null)
					{
						AngleAxis.RegisterSeries(this);
					}
					if (ValueAxis != null)
					{
						ValueAxis.RegisterSeries(this);
					}
				}
				RadialView.BucketCalculator.CalculateBuckets(base.Resolution);
				RenderSeries(animate: false);
				break;
			case "AngleAxis":
				if (AngleAxis != null && ValueAxis != null)
				{
					_axes = new RadialAxes(ValueAxis, AngleAxis);
				}
				if (oldValue != null)
				{
					((Axis)oldValue).DeregisterSeries(this);
				}
				if (newValue != null)
				{
					((Axis)newValue).RegisterSeries(this);
				}
				RadialView.BucketCalculator.CalculateBuckets(base.Resolution);
				RenderSeries(animate: false);
				break;
			case "ValueAxis":
				if (AngleAxis != null && ValueAxis != null)
				{
					_axes = new RadialAxes(ValueAxis, AngleAxis);
				}
				if (oldValue != null)
				{
					((Axis)oldValue).DeregisterSeries(this);
				}
				if (newValue != null)
				{
					((Axis)newValue).RegisterSeries(this);
				}
				RadialView.BucketCalculator.CalculateBuckets(base.Resolution);
				if (ValueAxis == null || !ValueAxis.UpdateRange())
				{
					RenderSeries(animate: false);
				}
				break;
			case "SyncLink":
				if (base.SyncLink != null && base.SeriesViewer != null)
				{
					RadialView.BucketCalculator.CalculateBuckets(base.Resolution);
					RenderSeries(animate: false);
				}
				break;
			case "TransitionProgress":
				TransitionFrame.Interpolate((float)base.TransitionProgress, PreviousFrame, CurrentFrame);
				if (!ClearAndAbortIfInvalid(base.View))
				{
					if (base.TransitionProgress == 1.0)
					{
						RenderFrame(CurrentFrame, RadialView);
					}
					else
					{
						RenderFrame(TransitionFrame, RadialView);
					}
					if (base.SeriesViewer != null)
					{
						base.SeriesViewer.RaiseSeriesAnimating(this);
					}
				}
				break;
			case "ClipSeriesToBounds":
				RenderSeries(animate: false);
				NotifyThumbnailAppearanceChanged();
				break;
			case "VisibilityProxy":
				if ((Visibility)oldValue != Visibility.Visible && (Visibility)newValue == Visibility.Visible)
				{
					RadialView.BucketCalculator.CalculateBuckets(base.Resolution);
				}
				break;
			case "IsCustomRadialStyleAllowed":
				ActualIsCustomRadialStyleAllowed = ResolveIsCustomRadialStyleAllowed();
				RenderSeries(animate: false);
				break;
			case "IsCustomRadialMarkerStyleAllowed":
				ActualIsCustomRadialMarkerStyleAllowed = ResolveIsCustomRadialMarkerStyleAllowed();
				RenderSeries(animate: false);
				break;
			}
		}

		protected virtual bool ResolveIsCustomRadialStyleAllowed()
		{
			return IsCustomRadialStyleAllowed;
		}

		protected virtual bool ResolveIsCustomRadialMarkerStyleAllowed()
		{
			return IsCustomRadialMarkerStyleAllowed;
		}

		[XamSuppressWidgetMember]
		[UwpSuppressWidgetMember]
		[WFSuppressWidgetMember]
		public bool CanUseAsValueAxis(object axis)
		{
			if (axis is NumericRadiusAxis)
			{
				return true;
			}
			return false;
		}

		[XamSuppressWidgetMember]
		[UwpSuppressWidgetMember]
		[WFSuppressWidgetMember]
		public bool CanUseAsAngleAxis(object axis)
		{
			if (axis is CategoryAngleAxis)
			{
				return true;
			}
			return false;
		}

		public override object GetItem(Point world)
		{
			int itemIndex = GetItemIndex(world);
			if (itemIndex < 0 || base.FastItemsSource == null || itemIndex >= base.FastItemsSource.Count)
			{
				return null;
			}
			return base.FastItemsSource[itemIndex];
		}

		public virtual double GetAngleFromWorld(Point world)
		{
			Rect windowRect = base.View.WindowRect;
			Rect viewport = base.View.Viewport;
			if (AngleAxis != null && !windowRect.IsEmpty && !viewport.IsEmpty && _axes != null)
			{
				double num = _axes.GetAngleTo(world);
				if (num < 0.0)
				{
					num += Math.PI * 2.0;
				}
				if (num > Math.PI * 2.0)
				{
					num -= Math.PI * 2.0;
				}
				return num;
			}
			return double.NaN;
		}

		public override double GetExactItemIndex(Point world)
		{
			Rect windowRect = base.View.WindowRect;
			Rect viewport = base.View.Viewport;
			double result = -1.0;
			if (AngleAxis != null && !windowRect.IsEmpty && !viewport.IsEmpty && _axes != null)
			{
				double num = _axes.GetAngleTo(world);
				if (num < 0.0)
				{
					num += Math.PI * 2.0;
				}
				if (num > Math.PI * 2.0)
				{
					num -= Math.PI * 2.0;
				}
				double num2 = AngleAxis.GetUnscaledAngle(num);
				if (AngleAxis.CategoryMode != CategoryMode.Mode0)
				{
					num2 -= 0.5;
				}
				result = num2;
			}
			return result;
		}

		public override int GetItemIndex(Point world)
		{
			int num = (int)Math.Round(GetExactItemIndex(world));
			if (base.FastItemsSource != null && num == base.FastItemsSource.Count)
			{
				num = 0;
			}
			return num;
		}

		public override bool ScrollIntoView(object item)
		{
			return false;
		}

		internal RadialFrame GetActiveFrame()
		{
			RadialFrame result = CurrentFrame;
			if (AnimationActive())
			{
				if (base.Animator.NeedsFlush)
				{
					base.Animator.Flush();
				}
				result = TransitionFrame;
			}
			return result;
		}

		public abstract double GetOffsetValue();

		[TreatAsPX]
		public abstract double GetCategoryWidth();

		internal abstract void PrepareFrame(RadialFrame radialFrame, RadialBaseView view);

		internal abstract void RenderFrame(RadialFrame radialFrame, RadialBaseView view);

		protected internal override void InvalidateAxes()
		{
			base.InvalidateAxes();
			if (AngleAxis != null)
			{
				AngleAxis.RenderAxis(animate: false);
			}
			if (ValueAxis != null)
			{
				ValueAxis.RenderAxis(animate: false);
			}
		}

		protected internal override bool ValidateSeries(Rect viewportRect, Rect windowRect, SeriesView view)
		{
			bool result = true;
			RadialBaseView radialBaseView = (RadialBaseView)view;
			if (!base.ValidateSeries(viewportRect, windowRect, view) || !view.HasSurface() || windowRect.IsEmpty || viewportRect.IsEmpty || AngleAxis == null || AngleAxis.ItemsSource == null || ValueAxis == null || _axes == null || base.FastItemsSource == null || AngleAxis.SeriesViewer == null || ValueAxis.SeriesViewer == null || ValueAxis.ActualMinimumValue == ValueAxis.ActualMaximumValue)
			{
				radialBaseView.BucketCalculator.BucketSize = 0;
				result = false;
			}
			return result;
		}

		protected internal override void RenderSeriesOverride(bool animate)
		{
			GetViewInfo(out var viewportRect, out var windowRect);
			if (!ValidateSeries(viewportRect, windowRect, base.View))
			{
				ClearRendering(wipeClean: true, base.View);
				return;
			}
			SeriesRenderingArguments args = new SeriesRenderingArguments(this, viewportRect, windowRect, animate, base.SkipPrepare);
			SeriesRenderer.Render(args, ref PreviousFrame, ref CurrentFrame, ref TransitionFrame, RadialView);
		}

		internal int GetMode2Index()
		{
			int num = 0;
			foreach (Series item in base.SeriesViewer.Series)
			{
				if (item == this)
				{
					return num;
				}
				if (item is RadialBase radialBase && radialBase.AngleAxis == AngleAxis && radialBase.PreferredCategoryMode(radialBase.AngleAxis) == CategoryMode.Mode2)
				{
					num++;
				}
			}
			return -1;
		}
	}
	public sealed class RadialColumnSeries : AnchoredRadialSeries

		public static readonly DependencyProperty RadiusYProperty = DependencyProperty.Register("RadiusY", typeof(double), typeof(RadialColumnSeries), new PropertyMetadata(0.0, delegate(DependencyObject sender, DependencyPropertyChangedEventArgs e)
		{
			((RadialColumnSeries)sender).RaisePropertyChanged("RadiusY", e.OldValue, e.NewValue);

		public override bool IsColumn => true;

			base.ClearRendering(wipeClean, view);
			RadialColumnSeriesView radialColumnSeriesView = (RadialColumnSeriesView)view;

			{
				radialColumnSeriesView.Columns.Count = 0;
			}
		}

		public override double GetItemSpan()
		{
			return base.AngleAxis.GetGroupSize(base.View.WindowRect, base.View.Viewport, GetEffectiveViewport(base.View));
		}

		internal override void RenderFrame(RadialFrame radialFrame, RadialBaseView view)
		{
			base.RenderFrame(radialFrame, view);
			List<double[]> buckets = radialFrame.Buckets;
			Rect windowRect = view.WindowRect;
			Rect viewport = view.Viewport;
			Rect effectiveViewport = GetEffectiveViewport(view);
			Rect contentViewport = GetContentViewport(view);
			PolarAxisRenderingParameters polarAxisRenderingParameters = (PolarAxisRenderingParameters)base.ValueAxis.CreateRenderingParams(viewport, windowRect, effectiveViewport, contentViewport);
			RadialColumnSeriesView radialColumnSeriesView = (RadialColumnSeriesView)view;
			NumericRadiusAxis valueAxis = base.ValueAxis;
			double val = Math.Max(0.0, 0.5 * valueAxis.ActualInnerRadiusExtentScale);
			val = Math.Max(val, polarAxisRenderingParameters.MinLength * 0.9);
			double num = ViewportUtils.TransformXToViewportLength(val, windowRect, viewport);
			double groupSize = base.AngleAxis.GetGroupSize(windowRect, viewport, effectiveViewport);
			double radius = Math.Max(0.1 * base.ValueAxis.ActualRadiusExtentScale, val);
			double xValue = _axes.GetXValue(0.0, radius, windowRect, viewport);
			double yValue = _axes.GetYValue(0.0, radius, windowRect, viewport);
			double xValue2 = _axes.GetXValue(groupSize, radius, windowRect, viewport);
			double yValue2 = _axes.GetYValue(groupSize, radius, windowRect, viewport);
			double num2 = Math.Sqrt((xValue - xValue2) * (xValue - xValue2) + (yValue - yValue2) * (yValue - yValue2));
			if (num2 < 1.0)
			{
				num2 = 1.0;
			}
			Point point = new Point(ViewportUtils.TransformXToViewport(0.5, windowRect, viewport), ViewportUtils.TransformYToViewport(0.5, windowRect, viewport));
			int count = base.ValueColumn.Count;
			RenderManager.InitRadialRenderSettings(this, ShouldOverrideRadialStyle(), GetCategoryItems, GetBucketSize(view), GetFirstBucket(view));
			RenderManager.InitialRenderRadiusX = RadiusX;
			RenderManager.InitialRenderRadiusY = RadiusY;
			RenderManager.ActualRenderRadiusX = RadiusX;
			RenderManager.ActualRenderRadiusY = RadiusY;
			bool flag = false;
			if (RenderManager.OverrideArgs != null)
			{
				flag = true;
			}
			CategoryAngleAxis angleAxis = base.AngleAxis;
			ScalerParams scalerParams = new ScalerParams(view.WindowRect, view.Viewport, angleAxis.IsInverted);
			scalerParams.EffectiveViewportRect = GetEffectiveViewport();
			for (int i = 0; i < buckets.Count; i++)
			{
				double radius2 = Math.Min(radialFrame.Buckets[i][2], polarAxisRenderingParameters.MaxLength * 1.1);
				double xValue3 = _axes.GetXValue(radialFrame.Buckets[i][0], radius2, windowRect, viewport);
				double yValue3 = _axes.GetYValue(radialFrame.Buckets[i][0], radius2, windowRect, viewport);
				double num3 = Math.Sqrt((xValue3 - point.X) * (xValue3 - point.X) + (yValue3 - point.Y) * (yValue3 - point.Y));
				double num4 = num;
				if (flag)
				{
					PerformRadialStyleOverride(buckets, i, count, angleAxis, scalerParams, view.IsThumbnailView);
				}
				_ = RenderManager.ActualRenderRadiusX;
				_ = RenderManager.ActualRenderRadiusY;
				Rectangle rectangle = radialColumnSeriesView.Columns[i];
				rectangle.Width = num2;
				rectangle.Height = Math.Abs(num3 - num4);
				double angle = radialFrame.Buckets[i][0] * 180.0 / Math.PI - 90.0;
				double xpos = point.X - num2 * 0.5;
				double ypos = point.Y + Math.Min(num4, num3);
				radialColumnSeriesView.PositionRectangle(rectangle, xpos, ypos, angle, point.X, point.Y);
				rectangle.RadiusX = RenderManager.ActualRenderRadiusX;
				rectangle.RadiusY = RenderManager.ActualRenderRadiusY;
				RenderManager.SetShapeAppearance(rectangle, strokeOnly: false, fillOnly: false, extended: false, useOutline: false);
			}
			radialColumnSeriesView.Columns.Count = buckets.Count;
			RadialColumnView.FinalizeColumns();
		}
	}

			((RadialLineSeriesView)view).ClearRadialLine();

		internal override void RenderFrame(RadialFrame radialFrame, RadialBaseView view)
		{
			base.RenderFrame(radialFrame, view);
			Rect windowRect = view.WindowRect;
			Rect viewport = view.Viewport;
			List<double[]> buckets = radialFrame.Buckets;
			int count = buckets.Count;
			List<double[]> list = new List<double[]>(count);
			double num = 0.0;
			for (int i = 0; i < count; i++)
			{
				double[] array = new double[4];
				list.Add(array);
				array[0] = _axes.GetXValue(radialFrame.Buckets[i][0], radialFrame.Buckets[i][1], windowRect, viewport);
				array[1] = _axes.GetYValue(radialFrame.Buckets[i][0], radialFrame.Buckets[i][1], windowRect, viewport);
				array[2] = _axes.GetXValue(radialFrame.Buckets[i][0], radialFrame.Buckets[i][2], windowRect, viewport);
				double num2 = radialFrame.Buckets[i][2];
				array[3] = _axes.GetYValue(radialFrame.Buckets[i][0], num2, windowRect, viewport);
				if (num2 > num)
				{
					num = num2;
				}
			}
			Rect effectiveViewport = GetEffectiveViewport(view);
			RenderManager.InitRadialRenderSettings(this, ShouldOverrideRadialStyle(), GetCategoryItems, GetBucketSize(view), GetFirstBucket(view));
			bool flag = false;
			if (RenderManager.OverrideArgs != null)
			{
				flag = true;
			}
			if (flag)
			{
				ScalerParams axisParams = new ScalerParams(view.WindowRect, view.Viewport, base.AngleAxis.IsInverted, effectiveViewport);
				PerformRadialStyleOverride(buckets, -1, base.ValueColumn.Count, base.AngleAxis, axisParams, view.IsThumbnailView);
			}
			RadialLineSeriesView radialLineSeriesView = (RadialLineSeriesView)view;
			Path polyline = radialLineSeriesView.Polyline0;
			Path polyline2 = radialLineSeriesView.Polyline1;
			Path polygon = radialLineSeriesView.Polygon01;
			RenderManager.SetShapeAppearance(polyline, strokeOnly: true, fillOnly: false, extended: true, useOutline: false);
			RenderManager.SetShapeAppearance(polyline2, strokeOnly: true, fillOnly: false, extended: true, useOutline: false);
			RenderManager.SetShapeAppearance(polygon, strokeOnly: false, fillOnly: true, extended: false, useOutline: false);
			polygon.Opacity = 0.75 * RenderManager.ActualRenderOpacity;
			radialLineSeriesView.RenderRadialLine(count, list, useX0AsX1: false, UnknownValuePlotting, GetLineClipper(list, count - 1, view), radialLineSeriesView.BucketCalculator.BucketSize, base.Resolution);
		}

		protected override void PropertyUpdatedOverride(object sender, string propertyName, object oldValue, object newValue)
		{
			base.PropertyUpdatedOverride(sender, propertyName, oldValue, newValue);
			if (propertyName == "UnknownValuePlotting")
			{
				RenderSeries(animate: false);
				NotifyThumbnailAppearanceChanged();
			}
		}
	}
	[WidgetIgnoreDepends("MarkerSeries")]
	[WidgetIgnoreDepends("RadialBase")]
	[WidgetIgnoreDepends("CategoryAxisBase")]
	[WidgetIgnoreDepends("CategoryDateTimeXAxis")]
	public class RadialSeriesRenderManager : SeriesRenderManager
	{
		public int BucketSize;

		public int FirstBucket;

		public AssigningRadialMarkerStyleEventArgs RadialMarkerOverrideArgs;

		public AssigningRadialStyleEventArgs RadialOverrideArgs;

		protected override AssigningSeriesStyleEventArgsBase CreateMarkerOverrideArgs()
		{
			RadialMarkerOverrideArgs = new AssigningRadialMarkerStyleEventArgs();
			return RadialMarkerOverrideArgs;
		}

		protected override AssigningSeriesShapeStyleEventArgsBase CreateShapeStyleOverrideArgs()
		{
			RadialOverrideArgs = new AssigningRadialStyleEventArgs();
			return RadialOverrideArgs;
		}

		public void InitRadialMarkerRenderSettings(MarkerSeries source, bool shouldOverrideMarkerStyle, GetCategoryItemsHandler getItems, int size, int first)
		{
			BucketSize = size;
			FirstBucket = first;
			InitMarkerRenderSettings(source, shouldOverrideMarkerStyle, getItems);
		}

		public void InitRadialRenderSettings(Series source, bool shouldOverrideRadialStyle, GetCategoryItemsHandler getItems, int size, int first)
		{
			BucketSize = size;
			FirstBucket = first;
			InitRenderSettings(source, shouldOverrideRadialStyle, getItems);
		}

		protected internal int[] GetBucketBounds(int count, int bucket)
		{
			int bucketSize = BucketSize;
			int num = Math.Min(bucket * bucketSize, count - 1);
			int num2 = Math.Min(num + bucketSize - 1, count - 1);
			return new int[2]
			{
				Math.Min(num + FirstBucket * bucketSize, count - 1),
				Math.Min(num2 + FirstBucket * bucketSize, count - 1)
			};
		}

		public void PopulateArgsBounds(AssigningSeriesStyleEventArgsBase args, bool isSorting, List<double[]> buckets, int currentIndex, int valueCount, CategoryAxisBase categoryAxis, ScalerParams axisParams, bool isThumbnail, bool isMarker)
		{
			if (currentIndex == -1)
			{
				args.HasDateRange = false;
				args.StartIndex = 0;
				args.EndIndex = valueCount - 1;
			}
			else if (isMarker)
			{
				args.StartIndex = currentIndex;
				args.EndIndex = currentIndex;
			}
			else
			{
				int[] bucketBounds = GetBucketBounds(valueCount, currentIndex);
				args.HasDateRange = false;
				args.StartIndex = bucketBounds[0];
				args.EndIndex = bucketBounds[1];
			}
		}
	}
	internal class SliceCoords
	{
		public Point A { get; set; }

		public Point B { get; set; }

		public Point C { get; set; }

		public Point D { get; set; }

		public Point A2 { get; set; }

		public Point B2 { get; set; }

		public Point C2 { get; set; }

		public Point D2 { get; set; }

		public bool IsLargeArc { get; set; }

		public Size OuterSize { get; set; }

		public Size InnerSize { get; set; }

		public Size CornerSize { get; set; }

		public static SliceCoords GetSliceCoords(Rect windowRect, Rect viewportRect, double startAngle, double endAngle, double zero, double radius, Point center)
		{
			double num = Math.Min(startAngle, endAngle);
			double num2 = Math.Max(startAngle, endAngle);
			double num3 = Math.Cos(num);
			double num4 = Math.Sin(num);
			double num5 = Math.Max(0.0, zero);
			double xValue = center.X + num3 * num5;
			double yValue = center.Y + num4 * num5;
			double xValue2 = center.X + num3 * radius;
			double yValue2 = center.Y + num4 * radius;
			double num6 = Math.Cos(num2);
			double num7 = Math.Sin(num2);
			double xValue3 = center.X + num6 * num5;
			double yValue3 = center.Y + num7 * num5;
			double xValue4 = center.X + num6 * radius;
			double yValue4 = center.Y + num7 * radius;
			xValue = ViewportUtils.TransformXToViewport(xValue, windowRect, viewportRect);
			yValue = ViewportUtils.TransformYToViewport(yValue, windowRect, viewportRect);
			xValue2 = ViewportUtils.TransformXToViewport(xValue2, windowRect, viewportRect);
			yValue2 = ViewportUtils.TransformYToViewport(yValue2, windowRect, viewportRect);
			xValue3 = ViewportUtils.TransformXToViewport(xValue3, windowRect, viewportRect);
			yValue3 = ViewportUtils.TransformYToViewport(yValue3, windowRect, viewportRect);
			xValue4 = ViewportUtils.TransformXToViewport(xValue4, windowRect, viewportRect);
			yValue4 = ViewportUtils.TransformYToViewport(yValue4, windowRect, viewportRect);
			Point a = new Point(xValue, yValue);
			Point b = new Point(xValue2, yValue2);
			Point c = new Point(xValue4, yValue4);
			Point d = new Point(xValue3, yValue3);
			double width = ViewportUtils.TransformXToViewportLength(radius, windowRect, viewportRect);
			double height = ViewportUtils.TransformYToViewportLength(radius, windowRect, viewportRect);
			double width2 = ViewportUtils.TransformXToViewportLength(num5, windowRect, viewportRect);
			double height2 = ViewportUtils.TransformYToViewportLength(num5, windowRect, viewportRect);
			return new SliceCoords
			{
				A = a,
				B = b,
				C = c,
				D = d,
				IsLargeArc = (num2 - num > Math.PI),
				OuterSize = new Size(width, height),
				InnerSize = new Size(width2, height2)
			};
		}

		internal static SliceCoords GetRoundedSliceCoords(Rect windowRect, Rect viewportRect, double startAngle, double endAngle, double zero, double radius, Point center, [SwiftMutableParameter] double radiusX, [SwiftMutableParameter] double radiusY)
		{
			double num = ViewportUtils.TransformXFromViewportLength(radiusY, windowRect, viewportRect);
			double num2 = radius - zero;
			if (num2 < 0.0)
			{
				return null;
			}
			if (ViewportUtils.TransformXToViewportLength(num2, windowRect, viewportRect) < 2.0)
			{
				return null;
			}
			if (num * 2.0 > num2)
			{
				num = num2 / 2.0;
				radiusY = ViewportUtils.TransformXToViewportLength(num, windowRect, viewportRect);
			}
			double num3 = Math.Atan(ViewportUtils.TransformXFromViewportLength(radiusX, windowRect, viewportRect) / (radius - num));
			if (num3 * 2.0 > Math.Abs(endAngle - startAngle))
			{
				num3 = Math.Abs(endAngle - startAngle) / 2.0;
				radiusX = ViewportUtils.TransformXToViewportLength(Math.Tan(num3) * (radius - num), windowRect, viewportRect);
			}
			SliceCoords sliceCoords = GetSliceCoords(windowRect, viewportRect, startAngle + num3, endAngle - num3, zero, radius, center);
			SliceCoords sliceCoords2 = GetSliceCoords(windowRect, viewportRect, startAngle, endAngle, zero + num * (zero / radius), radius - num, center);
			sliceCoords.B2 = sliceCoords.B;
			sliceCoords.D2 = sliceCoords.D;
			sliceCoords.A2 = sliceCoords2.A;
			sliceCoords.B = sliceCoords2.B;
			sliceCoords.C2 = sliceCoords2.C;
			sliceCoords.D = sliceCoords2.D;
			sliceCoords.CornerSize = new Size(radiusX, radiusY);
			return sliceCoords;
		}
	}

		private PathGeometry DrawSlice(Rect windowRect, Rect viewportRect, double startAngle, double endAngle, double zero, double radius, Point center)
		{
			SliceCoords sliceCoords = SliceCoords.GetSliceCoords(windowRect, viewportRect, startAngle, endAngle, zero, radius, center);
			PathFigure pathFigure = new PathFigure();
			pathFigure.StartPoint = sliceCoords.A;
			pathFigure.IsClosed = true;
			pathFigure.Segments.Add(new LineSegment
			{
				Point = sliceCoords.B
			});
			pathFigure.Segments.Add(new ArcSegment
			{
				Point = sliceCoords.C,
				Size = sliceCoords.OuterSize,
				SweepDirection = SweepDirection.Clockwise,
				IsLargeArc = sliceCoords.IsLargeArc
			});
			pathFigure.Segments.Add(new LineSegment
			{
				Point = sliceCoords.D
			});
			pathFigure.Segments.Add(new ArcSegment
			{
				Point = sliceCoords.A,
				Size = sliceCoords.InnerSize,
				SweepDirection = SweepDirection.Counterclockwise,
				IsLargeArc = sliceCoords.IsLargeArc
			});
			return new PathGeometry
			{
				Figures = { pathFigure }
			};
		}

		private PathGeometry DrawRoundedSlice(Rect windowRect, Rect viewportRect, double startAngle, double endAngle, double zero, double radius, Point center, double radiusX, double radiusY)
		{
			SliceCoords roundedSliceCoords = SliceCoords.GetRoundedSliceCoords(windowRect, viewportRect, startAngle, endAngle, zero, radius, center, radiusX, radiusY);
			if (roundedSliceCoords == null)
			{
				return DrawSlice(windowRect, viewportRect, startAngle, endAngle, zero, radius, center);
			}
			PathFigure pathFigure = new PathFigure();
			pathFigure.StartPoint = roundedSliceCoords.A;
			pathFigure.IsClosed = true;
			double rotationAngle = (startAngle + (endAngle - startAngle) * 0.5) * 180.0 / Math.PI + 90.0;
			Size size = new Size(roundedSliceCoords.CornerSize.Width * (zero / radius), roundedSliceCoords.CornerSize.Height * (zero / radius));
			pathFigure.Segments.Add(new ArcSegment
			{
				Point = roundedSliceCoords.A2,
				Size = size,
				RotationAngle = rotationAngle,
				SweepDirection = SweepDirection.Clockwise,
				IsLargeArc = false
			});
			pathFigure.Segments.Add(new LineSegment
			{
				Point = roundedSliceCoords.B
			});
			pathFigure.Segments.Add(new ArcSegment
			{
				Point = roundedSliceCoords.B2,
				Size = roundedSliceCoords.CornerSize,
				RotationAngle = rotationAngle,
				SweepDirection = SweepDirection.Clockwise,
				IsLargeArc = false
			});
			pathFigure.Segments.Add(new ArcSegment
			{
				Point = roundedSliceCoords.C,
				Size = roundedSliceCoords.OuterSize,
				SweepDirection = SweepDirection.Clockwise,
				IsLargeArc = roundedSliceCoords.IsLargeArc
			});
			pathFigure.Segments.Add(new ArcSegment
			{
				Point = roundedSliceCoords.C2,
				Size = roundedSliceCoords.CornerSize,
				RotationAngle = rotationAngle,
				SweepDirection = SweepDirection.Clockwise,
				IsLargeArc = false
			});
			pathFigure.Segments.Add(new LineSegment
			{
				Point = roundedSliceCoords.D
			});
			pathFigure.Segments.Add(new ArcSegment
			{
				Point = roundedSliceCoords.D2,
				Size = size,
				RotationAngle = rotationAngle,
				SweepDirection = SweepDirection.Clockwise,
				IsLargeArc = false
			});
			pathFigure.Segments.Add(new ArcSegment
			{
				Point = roundedSliceCoords.A,
				Size = roundedSliceCoords.InnerSize,
				SweepDirection = SweepDirection.Counterclockwise,
				IsLargeArc = roundedSliceCoords.IsLargeArc
			});
			return new PathGeometry
			{
				Figures = { pathFigure }
			};
		}

		protected override void PropertyUpdatedOverride(object sender, string propertyName, object oldValue, object newValue)
		{
			base.PropertyUpdatedOverride(sender, propertyName, oldValue, newValue);
			if (propertyName == "RadiusX" || propertyName == "RadiusY")
			{
				OnVisualPropertiesChanged();
			}
		}

	internal class RadialTrendLineManager : TrendLineManagerBase<double>
	{
		public override TrendLineManagerType ManagerType => TrendLineManagerType.Radial;

		public double RadiusExtentScale { get; set; }

		public double InnerRadiusExtentScale { get; set; }

		public Func<double, double, double> ProjectX { get; set; }

		public Func<double, double, double> ProjectY { get; set; }

		public void PrepareLine(List<Point> flattenedPoints, TrendLineType trendLineType, IList<double> valueColumn, int period, Func<double, double> GetScaledAngleValue, Func<double, double> GetScaledRadiusValue, TrendResolutionParams trendResolutionParams, Clipper clipper)
		{
			double num = trendResolutionParams.FirstBucket * trendResolutionParams.BucketSize;
			double num2 = trendResolutionParams.LastBucket * trendResolutionParams.BucketSize;
			List<Point> list = new List<Point>();
			if (trendResolutionParams.Window.IsEmpty || trendResolutionParams.Viewport.IsEmpty)
			{
				return;
			}
			if (trendLineType == TrendLineType.None)
			{
				base.TrendCoefficients = null;
				base.TrendColumn.Clear();
				return;
			}
			if (IsFit(trendLineType))
			{
				base.TrendColumn.Clear();
				base.TrendCoefficients = TrendFitCalculator.CalculateFit(list, trendLineType, trendResolutionParams, base.TrendCoefficients, valueColumn.Count, (int i) => i + 1, (int i) => valueColumn[i], (double x) => GetScaledAngleValue(x - 1.0), GetScaledRadiusValue, num + 1.0, num2 + 1.0);
			}
			if (IsAverage(trendLineType))
			{
				base.TrendCoefficients = null;
				TrendAverageCalculator.CalculateSingleValueAverage(trendLineType, base.TrendColumn, valueColumn, period);
				for (int num3 = trendResolutionParams.FirstBucket; num3 <= trendResolutionParams.LastBucket; num3++)
				{
					int num4 = num3 % valueColumn.Count * trendResolutionParams.BucketSize;
					if (num4 >= 0 && num4 < base.TrendColumn.Count)
					{
						double num5 = GetScaledAngleValue(num4);
						double num6 = GetScaledRadiusValue(base.TrendColumn[num4]);
						if (!double.IsNaN(num5) && !double.IsNaN(num6))
						{
							list.Add(new Point(num5 + trendResolutionParams.Offset, num6));
						}
					}
				}
			}
			if (list.Count > 0)
			{
				FlattenTrendLine(list, trendResolutionParams, flattenedPoints, clipper);
			}
		}

		protected override void FlattenTrendLine(IList<Point> trend, TrendResolutionParams trendResolutionParams, List<Point> flattenedPoints)
		{
			FlattenTrendLine(trend, trendResolutionParams, flattenedPoints, null);
		}

		protected override void FlattenTrendLine(IList<Point> trend, TrendResolutionParams trendResolutionParams, List<Point> flattenedPoints, Clipper clipper)
		{
			if (clipper != null)
			{
				clipper.Target = flattenedPoints;
			}
			PolarLinePlanner polarLinePlanner = new PolarLinePlanner();
			polarLinePlanner.AngleProvider = (int i) => trend[i].X;
			polarLinePlanner.RadiusProvider = (int i2) => trend[i2].Y;
			polarLinePlanner.Clipper = clipper;
			polarLinePlanner.Count = trend.Count;
			polarLinePlanner.Resolution = trendResolutionParams.Resolution;
			polarLinePlanner.TransformedXProvider = (int i3) => ProjectX(trend[i3].X, trend[i3].Y);
			polarLinePlanner.TransformedYProvider = (int i4) => ProjectY(trend[i4].X, trend[i4].Y);
			polarLinePlanner.UseCartesianInterpolation = true;
			polarLinePlanner.Viewport = trendResolutionParams.Viewport;
			polarLinePlanner.Window = trendResolutionParams.Window;
			polarLinePlanner.PrepareLine(null, null);
		}
	}
	internal class RangeCategoryBucketCalculator : CategoryBucketCalculator
	{
		[Weak]
		internal RangeCategorySeriesView RangeView { get; set; }

		internal RangeCategoryBucketCalculator(RangeCategorySeriesView view)
			: base(view)
		{
			RangeView = view;
		}

		internal override double[] GetBucketWithoutUnknowns(int index)
		{
			bool flag = false;
			RangeCategorySeries rangeCategorySeries = base.View.CategoryModel as RangeCategorySeries;
			IFastItemColumn<double> lowColumn = rangeCategorySeries.LowColumn;
			IFastItemColumn<double> highColumn = rangeCategorySeries.HighColumn;
			int val = ((rangeCategorySeries.LowColumn != null) ? rangeCategorySeries.LowColumn.Count : 0);
			int val2 = ((rangeCategorySeries.HighColumn != null) ? rangeCategorySeries.HighColumn.Count : 0);
			int num = Math.Min(val, val2);
			int num2 = index * BucketSize;
			int num3 = Math.Min(num2 + BucketSize - 1, num - 1);
			double num4 = double.MaxValue;
			double num5 = double.MinValue;
			bool flag2 = true;
			double num6 = 0.0;
			double num7 = 0.0;
			if (num2 <= num3)
			{
				for (int i = num2; i <= num3; i++)
				{
					num6 = lowColumn[i];
					num7 = highColumn[i];
					double num8;
					double num9;
					if (num6 < num7)
					{
						num8 = num6;
						num9 = num7;
					}
					else
					{
						num9 = num6;
						num8 = num7;
					}
					if (!flag2)
					{
						num4 = ((num4 < num8) ? num4 : num8);
						num5 = ((num5 > num8) ? num5 : num8);
						num4 = ((num4 < num9) ? num4 : num9);
						num5 = ((num5 > num9) ? num5 : num9);
					}
					else
					{
						num4 = Math.Min(num4, num8);
						num5 = Math.Max(num5, num8);
						num5 = Math.Max(num5, num9);
						num4 = Math.Min(num4, num9);
						flag2 = false;
					}
				}
			}
			if (flag && num7 < num6)
			{
				double num10 = num4;
				num4 = num5;
				num5 = num10;
			}
			if (flag2)
			{
				return new double[3]
				{
					double.NaN,
					double.NaN,
					double.NaN
				};
			}
			return new double[3]
			{
				0.5 * (double)(num2 + num3),
				num4,
				num5
			};
		}

		internal override double[] GetBucket(int index)
		{
			bool flag = false;
			RangeCategorySeries rangeCategorySeries = base.View.CategoryModel as RangeCategorySeries;
			IFastItemColumn<double> lowColumn = rangeCategorySeries.LowColumn;
			IFastItemColumn<double> highColumn = rangeCategorySeries.HighColumn;
			int val = ((rangeCategorySeries.LowColumn != null) ? rangeCategorySeries.LowColumn.Count : 0);
			int val2 = ((rangeCategorySeries.HighColumn != null) ? rangeCategorySeries.HighColumn.Count : 0);
			int num = Math.Min(val, val2);
			int num2 = index * BucketSize;
			int num3 = Math.Min(num2 + BucketSize - 1, num - 1);
			double num4 = double.NaN;
			double num5 = double.NaN;
			bool flag2 = true;
			double num6 = 0.0;
			double num7 = 0.0;
			if (num2 <= num3)
			{
				for (int i = num2; i <= num3; i++)
				{
					num6 = lowColumn[i];
					num7 = highColumn[i];
					double num8;
					double num9;
					if (num6 < num7)
					{
						num8 = num6;
						num9 = num7;
					}
					else
					{
						num9 = num6;
						num8 = num7;
					}
					if (!flag2)
					{
						if (!double.IsNaN(num8))
						{
							num4 = ((num4 < num8) ? num4 : num8);
							num5 = ((num5 > num8) ? num5 : num8);
						}
						if (!double.IsNaN(num9))
						{
							num4 = ((num4 < num9) ? num4 : num9);
							num5 = ((num5 > num9) ? num5 : num9);
						}
						continue;
					}
					if (!double.IsNaN(num8))
					{
						num4 = ((!double.IsNaN(num4)) ? Math.Min(num4, num8) : num8);
						if (!double.IsNaN(num5))
						{
							num5 = Math.Max(num5, num8);
						}
					}
					if (!double.IsNaN(num9))
					{
						num5 = ((!double.IsNaN(num5)) ? Math.Max(num5, num9) : num9);
						if (!double.IsNaN(num4))
						{
							num4 = Math.Min(num4, num9);
						}
					}
					if (!double.IsNaN(num4) && !double.IsNaN(num5))
					{
						flag2 = false;
					}
				}
			}
			if (num7 < num6 && flag)
			{
				double num10 = num4;
				num4 = num5;
				num5 = num10;
			}
			if (flag2)
			{
				return new double[3]
				{
					double.NaN,
					double.NaN,
					double.NaN
				};
			}
			return new double[3]
			{
				0.5 * (double)(num2 + num3),
				num4,
				num5
			};
		}

	public sealed class RangeAreaSeries : HorizontalRangeCategorySeries
	{
		[TSSuppressSynthesizedInitializer]
		internal RangeAreaSeriesView RangeAreaView { get; set; }

		public override bool IsAreaOrLine => true;

		public override bool IsArea => true;

		protected override SeriesView CreateView()
		{
			return new RangeAreaSeriesView(this);
		}

		protected internal override void OnViewCreated(SeriesView view)
		{
			base.OnViewCreated(view);
			RangeAreaView = (RangeAreaSeriesView)view;
		}

		protected bool TestRangeAreaOver(Point position, Point lowPosition, Point highPosition, bool isFinger)
		{
			if (double.IsNaN(lowPosition.X) || double.IsNaN(lowPosition.Y))
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (double.IsNaN(highPosition.X) || double.IsNaN(highPosition.Y))
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (position.Y <= lowPosition.Y && position.Y >= highPosition.Y)
			{
				return true;
			}
			return false;
		}

		public override bool TestHit(Point position, bool isFinger)
		{
			if (TestHighLowStrokeOver(position, isFinger))
			{
				return true;
			}
			if (TestMarkersOver(position, isFinger))
			{
				return true;
			}
			return false;
		}

		public RangeAreaSeries()
		{
			base.DefaultStyleKey = typeof(RangeAreaSeries);
		}

		internal override CategoryMode PreferredCategoryMode(CategoryAxisBase axis)
		{
			return CategoryMode.Mode0;
		}

		protected internal override void ClearRendering(bool wipeClean, SeriesView view)
		{
			base.ClearRendering(wipeClean, view);
			((RangeAreaSeriesView)view).ClearRangeArea();
		}

		internal override void RenderFrame(CategoryFrame frame, CategorySeriesView view)
		{
			base.RenderFrame(frame, view);
			int count = frame.Buckets.Count;
			List<double[]> list = new List<double[]>(count);
			for (int i = 0; i < count; i++)
			{
				double[] array = frame.Buckets[i];
				double[] array2 = new double[4]
				{
					array[0],
					array[1],
					0.0,
					0.0
				};
				double[] array3 = frame.Buckets[frame.Buckets.Count - 1 - i];
				array2[2] = array3[0];
				array2[3] = array3[2];
				list.Add(array2);
			}
			RangeAreaSeriesView rangeAreaSeriesView = view as RangeAreaSeriesView;
			Rect effectiveViewport = GetEffectiveViewport(rangeAreaSeriesView);
			RenderManager.InitCategoryRenderSettings(this, ShouldOverrideCategoryStyle(), GetCategoryItems, GetBucketSize(view), GetFirstBucket(view));
			bool flag = false;
			if (RenderManager.OverrideArgs != null)
			{
				flag = true;
			}
			if (flag)
			{
				ScalerParams axisParams = new ScalerParams(view.WindowRect, view.Viewport, base.XAxis.IsInverted, effectiveViewport);
				PerformCategoryStyleOverride(list, -1, base.LowColumn.Count, base.XAxis, axisParams, view.IsThumbnailView);
			}
			Polyline polyline = rangeAreaSeriesView.Polyline0;
			Polyline polyline2 = rangeAreaSeriesView.Polyline1;
			Polygon polygon = rangeAreaSeriesView.Polygon01;
			RenderManager.SetShapeAppearance(polyline, strokeOnly: true, fillOnly: false, extended: true, useOutline: true);
			RenderManager.SetShapeAppearance(polyline2, strokeOnly: true, fillOnly: false, extended: true, useOutline: true);
			RenderManager.SetShapeAppearance(polygon, strokeOnly: false, fillOnly: true, extended: false, useOutline: false);
			if (view.CheckFrameDirty(frame))
			{
				rangeAreaSeriesView.RasterizeRangeArea(frame.Buckets.Count, list, useX0asX1: false);
				view.UpdateFrameVersion(frame);
			}
			rangeAreaSeriesView.Polygon01.Opacity = RenderManager.ActualRenderOpacity * base.ActualAreaFillOpacity;
		}
	}
	internal class HighLowValuesHolder : ValuesHolder
	{
		public IList<double> HighValues { get; set; }

		public IList<double> LowValues { get; set; }

		public override int Count
		{
			get
			{
				if (HighValues == null || LowValues == null)
				{
					return 0;
				}
				return Math.Min(HighValues.Count, LowValues.Count);
			}
		}
	}

	internal class RangeCategoryFramePreparer : CategoryFramePreparerBase
	{
		[Weak]
		protected IHasCategoryTrendline TrendlineHost { get; set; }

		[Weak]
		protected IHasHighLowValueCategory ValuesProvider { get; set; }

		public RangeCategoryFramePreparer(IIsCategoryBased host)
			: this(host, host as ISupportsMarkers, host as IProvidesViewport, host as ISupportsErrorBars, host as IBucketizer)
		{
		}

		public RangeCategoryFramePreparer(IIsCategoryBased host, ISupportsMarkers markersHost, IProvidesViewport viewportHost, ISupportsErrorBars errorBarsHost, IBucketizer bucketizingHost)
			: base(host, markersHost, viewportHost, errorBarsHost, bucketizingHost)
		{
			TrendlineHost = new DefaultCategoryTrendlineHost();
			if (host is IHasCategoryTrendline)
			{
				TrendlineHost = host as IHasCategoryTrendline;
			}
			ValuesProvider = new DefaultHighLowValueProvider();
			if (host is IHasHighLowValueCategory)
			{
				ValuesProvider = host as IHasHighLowValueCategory;
			}
		}

		protected override bool PrepareMarker(CategoryFrame frame, double[] bucket, IDetectsCollisions collisionAvoider, int itemIndex, int markerCount, int markerBucket)
		{
			double num = bucket[0];
			double num2 = bucket[1];
			double num3 = bucket[2];
			if (!double.IsNaN(num) && !double.IsNaN(num2) && !double.IsNaN(num3))
			{
				frame.Markers.Add(new Point(num, (num2 + num3) / 2.0));
				base.MarkersHost.UpdateMarkerTemplate(markerCount, itemIndex, markerBucket);
				return true;
			}
			return false;
		}

		protected override void StoreYValues(ValuesHolder h, int index, bool useTemp, bool isFragment)
		{
			HighLowValuesHolder highLowValuesHolder = (HighLowValuesHolder)h;
			IList<double> highValues = highLowValuesHolder.HighValues;
			IList<double> lowValues = highLowValuesHolder.LowValues;
			double val = highValues[index];
			double val2 = lowValues[index];
			double num = Math.Max(val, val2);
			double num2 = Math.Min(val, val2);
			if (useTemp)
			{
				highLowValuesHolder.TempY0 = num2;
				highLowValuesHolder.TempY1 = num;
			}
			else
			{
				highLowValuesHolder.BucketY1 = num;
				highLowValuesHolder.BucketY0 = num2;
			}
		}

		protected override void MinMaxYValues(ValuesHolder h, int index, bool isFragment)
		{
			HighLowValuesHolder highLowValuesHolder = (HighLowValuesHolder)h;
			IList<double> highValues = highLowValuesHolder.HighValues;
			IList<double> lowValues = highLowValuesHolder.LowValues;
			double num = highValues[index];
			double num2 = lowValues[index];
			if (!double.IsNaN(num))
			{
				highLowValuesHolder.BucketY1 = Math.Max(highLowValuesHolder.BucketY1, num);
				highLowValuesHolder.BucketY0 = Math.Min(highLowValuesHolder.BucketY0, num);
			}
			if (!double.IsNaN(num2))
			{
				highLowValuesHolder.BucketY1 = Math.Max(highLowValuesHolder.BucketY1, num2);
				highLowValuesHolder.BucketY0 = Math.Min(highLowValuesHolder.BucketY0, num2);
			}
		}

		protected override double[] GetBucketSorting(double xVal, ValuesHolder h)
		{
			HighLowValuesHolder highLowValuesHolder = (HighLowValuesHolder)h;
			return new double[3] { xVal, highLowValuesHolder.BucketY0, highLowValuesHolder.BucketY1 };
		}

		protected override void ScaleBucketValues(PreparationParams p, double[] bucket, double offset, bool isSortingScaler, ScalerParams xParams, ScalerParams yParams)
		{
			if (isSortingScaler)
			{
				bucket[0] += offset;
			}
			else
			{
				bucket[0] = p.Scaler.GetScaledValue(bucket[0], xParams) + offset;
			}
			bucket[1] = p.YScaler.GetScaledValue(bucket[1], yParams);
			bucket[2] = p.YScaler.GetScaledValue(bucket[2], yParams);
		}

		protected override void ScaleFrameBucketValues(PreparationParams pp, double offset, bool isSortingScaler, ScalerParams xParams, ScalerParams yParams, bool errorBars, bool markers)
		{
			base.ScaleFrameBucketValues(pp, offset, isSortingScaler, xParams, yParams, errorBars, markers);
			_ = pp.BucketSize;
			int count = pp.Frame.Buckets.Count;
			List<double[]> buckets = pp.Frame.Buckets;
			List<double[]> markerBuckets = base.MarkerBuckets;
			int count2 = markerBuckets.Count;
			List<int> list = new List<int>();
			if (!isSortingScaler)
			{
				list.Add(0);
			}
			List<int> list2 = new List<int>();
			list2.Add(1);
			list2.Add(2);
			pp.Scaler.GetScaledBucketValueList(buckets, list, 0, count, xParams);
			pp.YScaler.GetScaledBucketValueList(buckets, list2, 0, count, yParams);
			for (int i = 0; i < count; i++)
			{
				buckets[i][0] = buckets[i][0] + offset;
			}
			if (markers)
			{
				pp.Scaler.GetScaledBucketValueList(markerBuckets, list, 0, count2, xParams);
				pp.YScaler.GetScaledBucketValueList(markerBuckets, list2, 0, count2, yParams);
				for (int j = 0; j < count2; j++)
				{
					markerBuckets[j][0] = markerBuckets[j][0] + offset;
				}
			}
		}

		protected override ValuesHolder GetValues(PreparationParams p)
		{
			return new HighLowValuesHolder
			{
				HighValues = ValuesProvider.HighColumn,
				LowValues = ValuesProvider.LowColumn
			};
		}
	}

		protected internal override AxisRange GetVisibleRange([SwiftMutableParameter] Rect forWindow)
		{
			if (forWindow.IsEmpty && base.SeriesViewer != null)
			{
				forWindow = base.SeriesViewer.ActualWindowRect;
			}
			CategoryAxisBase categoryAxis = GetCategoryAxis();
			if (LowColumn == null || HighColumn == null)
			{
				return null;
			}
			Rect contentViewport = GetContentViewport(base.View);
			ScalerParams p = new ScalerParams(forWindow, base.SeriesViewer.ViewportRect, categoryAxis.IsInverted, GetEffectiveViewport());
			double num = categoryAxis.GetUnscaledValue(contentViewport.Left, p);
			double num2 = categoryAxis.GetUnscaledValue(contentViewport.Right, p);
			if (categoryAxis.IsInverted)
			{
				double num3 = num;
				num = num2;
				num2 = num3;
			}
			ISortingAxis sortingAxis = null;
			if (categoryAxis.IsSorting)
			{
				sortingAxis = (ISortingAxis)categoryAxis;
				num = sortingAxis.GetIndexClosestToUnscaledValue(num);
				num2 = sortingAxis.GetIndexClosestToUnscaledValue(num2);
			}
			else
			{
				num = Math.Floor(num);
				num2 = Math.Ceiling(num2);
			}
			num = Math.Max(0.0, Math.Min(LowColumn.Count - 1, num));
			num2 = Math.Max(0.0, Math.Min(LowColumn.Count - 1, num2));
			double num4 = double.MaxValue;
			double num5 = double.MinValue;
			for (int i = (int)num; i <= (int)num2; i++)
			{
				int index = i;
				if (sortingAxis != null)
				{
					index = sortingAxis.SortedIndices[i];
				}
				double num6 = LowColumn[index];
				if (!LowColumn.MayContainUnknowns || (!double.IsInfinity(num6) && !double.IsNaN(num6)))
				{
					double num7 = HighColumn[index];
					if (!HighColumn.MayContainUnknowns || (!double.IsInfinity(num7) && !double.IsNaN(num7)))
					{
						num4 = Math.Min(num4, num6);
						num5 = Math.Max(num5, num7);
					}
				}
			}
			AxisRange range = new AxisRange(num4, num5);
			NumericAxisBase valueAxis = GetValueAxis();
			return ExpandRangeForMargin(range, valueAxis, forWindow);
		}

		public override bool ScrollIntoView(object item)
		{
			Rect rect = new Rect(0.0, 0.0, 1.0, 1.0);
			Rect windowRect = ((base.View != null) ? base.View.WindowRect : Rect.Empty);
			Rect rect2 = ((base.View != null) ? base.View.Viewport : Rect.Empty);
			int num = ((!windowRect.IsEmpty && !rect2.IsEmpty && base.FastItemsSource != null) ? base.FastItemsSource.IndexOf(item) : (-1));
			Axis xAxis = GetXAxis();
			Axis yAxis = GetYAxis();
			Rect effectiveViewportForUnitViewport = GetEffectiveViewportForUnitViewport(base.View);
			double num2;
			if (xAxis != null)
			{
				ScalerParams p = new ScalerParams(rect, rect, xAxis.IsInverted, effectiveViewportForUnitViewport);
				num2 = xAxis.GetScaledValue(num, p);
			}
			else
			{
				num2 = double.NaN;
			}
			double num3 = ((xAxis != null) ? FramePreparer.GetOffset(xAxis as ICategoryScaler, rect, rect, effectiveViewportForUnitViewport) : 0.0);
			num2 += num3;
			if (num >= 0)
			{
				if (!double.IsNaN(num2))
				{
					if (num2 < windowRect.Left + 0.1 * windowRect.Width)
					{
						num2 += 0.4 * windowRect.Width;
					}
					if (num2 > windowRect.Right - 0.1 * windowRect.Width)
					{
						num2 -= 0.4 * windowRect.Width;
					}
					windowRect.X = num2 - 0.5 * windowRect.Width;
				}
				if (yAxis != null && HighColumn != null && num < HighColumn.Count)
				{
					ScalerParams scalerParams = new ScalerParams(rect, rect, yAxis.IsInverted, effectiveViewportForUnitViewport);
					scalerParams.ReferenceValue = GetReferenceValue();
					double scaledValue = yAxis.GetScaledValue(HighColumn[num], scalerParams);
					double num4 = yAxis.GetScaledValue(LowColumn[num], scalerParams);
					if (!double.IsNaN(scaledValue) && !double.IsNaN(num4))
					{
						double num5 = Math.Abs(num4 - scaledValue);
						if (windowRect.Height < num5)
						{
							windowRect.Height = num5;
							windowRect.Y = Math.Min(num4, scaledValue);
						}
						else
						{
							if (num4 < windowRect.Top + 0.1 * windowRect.Height)
							{
								num4 += 0.4 * windowRect.Height;
							}
							if (num4 > windowRect.Bottom - 0.1 * windowRect.Height)
							{
								num4 -= 0.4 * windowRect.Height;
							}
							windowRect.Y = num4 - 0.5 * windowRect.Height;
						}
					}
				}
				if (base.SyncLink != null)
				{
					base.SyncLink.WindowNotify(base.SeriesViewer, windowRect, force: true);
				}
			}
			return num >= 0;
		}

		protected override void PropertyUpdatedOverride(object sender, string propertyName, object oldValue, object newValue)
		{
			base.PropertyUpdatedOverride(sender, propertyName, oldValue, newValue);
			switch (propertyName)
			{
			case "FastItemsSource":
				if (oldValue is IFastItemsSource)
				{
					((IFastItemsSource)oldValue).DeregisterColumn(LowColumn);
					((IFastItemsSource)oldValue).DeregisterColumn(HighColumn);
					LowColumn = null;
					HighColumn = null;
				}
				if (newValue is IFastItemsSource)
				{
					LowColumn = RegisterDoubleColumn(LowMemberPath);
					HighColumn = RegisterDoubleColumn(HighMemberPath);
				}
				if (!UpdateNumericAxisRange())
				{
					base.CategoryView.BucketCalculator.CalculateBuckets(base.Resolution);
					RenderSeries(animate: false);
				}
				break;
			case "LowMemberPath":
				if (base.FastItemsSource != null)
				{
					base.FastItemsSource.DeregisterColumn(LowColumn);
					LowColumn = RegisterDoubleColumn(LowMemberPath);
				}
				break;
			case "LowColumn":
				if (!UpdateNumericAxisRange())
				{
					base.CategoryView.BucketCalculator.CalculateBuckets(base.Resolution);
					RenderSeries(animate: false);
				}
				break;
			case "HighMemberPath":
				if (base.FastItemsSource != null)
				{
					base.FastItemsSource.DeregisterColumn(HighColumn);
					HighColumn = RegisterDoubleColumn(HighMemberPath);
				}
				break;
			case "HighColumn":
				if (!UpdateNumericAxisRange())
				{
					base.CategoryView.BucketCalculator.CalculateBuckets(base.Resolution);
					RenderSeries(animate: false);
				}
				break;
			}
		}

		protected internal override AxisRange GetRange(Axis axis)
		{
			if (LowColumn == null || LowColumn.Count == 0 || HighColumn == null || HighColumn.Count == 0)
			{
				return null;
			}
			if (axis == GetXAxis())
			{
				int num = Math.Min(LowColumn.Count, HighColumn.Count);
				return new AxisRange(0.0, num - 1);
			}
			if (axis == GetYAxis())
			{
				double val = Math.Min(LowColumn.Minimum, HighColumn.Minimum);
				double val2 = Math.Max(LowColumn.Maximum, HighColumn.Maximum);
				return new AxisRange(Math.Min(val, val2), Math.Max(val, val2));
			}
			return null;
		}

		protected override void DataUpdatedOverride(FastItemsSourceEventAction action, int position, int count, string propertyName)
		{
			if (GetXAxis() != null && GetXAxis() is ISortingAxis)
			{
				((ISortingAxis)GetXAxis()).NotifyDataChanged();
			}
			Axis xAxis = GetXAxis();
			switch (action)
			{
			case FastItemsSourceEventAction.Change:
				if (propertyName == LowMemberPath || propertyName == HighMemberPath)
				{
					xAxis?.UpdateRange();
					if (!UpdateNumericAxisRange())
					{
						RenderSeries(animate: true);
					}
				}
				break;
			case FastItemsSourceEventAction.Insert:
				xAxis?.UpdateRange();
				base.CategoryView.BucketCalculator.CalculateBuckets(base.Resolution);
				if (!UpdateNumericAxisRange())
				{
					RenderSeries(animate: true);
				}
				break;
			case FastItemsSourceEventAction.Remove:
				xAxis?.UpdateRange();
				base.CategoryView.BucketCalculator.CalculateBuckets(base.Resolution);
				if (!UpdateNumericAxisRange())
				{
					RenderSeries(animate: true);
				}
				break;
			case FastItemsSourceEventAction.Replace:
				xAxis?.UpdateRange();
				if (LowMemberPath != null && HighMemberPath != null && base.CategoryView.BucketCalculator.BucketSize > 0 && !UpdateNumericAxisRange())
				{
					RenderSeries(animate: true);
				}
				break;
			case FastItemsSourceEventAction.Reset:
				xAxis?.UpdateRange();
				base.CategoryView.BucketCalculator.CalculateBuckets(base.Resolution);
				if (!UpdateNumericAxisRange())
				{
					RenderSeries(animate: true);
				}
				break;
			}
		}

		protected internal override bool ValidateSeries(Rect viewportRect, Rect windowRect, SeriesView view)
		{
			bool result = base.ValidateSeries(viewportRect, windowRect, view);
			if (LowColumn == null || LowColumn.Count == 0 || HighColumn == null || HighColumn.Count == 0)
			{
				result = false;
			}
			return result;
		}

		internal override void PrepareFrame(CategoryFrame frame, CategorySeriesView view)
		{
			base.PrepareFrame(frame, view);
			FramePreparer.PrepareFrame(frame, view);
		}

		IDetectsCollisions IIsCategoryBased.ProvideCollisionDetector()
		{
			return new CollisionAvoider();
		}

		protected internal override void RenderThumbnail(Rect viewportRect, RenderSurface surface)
		{
			bool thumbnailDirty = base.ThumbnailDirty;
			base.RenderThumbnail(viewportRect, surface);
			if (!thumbnailDirty)
			{
				base.View.PrepSurface(surface);
				return;
			}
			base.View.PrepSurface(surface);
			if (!ClearAndAbortIfInvalid(base.ThumbnailView))
			{
				RangeCategoryFramePreparer rangeCategoryFramePreparer = new RangeCategoryFramePreparer(this, base.ThumbnailView as ISupportsMarkers, base.SeriesViewer.View.OverviewPlusDetailViewportHost, this, ((CategorySeriesView)base.ThumbnailView).BucketCalculator);
				if (!base.SkipThumbnailPrepare)
				{
					ThumbnailFrame = new CategoryFrame(3);
					ThumbnailFrame.ClearFrame();
					rangeCategoryFramePreparer.PrepareFrame(ThumbnailFrame, base.ThumbnailView);
				}
				base.SkipThumbnailPrepare = false;
				RenderFrame(ThumbnailFrame, (CategorySeriesView)base.ThumbnailView);
				base.ThumbnailDirty = false;
			}
		}

		public override void RenderAlternateView(Rect viewportRect, Rect windowRect, RenderSurface surface, string viewIdentifier, double effectiveScalingRatio)
		{
			base.RenderAlternateView(viewportRect, windowRect, surface, viewIdentifier, effectiveScalingRatio);
			SeriesView seriesView = base.SeriesInteractionManager.AlternateViews[viewIdentifier];
			RangeCategorySeriesView rangeCategorySeriesView = (RangeCategorySeriesView)seriesView;
			rangeCategorySeriesView.BucketCalculator.CalculateBuckets(base.Resolution);
			seriesView.PrepAltSurface(surface);
			if (!ClearAndAbortIfInvalid(rangeCategorySeriesView))
			{
				RangeCategoryFramePreparer rangeCategoryFramePreparer = new RangeCategoryFramePreparer(this, seriesView as ISupportsMarkers, seriesView, this, ((CategorySeriesView)seriesView).BucketCalculator);
				if (AlternateFrame == null)
				{
					AlternateFrame = new CategoryFrame(3);
				}
				AlternateFrame.ClearFrame();
				rangeCategoryFramePreparer.PrepareFrame(AlternateFrame, rangeCategorySeriesView);
				RenderFrame(AlternateFrame, rangeCategorySeriesView);
			}
		}

		internal override DataContext GetTooltipContext(object item)
		{
			if (item != null)
			{
				FastReflectionHelper fastReflectionHelper = new FastReflectionHelper(useTraditionalReflection: false, LowMemberPath);
				object propertyValue = fastReflectionHelper.GetPropertyValue(item.GetType(), item);
				fastReflectionHelper.PropertyName = HighMemberPath;
				object propertyValue2 = fastReflectionHelper.GetPropertyValue(item.GetType(), item);
				RangeCategorySeriesDataContext rangeCategorySeriesDataContext = new RangeCategorySeriesDataContext
				{
					Series = this,
					Item = item,
					ItemLow = propertyValue,
					ItemHigh = propertyValue2
				};
				Axis xAxis = GetXAxis();
				if (xAxis != null)
				{
					if (!(xAxis is CategoryDateTimeXAxis categoryDateTimeXAxis))
					{
						rangeCategorySeriesDataContext.XAxisLabel = xAxis.GetLabel(item);
					}
					else
					{
						fastReflectionHelper.PropertyName = categoryDateTimeXAxis.DateTimeMemberPath;
						object propertyValue3 = fastReflectionHelper.GetPropertyValue(item.GetType(), item);
						rangeCategorySeriesDataContext.XAxisLabel = $"{propertyValue3:D}";
					}
				}
				Axis yAxis = GetYAxis();
				if (yAxis != null)
				{
					if (!(yAxis is CategoryDateTimeXAxis categoryDateTimeXAxis2))
					{
						rangeCategorySeriesDataContext.YAxisLabel = yAxis.GetLabel(item);
					}
					else
					{
						fastReflectionHelper.PropertyName = categoryDateTimeXAxis2.DateTimeMemberPath;
						object propertyValue4 = fastReflectionHelper.GetPropertyValue(item.GetType(), item);
						rangeCategorySeriesDataContext.YAxisLabel = $"{propertyValue4:D}";
					}
				}
				return rangeCategorySeriesDataContext;
			}
			return new DataContext
			{
				Series = this,
				Item = item
			};
		}

		protected internal override double GetReferenceValue()
		{
			return Series.GetReferenceValue(LowColumn, GetXAxis() as ISortingAxis);
		}
	}

	{

		{
			((RangeColumnSeries)sender).RaisePropertyChanged("RadiusX", e.OldValue, e.NewValue);
		}));

		internal const string RadiusYPropertyName = "RadiusY";

		public static readonly DependencyProperty RadiusYProperty = DependencyProperty.Register("RadiusY", typeof(double), typeof(RangeColumnSeries), new PropertyMetadata(0.0, delegate(DependencyObject sender, DependencyPropertyChangedEventArgs e)
		{
			((RangeColumnSeries)sender).RaisePropertyChanged("RadiusY", e.OldValue, e.NewValue);
		}));

		public override bool IsColumn => true;

		public override bool IsMarkerlessDisplayPreferred => true;

		[TSSuppressSynthesizedInitializer]
		internal RangeColumnSeriesView RangeColumnView { get; set; }

		[WidgetDefaultNumber(0.0)]
		public double RadiusX
		{
			get
			{
				return (double)GetValue(RadiusXProperty);
			}
			set

			}
		}

		[WidgetDefaultNumber(0.0)]
		public double RadiusY
		{
			get
			{
				return (double)GetValue(RadiusYProperty);
			}
			set
