				SetValue(RadiusYProperty, value);
			}
		}

		protected internal override bool HasIndividualElements => true;

		protected override SeriesView CreateView()
		{
			return new RangeColumnSeriesView(this);
		}

		protected internal override void OnViewCreated(SeriesView view)
		{
			base.OnViewCreated(view);
			RangeColumnView = (RangeColumnSeriesView)view;
		}

		public RangeColumnSeries()
		{
			base.DefaultStyleKey = typeof(RangeColumnSeries);
		}

		internal override CategoryMode PreferredCategoryMode(CategoryAxisBase axis)
		{
			return CategoryMode.Mode2;
		}

		public override Rect GetSeriesValueBoundingBox(Point world)
		{
			if (base.XAxis == null || base.YAxis == null)
			{
				return Rect.Empty;
			}
			Point point = FromWorldPosition(world);
			Rect windowRect = base.View.WindowRect;
			Rect viewport = base.View.Viewport;
			Rect effectiveViewport = GetEffectiveViewport(base.View);
			new ScalerParams(windowRect, viewport, base.YAxis.IsInverted, effectiveViewport).ReferenceValue = GetReferenceValue();
			double[][] matchingBuckets = GetMatchingBuckets(GetCategoryAxis(), CurrentFrame.Buckets, GetBucketSize(base.View), GetFirstBucket(base.View), world, skipUnknowns: true);
			if (matchingBuckets == null)
			{
				return Rect.Empty;
			}
			double[] array = matchingBuckets[0];
			double[] array2 = matchingBuckets[1];
			double num = Math.Abs(point.X - array[0]);
			double num2 = Math.Abs(point.X - array2[0]);
			double groupSize = base.XAxis.GetGroupSize(windowRect, viewport, effectiveViewport);
			if (num < num2)
			{
				double x = array[0] - 0.5 * groupSize;
				double val = array[1];
				double val2 = array[2];
				return new Rect(x, Math.Min(val, val2), groupSize, Math.Max(val, val2) - Math.Min(val, val2));
			}
			double x2 = array2[0] - 0.5 * groupSize;
			double val3 = array2[1];
			double val4 = array2[2];
			return new Rect(x2, Math.Min(val3, val4), groupSize, Math.Max(val3, val4) - Math.Min(val3, val4));
		}

		public override bool TestHit(Point position, bool isFinger)
		{
			if (TestShapesOver(position, isFinger))
			{
				return true;
			}
			if (TestMarkersOver(position, isFinger))
			{
				return true;
			}
			return false;
		}

		protected internal override void ClearRendering(bool wipeClean, SeriesView view)
		{
			base.ClearRendering(wipeClean, view);
			RangeColumnSeriesView rangeColumnSeriesView = (RangeColumnSeriesView)view;
			if (wipeClean && rangeColumnSeriesView.Columns != null)
			{
				rangeColumnSeriesView.Columns.Count = 0;
			}
		}

		public override double GetItemSpan()
		{
			return base.XAxis.GetGroupSize(base.View.WindowRect, base.View.Viewport, GetEffectiveViewport(base.View));
		}

		internal override void RenderFrame(CategoryFrame frame, CategorySeriesView view)
		{
			base.RenderFrame(frame, view);
			RangeColumnSeriesView rangeColumnSeriesView = view as RangeColumnSeriesView;
			List<double[]> buckets = frame.Buckets;
			Rect windowRect = view.WindowRect;
			Rect viewport = view.Viewport;
			Rect effectiveViewport = GetEffectiveViewport(view);
			double groupSize = base.XAxis.GetGroupSize(windowRect, viewport, effectiveViewport);
			if (double.IsNaN(groupSize) || double.IsInfinity(groupSize))
			{
				rangeColumnSeriesView.Columns.Count = 0;
				return;
			}
			RenderManager.InitCategoryRenderSettings(this, ShouldOverrideCategoryStyle(), GetCategoryItems, GetBucketSize(view), GetFirstBucket(view));
			RenderManager.InitialRenderRadiusX = RadiusX;
			RenderManager.InitialRenderRadiusY = RadiusY;
			RenderManager.ActualRenderRadiusX = RadiusX;
			RenderManager.ActualRenderRadiusY = RadiusY;
			bool flag = false;
			if (RenderManager.OverrideArgs != null)
			{
				flag = true;
			}
			_ = base.XAxis.IsSorting;
			int count = base.LowColumn.Count;
			CategoryAxisBase xAxis = base.XAxis;
			ScalerParams axisParams = new ScalerParams(windowRect, viewport, base.XAxis.IsInverted, effectiveViewport);
			int num = 0;
			for (int i = 0; i < buckets.Count; i++)
			{
				double left = buckets[i][0] - 0.5 * groupSize;
				double num2 = Math.Min(buckets[i][1], buckets[i][2]);
				double num3 = Math.Abs(Math.Max(buckets[i][1], buckets[i][2]) - num2);
				if (!double.IsInfinity(num3))
				{
					Rectangle rectangle = rangeColumnSeriesView.Columns[num];
					num++;
					rectangle.Width = groupSize;
					rectangle.Height = num3;
					if (flag)
					{
						PerformCategoryStyleOverride(buckets, i, count, xAxis, axisParams, view.IsThumbnailView);
					}
					RenderManager.SetShapeAppearance(rectangle, strokeOnly: false, fillOnly: false, extended: false, useOutline: false);
					rectangle.RadiusX = RenderManager.ActualRenderRadiusX;
					rectangle.RadiusY = RenderManager.ActualRenderRadiusY;
					rangeColumnSeriesView.PositionRectangle(rectangle, left, num2);
				}
			}
			rangeColumnSeriesView.Columns.Count = num;
			view.UpdateFrameVersion(frame);
		}
	}
	[DontObfuscate]
	[WidgetModule("ScatterChart")]
	[WidgetDependencyProperty]
	[XamWrapper]
	[TSWidget]
	[HybridJavaWidget]
	[TSEmitModuleDefinitions]
	[WfWidgetDescription(true)]
	public class BrushScale : DependencyObject, INotifyPropertyChanged
	{
		private BrushCollection _brushes;

		[WFSuppressWidgetMember]
		public BrushCollection Brushes
		{
			get
			{
				return _brushes;
			}
			set
			{
				_ = _brushes;
				if (_brushes != null)
				{
					_brushes.CollectionChanged -= Brushes_CollectionChanged;
				}
				_brushes = value;
				if (_brushes != null)
				{
					_brushes.CollectionChanged += Brushes_CollectionChanged;
				}
				NotifySeries();
			}
		}

		internal List<Series> Series { get; set; }

		[XamSuppressWidgetMember]
		[UwpSuppressWidgetMember]
		public virtual bool IsReady => true;

		protected internal double GlobalMinimum { get; set; }

		protected internal double GlobalMaximum { get; set; }

		[HybridJavaSuppressWidgetMember]
		[BlazorSuppressWidgetMember]
		public event PropertyChangedEventHandler PropertyChanged;

		[HybridJavaSuppressWidgetMember]
		[BlazorSuppressWidgetMember]
		public event PropertyUpdatedEventHandler PropertyUpdated;

		public BrushScale()
		{
			Series = new List<Series>();
			Brushes = new BrushCollection();
			Brushes.CollectionChanged += Brushes_CollectionChanged;
			PropertyUpdated += delegate(object o, PropertyUpdatedEventArgs e)
			{
				PropertyUpdatedOverride(o, e.PropertyName, e.OldValue, e.NewValue);
			};
		}

		protected virtual void Brushes_CollectionChanged(object sender, NotifyCollectionChangedEventArgs e)
		{
			foreach (Series item in Series)
			{
				item.RenderSeries(animate: false);
				item.NotifyBrushScalesDirty();
				item.NotifyThumbnailAppearanceChanged();
			}
		}

		protected internal void EnsureGlobals()
		{
			if (!double.IsNaN(GlobalMinimum) && !double.IsNaN(GlobalMaximum))
			{
				return;
			}
			foreach (Series item in Series)
			{
				if (item is ISupportsFillScale)
				{
					((ISupportsFillScale)item).UpdateFillScaleGlobals();
				}
			}
		}

		public void RegisterSeries(Series series)
		{
			if (!Series.Contains(series))
			{
				Series.Add(series);
			}
		}

		public void UnregisterSeries(Series series)
		{
			if (Series.Contains(series))
			{
				Series.Remove(series);
			}
		}

		public virtual Brush GetBrush(int index)
		{
			if (Brushes == null || index < 0 || index >= Brushes.Count)
			{
				return null;
			}
			return Brushes[index];
		}

		protected internal Brush GetInterpolatedBrush(double index)
		{
			if (Brushes == null || Brushes.Count == 0 || index < 0.0)
			{
				return null;
			}
			return Brushes[index];
		}

		protected void RaisePropertyChanged(string name, object oldValue, object newValue)
		{
			if (this.PropertyChanged != null)
			{
				this.PropertyChanged(this, new PropertyChangedEventArgs(name));
			}
			if (this.PropertyUpdated != null)
			{
				this.PropertyUpdated(this, new PropertyUpdatedEventArgs(name, oldValue, newValue));
			}
		}

		protected virtual void PropertyUpdatedOverride(object sender, string propertyName, object oldValue, object newValue)
		{
			NotifySeries();
		}

		public void NotifySeries()
		{
			foreach (Series item in Series)
			{
				item.NotifyIndexedPropertiesChanged();
				item.RenderSeries(animate: false);
				item.NotifyBrushScalesDirty();
				item.NotifyThumbnailAppearanceChanged();
			}
		}

		protected internal void UpdateGlobals(double min, double max)
		{
			if (!double.IsNaN(min) && !double.IsInfinity(min))
			{
				if (double.IsNaN(GlobalMinimum))
				{
					GlobalMinimum = min;
				}
				else
				{
					GlobalMinimum = Math.Min(min, GlobalMinimum);
				}
			}
			if (!double.IsNaN(max) && !double.IsInfinity(max))
			{
				if (double.IsNaN(GlobalMaximum))
				{
					GlobalMaximum = max;
				}
				else
				{
					GlobalMaximum = Math.Max(max, GlobalMaximum);
				}
			}
		}

		protected internal void ResetGlobals()
		{
			GlobalMinimum = double.NaN;
			GlobalMaximum = double.NaN;
		}
	}
	internal class BubbleMarkerManager : MarkerManagerBase
	{
		internal IFastItemColumn<double> RadiusColumn { get; set; }

		internal List<double> ActualRadiusColumn { get; set; }

		internal List<Marker> ActualMarkers { get; set; }

		public BubbleMarkerManager(Func<object, Marker> provideMarkerStrategy, Func<int, object> provideItemStrategy, Action<IDictionary<object, OwnedPoint>> removeUnusedMarkers, Func<Point[]> getItemLocationsStrategy, Func<List<int>> activeMarkerIndexesStrategy)
			: base(provideMarkerStrategy, provideItemStrategy, removeUnusedMarkers, getItemLocationsStrategy, activeMarkerIndexesStrategy)
		{
			ActualRadiusColumn = new List<double>();
			ActualMarkers = new List<Marker>();
		}

		public override void WinnowMarkers(IDictionary<object, OwnedPoint> markers, [SwiftMutableParameter] int maximumMarkers, Rect windowRect, Rect viewportRect, double currentResolution)
		{
			Point[] array = base.GetItemLocationsStrategy();
			markers.Clear();
			ActualRadiusColumn.Clear();
			ActualMarkers.Clear();
			List<int> list = new List<int>();
			maximumMarkers = Math.Max(0, maximumMarkers);
			List<int> list2 = null;
			GetVisibleItems(windowRect, viewportRect, array, list);
			if (maximumMarkers >= list.Count)
			{
				list2 = list;
			}
			else
			{
				list2 = new List<int>();
				double resolution = Math.Max(8.0, currentResolution);
				Dictionary<int, MarkerManagerBucket> buckets = GetBuckets(viewportRect, list, resolution, array);
				List<int> list3 = new List<int>(buckets.Keys);
				if (MarkerManagerBase.UseDeterministicSelection)
				{
					list3.Sort();
				}
				SelectMarkerItems(maximumMarkers, buckets, list3, list2);
			}
			for (int i = 0; i < list2.Count; i++)
			{
				double x = array[list2[i]].X;
				double y = array[list2[i]].Y;
				double item = RadiusColumn[list2[i]];
				ActualRadiusColumn.Add(item);
				Marker marker = base.ProvideMarkerStrategy(base.ProvideItemStrategy(list2[i]));
				((DataContext)marker.Content).Item = base.ProvideItemStrategy(list2[i]);
				marker.CurrentIndex = list2[i];
				OwnedPoint ownedPoint = new OwnedPoint();
				ownedPoint.OwnerItem = ((DataContext)marker.Content).Item;
				ownedPoint.Point = new Point(x, y);
				if (!markers.ContainsKey(ownedPoint.OwnerItem))
				{
					markers.Add(ownedPoint.OwnerItem, ownedPoint);
					ActualMarkers.Add(marker);
				}
			}
		}

		public override void Render(IDictionary<object, OwnedPoint> markers, bool lightweight)
		{
			ICollection<object> collection = markers.Keys;
			if (MarkerManagerBase.UseDeterministicSelection)
			{
				List<object> list = new List<object>(markers.Keys);
				list.Sort(delegate(object o1, object o2)
				{
					OwnedPoint ownedPoint2 = markers[o1];
					OwnedPoint ownedPoint3 = markers[o2];
					double num4 = Math.Pow(ownedPoint2.Point.X, 2.0) + Math.Pow(ownedPoint2.Point.Y, 2.0);
					double num5 = Math.Pow(ownedPoint3.Point.X, 2.0) + Math.Pow(ownedPoint3.Point.Y, 2.0);
					return ((IComparable)num4).CompareTo((object)num5);
				});
				collection = list;
			}
			int num = 0;
			foreach (object item in collection)
			{
				OwnedPoint ownedPoint = markers[item];
				Marker marker = base.ProvideMarkerStrategy(ownedPoint.OwnerItem);
				Panel.SetZIndex(marker, num);
				if (!lightweight)
				{
					marker.Measure(new Size(double.PositiveInfinity, double.PositiveInfinity));
				}
				TranslateTransform translateTransform = marker.RenderTransform as TranslateTransform;
				double num2 = ownedPoint.Point.X;
				double num3 = ownedPoint.Point.Y;
				if (!lightweight)
				{
					num2 -= 0.5 * marker.DesiredSize.Width;
					num3 -= 0.5 * marker.DesiredSize.Height;
				}
				if (translateTransform == null || translateTransform.X != num2 || translateTransform.Y != num3)
				{
					marker.RenderTransform = new TranslateTransform
					{
						X = num2,
						Y = num3
					};
					marker.PositionX = num2;
					marker.PositionY = num3;
					num++;
				}
			}
			base.RemoveUnusedMarkers(markers);
		}
	}

		private Brush GetSubItemBrush(int index)
		{
			CustomPaletteBrushScale customPaletteBrushScale = FillScale as CustomPaletteBrushScale;
			ValueBrushScale valueBrushScale = FillScale as ValueBrushScale;
			BrushScale fillScale = FillScale;
			if (customPaletteBrushScale != null && base.FastItemsSource != null)
			{
				return customPaletteBrushScale.GetBrush(index, base.FastItemsSource.Count);
			}
			if (valueBrushScale != null)
			{
				return valueBrushScale.GetBrushByIndex(index, FillColumn);
			}
			return fillScale?.GetBrush(index);
		}

		bool IScaleLegendSeries.ForScaleColors(Action<Brush, double> action)
		{
			for (int i = 0; i < RadiusColumn.Count; i++)
			{
				if (FillScale == null || !FillScale.IsReady)
				{
					return false;
				}
				double num = double.NaN;
				if (FillColumn != null)
				{
					num = (FillColumn[i] - FillColumn.Minimum) / (FillColumn.Maximum - FillColumn.Minimum);
				}
				double num2 = (RadiusColumn[i] - RadiusColumn.Minimum) / (RadiusColumn.Maximum - RadiusColumn.Minimum);
				if (double.IsNaN(num))
				{
					num = 0.0;
				}
				if (double.IsNaN(num2))
				{
					num2 = num;
				}
				Brush actualMarkerBrush = base.ActualMarkerBrush;
				Brush subItemBrush = GetSubItemBrush(i);
				Brush arg = ((subItemBrush != null) ? subItemBrush : actualMarkerBrush);
				action(arg, num2);
			}
			return true;
		}

		public override object GetItemValue(object item, string memberPathName)
		{
			return ResolveMemberPath(memberPathName) switch
			{
				"LabelMemberPath" => GetItemValueByMemberPath(item, memberPathName, LabelMemberPath), 
				"RadiusMemberPath" => GetItemValueByMemberPath(item, memberPathName, RadiusMemberPath), 
				"XMemberPath" => GetItemValueByMemberPath(item, memberPathName, base.XMemberPath), 
				"YMemberPath" => GetItemValueByMemberPath(item, memberPathName, base.YMemberPath), 
				"FillMemberPath" => GetItemValueByMemberPath(item, memberPathName, FillMemberPath), 
				_ => base.GetItemValue(item, memberPathName), 
			};
		}

		internal override void CalculateCachedPoints(ScatterBaseView view, ScatterFrame frame, int count, Rect windowRect, Rect viewportRect)
		{
			if (count <= base.MaximumMarkers)
			{
				frame.CachedPoints = new Dictionary<object, OwnedPoint>(count);
			}
			int maximumMarkers = base.MaximumMarkers;
			IFastItemsSource fastItemsSource = base.FastItemsSource;
			Rect effectiveViewport = GetEffectiveViewport(view);
			ScalerParams scalerParams = new ScalerParams(windowRect, viewportRect, base.AxisInfoCache.XAxisIsInverted, effectiveViewport);
			ScalerParams p = new ScalerParams(windowRect, viewportRect, base.AxisInfoCache.YAxisIsInverted, effectiveViewport);
			bool flag = false;
			double num = 0.0;
			if (base.SeriesViewer != null && base.SeriesViewer.ShouldHorizontalWrap())
			{
				Tuple<bool, double> horizontalWrapInfo = base.SeriesViewer.GetHorizontalWrapInfo(windowRect, scalerParams);
				flag = horizontalWrapInfo.Item1;
				num = horizontalWrapInfo.Item2;
			}
			for (int i = 0; i < count; i++)
			{
				double num2 = base.XColumn[i];
				double num3 = base.YColumn[i];
				Point point = new Point(base.AxisInfoCache.XAxis.GetScaledValue(num2, scalerParams), base.AxisInfoCache.YAxis.GetScaledValue(num3, p));
				if (flag && (point.X < viewportRect.Left || point.X > viewportRect.Right) && point.X + num >= viewportRect.Left && point.X + num <= viewportRect.Right)
				{
					point = new Point(point.X + num, num3);
				}
				if (!double.IsInfinity(point.X) && !double.IsInfinity(point.Y))
				{
					object obj = fastItemsSource[i];
					if (count <= maximumMarkers && !frame.CachedPoints.ContainsKey(obj))
					{
						Point columnValues = new Point(num2, num3);
						frame.CachedPoints.Add(obj, new OwnedPoint
						{
							OwnerItem = obj,
							ColumnValues = columnValues,
							Point = point
						});
					}
				}
			}
		}

		internal override void PrepareFrame(ScatterFrame frame, ScatterBaseView view)
		{
			BubbleSeriesView bubbleSeriesView = view as BubbleSeriesView;
			((BubbleMarkerManager)bubbleSeriesView.MarkerManager).RadiusColumn = RadiusColumn;
			base.PrepareFrame(frame, view);
			if (Math.Min((base.XColumn != null) ? base.XColumn.Count : 0, (base.YColumn != null) ? base.YColumn.Count : 0) >= 1)
			{
				bubbleSeriesView.CreateMarkerSizes();
				bubbleSeriesView.SetMarkerColors();
			}
		}

		private void DrawLegend()
		{
			if (base.SeriesViewer != null && base.ActualLegend != null)
			{
				if (((IChartLegend)base.ActualLegend).IsItemwise)
				{
					IChartItemLegend obj = (IChartItemLegend)base.ActualLegend;
					((IChartLegend)base.ActualLegend).ClearLegendItemsForSeries((ILegendSeries)this);
					CreateLegendItems();
					obj.RenderItemwiseContent(this);
				}
				if (((IChartLegend)base.ActualLegend).IsScale)
				{
					IChartScaleLegend obj2 = (IChartScaleLegend)base.ActualLegend;
					obj2.RestoreOriginalState();
					obj2.InitializeLegend(this);
				}
			}
		}

		internal static double GetLinearSize(double min, double max, double smallSize, double largeSize, double value)
		{
			if (value <= min || double.IsNaN(value) || double.IsInfinity(value))
			{
				return smallSize;
			}
			if (value >= max)
			{
				return largeSize;
			}
			return smallSize + (largeSize - smallSize) / (max - min) * (value - min);
		}

		internal static double GetLogarithmicSize(double min, double max, double smallSize, double largeSize, double logBase_, double value)
		{
			double value2 = Math.Log(value, logBase_);
			double min2 = Math.Log(min, logBase_);
			double max2 = Math.Log(max, logBase_);
			return GetLinearSize(min2, max2, smallSize, largeSize, value2);
		}

		protected internal override bool ValidateSeries(Rect viewportRect, Rect windowRect, SeriesView view)
		{
			bool result = base.ValidateSeries(viewportRect, windowRect, view);
			if (RadiusColumn == null || base.FastItemsSource == null || RadiusColumn.Count == 0 || base.FastItemsSource.Count != RadiusColumn.Count)
			{
				result = false;
			}
			return result;
		}

		protected override bool MustReact(string propertyName, FastItemsSourceEventAction action)
		{
			if (action != FastItemsSourceEventAction.Change)
			{
				return true;
			}
			if (propertyName == null)
			{
				return true;
			}
			if (base.XMemberPath == propertyName || base.YMemberPath == propertyName || RadiusMemberPath == propertyName)
			{
				return true;
			}
			return false;
		}

		private void CreateLegendItems()
		{
			if (!(base.ActualLegend is ItemLegend) || base.FastItemsSource == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			LegendItems = new List<UIElement>();
			CustomPaletteBrushScale customPaletteBrushScale = FillScale as CustomPaletteBrushScale;
			ValueBrushScale valueBrushScale = FillScale as ValueBrushScale;
			BrushScale fillScale = FillScale;
			ActualRange actualRangeForFillColumn = GetActualRangeForFillColumn();
			double minimum = actualRangeForFillColumn.Minimum;
			double maximum = actualRangeForFillColumn.Maximum;
			IFastItemsSource fastItemsSource = base.FastItemsSource;
			for (int i = 0; i < fastItemsSource.Count; i++)
			{
				Brush itemBrush = null;
				if (valueBrushScale != null && FillColumn != null)
				{
					double value = FillColumn[i];
					itemBrush = valueBrushScale.GetBrushByRange(value, minimum, maximum);
				}
				else if (customPaletteBrushScale != null)
				{
					itemBrush = customPaletteBrushScale.GetBrush(i, fastItemsSource.Count);
				}
				else if (fillScale != null)
				{
					itemBrush = fillScale.GetBrush(i);
				}
				ContentControl contentControl = new ContentControl();
				contentControl.SetBinding(UIElement.VisibilityProperty, new Binding("LegendItemVisibility")
				{
					Source = this
				});
				string itemLabel = ((LabelColumn != null && LabelColumn[i] != null) ? LabelColumn[i].ToString() : "");
				contentControl.Content = new DataContext
				{
					Series = this,
					Item = fastItemsSource[i],
					ItemBrush = itemBrush,
					ItemLabel = itemLabel
				};
				DataTemplate discreteLegendItemTemplate = base.DiscreteLegendItemTemplate;
				contentControl.ContentTemplate = discreteLegendItemTemplate;
				LegendItems.Add(contentControl);
			}
		}

		protected override void DataUpdatedOverride(FastItemsSourceEventAction action, int position, int count, string propertyName)
		{
			base.DataUpdatedOverride(action, position, count, propertyName);
			if (RadiusScale != null)
			{
				RadiusScale.ResetGlobals();
			}
			if (FillScale != null)
			{
				FillScale.ResetGlobals();
			}
			DrawLegend();
		}

		protected internal override void NotifyBrushScalesDirty()
		{
			base.NotifyBrushScalesDirty();
			DrawLegend();
		}

		protected internal override void NotifySizeScalesDirty()
		{
			base.NotifySizeScalesDirty();
			DrawLegend();
		}

		protected override void PropertyUpdatedOverride(object sender, string propertyName, object oldValue, object newValue)
		{
			base.PropertyUpdatedOverride(sender, propertyName, oldValue, newValue);
			switch (propertyName)
			{
			case "FastItemsSource":
				if (RadiusScale != null)
				{
					RadiusScale.ResetGlobals();
				}
				if (FillScale != null)
				{
					FillScale.ResetGlobals();
				}
				if (oldValue is IFastItemsSource)
				{
					((IFastItemsSource)oldValue).DeregisterColumn(RadiusColumn);
					((IFastItemsSource)oldValue).DeregisterColumn(FillColumn);
					((IFastItemsSource)oldValue).DeregisterColumn(LabelColumn);
					RadiusColumn = null;
					FillColumn = null;
					LabelColumn = null;
				}
				if (newValue is IFastItemsSource)
				{
					RadiusColumn = RegisterDoubleColumn(RadiusMemberPath);
					if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(FillMemberPath))
					{
						FillColumn = RegisterDoubleColumn(FillMemberPath);
					}
					LabelColumn = RegisterObjectColumn(LabelMemberPath);
				}
				RenderSeries(animate: false);
				DrawLegend();
				break;
			case "RadiusMemberPath":
				if (RadiusScale != null)
				{
					RadiusScale.ResetGlobals();
				}
				if (base.FastItemsSource != null)
				{
					base.FastItemsSource.DeregisterColumn(RadiusColumn);
					RadiusColumn = RegisterDoubleColumn(RadiusMemberPath);
					DrawLegend();
				}
				break;
			case "RadiusColumn":
				if (RadiusScale != null)
				{
					RadiusScale.ResetGlobals();
				}
				base.ScatterView.TrendLineManager.Reset();
				RenderSeries(animate: false);
				NotifyThumbnailDataChanged();
				break;
			case "RadiusScale":
				if (oldValue != null)
				{
					((SizeScale)oldValue).Series.Remove(this);
					((SizeScale)oldValue).ResetGlobals();
				}
				if (newValue != null)
				{
					((SizeScale)newValue).Series.Add(this);
					((SizeScale)newValue).ResetGlobals();
				}
				RenderSeries(animate: false);
				NotifyThumbnailAppearanceChanged();
				break;
			case "RadiusScaleUseGlobalValues":
				RenderSeries(animate: false);
				NotifyThumbnailAppearanceChanged();
				break;
			case "DiscreteLegendItemTemplate":
				DrawLegend();
				break;
			case "FillScale":
				if (oldValue != null)
				{
					((BrushScale)oldValue).Series.Remove(this);
					((BrushScale)oldValue).ResetGlobals();
				}
				if (newValue != null)
				{
					((BrushScale)newValue).Series.Add(this);
					((BrushScale)newValue).ResetGlobals();
				}
				RenderSeries(animate: false);
				DrawLegend();
				NotifyThumbnailAppearanceChanged();
				break;
			case "FillScaleUseGlobalValues":
			case "MarkerOutlineUsesFillScale":
			case "MarkerOutlineBrightness":
			case "MarkerBrushBrightness":
				RenderSeries(animate: false);
				DrawLegend();
				NotifyThumbnailAppearanceChanged();
				break;
			case "FillColumn":
				RenderSeries(animate: false);
				NotifyThumbnailAppearanceChanged();
				break;
			case "FillMemberPath":
				if (FillScale != null)
				{
					FillScale.ResetGlobals();
				}
				if (base.FastItemsSource != null)
				{
					base.FastItemsSource.DeregisterColumn(FillColumn);
					FillColumn = RegisterDoubleColumn(FillMemberPath);
					DrawLegend();
				}
				break;
			case "LabelMemberPath":
				if (base.FastItemsSource != null)
				{
					base.FastItemsSource.DeregisterColumn(LabelColumn);
					LabelColumn = RegisterObjectColumn(LabelMemberPath);
					DrawLegend();
				}
				break;
			case "ActualLegend":
			{
				IChartLegend chartLegend = oldValue as IChartLegend;
				if (chartLegend != null && chartLegend.IsItemwise)
				{
					(chartLegend as IChartItemLegend).ClearLegendItemsForSeries(this);
				}
				if (chartLegend != null && chartLegend.IsScale)
				{
					IChartScaleLegend chartScaleLegend = chartLegend as IChartScaleLegend;
					bool flag = true;
					Series series = null;
					if (base.SeriesViewer != null)
					{
						foreach (Series item in base.SeriesViewer.Series)
						{
							if (item.Legend == chartScaleLegend)
							{
								series = item;
								flag = false;
							}
						}
					}
					if (flag)
					{
						chartScaleLegend.RestoreOriginalState();
					}
					else
					{
						chartScaleLegend.InitializeLegend(series as IScaleLegendSeries);
					}
				}
				DrawLegend();
				break;
			}
			case "SeriesViewer":
				DrawLegend();
				break;
			}
		}

		[SuppressWidgetMember]
		public void UpdateSizeScaleGlobals()
		{
			ActualRange actualRange = new ActualRange();
			actualRange.Minimum = double.NaN;
			actualRange.Maximum = double.NaN;
			if (RadiusColumn != null)
			{
				actualRange.Minimum = RadiusColumn.Minimum;
				actualRange.Maximum = RadiusColumn.Maximum;
			}
			if (RadiusScale != null)
			{
				RadiusScale.UpdateGlobals(actualRange.Minimum, actualRange.Maximum);
			}
		}

		[SuppressWidgetMember]
		public void UpdateFillScaleGlobals()
		{
			ActualRange actualRange = new ActualRange();
			actualRange.Minimum = double.NaN;
			actualRange.Maximum = double.NaN;
			if (FillColumn != null)
			{
				actualRange.Minimum = FillColumn.Minimum;
				actualRange.Maximum = FillColumn.Maximum;
			}
			if (FillScale != null)
			{
				FillScale.UpdateGlobals(actualRange.Minimum, actualRange.Maximum);
			}
		}

		internal ActualRange GetActualRangeForRadiusColumn(SizeScale actualRadiusScale)
		{
			ActualRange actualRange = new ActualRange();
			actualRange.Minimum = double.NaN;
			actualRange.Maximum = double.NaN;
			if (RadiusColumn != null)
			{
				actualRange.Minimum = RadiusColumn.Minimum;
				actualRange.Maximum = RadiusColumn.Maximum;
			}
			if (actualRadiusScale != null)
			{
				actualRadiusScale.EnsureGlobals();
				if (RadiusScaleUseGlobalValues)
				{
					actualRange.Minimum = actualRadiusScale.GlobalMinimum;
					actualRange.Maximum = actualRadiusScale.GlobalMaximum;
				}
			}
			return actualRange;
		}

		internal ActualRange GetActualRangeForFillColumn()
		{
			ActualRange actualRange = new ActualRange();
			actualRange.Minimum = double.NaN;
			actualRange.Maximum = double.NaN;
			if (FillColumn != null)
			{
				actualRange.Minimum = FillColumn.Minimum;
				actualRange.Maximum = FillColumn.Maximum;
			}
			if (FillScale is ValueBrushScale valueBrushScale)
			{
				valueBrushScale.EnsureGlobals();
				if (FillScaleUseGlobalValues && FillScale.Series.Count > 1)
				{
					actualRange.Minimum = valueBrushScale.GlobalMinimum;
					actualRange.Maximum = valueBrushScale.GlobalMaximum;
				}
			}
			return actualRange;
		}

		internal void SizeBubbles(List<Marker> actualMarkers, List<double> actualRadiusColumn, Rect viewportRect, bool isThumbnail)
		{
			double width = viewportRect.Width;
			if (!base.View.Viewport.IsEmpty)
			{
				width = base.View.Viewport.Width;
			}
			else if (base.SeriesViewer != null && !base.SeriesViewer.ViewportRect.IsEmpty)
			{
				width = base.SeriesViewer.ViewportRect.Width;
			}
			double num = DeviceUtils.FromPixelUnits(width);
			SizeScale sizeScale = RadiusScale ?? new SizeScale
			{
				MinimumValue = num / 10.0,
				MaximumValue = num / 5.0
			};
			if (sizeScale != null)
			{
				double minimumValue = sizeScale.MinimumValue;
				double maximumValue = sizeScale.MaximumValue;
				int logarithmBase = sizeScale.LogarithmBase;
				ActualRange actualRangeForRadiusColumn = GetActualRangeForRadiusColumn(sizeScale);
				double minimum = actualRangeForRadiusColumn.Minimum;
				double maximum = actualRangeForRadiusColumn.Maximum;
				if (sizeScale.IsLogarithmic)
				{
					for (int i = 0; i < actualRadiusColumn.Count; i++)
					{
						actualRadiusColumn[i] = GetLogarithmicSize(minimum, maximum, minimumValue, maximumValue, logarithmBase, actualRadiusColumn[i]);
					}
				}
				else
				{
					for (int j = 0; j < actualRadiusColumn.Count; j++)
					{
						actualRadiusColumn[j] = GetLinearSize(minimum, maximum, minimumValue, maximumValue, actualRadiusColumn[j]);
					}
				}
			}
			double num2 = 1.0;
			num2 = DeviceUtils.GetDIPScalingRatio();
			bool flag = RadiusScale == null;
			if (isThumbnail)
			{
				double num3 = viewportRect.Width / width;
				for (int k = 0; k < actualRadiusColumn.Count; k++)
				{
					if (flag)
					{
						actualRadiusColumn[k] /= num2;
					}
					actualRadiusColumn[k] *= num3;
				}
			}
			for (int l = 0; l < actualMarkers.Count; l++)
			{
				Marker marker = actualMarkers[l];
				marker.ClearValue(FrameworkElement.MinWidthProperty);
				marker.ClearValue(FrameworkElement.MinHeightProperty);
				marker.Margin = new Thickness(0.0);
				if (flag && !isThumbnail)
				{
					marker.Width = Math.Max(0.0, actualRadiusColumn[l] / num2);
					marker.Height = Math.Max(0.0, actualRadiusColumn[l] / num2);
				}
				else
				{
					marker.Width = Math.Max(0.0, actualRadiusColumn[l]);
					marker.Height = Math.Max(0.0, actualRadiusColumn[l]);
				}
			}
		}

		internal void SetMarkerColors(List<Marker> actualMarkers)
		{
			BubbleSeriesView bubbleSeriesView = base.ThumbnailView as BubbleSeriesView;
			BubbleView.MarkerAppearanceHandled = false;
			if (bubbleSeriesView != null)
			{
				bubbleSeriesView.MarkerAppearanceHandled = false;
			}
			CustomPaletteBrushScale customPaletteBrushScale = FillScale as CustomPaletteBrushScale;
			ValueBrushScale valueBrushScale = FillScale as ValueBrushScale;
			BrushScale fillScale = FillScale;
			ActualRange actualRangeForFillColumn = GetActualRangeForFillColumn();
			double minimum = actualRangeForFillColumn.Minimum;
			double maximum = actualRangeForFillColumn.Maximum;
			if (FillScale == null || !FillScale.IsReady || (valueBrushScale != null && FillMemberPath == null))
			{
				BubbleView.ClearMarkerBrushes();
				bubbleSeriesView?.ClearMarkerBrushes();
				return;
			}
			BubbleView.MarkerAppearanceHandled = true;
			if (bubbleSeriesView != null)
			{
				bubbleSeriesView.MarkerAppearanceHandled = true;
			}
			int count = actualMarkers.Count;
			IFastItemsSource fastItemsSource = base.FastItemsSource;
			for (int i = 0; i < count; i++)
			{
				if (actualMarkers[i].Content is DataContext dataContext)
				{
					Brush brush = null;
					int index = fastItemsSource.IndexOf(dataContext.Item);
					if (customPaletteBrushScale != null)
					{
						brush = customPaletteBrushScale.GetBrush(index, fastItemsSource.Count);
					}
					else if (valueBrushScale == null || FillColumn == null)
					{
						brush = ((fillScale != null) ? fillScale.GetBrush(index) : ((base.MarkerBrush != null) ? base.MarkerBrush : base.ActualMarkerBrush));
					}
					else
					{
						double value = FillColumn[index];
						brush = valueBrushScale.GetBrushByRange(value, minimum, maximum);
					}
					Brush brush2 = null;
					brush2 = ((base.MarkerOutline != null) ? base.MarkerOutline : base.ActualMarkerOutline);
					if (MarkerOutlineUsesFillScale && brush != null)
					{
						brush2 = brush;
					}
					if (brush2 != null && !double.IsNaN(MarkerOutlineBrightness))
					{
						brush2 = brush2.GetLightened(MarkerOutlineBrightness);
					}
					if (brush != null && !double.IsNaN(MarkerBrushBrightness))
					{
						brush = brush.GetLightened(MarkerBrushBrightness);
					}
					dataContext.ItemBrush = brush;
					dataContext.ItemOutline = brush2;
				}
			}
		}

		internal override DataContext GetTooltipContext(object item)
		{
			if (item != null)
			{
				int num = base.FastItemsSource.IndexOf(item);
				if (num != -1)
				{
					double num2 = base.XColumn[num];
					double num3 = base.YColumn[num];
					object itemRadius = null;
					if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(RadiusMemberPath))
					{
						itemRadius = RadiusColumn[num];
					}
					return new BubbleSeriesDataContext
					{
						Series = this,
						Item = item,
						ItemXValue = num2,
						ItemYValue = num3,
						ItemRadius = itemRadius
					};
				}
			}
			return new DataContext
			{
				Series = this,
				Item = item
			};
		}
	}

	public class CustomPaletteBrushScale : BrushScale
	{
		internal const string BrushSelectionModePropertyName = "BrushSelectionMode";

		public static readonly DependencyProperty BrushSelectionModeProperty = DependencyProperty.Register("BrushSelectionMode", typeof(BrushSelectionMode), typeof(CustomPaletteBrushScale), new PropertyMetadata(BrushSelectionMode.Select, delegate(DependencyObject o, DependencyPropertyChangedEventArgs e)
		{
			((CustomPaletteBrushScale)o).RaisePropertyChanged("BrushSelectionMode", e.OldValue, e.NewValue);
		}));

		[WidgetDefaultString("select")]
		public BrushSelectionMode BrushSelectionMode
		{
			get
			{
				return (BrushSelectionMode)GetValue(BrushSelectionModeProperty);
			}
			set
			{
				SetValue(BrushSelectionModeProperty, value);
			}
		}

		public override bool IsReady
		{
			get
			{
				if (base.Brushes != null)
				{
					return base.Brushes.Count > 0;
				}
				return false;
			}
		}

		public virtual Brush GetBrush(int index, int total)
		{
			if (base.Brushes == null || base.Brushes.Count == 0)
			{
				return null;
			}
			if (BrushSelectionMode == BrushSelectionMode.Select)
			{
				return GetBrush(index % base.Brushes.Count);
			}
			double linearSize = BubbleSeries.GetLinearSize(0.0, total - 1, 0.0, base.Brushes.Count - 1, index);
			return GetInterpolatedBrush(linearSize);
		}
	}

	public class SizeScale : DependencyObject, INotifyPropertyChanged
	{

		{
			((SizeScale)o).RaisePropertyChanged("MaximumValue", e.OldValue, e.NewValue);
		}));

		internal const string IsLogarithmicPropertyName = "IsLogarithmic";

		public static readonly DependencyProperty IsLogarithmicProperty = DependencyProperty.Register("IsLogarithmic", typeof(bool), typeof(SizeScale), new PropertyMetadata(false, delegate(DependencyObject o, DependencyPropertyChangedEventArgs e)
		{
			((SizeScale)o).RaisePropertyChanged("IsLogarithmic", e.OldValue, e.NewValue);
		}));

		internal const string LogarithmBasePropertyName = "LogarithmBase";

		public static readonly DependencyProperty LogarithmBaseProperty = DependencyProperty.Register("LogarithmBase", typeof(int), typeof(SizeScale), new PropertyMetadata(10, delegate(DependencyObject o, DependencyPropertyChangedEventArgs e)
		{
			((SizeScale)o).RaisePropertyChanged("LogarithmBase", e.OldValue, e.NewValue);
		}));

		public double GlobalMinimum { get; set; }

		public double GlobalMaximum { get; set; }

		protected internal List<Series> Series { get; set; }

		[WidgetDefaultNumber(double.NaN)]

			}
		}

		[HybridJavaSuppressWidgetMember]
		[BlazorSuppressWidgetMember]
		public event PropertyChangedEventHandler PropertyChanged;

		[HybridJavaSuppressWidgetMember]
		[BlazorSuppressWidgetMember]
		public event PropertyUpdatedEventHandler PropertyUpdated;

		public SizeScale()
		{
			GlobalMinimum = double.NaN;
			GlobalMaximum = double.NaN;
			Series = new List<Series>();
			PropertyUpdated += delegate(object o, PropertyUpdatedEventArgs e)
			{
				PropertyUpdatedOverride(o, e.PropertyName, e.OldValue, e.NewValue);
			};
		}

		public double GetCurrentGlobalMinimum()
		{
			return GlobalMinimum;
		}

		public double GetCurrentGlobalMaximum()
		{
			return GlobalMaximum;
		}

		protected internal void EnsureGlobals()
		{
			if (!double.IsNaN(GlobalMinimum) && !double.IsNaN(GlobalMaximum))
			{
				return;
			}
			foreach (Series item in Series)
			{
				if (item is ISupportsSizeScale)
				{
					((ISupportsSizeScale)item).UpdateSizeScaleGlobals();
				}
			}
		}

		protected internal void UpdateGlobals(double min, double max)
		{
			if (!double.IsNaN(min) && !double.IsInfinity(min))
			{
				if (double.IsNaN(GlobalMinimum))
				{
					GlobalMinimum = min;
				}
				else
				{
					GlobalMinimum = Math.Min(min, GlobalMinimum);
				}
			}
			if (!double.IsNaN(max) && !double.IsInfinity(max))
			{
				if (double.IsNaN(GlobalMaximum))
				{
					GlobalMaximum = max;
				}
				else
				{
					GlobalMaximum = Math.Max(max, GlobalMaximum);
				}
			}
		}

		protected internal void ResetGlobals()
		{
			GlobalMinimum = double.NaN;
			GlobalMaximum = double.NaN;
		}

		protected void RaisePropertyChanged(string name, object oldValue, object newValue)
		{
			if (this.PropertyChanged != null)
			{
				this.PropertyChanged(this, new PropertyChangedEventArgs(name));
			}
			if (this.PropertyUpdated != null)
			{
				this.PropertyUpdated(this, new PropertyUpdatedEventArgs(name, oldValue, newValue));
			}
		}

		protected virtual void PropertyUpdatedOverride(object sender, string propertyName, object oldValue, object newValue)
		{
			foreach (Series item in Series)
			{
				item.RenderSeries(animate: false);
				if (item.SeriesViewer != null)
				{
					item.NotifyThumbnailAppearanceChanged();
					item.NotifySizeScalesDirty();
				}
			}
		}
	}

		public override bool IsReady
		{

				return false;

		[TSSuppressWidgetMember]
		public virtual Brush GetBrushByIndex(int index, IFastItemColumn<double> FillColumn)
		{
			if (FillColumn == null || base.Brushes == null || base.Brushes.Count == 0 || index < 0 || index >= FillColumn.Count)
			{
				return null;
			}
			if (FillColumn.Count == 0)
			{
				return base.Brushes[0];
			}
			double num = ((double.IsNaN(MinimumValue) || double.IsInfinity(MinimumValue)) ? FillColumn.Minimum : MinimumValue);
			double num2 = ((double.IsNaN(MaximumValue) || double.IsInfinity(MaximumValue)) ? FillColumn.Maximum : MaximumValue);
			double num3 = FillColumn[index];
			if (num == num2)
			{
				if (num3 != num)
				{
					return null;
				}
				return base.Brushes[0];
			}
			return GetInterpolatedBrushLogarithmic(num, num2, num3);
		}

		[TSSuppressWidgetMember]
		public virtual Brush GetBrushByValue(double value, IFastItemColumn<double> FillColumn)
		{
			if (FillColumn == null || base.Brushes == null || base.Brushes.Count == 0)
			{
				return null;
			}
			if (FillColumn.Count <= 1)
			{
				return base.Brushes[0];
			}
			double num = ((double.IsNaN(MinimumValue) || double.IsInfinity(MinimumValue)) ? FillColumn.Minimum : MinimumValue);
			double num2 = ((double.IsNaN(MaximumValue) || double.IsInfinity(MaximumValue)) ? FillColumn.Maximum : MaximumValue);
			if (value < num)
			{
				return null;
			}
			if (value > num2)
			{
				return null;
			}
			return GetInterpolatedBrushLogarithmic(num, num2, value);
		}

		[TSSuppressWidgetMember]
		public virtual Brush GetBrushByRange(double value, double fillColumnMin, double fillColumnMax)
		{
			if (base.Brushes == null || base.Brushes.Count == 0 || double.IsNaN(value))
			{
				return null;
			}
			if (base.Brushes.Count == 1)
			{
				return base.Brushes[0];
			}
			double num = ((double.IsNaN(MinimumValue) || double.IsInfinity(MinimumValue)) ? fillColumnMin : MinimumValue);
			double num2 = ((double.IsNaN(MaximumValue) || double.IsInfinity(MaximumValue)) ? fillColumnMax : MaximumValue);
			if (double.IsNaN(num) || value < num)
			{
				return null;
			}
			if (double.IsNaN(num2) || value > num2)
			{
				return null;
			}
			return GetInterpolatedBrushLogarithmic(num, num2, value);
		}

		private Brush GetInterpolatedBrushLogarithmic(double min, double max, double value)
		{
			if (_currentIsLogarithmic && _currentLogarithmBase > 0)
			{
				double min2 = Math.Log(min, _currentLogarithmBase);
				double max2 = Math.Log(max, _currentLogarithmBase);
				double value2 = Math.Log(value, _currentLogarithmBase);
				return GetInterpolatedBrushLinear(min2, max2, value2);
			}
			return GetInterpolatedBrushLinear(min, max, value);
		}

		private Brush GetInterpolatedBrushLinear(double min, double max, double value)
		{
			if (value < min || value > max)
			{
				return null;
			}
			double index = (value - min) / (max - min) * (double)(base.Brushes.Count - 1);
			return GetInterpolatedBrush(index);
		}

		protected override void PropertyUpdatedOverride(object sender, string propertyName, object oldValue, object newValue)
		{
			if (!(propertyName == "LogarithmBase"))
			{
				if (propertyName == "IsLogarithmic")
				{
					_currentIsLogarithmic = (bool)newValue;
				}
			}
			else
			{
				_currentLogarithmBase = (int)newValue;
			}
			base.PropertyUpdatedOverride(sender, propertyName, oldValue, newValue);
		}
	}

		public override object GetItemValue(object item, string memberPathName)
		{
			string text = ResolveMemberPath(memberPathName);
			if (text == "XMemberPath")
			{
				return GetItemValueByMemberPath(item, memberPathName, XMemberPath);
			}
			if (text == "YMemberPath")
			{
				return GetItemValueByMemberPath(item, memberPathName, YMemberPath);
			}
			return null;
		}

		public override bool GetVisiblePointsOfInterest(List<SeriesPointOfInterest> points, bool useValueAsLabel, int labelPrecision)
		{
			if (!HasMarkers)
			{
				return false;
			}
			NumericXAxis xAxis = XAxis;
			ScalerParams xParams = new ScalerParams(base.SeriesViewer.ActualWindowRect, base.Viewport, xAxis.IsInverted);
			xParams.EffectiveViewportRect = GetEffectiveViewport(base.View);
			NumericYAxis yAxis = YAxis;
			ScalerParams yParams = new ScalerParams(base.SeriesViewer.ActualWindowRect, base.Viewport, yAxis.IsInverted);
			yParams.EffectiveViewportRect = GetEffectiveViewport(base.View);
			points.Clear();
			base.MarkerView.DoToAllMarkers(delegate(Marker m)
			{
				if (m.Visibility == Visibility.Visible)
				{
					SeriesPointOfInterest seriesPointOfInterest = new SeriesPointOfInterest();
					double num;
					double num2;
					if (m.RenderTransform is MatrixTransform)
					{
						Point point = ((MatrixTransform)m.RenderTransform).Transform(new Point(0.0, 0.0));
						num = point.X + m.DesiredSize.Width / 2.0;
						num2 = point.Y + m.DesiredSize.Height / 2.0;
					}
					else
					{
						TranslateTransform obj = (TranslateTransform)m.RenderTransform;
						num = obj.X + m.DesiredSize.Width / 2.0;
						num2 = obj.Y + m.DesiredSize.Height / 2.0;
					}
					if (!(num < base.Viewport.Left) && !(num > base.Viewport.Right) && !(num2 < base.Viewport.Top) && !(num2 > base.Viewport.Bottom))
					{
						seriesPointOfInterest.XValue = xAxis.GetUnscaledValue(num, xParams);
						seriesPointOfInterest.YValue = yAxis.GetUnscaledValue(num2, yParams);
						seriesPointOfInterest.DataContext = (DataContext)m.Content;
						points.Add(seriesPointOfInterest);
					}
				}
			});
			return true;
		}

		public override Rect GetSeriesValueMarkerBoundingBox(Point world)
		{
			if (!HasMarkers || !ShouldDisplayMarkers())
			{
				return Rect.Empty;
			}
			Marker hitMarker = base.MarkerView.GetHitMarker(FromWorldPosition(world));
			if (hitMarker != null)
			{
				return base.MarkerView.GetBoundingBoxForMarker(hitMarker);
			}
			return Rect.Empty;
		}

		public override bool TestHit(Point position, bool isFinger)
		{
			if (TestMarkersOver(position, isFinger))
			{
				return true;
			}
			return false;
		}

		public ScatterBase()
		{
			ActualItemSearchMode = GetResolvedItemSearchMode();
			RenderManager = new ScatterSeriesRenderManager();
			ThumbnailFrame = new ScatterFrame();
			_cachedWindowRect = Rect.Empty;
			_cachedViewportRect = Rect.Empty;
		}

		bool ISupportsErrorBars.ShouldDisplayErrorBars()
		{
			if (ErrorBarSettings == null || !base.View.Ready())
			{
				return false;
			}
			return true;
		}

		bool ISupportsErrorBars.ShouldSyncErrorBarsWithMarkers()
		{
			return ShouldDisplayMarkers();
		}

		protected internal override void InvalidateAxes()
		{
			base.InvalidateAxes();
			if (XAxis != null)
			{
				XAxis.RenderAxis(animate: false);
			}
			if (YAxis != null)
			{
				YAxis.RenderAxis(animate: false);
			}
		}

		protected override void PropertyUpdatedOverride(object sender, string propertyName, object oldValue, object newValue)
		{
			base.PropertyUpdatedOverride(sender, propertyName, oldValue, newValue);
			if (ScatterView.TrendLineManager.PropertyUpdated(sender, propertyName, oldValue, newValue))
			{
				RenderSeries(animate: false);
				NotifyThumbnailAppearanceChanged();
			}
			switch (propertyName)
			{
			case "FastItemsSource":
				if (oldValue is IFastItemsSource)
				{
					((IFastItemsSource)oldValue).DeregisterColumn(XColumn);
					((IFastItemsSource)oldValue).DeregisterColumn(YColumn);
					XColumn = null;
					YColumn = null;
				}
				if (newValue is IFastItemsSource)
				{
					XColumn = RegisterDoubleColumn(XMemberPath);
					YColumn = RegisterDoubleColumn(YMemberPath);
				}
				if ((YAxis != null && !YAxis.UpdateRange()) || (XAxis != null && !XAxis.UpdateRange()))
				{
					RenderSeries(animate: false);
				}
				break;
			case "XAxis":
				if (oldValue != null)
				{
					((Axis)oldValue).DeregisterSeries(this);
				}
				if (newValue != null)
				{
					((Axis)newValue).RegisterSeries(this);
				}
				if ((XAxis != null && !XAxis.UpdateRange()) || (newValue == null && oldValue != null))
				{
					RenderSeries(animate: false);
				}
				NotifyThumbnailAppearanceChanged();
				break;
			case "YAxis":
				if (oldValue != null)
				{
					((Axis)oldValue).DeregisterSeries(this);
				}
				if (newValue != null)
				{
					((Axis)newValue).RegisterSeries(this);
				}
				if ((YAxis != null && !YAxis.UpdateRange()) || (newValue == null && oldValue != null))
				{
					RenderSeries(animate: false);
				}
				NotifyThumbnailAppearanceChanged();
				break;
			case "XMemberPath":
				if (base.FastItemsSource != null)
				{
					base.FastItemsSource.DeregisterColumn(XColumn);
					XColumn = RegisterDoubleColumn(XMemberPath);
				}
				break;
			case "XColumn":
				ScatterView.TrendLineManager.Reset();
				if (XAxis != null && !XAxis.UpdateRange())
				{
					RenderSeries(animate: false);
				}
				break;
			case "YMemberPath":
				if (base.FastItemsSource != null)
				{
					base.FastItemsSource.DeregisterColumn(YColumn);
					YColumn = RegisterDoubleColumn(YMemberPath);
				}
				break;
			case "YColumn":
				ScatterView.TrendLineManager.Reset();
				if (YAxis != null && !YAxis.UpdateRange())
				{
					RenderSeries(animate: false);
				}
				break;
			case "MarkerCollisionAvoidance":
				RenderSeries(animate: false);
				NotifyThumbnailAppearanceChanged();
				break;
			case "MaximumMarkers":
				RenderSeries(animate: false);
				NotifyThumbnailAppearanceChanged();
				break;
			case "TransitionProgress":
				TransitionFrame.Interpolate((float)base.TransitionProgress, PreviousFrame, CurrentFrame);
				CacheViewInfo();
				try
				{
					if (!ClearAndAbortIfInvalid(base.View))
					{
						if (Math.Round(base.TransitionProgress * 100000.0) / 100000.0 == 1.0)
						{
							RenderFrame(CurrentFrame, ScatterView);
						}
						else
						{
							RenderFrame(TransitionFrame, ScatterView);
						}
						if (base.SeriesViewer != null)
						{
							base.SeriesViewer.RaiseSeriesAnimating(this);
						}
					}
					break;
				}
				finally
				{
					UnCacheViewInfo();
				}
			case "TrendLineBrush":
				UpdateIndexedProperties();
				break;
			case "ErrorBarSettings":
				if (ErrorBarSettings != null)
				{
					ErrorBarSettings.Series = this;
				}
				RenderSeries(animate: false);
				NotifyThumbnailAppearanceChanged();
				break;
			case "TrendLineType":
				NotifyThumbnailAppearanceChanged();
				break;
			case "IsCustomScatterStyleAllowed":
				ActualIsCustomScatterStyleAllowed = ResolveIsCustomScatterStyleAllowed();
				RenderSeries(animate: false);
				break;
			case "IsCustomScatterMarkerStyleAllowed":
				ActualIsCustomScatterMarkerStyleAllowed = ResolveIsCustomScatterMarkerStyleAllowed();
				RenderSeries(animate: false);
				break;
			case "ItemSearchMode":
				ActualItemSearchMode = GetResolvedItemSearchMode();
				break;
			}
		}

		protected virtual bool ResolveIsCustomScatterStyleAllowed()
		{
			return IsCustomScatterStyleAllowed;
		}

		protected virtual bool ResolveIsCustomScatterMarkerStyleAllowed()
		{
			return IsCustomScatterMarkerStyleAllowed;
		}

		[UwpSuppressWidgetMember]
		[WFSuppressWidgetMember]

		{
			if (axis is NumericYAxis)
			{
				return true;
			}
			return false;
		}

		[UwpSuppressWidgetMember]
		[WFSuppressWidgetMember]
		public bool CanUseAsXAxis(object axis)
