		private void UnCacheViewInfo()
		{
			_cachedViewportRect = Rect.Empty;
			_cachedWindowRect = Rect.Empty;
		}

		private void CacheViewInfo()
		{
			GetViewInfo(out _cachedViewportRect, out _cachedWindowRect);
		}

		protected virtual bool MustReact(string propertyName, FastItemsSourceEventAction action)
		{
			if (action != FastItemsSourceEventAction.Change)
			{
				return true;
			}
			if (propertyName == null)
			{
				return true;
			}
			if (XMemberPath == propertyName || YMemberPath == propertyName)
			{
				return true;
			}
			return false;
		}

		protected override void DataUpdatedOverride(FastItemsSourceEventAction action, int position, int count, string propertyName)
		{
			bool flag = false;
			if (MustReact(propertyName, action))
			{
				ScatterView.TrendLineManager.DataUpdated(action, position, count, propertyName);
				if (XAxis != null && !XAxis.UpdateRange())
				{
					flag = true;
				}
				if (YAxis != null && !YAxis.UpdateRange())
				{
					flag = true;
				}
				if (flag)
				{
					RenderSeries(animate: true);
				}
			}
		}

		internal void PrepLinePoints(ScatterFrame frame)
		{
			PrepLinePoints(frame, null);
		}

		internal void PrepLinePoints(ScatterFrame frame, Clipper clipper)
		{
			int val = ((XColumn != null) ? XColumn.Count : 0);
			int val2 = ((YColumn != null) ? YColumn.Count : 0);
			if (Math.Min(val, val2) > MaximumMarkers)
			{
				return;
			}
			frame.Points.Clear();
			List<OwnedPoint> list = new List<OwnedPoint>(frame.LinePoints.Values.Count);
			foreach (OwnedPoint value in frame.LinePoints.Values)
			{
				list.Add(value);
			}
			IFastItemsSource fastItemsSource = base.FastItemsSource;
			list.Sort(delegate(OwnedPoint p1, OwnedPoint p2)
			{
				int num = fastItemsSource.IndexOf(p1.OwnerItem);
				int num2 = fastItemsSource.IndexOf(p2.OwnerItem);
				if (num < num2)
				{
					return -1;
				}
				return (num > num2) ? 1 : 0;
			});
			if (clipper != null)
			{
				clipper.Target = frame.Points;
			}
			foreach (OwnedPoint item in list)
			{
				if (fastItemsSource.IndexOf(item.OwnerItem) >= 0)
				{
					if (clipper != null)
					{
						clipper.Add(item.Point);
					}
					else
					{
						frame.Points.Add(new Point(item.Point.X, item.Point.Y));
					}
				}
			}
		}

		protected internal override AxisRange GetRange(Axis axis)
		{
			if (axis != null && axis == XAxis && XColumn != null)
			{
				return new AxisRange(XColumn.Minimum, XColumn.Maximum);
			}
			if (axis != null && axis == YAxis && YColumn != null)
			{
				return new AxisRange(YColumn.Minimum, YColumn.Maximum);
			}
			return null;
		}

		public override object GetItem(Point world)
		{
			int itemIndex = GetItemIndex(world);
			if (base.FastItemsSource != null && itemIndex >= 0 && itemIndex < base.FastItemsSource.Count)
			{
				return base.FastItemsSource[itemIndex];
			}
			return null;
		}

		protected virtual ScatterItemSearchMode GetResolvedItemSearchMode()
		{
			if (ItemSearchMode != ScatterItemSearchMode.Auto)
			{
				return ItemSearchMode;
			}
			if (!IsLineOrSpline)
			{
				return ScatterItemSearchMode.ClosestVisiblePoint;
			}
			return ScatterItemSearchMode.ClosestPointOnClosestLine;
		}

		public override int GetItemIndex(Point world)
		{
			return (int)Math.Round(GetExactItemIndex(world));
		}

		public override double GetExactItemIndex(Point world)
		{
			return ActualItemSearchMode switch
			{
				ScatterItemSearchMode.ClosestVisiblePoint => GetExactItemIndexForClosestVisiblePoint(world), 
				ScatterItemSearchMode.ClosestVisiblePointOnClosestLine => GetExactItemIndexForClosestVisiblePointOnClosestLine(world), 
				ScatterItemSearchMode.ClosestPoint => GetExactItemIndexForClosestPoint(world), 
				ScatterItemSearchMode.ClosestPointOnClosestLine => GetExactItemIndexForClosestPointOnClosestLine(world), 
				_ => -1.0, 
			};
		}

		protected virtual double GetExactItemIndexForClosestPointOnClosestLine(Point world)
		{
			return PointAlongLineHelper(world, visibleOnly: false);
		}

		protected virtual double GetExactItemIndexForClosestPoint(Point world)
		{
			Point point = FromWorldPosition(world);
			double x = point.X;
			double y = point.Y;
			if (base.FastItemsSource == null || XAxis == null || YAxis == null || XColumn == null || YColumn == null)
			{
				return -1.0;
			}
			if (base.FastItemsSource.Count > ItemSearchThreshold)
			{
				return -1.0;
			}
			EnsureCachedArrays();
			double[] xValues = _xValues;
			double[] yValues = _yValues;
			if (xValues == null || yValues == null)
			{
				return -1.0;
			}
			double num = double.MaxValue;
			int num2 = -1;
			for (int i = 0; i < XColumn.Count; i++)
			{
				double num3 = xValues[i];
				double num4 = yValues[i];
				double num5 = (x - num3) * (x - num3) + (y - num4) * (y - num4);
				if (num5 < num)
				{
					num = num5;
					num2 = i;
				}
			}
			return num2;
		}

		private void EnsureCachedArrays()
		{
			Rect windowRect = base.View.WindowRect;
			Rect viewport = base.View.Viewport;
			Rect effectiveViewport = GetEffectiveViewport();
			if (AxisInfoCache != null)
			{
				ScalerParams p = new ScalerParams(windowRect, viewport, AxisInfoCache.XAxisIsInverted, effectiveViewport);
				ScalerParams p2 = new ScalerParams(windowRect, viewport, AxisInfoCache.YAxisIsInverted, effectiveViewport)
				{
					ReferenceValue = GetReferenceValue()
				};
				if (_xValues == null || _yValues == null)
				{
					double[] array = new double[XColumn.Count];
					XColumn.CopyTo(array, 0);
					double[] array2 = new double[YColumn.Count];
					YColumn.CopyTo(array2, 0);
					XAxis.GetScaledValueList(array, 0, array.Length, p);
					YAxis.GetScaledValueList(array2, 0, array2.Length, p2);
					_xValues = array;
					_yValues = array2;
				}
			}
		}

		private double PointAlongLineHelper(Point world, bool visibleOnly)
		{
			if (!IsLineOrSpline)
			{
				return -1.0;
			}
			Point startPoint = new Point(0.0, 0.0);
			ScatterFrame activeFrame = GetActiveFrame();
			if (activeFrame == null)
			{
				return -1.0;
			}
			if (activeFrame.Points == null)
			{
				return -1.0;
			}
			if (base.FastItemsSource == null || base.FastItemsSource.Count > ItemSearchThreshold)
			{
				return -1.0;
			}
			EnsureCachedArrays();
			double[] xValues = _xValues;
			double[] yValues = _yValues;
			if (xValues == null || yValues == null)
			{
				return -1.0;
			}
			Point targetPoint = FromWorldPosition(world);
			double num = double.MaxValue;
			int num2 = -1;
			for (int i = 0; i < _xValues.Length; i++)
			{
				Point point = new Point(_xValues[i], _yValues[i]);
				if (i > 0 && (!visibleOnly || activeFrame.Markers.ContainsKey(base.FastItemsSource[i]) || activeFrame.Markers.ContainsKey(base.FastItemsSource[i - 1])))
				{
					double num3 = GeometryUtil.DistSquaredToLineSegment(targetPoint, startPoint, point);
					if (num3 < num)
					{
						num = num3;
						num2 = i;
					}
				}
				startPoint = point;
			}
			if (num2 >= 0)
			{
				Point endPoint = new Point(_xValues[num2], _yValues[num2]);
				Point startPoint2 = new Point(_xValues[num2 - 1], _yValues[num2 - 1]);
				if (!visibleOnly || (activeFrame.Markers.ContainsKey(base.FastItemsSource[num2]) && activeFrame.Markers.ContainsKey(base.FastItemsSource[num2 - 1])))
				{
					double num4 = GeometryUtil.ProjectPointToLineSegment(targetPoint, startPoint2, endPoint);
					return (double)(num2 - 1) + num4;
				}
				if (activeFrame.Markers.ContainsKey(base.FastItemsSource[num2]))
				{
					return num2;
				}
				return num2 - 1;
			}
			return -1.0;
		}

		protected virtual double GetExactItemIndexForClosestVisiblePointOnClosestLine(Point world)
		{
			return PointAlongLineHelper(world, visibleOnly: true);
		}

		protected virtual double GetExactItemIndexForClosestVisiblePoint(Point world)
		{
			Marker minDistMarker = null;
			double minDistance = double.MaxValue;
			Point point = FromWorldPosition(world);
			double posX = point.X;
			double posY = point.Y;
			if (ScatterView.Markers.ActiveCount > ItemSearchThreshold)
			{
				return -1.0;
			}
			ScatterView.DoToAllActiveMarkers(delegate(Marker m)
			{
				if (m.Visibility == Visibility.Visible)
				{
					Rect boundingBoxForMarker = ScatterView.GetBoundingBoxForMarker(m);
					double num = boundingBoxForMarker.Left + boundingBoxForMarker.Width / 2.0;
					double num2 = boundingBoxForMarker.Top + boundingBoxForMarker.Height / 2.0;
					double num3 = (posX - num) * (posX - num) + (posY - num2) * (posY - num2);
					if (num3 < minDistance)
					{
						minDistance = num3;
						minDistMarker = m;
					}
				}
			});
			if (minDistMarker != null)
			{
				return minDistMarker.CurrentIndex;
			}
			return -1.0;
		}

		public override Point GetSeriesValuePosition(Point world, bool useInterpolation, bool skipUnknowns)
		{
			if (XAxis == null || YAxis == null || XColumn == null || YColumn == null)
			{
				return new Point(double.NaN, double.NaN);
			}
			Rect windowRect = base.View.WindowRect;
			Rect viewport = base.View.Viewport;
			Rect effectiveViewport = GetEffectiveViewport();
			ScalerParams p = new ScalerParams(windowRect, viewport, XAxis.IsInverted, effectiveViewport);
			ScalerParams p2 = new ScalerParams(windowRect, viewport, YAxis.IsInverted, effectiveViewport)
			{
				ReferenceValue = GetReferenceValue()
			};
			if (useInterpolation)
			{
				double exactItemIndex = GetExactItemIndex(world);
				if (exactItemIndex == -1.0)
				{
					return new Point(double.NaN, double.NaN);
				}
				int num = (int)Math.Floor(exactItemIndex);
				int num2 = (int)Math.Ceiling(exactItemIndex);
				if (num < 0)
				{
					num = 0;
				}
				if (num2 < 0)
				{
					num2 = 0;
				}
				if (num2 > base.FastItemsSource.Count - 1)
				{
					num2 = base.FastItemsSource.Count - 1;
				}
				if (num > base.FastItemsSource.Count - 1)
				{
					num = base.FastItemsSource.Count - 1;
				}
				if (num2 == num)
				{
					double scaledValue = XAxis.GetScaledValue(XColumn[num], p);
					double scaledValue2 = YAxis.GetScaledValue(YColumn[num], p2);
					return new Point(scaledValue, scaledValue2);
				}
				double num3 = exactItemIndex - Math.Floor(exactItemIndex);
				double scaledValue3 = XAxis.GetScaledValue(XColumn[num], p);
				double scaledValue4 = YAxis.GetScaledValue(YColumn[num], p2);
				double scaledValue5 = XAxis.GetScaledValue(XColumn[num2], p);
				double scaledValue6 = YAxis.GetScaledValue(YColumn[num2], p2);
				double num4 = scaledValue5 - scaledValue3;
				double num5 = scaledValue6 - scaledValue4;
				return new Point(scaledValue3 + num4 * num3, scaledValue4 + num5 * num3);
			}
			int itemIndex = GetItemIndex(world);
			if (itemIndex == -1)
			{
				return new Point(double.NaN, double.NaN);
			}
			double scaledValue7 = XAxis.GetScaledValue(XColumn[itemIndex], p);
			double scaledValue8 = YAxis.GetScaledValue(YColumn[itemIndex], p2);
			return new Point(scaledValue7, scaledValue8);
		}

		public override bool ScrollIntoView(object item)
		{
			Rect windowRect = ((base.SeriesViewer != null) ? base.SeriesViewer.ActualWindowRect : Rect.Empty);
			Rect rect = ((base.SeriesViewer != null) ? base.SeriesViewer.ViewportRect : Rect.Empty);
			Rect rect2 = new Rect(0.0, 0.0, 1.0, 1.0);
			Rect effectiveViewportForUnitViewport = GetEffectiveViewportForUnitViewport(base.View);
			ScalerParams p = new ScalerParams(rect2, rect2, XAxis.IsInverted, effectiveViewportForUnitViewport);
			ScalerParams p2 = new ScalerParams(rect2, rect2, YAxis.IsInverted, effectiveViewportForUnitViewport)
			{
				ReferenceValue = GetReferenceValue()
			};
			int num = ((!windowRect.IsEmpty && !rect.IsEmpty && base.FastItemsSource != null) ? base.FastItemsSource.IndexOf(item) : (-1));
			double num2 = ((XAxis != null && XColumn != null && num < XColumn.Count) ? XAxis.GetScaledValue(XColumn[num], p) : double.NaN);
			double num3 = ((YAxis != null && YColumn != null && num < YColumn.Count) ? YAxis.GetScaledValue(YColumn[num], p2) : double.NaN);
			if (!double.IsNaN(num2))
			{
				if (num2 < windowRect.Left + 0.1 * windowRect.Width)
				{
					num2 += 0.4 * windowRect.Width;
					windowRect.X = num2 - 0.5 * windowRect.Width;
				}
				if (num2 > windowRect.Right - 0.1 * windowRect.Width)
				{
					num2 -= 0.4 * windowRect.Width;
					windowRect.X = num2 - 0.5 * windowRect.Width;
				}
			}
			if (!double.IsNaN(num3))
			{
				if (num3 < windowRect.Top + 0.1 * windowRect.Height)
				{
					num3 += 0.4 * windowRect.Height;
					windowRect.Y = num3 - 0.5 * windowRect.Height;
				}
				if (num3 > windowRect.Bottom - 0.1 * windowRect.Height)
				{
					num3 -= 0.4 * windowRect.Height;
					windowRect.Y = num3 - 0.5 * windowRect.Height;
				}
			}
			if (base.SyncLink != null)
			{
				base.SyncLink.WindowNotify(base.SeriesViewer, windowRect, force: true);
			}
			return num >= 0;
		}

		protected override void ViewportRectChangedOverride(Rect oldViewportRect, Rect newViewportRect)
		{
			RenderSeries(animate: false);
		}

		protected override void WindowRectChangedOverride(Rect oldWindowRect, Rect newWindowRect)
		{
			RenderSeries(animate: false);
		}

		internal ScatterFrame GetActiveFrame()
		{
			ScatterFrame result = CurrentFrame;
			if (AnimationActive())
			{
				if (base.Animator.NeedsFlush)
				{
					base.Animator.Flush();
				}
				result = TransitionFrame;
			}
			return result;
		}

		internal virtual void CalculateCachedPoints(ScatterBaseView view, ScatterFrame frame, int count, Rect windowRect, Rect viewportRect)
		{
			frame.CachedPoints = new Dictionary<object, OwnedPoint>(count);
			Rect effectiveViewport = GetEffectiveViewport(view);
			IFastItemsSource fastItemsSource = base.FastItemsSource;
			ScalerParams scalerParams = new ScalerParams(windowRect, viewportRect, AxisInfoCache.XAxisIsInverted, effectiveViewport)
			{
				EffectiveViewportRect = GetEffectiveViewport(view)
			};
			ScalerParams p = new ScalerParams(windowRect, viewportRect, AxisInfoCache.YAxisIsInverted, effectiveViewport)
			{
				EffectiveViewportRect = GetEffectiveViewport(view),
				ReferenceValue = GetReferenceValue()
			};
			bool flag = false;
			double num = 0.0;
			if (base.SeriesViewer != null && base.SeriesViewer.ShouldHorizontalWrap())
			{
				Tuple<bool, double> horizontalWrapInfo = base.SeriesViewer.GetHorizontalWrapInfo(windowRect, scalerParams);
				flag = horizontalWrapInfo.Item1;
				num = horizontalWrapInfo.Item2;
			}
			for (int i = 0; i < count; i++)
			{
				double num2 = XColumn[i];
				double num3 = YColumn[i];
				Point point = new Point(AxisInfoCache.XAxis.GetScaledValue(num2, scalerParams), AxisInfoCache.YAxis.GetScaledValue(num3, p));
				if (flag && (point.X < viewportRect.Left || point.X > viewportRect.Right) && point.X + num >= viewportRect.Left && point.X + num <= viewportRect.Right)
				{
					point = new Point(point.X + num, num3);
				}
				if (!double.IsInfinity(point.X) && !double.IsInfinity(point.Y))
				{
					object obj = fastItemsSource[i];
					if (!frame.CachedPoints.ContainsKey(obj))
					{
						Point columnValues = new Point(num2, num3);
						Point point2 = new Point(point.X, point.Y);
						frame.CachedPoints.Add(obj, new OwnedPoint
						{
							OwnerItem = obj,
							ColumnValues = columnValues,
							Point = point2
						});
					}
				}
			}
		}

		internal virtual void PrepareFrame(ScatterFrame frame, ScatterBaseView view)
		{
			_xValues = null;
			_yValues = null;
			frame.Markers.Clear();
			frame.TrendLine.Clear();
			frame.HorizontalErrorBars.Clear();
			frame.VerticalErrorBars.Clear();
			frame.HorizontalErrorBarWidths.Clear();
			frame.VerticalErrorBarHeights.Clear();
			int num = Math.Min((XColumn != null) ? XColumn.Count : 0, (YColumn != null) ? YColumn.Count : 0);
			Rect windowRect = view.WindowRect;
			Rect viewport = view.Viewport;
			Rect effectiveViewport = GetEffectiveViewport(view);
			ScalerParams xParams = new ScalerParams(windowRect, viewport, XAxis.IsInverted, effectiveViewport);
			xParams.EffectiveViewportRect = GetEffectiveViewport(view);
			ScalerParams yParams = new ScalerParams(windowRect, viewport, YAxis.IsInverted, effectiveViewport)
			{
				ReferenceValue = GetReferenceValue()
			};
			yParams.EffectiveViewportRect = GetEffectiveViewport(view);
			if (num >= 1)
			{
				AxisInfoCache = new ScatterAxisInfoCache
				{
					XAxis = XAxis,
					YAxis = YAxis,
					XAxisIsInverted = XAxis.IsInverted,
					YAxisIsInverted = YAxis.IsInverted,
					FastItemsSource = base.FastItemsSource
				};
				if (num <= MaximumMarkers)
				{
					CalculateCachedPoints(view, frame, num, windowRect, viewport);
				}
				if (ShouldDisplayMarkers())
				{
					view.MarkerManager.WinnowMarkers(frame.Markers, MaximumMarkers, windowRect, viewport, base.Resolution);
				}
				Clipper clipper = new Clipper(viewport, isClosed: false)
				{
					Target = frame.TrendLine
				};
				Rect contentViewport = GetContentViewport(view);
				double unscaledValue = XAxis.GetUnscaledValue(contentViewport.Left, xParams);
				double unscaledValue2 = XAxis.GetUnscaledValue(contentViewport.Right, xParams);
				view.TrendLineManager.PrepareLine(frame.TrendLine, TrendLineType, XColumn, YColumn, TrendLinePeriod, (double x) => XAxis.GetScaledValue(x, xParams), (double y) => YAxis.GetScaledValue(y, yParams), new TrendResolutionParams
				{
					Resolution = base.Resolution,
					Viewport = viewport,
					Window = windowRect
				}, clipper, unscaledValue, unscaledValue2);
				PrepareErrorBars(frame, view);
			}
		}

		protected internal override void ClearRendering(bool wipeClean, SeriesView view)
		{
			base.ClearRendering(wipeClean, view);
			((ScatterBaseView)view).ClearRendering(wipeClean);
		}

		protected virtual HighlightingInfo GetSpecificHighlightingInfo(object item, Point world, HighlightingInfo prevValue)
		{
			return null;
		}

		protected HighlightingInfo GetSpecificMarkerHighlightingInfo(object item, Point world, HighlightingInfo prevValue)
		{
			GetActiveFrame();
			Marker hitMarker = ScatterView.GetHitMarker(FromWorldPosition(world));
			int num = -1;
			if (hitMarker == null)
			{
				if (item == null)
				{
					return null;
				}
				num = base.FastItemsSource.IndexOf(item);
			}
			else
			{
				num = hitMarker.CurrentIndex;
			}
			if (num == -1)
			{
				return null;
			}
			HighlightingInfo highlightingInfo = new HighlightingInfo();
			highlightingInfo.Series = this;
			highlightingInfo.StartIndex = num;
			highlightingInfo.EndIndex = num;
			highlightingInfo.IsFullRange = false;
			highlightingInfo.IsMarker = true;
			if (prevValue != null && prevValue.StartIndex == highlightingInfo.StartIndex && prevValue.EndIndex == highlightingInfo.EndIndex)
			{
				return prevValue;
			}
			return highlightingInfo;
		}

		public override Thickness ResolveDesiredAutoMargin()
		{
			if (base.MarkerType != MarkerType.None && base.MarkerType != MarkerType.Hidden)
			{
				Size fullMarkerSize = base.MarkerView.GetFullMarkerSize();
				double num = fullMarkerSize.Width / 2.0 + base.MarkerThickness / 2.0;
				double num2 = fullMarkerSize.Height / 2.0 + base.MarkerThickness / 2.0;
				return new Thickness(num, num2, num, num2);
			}
			return new Thickness(0.0, 0.0, 0.0, 0.0);
		}

		protected HighlightingInfo GetFullSeriesInfo(object item, Point world, HighlightingInfo prevValue)
		{
			HighlightingInfo highlightingInfo = new HighlightingInfo();
			highlightingInfo.Series = this;
			highlightingInfo.StartIndex = 0;
			highlightingInfo.EndIndex = base.FastItemsSource.Count - 1;
			highlightingInfo.IsFullRange = true;
			if (prevValue != null && prevValue.StartIndex == highlightingInfo.StartIndex && prevValue.EndIndex == highlightingInfo.EndIndex)
			{
				return prevValue;
			}
			return highlightingInfo;
		}

		protected internal override HighlightingInfo GetHighlightingInfo(object item, Point world, bool forceFullRange)
		{
			if (HasIndividualElements && IsSpecificHighlightingMode(base.ActualHighlightingMode) && !forceFullRange)
			{
				return PrevHighlightingInfo = GetSpecificHighlightingInfo(item, world, PrevHighlightingInfo);
			}
			return PrevHighlightingInfo = GetFullSeriesInfo(item, world, PrevHighlightingInfo);
		}

		protected internal override HighlightingInfo GetMarkerHighlightingInfo(object item, Point world, bool forceFullRange)
		{
			if (IsSpecificHighlightingMode(base.ActualHighlightingMode) && !forceFullRange)
			{
				return PrevMarkerHighlightingInfo = GetSpecificMarkerHighlightingInfo(item, world, PrevMarkerHighlightingInfo);
			}
			HighlightingInfo fullSeriesInfo = GetFullSeriesInfo(item, world, PrevMarkerHighlightingInfo);
			fullSeriesInfo.IsMarker = true;
			PrevMarkerHighlightingInfo = fullSeriesInfo;
			return fullSeriesInfo;
		}

		protected bool ShouldOverrideScatterStyle()
		{
			if (this.AssigningScatterStyle == null || !ActualIsCustomScatterStyleAllowed)
			{
				return base.ActualHighlightingMode != SeriesHighlightingMode.None;
			}
			return true;
		}

		protected bool ShouldOverrideMarkerStyle()
		{
			if (this.AssigningScatterMarkerStyle == null || !ActualIsCustomScatterMarkerStyleAllowed)
			{
				return base.ActualHighlightingMode != SeriesHighlightingMode.None;
			}
			return true;
		}

		internal virtual void RenderFrame(ScatterFrame frame, ScatterBaseView view)
		{
			Rect viewport = view.Viewport;
			AxisInfoCache = new ScatterAxisInfoCache
			{
				XAxis = XAxis,
				YAxis = YAxis,
				XAxisIsInverted = XAxis.IsInverted,
				YAxisIsInverted = YAxis.IsInverted
			};
			if (ShouldDisplayMarkers())
			{
				view.MarkerManager.Render(frame.Markers, base.UseLightweightMarkers);
				if (ShouldOverrideMarkerStyle())
				{
					ColorizeMarkers(view, frame);
				}
			}
			view.RenderMarkers();
			Clipper clipper = new Clipper(double.NaN, viewport.Bottom, double.NaN, viewport.Top, isClosed: false)
			{
				Target = view.TrendLineManager.TrendPolyline.Points
			};
			view.TrendLineManager.RasterizeTrendLine(frame.TrendLine, clipper);
			RenderErrorBars(frame, view);
		}

		[SuppressWidgetMember]
		public virtual object[] GetScatterItems(int startIndex, int endIndex)
		{
			return GetScatterItemsHelper(startIndex, endIndex);
		}

		protected object[] GetScatterItemsHelper(int orderedStartIndex, int orderedEndIndex)
		{
			if (orderedEndIndex < orderedStartIndex || orderedStartIndex < 0 || orderedStartIndex > XColumn.Count || orderedEndIndex < 0 || orderedEndIndex > XColumn.Count)
			{
				return null;
			}
			object[] array = new object[orderedEndIndex - orderedStartIndex + 1];
			for (int i = orderedStartIndex; i <= orderedEndIndex; i++)
			{
				array[i - orderedStartIndex] = base.FastItemsSource[i];
			}
			return array;
		}

		internal void ColorizeMarkers(ScatterBaseView view, ScatterFrame frame)
		{
			view.MarkerAppearanceHandled = true;
			RenderManager.InitScatterMarkerRenderSettings(this, ShouldOverrideMarkerStyle(), GetScatterItems);
			AssigningSeriesStyleEventArgsBase markerOverrideArgs = RenderManager.MarkerOverrideArgs;
			bool areMarkerStylesOverriden = markerOverrideArgs != null;
			GetEffectiveViewport(view);
			int valueCount = ((base.FastItemsSource != null) ? base.FastItemsSource.Count : 0);
			ScatterView.DoToAllMarkers(delegate(Marker marker)
			{
				if (marker.Visibility == Visibility.Visible)
				{
					int currentIndex = marker.CurrentIndex;
					DataContext dataContext = (DataContext)marker.Content;
					if (dataContext == null)
					{
						dataContext = (DataContext)(marker.Content = new DataContext());
					}
					if (areMarkerStylesOverriden)
					{
						PerformScatterMarkerStyleOverride(currentIndex, valueCount, view.IsThumbnailView);
					}
					RenderManager.SetMarkerAppearance(marker, dataContext);
				}
			});
		}

		protected void PerformScatterStyleOverride(int currentIndex, int valueCount, bool isThumbnail)
		{
			bool flag = base.ActualHighlightingMode != SeriesHighlightingMode.None;
			RenderManager.PopulateArgsBounds(RenderManager.OverrideArgs, currentIndex, valueCount, isMarker: false);
			RenderManager.PrePerformStyleOverride(base.ActualHighlightingFadeOpacity);
			AssigningScatterStyleEventArgs scatterOverrideArgs = RenderManager.ScatterOverrideArgs;
			HighlightingInfo info = null;
			IFastItemsSource fastItemsSource = base.FastItemsSource;
			if (flag && base.SeriesViewer != null)
			{
				info = (scatterOverrideArgs.HighlightingInfo = base.SeriesViewer.HighlightingManager.GetHighlightingInfo(this, fastItemsSource, scatterOverrideArgs.StartIndex, scatterOverrideArgs.EndIndex, isMarker: false));
			}
			scatterOverrideArgs.IsThumbnail = isThumbnail;
			RaiseAssigningScatterStyles(scatterOverrideArgs);
			RenderManager.PostPerformStyleOverride(this, info, isThumbnail, flag, currentIndex < 0);
		}

		protected void PerformScatterMarkerStyleOverride(int currentIndex, int valueCount, bool isThumbnail)
		{
			bool flag = base.ActualHighlightingMode != SeriesHighlightingMode.None;
			RenderManager.PopulateArgsBounds(RenderManager.MarkerOverrideArgs, currentIndex, valueCount, isMarker: true);
			RenderManager.PrePerformMarkerStyleOverride(base.ActualHighlightingFadeOpacity);
			AssigningScatterMarkerStyleEventArgs scatterMarkerOverrideArgs = RenderManager.ScatterMarkerOverrideArgs;
			HighlightingInfo highlightingInfo = null;
			IFastItemsSource fastItemsSource = base.FastItemsSource;
			if (flag && base.SeriesViewer != null)
			{
				highlightingInfo = base.SeriesViewer.HighlightingManager.GetHighlightingInfo(this, fastItemsSource, scatterMarkerOverrideArgs.StartIndex, scatterMarkerOverrideArgs.EndIndex, isMarker: true);
				if (base.SeriesViewer.HighlightingManager.IsCrossSeriesHighlight(this))
				{
					base.SeriesViewer.HighlightingManager.GetHighlightingInfo(this, fastItemsSource, scatterMarkerOverrideArgs.StartIndex, scatterMarkerOverrideArgs.EndIndex, isMarker: true);
				}
				scatterMarkerOverrideArgs.HighlightingInfo = highlightingInfo;
			}
			scatterMarkerOverrideArgs.IsThumbnail = isThumbnail;
			RaiseAssigningScatterMarkerStyles(scatterMarkerOverrideArgs);
			RenderManager.PostPerformMarkerStyleOverride(this, highlightingInfo, isThumbnail, flag, scatterMarkerOverrideArgs.TotalAllSeriesHighlightingProgress, base.SeriesViewer.HighlightingManager.TotalHighlightingProgress);
		}

		protected void RaiseAssigningScatterStyles(AssigningScatterStyleEventArgs args)
		{
			if (this.AssigningScatterStyle != null && ActualIsCustomScatterStyleAllowed)
			{
				this.AssigningScatterStyle(this, args);
			}
		}

		protected void RaiseAssigningScatterMarkerStyles(AssigningScatterMarkerStyleEventArgs args)
		{
			if (this.AssigningScatterMarkerStyle != null && ActualIsCustomScatterMarkerStyleAllowed)
			{
				this.AssigningScatterMarkerStyle(this, args);
			}
		}

		internal void PrepareErrorBars(ScatterFrame frame, ScatterBaseView view)
		{
			ErrorBarsHelper errorBarsHelper = new ErrorBarsHelper(this, view);
			if (ErrorBarSettings == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			IErrorBarCalculator horizontalCalculator = ErrorBarSettings.HorizontalCalculator;
			IErrorBarCalculator verticalCalculator = ErrorBarSettings.VerticalCalculator;
			double position = 0.0;
			double position2 = 0.0;
			double positiveSize = 0.0;
			double negativeSize = 0.0;
			foreach (object key in frame.Markers.Keys)
			{
				OwnedPoint ownedPoint = frame.Markers[key];
				if (horizontalCalculator != null)
				{
					switch (horizontalCalculator.GetCalculatorType())
					{
					case ErrorBarCalculatorType.Percentage:
						PreparePercentageErrorBarSize(ownedPoint, errorBarsHelper, horizontalCalculator, ref positiveSize, ref negativeSize, horizontal: true);
						break;
					case ErrorBarCalculatorType.Fixed:
						PrepareFixedErrorBarSize(ownedPoint, errorBarsHelper, horizontalCalculator, ref positiveSize, ref negativeSize, horizontal: true);
						break;
					case ErrorBarCalculatorType.Data:
						PrepareDataErrorBarSize(ownedPoint, errorBarsHelper, horizontalCalculator, key, ref positiveSize, ref negativeSize, horizontal: true);
						break;
					case ErrorBarCalculatorType.StandardDeviation:
						PrepareStandardDevErrorBarSize(errorBarsHelper, horizontalCalculator, ref position, ref positiveSize, ref negativeSize, horizontal: true);
						break;
					case ErrorBarCalculatorType.StandardError:
						PrepareFixedErrorBarSize(ownedPoint, errorBarsHelper, horizontalCalculator, ref positiveSize, ref negativeSize, horizontal: true);
						break;
					}
					OwnedPoint ownedPoint2 = new OwnedPoint();
					ownedPoint2.Point = errorBarsHelper.CalculateErrorBarCenterHorizontal(horizontalCalculator, AxisInfoCache.XAxis, ownedPoint.Point, position);
					ownedPoint2.OwnerItem = ownedPoint.OwnerItem;
					frame.HorizontalErrorBars.Add(key, ownedPoint2);
					frame.HorizontalErrorBarWidths.Add(key, new double[2] { positiveSize, negativeSize });
				}
				if (verticalCalculator != null)
				{
					switch (verticalCalculator.GetCalculatorType())
					{
					case ErrorBarCalculatorType.Percentage:
						PreparePercentageErrorBarSize(ownedPoint, errorBarsHelper, verticalCalculator, ref positiveSize, ref negativeSize, horizontal: false);
						break;
					case ErrorBarCalculatorType.Fixed:
						PrepareFixedErrorBarSize(ownedPoint, errorBarsHelper, verticalCalculator, ref positiveSize, ref negativeSize, horizontal: false);
						break;
					case ErrorBarCalculatorType.Data:
						PrepareDataErrorBarSize(ownedPoint, errorBarsHelper, verticalCalculator, key, ref positiveSize, ref negativeSize, horizontal: false);
						break;
					case ErrorBarCalculatorType.StandardDeviation:
						PrepareStandardDevErrorBarSize(errorBarsHelper, verticalCalculator, ref position2, ref positiveSize, ref negativeSize, horizontal: false);
						break;
					case ErrorBarCalculatorType.StandardError:
						PrepareFixedErrorBarSize(ownedPoint, errorBarsHelper, verticalCalculator, ref positiveSize, ref negativeSize, horizontal: false);
						break;
					}
					OwnedPoint ownedPoint3 = new OwnedPoint();
					ownedPoint3.Point = errorBarsHelper.CalculateErrorBarCenterVertical(verticalCalculator, AxisInfoCache.YAxis, ownedPoint.Point, position2);
					ownedPoint3.OwnerItem = ownedPoint.OwnerItem;
					frame.VerticalErrorBars.Add(key, ownedPoint3);
					frame.VerticalErrorBarHeights.Add(key, new double[2] { positiveSize, negativeSize });
				}
			}
		}

		internal void PreparePercentageErrorBarSize(OwnedPoint point, ErrorBarsHelper helper, IErrorBarCalculator calculator, ref double positiveSize, ref double negativeSize, bool horizontal)
		{
			if (horizontal)
			{
				NumericAxisBase xAxis = AxisInfoCache.XAxis;
				double scaledValue;
				NumericAxisBase refAxis;
				if (ErrorBarSettings.HorizontalCalculatorReference == ErrorBarCalculatorReference.X)
				{
					scaledValue = point.Point.X;
					refAxis = AxisInfoCache.XAxis;
				}
				else
				{
					scaledValue = point.Point.Y;
					refAxis = AxisInfoCache.YAxis;
				}
				helper.CalculateDependentErrorBarSize(scaledValue, calculator, refAxis, xAxis, ref positiveSize, ref negativeSize);
			}
			else
			{
				NumericAxisBase yAxis = AxisInfoCache.YAxis;
				double scaledValue2;
				NumericAxisBase refAxis2;
				if (ErrorBarSettings.VerticalCalculatorReference == ErrorBarCalculatorReference.X)
				{
					scaledValue2 = point.Point.X;
					refAxis2 = AxisInfoCache.XAxis;
				}
				else
				{
					scaledValue2 = point.Point.Y;
					refAxis2 = AxisInfoCache.YAxis;
				}
				helper.CalculateDependentErrorBarSize(scaledValue2, calculator, refAxis2, yAxis, ref positiveSize, ref negativeSize);
			}
		}

		internal void PrepareFixedErrorBarSize(OwnedPoint point, ErrorBarsHelper helper, IErrorBarCalculator calculator, ref double positiveSize, ref double negativeSize, bool horizontal)
		{
			if (horizontal)
			{
				helper.CalculateIndependentErrorBarSize(point.Point.X, calculator, AxisInfoCache.XAxis, ref positiveSize, ref negativeSize);
			}
			else
			{
				helper.CalculateIndependentErrorBarSize(point.Point.Y, calculator, AxisInfoCache.YAxis, ref positiveSize, ref negativeSize);
			}
		}

		internal void PrepareDataErrorBarSize(OwnedPoint point, ErrorBarsHelper helper, IErrorBarCalculator calculator, object key, ref double positiveSize, ref double negativeSize, bool horizontal)
		{
			IFastItemColumn<double> itemColumn = calculator.GetItemColumn();
			int num = base.FastItemsSource.IndexOf(key);
			if (itemColumn != null && num < itemColumn.Count)
			{
				double unscaledErrorBarValue = itemColumn[num];
				if (horizontal)
				{
					helper.CalculateFromUnscaledErrorBarValue(point.Point.X, unscaledErrorBarValue, AxisInfoCache.XAxis, ref positiveSize, ref negativeSize);
				}
				else
				{
					helper.CalculateFromUnscaledErrorBarValue(point.Point.Y, unscaledErrorBarValue, AxisInfoCache.YAxis, ref positiveSize, ref negativeSize);
				}
			}
			else
			{
				positiveSize = double.NaN;
				negativeSize = double.NaN;
			}
		}

		internal void PrepareStandardDevErrorBarSize(ErrorBarsHelper helper, IErrorBarCalculator calculator, ref double position, ref double positiveSize, ref double negativeSize, bool horizontal)
		{
			helper.CalculateIndependentErrorBarPosition(calculator, ref position);
			if (horizontal)
			{
				helper.CalculateStdDevErrorBarSize(position, calculator, AxisInfoCache.XAxis, ref positiveSize, ref negativeSize);
			}
			else
			{
				helper.CalculateStdDevErrorBarSize(position, calculator, AxisInfoCache.YAxis, ref positiveSize, ref negativeSize);
			}
		}

		internal void RenderErrorBars(ScatterFrame frame, ScatterBaseView view)
		{
			if (!view.HasSurface() || ErrorBarSettings == null)
			{
				view.HideErrorBars();
				return;
			}
			RenderErrorBarsHorizontal(frame, view);
			RenderErrorBarsVertical(frame, view);
		}

		private void RenderErrorBarsHorizontal(ScatterFrame frame, ScatterBaseView view)
		{
			view.AttachHorizontalErrorBars();
			ErrorBarsHelper errorBarsHelper = new ErrorBarsHelper(this, view);
			PathGeometry pathGeometry = new PathGeometry();
			IErrorBarCalculator horizontalCalculator = ErrorBarSettings.HorizontalCalculator;
			foreach (object key in frame.Markers.Keys)
			{
				if (horizontalCalculator == null || !frame.HorizontalErrorBarWidths.ContainsKey(key))
				{
					continue;
				}
				double num = frame.HorizontalErrorBarWidths[key][0];
				double num2 = frame.HorizontalErrorBarWidths[key][1];
				if (!double.IsNaN(num) && !double.IsNaN(num2))
				{
					Point point = frame.HorizontalErrorBars[key].Point;
					if (ErrorBarSettings.EnableErrorBarsHorizontal == EnableErrorBars.Both || ErrorBarSettings.EnableErrorBarsHorizontal == EnableErrorBars.Positive)
					{
						errorBarsHelper.AddErrorBarHorizontal(pathGeometry, point, num, positive: true);
					}
					if (ErrorBarSettings.EnableErrorBarsHorizontal == EnableErrorBars.Both || ErrorBarSettings.EnableErrorBarsHorizontal == EnableErrorBars.Negative)
					{
						errorBarsHelper.AddErrorBarHorizontal(pathGeometry, point, num2, positive: false);
					}
				}
			}
			view.ProvideHorizontalErrorBarGeometry(pathGeometry);
		}

		private void RenderErrorBarsVertical(ScatterFrame frame, ScatterBaseView view)
		{
			view.AttachVerticalErrorBars();
			ErrorBarsHelper errorBarsHelper = new ErrorBarsHelper(this, view);
			PathGeometry pathGeometry = new PathGeometry();
			IErrorBarCalculator verticalCalculator = ErrorBarSettings.VerticalCalculator;
			foreach (object key in frame.Markers.Keys)
			{
				if (verticalCalculator == null || !frame.VerticalErrorBarHeights.ContainsKey(key))
				{
					continue;
				}
				double num = frame.VerticalErrorBarHeights[key][0];
				double num2 = frame.VerticalErrorBarHeights[key][1];
				if (!double.IsNaN(num) && !double.IsNaN(num2))
				{
					Point point = frame.VerticalErrorBars[key].Point;
					if (ErrorBarSettings.EnableErrorBarsVertical == EnableErrorBars.Both || ErrorBarSettings.EnableErrorBarsVertical == EnableErrorBars.Positive)
					{
						errorBarsHelper.AddErrorBarVertical(pathGeometry, point, num, positive: true);
					}
					if (ErrorBarSettings.EnableErrorBarsVertical == EnableErrorBars.Both || ErrorBarSettings.EnableErrorBarsVertical == EnableErrorBars.Negative)
					{
						errorBarsHelper.AddErrorBarVertical(pathGeometry, point, num2, positive: false);
					}
				}
			}
			view.ProvideVerticalErrorBarGeometry(pathGeometry);
		}

		protected internal override bool ValidateSeries(Rect viewportRect, Rect windowRect, SeriesView view)
		{
			bool result = true;
			if (!base.ValidateSeries(viewportRect, windowRect, view) || windowRect.IsEmpty || viewportRect.IsEmpty || XAxis == null || YAxis == null || XAxis.SeriesViewer == null || YAxis.SeriesViewer == null || XColumn == null || YColumn == null || XColumn.Count == 0 || YColumn.Count == 0 || base.FastItemsSource == null || base.FastItemsSource.Count != XColumn.Count || base.FastItemsSource.Count != YColumn.Count || XAxis.SeriesViewer == null || YAxis.SeriesViewer == null || XAxis.ActualMinimumValue == XAxis.ActualMaximumValue || YAxis.ActualMinimumValue == YAxis.ActualMaximumValue)
			{
				result = false;
			}
			return result;
		}

		protected internal override void GetViewInfo(out Rect viewportRect, out Rect windowRect)
		{
			if (!_cachedViewportRect.IsEmpty && !_cachedWindowRect.IsEmpty)
			{
				viewportRect = _cachedViewportRect;
				windowRect = _cachedWindowRect;
			}
			else
			{
				viewportRect = base.View.Viewport;
				windowRect = base.View.WindowRect;
			}
		}

		protected internal override void RenderSeriesOverride([SwiftMutableParameter] bool animate)
		{
			CacheViewInfo();
			try
			{
				if (ClearAndAbortIfInvalid(base.View))
				{
					return;
				}
				if (base.FastItemsSource != null && base.FastItemsSource.Count > MaximumMarkers)
				{
					animate = false;
				}
				if (ShouldAnimate(animate) && !base.SkipPrepare)
				{
					ScatterFrame previousFrame = PreviousFrame;
					if (AnimationActive())
					{
						if (base.Animator.NeedsFlush)
						{
							base.Animator.Flush();
						}
						PreviousFrame = TransitionFrame;
						TransitionFrame = previousFrame;
					}
					else
					{
						PreviousFrame = CurrentFrame;
						CurrentFrame = previousFrame;
					}
					PrepareFrame(CurrentFrame, ScatterView);
					StartAnimation();
				}
				else
				{
					if (!base.SkipPrepare)
					{
						PrepareFrame(CurrentFrame, ScatterView);
					}
					RenderFrame(CurrentFrame, ScatterView);
				}
			}
			finally
			{
				UnCacheViewInfo();
			}
		}

		protected override void UpdateIndexedProperties()
		{
			base.UpdateIndexedProperties();
			if (base.Index >= 0)
			{
				ScatterView.UpdateTrendlineBrush();
			}
		}

		protected internal override void RenderThumbnail(Rect viewportRect, RenderSurface surface)
		{
			base.RenderThumbnail(viewportRect, surface);
			if (!base.ThumbnailDirty)
			{
				base.View.PrepSurface(surface);
				return;
			}
			base.View.PrepSurface(surface);
			if (!ClearAndAbortIfInvalid(base.ThumbnailView))
			{
				ScatterBaseView view = base.ThumbnailView as ScatterBaseView;
				if (!base.SkipThumbnailPrepare)
				{
					ThumbnailFrame = new ScatterFrame();
					PrepareFrame(ThumbnailFrame, view);
				}
				base.SkipThumbnailPrepare = false;
				RenderFrame(ThumbnailFrame, view);
				base.ThumbnailDirty = false;
			}
		}

		public override void RenderAlternateView(Rect viewportRect, Rect windowRect, RenderSurface surface, string viewIdentifier, double effectiveScalingRatio)
		{
			base.RenderAlternateView(viewportRect, windowRect, surface, viewIdentifier, effectiveScalingRatio);
			SeriesView seriesView = base.SeriesInteractionManager.AlternateViews[viewIdentifier];
			ScatterBaseView view = (ScatterBaseView)seriesView;
			seriesView.PrepAltSurface(surface);
			if (!ClearAndAbortIfInvalid(view))
			{
				if (AlternateFrame == null)
				{
					AlternateFrame = new ScatterFrame();
				}
				PrepareFrame(AlternateFrame, view);
				RenderFrame(AlternateFrame, view);
			}
		}

		internal virtual void RemoveUnusedMarkers(IDictionary<object, OwnedPoint> list, HashPool<object, Marker> markers)
		{
			List<object> list2 = new List<object>();
			foreach (object activeKey in markers.ActiveKeys)
			{
				if (!list.ContainsKey(activeKey))
				{
					list2.Add(activeKey);
				}
			}
			foreach (object item in list2)
			{
				markers.Remove(item);
			}
		}

		internal virtual Point[] GetMarkerLocations(ScatterBaseView view, HashPool<object, Marker> markers, [SwiftMutableParameter] Point[] locations, Rect windowRect, Rect viewportRect)
		{
			if (locations == null || locations.Length != AxisInfoCache.FastItemsSource.Count)
			{
				locations = new Point[AxisInfoCache.FastItemsSource.Count];
			}
			Rect effectiveViewport = GetEffectiveViewport(view);
			ScalerParams scalerParams = new ScalerParams(windowRect, viewportRect, XAxis.IsInverted, effectiveViewport)
			{
				EffectiveViewportRect = GetEffectiveViewport(view)
			};
			ScalerParams p = new ScalerParams(windowRect, viewportRect, YAxis.IsInverted, effectiveViewport)
			{
				EffectiveViewportRect = GetEffectiveViewport(view),
				ReferenceValue = GetReferenceValue()
			};
			Rect contentViewport = GetContentViewport(view);
			double num = AxisInfoCache.XAxis.GetUnscaledValue(contentViewport.Left, scalerParams);
			double num2 = AxisInfoCache.XAxis.GetUnscaledValue(contentViewport.Right, scalerParams);
			double num3 = AxisInfoCache.YAxis.GetUnscaledValue(contentViewport.Bottom, p);
			double num4 = AxisInfoCache.YAxis.GetUnscaledValue(contentViewport.Top, p);
			if (AxisInfoCache.XAxisIsInverted)
			{
				double num5 = num;
				num = num2;
				num2 = num5;
			}
			if (AxisInfoCache.YAxisIsInverted)
			{
				double num6 = num3;
				num3 = num4;
				num4 = num6;
			}
			ScatterAxisInfoCache axisInfoCache = AxisInfoCache;
			NumericXAxis xAxis = axisInfoCache.XAxis;
			NumericYAxis yAxis = axisInfoCache.YAxis;
			IFastItemColumn<double> xColumn = XColumn;
			IFastItemColumn<double> yColumn = YColumn;
			bool flag = false;
			double num7 = 0.0;
			double num8 = 0.0;
			if (base.SeriesViewer != null && base.SeriesViewer.ShouldHorizontalWrap())
			{
				Tuple<bool, double> horizontalWrapInfo = base.SeriesViewer.GetHorizontalWrapInfo(windowRect, scalerParams);
				flag = horizontalWrapInfo.Item1;
				num7 = horizontalWrapInfo.Item2;
				num8 = xAxis.GetUnscaledValue(0.0 + num7, scalerParams);
				double unscaledValue = xAxis.GetUnscaledValue(0.0, scalerParams);
				num8 -= unscaledValue;
			}
			for (int i = 0; i < AxisInfoCache.FastItemsSource.Count; i++)
			{
				double num9 = xColumn[i];
				double num10 = yColumn[i];
				if (flag)
				{
					if (num9 >= num && num9 <= num2 && num10 >= num3 && num10 <= num4)
					{
						locations[i].X = xAxis.GetScaledValue(num9, scalerParams);
						locations[i].Y = yAxis.GetScaledValue(num10, p);
					}
					else if (num9 + num8 >= num && num9 + num8 <= num2 && num10 >= num3 && num10 <= num4)
					{
						locations[i].X = xAxis.GetScaledValue(num9, scalerParams) + num7;
						locations[i].Y = yAxis.GetScaledValue(num10, p);
					}
					else
					{
						locations[i].X = double.NaN;
						locations[i].Y = double.NaN;
					}
				}
				else if (num9 >= num && num9 <= num2 && num10 >= num3 && num10 <= num4)
				{
					locations[i].X = xAxis.GetScaledValue(num9, scalerParams);
					locations[i].Y = yAxis.GetScaledValue(num10, p);
				}
				else
				{
					locations[i].X = double.NaN;
					locations[i].Y = double.NaN;
				}
			}
			return locations;
		}

		internal override void PrepareFrame(ScatterFrame frame, ScatterBaseView view)
		{
			base.PrepareFrame(frame, view);
			frame.Points.Clear();
			frame.LinePoints.Clear();
			Rect windowRect = view.WindowRect;
			Rect viewport = view.Viewport;
			Rect effectiveViewport = GetEffectiveViewport(view);
			double num = base.Resolution * base.Resolution;
			int num2 = 0;
			if (base.XColumn != null)
			{
				num2 = base.XColumn.Count;
			}
			if (base.YColumn != null)
			{
				num2 = Math.Min(base.YColumn.Count, num2);
			}
			ScalerParams p = new ScalerParams(windowRect, viewport, base.AxisInfoCache.XAxisIsInverted, effectiveViewport);
			ScalerParams p2 = new ScalerParams(windowRect, viewport, base.AxisInfoCache.YAxisIsInverted, effectiveViewport)
			{
				ReferenceValue = GetReferenceValue()
			};
			double[] array = new double[base.XColumn.Count];
			base.XColumn.CopyTo(array, 0);
			double[] array2 = new double[base.YColumn.Count];
			base.YColumn.CopyTo(array2, 0);
			base.XAxis.GetScaledValueList(array, 0, array.Length, p);
			base.YAxis.GetScaledValueList(array2, 0, array2.Length, p2);
			double top = viewport.Top - 10.0;
			double bottom = viewport.Bottom + 10.0;
			double left = viewport.Left - 10.0;
			double right = viewport.Right + 10.0;
			Clipper clipper = new Clipper(left, bottom, right, top, isClosed: false)
			{
				Target = frame.Points
			};
			int i = 0;
			while (i < num2)
			{
				int num3 = i;
				i++;
				if (num2 > base.MaximumMarkers)
				{
					for (; i < num2; i++)
					{
						double num4 = array[i] - array[num3];
						double num5 = array2[i] - array2[num3];
						if (num4 * num4 + num5 * num5 >= num)
						{
							break;
						}
					}
					clipper.Add(Centroid(array, array2, num3, i - 1));
				}
				else
				{
					OwnedPoint ownedPoint = new OwnedPoint();
					ownedPoint.Point = new Point(array[num3], array2[num3]);
					ownedPoint.OwnerItem = base.FastItemsSource[num3];
					if (!frame.LinePoints.ContainsKey(ownedPoint.OwnerItem))
					{
						frame.LinePoints.Add(ownedPoint.OwnerItem, ownedPoint);
					}
				}
			}
			if (num2 > base.MaximumMarkers)
			{
				clipper.Target = null;
			}
		}

		private Point Centroid(double[] X, double[] Y, int a, int b)
		{
			if (a == b)
			{
				return new Point(X[a], Y[a]);
			}
			double num = 0.0;
			double num2 = 0.0;
			double num3 = b - a + 1;
			for (int i = a; i <= b; i++)
			{
				num += X[i];
				num2 += Y[i];
			}
			return new Point(num / num3, num2 / num3);
		}

		internal override void RenderFrame(ScatterFrame frame, ScatterBaseView view)
		{
			view.ClearRendering(wipeClean: false);
			base.RenderFrame(frame, view);
			GetEffectiveViewport(view);
			Rect rect = new Rect(view.Viewport.Left, view.Viewport.Top, view.Viewport.Width, view.Viewport.Height);
			rect = RectUtil.InflateBy(rect, base.ActualThickness, base.ActualThickness);
			PrepLinePoints(frame, new Clipper(rect, isClosed: false));
			ScatterLineSeriesView scatterLineSeriesView = view as ScatterLineSeriesView;
			RenderManager.InitScatterRenderSettings(this, ShouldOverrideScatterStyle(), GetScatterItems);
			bool flag = false;
			if (RenderManager.OverrideArgs != null)
			{
				flag = true;
			}
			if (flag)
			{
				PerformScatterStyleOverride(-1, base.XColumn.Count, view.IsThumbnailView);
			}
			RenderManager.SetShapeAppearance(scatterLineSeriesView.Polyline, strokeOnly: true, fillOnly: false, extended: true, useOutline: false);
			PolylineSegments(scatterLineSeriesView.Polyline, frame.Points.Count, (int j) => frame.Points[j].X, (int j) => frame.Points[j].Y, UnknownValuePlotting, base.Resolution);
		}

		private void PolylineSegments(Path polylines, int count, Func<int, double> x0, Func<int, double> y0, UnknownValuePlotting unknownValuePlotting, double resolution)
		{
			PathGeometry pathGeometry = (PathGeometry)(polylines.Data = new PathGeometry());
			pathGeometry.Figures = new PathFigureCollection();
			List<PolyLineSegment> list = new List<PolyLineSegment>();
			int num = 0;
			for (int i = 0; i < count; i++)
			{
				if (!double.IsNaN(x0(i)) && !double.IsNaN(y0(i)))
				{
					continue;
				}
				if (i - num > 0)
				{
					if (unknownValuePlotting == UnknownValuePlotting.DontPlot || list.Count == 0)
					{
						PolyLineSegment item = new PolyLineSegment();
						list.Add(item);
					}
					PolylineSegments(list[list.Count - 1].Points, num, i - 1, x0, y0, resolution);
				}
				num = i + 1;
			}
			if (unknownValuePlotting == UnknownValuePlotting.DontPlot || list.Count == 0)
			{
				PolyLineSegment item2 = new PolyLineSegment();
				list.Add(item2);
			}
			PolylineSegments(list[list.Count - 1].Points, num, count - 1, x0, y0, resolution);
			for (int j = 0; j < list.Count; j++)
			{
				PolyLineSegment polyLineSegment = list[j];
				if (polyLineSegment.Points.Count > 0)
				{
					PathFigure pathFigure = new PathFigure
					{
						StartPoint = polyLineSegment.Points[0]
					};
					pathFigure.Segments.Add(polyLineSegment);
					pathGeometry.Figures.Add(pathFigure);
				}
			}
		}

		private IList<int> FlattenHelper(IList<int> result, Func<int, double> X, Func<int, double> Y, int b, int e, double E)
		{
			List<int> result2 = new List<int>();
			int num = b;
			for (int num2 = e - num + 1; num2 > 0; num2 = e - num + 1)
			{
				if (num2 <= 512)
				{
					Flattener.Flatten(result2, X, Y, num, e, E);
					num = e + 1;
				}
				else
				{
					int num3 = num + 512 - 1;
					Flattener.Flatten(result2, X, Y, num, num3, E);
					num = num3 + 1;
				}
			}
			return result2;
		}

		private void PolylineSegments(PointCollection polylinePoints, int startIndex, int endIndex, Func<int, double> x0, Func<int, double> y0, double resolution)
		{
			if (endIndex > -1)
			{
				double e = ((ReadLocalValue(Series.ResolutionProperty) == DependencyProperty.UnsetValue) ? 1.0 : resolution);
				IList<int> list = FlattenHelper(new List<int>(), x0, y0, startIndex, endIndex, e);
				for (int i = 0; i < list.Count; i++)
				{
					int arg = list[i];
					polylinePoints.Add(new Point(x0(arg), y0(arg)));
				}
			}
		}

		}

	{
		internal const string StiffnessPropertyName = "Stiffness";

		public static readonly DependencyProperty StiffnessProperty = DependencyProperty.Register("Stiffness", typeof(double), typeof(ScatterSplineSeries), new PropertyMetadata(0.5, delegate(DependencyObject sender, DependencyPropertyChangedEventArgs e)
		{

			if (propertyName == "Stiffness")
			{
				RenderSeries(animate: false);
				NotifyThumbnailAppearanceChanged();

		internal override void PrepareFrame(ScatterFrame frame, ScatterBaseView view)
		{
			base.PrepareFrame(frame, view);
			frame.Points.Clear();
			frame.LinePoints.Clear();
			Rect windowRect = view.WindowRect;
			Rect viewport = view.Viewport;
			Rect effectiveViewport = GetEffectiveViewport(view);
			double num = base.Resolution * base.Resolution;
			int num2 = Math.Min((base.XColumn != null) ? base.XColumn.Count : 0, (base.YColumn != null) ? base.YColumn.Count : 0);
			ScalerParams px = new ScalerParams(windowRect, viewport, base.AxisInfoCache.XAxisIsInverted, effectiveViewport);
			ScalerParams py = new ScalerParams(windowRect, viewport, base.AxisInfoCache.YAxisIsInverted, effectiveViewport)
			{
				ReferenceValue = GetReferenceValue()
			};
			Func<int, double> func = (int i) => base.AxisInfoCache.XAxis.GetScaledValue(base.XColumn[i], px);
			Func<int, double> func2 = (int i) => base.AxisInfoCache.YAxis.GetScaledValue(base.YColumn[i], py);
			Clipper clipper = new Clipper(viewport, isClosed: false)
			{
				Target = frame.Points
			};
			int num3 = 0;
			while (num3 < num2)
			{
				int num4 = num3;
				for (num3++; num3 < num2 && Measure(func, func2, num4, num3) < num; num3++)
				{
				}
				if (num2 > base.MaximumMarkers)
				{
					clipper.Add(Centroid(func, func2, num4, num3 - 1));
					continue;
				}
				OwnedPoint ownedPoint = new OwnedPoint();
				ownedPoint.Point = new Point(func(num4), func2(num4));
				ownedPoint.OwnerItem = base.FastItemsSource[num4];
				if (!frame.LinePoints.ContainsKey(ownedPoint.OwnerItem))
				{
					frame.LinePoints.Add(ownedPoint.OwnerItem, ownedPoint);
				}
			}
			if (num2 > base.MaximumMarkers)
			{
				clipper.Target = null;
			}
		}

		private Point Centroid(Func<int, double> X, Func<int, double> Y, int a, int b)
		{
			if (a == b)
			{
				return new Point(X(a), Y(a));
			}
			double num = 0.0;
			double num2 = 0.0;
			double num3 = b - a + 1;
			for (int i = a; i <= b; i++)
			{
				num += X(i);
				num2 += Y(i);
			}
			return new Point(num / num3, num2 / num3);
		}

		private double Measure(Func<int, double> X, Func<int, double> Y, int a, int b)
		{
			double num = X(b) - X(a);
			double num2 = Y(b) - Y(a);
			return num * num + num2 * num2;
		}

		protected internal override void ClearRendering(bool wipeClean, SeriesView view)
		{
			base.ClearRendering(wipeClean, view);
			((PathGeometry)(view as ScatterSplineSeriesView).Path.Data).Reset();
		}

		internal override void RenderFrame(ScatterFrame frame, ScatterBaseView view)
		{
			ClearRendering(wipeClean: false, view);
			base.RenderFrame(frame, view);
			PrepLinePoints(frame);
			ScatterSplineSeriesView obj = view as ScatterSplineSeriesView;
			Path path = obj.Path;
			RenderManager.InitScatterRenderSettings(this, ShouldOverrideScatterStyle(), GetScatterItems);
			bool flag = false;
			if (RenderManager.OverrideArgs != null)
			{
				flag = true;
			}
			if (flag)
			{
				PerformScatterStyleOverride(-1, base.XColumn.Count, view.IsThumbnailView);
			}
			RenderManager.SetShapeAppearance(path, strokeOnly: true, fillOnly: false, extended: true, useOutline: false);
			((PathGeometry)obj.Path.Data).Figures = Numeric.Spline2D(frame.Points.Count, (int i) => frame.Points[i].X, (int i) => frame.Points[i].Y, Stiffness);
		}
	}
	internal class ScatterTrendLineManager : TrendLineManagerBase<Point>
	{
		public override TrendLineManagerType ManagerType => TrendLineManagerType.Scatter;

		public void PrepareLine(List<Point> flattenedPoints, TrendLineType trendLineType, IList<double> XColumn, IList<double> YColumn, int period, Func<double, double> GetScaledXValue, Func<double, double> GetScaledYValue, TrendResolutionParams trendResolutionParams, Clipper clipper, double min, double max)
		{
			List<Point> list = new List<Point>();
			int num = 0;
			if (XColumn != null)
			{
				num = XColumn.Count;
			}
			if (YColumn != null)
			{
				num = Math.Min(num, YColumn.Count);
			}
			if (trendResolutionParams.Window.IsEmpty || trendResolutionParams.Viewport.IsEmpty)
			{
				return;
			}
			if (trendLineType == TrendLineType.None)
			{
				base.TrendCoefficients = null;
				base.TrendColumn.Clear();
			}
			else if (IsFit(trendLineType))
			{
				base.TrendColumn.Clear();
				base.TrendCoefficients = TrendFitCalculator.CalculateFit(list, trendLineType, trendResolutionParams, base.TrendCoefficients, num, (int i) => XColumn[i], (int i) => YColumn[i], GetScaledXValue, GetScaledYValue, min, max);
			}
			else if (IsAverage(trendLineType))
			{
				base.TrendCoefficients = null;
				base.TrendColumn.Clear();
				TrendAverageCalculator.CalculateXYAverage(trendLineType, base.TrendColumn, XColumn, YColumn, period);
				foreach (Point item in base.TrendColumn)
				{
					double num2 = GetScaledXValue(item.X);
					double num3 = GetScaledYValue(item.Y);
					if (!double.IsNaN(num2) && !double.IsNaN(num3))
					{
						list.Add(new Point(num2, num3));
					}
				}
			}
			FlattenTrendLine(list, trendResolutionParams, flattenedPoints, clipper);
		}
	}

	[Browsable(false)]

	public class AreaFragment : FragmentBase
	{
		[TSSuppressSynthesizedInitializer]
		internal AreaFragmentView AreaFragmentView { get; set; }

		public override bool IsAreaOrLine => true;

		public override bool IsArea => true;

		internal AreaFragment()
		{
			base.DefaultStyleKey = typeof(AreaFragment);
		}

		protected override SeriesView CreateView()
		{
			return new AreaFragmentView(this);
		}

		protected internal override void OnViewCreated(SeriesView view)
		{
			base.OnViewCreated(view);
			AreaFragmentView = (AreaFragmentView)view;
		}

		protected bool TestRangeAreaOver(Point position, bool isFinger)
		{
			PathGeometry pathData = (PathGeometry)AreaFragmentView.polygon0.Data;
			if (TestOverPoly(position, pathData))
			{
				return true;
			}
			PathGeometry pathData2 = (PathGeometry)AreaFragmentView.polygon1.Data;
			if (TestOverPoly(position, pathData2))
			{
				return true;
			}
			return false;
		}

		public override bool TestHit(Point position, bool isFinger)
		{
			if (TestNearStrokes(position, isFinger))
			{
				return true;
			}
			if (TestRangeAreaOver(position, isFinger))
			{
				return true;
			}
			if (TestMarkersOver(position, isFinger))
			{
				return true;
			}
			return false;
		}

		private bool TestNearStrokes(Point position, bool isFinger)
		{
			PathGeometry pathData = (PathGeometry)AreaFragmentView.polyline0.Data;
			if (TestNearStroke(position, isFinger, pathData))
			{
				return true;
			}
			PathGeometry pathData2 = (PathGeometry)AreaFragmentView.polyline1.Data;
			if (TestNearStroke(position, isFinger, pathData2))
			{
				return true;
			}
			return false;
		}

		internal override CategoryMode PreferredCategoryMode(CategoryAxisBase axis)
		{
			return CategoryMode.Mode0;
		}

		protected internal override void ClearRendering(bool wipeClean, SeriesView view)
		{
			base.ClearRendering(wipeClean, view);
			((AreaFragmentView)view).ClearRendering();
		}

		internal override void RenderFrame(CategoryFrame frame, CategorySeriesView view)
		{
			base.RenderFrame(frame, view);
			base.LineRasterizer.IsSortingAxis = base.XAxis is ISortingAxis;
			AreaFragmentView areaFragmentView = view as AreaFragmentView;
			List<double[]> buckets = frame.Buckets;
			Rect effectiveViewport = GetEffectiveViewport(areaFragmentView);
			RenderManager.InitCategoryRenderSettings(this, ShouldOverrideCategoryStyle(), GetCategoryItems, GetBucketSize(view), GetFirstBucket(view));
			bool flag = false;
			if (RenderManager.OverrideArgs != null)
			{
				flag = true;
			}
			if (flag)
			{
				ScalerParams axisParams = new ScalerParams(view.WindowRect, view.Viewport, CachedXAxis.IsInverted, effectiveViewport);
				PerformCategoryStyleOverride(buckets, -1, base.ValueColumn.Count, CachedXAxis, axisParams, view.IsThumbnailView);
			}
			RenderManager.SetShapeAppearance(areaFragmentView.polyline0, strokeOnly: true, fillOnly: false, extended: true, useOutline: true);
			RenderManager.SetShapeAppearance(areaFragmentView.polyline1, strokeOnly: true, fillOnly: false, extended: true, useOutline: true);
			RenderManager.SetShapeAppearance(areaFragmentView.polygon0, strokeOnly: false, fillOnly: true, extended: false, useOutline: false);
			RenderManager.SetShapeAppearance(areaFragmentView.polygon1, strokeOnly: false, fillOnly: true, extended: false, useOutline: false);
			int bucketSize = areaFragmentView.BucketCalculator.BucketSize;
			base.LineRasterizer.RasterizePolygonPaths(areaFragmentView.polygon0, areaFragmentView.polyline0, areaFragmentView.polygon1, areaFragmentView.polyline1, frame.Buckets.Count, frame.Buckets, useX0AsX1: true, bucketSize, base.Resolution, delegate(PointCollection p0, PointCollection l0, PointCollection p01, PointCollection l1, bool f)
			{
				TerminatePolygon(p0, frame.Buckets, view);
			}, UnknownValuePlotting.LinearInterpolate);
			areaFragmentView.polygon0.Opacity = RenderManager.ActualRenderOpacity * base.ActualAreaFillOpacity;
			areaFragmentView.polygon1.Opacity = 0.5 * RenderManager.ActualRenderOpacity * base.ActualAreaFillOpacity;
		}

		protected internal override void UpdateActualAreaFillOpacity()
		{
			if (base.SeriesViewer is XamDataChart)
			{
				base.ActualAreaFillOpacity = (double.IsNaN(base.AreaFillOpacity) ? base.ParentSeries.ActualAreaFillOpacity : base.AreaFillOpacity);
			}
		}
	}

	public class BarFragment : ColumnFragment
	{
		public override bool IsBar => true;

		public override bool IsMarkerlessDisplayPreferred => true;

		public override bool IsColumn => false;

		[SwiftClientName("barFragmentXAxis")]
		[TSClientName("barFragmentXAxis")]
		public new NumericXAxis XAxis

					return null;

			}
		}

		[SwiftClientName("barFragmentYAxis")]
		[TSClientName("barFragmentYAxis")]
		public new CategoryYAxis YAxis
		{
			get
			{
				if (base.ParentSeries == null)
				{
					return null;
				}
				return ((StackedBarSeries)base.ParentSeries).YAxis;
			}
		}

		public override bool IsVertical => true;

		internal BarFragment()
		{
			base.DefaultStyleKey = typeof(BarFragment);
		}

		protected internal override CategoryAxisBase GetCategoryAxis()
		{
			if (base.ParentSeries == null)
			{
				return null;
			}
			return (CategoryAxisBase)base.ParentSeries.GetYAxis();
		}

		public override double GetExactItemIndex(Point world)
		{
			Rect window = ((base.SeriesViewer != null) ? base.SeriesViewer.ActualWindowRect : Rect.Empty);
			Rect viewport = base.View.Viewport;
			Rect contentViewport = GetContentViewport(base.View);
			Rect effectiveViewport = GetEffectiveViewport(base.View);
			CategoryAxisBase categoryAxis = GetCategoryAxis();
			double result = -1.0;
			if (categoryAxis != null && !window.IsEmpty && !viewport.IsEmpty)
			{
				ScalerParams p = new ScalerParams(window, viewport, categoryAxis.IsInverted, effectiveViewport);
				double unscaledValue = categoryAxis.GetUnscaledValue(contentViewport.Top, p);
				double unscaledValue2 = categoryAxis.GetUnscaledValue(contentViewport.Bottom, p);
				double num = (world.Y - window.Top) / window.Height;
				double num2 = unscaledValue + num * (unscaledValue2 - unscaledValue);
				if (categoryAxis.CategoryMode != CategoryMode.Mode0)
				{
					num2 -= 0.5;
				}
				result = num2;
			}
			return result;
		}

		protected internal override NumericAxisBase GetValueAxis()
		{
			if (base.ParentSeries == null)
			{
				return null;
			}
			return base.ParentSeries.GetValueAxis();
		}

		protected override Rect InflateBox(Rect box, double p)
		{
			double num = box.Left + box.Width / 2.0;
			double num2 = box.Top + box.Height / 2.0;
			double x = num - box.Width / 2.0;
			double y = num2 - (box.Height / 2.0 + p);
			double height = box.Height + p * 2.0;
			double width = box.Width;
			return new Rect(x, y, width, height);
		}

		public override Rect GetSeriesValueBoundingBox(Point world)
		{
			if (GetCategoryAxis() == null)
			{
				return Rect.Empty;
			}
			Point point = FromWorldPosition(world);
			Rect windowRect = base.View.WindowRect;
			Rect viewport = base.View.Viewport;
			Rect effectiveViewport = GetEffectiveViewport(base.View);
			CategoryAxisBase categoryAxis = GetCategoryAxis();
			new ScalerParams(windowRect, viewport, categoryAxis.IsInverted, effectiveViewport);
			double[][] matchingBuckets = GetMatchingBuckets(GetCategoryAxis(), CurrentFrame.Buckets, GetBucketSize(base.View), GetFirstBucket(base.View), world, skipUnknowns: true);
			if (matchingBuckets == null)
			{
				return Rect.Empty;
			}
			double[] array = matchingBuckets[0];
			double[] array2 = matchingBuckets[1];
			double num = Math.Abs(point.Y - array[0]);
			double num2 = Math.Abs(point.Y - array2[0]);
			double groupSize = categoryAxis.GetGroupSize(windowRect, viewport, effectiveViewport);
			if (num < num2)
			{
				double y = array[0] - 0.5 * groupSize;
				double num3 = array[2];
				double val = array[1];
				return new Rect(num3, y, Math.Max(val, num3) - Math.Min(val, num3), groupSize);
			}
			double y2 = array2[0] - 0.5 * groupSize;
			double num4 = array2[2];
			double val2 = array2[1];
			return new Rect(num4, y2, Math.Max(val2, num4) - Math.Min(val2, num4), groupSize);
		}

		public override bool TestHit(Point position, bool isFinger)
		{
			if (TestShapesOver(position, isFinger))
			{
				return true;
			}
			if (TestMarkersOver(position, isFinger))
			{
				return true;
			}
			return false;
		}

		internal override bool PrepareMarker(ISupportsMarkers markersHost, CategoryFrame frame, double[] bucket, IDetectsCollisions collisionAvoider, double value, int itemIndex, int markerCount, int bucketIndex)
		{
			double num = bucket[0];
			double num2 = ((value < 0.0) ? bucket[2] : bucket[1]);
			Rect rc = new Rect(num2 - 5.0, num - 5.0, 11.0, 11.0);
			if (!double.IsNaN(num2) && !double.IsNaN(num) && !double.IsInfinity(num2) && !double.IsInfinity(num) && collisionAvoider.TryAdd(rc))
			{
				frame.Markers.Add(new Point(num2, num));
				markersHost.UpdateMarkerTemplate(markerCount, itemIndex, bucketIndex);
				return true;
			}
			return false;
		}

		public override object GetItem(Point world)
		{
			int num = 0;
			if (YAxis is ISortingAxis)
			{
				num = GetItemIndexSorted(world);
				if (num == -1)
				{
					return null;
				}
			}
			else
			{
				num = GetItemIndex(world);
			}
			if (num < 0 || base.FastItemsSource == null || num >= base.FastItemsSource.Count)
			{
				return null;
			}
			return base.FastItemsSource[num];
		}

		protected internal override int GetItemIndexSorted(Point world)
		{
			Rect windowRect = base.View.WindowRect;
			Rect viewport = base.View.Viewport;
			if (windowRect.IsEmpty || viewport.IsEmpty)
			{
				return -1;
			}
			Rect effectiveViewport = GetEffectiveViewport(base.View);
			ScalerParams p = new ScalerParams(windowRect, viewport, YAxis.IsInverted, effectiveViewport);
			ISortingAxis sortingAxis = YAxis as ISortingAxis;
			Rect contentViewport = GetContentViewport(base.View);
			double unscaledValue = YAxis.GetUnscaledValue(contentViewport.Top, p);
			double unscaledValue2 = YAxis.GetUnscaledValue(contentViewport.Bottom, p);
			double num = (world.Y - windowRect.Top) / windowRect.Height;
			double num2 = unscaledValue + (unscaledValue2 - unscaledValue) * num;
			if ((long)num2 <= DateTime.MinValue.Ticks || (long)num2 >= DateTime.MaxValue.Ticks)
			{
				return -1;
			}
			return sortingAxis.GetIndexClosestToUnscaledValue(num2);
		}

		internal override double GetWorldZeroValue(CategorySeriesView view)
		{
			double result = 0.0;
			Rect windowRect = view.WindowRect;
			Rect viewport = view.Viewport;
			Rect effectiveViewport = GetEffectiveViewport(view);
			ScalerParams p = new ScalerParams(windowRect, viewport, XAxis.IsInverted, effectiveViewport);
			if (!windowRect.IsEmpty && !viewport.IsEmpty && XAxis != null)
			{
				result = XAxis.GetScaledValue(0.0, p);
			}
			return result;
		}

		protected override void PropertyUpdatedOverride(object sender, string propertyName, object oldValue, object newValue)
		{
			base.PropertyUpdatedOverride(sender, propertyName, oldValue, newValue);
			if (base.ParentSeries == null || XAxis == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			NumericAxisBase xAxis = XAxis;
			if (propertyName == "ValueColumn")
			{
				if (base.AnchoredView.HasTrendLineManager)
				{
					base.AnchoredView.TrendLineManager.Reset();
				}
				if (xAxis != null && !xAxis.UpdateRange())
				{
					base.ParentSeries.GetSeriesView().BucketCalculator.CalculateBuckets(base.Resolution);
					RenderSeries(animate: false);
				}
			}
		}
	}
	internal class AreaFragmentBucketCalculator : AnchoredCategoryBucketCalculator
	{
		internal AreaFragmentBucketCalculator(AnchoredCategorySeriesView view)
			: base(view)
		{
		}

		internal override double[] GetBucketWithoutUnknowns(int index)
		{
			return GetBucket(index);
		}

		internal override double[] GetBucket(int index)
		{
			int num = Math.Min(index * BucketSize, base.AnchoredView.AnchoredModel.ValueColumn.Count - 1);
			int num2 = Math.Min(num + BucketSize - 1, base.AnchoredView.AnchoredModel.ValueColumn.Count - 1);
			double num3 = double.NaN;
			double num4 = double.NaN;
			FragmentBase obj = (FragmentBase)base.AnchoredView.AnchoredModel;
			StackedSeriesBase parentSeries = obj.ParentSeries;
			bool flag = parentSeries is IStacked100Series;
			IFastItemColumn<double> valueColumn = base.AnchoredView.AnchoredModel.ValueColumn;
			double[] highs = parentSeries.Highs;
			double[] lows = parentSeries.Lows;
			List<double> lowValues = obj.LogicalSeriesLink.LowValues;
			List<double> highValues = obj.LogicalSeriesLink.HighValues;
			for (int i = num; i <= num2; i++)
			{
				double num5 = valueColumn[i];
				if (double.IsNaN(num5) || double.IsInfinity(num5))
				{
					num5 = 0.0;
				}
				double num6 = Math.Abs(lows[i]) + highs[i];
				num5 = ((!flag) ? ((num5 < 0.0) ? (lowValues[i] + num5) : (highValues[i] + num5)) : ((num6 == 0.0) ? 0.0 : ((!(num5 < 0.0)) ? ((highValues[i] + num5) / num6 * 100.0) : ((lowValues[i] + num5) / num6 * 100.0))));
				if (!double.IsNaN(num3))
				{
					if (!double.IsNaN(num5))
					{
						num3 = Math.Min(num3, num5);
						num4 = Math.Max(num4, num5);
					}
				}
				else
				{
					num3 = num5;
					num4 = num5;
				}
			}
			if (double.IsNaN(num3))
			{
				return new double[3]
				{
					0.5 * (double)(num + num2),
					double.NaN,
					double.NaN
				};
			}
			return new double[3]
			{
				0.5 * (double)(num + num2),
				num3,
				num4
			};
		}
	}
	internal class LineFragmentBucketCalculator : AnchoredCategoryBucketCalculator
	{
		public LineFragmentBucketCalculator(AnchoredCategorySeriesView view)
			: base(view)
		{
		}

		internal override double[] GetBucketWithoutUnknowns(int index)
		{
			return GetBucket(index);
		}

		internal override double[] GetBucket(int index)
		{
			int num = Math.Min(index * BucketSize, base.AnchoredView.AnchoredModel.ValueColumn.Count - 1);
			int num2 = Math.Min(num + BucketSize - 1, base.AnchoredView.AnchoredModel.ValueColumn.Count - 1);
			double num3 = double.NaN;
			double num4 = double.NaN;
			FragmentBase fragmentBase = base.AnchoredView.AnchoredModel as FragmentBase;
			StackedSeriesBase parentSeries = fragmentBase.ParentSeries;
			for (int i = num; i <= num2; i++)
			{
				double num5 = base.AnchoredView.AnchoredModel.ValueColumn[i];
				double num6 = Math.Abs(parentSeries.Lows[i]) + parentSeries.Highs[i];
				if (double.IsNaN(num5) || double.IsInfinity(num5))
				{
					num5 = 0.0;
				}
				num5 = ((!(parentSeries is IStacked100Series)) ? ((num5 < 0.0) ? (fragmentBase.LogicalSeriesLink.LowValues[i] + num5) : (fragmentBase.LogicalSeriesLink.HighValues[i] + num5)) : ((num6 == 0.0) ? 0.0 : ((!(num5 < 0.0)) ? ((fragmentBase.LogicalSeriesLink.HighValues[i] + num5) / num6 * 100.0) : ((fragmentBase.LogicalSeriesLink.LowValues[i] + num5) / num6 * 100.0))));
				if (!double.IsNaN(num3))
				{
					if (!double.IsNaN(num5))
					{
						num3 = Math.Min(num3, num5);
						num4 = Math.Max(num4, num5);
					}
				}
				else
				{
					num3 = num5;
					num4 = num5;
				}
			}
			if (double.IsNaN(num3))
			{
				return new double[3]
				{
					0.5 * (double)(num + num2),
					double.NaN,
					double.NaN
				};
			}
			return new double[3]
			{

			};

	internal class SplineFragmentBucketCalculator : AnchoredCategoryBucketCalculator
	{
		internal SplineFragmentBucketCalculator(AnchoredCategorySeriesView view)
			: base(view)
		{
		}

		internal override double[] GetBucket(int index)
		{
			int num = Math.Min(index * BucketSize, base.AnchoredView.AnchoredModel.ValueColumn.Count - 1);
			int num2 = Math.Min(num + BucketSize - 1, base.AnchoredView.AnchoredModel.ValueColumn.Count - 1);
			double num3 = double.NaN;
			double num4 = double.NaN;
			SplineFragmentBase splineFragmentBase = base.AnchoredView.AnchoredModel as SplineFragmentBase;
			StackedSeriesBase parentSeries = splineFragmentBase.ParentSeries;
			for (int i = num; i <= num2; i++)
			{
				double num5 = base.AnchoredView.AnchoredModel.ValueColumn[i];
				double num6 = Math.Abs(parentSeries.Lows[i]) + parentSeries.Highs[i];
				if (double.IsNaN(num5) || double.IsInfinity(num5))
				{
					num5 = 0.0;
				}
				num5 = ((!(parentSeries is IStacked100Series)) ? ((num5 < 0.0) ? (splineFragmentBase.LogicalSeriesLink.LowValues[i] + num5) : (splineFragmentBase.LogicalSeriesLink.HighValues[i] + num5)) : ((num6 == 0.0) ? 0.0 : ((!(num5 < 0.0)) ? ((splineFragmentBase.LogicalSeriesLink.HighValues[i] + num5) / num6 * 100.0) : ((splineFragmentBase.LogicalSeriesLink.LowValues[i] + num5) / num6 * 100.0))));
				if (!double.IsNaN(num3))
				{
					if (!double.IsNaN(num5))
					{
						num3 = Math.Min(num3, num5);
						num4 = Math.Max(num4, num5);
					}
				}
				else
				{
					num3 = num5;
					num4 = num5;
				}
			}
			if (double.IsNaN(num3))
			{
				return new double[3]
				{
					0.5 * (double)(num + num2),
					double.NaN,
					double.NaN
				};
			}
			return new double[3]
			{
				0.5 * (double)(num + num2),
				num3,
				num4
			};
		}
	}

		{
			StackedBarSeries stackedBarSeries = base.View.CategoryModel as StackedBarSeries;
			double[] result = new double[3]
			{
				double.NaN,
				double.NaN,
				double.NaN
			};
			if (!(series is BarFragment { LogicalSeriesLink: not null } barFragment))
			{
				return result;
			}
			double num = series.ValueColumn[sortingIndex];
			double num2 = 0.0;
			double num3 = 0.0;
			double num4 = double.NaN;
			double num5 = double.NaN;
			double num6 = double.NegativeInfinity;
			double num7 = double.PositiveInfinity;
			Rect effectiveViewport = stackedBarSeries.GetEffectiveViewport(base.View);
			int num8 = Math.Min((stackedBarSeries.Lows != null) ? stackedBarSeries.Lows.Length : 0, (stackedBarSeries.Highs != null) ? stackedBarSeries.Highs.Length : 0);
			int num9 = sortingIndex * BucketSize;
			int num10 = Math.Min(num9 + BucketSize - 1, num8 - 1);
			for (int i = num9; i <= num10; i++)
			{
				num = series.ValueColumn[i];
				num2 = Math.Abs(stackedBarSeries.Lows[i]) + stackedBarSeries.Highs[i];
				if (num < num3)
				{
					num7 = Math.Min(num7, (barFragment.LogicalSeriesLink.LowValues[i] + num) / num2 * 100.0);
					num6 = Math.Max(num6, barFragment.LogicalSeriesLink.LowValues[i] / num2 * 100.0);
				}
				else
				{
					num7 = Math.Min(num7, barFragment.LogicalSeriesLink.HighValues[i] / num2 * 100.0);

						num5 = Math.Max(num5, num7);
					}
					if (!double.IsNaN(num6))
					{
						num4 = Math.Min(num4, num6);
						num5 = Math.Max(num5, num6);
					}
				}
				else
				{
					num4 = num7;
					num5 = num6;
				}
			}
			ScalerParams p = new ScalerParams(windowRect, viewportRect, stackedBarSeries.XAxis.IsInverted, effectiveViewport);
			return new double[3]
			{
				currentFrame.Buckets[index - FirstBucket][0],
				stackedBarSeries.XAxis.GetScaledValue(num5, p),
				stackedBarSeries.XAxis.GetScaledValue(num4, p)

	internal class StackedBarBucketCalculator : StackedBucketCalculator
	{
		internal StackedBarBucketCalculator(CategorySeriesView view)
			: base(view)
		{
		}

		protected internal override void CalculateBuckets(double resolution)
		{
			Rect windowRect = base.View.WindowRect;
			Rect viewport = base.View.Viewport;
			StackedBarSeries stackedBarSeries = base.View.CategoryModel as StackedBarSeries;
			IFastItemsSource fastItemsSource = base.View.CategoryModel.FastItemsSource;
			if (windowRect.IsEmpty || viewport.IsEmpty || stackedBarSeries.YAxis == null || fastItemsSource == null || fastItemsSource.Count == 0)
			{
				BucketSize = 0;
				return;
			}
			Rect effectiveViewport = stackedBarSeries.GetEffectiveViewport(base.View);
			ScalerParams p = new ScalerParams(windowRect, viewport, stackedBarSeries.YAxis.IsInverted, effectiveViewport);
			Rect contentViewport = stackedBarSeries.GetContentViewport(base.View);
			double num = Math.Floor(stackedBarSeries.YAxis.GetUnscaledValue(contentViewport.Top, p, CategoryMode.Mode0));
			double num2 = Math.Ceiling(stackedBarSeries.YAxis.GetUnscaledValue(contentViewport.Bottom, p, CategoryMode.Mode0));
			if (!stackedBarSeries.YAxis.IsInverted)
			{
				num2 = Math.Ceiling(stackedBarSeries.YAxis.GetUnscaledValue(contentViewport.Top, p, CategoryMode.Mode0));
				num = Math.Floor(stackedBarSeries.YAxis.GetUnscaledValue(contentViewport.Bottom, p, CategoryMode.Mode0));
			}
			double val = Math.Floor((num2 - num + 1.0) * resolution / contentViewport.Height);
			BucketSize = (int)Math.Max(1.0, val);
			FirstBucket = (int)Math.Max(0.0, Math.Floor(num / (double)BucketSize) - 1.0);
			LastBucket = (int)Math.Ceiling(num2 / (double)BucketSize);
		}

		internal override double[] GetBucket(int index)
		{
			return base.GetBucket(index);
		}

		internal override double[] GetBucket(AnchoredCategorySeries series, int index, int sortingIndex, Rect windowRect, Rect viewportRect, CategoryFrame currentFrame)
		{
			double[] result = new double[3]
			{
				double.NaN,
				double.NaN,
				double.NaN
			};
			if (!(series is BarFragment { LogicalSeriesLink: not null } barFragment))
			{
				return result;
			}
			StackedBarSeries stackedBarSeries = base.View.CategoryModel as StackedBarSeries;
			double num = series.ValueColumn[sortingIndex];
			double num2 = 0.0;
			double num3 = double.NaN;
			double num4 = double.NaN;
			double num5 = double.NegativeInfinity;
			double num6 = double.PositiveInfinity;
			Rect effectiveViewport = stackedBarSeries.GetEffectiveViewport(base.View);
			int num7 = Math.Min((stackedBarSeries.Lows != null) ? stackedBarSeries.Lows.Length : 0, (stackedBarSeries.Highs != null) ? stackedBarSeries.Highs.Length : 0);
			int num8 = sortingIndex * BucketSize;
			int num9 = Math.Min(num8 + BucketSize - 1, num7 - 1);
			for (int i = num8; i <= num9; i++)
			{
				num = series.ValueColumn[i];
				if (num < num2)
				{
					num6 = Math.Min(num6, barFragment.LogicalSeriesLink.LowValues[i] + num);
					num5 = Math.Max(num5, barFragment.LogicalSeriesLink.LowValues[i]);
				}
				else
				{
					num6 = Math.Min(num6, barFragment.LogicalSeriesLink.HighValues[i]);
					num5 = Math.Max(num5, barFragment.LogicalSeriesLink.HighValues[i] + num);
				}
				if (!double.IsNaN(num3))
				{
					if (!double.IsNaN(num6))
					{
						num3 = Math.Min(num3, num6);
						num4 = Math.Max(num4, num6);
					}
					if (!double.IsNaN(num5))
					{
						num3 = Math.Min(num3, num5);
						num4 = Math.Max(num4, num5);
					}
				}
				else
				{
					num3 = num6;
					num4 = num5;
				}
			}
			ScalerParams p = new ScalerParams(windowRect, viewportRect, stackedBarSeries.XAxis.IsInverted, effectiveViewport);
			return new double[3]
			{
				currentFrame.Buckets[index - FirstBucket][0],
				stackedBarSeries.XAxis.GetScaledValue(num4, p),
				stackedBarSeries.XAxis.GetScaledValue(num3, p)
			};
		}
