	internal class StackedBucketCalculator : CategoryBucketCalculator
	{
		internal StackedBucketCalculator(CategorySeriesView view)
			: base(view)
		{
		}

		internal override double[] GetBucket(int index)
		{
			StackedSeriesBase stackedSeriesBase = base.View.CategoryModel as StackedSeriesBase;
			int num = Math.Min((stackedSeriesBase.Lows != null) ? stackedSeriesBase.Lows.Length : 0, (stackedSeriesBase.Highs != null) ? stackedSeriesBase.Highs.Length : 0);
			int num2 = Math.Min(index * BucketSize, num - 1);
			int num3 = Math.Min(num2 + BucketSize - 1, num - 1);
			double num4 = double.NaN;
			double num5 = double.NaN;
			for (int i = num2; i <= num3; i++)
			{
				double num6 = Math.Min(stackedSeriesBase.Lows[i], stackedSeriesBase.Highs[i]);
				double num7 = Math.Max(stackedSeriesBase.Lows[i], stackedSeriesBase.Highs[i]);
				if (!double.IsNaN(num4))
				{
					if (!double.IsNaN(num6))
					{
						num4 = Math.Min(num4, num6);
						num5 = Math.Max(num5, num6);
					}
					if (!double.IsNaN(num7))
					{
						num4 = Math.Min(num4, num7);
						num5 = Math.Max(num5, num7);
					}
				}
				else
				{
					num4 = num6;
					num5 = num7;
				}
			}
			if (!double.IsNaN(num4) && !double.IsNaN(num5))
			{
				return new double[3]
				{
					0.5 * (double)(num2 + num3),
					num4,
					num5
				};
			}
			return new double[3]
			{
				double.NaN,
				double.NaN,
				double.NaN
			};
		}

		}));

		public override Rect GetSeriesValueBoundingBox(Point world)
		{
			if (GetCategoryAxis() == null || YAxis == null)
			{
				return Rect.Empty;
			}
			Point point = FromWorldPosition(world);
			Rect windowRect = base.View.WindowRect;
			Rect viewport = base.View.Viewport;
			Rect effectiveViewport = GetEffectiveViewport(base.View);
			new ScalerParams(windowRect, viewport, YAxis.IsInverted, effectiveViewport);
			double[][] matchingBuckets = GetMatchingBuckets(GetCategoryAxis(), CurrentFrame.Buckets, GetBucketSize(base.View), GetFirstBucket(base.View), world, skipUnknowns: true);
			if (matchingBuckets == null)
			{
				return Rect.Empty;
			}
			double[] array = matchingBuckets[0];
			double[] array2 = matchingBuckets[1];
			double num = Math.Abs(point.X - array[0]);
			double num2 = Math.Abs(point.X - array2[0]);
			double groupSize = GetCategoryAxis().GetGroupSize(windowRect, viewport, effectiveViewport);
			if (num < num2)
			{
				double x = array[0] - 0.5 * groupSize;
				double val = array[1];
				double val2 = array[2];
				return new Rect(x, Math.Min(val, val2), groupSize, Math.Max(val, val2) - Math.Min(val, val2));
			}
			double x2 = array2[0] - 0.5 * groupSize;
			double val3 = array2[1];
			double val4 = array2[2];
			return new Rect(x2, Math.Min(val3, val4), groupSize, Math.Max(val3, val4) - Math.Min(val3, val4));
		}

		public override bool TestHit(Point position, bool isFinger)
		{
			if (TestShapesOver(position, isFinger))
			{
				return true;
			}
			if (TestMarkersOver(position, isFinger))
			{
				return true;
			}
			return false;
		}

		protected override bool TestShapesOver(Point position, bool isFinger)
		{
			Rect seriesValueBoundingBoxFromSeriesPixel = GetSeriesValueBoundingBoxFromSeriesPixel(position);
			if (seriesValueBoundingBoxFromSeriesPixel.IsEmpty)
			{
				return false;
			}
			return InflateBox(seriesValueBoundingBoxFromSeriesPixel, GetHitTestAllowance(isFinger)).Contains(position);
		}

		protected virtual Rect InflateBox(Rect box, double p)
		{
			double num = box.Left + box.Width / 2.0;
			double num2 = box.Top + box.Height / 2.0;
			double x = num - (box.Width / 2.0 + p);
			double y = num2 - box.Height / 2.0;
			double height = box.Height;
			double width = box.Width + p * 2.0;
			return new Rect(x, y, width, height);
		}

		protected internal override object Item(object sender, Point point)
		{
			object obj = ((sender is FrameworkElement frameworkElement) ? (frameworkElement.DataContext as DataContext) : null)?.Item;
			if (obj == null)
			{
				Rect rect = new Rect(0.0, 0.0, base.ParentSeries.ActualWidth, base.ParentSeries.ActualHeight);
				Rect rect2 = ((base.SeriesViewer != null) ? base.SeriesViewer.ActualWindowRect : Rect.Empty);
				Point world = new Point(rect2.Left + rect2.Width * (point.X - rect.Left) / rect.Width, rect2.Top + rect2.Height * (point.Y - rect.Top) / rect.Height);
				obj = GetItem(world);
			}
			return obj;
		}

		public override object GetItem(Point world)
		{
			int num = 0;
			if (GetCategoryAxis() is ISortingAxis)
			{
				num = GetItemIndexSorted(world);
				if (num == -1)
				{
					return null;
				}
			}
			else
			{
				num = GetItemIndex(world);
			}
			if (num < 0 || base.FastItemsSource == null || num >= base.FastItemsSource.Count)
			{
				return null;
			}
			return base.FastItemsSource[num];
		}

		protected internal override int GetItemIndexSorted(Point world)
		{
			Rect windowRect = base.View.WindowRect;
			Rect viewport = base.View.Viewport;
			Rect effectiveViewport = GetEffectiveViewport(base.View);
			if (windowRect.IsEmpty || viewport.IsEmpty)
			{
				return -1;
			}
			CategoryAxisBase categoryAxis = GetCategoryAxis();
			ScalerParams p = new ScalerParams(windowRect, viewport, categoryAxis.IsInverted, effectiveViewport);
			ISortingAxis sortingAxis = XAxis as ISortingAxis;
			Rect contentViewport = GetContentViewport(base.View);
			double unscaledValue = categoryAxis.GetUnscaledValue(contentViewport.Left, p);
			double unscaledValue2 = categoryAxis.GetUnscaledValue(contentViewport.Right, p);
			double num = (world.X - windowRect.Left) / windowRect.Width;
			double num2 = unscaledValue + (unscaledValue2 - unscaledValue) * num;
			if ((long)num2 <= DateTime.MinValue.Ticks || (long)num2 >= DateTime.MaxValue.Ticks)
			{
				return -1;
			}
			return sortingAxis.GetIndexClosestToUnscaledValue(num2);
		}

		public override int GetItemIndex(Point world)
		{
			if (base.ParentSeries == null)
			{
				return -1;
			}
			return base.ParentSeries.GetFragmentItemIndex(world);
		}

		internal override bool PrepareMarker(ISupportsMarkers markersHost, CategoryFrame frame, double[] bucket, IDetectsCollisions collisionAvoider, double value, int itemIndex, int markerCount, int bucketIndex)
		{
			double num = 0.0;
			double num2 = bucket[0];
			double num3 = ((value < num) ? bucket[2] : bucket[1]);
			Rect rc = new Rect(num2 - 5.0, num3 - 5.0, 11.0, 11.0);
			if (!double.IsNaN(num2) && !double.IsNaN(num3) && !double.IsInfinity(num2) && !double.IsInfinity(num3) && collisionAvoider.TryAdd(rc))
			{
				frame.Markers.Add(new Point(num2, num3));
				markersHost.UpdateMarkerTemplate(markerCount, itemIndex, bucketIndex);
				return true;
			}
			return false;
		}

		private SeriesView GetParentView(SeriesView view)
		{
			if (view.IsAlternateView)
			{
				return base.ParentSeries.SeriesInteractionManager.AlternateViews[view.AlternateViewIdentifier];
			}
			if (view == base.ThumbnailView)
			{
				return base.ParentSeries.ThumbnailView;
			}
			return base.ParentSeries.CategoryView;
		}

		public override void RenderAlternateView(Rect viewportRect, Rect windowRect, RenderSurface surface, string viewIdentifier, double effectiveScalingRatio)
		{
			base.SeriesInteractionManager.EnsureAlternateView(this, viewportRect, windowRect, viewIdentifier, effectiveScalingRatio);
			SeriesView seriesView = base.SeriesInteractionManager.AlternateViews[viewIdentifier];
			CategorySeriesView view = (CategorySeriesView)seriesView;
			seriesView.PrepAltSurface(surface);
			((CategorySeriesView)GetParentView(seriesView)).BucketCalculator.CalculateBuckets(base.Resolution);
			if (!ClearAndAbortIfInvalid(view))
			{
				if (base.AlternateFrame == null)
				{
					base.AlternateFrame = new CategoryFrame(3);
				}
				base.AlternateFrame.ClearFrame();
				PrepareFrame(base.AlternateFrame, view);
				RenderFrame(base.AlternateFrame, view);
			}
		}

		internal override void PrepareFrame(CategoryFrame frame, CategorySeriesView view)
		{
			frame.ClearFrame();
			if (base.ValueColumn == null || base.ParentSeries == null || base.LogicalSeriesLink == null || base.LogicalSeriesLink.HighValues.Count == 0 || base.LogicalSeriesLink.LowValues.Count == 0)
			{
				return;
			}
			CategoryFrame categoryFrame = (view.IsAlternateView ? base.ParentSeries.AlternateFrame : ((view != base.ThumbnailView) ? base.ParentSeries.CurrentFrame : base.ParentSeries.ThumbnailFrame));
			CategorySeriesView obj = GetParentView(view) as CategorySeriesView;
			frame.Buckets.Clear();
			frame.Markers.Clear();
			int firstBucket = obj.BucketCalculator.FirstBucket;
			int lastBucket = obj.BucketCalculator.LastBucket;
			IScaler yScaler = base.ParentSeries.FramePreparer.CategoryBasedHost.YScaler;
			ISortingAxis sortingAxis = base.ParentSeries.FramePreparer.CategoryBasedHost.Scaler as ISortingAxis;
			bool flag = yScaler is NumericAxisBase && ((NumericAxisBase)yScaler).IsReallyLogarithmic;
			StackedBucketCalculator stackedBucketCalculator = obj.BucketCalculator as StackedBucketCalculator;
			int bucketSize = obj.BucketCalculator.BucketSize;
			int num = 0;
			for (int i = firstBucket; i <= lastBucket; i++)
			{
				int itemIndex = i * bucketSize;
				if (base.Visibility != Visibility.Visible)
				{
					break;
				}
				if (i < base.ValueColumn.Count && i < categoryFrame.Buckets.Count + firstBucket)
				{
					double num2 = base.ValueColumn[i];
					bool num3 = !flag || (flag && num2 > 0.0);
					double[] array = ((sortingAxis != null) ? stackedBucketCalculator.GetBucket(this, i, sortingAxis.SortedIndices[i], view.WindowRect, view.Viewport, categoryFrame) : stackedBucketCalculator.GetBucket(this, i, i, view.WindowRect, view.Viewport, categoryFrame));
					frame.Buckets.Add(array);
					if (num3 && PrepareMarker(view, frame, array, base.FramePreparer.CategoryBasedHost.ProvideCollisionDetector(), num2, itemIndex, num, frame.Buckets.Count - 1))
					{
						num++;
					}
				}
			}
			view.Markers.Count = num;
		}

		internal override void RenderFrame(CategoryFrame frame, CategorySeriesView view)
		{
			base.RenderFrame(frame, view);
			if (base.ParentSeries != null)
			{
				base.ParentSeries.RenderFragment(this, frame, view);
				CategoryMarkerManager.RasterizeMarkers(this, frame.Markers, view.Markers, base.UseLightweightMarkers);
			}
		}

		protected override void PropertyUpdatedOverride(object sender, string propertyName, object oldValue, object newValue)
		{
			base.PropertyUpdatedOverride(sender, propertyName, oldValue, newValue);
		}
	}

		internal virtual void TerminatePolygon(PointCollection polygon, List<double[]> buckets, CategorySeriesView view)
		{
			double worldZeroValue = GetWorldZeroValue(view);
			ObservableCollection<AnchoredCategorySeries> observableCollection = (LogicalSeriesLink.Positive ? ParentSeries.StackedSeriesManager.PositiveSeries : ParentSeries.StackedSeriesManager.NegativeSeries);
			int num = observableCollection.IndexOf(this);
			if (polygon.Count == 0 || num == -1)
			{
				return;
			}
			bool flag = false;
			int num2 = num;
			while (num2 >= 0 && !flag)
			{
				if (num2 == 0)
				{
					polygon.Add(new Point(polygon[polygon.Count - 1].X, worldZeroValue));
					polygon.Add(new Point(polygon[0].X, worldZeroValue));
					break;
				}
				if (observableCollection[num2 - 1] is FragmentBase { LineRasterizer: not null } fragmentBase && fragmentBase.LineRasterizer.FlattenedLinePoints.Count > 0 && base.View != null && fragmentBase.ValidateSeries(base.View.Viewport, base.View.WindowRect, base.View))
				{
					flag = true;
					for (int num3 = fragmentBase.LineRasterizer.FlattenedLinePoints.Count - 1; num3 >= 0; num3--)
					{
						polygon.Add(fragmentBase.LineRasterizer.FlattenedLinePoints[num3]);
					}
				}
				num2--;
			}
		}

		protected internal override bool ValidateSeries(Rect viewportRect, Rect windowRect, SeriesView view)
		{

			CategoryAxisBase categoryAxisBase = ParentSeries.GetXAxis() as CategoryAxisBase;
			Axis yAxis = ParentSeries.GetYAxis();
			if (ParentSeries == null || categoryAxisBase == null || categoryAxisBase.ItemsSource == null || yAxis == null || ParentSeries.FastItemsSource == null || categoryAxisBase.SeriesViewer == null || yAxis.SeriesViewer == null)
			{
				result = false;
			}
			if (base.ValueColumn == null)
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (double.IsInfinity(base.ValueColumn.Minimum) && double.IsInfinity(base.ValueColumn.Maximum))
			{
				result = false;
			}
			if (double.IsNaN(base.ValueColumn.Minimum) && double.IsNaN(base.ValueColumn.Maximum))
			{
				result = false;
			}
			return result;
		}

		internal override double GetWorldZeroValue(CategorySeriesView view)
		{
			double result = 0.0;
			Rect windowRect = view.WindowRect;

			scalerParams.ReferenceValue = GetReferenceValue();
			if (!windowRect.IsEmpty && !viewport.IsEmpty && base.YAxis != null)
			{
				result = base.YAxis.GetScaledValue(0.0, scalerParams);
			}
			return result;
		}

		internal int GetLegendItemIndex()
		{
			if (ParentSeries == null)
			{
				return -1;
			}
			int num = ParentSeries.Index;
			int num2 = 0;
			int num3 = 1;
			if (ParentSeries.ReverseLegendOrder)
			{
				num2 = ParentSeries.ActualSeries.Count - 1;
				num3 = -1;
			}
			for (int i = num2; ParentSeries.ReverseLegendOrder ? (i >= 0) : (i < ParentSeries.ActualSeries.Count); i += num3)
			{
				StackedFragmentSeries stackedFragmentSeries = ParentSeries.ActualSeries[i];
				if (stackedFragmentSeries.VisualSeriesLink == this)
				{
					return num;
				}
				if (ParentSeries.ActualLegend != null && stackedFragmentSeries.ActualVisibility == Visibility.Visible && stackedFragmentSeries.ActualLegendItemVisibility == Visibility.Visible)
				{
					num++;
				}
			}
			return -1;
		}

		protected override void PropertyUpdatedOverride(object sender, string propertyName, object oldValue, object newValue)

			{

			}
			if (!(propertyName == "ValueColumn"))
			{
				if (propertyName == "ActualBrush" && LogicalSeriesLink != null)
				{
					LogicalSeriesLink.ActualBrush = base.ActualBrush;
				}
				return;
			}
			if (base.AnchoredView.HasTrendLineManager)
			{
				base.AnchoredView.TrendLineManager.Reset();
			}
			if (numericAxisBase != null && !numericAxisBase.UpdateRange())

				RenderSeries(animate: false);
			}
		}

		internal override DataContext GetTooltipContext(object item)
		{
			if (item != null)
			{
				FastReflectionHelper fastReflectionHelper = new FastReflectionHelper(useTraditionalReflection: false, base.ValueMemberPath);
				object propertyValue = fastReflectionHelper.GetPropertyValue(item.GetType(), item);
				AnchoredCategorySeriesDataContext anchoredCategorySeriesDataContext = new AnchoredCategorySeriesDataContext
				{
					Series = this,
					Item = item,
					ItemValue = propertyValue
				};
				if (ParentSeries.GetXAxis() != null)
				{
					Axis xAxis = ParentSeries.GetXAxis();
					if (xAxis != null)
					{
						if (!(xAxis is CategoryDateTimeXAxis categoryDateTimeXAxis))
						{
							anchoredCategorySeriesDataContext.XAxisLabel = xAxis.GetLabel(item);
						}
						else
						{
							fastReflectionHelper.PropertyName = categoryDateTimeXAxis.DateTimeMemberPath;
							object propertyValue2 = fastReflectionHelper.GetPropertyValue(item.GetType(), item);
							anchoredCategorySeriesDataContext.XAxisLabel = $"{propertyValue2:D}";
						}
					}
				}
				if (ParentSeries.GetYAxis() != null)
				{
					Axis yAxis = ParentSeries.GetYAxis();
					if (yAxis != null)
					{
						if (!(yAxis is CategoryDateTimeXAxis categoryDateTimeXAxis2))
						{
							anchoredCategorySeriesDataContext.YAxisLabel = yAxis.GetLabel(item);
						}
						else
						{
							fastReflectionHelper.PropertyName = categoryDateTimeXAxis2.DateTimeMemberPath;
							object propertyValue3 = fastReflectionHelper.GetPropertyValue(item.GetType(), item);
							anchoredCategorySeriesDataContext.YAxisLabel = $"{propertyValue3:D}";
						}
					}
				}
				return anchoredCategorySeriesDataContext;
			}
			return new DataContext
			{
				Series = this,
				Item = item
			};
		}

	internal class FragmentBaseValueList : IList<double>, ICollection<double>, IEnumerable<double>, IEnumerable
	{
		private FragmentBase _fragment;

		public double this[int index]
		{
			get
			{
				bool flag = false;
				if (_fragment.ParentSeries != null)
				{
					flag = _fragment.ParentSeries.IsPercentBased;
				}
				StackedSeriesBase parentSeries = _fragment.ParentSeries;
				if (parentSeries == null)
				{
					return double.NaN;
				}
				if (parentSeries.Lows == null || parentSeries.Highs == null || parentSeries.Lows.Length == 0 || parentSeries.Highs.Length == 0)
				{
					return double.NaN;
				}
				double num = _fragment.ValueColumn[index];
				double num2 = Math.Abs(parentSeries.Lows[index]) + parentSeries.Highs[index];
				List<double> highValues = _fragment.LogicalSeriesLink.HighValues;
				List<double> lowValues = _fragment.LogicalSeriesLink.LowValues;
				if (double.IsNaN(num) || double.IsInfinity(num))
				{
					num = 0.0;
				}
				if (flag)
				{
					if (num2 == 0.0)
					{
						return 0.0;
					}
					if (num < 0.0)
					{
						return (lowValues[index] + num) / num2 * 100.0;
					}
					return (highValues[index] + num) / num2 * 100.0;
				}
				return (num < 0.0) ? (lowValues[index] + num) : (highValues[index] + num);
			}
			set
			{
				throw new NotImplementedException();
			}
		}

		public int Count => _fragment.ValueColumn.Count;

		{
			get
			{
				throw new NotImplementedException();
			}
		}

		internal void TerminatePolygon(PointCollection polygon, List<double[]> buckets, CategorySeriesView view)
		{
			double worldZeroValue = GetWorldZeroValue(view);
			ObservableCollection<AnchoredCategorySeries> observableCollection = (base.LogicalSeriesLink.Positive ? base.ParentSeries.StackedSeriesManager.PositiveSeries : base.ParentSeries.StackedSeriesManager.NegativeSeries);
			int num = observableCollection.IndexOf(this);
			if (polygon.Count == 0 || num == -1)
			{
				return;
			}
			bool flag = false;
			int num2 = num;
			while (num2 >= 0 && !flag)
			{
				if (num2 == 0)
				{
					polygon.Add(new Point(polygon[polygon.Count - 1].X, worldZeroValue));
					polygon.Add(new Point(polygon[0].X, worldZeroValue));
					break;
				}
				if (observableCollection[num2 - 1] is SplineFragmentBase { LineRasterizer: not null } splineFragmentBase && splineFragmentBase.LineRasterizer.FlattenedLinePoints.Count > 0 && base.View != null && splineFragmentBase.ValidateSeries(base.View.Viewport, base.View.WindowRect, base.View))
				{
					flag = true;
					for (int num3 = splineFragmentBase.LineRasterizer.FlattenedLinePoints.Count - 1; num3 >= 0; num3--)
					{
						polygon.Add(splineFragmentBase.LineRasterizer.FlattenedLinePoints[num3]);
					}
				}
				num2--;
			}
		}

		internal override double GetWorldZeroValue(CategorySeriesView view)
		{
			double result = 0.0;
			Rect windowRect = view.WindowRect;
			Rect viewport = view.Viewport;
			Rect effectiveViewport = GetEffectiveViewport(view);
			ScalerParams p = new ScalerParams(windowRect, viewport, base.YAxis.IsInverted, effectiveViewport);
			if (!windowRect.IsEmpty && !viewport.IsEmpty && base.YAxis != null)
			{
				result = base.YAxis.GetScaledValue(0.0, p);
			}
			return result;
		}

				base.ActualAreaFillOpacity = (double.IsNaN(base.AreaFillOpacity) ? base.ParentSeries.ActualAreaFillOpacity : base.AreaFillOpacity);
			}
		}

	[Browsable(false)]
	[EditorBrowsable(EditorBrowsableState.Never)]
	[WidgetModuleExclusionParent("CategoryChart")]
	public abstract class SplineFragmentBase : SplineSeriesBase
	{
		[Weak]
		private StackedSeriesBase _parentSeries;

		[Weak]
		[DontObfuscate]
		internal StackedFragmentSeries LogicalSeriesLink { get; set; }

		internal StackedSeriesBase ParentSeries
		{

			{
				return _parentSeries;
			}
			set
			{
				_parentSeries = value;
			}
		}

		protected internal override bool IsDropShadowSupported => false;

		public override bool IsFragment => true;

		public SplineFragmentBase()
		{
			LineRasterizer = new CategoryLineRasterizer();
		}

		{
			return CategoryMode.Mode0;
		}

		protected internal override string ResolveFragmentName()
		{

			{
				return LogicalSeriesLink.Name;
			}
			return null;
		}

		public override Point GetSeriesValuePosition(Point world, bool useInterpolation, bool skipUnknowns)
		{
			return GetSeriesValuePositionHelper(world, useInterpolation, skipUnknowns, base.FramePreparer.GetOffset(GetCategoryAxis(), base.View.WindowRect, base.View.Viewport, GetEffectiveViewport(base.View)), GetValueAxis(), GetCategoryAxis(), GetStackedFragmentValue, (Point w, bool skip) => GetPreviousOrExactIndexHelper(w, skip, GetCategoryAxis(), GetExactUnsortedItemIndex, new SplineFragmentBaseValueList(this)), (Point w, bool skip) => GetNextOrExactIndexHelper(w, skip, GetCategoryAxis(), GetExactUnsortedItemIndex, new SplineFragmentBaseValueList(this)));
		}

			{
				GetCategoryAxis(),
				GetValueAxis()
			};
		}

		private double GetStackedFragmentValue(Point world, bool useInterpolation, bool skipUnknowns)
		{
			if (base.SeriesViewer == null)
			{
				return double.NaN;
			}
			Rect effectiveViewport = GetEffectiveViewport(base.View);
			ScalerParams pars = new ScalerParams(base.SeriesViewer.ActualWindowRect, base.View.Viewport, GetCategoryAxis().IsInverted, effectiveViewport);
			double offset = base.FramePreparer.GetOffset(GetCategoryAxis(), base.SeriesViewer.ActualWindowRect, base.View.Viewport, effectiveViewport);
			return GetSeriesValueHelper(new SplineFragmentBaseValueList(this), world, GetCategoryAxis(), pars, offset, GetExactUnsortedItemIndex, useInterpolation, skipUnknowns);
		}

		protected internal override int GetFragmentIndex()
		{
			StackedSeriesBase parentSeries = ParentSeries;
			if (parentSeries.Index == -1 || parentSeries.StackedSeriesManager == null || parentSeries.StackedSeriesManager.SeriesVisual.IndexOf(this) == -1)
			{
				return -1;

		}

		public override int ResolveLegendIndex()

			{
				return -1 + parentSeries.Index + parentSeries.ActualSeries.Count - parentSeries.StackedSeriesManager.SeriesVisual.IndexOf(this);

		internal override bool PrepareMarker(CategoryFrame frame, double[] bucket, CollisionAvoider collisionAvoider, int itemIndex, int markerCount, CategorySeriesView view, int bucketIndex)
		{
			double num = bucket[0];
			double num2 = bucket[1];
			Rect rc = new Rect(num - 5.0, num2 - 5.0, 11.0, 11.0);
			if (!double.IsNaN(num) && !double.IsNaN(num2) && !double.IsInfinity(num) && !double.IsInfinity(num2) && collisionAvoider.TryAdd(rc))
			{
				frame.Markers.Add(new Point(num, num2));
				Marker marker = view.Markers[markerCount];
				((DataContext)marker.Content).Item = base.FastItemsSource[itemIndex];
				marker.MarkerBucket = bucketIndex;
				return true;
			}
			return false;
		}

		protected internal override bool ValidateSeries(Rect viewportRect, Rect windowRect, SeriesView view)
		{
			bool result = base.ValidateSeries(viewportRect, windowRect, view);
			CategoryAxisBase categoryAxisBase = ParentSeries.GetXAxis() as CategoryAxisBase;
			Axis yAxis = ParentSeries.GetYAxis();
			if (ParentSeries == null || categoryAxisBase == null || categoryAxisBase.ItemsSource == null || yAxis == null || ParentSeries.FastItemsSource == null || categoryAxisBase.SeriesViewer == null || yAxis.SeriesViewer == null)
			{
				result = false;
			}
			if (base.ValueColumn == null)
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (double.IsInfinity(base.ValueColumn.Minimum) && double.IsInfinity(base.ValueColumn.Maximum))
			{
				result = false;
			}
			if (double.IsNaN(base.ValueColumn.Minimum) && double.IsNaN(base.ValueColumn.Maximum))
			{
				result = false;
			}
			return result;
		}

		{
			return null;
		}

		internal void PrepareDateTimeFrame(CategoryFrame frame, Rect windowRect, Rect viewportRect, CategoryAxisBase xaxis, NumericYAxis yaxis, CategorySeriesView view)
		{
			ISortingAxis sortingXAxis = xaxis as ISortingAxis;
			if (sortingXAxis == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			Rect effectiveViewport = GetEffectiveViewport(view);
			ScalerParams p = new ScalerParams(windowRect, viewportRect, xaxis.IsInverted, effectiveViewport);
			ScalerParams p2 = new ScalerParams(windowRect, viewportRect, yaxis.IsInverted, effectiveViewport);
			xaxis.GetUnscaledValue(2.0, p);
			xaxis.GetUnscaledValue(1.0, p);
			bool flag = ShouldDisplayMarkers();
			int num = 0;
			double offset = GetOffset(xaxis, windowRect, viewportRect, effectiveViewport);
			Func<int, double> total = (int i) => Math.Abs(ParentSeries.Lows[i]) + ParentSeries.Highs[i];
			Func<int, double> func = (int i) => i;
			Func<int, double> func2 = delegate(int i)
			{
				int num19 = sortingXAxis.SortedIndices[i];
				if (ParentSeries is IStacked100Series)
				{
					if (!(base.ValueColumn[num19] < 0.0))
					{
						return (LogicalSeriesLink.HighValues[num19] + base.ValueColumn[num19]) / total(num19) * 100.0;
					}
					return (LogicalSeriesLink.LowValues[num19] + base.ValueColumn[num19]) / total(num19) * 100.0;
				}
				return (!(base.ValueColumn[num19] < 0.0)) ? (LogicalSeriesLink.HighValues[num19] + base.ValueColumn[num19]) : (LogicalSeriesLink.LowValues[num19] + base.ValueColumn[num19]);
			};
			int lastBucket = base.CategoryView.BucketCalculator.LastBucket;
			int firstBucket = base.CategoryView.BucketCalculator.FirstBucket;
			int num2 = (int)Math.Ceiling(viewportRect.Width / (double)(lastBucket - firstBucket));
			CollisionAvoider collisionAvoider = new CollisionAvoider();
			int bucketSize = base.CategoryView.BucketCalculator.BucketSize;
			if (bucketSize <= 0 || (firstBucket <= 0 && lastBucket <= 0))
			{
				base.CategoryView.Markers.Count = num;
				return;
			}
			int num3 = 0;
			for (int num4 = firstBucket; num4 < lastBucket + 1; num4++)
			{
				double[] bucket = null;
				int num5 = num4 * bucketSize;
				if (sortingXAxis != null && sortingXAxis.SortedIndices != null && num5 >= 0 && num5 < sortingXAxis.SortedIndices.Count)
				{
					num5 = sortingXAxis.SortedIndices[num5];
				}
				if (num4 >= base.ValueColumn.Count - 1)
				{
					if (flag && PrepareMarker(frame, frame.Buckets[frame.Buckets.Count - 1], collisionAvoider, Math.Min(num5, base.FastItemsSource.Count - 1), num, view, num3 - 1))
					{
						num++;
					}
					break;
				}
				double num6 = func(num4);
				double num7 = func2(num4);
				double num8 = func(num4 + 1);
				double num9 = func2(num4 + 1);
				double num10 = num8 - num6;
				double num11 = base.UColumn[num4];
				double num12 = base.UColumn[num4 + 1];
				double unscaledValueAt = sortingXAxis.GetUnscaledValueAt(sortingXAxis.SortedIndices[num4]);
				double num13 = xaxis.GetScaledValue(unscaledValueAt, p) + offset;
				double scaledValue = yaxis.GetScaledValue(num7, p2);
				frame.Buckets.Add(new double[3] { num13, scaledValue, scaledValue });
				num3++;
				for (int num14 = 1; num14 < num2; num14++)
				{
					double num15 = (double)num14 / (double)num2;
					double num16 = num6 + num10 * num15;
					double num17 = (num8 - num16) / num10;
					double num18 = (num16 - num6) / num10;
					double unscaledValue = num17 * num7 + num18 * num9 + ((num17 * num17 * num17 - num17) * num11 + (num18 * num18 * num18 - num18) * num12) * (num10 * num10) / 6.0;
					double unscaledValueAt2 = sortingXAxis.GetUnscaledValueAt(sortingXAxis.SortedIndices[num4]);
					double unscaledValueAt3 = sortingXAxis.GetUnscaledValueAt(sortingXAxis.SortedIndices[num4 + 1]);
					if (unscaledValueAt2 == unscaledValueAt3 && num7 == num9)
					{
						break;
					}
					double unscaledValue2 = unscaledValueAt2 + (unscaledValueAt3 - unscaledValueAt2) * num15;
					num16 = xaxis.GetScaledValue(unscaledValue2, p) + offset;
					unscaledValue = yaxis.GetScaledValue(unscaledValue, p2);
					frame.Buckets.Add(new double[3] { num16, unscaledValue, unscaledValue });
					num3++;
				}
				if (flag)
				{
					bucket = new double[3] { num13, scaledValue, scaledValue };
				}
				if (flag && PrepareMarker(frame, bucket, collisionAvoider, Math.Min(num5, base.FastItemsSource.Count - 1), num, view, num3 - 1))
				{
					num++;
				}
			}
			base.CategoryView.Markers.Count = num;
		}

		internal override void PrepareFrame(CategoryFrame frame, CategorySeriesView view)
		{
			frame.ClearFrame();
			if (base.ValueColumn == null || ParentSeries == null || LogicalSeriesLink == null || LogicalSeriesLink.LowValues.Count == 0 || LogicalSeriesLink.HighValues.Count == 0 || base.CategoryView.BucketCalculator.BucketSize == 0)
			{
				return;
			}
			base.PrepareFrame(frame, view);
			if (frame.Buckets.Count <= 1)
			{
				return;
			}
			Rect windowRect = view.WindowRect;
			Rect viewport = view.Viewport;
			Rect effectiveViewport = GetEffectiveViewport(view);
			CategoryAxisBase categoryAxisBase = ParentSeries.GetXAxis() as CategoryAxisBase;
			NumericYAxis numericYAxis = ParentSeries.GetYAxis() as NumericYAxis;
			ScalerParams p = new ScalerParams(windowRect, viewport, categoryAxisBase.IsInverted, effectiveViewport);
			ScalerParams p2 = new ScalerParams(windowRect, viewport, numericYAxis.IsInverted, effectiveViewport);
			frame.Buckets.Clear();
			frame.Markers.Clear();
			bool flag = ShouldDisplayMarkers();
			int num = 0;
			CategorySeriesView categorySeriesView;
			if (view.IsAlternateView)
			{
				_ = ParentSeries.AlternateFrame;
				categorySeriesView = (CategorySeriesView)ParentSeries.SeriesInteractionManager.AlternateViews[view.AlternateViewIdentifier];
			}
			else if (view == base.ThumbnailView)
			{
				_ = ParentSeries.ThumbnailFrame;
				categorySeriesView = ParentSeries.ThumbnailView as CategorySeriesView;
			}
			else
			{
				_ = ParentSeries.CurrentFrame;
				categorySeriesView = ParentSeries.CategoryView;
			}
			_ = categorySeriesView.BucketCalculator.BucketSize;
			ISortingAxis sortingAxis = categoryAxisBase as ISortingAxis;
			if (sortingAxis != null && sortingAxis.SortedIndices.Count != base.FastItemsSource.Count)
			{
				return;
			}
			CategoryMode categoryMode = PreferredCategoryMode(categoryAxisBase);
			if (categoryMode == CategoryMode.Mode0 && categoryAxisBase.CategoryMode != CategoryMode.Mode0)
			{
				categoryMode = CategoryMode.Mode1;
			}
			double num2 = 0.0;
			switch (categoryMode)
			{
			case CategoryMode.Mode0:
				num2 = 0.0;
				break;
			case CategoryMode.Mode1:
				num2 = 0.5 * categoryAxisBase.GetCategorySize(windowRect, viewport, effectiveViewport);
				break;
			case CategoryMode.Mode2:
				_ = base.Index;
				num2 = categoryAxisBase.GetGroupCenter(base.Index, windowRect, viewport, effectiveViewport);
				break;
			}
			if (categoryAxisBase.IsInverted)
			{
				num2 = 0.0 - num2;
			}
			Func<int, double> total = (int i) => Math.Abs(ParentSeries.Lows[i]) + ParentSeries.Highs[i];
			Func<int, double> func = (int i) => i;
			Func<int, double> func2 = delegate(int i)
			{
				double num19 = base.ValueColumn[i];
				if (double.IsNaN(num19) || double.IsInfinity(num19))
				{
					num19 = 0.0;
				}
				if (ParentSeries is IStacked100Series)
				{
					if (total(i) == 0.0)
					{
						return 0.0;
					}
					if (!(num19 < 0.0))
					{
						return (LogicalSeriesLink.HighValues[i] + num19) / total(i) * 100.0;
					}
					return (LogicalSeriesLink.LowValues[i] + num19) / total(i) * 100.0;
				}
				return (!(num19 < 0.0)) ? (LogicalSeriesLink.HighValues[i] + num19) : (LogicalSeriesLink.LowValues[i] + num19);
			};
			int bucketSize = view.BucketCalculator.BucketSize;
			EnsureSplineShape(view);
			int firstBucket = categorySeriesView.BucketCalculator.FirstBucket;
			int lastBucket = categorySeriesView.BucketCalculator.LastBucket;
			int num3 = (int)Math.Ceiling(viewport.Width / (double)(lastBucket - firstBucket));
			CollisionAvoider collisionAvoider = new CollisionAvoider();
			if (sortingAxis != null)
			{
				PrepareDateTimeFrame(frame, windowRect, viewport, categoryAxisBase, numericYAxis, view);
				return;
			}
			int num4 = 0;
			int num5 = 0;
			for (int num6 = firstBucket; num6 < lastBucket + 1 && num6 < base.ValueColumn.Count; num6++)
			{
				double[] array = null;
				if (bucketSize == 1)
				{
					if (num6 >= base.ValueColumn.Count - 1)
					{
						if (flag && frame.Buckets.Count > 0 && PrepareMarker(frame, frame.Buckets[frame.Buckets.Count - 1], collisionAvoider, Math.Min(num6 * bucketSize, base.FastItemsSource.Count - 1), num, view, num4 - 1))
						{
							num++;
						}
						break;
					}
					double num7 = func(num6);
					double num8 = func(num6 + 1);
					double num9 = func2(num6);
					double num10 = func2(num6 + 1);
					double num11 = num8 - num7;
					double num12 = base.UColumn[num6];
					double num13 = base.UColumn[num6 + 1];
					double num14 = categoryAxisBase.GetScaledValue(num7, p) + num2;
					double scaledValue = numericYAxis.GetScaledValue(num9, p2);
					frame.Buckets.Add(new double[3] { num14, scaledValue, scaledValue });
					num4++;
					num5 = num4;
					for (int num15 = 1; num15 < num3; num15++)
					{
						double num16 = num7 + num11 * (double)num15 / (double)num3;
						double num17 = (num8 - num16) / num11;
						double num18 = (num16 - num7) / num11;
						double unscaledValue = num17 * num9 + num18 * num10 + ((num17 * num17 * num17 - num17) * num12 + (num18 * num18 * num18 - num18) * num13) * (num11 * num11) / 6.0;
						num16 = categoryAxisBase.GetScaledValue(num16, p) + num2;
						unscaledValue = numericYAxis.GetScaledValue(unscaledValue, p2);
						frame.Buckets.Add(new double[3] { num16, unscaledValue, unscaledValue });
						num4++;
					}
					if (flag)
					{
						array = new double[3] { num14, scaledValue, scaledValue };
					}
				}
				else
				{
					array = view.BucketCalculator.GetBucket(num6);
					if (!double.IsNaN(array[0]))
					{
						array[0] = categoryAxisBase.GetScaledValue(array[0], p) + num2;
						array[1] = numericYAxis.GetScaledValue(array[1], p2);
						array[2] = numericYAxis.GetScaledValue(array[2], p2);
						frame.Buckets.Add(array);
						num4++;
						num5 = num4;
					}
				}
				if (flag && PrepareMarker(frame, array, collisionAvoider, Math.Min(num6 * bucketSize, base.FastItemsSource.Count - 1), num, view, num5 - 1))
				{
					num++;
				}
			}
			view.Markers.Count = num;
		}

		internal override double[][] GetRasterizedYAxisValues(CategorySeriesView view)
		{
			Func<int, double> total = (int i) => Math.Abs(ParentSeries.Lows[i]) + ParentSeries.Highs[i];
			Func<int, double> func = (int i) => i;
			Func<int, double> func2 = delegate(int i)
			{
				double num20 = base.ValueColumn[i];
				if (double.IsNaN(num20) || double.IsInfinity(num20))
				{
					num20 = 0.0;
				}
				if (ParentSeries is IStacked100Series)
				{
					if (total(i) == 0.0)
					{
						return 0.0;
					}
					if (!(num20 < 0.0))
					{
						return (LogicalSeriesLink.HighValues[i] + num20) / total(i) * 100.0;
					}
					return (LogicalSeriesLink.LowValues[i] + num20) / total(i) * 100.0;
				}
				return (!(num20 < 0.0)) ? (LogicalSeriesLink.HighValues[i] + num20) : (LogicalSeriesLink.LowValues[i] + num20);
			};
			List<double[]> list = new List<double[]>();
			Rect windowRect = view.WindowRect;
			Rect viewport = view.Viewport;
			ISortingAxis sortingAxis = CachedXAxis as ISortingAxis;
			int num = 0;
			int num2 = 0;
			int num3 = 0;
			double resolution = base.Resolution;
			Rect contentViewport = GetContentViewport(base.View);
			CategoryAxisBase cachedXAxis = CachedXAxis;
			Rect effectiveViewport = GetEffectiveViewport(view);
			if (sortingAxis == null || sortingAxis.SortedIndices == null)
			{
				new ScalerParams(windowRect, viewport, cachedXAxis.IsInverted, effectiveViewport);
				double num4 = 0.0;
				double num5 = cachedXAxis.ItemsCount - 1;
				double val = Math.Floor((num5 - num4 + 1.0) * resolution / contentViewport.Width);
				num = (int)Math.Max(1.0, val);
				num2 = (int)Math.Max(0.0, Math.Floor(num4 / (double)num) - 1.0);
				num3 = (int)Math.Ceiling(num5 / (double)num);
			}
			else
			{
				num2 = 0;
				num3 = cachedXAxis.ItemsCount - 1;
				num = 1;
			}
			int num6 = (int)Math.Ceiling(viewport.Width / (double)(num3 - num2));
			new CollisionAvoider();
			if (sortingAxis != null)
			{
				return GetRasterizedYAxisValuesForDateTime(view);
			}
			for (int num7 = num2; num7 < num3 + 1 && num7 < base.ValueColumn.Count; num7++)
			{
				double[] array = null;
				if (num == 1)
				{
					if (num7 >= base.ValueColumn.Count - 1)
					{
						break;
					}
					double num8 = func(num7);
					double num9 = func(num7 + 1);
					double num10 = func2(num7);
					double num11 = func2(num7 + 1);
					double num12 = num9 - num8;
					double num13 = base.UColumn[num7];
					double num14 = base.UColumn[num7 + 1];
					list.Add(new double[2] { num10, num10 });
					for (int num15 = 1; num15 < num6; num15++)
					{
						double num16 = num8 + num12 * (double)num15 / (double)num6;
						double num17 = (num9 - num16) / num12;
						double num18 = (num16 - num8) / num12;
						double num19 = num17 * num10 + num18 * num11 + ((num17 * num17 * num17 - num17) * num13 + (num18 * num18 * num18 - num18) * num14) * (num12 * num12) / 6.0;
						list.Add(new double[2] { num19, num19 });
					}
				}
				else
				{
					array = view.BucketCalculator.GetBucket(num7);
					if (!double.IsNaN(array[0]))
					{
						list.Add(new double[2]

							array[0],

		internal override double[][] GetRasterizedYAxisValuesForDateTime(CategorySeriesView view)
		{
			List<double[]> list = new List<double[]>();
			_ = view.WindowRect;
			Rect viewport = view.Viewport;
			CategoryAxisBase cachedXAxis = CachedXAxis;
			ISortingAxis sortingXAxis = cachedXAxis as ISortingAxis;
			if (sortingXAxis == null)
			{
				return null;
			}
			GetEffectiveViewport(view);
			ShouldDisplayMarkers();
			int count = 0;
			Func<int, double> total = (int i) => Math.Abs(ParentSeries.Lows[i]) + ParentSeries.Highs[i];
			Func<int, double> func = (int i) => i;
			Func<int, double> func2 = delegate(int i)
			{
				int num21 = sortingXAxis.SortedIndices[i];
				if (ParentSeries is IStacked100Series)
				{
					if (!(base.ValueColumn[num21] < 0.0))
					{
						return (LogicalSeriesLink.HighValues[num21] + base.ValueColumn[num21]) / total(num21) * 100.0;
					}
					return (LogicalSeriesLink.LowValues[num21] + base.ValueColumn[num21]) / total(num21) * 100.0;
				}
				return (!(base.ValueColumn[num21] < 0.0)) ? (LogicalSeriesLink.HighValues[num21] + base.ValueColumn[num21]) : (LogicalSeriesLink.LowValues[num21] + base.ValueColumn[num21]);
			};
			int num = 0;
			int num2 = 0;
			int num3 = 0;
			double resolution = base.Resolution;
			Rect contentViewport = GetContentViewport(base.View);
			if (sortingXAxis == null || sortingXAxis.SortedIndices == null)
			{
				double num4 = 0.0;
				double num5 = cachedXAxis.ItemsCount - 1;
				double val = Math.Floor((num5 - num4 + 1.0) * resolution / contentViewport.Width);
				num = (int)Math.Max(1.0, val);
				num2 = (int)Math.Max(0.0, Math.Floor(num4 / (double)num) - 1.0);
				num3 = (int)Math.Ceiling(num5 / (double)num);
			}
			else
			{
				num2 = 0;
				num3 = cachedXAxis.ItemsCount - 1;
				num = 1;
			}
			if (num <= 0 || (num2 <= 0 && num3 <= 0))
			{
				base.CategoryView.Markers.Count = count;
				return null;
			}
			int num6 = (int)Math.Ceiling(viewport.Width / (double)(num3 - num2));
			new CollisionAvoider();
			for (int num7 = num2; num7 < num3 + 1 && num7 < base.ValueColumn.Count - 1; num7++)
			{
				double num8 = func(num7);
				double num9 = func2(num7);
				double num10 = func(num7 + 1);
				double num11 = func2(num7 + 1);
				double num12 = num10 - num8;
				double num13 = base.UColumn[num7];
				double num14 = base.UColumn[num7 + 1];
				list.Add(new double[2] { num9, num9 });
				for (int num15 = 1; num15 < num6; num15++)
				{
					double num16 = (double)num15 / (double)num6;
					double num17 = num8 + num12 * num16;
					double num18 = (num10 - num17) / num12;
					double num19 = (num17 - num8) / num12;
					double num20 = num18 * num9 + num19 * num11 + ((num18 * num18 * num18 - num18) * num13 + (num19 * num19 * num19 - num19) * num14) * (num12 * num12) / 6.0;
					list.Add(new double[2] { num20, num20 });
				}
			}
			return list.ToArray();
		}

		internal override void EnsureSplineShape(CategorySeriesView view)
		{
			base.EnsureSplineShape(view);
			Func<int, double> total = (int i) => Math.Abs(ParentSeries.Lows[i]) + ParentSeries.Highs[i];
			Func<int, double> x = (int i) => i;
			Func<int, double> y = delegate(int i)
			{
				double num5 = base.ValueColumn[i];
				if (double.IsNaN(num5) || double.IsInfinity(num5))
				{
					num5 = 0.0;
				}
				if (ParentSeries is IStacked100Series)
				{
					if (total(i) == 0.0)
					{
						return 0.0;
					}
					if (!(num5 < 0.0))
					{
						return (LogicalSeriesLink.HighValues[i] + num5) / total(i) * 100.0;
					}
					return (LogicalSeriesLink.LowValues[i] + num5) / total(i) * 100.0;
				}
				return (!(num5 < 0.0)) ? (LogicalSeriesLink.HighValues[i] + num5) : (LogicalSeriesLink.LowValues[i] + num5);
			};
			CategoryAxisBase cachedXAxis = CachedXAxis;
			double num = ((base.SplineType == SplineType.Natural) ? double.NaN : 0.0);
			if (cachedXAxis != null && cachedXAxis is ISortingAxis && ((ISortingAxis)cachedXAxis).SortedIndices != null)
			{
				SafeSortedReadOnlyDoubleCollection sorted = new SafeSortedReadOnlyDoubleCollection(base.ValueColumn, ((ISortingAxis)cachedXAxis).SortedIndices);
				y = (int i) => sorted[i];
			}
			base.UColumn = Numeric.SafeCubicSplineFit(base.ValueColumn.Count, x, y, num, num);
			if (!base.IsSplineShapePartOfRange)
			{
				return;
			}
			double num2 = double.MinValue;
			double num3 = double.MaxValue;
			double[][] rasterizedYAxisValues = GetRasterizedYAxisValues(view);
			if (rasterizedYAxisValues == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			for (int num4 = 0; num4 < rasterizedYAxisValues.Length; num4++)
			{
				if (!double.IsNaN(rasterizedYAxisValues[num4][0]) && !double.IsNaN(rasterizedYAxisValues[num4][1]))
				{
					if (rasterizedYAxisValues[num4][1] > num2)
					{
						num2 = rasterizedYAxisValues[num4][1];
					}
					if (rasterizedYAxisValues[num4][0] < num3)
					{
						num3 = rasterizedYAxisValues[num4][0];
					}
				}
			}
			base.UColumnMinValue = num3;
			base.UColumnMaxValue = num2;
		}

		protected override void PropertyUpdatedOverride(object sender, string propertyName, object oldValue, object newValue)
		{
			base.PropertyUpdatedOverride(sender, propertyName, oldValue, newValue);
			if (propertyName == "ActualBrush" && LogicalSeriesLink != null)
			{
				LogicalSeriesLink.ActualBrush = base.ActualBrush;
			}
		}
	}
	internal class SplineFragmentBaseValueList : IList<double>, ICollection<double>, IEnumerable<double>, IEnumerable
	{
		private SplineFragmentBase _fragment;

		public double this[int index]
		{
			get
			{
				bool flag = false;
				if (_fragment.ParentSeries != null)
				{
					flag = _fragment.ParentSeries.IsPercentBased;
				}
				StackedSeriesBase parentSeries = _fragment.ParentSeries;
				if (parentSeries == null)
				{
					return double.NaN;
				}
				double num = _fragment.ValueColumn[index];
				double num2 = Math.Abs(parentSeries.Lows[index]) + parentSeries.Highs[index];
				List<double> highValues = _fragment.LogicalSeriesLink.HighValues;
				List<double> lowValues = _fragment.LogicalSeriesLink.LowValues;
				if (double.IsNaN(num) || double.IsInfinity(num))
				{
					num = 0.0;
				}
				if (flag)
				{
					if (num2 == 0.0)
					{
						return 0.0;
					}
					if (num < 0.0)
					{
						return (lowValues[index] + num) / num2 * 100.0;
					}
					return (highValues[index] + num) / num2 * 100.0;
				}
				return (num < 0.0) ? (lowValues[index] + num) : (highValues[index] + num);
			}
			set
			{
				throw new NotImplementedException();
			}
		}

	internal static class Stacked100DataPreparer
	{
		internal static void PrepareData(StackedSeriesBase target)
		{
			if (target.FastItemsSource == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			double num = double.PositiveInfinity;
			double num2 = double.NegativeInfinity;
			for (int i = 0; i < target.FastItemsSource.Count; i++)
			{
				double num3 = Math.Abs(target.Lows[i]) + target.Highs[i];
				if (num3 == 0.0)
				{
					num = Math.Min(num, 0.0);
					num2 = Math.Max(num2, 0.0);
				}
				else
				{
					num = Math.Min(num, target.Lows[i] / num3 * 100.0);
					num2 = Math.Max(num2, target.Highs[i] / num3 * 100.0);
				}
			}
			target.Minimum = num;
			target.Maximum = num2;
		}
	}

	[WidgetCreatableNonLeaf]
	public class StackedBarSeries : VerticalStackedSeriesBase, IBarSeries
	{
		internal const string RadiusXPropertyName = "RadiusX";

		public static readonly DependencyProperty RadiusXProperty = DependencyProperty.Register("RadiusX", typeof(double), typeof(StackedBarSeries), new PropertyMetadata(0.0, delegate(DependencyObject sender, DependencyPropertyChangedEventArgs e)
		{
			((StackedBarSeries)sender).RaisePropertyChanged("RadiusX", e.OldValue, e.NewValue);
		}));

		internal const string RadiusYPropertyName = "RadiusY";

		public static readonly DependencyProperty RadiusYProperty = DependencyProperty.Register("RadiusY", typeof(double), typeof(StackedBarSeries), new PropertyMetadata(0.0, delegate(DependencyObject sender, DependencyPropertyChangedEventArgs e)
		{
			((StackedBarSeries)sender).RaisePropertyChanged("RadiusY", e.OldValue, e.NewValue);
		}));

		public override bool IsBar => true;

		public override bool IsMarkerlessDisplayPreferred => true;

		[TSSuppressSynthesizedInitializer]
		internal StackedBarSeriesView StackedBarView { get; set; }

		[WidgetDefaultNumber(0.0)]
		public double RadiusX
		{
			get
			{
				return (double)GetValue(RadiusXProperty);
			}
			set
			{
				SetValue(RadiusXProperty, value);
			}
		}

		[WidgetDefaultNumber(0.0)]
		public double RadiusY
		{
			get
			{
				return (double)GetValue(RadiusYProperty);
			}
			set
			{
				SetValue(RadiusYProperty, value);
			}
		}

		public StackedBarSeries()
		{
			base.DefaultStyleKey = typeof(StackedBarSeries);
		}

		[JAVASuppressWidgetMember]
		public override void OnApplyTemplate()
		{
			base.OnApplyTemplate();
			RenderSeries(animate: false);
		}

		protected override SeriesView CreateView()
		{
			return new StackedBarSeriesView(this);
		}

		protected internal override void OnViewCreated(SeriesView view)
		{
			base.OnViewCreated(view);
			StackedBarView = (StackedBarSeriesView)view;
		}

		internal override CategorySeriesView GetSeriesView()
		{
			return StackedBarView;
		}

		internal override CategoryMode PreferredCategoryMode(CategoryAxisBase axis)
		{
			return CategoryMode.Mode2;
		}

		protected internal override int GetMode2Index()
		{
			int num = 0;
			foreach (Series item in base.SeriesViewer.Series)
			{
				if (item == this)
				{
					return num;
				}
				if (item is IBarSeries barSeries && barSeries.YAxis == base.YAxis && barSeries.GetPreferredCategoryMode() == CategoryMode.Mode2)
				{
					num++;
				}
			}
			return -1;
		}

		internal override double GetScaledWorldZeroValue()
		{
			double result = 0.0;
			Rect window = ((base.SeriesViewer != null) ? base.SeriesViewer.ActualWindowRect : Rect.Empty);
			Rect viewport = base.View.Viewport;
			if (!window.IsEmpty && !viewport.IsEmpty && base.XAxis != null)
			{
				Rect effectiveViewport = GetEffectiveViewport(base.View);
				ScalerParams p = new ScalerParams(window, viewport, base.XAxis.IsInverted, effectiveViewport);
				result = base.XAxis.GetScaledValue(base.XAxis.ReferenceValue, p);
			}
			return result;
		}

		internal override double GetUnscaledWorldZeroValue()
		{
			if (base.XAxis != null)
			{
				return base.XAxis.ReferenceValue;
			}
			return 0.0;
		}

		protected internal override AxisRange GetRange(Axis axis)
		{
			if (base.ItemsSource == null)
			{
				return null;
			}
			if (axis == base.YAxis)
			{
				return new AxisRange(0.0, base.FastItemsSource.Count - 1);
			}
			if (axis == base.XAxis)
			{
				PrepareData();
				return new AxisRange(base.Minimum, base.Maximum);
			}
			return null;
		}

		public override bool ScrollIntoView(object item)
		{
			int num = ((base.FastItemsSource != null) ? base.FastItemsSource.IndexOf(item) : (-1));
			Rect windowRect = ((base.SeriesViewer != null) ? base.SeriesViewer.ActualWindowRect : Rect.Empty);
			_ = base.View.Viewport;
			Rect rect = new Rect(0.0, 0.0, 1.0, 1.0);
			Rect effectiveViewportForUnitViewport = GetEffectiveViewportForUnitViewport(base.View);
			ScalerParams p = new ScalerParams(rect, rect, base.XAxis.IsInverted, effectiveViewportForUnitViewport);
			ScalerParams p2 = new ScalerParams(rect, rect, base.YAxis.IsInverted, effectiveViewportForUnitViewport);
			if (num >= 0)
			{
				if (base.YAxis != null)
				{
					double num2 = base.YAxis.GetScaledValue(num, p2);
					if (num2 < windowRect.Top + 0.1 * windowRect.Height)
					{
						num2 += 0.4 * windowRect.Height;
					}
					if (num2 > windowRect.Bottom - 0.1 * windowRect.Height)
					{
						num2 -= 0.4 * windowRect.Height;
					}
					windowRect.Y = num2 - 0.5 * windowRect.Height;
				}
				if (base.XAxis != null && base.Highs != null && num < base.Highs.Length)
				{
					double scaledValue = base.XAxis.GetScaledValue(base.Highs[num], p);
					double num3 = base.XAxis.GetScaledValue(base.Lows[num], p);
					if (!double.IsNaN(scaledValue) && !double.IsNaN(num3))
					{
						double num4 = Math.Abs(num3 - scaledValue);
						if (windowRect.Width < num4)
						{
							windowRect.Width = num4;
							windowRect.X = Math.Min(num3, scaledValue);
						}
						else
						{
							if (num3 < windowRect.Left + 0.1 * windowRect.Width)
							{
								num3 += 0.4 * windowRect.Width;
							}
							if (num3 > windowRect.Right - 0.1 * windowRect.Width)
							{
								num3 -= 0.4 * windowRect.Width;
							}
							windowRect.X = num3 - 0.5 * windowRect.Width;
						}
					}
				}
				base.SyncLink.WindowNotify(base.SeriesViewer, windowRect, force: true);
			}
			return num >= 0;
		}

		protected internal override bool ValidateSeries(Rect viewportRect, Rect windowRect, SeriesView view)
		{
			bool result = true;
			CategorySeriesView categorySeriesView = (CategorySeriesView)view;
			if (!view.HasSurface() || windowRect.IsEmpty || viewportRect.IsEmpty || base.YAxis == null || base.YAxis.ItemsSource == null || base.XAxis == null || base.FastItemsSource == null || base.XAxis.SeriesViewer == null || base.YAxis.SeriesViewer == null || base.XAxis.ActualMinimumValue == base.XAxis.ActualMaximumValue)
			{
				categorySeriesView.BucketCalculator.BucketSize = 0;
				result = false;
			}
			return result;
		}

		protected override void DataUpdatedOverride(FastItemsSourceEventAction action, int position, int count, string propertyName)
		{
			switch (action)
			{
			case FastItemsSourceEventAction.Remove:
			case FastItemsSourceEventAction.Insert:
			case FastItemsSourceEventAction.Reset:
				base.CategoryView.BucketCalculator.CalculateBuckets(base.Resolution);
				break;
			}
			switch (action)
			{
			case FastItemsSourceEventAction.Reset:
				if (base.XAxis != null && !base.XAxis.UpdateRange())
				{
					RenderSeries(animate: true);
				}
				break;
			case FastItemsSourceEventAction.Insert:
				if (base.XAxis != null && !base.XAxis.UpdateRange())
				{
					RenderSeries(animate: true);
				}
				break;
			case FastItemsSourceEventAction.Remove:
				if (base.XAxis != null && !base.XAxis.UpdateRange())
				{
					RenderSeries(animate: true);
				}
				break;
			case FastItemsSourceEventAction.Replace:
				if (base.CategoryView.BucketCalculator.BucketSize > 0)
				{
					RenderSeries(animate: true);
				}
				break;
			case FastItemsSourceEventAction.Change:
				if (base.XAxis != null && !base.XAxis.UpdateRange())
				{
					RenderSeries(animate: true);
				}
				break;
			}
		}

		public override int GetItemIndex(Point world)
		{
			Rect window = ((base.SeriesViewer != null) ? base.SeriesViewer.ActualWindowRect : Rect.Empty);
			Rect viewport = base.View.Viewport;
			Rect effectiveViewport = GetEffectiveViewport(base.View);
			int result = -1;
			if (base.YAxis != null && !window.IsEmpty && !viewport.IsEmpty)
			{
				ScalerParams p = new ScalerParams(window, viewport, base.YAxis.IsInverted, effectiveViewport);
				Rect contentViewport = GetContentViewport(base.View);
				double unscaledValue = base.YAxis.GetUnscaledValue(contentViewport.Top, p);
				double unscaledValue2 = base.YAxis.GetUnscaledValue(contentViewport.Bottom, p);
				double num = (world.Y - window.Top) / window.Height;
				double num2 = unscaledValue + num * (unscaledValue2 - unscaledValue);
				if (base.YAxis.CategoryMode != CategoryMode.Mode0)
				{
					num2 -= 0.5;
				}
				result = (int)Math.Round(num2);
			}
			return result;
		}

		public override object GetItem(Point world)
		{
			int itemIndex = GetItemIndex(world);
			if (itemIndex < 0 || base.FastItemsSource == null || itemIndex >= base.FastItemsSource.Count)
			{
				return null;
			}
			return base.FastItemsSource[itemIndex];
		}

		internal override void UpdateAxisRanges()
		{
			if (base.XAxis != null)
			{
				base.XAxis.UpdateRange(immediate: true);
			}
			if (base.YAxis != null)
			{
				base.YAxis.UpdateRange(immediate: true);
			}
		}

		internal override int GetFragmentItemIndex(Point world)
		{
			return GetItemIndex(world);
		}

		internal override bool ValidateFragmentSeries(AnchoredCategorySeries series, Rect viewportRect, Rect windowRect, SeriesView view)
		{
			bool result = true;
			if (!view.HasSurface() || windowRect.IsEmpty || viewportRect.IsEmpty || base.YAxis == null || base.YAxis.ItemsSource == null || base.XAxis == null || base.FastItemsSource == null || base.XAxis.SeriesViewer == null || base.YAxis.SeriesViewer == null)
			{
				result = false;
			}
			CategorySeriesView categorySeriesView = (CategorySeriesView)view;
			if (series.ValueColumn == null || series.ValueColumn.Count == 0 || categorySeriesView.BucketCalculator.BucketSize < 1)
			{
				result = false;
			}
			return result;
		}

		public override double GetItemSpan()
		{
			return base.YAxis.GetGroupSize(base.View.WindowRect, base.View.Viewport, GetEffectiveViewport(base.View));
		}

		internal override void RenderFragment(AnchoredCategorySeries series, CategoryFrame frame, CategorySeriesView view)
		{
			BarFragment barSeries = series as BarFragment;
			ColumnFragmentView columnFragmentView = view as ColumnFragmentView;
			if (!ValidateSeries(view.Viewport, view.WindowRect, view) || barSeries == null || columnFragmentView == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			double groupSize = base.YAxis.GetGroupSize(view.WindowRect, view.Viewport, GetEffectiveViewport(view));
			if (double.IsNaN(groupSize) || double.IsInfinity(groupSize))
			{
				barSeries.ColumnFragmentView.Columns.Count = 0;
				return;
			}
			int num = 0;
			barSeries.RenderManager.InitCategoryRenderSettings(barSeries, barSeries.ShouldOverrideCategoryStyle(), (int i1, int i2) => barSeries.GetCategoryItems(i1, i2), barSeries.GetBucketSize(view), barSeries.GetFirstBucket(view));
			barSeries.RenderManager.InitialRenderRadiusX = barSeries.RadiusX;
			barSeries.RenderManager.InitialRenderRadiusY = barSeries.RadiusY;
			barSeries.RenderManager.ActualRenderRadiusX = barSeries.RadiusX;
			barSeries.RenderManager.ActualRenderRadiusY = barSeries.RadiusY;
			int count = barSeries.ValueColumn.Count;
			Rect windowRect = view.WindowRect;
			Rect viewport = view.Viewport;
			Rect effectiveViewport = GetEffectiveViewport(view);
			bool flag = false;
			if (barSeries.RenderManager.OverrideArgs != null)
			{
				flag = true;
			}
			List<double[]> buckets = frame.Buckets;
			CategoryAxisBase categoryAxis = barSeries.GetCategoryAxis();
			ScalerParams axisParams = new ScalerParams(windowRect, viewport, categoryAxis.IsInverted, effectiveViewport);
			int num2 = 0;
			foreach (double[] bucket in frame.Buckets)
			{
				if (double.IsInfinity(bucket[0]) || double.IsNaN(bucket[0]) || double.IsInfinity(bucket[1]) || double.IsInfinity(bucket[2]) || double.IsNaN(bucket[1]) || double.IsNaN(bucket[2]))
				{
					num2++;
					continue;
				}
				double top = bucket[0] - 0.5 * groupSize;
				double val = bucket[1];
				double val2 = bucket[2];
				val2 = Math.Max(val2, -100.0);
				val = Math.Min(val, view.Viewport.Right + 100.0);
				Rectangle rectangle = columnFragmentView.Columns[num];
				rectangle.Height = groupSize;
				rectangle.Width = Math.Abs(val - val2);
				if (flag)
				{
					barSeries.PerformCategoryStyleOverride(buckets, num2, count, categoryAxis, axisParams, view.IsThumbnailView);
				}
				barSeries.RenderManager.SetShapeAppearance(rectangle, strokeOnly: false, fillOnly: false, extended: false, useOutline: false);
				rectangle.RadiusX = barSeries.RenderManager.ActualRenderRadiusX;
				rectangle.RadiusY = barSeries.RenderManager.ActualRenderRadiusY;
				columnFragmentView.PositionRectangle(rectangle, Math.Min(val, val2), top);
				num++;
				num2++;
			}
			columnFragmentView.Columns.Count = num;
		}

		protected override void PropertyUpdatedOverride(object sender, string propertyName, object oldValue, object newValue)
		{
			base.PropertyUpdatedOverride(sender, propertyName, oldValue, newValue);
			switch (propertyName)
			{
			case "RadiusX":
			case "RadiusY":
				foreach (StackedFragmentSeries item in base.ActualSeries)
				{
					item.UpdateRadiusX();
					item.UpdateRadiusY();
				}
				RenderSeries(animate: false);
				break;
			case "SyncLink":
				if (base.XAxis != null)
				{
					base.XAxis.UpdateRange();
				}
				break;
			case "FastItemsSource":
				if (base.XAxis != null && !base.XAxis.UpdateRange())
				{
					StackedBarView.BucketCalculator.CalculateBuckets(base.Resolution);
				}
				RenderSeries(animate: false);
				break;
			case "SeriesViewer":
				if (oldValue != null && newValue == null)
				{
					DeregisterForAxis(base.XAxis);
					DeregisterForAxis(base.YAxis);
				}
				if (oldValue == null && newValue != null)
				{
					RegisterForAxis(base.XAxis);
					RegisterForAxis(base.YAxis);
				}
				StackedBarView.BucketCalculator.CalculateBuckets(base.Resolution);
				RenderSeries(animate: false);
				if (base.XAxis != null)
				{
					base.XAxis.UpdateRange();
				}
				break;
			}
		}

		CategoryMode IBarSeries.GetPreferredCategoryMode()
		{
			return PreferredCategoryMode(base.YAxis);
		}
	}

		internal override void RenderFragment(AnchoredCategorySeries series, CategoryFrame frame, CategorySeriesView view)
		{
			ColumnFragment columnSeries = series as ColumnFragment;
			ColumnFragmentView columnFragmentView = view as ColumnFragmentView;
			if (!ValidateSeries(view.Viewport, view.WindowRect, view) || columnSeries == null || columnFragmentView == null || columnSeries == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			Rect effectiveViewport = GetEffectiveViewport(view);
			double groupSize = base.XAxis.GetGroupSize(view.WindowRect, view.Viewport, effectiveViewport);
			if (double.IsNaN(groupSize) || double.IsInfinity(groupSize))
			{
				columnSeries.ColumnFragmentView.Columns.Count = 0;
				return;
			}
			int num = 0;
			columnSeries.RenderManager.InitCategoryRenderSettings(columnSeries, columnSeries.ShouldOverrideCategoryStyle(), (int i1, int i2) => columnSeries.GetCategoryItems(i1, i2), columnSeries.GetBucketSize(view), columnSeries.GetFirstBucket(view));
			columnSeries.RenderManager.InitialRenderRadiusX = columnSeries.RadiusX;
			columnSeries.RenderManager.InitialRenderRadiusY = columnSeries.RadiusY;
			columnSeries.RenderManager.ActualRenderRadiusX = columnSeries.RadiusX;
			columnSeries.RenderManager.ActualRenderRadiusY = columnSeries.RadiusY;
			Rect windowRect = view.WindowRect;
			Rect viewport = view.Viewport;
			Rect effectiveViewport2 = GetEffectiveViewport(view);
			bool flag = false;
			if (columnSeries.RenderManager.OverrideArgs != null)
			{
				flag = true;
			}
			List<double[]> buckets = frame.Buckets;
			CategoryAxisBase categoryAxis = columnSeries.GetCategoryAxis();
			ScalerParams axisParams = new ScalerParams(windowRect, viewport, categoryAxis.IsInverted, effectiveViewport2);
			int count = columnSeries.ValueColumn.Count;
			int num2 = 0;
			foreach (double[] bucket in frame.Buckets)
			{
				if (double.IsInfinity(bucket[0]) || double.IsNaN(bucket[0]) || double.IsInfinity(bucket[1]) || double.IsInfinity(bucket[2]) || double.IsNaN(bucket[1]) || double.IsNaN(bucket[2]))
				{
					num2++;
					continue;
				}
				double left = bucket[0] - 0.5 * groupSize;
				double val = bucket[1];
				double val2 = bucket[2];
				val = Math.Max(val, -100.0);
				val2 = Math.Min(val2, view.Viewport.Bottom + 100.0);
				Rectangle rectangle = columnFragmentView.Columns[num];
				rectangle.Width = groupSize;
				rectangle.Height = Math.Abs(val2 - val);
				if (flag)
				{
					columnSeries.PerformCategoryStyleOverride(buckets, num2, count, categoryAxis, axisParams, view.IsThumbnailView);
				}
				columnSeries.RenderManager.SetShapeAppearance(rectangle, strokeOnly: false, fillOnly: false, extended: false, useOutline: false);
				rectangle.RadiusX = columnSeries.RenderManager.ActualRenderRadiusX;
				rectangle.RadiusY = columnSeries.RenderManager.ActualRenderRadiusY;
				columnFragmentView.PositionRectangle(rectangle, left, Math.Min(val2, val));
				num++;
				num2++;
			}
			columnFragmentView.Columns.Count = num;
		}

		protected override void PropertyUpdatedOverride(object sender, string propertyName, object oldValue, object newValue)
		{
			base.PropertyUpdatedOverride(sender, propertyName, oldValue, newValue);
			switch (propertyName)
			{
			case "RadiusX":
			case "RadiusY":
				foreach (StackedFragmentSeries item in base.ActualSeries)
				{
					item.UpdateRadiusX();
					item.UpdateRadiusY();
				}
				RenderSeries(animate: false);
				break;
			case "SyncLink":
				if (base.YAxis != null)
				{
					base.YAxis.UpdateRange();
				}
				break;
			case "SeriesViewer":
				if (base.YAxis != null)
				{
					base.YAxis.UpdateRange();
				}
				break;
			}
		}
	}

		public StackedFragmentSeries()
		{
			HighValues = new List<double>();
			LowValues = new List<double>();
			Buckets = new List<double[]>();
			PropertyUpdated += delegate(object o, PropertyUpdatedEventArgs e)
			{
				PropertyUpdatedOverride(o, e.PropertyName, e.OldValue, e.NewValue);
			};
		}

		internal void UpdateShowDefaultTooltip()
		{
			if (ParentSeries == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			ActualShowDefaultTooltip = ((ReadLocalValue(ShowDefaultTooltipProperty) == DependencyProperty.UnsetValue) ? ParentSeries.ShowDefaultTooltip : ShowDefaultTooltip);
			if (ToolTip == null && ActualShowDefaultTooltip)
			{
				ResourceDictionary resourceDictionary = null;
				try
				{
					Uri source = CoreUtilities.BuildEmbeddedResourceUri(typeof(XamDataChart).Assembly, "themes/TooltipTemplates.xaml");
					resourceDictionary = new ResourceDictionary
					{
						Source = source
					};
				}
				catch
				{
				}
				if (resourceDictionary != null)
				{
					DataTemplate dataTemplate = null;
					dataTemplate = ((ParentSeries == null) ? ((DataTemplate)resourceDictionary[DefaultTooltipTemplateName]) : ((DataTemplate)resourceDictionary[ParentSeries.DefaultTooltipTemplateName]));
					if (_defaultTooltipContentControl == null)
					{
						_defaultTooltipContentControl = new ContentControl();
						_defaultTooltipContentControl.ContentTemplate = dataTemplate;
						_defaultTooltipContentControl.SetBinding(ContentControl.ContentProperty, new Binding());
					}
					ToolTip = _defaultTooltipContentControl;
				}
			}
			else if (!ActualShowDefaultTooltip && ToolTip == _defaultTooltipContentControl)
			{
				ToolTip = null;
			}
		}

		internal void UpdateAreaFillOpacity()
		{
			if (ParentSeries != null)
			{
				double num = double.NaN;
				if (ParentSeries.IsStacked && ParentSeries.IsArea && !ParentSeries.IsSpline)
				{
					num = ((StackedAreaSeries)ParentSeries).ActualAreaFillOpacity;
				}
				if (ParentSeries.IsStacked && ParentSeries.IsArea && ParentSeries.IsSpline)
				{
					num = ((StackedSplineAreaSeries)ParentSeries).ActualAreaFillOpacity;
				}
				ActualAreaFillOpacity = ((!double.IsNaN(AreaFillOpacity)) ? AreaFillOpacity : num);
			}
		}

		internal void UpdateIsSplineShapePartOfRangePropertyName()
		{
			if (ParentSeries == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			bool actualIsSplineShapePartOfRange = false;
			if (ParentSeries.IsStacked && ParentSeries.IsSpline && ParentSeries.IsArea)
			{
				actualIsSplineShapePartOfRange = ((StackedSplineAreaSeries)ParentSeries).IsSplineShapePartOfRange;
			}
			if (ParentSeries.IsStacked && ParentSeries.IsBar)
			{
				actualIsSplineShapePartOfRange = ((StackedSplineSeries)ParentSeries).IsSplineShapePartOfRange;
			}
			ActualIsSplineShapePartOfRange = actualIsSplineShapePartOfRange;
			if (VisualSeriesLink != null)
			{
				if (VisualSeriesLink is SplineFragment)
				{
					((SplineFragment)VisualSeriesLink).IsSplineShapePartOfRange = ActualIsSplineShapePartOfRange;
				}
				if (VisualSeriesLink is SplineAreaFragment)
				{
					((SplineAreaFragment)VisualSeriesLink).IsSplineShapePartOfRange = ActualIsSplineShapePartOfRange;
				}
			}
		}

		protected void RaisePropertyChanged(string propertyName, object oldValue, object newValue)
		{
			if (this.PropertyChanged != null)
			{
				this.PropertyChanged(this, new PropertyChangedEventArgs(propertyName));
			}
			if (this.PropertyUpdated != null)
			{
				this.PropertyUpdated(this, new PropertyUpdatedEventArgs(propertyName, oldValue, newValue));
			}
		}

		protected virtual void PropertyUpdatedOverride(object sender, string propertyName, object oldValue, object newValue)
		{
			if (ParentSeries != null)
			{
				switch (propertyName)
				{
				case "Visibility":
					UpdateVisibility();
					break;
				case "Brush":
					UpdateBrush();
					break;
				case "DashArray":
					UpdateDashArray();
					break;
				case "DashCap":
					UpdateDashCap();
					break;
				case "Cursor":
					UpdateCursor();
					break;
				case "Effect":
					UpdateEffect();
					break;
				case "IsDropShadowEnabled":
					_hasUserSetDropShadow = true;
					UpdateIsDropShadowEnabled();
					break;
				case "ShadowBlur":
					UpdateShadowBlur();
					break;
				case "ShadowColor":
					UpdateShadowColor();
					break;
				case "ShadowDirection":
					UpdateShadowDirection();
					break;
				case "ShadowOpacity":
					UpdateShadowOpacity();
					break;
				case "ShadowDepth":
					UpdateShadowDepth();
					break;
				case "EndCap":
					UpdateEndCap();
					break;
				case "IsHitTestVisible":
					UpdateIsHitTestVisible();
					break;
				case "MarkerTemplate":
					UpdateMarkerTemplate();
					break;
				case "MarkerType":
					UpdateMarkerType();
					break;
				case "LegendItemBadgeTemplate":
					UpdateLegendItemBadgeTemplate();
					break;
				case "LegendItemTemplate":
					UpdateLegendItemTemplate();
					break;
				case "LegendItemVisibility":
					UpdateLegendItemVisibility();
					break;
				case "LegendItemBadgeShape":
					UpdateLegendItemBadgeShape();
					break;
				case "LegendItemBadgeMode":
					UpdateLegendItemBadgeMode();
					break;
				case "MarkerBrush":
					UpdateMarkerBrush();
					break;
				case "MarkerOutline":
					UpdateMarkerOutline();
					break;
				case "MarkerStyle":
					UpdateMarkerStyle();
					break;
				case "MarkerThickness":
					UpdateMarkerThickness();
					break;
				case "Opacity":
					UpdateOpacity();
					break;
				case "OpacityMask":
					UpdateOpacityMask();
					break;
				case "ItemsSource":
					UpdateItemsSource();
					break;
				case "Outline":
					UpdateOutline();
					break;
				case "OutlineMode":
					UpdateOutlineMode();
					break;
				case "MarkerFillOpacity":
					UpdateMarkerFillOpacity();
					break;
				case "AreaFillOpacity":
					UpdateAreaFillOpacity();
					break;
				case "RadiusX":
					UpdateRadiusX();
					break;
				case "RadiusY":
					UpdateRadiusY();
					break;
				case "IsSplineShapePartOfRange":
					UpdateIsSplineShapePartOfRangePropertyName();
					break;
				case "StartCap":
					UpdateStartCap();
					break;
				case "Thickness":
					UpdateThickness();
					break;
				case "ToolTip":
					UpdateToolTip();
					break;
				case "UseLightweightMarkers":
					UpdateUseLightweightMarkers();
					break;
				case "ShowDefaultTooltip":
					UpdateShowDefaultTooltip();
					break;
				}
				ParentSeries.RenderSeries(animate: false);
			}
		}
	}
	[WidgetCreatableNonLeaf]
	public class StackedLineSeries : HorizontalStackedSeriesBase
	{
		public override bool IsLineOnly => true;

		[TSSuppressSynthesizedInitializer]
		internal StackedLineSeriesView StackedLineView { get; set; }

		public StackedLineSeries()
		{
			base.DefaultStyleKey = typeof(StackedLineSeries);
		}

		[JAVASuppressWidgetMember]
		public override void OnApplyTemplate()
		{
			base.OnApplyTemplate();
			RenderSeries(animate: false);
		}

		protected override SeriesView CreateView()
		{
			return new StackedLineSeriesView(this);
		}

		protected internal override void OnViewCreated(SeriesView view)
		{
			base.OnViewCreated(view);
			StackedLineView = (StackedLineSeriesView)view;
		}

		protected internal override AxisRange GetRange(Axis axis)
		{
			if (base.ItemsSource == null)
			{
				return null;
			}
			if (axis == base.XAxis)
			{
				return new AxisRange(0.0, base.FastItemsSource.Count - 1);
			}
			if (axis == base.YAxis)
			{
				PrepareData();
				return new AxisRange(base.Minimum, base.Maximum);
			}
			return null;
		}

		internal override CategoryMode PreferredCategoryMode(CategoryAxisBase axis)
		{
			return CategoryMode.Mode0;
		}
	}
	public abstract class HorizontalStackedSeriesBase : StackedSeriesBase
	{
		internal const string XAxisPropertyName = "XAxis";

		public static readonly DependencyProperty XAxisProperty = DependencyProperty.Register("XAxis", typeof(CategoryAxisBase), typeof(HorizontalStackedSeriesBase), new PropertyMetadata(null, delegate(DependencyObject sender, DependencyPropertyChangedEventArgs e)
		{
			((HorizontalStackedSeriesBase)sender).RaisePropertyChanged("XAxis", e.OldValue, e.NewValue);
		}));

		internal const string YAxisPropertyName = "YAxis";

		public static readonly DependencyProperty YAxisProperty = DependencyProperty.Register("YAxis", typeof(NumericYAxis), typeof(HorizontalStackedSeriesBase), new PropertyMetadata(null, delegate(DependencyObject sender, DependencyPropertyChangedEventArgs e)
		{
			((HorizontalStackedSeriesBase)sender).RaisePropertyChanged("YAxis", e.OldValue, e.NewValue);
		}));

		private string _defaultTooltipTemplateName = "HorizontalAnchoredCategorySeriesTooltipTemplate";

		[WFSuppressWidgetMember]
		[JsonAPITreatAsRef]
		[TSWidgetNameBinding("bindAxes:axes:Ig*AxisComponent")]
		public CategoryAxisBase XAxis
		{
			get
			{
				return (CategoryAxisBase)GetValue(XAxisProperty);
			}
			set
			{
				SetValue(XAxisProperty, value);
			}
		}

		[TSWidgetNameBinding("bindAxes:axes:Ig*AxisComponent")]
		[WFSuppressWidgetMember]
		[JsonAPITreatAsRef]
		public NumericYAxis YAxis
		{
			get
			{
				return (NumericYAxis)GetValue(YAxisProperty);
			}
			set
			{
				SetValue(YAxisProperty, value);
			}
		}

		internal override string DefaultTooltipTemplateName => _defaultTooltipTemplateName;

		public override double GetOffsetValue()
		{
			return base.FramePreparer.GetOffset(XAxis, base.View.WindowRect, base.View.Viewport, GetEffectiveViewport(base.View));
		}

		public override double GetCategoryWidth()
		{
			return XAxis.GetCategorySize(base.View.WindowRect, base.View.Viewport, GetEffectiveViewport(base.View));
		}

		internal override Axis GetXAxis()
		{
			return XAxis;
		}

		internal override Axis GetYAxis()
		{
			return YAxis;
		}

		public override Axis[] GetAxes()
		{
			return new Axis[2]
			{
				GetXAxis(),
				GetYAxis()
			};
		}

		internal override bool UpdateNumericAxisRange()
		{
			if (YAxis != null)
			{
				return YAxis.UpdateRange();
			}
			return false;
		}

		protected internal override void UpdateActualAreaFillOpacity()
		{
			if (!(base.SeriesViewer is XamDataChart xamDataChart))
			{
				return;
			}
			base.ActualAreaFillOpacity = (double.IsNaN(base.AreaFillOpacity) ? xamDataChart.ChartView.DefaultAreaFillOpacity : base.AreaFillOpacity);
			foreach (StackedFragmentSeries item in base.ActualSeries)
			{
				item.UpdateAreaFillOpacity();
			}
		}

		protected override void PropertyUpdatedOverride(object sender, string propertyName, object oldValue, object newValue)
		{
			base.PropertyUpdatedOverride(sender, propertyName, oldValue, newValue);
			if (!(propertyName == "XAxis"))
			{
				if (propertyName == "YAxis" && oldValue != newValue)
				{
					DeregisterForAxis(oldValue as Axis);
					RegisterForAxis(newValue as Axis);
					base.CategoryView.BucketCalculator.CalculateBuckets(base.Resolution);
					UpdateNumericAxisRange();
					RenderSeries(animate: false);
					NotifyThumbnailAppearanceChanged();
				}
			}
			else if (oldValue != newValue)
			{
				DeregisterForAxis(oldValue as Axis);
				RegisterForAxis(newValue as Axis);
				base.CategoryView.BucketCalculator.CalculateBuckets(base.Resolution);
				RenderSeries(animate: false);
				NotifyThumbnailAppearanceChanged();
			}
		}

		[XamSuppressWidgetMember]
		[UwpSuppressWidgetMember]
		[WFSuppressWidgetMember]
		public bool CanUseAsYAxis(object axis)
		{
			if (axis is NumericYAxis)
			{
				return true;
			}
			return false;
		}

		[XamSuppressWidgetMember]
		[UwpSuppressWidgetMember]
		[WFSuppressWidgetMember]
		public bool CanUseAsXAxis(object axis)
		{
			if (axis is CategoryXAxis || ((Axis)axis).IsDateTime)
			{
				return true;
			}
			return false;
		}
	}

		{

			Series.CollectionChanged += Series_CollectionChanged;
			base.FramePreparer = new StackedSeriesFramePreparer(this, StackedView, this, this, StackedView.BucketCalculator);
			StackedSeriesManager = new StackedSeriesManager(this);
			AutoGeneratedSeries = new StackedSeriesCollection();
			AutoGeneratedSeries.CollectionChanged += Series_CollectionChanged;
			AutoGeneratedSeries.CollectionResetting += AutoGeneratedSeries_CollectionResetting;
