		protected internal override void ForSubVisualSeries(Func<Series, bool> action)
		{
			for (int i = 0; i < StackedSeriesManager.SeriesVisual.Count; i++)
			{
				AnchoredCategorySeries arg = StackedSeriesManager.SeriesVisual[i];
				if (!action(arg))
				{
					break;
				}
			}
		}

		private void AutoGeneratedSeries_CollectionResetting(object sender, EventArgs e)
		{
			foreach (StackedFragmentSeries item in AutoGeneratedSeries)
			{
				if (StackedSeriesManager != null && StackedSeriesManager.SeriesLogical.Contains(item))
				{
					item.ParentSeries = null;
					StackedSeriesManager.SeriesLogical.Remove(item);
				}
			}
		}

		private void Series_CollectionResetting(object sender, EventArgs e)
		{
			foreach (StackedFragmentSeries item in Series)
			{
				if (StackedSeriesManager != null && StackedSeriesManager.SeriesLogical.Contains(item))
				{
					item.ParentSeries = null;
					StackedSeriesManager.SeriesLogical.Remove(item);
				}
			}
		}

		private void Series_CollectionChanged(object sender, NotifyCollectionChangedEventArgs e)
		{
			if (e.OldItems != null)
			{
				foreach (StackedFragmentSeries oldItem in e.OldItems)
				{
					if (StackedSeriesManager != null && StackedSeriesManager.SeriesLogical.Contains(oldItem))
					{
						oldItem.ParentSeries = null;
						StackedSeriesManager.SeriesLogical.Remove(oldItem);
					}
				}
			}
			if (e.NewItems != null)
			{
				int num = e.NewStartingIndex;
				foreach (StackedFragmentSeries newItem in e.NewItems)
				{
					if (StackedSeriesManager != null && !StackedSeriesManager.SeriesLogical.Contains(newItem))
					{
						newItem.ParentSeries = this;
						newItem.UpdateCursor();
						newItem.UpdateEffect();
						newItem.UpdateIsDropShadowEnabled();
						newItem.UpdateShadowBlur();
						newItem.UpdateShadowColor();
						newItem.UpdateShadowDirection();
						newItem.UpdateShadowOpacity();
						newItem.UpdateShadowDepth();
						newItem.UpdateShowDefaultTooltip();
						newItem.UpdateBrush();
						newItem.UpdateDashArray();
						newItem.UpdateHighlightingFadeOpacity();
						newItem.UpdateDashCap();
						newItem.UpdateEndCap();
						newItem.UpdateIsHitTestVisible();
						newItem.UpdateLegendItemBadgeTemplate();
						newItem.UpdateLegendItemTemplate();
						newItem.UpdateLegendItemVisibility();
						newItem.UpdateMarkerTemplate();
						newItem.UpdateMarkerType();
						newItem.UpdateMarkerBrush();
						newItem.UpdateMarkerOutline();
						newItem.UpdateMarkerStyle();
						newItem.UpdateMarkerTemplate();
						newItem.UpdateMarkerThickness();
						newItem.UpdateOpacity();
						newItem.UpdateOpacityMask();
						newItem.UpdateOutline();
						newItem.UpdateAreaFillOpacity();
						newItem.UpdateRadiusX();
						newItem.UpdateRadiusY();
						newItem.UpdateStartCap();
						newItem.UpdateThickness();
						newItem.UpdateToolTip();
						newItem.UpdateMarkerFillOpacity();
						newItem.UpdateOutlineMode();
						newItem.UpdateUseLightweightMarkers();
						newItem.UpdateVisibility();
						if (!AutoGenerateSeries)
						{
							StackedSeriesManager.SeriesLogical.Insert(num, newItem);
							num++;
						}
					}
				}
			}
			if (!AutoGenerateSeries)
			{
				UpdateAxisRanges();
			}
		}

		private DependencyObject GetFragment(DependencyObject element)
		{
			DependencyObject parent = VisualTreeHelper.GetParent(element);
			if (parent is FragmentBase)
			{
				return parent;
			}
			if (parent == null)
			{
				return null;
			}
			return GetFragment(parent);
		}

		public override void SimulateHover(Point point)
		{
			HitTestResult hitTestResult = VisualTreeHelper.HitTest(this, point);
			if (hitTestResult == null || hitTestResult.VisualHit == null)
			{
				if (base.SeriesInteractionManager.MouseIsOver)
				{
					OnMouseLeave(point, null, null);
				}
				return;
			}
			DependencyObject visualHit = hitTestResult.VisualHit;
			FragmentBase fragmentBase = (FragmentBase)GetFragment(visualHit);
			if (fragmentBase != null)
			{
				object data = null;
				if (!fragmentBase.SeriesInteractionManager.MouseIsOver)
				{
					fragmentBase.OnMouseEnter(point, visualHit, data, isFinger: false);
				}
				fragmentBase.OnMouseMove(point, visualHit, data);
			}
		}

		internal override CategoryFramePreparer GetFramePreparer(CategorySeriesView view)
		{
			if (view != null && view.IsThumbnailView)
			{
				if (view.IsAlternateView)
				{
					return new StackedSeriesFramePreparer(this, view, view, this, view.BucketCalculator);
				}
				CategorySeriesView categorySeriesView = base.ThumbnailView as CategorySeriesView;
				return new StackedSeriesFramePreparer(this, categorySeriesView, base.SeriesViewer.View.OverviewPlusDetailViewportHost, this, categorySeriesView.BucketCalculator);
			}
			return base.FramePreparer;
		}

		internal override void PrepareFrame(CategoryFrame frame, CategorySeriesView view)
		{
			frame.ClearFrame();
			PrepareData();
			GetFramePreparer(view).PrepareFrame(frame, view);
		}

		protected internal override void ClearRendering(bool wipeClean, SeriesView view)
		{
			base.ClearRendering(wipeClean, view);
			foreach (StackedFragmentSeries item in ActualSeries)
			{
				if (item.VisualSeriesLink != null)
				{
					item.VisualSeriesLink.ClearRendering(wipeClean, item.VisualSeriesLink.View);
				}
			}
		}

		internal void CalculateStackedValues()
		{
			PrepareData();
		}

		internal virtual void UpdateAxisRanges()
		{
			GetXAxis()?.UpdateRange(immediate: true);
			GetYAxis()?.UpdateRange(immediate: true);
		}

		public override bool ScrollIntoView(object item)
		{
			int num = ((base.FastItemsSource != null) ? base.FastItemsSource.IndexOf(item) : (-1));
			Rect windowRect = ((base.SeriesViewer != null) ? base.SeriesViewer.ActualWindowRect : Rect.Empty);
			_ = base.View.Viewport;
			Rect rect = new Rect(0.0, 0.0, 1.0, 1.0);
			Rect effectiveViewportForUnitViewport = GetEffectiveViewportForUnitViewport(base.View);
			if (num >= 0)
			{
				Axis xAxis = GetXAxis();
				if (xAxis != null)
				{
					ScalerParams p = new ScalerParams(rect, rect, xAxis.IsInverted, effectiveViewportForUnitViewport);
					double num2 = xAxis.GetScaledValue(num, p);
					if (num2 < windowRect.Left + 0.1 * windowRect.Width)
					{
						num2 += 0.4 * windowRect.Width;
					}
					if (num2 > windowRect.Right - 0.1 * windowRect.Width)
					{
						num2 -= 0.4 * windowRect.Width;
					}
					windowRect.X = num2 - 0.5 * windowRect.Width;
				}
				Axis yAxis = GetYAxis();
				if (yAxis != null && Highs != null && num < Highs.Length)
				{
					ScalerParams p2 = new ScalerParams(rect, rect, yAxis.IsInverted, effectiveViewportForUnitViewport);
					double scaledValue = yAxis.GetScaledValue(Highs[num], p2);
					double num3 = yAxis.GetScaledValue(Lows[num], p2);
					if (!double.IsNaN(scaledValue) && !double.IsNaN(num3))
					{
						double num4 = Math.Abs(num3 - scaledValue);
						if (windowRect.Height < num4)
						{
							windowRect.Height = num4;
							windowRect.Y = Math.Min(num3, scaledValue);
						}
						else
						{
							if (num3 < windowRect.Top + 0.1 * windowRect.Height)
							{
								num3 += 0.4 * windowRect.Height;
							}
							if (num3 > windowRect.Bottom - 0.1 * windowRect.Height)
							{
								num3 -= 0.4 * windowRect.Height;
							}
							windowRect.Y = num3 - 0.5 * windowRect.Height;
						}
					}
				}
				base.SyncLink.WindowNotify(base.SeriesViewer, windowRect, force: true);
			}
			return num >= 0;
		}

		protected internal override AxisRange GetRange(Axis axis)
		{
			if (Lows == null || Lows.Length == 0 || Highs == null || Highs.Length == 0)
			{
				return null;
			}
			if (axis == GetXAxis())
			{
				int num = Math.Min(Lows.Length, Highs.Length);
				return new AxisRange(0.0, num - 1);
			}
			if (axis == GetYAxis())
			{
				return new AxisRange(Minimum, Maximum);
			}
			return null;
		}

		protected internal override bool ShouldDisplayMarkers()
		{
			return false;
		}

		protected override void DataUpdatedOverride(FastItemsSourceEventAction action, int position, int count, string propertyName)
		{
			PrepareData();
			if (action == FastItemsSourceEventAction.Reset && AutoGenerateSeries && base.ItemsSource is GroupBy)
			{
				GenerateSeries();
			}
			UpdateNumericAxisRange();
			RenderSeries(animate: false);
		}

		internal virtual CategorySeriesView GetSeriesView()
		{
			return StackedView;
		}

		internal virtual double GetScaledWorldZeroValue()
		{
			double result = 0.0;
			Rect windowRect = base.View.WindowRect;
			Rect viewport = base.View.Viewport;
			Rect effectiveViewport = GetEffectiveViewport(base.View);
			NumericYAxis numericYAxis = GetYAxis() as NumericYAxis;
			if (!windowRect.IsEmpty && !viewport.IsEmpty && numericYAxis != null)
			{
				ScalerParams p = new ScalerParams(windowRect, viewport, numericYAxis.IsInverted, effectiveViewport);
				result = numericYAxis.GetScaledValue(numericYAxis.ReferenceValue, p);
			}
			return result;
		}

		internal virtual double GetUnscaledWorldZeroValue()
		{
			if (GetYAxis() is NumericYAxis numericYAxis)
			{
				return numericYAxis.ReferenceValue;
			}
			return 0.0;
		}

		internal virtual int GetFragmentSeriesIndex(StackedFragmentSeries series)
		{
			if (base.Index >= 0 && ActualSeries != null && ActualSeries.Count != 0)
			{
				return base.Index + ActualSeries.IndexOf(series);
			}
			return -1;
		}

		internal virtual int GetFragmentItemIndex(Point world)
		{
			Rect window = ((base.SeriesViewer != null) ? base.SeriesViewer.ActualWindowRect : Rect.Empty);
			Rect viewport = base.View.Viewport;
			Rect effectiveViewport = GetEffectiveViewport(base.View);
			CategoryAxisBase categoryAxisBase = GetXAxis() as CategoryAxisBase;
			int result = -1;
			if (categoryAxisBase != null && !window.IsEmpty && !viewport.IsEmpty)
			{
				ScalerParams p = new ScalerParams(window, viewport, categoryAxisBase.IsInverted, effectiveViewport);
				Rect contentViewport = GetContentViewport(base.View);
				double unscaledValue = categoryAxisBase.GetUnscaledValue(contentViewport.Left, p);
				double unscaledValue2 = categoryAxisBase.GetUnscaledValue(contentViewport.Right, p);
				double num = (world.X - window.Left) / window.Width;
				double num2 = unscaledValue + num * (unscaledValue2 - unscaledValue);
				if (categoryAxisBase.CategoryMode != CategoryMode.Mode0)
				{
					num2 -= 0.5;
				}
				result = (int)Math.Round(num2);
			}
			return result;
		}

		internal virtual bool ValidateFragmentSeries(AnchoredCategorySeries series, Rect viewportRect, Rect windowRect, SeriesView view)
		{
			bool result = true;
			CategoryAxisBase categoryAxisBase = GetXAxis() as CategoryAxisBase;
			NumericYAxis numericYAxis = GetYAxis() as NumericYAxis;
			if (!view.HasSurface() || windowRect.IsEmpty || viewportRect.IsEmpty || categoryAxisBase == null || categoryAxisBase.ItemsSource == null || numericYAxis == null || base.FastItemsSource == null || categoryAxisBase.SeriesViewer == null || numericYAxis.SeriesViewer == null || numericYAxis.ActualMinimumValue == numericYAxis.ActualMaximumValue)
			{
				result = false;
			}
			int bucketSize = ((CategorySeriesView)view).BucketCalculator.BucketSize;
			if (series.ValueColumn == null || series.ValueColumn.Count == 0 || bucketSize < 1 || series.Visibility != Visibility.Visible)
			{
				result = false;
			}
			return result;
		}

		internal void GenerateSeries()
		{
			if (base.SeriesViewer == null || StackedSeriesManager == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			if (!AutoGenerateSeries)
			{
				AutoGeneratedSeries.Clear();
				foreach (StackedFragmentSeries item in Series)
				{
					if (!StackedSeriesManager.SeriesLogical.Contains(item))
					{
						StackedSeriesManager.SeriesLogical.Add(item);
					}
				}
				UpdateAxisRanges();
				return;
			}
			GroupBy groupBy = base.ItemsSource as GroupBy;
			bool flag = false;
			if (groupBy != null)
			{
				Dictionary<string, bool> dictionary = new Dictionary<string, bool>();
				for (int i = 0; i < groupBy.SeriesKeys.Count; i++)
				{
					dictionary.Add(groupBy.SeriesKeys[i], value: true);
					if (!_previousSeriesKeys.ContainsKey(groupBy.SeriesKeys[i]))
					{
						flag = true;
					}
				}
				foreach (string key in _previousSeriesKeys.Keys)
				{
					if (!dictionary.ContainsKey(key))
					{
						flag = true;
					}
				}
			}
			if (!flag)
			{
				return;
			}
			AutoGeneratedSeries.Clear();
			if (groupBy == null || string.IsNullOrEmpty(groupBy.ValueMemberPath))
			{
				return;
			}
			_previousSeriesKeys.Clear();
			for (int j = 0; j < groupBy.NumberOfSeries; j++)
			{
				_previousSeriesKeys.Add(groupBy.SeriesKeys[j], value: true);
				string valueMemberPath = groupBy.SeriesKeys[j] + "_" + groupBy.ValueMemberPath.Replace("[", "").Replace("]", "");
				StackedFragmentSeries stackedFragmentSeries = new StackedFragmentSeries
				{
					ParentSeries = this,
					Chart = base.SeriesViewer,
					ValueMemberPath = valueMemberPath
				};
				AutoGeneratedSeries.Add(stackedFragmentSeries);
				stackedFragmentSeries.Index = GetFragmentSeriesIndex(stackedFragmentSeries);
				StackedSeriesManager.SeriesLogical.Add(stackedFragmentSeries);
				StackedSeriesCreatedEventArgs e = new StackedSeriesCreatedEventArgs(stackedFragmentSeries);
				if (this.SeriesCreated != null)
				{
					this.SeriesCreated(stackedFragmentSeries, e);
				}
			}
			RenderSeries(animate: false);
		}

		internal override void RenderFrame(CategoryFrame frame, CategorySeriesView view)
		{
			base.RenderFrame(frame, view);
			StackedSeriesManager.RenderSeries();
		}

		internal virtual void RenderFragment(AnchoredCategorySeries series, CategoryFrame frame, CategorySeriesView view)
		{
		}

		protected virtual void PrepareData()
		{
			if (base.FastItemsSource == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			int count = base.FastItemsSource.Count;
			Highs = new double[count];
			Lows = new double[count];
			Minimum = double.PositiveInfinity;
			Maximum = double.NegativeInfinity;
			double num = 0.0;
			foreach (StackedFragmentSeries item in ActualSeries)
			{
				if (item.ItemsSource != null && item.VisualSeriesLink == null)
				{
					continue;
				}
				if (item.ItemsSource != null)
				{
					item.ValueColumn = item.VisualSeriesLink.ValueColumn;
				}
				if (item.ItemsSource == null)
				{
					base.FastItemsSource.DeregisterColumn(item.ValueColumn);
					item.ValueColumn = RegisterDoubleColumn(item.ValueMemberPath);
				}
				if (item.VisualSeriesLink != null && item.ItemsSource == null)
				{
					item.VisualSeriesLink.ShouldSuspendChangedNotification = true;
					item.VisualSeriesLink.ValueColumn = item.ValueColumn;
					item.VisualSeriesLink.ShouldSuspendChangedNotification = false;
				}
				item.Positive = true;
				if (item.ValueColumn == null)
				{
					continue;
				}
				item.HighValues.Clear();
				item.LowValues.Clear();
				for (int i = 0; i < item.ValueColumn.Count; i++)
				{
					double num2 = item.ValueColumn[i];
					if (num2 < num)
					{
						item.HighValues.Add(num);
						item.LowValues.Add(Lows[i]);
						Lows[i] += num2;
						if (item.Positive)
						{
							item.Positive = false;
						}
					}
					else if (num2 >= num)
					{
						item.HighValues.Add(Highs[i]);
						item.LowValues.Add(num);
						Highs[i] += num2;
					}
					else if (double.IsNaN(num2) || double.IsInfinity(num2))
					{
						item.HighValues.Add(Highs[i]);
						item.LowValues.Add(Lows[i]);
					}
				}
			}
			for (int j = 0; j < count; j++)
			{
				Minimum = Math.Min(Minimum, Lows[j]);
				Maximum = Math.Max(Maximum, Highs[j]);
			}
		}

		protected internal override void RenderThumbnail(Rect viewportRect, RenderSurface surface)
		{
			bool thumbnailDirty = base.ThumbnailDirty;
			base.RenderThumbnail(viewportRect, surface);
			if (!thumbnailDirty)
			{
				base.View.PrepSurface(surface);
				return;
			}
			base.View.PrepSurface(surface);
			if (ClearAndAbortIfInvalid(base.ThumbnailView))
			{
				return;
			}
			foreach (StackedFragmentSeries item in Series)
			{
				item.VisualSeriesLink.RenderThumbnail(viewportRect, surface);
			}
			base.ThumbnailDirty = false;
		}

		public override void RenderAlternateView(Rect viewportRect, Rect windowRect, RenderSurface surface, string viewIdentifier, double effectiveScalingRatio)
		{
			base.RenderAlternateView(viewportRect, windowRect, surface, viewIdentifier, effectiveScalingRatio);
			SeriesView seriesView = base.SeriesInteractionManager.AlternateViews[viewIdentifier];
			((CategorySeriesView)seriesView).BucketCalculator.CalculateBuckets(base.Resolution);
			seriesView.PrepAltSurface(surface);
			if (ClearAndAbortIfInvalid(seriesView))
			{
				return;
			}
			if (AlternateFrame == null)
			{
				AlternateFrame = new CategoryFrame(3);
			}
			AlternateFrame.ClearFrame();
			PrepareData();
			GetFramePreparer((CategorySeriesView)seriesView).PrepareFrame(AlternateFrame, seriesView);
			RenderFrame(AlternateFrame, (CategorySeriesView)seriesView);
			foreach (StackedFragmentSeries item in Series)
			{
				item.VisualSeriesLink.RenderAlternateView(viewportRect, windowRect, surface, viewIdentifier, effectiveScalingRatio);
			}
		}

		[TSSuppressWidgetMember]
		[JAVASuppressWidgetMember]
		public override SeriesVisualData ExportVisualData()
		{
			object obj = base.SeriesVisualDataManager.ExportStackedVisualData(this, base.Viewport);
			foreach (StackedFragmentSeries item in Series)
			{
				object obj2 = base.SeriesVisualDataManager.CreateFragmentVisualData(this, base.Viewport, item.GetType().Name, item.Name);
				item.VisualSeriesLink.View.ExportViewShapes(obj2);
				base.SeriesVisualDataManager.AddSubSeriesVisualData(obj, obj2);
			}
			ExportVisualDataOverride(obj);
			base.View.ExportViewShapes(obj);
			return (SeriesVisualData)obj;
		}

	[XamWidget]

	[TSWidget]
	public class StackedSeriesCollection : ObservableCollection<StackedFragmentSeries>
	{
		public StackedFragmentSeries this[string seriesName]
		{
			get
			{
				using (IEnumerator<StackedFragmentSeries> enumerator = GetEnumerator())
				{
					while (enumerator.MoveNext())
					{
						StackedFragmentSeries current = enumerator.Current;
						if (seriesName == current.Name)
						{
							return current;
						}
					}
				}
				return null;
			}
		}

		public event EventHandler<EventArgs> CollectionResetting;

		protected override void ClearItems()
		{
			if (this.CollectionResetting != null)
			{
				this.CollectionResetting(this, null);
			}
			base.ClearItems();
		}
	}
	internal class StackedSeriesFramePreparer : CategoryFramePreparer
	{
		public StackedSeriesFramePreparer(IIsCategoryBased host)
			: base(host)
		{
		}

		public StackedSeriesFramePreparer(IIsCategoryBased host, ISupportsMarkers markersHost, IProvidesViewport viewportHost, ISupportsErrorBars errorBarsHost, IBucketizer bucketizingHost)
			: base(host, markersHost, viewportHost, errorBarsHost, bucketizingHost)
		{
		}

		protected override ValuesHolder GetValues(PreparationParams p)
		{
			SingleValuesHolder singleValuesHolder = new SingleValuesHolder();
			if (base.CategoryBasedHost is StackedColumnSeries || base.CategoryBasedHost is StackedBarSeries)
			{
				StackedSeriesBase stackedSeriesBase = base.CategoryBasedHost as StackedSeriesBase;
				if (stackedSeriesBase.ActualSeries.Count > 0)
				{
					singleValuesHolder.Values = stackedSeriesBase.ActualSeries[0].ValueColumn;
				}
				return singleValuesHolder;
			}
			IList<double> valueColumn = base.ValuesProvider.ValueColumn;
			singleValuesHolder.Values = valueColumn;
			return singleValuesHolder;
		}

		protected override int PrepareData(PreparationParams p, ValuesHolder h, double offset, bool markers, bool errorBars)
		{
			int num = 0;
			bool isCluster = false;
			bool isSortingScaler = p.SortingScaler != null;
			IDetectsCollisions collisionAvoider = base.CategoryBasedHost.ProvideCollisionDetector();
			bool useHighMarkerFidelity = p.UseHighMarkerFidelity;
			Rect effectiveViewportRect = p.EffectiveViewportRect;
			bool mayContainUnknowns = base.CategoryBasedHost.MayContainUnknowns;
			ScalerParams scalerParams = new ScalerParams(p.WindowRect, p.ViewportRect, p.Scaler.IsInverted, effectiveViewportRect);
			ScalerParams scalerParams2 = new ScalerParams(p.WindowRect, p.ViewportRect, p.YScaler.IsInverted, effectiveViewportRect);
			scalerParams2.ReferenceValue = base.CategoryBasedHost.GetHostReferenceValue();
			double singlePixelSpan = p.Scaler.GetUnscaledValue(2.0, scalerParams) - p.Scaler.GetUnscaledValue(1.0, scalerParams);
			_ = p.WindowRect;
			_ = p.ViewportRect;
			bool flag = p.YScaler is NumericAxisBase && ((NumericAxisBase)p.YScaler).IsReallyLogarithmic;
			for (int i = p.FirstBucket; i <= p.LastBucket; i++)
			{
				double[] endBucket;
				double[] array = ((p.SortingScaler != null) ? SortingBucketize(p, ref i, h, singlePixelSpan, out isCluster, out endBucket, offset) : (mayContainUnknowns ? base.BucketizingHost.GetBucket(i) : base.BucketizingHost.GetBucketWithoutUnknowns(i)));
				bool flag2 = !flag || (flag && array[1] > 0.0);
				double num2 = array[0];
				if (!double.IsNaN(array[0]))
				{
					ScaleBucketValues(p, array, offset, isSortingScaler, scalerParams, scalerParams2);
					p.Frame.Buckets.Add(array);
					int num3 = i * p.BucketSize;
					if (p.SortingScaler != null && p.SortingScaler.SortedIndices != null && num3 >= 0 && num3 < p.SortingScaler.SortedIndices.Count)
					{
						num3 = p.SortingScaler.SortedIndices[num3];
					}
					double[] array2 = array;
					if (useHighMarkerFidelity && num3 < h.Count)
					{
						array2 = new double[array.Length];
						array2[0] = num2;
						StoreYValues(h, num3, useTemp: true, p.IsFragment);
						array2[1] = h.TempY0;
						array2[2] = h.TempY1;
						ScaleBucketValues(p, array2, offset, isSortingScaler, scalerParams, scalerParams2);
					}
					if (markers && flag2 && PrepareMarker(p.Frame, array2, collisionAvoider, Math.Min(num3, h.Count - 1), num, p.Frame.Buckets.Count - 1))
					{
						num++;
					}
				}
			}
			return num;
		}

		protected override bool PrepareMarker(CategoryFrame frame, double[] bucket, IDetectsCollisions collisionAvoider, int itemIndex, int markerCount, int markerBucket)
		{
			double num = bucket[0];
			double num2 = bucket[1];
			if (base.MarkersHost is IBarSeries)
			{
				num2 = bucket[0];
				num = bucket[1];
			}
			Rect rc = new Rect(num - 5.0, num2 - 5.0, 11.0, 11.0);
			if (!double.IsNaN(num) && !double.IsNaN(num2) && !double.IsInfinity(num) && !double.IsInfinity(num2) && collisionAvoider.TryAdd(rc))
			{
				frame.Markers.Add(new Point(num, num2));
				base.MarkersHost.UpdateMarkerTemplate(markerCount, itemIndex, markerBucket);
				return true;
			}
			return false;
		}
	}

	public class StackedSplineAreaSeries : HorizontalStackedSeriesBase
	{
		private const string IsSplineShapePartOfRangePropertyName = "IsSplineShapePartOfRange";

		public static readonly DependencyProperty IsSplineShapePartOfRangeProperty = DependencyProperty.Register("IsSplineShapePartOfRange", typeof(bool), typeof(StackedSplineAreaSeries), new PropertyMetadata(false, delegate(DependencyObject sender, DependencyPropertyChangedEventArgs e)
		{
			((StackedSplineAreaSeries)sender).RaisePropertyChanged("IsSplineShapePartOfRange", e.OldValue, e.NewValue);
		}));

		[WidgetDefaultBoolean(false)]
		public bool IsSplineShapePartOfRange
		{
			get
			{
				return (bool)GetValue(IsSplineShapePartOfRangeProperty);
			}
			set
			{
				SetValue(IsSplineShapePartOfRangeProperty, value);
			}
		}

		public override bool IsArea => true;

		public override bool IsSpline => true;

		[TSSuppressSynthesizedInitializer]
		internal StackedSplineAreaSeriesView StackedSplineAreaView { get; set; }

		public StackedSplineAreaSeries()
		{
			base.DefaultStyleKey = typeof(StackedSplineAreaSeries);
		}

		[JAVASuppressWidgetMember]
		[TSSuppressWidgetMember]
		public override void OnApplyTemplate()
		{
			base.OnApplyTemplate();
			RenderSeries(animate: false);
		}

		protected override SeriesView CreateView()
		{
			return new StackedSplineAreaSeriesView(this);
		}

		protected internal override void OnViewCreated(SeriesView view)
		{
			base.OnViewCreated(view);
			StackedSplineAreaView = (StackedSplineAreaSeriesView)view;
		}

		protected internal override AxisRange GetRange(Axis axis)
		{
			if (base.ItemsSource == null)
			{
				return null;
			}
			if (axis == base.XAxis)
			{
				return new AxisRange(0.0, base.FastItemsSource.Count - 1);
			}
			if (axis == base.YAxis)
			{
				PrepareData();
				return new AxisRange(base.Minimum, base.Maximum);
			}
			return null;
		}

		internal override CategoryMode PreferredCategoryMode(CategoryAxisBase axis)
		{
			return CategoryMode.Mode0;
		}

		protected override void PropertyUpdatedOverride(object sender, string propertyName, object oldValue, object newValue)
		{
			base.PropertyUpdatedOverride(sender, propertyName, oldValue, newValue);
			if (!(propertyName == "IsSplineShapePartOfRange"))
			{
				return;
			}
			foreach (StackedFragmentSeries item in base.ActualSeries)
			{
				item.UpdateIsSplineShapePartOfRangePropertyName();
			}
		}
	}

		private double GetScaledValueHelper(double unscaledValue, Rect windowRect, Rect viewportRect)
		{
			int num = ((base.CategoryMode == CategoryMode.Mode0) ? (CachedItemsCount - 1) : CachedItemsCount);
			if (num < 0)

			}

			if (!base.IsInvertedCached)
			{
				num2 = 1.0 - num2;
			}
			return viewportRect.Top + viewportRect.Height * (num2 - windowRect.Top) / windowRect.Height;
		}

		[JAVASuppressWidgetMember]

		{

				num = num * p.ViewportRect.Height + p.ViewportRect.Top;
				return GetUnscaledValue(num, NumericScaler.UnitRect, p.EffectiveViewportRect, base.CategoryMode);
			}
			return GetUnscaledValue(scaledValue, p.WindowRect, p.ViewportRect, base.CategoryMode);
		}

		internal override double GetGroupSize(Rect windowRect, Rect viewportRect, Rect effectiveViewportRect)

				num2 = Math.Min(base.Overlap, 1.0);
			}
			double num3 = 1.0 - 0.5 * num;
			return Math.Max(GetCategorySize(windowRect, viewportRect, effectiveViewportRect) * num3 / ((double)base.Mode2GroupCount - (double)(base.Mode2GroupCount - 1) * num2), 1.0);
		}

		internal override double GetGroupCenter(int index, Rect windowRect, Rect viewportRect, Rect effectiveViewportRect)
		{
			double num = 0.5;
			if (base.Mode2GroupCount > 1)
			{
				double num2 = 0.0;
				if (!double.IsNaN(base.Gap))
				{
					num2 = MathUtil.Clamp(base.Gap, 0.0, 1.0);
				}
				double num3 = 0.0;
				if (!double.IsNaN(base.Overlap))
				{
					num3 = Math.Min(base.Overlap, 1.0);
				}
				double num4 = 1.0 - 0.5 * num2;
				double num5 = num4 / ((double)base.Mode2GroupCount - (double)(base.Mode2GroupCount - 1) * num3);
				double num6 = (num4 - num5) / (double)(base.Mode2GroupCount - 1);
				num = 0.25 * num2 + 0.5 * num5 + (double)index * num6;
			}
			return GetCategorySize(windowRect, viewportRect, effectiveViewportRect) * num;
		}

		public void ScrollIntoView(object item)
		{

			int num = ((!windowRect.IsEmpty && !viewportRect.IsEmpty && base.FastItemsSource != null) ? base.FastItemsSource.IndexOf(item) : (-1));
			double num2 = ((num > -1) ? GetScaledValue(num, p) : double.NaN);
			if (double.IsNaN(num2) || !base.SeriesViewer.IsSyncReady)
			{
				return;
			}
			if (!double.IsNaN(num2))
			{
				if (num2 < windowRect.Top + 0.1 * windowRect.Height)
				{
					num2 += 0.4 * windowRect.Height;
					windowRect.Y = num2 - 0.5 * windowRect.Height;
				}
				if (num2 > windowRect.Bottom - 0.1 * windowRect.Height)
				{
					num2 -= 0.4 * windowRect.Height;
					windowRect.Y = num2 - 0.5 * windowRect.Height;

			}

		}

		protected override void RenderAxisOverride(bool animate)
		{
			base.RenderAxisOverride(animate);
			Rect rect = ((base.SeriesViewer != null) ? base.SeriesViewer.ActualWindowRect : Rect.Empty);
			Rect viewportRect = base.ViewportRect;
			Rect currentEffectiveViewport = GetCurrentEffectiveViewport();

			GeometryCollection axisLinesGeometry = View.GetAxisLinesGeometry();
			GeometryCollection stripsGeometry = View.GetStripsGeometry();
			GeometryCollection majorLinesGeometry = View.GetMajorLinesGeometry();
			GeometryCollection minorLinesGeometry = View.GetMinorLinesGeometry();
			PathRenderingInfo axisLinesPathInfo = View.GetAxisLinesPathInfo();
			PathRenderingInfo majorLinesPathInfo = View.GetMajorLinesPathInfo();
			PathRenderingInfo minorLinesPathInfo = View.GetMinorLinesPathInfo();
			UpdateLineVisibility();

			ClearMarks(stripsGeometry);

			}

			if (base.LabelSettings != null)
			{

			}
			if (base.ItemsSource == null || base.FastItemsSource == null || base.FastItemsSource.Count == 0)
			{
				base.TextBlocks.Count = 0;
				base.AnnotationTextBlocks.Count = 0;
				base.AnnotationBackings.Count = 0;

			}
			else
			{
				if (rect.IsEmpty || viewportRect.IsEmpty)
				{
					return;
				}
				double unscaledValue = GetUnscaledValue(contentViewport.Top, p);
				double unscaledValue2 = GetUnscaledValue(contentViewport.Bottom, p);
				if (!base.IsInverted)
				{
					unscaledValue = Math.Ceiling(unscaledValue);
					unscaledValue2 = Math.Floor(unscaledValue2);
				}
				else
				{
					unscaledValue = Math.Floor(unscaledValue);
					unscaledValue2 = Math.Ceiling(unscaledValue2);
				}
				double crossingValue = viewportRect.Left;

				double num = Math.Min(unscaledValue, unscaledValue2);
				double num2 = Math.Max(unscaledValue, unscaledValue2);
				LinearCategorySnapper linearCategorySnapper = new LinearCategorySnapper(num, num2, contentViewport.Height, Interval, base.CategoryMode, ResolveHeuristicResolution());
				double num3 = linearCategorySnapper.Interval;
				while (!HasUserInterval() && num3 < 10.0 && ShouldUseLowerInterval(num3, rect, viewportRect, currentEffectiveViewport))
				{
					num3 -= 1.0;
				}
				if (linearCategorySnapper.Interval != num3)
				{
					linearCategorySnapper = new LinearCategorySnapper(num, num2, contentViewport.Height, num3, base.CategoryMode, ResolveHeuristicResolution());
				}
				double num4 = Math.Floor((num - 0.0) / linearCategorySnapper.Interval);
				double num5 = Math.Ceiling((num2 - 0.0) / linearCategorySnapper.Interval);
				if (!double.IsNaN(num4) && !double.IsNaN(num5))
				{
					int num6 = (int)num4;
					int num7 = (int)num5;
					double num8 = GetScaledValue(0.0 + (double)num6 * linearCategorySnapper.Interval, p);
					double num9 = Math.Abs(GetScaledValue(linearCategorySnapper.Interval, p) - GetScaledValue(0.0, p));
					base.LabelPanel.Interval = GetScaledValue(linearCategorySnapper.Interval, p);
					for (int i = num6; i <= num7; i++)
					{
						double scaledValue = GetScaledValue(0.0 + (double)(i + 1) * linearCategorySnapper.Interval, p);
						if (num8 <= contentViewport.Bottom)
						{
							if (i % 2 == 0)
							{
								HorizontalStrip(stripsGeometry, num8, scaledValue, viewportRect);
							}
							HorizontalLine(majorLinesGeometry, num8, viewportRect, majorLinesPathInfo, isAxisLine: false);
							base.MajorLinePositions.Add(num8);
						}
						if (base.CategoryMode != CategoryMode.Mode0 && base.Mode2GroupCount != 0 && base.ShouldRenderMinorLines)
						{
							if (MinorInterval > 0.0 && MinorInterval < linearCategorySnapper.Interval)
							{
								double num10 = num9 * MinorInterval;
								if (!base.IsInverted)
								{
									double num11 = num8;
									while (num11 - num10 > scaledValue)
									{
										num11 -= num10;
										if (Math.Abs(num11 - scaledValue) < 0.0001)
										{
											break;
										}
										HorizontalLine(minorLinesGeometry, num11, viewportRect, minorLinesPathInfo, isAxisLine: false);
									}
								}
								else
								{
									double num12 = num8;
									while (num12 + num10 < scaledValue)
									{
										num12 += num10;
										if (Math.Abs(num12 - scaledValue) < 0.0001)
										{
											break;
										}
										HorizontalLine(minorLinesGeometry, num12, viewportRect, minorLinesPathInfo, isAxisLine: false);
									}
								}
								ActualMinorInterval = MinorInterval;
							}
							else
							{
								for (int j = 0; j < (int)linearCategorySnapper.Interval; j++)
								{
									for (int k = 0; k < base.Mode2GroupCount; k++)
									{
										double num13 = GetGroupCenter(k, rect, viewportRect, currentEffectiveViewport);
										if (!base.IsInverted)
										{
											num13 = 0.0 - num13;
										}
										double y = GetScaledValue((double)j + (double)i * linearCategorySnapper.Interval, p) + num13;
										HorizontalLine(minorLinesGeometry, y, viewportRect, minorLinesPathInfo, isAxisLine: false);
									}
								}
								ActualMinorInterval = 0.5;
							}
						}
						double num14 = num8;
						if (base.CategoryMode != CategoryMode.Mode0)
						{
							double scaledValue2 = GetScaledValue((double)i * linearCategorySnapper.Interval + 1.0, p);
							num14 = (num8 + scaledValue2) / 2.0;
						}
						if (num14 <= contentViewport.Bottom && num14 >= contentViewport.Top)
						{
							int num15 = 0;
							num15 = ((linearCategorySnapper.Interval >= 1.0) ? (i * (int)Math.Floor(linearCategorySnapper.Interval)) : (((double)i * linearCategorySnapper.Interval * 2.0 % 2.0 != 0.0) ? (-1) : ((int)Math.Floor((double)i * linearCategorySnapper.Interval))));
							if (base.FastItemsSource != null && num15 < base.FastItemsSource.Count && num15 >= 0)
							{
								object dataItem = base.FastItemsSource[num15];
								object label = GetLabel(dataItem);
								if (!double.IsNaN(num14) && !double.IsInfinity(num14) && label != null && (!(label is string) || !((string)label).Equals("")))
								{
									base.LabelDataContext.Add(label);
									base.LabelPositions.Add(new LabelPosition(num14));
								}
							}
						}
						num8 = scaledValue;
					}
				}
				ActualInterval = linearCategorySnapper.Interval;
				if ((base.LabelSettings == null || base.LabelSettings.Visibility == Visibility.Visible) && base.CrossingAxis != null && base.LabelSettings != null && (base.LabelSettings.Location == AxisLabelsLocation.InsideLeft || base.LabelSettings.Location == AxisLabelsLocation.InsideRight))
				{
					base.SeriesViewer.InvalidatePanels();
				}
				View.UpdateLabelPanelContent(base.LabelDataContext, base.LabelPositions);
				RenderLabels();
			}
		}
	}
	internal class BarFramePreparer : CategoryFramePreparer
	{
		public BarFramePreparer(IIsCategoryBased host)
			: this(host, host as ISupportsMarkers, host as IProvidesViewport, host as ISupportsErrorBars, host as IBucketizer)
		{
		}

		public BarFramePreparer(IIsCategoryBased host, ISupportsMarkers markersHost, IProvidesViewport viewportHost, ISupportsErrorBars errorBarsHost, IBucketizer bucketizingHost)
			: base(host, markersHost, viewportHost, errorBarsHost, bucketizingHost)
		{
			base.TrendlineHost = new DefaultCategoryTrendlineHost();
			if (host is IHasCategoryTrendline)
			{
				base.TrendlineHost = host as IHasCategoryTrendline;
			}
			base.ValuesProvider = new DefaultSingleValueProvider();
			if (host is IHasSingleValueCategory)
			{
				base.ValuesProvider = host as IHasSingleValueCategory;
			}
		}

		protected override bool PrepareMarker(CategoryFrame frame, double[] bucket, IDetectsCollisions collisionAvoider, int itemIndex, int markerCount, int markerBucket)
		{
			double num = bucket[1];
			double num2 = bucket[0];
			Rect rc = new Rect(num - 5.0, num2 - 5.0, 11.0, 11.0);
			if (!double.IsNaN(num) && !double.IsNaN(num2) && !double.IsInfinity(num) && !double.IsInfinity(num2) && collisionAvoider.TryAdd(rc))
			{
				frame.Markers.Add(new Point(num, num2));
				base.MarkersHost.UpdateMarkerTemplate(markerCount, itemIndex, markerBucket);
				return true;
			}
			return false;
		}

		protected override void PrepareTrendline(PreparationParams p, ValuesHolder h, double offset)
		{
			if (base.TrendlineHost.TrendLineType == TrendLineType.None || base.TrendlineHost.TrendlinePreparer == null || base.TrendlineHost.TrendLinePeriod < 1)
			{
				return;
			}
			Rect effectiveViewportRect = p.EffectiveViewportRect;
			ScalerParams sParams = new ScalerParams(p.WindowRect, p.ViewportRect, p.Scaler.IsInverted, effectiveViewportRect);
			ScalerParams yParams = new ScalerParams(p.WindowRect, p.ViewportRect, p.YScaler.IsInverted, effectiveViewportRect);
			IList<double> list = ((SingleValuesHolder)h).Values;
			if (p.SortingScaler != null && p.SortingScaler.SortedIndices != null)
			{
				list = new SafeSortedReadOnlyDoubleCollection(list, p.SortingScaler.SortedIndices);
			}
			TrendResolutionParams trendResolutionParams = new TrendResolutionParams
			{
				BucketSize = p.BucketSize,
				FirstBucket = p.FirstBucket,
				LastBucket = p.LastBucket,
				Offset = offset,
				Resolution = p.Resolution,
				Viewport = p.ViewportRect
			};
			if (base.TrendlineHost.TrendLineType != TrendLineType.None)
			{
				base.TrendlineHost.TrendlinePreparer.PrepareLineCore(p.Frame.Trend, base.TrendlineHost.TrendLineType, list, base.TrendlineHost.TrendLinePeriod, (double x) => p.YScaler.GetScaledValue(x, yParams), (double y) => p.Scaler.GetScaledValue(y, sParams), trendResolutionParams);
			}
		}
	}
	internal class BarTrendFitCalculator
	{
		public static double[] CalculateFit(List<Point> trend, TrendLineType trendLineType, TrendResolutionParams trendResolutionParams, [SwiftMutableParameter] double[] trendCoefficients, int count, Func<int, double> GetUnscaledX, Func<int, double> GetUnscaledY, Func<double, double> GetScaledXValue, Func<double, double> GetScaledYValue, double ymin, double ymax)
		{
			if (trendCoefficients == null)
			{
				trendCoefficients = trendLineType switch
				{
					TrendLineType.LinearFit => LeastSquaresFit.LinearFit(count, GetUnscaledY, GetUnscaledX), 
					TrendLineType.QuadraticFit => LeastSquaresFit.QuadraticFit(count, GetUnscaledY, GetUnscaledX), 
					TrendLineType.CubicFit => LeastSquaresFit.CubicFit(count, GetUnscaledY, GetUnscaledX), 
					TrendLineType.QuarticFit => LeastSquaresFit.QuarticFit(count, GetUnscaledY, GetUnscaledX), 
					TrendLineType.QuinticFit => LeastSquaresFit.QuinticFit(count, GetUnscaledY, GetUnscaledX), 
					TrendLineType.ExponentialFit => LeastSquaresFit.ExponentialFit(count, GetUnscaledY, GetUnscaledX), 
					TrendLineType.LogarithmicFit => LeastSquaresFit.LogarithmicFit(count, GetUnscaledY, GetUnscaledX), 
					TrendLineType.PowerLawFit => LeastSquaresFit.PowerLawFit(count, GetUnscaledY, GetUnscaledX), 
					_ => throw new NotImplementedException(), 
				};
			}
			if (trendCoefficients == null)
			{
				return null;
			}
			for (int i = 0; (double)i < trendResolutionParams.Viewport.Height; i += 2)
			{
				double num = (double)i / (trendResolutionParams.Viewport.Height - 1.0);
				double num2 = ymin + num * (ymax - ymin);
				double num3 = double.NaN;
				num3 = GetScaledXValue(trendLineType switch
				{
					TrendLineType.LinearFit => LeastSquaresFit.LinearEvaluate(trendCoefficients, num2), 
					TrendLineType.QuadraticFit => LeastSquaresFit.QuadraticEvaluate(trendCoefficients, num2), 
					TrendLineType.CubicFit => LeastSquaresFit.CubicEvaluate(trendCoefficients, num2), 
					TrendLineType.QuarticFit => LeastSquaresFit.QuarticEvaluate(trendCoefficients, num2), 
					TrendLineType.QuinticFit => LeastSquaresFit.QuinticEvaluate(trendCoefficients, num2), 
					TrendLineType.ExponentialFit => LeastSquaresFit.ExponentialEvaluate(trendCoefficients, num2), 
					TrendLineType.LogarithmicFit => LeastSquaresFit.LogarithmicEvaluate(trendCoefficients, num2), 
					TrendLineType.PowerLawFit => LeastSquaresFit.PowerLawEvaluate(trendCoefficients, num2), 
					_ => throw new NotImplementedException(), 
				});
				num2 = GetScaledYValue(num2);
				if (!double.IsNaN(num3) && !double.IsInfinity(num3))
				{
					trend.Add(new Point(num3, num2 + trendResolutionParams.Offset));
				}
			}
			return trendCoefficients;
		}
	}
	internal class BarTrendLineManager : CategoryTrendLineManager
	{
		public override void PrepareLineCore(List<Point> flattenedPoints, TrendLineType trendLineType, IList<double> valueColumn, int period, Func<double, double> GetScaledXValue, Func<double, double> GetScaledYValue, TrendResolutionParams trendResolutionParams)
		{
			double num = trendResolutionParams.FirstBucket * trendResolutionParams.BucketSize;
			double num2 = trendResolutionParams.LastBucket * trendResolutionParams.BucketSize;
			List<Point> list = new List<Point>();
			if (trendLineType == TrendLineType.None)
			{
				base.TrendCoefficients = null;
				base.TrendColumn.Clear();
				return;
			}
			if (IsFit(trendLineType))
			{
				base.TrendColumn.Clear();
				base.TrendCoefficients = BarTrendFitCalculator.CalculateFit(list, trendLineType, trendResolutionParams, base.TrendCoefficients, valueColumn.Count, (int i) => valueColumn[i], (int i) => i + 1, GetScaledXValue, (double num6) => GetScaledYValue(num6 - 1.0), num + 1.0, num2 + 1.0);
			}
			if (IsAverage(trendLineType))
			{
				base.TrendCoefficients = null;
				TrendAverageCalculator.CalculateSingleValueAverage(trendLineType, base.TrendColumn, valueColumn, period);
				for (int num3 = trendResolutionParams.FirstBucket; num3 <= trendResolutionParams.LastBucket; num3++)
				{
					int num4 = num3 * trendResolutionParams.BucketSize;
					if (num4 >= 0 && num4 < base.TrendColumn.Count)
					{
						double x = GetScaledXValue(base.TrendColumn[num4]);
						double num5 = GetScaledYValue(num4);
						list.Add(new Point(x, num5 + trendResolutionParams.Offset));
					}
				}
			}
			FlattenTrendLine(list, trendResolutionParams, flattenedPoints);
		}
	}
	[TSImportModule("igniteui-charts/ISupportsMarkers", "ISupportsMarkers")]
	public sealed class BarSeries : VerticalAnchoredCategorySeries, IBarSeries

		public static readonly DependencyProperty RadiusYProperty = DependencyProperty.Register("RadiusY", typeof(double), typeof(BarSeries), new PropertyMetadata(0.0, delegate(DependencyObject sender, DependencyPropertyChangedEventArgs e)
		{
			((BarSeries)sender).RaisePropertyChanged("RadiusY", e.OldValue, e.NewValue);
		}));

		public override bool IsBar => true;

		public override bool IsMarkerlessDisplayPreferred => true;

		[TSSuppressSynthesizedInitializer]
		internal BarSeriesView BarView { get; set; }

		protected internal override bool HasIndividualElements => true;

		[WidgetDefaultNumber(0.0)]
		public double RadiusX

		}

		protected internal override void OnViewCreated(SeriesView view)
		{
			base.OnViewCreated(view);
			BarView = (BarSeriesView)view;
		}

		public override Rect GetSeriesValueBoundingBox(Point world)
		{
			if (base.XAxis == null || base.YAxis == null || CurrentFrame.Buckets.Count == 0)
			{
				return Rect.Empty;
			}
			Rect windowRect = base.View.WindowRect;
			Rect viewport = base.View.Viewport;
			Rect effectiveViewport = GetEffectiveViewport(base.View);
			new ScalerParams(windowRect, viewport, base.XAxis.IsInverted, effectiveViewport);
			Point point = FromWorldPosition(world);
			int previousOrExactIndex = GetPreviousOrExactIndex(world, skipUnknowns: true);
			int nextOrExactIndex = GetNextOrExactIndex(world, skipUnknowns: true);
			int num = (int)Math.Floor((double)previousOrExactIndex / (double)GetBucketSize(base.View));
			int num2 = (int)Math.Floor((double)nextOrExactIndex / (double)GetBucketSize(base.View));
			int num3 = num - GetFirstBucket(base.View);
			int num4 = num2 - GetFirstBucket(base.View);
			if (num3 < 0)
			{
				num3 = 0;
			}
			if (num3 > CurrentFrame.Buckets.Count - 1)
			{
				num3 = CurrentFrame.Buckets.Count - 1;
			}
			if (num4 < 0)
			{
				num4 = 0;
			}
			if (num4 > CurrentFrame.Buckets.Count - 1)
			{
				num4 = CurrentFrame.Buckets.Count - 1;
			}
			double[] array = CurrentFrame.Buckets[num3];
			double[] array2 = CurrentFrame.Buckets[num4];
			double num5 = Math.Abs(point.Y - array[0]);
			double num6 = Math.Abs(point.Y - array2[0]);
			double worldZeroValue = GetWorldZeroValue(base.CategoryView);
			double groupSize = base.YAxis.GetGroupSize(windowRect, viewport, effectiveViewport);
			if (num5 < num6)
			{
				double y = array[0] - 0.5 * groupSize;
				double val = array[1];
				double val2 = worldZeroValue;
				return new Rect(Math.Min(val2, val), y, Math.Max(val2, val) - Math.Min(val2, val), groupSize);
			}
			double y2 = array2[0] - 0.5 * groupSize;
			double val3 = array2[1];
			double val4 = worldZeroValue;
			return new Rect(Math.Min(val4, val3), y2, Math.Max(val4, val3) - Math.Min(val4, val3), groupSize);
		}

		public override bool TestHit(Point position, bool isFinger)
		{
			if (TestShapesOver(position, isFinger))
			{
				return true;
			}
			if (TestMarkersOver(position, isFinger))
			{
				return true;
			}
			return false;
		}

		public BarSeries()
		{
			base.DefaultStyleKey = typeof(BarSeries);
			base.FramePreparer = new BarFramePreparer(this, BarView, this, this, BarView.BucketCalculator);
		}

		internal override CategoryFramePreparer GetFramePreparer(CategorySeriesView view)
		{
			if (view != null && view.IsThumbnailView)
			{
				if (view.IsAlternateView)
				{
					return new BarFramePreparer(this, view, view, this, view.BucketCalculator);
				}
				return new BarFramePreparer(this, view, base.SeriesViewer.View.OverviewPlusDetailViewportHost, this, view.BucketCalculator);
			}
			return base.FramePreparer;
		}

		[JAVASuppressWidgetMember]
		[TSSuppressWidgetMember]
		[SwiftSuppressWidgetMember]
		public override void OnApplyTemplate()
		{
			base.OnApplyTemplate();
		}

		internal override CategoryMode PreferredCategoryMode(CategoryAxisBase axis)
		{
			return CategoryMode.Mode2;
		}

		protected internal override void ClearRendering(bool wipeClean, SeriesView view)
		{
			base.ClearRendering(wipeClean, view);
			BarSeriesView barSeriesView = view as BarSeriesView;
			if (wipeClean && barSeriesView != null && barSeriesView.Columns != null)
			{
				barSeriesView.Columns.Count = 0;
			}
		}

		protected internal override int GetMode2Index()
		{
			int num = 0;
			foreach (Series item in base.SeriesViewer.Series)
			{
				if (item == this)
				{
					return num;
				}
				if (item is IBarSeries barSeries && barSeries.YAxis == base.YAxis && barSeries.GetPreferredCategoryMode() == CategoryMode.Mode2)
				{
					num++;
				}
			}
			return -1;
		}

		internal override double GetWorldZeroValue(CategorySeriesView view)
		{
			double result = 0.0;
			Rect windowRect = view.WindowRect;
			Rect viewport = view.Viewport;
			Rect effectiveViewport = GetEffectiveViewport(view);
			if (!windowRect.IsEmpty && !viewport.IsEmpty && base.XAxis != null)
			{
				ScalerParams p = new ScalerParams(windowRect, viewport, base.XAxis.IsInverted, effectiveViewport);
				result = base.XAxis.GetScaledValue(base.XAxis.ReferenceValue, p);
			}
			return result;
		}

		protected internal override AxisRange GetRange(Axis axis)
		{
			if (base.ValueColumn == null || base.ValueColumn.Count == 0)
			{
				return null;
			}
			if (axis == base.YAxis)
			{
				return new AxisRange(0.0, base.ValueColumn.Count - 1);
			}
			if (axis == base.XAxis)
			{
				return new AxisRange(base.ValueColumn.Minimum, base.ValueColumn.Maximum);
			}
			return null;
		}

		public override bool ScrollIntoView(object item)
		{
			Rect windowRect = base.View.WindowRect;
			Rect viewport = base.View.Viewport;
			Rect rect = new Rect(0.0, 0.0, 1.0, 1.0);
			int num = ((!windowRect.IsEmpty && !viewport.IsEmpty && base.FastItemsSource != null) ? base.FastItemsSource.IndexOf(item) : (-1));
			Rect effectiveViewportForUnitViewport = GetEffectiveViewportForUnitViewport(base.View);
			ScalerParams p = new ScalerParams(rect, rect, base.XAxis.IsInverted, effectiveViewportForUnitViewport);
			ScalerParams p2 = new ScalerParams(rect, rect, base.YAxis.IsInverted, effectiveViewportForUnitViewport);
			double num2 = ((base.YAxis != null) ? base.YAxis.GetScaledValue(num, p2) : double.NaN);
			double num3 = ((base.YAxis != null) ? base.FramePreparer.GetOffset(base.YAxis, rect, rect, effectiveViewportForUnitViewport) : 0.0);
			num2 += num3;
			double num4 = ((base.XAxis != null && base.ValueColumn != null && num < base.ValueColumn.Count) ? base.XAxis.GetScaledValue(base.ValueColumn[num], p) : double.NaN);
			if (!double.IsNaN(num4))
			{
				if (num4 < windowRect.Left + 0.1 * windowRect.Width)
				{
					num4 += 0.4 * windowRect.Width;
					windowRect.X = num4 - 0.5 * windowRect.Width;
				}
				if (num4 > windowRect.Right - 0.1 * windowRect.Width)
				{
					num4 -= 0.4 * windowRect.Width;
					windowRect.X = num4 - 0.5 * windowRect.Width;
				}
			}
			if (!double.IsNaN(num2))
			{
				if (num2 < windowRect.Top + 0.1 * windowRect.Height)
				{
					num2 += 0.4 * windowRect.Height;
					windowRect.Y = num2 - 0.5 * windowRect.Height;
				}
				if (num2 > windowRect.Bottom - 0.1 * windowRect.Height)
				{
					num2 -= 0.4 * windowRect.Height;
					windowRect.Y = num2 - 0.5 * windowRect.Height;
				}
			}
			if (base.SyncLink != null)
			{
				base.SyncLink.WindowNotify(base.SeriesViewer, windowRect, force: true);
			}
			return num >= 0;
		}

		public override double GetItemSpan()
		{
			return base.YAxis.GetGroupSize(base.View.WindowRect, base.View.Viewport, GetEffectiveViewport(base.View));
		}

		internal override void RenderFrame(CategoryFrame frame, CategorySeriesView view)
		{
			base.RenderFrame(frame, view);
			List<double[]> buckets = frame.Buckets;
			if (!view.HasSurface())
			{
				return;
			}
			Rect windowRect = view.WindowRect;
			Rect viewport = view.Viewport;
			Rect effectiveViewport = GetEffectiveViewport(view);
			ScalerParams p = new ScalerParams(windowRect, viewport, base.XAxis.IsInverted, effectiveViewport);
			CategoryYAxis yAxis = base.YAxis;
			ScalerParams axisParams = new ScalerParams(windowRect, viewport, base.YAxis.IsInverted, effectiveViewport);
			NumericXAxis xAxis = base.XAxis;
			double scaledValue = xAxis.GetScaledValue(xAxis.ReferenceValue, p);
			double groupSize = base.YAxis.GetGroupSize(windowRect, viewport, effectiveViewport);
			BarSeriesView barSeriesView = view as BarSeriesView;
			if (double.IsNaN(groupSize) || double.IsInfinity(groupSize) || double.IsNaN(scaledValue))
			{
				barSeriesView.Columns.Count = 0;
				return;
			}
			RenderManager.InitCategoryRenderSettings(this, ShouldOverrideCategoryStyle(), GetCategoryItems, GetBucketSize(view), GetFirstBucket(view));
			RenderManager.InitialRenderRadiusX = RadiusX;
			RenderManager.InitialRenderRadiusY = RadiusY;
			RenderManager.ActualRenderRadiusX = RadiusX;
			RenderManager.ActualRenderRadiusY = RadiusY;
			bool flag = false;
			if (RenderManager.OverrideArgs != null)
			{
				flag = true;
			}
			_ = base.XAxis.IsSorting;
			int count = base.ValueColumn.Count;
			for (int i = 0; i < buckets.Count; i++)
			{
				double y = buckets[i][0] - 0.5 * groupSize;
				double val = buckets[i][1];
				double val2 = scaledValue;
				val2 = Math.Max(val2, -100.0);
				val = Math.Min(val, viewport.Right + 100.0);
				Rectangle rectangle = barSeriesView.Columns[i];
				rectangle.Height = groupSize;
				rectangle.Width = Math.Abs(val - val2);
				if (flag)
				{
					PerformCategoryStyleOverride(buckets, i, count, yAxis, axisParams, view.IsThumbnailView);
				}
				RenderManager.SetShapeAppearance(rectangle, strokeOnly: false, fillOnly: false, extended: false, useOutline: false);
				rectangle.RadiusX = RenderManager.ActualRenderRadiusX;
				rectangle.RadiusY = RenderManager.ActualRenderRadiusY;
				barSeriesView.SetColumnPosition(rectangle, Math.Min(val, val2), y);
			}
			barSeriesView.Columns.Count = buckets.Count;
			view.UpdateFrameVersion(frame);
		}

		protected override void DataUpdatedOverride(FastItemsSourceEventAction action, int position, int count, string propertyName)
		{
			switch (action)
			{
			case FastItemsSourceEventAction.Remove:
			case FastItemsSourceEventAction.Insert:
			case FastItemsSourceEventAction.Reset:
				base.AnchoredView.BucketCalculator.CalculateBuckets(base.Resolution);
				break;
			}
			if (base.AnchoredView.HasTrendLineManager)
			{
				base.AnchoredView.TrendLineManager.DataUpdated(action, position, count, propertyName);
			}
			switch (action)
			{
			case FastItemsSourceEventAction.Reset:
				if (base.XAxis != null && !base.XAxis.UpdateRange())
				{
					RenderSeries(animate: true);
				}
				break;
			case FastItemsSourceEventAction.Insert:
				if (base.XAxis != null && !base.XAxis.UpdateRange())
				{
					RenderSeries(animate: true);
				}
				break;
			case FastItemsSourceEventAction.Remove:
				if (base.XAxis != null && !base.XAxis.UpdateRange())
				{
					RenderSeries(animate: true);
				}
				break;
			case FastItemsSourceEventAction.Replace:
				if (base.ValueMemberPath != null && base.AnchoredView.BucketCalculator.BucketSize > 0)
				{
					RenderSeries(animate: true);
				}
				break;
			case FastItemsSourceEventAction.Change:
				if (propertyName == base.ValueMemberPath && base.XAxis != null && !base.XAxis.UpdateRange())
				{
					RenderSeries(animate: true);
				}
				break;
			}
		}

		protected override void PropertyUpdatedOverride(object sender, string propertyName, object oldValue, object newValue)
		{
			base.PropertyUpdatedOverride(sender, propertyName, oldValue, newValue);
			switch (propertyName)
			{
			case "XAxis":
				if (oldValue != null)
				{
					((Axis)oldValue).DeregisterSeries(this);
				}
				if (newValue != null)
				{
					((Axis)newValue).RegisterSeries(this);
				}
				base.AnchoredView.BucketCalculator.CalculateBuckets(base.Resolution);
				if (base.XAxis != null && base.XAxis.UpdateRange())
				{
					RenderSeries(animate: false);
				}
				break;
			case "YAxis":
				if (oldValue != null)
				{
					((Axis)oldValue).DeregisterSeries(this);
				}
				if (newValue != null)
				{
					((Axis)newValue).RegisterSeries(this);
				}
				if (base.AnchoredView.HasTrendLineManager)
				{
					base.AnchoredView.TrendLineManager = CategoryTrendLineManagerFactory.SelectManager(base.AnchoredView.TrendLineManager, base.YAxis, base.RootCanvas, this, base.Res);
				}
				base.AnchoredView.BucketCalculator.CalculateBuckets(base.Resolution);
				RenderSeries(animate: false);
				break;
			case "FastItemsSource":
				if (base.XAxis != null && !base.XAxis.UpdateRange())
				{
					base.AnchoredView.BucketCalculator.CalculateBuckets(base.Resolution);
					RenderSeries(animate: false);
				}
				break;
			case "ValueColumn":
				if (base.XAxis != null && !base.XAxis.UpdateRange())
				{
					base.AnchoredView.BucketCalculator.CalculateBuckets(base.Resolution);
					RenderSeries(animate: false);
				}
				break;
			case "SeriesViewer":
				if (oldValue != null && newValue == null)
				{
					DeregisterForAxis(base.XAxis);
					DeregisterForAxis(base.YAxis);
				}
				if (oldValue == null && newValue != null)
				{
					RegisterForAxis(base.XAxis);
					RegisterForAxis(base.YAxis);
				}
				base.AnchoredView.BucketCalculator.CalculateBuckets(base.Resolution);
				RenderSeries(animate: false);
				break;
			}
		}

		CategoryMode IBarSeries.GetPreferredCategoryMode()
		{
			return PreferredCategoryMode(base.YAxis);
		}
	}
	internal class BarBucketCalculator : CategoryBucketCalculator
	{
		[Weak]
		protected BarSeriesView BarView { get; set; }

		internal BarBucketCalculator(BarSeriesView view)
			: base(view)
		{
			BarView = view;
		}

		protected internal override void CalculateBuckets(double resolution)
		{
			Rect windowRect = base.View.WindowRect;
			Rect viewport = base.View.Viewport;
			IFastItemsSource fastItemsSource = base.View.CategoryModel.FastItemsSource;
			if (windowRect.IsEmpty || viewport.IsEmpty || BarView.BarModel.YAxis == null || fastItemsSource == null || fastItemsSource.Count == 0)
			{
				BucketSize = 0;
				return;
			}
			BarSeries barSeries = base.View.CategoryModel as BarSeries;
			Rect contentViewport = barSeries.GetContentViewport(base.View);
			Rect effectiveViewport = barSeries.GetEffectiveViewport(base.View);
			ScalerParams p = new ScalerParams(windowRect, viewport, barSeries.YAxis.IsInverted, effectiveViewport);
			double num = Math.Floor(barSeries.YAxis.GetUnscaledValue(contentViewport.Top, p, CategoryMode.Mode0));
			double num2 = Math.Ceiling(barSeries.YAxis.GetUnscaledValue(contentViewport.Bottom, p, CategoryMode.Mode0));
			if (!barSeries.YAxis.IsInverted)
			{
				num2 = Math.Ceiling(barSeries.YAxis.GetUnscaledValue(contentViewport.Top, p, CategoryMode.Mode0));
				num = Math.Floor(barSeries.YAxis.GetUnscaledValue(contentViewport.Bottom, p, CategoryMode.Mode0));
			}
			double val = Math.Floor((num2 - num + 1.0) * resolution / contentViewport.Height);
			BucketSize = (int)Math.Max(1.0, val);
			FirstBucket = (int)Math.Max(0.0, Math.Floor(num / (double)BucketSize) - 1.0);
			LastBucket = (int)Math.Ceiling(num2 / (double)BucketSize);
		}

		internal override double[] GetBucketWithoutUnknowns(int index)
		{
			IFastItemColumn<double> valueColumn = BarView.AnchoredModel.ValueColumn;
			int count = valueColumn.Count;
			int num = index * BucketSize;
			int num2 = num + BucketSize - 1;
			int num3 = count - 1;
			num = ((num < num3) ? num : num3);
			num2 = ((num2 < num3) ? num2 : num3);
			double num4 = double.MaxValue;
			double num5 = double.MinValue;
			bool flag = true;
			for (int i = num; i <= num2; i++)
			{
				double num6 = valueColumn[i];
				num4 = ((num4 < num6) ? num4 : num6);
				num5 = ((num5 > num6) ? num5 : num6);
				Math.Max(num5, num6);
				flag = false;
			}
			if (flag)
			{
				return new double[3]
				{
					0.5 * (double)(num + num2),
					double.NaN,
					double.NaN
				};
			}
			return new double[3]
			{
				0.5 * (double)(num + num2),
				num4,
				num5
			};
		}

		internal override double[] GetBucket(int index)
		{
			IFastItemColumn<double> valueColumn = BarView.AnchoredModel.ValueColumn;
			int count = valueColumn.Count;
			int num = index * BucketSize;
			int num2 = num + BucketSize - 1;
			int num3 = count - 1;
			num = ((num < num3) ? num : num3);
			num2 = ((num2 < num3) ? num2 : num3);
			double num4 = double.NaN;
			double num5 = double.NaN;
			for (int i = num; i <= num2; i++)
			{
				double num6 = valueColumn[i];
				if (!double.IsNaN(num4))
				{
					if (!double.IsNaN(num6))
					{
						num4 = Math.Min(num4, num6);
						num5 = Math.Max(num5, num6);
					}
				}
				else
				{
					num4 = num6;
					num5 = num6;
				}
			}
			if (double.IsNaN(num4))
			{
				return new double[3]
				{
					0.5 * (double)(num + num2),
					double.NaN,
					double.NaN
				};
			}
			return new double[3]
			{
				0.5 * (double)(num + num2),
				num4,
				num5
			};
		}

		public override double GetErrorBucket(int bucket, IFastItemColumn<double> column)
		{
			int count = column.Count;
			int num = Math.Min(bucket * BucketSize, count - 1);
			int num2 = Math.Min(num + BucketSize - 1, count - 1);
			double num3 = double.NaN;
			for (int i = num; i <= num2; i++)
			{
				double num4 = column[i];
				if (!double.IsNaN(num3))
				{
					if (!double.IsNaN(num4))
					{
						num3 = Math.Min(num3, num4);
					}
				}
				else
				{
					num3 = num4;
				}
			}
			if (!double.IsNaN(num3))
			{
				return num3;
			}
			return double.NaN;
		}
	}

		}

		}

		protected internal override double GetDistanceToIndex(Point world, int index, Axis axis, ScalerParams p, double offset)
		{
			if (base.ValueColumn == null)
			{
				return double.PositiveInfinity;
			}
			return GetDistanceToIndexHelper(world, index, YAxis, p, offset, base.ValueColumn.Count, GetExactUnsortedItemIndex);
		}

		public override Rect GetSeriesValueMarkerBoundingBox(Point world)
		{
			if (!HasMarkers || !ShouldDisplayMarkers())
			{
				return Rect.Empty;
			}
			return VerticalAnchoredCategorySeriesInteractionManager.GetSeriesValueMarkerBoundingBox(this, CurrentFrame.Markers, world, GetMarkerBoundingBox);
		}

		private Rect GetMarkerBoundingBox(int index)
		{
			return base.AnchoredView.GetMarkerBoundingBox(index);
		}

		public override bool TestHit(Point position, bool isFinger)
		{
			if (TestHighLowStrokeOver(position, isFinger))
			{
				return true;
			}
			if (TestMarkersOver(position, isFinger))
			{
				return true;
			}
			return false;
		}

		public override double GetSeriesValue(Point world, bool useInterpolation, bool skipUnknowns)
		{
			if (base.SeriesViewer == null)
			{
				return double.NaN;
			}
			Rect effectiveViewport = GetEffectiveViewport(base.View);
			CategoryAxisBase categoryAxis = GetCategoryAxis();
			ScalerParams pars = new ScalerParams(base.SeriesViewer.ActualWindowRect, base.View.Viewport, categoryAxis.IsInverted, effectiveViewport);
			double offset = base.FramePreparer.GetOffset(categoryAxis, base.SeriesViewer.ActualWindowRect, base.View.Viewport, effectiveViewport);
			return GetSeriesValueHelper(base.ValueColumn, world, categoryAxis, pars, offset, GetExactUnsortedItemIndex, useInterpolation, skipUnknowns);
		}

		public override Point GetSeriesValuePosition(Point world, bool useInterpolation, bool skipUnknowns)
		{
			CategoryAxisBase categoryAxis = GetCategoryAxis();
			return GetSeriesValuePositionHelper(world, useInterpolation, skipUnknowns, base.FramePreparer.GetOffset(categoryAxis, base.View.WindowRect, base.View.Viewport, GetEffectiveViewport(base.View)), GetValueAxis(), categoryAxis, null, null, null);
		}

		internal override Axis GetXAxis()
		{
			return XAxis;
		}

		internal override Axis GetYAxis()
		{
			return YAxis;
		}

		internal override void SetXAxis(Axis xAxis)
		{
			XAxis = xAxis as NumericXAxis;
		}

		internal override void SetYAxis(Axis yAxis)
		{
			YAxis = yAxis as CategoryYAxis;
		}

		internal override bool UpdateNumericAxisRange()
		{
			if (XAxis != null)
			{
				return XAxis.UpdateRange();
			}
			return false;
		}

		[SuppressWidgetMember]
		public override object[] GetCategoryItems(int startIndex, int endIndex)
		{
			return GetCategoryItemsHelper(startIndex, endIndex, YAxis);
		}

		public override double GetExactItemIndex(Point world)
		{
			return VerticalAnchoredCategorySeriesInteractionManager.GetExactItemIndex(this, world);
		}

		protected internal override double GetExactUnsortedItemIndex(Point world)
		{
			return GetExactUnsortedItemIndexHelper(world, GetCategoryAxis());
		}

		public override int GetItemIndex(Point world)
		{
			return (int)Math.Round(GetExactItemIndex(world));
		}

		public override object GetItem(Point world)
		{
			int itemIndex = GetItemIndex(world);
			if (itemIndex < 0 || base.FastItemsSource == null || itemIndex >= base.FastItemsSource.Count)
			{
				return null;
			}
			return base.FastItemsSource[itemIndex];
		}

		protected override void PropertyUpdatedOverride(object sender, string propertyName, object oldValue, object newValue)
		{
			base.PropertyUpdatedOverride(sender, propertyName, oldValue, newValue);
			switch (propertyName)
			{
			case "XAxis":
				if (oldValue != newValue)
				{
					DeregisterForAxis(oldValue as Axis);
					RegisterForAxis(newValue as Axis);
					base.CategoryView.BucketCalculator.CalculateBuckets(base.Resolution);
					RenderSeries(animate: false);
					NotifyThumbnailAppearanceChanged();
				}
				break;
			case "YAxis":
				if (oldValue != newValue)
				{
					DeregisterForAxis(oldValue as Axis);
					RegisterForAxis(newValue as Axis);
					base.CategoryView.BucketCalculator.CalculateBuckets(base.Resolution);
					UpdateNumericAxisRange();
					RenderSeries(animate: false);
					NotifyThumbnailAppearanceChanged();
				}
				break;
			case "TrendLineType":
				if ((TrendLineType)newValue != TrendLineType.None)
				{
					base.AnchoredView.TrendLineManager = CategoryTrendLineManagerFactory.SelectManager(base.AnchoredView.TrendLineManager, YAxis, base.RootCanvas, this, base.Res);
				}
				break;
			}
		}

		[XamSuppressWidgetMember]
		[UwpSuppressWidgetMember]
		public bool CanUseAsYAxis(object axis)
		{
			if (axis is CategoryYAxis)
			{
				return true;
			}
			return false;
		}

		[XamSuppressWidgetMember]
		[UwpSuppressWidgetMember]
		public bool CanUseAsXAxis(object axis)
		{
			if (axis is NumericXAxis)
			{
				return true;
			}
			return false;
		}
	}

		{
			if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(propertyName))
			{
				SetCurrentValue(ChartTypeProperty, Implementation.ChartType);
				SetCurrentValue(IsCategoryHighlightingEnabledProperty, Implementation.IsCategoryHighlightingEnabled);
				SetCurrentValue(IsItemHighlightingEnabledProperty, Implementation.IsItemHighlightingEnabled);
				SetCurrentValue(IsTransitionInEnabledProperty, Implementation.IsTransitionInEnabled);
				SetCurrentValue(MarkerCollisionAvoidanceProperty, Implementation.MarkerCollisionAvoidance);
				SetCurrentValue(NegativeBrushesProperty, Implementation.NegativeBrushes);
				SetCurrentValue(NegativeOutlinesProperty, Implementation.NegativeOutlines);
				SetCurrentValue(TransitionInModeProperty, Implementation.TransitionInMode);
				SetCurrentValue(TransitionInSpeedTypeProperty, Implementation.TransitionInSpeedType);
				SetValue(XAxisActualMaximumPropertyKey, Implementation.XAxisActualMaximum);
				SetValue(XAxisActualMinimumPropertyKey, Implementation.XAxisActualMinimum);
				SetCurrentValue(XAxisGapProperty, Implementation.XAxisGap);
				SetCurrentValue(XAxisIntervalProperty, Implementation.XAxisInterval);
				SetCurrentValue(XAxisMinorIntervalProperty, Implementation.XAxisMinorInterval);
				SetCurrentValue(XAxisOverlapProperty, Implementation.XAxisOverlap);
				SetCurrentValue(YAxisAbbreviateLargeNumbersProperty, Implementation.YAxisAbbreviateLargeNumbers);
				SetValue(YAxisActualMaximumPropertyKey, Implementation.YAxisActualMaximum);
				SetValue(YAxisActualMinimumPropertyKey, Implementation.YAxisActualMinimum);
				SetCurrentValue(YAxisIntervalProperty, Implementation.YAxisInterval);
				SetCurrentValue(YAxisIsLogarithmicProperty, Implementation.YAxisIsLogarithmic);

	[DontObfuscate]
	[TSWidget]
	[HybridJavaWidget]
	[XamWrapper]
	public abstract class ColorScale : DependencyObject, INotifyPropertyChanged
	{
		[HybridJavaSuppressWidgetMember]
		[BlazorSuppressWidgetMember]
		public event PropertyChangedEventHandler PropertyChanged;

		[HybridJavaSuppressWidgetMember]
		[BlazorSuppressWidgetMember]
		public event PropertyUpdatedEventHandler PropertyUpdated;

		[TSSuppressWidgetMember]
		public abstract Color GetColor(double value, double defaultMinimum, double defaultMaximum, IList<double> valueColumn);

		protected void RaisePropertyChanged(string name, object oldValue, object newValue)
		{
			if (this.PropertyChanged != null)
			{
				this.PropertyChanged(this, new PropertyChangedEventArgs(name));
			}
			if (this.PropertyUpdated != null)
			{
				this.PropertyUpdated(this, new PropertyUpdatedEventArgs(name, oldValue, newValue));
			}
		}

		protected virtual void PropertyUpdatedOverride(object sender, string propertyName, object oldValue, object newValue)
		{
		}
	}
	[TSWidget]
	[HybridJavaWidget]
	public enum ColorScaleInterpolationMode
	{
		Select,
		InterpolateRGB,
		InterpolateHSV
	}
	[WidgetModule("GeographicMap")]
	[XamWrapper]
	[TSWidget]
	[TSEmitModuleDefinitions]
	public class CustomPaletteColorScale : ColorScale
	{
		private const string MinimumValuePropertyName = "MinimumValue";

		public static readonly DependencyProperty MinimumValueProperty = DependencyProperty.Register("MinimumValue", typeof(double), typeof(CustomPaletteColorScale), new PropertyMetadata(double.NaN, delegate(DependencyObject sender, DependencyPropertyChangedEventArgs e)
		{
			(sender as CustomPaletteColorScale).RaisePropertyChanged("MinimumValue", e.OldValue, e.NewValue);
		}));

		private const string MaximumValuePropertyName = "MaximumValue";

		public static readonly DependencyProperty MaximumValueProperty = DependencyProperty.Register("MaximumValue", typeof(double), typeof(CustomPaletteColorScale), new PropertyMetadata(double.NaN, delegate(DependencyObject sender, DependencyPropertyChangedEventArgs e)
		{
			(sender as CustomPaletteColorScale).RaisePropertyChanged("MaximumValue", e.OldValue, e.NewValue);
		}));

		private ObservableCollection<Color> _palette;

		private const string PalettePropertyName = "Palette";

		private Color _transparent;

		private double _cachedMinimum = double.NaN;

		private double _cachedMaximum = double.NaN;

		private bool _cachedMinimumIsNaN = true;

		private bool _cachedMaximumIsNaN = true;

		private ColorScaleInterpolationMode _cachedInterpolationMode;

		private const string InterpolationModePropertyName = "InterpolationMode";

		public static readonly DependencyProperty InterpolationModeProperty = DependencyProperty.Register("InterpolationMode", typeof(ColorScaleInterpolationMode), typeof(CustomPaletteColorScale), new PropertyMetadata(ColorScaleInterpolationMode.Select, delegate(DependencyObject sender, DependencyPropertyChangedEventArgs e)
		{
			(sender as CustomPaletteColorScale).RaisePropertyChanged("InterpolationMode", e.OldValue, e.NewValue);
		}));

		public double MinimumValue
		{
			get
			{
				return (double)GetValue(MinimumValueProperty);
			}
			set
			{
				SetValue(MinimumValueProperty, value);
			}
		}

		public double MaximumValue
		{
			get
			{
				return (double)GetValue(MaximumValueProperty);
			}
			set
			{
				SetValue(MaximumValueProperty, value);
			}
		}

		[TypeConverter(typeof(ColorCollectionConverter))]
		[WFSuppressWidgetMember]
		[TSImportModule("igniteui-core/ObservableColorCollection", "ObservableColorCollection")]
		public ObservableCollection<Color> Palette
		{
			get
			{
				return _palette;
			}
			set
			{
				ObservableCollection<Color> palette = _palette;
				if (_palette != null)
				{
					_palette.CollectionChanged -= Palette_CollectionChanged;
				}
				_palette = value;
				if (_palette != null)
				{
					_palette.CollectionChanged += Palette_CollectionChanged;
				}
				RaisePropertyChanged("Palette", palette, Palette);
			}
		}

		public ColorScaleInterpolationMode InterpolationMode
		{
			get
			{
				return (ColorScaleInterpolationMode)GetValue(InterpolationModeProperty);
			}
			set
			{
				SetValue(InterpolationModeProperty, value);
			}
		}

		public CustomPaletteColorScale()
		{
			_transparent = Colors.Transparent;
			_palette = new ObservableCollection<Color>();
			_palette.CollectionChanged += Palette_CollectionChanged;
			base.PropertyUpdated += delegate(object o, PropertyUpdatedEventArgs e)
			{
				PropertyUpdatedOverride(o, e.PropertyName, e.OldValue, e.NewValue);
			};
		}

		private void Palette_CollectionChanged(object sender, NotifyCollectionChangedEventArgs e)
		{
			RaisePropertyChanged("Palette", Palette, Palette);
		}

		protected override void PropertyUpdatedOverride(object sender, string propertyName, object oldValue, object newValue)
		{
			base.PropertyUpdatedOverride(sender, propertyName, oldValue, newValue);
			switch (propertyName)
			{
			case "MinimumValue":
				_cachedMinimum = MinimumValue;
				_cachedMinimumIsNaN = double.IsNaN(_cachedMinimum);
				break;
			case "MaximumValue":
				_cachedMaximum = MaximumValue;
				_cachedMaximumIsNaN = double.IsNaN(_cachedMaximum);
				break;
			case "InterpolationMode":
				_cachedInterpolationMode = InterpolationMode;
				break;
			}
		}

		[TSSuppressWidgetMember]
		public override Color GetColor(double value, double defaultMinimum, double defaultMaximum, IList<double> valueColumn)
		{
			if (_palette == null || _palette.Count == 0 || valueColumn == null)
			{
				return _transparent;
			}
			double num = (_cachedMinimumIsNaN ? defaultMinimum : _cachedMinimum);
			double num2 = (_cachedMaximumIsNaN ? defaultMaximum : _cachedMaximum);
			double num3 = (value - num) / (num2 - num);
			if (double.IsNaN(num3) || double.IsInfinity(num3) || num3 < 0.0 || num3 > 1.0)
			{
				return _transparent;
			}
			double num4 = num3 * (double)(_palette.Count - 1);
			if (_cachedInterpolationMode == ColorScaleInterpolationMode.InterpolateHSV || _cachedInterpolationMode == ColorScaleInterpolationMode.InterpolateRGB)
			{
				double num5 = Math.Floor(num4);
				double num6 = Math.Ceiling(num4);
				Color minimum = _palette[(int)num5];
				Color maximum_ = _palette[(int)num6];
				double interpolation_ = num4 - num5;
				InterpolationMode interpolationMode = ((_cachedInterpolationMode == ColorScaleInterpolationMode.InterpolateHSV) ? Infragistics.InterpolationMode.HSV : Infragistics.InterpolationMode.RGB);
				return minimum.GetInterpolation(interpolation_, maximum_, interpolationMode);
			}
			int index = (int)Math.Round(num4);
			return _palette[index];
		}
	}
	public class CustomContourValueResolver : ContourValueResolver
	{
		public event CustomContourValueResolverEventHandler GetCustomContourValues;

		public override IEnumerable<double> GetContourValues(IFastItemColumn<double> valueColumn)
		{
			CustomContourValueResolverEventArgs e = new CustomContourValueResolverEventArgs(valueColumn);
			OnGetCustomContourValues(e);
			if (e.ContourValuesEnumerable != null)
			{
				return e.ContourValuesEnumerable;
			}
			return new double[0];
		}

		private void OnGetCustomContourValues(CustomContourValueResolverEventArgs e)
		{
			if (this.GetCustomContourValues != null)
			{
				this.GetCustomContourValues(this, e);
			}
		}
	}
	[TSWidget]
	[HybridJavaWidget]
	public sealed class CustomContourValueResolverEventArgs : EventArgs
	{
		[TSSuppressWidgetMember]
		public IFastItemColumn<double> ValueColumn { get; private set; }

		[TSSuppressWidgetMember]
		public IEnumerable<double> ContourValuesEnumerable { get; set; }

		internal CustomContourValueResolverEventArgs(IFastItemColumn<double> valueColumn)
		{
			ValueColumn = valueColumn;
		}
	}
	public delegate void CustomContourValueResolverEventHandler(object sender, CustomContourValueResolverEventArgs e);

		protected override void PropertyUpdatedOverride(object sender, string propertyName, object oldValue, object newValue)
		{
			base.PropertyUpdatedOverride(sender, propertyName, oldValue, newValue);
			switch (propertyName)
			{
			case "FastItemsSource":
				if (oldValue is IFastItemsSource fastItemsSource)
				{
					fastItemsSource.DeregisterColumn(ValueColumn);
					ValueColumn = null;
				}
				if (newValue is IFastItemsSource)
				{
					ValueColumn = RegisterDoubleColumn(ValueMemberPath);
				}
				RenderSeries(animate: false);
				break;
			case "ValueMemberPath":
				if (base.FastItemsSource != null)
				{
					base.FastItemsSource.DeregisterColumn(ValueColumn);
					ValueColumn = RegisterDoubleColumn(ValueMemberPath);
				}
				RenderSeries(animate: false);
				NotifyThumbnailAppearanceChanged();
				break;
			case "ValueResolver":
				RenderSeries(animate: false);
				NotifyThumbnailAppearanceChanged();
				break;
			case "FillScale":
			{
				BrushScale brushScale = (BrushScale)oldValue;
				BrushScale brushScale2 = (BrushScale)newValue;
				brushScale?.UnregisterSeries(this);
				brushScale2?.RegisterSeries(this);
				UpdateActualFillScale();
				RenderSeries(animate: false);
				NotifyThumbnailAppearanceChanged();
				break;
			}
			case "ActualBrush":
				UpdateActualFillScale();
				RenderSeries(animate: false);
				NotifyThumbnailAppearanceChanged();
				break;
			}
		}
