		protected virtual void RenderWithView(SeriesView view)
		{
			if (ClearAndAbortIfInvalid(view))
			{
				return;
			}
			ScatterContourSeriesView scatterContourSeriesView = (ScatterContourSeriesView)view;
			view.GetViewInfo(out var viewportRect, out var windowRect);
			ScalerParams scalerParams = new ScalerParams(windowRect, viewportRect, base.XAxis.IsInverted);
			scalerParams.EffectiveViewportRect = GetEffectiveViewport(view);
			ScalerParams scalerParams2 = new ScalerParams(windowRect, viewportRect, base.YAxis.IsInverted);
			scalerParams2.EffectiveViewportRect = GetEffectiveViewport(view);
			NumericXAxis xAxis = base.XAxis;
			NumericYAxis yAxis = base.YAxis;
			int count = base.TriangleVertexColumn1.Count;
			double[] array = new double[base.XColumn.Count];
			double[] array2 = new double[base.YColumn.Count];
			base.XColumn.CopyTo(array, 0);
			base.YColumn.CopyTo(array2, 0);
			IList<double> valueColumn = ValueColumn;
			IList<int> triangleVertexColumn = base.TriangleVertexColumn1;
			IList<int> triangleVertexColumn2 = base.TriangleVertexColumn2;
			IList<int> triangleVertexColumn3 = base.TriangleVertexColumn3;
			double[] array3 = new List<double>(ValueResolver.GetContourValues(ValueColumn)).ToArray();
			xAxis.GetScaledValueList(array, 0, array.Length, scalerParams);
			yAxis.GetScaledValueList(array2, 0, array2.Length, scalerParams2);
			int num = array3.Length;
			ContourBuilder[] array4 = new ContourBuilder[num];
			for (int i = 0; i < num; i++)
			{
				array4[i] = new ContourBuilder();
			}
			double top = viewportRect.Top;
			double left = viewportRect.Left;
			double right = viewportRect.Right;
			double bottom = viewportRect.Bottom;
			int num2 = array.Length;
			for (int j = 0; j < count; j++)
			{
				int num3 = triangleVertexColumn[j];
				int num4 = triangleVertexColumn2[j];
				int num5 = triangleVertexColumn3[j];
				if (num3 >= num2 || num4 >= num2 || num5 >= num2 || num3 < 0 || num4 < 0 || num5 < 0)
				{
					continue;
				}
				double x = array[num3];
				double y = array2[num3];
				Point point = new Point(x, y);
				double x2 = array[num4];
				double y2 = array2[num4];
				Point point2 = new Point(x2, y2);
				double x3 = array[num5];
				double y3 = array2[num5];
				Point point3 = new Point(x3, y3);
				double num6 = ((point2.Y < point3.Y) ? point2.Y : point3.Y);
				num6 = ((point.Y < num6) ? point.Y : num6);
				double num7 = ((point2.Y > point3.Y) ? point2.Y : point3.Y);
				num7 = ((point.Y > num7) ? point.Y : num7);
				double num8 = ((point2.X < point3.X) ? point2.X : point3.X);
				num8 = ((point.X < num8) ? point.X : num8);
				double num9 = ((point2.X > point3.X) ? point2.X : point3.X);
				num9 = ((point.X > num9) ? point.X : num9);
				if (!(num6 < bottom) || !(num7 > top) || !(num8 < right) || !(num9 > left))
				{
					continue;
				}
				double num10 = valueColumn[num3];
				double num11 = valueColumn[num4];
				double num12 = valueColumn[num5];
				if (double.IsNaN(num10) || double.IsNaN(num11) || double.IsNaN(num12))
				{
					continue;
				}
				for (int k = 0; k < num; k++)
				{
					double num13 = array3[k];
					ContourBuilder contourBuilder = array4[k];
					switch (((num10 < num13) ? 1 : 0) | ((num11 < num13) ? 2 : 0) | ((num12 < num13) ? 4 : 0))
					{
					case 1:
						contourBuilder.AddSegment(contourBuilder.Point(num3, point.X, point.Y, num10, num4, point2.X, point2.Y, num11, num13), contourBuilder.Point(num5, point3.X, point3.Y, num12, num3, point.X, point.Y, num10, num13));
						break;
					case 2:
						contourBuilder.AddSegment(contourBuilder.Point(num4, point2.X, point2.Y, num11, num5, point3.X, point3.Y, num12, num13), contourBuilder.Point(num3, point.X, point.Y, num10, num4, point2.X, point2.Y, num11, num13));
						break;
					case 3:
						contourBuilder.AddSegment(contourBuilder.Point(num4, point2.X, point2.Y, num11, num5, point3.X, point3.Y, num12, num13), contourBuilder.Point(num5, point3.X, point3.Y, num12, num3, point.X, point.Y, num10, num13));
						break;
					case 4:
						contourBuilder.AddSegment(contourBuilder.Point(num5, point3.X, point3.Y, num12, num3, point.X, point.Y, num10, num13), contourBuilder.Point(num4, point2.X, point2.Y, num11, num5, point3.X, point3.Y, num12, num13));
						break;
					case 5:
						contourBuilder.AddSegment(contourBuilder.Point(num3, point.X, point.Y, num10, num4, point2.X, point2.Y, num11, num13), contourBuilder.Point(num4, point2.X, point2.Y, num11, num5, point3.X, point3.Y, num12, num13));
						break;
					case 6:
						contourBuilder.AddSegment(contourBuilder.Point(num5, point3.X, point3.Y, num12, num3, point.X, point.Y, num10, num13), contourBuilder.Point(num3, point.X, point.Y, num10, num4, point2.X, point2.Y, num11, num13));
						break;
					}
				}
			}
			Clipper clipper = new Clipper(viewportRect.Inflate(2.0), isClosed: false);
			List<List<List<Point>>> list = new List<List<List<Point>>>();
			for (int l = 0; l < num; l++)
			{
				ContourBuilder contourBuilder2 = array4[l];
				List<List<Point>> list2 = new List<List<Point>>();
				List<List<int>> polylines = contourBuilder2.GetPolylines();
				for (int m = 0; m < polylines.Count; m++)
				{
					List<int> list3 = polylines[m];
					List<Point> item = (List<Point>)(clipper.Target = new List<Point>());
					foreach (int item2 in list3)
					{
						clipper.Add(new Point(contourBuilder2.X[item2], contourBuilder2.Y[item2]));
					}
					clipper.Target = null;
					list2.Add(item);
				}
				list.Add(list2);
			}
			scatterContourSeriesView.ApplyVisuals(list, array3);
		}

		protected override void UpdateIndexedProperties()
		{
			base.UpdateIndexedProperties();
			UpdateActualFillScale();
		}

		private void UpdateActualFillScale()
		{
			Brush brush = base.ActualBrush;
			if (brush == null)
			{
				brush = base.Brush;
			}
			if (brush == null)
			{
				brush = BrushUtil.FromArgb(byte.MaxValue, byte.MaxValue, byte.MaxValue, byte.MaxValue);
			}
			ValueBrushScale valueBrushScale = new ValueBrushScale();
			valueBrushScale.Brushes = new BrushCollection();
			if (FillScale == null || FillScale.Brushes == null || FillScale.Brushes.Count == 0)
			{
				valueBrushScale.Brushes.Add(brush.GetLightened(-0.5));
				valueBrushScale.Brushes.Add(brush);
			}
			else
			{
				foreach (Brush brush2 in FillScale.Brushes)
				{
					valueBrushScale.Brushes.Add(brush2);
				}
			}
			if (FillScale != null)
			{
				if (!double.IsNaN(FillScale.MinimumValue))
				{
					valueBrushScale.MinimumValue = FillScale.MinimumValue;
				}
				if (!double.IsNaN(FillScale.MaximumValue))
				{
					valueBrushScale.MaximumValue = FillScale.MaximumValue;
				}
				valueBrushScale.LogarithmBase = FillScale.LogarithmBase;
				valueBrushScale.IsLogarithmic = FillScale.IsLogarithmic;
			}
			ActualFillScale = valueBrushScale;
		}

		private void ValueResolverEvent(object sender, EventArgs e)
		{
			RenderSeries(animate: false);
		}

		protected internal override bool ValidateSeries(Rect viewportRect, Rect windowRect, SeriesView view)
		{
			if (base.ValidateSeries(viewportRect, windowRect, view) && ValueResolver != null && base.XColumn != null && base.YColumn != null && base.TriangleVertexColumn1 != null && base.TriangleVertexColumn2 != null && base.TriangleVertexColumn3 != null && base.XColumn.Count > 0 && base.YColumn.Count > 0 && base.TriangleVertexColumn1.Count > 0 && base.TriangleVertexColumn2.Count > 0)
			{
				return base.TriangleVertexColumn3.Count > 0;
			}
			return false;
		}

		internal override DataContext GetTooltipContext(object item)
		{
			if (item != null)
			{
				return new DataContext
				{
					Series = this,
					Item = item
				};
			}
			return new DataContext
			{
				Series = this,
				Item = item
			};
		}
	}
	[EditorBrowsable(EditorBrowsableState.Never)]
	internal class PolylineBuilder
	{
		protected Dictionary<int, List<int>> byBegin = new Dictionary<int, List<int>>();

		protected Dictionary<int, List<int>> byEnd = new Dictionary<int, List<int>>();

		public virtual void Clear()
		{
			byBegin.Clear();
			byEnd.Clear();
		}

		public List<List<int>> GetPolylines()
		{
			List<List<int>> list = new List<List<int>>();
			foreach (List<int> value in byBegin.Values)
			{
				list.Add(value);
			}
			return list;
		}

		public void AddSegment(int begin, int end)
		{
			List<int> value = null;
			List<int> value2 = null;
			byEnd.TryGetValue(begin, out value);
			byBegin.TryGetValue(end, out value2);
			if (value == null && value2 == null)
			{
				List<int> list = new List<int>();
				list.Add(begin);
				list.Add(end);
				byBegin.Add(begin, list);
				byEnd.Add(end, list);
			}
			if (value == null && value2 != null)
			{
				byBegin.Remove(end);
				value2.Insert(0, begin);
				byBegin.Add(begin, value2);
			}
			if (value != null && value2 == null)
			{
				byEnd.Remove(begin);
				value.Add(end);
				byEnd.Add(end, value);
			}
			if (value != null && value2 != null)
			{
				if (value == value2)
				{
					value.Add(end);
					byEnd.Remove(begin);
					return;
				}
				byBegin.Remove(value2[0]);
				byEnd.Remove(value2[value2.Count - 1]);
				byEnd.Remove(value[value.Count - 1]);
				value.AddRange(value2);
				byEnd.Add(value[value.Count - 1], value);
			}
		}
	}
	[EditorBrowsable(EditorBrowsableState.Never)]
	internal class ContourBuilder : PolylineBuilder
	{
		private const long HASH_CONSTANT = 4294967296L;

		private Dictionary<long, int> dictionary = new Dictionary<long, int>();

		private List<float> x = new List<float>();

		private List<float> y = new List<float>();

		public IList<float> X => x;

		public IList<float> Y => y;

		public override void Clear()
		{
			base.Clear();
			dictionary.Clear();
			x.Clear();
			y.Clear();
		}

		public int Point(int b, double xb, double yb, double zb, int e, double xe, double ye, double ze, double z)
		{
			long key = Math.Min(b, e) + 4294967296L * Math.Max(b, e);
			int value = -1;
			if (!dictionary.TryGetValue(key, out value))
			{
				value = x.Count;
				double num = (z - zb) / (ze - zb);
				dictionary.Add(key, value);
				x.Add((float)(xb + num * (xe - xb)));
				y.Add((float)(yb + num * (ye - yb)));
			}
			return value;
		}
	}
	[XamWrapper]
	[TSWidget]
	[HybridJavaWidget]
	[TSEmitModuleDefinitions]
	public abstract class ContourValueResolver : DependencyObject
	{
		public event EventHandler<EventArgs> Updated;

		[TSSuppressWidgetMember]
		public abstract IEnumerable<double> GetContourValues(IFastItemColumn<double> valueColumn);

		protected virtual void PropertyUpdated(string propertyName, object oldValue, object newValue)
		{
			if (this.Updated != null)
			{
				this.Updated(this, EventArgs.Empty);
			}
		}
	}
	public class LinearContourValueResolver : ContourValueResolver
	{
		private const string ValueCountPropertyName = "ValueCount";

		public static readonly DependencyProperty ValueCountProperty = DependencyProperty.Register("ValueCount", typeof(int), typeof(LinearContourValueResolver), new PropertyMetadata(10, delegate(DependencyObject sender, DependencyPropertyChangedEventArgs e)
		{
			((LinearContourValueResolver)sender).PropertyUpdated("ValueCount", e.OldValue, e.NewValue);
		}));

		[DontObfuscate]
		public int ValueCount
		{
			get
			{
				return (int)GetValue(ValueCountProperty);
			}
			set
			{
				SetValue(ValueCountProperty, value);
			}
		}

		public override IEnumerable<double> GetContourValues(IFastItemColumn<double> valueColumn)
		{
			for (int i = 0; i < ValueCount; i++)
			{
				yield return valueColumn.Minimum + (valueColumn.Maximum - valueColumn.Minimum) * (double)(i + 1) / (double)(ValueCount + 1);
			}
		}
	}

					object colorScale = _ColorScale;

		public override object GetItemValue(object item, string memberPathName)
		{
			if (ResolveMemberPath(memberPathName) == "ColorMemberPath")
			{
				return GetItemValueByMemberPath(item, memberPathName, ColorMemberPath);
			}
			return base.GetItemValue(item, memberPathName);
		}

		protected override void PropertyUpdatedOverride(object sender, string propertyName, object oldValue, object newValue)
		{
			base.PropertyUpdatedOverride(sender, propertyName, oldValue, newValue);
			switch (propertyName)
			{
			case "FastItemsSource":
				if (oldValue is IFastItemsSource fastItemsSource)
				{
					fastItemsSource.DeregisterColumn(ColorColumn);
					ColorColumn = null;
				}
				if (newValue is IFastItemsSource)
				{
					ColorColumn = RegisterDoubleColumn(ColorMemberPath);
				}
				RenderSeries(animate: false);
				break;
			case "ColorMemberPath":
				if (base.FastItemsSource != null)
				{
					base.FastItemsSource.DeregisterColumn(ColorColumn);
					ColorColumn = RegisterDoubleColumn(ColorMemberPath);
				}
				RenderSeries(animate: false);
				NotifyThumbnailAppearanceChanged();
				break;
			case "ColorScale":
				UpdateActualColorScale();
				RenderSeries(animate: false);
				NotifyThumbnailAppearanceChanged();
				break;
			}
		}

		protected virtual void RenderWithView(SeriesView view)
		{
			if (!ClearAndAbortIfInvalid(view))
			{
				view.GetViewInfo(out var viewportRect, out var windowRect);
				ScatterAreaSeriesView scatterAreaSeriesView = (ScatterAreaSeriesView)view;
				WriteableBitmap bitmap = null;
				TriangleRasterizer triangleRasterizer = null;
				NumericXAxis xAxis = base.XAxis;
				NumericYAxis yAxis = base.YAxis;
				Rect effectiveViewport = GetEffectiveViewport(view);
				ScalerParams scalerParams = new ScalerParams(windowRect, viewportRect, xAxis.IsInverted);
				scalerParams.EffectiveViewportRect = effectiveViewport;
				ScalerParams scalerParams2 = new ScalerParams(windowRect, viewportRect, yAxis.IsInverted);
				scalerParams2.EffectiveViewportRect = effectiveViewport;
				triangleRasterizer = CreateBitmap(view, scalerParams, scalerParams2);
				if (triangleRasterizer != null)
				{
					scatterAreaSeriesView.CloseRasterizer(triangleRasterizer);
				}
				else
				{
					scatterAreaSeriesView.SetBitmap(bitmap);
				}
			}
		}

		private void AssertMouseOver(ScatterAreaSeriesView view)
		{
			view.GetViewInfo(out var viewportRect, out var _);
			int num = (int)Math.Round(viewportRect.Width) * (int)Math.Round(viewportRect.Height);
			int[] array = view.ItemIndexes;
			if (array == null || array.Length != num)
			{
				array = new int[num];
			}
			else
			{
				Array.Clear(array, 0, array.Length);
			}
			view.ItemIndexes = array;
		}

		public override object GetItem(Point world)
		{
			int num = (int)Math.Round(base.Viewport.Width);
			int num2 = (int)Math.Round(base.Viewport.Height);
			int[] itemIndexes = ((ScatterAreaSeriesView)base.View).ItemIndexes;
			if (itemIndexes == null || itemIndexes.Length != num * num2 || base.TriangleVertexColumn1 == null || base.TriangleVertexColumn1.Count < 1 || base.TriangleVertexColumn2 == null || base.TriangleVertexColumn2.Count < 1 || base.TriangleVertexColumn3 == null || base.TriangleVertexColumn3.Count < 1)
			{
				return null;
			}
			Rect windowRect = base.SeriesViewer.WindowRect;
			double num3 = (world.X - windowRect.Left) / windowRect.Width;
			double num4 = (world.Y - windowRect.Top) / windowRect.Height;
			int num5 = (int)Math.Round((double)num * num3);
			int num6 = (int)Math.Round((double)num2 * num4);
			int num7 = num * num6 + num5;
			if (num7 < 0 || num7 > itemIndexes.Length - 1)
			{
				return null;
			}
			int num8 = itemIndexes[num7] - 1;
			if (num8 < 0 || num8 > base.TriangleVertexColumn1.Count)
			{
				return null;
			}
			int num9 = XSource.Length;
			int num10 = base.TriangleVertexColumn1[num8];
			int num11 = base.TriangleVertexColumn2[num8];
			int num12 = base.TriangleVertexColumn3[num8];
			if (num10 >= num9 || num11 >= num9 || num12 >= num9)
			{
				return null;
			}
			double num13 = (XSource[num10] - base.Viewport.Left) / base.Viewport.Width;
			double num14 = (YSource[num10] - base.Viewport.Top) / base.Viewport.Height;
			double num15 = (XSource[num11] - base.Viewport.Left) / base.Viewport.Width;
			double num16 = (YSource[num11] - base.Viewport.Top) / base.Viewport.Height;
			double num17 = (XSource[num12] - base.Viewport.Left) / base.Viewport.Width;
			double num18 = (YSource[num12] - base.Viewport.Top) / base.Viewport.Height;
			double num19 = Math.Pow(num13 - num3, 2.0) + Math.Pow(num14 - num4, 2.0);
			double num20 = Math.Pow(num15 - num3, 2.0) + Math.Pow(num16 - num4, 2.0);
			double num21 = Math.Pow(num17 - num3, 2.0) + Math.Pow(num18 - num4, 2.0);
			if (num19 < num20 && num19 < num21)
			{
				return base.FastItemsSource[num10];
			}
			if (num20 < num19 && num20 < num21)
			{
				return base.FastItemsSource[num11];
			}
			if (num21 < num19 && num21 < num20)
			{
				return base.FastItemsSource[num12];
			}
			return base.FastItemsSource[num10];
		}

		internal TriangleRasterizer CreateBitmap(SeriesView view, ScalerParams xParams, ScalerParams yParams)
		{
			view.GetViewInfo(out var viewportRect, out var _);
			viewportRect = new Rect(0.0, 0.0, viewportRect.Width, viewportRect.Height);
			xParams = new ScalerParams(xParams.WindowRect, viewportRect, xParams.IsInverted, xParams.EffectiveViewportRect);
			yParams = new ScalerParams(yParams.WindowRect, viewportRect, yParams.IsInverted, yParams.EffectiveViewportRect);
			yParams.ReferenceValue = GetReferenceValue();
			ScatterAreaSeriesView scatterAreaSeriesView = (ScatterAreaSeriesView)view;
			NumericXAxis xAxis = base.XAxis;
			NumericYAxis yAxis = base.YAxis;
			int count = base.TriangleVertexColumn1.Count;
			double[] array = new double[base.XColumn.Count];
			double[] array2 = new double[base.YColumn.Count];
			base.XColumn.CopyTo(array, 0);
			base.YColumn.CopyTo(array2, 0);
			IList<double> colorColumn = ColorColumn;
			IList<int> triangleVertexColumn = base.TriangleVertexColumn1;
			IList<int> triangleVertexColumn2 = base.TriangleVertexColumn2;
			IList<int> triangleVertexColumn3 = base.TriangleVertexColumn3;
			XSource = array;
			YSource = array2;
			xAxis.GetScaledValueList(array, 0, array.Length, xParams);
			yAxis.GetScaledValueList(array2, 0, array2.Length, yParams);
			ColorScale actualColorScale = ActualColorScale;
			TriangleRasterizer rasterizer = scatterAreaSeriesView.GetRasterizer(xParams.ViewportRect, actualColorScale, ColorColumn);
			double top = viewportRect.Top;
			double left = viewportRect.Left;
			double right = viewportRect.Right;
			double bottom = viewportRect.Bottom;
			AssertMouseOver(scatterAreaSeriesView);
			int[] itemIndexes = scatterAreaSeriesView.ItemIndexes;
			int num = array.Length;
			for (int i = 0; i < count; i++)
			{
				int num2 = triangleVertexColumn[i];
				int num3 = triangleVertexColumn2[i];
				int num4 = triangleVertexColumn3[i];
				if (num2 < num && num3 < num && num4 < num && num2 >= 0 && num3 >= 0 && num4 >= 0)
				{
					double x = array[num2];
					double y = array2[num2];
					Point p = new Point(x, y);
					double x2 = array[num3];
					double y2 = array2[num3];
					Point p2 = new Point(x2, y2);
					double x3 = array[num4];
					double y3 = array2[num4];
					Point p3 = new Point(x3, y3);
					double num5 = ((p2.Y < p3.Y) ? p2.Y : p3.Y);
					num5 = ((p.Y < num5) ? p.Y : num5);
					double num6 = ((p2.Y > p3.Y) ? p2.Y : p3.Y);
					num6 = ((p.Y > num6) ? p.Y : num6);
					double num7 = ((p2.X < p3.X) ? p2.X : p3.X);
					num7 = ((p.X < num7) ? p.X : num7);
					double num8 = ((p2.X > p3.X) ? p2.X : p3.X);
					num8 = ((p.X > num8) ? p.X : num8);
					if (num5 < bottom && num6 > top && num7 < right && num8 > left)
					{
						double value = colorColumn[num2];
						double value2 = colorColumn[num3];
						double value3 = colorColumn[num4];
						rasterizer.RasterizeTriangle(i, itemIndexes, p, p2, p3, value, value2, value3);
					}
				}
			}
			return rasterizer;
		}

		protected ObservableCollection<Color> GetScalePaletteBasedOnSeriesBrush()
		{
			Brush actualBrush = base.ActualBrush;
			Color color = ((actualBrush != null) ? ColorUtil.FromBrush(actualBrush) : ColorUtil.FromString("#000000"));
			return new ObservableCollection<Color>
			{
				color.GetLightened(-0.5),
				color
			};
		}

		public void UpdateActualColorScale()
		{
			ColorScale colorScale = ColorScale;
			if (colorScale == null)
			{
				colorScale = new CustomPaletteColorScale
				{
					Palette = GetScalePaletteBasedOnSeriesBrush(),
					InterpolationMode = ColorScaleInterpolationMode.InterpolateHSV
				};
			}
			else if (colorScale is CustomPaletteColorScale)
			{
				CustomPaletteColorScale customPaletteColorScale = (CustomPaletteColorScale)colorScale;
				if (customPaletteColorScale.Palette == null || customPaletteColorScale.Palette.Count == 0)
				{
					customPaletteColorScale.Palette = GetScalePaletteBasedOnSeriesBrush();
				}
				colorScale = customPaletteColorScale;
			}
			new ObservableCollection<Color>();
			if (colorScale is CustomPaletteColorScale)
			{
				_ = ((CustomPaletteColorScale)colorScale).Palette;
			}
			else
			{
				GetScalePaletteBasedOnSeriesBrush();
			}
			ActualColorScale = colorScale;
		}

		protected override void UpdateIndexedProperties()
		{
			base.UpdateIndexedProperties();
			UpdateActualColorScale();
		}

		protected internal override void ClearRendering(bool wipeClean, SeriesView view)
		{
			base.ClearRendering(wipeClean, view);
			((ScatterAreaSeriesView)view).ClearBitmap();
		}

		protected override SeriesView CreateView()
		{
			return new ScatterAreaSeriesView(this);
		}

		protected internal override void OnViewCreated(SeriesView view)
		{
			base.OnViewCreated(view);
			ScatterAreaSeriesView = view as ScatterAreaSeriesView;
		}

		public void AttachImage(Image image)
		{
			if (ScatterAreaSeriesView != null)
			{
				ScatterAreaSeriesView.AttachImage(image);
			}
		}

		internal override DataContext GetTooltipContext(object item)
		{
			if (item != null)
			{
				int num = base.FastItemsSource.IndexOf(item);
				if (num != -1)
				{
					double num2 = base.XColumn[num];
					double num3 = base.YColumn[num];
					object value = null;
					if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(ColorMemberPath))
					{
						value = ColorColumn[num];
					}
					return new ScatterSeriesValueDataContext
					{
						Series = this,
						Item = item,
						ItemXValue = num2,
						ItemYValue = num3,
						Value = value
					};
				}
			}
			return new DataContext
			{
				Series = this,
				Item = item
			};
		}
	}
	[TSImportModule("igniteui-core/ColorUtil", "ColorUtil")]
	internal class TriangleRasterizer
	{
		private class PointAndValue
		{
			internal Point Point { get; set; }

			internal double Value { get; set; }
		}

		internal int[] PixelData;

		private double _defaultMinimum;

		private double _defaultMaximum;

		private ColorScale _colorScale;

		private IList<double> _colorColumn;

		internal WriteableBitmap Bitmap { get; set; }

		private double DefaultMinimum
		{
			get
			{
				return _defaultMinimum;
			}
			set
			{
				_defaultMinimum = value;
			}
		}

		private double DefaultMaximum
		{
			get
			{
				return _defaultMaximum;
			}
			set
			{
				_defaultMaximum = value;
			}
		}

		private ColorScale ColorScale
		{
			get
			{
				return _colorScale;
			}
			set
			{
				_colorScale = value;
			}
		}

		private IList<double> ColorColumn
		{
			get
			{
				return _colorColumn;
			}
			set
			{
				_colorColumn = value;
			}
		}

		internal TriangleRasterizer(WriteableBitmap bitmap, ColorScale colorScale, double defaultMinimum, double defaultMaximum, IFastItemColumn<double> colorColumn)
		{
			if (bitmap == null || colorScale == null || colorColumn == null)
			{
				throw new ArgumentNullException();
			}
			Bitmap = bitmap;
			ColorScale = colorScale;
			ColorColumn = colorColumn;
			_defaultMinimum = defaultMinimum;
			_defaultMaximum = defaultMaximum;
			PixelData = new int[bitmap.PixelHeight * bitmap.PixelWidth];
		}

		internal void RasterizeTriangle(int index, int[] indexBuffer, Point p0, Point p1, Point p2, double value0, double value1, double value2)
		{
			_ = Bitmap.PixelWidth;
			int pixelHeight = Bitmap.PixelHeight;
			if (p1.Y > p2.Y)
			{
				Point point = p1;
				p1 = p2;
				p2 = point;
				double num = value1;
				value1 = value2;
				value2 = num;
			}
			if (p0.Y > p2.Y)
			{
				Point point2 = p0;
				p0 = p2;
				p2 = point2;
				double num2 = value0;
				value0 = value2;
				value2 = num2;
			}
			if (p0.Y > p1.Y)
			{
				Point point3 = p0;
				p0 = p1;
				p1 = point3;
				double num3 = value0;
				value0 = value1;
				value1 = num3;
			}
			int num4 = (int)Math.Round(p0.Y);
			int num5 = (int)Math.Round(p1.Y);
			int num6 = (int)Math.Round(p2.Y);
			if (num6 == num4 || double.IsNaN(value0) || double.IsNaN(value1) || double.IsNaN(value2))
			{
				return;
			}
			bool flag = (p1.X - p0.X) * (p2.Y - p0.Y) - (p2.X - p0.X) * (p1.Y - p0.Y) >= 0.0;
			int num7 = Math.Max(0, num4);
			int num8 = Math.Min(pixelHeight - 1, num5);
			for (int i = num7; i < num8; i++)
			{
				double num9 = (double)(i - num4) / (double)(num5 - num4);
				double num10 = p0.X + num9 * (p1.X - p0.X);
				double num11 = value0 + num9 * (value1 - value0);
				double num12 = (double)(i - num4) / (double)(num6 - num4);
				double num13 = p0.X + num12 * (p2.X - p0.X);
				double num14 = value0 + num12 * (value2 - value0);
				if (flag)
				{
					RasterizeLine(index, indexBuffer, i, (int)Math.Floor(num13), (int)Math.Ceiling(num10), num14, num11);
				}
				else
				{
					RasterizeLine(index, indexBuffer, i, (int)Math.Floor(num10), (int)Math.Ceiling(num13), num11, num14);
				}
			}
			int num15 = Math.Min(pixelHeight - 1, Math.Max(0, num5));
			int num16 = Math.Min(pixelHeight - 1, num6);
			double num17 = 0.0;
			double num18 = p1.X + num17 * (p2.X - p1.X);
			double num19 = value1 + num17 * (value2 - value1);
			int num20 = num15;
			double num21 = num6 - num4;
			double num22 = (double)(num20 - num4) / num21;
			double num23 = p0.X + num22 * (p2.X - p0.X);
			double num24 = value0 + num22 * (value2 - value0);
			do
			{
				if (flag)
				{
					RasterizeLine(index, indexBuffer, num20, (int)Math.Floor(num23), (int)Math.Ceiling(num18), num24, num19);
				}
				else
				{
					RasterizeLine(index, indexBuffer, num20, (int)Math.Floor(num18), (int)Math.Ceiling(num23), num19, num24);
				}
				num20++;
				num17 = (double)(num20 - num5) / (double)(num6 - num5);
				num18 = p1.X + num17 * (p2.X - p1.X);
				num19 = value1 + num17 * (value2 - value1);
				num22 = (double)(num20 - num4) / num21;
				num23 = p0.X + num22 * (p2.X - p0.X);
				num24 = value0 + num22 * (value2 - value0);
			}
			while (num20 < num16);
		}

		private void RasterizeLine(int index, int[] indexBuffer, int y, int x0, int x1, double value0, double value1)
		{
			int pixelWidth = Bitmap.PixelWidth;
			int num = ((x0 > 0) ? x0 : 0);
			int num2 = ((x1 < pixelWidth - 1) ? x1 : (pixelWidth - 1));
			double num3 = value1 - value0;
			double num4 = 1.0 / (double)(x1 - x0);
			IList<double> colorColumn = _colorColumn;
			double defaultMinimum = _defaultMinimum;
			double defaultMaximum = _defaultMaximum;
			int num5 = y * pixelWidth;
			for (int i = num; i <= num2; i++)
			{
				double value2 = value0 + num3 * (double)(i - x0) * num4;
				Color color = _colorScale.GetColor(value2, defaultMinimum, defaultMaximum, colorColumn);
				if (color.A != 0)
				{
					PixelData[y * pixelWidth + i] = ColorUtil.ColorToInt(color);
					indexBuffer[num5 + i] = index + 1;
				}
			}
		}

		public void PostRasterize()
		{
			WriteableBitmap bitmap = Bitmap;
			bitmap.Lock();
			bitmap.WritePixels(new Int32Rect(0, 0, bitmap.PixelWidth, bitmap.PixelHeight), PixelData, 4 * bitmap.PixelWidth, 0);
			bitmap.Unlock();
		}

		private void SetPixel(int position, Color color)
		{
		}

		private void SetPixel(int x, int y, Color color)
		{
		}
	}

		public ScatterPolygonSeries()
		{
			base.DefaultStyleKey = typeof(ScatterPolygonSeries);
		}

		protected override bool ShouldRecordMarkerPositions()
		{
			return ShouldDisplayMarkers();
		}

		protected override void RenderWithView(SeriesView view)
		{
			ScatterPolygonSeriesView scatterPolygonSeriesView = (ScatterPolygonSeriesView)view;
			scatterPolygonSeriesView.ShapeStyleChanged(ShapeStyle);
			scatterPolygonSeriesView.ShapeStyleSelectorChanged(ShapeStyleSelector);
			base.RenderWithView(view);
			if (ClearAndAbortIfInvalid(view))
			{
				return;
			}
			view.GetViewInfo(out var viewportRect, out var windowRect);
			Rect effectiveViewport = GetEffectiveViewport(view);
			xParams = new ScalerParams(windowRect, viewportRect, base.XAxis.IsInverted);
			xParams.EffectiveViewportRect = effectiveViewport;
			yParams = new ScalerParams(windowRect, viewportRect, base.YAxis.IsInverted);
			yParams.EffectiveViewportRect = effectiveViewport;
			if (viewportRect.Width < 1.0 || viewportRect.Height < 1.0)
			{
				return;
			}
			AxisInfoCache = new ShapeAxisInfoCache
			{
				XAxis = base.XAxis,
				YAxis = base.YAxis,
				XAxisIsInverted = base.XAxis.IsInverted,
				YAxisIsInverted = base.YAxis.IsInverted,
				FastItemsSource = base.FastItemsSource,
				ShapeColumn = base.ShapeColumn
			};
			if (ShouldDisplayMarkers())
			{
				Dictionary<object, OwnedPoint> markers = new Dictionary<object, OwnedPoint>();
				scatterPolygonSeriesView.MarkerManager.WinnowMarkers(markers, 400, windowRect, viewportRect, base.Resolution);
				scatterPolygonSeriesView.MarkerManager.Render(markers, lightweight: false);
				if (ShouldOverrideMarkerStyle())
				{
					ColorizeMarkers((ScatterPolygonSeriesView)view);
				}
			}
		}

		internal void ColorizeMarkers(ScatterPolygonSeriesView view)
		{
			view.MarkerAppearanceHandled = true;
			RenderManager.InitShapeMarkerRenderSettings(this, ShouldOverrideMarkerStyle(), GetShapeItems);
			AssigningSeriesStyleEventArgsBase markerOverrideArgs = RenderManager.MarkerOverrideArgs;
			bool areMarkerStylesOverriden = markerOverrideArgs != null;
			GetEffectiveViewport(view);
			int valueCount = ((base.FastItemsSource != null) ? base.FastItemsSource.Count : 0);
			view.DoToAllMarkers(delegate(Marker marker)
			{
				if (marker.Visibility == Visibility.Visible)
				{
					int currentIndex = marker.CurrentIndex;
					DataContext dataContext = (DataContext)marker.Content;
					if (dataContext == null)
					{
						dataContext = (DataContext)(marker.Content = new DataContext());
					}
					if (areMarkerStylesOverriden)
					{
						PerformShapeMarkerStyleOverride(currentIndex, valueCount, view.IsThumbnailView);
					}
					RenderManager.SetMarkerAppearance(marker, dataContext);
				}
			});
		}

		private bool ShouldDisplayMarkers()
		{
			if (CachedActualMarkerTemplate != null)
			{
				if (MarkerType == MarkerType.None || MarkerType == MarkerType.Unset)
				{
					return MarkerTemplate != null;
				}
				return true;
			}
			return false;
		}

		protected internal virtual MarkerOutlineMode ResolveMarkerOutlineMode()
		{
			if (MarkerOutlineMode == MarkerOutlineMode.Auto)
			{
				return MarkerOutlineMode.Normal;
			}
			return MarkerOutlineMode;
		}

		internal override void UpdateMarkerOutlineMode(MarkerOutlineMode markerOutlineMode)
		{
			base.UpdateMarkerOutlineMode(markerOutlineMode);
			MarkerOutlineMode = markerOutlineMode;
		}

		protected internal virtual MarkerFillMode ResolveMarkerFillMode()
		{
			if (MarkerFillMode == MarkerFillMode.Auto)
			{
				return MarkerFillMode.MatchMarkerOutline;
			}
			return MarkerFillMode;
		}

		internal override void UpdateMarkerFillMode(MarkerFillMode markerFillMode)
		{
			base.UpdateMarkerFillMode(markerFillMode);
			MarkerFillMode = markerFillMode;
		}

		internal override void UpdateMarkerThickness(double markerThickness)
		{
			base.UpdateMarkerThickness(markerThickness);
			MarkerThickness = markerThickness;
		}

		protected override void UpdateIndexedProperties()
		{
			base.UpdateIndexedProperties();
			if (base.Index < 0)
			{
				return;
			}
			if (MarkerTemplate != null)
			{
				ShapeView.ClearActualMarkerTemplate();
				ShapeView.BindMarkerTemplateToActual();
			}
			else
			{
				string markerTemplatePropertyName = MarkerSeries.GetMarkerTemplatePropertyName(MarkerSeries.ResolveMarkerType(this, MarkerType));
				if (markerTemplatePropertyName == null)
				{
					ActualMarkerTemplate = MarkerSeries.NullMarkerTemplate;
				}
				else
				{
					ShapeView.BindActualToMarkerTemplate(markerTemplatePropertyName);
				}
			}
			if (MarkerBrush != null && MarkerType != MarkerType.Hidden)
			{
				ShapeView.ClearActualMarkerBrush();
				ShapeView.BindMarkerBrushToActual();
			}
			else if (MarkerType == MarkerType.Hidden)
			{
				ActualMarkerBrush = base.View.GetTransparentBrush();
			}
			else if (CachedMarkerFillMode != MarkerFillMode.MatchMarkerOutline)
			{
				if (base.SeriesViewer != null)
				{
					Brush brush = base.SeriesViewer.GetMarkerBrushByIndex(base.Index);
					if (!double.IsNaN(base.ActualMarkerFillOpacity) && base.ActualMarkerFillOpacity != 1.0)
					{
						brush = brush.ModifyOpacity(base.ActualMarkerFillOpacity);
						if (base.ShouldFreezeBrushesCached && brush.CanFreeze)
						{
							brush.Freeze();
						}
					}
					ActualMarkerBrush = brush;
				}
				else
				{
					ActualMarkerBrush = null;
				}
			}
			if (MarkerOutline != null)
			{
				ShapeView.ClearActualMarkerOutline();
				ShapeView.BindMarkerOutlineToActual();
			}
			else if (MarkerType == MarkerType.Hidden)
			{
				ActualMarkerOutline = base.View.GetTransparentBrush();
			}
			else if (MarkerOutlineMode == MarkerOutlineMode.MatchMarkerBrush)
			{
				ActualMarkerOutline = ActualMarkerBrush;
			}
			else
			{
				ActualMarkerOutline = ((base.SeriesViewer == null) ? null : base.SeriesViewer.GetMarkerOutlineByIndex(base.Index));
			}
			if (CachedMarkerFillMode != MarkerFillMode.MatchMarkerOutline || MarkerBrush != null || MarkerType == MarkerType.Hidden)
			{
				return;
			}
			if (ActualMarkerOutline != null)
			{
				Brush brush2 = ActualMarkerOutline;
				if (!double.IsNaN(base.ActualMarkerFillOpacity) && base.ActualMarkerFillOpacity != 1.0)
				{
					brush2 = brush2.ModifyOpacity(base.ActualMarkerFillOpacity);
					if (base.ShouldFreezeBrushesCached && brush2.CanFreeze)
					{
						brush2.Freeze();
					}
				}
				ActualMarkerBrush = brush2;
			}
			else
			{
				ActualMarkerBrush = null;
			}
		}

		protected override void OnIndexChanged()
		{
			base.OnIndexChanged();
			CachedMarkerOutlineMode = ResolveMarkerOutlineMode();
			CachedMarkerFillMode = ResolveMarkerFillMode();
		}

		protected override void PropertyUpdatedOverride(object sender, string propertyName, object oldValue, object newValue)
		{
			base.PropertyUpdatedOverride(sender, propertyName, oldValue, newValue);
			switch (propertyName)
			{
			case "MarkerBrush":
			case "MarkerType":
			case "MarkerOutline":
			case "MarkerTemplate":
			case "MarkerThickness":
				UpdateIndexedProperties();
				OnVisualPropertiesChanged();
				break;
			case "MarkerOutlineMode":
				CachedMarkerOutlineMode = ResolveMarkerOutlineMode();
				UpdateIndexedProperties();
				OnVisualPropertiesChanged();
				break;
			case "MarkerFillMode":
				CachedMarkerFillMode = ResolveMarkerFillMode();
				UpdateIndexedProperties();
				OnVisualPropertiesChanged();
				break;
			case "ActualMarkerTemplate":
				CachedActualMarkerTemplate = (DataTemplate)newValue;
				if (oldValue == MarkerSeries.NullMarkerTemplate || newValue == MarkerSeries.NullMarkerTemplate || oldValue == null || newValue != null)
				{
					ShapeView.DoUpdateMarkerTemplates();
					RenderSeries(animate: false);
				}
				RenderSeries(animate: false);
				NotifyThumbnailAppearanceChanged();
				break;
			case "ShapeStyle":
				ShapeView.ShapeStyleChanged(ShapeStyle);
				RenderSeries(animate: false);
				NotifyThumbnailAppearanceChanged();
				break;
			case "ShapeStyleSelector":
				ShapeView.ShapeStyleSelectorChanged(ShapeStyleSelector);
				RenderSeries(animate: false);
				NotifyThumbnailAppearanceChanged();
				break;
			case "MarkerCollisionAvoidance":
				RenderSeries(animate: false);
				NotifyThumbnailAppearanceChanged();
				break;
			case "ActualMarkerBrush":
			case "ActualMarkerOutline":
				if (ShouldDisplayMarkers())
				{
					RenderSeries(animate: false);
				}
				break;
			}
		}

		internal void RemoveUnusedMarkers(IDictionary<object, OwnedPoint> list, HashPool<object, Marker> markers)
		{
			List<object> list2 = new List<object>();
			foreach (object activeKey in markers.ActiveKeys)
			{
				if (!list.ContainsKey(activeKey))
				{
					list2.Add(activeKey);
				}
			}
			foreach (object item in list2)
			{
				markers.Remove(item);
			}
		}

		public override bool GetVisiblePointsOfInterest(List<SeriesPointOfInterest> points, bool useValueAsLabel, int labelPrecision)
		{
			if (!HasMarkers)
			{
				return false;
			}
			NumericXAxis xAxis = base.XAxis;
			ScalerParams xParams = new ScalerParams(base.SeriesViewer.ActualWindowRect, base.Viewport, xAxis.IsInverted);
			xParams.EffectiveViewportRect = GetEffectiveViewport(base.View);
			NumericYAxis yAxis = base.YAxis;
			ScalerParams yParams = new ScalerParams(base.SeriesViewer.ActualWindowRect, base.Viewport, yAxis.IsInverted);
			yParams.EffectiveViewportRect = GetEffectiveViewport(base.View);
			points.Clear();
			ShapeView.DoToAllMarkers(delegate(Marker m)
			{
				if (m.Visibility == Visibility.Visible)
				{
					SeriesPointOfInterest seriesPointOfInterest = new SeriesPointOfInterest();
					double num;
					double num2;
					if (m.RenderTransform is MatrixTransform)
					{
						Point point = ((MatrixTransform)m.RenderTransform).Transform(new Point(0.0, 0.0));
						num = point.X + m.DesiredSize.Width / 2.0;
						num2 = point.Y + m.DesiredSize.Height / 2.0;
					}
					else
					{
						TranslateTransform obj = (TranslateTransform)m.RenderTransform;
						num = obj.X + m.DesiredSize.Width / 2.0;
						num2 = obj.Y + m.DesiredSize.Height / 2.0;
					}
					if (!(num < base.Viewport.Left) && !(num > base.Viewport.Right) && !(num2 < base.Viewport.Top) && !(num2 > base.Viewport.Bottom))
					{
						seriesPointOfInterest.XValue = xAxis.GetUnscaledValue(num, xParams);
						seriesPointOfInterest.YValue = yAxis.GetUnscaledValue(num2, yParams);
						seriesPointOfInterest.DataContext = (DataContext)m.Content;
						points.Add(seriesPointOfInterest);
					}
				}
			});
			return true;
		}

		internal Point[] GetMarkerLocations(ScatterPolygonSeriesView view, HashPool<object, Marker> markers, Point[] locations, Rect windowRect, Rect viewport)
		{
			if (locations == null || locations.Length != AxisInfoCache.FastItemsSource.Count)
			{
				locations = new Point[AxisInfoCache.FastItemsSource.Count];
			}
			ScalerParams scalerParams = new ScalerParams(windowRect, viewport, base.XAxis.IsInverted)
			{
				EffectiveViewportRect = GetEffectiveViewport(view)
			};
			ScalerParams scalerParams2 = new ScalerParams(windowRect, viewport, base.YAxis.IsInverted)
			{
				EffectiveViewportRect = GetEffectiveViewport(view)
			};
			Rect contentViewport = GetContentViewport(view);
			double unscaledValue = AxisInfoCache.XAxis.GetUnscaledValue(contentViewport.Left, scalerParams);
			double unscaledValue2 = AxisInfoCache.XAxis.GetUnscaledValue(contentViewport.Right, scalerParams);
			double unscaledValue3 = AxisInfoCache.YAxis.GetUnscaledValue(contentViewport.Bottom, scalerParams2);
			double unscaledValue4 = AxisInfoCache.YAxis.GetUnscaledValue(contentViewport.Top, scalerParams2);
			if (AxisInfoCache.XAxisIsInverted)
			{
				double num = unscaledValue;
				unscaledValue = unscaledValue2;
				unscaledValue2 = num;
			}
			if (AxisInfoCache.YAxisIsInverted)
			{
				double num2 = unscaledValue3;
				unscaledValue3 = unscaledValue4;
				unscaledValue4 = num2;
			}
			ShapeAxisInfoCache axisInfoCache = AxisInfoCache;
			_ = axisInfoCache.XAxis;
			_ = axisInfoCache.YAxis;
			double left = scalerParams.ViewportRect.Left;
			double right = scalerParams.ViewportRect.Right;
			double top = scalerParams2.ViewportRect.Top;
			double bottom = scalerParams2.ViewportRect.Bottom;
			for (int i = 0; i < AxisInfoCache.FastItemsSource.Count; i++)
			{
				double num3 = 0.0;
				double num4 = 0.0;
				FlattenedShape value = null;
				view.MarkerPositions.TryGetValue(i, out value);
				if (value == null)
				{
					locations[i].X = double.NaN;
					locations[i].Y = double.NaN;
					continue;
				}
				Point center = value.FullBounds.GetCenter();
				num3 = center.X;
				num4 = center.Y;
				if (num3 >= left && num3 <= right && num4 >= top && num4 <= bottom)
				{
					locations[i].X = num3;
					locations[i].Y = num4;
				}
				else
				{
					locations[i].X = double.NaN;
					locations[i].Y = double.NaN;
				}
			}
			return locations;
		}

		internal List<int> GetActiveIndexes(HashPool<object, Marker> markers, List<int> indexes)
		{
			if (indexes == null)
			{
				indexes = new List<int>(markers.ActiveCount);
			}
			else
			{
				indexes.Clear();
			}
			int num = 0;
			IFastItemsSource fastItemsSource = base.FastItemsSource;
			foreach (object activeKey in markers.ActiveKeys)
			{
				indexes.Add(fastItemsSource.IndexOf(activeKey));
				num++;
			}
			return indexes;
		}

		internal override DataContext GetTooltipContext(object item)
		{
			if (item != null && base.FastItemsSource.IndexOf(item) != -1)
			{
				object value = null;
				return new ScatterSeriesValueDataContext
				{
					Series = this,
					Item = item,
					Value = value
				};
			}
			return new DataContext
			{
				Series = this,
				Item = item
			};
		}
	}
	internal class ShapeAxisInfoCache
	{
		public NumericXAxis XAxis { get; set; }

		public NumericYAxis YAxis { get; set; }

		public bool XAxisIsInverted { get; set; }

		public bool YAxisIsInverted { get; set; }

		public IFastItemsSource FastItemsSource { get; set; }

		public IFastItemColumn<object> ShapeColumn { get; set; }
	}
	[TSImportModule("igniteui-core/InvalidOperationException", "InvalidOperationException")]
	[HybridJavaSuppressWidget]
	public abstract class ShapeSeriesBase : Series

		public override object GetItemValue(object item, string memberPathName)
		{
			if (ResolveMemberPath(memberPathName) == "ShapeMemberPath")
			{
				return GetItemValueByMemberPath(item, memberPathName, ShapeMemberPath);
			}
			return null;
		}

		protected virtual HighlightingInfo GetSpecificHighlightingInfo(object item, Point world, HighlightingInfo prevValue)
		{
			Point position = FromWorldPosition(world);
			FrameworkElement hitShape = ShapeSeriesView.GetHitShape(position, isFinger: false);
			int num = -1;
			if (hitShape == null)
			{
				if (item == null)
				{
					return null;
				}
				num = base.FastItemsSource.IndexOf(item);
			}
			else if (hitShape.DataContext != null)
			{
				num = ((DataContext)hitShape.DataContext).CachedIndex;
			}
			if (num == -1)
			{
				return null;
			}
			HighlightingInfo highlightingInfo = new HighlightingInfo();
			highlightingInfo.Series = this;
			highlightingInfo.StartIndex = num;
			highlightingInfo.EndIndex = num;
			highlightingInfo.IsFullRange = false;
			if (prevValue != null && prevValue.StartIndex == highlightingInfo.StartIndex && prevValue.EndIndex == highlightingInfo.EndIndex)
			{
				return prevValue;
			}
			return highlightingInfo;
		}

		protected HighlightingInfo GetSpecificMarkerHighlightingInfo(object item, Point world, HighlightingInfo prevValue)
		{
			Marker hitMarker = ShapeSeriesView.GetHitMarker(FromWorldPosition(world));
			int num = -1;
			if (hitMarker == null)
			{
				if (item == null)
				{
					return null;
				}
				num = base.FastItemsSource.IndexOf(item);
			}
			else
			{
				num = hitMarker.CurrentIndex;
			}
			if (num == -1)
			{
				return null;
			}
			HighlightingInfo highlightingInfo = new HighlightingInfo();
			highlightingInfo.Series = this;
			highlightingInfo.StartIndex = num;
			highlightingInfo.EndIndex = num;
			highlightingInfo.IsFullRange = false;
			highlightingInfo.IsMarker = true;
			if (prevValue != null && prevValue.StartIndex == highlightingInfo.StartIndex && prevValue.EndIndex == highlightingInfo.EndIndex)
			{
				return prevValue;
			}
			return highlightingInfo;
		}

		protected virtual ShapeItemSearchMode GetResolvedItemSearchMode()
		{
			if (ItemSearchMode != ShapeItemSearchMode.Auto)
			{
				return ItemSearchMode;
			}
			return ShapeItemSearchMode.ClosestBoundingBox;
		}

		public override double GetExactItemIndex(Point world)
		{
			return ActualItemSearchMode switch
			{
				ShapeItemSearchMode.ClosestBoundingBox => GetExactItemIndexForClosestBoundingBox(world).Item1, 
				ShapeItemSearchMode.ClosestShape => GetExactItemIndexForClosestShape(world), 
				ShapeItemSearchMode.ClosestPointOnClosestShape => GetExactItemIndexForClosestShape(world), 
				_ => -1.0, 
			};
		}

		protected virtual Tuple<double, Point> GetExactItemIndexForClosestBoundingBox(Point world)
		{
			Point point = FromWorldPosition(world);
			Point item = new Point(double.NaN, double.NaN);
			List<ShapeHitRegion> shapeHitRegions = ShapeSeriesView.ShapeHitRegions;
			if (shapeHitRegions == null)
			{
				return new Tuple<double, Point>(-1.0, item);
			}
			ShapeHitRegion hitRegion = ShapeSeriesView.GetHitRegion(point, isFinger: false, !AreShapesClosed);
			if (hitRegion != null)
			{
				item = hitRegion.Bounds.GetCenter();
				return new Tuple<double, Point>(hitRegion.Index, item);
			}
			_ = point.X;
			_ = point.Y;
			if (base.FastItemsSource == null || XAxis == null || YAxis == null || BoundsColumn == null)
			{
				return new Tuple<double, Point>(-1.0, item);
			}
			if (base.FastItemsSource.Count > ItemSearchThreshold)
			{
				return new Tuple<double, Point>(-1.0, item);
			}
			double num = double.MaxValue;
			int num2 = -1;
			for (int i = 0; i < shapeHitRegions.Count; i++)
			{
				double distanceSquared = shapeHitRegions[i].Bounds.GetDistanceSquared(point);
				if (distanceSquared < num)
				{
					num = distanceSquared;
					num2 = shapeHitRegions[i].Index;
					item = shapeHitRegions[i].Bounds.GetCenter();
				}
			}
			return new Tuple<double, Point>(num2, item);
		}

		private Tuple<int, Point, Point> GetClosestShape(Point world)
		{
			Point point = FromWorldPosition(world);
			_ = point.X;
			_ = point.Y;
			Point point2 = new Point(double.NaN, double.NaN);
			if (base.FastItemsSource == null || XAxis == null || YAxis == null || BoundsColumn == null)
			{
				return new Tuple<int, Point, Point>(-1, point2, point2);
			}
			if (base.FastItemsSource.Count > ItemSearchThreshold)
			{
				return new Tuple<int, Point, Point>(-1, point2, point2);
			}
			double num = double.MaxValue;
			List<ShapeHitRegion> shapeHitRegions = ShapeSeriesView.ShapeHitRegions;
			if (shapeHitRegions == null)
			{
				return new Tuple<int, Point, Point>(-1, point2, point2);
			}
			ShapeHitRegion hitRegion = ShapeSeriesView.GetHitRegion(point, isFinger: false, !AreShapesClosed);
			if (hitRegion != null)
			{
				Point center = hitRegion.Bounds.GetCenter();
				Tuple<double, Point> tuple = DistanceSquaredToPolygon(point, hitRegion.Points, AreShapesClosed);
				return new Tuple<int, Point, Point>(hitRegion.Index, tuple.Item2, center);
			}
			for (int i = 0; i < shapeHitRegions.Count; i++)
			{
				Rect bounds = shapeHitRegions[i].Bounds;
				double distanceSquared = bounds.GetDistanceSquared(point);
				double num2 = bounds.Width * bounds.Width + bounds.Height * bounds.Height + distanceSquared;
				if (num2 <= num)
				{
					num = num2;
				}
			}
			double num3 = double.MaxValue;
			int num4 = -1;
			for (int j = 0; j < shapeHitRegions.Count; j++)
			{
				if (shapeHitRegions[j].Bounds.GetDistanceSquared(point) < num)
				{
					Tuple<double, Point> tuple2 = DistanceSquaredToPolygon(point, shapeHitRegions[j].Points, AreShapesClosed);
					if (tuple2.Item1 < num3)
					{
						num3 = tuple2.Item1;
						point2 = tuple2.Item2;
						num4 = j;
					}
				}
			}
			if (num4 >= 0)
			{
				return new Tuple<int, Point, Point>(shapeHitRegions[num4].Index, point2, shapeHitRegions[num4].Bounds.GetCenter());
			}
			return new Tuple<int, Point, Point>(-1, point2, point2);
		}

		private Tuple<double, Point> DistanceSquaredToPolygon(Point pos, List<Point> points, bool isClosed)
		{
			Point startPoint = new Point(double.NaN, double.NaN);
			double num = double.MaxValue;
			Point item = new Point(double.NaN, double.NaN);
			bool flag = false;
			int num2 = -1;
			for (int i = 0; i < points.Count; i++)
			{
				Point point = points[i];
				if (i >= 1)
				{
					double num3 = GeometryUtil.DistSquaredToLineSegment(pos, startPoint, point);
					if (num3 < num)
					{
						num = num3;
						flag = true;
						num2 = i;
					}
				}
				startPoint = point;
			}
			if (isClosed)
			{
				Point endPoint = points[0];
				double num4 = GeometryUtil.DistSquaredToLineSegment(pos, startPoint, endPoint);
				if (num4 < num)
				{
					num = num4;
					double num5 = GeometryUtil.ProjectPointToLineSegment(pos, startPoint, endPoint);
					item = new Point(startPoint.X + (endPoint.X - startPoint.X) * num5, startPoint.Y + (endPoint.Y - startPoint.Y) * num5);
					return new Tuple<double, Point>(num, item);
				}
			}
			if (flag)
			{
				Point startPoint2 = points[num2 - 1];
				Point endPoint2 = points[num2];
				double num6 = GeometryUtil.ProjectPointToLineSegment(pos, startPoint2, endPoint2);
				item = new Point(startPoint2.X + (endPoint2.X - startPoint2.X) * num6, startPoint2.Y + (endPoint2.Y - startPoint2.Y) * num6);
			}
			return new Tuple<double, Point>(num, item);
		}

		protected virtual double GetExactItemIndexForClosestShape(Point world)
		{
			return GetClosestShape(world).Item1;
		}

		public override Point GetSeriesValuePosition(Point world, bool useInterpolation, bool skipUnknowns)
		{
			if (XAxis == null || YAxis == null || BoundsColumn == null)
			{
				return new Point(double.NaN, double.NaN);
			}
			return ActualItemSearchMode switch
			{
				ShapeItemSearchMode.ClosestBoundingBox => GetExactItemIndexForClosestBoundingBox(world).Item2, 
				ShapeItemSearchMode.ClosestShape => GetClosestShape(world).Item3, 
				ShapeItemSearchMode.ClosestPointOnClosestShape => GetClosestShape(world).Item2, 
				_ => new Point(double.NaN, double.NaN), 
			};
		}

		public override object GetItem(Point world)
		{
			int itemIndex = GetItemIndex(world);
			if (base.FastItemsSource != null && itemIndex >= 0 && itemIndex < base.FastItemsSource.Count)
			{
				return base.FastItemsSource[itemIndex];
			}
			return null;
		}

		protected HighlightingInfo GetFullSeriesInfo(object item, Point world, HighlightingInfo prevValue)
		{
			HighlightingInfo highlightingInfo = new HighlightingInfo();
			highlightingInfo.Series = this;
			highlightingInfo.StartIndex = 0;
			highlightingInfo.EndIndex = base.FastItemsSource.Count - 1;
			highlightingInfo.IsFullRange = true;
			if (prevValue != null && prevValue.StartIndex == highlightingInfo.StartIndex && prevValue.EndIndex == highlightingInfo.EndIndex)
			{
				return prevValue;
			}
			return highlightingInfo;
		}

		protected internal override HighlightingInfo GetHighlightingInfo(object item, Point world, bool forceFullRange)
		{
			if (HasIndividualElements && IsSpecificHighlightingMode(base.ActualHighlightingMode) && !forceFullRange)
			{
				return PrevHighlightingInfo = GetSpecificHighlightingInfo(item, world, PrevHighlightingInfo);
			}
			return PrevHighlightingInfo = GetFullSeriesInfo(item, world, PrevHighlightingInfo);
		}

		protected internal override HighlightingInfo GetMarkerHighlightingInfo(object item, Point world, bool forceFullRange)
		{
			if (IsSpecificHighlightingMode(base.ActualHighlightingMode) && !forceFullRange)
			{
				return PrevMarkerHighlightingInfo = GetSpecificMarkerHighlightingInfo(item, world, PrevMarkerHighlightingInfo);
			}
			HighlightingInfo fullSeriesInfo = GetFullSeriesInfo(item, world, PrevMarkerHighlightingInfo);
			fullSeriesInfo.IsMarker = true;
			PrevMarkerHighlightingInfo = fullSeriesInfo;
			return fullSeriesInfo;
		}

		protected bool ShouldOverrideShapeStyle()
		{
			if (this.AssigningShapeStyle == null || !ActualIsCustomShapeStyleAllowed)
			{
				return base.ActualHighlightingMode != SeriesHighlightingMode.None;
			}
			return true;
		}

		protected bool ShouldOverrideMarkerStyle()
		{
			if (this.AssigningShapeMarkerStyle == null || !ActualIsCustomShapeMarkerStyleAllowed)
			{
				return base.ActualHighlightingMode != SeriesHighlightingMode.None;
			}
			return true;
		}

		protected override IFastItemColumn<object> RegisterObjectColumn(string memberPath)
		{
			return base.RegisterObjectColumn(memberPath);
		}

		protected override void PropertyUpdatedOverride(object sender, string propertyName, object oldValue, object newValue)
		{
			base.PropertyUpdatedOverride(sender, propertyName, oldValue, newValue);
			bool flag = false;
			switch (propertyName)
			{
			case "ItemSearchMode":
				ActualItemSearchMode = GetResolvedItemSearchMode();
				break;
			case "FastItemsSource":
			{
				if (oldValue is IFastItemsSource fastItemsSource)
				{
					fastItemsSource.DeregisterColumn(ShapeColumn);
					ShapeColumn = null;
				}
				if (newValue is IFastItemsSource)
				{
					ShapeColumn = RegisterObjectColumn(ShapeMemberPath);
				}
				bool num = XAxis != null && !XAxis.UpdateRange();
				flag = YAxis != null && !YAxis.UpdateRange();
				if (num || flag)
				{
					RenderSeries(animate: false);
				}
				break;
			}
			case "ShapeMemberPath":
				if (base.FastItemsSource != null)
				{
					base.FastItemsSource.DeregisterColumn(ShapeColumn);
					ShapeColumn = RegisterObjectColumn(ShapeMemberPath);
				}
				break;
			case "ShapeColumn":
			{
				ResetBoundsColumn();
				bool num2 = XAxis != null && !XAxis.UpdateRange();
				flag = YAxis != null && !YAxis.UpdateRange();
				if (num2 || flag)
				{
					RenderSeries(animate: false);
				}
				NotifyThumbnailAppearanceChanged();
				break;
			}
			case "XAxis":
			case "YAxis":
			{
				_xAxis = XAxis;
				_yAxis = YAxis;
				Axis axis = (Axis)oldValue;
				Axis axis2 = (Axis)newValue;
				UnInitializeAxis(axis);
				InitializeAxis(axis2);
				if ((axis2 != null && !axis2.UpdateRange()) || (axis2 == null && axis != null))
				{
					RenderSeries(animate: false);
				}
				NotifyThumbnailAppearanceChanged();
				break;
			}
			case "Resolution":
				_resolution = base.Resolution;
				NotifyThumbnailAppearanceChanged();
				break;
			case "ActualBrush":
				RenderSeries(animate: false);
				break;
			case "ShapeFilterResolution":
				ShapeFilterResolutionCached = ShapeFilterResolution;
				RenderSeries(animate: false);
				NotifyThumbnailAppearanceChanged();
				break;
			case "ActualThickness":
				RenderSeries(animate: false);
				NotifyThumbnailAppearanceChanged();
				break;
			case "IsCustomShapeStyleAllowed":
				ActualIsCustomShapeStyleAllowed = ResolveIsCustomShapeStyleAllowed();
				RenderSeries(animate: false);
				break;
			case "IsCustomShapeMarkerStyleAllowed":
				ActualIsCustomShapeMarkerStyleAllowed = ResolveIsCustomShapeMarkerStyleAllowed();
				RenderSeries(animate: false);
				break;
			}
		}

		protected virtual bool ResolveIsCustomShapeStyleAllowed()
		{
			return IsCustomShapeStyleAllowed;
		}

		protected virtual bool ResolveIsCustomShapeMarkerStyleAllowed()
		{
			return IsCustomShapeMarkerStyleAllowed;
		}

		[XamSuppressWidgetMember]
		[UwpSuppressWidgetMember]
		[WFSuppressWidgetMember]
		public bool CanUseAsYAxis(object axis)
		{
			if (axis is NumericYAxis)
			{
				return true;
			}
			return false;
		}

		[XamSuppressWidgetMember]
		[UwpSuppressWidgetMember]
		[WFSuppressWidgetMember]
		public bool CanUseAsXAxis(object axis)
		{
			if (axis is NumericXAxis)
			{
				return true;
			}
			return false;
		}

		private void ResetBoundsColumn()
		{
			BoundsColumn = null;
			if (ShapeColumn != null)
			{
				BoundsColumn = new List<Rect>(ShapeColumn.Count);
				for (int i = 0; i < ShapeColumn.Count; i++)
				{
					BoundsColumn.Add(GetBounds(ShapeColumn[i]));
				}
			}
		}

		private Rect GetBounds(object dataItem)
		{
			if (dataItem is IEnumerable<IEnumerable<Point>>)
			{
				return ((IEnumerable<IEnumerable<Point>>)dataItem).GetBounds();
			}
			if (dataItem is IEnumerable<Point>)
			{
				return ((IEnumerable<Point>)dataItem).GetBounds();
			}
			return Rect.Empty;
		}

		private List<FlattenedShape> GetPlotPoints(SeriesView view, Clipper clipper, object itemPoints, ScalerParams xParams, ScalerParams yParams, double offset, double wrapOffset)
		{
			if (itemPoints is List<List<Point>>)
			{
				return MapAndFlatten(view, clipper, (List<List<Point>>)itemPoints, xParams, yParams, offset, wrapOffset);
			}
			if (itemPoints is IEnumerable<IEnumerable<Point>>)
			{
				IEnumerable<IEnumerable<Point>> obj = (IEnumerable<IEnumerable<Point>>)itemPoints;
				List<FlattenedShape> list = new List<FlattenedShape>();
				FlattenedShape flattenedShape = null;
				{
					foreach (IEnumerable<Point> item in obj)
					{
						flattenedShape = MapAndFlatten(view, clipper, item.ToPointList(), xParams, yParams, offset, wrapOffset);
						if (flattenedShape != null)
						{
							list.Add(flattenedShape);
						}
					}
					return list;
				}
			}
			if (itemPoints is IEnumerable<Point>)
			{
				IEnumerable<Point> points = (IEnumerable<Point>)itemPoints;
				FlattenedShape flattenedShape2 = MapAndFlatten(view, clipper, points.ToPointList(), xParams, yParams, offset, wrapOffset);
				List<FlattenedShape> list2 = new List<FlattenedShape>();
				if (flattenedShape2 != null)
				{
					list2.Add(flattenedShape2);
				}
				return list2;
			}
			throw new InvalidOperationException("Unrecognized data in ShapeColumn");
		}

		{
			return false;
		}

		public override void RenderAlternateView(Rect viewportRect, Rect windowRect, RenderSurface surface, string viewIdentifier, double effectiveScalingRatio)
		{
			base.RenderAlternateView(viewportRect, windowRect, surface, viewIdentifier, effectiveScalingRatio);
			SeriesView seriesView = base.SeriesInteractionManager.AlternateViews[viewIdentifier];
			_ = (ShapeSeriesViewBase)seriesView;
			seriesView.PrepAltSurface(surface);
			if (!ClearAndAbortIfInvalid(seriesView))
			{
				RenderWithView(seriesView);
			}
		}

		protected virtual void RenderWithView(SeriesView view)
		{
			if (ClearAndAbortIfInvalid(view))
			{
				return;
			}
			ShapeSeriesViewBase shapeSeriesView = (ShapeSeriesViewBase)view;
			view.GetViewInfo(out var viewportRect, out var windowRect);
			if (viewportRect.Width < 1.0 || viewportRect.Height < 1.0 || ShapeColumn == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			NumericXAxis xAxis = XAxis;
			NumericYAxis yAxis = YAxis;
			Rect effectiveViewport = GetEffectiveViewport(view);
			ScalerParams scalerParams = new ScalerParams(windowRect, viewportRect, xAxis.IsInverted);
			scalerParams.EffectiveViewportRect = effectiveViewport;
			ScalerParams scalerParams2 = new ScalerParams(windowRect, viewportRect, yAxis.IsInverted);
			scalerParams2.EffectiveViewportRect = effectiveViewport;
			if (!base.SkipPrepare)
			{
				shapeSeriesView.InitializeShapes();
				Rect bounds = new Rect(0.0, 0.0, 0.0, 0.0);
				int count = ShapeColumn.Count;
				if (_boundsTop == null || _boundsTop.Length != count)
				{
					_boundsTop = new double[count];
					_boundsLeft = new double[count];
					_boundsRight = new double[count];
					_boundsBottom = new double[count];
				}
				double[] boundsTop = _boundsTop;
				double[] boundsLeft = _boundsLeft;
				double[] boundsRight = _boundsRight;
				double[] boundsBottom = _boundsBottom;
				for (int i = 0; i < count; i++)
				{
					Rect rect = BoundsColumn[i];
					boundsTop[i] = rect.Top;
					boundsLeft[i] = rect.Left;
					boundsRight[i] = rect.Right;
					boundsBottom[i] = rect.Bottom;
				}
				_xAxis.GetScaledValueList(boundsLeft, 0, boundsLeft.Length, scalerParams);
				_xAxis.GetScaledValueList(boundsRight, 0, boundsRight.Length, scalerParams);
				_yAxis.GetScaledValueList(boundsTop, 0, boundsTop.Length, scalerParams2);
				_yAxis.GetScaledValueList(boundsBottom, 0, boundsBottom.Length, scalerParams2);
				shapeSeriesView.ProvideBounds(boundsLeft, boundsTop, boundsRight, boundsBottom);
				IFastItemColumn<object> shapeColumn = ShapeColumn;
				IFastItemsSource fastItemsSource = base.FastItemsSource;
				UpdateClipRect(shapeSeriesView);
				double left = viewportRect.Left;
				double right = viewportRect.Right;
				double top = viewportRect.Top;
				double bottom = viewportRect.Bottom;
				Clipper clipper = null;
				clipper = ((!ClipRect.IsEmpty) ? new Clipper(ClipRect.Left, ClipRect.Bottom, ClipRect.Right, ClipRect.Top, IsClosed) : null);
				bool flag = ShouldRecordMarkerPositions();
				if (flag)
				{
					shapeSeriesView.MarkerPositions.Clear();
				}
				bool flag2 = false;
				double num = 0.0;
				if (base.SeriesViewer != null && base.SeriesViewer.ShouldHorizontalWrap())
				{
					Tuple<bool, double> horizontalWrapInfo = base.SeriesViewer.GetHorizontalWrapInfo(windowRect, scalerParams);
					flag2 = horizontalWrapInfo.Item1;
					num = horizontalWrapInfo.Item2;
				}
				for (int j = 0; j < count; j++)
				{
					double val = boundsLeft[j];
					double val2 = boundsTop[j];
					double val3 = boundsBottom[j];
					double val4 = boundsRight[j];
					bounds.X = Math.Min(val, val4);
					bounds.Y = Math.Min(val2, val3);
					bounds.Width = Math.Max(val, val4) - bounds.X;
					bounds.Height = Math.Max(val2, val3) - bounds.Y;
					if (bounds.IntersectsWith(viewportRect))
					{
						Clipper clipper2 = ((!(bounds.X < left) && !(bounds.Y < top) && !(bounds.X > right) && !(bounds.Y > bottom)) ? null : clipper);
						List<FlattenedShape> plotPoints = GetPlotPoints(view, clipper2, shapeColumn[j], scalerParams, scalerParams2, 0.0, num);
						if (flag)
						{
							RecordMarkerPosition(shapeSeriesView, j, plotPoints);
						}
						shapeSeriesView.AddShape(j, fastItemsSource[j], bounds, plotPoints);
					}
					else
					{
						if (!flag2)
						{
							continue;
						}
						bounds.X += num;
						if (bounds.IntersectsWith(viewportRect))
						{
							Clipper clipper2 = ((!(bounds.X < left) && !(bounds.Y < top) && !(bounds.X > right) && !(bounds.Y > bottom)) ? null : clipper);
							List<FlattenedShape> plotPoints2 = GetPlotPoints(view, clipper2, shapeColumn[j], scalerParams, scalerParams2, num, num);
							if (flag)
							{
								RecordMarkerPosition(shapeSeriesView, j, plotPoints2);
							}
							shapeSeriesView.AddShape(j, fastItemsSource[j], bounds, plotPoints2);
						}
					}
				}
				shapeSeriesView.FinalizeShapes();
			}
			bool shouldOverrideShapeStyle = ShouldOverrideShapeStyle();
			RenderManager.InitShapeRenderSettings(this, ShouldOverrideShapeStyle(), GetShapeItems);
			bool areStylesOverriden = false;
			if (RenderManager.OverrideArgs != null)
			{
				areStylesOverriden = true;
			}
			bool isThumbnailView = view.IsThumbnailView;
			bool isShapeControl = IsShapeControl;
			bool hasShapeStyle = shapeSeriesView.HasShapeStyle;
			shapeSeriesView.DoToActiveElements(delegate(FrameworkElement s)
			{
				object item = ((s.DataContext != null) ? ((DataContext)s.DataContext).Item : null);
				int currentIndex = ((s.DataContext != null) ? ((DataContext)s.DataContext).CachedIndex : (-1));
				shapeSeriesView.ApplyStyling(s, item, shouldOverrideShapeStyle);
				if (areStylesOverriden)
				{
					PerformShapeStyleOverride(s, isShapeControl, currentIndex, ShapeColumn.Count, isThumbnailView, hasShapeStyle);
				}
				else if (hasShapeStyle)
				{
					if (isShapeControl)
					{
						RenderManager.PrePerformShapeControlStyleOverride((ShapeControl)s, base.ActualHighlightingFadeOpacity, hasShapeStyle);
					}
					else
					{
						RenderManager.PrePerformShapeStyleOverride((Shape)s, base.ActualHighlightingFadeOpacity, hasShapeStyle);
					}
				}
				if (isShapeControl)
				{
					RenderManager.SetShapeControlAppearance((ShapeControl)s, strokeOnly: false, fillOnly: false, extended: false, useOutline: false);
				}
				else
				{
					RenderManager.SetShapeAppearance((Shape)s, strokeOnly: false, fillOnly: false, extended: false, useOutline: false);
				}
			});
		}

		protected void PerformShapeStyleOverride(FrameworkElement shape, bool isShapeControl, int currentIndex, int valueCount, bool isThumbnail, bool hasShapeStyle)
		{
			bool flag = base.ActualHighlightingMode != SeriesHighlightingMode.None;
			RenderManager.PopulateArgsBounds(RenderManager.OverrideArgs, currentIndex, valueCount, isMarker: false);
			if (isShapeControl)
			{
				RenderManager.PrePerformShapeControlStyleOverride((ShapeControl)shape, base.ActualHighlightingFadeOpacity, hasShapeStyle);
			}
			else
			{
				RenderManager.PrePerformShapeStyleOverride((Shape)shape, base.ActualHighlightingFadeOpacity, hasShapeStyle);
			}
			AssigningShapeStyleEventArgs shapeOverrideArgs = RenderManager.ShapeOverrideArgs;
			HighlightingInfo info = null;
			IFastItemsSource fastItemsSource = base.FastItemsSource;
			if (flag && base.SeriesViewer != null)
			{
				info = (shapeOverrideArgs.HighlightingInfo = base.SeriesViewer.HighlightingManager.GetHighlightingInfo(this, fastItemsSource, shapeOverrideArgs.StartIndex, shapeOverrideArgs.EndIndex, isMarker: false));
			}
			shapeOverrideArgs.IsThumbnail = isThumbnail;
			RaiseAssigningShapeStyles(shapeOverrideArgs);
			RenderManager.PostPerformStyleOverride(this, info, isThumbnail, flag, isMainShape: false);
		}

		protected void PerformShapeMarkerStyleOverride(int currentIndex, int valueCount, bool isThumbnail)
		{
			bool flag = base.ActualHighlightingMode != SeriesHighlightingMode.None;
			RenderManager.PopulateArgsBounds(RenderManager.MarkerOverrideArgs, currentIndex, valueCount, isMarker: true);
			RenderManager.PrePerformMarkerStyleOverride(base.ActualHighlightingFadeOpacity);
			AssigningShapeMarkerStyleEventArgs shapeMarkerOverrideArgs = RenderManager.ShapeMarkerOverrideArgs;
			HighlightingInfo highlightingInfo = null;
			IFastItemsSource fastItemsSource = base.FastItemsSource;
			if (flag && base.SeriesViewer != null)
			{
				highlightingInfo = base.SeriesViewer.HighlightingManager.GetHighlightingInfo(this, fastItemsSource, shapeMarkerOverrideArgs.StartIndex, shapeMarkerOverrideArgs.EndIndex, isMarker: true);
				if (base.SeriesViewer.HighlightingManager.IsCrossSeriesHighlight(this))
				{
					base.SeriesViewer.HighlightingManager.GetHighlightingInfo(this, fastItemsSource, shapeMarkerOverrideArgs.StartIndex, shapeMarkerOverrideArgs.EndIndex, isMarker: true);
				}
				shapeMarkerOverrideArgs.HighlightingInfo = highlightingInfo;
			}
			shapeMarkerOverrideArgs.IsThumbnail = isThumbnail;
			RaiseAssigningShapeMarkerStyles(shapeMarkerOverrideArgs);
			RenderManager.PostPerformMarkerStyleOverride(this, highlightingInfo, isThumbnail, flag, shapeMarkerOverrideArgs.SumAllSeriesHighlightingProgress, base.SeriesViewer.HighlightingManager.SumHighlightingProgress);
		}

		protected void RaiseAssigningShapeStyles(AssigningShapeStyleEventArgs args)
		{
			if (this.AssigningShapeStyle != null && ActualIsCustomShapeStyleAllowed)
			{
				this.AssigningShapeStyle(this, args);
			}
		}

		protected void RaiseAssigningShapeMarkerStyles(AssigningShapeMarkerStyleEventArgs args)
		{
			if (this.AssigningShapeMarkerStyle != null && ActualIsCustomShapeMarkerStyleAllowed)
			{
				this.AssigningShapeMarkerStyle(this, args);
			}
		}

		[SuppressWidgetMember]
		public virtual object[] GetShapeItems(int startIndex, int endIndex)
		{
			return GetShapeItemsHelper(startIndex, endIndex);
		}

		protected object[] GetShapeItemsHelper(int orderedStartIndex, int orderedEndIndex)
		{
			if (orderedEndIndex < orderedStartIndex || orderedStartIndex < 0 || orderedStartIndex > ShapeColumn.Count || orderedEndIndex < 0 || orderedEndIndex > ShapeColumn.Count)
			{
				return null;
			}
			object[] array = new object[orderedEndIndex - orderedStartIndex + 1];
			for (int i = orderedStartIndex; i <= orderedEndIndex; i++)
			{
				array[i - orderedStartIndex] = base.FastItemsSource[i];
			}
			return array;
		}

		private static void RecordMarkerPosition(ShapeSeriesViewBase shapeSeriesView, int shapeIndex, List<FlattenedShape> plotPoints)
		{
			double num = 0.0;
			FlattenedShape value = null;
			for (int i = 0; i < plotPoints.Count; i++)
			{
				FlattenedShape flattenedShape = plotPoints[i];
				double num2 = flattenedShape.Bounds.Width * flattenedShape.Bounds.Height;
				if (num2 > num)
				{
					num = num2;
					value = flattenedShape;
				}
			}
			shapeSeriesView.MarkerPositions.Add(shapeIndex, value);
		}

		protected internal override void InvalidateAxes()
		{
			base.InvalidateAxes();
			if (XAxis != null)
			{
				XAxis.RenderAxis();
			}
			if (YAxis != null)
			{
				YAxis.RenderAxis();
			}
		}

		protected override void WindowRectChangedOverride(Rect oldWindowRect, Rect newWindowRect)
		{
			RenderSeries(animate: false);
		}

		protected override void ViewportRectChangedOverride(Rect oldViewportRect, Rect newViewportRect)
		{
			RenderSeries(animate: false);
		}

		protected override void DataUpdatedOverride(FastItemsSourceEventAction action, int position, int count, string propertyName)
		{
			base.DataUpdatedOverride(action, position, count, propertyName);
			switch (action)
			{
			case FastItemsSourceEventAction.Change:
				if (propertyName == ShapeMemberPath)
				{
					BoundsColumn[position] = GetBounds(ShapeColumn[position]);
				}
				break;
			case FastItemsSourceEventAction.Insert:
			{
				for (int j = position; j < position + count; j++)
				{
					BoundsColumn.Insert(j, GetBounds(ShapeColumn[j]));
				}
				break;
			}
			case FastItemsSourceEventAction.Remove:
				BoundsColumn.RemoveRange(position, count);
				break;
			case FastItemsSourceEventAction.Replace:
			{
				for (int i = position; i < position + count; i++)
				{
					BoundsColumn[i] = GetBounds(ShapeColumn[i]);
				}
				break;
			}
			case FastItemsSourceEventAction.Reset:
				ResetBoundsColumn();
				break;
			}
			RenderSeries(animate: false);
		}

		protected internal override bool ValidateSeries(Rect viewportRect, Rect windowRect, SeriesView view)
		{
			bool result = true;
			if (!base.ValidateSeries(viewportRect, windowRect, view) || (RequiresShapes && ShapeColumn == null) || windowRect.IsEmpty || viewportRect.IsEmpty || XAxis == null || YAxis == null || XAxis.SeriesViewer == null || YAxis.SeriesViewer == null || XAxis.ActualMinimumValue == XAxis.ActualMaximumValue || YAxis.ActualMinimumValue == YAxis.ActualMaximumValue || ShapeColumn == null || ShapeColumn.Count == 0 || BoundsColumn == null || BoundsColumn.Count == 0 || BoundsColumn.Count != ShapeColumn.Count)
			{
				result = false;
			}
			return result;
		}

		{
			base.OnViewCreated(view);
			ShapeSeriesView = view as ShapeSeriesViewBase;
		}

		private List<FlattenedShape> MapAndFlatten(SeriesView view, Clipper clipper, List<List<Point>> points, ScalerParams xParams, ScalerParams yParams, double offset, double wrapOffset)
		{
			List<FlattenedShape> list = new List<FlattenedShape>();
			int count = points.Count;
			for (int i = 0; i < count; i++)
			{
				List<Point> points2 = points[i];
				FlattenedShape flattenedShape = MapAndFlatten(view, clipper, points2, xParams, yParams, offset, wrapOffset);
				if (flattenedShape != null)
				{
					list.Add(flattenedShape);
				}
			}
			return list;
		}

		private FlattenedShape MapAndFlatten(SeriesView view, Clipper clipper, List<Point> points, ScalerParams xParams, ScalerParams yParams, double offset, double wrapOffset)
		{
			Tuple<double[], double[]> tuple = MapPoints(points, xParams, yParams);
			double[] item = tuple.Item1;
			double[] item2 = tuple.Item2;
			int num = item.Length;
			double num2 = double.MaxValue;
			double num3 = double.MaxValue;
			double num4 = double.MinValue;
			double num5 = double.MinValue;
			if (offset != 0.0)
			{
				for (int i = 0; i < num; i++)
				{
					item[i] += offset;
				}
			}
			for (int j = 0; j < num; j++)
			{
				double num6 = item[j];
				double num7 = item2[j];
				num2 = ((num6 < num2) ? num6 : num2);
				num3 = ((num7 < num3) ? num7 : num3);
				num4 = ((num6 > num4) ? num6 : num4);
				num5 = ((num7 > num5) ? num7 : num5);
			}
			bool flag = !(num2 > ClipRect.Right) && !(num4 < ClipRect.Left) && !(num3 > ClipRect.Bottom) && !(num5 < ClipRect.Top);
			if (!flag && offset == 0.0 && wrapOffset != 0.0)
			{
				if (wrapOffset != 0.0)
				{
					for (int k = 0; k < num; k++)
					{
						item[k] += wrapOffset;
					}
				}
				for (int l = 0; l < num; l++)
				{
					double num6 = item[l];
					double num7 = item2[l];
					num2 = ((num6 < num2) ? num6 : num2);
					num3 = ((num7 < num3) ? num7 : num3);
					num4 = ((num6 > num4) ? num6 : num4);
					num5 = ((num7 > num5) ? num7 : num5);
				}
				flag = !(num2 > ClipRect.Right) && !(num4 < ClipRect.Left) && !(num3 > ClipRect.Bottom) && !(num5 < ClipRect.Top);
			}
			if (!flag)
			{
				return null;
			}
			bool flag2 = clipper != null && (num2 < ClipRect.Left || num3 < ClipRect.Top || num4 > ClipRect.Right || num5 > ClipRect.Bottom);
			Rect rect = new Rect(num2, num3, num4 - num2, num5 - num3);
			if (!((ShapeSeriesViewBase)view).ShouldRenderShape(rect))
			{
				return null;
			}
			num2 = ((num2 < ClipRect.Left) ? ClipRect.Left : num2);
			num4 = ((num4 > ClipRect.Right) ? ClipRect.Right : num4);
			num3 = ((num3 < ClipRect.Top) ? ClipRect.Top : num3);
			num5 = ((num5 > ClipRect.Bottom) ? ClipRect.Bottom : num5);
			int count = PolySimplification.VertexReduction(tuple, base.Resolution);
			List<Point> list = new DefaultFlattener().FastFlatten(tuple.Item1, tuple.Item2, count, _resolution);
			int count2 = list.Count;
			if (flag2)
			{
				List<Point> list2 = (List<Point>)(clipper.Target = new List<Point>());
				for (int m = 0; m < count2; m++)
				{
					clipper.Add(list[m]);
				}
				clipper.Target = null;
				list = list2;
			}
			if (list == null || list.Count == 0)
			{
				return null;
			}
			return new FlattenedShape
			{
				Shape = list,
				Bounds = new Rect(num2, num3, num4 - num2, num5 - num3),
				FullBounds = rect
			};
		}

		private Tuple<double[], double[]> MapPoints(List<Point> points, ScalerParams xParams, ScalerParams yParams)
		{
			NumericXAxis xAxis = _xAxis;
			NumericYAxis yAxis = _yAxis;
			int count = points.Count;
			double[] array = new double[count];
			double[] array2 = new double[count];
			for (int i = 0; i < count; i++)
			{
				array[i] = points[i].X;
				array2[i] = points[i].Y;
			}
			xAxis.GetScaledValueList(array, 0, array.Length, xParams);
			yAxis.GetScaledValueList(array2, 0, array2.Length, yParams);
			return new Tuple<double[], double[]>(array, array2);
		}

		{
			view.UpdateClipRect();
		}

			base.ClearRendering(wipeClean, view);
			((ShapeSeriesViewBase)view).ClearRendering();
		}

		private void InitializeAxis(Axis axis)
		{
			axis?.RegisterSeries(this);
		}

		private void UnInitializeAxis(Axis axis)
		{
			axis?.DeregisterSeries(this);
		}

		protected internal override AxisRange GetRange(Axis axis)
		{
			if (axis is NumericXAxis && BoundsColumn != null)
			{
				double num = double.MaxValue;
				double num2 = double.MinValue;
				foreach (Rect item in BoundsColumn)
				{
					num = Math.Min(num, item.Left);
					num2 = Math.Max(num2, item.Right);
				}
				return new AxisRange(num, num2);
			}
			if (axis is NumericYAxis && BoundsColumn != null)
			{
				double num3 = double.MaxValue;
				double num4 = double.MinValue;
				foreach (Rect item2 in BoundsColumn)
				{
					num3 = Math.Min(num3, item2.Top);
					num4 = Math.Max(num4, item2.Bottom);
				}
				return new AxisRange(num3, num4);
			}
			return null;
		}
	}

		public override bool IsShape => true;
