		public event TriangulationStatusEventHandler TriangulationStatusChanged;

		protected internal override void ClearAxes()
		{
			base.ClearAxes();
			XAxis = null;
			YAxis = null;
		}

		public override object GetItemValue(object item, string memberPathName)
		{
			string text = ResolveMemberPath(memberPathName);
			if (text == "XMemberPath")
			{
				return GetItemValueByMemberPath(item, memberPathName, XMemberPath);
			}
			if (text == "YMemberPath")
			{
				return GetItemValueByMemberPath(item, memberPathName, YMemberPath);
			}
			return base.GetItemValue(item, memberPathName);
		}

		protected internal override void RenderSeriesOverride(bool animate)
		{
			if (base.FastItemsSource != null && FastTrianglesSource == null && Triangulation == null && XColumn != null && YColumn != null && XColumn.Count >= 3 && YColumn.Count >= 3 && !AutoTriangulated)
			{
				StartTriangulation();
				AutoTriangulated = true;
			}
		}

		private void StartTriangulation()
		{
			_triangulator = new Triangulator(base.FastItemsSource.Count, XColumn, YColumn);
			_triangulator.TriangulationStatusChanged += triangulator_TriangulationStatusChanged;
			_triangulator.TriangulateAsync();
		}

		private void CancelTriangulation()
		{
			if (_triangulator != null)
			{
				_triangulator.Cancel();
				_triangulator.TriangulationStatusChanged -= triangulator_TriangulationStatusChanged;
				_triangulator = null;
			}
		}

		private void triangulator_TriangulationStatusChanged(object sender, TriangulationStatusEventArgs args)
		{
			if (this.TriangulationStatusChanged != null)
			{
				this.TriangulationStatusChanged(this, new TriangulationStatusEventArgs(args.CurrentStatus));
			}
			if (args.CurrentStatus >= 100 && _triangulator != null)
			{
				_triangulator.TriangulationStatusChanged -= triangulator_TriangulationStatusChanged;
				Triangulation = _triangulator.GetResult();
				_triangulator = null;
				IFastItemsSource itemsSource = new FastItemsSource
				{
					ItemsSource = Triangulation
				};
				TriangleVertexColumn1 = RegisterTriangleIntColumn(itemsSource, "V1");
				TriangleVertexColumn2 = RegisterTriangleIntColumn(itemsSource, "V2");
				TriangleVertexColumn3 = RegisterTriangleIntColumn(itemsSource, "V3");
				RenderSeries(animate: false);
			}
		}

		protected IFastItemColumn<int> RegisterTriangleIntColumn(IFastItemsSource itemsSource, string memberPath)
		{
			return itemsSource.RegisterColumnInt(memberPath);
		}

		protected override void PropertyUpdatedOverride(object sender, string propertyName, object oldValue, object newValue)
		{
			base.PropertyUpdatedOverride(sender, propertyName, oldValue, newValue);
			switch (propertyName)
			{
			case "FastItemsSource":
				if (oldValue is IFastItemsSource fastItemsSource2)
				{
					fastItemsSource2.DeregisterColumn(XColumn);
					fastItemsSource2.DeregisterColumn(YColumn);
					XColumn = null;
					YColumn = null;
				}
				RefreshAutoTriangulation();
				if (newValue is IFastItemsSource)
				{
					XColumn = RegisterDoubleColumn(XMemberPath);
					YColumn = RegisterDoubleColumn(YMemberPath);
				}
				RenderSeries(animate: false);
				break;
			case "XMemberPath":
				if (base.FastItemsSource != null)
				{
					base.FastItemsSource.DeregisterColumn(XColumn);
					XColumn = RegisterDoubleColumn(XMemberPath);
				}
				RefreshAutoTriangulation();
				RenderSeries(animate: false);
				NotifyThumbnailAppearanceChanged();
				break;
			case "YMemberPath":
				if (base.FastItemsSource != null)
				{
					base.FastItemsSource.DeregisterColumn(YColumn);
					YColumn = RegisterDoubleColumn(YMemberPath);
				}
				RefreshAutoTriangulation();
				RenderSeries(animate: false);
				NotifyThumbnailAppearanceChanged();
				break;
			case "XAxis":
				if (oldValue != null)
				{
					(oldValue as Axis).DeregisterSeries(this);
				}
				if (newValue != null)
				{
					(newValue as Axis).RegisterSeries(this);
				}
				if ((XAxis != null && !XAxis.UpdateRange()) || (newValue == null && oldValue != null))
				{
					RenderSeries(animate: false);
				}
				NotifyThumbnailAppearanceChanged();
				break;
			case "YAxis":
				if (oldValue != null)
				{
					(oldValue as Axis).DeregisterSeries(this);
				}
				if (newValue != null)
				{
					(newValue as Axis).RegisterSeries(this);
				}
				if ((YAxis != null && !YAxis.UpdateRange()) || (newValue == null && oldValue != null))
				{
					RenderSeries(animate: false);
				}
				NotifyThumbnailAppearanceChanged();
				break;
			case "TrianglesSource":
				if (TrianglesSource != null)
				{
					CancelTriangulation();
					FastTrianglesSource = new FastItemsSource
					{
						ItemsSource = TrianglesSource
					};
				}
				else
				{
					FastTrianglesSource = null;
				}
				break;
			case "FastTrianglesSource":
				if (oldValue is IFastItemsSource fastItemsSource)
				{
					fastItemsSource.DeregisterColumn(TriangleVertexColumn1);
					fastItemsSource.DeregisterColumn(TriangleVertexColumn2);
					fastItemsSource.DeregisterColumn(TriangleVertexColumn3);
					TriangleVertexColumn1 = null;
					TriangleVertexColumn2 = null;
					TriangleVertexColumn3 = null;
				}
				if (newValue is IFastItemsSource itemsSource)
				{
					TriangleVertexColumn1 = RegisterTriangleIntColumn(itemsSource, TriangleVertexMemberPath1);
					TriangleVertexColumn2 = RegisterTriangleIntColumn(itemsSource, TriangleVertexMemberPath2);
					TriangleVertexColumn3 = RegisterTriangleIntColumn(itemsSource, TriangleVertexMemberPath3);
				}
				RenderSeries(animate: false);
				NotifyThumbnailAppearanceChanged();
				break;
			case "TriangleVertexMemberPath1":
				if (FastTrianglesSource != null)
				{
					FastTrianglesSource.DeregisterColumn(TriangleVertexColumn1);
					TriangleVertexColumn1 = RegisterTriangleIntColumn(FastTrianglesSource, TriangleVertexMemberPath1);
				}
				RenderSeries(animate: false);
				NotifyThumbnailAppearanceChanged();
				break;
			case "TriangleVertexMemberPath2":
				if (FastTrianglesSource != null)
				{
					FastTrianglesSource.DeregisterColumn(TriangleVertexColumn2);
					TriangleVertexColumn2 = RegisterTriangleIntColumn(FastTrianglesSource, TriangleVertexMemberPath2);
				}
				RenderSeries(animate: false);
				NotifyThumbnailAppearanceChanged();
				break;
			case "TriangleVertexMemberPath3":
				if (FastTrianglesSource != null)
				{
					FastTrianglesSource.DeregisterColumn(TriangleVertexColumn3);
					TriangleVertexColumn3 = RegisterTriangleIntColumn(FastTrianglesSource, TriangleVertexMemberPath3);
				}
				RenderSeries(animate: false);
				NotifyThumbnailAppearanceChanged();
				break;
			case "XColumn":
				if (XAxis != null)
				{
					XAxis.UpdateRange();
				}
				break;
			case "YColumn":
				if (YAxis != null)
				{
					YAxis.UpdateRange();
				}
				break;
			}
		}

		[XamSuppressWidgetMember]
		[UwpSuppressWidgetMember]
		[WFSuppressWidgetMember]
		public bool CanUseAsYAxis(object axis)
		{
			if (axis is NumericYAxis)
			{
				return true;
			}
			return false;
		}

		[XamSuppressWidgetMember]
		[UwpSuppressWidgetMember]
		[WFSuppressWidgetMember]
		public bool CanUseAsXAxis(object axis)
		{
			if (axis is NumericXAxis)
			{
				return true;
			}
			return false;
		}

		protected internal override bool ValidateSeries(Rect viewportRect, Rect windowRect, SeriesView view)
		{
			if (base.ValidateSeries(viewportRect, windowRect, view) && base.FastItemsSource != null && XAxis != null && YAxis != null && XAxis.SeriesViewer != null && YAxis.SeriesViewer != null && viewportRect.Width > 0.0 && viewportRect.Height > 0.0 && TriangleVertexColumn1 != null && TriangleVertexColumn1.Count > 0 && TriangleVertexColumn2 != null && TriangleVertexColumn2.Count > 0 && TriangleVertexColumn3 != null && TriangleVertexColumn3.Count > 0 && XColumn != null && XColumn.Count > 0 && YColumn != null)
			{
				return YColumn.Count > 0;
			}
			return false;
		}

		private void RefreshAutoTriangulation()
		{
			if (TrianglesSource == null)
			{
				Triangulation = null;
				TriangleVertexColumn1 = null;
				TriangleVertexColumn2 = null;
				TriangleVertexColumn3 = null;
				AutoTriangulated = false;
			}
		}

		protected internal override void InvalidateAxes()
		{
			base.InvalidateAxes();
			if (XAxis != null)
			{
				XAxis.RenderAxis();
			}
			if (YAxis != null)
			{
				YAxis.RenderAxis();
			}
		}

		protected override void DataUpdatedOverride(FastItemsSourceEventAction action, int position, int count, string propertyName)
		{
			base.DataUpdatedOverride(action, position, count, propertyName);
			RefreshAutoTriangulation();
			RenderSeries(animate: false);
		}

		protected internal override AxisRange GetRange(Axis axis)
		{
			if (axis != null && axis == XAxis && XColumn != null)
			{
				return new AxisRange(XColumn.Minimum, XColumn.Maximum);
			}
			if (axis != null && axis == YAxis && YColumn != null)
			{
				return new AxisRange(YColumn.Minimum, YColumn.Maximum);
			}
			return null;
		}

		protected override void WindowRectChangedOverride(Rect oldWindowRect, Rect newWindowRect)
		{
			RenderSeries(animate: false);
		}

		protected override void ViewportRectChangedOverride(Rect oldViewportRect, Rect newViewportRect)
		{
			RenderSeries(animate: false);
		}
	}
	[WidgetIgnoreDepends("MarkerSeries")]
	[WidgetIgnoreDepends("ShapeSeriesBase")]
	[WidgetIgnoreDepends("NumericYAxis")]
	[WidgetIgnoreDepends("NumericXAxis")]
	public class ShapeSeriesRenderManager : SeriesRenderManager
	{
		public AssigningShapeMarkerStyleEventArgs ShapeMarkerOverrideArgs;

		public AssigningShapeStyleEventArgs ShapeOverrideArgs;

		protected override AssigningSeriesStyleEventArgsBase CreateMarkerOverrideArgs()
		{
			ShapeMarkerOverrideArgs = new AssigningShapeMarkerStyleEventArgs();
			return ShapeMarkerOverrideArgs;
		}

		protected override AssigningSeriesShapeStyleEventArgsBase CreateShapeStyleOverrideArgs()
		{
			ShapeOverrideArgs = new AssigningShapeStyleEventArgs();
			return ShapeOverrideArgs;
		}

		public void PrePerformShapeStyleOverride(Shape shape, double fadeOpacity, bool hasShapeStyle)
		{
			ActualRenderFill = InitialRenderFill;
			ActualRenderOutline = InitialRenderOutline;
			ActualRenderThickness = InitialRenderThickness;
			ActualRenderDashArray = InitialRenderDashArray;
			ActualRenderDashCap = InitialRenderDashCap;
			ActualRenderRadiusX = InitialRenderRadiusX;
			ActualRenderRadiusY = InitialRenderRadiusY;
			ActualRenderOpacity = InitialRenderOpacity;
			if (hasShapeStyle)
			{
				if (shape.Fill != null)
				{
					ActualRenderFill = shape.Fill;
				}
				if (shape.Stroke != null)
				{
					ActualRenderOutline = shape.Stroke;
				}
				if (!double.IsNaN(shape.StrokeThickness))
				{
					ActualRenderThickness = shape.StrokeThickness;
				}
			}
			AssigningSeriesShapeStyleEventArgsBase overrideArgs = base.OverrideArgs;
			if (overrideArgs != null)
			{
				overrideArgs.Fill = ActualRenderFill;
				overrideArgs.Stroke = ActualRenderOutline;
				overrideArgs.StrokeThickness = ActualRenderThickness;
				overrideArgs.StrokeDashArray = ActualRenderDashArray;
				overrideArgs.StrokeDashCap = ActualRenderDashCap;
				overrideArgs.RadiusX = ActualRenderRadiusX;
				overrideArgs.RadiusY = ActualRenderRadiusY;
				overrideArgs.Opacity = ActualRenderOpacity;
				overrideArgs.IsNegativeShape = ActualNegativeShape;
				overrideArgs.FadeOpacity = fadeOpacity;
				overrideArgs.HighlightingHandled = false;
			}
		}

		public void PrePerformShapeControlStyleOverride(ShapeControl shape, double fadeOpacity, bool hasShapeStyle)
		{
			ActualRenderFill = InitialRenderFill;
			ActualRenderOutline = InitialRenderOutline;
			ActualRenderThickness = InitialRenderThickness;
			ActualRenderDashArray = InitialRenderDashArray;
			ActualRenderDashCap = InitialRenderDashCap;
			ActualRenderRadiusX = InitialRenderRadiusX;
			ActualRenderRadiusY = InitialRenderRadiusY;
			ActualRenderOpacity = InitialRenderOpacity;
			if (hasShapeStyle)
			{
				if (shape.Background != null)
				{
					ActualRenderFill = shape.Background;
				}
				if (shape.BorderBrush != null)
				{
					ActualRenderOutline = shape.BorderBrush;
				}
				if (!double.IsNaN(shape.BorderThickness.Left) || !double.IsNaN(shape.BorderThickness.Top) || !double.IsNaN(shape.BorderThickness.Right) || !double.IsNaN(shape.BorderThickness.Bottom))
				{
					ActualRenderThickness = Math.Max(shape.BorderThickness.Left, Math.Max(shape.BorderThickness.Top, Math.Max(shape.BorderThickness.Right, shape.BorderThickness.Bottom)));
				}
			}
			AssigningSeriesShapeStyleEventArgsBase overrideArgs = base.OverrideArgs;
			if (overrideArgs != null)
			{
				overrideArgs.Fill = ActualRenderFill;
				overrideArgs.Stroke = ActualRenderOutline;
				overrideArgs.StrokeThickness = ActualRenderThickness;
				overrideArgs.StrokeDashArray = ActualRenderDashArray;
				overrideArgs.StrokeDashCap = ActualRenderDashCap;
				overrideArgs.RadiusX = ActualRenderRadiusX;
				overrideArgs.RadiusY = ActualRenderRadiusY;
				overrideArgs.Opacity = ActualRenderOpacity;
				overrideArgs.IsNegativeShape = ActualNegativeShape;
				overrideArgs.FadeOpacity = fadeOpacity;
				overrideArgs.HighlightingHandled = false;
			}
		}

		public void SetShapeControlAppearance(ShapeControl shape, bool strokeOnly, bool fillOnly, bool extended, bool useOutline)
		{
			Brush brush = ActualRenderFill;
			if (useOutline)
			{
				brush = ActualRenderOutline;
			}
			if (fillOnly)
			{
				shape.Background = brush;
			}
			else
			{
				if (strokeOnly)
				{
					shape.BorderBrush = brush;
				}
				else
				{
					shape.Background = brush;
					shape.BorderBrush = ActualRenderOutline;
				}
				shape.BorderThickness = new Thickness(ActualRenderThickness);
			}
			shape.Opacity = ActualRenderOpacity;
		}

		public void InitShapeMarkerRenderSettings(ShapeSeriesBase source, bool shouldOverrideMarkerStyle, GetCategoryItemsHandler getItems)
		{
			InitMarkerRenderSettings(source, shouldOverrideMarkerStyle, getItems);
		}

		public void InitShapeRenderSettings(Series source, bool shouldOverrideCategoryStyle, GetCategoryItemsHandler getItems)
		{
			InitRenderSettings(source, shouldOverrideCategoryStyle, getItems);
		}

		public void PopulateArgsBounds(AssigningSeriesStyleEventArgsBase args, int currentIndex, int valueCount, bool isMarker)
		{
			if (currentIndex == -1)
			{
				args.HasDateRange = false;
				args.StartIndex = 0;
				args.EndIndex = valueCount - 1;
			}
			else if (isMarker)
			{
				args.StartIndex = currentIndex;
				args.EndIndex = currentIndex;
			}
			else
			{
				args.HasDateRange = false;
				args.StartIndex = currentIndex;
				args.EndIndex = currentIndex;
			}
		}
	}

		public double MaxMarkerHighlightingProgress { get; set; }

		public double SumMarkerHighlightingProgress { get; set; }

		public double TotalHighlightingProgress { get; set; }

		public HighlightingManager()
		{
			HighlightingBehavior = SeriesHighlightingBehavior.DirectlyOver;
			DirtySeries = new List<Series>();
			DismissHighlightDelay = 200;
		}

		public void StartHighlight([SwiftMutableParameter] HighlightingInfo info)
		{
			if (info != null)
			{
				ProcessQueuedEndHighlights(info);
				InProgress = true;
				if (!_activeHighlights.ContainsKey(info))
				{
					info.State = HighlightingState.In;
					_activeHighlights[info] = info;
					_allHighlights.Add(info);
				}
				else
				{
					info = _activeHighlights[info];
				}
				if (info.State == HighlightingState.Out)
				{
					info.State = HighlightingState.In;
				}
			}
		}

		private HighlightingInfo ProcessQueuedEndHighlights([SwiftMutableParameter] HighlightingInfo info)
		{
			HighlightingInfo highlightingInfo = null;
			if (_queuedEndHighlights.ContainsKey(info))
			{
				info = _queuedEndHighlights[info];
				_queuedEndHighlights.Remove(info);
				_allQueuedEndHighlights.Remove(info);
				highlightingInfo = info;
			}
			List<HighlightingInfo> toRemove = _toRemove;
			for (int i = 0; i < _allQueuedEndHighlights.Count; i++)
			{
				HighlightingInfo highlightingInfo2 = _allQueuedEndHighlights[i];
				if (highlightingInfo2.IsFullRange && info.IsFullRange && info.Series == highlightingInfo2.Series)
				{
					if (highlightingInfo == null)
					{
						_queuedEndHighlights.Remove(highlightingInfo2);
						_allQueuedEndHighlights.Remove(highlightingInfo2);
						HighlightingInfo highlightingInfo3 = _activeHighlights[highlightingInfo2];
						_activeHighlights.Remove(highlightingInfo3);
						_allHighlights.Remove(highlightingInfo3);
						highlightingInfo3.StartIndex = info.StartIndex;
						highlightingInfo3.EndIndex = info.EndIndex;
						highlightingInfo3.IsExclusive = info.IsExclusive;
						_activeHighlights[highlightingInfo3] = highlightingInfo3;
						_allHighlights.Add(highlightingInfo3);
						highlightingInfo = highlightingInfo3;
					}
					else
					{
						toRemove.Add(highlightingInfo2);
					}
				}
				if (IsExclusiveHighlight && highlightingInfo2.Series != info.Series)
				{
					toRemove.Add(highlightingInfo2);
				}
				if (highlightingInfo2.Series == info.Series && highlightingInfo2.IsMarker == info.IsMarker && !highlightingInfo2.IsFullRange && (highlightingInfo2.StartIndex != info.StartIndex || highlightingInfo2.EndIndex != info.EndIndex))
				{
					toRemove.Add(highlightingInfo2);
				}
			}
			for (int j = 0; j < toRemove.Count; j++)
			{
				_allQueuedEndHighlights.Remove(toRemove[j]);
				_queuedEndHighlights.Remove(toRemove[j]);
				EndHighlightCore(toRemove[j]);
			}
			toRemove.Clear();
			if (highlightingInfo != null)
			{
				return highlightingInfo;
			}
			return info;
		}

		public void EndHighlight([SwiftMutableParameter] HighlightingInfo info)
		{
			if (info != null && _activeHighlights.ContainsKey(info))
			{
				info = _activeHighlights[info];
				QueueEndHighlight(info);
			}
		}

		private void QueueEndHighlight(HighlightingInfo info)
		{
			if (_queuedEndHighlights.ContainsKey(info))
			{
				_ = _queuedEndHighlights[info];
			}
			else
			{
				_queuedEndHighlights.Add(info, info);
				_allQueuedEndHighlights.Add(info);
				info.EndingStart = ExecutionContext.GetCurrentRelativeTime();
			}
			_endingCheckNeeded = true;
			if (!_endingCheckQueued)
			{
				_endingCheckQueued = true;
				ExecutionContext.ExecuteDelayed(CheckEndingHighlights, DismissHighlightDelay);
			}
		}

		private void CheckEndingHighlights()
		{
			_endingCheckQueued = false;
			if (!_endingCheckNeeded)
			{
				return;
			}
			List<HighlightingInfo> toRemove = _toRemove;
			long num = 0L;
			long currentRelativeTime = ExecutionContext.GetCurrentRelativeTime();
			for (int i = 0; i < _allQueuedEndHighlights.Count; i++)
			{
				HighlightingInfo highlightingInfo = _allQueuedEndHighlights[i];
				if (currentRelativeTime - highlightingInfo.EndingStart >= DismissHighlightDelay)
				{
					toRemove.Add(highlightingInfo);
				}
				else
				{
					num = Math.Max(num, DismissHighlightDelay - (currentRelativeTime - highlightingInfo.EndingStart));
				}
			}
			for (int j = 0; j < toRemove.Count; j++)
			{
				_allQueuedEndHighlights.Remove(toRemove[j]);
				_queuedEndHighlights.Remove(toRemove[j]);
				EndHighlightCore(toRemove[j]);
			}
			if (toRemove.Count > 0 && EnsureAnimator != null)
			{
				EnsureAnimator();
			}
			toRemove.Clear();
			if (num > 0)
			{
				_endingCheckNeeded = true;
				_endingCheckQueued = true;
				ExecutionContext.ExecuteDelayed(CheckEndingHighlights, (int)num);
			}
		}

		private void EndHighlightCore(HighlightingInfo info)
		{
			if (info.State == HighlightingState.In)
			{
				info.State = HighlightingState.Out;
			}
			if (info.State == HighlightingState.Static)
			{
				info.State = HighlightingState.Out;
				info.Progress = 1.0;
			}
		}

		public void Clear()
		{
			_allQueuedEndHighlights.Clear();
			_queuedEndHighlights.Clear();
			_endingCheckNeeded = false;
			_allHighlights.Clear();
			_activeHighlights.Clear();
			MaxHighlightingProgress = 0.0;
			SumHighlightingProgress = 0.0;
			MaxMarkerHighlightingProgress = 0.0;
			SumMarkerHighlightingProgress = 0.0;
			TotalHighlightingProgress = 0.0;
		}

		public HighlightingInfo GetHighlightingInfo(Series owner, IFastItemsSource itemsSource, int startIndex, int endIndex, bool isMarker)
		{
			for (int i = 0; i < _allHighlights.Count; i++)
			{
				HighlightingInfo highlightingInfo = _allHighlights[i];
				int startIndex2 = highlightingInfo.StartIndex;
				int endIndex2 = highlightingInfo.EndIndex;
				if (((startIndex >= startIndex2 && endIndex <= endIndex2) || highlightingInfo.IsFullRange) && highlightingInfo.IsMarker == isMarker && owner == highlightingInfo.Series && (highlightingInfo.State == HighlightingState.In || highlightingInfo.State == HighlightingState.Static))
				{
					return highlightingInfo;
				}
			}
			for (int j = 0; j < _allHighlights.Count; j++)
			{
				HighlightingInfo highlightingInfo2 = _allHighlights[j];
				int startIndex3 = highlightingInfo2.StartIndex;
				int endIndex3 = highlightingInfo2.EndIndex;
				if (((startIndex >= startIndex3 && endIndex <= endIndex3) || highlightingInfo2.IsFullRange) && highlightingInfo2.IsMarker == isMarker && owner == highlightingInfo2.Series && highlightingInfo2.State == HighlightingState.Out)
				{
					return highlightingInfo2;
				}
			}
			return null;
		}

		public bool Tick(double progress)
		{
			_dirtySeriesMap.Clear();
			DirtySeries.Clear();
			_progressing.Clear();
			AllDirty = false;
			double num = 0.0;
			num = ((!(_lastProgress > progress)) ? (progress - _lastProgress) : (1.0 - _lastProgress + progress));
			_lastProgress = progress;
			bool flag = false;
			List<HighlightingInfo> list = new List<HighlightingInfo>();
			MaxHighlightingProgress = 0.0;
			SumHighlightingProgress = 0.0;
			MaxMarkerHighlightingProgress = 0.0;
			SumMarkerHighlightingProgress = 0.0;
			TotalHighlightingProgress = 0.0;
			bool flag2 = false;
			bool flag3 = false;
			bool flag4 = false;
			double num2 = 0.0;
			double num3 = 0.0;
			double num4 = 0.0;
			double num5 = 0.0;
			double num6 = 0.0;
			double num7 = 0.0;
			for (int i = 0; i < _allHighlights.Count; i++)
			{
				HighlightingInfo highlightingInfo = _allHighlights[i];
				if (highlightingInfo.State == HighlightingState.In)
				{
					if (highlightingInfo.IsMarker)
					{
						flag2 = true;
						num4 += Math.Min(1.0 - highlightingInfo.Progress, num);
					}
					else if (!IsExclusiveHighlight && !highlightingInfo.IsFullRange)
					{
						flag4 = true;
						num6 += Math.Min(1.0 - highlightingInfo.Progress, num);
					}
					else
					{
						flag3 = true;
						num2 += Math.Min(1.0 - highlightingInfo.Progress, num);
					}
				}
				if (highlightingInfo.State == HighlightingState.Out)
				{
					if (highlightingInfo.IsMarker)
					{
						num5 += Math.Min(highlightingInfo.Progress, num);
					}
					else if (!IsExclusiveHighlight && !highlightingInfo.IsFullRange)
					{
						num7 += Math.Min(highlightingInfo.Progress, num);
					}
					else
					{
						num3 += Math.Min(highlightingInfo.Progress, num);
					}
				}
			}
			double num8 = 1.0;
			double num9 = 1.0;
			double num10 = 1.0;
			if (flag3 && num3 > num2)
			{
				num8 = num2 / num3;
			}
			if (flag2 && num5 > num4)
			{
				num9 = num4 / num5;
			}
			num10 = ((!flag4 || !(num7 > num6)) ? num8 : (num6 / num7));
			for (int j = 0; j < _allHighlights.Count; j++)
			{
				HighlightingInfo highlightingInfo2 = _allHighlights[j];
				double num11 = num;
				if (highlightingInfo2.State == HighlightingState.Out)
				{
					num11 = Math.Min(num11, highlightingInfo2.Progress);
					num11 = (highlightingInfo2.IsMarker ? (num11 * num9) : ((!highlightingInfo2.IsFullRange) ? (num11 * num10) : (num11 * num8)));
					highlightingInfo2.Progress -= num11;
				}
				else
				{
					highlightingInfo2.Progress += num11;
				}
				if (highlightingInfo2.State == HighlightingState.Static)
				{
					highlightingInfo2.Progress = 1.0;
				}
				if (highlightingInfo2.Progress > 1.0)
				{
					highlightingInfo2.Progress = 1.0;
				}
				if (highlightingInfo2.Progress < 0.0)
				{
					highlightingInfo2.Progress = 0.0;
				}
				if (highlightingInfo2.IsMarker)
				{
					MaxMarkerHighlightingProgress = Math.Max(highlightingInfo2.Progress, MaxMarkerHighlightingProgress);
					SumMarkerHighlightingProgress += highlightingInfo2.Progress;
				}
				else
				{
					MaxHighlightingProgress = Math.Max(highlightingInfo2.Progress, MaxHighlightingProgress);
					SumHighlightingProgress += highlightingInfo2.Progress;
				}
				if (highlightingInfo2.State != HighlightingState.Out && highlightingInfo2.Progress != 1.0)
				{
					flag = true;
				}
				if (highlightingInfo2.State == HighlightingState.Out && highlightingInfo2.Progress != 0.0)
				{
					flag = true;
				}
				if (highlightingInfo2.Progress == 1.0 && highlightingInfo2.State == HighlightingState.In)
				{
					highlightingInfo2.State = HighlightingState.Static;
				}
				if (highlightingInfo2.Progress == 0.0 && highlightingInfo2.State == HighlightingState.Out)
				{
					list.Add(highlightingInfo2);
				}
				if (IsCrossSeriesHighlight(highlightingInfo2.Series))
				{
					AllDirty = true;
				}
				else if (!_dirtySeriesMap.ContainsKey(highlightingInfo2.Series))
				{
					_dirtySeriesMap.Add(highlightingInfo2.Series, value: true);
					DirtySeries.Add(highlightingInfo2.Series);
				}
			}
			foreach (HighlightingInfo item in list)
			{
				_activeHighlights.Remove(item);
				_allHighlights.Remove(item);
			}
			if (_activeHighlights.Count == 0)
			{
				InProgress = false;
				MaxHighlightingProgress = 0.0;
				SumHighlightingProgress = 0.0;
				MaxMarkerHighlightingProgress = 0.0;
				SumMarkerHighlightingProgress = 0.0;
				TotalHighlightingProgress = 0.0;
			}
			_progressingSeries.Clear();
			for (int k = 0; k < _allHighlights.Count; k++)
			{
				HighlightingInfo highlightingInfo3 = _allHighlights[k];
				HighlightingData highlightingData = null;
				if (_progressing.ContainsKey(highlightingInfo3.Series))
				{
					highlightingData = _progressing[highlightingInfo3.Series];
				}
				else
				{
					highlightingData = new HighlightingData();
					highlightingData.IndividualSeriesSum = 0.0;
					highlightingData.SeriesSum = 0.0;
					highlightingData.Series = highlightingInfo3.Series;
					highlightingData.MarkerSum = 0.0;
					highlightingData.SeriesExclusiveSum = 0.0;
					_progressing.Add(highlightingInfo3.Series, highlightingData);
					_progressingSeries.Add(highlightingInfo3.Series);
				}
				if (highlightingInfo3.IsMarker)
				{
					highlightingData.MarkerSum += highlightingInfo3.Progress;
				}
				else if (highlightingInfo3.IsFullRange)
				{
					if (highlightingInfo3.IsExclusive)
					{
						highlightingData.SeriesExclusiveSum += highlightingInfo3.Progress;
					}
					else
					{
						highlightingData.SeriesSum += highlightingInfo3.Progress;
					}
				}
				else
				{
					highlightingData.IndividualSeriesSum += highlightingInfo3.Progress;
				}
			}
			if (IsExclusiveHighlight)
			{
				TotalHighlightingProgress = Math.Max(SumHighlightingProgress, SumMarkerHighlightingProgress);
			}
			else
			{
				double num12 = 0.0;
				double num13 = 0.0;
				double num14 = 0.0;
				double num15 = 0.0;
				double num16 = 0.0;
				int num17 = 0;
				int num18 = 0;
				for (int l = 0; l < _progressingSeries.Count; l++)
				{
					HighlightingData highlightingData2 = _progressing[_progressingSeries[l]];
					if (highlightingData2.IndividualSeriesSum > 0.0)
					{
						num17++;
					}
					if (highlightingData2.MarkerSum > 0.0)
					{
						num18++;
					}
					if (highlightingData2.SeriesSum > 0.0)
					{
						num14 += 1.0;
					}
					num12 += highlightingData2.IndividualSeriesSum;
					num13 += highlightingData2.SeriesSum;
					num16 += highlightingData2.SeriesExclusiveSum;
					num15 += highlightingData2.MarkerSum;
				}
				if (num17 > 0)
				{
					num12 /= (double)num17;
				}
				if (num18 > 0)
				{
					num15 /= (double)num18;
				}
				if (HighlightingBehavior == SeriesHighlightingBehavior.NearestItemsRetainMainShapes && num14 > 0.0)
				{
					num13 /= num14;
				}
				TotalHighlightingProgress = Math.Max(num16, Math.Max(num12, Math.Max(num13, num15)));
			}
			if (!flag)
			{
				_lastProgress = 0.0;
			}
			return flag;
		}

		public bool IsCrossSeriesHighlight(Series target)
		{
			if (target.ActualHighlightingMode == SeriesHighlightingMode.FadeOthers || target.ActualHighlightingMode == SeriesHighlightingMode.FadeOthersSpecific)
			{
				return true;
			}
			return false;
		}
	}
	internal class HighlightingData
	{
		public Series Series;

		public double MarkerSum;

		public double SeriesSum;

		public double SeriesExclusiveSum;

		public double IndividualSeriesSum;
	}
	internal class HighlightingInfoComparer : IEqualityComparer<HighlightingInfo>
	{
		public bool Equals(HighlightingInfo x, HighlightingInfo y)
		{
			if (x == null && y != null)
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (x != null && y == null)
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (x.IsMarker == y.IsMarker && x.StartIndex == y.StartIndex && x.EndIndex == y.EndIndex)
			{
				return x.Series == y.Series;
			}
			return false;
		}

		public int GetHashCode(HighlightingInfo obj)
		{
			return (((23 * 31 + (obj.IsMarker ? 1 : 0)) * 31 + obj.StartIndex) * 31 + obj.EndIndex) * 31 + ((obj.Series != null) ? obj.Series.GetHashCode() : 0);
		}
	}
	[TSImportModule("igniteui-charts/SeriesView", "SeriesView")]
	internal class SeriesViewerInteractionManager : ISeriesViewerInteractionManager
	{
		private double _previousZoomPosX;

		private double _previousZoomPosY;

		private Rect _zoomStartWindow;

		private double _currZoomScaleX;

		private double _currZoomScaleY;

		private double _currIsoZoomScale;

		private double _lastDistanceRatio;

		private bool _ignoreContactUp;

		private TileZoomManager _tileManager;

		internal const double DRAG_DISTANCE = 10.0;

		internal const double DRAG_DISTANCE_NEAR = 2.0;

		private HighlightingManager _highlightingManager;

		public IHighlightingManager HighlightingManager
		{
			get
			{
				if (_highlightingManager == null)
				{
					_highlightingManager = new HighlightingManager();
				}
				return _highlightingManager;
			}
		}

		internal Rect Anchor { get; set; }

		internal Rect DragState { get; set; }

		protected internal bool IsTileZoomRunning { get; private set; }

		internal TileZoomManager TileManager => _tileManager;

		internal Rect DragStartPoint { get; set; }

		private Rect WindowRectAtStartOfWindowOperation { get; set; }

		public SeriesViewerInteractionManager()
		{
			DragStartPoint = Rect.Empty;
			Anchor = Rect.Empty;
		}

		public void SimulateHover(SeriesViewer target, Point point)
		{
			object obj = null;
			object data = null;
			Series series = null;
			series = target.View.GetCurrentSeriesOver();
			HitTestResult hitTestResult = VisualTreeHelper.HitTest(target, point);
			Series series2 = null;
			series2 = hitTestResult.VisualHit as Series;
			if ((hitTestResult == null || hitTestResult.VisualHit == null) && series.SeriesInteractionManager.MouseIsOver)
			{
				series.SeriesInteractionManager.OnMouseLeave(series, point, null, null, isFinger: false);
			}
			obj = hitTestResult.VisualHit;
			target?.SimulatePlotHover(point);
			if (series2 != null && !series2.SeriesInteractionManager.MouseIsOver)
			{
				series2.SeriesInteractionManager.OnMouseEnter(series2, point, obj, data, isFinger: false);
			}
		}

		public void RenderCrosshairs(SeriesViewer target)
		{
			Point crosshairPoint = target.CrosshairPoint;
			Point point = crosshairPoint;
			SeriesViewerView view = target.View;
			bool num = target.AllCanDisplayAnnotations();
			bool areCrossHairsActivated = target.AreCrossHairsActivated;
			bool pinching = target.Pinching;
			bool suppressCrosshairChange = target.SuppressCrosshairChange;
			if (!num)
			{
				point = new Point(double.NaN, double.NaN);
			}
			if (point.X < 0.0 || point.X > 1.0 || point.Y < 0.0 || point.Y > 1.0)
			{
				point = new Point(double.NaN, double.NaN);
			}
			for (int i = 0; i < target.Series.Count; i++)
			{
				target.Series[i].MoveCursorPoint(point);
			}
			bool num2 = target.State == InteractionState.None && !target.IsDefaultCrosshairDisabled && (target.CrosshairsVisible || areCrossHairsActivated) && !pinching && !suppressCrosshairChange;
			Rect viewportRect = target.ViewportRect;
			if (num2 && !double.IsNaN(crosshairPoint.X) && !viewportRect.IsEmpty)
			{
				double num3 = viewportRect.Width * (crosshairPoint.X - target.ActualWindowRect.Left) / target.ActualWindowRect.Width;
				view.UpdateVerticalCrosshair(viewportRect.Left + num3, viewportRect.Top, viewportRect.Left + num3, viewportRect.Bottom);
				view.ShowVerticalCrosshair();
				view.UpdateInfoBoxXTranslation(num3);
			}
			else
			{
				view.HideVerticalCrosshair();
			}
			if (num2 && !double.IsNaN(crosshairPoint.Y) && !viewportRect.IsEmpty)
			{
				double num4 = viewportRect.Height * (crosshairPoint.Y - target.ActualWindowRect.Top) / target.ActualWindowRect.Height;
				view.UpdateHorizontalCrosshair(viewportRect.Left, viewportRect.Top + num4, viewportRect.Right, viewportRect.Top + num4);
				view.ShowHorizontalCrosshair();
			}
			else
			{
				view.HideHorizontalCrosshair();
			}
		}

		public void OnStateChanged(SeriesViewer target)
		{
			switch (target.State)
			{
			case InteractionState.None:
				target.View.SetDefaultCursor();
				RenderCrosshairs(target);
				target.View.GoToIdleState();
				break;
			case InteractionState.DragZoom:
				target.View.SetHandCursor();
				target.View.HideTooltip();
				RenderCrosshairs(target);
				target.View.GoToDraggingVisualState();
				break;
			case InteractionState.DragPan:
				target.View.SetHandCursor();
				target.View.HideTooltip();
				RenderCrosshairs(target);
				target.View.GoToPanningVisualState();
				break;
			}
		}

		public void OnDragDelta(SeriesViewer target, Point point)
		{
			if (point.X >= 0.0 && point.Y >= 0.0 && point.X <= target.ViewportRect.Width && point.Y <= target.ViewportRect.Height)
			{
				ShowDragTooltip(target, point);
			}
			else
			{
				target.HideDragCrosshairAndTooltip();
			}
		}

		private void ShowDragTooltip(SeriesViewer target, Point pt)
		{
			SeriesViewerView view = target.View;
			Rect viewportRect = target.ViewportRect;
			if (target.IsDefaultTooltipDisabled || target.IsDefaultCrosshairDisabled || !target.AreCrossHairsActivated)
			{
				return;
			}
			bool flag = viewportRect.Height > viewportRect.Width;
			flag = true;
			view.ClearInfoBox(flag);
			foreach (Series item in target.Series)
			{
				if (item.IsStacked)
				{
					item.ForSubVisualSeries(delegate(Series s)
					{
						if (s.Visibility == Visibility.Visible)
						{
							s.ShowTooltip(pt, view.AddToInfoBox);
						}
						return true;
					});
				}
				else if (item.Visibility == Visibility.Visible)
				{
					item.ShowTooltip(pt, view.AddToInfoBox);
				}
			}
			view.ShowInfoBox();
		}

		private void ShowDragCrosshair(SeriesViewer target, Point pt)
		{
			if (target.CrosshairsVisible || target.IsDragCrosshairEnabled || target.IsAnnotationLayerPresent)
			{
				target.AreCrossHairsActivated = true;
				target.OnZoomPanInteractionEnding();
				Anchor = new Rect(pt.X, pt.Y, 0.0, 0.0);
				DragState = new Rect(pt.X, pt.Y, 0.0, 0.0);
				target.State = InteractionState.None;
				target.CrosshairNotify(target.ToWorld(pt));
			}
		}

		public void OnPlotAreaHold(SeriesViewer target, Point pt)
		{
			ShowDragCrosshair(target, pt);
			ShowDragTooltip(target, pt);
			RenderCrosshairs(target);
		}

		public void OnDragStarted(SeriesViewer target, Point pt, bool isFinger)
		{
			if (!target.AreCrossHairsActivated)
			{
				StartWindowOperation(target, pt, isFinger);
			}
		}

		public void OnDragCompleted(SeriesViewer target, Point point)
		{
			DragStartPoint = Rect.Empty;
			target.HideDragCrosshairAndTooltip();
		}

		public void OnZoomStart(SeriesViewer target)
		{
			SeriesViewerView view = target.View;
			_lastDistanceRatio = 1.0;
			target.AreCrossHairsActivated = false;
			view.HidePreviewPath();
			view.HideDragPath();
			view.HideInfoBox();
			target.CrosshairNotify(new Point(double.NaN, double.NaN));
			view.HideHorizontalCrosshair();
			view.HideVerticalCrosshair();
			view.HideTooltip();
			target.State = InteractionState.None;
			_ignoreContactUp = true;
			target.Pinching = true;
			target.OnZoomPanInteractionStarting();
		}

		public void OnPinchStarted(SeriesViewer target, Point point)
		{
			OnZoomStart(target);
		}

		public void OnZoomStarted(SeriesViewer target, Point point, double deltaScaleX, double deltaScaleY, double isoDeltaScale)
		{
			_previousZoomPosX = point.X;
			_previousZoomPosY = point.Y;
			_currZoomScaleX = deltaScaleX;
			_currZoomScaleY = deltaScaleY;
			_currIsoZoomScale = isoDeltaScale;
			_zoomStartWindow = target.ActualWindowRect;
			OnZoomStart(target);
		}

		public void OnPinchDelta(SeriesViewer target, double p, Point anchor)
		{
			SeriesViewerView view = target.View;
			view.HideHorizontalCrosshair();
			view.HideVerticalCrosshair();
			if (view.UseDeltaZoom)
			{
				DoDeltaZoom(target, p);
			}
			else
			{
				DoScale(target, p, anchor);
			}
		}

		public void OnZoomDelta(SeriesViewer target, Point p, double deltaScaleX, double deltaScaleY, double isoDeltaScale)
		{
			SeriesViewerView view = target.View;
			view.HideHorizontalCrosshair();
			view.HideVerticalCrosshair();
			_currZoomScaleX *= deltaScaleX;
			_currZoomScaleY *= deltaScaleY;
			_currIsoZoomScale *= isoDeltaScale;
			if (target.IsIsoScaled)
			{
				_currZoomScaleX = _currIsoZoomScale;
				_currZoomScaleY = _currIsoZoomScale;
			}
			Rect actualWindowRect = target.ActualWindowRect;
			Rect viewportRect = target.ViewportRect;
			double num = p.X - _previousZoomPosX;
			double num2 = p.Y - _previousZoomPosY;
			_previousZoomPosX = p.X;
			_previousZoomPosY = p.Y;
			_ = actualWindowRect.Width;
			_ = actualWindowRect.Height;
			double num3 = _zoomStartWindow.Width / _currZoomScaleX;
			double num4 = _zoomStartWindow.Height / _currZoomScaleY;
			if (num3 > 1.0)
			{
				num3 = 1.0;
			}
			if (num4 > 1.0)
			{
				num4 = 1.0;
			}
			Point point = new Point(p.X, p.Y);
			Point point2 = new Point((point.X - viewportRect.Left) / viewportRect.Width * actualWindowRect.Width + actualWindowRect.Left, (point.Y - viewportRect.Top) / viewportRect.Height * actualWindowRect.Height + actualWindowRect.Top);
			Rect rect = new Rect(actualWindowRect.Left, actualWindowRect.Top, num3, num4);
			Point point3 = new Point((point2.X - rect.Left) / rect.Width * viewportRect.Width + viewportRect.Left, (point2.Y - rect.Top) / rect.Height * viewportRect.Height + viewportRect.Top);
			double num5 = point3.X - point.X - num;
			double num6 = point3.Y - point.Y - num2;
			double num7 = num5 / viewportRect.Width * rect.Width;
			double num8 = num6 / viewportRect.Height * rect.Height;
			rect = new Rect(rect.Left + num7, rect.Top + num8, rect.Width, rect.Height);
			actualWindowRect = rect;
			target.WindowNotify(actualWindowRect, userInteraction: true);
		}

		public void OnManipulationStarted(SeriesViewer target, Point point)
		{
			Anchor = new Rect(point.X, point.Y, 0.0, 0.0);
			DragState = new Rect(point.X, point.Y, 0.0, 0.0);
		}

		private void DoScale(SeriesViewer target, double scaleDelta, Point anchor)
		{
			double width = target.ActualWindowRect.Width;
			double height = target.ActualWindowRect.Height;
			double num = target.ActualWindowRect.Left + width / 2.0;
			double num2 = target.ActualWindowRect.Top + height / 2.0;
			width /= scaleDelta;
			height /= scaleDelta;
			double x = num - width / 2.0;
			double y = num2 - height / 2.0;
			target.WindowNotify(new Rect(x, y, width, height), userInteraction: true);
		}

		public void OnPinchCompleted(SeriesViewer target, double p, Point anchor)
		{
			if (target.View.UseDeltaZoom)
			{
				DoDeltaZoom(target, p);
			}
			else
			{
				DoScale(target, p, anchor);
			}
			Anchor = Rect.Empty;
			target.Pinching = false;
		}

		public void OnGestureCompleted(SeriesViewer target, Point pt)
		{
			target.Pinching = false;
			Anchor = Rect.Empty;
			target.HideDragCrosshairAndTooltip();
		}

		public void OnZoomCompleted(SeriesViewer target, Point pt, double scaleDeltaX, double scaleDeltaY, double isoScaleDelta)
		{
			target.Pinching = false;
			Anchor = Rect.Empty;
			target.HideDragCrosshairAndTooltip();
		}

		private void DoDeltaZoom(SeriesViewer target, double deltaZoom)
		{
			Rect windowRect = target.WindowRect;
			double num = 1.0 / deltaZoom;
			Point point = new Point(windowRect.X + windowRect.Width / 2.0, windowRect.Y + windowRect.Height / 2.0);
			Point point2 = new Point(windowRect.X - point.X, windowRect.Y - point.Y);
			Rect windowRect2 = new Rect(point2.X * num + point.X, point2.Y * num + point.Y, windowRect.Width * num, windowRect.Height * num);
			target.WindowNotify(windowRect2, userInteraction: true);
		}

		private void DoZoom(SeriesViewer target, double distanceRatio)
		{
			_ = target.ViewportRect;
			Rect windowRect = target.WindowRect;
			double num = distanceRatio - _lastDistanceRatio;
			if (num != 0.0)
			{
				double num2 = 0.03;
				double num3 = ((num < 0.0) ? (1.0 + num2) : (1.0 - num2));
				Point point = new Point(windowRect.X + windowRect.Width / 2.0, windowRect.Y + windowRect.Height / 2.0);
				Point point2 = new Point(windowRect.X - point.X, windowRect.Y - point.Y);
				Rect windowRect2 = new Rect(point2.X * num3 + point.X, point2.Y * num3 + point.Y, windowRect.Width * num3, windowRect.Height * num3);
				target.WindowNotify(windowRect2, userInteraction: true);
			}
		}

		public void OnContactStarted(SeriesViewer target, Point pt, bool isFinger)
		{
			if (!target.Pinching)
			{
				_ignoreContactUp = false;
			}
			StartWindowOperation(target, pt, isFinger);
			target.OnPlotAreaMouseDown(pt, isFinger);
		}

		protected void StartWindowOperation(SeriesViewer target, Point pt, bool isFinger)
		{
			SeriesViewerView view = target.View;
			InteractionState interactionState = target.ResolveDefaultInteraction(isFinger);
			InteractionState interactionState2 = ((view.CurrentModifiers == ModifierKeys.None) ? ((interactionState != InteractionState.DragZoom) ? interactionState : (target.IsZoomingEnabled() ? interactionState : InteractionState.None)) : ((view.CurrentModifiers == target.DragModifier) ? InteractionState.DragZoom : ((view.CurrentModifiers == target.PanModifier) ? InteractionState.DragPan : InteractionState.None)));
			if (interactionState2 == InteractionState.DragZoom || interactionState2 == InteractionState.DragPan)
			{
				target.View.FocusChart();
				target.View.PlotAreaCaptureMouse();
			}
			target.State = interactionState2;
			switch (target.State)
			{
			case InteractionState.DragZoom:
				target.CrosshairNotify(new Point(double.NaN, double.NaN));
				Anchor = new Rect(pt.X, pt.Y, 0.0, 0.0);
				DragState = new Rect(pt.X, pt.Y, 0.0, 0.0);
				DragStartPoint = new Rect(pt.X, pt.Y, 0.0, 0.0);
				view.ShowDragPath();
				view.UpdateDragPath(Anchor);
				target.PreviewNotify(Rect.Empty, userInteraction: true);
				break;
			case InteractionState.DragPan:
				Anchor = new Rect(pt.X, pt.Y, 0.0, 0.0);
				DragStartPoint = new Rect(pt.X, pt.Y, 0.0, 0.0);
				break;
			}
			WindowRectAtStartOfWindowOperation = target.ActualWindowRect;
			target.WindowRectAtStartOfWindowOperation = target.ActualWindowRect;
		}

		public void OnZoomPanInteractionStarting(SeriesViewer target)
		{
			target.StartTiledZoomingIfNecessary();
			target.View.OnZoomPanInteractionStarting();
		}

		public void OnZoomPanInteractionEnding(SeriesViewer target)
		{
			target.EndTiledZoomingIfRunning();
			target.View.OnZoomPanInteractionEnding();
		}

		public void StartTiledZoomIfNecessary(SeriesViewer target)
		{
			if (target.ActualUseTiledZooming && !IsTileZoomRunning)
			{
				IsTileZoomRunning = true;
				StartTileZoom(target);
			}
		}

		public void EndTiledZoomIfRunning(SeriesViewer target)
		{
			if (IsTileZoomRunning)
			{
				EndTileZoom(target);
				IsTileZoomRunning = false;
			}
		}

		public void ClearTileZoomCache(SeriesViewer target)
		{
			if (_tileManager != null)
			{
				TileManager.ClearTileCache();
			}
		}

		private void StartTileZoom(SeriesViewer target)
		{
			if (_tileManager == null)
			{
				_tileManager = new TileZoomManager(target, roundDown: true, target.ActualZoomTileCacheSize);
				_tileManager.RoundDown = !target.PreferHigherResolutionTiles;
			}
			target.IgnoreWindowChanges = true;
			target.PrepareAxesForTiledZoom();
			_tileManager.Start();
			target.View.CancelDeferredCacheClear();
			target.View.CancelEndToTiledZoom();
		}

		internal void EndTileZoom(SeriesViewer target)
		{
			if (_tileManager != null)
			{
				target.IgnoreWindowChanges = false;
				target.View.OnTileZoomEnding();
				_tileManager.End();
				target.RefreshAllContentAfterTiledZoom();
				target.View.DeferCacheClear();
			}
		}

		public void DeferredClearOfTileZoomCache(SeriesViewer target)
		{
			target.ClearTileZoomCache();
			target.ReleaseAxesFromTiledZoom();
		}

		private bool ShouldAllowPan(SeriesViewer target)
		{
			if (target.State != InteractionState.DragPan)
			{
				if (target.View.Scaling)
				{
					return !target.AreCrossHairsActivated;
				}
				return false;
			}
			return true;
		}

		private bool ShouldImmediatePan(SeriesViewer target, bool isFinger)
		{
			if (!(target.WindowResponse == WindowResponse.Immediate || isFinger) && !target.ActualUseTiledZooming && !target.View.Scaling)
			{
				return target.View.Translating;
			}
			return true;
		}

		private bool ShouldAllowDragZoom(SeriesViewer target)
		{
			if (target.State == InteractionState.DragZoom)
			{
				return !target.View.Scaling;
			}
			return false;
		}

		public void OnContactMoved(SeriesViewer target, Point pt, bool isFinger)
		{
			SeriesViewerView view = target.View;
			if (Anchor.IsEmpty && isFinger)
			{
				StartWindowOperation(target, pt, isFinger);
			}
			double num = 2.0;
			if (isFinger)
			{
				num = 10.0;
			}
			bool flag = false;
			Rect rect = new Rect(new Point(Anchor.X, Anchor.Y), pt);
			Rect rect2 = new Rect(0.0, 0.0, 0.0, 0.0);
			if (!DragStartPoint.IsEmpty)
			{
				rect2 = new Rect(new Point(DragStartPoint.X, DragStartPoint.Y), pt);
			}
			if (rect2.Width > num && rect2.Height > num)
			{
				flag = true;
				foreach (Series item in target.Series)
				{
					item.View.FinishTouchUp(pt, null);
				}
			}
			if (!target.Pinching && flag)
			{
				_ignoreContactUp = false;
			}
			if (!target.Pinching && (target.AreCrossHairsActivated || !isFinger))
			{
				target.CrosshairNotify(target.ToWorld(pt));
			}
			if (ShouldAllowDragZoom(target))
			{
				if (flag)
				{
					Rect windowRect = target.ToWorld(rect);
					target.PreviewNotify(windowRect, userInteraction: true);
				}
				else
				{
					target.PreviewNotify(Rect.Empty, userInteraction: true);
				}
				target.OnCheckDragZoomStarting();
				view.UpdateDragPath(rect);
			}
			Rect viewportRect = target.ViewportRect;
			Rect actualWindowRect = target.ActualWindowRect;
			if (ShouldAllowPan(target))
			{
				Rect rect3 = viewportRect;
				double x = actualWindowRect.Left + actualWindowRect.Width * (Anchor.X - pt.X) / rect3.Width;
				double y = actualWindowRect.Top + actualWindowRect.Height * (Anchor.Y - pt.Y) / rect3.Height;
				Rect windowRect2 = new Rect(x, y, actualWindowRect.Width, actualWindowRect.Height);
				if (ShouldImmediatePan(target, isFinger))
				{
					if (rect2.Width != 0.0 || rect2.Height != 0.0)
					{
						target.OnZoomPanInteractionStarting();
					}
					target.PreviewNotify(Rect.Empty, userInteraction: true);
					target.WindowNotify(windowRect2, userInteraction: true);
					Anchor = new Rect(pt, new Size(0.0, 0.0));
					DragState = new Rect(pt, new Size(0.0, 0.0));
				}
				else
				{
					target.PreviewNotify(windowRect2, userInteraction: true);
				}
			}
			DragState = new Rect(pt, new Size(0.0, 0.0));
			view.CheckInteractionCompleted(pt);
		}

		public void OnContactCompleted(SeriesViewer target, Point pt, bool isFinger, bool isSecondaryFinger)
		{
			SeriesViewerView view = target.View;
			double num = 2.0;
			if (isFinger)
			{
				num = 10.0;
			}
			Rect viewportRect = target.ViewportRect;
			Rect actualWindowRect = target.ActualWindowRect;
			if (!_ignoreContactUp)
			{
				bool flag = false;
				Rect rect = new Rect(new Point(Anchor.X, Anchor.Y), pt);
				if (rect.Width > num && rect.Height > num)
				{
					flag = true;
				}
				if (target.State == InteractionState.DragZoom)
				{
					target.OnCheckDragZoomEnding();
					view.HideDragPath();
					if (flag)
					{
						target.WindowNotify(target.ToWorld(rect), userInteraction: true);
					}
				}
				if (target.State == InteractionState.DragPan)
				{
					Rect rect2 = viewportRect;
					double x = actualWindowRect.Left + actualWindowRect.Width * (Anchor.X - pt.X) / rect2.Width;
					double y = actualWindowRect.Top + actualWindowRect.Height * (Anchor.Y - pt.Y) / rect2.Height;
					target.WindowNotify(new Rect(x, y, actualWindowRect.Width, actualWindowRect.Height), userInteraction: true);
				}
			}
			bool flag2 = false;
			Rect rect3 = new Rect(new Point(DragStartPoint.X, DragStartPoint.Y), pt);
			if (rect3.Width > num || rect3.Height > num)
			{
				flag2 = true;
			}
			if (flag2)
			{
				target.SuppressCrosshairChange = true;
			}
			target.State = InteractionState.None;
			target.PreviewNotify(Rect.Empty, userInteraction: true);
			view.CompleteMouseCapture();
			target.SuppressCrosshairChange = false;
			if (isFinger)
			{
				view.HideTooltip();
				view.HideHorizontalCrosshair();
				view.HideVerticalCrosshair();
			}
			target.HideDragCrosshairAndTooltip();
			target.OnZoomPanInteractionEnding();
			target.OnPlotAreaMouseUp(pt, isFinger, isSecondaryFinger);
		}

		public void OnPreferHigherResolutionTilesChanged(SeriesViewer target)
		{
			if (TileManager != null)
			{
				TileManager.RoundDown = !target.PreferHigherResolutionTiles;
			}
		}

		public bool OnKeyDown(SeriesViewer target, Key key)
		{
			SeriesViewerView view = target.View;
			Rect actualWindowRect = target.ActualWindowRect;
			if (target.State == InteractionState.DragPan && key == Key.Escape)
			{
				view.CancelMouseInteractions();
				target.State = InteractionState.None;
				target.OnZoomPanInteractionEnding();
				target.PreviewNotify(Rect.Empty, userInteraction: true);
				if (target.WindowResponse == WindowResponse.Immediate)
				{
					target.WindowNotify(WindowRectAtStartOfWindowOperation, userInteraction: true);
				}
				return true;
			}
			if (target.State == InteractionState.DragZoom && key == Key.Escape)
			{
				view.CancelMouseInteractions();
				target.State = InteractionState.None;
				target.OnZoomPanInteractionEnding();
				view.HideDragPath();
				target.PreviewNotify(Rect.Empty, userInteraction: true);
				return true;
			}
			Rect rect = Rect.Empty;
			bool result = false;
			switch (key)
			{
			case Key.Home:
				result = true;
				rect = new Rect(0.0, 0.0, 1.0, 1.0);
				break;
			case Key.Next:
				result = true;
				rect = new Rect(actualWindowRect.Left - 0.1 * actualWindowRect.Width, actualWindowRect.Top - 0.1 * actualWindowRect.Height, 1.2 * actualWindowRect.Width, 1.2 * actualWindowRect.Height);
				break;
			case Key.Prior:
				result = true;
				rect = new Rect(actualWindowRect.Left + 0.1 * actualWindowRect.Width, actualWindowRect.Top + 0.1 * actualWindowRect.Height, 0.8 * actualWindowRect.Width, 0.8 * actualWindowRect.Height);
				break;
			case Key.Left:
				result = true;
				rect = new Rect(actualWindowRect.Left - 0.1 * actualWindowRect.Width, actualWindowRect.Top, actualWindowRect.Width, actualWindowRect.Height);
				rect.X -= Math.Min(rect.Left, 0.0);
				break;
			case Key.Right:
				result = true;
				rect = new Rect(actualWindowRect.Left + 0.1 * actualWindowRect.Width, actualWindowRect.Top, actualWindowRect.Width, actualWindowRect.Height);
				rect.X -= Math.Max(rect.Right - 1.0, 0.0);
				break;
			case Key.Up:
				result = true;
				rect = new Rect(actualWindowRect.Left, actualWindowRect.Top - 0.1 * actualWindowRect.Height, actualWindowRect.Width, actualWindowRect.Height);
				rect.Y -= Math.Min(rect.Top, 0.0);
				break;
			case Key.Down:
				result = true;
				rect = new Rect(actualWindowRect.Left, actualWindowRect.Top + 0.1 * actualWindowRect.Height, actualWindowRect.Width, actualWindowRect.Height);
				rect.Y -= Math.Max(rect.Bottom - 1.0, 0.0);
				break;
			}
			if (!rect.IsEmpty && rect != actualWindowRect)
			{
				target.WindowNotify(rect, userInteraction: true);
			}
			return result;
		}

		public bool OnMouseWheel(SeriesViewer target, Point pt, double delta)
		{
			_ = target.View;
			Rect actualWindowRect = target.ActualWindowRect;
			if (target.ViewportRect.Left > pt.X || target.ViewportRect.Right < pt.X || target.ViewportRect.Top > pt.Y || target.ViewportRect.Bottom < pt.Y)
			{
				return false;
			}
			double num = actualWindowRect.Left + actualWindowRect.Width * pt.X / target.ViewportRect.Width;
			double num2 = actualWindowRect.Top + actualWindowRect.Height * pt.Y / target.ViewportRect.Height;
			double num3 = 1.0 - MathUtil.Clamp(delta, -0.5, 0.5);
			double num4 = Math.Max(0.0, num - num3 * (num - actualWindowRect.Left));
			double num5 = Math.Min(1.0, num2 + num3 * (actualWindowRect.Bottom - num2));
			double num6 = Math.Min(1.0, num + num3 * (actualWindowRect.Right - num));
			double num7 = Math.Max(0.0, num2 - num3 * (num2 - actualWindowRect.Top));
			target.OnZoomPanInteractionStarting();
			DeferEndToTiledZoom(target, 1000);
			target.WindowNotify(new Rect(num4, num7, num6 - num4, num5 - num7), userInteraction: true);
			return target.IsZoomingEnabled();
		}

		private void DeferEndToTiledZoom(SeriesViewer target, int delay)
		{
			target.View.DeferEndToTiledZoom(delay);
		}

		public void OnDoubleTap(SeriesViewer target, Point pt)
		{
			Rect actualWindowRect = target.ActualWindowRect;
			double num = actualWindowRect.Left + actualWindowRect.Width * pt.X / target.ViewportRect.Width;
			double num2 = actualWindowRect.Top + actualWindowRect.Height * pt.Y / target.ViewportRect.Height;
			double num3 = 0.7;
			double num4 = Math.Max(0.0, num - num3 * (num - actualWindowRect.Left));
			double num5 = Math.Min(1.0, num2 + num3 * (actualWindowRect.Bottom - num2));
			double num6 = Math.Min(1.0, num + num3 * (actualWindowRect.Right - num));
			double num7 = Math.Max(0.0, num2 - num3 * (num2 - actualWindowRect.Top));
			target.WindowNotify(new Rect(num4, num7, num6 - num4, num5 - num7), userInteraction: true);
		}

		public void ClearVisibleTiles(SeriesViewer target)
		{
			TileManager.ClearVisible();
		}

		public Rect GetDragState()
		{
			return DragState;
		}
	}
	internal class AnchoredCategorySeriesInteractionManager : IAnchoredCategorySeriesInteractionManager
	{
		public object GetItem(Series target, Point world, int bucketSize, IFastItemColumn<double> valueColumn, Axis xAxis, Axis yAxis, bool isNearestY, Func<Point, object> getItemBase)
		{
			if (!isNearestY)
			{
				return getItemBase(world);
			}
			if (xAxis == null || xAxis.IsSorting || yAxis == null || valueColumn == null || double.IsNaN(world.X) || double.IsNaN(world.Y))
			{
				return getItemBase(world);
			}
			if (bucketSize <= 1)
			{
				return getItemBase(world);
			}
			int num = (int)Math.Round(target.GetExactItemIndex(world));
			if (num < 0 || num >= target.FastItemsSource.Count)
			{
				return getItemBase(world);
			}
			int num2 = num / bucketSize;
			int num3 = bucketSize * num2;
			int num4 = Math.Min(num3 + bucketSize, valueColumn.Count - 1);
			Rect contentViewport = target.GetContentViewport(target.View);
			ScalerParams p = new ScalerParams(target.SeriesViewer.WindowRect, target.SeriesViewer.ViewportRect, yAxis.IsInverted, target.SeriesViewer.EffectiveViewport);
			double top = contentViewport.Top;
			double bottom = contentViewport.Bottom;
			double scaledValue = top + (bottom - top) * world.Y;
			double unscaledValue = yAxis.GetUnscaledValue(scaledValue, p);
			double num5 = double.MaxValue;
			int index = num3;
			for (int i = num3; i <= num4; i++)
			{
				double num6 = Math.Abs(valueColumn[i] - unscaledValue);
				if (num6 < num5)
				{
					num5 = num6;
					index = i;
				}
			}
			return target.FastItemsSource[index];
		}

		public bool ScrollIntoView(Series target, IFastItemColumn<double> valueColumn, Axis xAxis, Axis yAxis, double offset, object item)
		{
			Rect windowRect = target.View.WindowRect;
			Rect viewport = target.View.Viewport;
			Rect rect = new Rect(0.0, 0.0, 1.0, 1.0);
			int num = ((!windowRect.IsEmpty && !viewport.IsEmpty && target.FastItemsSource != null) ? target.FastItemsSource.IndexOf(item) : (-1));
			Rect effectiveViewportForUnitViewport = target.GetEffectiveViewportForUnitViewport(target.View);
			ScalerParams p = new ScalerParams(rect, rect, xAxis.IsInverted, effectiveViewportForUnitViewport);
			ScalerParams scalerParams = new ScalerParams(rect, rect, yAxis.IsInverted, effectiveViewportForUnitViewport);
			scalerParams.ReferenceValue = target.GetReferenceValue();
			double num2 = xAxis?.GetScaledValue(num, p) ?? double.NaN;
			num2 += offset;
			double num3 = ((yAxis != null && valueColumn != null && num < valueColumn.Count) ? yAxis.GetScaledValue(valueColumn[num], scalerParams) : double.NaN);

		public double GetDistanceToIndexHelper(Series target, Point world, int index, Axis axis, ScalerParams scalerParams, double offset, int count, Func<Point, double> getExactUnsortedIndex)

				}
				if (index >= 0 && index < count)
				{
					double unscaledValueAt3 = sortingAxis.GetUnscaledValueAt(sortingAxis.SortedIndices[index]);

		public double GetInterpolatedSeriesValue(Series target, double p, IList<double> column, int prevItem, int nextItem, int unsortedPrevItem, int unsortedNextItem, double offset, bool isSorting)
		{
			double num = double.NaN;
			if (prevItem >= 0 && prevItem < column.Count)
			{
				num = column[prevItem];
			}
			double num2 = double.NaN;
			if (nextItem >= 0 && nextItem < column.Count)
			{
				num2 = column[nextItem];
			}
			if (unsortedNextItem == 0)
			{
				return num2;
			}
			if (unsortedPrevItem == column.Count - 1)
			{
				return num;
			}
			if (double.IsNaN(num2) && offset != 0.0 && p <= 0.5 && !isSorting)
			{
				return num;
			}
			if (double.IsNaN(num) && offset != 0.0 && p >= 0.5 && !isSorting)
			{
				return num2;
			}
			return num * (1.0 - p) + num2 * p;
		}

		public double[][] GetMatchingBuckets(Series target, CategoryAxisBase categoryAxis, List<double[]> buckets, int bucketSize, int firstBucket, Point world, bool skipUnknowns)

				double maxPosition = target.View.Viewport.Right * 2.0;
				num3 = BucketBinarySearch(buckets, pos, isInverted, maxPosition);
				if (num3 < 0)
				{
					num3 = ~num3;
					num3--;
				}
				if (num3 < 0)
				{
					num3 = 0;
				}
				if (num3 > buckets.Count - 1)
				{
					num3 = buckets.Count - 1;
				}
				int num4 = num3;
				int num5 = num3 + 1;
				if (num5 > buckets.Count - 1)
				{
					num5 = buckets.Count - 1;
				}
				num = num4;
				num2 = num5;
			}
			else
			{
				int previousOrExactIndex = target.GetPreviousOrExactIndex(world, skipUnknowns);
				int nextOrExactIndex = target.GetNextOrExactIndex(world, skipUnknowns);
				int num6 = (int)Math.Floor((double)previousOrExactIndex / (double)bucketSize);
				int num7 = (int)Math.Floor((double)nextOrExactIndex / (double)bucketSize);
				num = num6 - firstBucket;
				num2 = num7 - firstBucket;
				if (num2 == num)
				{
					num2++;
				}
			}
			if (num < 0)
			{
				num = 0;
			}
			if (num > buckets.Count - 1)
			{
				num = buckets.Count - 1;
			}
			if (num2 < 0)
			{
				num2 = 0;
			}
			if (num2 > buckets.Count - 1)
			{
				num2 = buckets.Count - 1;
			}
			if (num < 0 || num2 < 0)
			{
				return null;
			}
			double[] array = buckets[num];
			double[] array2 = buckets[num2];
			return new double[2][] { array, array2 };
		}

		private static int BucketBinarySearch(IList<double[]> list, Point pos, bool isInverted, double maxPosition)
		{
			int num = 0;
			int num2 = list.Count - 1;
			while (num <= num2)
			{
				int num3 = num + (num2 - num >> 1);
				double[] array = list[num3];
				int num4 = ((!isInverted) ? ((pos.X < array[0]) ? (-1) : ((pos.X > array[0]) ? 1 : 0)) : ((maxPosition - pos.X < maxPosition - array[0]) ? (-1) : ((maxPosition - pos.X > maxPosition - array[0]) ? 1 : 0)));
				if (num4 < 0)
				{
					num2 = num3 - 1;
					continue;
				}
				if (num4 > 0)
				{
					num = num3 + 1;
					continue;
				}
				return num3;
			}
			return ~num;
		}

		public Point GetSeriesValuePositionHelper(Series target, Point world, bool useInterpolation, bool skipUnknowns, double offset, Axis valueAxis, Axis indexAxis, Func<Point, bool, bool, double> getSeriesValue, Func<Point, bool, int> getPrevious, Func<Point, bool, int> getNext)
		{
			if (valueAxis == null || indexAxis == null || target.View == null || target.View.WindowRect.IsEmpty || target.View.Viewport.IsEmpty)
			{
				return new Point(double.NaN, double.NaN);
			}
			Rect effectiveViewport = target.GetEffectiveViewport(target.View);
			ScalerParams scalerParams = new ScalerParams(target.View.WindowRect, target.View.Viewport, valueAxis.IsInverted, effectiveViewport);
			if (valueAxis.IsVertical)
			{
				scalerParams.ReferenceValue = target.GetReferenceValue();
			}
			scalerParams.EffectiveViewportRect = target.GetEffectiveViewport(target.View);
			SeriesView view = target.View;
			Rect contentViewport = target.GetContentViewport(view);
			double y;
			if (indexAxis.IsVertical)
			{
				y = world.Y;
				y = contentViewport.Top + contentViewport.Height * (y - view.WindowRect.Top) / view.WindowRect.Height;
			}
			else
			{
				y = world.X;
				y = contentViewport.Left + contentViewport.Width * (y - view.WindowRect.Left) / view.WindowRect.Width;
			}
			if (!useInterpolation && indexAxis != null)
			{
				int num = getPrevious?.Invoke(world, skipUnknowns) ?? target.GetPreviousOrExactIndex(world, skipUnknowns);
				int num2 = getNext?.Invoke(world, skipUnknowns) ?? target.GetNextOrExactIndex(world, skipUnknowns);
				if (num == -1 && num2 == -1)
				{
					return new Point(double.NaN, double.NaN);
				}
				ScalerParams scalerParams2 = new ScalerParams(view.WindowRect, view.Viewport, indexAxis.IsInverted, effectiveViewport);
				scalerParams2.EffectiveViewportRect = target.SeriesViewer.EffectiveViewport;
				double distanceToIndex = target.GetDistanceToIndex(world, num, indexAxis, scalerParams2, offset);
				double num3 = target.GetDistanceToIndex(world, num2, indexAxis, scalerParams2, offset);
				double num4 = num2;
				double num5 = num;
				if (indexAxis.IsSorting)
				{
					ISortingAxis sortingAxis = (ISortingAxis)indexAxis;
					if (num4 >= 0.0 && num4 < (double)sortingAxis.SortedIndices.Count)
					{
						num4 = sortingAxis.GetUnscaledValueAt(sortingAxis.SortedIndices[(int)num4]);
					}
					if (num5 >= 0.0 && num5 < (double)sortingAxis.SortedIndices.Count)
					{
						num5 = sortingAxis.GetUnscaledValueAt(sortingAxis.SortedIndices[(int)num5]);
					}
				}
				if (num3 + distanceToIndex != 0.0 && Math.Abs(num3 / (distanceToIndex + num3) - 0.5) < 1E-07)
				{
					num3 = distanceToIndex;
				}
				y = ((!(num3 <= distanceToIndex)) ? (indexAxis.GetScaledValue(num5, scalerParams2) + offset) : (indexAxis.GetScaledValue(num4, scalerParams2) + offset));
			}
			else if (indexAxis.IsCategory && !indexAxis.IsDateTime && ((CategoryAxisBase)indexAxis).CategoryMode != CategoryMode.Mode0)
			{

				if (target.IsVertical)

					num6 *= -1.0;
				}
				if (indexAxis.IsInverted)
				{
					num6 *= -1.0;
				}
				y -= num6;
				y += offset;
			}
			double unscaledValue = getSeriesValue?.Invoke(world, useInterpolation, skipUnknowns) ?? target.GetSeriesValue(world, useInterpolation, skipUnknowns);

		public void ModifyHighlights(Series target, object item, Point world, bool fromFinger, [SwiftMutableParameter] bool directlyOver, bool leaving, bool forceFullRange, [SwiftMutableParameter] bool isClosest, bool isLeavingPlot)
		{
			if (fromFinger || (target.SeriesViewer.JustZoomed() && !leaving) || target.ActualHighlightingMode == SeriesHighlightingMode.None || target.SeriesViewer == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			SeriesHighlightingBehavior actualHighlightingBehavior = target.SeriesViewer.ActualHighlightingBehavior;
			bool flag = actualHighlightingBehavior == SeriesHighlightingBehavior.NearestItems || actualHighlightingBehavior == SeriesHighlightingBehavior.NearestItemsRetainMainShapes || actualHighlightingBehavior == SeriesHighlightingBehavior.NearestItemsAndSeries;
			bool flag2 = actualHighlightingBehavior == SeriesHighlightingBehavior.NearestItems || actualHighlightingBehavior == SeriesHighlightingBehavior.NearestItemsAndSeries;
			if (!forceFullRange && flag)
			{
				directlyOver = false;
			}
			if ((target.HasIndividualElements && target.HasSpecificHighlightingMode) || forceFullRange)
			{
				flag2 = false;
			}

			{
				isClosest = false;
			}
			if (actualHighlightingBehavior == SeriesHighlightingBehavior.NearestItemsRetainMainShapes)
			{
				isClosest = true;
			}
			HighlightingInfo highlightingInfo = null;
			HighlightingInfo highlightingInfo2 = null;
			IHighlightingManager highlightingManager = target.SeriesViewer.HighlightingManager;
			_ = target.SeriesViewer.HighlightingAnimator;
			int num;
			int num2;
			if (!((leaving && forceFullRange) || (leaving && !flag) || isLeavingPlot))
			{
				if (flag2)
				{
					num = ((!isClosest) ? 1 : 0);
					if (num != 0)
					{
						goto IL_00e3;
					}
				}
				else
				{
					num = 0;
				}
				num2 = ((forceFullRange || directlyOver || (flag && !flag2) || (flag && flag2 && isClosest)) ? 1 : 0);
				goto IL_00e4;
			}
			num = 1;
			goto IL_00e3;
			IL_00e3:
			num2 = 0;
			goto IL_00e4;
			IL_00e4:
			bool flag3 = (byte)num2 != 0;
			bool flag4 = (leaving && (!flag || forceFullRange)) || isLeavingPlot || (!target.HasSpecificHighlightingMode && flag && flag2 && !isClosest);
			bool flag5 = !flag4 && (directlyOver || (flag && target.HasSpecificHighlightingMode) || (!target.HasSpecificHighlightingMode && flag && !flag2) || (!target.HasSpecificHighlightingMode && flag && flag2 && isClosest));
			if (num != 0 && LastHighlightingInfo != null)
			{
				highlightingInfo = LastHighlightingInfo;
			}
			else
			{
				highlightingInfo = target.GetHighlightingInfo(item, world, forceFullRange);
				if (LastHighlightingInfo != null && LastHighlightingInfo != highlightingInfo && target.SeriesViewer != null)
				{
					highlightingManager.EndHighlight(LastHighlightingInfo);
				}
				LastHighlightingInfo = highlightingInfo;
			}
			if (target.HasMarkers)
			{
				if (flag4 && LastMarkerHighlightingInfo != null)
				{
					highlightingInfo2 = LastMarkerHighlightingInfo;
				}
				else
				{
					highlightingInfo2 = target.GetMarkerHighlightingInfo(item, world, forceFullRange);
					if (LastMarkerHighlightingInfo != null && LastMarkerHighlightingInfo != highlightingInfo2)
					{
						highlightingManager.EndHighlight(LastMarkerHighlightingInfo);
					}
					LastMarkerHighlightingInfo = highlightingInfo2;
				}
			}
			if (num != 0)
			{

			}
			else if (flag3)

				}

			if (flag4)
			{

				{

				}
			}
			else if (flag5 && highlightingInfo2 != null)

			}
