		private void EnsureAnimator(Series target)
		{
			if (target.SeriesViewer != null)
			{
				DoubleAnimator highlightingAnimator = target.SeriesViewer.HighlightingAnimator;
				if (!highlightingAnimator.AnimationActive() && highlightingAnimator.IntervalMilliseconds > 0)
				{
					highlightingAnimator.Start();
				}
				if (highlightingAnimator.IntervalMilliseconds == 0)
				{
					target.SeriesViewer.UpdateHighlights(1.0);
				}
			}
		}

		public double ApplyHighlightingOpacity(Series target, HighlightingInfo info, [SwiftMutableParameter] double opacity, [SwiftMutableParameter] double othersProgress, [SwiftMutableParameter] double secondaryOthersProgress, double fadeOpacity, bool isMainShape)
		{
			if (target.ActualHighlightingMode == SeriesHighlightingMode.Brighten || target.ActualHighlightingMode == SeriesHighlightingMode.BrightenSpecific)
			{
				return opacity;
			}
			if (target.ActualHighlightingMode == SeriesHighlightingMode.FadeOthers || target.ActualHighlightingMode == SeriesHighlightingMode.FadeOthersSpecific)
			{
				double num = 0.0;
				if (info != null)
				{
					num = info.Progress;
				}
				if (num > 1.0)
				{
					num = 1.0;
				}
				if (othersProgress > 1.0)
				{
					othersProgress = 1.0;
				}
				if (secondaryOthersProgress > 1.0)
				{
					secondaryOthersProgress = 1.0;
				}
				num -= Math.Max(othersProgress, secondaryOthersProgress);
				opacity = fadeOpacity + (1.0 + num) * (1.0 - fadeOpacity);
				return opacity;
			}
			return opacity;
		}

		public Brush ApplyHighlightingColor(Series target, HighlightingInfo info, Brush brush)
		{
			if (target.ActualHighlightingMode == SeriesHighlightingMode.Brighten || target.ActualHighlightingMode == SeriesHighlightingMode.BrightenSpecific)
			{
				double num = 0.0;
				if (info != null)
				{
					num = info.Progress;
				}
				double num2 = num;
				num2 *= 0.5;
				return GetBrightenedBrush(brush, num2);
			}
			if (target.ActualHighlightingMode != SeriesHighlightingMode.FadeOthers)
			{
				_ = target.ActualHighlightingMode;
				_ = 4;
			}
			return brush;
		}

		protected Brush GetBrightenedBrush(Brush brush, double additionalBrightness)
		{
			if (brush != null)
			{
				if (additionalBrightness == 0.0)
				{
					return brush;
				}
				return brush.GetLightened(additionalBrightness);
			}
			return null;
		}

		public void OnMouseEnter(Series target, Point pt, object source, object data, bool isFinger)
		{
			target.View.GoToMouseOverState();
			MouseIsOver = true;
			object obj = (LastHoverItem = target.Item(source, pt));
			if (!isFinger && target.SeriesViewer != null && !target.ContentInfo.IsDirty)
			{
				UpdateToolTip(target, pt, obj, data);
			}
			_isMouseEnterDeferred = false;
			if (target.ShouldDeferEnterAndLeave && obj == null)
			{
				_isMouseEnterDeferred = true;
			}
			if (target.SeriesViewer != null && !_isMouseEnterDeferred)
			{
				if (target.ShouldDeferEnterAndLeave)
				{
					_isMouseLeaveDeferred = true;
				}
				ModifyHighlights(target, obj, target.ToWorldPosition(pt), isFinger, directlyOver: true, leaving: false, forceFullRange: false, target == target.SeriesViewer.ClosestSeries, isLeavingPlot: false);
				target.SeriesViewer.OnSeriesMouseEnter(target, obj, data);
			}
		}

		public void SimulateHover(Series target, Point point)
		{
			object obj = null;
			object data = null;
			HitTestResult hitTestResult = VisualTreeHelper.HitTest(target, point);
			if (hitTestResult == null || hitTestResult.VisualHit == null)
			{
				if (MouseIsOver)
				{
					OnMouseLeave(target, point, null, null, isFinger: false);
				}
				if (target.SeriesViewer != null)
				{
					target.SeriesViewer.SimulatePlotHover(point);
				}
				return;
			}
			obj = hitTestResult.VisualHit;
			if (target.SeriesViewer != null)
			{
				target.SeriesViewer.SimulatePlotHover(point);
			}
			if (!MouseIsOver)
			{
				OnMouseEnter(target, point, obj, data, isFinger: false);
			}
			OnMouseMove(target, point, obj, data, isFinger: false);
		}

		public void OnMouseMove(Series target, Point point, object source, object data, bool isFinger)
		{
			object obj = target.Item(source, point);
			if (!isFinger)
			{
				UpdateToolTip(target, point, obj, data);
			}
			if (obj != null)
			{
				LastHoverItem = obj;
			}
			if (target.SeriesViewer != null && obj != null && _isMouseEnterDeferred)
			{
				_isMouseEnterDeferred = false;
				_isMouseLeaveDeferred = true;
				ModifyHighlights(target, obj, target.ToWorldPosition(point), isFinger, directlyOver: true, leaving: false, forceFullRange: false, target == target.SeriesViewer.ClosestSeries, isLeavingPlot: false);
				target.SeriesViewer.OnSeriesMouseEnter(target, obj, data);
			}
			if (target.SeriesViewer != null && (!target.ShouldDeferEnterAndLeave || obj != null) && !_isMouseEnterDeferred)
			{
				ModifyHighlights(target, obj, target.ToWorldPosition(point), isFinger, directlyOver: true, leaving: false, forceFullRange: false, target == target.SeriesViewer.ClosestSeries, isLeavingPlot: false);
				target.SeriesViewer.OnSeriesMouseMove(target, obj, data);
			}
			if (obj == null && !_isMouseEnterDeferred && target.ShouldDeferEnterAndLeave)
			{
				ModifyHighlights(target, obj, target.ToWorldPosition(point), isFinger, directlyOver: false, leaving: true, forceFullRange: false, target == target.SeriesViewer.ClosestSeries, isLeavingPlot: false);
				target.SeriesViewer.OnSeriesMouseLeave(target, LastHoverItem, data);
				_isMouseLeaveDeferred = false;
				_isMouseEnterDeferred = true;
			}
		}

		public void OnMouseLeave(Series target, Point pt, object p, object data, bool isFinger)
		{
			target.View.GoToNormalState();
			MouseIsOver = false;
			object lastHoverItem = LastHoverItem;
			target.View.HideTooltip();
			if (target.SeriesViewer != null && (_isMouseLeaveDeferred || !target.ShouldDeferEnterAndLeave))
			{
				_isMouseLeaveDeferred = false;
				_isMouseEnterDeferred = false;
				ModifyHighlights(target, lastHoverItem, target.ToWorldPosition(pt), isFinger, directlyOver: false, leaving: true, forceFullRange: false, target == target.SeriesViewer.ClosestSeries, isLeavingPlot: false);
				target.SeriesViewer.OnSeriesMouseLeave(target, lastHoverItem, data);
			}
		}

		public void OnLeftButtonDown(Series target, Point pt, object source, object data)
		{
			Pressed = true;
			if (target.SeriesViewer != null)
			{
				target.SeriesViewer.OnSeriesMouseLeftButtonDown(target, target.Item(source, pt), data);
			}
		}

		public void OnMouseLeftButtonUp(Series target, Point pt, object source, object data)
		{
			Pressed = false;
			if (target.SeriesViewer != null)
			{
				target.SeriesViewer.OnSeriesMouseLeftButtonUp(target, target.Item(source, pt), data);
			}
		}

		public void OnLostMouseCapture(Series target, Point pt, object source, object data)
		{
			if (!target.View.MouseButtonUserReleased)
			{
				if (Pressed)
				{
					OnMouseLeftButtonUp(target, pt, source, data);
				}
				if (MouseIsOver)
				{
					OnMouseLeave(target, pt, source, data, isFinger: false);
				}
			}
		}

		public void OnRightButtonDown(Series target, Point pt, object source, object data)
		{
			if (target.SeriesViewer != null)
			{
				target.SeriesViewer.OnSeriesMouseRightButtonDown(target, target.Item(source, pt), data);
			}
		}

		public void OnRightButtonUp(Series target, Point pt, object source, object data)
		{
			if (target.SeriesViewer != null)
			{
				target.SeriesViewer.OnSeriesMouseRightButtonUp(target, target.Item(source, pt), data);
			}
		}

		public void ShowToolTip(Series target, Point pt, Action<object> add)
		{
			target.View.ChartToolTipManager.ShowTooltip(pt, add);
		}

		private bool ShouldUpdateTooltip(Series target)
		{
			bool flag = false;
			if (target.SeriesViewer != null)
			{
				flag = target.SeriesViewer.IsDefaultTooltipDisabled;
			}
			if (flag)
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (target.SeriesViewer == null)
			{
				return true;
			}
			if (!target.SeriesViewer.View.Scaling)
			{
				return !target.SeriesViewer.View.Translating;
			}
			return false;
		}

		public void UpdateToolTip(Series target, Point pt, object item, object data)
		{
			if (ShouldUpdateTooltip(target))
			{
				target.View.ChartToolTipManager.UpdateToolTip(pt, item, data);
			}
		}

		internal Popup GetToolTipPopup(Series target)
		{
			Series series = target.GetSeriesComponentsForView().Series;
			if (series != null && series.SeriesViewer != null)
			{
				return series.SeriesViewer.ToolTipPopup;
			}
			return null;
		}

		public void HideTooltip(Series target)
		{
			Popup toolTipPopup = GetToolTipPopup(target);
			if (((toolTipPopup != null) ? (toolTipPopup.Child as ContentControl) : null) != null)
			{
				toolTipPopup.IsOpen = false;
			}
		}

		public void UpdateToolTipValue(Series target, object toolTip)
		{
			target.View.ToolTipFormatter = ((toolTip is string) ? new StringFormatter
			{
				FormatString = (toolTip as string)
			} : null);
			Popup toolTipPopup = GetToolTipPopup(target);
			ContentControl contentControl = ((toolTipPopup != null) ? (toolTipPopup.Child as ContentControl) : null);
			target.RemoveToolTipFromCurrentParent();
			if (contentControl != null && (toolTipPopup.DataContext as DataContext).Series == target.GetSeriesComponentsForView().Series)
			{
				target.CurrentToolTipParent = contentControl;
				if (toolTip is string)
				{
					contentControl.Content = target.View.ToolTipFormatter.Format(toolTipPopup.DataContext as DataContext, null);
				}
				if (toolTip is UIElement)
				{
					contentControl.Content = toolTip as UIElement;
				}
			}
		}

		public void RemoveToolTipFromCurrentParent(Series target)
		{
		}

		public void EnsureAlternateView(Series target, Rect viewportRect, Rect windowRect, string viewIdentifier, double effectiveScalingRatio)
		{
			if (!_alternateViews.TryGetValue(viewIdentifier, out var value))
			{
				value = target.RequestView();
				value.IsThumbnailView = true;
				value.IsAlternateView = true;
				value.OnInit();
				value.AlternateViewIdentifier = viewIdentifier;
				_alternateViews[viewIdentifier] = value;
			}
			value.ScalingRatioOverride = effectiveScalingRatio;
			value.Viewport = viewportRect;
			value.AlternateWindow = windowRect;
		}

		public void RemoveAlternateView(Series target, string viewIdentifier, SeriesViewer oldViewer)
		{
			if (oldViewer == null)
			{
				_ = target.SeriesViewer;
			}
			if (_alternateViews.TryGetValue(viewIdentifier, out var _))
			{
				_alternateViews.Remove(viewIdentifier);
			}
		}

		public void RemoveAllAlternateViews(Series target, SeriesViewer oldViewer)
		{
			List<string> list = new List<string>();
			foreach (string key in _alternateViews.Keys)
			{
				list.Add(key);
			}
			for (int i = 0; i < list.Count; i++)
			{
				RemoveAlternateView(target, list[i], oldViewer);
			}
		}
	}
	internal class VerticalAnchoredCategorySeriesInteractionManager : IVerticalAnchoredCategorySeriesInteractionManager
	{
		public double GetExactItemIndex(Series target, Point world)
		{
			Rect window = ((target.SeriesViewer != null) ? target.SeriesViewer.ActualWindowRect : Rect.Empty);
			Rect viewport = target.View.Viewport;
			Rect contentViewport = target.GetContentViewport(target.View);
			Rect effectiveViewport = target.GetEffectiveViewport(target.View);
			CategoryAxisBase categoryAxisIfPresent = target.GetCategoryAxisIfPresent();
			double result = -1.0;
			if (categoryAxisIfPresent != null && !window.IsEmpty && !viewport.IsEmpty)
			{
				ScalerParams p = new ScalerParams(window, viewport, categoryAxisIfPresent.IsInverted, effectiveViewport);
				double unscaledValue = categoryAxisIfPresent.GetUnscaledValue(contentViewport.Top, p);
				double unscaledValue2 = categoryAxisIfPresent.GetUnscaledValue(contentViewport.Bottom, p);
				double num = (world.Y - window.Top) / window.Height;
				double num2 = unscaledValue + num * (unscaledValue2 - unscaledValue);
				if (categoryAxisIfPresent.CategoryMode != CategoryMode.Mode0)
				{
					num2 -= 0.5;
				}
				result = num2;
			}
			return result;
		}

		public Rect GetSeriesValueMarkerBoundingBox(Series target, List<Point> markers, Point world, Func<int, Rect> getMarkerBoundingBox)
		{
			if (markers == null || markers.Count == 0)
			{
				return Rect.Empty;
			}
			Point pos = target.FromWorldPosition(world);
			int num = -1;
			bool isInverted = target.GetCategoryAxisIfPresent().IsInverted;
			double maxPosition = target.View.Viewport.Bottom * 2.0;
			num = ((!isInverted) ? markers.BinarySearch((Point item) => (!(pos.Y < item.Y)) ? ((pos.Y > item.Y) ? 1 : 0) : (-1)) : markers.BinarySearch((Point item) => (!(maxPosition - pos.Y < maxPosition - item.Y)) ? ((maxPosition - pos.Y > maxPosition - item.Y) ? 1 : 0) : (-1)));
			if (num < 0)
			{
				num = ~num;
			}
			if (num < 0)
			{
				num = 0;
			}
			if (num > markers.Count - 1)
			{
				num = markers.Count - 1;
			}
			int num2 = num;
			int num3 = num;
			if (num2 > 0)
			{
				num2--;
			}
			if (num3 < markers.Count - 1)
			{
				num3++;
			}
			double y = markers[num2].Y;
			double y2 = markers[num].Y;
			double y3 = markers[num3].Y;
			double num4 = Math.Abs(y - pos.Y);
			double num5 = Math.Abs(y2 - pos.Y);
			double num6 = Math.Abs(y3 - pos.Y);
			Rect result = getMarkerBoundingBox(num2);
			Rect result2 = getMarkerBoundingBox(num);
			Rect result3 = getMarkerBoundingBox(num3);
			bool flag = result.Contains(pos);
			bool flag2 = result2.Contains(pos);
			bool flag3 = result3.Contains(pos);
			if (num5 <= num4 && num5 <= num6)
			{
				if (!isInverted && flag3)
				{
					return result3;
				}
				if (isInverted && flag)
				{
					return result;
				}
				return result2;
			}
			if (num4 <= num5 && num4 <= num6)
			{
				if (!isInverted && flag2)
				{
					return result2;
				}
				return getMarkerBoundingBox(num2);
			}
			if (num6 <= num5 && num6 <= num4)
			{
				if (isInverted && flag2)
				{
					return result2;
				}
				return getMarkerBoundingBox(num3);
			}
			return Rect.Empty;
		}
	}
	internal class SeriesVisualDataManager : ISeriesVisualDataManager
	{
		public void AddSubSeriesVisualData(object svd, object fragmentVisualData)
		{
			StackedSeriesVisualData obj = (StackedSeriesVisualData)svd;
			SeriesVisualData item = (SeriesVisualData)fragmentVisualData;
			obj.FragmentSeries.Add(item);
		}

		public void CopyVisualData(object target, object source)
		{
			SeriesVisualData seriesVisualData = (SeriesVisualData)target;
			SeriesVisualData seriesVisualData2 = (SeriesVisualData)source;
			foreach (PrimitiveVisualData shape in seriesVisualData2.Shapes)
			{
				seriesVisualData.Shapes.Add(shape);
			}
			foreach (MarkerVisualData markerShape in seriesVisualData2.MarkerShapes)
			{
				seriesVisualData.MarkerShapes.Add(markerShape);
			}
			seriesVisualData.Pixels = seriesVisualData2.Pixels;
			seriesVisualData.PixelWidth = seriesVisualData2.PixelWidth;
		}

		public object CreateFragmentVisualData(Series series, Rect viewport, string name1, string name2)
		{
			return new SeriesVisualData
			{
				Viewport = RectData.FromRect(viewport),
				Type = name1,
				Name = name2
			};
		}

		public void ExportMarkerVisualData(MarkerSeries series, object svd)
		{
			SeriesVisualData svd2 = (SeriesVisualData)svd;
			series.MarkerView.DoToAllMarkers(delegate(Marker m)
			{
				object markerVisualData = GetMarkerVisualData(series, m, series.CachedActualMarkerTemplate);
				svd2.MarkerShapes.Add(markerVisualData as MarkerVisualData);
			});
		}

		public object GetMarkerVisualData(Series series, Marker m, DataTemplate markerTemplate)
		{
			MarkerVisualData markerVisualData = new MarkerVisualData();
			PrimitiveAppearanceData primitiveAppearanceData = new PrimitiveAppearanceData();
			if (m.RenderTransform is TranslateTransform translateTransform)
			{
				markerVisualData.X = translateTransform.X + m.DesiredSize.Width / 2.0;
				markerVisualData.Y = translateTransform.Y + m.DesiredSize.Height / 2.0;
				markerVisualData.Bounds = new RectData(translateTransform.X, translateTransform.Y, m.DesiredSize.Width, m.DesiredSize.Height);
			}
			primitiveAppearanceData.Fill = ColorData.FromColor(Color.FromArgb(0, 0, 0, 0));
			primitiveAppearanceData.Stroke = ColorData.FromColor(Color.FromArgb(0, 0, 0, 0));
			markerVisualData.Index = -1;
			markerVisualData.ContentTemplate = m.ContentTemplate;
			if (m.Content != null && m.Content is DataContext && m.Visibility == Visibility.Visible)
			{
				DataContext dataContext = (DataContext)m.Content;
				primitiveAppearanceData.Fill = AppearanceHelper.FromBrush(dataContext.ActualItemBrush);
				primitiveAppearanceData.FillExtended = AppearanceHelper.FromBrushExtended(dataContext.ActualItemBrush);
				primitiveAppearanceData.Stroke = AppearanceHelper.FromBrush(dataContext.ActualItemOutline);
				primitiveAppearanceData.StrokeExtended = AppearanceHelper.FromBrushExtended(dataContext.ActualItemOutline);
				primitiveAppearanceData.StrokeThickness = series.GetActualMarkerThickness();
				if (dataContext.Item != null)
				{
					markerVisualData.Index = series.FastItemsSource.IndexOf(dataContext.Item);
				}
			}
			primitiveAppearanceData.IsVisible = m.Visibility == Visibility.Visible;
			markerVisualData.IsVisible = m.Visibility == Visibility.Visible;
			markerVisualData.MarkerAppearance = primitiveAppearanceData;
			markerVisualData.MarkerType = GetMarkerType(series, markerTemplate);
			return markerVisualData;
		}

		public string GetMarkerType(Series series, DataTemplate markerTemplate)
		{
			if (markerTemplate == series.SeriesViewer.CircleMarkerTemplate)
			{
				return "Circle";
			}
			if (markerTemplate == series.SeriesViewer.DiamondMarkerTemplate)
			{
				return "Diamond";
			}
			if (markerTemplate == series.SeriesViewer.HexagonMarkerTemplate)
			{
				return "Hexagon";
			}
			if (markerTemplate == series.SeriesViewer.HexagramMarkerTemplate)
			{
				return "Hexagram";
			}
			if (markerTemplate == series.SeriesViewer.PentagonMarkerTemplate)
			{
				return "Pentagon";
			}
			if (markerTemplate == series.SeriesViewer.PentagramMarkerTemplate)
			{
				return "Pentagram";
			}
			if (markerTemplate == series.SeriesViewer.PyramidMarkerTemplate)
			{
				return "Pyramid";
			}
			if (markerTemplate == series.SeriesViewer.SquareMarkerTemplate)
			{
				return "Square";
			}
			if (markerTemplate == series.SeriesViewer.TetragramMarkerTemplate)
			{
				return "Tetragram";
			}
			if (markerTemplate == series.SeriesViewer.TriangleMarkerTemplate)
			{
				return "Triangle";
			}
			return "None";
		}

				primitiveAppearanceData.Fill = AppearanceHelper.FromBrush(dataContext.ActualItemBrush);
				primitiveAppearanceData.Stroke = AppearanceHelper.FromBrush(dataContext.ActualItemOutline);
			}
			markerVisualData.IsVisible = m.Visibility == Visibility.Visible;
			markerVisualData.MarkerAppearance = primitiveAppearanceData;
			if (m.ContentTemplate == series.SeriesViewer.CircleMarkerTemplate)
			{
				markerVisualData.MarkerType = "Circle";
			}
			else if (m.ContentTemplate == series.SeriesViewer.DiamondMarkerTemplate)
			{
				markerVisualData.MarkerType = "Diamond";
			}
			else if (m.ContentTemplate == series.SeriesViewer.HexagonMarkerTemplate)
			{
				markerVisualData.MarkerType = "Hexagon";
			}
			else if (m.ContentTemplate == series.SeriesViewer.HexagramMarkerTemplate)
			{
				markerVisualData.MarkerType = "Hexagram";
			}
			else if (m.ContentTemplate == series.SeriesViewer.PentagonMarkerTemplate)
			{
				markerVisualData.MarkerType = "Pentagon";
			}
			else if (m.ContentTemplate == series.SeriesViewer.PentagramMarkerTemplate)
			{
				markerVisualData.MarkerType = "Pentagram";
			}
			else if (m.ContentTemplate == series.SeriesViewer.PyramidMarkerTemplate)
			{
				markerVisualData.MarkerType = "Pyramid";
			}
			else if (m.ContentTemplate == series.SeriesViewer.SquareMarkerTemplate)

			else if (m.ContentTemplate == series.SeriesViewer.TetragramMarkerTemplate)

		public object ExportVisualData(Series series, Rect viewport)
		{
			return new SeriesVisualData
			{
				Viewport = RectData.FromRect(viewport),
				Type = SanitizeTypeName(series.GetType().Name),
				Name = series.Name,
				Opacity = series.Opacity
			};
		}

		public void ExportSeriesPixelsData(object svd, int[] pixels, int imageWidth, int imageHeight)
		{
			SeriesVisualData obj = (SeriesVisualData)svd;
			obj.Pixels = pixels;
			obj.PixelWidth = imageWidth;
			obj.PixelHeight = imageHeight;
		}

		private string SanitizeTypeName(string name)
		{
			return name;
		}

		public void AddPointerTooltipData(object svd, object vd, double offsetX, double offsetY, List<string> categoryNames)
		{
			if (vd != null)
			{
				SeriesVisualData obj = (SeriesVisualData)svd;
				PointerTooltipVisualData pointerTooltipVisualData = (PointerTooltipVisualData)vd;
				pointerTooltipVisualData.OffsetX = offsetX;
				pointerTooltipVisualData.OffsetY = offsetY;
				pointerTooltipVisualData.CategoryNames = categoryNames;
				obj.PointerTooltips.Add(pointerTooltipVisualData);
			}
		}

		public object ExportPointerTooltipData(Polygon pointerShape, Polyline pointerOutlineShape, Rectangle lastRectangle, Rect viewport)
		{
			return new PointerTooltipVisualData
			{
				PointerFillShape = new PolygonVisualData("fillShape", pointerShape),
				PointerOutlineShape = new PolyLineVisualData("outlineShape", pointerOutlineShape),
				BoxShape = new RectangleVisualData("boxShape", lastRectangle),
				Viewport = RectData.FromRect(viewport)
			};
		}

		public void ExportCalloutData(double left, double top, double marginLeft, double marginTop, object svd, Rectangle calloutBackgrond, TextBlock calloutText, FontInfo font, Line calloutLeaderLine, string name, string[] tags)
		{
			CalloutVisualData calloutVisualData = new CalloutVisualData();
			calloutVisualData.Left = left;
			calloutVisualData.Top = top;
			calloutVisualData.MarginLeft = marginLeft;
			calloutVisualData.MarginTop = marginTop;
			calloutVisualData.Background = new RectangleVisualData("calloutBackground", calloutBackgrond);
			calloutVisualData.Text = AppearanceHelper.FromTextElement(calloutText, font);
			calloutVisualData.Line = new LineVisualData("calloutLeaderLine", calloutLeaderLine);
			((SeriesVisualData)svd).CalloutShapes.Add(calloutVisualData);
		}
	}
	internal class AxisVisualDataManager : IAxisVisualDataManager
	{
		private string SanitizeTypeName(string name)
		{
			return name;
		}

		private Rect ExportTitleBounds(Axis axis, TextBlock textBlock)
		{
			List<Point> corners = new Rect(0.0, 0.0, textBlock.ActualWidth, textBlock.ActualHeight).GetCorners();
			double num = double.MaxValue;
			double num2 = double.MaxValue;
			double num3 = double.MinValue;
			double num4 = double.MinValue;
			foreach (Point item in corners)
			{
				Point point = textBlock.TransformToVisual(axis.LabelPanel).Transform(item);
				num = Math.Min(num, point.Y);
				num2 = Math.Min(num2, point.X);
				num3 = Math.Max(num3, point.X);
				num4 = Math.Max(num4, point.Y);
			}
			return new Rect(num2, num, num3 - num2, num4 - num);
		}

		private ChartTitleVisualData ExportTitleVisualData(Axis axis, SeriesViewer model, string axisType, TextBlock titlePresenter)
		{
			ChartTitleVisualData chartTitleVisualData = new ChartTitleVisualData();
			AxisView view = axis.View;
			Rect rect = view.ExportLabelsPanelViewport();
			chartTitleVisualData.Viewport = RectData.FromRect(rect);
			Rect rect2 = ExportTitleBounds(axis, titlePresenter);
			chartTitleVisualData.TextPlotArea = RectData.FromRect(rect2);
			bool visibility = titlePresenter.Visibility == Visibility.Visible && titlePresenter.Parent != null;
			FontInfo font = null;
			Thickness thickness = view.ExportTitleMargin(titlePresenter);
			FontInfo fontInfoForText = GetFontInfoForText(axis, titlePresenter, font);
			LabelAppearanceData labelAppearanceData = AppearanceHelper.FromTextElement(titlePresenter, fontInfoForText);
			labelAppearanceData.MarginLeft = thickness.Left;
			labelAppearanceData.MarginRight = thickness.Right;
			labelAppearanceData.MarginTop = thickness.Top;
			labelAppearanceData.MarginBottom = thickness.Bottom;
			labelAppearanceData.FontStretch = titlePresenter.FontStretch.ToString();
			labelAppearanceData.TextWrapping = titlePresenter.TextWrapping.ToString();
			labelAppearanceData.Visibility = visibility;
			if (axis.TitleSettings != null)
			{
				labelAppearanceData.HorizontalAlignment = axis.TitleSettings.HorizontalAlignment.ToString();
				labelAppearanceData.VerticalAlignment = axis.TitleSettings.VerticalAlignment.ToString();
				labelAppearanceData.TextPosition = axis.TitleSettings.Position.ToString();
			}
			else
			{
				labelAppearanceData.HorizontalAlignment = HorizontalAlignment.Center.ToString();
				labelAppearanceData.VerticalAlignment = VerticalAlignment.Center.ToString();
				labelAppearanceData.TextPosition = AxisTitlePosition.Auto.ToString();
			}
			chartTitleVisualData.Appearance = labelAppearanceData;
			return chartTitleVisualData;
		}

		public object ExportVisualData(Axis axis)
		{
			AxisVisualData axisVisualData = new AxisVisualData();
			axisVisualData.Viewport = RectData.FromRect(axis.ViewportRect);
			axisVisualData.LabelsViewport = RectData.FromRect(axis.View.ExportLabelsPanelViewport());
			axisVisualData.Type = SanitizeTypeName(axis.GetType().Name);
			axisVisualData.Name = axis.Name;
			PathVisualData axisLine = new PathVisualData("axisLine", axis.View.AxisLines);
			axisVisualData.AxisLine = axisLine;
			axisVisualData.TickMarks = new PathVisualData("tickMarks", axis.LabelPanel.View.Ticks);
			if (!axis.LabelPanel.Children.Contains(axis.LabelPanel.View.Ticks))
			{
				((PathVisualData)axisVisualData.TickMarks).Data.Clear();
			}
			axisVisualData.MinorLines = new PathVisualData("minorLines", axis.View.MinorLines);
			axisVisualData.MajorLines = new PathVisualData("majorLines", axis.View.MajorLines);
			axisVisualData.Strips = new PathVisualData("strips", axis.View.Strips);
			if (axis.Title != null)
			{
				ChartTitleVisualData title = ExportTitleVisualData(axis, axis.SeriesViewer, axisVisualData.Type, axis.TitleTextBlock);
				axisVisualData.Title = title;
			}
			else
			{
				axisVisualData.Title = null;
			}
			FontInfo font = null;
			GeometryCollection children = ((GeometryGroup)axis.LabelPanel.View.Ticks.Data).Children;
			if (1 < children.Count)
			{
				for (int i = 1; i < children.Count; i++)
				{
					LineGeometry lineGeometry = (LineGeometry)children[i];
					LineGeometry lineGeometry2 = (LineGeometry)children[i - 1];
					double num = lineGeometry.StartPoint.X - lineGeometry.EndPoint.X;
					double num2 = lineGeometry.StartPoint.Y - lineGeometry.EndPoint.Y;
					double num3 = lineGeometry2.StartPoint.X - lineGeometry2.EndPoint.X;
					double num4 = lineGeometry2.StartPoint.Y - lineGeometry2.EndPoint.Y;
					if (num != num3 || num2 != num4)
					{
						throw new Exception("Not all tick marks have the same length!");
					}
					if (1 == i)
					{
						axisVisualData.TickMarksLength = Math.Sqrt(Math.Pow(num, 2.0) + Math.Pow(num2, 2.0));
					}
				}
			}
			List<LabelPosition> labelPositions = axis.LabelPanel.LabelPositions;
			IEnumerable<object> labels = axis.LabelPanel.View.GetLabels();
			if (labelPositions.Count > 0)
			{
				for (int j = 0; j < labelPositions.Count; j++)
				{
					LabelPosition labelPosition = axis.LabelPanel.LabelPositions[j];
					object labelValue = axis.LabelPanel.LabelDataContext[j];
					AxisLabelVisualData axisLabelVisualData = new AxisLabelVisualData
					{
						LabelPosition = labelPosition.Value,
						LabelValue = labelValue,
						PanelPosition = PointData.FromPoint(axis.View.ExportLabelsPanelPosition())
					};
					List<TextBlock> list = new List<TextBlock>();
					foreach (object item in labels)
					{
						list.Add((TextBlock)item);
					}
					if (j < list.Count)
					{
						FontInfo fontInfoForText = GetFontInfoForText(axis, list[j], font);
						axisLabelVisualData.Appearance = AppearanceHelper.FromTextElement(list[j], fontInfoForText);
						axisLabelVisualData.Position = PointData.FromPoint(axis.View.ExportLabelPosition(list[j]));
						axisLabelVisualData.Size = SizeData.FromSize(new Size(list[j].ActualWidth, list[j].ActualHeight));
					}
					axisVisualData.Labels.Add(axisLabelVisualData);
				}
			}
			List<RectangleVisualData> list2 = null;
			if (axis.AnnotationBackings.Active.Count > 0)
			{
				for (int k = 0; k < axis.AnnotationBackings.Active.Count; k++)
				{
					if (list2 == null)
					{
						list2 = new List<RectangleVisualData>();
					}
					RectangleVisualData rectangleVisualData = new RectangleVisualData("annotationBacking_" + k, axis.AnnotationBackings[k]);
					Point point = axis.AnnotationBackings[k].TransformToVisual(axis.LabelPanel).Transform(new Point(0.0, 0.0));
					rectangleVisualData.Appearance.CanvasLeft = point.X;
					rectangleVisualData.Appearance.CanvasTop = point.Y;
					rectangleVisualData.Width = axis.AnnotationBackings[k].ActualWidth;
					rectangleVisualData.Height = axis.AnnotationBackings[k].ActualHeight;
					list2.Add(rectangleVisualData);
				}
			}
			axisVisualData.AnnotationBackings = list2;
			return axisVisualData;
		}

		private FontInfo GetFontInfoForText(Axis axis, TextBlock text, FontInfo font)
		{
			return FontUtil.GetFontInfo(text, font);
		}
	}
	internal class DataChartVisualDataManager : IDataChartVisualDataManager
	{
		public object ExportVisualData(XamDataChart xamDataChart)
		{
			ChartVisualData chartVisualData = new ChartVisualData();
			for (int i = 0; i < xamDataChart.Axes.Count; i++)
			{
				AxisVisualData item = xamDataChart.Axes[i].ExportVisualData();
				chartVisualData.Axes.Add(item);
			}
			for (int j = 0; j < xamDataChart.Series.Count; j++)
			{
				SeriesVisualData item2 = xamDataChart.Series[j].ExportVisualData();
				chartVisualData.Series.Add(item2);
			}
			chartVisualData.Name = xamDataChart.Name;
			ExportChartTitleData(xamDataChart, chartVisualData);
			ExportChartViewData(xamDataChart, chartVisualData);
			chartVisualData.DefaultTooltip = xamDataChart.ToolTipPopup;
			return chartVisualData;
		}

		private void ExportChartViewData(XamDataChart xamDataChart, ChartVisualData cvd)
		{
			cvd.Width = xamDataChart.ActualWidth;
			cvd.Height = xamDataChart.ActualHeight;
			cvd.ContentArea = RectData.FromRect(xamDataChart.View.GetContentArea());
			cvd.CentralArea = new RectData(0.0, 0.0, xamDataChart.CentralArea.ActualWidth, xamDataChart.CentralArea.ActualHeight);
			cvd.PlotArea = RectData.FromRect(xamDataChart.ViewportRect);
		}

		public Rect ExportTitleBounds(TextBlock textBlock, SeriesViewer model)
		{
			List<Point> corners = new Rect(0.0, 0.0, textBlock.ActualWidth, textBlock.ActualHeight).GetCorners();
			double num = double.MaxValue;
			double num2 = double.MaxValue;
			double num3 = double.MinValue;
			double num4 = double.MinValue;
			foreach (Point item in corners)
			{
				Point point = textBlock.TransformToVisual(model).Transform(item);
				num = Math.Min(num, point.Y);
				num2 = Math.Min(num2, point.X);
				num3 = Math.Max(num3, point.X);
				num4 = Math.Max(num4, point.Y);
			}
			return new Rect(num2, num, num3 - num2, num4 - num);
		}

		private void ExportChartTitleData(XamDataChart xamDataChart, ChartVisualData visualData)
		{
			double num = 0.0;
			if (xamDataChart.Title != null)
			{
				ChartTitleVisualData chartTitleVisualData = ExportTitleVisualData(xamDataChart, xamDataChart.TitlePresenter);
				num = chartTitleVisualData.Viewport.Height;
				visualData.Title = chartTitleVisualData;
			}
			if (xamDataChart.Subtitle != null)
			{
				ChartTitleVisualData chartTitleVisualData2 = ExportTitleVisualData(xamDataChart, xamDataChart.SubtitlePresenter);
				RectData viewport = chartTitleVisualData2.Viewport;
				double left = viewport.Left;
				double top = viewport.Top + num;
				chartTitleVisualData2.Viewport = new RectData(left, top, viewport.Width, viewport.Height);
				visualData.Subtitle = chartTitleVisualData2;
			}
		}

		internal ChartTitleVisualData ExportTitleVisualData(SeriesViewer model, ContentControl titlePresenter)
		{
			bool visibility = titlePresenter.Visibility == Visibility.Visible && titlePresenter.Parent != null;
			double num = titlePresenter.Margin.Bottom + titlePresenter.Margin.Top;
			ChartTitleVisualData chartTitleVisualData = new ChartTitleVisualData();
			Rect contentArea = model.View.GetContentArea();
			chartTitleVisualData.Viewport = new RectData(contentArea.Left, contentArea.Top, contentArea.Width, titlePresenter.ActualHeight + num);
			LabelAppearanceData labelAppearanceData = new LabelAppearanceData();
			if (titlePresenter.Content is string)
			{
				labelAppearanceData = VisualDataExporter.ExportLabelAppearance(titlePresenter);
				labelAppearanceData.Text = titlePresenter.Content as string;
				labelAppearanceData.Visibility = visibility;
				List<TextBlock> list = titlePresenter.VisualDescendantsOfType<TextBlock>().ToList();
				if (list.Count > 0)
				{
					TextBlock textBlock = list[0];
					chartTitleVisualData.TextPlotArea = RectData.FromRect(ExportTitleBounds(textBlock, model));
				}
			}
			chartTitleVisualData.Appearance = labelAppearanceData;
			return chartTitleVisualData;
		}
	}
	[DontObfuscate]
	internal class VisualDataFactoryManager
	{
		private static bool _isRegistered;

		public static void Register()
		{
			if (!_isRegistered)
			{
				DVContainer.Instance.RegisterFactory(typeof(IDataChartVisualDataManager), () => new DataChartVisualDataManager());
				DVContainer.Instance.RegisterFactory(typeof(IAxisVisualDataManager), () => new AxisVisualDataManager());
				DVContainer.Instance.RegisterFactory(typeof(ISeriesVisualDataManager), () => new SeriesVisualDataManager());
				_isRegistered = true;
			}
		}
	}

		public event CalloutStyleUpdatingEventHandler CalloutStyleUpdating
		{
			add
			{
				CalloutStyleUpdatingEventHandler calloutStyleUpdating = _calloutStyleUpdating;
				_calloutStyleUpdating = (CalloutStyleUpdatingEventHandler)Delegate.Combine(_calloutStyleUpdating, value);
				if (_calloutStyleUpdating != null && calloutStyleUpdating == null)
				{
					Implementation.CalloutStyleUpdating += OnCalloutStyleUpdating;
				}
			}
			remove
			{
				CalloutStyleUpdatingEventHandler calloutStyleUpdating = _calloutStyleUpdating;
				_calloutStyleUpdating = (CalloutStyleUpdatingEventHandler)Delegate.Remove(_calloutStyleUpdating, value);
				if (_calloutStyleUpdating == null && calloutStyleUpdating != null)
				{
					Implementation.CalloutStyleUpdating -= OnCalloutStyleUpdating;
				}
			}
		}

		public event PropertyChangedEventHandler PropertyChanged
		{
			add
			{
				_propertyChanged = (PropertyChangedEventHandler)Delegate.Combine(_propertyChanged, value);
			}
			remove
			{
				_propertyChanged = (PropertyChangedEventHandler)Delegate.Remove(_propertyChanged, value);
			}
		}

		public event ChartSeriesEventHandler SeriesAdded
		{
			add
			{
				ChartSeriesEventHandler seriesAdded = _seriesAdded;
				_seriesAdded = (ChartSeriesEventHandler)Delegate.Combine(_seriesAdded, value);
				if (_seriesAdded != null && seriesAdded == null)
				{
					Implementation.SeriesAdded += OnSeriesAdded;
				}
			}
			remove
			{
				ChartSeriesEventHandler seriesAdded = _seriesAdded;
				_seriesAdded = (ChartSeriesEventHandler)Delegate.Remove(_seriesAdded, value);
				if (_seriesAdded == null && seriesAdded != null)
				{
					Implementation.SeriesAdded -= OnSeriesAdded;
				}
			}
		}

		public event DomainChartSeriesPointerEventHandler SeriesPointerDown
		{
			add
			{
				DomainChartSeriesPointerEventHandler seriesPointerDown = _seriesPointerDown;
				_seriesPointerDown = (DomainChartSeriesPointerEventHandler)Delegate.Combine(_seriesPointerDown, value);
				if (_seriesPointerDown != null && seriesPointerDown == null)
				{
					Implementation.SeriesPointerDown += OnSeriesPointerDown;

			}

				if (_seriesPointerDown == null && seriesPointerDown != null)
				{
					Implementation.SeriesPointerDown -= OnSeriesPointerDown;
				}
			}
		}

		internal XamDomainChart(DomainChart impl)
		{
			_implementation = impl;
			_implementation.ExternalObject = this;
			INotifyPropertyChanged implementation = _implementation;
			if (implementation != null)
			{
				implementation.PropertyChanged += OnImplementation_PropertyChangedImpl;
			}
		}

		private void OnImplementation_PropertyChangedImpl(object sender, PropertyChangedEventArgs e)
		{
			if (!(e.PropertyName == _innerPropertyBeingSet))
			{
				OnImplementation_PropertyChanged(e.PropertyName);
			}
		}

		internal static void SetInnerProperty<T>(T d, object newValue, Action<T, object> setter, string propertyName) where T : XamDomainChart
		{
			string innerPropertyBeingSet = d._innerPropertyBeingSet;
			d._innerPropertyBeingSet = propertyName;
			try
			{
				setter(d, newValue);
			}
			finally
			{
				d._innerPropertyBeingSet = innerPropertyBeingSet;
			}
		}

		internal override void OnImplementation_PropertyChanged(string propertyName)
		{
			if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(propertyName))
			{
				SetCurrentValue(MarkerCollisionProperty, Implementation.MarkerCollision);
				SetCurrentValue(XAxisAbbreviateLargeNumbersProperty, Implementation.XAxisAbbreviateLargeNumbers);
				SetValue(XAxisActualMaximumPropertyKey, Implementation.XAxisActualMaximum);
				SetValue(XAxisActualMinimumPropertyKey, Implementation.XAxisActualMinimum);
				SetCurrentValue(XAxisIntervalProperty, Implementation.XAxisInterval);
				SetCurrentValue(XAxisIsLogarithmicProperty, Implementation.XAxisIsLogarithmic);
				SetCurrentValue(XAxisLogarithmBaseProperty, Implementation.XAxisLogarithmBase);
				SetCurrentValue(XAxisMaximumValueProperty, Implementation.XAxisMaximumValue);
				SetCurrentValue(XAxisMinimumValueProperty, Implementation.XAxisMinimumValue);
				SetCurrentValue(XAxisMinorIntervalProperty, Implementation.XAxisMinorInterval);
				SetCurrentValue(YAxisAbbreviateLargeNumbersProperty, Implementation.YAxisAbbreviateLargeNumbers);
				SetValue(YAxisActualMaximumPropertyKey, Implementation.YAxisActualMaximum);
				SetValue(YAxisActualMinimumPropertyKey, Implementation.YAxisActualMinimum);
				SetCurrentValue(YAxisIntervalProperty, Implementation.YAxisInterval);
				SetCurrentValue(YAxisIsLogarithmicProperty, Implementation.YAxisIsLogarithmic);
				SetCurrentValue(YAxisLogarithmBaseProperty, Implementation.YAxisLogarithmBase);
				SetCurrentValue(YAxisMaximumValueProperty, Implementation.YAxisMaximumValue);
				SetCurrentValue(YAxisMinimumValueProperty, Implementation.YAxisMinimumValue);
				SetCurrentValue(YAxisMinorIntervalProperty, Implementation.YAxisMinorInterval);
			}
			else
			{
				switch (propertyName)
				{
				case "MarkerCollision":
					SetCurrentValue(MarkerCollisionProperty, Implementation.MarkerCollision);
					break;
				case "XAxisAbbreviateLargeNumbers":
					SetCurrentValue(XAxisAbbreviateLargeNumbersProperty, Implementation.XAxisAbbreviateLargeNumbers);
					break;
				case "XAxisActualMaximum":
					SetValue(XAxisActualMaximumPropertyKey, Implementation.XAxisActualMaximum);
					break;
				case "XAxisActualMinimum":
					SetValue(XAxisActualMinimumPropertyKey, Implementation.XAxisActualMinimum);
					break;
				case "XAxisInterval":
					SetCurrentValue(XAxisIntervalProperty, Implementation.XAxisInterval);
					break;
				case "XAxisIsLogarithmic":
					SetCurrentValue(XAxisIsLogarithmicProperty, Implementation.XAxisIsLogarithmic);
					break;
				case "XAxisLogarithmBase":
					SetCurrentValue(XAxisLogarithmBaseProperty, Implementation.XAxisLogarithmBase);
					break;
				case "XAxisMaximumValue":
					SetCurrentValue(XAxisMaximumValueProperty, Implementation.XAxisMaximumValue);
					break;
				case "XAxisMinimumValue":
					SetCurrentValue(XAxisMinimumValueProperty, Implementation.XAxisMinimumValue);
					break;
				case "XAxisMinorInterval":
					SetCurrentValue(XAxisMinorIntervalProperty, Implementation.XAxisMinorInterval);
					break;
				case "YAxisAbbreviateLargeNumbers":
					SetCurrentValue(YAxisAbbreviateLargeNumbersProperty, Implementation.YAxisAbbreviateLargeNumbers);
					break;
				case "YAxisActualMaximum":
					SetValue(YAxisActualMaximumPropertyKey, Implementation.YAxisActualMaximum);
					break;
				case "YAxisActualMinimum":
					SetValue(YAxisActualMinimumPropertyKey, Implementation.YAxisActualMinimum);
					break;
				case "YAxisInterval":
					SetCurrentValue(YAxisIntervalProperty, Implementation.YAxisInterval);
					break;
				case "YAxisIsLogarithmic":
					SetCurrentValue(YAxisIsLogarithmicProperty, Implementation.YAxisIsLogarithmic);
					break;
				case "YAxisLogarithmBase":
					SetCurrentValue(YAxisLogarithmBaseProperty, Implementation.YAxisLogarithmBase);
					break;
				case "YAxisMaximumValue":
					SetCurrentValue(YAxisMaximumValueProperty, Implementation.YAxisMaximumValue);
					break;
				case "YAxisMinimumValue":
					SetCurrentValue(YAxisMinimumValueProperty, Implementation.YAxisMinimumValue);
					break;
				case "YAxisMinorInterval":
					SetCurrentValue(YAxisMinorIntervalProperty, Implementation.YAxisMinorInterval);
					break;
				}
			}
			base.OnImplementation_PropertyChanged(propertyName);
			switch (propertyName)
			{
			case "MarkerCollision":
			case "XAxisAbbreviateLargeNumbers":
			case "XAxisActualMaximum":
			case "XAxisActualMinimum":
			case "XAxisInterval":
			case "XAxisIsLogarithmic":
			case "XAxisLogarithmBase":
			case "XAxisMaximumValue":
			case "XAxisMinimumValue":
			case "XAxisMinorInterval":
			case "YAxisAbbreviateLargeNumbers":
			case "YAxisActualMaximum":
			case "YAxisActualMinimum":
			case "YAxisInterval":
			case "YAxisIsLogarithmic":
			case "YAxisLogarithmBase":
			case "YAxisMaximumValue":
			case "YAxisMinimumValue":
			case "YAxisMinorInterval":
				OnPropertyChanged(propertyName);
				break;
			}
		}

	public class XamScatterChart : XamCartesianChart

		{

				SetValue(ChartTypeProperty, value);
			}
		}

		internal new ScatterChart Implementation => (ScatterChart)_implementation;

		public XamScatterChart()
			: this(new ScatterChart())
		{
		}

		internal XamScatterChart(ScatterChart impl)
			: base(impl)
		{
		}

		internal override void OnImplementation_PropertyChanged(string propertyName)
		{
			if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(propertyName))
			{
				SetCurrentValue(ChartTypeProperty, Implementation.ChartType);
			}
			else if (propertyName == "ChartType")
			{
				SetCurrentValue(ChartTypeProperty, Implementation.ChartType);
			}
			base.OnImplementation_PropertyChanged(propertyName);
			if (propertyName == "ChartType")
			{
				OnPropertyChanged(propertyName);
			}
		}

		static XamScatterChart()
		{
			ChartTypeProperty = DependencyPropertyUtilities.Register("ChartType", typeof(ScatterChartType), typeof(XamScatterChart), ScatterChartType.Auto, delegate(DependencyObject d, DependencyPropertyChangedEventArgs e)
			{
				XamDomainChart.SetInnerProperty((XamScatterChart)d, e.NewValue, delegate(XamScatterChart c, object v)
				{
					c.Implementation.ChartType = (ScatterChartType)v;
				}, "ChartType");
			});
			FrameworkElement.DefaultStyleKeyProperty.OverrideMetadata(typeof(XamScatterChart), new FrameworkPropertyMetadata(typeof(XamScatterChart)));
			ThemeManager.RegisterControl(typeof(XamScatterChart));
		}
	}

namespace Infragistics.Controls.Charts.DataAdapters.Rules
{
	[DontHide]
	[DontObfuscate]
	public class BreakEvenDataRule : PriorityDataRule
	{
		public BreakEvenDataRule()
		{
			base.Priority = 100;
		}

		public override void Evaluate(DataSeriesAdapterRunContext context)
		{
			BreakEvenDataInfo dataInfo = GetDataInfo(context);
			if (dataInfo != null && dataInfo.ScatterType != ScatterType.Unknown)
			{
				AddDataSeries(context, dataInfo);
			}
		}

		private void AddDataSeries(DataSeriesAdapterRunContext context, BreakEvenDataInfo data)
		{
			string title = context.Localize("BreakEvenTitle_ProfitArea", "Profit Area");
			string title2 = context.Localize("BreakEvenTitle_LossArea", "Loss Area");
			string title3 = context.Localize("BreakEvenTitle_SafetyMargin", "Safety Margin");
			string title4 = context.Localize("BreakEvenTitle_SalesRevenue", "Sales Revenue");
			string title5 = context.Localize("BreakEvenTitle_TotalCost", "Total Cost");
			string title6 = context.Localize("BreakEvenTitle_FixedCost", "Fixed Cost");
			string title7 = context.Localize("BreakEvenTitle_VariableCost", "Variable Cost");
			string title8 = context.Localize("BreakEvenTitle_MarginalProfit", "Marginal Profit");
			string title9 = context.Localize("BreakEvenTitle_BreakEven", "Break Even");
			string currentPath = context.GetCurrentPath();
			DataSeries dataSeries = new DataSeries();
			dataSeries.Data = ToPointList(data.PositiveRevenuePoints);
			dataSeries.DataPath = "PositiveRevenuePoints";
			dataSeries.AddMemberPathHint("Points", DataSeriesIntent.SeriesShape);
			dataSeries.SuggestedSeries = DataSeriesType.ScatterPolygon;
			dataSeries.SuggestedPrimaryAxis = DataSeriesAxisType.Linear;
			dataSeries.SuggestedSecondaryAxis = DataSeriesAxisType.Linear;
			dataSeries.SuggestedMarker = DataSeriesMarker.None;
			dataSeries.Title = title;
			context.AddDataSeries(dataSeries, this);
			DataSeries dataSeries2 = new DataSeries();
			dataSeries2.Data = ToPointList(data.NegativeRevenuePoints);
			dataSeries2.DataPath = "NegativeRevenuePoints";
			dataSeries2.AddMemberPathHint("Points", DataSeriesIntent.SeriesShape);
			dataSeries2.SuggestedSeries = DataSeriesType.ScatterPolygon;
			dataSeries2.SuggestedPrimaryAxis = DataSeriesAxisType.Linear;
			dataSeries2.SuggestedSecondaryAxis = DataSeriesAxisType.Linear;
			dataSeries2.SuggestedMarker = DataSeriesMarker.None;
			dataSeries2.Title = title2;
			context.AddDataSeries(dataSeries2, this);
			DataSeries dataSeries3 = new DataSeries();
			dataSeries3.Data = ToPointList(data.ProfitPoints);
			dataSeries3.DataPath = "ProfitPoints";
			dataSeries3.AddMemberPathHint("Points", DataSeriesIntent.SeriesShape);

			dataSeries3.SuggestedSecondaryAxis = DataSeriesAxisType.Linear;
			dataSeries3.SuggestedMarker = DataSeriesMarker.None;
			dataSeries3.Title = title3;

			dataSeries4.DataPath = "SalesRevenue";
			dataSeries4.AddMemberPathHint("SalesRevenue", DataSeriesIntent.SeriesY);

			dataSeries4.SuggestedSecondaryAxis = DataSeriesAxisType.Linear;

			dataSeries4.Title = title4;
			context.AddDataSeries(dataSeries4, this);
			MarkUsedSourcePath(dataSeries4, context, data.BindingRevenue, currentPath);
			DataSeries dataSeries5 = new DataSeries();

			dataSeries5.DataPath = "TotalCost";

			dataSeries5.SuggestedSecondaryAxis = DataSeriesAxisType.Linear;

			dataSeries6.Data = data.ActualItems;
			dataSeries6.DataPath = "FixedCost";
			dataSeries6.AddMemberPathHint("FixedCost", DataSeriesIntent.SeriesY);

		private List<BreakEvenPoints> ToPointList(List<List<Point>> points)
		{
			return new List<BreakEvenPoints>
			{
				new BreakEvenPoints
				{
					Points = points
				}
			};
		}

		private void MarkUsedSourcePath(DataSeries dataSeries, DataSeriesAdapterRunContext context, DataSeriesMemberPathHint hint, string originalPath)
		{
			DataSeriesMemberPathHint dataSeriesMemberPathHint = new DataSeriesMemberPathHint();
			dataSeriesMemberPathHint.Intent = DataSeriesIntent.GenerationInput;
			dataSeriesMemberPathHint.Path = originalPath + "." + hint.Path;
			dataSeries.AddMemberPathHint(dataSeriesMemberPathHint);
		}

		internal BreakEvenDataInfo GetDataInfo(DataSeriesAdapterRunContext context)
		{
			BreakEvenDataInfo breakEvenDataInfo = new BreakEvenDataInfo(context);
			if (breakEvenDataInfo.ItemsTotal == 0)
			{
				return null;
			}
			for (int i = 0; i < breakEvenDataInfo.ItemsTotal; i++)
			{
				if (i == 0)
				{
					List<string> propNames = ToList(breakEvenDataInfo.Analyzer.GetAllStringProperties());
					List<string> propNames2 = ToList(breakEvenDataInfo.Analyzer.GetAllNumericProperties());
					breakEvenDataInfo.UpdateNumericProps(propNames2);
					breakEvenDataInfo.UpdateStringProps(propNames);
					if (!breakEvenDataInfo.BindingUnits.HasPath() || !breakEvenDataInfo.BindingRevenue.HasPath() || !breakEvenDataInfo.BindingFixedCost.HasPath() || !breakEvenDataInfo.BindingVariableCost.HasPath())
					{
						return null;
					}
				}
				object itemAtIndex = breakEvenDataInfo.Provider.GetItemAtIndex(i);
				BreakEvenItem breakEvenItem = new BreakEvenItem();
				breakEvenItem.FixedCost = double.Parse(breakEvenDataInfo.Provider.GetItemValue(itemAtIndex, breakEvenDataInfo.BindingFixedCost.Path).ToString());
				breakEvenItem.VariableCost = double.Parse(breakEvenDataInfo.Provider.GetItemValue(itemAtIndex, breakEvenDataInfo.BindingVariableCost.Path).ToString());
				breakEvenItem.Units = double.Parse(breakEvenDataInfo.Provider.GetItemValue(itemAtIndex, breakEvenDataInfo.BindingUnits.Path).ToString());
				breakEvenItem.SalesRevenue = double.Parse(breakEvenDataInfo.Provider.GetItemValue(itemAtIndex, breakEvenDataInfo.BindingRevenue.Path).ToString());
				double num = double.NaN;
				if (breakEvenDataInfo.BindingMarginalProfit.HasPath())
				{
					num = double.Parse(breakEvenDataInfo.Provider.GetItemValue(itemAtIndex, breakEvenDataInfo.BindingMarginalProfit.Path).ToString());
				}
				if (double.IsNaN(num) || double.IsInfinity(num))
				{
					breakEvenItem.MarginalProfit = breakEvenItem.SalesRevenue - breakEvenItem.VariableCost;
				}
				else
				{
					breakEvenItem.MarginalProfit = num;
				}
				breakEvenDataInfo.OrginalItems.Add(breakEvenItem);
			}
			breakEvenDataInfo.GeneratePoints();
			breakEvenDataInfo.ScatterType = ScatterType.BreakEven;
			return breakEvenDataInfo;
		}
	}
