	}
	[DontObfuscate]
	[EditorBrowsable(EditorBrowsableState.Never)]
	public class BreakEvenItem
	{
		[ClientName("FixedCost")]
		public double FixedCost { get; set; }

		[ClientName("VariableCost")]
		public double VariableCost { get; set; }

		[ClientName("SalesRevenue")]
		public double SalesRevenue { get; set; }

		[ClientName("MarginalProfit")]
		public double MarginalProfit { get; set; }

		[ClientName("Units")]
		public double Units { get; set; }

		[ClientName("Ratio")]
		public double Ratio { get; set; }

		[ClientName("ActualProfit")]
		public double ActualProfit => SalesRevenue - VariableCost - FixedCost;

		[ClientName("TotalCost")]
		public double TotalCost => FixedCost + VariableCost;
	}
	internal class BreakEvenDataInfo : ScatterDataInfo
	{
		public List<BreakEvenItem> ActualItems { get; set; }

		public List<BreakEvenItem> BreakEvenLines { get; set; }

		public List<BreakEvenItem> OrginalItems { get; set; }

		public BreakEvenItem Min { get; set; }

		public BreakEvenItem Max { get; set; }

		public List<List<Point>> ProfitPoints { get; set; }

		public List<List<Point>> NegativeRevenuePoints { get; set; }

		public List<List<Point>> PositiveRevenuePoints { get; set; }

		public DataSeriesMemberPathHint BindingFixedCost { get; set; }

		public DataSeriesMemberPathHint BindingVariableCost { get; set; }

		public DataSeriesMemberPathHint BindingTotalCost { get; set; }

		public DataSeriesMemberPathHint BindingRevenue { get; set; }

		public DataSeriesMemberPathHint BindingMarginalProfit { get; set; }

		public DataSeriesMemberPathHint BindingUnits { get; set; }

		public BreakEvenDataInfo(DataSeriesAdapterRunContext context)
			: base(context)
		{
			ActualItems = new List<BreakEvenItem>();
			OrginalItems = new List<BreakEvenItem>();
			BreakEvenLines = new List<BreakEvenItem>();
			BindingUnits = new DataSeriesMemberPathHint
			{
				Intent = DataSeriesIntent.SalesUnit
			};
			BindingFixedCost = new DataSeriesMemberPathHint
			{
				Intent = DataSeriesIntent.SalesFixedCost
			};
			BindingVariableCost = new DataSeriesMemberPathHint
			{
				Intent = DataSeriesIntent.SalesVariableCost
			};
			BindingTotalCost = new DataSeriesMemberPathHint
			{
				Intent = DataSeriesIntent.SalesTotalCost
			};
			BindingRevenue = new DataSeriesMemberPathHint
			{
				Intent = DataSeriesIntent.SalesRevenue
			};
			BindingMarginalProfit = new DataSeriesMemberPathHint
			{
				Intent = DataSeriesIntent.SalesMarginalProfit
			};
		}

		public void GeneratePoints()
		{
			BreakEvenLines.Clear();
			ActualItems.Clear();
			ActualItems.AddRange(OrginalItems);
			if (ActualItems.Count == 1)
			{
				BreakEvenItem breakEvenItem = new BreakEvenItem();
				breakEvenItem.FixedCost = OrginalItems[0].FixedCost;
				breakEvenItem.VariableCost = 0.0;
				breakEvenItem.MarginalProfit = 0.0;
				breakEvenItem.SalesRevenue = 0.0;
				breakEvenItem.Units = 0.0;
				ActualItems.Add(breakEvenItem);
			}
			Min = new BreakEvenItem
			{
				MarginalProfit = double.MaxValue,
				VariableCost = double.MaxValue,
				FixedCost = double.MaxValue,
				SalesRevenue = double.MaxValue,
				Units = double.MaxValue
			};
			Max = new BreakEvenItem
			{
				MarginalProfit = double.MinValue,
				VariableCost = double.MinValue,
				FixedCost = double.MinValue,
				SalesRevenue = double.MinValue,
				Units = double.MinValue
			};
			foreach (BreakEvenItem actualItem in ActualItems)
			{
				Min.VariableCost = Math.Min(Min.VariableCost, actualItem.VariableCost);
				Max.VariableCost = Math.Max(Max.VariableCost, actualItem.VariableCost);
				Min.FixedCost = Math.Min(Min.FixedCost, actualItem.FixedCost);
				Max.FixedCost = Math.Max(Max.FixedCost, actualItem.FixedCost);
				Min.Units = Math.Min(Min.Units, actualItem.Units);
				Max.Units = Math.Max(Max.Units, actualItem.Units);
				Min.MarginalProfit = Math.Min(Min.MarginalProfit, actualItem.MarginalProfit);
				Max.MarginalProfit = Math.Max(Max.MarginalProfit, actualItem.MarginalProfit);
				Min.SalesRevenue = Math.Min(Min.SalesRevenue, actualItem.SalesRevenue);
				Max.SalesRevenue = Math.Max(Max.SalesRevenue, actualItem.SalesRevenue);
			}
			LineEquation lineEquation = new LineEquation(Min.Units, Min.MarginalProfit, Max.Units, Max.MarginalProfit);
			LineEquation lineEquation2 = new LineEquation(Min.Units, Min.SalesRevenue, Max.Units, Max.SalesRevenue);
			LineEquation lineEquation3 = new LineEquation(Min.Units, Min.TotalCost, Max.Units, Max.TotalCost);
			LineEquation lineEquation4 = new LineEquation(Min.Units, Min.FixedCost, Max.Units, Max.FixedCost);
			Point item = Compute.Intersection(lineEquation2, lineEquation3);
			Point item2 = Compute.Intersection(lineEquation, lineEquation4);
			BreakEvenItem breakEvenItem2 = new BreakEvenItem();
			breakEvenItem2.FixedCost = ActualItems[0].FixedCost;
			breakEvenItem2.VariableCost = item.Y - breakEvenItem2.FixedCost;
			breakEvenItem2.SalesRevenue = item.Y;
			breakEvenItem2.MarginalProfit = item2.Y;
			breakEvenItem2.Units = item.X;
			BreakEvenItem breakEvenItem3 = new BreakEvenItem();
			breakEvenItem3.SalesRevenue = item.Y;
			breakEvenItem3.Units = item.X;
			new BreakEvenItem
			{
				SalesRevenue = item2.Y,
				Units = item2.X
			};
			BreakEvenItem breakEvenItem4 = new BreakEvenItem();
			breakEvenItem4.SalesRevenue = item.Y;
			breakEvenItem4.Units = Min.Units;
			BreakEvenItem breakEvenItem5 = new BreakEvenItem();
			breakEvenItem5.SalesRevenue = 0.0;
			breakEvenItem5.Units = item.X;
			BreakEvenLines.Add(breakEvenItem4);
			BreakEvenLines.Add(breakEvenItem3);
			BreakEvenLines.Add(breakEvenItem5);
			ProfitPoints = new List<List<Point>>();
			ProfitPoints.Add(new List<Point> { item2, lineEquation4.End, lineEquation.End });
			NegativeRevenuePoints = new List<List<Point>>();
			NegativeRevenuePoints.Add(new List<Point> { item, lineEquation2.Start, lineEquation3.Start });
			PositiveRevenuePoints = new List<List<Point>>();
			PositiveRevenuePoints.Add(new List<Point> { item, lineEquation3.End, lineEquation2.End });
		}

		internal override void UpdateNumericProps(List<string> propNames, string propFormat = null)
		{
			if (propNames != null && propNames.Count != 0)
			{
				BindingVariableCost.Update(ShapeChartUtils.GetVariableCost(propNames), propFormat);
				BindingFixedCost.Update(ShapeChartUtils.GetFixedCost(propNames), propFormat);
				BindingTotalCost.Update(ShapeChartUtils.GetTotalCost(propNames), propFormat);
				BindingRevenue.Update(ShapeChartUtils.GetSalesRevenue(propNames), propFormat);
				BindingMarginalProfit.Update(ShapeChartUtils.GetSalesProfit(propNames), propFormat);
				BindingUnits.Update(ShapeChartUtils.GetSalesUnits(propNames), propFormat);
			}
		}
	}
	internal class LineEquation
	{
		public bool IsVertical { get; private set; }

		public double M { get; private set; }

		public Point Start { get; private set; }

		public Point End { get; private set; }

		public double A { get; private set; }

		public double B { get; private set; }

		public double C { get; private set; }

		internal LineEquation(double x1, double y1, double x2, double y2)
			: this(new Point(x1, y1), new Point(x2, y2))
		{
		}

		internal LineEquation(Point start, Point end)
		{
			Start = start;
			End = end;
			M = (End.Y - Start.Y) / (End.X - Start.X);
			A = 0.0 - M;
			B = 1.0;
			C = Start.Y - M * Start.X;
			IsVertical = Math.Abs(End.X - Start.X) < 9.999999747378752E-06;
		}
	}
	internal static class Compute
	{
		internal static Point Intersection(Point line1start, Point line1end, Point line2start, Point line2end)
		{
			return Intersection(new LineEquation(line1start, line1end), new LineEquation(line2start, line2end));
		}

		internal static Point Intersection(LineEquation line1, LineEquation line2)
		{
			Point result = new Point(double.NaN, double.NaN);
			if (line1.IsVertical && line2.IsVertical)
			{
				return result;
			}
			if (line1.IsVertical || line2.IsVertical)
			{
				LineEquation obj = (line2.IsVertical ? line2 : line1);
				LineEquation lineEquation = (line2.IsVertical ? line1 : line2);
				double y = (obj.Start.X - lineEquation.Start.X) * (lineEquation.End.Y - lineEquation.Start.Y) / (lineEquation.End.X - lineEquation.Start.X) + lineEquation.Start.Y;
				return new Point(line1.IsVertical ? line1.Start.X : line2.Start.X, y);
			}
			double num = line1.A * line2.B - line2.A * line1.B;
			if (Math.Abs(num - 0.0) > 9.999999747378752E-05)
			{
				double x = (line2.B * line1.C - line1.B * line2.C) / num;
				double y2 = (line1.A * line2.C - line2.A * line1.C) / num;
				result = new Point(x, y2);
			}
			return result;
		}
	}
	[DontHide]
	[DontObfuscate]
	public abstract class PriorityDataRule : IDataSeriesAdapterRule
	{
		public int Priority { get; set; }

		public virtual void Evaluate(DataSeriesAdapterRunContext context)
		{
		}

		internal List<string> ToList(string[] propNames)
		{
			List<string> list = new List<string>();
			foreach (string item in propNames)
			{
				list.Add(item);
			}
			return list;
		}
	}
	[DontHide]
	[DontObfuscate]
	public class ScatterDataRule : PriorityDataRule
	{
		public int MonotonicCheckAmount { get; set; }

		public int SmallDataSourceThreshold { get; set; }

		public int HugeDataSourceThreshold { get; set; }

		public ScatterDataRule()
		{
			base.Priority = 10;
			MonotonicCheckAmount = 1000;
			SmallDataSourceThreshold = 1000;
			HugeDataSourceThreshold = 10000;
		}

		public override void Evaluate(DataSeriesAdapterRunContext context)
		{
			ShapeDataInfo dataInfo = GetDataInfo(context);
			if (dataInfo != null && dataInfo.ScatterType != ScatterType.Unknown)
			{
				AddDataSeries(context, dataInfo);
			}
		}

		internal virtual void AddDataSeries(DataSeriesAdapterRunContext context, ShapeDataInfo data)
		{
			DataSeries dataSeries = new DataSeries();
			if (data.BindingX.HasPath())
			{
				dataSeries.AddMemberPathHint(data.BindingX);
			}
			if (data.BindingY.HasPath())
			{
				dataSeries.AddMemberPathHint(data.BindingY);
			}
			if (data.BindingValue.HasPath())
			{
				dataSeries.AddMemberPathHint(data.BindingValue);
			}
			if (data.BindingRadius.HasPath())
			{
				dataSeries.AddMemberPathHint(data.BindingRadius);
			}
			if (data.BindingFill.HasPath())
			{
				dataSeries.AddMemberPathHint(data.BindingFill);
			}
			if (data.BindingLabel.HasPath())
			{
				dataSeries.AddMemberPathHint(data.BindingLabel);
			}
			if (data.ScatterType == ScatterType.Unknown)
			{
				dataSeries.SuggestedSeries = DataSeriesType.Unknown;
			}
			else if (data.PointsTotal <= SmallDataSourceThreshold)
			{
				if (data.BindingRadius.HasPath())
				{
					dataSeries.SuggestedSeries = DataSeriesType.ScatterBubble;
					dataSeries.Title = data.BindingRadius.Path;
				}
				else if (data.BindingFill.HasPath())
				{
					dataSeries.SuggestedSeries = DataSeriesType.ScatterArea;
					dataSeries.Title = data.BindingValue.Path;
				}
				else if (data.BindingValue.HasPath())
				{
					dataSeries.SuggestedSeries = DataSeriesType.ScatterContour;
					dataSeries.Title = data.BindingValue.Path;
				}
				else
				{
					if (data.ItemsTotal <= MonotonicCheckAmount)
					{
						if (data.Analyzer.IsMonotonic(data.Provider, data.BindingX.Path, MonotonicCheckAmount) || data.Analyzer.IsMonotonic(data.Provider, data.BindingY.Path, MonotonicCheckAmount))
						{
							dataSeries.SuggestedSeries = DataSeriesType.ScatterLine;
						}
						else
						{
							dataSeries.SuggestedSeries = DataSeriesType.ScatterPoint;
						}
					}
					else
					{
						dataSeries.SuggestedSeries = DataSeriesType.ScatterPoint;
					}
					dataSeries.Title = data.BindingX.Path + " vs " + data.BindingY.Path;
				}
			}
			else if (data.PointsTotal <= HugeDataSourceThreshold)
			{
				if (data.BindingFill.HasPath())
				{
					dataSeries.SuggestedSeries = DataSeriesType.ScatterArea;
					dataSeries.Title = data.BindingFill.Path;
				}
				else if (data.BindingValue.HasPath())
				{
					dataSeries.SuggestedSeries = DataSeriesType.ScatterContour;
					dataSeries.Title = data.BindingValue.Path;
				}
				else
				{
					dataSeries.SuggestedSeries = DataSeriesType.ScatterHighDensity;
					dataSeries.Title = data.BindingX.Path + " vs " + data.BindingY.Path;
				}
			}
			else
			{
				dataSeries.SuggestedSeries = DataSeriesType.ScatterHighDensity;
				dataSeries.Title = data.BindingX.Path + " vs " + data.BindingY.Path;
			}
			dataSeries.SuggestedPrimaryAxis = DataSeriesAxisType.Linear;
			dataSeries.SuggestedSecondaryAxis = DataSeriesAxisType.Linear;
			dataSeries.Title = context.Analyzer.ExpandCamelCasedWords(dataSeries.Title);
			context.AddDataSeries(dataSeries, this);
		}

		internal ShapeDataInfo GetDataInfo(DataSeriesAdapterRunContext context)
		{
			ShapeDataInfo shapeDataInfo = new ShapeDataInfo(context);
			if (shapeDataInfo.ItemsTotal == 0)
			{
				return null;
			}
			for (int i = 0; i < shapeDataInfo.ItemsTotal; i++)
			{
				object itemAtIndex = shapeDataInfo.Provider.GetItemAtIndex(i);
				if (i == 0)
				{
					List<string> propNames = ToList(context.Analyzer.GetAllStringProperties());
					List<string> propNames2 = ToList(context.Analyzer.GetAllNumericProperties());
					shapeDataInfo.UpdateNumericProps(propNames2);
					shapeDataInfo.UpdateStringProps(propNames);
					if (shapeDataInfo.Analyzer.GetAllPropertiesWithName("ShapeType").Length != 0)
					{
						object itemValue = shapeDataInfo.Provider.GetItemValue(itemAtIndex, "ShapeType");
						if (itemValue is ShapeType)
						{
							shapeDataInfo.ScatterType = ShapeChartUtils.GetScatterType((ShapeType)itemValue);
						}
					}
					string[] allPropertiesWithName = shapeDataInfo.Analyzer.GetAllPropertiesWithName("Fields");
					if (allPropertiesWithName.Length == 0)
					{
						allPropertiesWithName = shapeDataInfo.Analyzer.GetAllPropertiesWithName("fields");
					}
					if (allPropertiesWithName.Length != 0 && shapeDataInfo.Provider.GetItemValue(itemAtIndex, allPropertiesWithName[0]) is IEnumerable)
					{
						List<string> list = shapeDataInfo.Provider.GetItemValue(itemAtIndex, "FieldsNames") as List<string>;
						if (list == null)
						{
							list = shapeDataInfo.Provider.GetItemValue(itemAtIndex, "fieldsNames") as List<string>;
						}
						List<string> list2 = shapeDataInfo.Provider.GetItemValue(itemAtIndex, "FieldsTypes") as List<string>;
						if (list2 == null)
						{
							list2 = shapeDataInfo.Provider.GetItemValue(itemAtIndex, "fieldsTypes") as List<string>;
						}
						if (list2 != null && list != null)
						{
							propNames2 = new List<string>();
							propNames = new List<string>();
							for (int j = 0; j < list2.Count; j++)
							{
								if (list2[j] == "string")
								{
									propNames.Add(list[j]);
								}
								else
								{
									propNames2.Add(list[j]);
								}
							}
							shapeDataInfo.UpdateNumericProps(propNames2, allPropertiesWithName[0] + "[NAME]");
							shapeDataInfo.UpdateStringProps(propNames, allPropertiesWithName[0] + "[NAME]");
						}
					}
					List<string> propNames3 = ToList(context.Analyzer.GetAllObjectProperties());
					shapeDataInfo.UpdateCollectionProps(propNames3);
				}
				if (!shapeDataInfo.BindingShapes.HasPath())
				{
					shapeDataInfo.PointsTotal = shapeDataInfo.ItemsTotal;
					if (shapeDataInfo.ScatterType == ScatterType.Unknown)
					{
						if (shapeDataInfo.BindingX.HasPath() && shapeDataInfo.BindingY.HasPath())
						{
							shapeDataInfo.ScatterType = ScatterType.Point;
						}
					}
					else
					{
						shapeDataInfo.ScatterType = ScatterType.Unknown;
					}
					break;
				}
				object itemValue2 = shapeDataInfo.Provider.GetItemValue(itemAtIndex, shapeDataInfo.BindingShapes.Path);
				if (itemValue2 == null || !context.Analyzer.IsCollection(itemValue2))
				{
					continue;
				}
				shapeDataInfo.ShapesPerRecord = Math.Max(shapeDataInfo.Provider.ActualCount, shapeDataInfo.ShapesPerRecord);
				shapeDataInfo.ShapesTotal += shapeDataInfo.Provider.ActualCount;
				IDataSourceLocalDataProvider subProvider = context.GetSubProvider(itemValue2, shapeDataInfo.BindingShapes.Path);
				if (subProvider.ActualCount == 0)
				{
					continue;
				}
				for (int k = 0; k < subProvider.ActualCount; k++)
				{
					object itemAtIndex2 = subProvider.GetItemAtIndex(k);
					if (itemAtIndex2 == null || !context.Analyzer.IsCollection(itemAtIndex2))
					{
						continue;
					}
					shapeDataInfo.PointsPerShape = Math.Max(subProvider.ActualCount, shapeDataInfo.PointsPerShape);
					shapeDataInfo.PointsTotal += subProvider.ActualCount;
					IDataSourceLocalDataProvider subProvider2 = context.GetSubProvider(itemAtIndex2, "[" + k + "]");
					int actualCount = subProvider2.ActualCount;
					if (actualCount == 0)
					{
						continue;
					}
					if (i == 0 && k == 0 && (!shapeDataInfo.BindingX.HasPath() || !shapeDataInfo.BindingY.HasPath()))
					{
						List<string> propNames4 = ToList(context.Analyzer.GetAllNumericProperties());
						string propFormat = shapeDataInfo.BindingShapes.Path + "[0][0].NAME";
						shapeDataInfo.UpdateNumericProps(propNames4, propFormat);
					}
					if (shapeDataInfo.ScatterType == ScatterType.Unknown)
					{
						if (subProvider2.ActualCount == 1)
						{
							shapeDataInfo.ScatterType = ScatterType.Point;
						}
						else
						{
							Point point = ToPoint(subProvider2.GetItemAtIndex(0));
							Point point2 = ToPoint(subProvider2.GetItemAtIndex(actualCount - 1));
							if (point.X == point2.X && point.Y == point2.Y)
							{
								shapeDataInfo.ScatterType = ScatterType.Polygon;
							}
							else
							{
								shapeDataInfo.ScatterType = ScatterType.Polyline;
							}
						}
					}
					context.PopSubProvider();
				}
				context.PopSubProvider();
				if (shapeDataInfo.ScatterType == ScatterType.Unknown)
				{
					if (shapeDataInfo.PointsTotal == shapeDataInfo.ItemsTotal || shapeDataInfo.ShapesPerRecord == 1)
					{
						shapeDataInfo.ScatterType = ScatterType.Point;
					}
					if (shapeDataInfo.BindingValue.HasPath())
					{
						shapeDataInfo.ScatterType = ScatterType.Polyline;
					}
				}
			}
			return shapeDataInfo;
		}

		private Point ToPoint(object p)
		{
			if (p == null)
			{
				return new Point(double.NaN, double.NaN);
			}
			if (p is Point)
			{
				return (Point)p;
			}
			return new Point(double.NaN, double.NaN);
		}
	}
	internal class ScatterDataInfo
	{
		public int ItemsTotal { get; set; }

		public DataSeriesAdapterRunContext Context { get; set; }

		public DataSeriesDataProviderAnalyzer Analyzer => Context.Analyzer;

		public IDataSourceLocalDataProvider Provider { get; set; }

		public ScatterType ScatterType { get; set; }

		public DataSeriesMemberPathHint BindingX { get; set; }

		public DataSeriesMemberPathHint BindingY { get; set; }

		public DataSeriesMemberPathHint BindingRadius { get; set; }

		public DataSeriesMemberPathHint BindingFill { get; set; }

		public DataSeriesMemberPathHint BindingLabel { get; set; }

		public DataSeriesMemberPathHint BindingValue { get; set; }

		public DataSeriesMemberPathHint BindingGroup { get; set; }

		public DataSeriesMemberPathHint BindingShapes { get; set; }

		public ScatterDataInfo(DataSeriesAdapterRunContext context)
		{
			Context = context;
			Provider = context.GetCurrentDataSource();
			if (Provider != null)
			{
				ItemsTotal = Provider.ActualCount;
			}
			ScatterType = ScatterType.Unknown;
			BindingX = new DataSeriesMemberPathHint
			{
				Intent = DataSeriesIntent.SeriesX
			};
			BindingY = new DataSeriesMemberPathHint
			{
				Intent = DataSeriesIntent.SeriesY
			};
			BindingRadius = new DataSeriesMemberPathHint
			{
				Intent = DataSeriesIntent.SeriesRadius
			};
			BindingFill = new DataSeriesMemberPathHint
			{
				Intent = DataSeriesIntent.SeriesFill
			};
			BindingLabel = new DataSeriesMemberPathHint
			{
				Intent = DataSeriesIntent.SeriesLabel
			};
			BindingValue = new DataSeriesMemberPathHint
			{
				Intent = DataSeriesIntent.SeriesValue
			};
			BindingGroup = new DataSeriesMemberPathHint
			{
				Intent = DataSeriesIntent.SeriesGroup
			};
			BindingShapes = new DataSeriesMemberPathHint
			{
				Intent = DataSeriesIntent.SeriesShape
			};
		}

		internal virtual void UpdateStringProps(List<string> propNames, string propFormat = null)
		{
			if (propNames == null || propNames.Count == 0)
			{
				return;
			}
			if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(BindingGroup.Path))
			{
				List<string> list = ShapeChartUtils.GetGroup(propNames);
				if (list.Count > 0)
				{
					BindingGroup.Update(list[0], propFormat);
				}
			}
			if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(BindingLabel.Path))
			{
				List<string> label = ShapeChartUtils.GetLabel(propNames);
				if (label.Count > 0)
				{
					BindingLabel.Update(label[0], propFormat);
				}
			}
		}

		internal virtual void UpdateCollectionProps(List<string> propNames, string propFormat = null)
		{
			if (propNames != null && propNames.Count != 0 && string.IsNullOrEmpty(BindingShapes.Path))
			{
				List<string> shapes = ShapeChartUtils.GetShapes(propNames);
				if (shapes.Count > 0)
				{
					BindingShapes.Update(shapes[0], propFormat);
				}
			}
		}

		internal virtual void UpdateNumericProps(List<string> propNames, string propFormat = null)
		{
			if (propNames == null || propNames.Count == 0)
			{
				return;
			}
			BindingX.Update(ShapeChartUtils.GetX(propNames), propFormat);
			BindingY.Update(ShapeChartUtils.GetY(propNames), propFormat);
			BindingFill.Update(ShapeChartUtils.GetFill(propNames), propFormat);
			BindingRadius.Update(ShapeChartUtils.GetRadius(propNames), propFormat);
			BindingValue.Update(ShapeChartUtils.GetValue(propNames), propFormat);
			if (!BindingX.HasPath() && propNames.Count > 0)
			{
				int index = propNames.Count - 1;
				BindingX.Update(propNames[index], propFormat);
				propNames.RemoveAt(index);
			}
			if (!BindingY.HasPath() && propNames.Count > 0)
			{
				int index2 = propNames.Count - 1;
				BindingY.Update(propNames[index2], propFormat);
				propNames.RemoveAt(index2);
			}
			if (!BindingValue.HasPath() && propNames.Count > 0)
			{
				int index3 = propNames.Count - 1;
				BindingValue.Update(propNames[index3], propFormat);
				propNames.RemoveAt(index3);
			}
			if (!BindingRadius.HasPath() && propNames.Count > 0)
			{
				int index4 = propNames.Count - 1;
				BindingRadius.Update(propNames[index4], propFormat);
				propNames.RemoveAt(index4);
			}
			if (!BindingFill.HasPath() && propNames.Count > 0)
			{
				int index5 = propNames.Count - 1;
				BindingFill.Update(propNames[index5], propFormat);
				propNames.RemoveAt(index5);
			}
			if (!BindingX.HasPath())
			{
				if (BindingRadius.HasPath())
				{
					BindingX.Path = BindingRadius.Path;
				}
				else if (BindingFill.HasPath())
				{
					BindingX.Path = BindingFill.Path;
				}
				else if (BindingValue.HasPath())
				{
					BindingX.Path = BindingValue.Path;
				}
			}
			if (!BindingY.HasPath())
			{
				if (BindingValue.HasPath())
				{
					BindingY.Path = BindingValue.Path;
				}
				else if (BindingFill.HasPath())
				{
					BindingY.Path = BindingFill.Path;
				}
				else if (BindingRadius.HasPath())
				{
					BindingY.Path = BindingRadius.Path;
				}
			}
		}

		public List<string> GetStringProperties()
		{
			List<string> list = new List<string>();
			string[] allStringProperties = Analyzer.GetAllStringProperties();
			foreach (string item in allStringProperties)
			{
				list.Add(item);
			}
			return list;
		}
	}
	internal class ShapeDataInfo : ScatterDataInfo
	{
		public int ShapesTotal { get; set; }

		public int ShapesPerRecord { get; set; }

		public int PointsPerShape { get; set; }

		public int PointsTotal { get; set; }

		public ShapeDataInfo(DataSeriesAdapterRunContext context)
			: base(context)
		{
			ShapesTotal = 0;
			ShapesPerRecord = 0;
			PointsPerShape = 0;
			PointsTotal = 0;
		}
	}
	[DontHide]
	[DontObfuscate]
	public class ShapeDataRule : ScatterDataRule
	{
		public ShapeDataRule()
		{
			base.Priority = 20;
		}

		internal override void AddDataSeries(DataSeriesAdapterRunContext context, ShapeDataInfo data)
		{
			DataSeries dataSeries = new DataSeries();
			if (data.BindingX.HasPath())
			{
				dataSeries.AddMemberPathHint(data.BindingX);
			}
			if (data.BindingY.HasPath())
			{
				dataSeries.AddMemberPathHint(data.BindingY);
			}
			if (data.BindingValue.HasPath())
			{
				dataSeries.AddMemberPathHint(data.BindingValue);
			}
			if (data.BindingRadius.HasPath())
			{
				dataSeries.AddMemberPathHint(data.BindingRadius);
			}
			if (data.BindingFill.HasPath())
			{
				dataSeries.AddMemberPathHint(data.BindingFill);
			}
			if (data.BindingLabel.HasPath())
			{
				dataSeries.AddMemberPathHint(data.BindingLabel);
			}
			if (data.BindingShapes.HasPath())
			{
				dataSeries.AddMemberPathHint(data.BindingShapes);
			}
			if (data.ScatterType == ScatterType.Unknown)
			{
				dataSeries.SuggestedSeries = DataSeriesType.Unknown;
			}
			else if (data.ScatterType == ScatterType.Point)
			{
				if (data.PointsTotal <= base.SmallDataSourceThreshold)
				{
					if (data.BindingRadius.HasPath())
					{
						dataSeries.SuggestedSeries = DataSeriesType.ScatterBubble;
						dataSeries.Title = data.BindingRadius.Path;
					}
					else if (data.BindingFill.HasPath())
					{
						dataSeries.SuggestedSeries = DataSeriesType.ScatterArea;
						dataSeries.Title = data.BindingFill.Path;
					}
					else if (data.BindingValue.HasPath())
					{
						dataSeries.SuggestedSeries = DataSeriesType.ScatterContour;
						dataSeries.Title = data.BindingValue.Path;
					}
					else
					{
						if (data.ItemsTotal <= base.MonotonicCheckAmount)
						{
							if (data.Analyzer.IsMonotonic(data.Provider, data.BindingX.Path, base.MonotonicCheckAmount) || data.Analyzer.IsMonotonic(data.Provider, data.BindingY.Path, base.MonotonicCheckAmount))
							{
								dataSeries.SuggestedSeries = DataSeriesType.ScatterLine;
							}
							else
							{
								dataSeries.SuggestedSeries = DataSeriesType.ScatterPoint;
							}
						}
						else
						{
							dataSeries.SuggestedSeries = DataSeriesType.ScatterPoint;
						}
						dataSeries.Title = data.BindingX.Path + " vs " + data.BindingY.Path;
					}
				}
				else if (data.PointsTotal <= base.HugeDataSourceThreshold)
				{
					if (data.BindingFill.HasPath())
					{
						dataSeries.SuggestedSeries = DataSeriesType.ScatterArea;
						dataSeries.Title = data.BindingFill.Path;
					}
					else if (data.BindingValue.HasPath())
					{
						dataSeries.SuggestedSeries = DataSeriesType.ScatterContour;
						dataSeries.Title = data.BindingValue.Path;
					}
					else
					{
						dataSeries.SuggestedSeries = DataSeriesType.ScatterHighDensity;
						dataSeries.Title = data.BindingX.Path + " vs " + data.BindingY.Path;
					}
				}
				else
				{
					dataSeries.SuggestedSeries = DataSeriesType.ScatterHighDensity;
					dataSeries.Title = data.BindingX.Path + " vs " + data.BindingY.Path;
				}
			}
			else if (data.ScatterType == ScatterType.Polyline)
			{
				dataSeries.SuggestedSeries = DataSeriesType.ScatterPolyline;
			}
			else if (data.ScatterType == ScatterType.Polygon)
			{
				dataSeries.SuggestedSeries = DataSeriesType.ScatterPolygon;
			}
			dataSeries.SuggestedPrimaryAxis = DataSeriesAxisType.Linear;
			dataSeries.SuggestedSecondaryAxis = DataSeriesAxisType.Linear;
			dataSeries.Title = context.Analyzer.ExpandCamelCasedWords(dataSeries.Title);
			context.AddDataSeries(dataSeries, this);
		}
	}
	internal enum ScatterType
	{
		Unknown,
		Polyline,
		Polygon,
		Point,
		BreakEven
	}
	internal class ShapeChartUtils
	{
		internal static ScatterType GetScatterType(ShapeType shapeType)
		{
			switch (shapeType)
			{
			case ShapeType.PolyLine:
			case ShapeType.PolyLineZ:
				return ScatterType.Polyline;
			case ShapeType.Polygon:
			case ShapeType.PolygonZ:
				return ScatterType.Polygon;
			case ShapeType.Point:
				return ScatterType.Point;
			default:
				return ScatterType.Unknown;
			}
		}

		internal static List<string> GetY(IList<string> remainingProps)
		{
			return GetProps(IsPropertyY, remainingProps);
		}

		internal static bool IsPropertyY(string v)
		{
			v = v.ToLower();
			if (!string.Equals(v, "y") && !string.Equals(v, "yvalue") && !string.Equals(v, "ycolumn") && !string.Equals(v, "ypoint") && !string.Equals(v, "ylocation") && !string.Equals(v, "ycoordinate") && !string.Equals(v, "ydimension") && !string.Equals(v, "lat"))
			{
				return string.Equals(v, "latitude");
			}
			return true;
		}

		internal static List<string> GetX(IList<string> remainingProps)
		{
			return GetProps(IsPropertyX, remainingProps);
		}

		internal static bool IsPropertyX(string v)
		{
			v = v.ToLower();
			if (!string.Equals(v, "x") && !string.Equals(v, "xvalue") && !string.Equals(v, "xcolumn") && !string.Equals(v, "xpoint") && !string.Equals(v, "xlocation") && !string.Equals(v, "xcoordinate") && !string.Equals(v, "xdimension") && !string.Equals(v, "lon"))
			{
				return string.Equals(v, "longitude");
			}
			return true;
		}

		internal static List<string> GetRadius(IList<string> remainingProps)
		{
			return GetProps(IsPropertyRadius, remainingProps);
		}

		internal static bool IsPropertyRadius(string v)
		{
			v = v.ToLower();
			if (!string.Equals(v, "r") && !string.Equals(v, "radius") && !string.Equals(v, "radiusvalue") && !string.Equals(v, "rvalue") && !string.Equals(v, "rcolumn") && !string.Equals(v, "rdimension") && !string.Equals(v, "bubble") && !string.Equals(v, "bubblesize"))
			{
				return string.Equals(v, "size");
			}
			return true;
		}

		internal static List<string> GetValue(IList<string> remainingProps)
		{
			return GetProps(IsPropertyValue, remainingProps);
		}

		internal static bool IsPropertyValue(string v)
		{
			v = v.ToLower();
			if (!string.Equals(v, "v") && !string.Equals(v, "value") && !string.Equals(v, "vcolumn") && !string.Equals(v, "z") && !string.Equals(v, "zvalue") && !string.Equals(v, "zcolumn") && !string.Equals(v, "zdimension") && !string.Equals(v, "zcoordinate") && !string.Equals(v, "magnitude") && !string.Equals(v, "elevation") && !string.Equals(v, "depth") && !string.Equals(v, "capacity"))

			}

		{
			return GetProps(IsPropertyFill, remainingProps);
		}

			v = v.ToLower();
			if (!string.Equals(v, "f") && !string.Equals(v, "fill") && !string.Equals(v, "fillvalue") && !string.Equals(v, "fvalue") && !string.Equals(v, "fcolumn") && !string.Equals(v, "color") && !string.Equals(v, "colorvalue") && !string.Equals(v, "cvalue"))
			{
				return string.Equals(v, "ccolumn");
			}
			return true;

			v = v.ToLower();
			if (!string.Equals(v, "l") && !string.Equals(v, "label") && !string.Equals(v, "lvalue") && !string.Equals(v, "lcolumn") && !string.Equals(v, "n") && !string.Equals(v, "name") && !string.Equals(v, "nvalue"))
			{
				return string.Equals(v, "ncolumn");

			if (!string.Equals(v, "g") && !string.Equals(v, "groupping") && !string.Equals(v, "group") && !string.Equals(v, "gvalue") && !string.Equals(v, "gcolumn") && !string.Equals(v, "region"))
			{
				return string.Equals(v, "type");
			}
			return true;
		}

		{
			return GetProps(IsPropertyShapes, remainingProps);

		internal static bool IsPropertyShapes(string v)
		{
			v = v.ToLower();
			if (!string.Equals(v, "points") && !string.Equals(v, "shapes") && !string.Equals(v, "locations") && !string.Equals(v, "positions") && !string.Equals(v, "coordinates"))
			{
				return string.Equals(v, "vectors");
			}
			return true;
		}

		internal static List<string> GetSalesProfit(IList<string> remainingProps)
		{
			return GetProps(IsPropertySalesProfit, remainingProps);
		}

		internal static bool IsPropertySalesProfit(string prop)
		{
			prop = prop.ToLower();
			return prop.Contains("marginalprofit");
		}

		internal static List<string> GetSalesRevenue(IList<string> remainingProps)
		{
			return GetProps(IsPropertySalesRevenue, remainingProps);
		}

		internal static bool IsPropertySalesRevenue(string prop)
		{
			prop = prop.ToLower();
			if (!prop.Contains("revenue"))
			{
				return prop.Contains("totalsales");
			}
			return true;
		}

		internal static List<string> GetFixedCost(IList<string> remainingProps)
		{
			return GetProps(IsPropertyFixedCost, remainingProps);
		}

		internal static bool IsPropertyFixedCost(string prop)
		{
			prop = prop.ToLower();
			if (!prop.Contains("fixedcost"))
			{
				return prop.Contains("fixedexpense");
			}
			return true;
		}

		internal static List<string> GetVariableCost(IList<string> remainingProps)
		{
			return GetProps(IsPropertyVariableCost, remainingProps);
		}

		internal static bool IsPropertyVariableCost(string prop)
		{
			prop = prop.ToLower();
			if (!prop.Contains("variablecost"))
			{
				return prop.Contains("variableexpense");
			}
			return true;
		}

		internal static List<string> GetTotalCost(IList<string> remainingProps)
		{
			return GetProps(IsPropertyTotalCost, remainingProps);
		}

		internal static bool IsPropertyTotalCost(string prop)
		{
			prop = prop.ToLower();
			if (!prop.Contains("totalcost"))
			{
				return prop.Contains("totalexpense");
			}
			return true;
		}

		internal static List<string> GetSalesUnits(IList<string> remainingProps)
		{
			return GetProps(IsPropertySalesUnits, remainingProps);
		}

		internal static bool IsPropertySalesUnits(string prop)
		{
			prop = prop.ToLower();
			if (!prop.Contains("units") && !prop.Contains("volume"))
			{
				return prop.Contains("quantity");
			}
			return true;
		}

		private static List<string> GetProps(Func<string, bool> matchFunc, IList<string> remainingProps)
		{
			List<string> list = new List<string>();
			for (int i = 0; i < remainingProps.Count; i++)
			{
				if (matchFunc(remainingProps[i]))
				{
					list.Add(remainingProps[i]);
					remainingProps.RemoveAt(i);
					i--;
				}
			}
			return list;
		}
	}

namespace Infragistics.Controls.Charts.CalculationStrategies
{
	public class AbsoluteVolumeOscillatorIndicatorStrategy : IndicatorCalculationStrategy
	{
		public override IList<string> BasedOn(FinancialCalculationDataSource dataSource, FinancialCalculationSupportingCalculations supportingCalculations)
		{
			List<string> list = new List<string>();
			list.AddRange(supportingCalculations.ShortVolumeOscillatorAverage.BasedOn);
			list.AddRange(supportingCalculations.LongVolumeOscillatorAverage.BasedOn);
			return list;
		}

		public override bool CalculateIndicator(FinancialCalculationDataSource dataSource, FinancialCalculationSupportingCalculations supportingCalculations)
		{
			IEnumerator<double> enumerator = supportingCalculations.ShortVolumeOscillatorAverage.Strategy(dataSource).GetEnumerator();
			IEnumerator<double> enumerator2 = supportingCalculations.LongVolumeOscillatorAverage.Strategy(dataSource).GetEnumerator();
			IList<double> indicatorColumn = dataSource.IndicatorColumn;
			int num = 0;
			while (enumerator.MoveNext() && enumerator2.MoveNext())
			{
				double arg = enumerator.Current - enumerator2.Current;
				indicatorColumn[num] = supportingCalculations.MakeSafe(arg);
				num++;
			}
			return true;
		}
	}
	public class AccumulationDistributionIndicatorStrategy : StreamingIndicatorCalculationStrategy
	{
		public override IList<string> BasedOn(FinancialCalculationDataSource dataSource, FinancialCalculationSupportingCalculations supportingCalculations)
		{
			return new List<string> { "CloseColumn", "LowColumn", "HighColumn", "VolumeColumn" };
		}

		public override bool CalculateIndicator(FinancialCalculationDataSource dataSource, FinancialCalculationSupportingCalculations supportingCalculations)
		{
			int num = 0;
			foreach (double item in ProvideStream(dataSource, supportingCalculations))
			{
				dataSource.IndicatorColumn[num] = item;
				num++;
			}
			return true;
		}

		public override IEnumerable<double> ProvideStream(FinancialCalculationDataSource dataSource, FinancialCalculationSupportingCalculations supportingCalculations)
		{
			double ad = 0.0;
			double min = double.PositiveInfinity;
			double max = double.NegativeInfinity;
			int val = ((dataSource.IndicatorColumn != null) ? dataSource.IndicatorColumn.Count : 0);
			int val2 = ((dataSource.CloseColumn != null) ? dataSource.CloseColumn.Count : 0);
			int val3 = ((dataSource.HighColumn != null) ? dataSource.HighColumn.Count : 0);
			int val4 = ((dataSource.VolumeColumn != null) ? dataSource.VolumeColumn.Count : 0);
			int count = Math.Min(val, Math.Min(val2, Math.Min(val3, val4)));
			int i = 0;
			while (i < count)
			{
				double num = dataSource.CloseColumn[i];
				double num2 = dataSource.LowColumn[i];
				double num3 = dataSource.HighColumn[i];
				double num4 = dataSource.VolumeColumn[i];
				double num5 = (num - num2 - (num3 - num)) / (num3 - num2);
				ad += supportingCalculations.MakeSafe(num5 * num4);
				min = Math.Min(min, ad);
				max = Math.Max(max, ad);
				yield return ad;
				int num6 = i + 1;
				i = num6;
			}
		}
	}
	public class AverageDirectionalIndexIndicatorStrategy : IndicatorCalculationStrategy
	{
		public override IList<string> BasedOn(FinancialCalculationDataSource dataSource, FinancialCalculationSupportingCalculations supportingCalculations)
		{
			List<string> list = new List<string>();
			list.Add("LowColumn");
			list.Add("HighColumn");
			list.AddRange(dataSource.TrueRange.BasedOn);
			list.AddRange(supportingCalculations.EMA.BasedOn);
			return list;
		}

		private double UpMove(int index, IList<double> highColumn, IList<double> lowColumn)
		{
			return highColumn[index] - highColumn[index - 1];
		}

		private double DownMove(int index, IList<double> highColumn, IList<double> lowColumn)
		{
			return lowColumn[index - 1] - lowColumn[index];
		}

		private IEnumerable<double> PlusDM(IList<double> highColumn, IList<double> lowColumn)
		{
			yield return 0.0;
			for (int i = 1; i < highColumn.Count; i++)
			{
				double num = UpMove(i, highColumn, lowColumn);
				double num2 = DownMove(i, highColumn, lowColumn);
				if (num > num2 && num > 0.0)
				{
					yield return num;
				}
				else
				{
					yield return 0.0;
				}
			}
		}

		private IEnumerable<double> MinusDM(IList<double> highColumn, IList<double> lowColumn)
		{
			yield return 0.0;
			for (int i = 1; i < highColumn.Count; i++)
			{
				double num = UpMove(i, highColumn, lowColumn);
				double num2 = DownMove(i, highColumn, lowColumn);
				if (num2 > num && num2 > 0.0)
				{
					yield return num2;
				}
				else
				{
					yield return 0.0;
				}
			}
		}

		private IEnumerable<double> PlusDI(FinancialCalculationDataSource dataSource, FinancialCalculationSupportingCalculations supportingCalculations)
		{
			IEnumerator<double> emaPlusDM = supportingCalculations.EMA.Strategy(PlusDM(dataSource.HighColumn, dataSource.LowColumn), dataSource.Period).GetEnumerator();
			IEnumerator<double> averageTrueRange = supportingCalculations.EMA.Strategy(dataSource.TrueRange, dataSource.Period).GetEnumerator();
			while (emaPlusDM.MoveNext() && averageTrueRange.MoveNext())
			{
				yield return supportingCalculations.MakeSafe(emaPlusDM.Current / averageTrueRange.Current);
			}
		}

		private IEnumerable<double> MinusDI(FinancialCalculationDataSource dataSource, FinancialCalculationSupportingCalculations supportingCalculations)
		{
			IEnumerator<double> emaMinusDM = supportingCalculations.EMA.Strategy(MinusDM(dataSource.HighColumn, dataSource.LowColumn), dataSource.Period).GetEnumerator();
			IEnumerator<double> averageTrueRange = supportingCalculations.EMA.Strategy(dataSource.TrueRange, dataSource.Period).GetEnumerator();
			while (emaMinusDM.MoveNext() && averageTrueRange.MoveNext())
			{
				yield return supportingCalculations.MakeSafe(emaMinusDM.Current / averageTrueRange.Current);
			}
		}

		private IEnumerable<double> ADXHelper(FinancialCalculationDataSource dataSource, FinancialCalculationSupportingCalculations supportingCalculations)
		{
			IEnumerator<double> plusDI = PlusDI(dataSource, supportingCalculations).GetEnumerator();
			IEnumerator<double> minusDI = MinusDI(dataSource, supportingCalculations).GetEnumerator();
			plusDI.MoveNext();
			minusDI.MoveNext();
			while (plusDI.MoveNext() && minusDI.MoveNext())
			{
				yield return Math.Abs(supportingCalculations.MakeSafe((plusDI.Current - minusDI.Current) / (plusDI.Current + minusDI.Current)));
			}
		}

		private IEnumerable<double> ADX(FinancialCalculationDataSource dataSource, FinancialCalculationSupportingCalculations supportingCalculations)
		{
			IEnumerator<double> adxHelperEMA = supportingCalculations.EMA.Strategy(ADXHelper(dataSource, supportingCalculations), dataSource.Period).GetEnumerator();
			yield return 0.0;
			while (adxHelperEMA.MoveNext())
			{
				yield return adxHelperEMA.Current * 100.0;
			}
		}

		public override bool CalculateIndicator(FinancialCalculationDataSource dataSource, FinancialCalculationSupportingCalculations supportingCalculations)
		{
			IEnumerator<double> enumerator = ADX(dataSource, supportingCalculations).GetEnumerator();
			IList<double> indicatorColumn = dataSource.IndicatorColumn;
			for (int i = 0; i < indicatorColumn.Count; i++)
			{
				if (enumerator.MoveNext())
				{
					indicatorColumn[i] = enumerator.Current;
				}
			}
			return true;
		}
	}

			if (count > 0)
			{
				indicatorColumn[0] = 0.0;
			}
			for (int i = 1; i < count; i++)
			{
				double num = (highColumn[i] + lowColumn[i]) / 2.0;
				double num2 = (highColumn[i - 1] + lowColumn[i - 1]) / 2.0;
				double num3 = num - num2;
				double num4 = 10000.0;
				double num5 = supportingCalculations.MakeSafe(volumeColumn[i] / num4 / (highColumn[i] - lowColumn[i]));
				indicatorColumn[i] = supportingCalculations.MakeSafe(num3 / num5);
			}
			return true;
		}

	public class ForceIndexIndicatorStrategy : IndicatorCalculationStrategy
	{
		public override IList<string> BasedOn(FinancialCalculationDataSource dataSource, FinancialCalculationSupportingCalculations supportingCalculations)

			list.AddRange(supportingCalculations.EMA.BasedOn);
			return list;
		}

		protected IEnumerable<double> FI(FinancialCalculationDataSource dataSource)
		{
			int count = 0;
			IList<double> closeColumn = dataSource.CloseColumn;
			IList<double> volumeColumn = dataSource.VolumeColumn;
			_ = dataSource.IndicatorColumn;
			if (closeColumn != null && volumeColumn != null)
			{
				count = Math.Min(closeColumn.Count, volumeColumn.Count);
			}
			if (count > 0)
			{
				yield return 0.0;
			}
			int i = 1;
			while (i < count)
			{
				yield return volumeColumn[i] * (closeColumn[i] - closeColumn[i - 1]);
				int num = i + 1;
				i = num;
			}
		}

		public override bool CalculateIndicator(FinancialCalculationDataSource dataSource, FinancialCalculationSupportingCalculations supportingCalculations)
		{
			IEnumerable<double> enumerable = FI(dataSource);
			int period = dataSource.Period;
			IList<double> indicatorColumn = dataSource.IndicatorColumn;
			if (period != 0 && !double.IsNaN(period) && !double.IsInfinity(period))
			{
				enumerable = supportingCalculations.EMA.Strategy(enumerable, dataSource.Period);
			}
			int num = 0;
			foreach (double item in enumerable)
			{
				indicatorColumn[num] = item;
				num++;
			}
			return true;
		}
	}

	public class PercentKCalculationStrategy : StreamingIndicatorCalculationStrategy
	{
		public override IList<string> BasedOn(FinancialCalculationDataSource dataSource, FinancialCalculationSupportingCalculations supportingCalculations)
		{
			return new List<string> { "HighColumn", "LowColumn", "CloseColumn" };
		}

		public override IEnumerable<double> ProvideStream(FinancialCalculationDataSource dataSource, FinancialCalculationSupportingCalculations supportingCalculations)
		{
			int period = dataSource.Period;
			IList<double> highColumn = dataSource.HighColumn;
			IList<double> lowColumn = dataSource.LowColumn;
			for (int i = 0; i < dataSource.Count; i++)
			{
				int num = Math.Min(period, i);
				double num2 = double.MinValue;
				double num3 = double.MaxValue;
				for (int j = 0; j < num; j++)
				{
					if (!double.IsNaN(highColumn[i - j]))
					{
						num2 = Math.Max(num2, highColumn[i - j]);
					}
					if (!double.IsNaN(lowColumn[i - j]))
					{
						num3 = Math.Min(num3, lowColumn[i - j]);
					}
				}
				yield return supportingCalculations.MakeSafe((dataSource.CloseColumn[i] - num3) / (num2 - num3) * 100.0);
			}
		}

		public override bool CalculateIndicator(FinancialCalculationDataSource dataSource, FinancialCalculationSupportingCalculations supportingCalculations)
		{
			int num = 0;
			foreach (double item in ProvideStream(dataSource, supportingCalculations))
			{
				dataSource.IndicatorColumn[num] = item;
				num++;
			}
			return true;
		}
	}

			int period = dataSource.Period;

			double[] array = new double[period];
			for (num = 0; num < period; num++)
			{
				array[num] = 0.0;
			}
			double num2 = 0.0;
			double[] array2 = new double[period];
			for (num = 0; num < period; num++)
			{
				array2[num] = 0.0;
			}
			double num3 = 0.0;
			double num4 = 0.0;
			num = 0;
			while (enumerator.MoveNext() && enumerator2.MoveNext())
			{
				int num5 = num % period;
				double num6 = enumerator.Current * enumerator2.Current;
				num2 -= array[num5];
				num3 -= array2[num5];
				switch (Math.Sign(num6 - num4))
				{
				case -1:
					array[num5] = 0.0;
					array2[num5] = num6;
					break;
				case 0:
					array[num5] = 0.0;
					array2[num5] = 0.0;
					break;
				case 1:
					array[num5] = num6;
					array2[num5] = 0.0;
					break;
				}
				num2 += array[num5];
				num3 += array2[num5];
				double value = supportingCalculations.MakeSafe(100.0 * num2 / (num2 + num3));
				dataSource.IndicatorColumn[num] = value;
				num4 = num6;
				num++;
			}
			return true;
		}
	}

	public class RateOfChangeAndMomentumIndicatorStrategy : IndicatorCalculationStrategy
	{
		public override IList<string> BasedOn(FinancialCalculationDataSource dataSource, FinancialCalculationSupportingCalculations supportingCalculations)
		{
			return new List<string> { "CloseColumn" };
		}

		public override bool CalculateIndicator(FinancialCalculationDataSource dataSource, FinancialCalculationSupportingCalculations supportingCalculations)
		{
			IList<double> closeColumn = dataSource.CloseColumn;
			IList<double> indicatorColumn = dataSource.IndicatorColumn;
			int period = dataSource.Period;
			int num = 0;
			double[] array = new double[period];
			for (num = 0; num < period; num++)
			{
				array[num] = 0.0;
			}
			num = 0;
			foreach (double item in closeColumn)
			{
				int num2 = num % period;
				double value = supportingCalculations.MakeSafe(100.0 * (item - array[num2]) / array[num2]);
				indicatorColumn[num] = value;
				array[num2] = item;
				num++;
			}
			return true;
		}

	public class RelativeStrengthIndexIndicatorStrategy : StreamingIndicatorCalculationStrategy
	{
		public override IList<string> BasedOn(FinancialCalculationDataSource dataSource, FinancialCalculationSupportingCalculations supportingCalculations)
		{
			return new List<string> { "CloseColumn" };
		}

		public override bool CalculateIndicator(FinancialCalculationDataSource dataSource, FinancialCalculationSupportingCalculations supportingCalculations)
		{
			int num = 0;
			foreach (double item in ProvideStream(dataSource, supportingCalculations))
			{
				dataSource.IndicatorColumn[num] = item;
				num++;
			}
			return true;
		}

		public override IEnumerable<double> ProvideStream(FinancialCalculationDataSource dataSource, FinancialCalculationSupportingCalculations supportingCalculations)
		{
			double period = dataSource.Period;
			_ = 2.0 / (period + 1.0);
			double Uema = 0.0;
			double Dema = 0.0;
			IList<double> indicatorColumn = dataSource.IndicatorColumn;
			IList<double> closeColumn = dataSource.CloseColumn;
			if (indicatorColumn.Count > 0)
			{
				yield return 0.0;
			}
			int i = 1;
			while (i < Math.Min(dataSource.Period, indicatorColumn.Count))
			{
				double num = closeColumn[i] - closeColumn[i - 1];
				double num2 = ((num > 0.0) ? num : 0.0);
				double num3 = ((num > 0.0) ? 0.0 : (0.0 - num));
				Uema += num2 / (period - 1.0);
				Dema += num3 / (period - 1.0);
				yield return 0.0;
				int num4 = i + 1;
				i = num4;
			}
			int i2 = dataSource.Period;
			while (i2 < indicatorColumn.Count)
			{
				double num5 = closeColumn[i2] - closeColumn[i2 - 1];
				double num6 = ((num5 > 0.0) ? num5 : 0.0);
				double num7 = ((num5 > 0.0) ? 0.0 : (0.0 - num5));
				Uema = (Uema * (period - 1.0) + num6) / period;
				Dema = (Dema * (period - 1.0) + num7) / period;
				yield return supportingCalculations.MakeSafe((Uema != 0.0) ? (100.0 * Uema / (Uema + Dema)) : 0.0);
				int num4 = i2 + 1;
				i2 = num4;
			}
		}
	}

	{
		internal StreamingIndicatorCalculationStrategy RSIStrategy { get; set; }

		public StochRSIIndicatorStrategy()
		{
			RSIStrategy = new RelativeStrengthIndexIndicatorStrategy();
		}

		public override IList<string> BasedOn(FinancialCalculationDataSource dataSource, FinancialCalculationSupportingCalculations supportingCalculations)
		{
			List<string> list = new List<string>();
			list.AddRange(RSIStrategy.BasedOn(dataSource, supportingCalculations));
			return list;
		}

		public override bool CalculateIndicator(FinancialCalculationDataSource dataSource, FinancialCalculationSupportingCalculations supportingCalculations)
		{
			IEnumerator<double> enumerator = RSIStrategy.ProvideStream(dataSource, supportingCalculations).GetEnumerator();
			int period = dataSource.Period;
			int num = 0;
			double[] array = new double[period];
			for (num = 0; num < period; num++)
			{
				array[num] = 0.0;
			}
			num = 0;
			while (enumerator.MoveNext())
			{
				int num2 = Math.Min(period, num);
				double num3 = double.MinValue;
				double num4 = double.MaxValue;
				int num5 = num % period;
				for (int i = 0; i < num2; i++)
				{
					if (!double.IsNaN(array[num2 - i - 1]))
					{
						num3 = Math.Max(num3, array[num2 - i - 1]);
					}
					if (!double.IsNaN(array[num2 - i - 1]))
					{
						num4 = Math.Min(num4, array[num2 - i - 1]);
					}
				}
				array[num5] = enumerator.Current;
				double value = supportingCalculations.MakeSafe((enumerator.Current - num4) / (num3 - num4));
				dataSource.IndicatorColumn[num] = value;
				num++;
			}
			return true;
		}
	}

	public class UltimateOscillatorIndicatorCalculationStrategy : IndicatorCalculationStrategy
	{
		public override IList<string> BasedOn(FinancialCalculationDataSource dataSource, FinancialCalculationSupportingCalculations supportingCalculations)
		{
			List<string> list = new List<string>();
			list.AddRange(dataSource.TrueLow.BasedOn);

			list.AddRange(supportingCalculations.MovingSum.BasedOn);
			return list;
		}

		protected List<double> BuyingPressure(FinancialCalculationDataSource dataSource)
		{
			int num = 0;
			List<double> list = new List<double>();
			IEnumerator<double> enumerator = dataSource.TrueLow.GetEnumerator();
			while (enumerator.MoveNext())
			{
				list.Add(dataSource.CloseColumn[num] - enumerator.Current);
				num++;
			}
			return list;
		}

		public override bool CalculateIndicator(FinancialCalculationDataSource dataSource, FinancialCalculationSupportingCalculations supportingCalculations)
		{
			IEnumerable<double> source = BuyingPressure(dataSource);
			IEnumerable<double> trueRange = dataSource.TrueRange;
			IEnumerator<double> enumerator = supportingCalculations.MovingSum.Strategy(source, 7).GetEnumerator();
			IEnumerator<double> enumerator2 = supportingCalculations.MovingSum.Strategy(trueRange, 7).GetEnumerator();
			IEnumerator<double> enumerator3 = supportingCalculations.MovingSum.Strategy(source, 14).GetEnumerator();
			IEnumerator<double> enumerator4 = supportingCalculations.MovingSum.Strategy(trueRange, 14).GetEnumerator();
			IEnumerator<double> enumerator5 = supportingCalculations.MovingSum.Strategy(source, 28).GetEnumerator();
			IEnumerator<double> enumerator6 = supportingCalculations.MovingSum.Strategy(trueRange, 28).GetEnumerator();
			int num = 0;
			while (enumerator.MoveNext() && enumerator2.MoveNext() && enumerator3.MoveNext() && enumerator4.MoveNext() && enumerator5.MoveNext() && enumerator6.MoveNext())
			{
				double value = supportingCalculations.MakeSafe(4.0 * (enumerator.Current / enumerator2.Current) + 2.0 * (enumerator3.Current / enumerator4.Current) + enumerator5.Current / enumerator6.Current) / 7.0 * 100.0;
				dataSource.IndicatorColumn[num] = value;
				num++;
			}
			return true;
		}
	}
	public class WeightedCloseIndicatorStrategy : ItemwiseIndicatorCalculationStrategy
	{
		public override IList<string> BasedOn(FinancialCalculationDataSource dataSource, FinancialCalculationSupportingCalculations supportingCalculations)

			return new List<string> { "HighColumn", "LowColumn", "CloseColumn" };
		}

		public override bool CalculateIndicatorItem(FinancialCalculationDataSource dataSource, FinancialCalculationSupportingCalculations supportingCalculations, int currentIndex)
		{
			dataSource.IndicatorColumn[currentIndex] = (dataSource.HighColumn[currentIndex] + dataSource.LowColumn[currentIndex] + dataSource.CloseColumn[currentIndex] * 2.0) / 4.0;

	}
	public class WilliamsPercentRIndicatorStrategy : IndicatorCalculationStrategy
	{
		public override IList<string> BasedOn(FinancialCalculationDataSource dataSource, FinancialCalculationSupportingCalculations supportingCalculations)
		{
			return new List<string> { "HighColumn", "LowColumn", "CloseColumn" };
		}

		public override bool CalculateIndicator(FinancialCalculationDataSource dataSource, FinancialCalculationSupportingCalculations supportingCalculations)
		{
			int period = dataSource.Period;
			IList<double> highColumn = dataSource.HighColumn;
			IList<double> lowColumn = dataSource.LowColumn;
			for (int i = 0; i < dataSource.Count; i++)
			{
				int num = Math.Min(period, i);
				double num2 = double.MinValue;
				double num3 = double.MaxValue;
				for (int j = 0; j < num; j++)
				{
					if (!double.IsNaN(highColumn[i - j]))
					{
						num2 = Math.Max(num2, highColumn[i - j]);
					}
					if (!double.IsNaN(lowColumn[i - j]))
					{
						num3 = Math.Min(num3, lowColumn[i - j]);
					}
				}
				dataSource.IndicatorColumn[i] = supportingCalculations.MakeSafe((dataSource.CloseColumn[i] - num2) / (num2 - num3) * 100.0);
			}
			return true;
		}
	}

			InnerLabelBounds = RectData.FromRect(Rect.Empty);
		}

		public void ScaleByViewport(RectData viewport)
		{
			if (Appearance != null)
			{
				Appearance.ScaleByViewport(viewport);
			}
			if (OuterLabelBounds != null)
			{
				double num = (OuterLabelBounds.Left - viewport.Left) / viewport.Width;
				double num2 = (OuterLabelBounds.Left + OuterLabelBounds.Width - viewport.Left) / viewport.Width;
				double num3 = (OuterLabelBounds.Top - viewport.Top) / viewport.Height;
				double num4 = (OuterLabelBounds.Top + OuterLabelBounds.Height - viewport.Top) / viewport.Height;
				OuterLabelBounds = new RectData(num, num3, num2 - num, num4 - num3);
			}
			if (OuterLabelPosition != null)
			{
				double x = (OuterLabelPosition.X - viewport.Left) / viewport.Width;
				double y = (OuterLabelPosition.Y - viewport.Top) / viewport.Height;
				OuterLabelPosition = new PointData(x, y);
			}
			if (InnerLabelBounds != null)
			{
				double num5 = (InnerLabelBounds.Left - viewport.Left) / viewport.Width;
				double num6 = (InnerLabelBounds.Left + InnerLabelBounds.Width - viewport.Left) / viewport.Width;
				double num7 = (InnerLabelBounds.Top - viewport.Top) / viewport.Height;
				double num8 = (InnerLabelBounds.Top + InnerLabelBounds.Height - viewport.Top) / viewport.Height;
				InnerLabelBounds = new RectData(num5, num7, num6 - num5, num8 - num7);
			}
			if (InnerLabelPosition != null)
			{
				double x2 = (InnerLabelPosition.X - viewport.Left) / viewport.Width;
				double y2 = (InnerLabelPosition.Y - viewport.Top) / viewport.Height;
				InnerLabelPosition = new PointData(x2, y2);
			}
			PointData[] array = new PointData[SlicePoints.Length];
			int num9 = 0;
			PointData[] slicePoints = SlicePoints;
			foreach (PointData obj in slicePoints)
			{
				double x3 = (obj.X - viewport.Left) / viewport.Width;
				double y3 = (obj.Y - viewport.Top) / viewport.Height;
				array[num9] = new PointData(x3, y3);
				num9++;
			}
			SlicePoints = array;
		}

		public string Serialize()
		{
			StringBuilder stringBuilder = new StringBuilder();
			stringBuilder.AppendLine("{");
			stringBuilder.AppendLine("index: " + Index + ", ");
			if (InnerLabel != null)
			{
				stringBuilder.AppendLine("innerLabel: \"" + InnerLabel + "\", ");
			}
			if (OuterLabel != null)
			{
				stringBuilder.AppendLine("outerLabel: \"" + InnerLabel + "\", ");
			}
			if (Appearance != null)
			{
				stringBuilder.AppendLine("appearance: " + Appearance.Serialize() + ", ");
			}
			if (InnerLabelAppearance != null)
			{
				stringBuilder.AppendLine("innerLabelAppearance: " + InnerLabelAppearance.Serialize() + ", ");
			}
			if (OuterLabelAppearance != null)
			{
				stringBuilder.AppendLine("outerLabelAppearance: " + OuterLabelAppearance.Serialize() + ", ");
			}
			if (SlicePoints != null)
			{
				stringBuilder.AppendLine("slicePoints: [");
				for (int i = 0; i < SlicePoints.Length; i++)
				{
					stringBuilder.AppendLine("{ x: " + SlicePoints[i].X + ", y: " + SlicePoints[i].Y + " }");
					if (i < SlicePoints.Length - 1)
					{
						stringBuilder.Append(",");
					}
				}
				stringBuilder.AppendLine("], ");
			}
			if (InnerLabelBounds != null)
			{
				stringBuilder.AppendLine("innerLabelBounds: { left: " + InnerLabelBounds.Left + ", top: " + InnerLabelBounds.Top + ", width: " + InnerLabelBounds.Width + ", height: " + InnerLabelBounds.Height + "}, ");
			}
			if (OuterLabelBounds != null)
			{
				stringBuilder.AppendLine("outerLabelBounds: { left: " + OuterLabelBounds.Left + ", top: " + OuterLabelBounds.Top + ", width: " + OuterLabelBounds.Width + ", height: " + OuterLabelBounds.Height + "}, ");
			}
			if (InnerLabelPosition != null)
			{
				stringBuilder.AppendLine("innerLabelPosition: { x: " + InnerLabelPosition.X + ", y: " + InnerLabelPosition.Y + "}, ");
			}
			if (OuterLabelPosition != null)
			{
				stringBuilder.AppendLine("outerLabelPosition: { x: " + OuterLabelPosition.X + ", y: " + OuterLabelPosition.Y + "}, ");
			}
			stringBuilder.AppendLine("isSelected: " + (IsSelected ? "true" : "false"));
			stringBuilder.AppendLine("}");
			return stringBuilder.ToString();
		}
	}

	[DontObfuscate]
	public class DoughnutChartVisualData
	{
		public RingSeriesVisualDataList Series { get; set; }

		public double Height { get; set; }

		public double Width { get; set; }

		public double HoleRadius { get; set; }

		public double DipScalingRatio { get; set; }

		public RectData Viewport { get; set; }

		public DoughnutChartVisualData()
		{
			DipScalingRatio = 1.0;
		}

		public virtual void ScaleByViewport()
		{
			if (Series == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			foreach (RingSeriesVisualData item in Series)
			{
				foreach (RingVisualData ring in item.Rings)
				{
					foreach (ArcVisualData arc in ring.Arcs)
					{
						foreach (SliceVisualData slice in arc.Slices)
						{
							slice.ScaleByViewport(Viewport);
						}
					}
				}
			}
		}

		public string Serialize()
		{
			StringBuilder stringBuilder = new StringBuilder();
			bool flag = true;
			stringBuilder.AppendLine("{");
			if (!double.IsNaN(Width))
			{
				if (flag)
				{
					flag = false;
				}
				else
				{
					stringBuilder.Append(", ");
				}
				stringBuilder.Append("width: ");
				stringBuilder.AppendLine(Width.ToString());
			}
			if (!double.IsNaN(Height))
			{
				if (flag)
				{
					flag = false;
				}
				else
				{
					stringBuilder.Append(", ");
				}
				stringBuilder.Append("height: ");
				stringBuilder.AppendLine(Height.ToString());
			}
			if (!double.IsNaN(HoleRadius))
			{
				if (flag)
				{
					flag = false;
				}
				else
				{
					stringBuilder.Append(", ");
				}
				stringBuilder.Append("holeRadius: ");
				stringBuilder.AppendLine(HoleRadius.ToString());
			}
			if (Viewport != null)
			{
				if (flag)
				{
					flag = false;
				}
				else
				{
					stringBuilder.Append(", ");
				}
				stringBuilder.AppendLine("viewport: {");
				stringBuilder.Append("left: " + Viewport.Left + ", top: " + Viewport.Top + ", width: " + Viewport.Width + ", height: " + Viewport.Height);
				stringBuilder.AppendLine("}");
			}
			if (Series != null)
			{
				if (flag)
				{
					flag = false;
				}
				else
				{
					stringBuilder.Append(", ");
				}
				stringBuilder.AppendLine("series: [");
				for (int i = 0; i < Series.Count; i++)
				{
					if (i != 0)
					{
						stringBuilder.Append(", ");
					}
					stringBuilder.Append(Series[i].Serialize());
				}
				stringBuilder.AppendLine("]");
			}
			if (!flag)
			{
				stringBuilder.Append(", ");
			}
			stringBuilder.Append("dipScalingRatio: " + DipScalingRatio);
			stringBuilder.AppendLine("}");
			return stringBuilder.ToString();
		}

	public class PieChartVisualData
	{
		public PieSliceVisualDataList Slices { get; set; }

		public PieSliceVisualData OthersSlice { get; set; }

		public string Name { get; set; }

		public RectData Viewport { get; set; }

		public double Width { get; set; }

		public double Height { get; set; }

		public List<object> Others { get; set; }

		public double RadiusFactor { get; set; }

		public double LeaderLineMargin { get; set; }

		public bool IsViewportScaled { get; set; }

		public double DipScalingRatio { get; set; }

		public PieChartVisualData()
		{
			Slices = new PieSliceVisualDataList();
			Others = new List<object>();
			DipScalingRatio = 1.0;
		}

		public void ScaleByViewport()
		{
			if (!IsViewportScaled)
			{
				IsViewportScaled = true;
				for (int i = 0; i < Slices.Count; i++)
				{
					Slices[i].ScaleByViewport(Viewport);
				}
				if (OthersSlice != null)
				{
					OthersSlice.ScaleByViewport(Viewport);
				}
			}
		}

		public string Serialize()
		{
			StringBuilder stringBuilder = new StringBuilder();
			stringBuilder.AppendLine("{");
			stringBuilder.AppendLine("name: " + Name + ",");
			stringBuilder.AppendLine("leaderLineMargin: " + LeaderLineMargin + ",");
			stringBuilder.AppendLine("radiusFactor: " + RadiusFactor + ",");
			stringBuilder.AppendLine("width: " + Width + ",");
			stringBuilder.AppendLine("height: " + Height + ",");
			stringBuilder.AppendLine("isViewportScaled: " + (IsViewportScaled ? "true" : "false") + ", ");
			stringBuilder.AppendLine("slices: [");
			for (int i = 0; i < Slices.Count; i++)
			{
				if (i != 0)
				{
					stringBuilder.Append(", ");
				}
				stringBuilder.Append(Slices[i].Serialize());
			}
			stringBuilder.AppendLine("],");
			stringBuilder.AppendLine("viewport: { left: " + Viewport.Left + ", top: " + Viewport.Top + ", width: " + Viewport.Width + ", height: " + Viewport.Height + "}");
			stringBuilder.Append(", dipScalingRatio: " + DipScalingRatio);
			stringBuilder.AppendLine("}");
			return stringBuilder.ToString();
		}
	}

	[DontObfuscate]
	public class PieSliceVisualData
	{
		public double StartAngle { get; set; }

		public double EndAngle { get; set; }

		public PointData Origin { get; set; }

		public PointData ExplodedOrigin { get; set; }

		public double Radius { get; set; }

		public double ExplodedRadius { get; set; }

		public double InnerExtentStart { get; set; }

		public double InnerExtentEnd { get; set; }

		public bool IsSelected { get; set; }

		public bool IsExploded { get; set; }

		public bool IsOthersSlice { get; set; }

		public int Index { get; set; }

		public string Label { get; set; }

		public double LabelAngle { get; set; }

		public RectData LabelBounds { get; set; }

		public PrimitiveAppearanceData Appearance { get; set; }

		public LabelAppearanceData LabelAppearance { get; set; }

		public PrimitiveAppearanceData LeaderLineAppearance { get; set; }

		public PathVisualData SlicePath { get; set; }

		public PathVisualData LeaderLinePath { get; set; }

		public PieSliceVisualData()
		{
			LabelBounds = RectData.Empty;
		}

		public void ScaleByViewport(RectData viewport)
		{
			if (SlicePath != null)
			{
				SlicePath.ScaleByViewport(viewport);
			}
			if (LeaderLinePath != null)
			{
				LeaderLinePath.ScaleByViewport(viewport);
			}
			if (!LabelBounds.IsEmpty)
			{
				double num = (LabelBounds.Left - viewport.Left) / viewport.Width;
				double num2 = (LabelBounds.Top - viewport.Top) / viewport.Height;
				double num3 = (LabelBounds.Left + LabelBounds.Width - viewport.Left) / viewport.Width;
				double num4 = (LabelBounds.Top + LabelBounds.Height - viewport.Top) / viewport.Height;
				LabelBounds = new RectData(num, num2, num3 - num, num4 - num2);
			}
			if (Origin != null)
			{
				Origin = new PointData((Origin.X - viewport.Left) / viewport.Width, (Origin.Y - viewport.Top) / viewport.Height);
			}
			if (ExplodedOrigin != null)
			{
				ExplodedOrigin = new PointData((ExplodedOrigin.X - viewport.Left) / viewport.Width, (ExplodedOrigin.Y - viewport.Top) / viewport.Height);
			}
		}

		public string Serialize()
		{
			StringBuilder stringBuilder = new StringBuilder();
			stringBuilder.AppendLine("{");
			if (Label != null)
			{
				stringBuilder.AppendLine("label: \"" + Label + "\", ");
			}
			if (Appearance != null)
			{
				stringBuilder.AppendLine("appearance: " + Appearance.Serialize() + ", ");
			}
			if (LabelAppearance != null)
			{
				stringBuilder.AppendLine("labelAppearance: " + LabelAppearance.Serialize() + ", ");
			}
			if (LeaderLineAppearance != null)
			{
				stringBuilder.AppendLine("leaderLineAppearance: " + LeaderLineAppearance.Serialize() + ", ");
			}
			if (SlicePath != null)
			{
				stringBuilder.AppendLine("slicePath: " + SlicePath.Serialize() + ", ");
			}
			if (LeaderLinePath != null)
			{
				string text = LeaderLinePath.Serialize();
				if (text != null)
				{
					stringBuilder.AppendLine("leaderLinePath: " + text + ", ");
				}
			}
			stringBuilder.AppendLine("labelAngle: " + LabelAngle + ", ");
			stringBuilder.AppendLine("labelBounds: { left: " + LabelBounds.Left + ", top: " + LabelBounds.Top + ", width: " + LabelBounds.Width + ", height: " + LabelBounds.Height + "}");
			stringBuilder.AppendLine("}");
			return stringBuilder.ToString();
		}
	}
	[DontObfuscate]
	public class ChartVisualData
	{
		public AxisVisualDataList Axes { get; set; }

		public SeriesVisualDataList Series { get; set; }

		public ChartTitleVisualData Title { get; set; }

		public ChartTitleVisualData Subtitle { get; set; }

		public double Width { get; set; }

		public double Height { get; set; }

		public RectData ContentArea { get; set; }

		public RectData CentralArea { get; set; }

		public RectData PlotArea { get; set; }

		public string Name { get; set; }

		public bool IsViewportScaled { get; set; }

		public Popup DefaultTooltip { get; set; }

		public double DipScalingRatio { get; set; }

		public ChartVisualData()
		{
			DipScalingRatio = 1.0;
			Axes = new AxisVisualDataList();
			Series = new SeriesVisualDataList();
		}

		public void ScaleByViewport()
		{
			foreach (AxisVisualData axis in Axes)
			{
				axis.ScaleByViewport();
			}
			foreach (SeriesVisualData item in Series)
			{
				item.ScaleByViewport();
			}
			if (Title != null)
			{
				Title.ScaleByViewport();
			}
			if (Subtitle != null)
			{
				Subtitle.ScaleByViewport();
			}
		}

		public RectData GetBounds()
		{
			return new RectData(0.0, 0.0, Width, Height);
		}

		public string Serialize()
		{
			StringBuilder stringBuilder = new StringBuilder();
			stringBuilder.AppendLine("{");
			if (Name != null)
			{
				stringBuilder.AppendLine("name: '" + Name + "',");
			}
			stringBuilder.AppendLine("width: " + Width + ",");
			stringBuilder.AppendLine("height: " + Height + ",");
			stringBuilder.AppendLine("plotArea: { left: " + PlotArea.Left + ", top: " + PlotArea.Top + ", width: " + PlotArea.Width + ", height: " + PlotArea.Height + "}, ");
			stringBuilder.AppendLine("contentArea: { left: " + ContentArea.Left + ", top: " + ContentArea.Top + ", width: " + ContentArea.Width + ", height: " + ContentArea.Height + "}, ");
			stringBuilder.AppendLine("centralArea: { left: " + CentralArea.Left + ", top: " + CentralArea.Top + ", width: " + CentralArea.Width + ", height: " + CentralArea.Height + "}, ");
			stringBuilder.AppendLine("isViewportScaled: " + (IsViewportScaled ? "true" : "false") + ", ");
			stringBuilder.AppendLine("axes: [");
			for (int i = 0; i < Axes.Count; i++)
			{
				if (i != 0)
				{
					stringBuilder.Append(", ");
				}
				stringBuilder.Append(Axes[i].Serialize());
			}
			stringBuilder.AppendLine("],");
			stringBuilder.AppendLine("series: [");
			for (int j = 0; j < Series.Count; j++)
			{
				if (j != 0)
				{
					stringBuilder.Append(", ");
				}
				stringBuilder.Append(Series[j].Serialize());
			}
			stringBuilder.AppendLine("]");
			if (Title != null)
			{
				stringBuilder.AppendLine(", title: " + Title.Serialize());
			}
			if (Subtitle != null)
			{
				stringBuilder.AppendLine(", subtitle: " + Subtitle.Serialize());
			}
			stringBuilder.Append(", dipScalingRatio: " + DipScalingRatio);
			stringBuilder.AppendLine("}");
			return stringBuilder.ToString();
		}

		public string GetSerializedSeriesPoints(string seriesName, string tag, GetPointsSettings settings)
		{
			List<List<PointData>> list = new List<List<PointData>>();
			for (int i = 0; i < Series.Count; i++)
			{
				if (Series[i].Name == seriesName)
				{
					PrimitiveVisualDataList primitiveVisualDataList = Series[i].Shapes.ContainingTag(tag);
					for (int j = 0; j < primitiveVisualDataList.Count; j++)
					{
						primitiveVisualDataList[i].GetPointsOverride(list, settings);
					}
				}
			}
			StringBuilder stringBuilder = new StringBuilder();
			stringBuilder.AppendLine("[");
			for (int k = 0; k < list.Count; k++)
			{
				List<PointData> list2 = list[k];
				stringBuilder.AppendLine("[");
				for (int l = 0; l < list2.Count; l++)
				{
					if (l != 0)
					{
						stringBuilder.Append(", ");
					}
					stringBuilder.Append("{ x: " + list2[l].X + ", y: " + list2[l].Y + "}");
				}
				stringBuilder.AppendLine("]");
			}
			stringBuilder.AppendLine("]");
			return stringBuilder.ToString();
		}
	}

			StringBuilder stringBuilder = new StringBuilder();
			stringBuilder.AppendLine("{");
			stringBuilder.AppendLine("viewport: " + Viewport.Serialize() + ", ");

			stringBuilder.AppendLine("}");
			return stringBuilder.ToString();

		internal void ScaleByViewport(RectData viewport)
		{
			double left = (TextPlotArea.Left - viewport.Left) / viewport.Width;
			double top = (TextPlotArea.Top - viewport.Top) / viewport.Height;
			double width = TextPlotArea.Width / viewport.Width;
			double height = TextPlotArea.Height / viewport.Height;
			TextPlotArea = new RectData(left, top, width, height);
		}

		internal void ScaleByViewport()
		{
			double left = (TextPlotArea.Left - Viewport.Left) / Viewport.Width;
			double top = (TextPlotArea.Top - Viewport.Top) / Viewport.Height;
			double width = TextPlotArea.Width / Viewport.Width;
			double height = TextPlotArea.Height / Viewport.Height;
			TextPlotArea = new RectData(left, top, width, height);
		}

		internal void UnScaleByViewport(Rect viewport)
		{
			double left = TextPlotArea.Left * viewport.Width;
			double top = TextPlotArea.Top * viewport.Height;
			double width = TextPlotArea.Width * viewport.Width;
			double height = TextPlotArea.Height * viewport.Height;
			TextPlotArea = new RectData(left, top, width, height);
		}

		internal void UnScaleByViewport()
		{
			double left = TextPlotArea.Left * Viewport.Width;
			double top = TextPlotArea.Top * Viewport.Height;
			double width = TextPlotArea.Width * Viewport.Width;
			double height = TextPlotArea.Height * Viewport.Height;
			TextPlotArea = new RectData(left, top, width, height);
		}
	}

	[DontObfuscate]
	public class SeriesVisualData
	{
		public string Name { get; set; }

		public string Type { get; set; }

		public RectData Viewport { get; set; }

		public double Opacity { get; set; }

		public PrimitiveVisualDataList Shapes { get; set; }

		public PointerTooltipVisualDataList PointerTooltips { get; set; }

		public MarkerVisualDataList MarkerShapes { get; set; }

		public CalloutVisualDataList CalloutShapes { get; set; }

		public int[] Pixels { get; set; }

		public int PixelWidth { get; set; }

		public int PixelHeight { get; set; }

		public SeriesVisualData()
		{
			Shapes = new PrimitiveVisualDataList();
			MarkerShapes = new MarkerVisualDataList();
			PointerTooltips = new PointerTooltipVisualDataList();
			CalloutShapes = new CalloutVisualDataList();
		}

		internal virtual void ScaleByViewport()
		{
			foreach (PrimitiveVisualData shape in Shapes)
			{
				shape.ScaleByViewport(Viewport);
			}
			foreach (MarkerVisualData markerShape in MarkerShapes)
			{
				markerShape.ScaleByViewport(Viewport);
			}
			foreach (PointerTooltipVisualData pointerTooltip in PointerTooltips)
			{
				pointerTooltip.ScaleByViewport(Viewport);
			}
			foreach (CalloutVisualData calloutShape in CalloutShapes)
			{
				calloutShape.ScaleByViewport(Viewport);
			}
		}

		public virtual string Serialize()
		{
			StringBuilder stringBuilder = new StringBuilder();
			stringBuilder.AppendLine("{");
			if (Name != null)
			{
				stringBuilder.AppendLine("name: \"" + Name + "\",");
			}
			stringBuilder.AppendLine("type: \"" + Type + "\", ");
			stringBuilder.AppendLine("opacity: " + Opacity + ", ");
			stringBuilder.AppendLine("viewport: { left: " + Viewport.Left + ", top: " + Viewport.Top + ", width: " + Viewport.Width + ", height: " + Viewport.Height + "}, ");
			stringBuilder.AppendLine("shapes: [");
			for (int i = 0; i < Shapes.Count; i++)
			{
				if (i != 0)
				{
					stringBuilder.Append(", ");
				}
				stringBuilder.Append(Shapes[i].Serialize());
			}
			stringBuilder.AppendLine("],");
			stringBuilder.AppendLine("pointerTooltips: [");
			for (int j = 0; j < PointerTooltips.Count; j++)
			{
				if (j != 0)
				{
					stringBuilder.Append(", ");
				}
				stringBuilder.Append(PointerTooltips[j].Serialize());
			}
			stringBuilder.AppendLine("],");
			if (CalloutShapes != null && CalloutShapes.Count > 0)
			{
				stringBuilder.AppendLine("calloutshapes: [");
				for (int k = 0; k < CalloutShapes.Count; k++)
				{
					if (k != 0)
					{
						stringBuilder.Append(", ");
					}
					stringBuilder.Append(CalloutShapes[k].Serialize());
				}
				stringBuilder.AppendLine("],");
			}
			stringBuilder.AppendLine("markerShapes: [");
			for (int l = 0; l < MarkerShapes.Count; l++)
			{
				if (l != 0)
				{
					stringBuilder.Append(", ");
				}
				stringBuilder.Append(MarkerShapes[l].Serialize());
			}
			stringBuilder.AppendLine("]");
			SerializeExtraProperties(stringBuilder);
			if (Pixels != null)
			{
				stringBuilder.AppendLine(", pixels: [");
				for (int m = 0; m < Pixels.Length; m++)
				{
					if (m != 0)
					{
						stringBuilder.Append(", ");
					}
					stringBuilder.Append(Pixels[m].ToString());
				}
				stringBuilder.AppendLine("], ");
				stringBuilder.AppendLine("pixelWidth: " + PixelWidth + ", ");
			}
			stringBuilder.AppendLine("}");
			return stringBuilder.ToString();
		}

		internal virtual void SerializeExtraProperties(StringBuilder sb)
		{
		}
	}

			if (Bounds != null)
			{
				double num = (Bounds.Left - viewport.Left) / viewport.Width;
				double num2 = (Bounds.Top - viewport.Top) / viewport.Height;
				double num3 = (Bounds.Left + Bounds.Width - viewport.Left) / viewport.Width;
				double num4 = (Bounds.Top + Bounds.Height - viewport.Top) / viewport.Height;
				Bounds = new RectData(num, num2, num3 - num, num4 - num2);
			}
		}
