	[DontObfuscate]
	public class AxisVisualData
	{
		public string Name { get; set; }

		public string Type { get; set; }

		public RectData Viewport { get; set; }

		public double TickMarksLength { get; set; }

		public PrimitiveVisualData TickMarks { get; set; }

		public AxisLabelVisualDataList Labels { get; set; }

		public PrimitiveVisualData AxisLine { get; set; }

		public PrimitiveVisualData MajorLines { get; set; }

		public PrimitiveVisualData MinorLines { get; set; }

		public PrimitiveVisualData Strips { get; set; }

		public RectData LabelsPlotArea { get; set; }

		public RectData LabelsViewport { get; set; }

		public ChartTitleVisualData Title { get; set; }

		public List<RectangleVisualData> AnnotationBackings { get; set; }

		public AxisVisualData()
		{
			TickMarksLength = 0.0;
			Labels = new AxisLabelVisualDataList();
			Title = new ChartTitleVisualData();
		}

		internal void ScaleByViewport()
		{
			bool isHorizontal = true;
			if (Type.Equals("NumericYAxis") || Type.Equals("CategoryYAxis") || Type.Equals("PercentChangeYAxis"))
			{
				isHorizontal = false;
			}
			foreach (AxisLabelVisualData label in Labels)
			{
				label.ScaleByViewport(LabelsViewport, isHorizontal);
			}
			TickMarks.ScaleByViewport(LabelsViewport);
			AxisLine.ScaleByViewport(LabelsViewport);
			if (Title != null)
			{
				Title.ScaleByViewport(LabelsViewport);
			}
			MajorLines.ScaleByViewport(Viewport);
			MinorLines.ScaleByViewport(Viewport);
			Strips.ScaleByViewport(Viewport);
			if (AnnotationBackings == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			foreach (RectangleVisualData annotationBacking in AnnotationBackings)
			{
				annotationBacking.ScaleByViewport(LabelsViewport);
			}
		}

		public string Serialize()
		{
			StringBuilder stringBuilder = new StringBuilder();
			stringBuilder.AppendLine("{");
			if (Name != null)
			{
				stringBuilder.AppendLine("name: \"" + Name + "\",");
			}
			stringBuilder.AppendLine("type: \"" + Type + "\", ");
			stringBuilder.AppendLine("tickMarksLength: \"" + TickMarksLength + "\", ");
			stringBuilder.AppendLine("viewport: " + Viewport.Serialize() + ", ");
			stringBuilder.AppendLine("labelsViewport: " + LabelsViewport.Serialize() + ", ");
			if (LabelsPlotArea != null)
			{
				stringBuilder.AppendLine("labelsPlotArea: " + LabelsPlotArea.Serialize() + ", ");
			}
			stringBuilder.AppendLine("labels: [");
			for (int i = 0; i < Labels.Count; i++)
			{
				if (i != 0)
				{
					stringBuilder.Append(", ");
				}
				stringBuilder.Append(Labels[i].Serialize());
			}
			stringBuilder.AppendLine("],");
			if (Title != null)
			{
				stringBuilder.AppendLine("title: " + ((Title != null) ? Title.Serialize() : "null") + ", ");
			}
			stringBuilder.AppendLine("axisLine: " + ((AxisLine != null) ? AxisLine.Serialize() : "null") + ", ");
			stringBuilder.AppendLine("tickMarks: " + ((TickMarks != null) ? TickMarks.Serialize() : "null") + ", ");
			if (AnnotationBackings != null)
			{
				stringBuilder.AppendLine("annotationBackings: [");
				for (int j = 0; j < AnnotationBackings.Count; j++)
				{
					if (j != 0)
					{
						stringBuilder.Append(", ");
					}
					stringBuilder.Append(AnnotationBackings[j].Serialize());
				}
				stringBuilder.AppendLine("],");
			}
			if (AxisLine != null)
			{
				stringBuilder.AppendLine("majorLines: " + ((MajorLines != null) ? MajorLines.Serialize() : "null") + ", ");
				stringBuilder.AppendLine("minorLines: " + ((MinorLines != null) ? MinorLines.Serialize() : "null") + ", ");
				stringBuilder.AppendLine("strips: " + ((Strips != null) ? Strips.Serialize() : "null"));
			}
			stringBuilder.AppendLine("}");
			return stringBuilder.ToString();
		}
	}

	[DontObfuscate]
	public class AxisLabelVisualData
	{
		public object LabelValue { get; set; }

		public double LabelPosition { get; set; }

		public PointData Position { get; set; }

		public PointData PanelPosition { get; set; }

		public LabelAppearanceData Appearance { get; set; }

		public SizeData Size { get; set; }

		public AxisLabelVisualData()
		{
			Position = new PointData(double.NaN, double.NaN);
			Size = new SizeData(double.NaN, double.NaN);
			PanelPosition = new PointData(double.NaN, double.NaN);
		}

		public string Serialize()
		{
			StringBuilder stringBuilder = new StringBuilder();
			stringBuilder.AppendLine("{");
			stringBuilder.AppendLine("position: { x: " + Position.X + ", y: " + Position.Y + "},");
			stringBuilder.AppendLine("size: { width: " + Size.Width + ", height: " + Size.Height + "},");
			stringBuilder.AppendLine("labelPosition: " + LabelPosition + ",");
			stringBuilder.AppendLine("appearance: " + ((Appearance != null) ? Appearance.Serialize() : "null"));
			stringBuilder.AppendLine("}");
			return stringBuilder.ToString();
		}

		internal void ScaleByViewport(RectData viewport, bool isHorizontal)
		{
			if (isHorizontal)
			{
				LabelPosition = (LabelPosition - viewport.Left) / viewport.Width;
			}
			else
			{
				LabelPosition = (LabelPosition - viewport.Top) / viewport.Height;
			}
			double x = (Position.X - viewport.Left) / viewport.Width;
			double y = (Position.Y - viewport.Top) / viewport.Height;
			Position = new PointData(x, y);
			double width = Size.Width / viewport.Width;
			double height = Size.Height / viewport.Height;
			Size = new SizeData(width, height);
		}
	}

	[DontObfuscate]
	public class CalloutVisualData
	{
		public RectangleVisualData Background { get; set; }

		public LabelAppearanceData Text { get; set; }

		public LineVisualData Line { get; set; }

		public double Left { get; set; }

		public double Top { get; set; }

		public double MarginLeft { get; set; }

		public double MarginTop { get; set; }

		public string Serialize()
		{
			StringBuilder stringBuilder = new StringBuilder();
			stringBuilder.AppendLine("{");
			stringBuilder.AppendLine("left: " + Left + ",");
			stringBuilder.AppendLine("top: " + Top + ",");
			stringBuilder.AppendLine("marginLeft: " + MarginLeft + ",");
			stringBuilder.AppendLine("marginTop: " + MarginTop + ",");
			stringBuilder.AppendLine("background: " + Background.Serialize() + ",");
			stringBuilder.AppendLine("text: " + Text.Serialize() + ",");
			stringBuilder.AppendLine("line: " + Line.Serialize());
			stringBuilder.AppendLine("}");
			return stringBuilder.ToString();
		}

		public void ScaleByViewport(RectData viewport)
		{
			Left = (Left - viewport.Left) / viewport.Width;
			Top = (Top - viewport.Top) / viewport.Height;
			MarginLeft /= viewport.Width;
			MarginTop /= viewport.Height;
			Background.ScaleByViewport(viewport);
			Line.ScaleByViewport(viewport);
		}
	}
	[DontObfuscate]
	public class PointerTooltipVisualData
	{
		public RectangleVisualData BoxShape { get; set; }

		public PolygonVisualData PointerFillShape { get; set; }

		public PolyLineVisualData PointerOutlineShape { get; set; }

		public double OffsetX { get; set; }

		public double OffsetY { get; set; }

		public List<string> CategoryNames { get; set; }

		public RectData Viewport { get; set; }

		public string Serialize()
		{
			string text = "";
			if (CategoryNames != null)
			{
				foreach (string categoryName in CategoryNames)
				{
					text = text + "\"" + categoryName + "\",";
				}
				if (text != "")
				{
					text = text.Substring(0, text.Length - 1);
				}
			}
			StringBuilder stringBuilder = new StringBuilder();
			stringBuilder.AppendLine("{");
			stringBuilder.AppendLine("offsetX: " + OffsetX + ", ");
			stringBuilder.AppendLine("offsetY: " + OffsetY + ", ");
			stringBuilder.AppendLine("boxShape: " + BoxShape.Serialize() + ", ");
			stringBuilder.AppendLine("pointerFillShape: " + PointerFillShape.Serialize() + ", ");
			stringBuilder.AppendLine("viewport: { left: " + Viewport.Left + ", top: " + Viewport.Top + ", width: " + Viewport.Width + ", height: " + Viewport.Height + "}, ");
			stringBuilder.AppendLine("pointerOutlineShape: " + PointerOutlineShape.Serialize() + ", ");
			stringBuilder.AppendLine("categoryNames: [" + text + "]");
			stringBuilder.AppendLine("}");
			return stringBuilder.ToString();
		}

		public void ScaleByViewport(RectData viewport)
		{
			BoxShape.ScaleByViewport(Viewport);
			PointerFillShape.ScaleByViewport(Viewport);
			PointerOutlineShape.ScaleByViewport(Viewport);
			OffsetX = (OffsetX - viewport.Left) / viewport.Width;
			OffsetY = (OffsetY - viewport.Top) / viewport.Height;
		}
	}
	public class StackedSeriesVisualData : SeriesVisualData
	{
		public SeriesVisualDataList FragmentSeries { get; set; }

		public StackedSeriesVisualData()
		{
			FragmentSeries = new SeriesVisualDataList();
		}

		internal override void ScaleByViewport()
		{
			base.ScaleByViewport();
			for (int i = 0; i < FragmentSeries.Count; i++)
			{
				FragmentSeries[i].ScaleByViewport();
			}
		}

		internal override void SerializeExtraProperties(StringBuilder sb)
		{
			base.SerializeExtraProperties(sb);
			if (FragmentSeries == null || FragmentSeries.Count <= 0)
			{
				return;
			}
			sb.AppendLine(",");
			sb.AppendLine("fragmentSeries: [");
			for (int i = 0; i < FragmentSeries.Count; i++)
			{
				if (i > 0)
				{
					sb.AppendLine(",");
				}
				sb.Append(FragmentSeries[i].Serialize());
			}
			sb.AppendLine("]");
		}
	}
	internal static class VisualExportHelper
	{
		public static Rect GetRotatedBounds(TextBlock textBlock)
		{
			Point point = new Point(Canvas.GetLeft(textBlock), Canvas.GetTop(textBlock));
			Rect rect = new Rect(point.X, point.Y, textBlock.ActualWidth, textBlock.ActualHeight);
			Transform renderTransform = textBlock.RenderTransform;
			if (renderTransform == null)
			{
				return rect;
			}
			double angle = 0.0;
			double num = 0.0;
			double num2 = 0.0;
			RotateTransform rotateTransform = null;
			if (renderTransform is RotateTransform)
			{
				rotateTransform = renderTransform as RotateTransform;
				angle = rotateTransform.Angle;
			}
			else if (renderTransform is TransformGroup)
			{
				foreach (Transform child in (renderTransform as TransformGroup).Children)
				{
					if (child is RotateTransform)
					{
						rotateTransform = child as RotateTransform;
						angle = rotateTransform.Angle;
					}
					if (child is TranslateTransform)
					{
						TranslateTransform obj = child as TranslateTransform;
						num = obj.X;
						num2 = obj.Y;
					}
				}
			}
			if (rotateTransform != null)
			{
				rect = rect.RotateAboutPoint(rotateTransform.CenterX, rotateTransform.CenterY, angle);
			}
			rect.X += num;
			rect.Y += num2;
			return rect;
		}
	}
	internal static class VisualDataSerializer
	{
		public static string Serialize(this Rect rect)
		{
			return "{ left: " + rect.Left + ", top: " + rect.Top + ", width: " + rect.Width + ", height: " + rect.Height + " }";
		}
	}

	internal class MessageChannel
	{
		private Queue<Message> _sendQueue = new Queue<Message>();

		[Weak]
		private MessageChannel _connectedTo;

		private event MessageEventHandler MessageSent;

		public void SendMessage(Message message)
		{
			if (this.MessageSent != null)
			{
				this.MessageSent(message);
			}
			else
			{
				_sendQueue.Enqueue(message);
			}
		}

		public void AttachTarget(MessageEventHandler m)
		{
			MessageSent += m;
			while (_sendQueue.Count > 0)
			{
				Message message = _sendQueue.Dequeue();
				this.MessageSent(message);
			}
		}

		public void DetachTarget(MessageEventHandler m)
		{
			MessageSent -= m;
		}

		public void ConnectTo(MessageChannel m)
		{
			_connectedTo = m;
			AttachTarget(SendToNext);
		}

		public void DetachFromNext()
		{
			if (_connectedTo != null)
			{
				DetachTarget(SendToNext);
				_connectedTo = null;
			}
		}

		[Weak]
		public void SendToNext(Message m)
		{
			if (_connectedTo != null)
			{
				_connectedTo.SendMessage(m);
			}
		}

		public override string ToString()
		{
			StringBuilder stringBuilder = new StringBuilder();
			foreach (Message item in _sendQueue)
			{
				stringBuilder.AppendLine(item.ToString());
			}
			return stringBuilder.ToString();
		}
	}
	internal delegate void MessageEventHandler(Message message);
	internal class MessageHandler
	{
		private Dictionary<Type, MessageHandlerEventHandler> _dictionary = new Dictionary<Type, MessageHandlerEventHandler>();

		public void AddHandler(Type messageType, MessageHandlerEventHandler handler)
		{
			_dictionary.Add(messageType, handler);
		}

		public void MessageReceived(Message m)
		{
			if (_dictionary.TryGetValue(m.GetType(), out var value))
			{
				value(m);
			}
		}
	}
	internal delegate void MessageHandlerEventHandler(Message m);

namespace Infragistics.Controls.Charts.Util
{
	internal class CollisionAvoider : IDetectsCollisions
	{
		private List<Rect> rects = new List<Rect>();

		public bool TryAdd(Rect rc)
		{
			int num = rects.Count - 1;
			while (num >= 0 && !(rc.Left > rects[num].Right))
			{
				if (rects[num].IntersectsWith(rc))
				{
					return false;
				}
				num--;
			}
			if (rects.Count == 0 || rc.Right >= rects[rects.Count - 1].Right)
			{
				rects.Add(rc);
			}
			else
			{
				rects.Add(rc);
				rects.Sort((Rect a, Rect b) => Math.Sign(a.Right - b.Right));
			}
			return true;
		}

		public void Clear()
		{
			rects.Clear();
		}
	}
	internal interface IDetectsCollisions
	{
		bool TryAdd(Rect rc);

		void Clear();
	}

		{
			_target = target;

		internal double MakeSafe(double value)
		{
			if (double.IsInfinity(value) || double.IsNaN(value))
			{
				return 0.0;
			}
			return value;
		}

		[CatchesAll]
		private IEnumerable<double> MakeSafe()
		{
			if (_target == null)
			{
				yield break;
			}
			foreach (double item in _target)
			{
				yield return MakeSafe(item);
			}
		}

		public IEnumerator<double> GetEnumerator()
		{
			return MakeSafe().GetEnumerator();
		}

		IEnumerator IEnumerable.GetEnumerator()
		{
			return GetEnumerator();
		}
	}

	[EditorBrowsable(EditorBrowsableState.Never)]
	public class Partitioner : Numeric
	{
		private Partitioner()
		{
		}

		public static int PartitionByValue<T>(IList<T> values, T value, int begin, int end) where T : IComparable
		{
			int i = begin;
			for (int num = end; i <= num; i++)
			{
				for (; i <= num && values[i].CompareTo(value) <= 0; i++)
				{
				}
				while (i < num && values[num].CompareTo(value) > 0)
				{
					num--;
				}
				if (i < num)
				{
					Swap(values, i, num);
					num--;
				}
			}
			return i - 1;
		}

		public static int PartitionByValue<T>(IList<T> values, IList<int> indices, T value, int begin, int end) where T : IComparable
		{
			return PartitionByValue((int i) => values[i], indices, value, begin, end);
		}

		public static int PartitionByValue<T>(ComparableDelegate values, IList<int> indices, T value, int begin, int end) where T : IComparable
		{
			int i = begin;
			for (int num = end; i <= num; i++)
			{
				for (; i < num; i++)
				{
					IComparable obj = values(indices[i]);
					if (value.CompareTo(obj) < 0)
					{
						break;
					}
				}
				while (i < num)
				{
					IComparable obj2 = values(indices[num]);
					if (value.CompareTo(obj2) >= 0)
					{
						break;
					}
					num--;
				}
				if (i < num)
				{
					Swap(indices, i, num);
					num--;
				}
			}
			return i - 1;
		}

		public static T Partition<T>(IList<T> list, int k) where T : IComparable
		{
			return Partition(list, k, 0, list.Count);
		}

		public static T Partition<T>(IList<T> list, int k, int position, int count) where T : IComparable
		{
			int num = position;
			int num2 = position + count - 1;
			while (num2 > num + 1)
			{
				int a = num + num2 >> 1;
				Swap(list, a, num + 1);
				if (list[num].CompareTo(list[num2]) > 0)
				{
					Swap(list, num, num2);
				}
				if (list[num + 1].CompareTo(list[num2]) > 0)
				{
					Swap(list, num + 1, num2);
				}
				if (list[num].CompareTo(list[num + 1]) > 0)
				{
					Swap(list, num, num + 1);
				}
				int num3 = num + 1;
				int num4 = num2;
				T val = list[num + 1];
				while (true)
				{
					num3++;
					if (list[num3].CompareTo(val) >= 0)
					{
						do
						{
							num4--;
						}
						while (list[num4].CompareTo(val) > 0);
						if (num4 < num3)
						{
							break;
						}
						Swap(list, num3, num4);
					}
				}
				list[num + 1] = list[num4];
				list[num4] = val;
				if (num4 >= k)
				{
					num2 = num4 - 1;
				}
				if (num4 <= k)
				{
					num = num3;
				}
			}
			if (num2 == num + 1 && list[num2].CompareTo(list[num]) < 0)
			{
				Swap(list, num, num2);
			}
			return list[k];
		}

		public static T Partition<T>(IList<T> list, int k, IList<int> indices) where T : IComparable
		{
			return Partition(list, k, indices, 0, indices.Count);
		}

		public static T Partition<T>(IList<T> list, int k, IList<int> indices, int position, int count) where T : IComparable
		{
			int num = position;
			int num2 = position + count - 1;
			while (num2 > num + 1)
			{
				int a = num + num2 >> 1;
				Swap(indices, a, num + 1);
				if (list[indices[num]].CompareTo(list[indices[num2]]) > 0)
				{
					Swap(indices, num, num2);
				}
				if (list[indices[num + 1]].CompareTo(list[indices[num2]]) > 0)
				{
					Swap(indices, num + 1, num2);
				}
				if (list[indices[num]].CompareTo(list[indices[num + 1]]) > 0)
				{
					Swap(indices, num, num + 1);
				}
				int num3 = num + 1;
				int num4 = num2;
				int num5 = indices[num + 1];
				T val = list[num5];
				while (true)
				{
					num3++;
					if (list[indices[num3]].CompareTo(val) >= 0)
					{
						do
						{
							num4--;
						}
						while (list[indices[num4]].CompareTo(val) > 0);
						if (num4 < num3)
						{
							break;
						}
						Swap(indices, num3, num4);
					}
				}
				indices[num + 1] = indices[num4];
				indices[num4] = num5;
				if (num4 >= k)
				{
					num2 = num4 - 1;
				}
				if (num4 <= k)
				{
					num = num3;
				}
			}
			if (num2 == num + 1 && list[indices[num2]].CompareTo(list[indices[num]]) < 0)
			{
				Swap(indices, num, num2);
			}
			return list[indices[k]];
		}

		public static IComparable Partition(ComparableDelegate comparable, int k, IList<int> indices)
		{
			return Partition(comparable, k, indices, 0, indices.Count);
		}

		public static IComparable Partition(ComparableDelegate comparable, int k, IList<int> indices, int position, int count)
		{
			int num = position;
			int num2 = position + count - 1;
			while (num2 > num + 1)
			{
				int a = num + num2 >> 1;
				Swap(indices, a, num + 1);
				if (comparable(indices[num]).CompareTo(comparable(indices[num2])) > 0)
				{
					Swap(indices, num, num2);
				}
				if (comparable(indices[num + 1]).CompareTo(comparable(indices[num2])) > 0)
				{
					Swap(indices, num + 1, num2);
				}
				if (comparable(indices[num]).CompareTo(comparable(indices[num + 1])) > 0)
				{
					Swap(indices, num, num + 1);
				}
				int num3 = num + 1;
				int num4 = num2;
				int num5 = indices[num + 1];
				IComparable obj = comparable(num5);
				while (true)
				{
					num3++;
					if (comparable(indices[num3]).CompareTo(obj) >= 0)
					{
						do
						{
							num4--;
						}
						while (comparable(indices[num4]).CompareTo(obj) > 0);
						if (num4 < num3)
						{
							break;
						}
						Swap(indices, num3, num4);
					}
				}
				indices[num + 1] = indices[num4];
				indices[num4] = num5;
				if (num4 >= k)
				{
					num2 = num4 - 1;
				}
				if (num4 <= k)
				{
					num = num3;
				}
			}
			if (num2 == num + 1 && comparable(indices[num2]).CompareTo(comparable(indices[num])) < 0)
			{
				Swap(indices, num, num2);
			}
			return comparable(indices[k]);
		}

		private static void Swap<T>(IList<T> list, int a, int b)
		{
			T value = list[a];
			list[a] = list[b];
			list[b] = value;
		}
	}
	internal class Bezier
	{
		private double _resolution;

		private Point _p0;

		private Point _p1;

		private Point _p2;

		private Point _p3;

		private double _threshold = double.MaxValue;

		private Stack<BezierOp> _opStack = new Stack<BezierOp>();

		public double Resolution => _resolution;

		public Point P0 => _p0;

		public Point P1 => _p1;

		public Point P2 => _p2;

		public Point P3 => _p3;

		public bool Valid { get; set; }

		public List<BezierPoint> Points { get; set; }

		private List<BezierPoint> SortedPoints { get; set; }

		public Bezier(Point p0, Point p1, Point p2, Point p3, double resolution, double threshold)
		{
			_p0 = p0;
			_p1 = p1;
			_p2 = p2;
			_p3 = p3;
			_resolution = resolution;
			_threshold = threshold;
			Valid = Raseterize();
		}

		private BezierPoint Evaluate(double t)
		{
			double num = 1.0 - t;
			double num2 = num * num;
			double num3 = num2 * num;
			double num4 = t * t;
			double num5 = num4 * t;
			Point point = new Point(num3 * _p0.X + 3.0 * num2 * t * _p1.X + 3.0 * num * num4 * _p2.X + num5 * _p3.X, num3 * _p0.Y + 3.0 * num2 * t * _p1.Y + 3.0 * num * num4 * _p2.Y + num5 * _p3.Y);
			return new BezierPoint
			{
				Point = point,
				TValue = t
			};
		}

		private bool Raseterize()
		{
			Points = new List<BezierPoint>();
			SortedPoints = new List<BezierPoint>();
			BezierOp bezierOp = new BezierOp();
			bezierOp.Start = 0.0;
			bezierOp.End = 1.0;
			_opStack.Clear();
			_opStack.Push(bezierOp);
			int num = 0;
			while (_opStack.Count > 0)
			{
				BezierOp bezierOp2 = _opStack.Pop();
				BezierPoint bezierPoint = Evaluate(bezierOp2.Start);
				BezierPoint bezierPoint2 = Evaluate(bezierOp2.End);
				if ((bezierPoint2.Point.X - bezierPoint.Point.X) * (bezierPoint2.Point.X - bezierPoint.Point.X) + (bezierPoint2.Point.Y - bezierPoint.Point.Y) * (bezierPoint2.Point.Y - bezierPoint.Point.Y) < _resolution)
				{
					bezierPoint.Index = num++;
					bezierPoint2.Index = num++;
					Points.Add(bezierPoint);
					Points.Add(bezierPoint2);
					if (bezierPoint.Point.X > _threshold || bezierPoint2.Point.X > _threshold)
					{
						return false;
					}
				}
				else
				{
					double num2 = (bezierOp2.Start + bezierOp2.End) / 2.0;
					BezierOp bezierOp3 = new BezierOp();
					bezierOp3.Start = bezierOp2.Start;
					bezierOp3.End = num2;
					BezierOp bezierOp4 = new BezierOp();
					bezierOp4.Start = num2;
					bezierOp4.End = bezierOp2.End;
					_opStack.Push(bezierOp4);
					_opStack.Push(bezierOp3);
				}
			}
			foreach (BezierPoint point in Points)
			{
				SortedPoints.Add(point);
			}
			SortPoints();
			return true;
		}

		private void SortPoints()
		{
			SortedPoints.Sort((BezierPoint p1, BezierPoint p2) => ((IComparable)p1.Point.Y).CompareTo((object)p2.Point.Y));
		}

		public BezierPoint GetPointAt(double y)
		{
			int num = BinarySearch(delegate(BezierPoint p)
			{
				if (y < p.Point.Y)
				{
					return -1;
				}
				return (y > p.Point.Y) ? 1 : 0;
			});
			if (num < 0)
			{
				num = ~num;
			}
			if (num < 0)
			{
				num = 0;
			}
			if (num > SortedPoints.Count - 1)
			{
				num = SortedPoints.Count - 1;
			}
			double num2 = 100000001.0;
			double num3 = 100000000.0;
			double num4 = 100000002.0;
			num3 = Math.Abs(SortedPoints[num].Point.Y - y);
			if (num - 1 >= 0)
			{
				num2 = Math.Abs(SortedPoints[num - 1].Point.Y - y);
			}
			if (num + 1 < SortedPoints.Count)
			{
				num4 = Math.Abs(SortedPoints[num + 1].Point.Y - y);
			}
			if (num3 <= num2 && num3 <= num4)
			{
				return SortedPoints[num];
			}
			if (num2 <= num3 && num2 <= num4 && num - 1 > 0)
			{
				return SortedPoints[num - 1];
			}
			if (num4 <= num2 && num4 <= num3 && num + 1 < SortedPoints.Count)
			{
				return SortedPoints[num + 1];
			}
			return SortedPoints[num];
		}

		private int BinarySearch(BezierPointComparison comparisonFunction)
		{
			int num = 0;
			int num2 = SortedPoints.Count - 1;
			while (num <= num2)
			{
				int num3 = num + (num2 - num >> 1);
				int num4 = comparisonFunction(SortedPoints[num3]);
				if (num4 < 0)
				{
					num2 = num3 - 1;
					continue;
				}
				if (num4 > 0)
				{
					num = num3 + 1;
					continue;
				}
				return num3;
			}
			return ~num;
		}
	}
